tei:div.tei:p: ca tsā sto7snyekro 4 ṅkal+yashā+o+o nga tsho— shek+ṣ-imya rgyu 0 chu byesmi rde jiྈhādze+e༄ sku ji yak+ṣi rdzithā sgo༄spro mi pya khyuji rdzi tswa ྾lha tshokhyi t+yā tho 9rdzi rdzerajo — sdurnyo d+ku 0 spre 4dīr+sha spe rngo3༄snyeshaṃsnotsheṇa d+ngharme rtsosna sgo ngak+ṣe rmerngosnye — ram̐ sgro rmisha 1 khu dza2lo oṃ 44 pe

dkar chagadapal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rig pa rtsis la 'jug pa'i sgo sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnam grangs mdo bcas rab tu byed pa dri med 'od zer mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi me tog ces bya ba bzhugs/ / (1)sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ji ltar gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa rjes su dran pa bskyed pa legs bshad sa bon tsam smos pa nyung ngu don gsal rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so (37)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skar rtsis kyi 'phro nges par dag pa rtag pa'i longs spyod man ngag grub pa'i go 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (61)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag go la legs par bshad pa nyung gsal rnam dag kun bzang 'od snang rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (73)dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams rten dang brten par bcas pa'i tshul dpe'u ris legs par bkod pa'i kha byang nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (81)'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag legs bshad nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba skal ldan snying gi pad+mo 'dzum par byed pa bzhugs/ (97)bod du dus 'khor skar rtsis kyi lugs srol ji snyed byung ba kun gcig tu gsal bar byed pa kun mdzes nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (104)rig gnas rtsis kyi man ngag dri med 'od snang rab byed kun mdzes nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (108)chos rje rin po che tshwa nas zhus pa'i sman sgrub kyi dris lan/ (119)skar rtsis yan lag lnga'i lag len byed grub spyi nor klags tsam gyi rtogs pa bzhugs so/ / (132)rgyud dgongs lo 'pho dgun 'bring rgyal nya zla ba'i dang por bzhag pa'i tshul nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (135)1

rig 'dzin grub pa'i rtsis kyi rtsa don grub pa nor bu'i ljon shing phun tshogs snye ma rab tu rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ (137)tsi na gser gyi gtsug lag 'byung rtsis sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig shin tu gces pa bzhugs so (139)skar rtsis la nye bar 'kho ba grangs kyi rtsom byed rtsa ba drug pa'i mngon brjod gzhung chung ṭi ka dang bcas pa til gyi me snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (141)lnga bsdus ri mo bzhugs so/ / (148)rgyud kyi dgongs don ti thung sbyor sgrol zung 'jug bde lin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (152)rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa gsal ba nor bu'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (159)sra rtsi bya thabs rdul med me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (167)dbyangs can sgra mdo'i dbye ba'i gzhung gsal rin chen 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so (167)rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang yang kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor zab gsal snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (170)byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blang ba'i cho ga snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ / (180)bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rim pa lnga tshig nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (182)lam zab mo bla bsgrub skor gyi rdo rje sems dpa' phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi bsgrub pa mchog tu zab pa bzhugs so/ / (185)bka' yang gsang bla na med pa rdzogs chen kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal gyi khrid kyi 'chad 'thab 'od kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (188)bu ston kha ches mdzad pa'i chos 'byung rin po che'i mdzod las rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus nye bar btus pa bzhugs so/ / (196)'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs yongs gces zab bsdus snying po'i don khrid legs bshad nyung ngu rab gsal dngos grub 'dod 'byung rin chen za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (215)sgra yi gnas brgyad go bder mdor bstan bzhugs so/ / (235)2

'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad snying po rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yid bzhin mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (237)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po bzhugs so/ / (243)dpal rta mchog nag po'i dbang bshad yid ches dam pa'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(247)kun rig bdag skyed rgyun khyer snying po rab dkar phan bde rgyas pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (250)'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs gso sbyong dang 'brel ba bklag chog thar gling bgrod pa'i gru rdzing dam pa/ (256)spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ / (287)'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs gzhan phan thugs rje'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (288)bcom ldan 'das 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs snying po byang chub mchog gi gru 'dzin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (291)thugs rje chen po lo kai shā ra'i sgrub thabs/ (296)bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bsrung bzlog man ngag gi khyad par can tshig nyung don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (297)bka' 'dus snying po'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs/ (299)rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag 'jam dpal zhal lung gi 'pho ba nyung gsal ye shes dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (299)rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyi mdzad pa'i lam gang shar ma'i 'grel pa bzhugs so/ / (301)bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen yig snying po rab tu gsal ba grub pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (314)nar ma'i rnal 'byor tshul sa bon tsam du smos pa thar pa'i shing rta 'dir mchis so/ / (318)ye shes mgon po sde bdun gyi gtor 'bul snying por dril ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhugs so (323)ye shes mgon po legs ldan trak+ṣa kyi 'phrin las rgyun khyer snying po bzhugs so/ / (324)

dpal nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sku brnyan rang byung bod thang mgon por bstod cing 'phrin las gsol ba'i tshig phreng bzhed don lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyangs ces pa bzhugs so (325)rtsis mgon lha chen dpal 'bar gyi sgrub thabs 'dod don kun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so (328)lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi'i sgrub thabs/ (331)rdzogs chen bka' yi bsrung ma gza' bdud chen po'i mchod chog yid bzhin lhun grub bzhugs so (334)dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i mchod sprin dpag bsam ljon pa bzhugs so/ / (336)dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i bka' sdod ging chen srog gi spu gri'i mchod bstod 'phrin las lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba'i snyem glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (337)rdo rje phur ba'i bsrung ma'i mchod byang nyung dril 'phrin las kun grub bzhugs so/ / (345)ngo mtshar dpal gyi ri bo 'bri gnyan spen ne ri bkra'i gnas bdag dgra lha chen po'i mchod bstod mdor dril 'dod don lhun grub dpag bsam ljon pa bzhugs so/ / (346)dpal stag lung thang pa'i bstan srung jo mo sbrag btsan gyi gsol mchod 'dod don yid bzhin ljon pa bzhugs so/ / (349)brag dmar zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma chos skyongs pe har rgyal po yi gsol mchod 'dod don yongs 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (356)rigs mtshun lha bsrungs gnyan po rdo rje brag btsan gyi gsol mchod 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (365)mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi zhing skyong gter bdag mkha' 'gro rgya dkar ral gcig ma yi 'phrin las rab dga'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (368)'bras ljongs stag rtse'i gsol mchod/ (374)mnga' ris mar yul sku lha mched gsum gyi gsol mchod 'dod don kun grub lha yi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / rdzi (376)bzhes 'bod nyams pa'i srog gcod spu gri 'bar ba bzhugs/ (377)rgya nag hwa shang gi byung tshul grub mtha'i phyogs snga bcas sa bon tsam smos pa yid kyi dri ma dag 4

byed dge ba'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (379)gsang chen rdo rje theg mchog bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lo rgyus rab bsdus sa bon tsam du smos pa legs bshad bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (390)grub thob chen po brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'bri yig shin tu dag cing gsal ba legs bshad gser thur zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (404)bka' tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa nges don snying po'i mdo'i dkar chag bsam 'phel nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (412)bcom ldan 'das dpal che mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa byung tshul sa bon tsam smos pa ma ṇi ka yi do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (414)rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yi lha'i mtshan grangs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (417)smon tshig sna tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs so/ / (420)jo nang rtag brtan dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du dge rgyun sbyar ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so (447)shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal kong yul smad gnas chen rgya la yi 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi rten rang byung mchod rten gyi dkar chag shugs byung rdo rje'i glu mi 'gyur byin rlabs gzi 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (454)bka' 'gyur phan khang bcas kyi dkar chag mthong ba don ldan bzhugs so/ / (456)mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar po'i nye 'dabs kyi nam ling dgon sder sde pa lhas sbyin bsam grub kyi sbyor 'jags sogs gnang ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ / (464)stod mnga' ris mar yul la dwags he mi grwa tshang rjes 'brangs bcas kyi bca' yig (467)klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gis dkyil 'khor lha mtshan gsal bar phyes pa ke ta ka yi thig so lta bu bzhugs so/ / (475)bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma 'byung ba bla med kyi dkyil chog bdag 'jug gi rdzas tho bzhugs/ (477)dus 'khor byis 'jug gi dbang rdzas tho dang bde mchog nag po'i lugs kyi rdzas tho/ (478)klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi cha lag gi bsgrub pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med rdo rje rgya mdud kyi bdag mdun bskyod bzlas bdag 'jug bcas kyi cho ga khrigs chags su bkod pa bzhugs 5

so (482)dus 'khor brjed byang / (491)yig med snyan rgyud man ngag che'i sgrub pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don zab pa'i yang snying bzhugs so (491)yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur bklags chog tu bkod pa gu ru'i dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (493)bla ma dgongs 'dus rtsa gsum gcig dril sgrub thabs nor bu lugs rgyun khyer bdud rtsi'i thig pa zhes pa bya ba bzhugs so/ / (504)gu ru drag po me 'phreng can gyi nyams len rgyun khyer yang zab rdo rje pha lam/ (510)bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phur pa'i las byang rdo rje rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (517)gsang ba ye shes snying gi thig le'i gsol 'debs rdo rje'i thol glu bde chen sprin dpung bya ba/ (530)gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub gzhung rgyun khyer snying po bcud dril dngos grub gter 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (531)gsang ba ye shes bsnyen bsgrub kyi zur 'debs thun mtshams mjes rgyan pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (535)mkha' 'gro kun gyi yang snying gsang ba ye shes 'khor lo'i bshags bskangs dkyil 'khor kun khyab dgyes byed dri med klong yangs dngos grub mchog gi char 'bebs ces bya ba bzhugs so (536)rta phyag khyung gsum gyi 'dzab dgongs bzhugs/ (550)rta phyag smon lam bzhugs/ (552)thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying tig gi dbang mchog 'gro kun 'dren pa'i lcags kyu bklags pas don grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (553)dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer snying po don yongs su grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so (563)bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang sgrub rgyun khyer gyi man ngag bzhugs so/ / (565)bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub rgyun khyer snying po bzhugs so/ / (566)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro drwa ba sdom pa chen 6

po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mchog gi rdo rje rin po che 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(568)dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs nar ma'i rnal 'byor khyer bde bzhugs so/ / (619)'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsgrub dkyil mi shigs bde ba chen po'i thig le kun tu 'phro ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (620)bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi zhing skyong spyi dang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga chen po dngos grub bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / (633)yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu snyan brgyud zab mo las byung ba rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu gces pa shog dril gong khug ma yod: (649)o rgyan nas byung ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (651)dpal rta mgrin gyi gsang sgrub rgyun khyer yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ / (656)dpal rta mgrin nag po'i lam khyer snying po bzhugs so/ / (657)dpal rta mgrin nag po'i nyams len rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ / (658)gu ru pad+ma'i nā ga bdud 'dul dang ras chung pa'i gtum chung me 'bar ru grags pa chu bo gcig 'dril zab gces gsang ba'i nyams len snying gi dum bu bzhugs so/ / (660)dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i bsnyen bsgrub snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (661)dpal gsang bdag bsnyen pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'od 'bar bzhugs so/ / (663)rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs snying gi dum bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / (664)rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs khyer bde bzhugs/ (667)dus 'khor ye shes khyung khra rgyud lugs man ngag rgyun khyer ngag 'don snying po bzhugs so/ / (667)tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (668)nang gtor 'bul chog (670)dkon mchog spyi gtor yid bzhin dpal ster bzhugs so/ / (671)dam chos sprul sku snying thig rtsa gsum bsrung ma dang bcas pa'i gtor 'bul rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ / (674)yang gsang bla na med pa bstan bsrung nyams len rgyun khyer snying po yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (676)7

'phags mchog nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i rgyun khyer gyi rim pa bzhugs so/ / (681)bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rje me 'od kun tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (683)khrus gsol rig stobs nang 'dren khrus bzhugs so/ / (696)yang zab thugs kyi gter kha u pa de sha'i skor las: dpal yang gsang drang srong nag po'i 'phrin las gzhung bsrang zab khyad can rab 'jigs bskal me 'khrugs pa'i sgra dbyangs myur mgyogs drag po rdo rje'i char 'bebs dgra bgegs rdul brlags ces gsang ba'i phyag rgya can no: (700)la dwags rgyal po dang mu we rgyal po gnyis kyi chings 'dum la phebs skor/ / (717)

༄gi /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rig pa rtsis la 'jug pa'i sgo sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnam grangs mdo bcas rab tu byed pa dri med 'od zer mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi me tog ces bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swāste/ na maḥshrī sa man+ta bha dra kā la tsakra ya/ kun mkhyen kun la sman mdzad pa/ /bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas srid zhi'i mgon/ /dpal ldan bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /rnam kun dad pas 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /gzhon nu gang zhig rig pa'i gnas/ /grangs la ma rmongs rtsis kyi sgor/ /'jug par 'dod pa'i skyes bu la//shin tu gces pa spyi yi nor/ /dang po lag len ri mo'i gnad/ /man ngag ji snyed ma sbas pa/ /go bde lhug par brdal ba'i tshig /bklags pas shes pa 'dir spel bya/ /de la thog ma nges pa'i gnad/ /'di ltar ngag tshig brda' chad gang / /yi ge'i gzugs su shar ba 'di/ /sangs rgyas 'phrine las 'jug pa nyid/ /yun phyir rnam grangs 'byams klas pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nyid du shes/ /de las mi mjed 'dzam gling 'dir/ /yul gru sna tshogs skad rigs kyang / /shin tu mang por gnas pa bzhin/ /yi ge'i gzugs kyang ji snyed grubarka/ /de yang rgya gar bal bod kyi/ /yig 'bru phan tshun gral sbrel bas/ /yig 'phreng 'phred byas steng 'og 'byung ske/ /rgya nag hor sogs yi ge rnams/ /yig 'bru steng 'og sbrel ba yi/ /yig 'phreng 'greng thab mthur gshibs gnas/ /dmigs gsal las gzhan spyir btang du/ /yi ge'i gnas tshul de ltar mthong yig rigs de dag thams cad kyang / /'bri dang klog tshul mthun pa nyid/ /dbu phyogs thog ma g.yon nas 'byung —//tha ma g.yas kyi phyogs 'gro'o/ /de ltar yi ge'i spyi'i rnam bzhag /gleng gzhi'i tshul du sa bon tsam/ /grangs brda' ang ki 'bri klog gnas/ /gtan la phab phyir smra byas te/ /da ni nye bar brjod pa'i don/ /skar rtsis ri mo mkhan spyi la/ /grangs kyi brda' 'gyur ang ki zhes/ /rnam 'gyur dgu dang thig bcas bcu//yig gzugs re khā gang bde nyid/ /phal cher mthun par gyur pa 'di/ /rtsis la ji bzhin 'jug pa yi/ /gaṇ+ḍar ri mo bsgyid pa'i tshe/ /yi ge spyi las lugs bklogs par/ /mas nas dbu rtsam yas bsgrod bri/ /ci phyir gcig bcu brgya stong sogs/ /mtha' nas yar la bsgrang dgos pas/ /ang ki bri sbrang mas phyogs sam//g.yas nas bya zhes don de yin/ /'on kyang klogs tshe spyi 'dra bar/ /yas thogs nas klags de yi tshe//mang mtha' yas 'byung dper nyi khri/ /chig stong drug brgya brjod bzhin no/ /de yang g.yas g.yon phyogs 1

tha snyad/ /'di lta nyid du nges bya ste/ /rang mdun gdong pa dbus su bzhag /lag pa g.yon dang g.yas phyogs la/ /de de'i brda' ru btag pa dag /shes par gyis shig gzhon nu kyai/ /des na yas gong mgo bo zhes / /lag g.yon phyogs su nges pa bzung / /mas 'go mtha' gzhug ming gdags rnams/ /lag g.yas phyogs su rig par gyis/ /'on kyang res 'ga' gong 'go la/ /steng 'og brdar 'jug ma nor gces/ /grangs 'dzin ri mo mtha' dag gnad/ /gtso bo phri bsnan bsgyur bgod de/ /de ming tha snyad brda' du ma/ /'byung rnams ma 'dres nges par bya/ /de yang sbyangs phrog phri phral dbyid/ /dbrog dman dor dbyen bu lon spang / /don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ /steng sbyin bsre bsnan gzhug bsnon bcug /'dus dang der ldan nor gyur bsdud/ /ming gi grangs las don gcig go/ /longs spyad ma spyad zos ma zos/ /brjod pa dag kyang gong rjes 'gro/ /bsgyur la bsnun dang sgres zhes bya/ /gnyis yan bsgyur la spel bsil 'jug /'god la bcad spyad khyer zhes bya/ /bstub spyod dor yang brdar bzhag mthong / /blo gsal da lta'i rnam rtog gis/ /bzhag sa mtha' dag sus brjod nus/ /'on kyang grags ches ming gi grangs/ /ji snyed 'di ru mdor brjod pa/ /de dag ri mo'i lam 'jug tshe/ /blo yi gnas su gsal bar bya/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar shes bya ste/ /sbyangs dang ster ba mas nas bya/ /bgod dang bsgyur ba yas nas so/ /bsgyur bgod sbyang ster gang byed kyang / /steng 'og go rim grangs kyi gnas/ /ma nor rang sa phrod khro gces/ /de ltar spyi don bshad zin nas/ /da ni bye brag nges pa'i gnad/ /bsgyur bgod byed la gnas thog mar/ /thig le 'byung bar mi srid med/ /bgod lhag thog mar thig 'byung ba/ /de yi nor kyang thig ler 'gyur/ /bsgyur bgod thig le'i dbus mtha' ru/ /'byung ba de ni bzung bya yin/ /bsgyur byed tha mar thig byung ba/ /bsgyur gzhi'i gral rim de mthar bgod/ /bgod byed thig le mthar byung na/ /bgod bzhi'i gral mtha' 'og tu 'jog /thig les bsgyur bgod stong pa las/ /gzugs 'gyur gzhan dngos mi ston yang / /rang gi grangs gnas bsrung ba sogs/ /las ni shin tu che ba byed/ /bsgyur bgod gzhi de mang ngam nyung / /ma nges bsgyur byed bgod byed ni/ /mang nyung dbang gi 'di ltar grags/ /nyag ma gcig nas dgu yi bar/ /ang ki gcig yin bskyang bsgyur bgod/ /bcu yan aṅgi gnyis gsum sogs/ /mang pos byed la bsgrags bsgyur dang / /bsgrags dgos zhes su btags pa yin/ /bye brag bsgyur bar gnas gsum nges/ /thig stong gcig gis rang so zin/ /lhag ma gzhan gyis 'phel bar bya/ /zhib bshad grogs med thig kho nas/ /bsgyur tshe bsgyur bya dbyi bas stong / /gnas bsrung dgos na thig le ni/ /bsgyur bya thig ler bsgyur pa na/ /bsgyur byed nus pa zad pa ste/ /nor mtshan dgos na thig le bgod/ /gcig bsgyur mang nyung med rang so/ /gnyis pa yan gyis bsgyur mang 'phel 'gro/ /bcus bsgyur grang mthar thig le 'phar/ /bsgrags bsgyur rnams la bsgyur 2

bya yi/ /'og tu bsgyur byed tha ma bri/ /brgyas bsgyur grangs mthar thig gnyis byung / /de bzhin stong la thig le gsum/ /khrir bzhi 'bum la thig lnga ste/ /grangs med bar du de rigs 'grel/ /gzhan yang phyed bsgyur phyed cha dang / /de bzhin sum chas bsgyur ba dang / /bzhi chas bsgyur ba de de'i cha/ /rig pa de yi gzhan yang spel / /cha gyur de 'dra mi nor ched/ /phyed rtags ri mo 'phred la 'then/ /sum cha zur gsum bzhi grub bzhi / /bri zhes gnad 'dir mkhas pas gsungs/ /bgod dang sbyar ba'i gnad bstan na/ /bgod pa la ni thob nor 'byung / /sbyang la phal cher nor gyi dbyen/ /bgod pas bsil ba sdud byed cing / /sbyangs bas lhag ma'i nus pa ston/ /gzhan ni rigs pa mtshungs par gnas/ /bskyang bgod rang gi thob tshad khyer/ /bsgrag bgod 'og ma'i thob dang bstun/ /mang thal 'og mas mi thob chad/ /nyung thal 'og mas skyar theb lhag /de dag skyon yin spang bya ste/ /de phyir mang nyung tshad zin gnad/ /bgod tshod ma zin gong ma yi/ /khyer ches ma thob gong ma'i nor/ /gcig phab bgod byed sngar gzugs bsgyur/ /'og mas bgod pas rnam par dag /gong mas khyer nyung 'og ma ru/ /bgod pa'i lhag mar slar thob na/ /rang gi gnas der thob nor brtsegs/ /'di dag mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes yin/ /bgod byed mang nyung ji ltar yang / /bgod theng re la khyer thob nor/ /gcig las mi 'byung de 'jug nas/ /nges pa yod na mas nas yar/ /bgod bgrangs mthun pa'i gnas su 'jug /bgod yul mang na 'dzug yul nyung / /de tshe thob grangs ma nor gral/ /dbu nas mar la rim bsgrig nas/ /'dzug yul sleb tshe gong dang 'dra/ /'dzug yul med na nor rang nyid/ /gral 'phreng bsgregs sam gnas skabs su/ /'phral 'kho med na dor bas chog /gang zhig dbus mthar ma thob skabs/ /byung tshe nor bu thig le sbyin/ /de yang bgod byed nyung ba dang / /bgod bzhi mang ngam mnyam na thob/ /bgod byed mang la bgod bzhi nyung / /bsnan sogs bya ba gzhan med na/ /nam yang thob par mi 'gyur gyi/ /gnad 'di 'phri la'ang shes gyis kwa /gzhan yang spyir btang aṅgi yi/ /gral mtha' nas yar gcig bcu sogs/ /grangs gzhan lugs bsgrang ba'i tshul/ /gong du bshad pa ji bzhin la/ /bgod dang sbyangs la sogs pa'i dus/ /las byed aṅgi rang rang gi/ /steng thad gnad de gcig par nges/ /de yan bcu sogs rim par sbyar/ /sbyangs bgod rang gi steng thad nas/ /ma long gong nas bcu tshan phab/ /des kyang ma long de gong nas/ /brgya 'beb la sogs rim pas bya/ /bsre bsnan byed pa rang thad kyi/ /gcig bcu brgya yi gnas mal gang / /ma 'chug bya ste 'og ma'i grangs/ /long tshe gong nas gong 'pho 'gro/ /de yang zhib mor bshad pa na/ /bcu man rtsa ba'i grangs yin la/ /dgu man gcig gi gnas mal 'gyur/ /gcig nas bcu long gong du 'pho/ /gal te bcu yi lhag byung na/ /sngar gnas rang mal gcig par 'khod/ /dper na bcu dang gcig gi gnas/ /gnyis kar dgu re long ba la/ /gcig gi gnas su dgu bsnan pas//3

bcu long gong gi dgur byin pas/ /bcu nas gong 'phar brgya ru 'gro/ /bcu gnas stong ste thig le shar/ /nyag brgyad sngar shul gcig par gnas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshul 'di yi/ /brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sogs//kun la rig pas shes par bya/ /yang ni 'di ltar rig par bya/ /bgod bzhi bgod byed shod mnyam tshe/ /rang rang 'khor lo de rdzogs tshad/ /bgod bzhi mang po bgod pa na/ /bgod nor ci tsam byung ba de/ /'khor lo de 'khor grangs tshad yin/ /bgos pa'i lhag ma ma lus pa'am/ /bgod gzhi nyung nas ma thob na//'khor lo gang yin de tshung nas/ /bsgrang bya'i grangs nyid yin shes byos/ /tshul 'di bgod byed nges pa can—/ /yod pa kun la rig pa yin/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar shes par bya/ /bgod gzhi grangs tshad gang yin deske//gnyis kyi bgos pa'i thob nor ni/ /bgod bzhi grangs de'i phyed char 'gyur/ /des mtshon sum bzhi lnga sogs kyi/ /bgod nor de de'i char shes bya/ /bgod bzhir ya 'khyar lhag byung skabs/ /de yang nges par bsre dgos tshe/ /ya 'khyar de dang shed mtshungs pas/ /bgod gzhi bsgyur bas ya 'khyar bsre/ /bgod byed de yang cha mthun bsil/ /de yi bgod pas rnam par dag /spyir ni bgod pa'i gzhi de nyid/ /bgod byed nyid dam dag pa'i nor/ /de yi bgod gzhi de bsgyur nas/ /slar yang rang rang tshad dag pas/ /bgos pas ri mo dag pa ste/ /tshul 'di rnam 'gyur du ma bcas/ /khong du legs par chud pa'i tshe/ /ri mo lhad med rnam dag pa'i/ /cho ga rig pas gsar bskrun 'dod/ /kun kyang gegs med 'grub pa yin/ /gnas skabs phral gyi ri mo ni/ /gcig nas grangs med bar bsgyur gzhi/ /ci 'dod bsgyur byed yang de bzhin/ /rnam 'gyur bcas kun mi 'khrul bar/ /lhag med spyad thob snga gzugs 'char/ /de tshe ri mo sbyang ba ste/ /rtsis gzhung gang 'dod la 'jug pas/ /ngal med de bklags rtog go kyai/ da dung gzhan yang gces pa'i gnad / /'phral 'kho 'ga' zhig 'dir brtan na/ /dus dang yul dang rdzas sogs kun/ /phra dang sbom dang rags pa rnams/ /go rim bzhin du 'og nas steng / /rim pa bzhin du brtsegs par bya/ /don des steng nas rim phab pas/ /gong ma'i cha shas 'og mar 'gyur/ /de yang zhib mor bshad pa na/ /dper na steng nas zhag gcig phab/ /de 'og chu tshod drug cur 'gyur/ /chu tshod gcig phab srang drug cu/ /srang gcig phab pas dbugs drug grags/ /de phab de yi cha shas 'gyur/ /de dag slar yang rang rang gi/ /'khor los steng dril zhag tu 'pho/ /de ni steng nas dpag tshad cig /phab pa 'og tu rgyang grags brgyad/ /rgyang grags cig gi gzhu lnga brgya/ /gzhu 'dom gang la khru bzhi ste/ /khru ni sor mo nyi shu bzhi/ /sor gang nas bdun de nas tsam/ /shig dang sro ma nyi zer rdul/ /glang lug ri bong rdul dang ni/ /chu lcags rdul phran phra rabs kyi/ /rdul bar rim par bdun 'gyur dman/ /de rnams 'og nas rang tshod kyi/ /gong du rim par dril ba yi/ /dpag tshad gnas su 'gyur 'di ni/ /mngon pa mdzod kyi lugs shes bya/ /gzhan yang 'chi med seng ge yi// 4

mdzad pa'i mngon brjod mdzod las ni/ /sor mo nyer bzhi khru ste de/ /bzhi ni gzhu ste 'dom gang nyid/ /de brgyar na lwa zhes su bshad/ /chig stong gzhu ni rgyang grags te/ /rgyang grags gnyis ni ga bhu ti/ /de gnyis la ni dpag tshad do/ /'di ni kun mkhyen si tu yi/ /bsgyur ba'i mngon brjod 'gre ltar ste/ /'grel pa mngon 'gyur nyung ngu der/ /dpag tshad dus 'khor lugs mthun mthong / /dpal mchog dus kyi 'khor lo nas/ /gzhu 'dom nyis stong rgyang grags gcig /rgyang grags bzhi ni dpag tshad gnas/ /gsal ba nyid du gsung ba ste/ /de ltar gzhung gsum rgyang grags ni/ /tha dad mngon pa mngon brjod kyi/ /dpag tshad mthun de de dus 'khor/ /dpag tshad phyed yin shes par bya/ /gzhan gyi rdzas kyi dngos po la/ /srang bzho se ba ḍi o koraglu/ /de bzhin khal bra phul cha shas/ /'degs khal nyag spor cha shas rnams/ /steng nas 'beb dang 'og nas dril/ /gong ma'i tshul gyi shes par bya/ /mi chos grangs rtsis mtha' dag yang / /tshul 'di rtogs pas bde bklags so/ /mdor na shes bya kun rtsi yang / /bri bya yi ge aṅgi bcu/ /de spel bsgyur bgod 'phri bsnan gnad / /shes na grangs rtsis ma rmongs 'gyur/ /de tshul legs par go ba na/ /grangs kyi rnam 'gyur ri mo'i 'khrulaske/ /ji snyed blo la rang shar 'byung / /de snyed 'byams klas nyid shes byos/ /'dir brjod ri mo'i gnad de rnams/ /tshig don ma nor yid gzhung pos/ /rtsis la 'jug skabs dran pa yi/ /rtag tu bzung bya dam par nges/ /des na rtsis kyi sngon 'gror ming / /btags kyang rig gnas 'dir 'jug sgo/ /tshegs chung don che med thabs med/ /shin tu bces pa'i man ngag yin/ /'on kyang blo gsal brtson 'grus can/ /mkhas pa yun du bsten byas nas/ /rig pa blo la 'dzin pa la/ /yi ge 'di ltas ci zhig bya/ /des na de ltar mgu ba'i skyes/ /bdag gi brjod pa 'di mi sems/ /ma sbyangs shes pa'i rtsal ma rdzogs/ /brtson pa'i shugs drag mi ldan bzhin/ /rig pa 'di la zhugs 'dod pa'i/ /rang 'dra rtsis pa gsar bu la/ /rtog dpyod dbang gi yid 'khrugs pa'i/ /ngal ba spang zhing brjed bsos bslad/ /rtsis mkhan mkhas pa'i gsung gi rgyun7/ /yang yang sgrogs pa'i don ji bzhin/ /bklags pa tsam gyi shes pa'i gtam/ /gsal bar brjod la nyes yod min/ /de skad tshe ring lha lam las 'ong pa'i/ /rgyu skar dbang po ji bzhin ches dkar rgyur/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i tshig gi nor bu 'di/ /bkod pa'i dge bas kun mkhyen mchog thob shog /ces rig pa rtsis kyi 'jug sgo spyi don ri mo'i gnad shin tu gsal bar brtan pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /de nas grangs rtsis bstan pa la/ /rtsa ba'i grangs dang gnas gzhan tshogs/ /mngon brjod grangs kyi brda' chad bcas/ /'di ru bshad bya/ dang po ni/ dgu gcig gcig ni dgu rang yin/ /dgu gnyis gnyis dgu bco brgyad la/ /dgu gsum gsum dgu nyi shu bdun/ /dgu bzhi bzhi dgu sum cu drug /dgu lnga lnga dgu bzhi bcu lnga/ /dgu drug drug dgu lnga bcu bzhi/ /dgu bdun bdun dgu drug cu gsum/ /dgu 5

brgyad brgyad dgu bdun bcu gnyis/ /dgu dgu brgyad cu gya gcig go/ /brgyad gcig gcig brgyad brgyad rang yin/ /brgyad gnyis gnyis brgyad bcu drug la/ /brgyad gsum gsum brgyad nyi shu bzhi/ /brgyad bzhi bzhi brgyad sum cu gnyis/ /brgyad lnga lnga brgyad bzhi bcu tham/ /brgyad drug drug brgyad bzhi bcu brgyad/ /brgyad bdun bdun brgyad lnga bcu drug /brgyad brgyad drug cu re bzhi'o/ /bdun gcig gcig ni bdun rang yin/ /bdun gnyis gnyis bdun bcu bzhi la/ /bdun gsum gsum bdun nyi shu gcig /bdun bzhi bzhi bdun nyi shu brgyad/ /bdun lnga lnga bdun sum cu lnga/ /bdun drug drug bdun bzhi bcu gnyis/ /bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ /drug gcig gcig ni drug rang yin/ /drug gnyis gnyis drug bcu gnyis la/ /drug gsum gsum drug bco brgyad do/ /drug bzhi bzhi drug nyi shu bzhi/ /drug lnga lngadrug sum cu tham/ /drug drug sum cu so drug go/ /lnga gcig gcig lnga lnga rang yin/ /lnga gnyis gnyis lnga bcu tham pa/ /lnga gsum gsum lnga bco lnga la/ /lnga bzhi bzhi lnga nyi shu tham/ /lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /bzhi gcig gcig bzhi bzhi rang yin/ /bzhi gnyis gnyis bzhi brgyad rakhya yin la/ /bzhi gsum gsum bzhi bcu gnyis so/ /bzhi bzhi dag ni bcu drug go/ /gsum gcig gcig gsum gsum rang yin/ /gsum gnyis gnyis gsum drug yin la/ /gsum gsum dag la dgu zer ro/ /gnyis gcig gcig gnyis gnyis rang yin / /gnyis gnyis dag la bzhi zhes grags/ /gcig gcig de ni gcig nyid do/ /rdzogs dang thob par thig le'o/ /de ltar dgu mthar grags pa 'di/ /ngag byang yid la chub pa bces/ /gzhan ni ri mo rnam dag gamaske/ /'grub par dka' zhes rang nyid kyang / /ma sbyangs gzhan la gdams rings ba/ /ne tsho'i spun zla dag gi'ang smra/ /gnyis pa grangs kyi gnas gzhan ni/ /sangs rgyas pa kun mthun gyur cing / /rtsis mkhan rnams la grags che ba/ /sde snod mngon pa nas gsungs grangs/ /gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams/ /rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya/ /chen po'i zla dang bcas pa ni/ /ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram gtam/ /dkrigs dang mi 'khrugs khyad phyin dang / /spang brten ded 'dren mtha' snang dang / /sgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs phyin rtogs 'gro 'byin sdul dang / /rgya stag stobs 'khor brda' shes dang / /rnam 'byung stobs mig nyi shu gcig /bar du brgyad ni ma snyed pas/ /rang gi ming gang rung ba zhug /grangs med bar du bcu 'gyur bsgres/ /tshigs bcad de ni mkhas pas lung / /sil bu las ni grangs bzhin ste/ /de la bsnan 'os brgyad kyi ming / /tshad med bzhi 'am bsdu ba bzhi/ /nyal nyol la sogs gang rung bzhi/ /chen por bcas pas kha 'gengs zhes/ /mkhas mchog mkhyen gter can des gsungasaske/ /'dir ni byams pa snying rje dang / /dga' ba btang snyoms che bsnan brgyad/ /dam pas bzhed bzhin rang lugs bzhag /gzhan yang mdo dang rgyud sde nas/ /grangs gzhan rnam grangs mi 'dra ba/ /ji 6

snyed gsungs las cung zad gcig /shes bya'i ched du 'dir brjod na/ /theg chen rgya che rol pa'i mdor/ /bdag cag ston pa gzhon nu yi/ /rol rtsed skabs su rtsis mkhan che/ /srid sgrub zhes par bka' stsal grangasaske//bye ba ther 'bum khrag khrig dang / /gtam dang dkrigs dang mi 'khrugs pa/ /khyad 'byin phang steng mda' 'dzin dang / /glang po'u stobs dang ngog thob dang / /rnam par bzhag gdags rgyu rig pa/ /lag sbyin rgyud dbang rdzogs thob dang / /bsgrangs rtogs sgrib pa dang ni stobs/ /kun stobs rnam par brda' shes ldan/ /brda' kun shes dang rnam par 'byung / /de yi mtshan nyid ces bya ste/ /de ltar grangs gnas nyi shu bzhi/ /bye ba brgya ni ther 'bum ste/ /de bzhin brgya yi gong du bsgres/ /de yi mtshan nyid ces bya'i rtsis/ /'di ni ri yi rgyal po gang / /rtsis bzhir byas kyang chod par byed/ /de yi mtshan nyid gong du ni/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo nor bu'i grangs/ /des ni gaṅga klung dag ni/ /byed snyed rtsis gzhir byas kyang bcod/ /de yi gong na'ang rim pa bzhin/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo nges sgrogs dang / /ded 'dren gdags pa gtan la 'bebs—/ /gcod rtogs gcod rtogs ldan pa rnams/ /thams cad rnam par 'byed zhes te/ /des ni gaṅga klung bcu yi/ /bye ma rtsis bzhir byas kyang chod/ /de gong snying po mchog shes grangs/ /des ni gaṅga klung bye bske/ /phrag brgya'i bye ma'ang rtsis gzhir bcod/ /de yi gong na rdul phra rag /'jug pa'i rjes su song ba zhesatso/ /grangs de sa bcu rgyun mtha' ba'i/ /spyod yul kho nar gsungs pa dang / /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i nor bu nas / /phra rag la 'jug rjes song bar/ /gnas brgyad bsgros tshad ma gsungs pas/ /gong gi brgya 'gyur rig pa yi/ /bzung yul min par kho bos rtogs/ /gzhan dka'i grangs kyi brdar shes so/ /gzhan yang theg chen sngags kyi rgyud/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i cho ga ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shāka thub kyi/ /'jam dpal la gsung grangs rtsis ni/ /'di ltar gcig bcu brgya stong khri/ /'bum phrag bye ba sa ya dang / /dung phur rnams ni bskyang pa ste/ /de nas ther 'bum che chung gnyis/ /shu rngog mchog nyal re re'o/ /yang ni rkyang phyed khyad 'byin dang / /sgyu ma mtsho yas rnams dang ni/ /dug chen rgya mtsho'i bar du ni/ /kun kyang chen po'i zla bcas yinaske/ /mchog byas ban bun re re'o/ /de nas ma lus che chung gnyis/ /de yi 'og tu grangs med te/ /de ltar grangs med bcu dpag med/ /dpag med stong ni 'jig rten zhes/ /'jig rten bcu ni 'jig rten che/ /de 'og mun pa skyang pa'i grangs/ /snang ba phung po che bcas gnyis/ /phung po che bcu zab par brjod/ /de nas rim bzhin bsten pa dang / /rab brtan grangs mang ldan re re/ /yang ni gnas dang gnas chen po/ /dpag dang dpag med chen po dang / /don chen rab 'byor rgya mtsho che/ /phan pa mchog dang gtso bo khyim/ /de mthar bsam mi khyab tu brjod/ /de nas yang ni mi zad gzugs/ /rgyal thabs 'dod dang dge ba rnamasaske/ /zla dang bral ba re re'o/ /de las sems las 'byung che chung / /sems rnams dbyings dang brjod 7

pa dang / /brjod med rnams ni re re'o/ /bsnyad yas dang ni phyar phyur/ /shu rngog rnams ni che bcas nyid/ /de nas dge zhing zhi ba zhes/ /rtsis kyi phar phyin gnas su gsungs/ /de nas yang ni chu 'byung dang / /sems skyod dpag dang dam pa dang / /sangs rgyu yul dang 'phel byed pa/ /de yi mthar ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang dang ni spyod yul lo/ /de yang sangs rgyas zhing gaṅga'i/ /bye snyed kun bsdus rdul phra rag /ma lus bsil ba grangs rtsis dper/ /'dul mkhas rgyal ba mchog des gsungs/ /don du nam mkha'i mtha' ci tsam / /ches phra'i rdul phran char bsil grangs/ /sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen gzhan gyi min/ /der bsam dad pas 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud 'dir gcig nas 'phel byed par/ /grangs gnas bdun bcu rtsa gcig las/ /zab pa yan chad 'jig rten chung / /ma rtogs gzhan kun bcu 'gyur gsungs/ /de lhag grangs gzhan gnas gyur pa'i/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi'i bsgres byed tshad/ /gzhung las gsal bar ma gsungs pas/ /'dir yang rtags par mi nus so/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud 'dir/ /'jig rten lugs kyi grangs rtsis bzhesaglu/ /sngon dus 'phags yul spyir grags sam/ /yang na rig byed gzhung nyid dam/ /de yi rigs sngags dag gi rgyud/ /phal pa dag tu brtan gyur grangs/ /gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur dang / /ther 'bum shugs rngog mchog nyal dang / /skye 'phyis bye ma nab nub dang / /mtsho yas ltabs phyo rdzi zhe gnas/ /bco brgyad gong du bsdu 'gyur bsgre/ /de ltar 'dir ni rnam grangs tshul/ /theg chen mdo dang sngags rgyud nas/ /bshad pa'i grangs rtsis rigs gsum dang / /mngon pa dang bcas bzhi yin la/ /gzhan ni rgyas pa'i mdo phal chen/ /byang chub sems gnas le'u ru/ /'phags pa sems kyi rgyal po la/ /bdag cag ston pas bka' stsal grangs/ /brgya stong phrag brgya ni bye ba/ /de bzhin rim par bsgrangs ba yi//shin tu brtan pa zhes bya'i bar/ /grangs gnas brgya dang sum cu dang / /de bzhin rgyas pa'i mdo chen de'i—/ /sdong po bkod pa'i le'u ru/ /byang sems tshong dpon nor bzang la/ /lha mo dge bsnyen yid bzhin gyiske/ /bshad pa byang chub sems dpa'i rtsis/ /gcig nas brjod med brjod med pa/ /bsgres par grangs nas brgya phrag lhag /bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yod pa dang / /de bzhin byang sems khye'u gzung / /dbang po'i dbang phyug gi gsungs pa/ /brgya nas shin tu brtan pa'i bar/ /grangs gnas brgya dang so gcig dang / /khyim bdag 'phags pa nan khug gi/ /brgya nas brjod med yang brjod med/ /bar gyi grangs gnas sum bcu sogs/ /phal chen sdong bkod nas gsung zhing / /de ltar bka' las grangs rnams bzhag /mang nyung ji snyed snang gyur dang / /bstan bcos 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /rnam par nges las grangs drug cu/ /gsung dang 'chi med seng ge yi/ /mngon brjod mdzod las rig byed pa'i/ /lugs bsgyur gcig nas grangs med bar/ /grangs gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig tu/ /bshad pa sogs ni shes 'dod na/ /rang rang gzhung 8

der blta bar byos/ /nyer 'kho gong brtan gyis rtogs mthus/ /'dir gzhan zhib par ma smos so/ /grangs 'dir sa ya bye ba zhes/ /spyir btang kun la de yin yang / /bod sngags snying pa'i gzhung 'ga' ru/ /bye ba sa ya zhes par 'dod/ /de ni 'phags yul brda' gcig la/ /bod skad 'gyur khyad byung bar sems de tshul spyi lta yin snyam na/ /zhib mor bshad kyi 'phags yul du/ /'bum phrag skad dod lak+ṣa'i mthar/ /'bum phrag bcu ming ni yu dha/ /'bum phrag brgya la ko ṭī zhes/ /rim par gnas la 'gyur snga mas/ /ni yu dha ni bye bar mdzad/ /phyi mas sa ya zhes su bsgyur/ /de bzhin ko ṭī 'gyur snga mas/ /sa ya phyi mas bye bar bsgyur/ /'gyur khyad de lta yin par grub/ /de yang bod snying grangs gnas kyi/ /rgya dpe mthong na dpyad bya ste/ /'on kyang 'dir brjod nyid nges snyam/ /spyir ni sa ya bye ba la/ /skad dod mang ngo shes par gyis/ /de yang grangs rtsis mang 'di kun/ /'dod rgyal nyid du brtags pas na/ /rgyu mtshan bshad par mi nus zhes/ /mkhas pas gsung bzhin legs par rtogs/ /da ni gsum pa grangs kyi ming / /mngon par brjod pa'i brda' bstan pa/ /rang bzhin ngo bo tshul dang gzugs/ /zla ba ri bong can rnams gcig /phyogs bsgrod mig lag zung khrig gnyis/ /dus me bsreg za 'arnag rten dang / /yon tan rtse mo can rnams gsum/ /chu gter rig byed dus mtsho bzhi/ /mda' dang dbang po 'byung ba lnga/ /dus dang 'od zer ro ni drug /thub pa gza' ri sa 'dzin bdun/ /nor lha klu dang lto 'gro dang / /lag 'gro gdengs can rnams ni brgyad/ /gza' bug srin po dgu ru grags/ /phyogs ni bcu nges skabs 'ga' ru/ /bug pa gza' yang bcur 'jug mthong / /drag po 'phrog byed bde byed dang / /dbang phyug la sogs bcu gcig ming / /nyi ma nyin byed khyim bcu gnyisaske/ /myos byed 'dod pa bcu gsum mo/ /srid pa ma nu yid bcu bzhi/ /tshes dang nyin zhag bco lnga'o/ /mi bdag rgyal po bcu drug 'jug /nyes pa skyon ni bco brgyad do/ /rgyal dbang rgyal ba nyer bzhi yin/ /nyer lnga la ni de nyid brjod/ /skar ma 'khor lo nyer bdun no/ /so ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dran/ /ming de rnams ni bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /rtsa 'bral las gsung mdo tsam ste/ /gzhan ni 'phags yul las byung ba/ /rig byed mngon brjod gzhung rnams las/ /grags pa gang yin der rtogs bya/ /cha shas gzhan du brjod kyang 'dod/ /phyis 'byung bod blo gsar bzhag brda'/ /mang mthong 'dir ni btang snyoms so/ /de snyad tshe ldan yid kyi dbang gsal zhing / /rig pa 'dir 'jug 'dod pa gzhu lo/ /grangs rtsis nor bu'i 'phreng ba bsgrangs bzhin 'di/ /spel mthus kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gnas thob shog /ces rig pa rtsis kyi 'jug sgo grangs rtsis kyi gnas gsal bar bstan pa'i skabs de gnyis pa'o/ /de nas bye brag skar rtsis kyi/ /rtsi bya yang ni rtsi ba'i gzhi/ /lo zla dus zer khyim skyes zhing / /dbugs srang dbyug zhag gza' dang tshes/ /skar sbyor byed 'phrod stobs dus sbyor/ /rten 'brel de rnams 9

'phros bcas dang / /phyi nang sbyor ba'i tshul cung zad/ /mtshon pa tsam yang bshad pa ste/ /de la dang po lo'i tha skad/ /nyi mas bcu gnyis khyim bsgrod cing / /zla ba yar mar ngo nyer bzhi/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhi po/ /tshang la kun tu lo ru grags/ /legs sbyar skad du wabat+par+ṣa zhes/ /nges tshig yongs bgrangs dang bgrangs gzhi/ /'gro 'ong dang ni 'dor byed zhes/ /'chi med mdzod las legs par bshad/ /de ltar lo la bye brag ming / /'phags yul phyi rol byed kun la/ /nyi ma ltar grags rab byung sogs/ /bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ /bde mchog 'grel par brtan pa ni/ /rab byung rnam byung dkar po dang / /rab myos skyes bdag aṅgi ra/ /dpal zhal dngos po lang tsho ldan/ /'dzin byed dbang phyug 'bru mang po/ /bag ldan rnam gnon khyu mchog dang / /sna tshogs nyi ma nyi sgrol byed/ /sa skyong mi zad thams cad 'dul/ /kun 'dzin dpa' bdag rnam 'gyur dang / /bong bu dga' ba rnam rgyal ba/ /rgyal ba myos byed gdong ngan pa/ /gse 'phyang gnam 'phyang bsgyur byed dang / /kun ldan 'phar ba dge byed pa/ /mdzes byed khro mo sna tshogs dbyig /zil mnon spre'u phur bu dang / /zhi ba thun mong 'gal byed dang / /yongs 'dzin bag bral kun dga' dang / /srin po a na la dmar ser/ /dus kyi pho nya don grub grag /blo dka' rnga sgra dmar 'gro dang ske/ /'dod dbang khro bo zad pa'o/ /de ltar drug cu lo yi ming / /'di la lo tsā snga phyi yis/ /'gyur khyad rab byung rnam byung la/ /rab skyes 'byor pa zhes su 'don/ /de sogs 'dra min mchis las 'dir/ /cung zad mdzes pa'i cha bsdus byas/ /de ltar 'phags yul lo yi ming klu/ /ma hā tsi ni'i gtsug lag las/ /pho mo zung sdeb lo bcu gnyis/ /byi glang stag yos 'brug sbrul dang / /rta lug sprel bya khyi phag rnams/ /lngas bsgyur lo rgan drug cu'o/ /rgya nag rig byed 'byung lnga'i brda'/ /keg ji kung gshang 'u zhes pa/ /shing me sa lcags chu khams te/ /'di ni 'phags yul dbyangs yig bzhin/ /rgya yul tshig gi sdeb sbyor bzhi/ /mtha' dag 'di la brten par snang / /lo yi dang po shing byi la/ /drug cu'i tha ma chu phag 'dod/ /'dir ni rab byung me yos sbyaraglu/ /zad pa me stag mtha' yin zhes/ /bod 'dir sngon gyi mkhas pa 'gas/ /gsung ltar kun gyi 'phyam brdal sgrogs/ /da lta'i dus su 'phags yul lho/ /'bigs byed khongs su de mthun 'dod/ /'bigs byed byang phyogs rgya bal kun/ /rab byung me sbrul nas brtsam sbyor/ /'dod tshul de lta phyin chad du/ /shes kun yi ge 'di mthus so/ /gzhan yang bde mkhas kha cig gi/ /rab byung shing byir sbyor ba'ang yod/ /de ltar rgya nag 'byung lnga shing / /lugs gzhan rlung dang gnad gcig cing / /lcags ni rdo ste sa yi khams/ /lhag ma rnams ni mthun pa nyid / /de nas gnyis pa zla ba yi/ /nges pa yar dmar ngo dkar nag /cha shas bco lnga gnyis rdzogs par/ /bzhag te legs sbyar skar ma sā/ /de ming bye brag rgya nag tu/ /'byung po'i ming dang dus kyi brda'/ /chen po hor gyi zla grangs dang / /bod kyi bstan bcos chen po'i lugs/ /rgya gar spyir 10

grags rig byed las/ /zla ba'i nya skar nyi ma'i khyim/ /khyad 'phags rgyal bas rgyud rnams su/ /rten 'brel nyid dang ming bye brag /de ltar rnam grangs brgyad po nyid/ /go rim bzhin du bshad bya ste/ /de yang lo mgo zla ba'i dbu/ /'dzin tshul mi gcig mang na yang / /gza' rnams rtag pa'i longs spyod ni/ /thog ma lug khyim nas rtsam pas/ /des na skar rtsis zla ba'i dbu/ /nag pa nas rtsam de bzhin 'chad/ /rgya nag sbrul zla dbyar ra ba/ /hor zla gsum pa dpyid zla 'bring / /'phags yul nag zla lug gi khyim/ /rgyud nas ming gzugs khyu mchog zla/ /rgya nag rta zla dbyar 'bring po/ /hor zla bzhi pa dpyid tha chung / /'phags yul sa ga glang gi khyim/ /rgyud nas skye mched rus sbal zla/ /de bzhin lug zla dbyar tha chung / /hor zla lnga pa dbyar ra ba / /snron gyi zla ba 'khrigs pa'i khyim/ /rten 'brel reg dang chu srin zla/ /dbang chen spre'u zla ston ra ba/ /hor zla drug pa dbyar 'bring po/ /chu stod zla ba sbal pa'i khyim/ /tshor ba dang ni yugs sa'o/ /bya zla ston zla 'bring po dang / /hor zla bdun pa dbyar tha chung / /gro zhun zla ba seng ge'i khyim/ /sred dang rme ba'i zla ba'o//khyi ste ston zla tha chung nyid/ /hor zla brgyad pa ston ra ba/ /khrums zla bu mo'i khyim zhes bya/ /leb pa'i zla ba 'bug pa'o/ /phag gi zla ba dgun ra ba/ /hor zla dgu pa ston 'bring po/ /dbyu dgu'i nya ba srang gi khyim/ /srid dang 'phyo ba'i zla ba'o/ /byi ba dgun zla 'bring po ni/ /hor zla bcu pa ston tha chung / /smin drug zla ba sdig pa'i khyim/ /skye ba dang ni mi lam mo/ /glang zla dgun tha zla 'khor mtha'/ /hor zla bcu gcig dgun ra ste—/ /de ni mgo zla gzhu yi khyim/ /rga shi sa yi dbang phyug go/ /zla ba'i rgyal po stag dpyid ra/ /hor zla bcu gnyis dgun 'bring po/ /zla dang rgyal 'dzom chu srin khyim/ /rten 'brel ma rig zla 'phel ba/ /yos kyi zla ba dpyid 'bring po/ /hor zla dang po dgun tha chung / /mchu yi zla ba bum pa'i khyim/ /'du byed zla ba gti mug goglu/ /'brug gi zla ba dpyid tha chung klu /hor zla gnyis pa dpyid ra ba/ /sbo yi zla ba nya yi khyim/ /rnam shes dang ni bzang po'o/ /de ltar zla ming sde tshan du/ /sdeb nas go bder mdor spel byas/ /rgya nag skad du zla ba'i ming / /yol zhes bod kyi sngon rnams smra/ /rgya nag li thur yād zhes pa/ /yod zhes shin tu mkhas pas te/ /des gsung rgya nag li thu ltar/ /hor zla gcig nas bcu gnyis bar/ /cin yād o yād gsan yād dang ske/ /gsi yād 'u yād li'u yād/ /tshe yād pā yād ci'u yād/ /shi yād hor zla bcu pa yin/ /shi yi yād ni bcu gcig pa/ /shi o yād ni bcu gnyis so/ /de bzhin sems can ming gis brdas/ /bzhag pa stag la yin zhes bya/ /yos la mo 'brug la shan+ta/ /gsi sbrul 'u rta lug la za'i/ /zha sprel ye'u bya zu'i khyi/ /ha'i phag mgo byi bar tsi/ /cha'o glang ste kun gyi mthar/ /yād sbyar de de'i zla bar shes/ /gzhan yang rdo rje gdan bzhi dang ske/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsung pa'i/ /zla ming khyu mchog la sogs pa/ /legs sbyar skad du smos pa na/ /ri khya ba dang kurma dang / /ma ka ra ha rāṇ+ḍa dang / /ka yi ra dang bhi bṛ ka /byā ku li dang swa sna dang / /kā ma ṇa 11

dang ro hi ta/ /mo hi ta dang bha dra'o/ /gsum pa dus ni spyir skal pa/ /chags nas 'jig stong chen po bzhi/ /gzhan ni rdzogs ldan gsum ldan dang / /gnyis ldan rtsod ldan dus bzhi ste/ /de la tshe dpal 'byor pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dus bzhi dang / /rigs ldan rgyal po'i dus bzhir dbye/ /dus tshod lo zla'i phung po bcas/ /gza' dgu lhag gcig nges skyes nas/ /lhan cig khyim rdzogs mthar spyod pa/ /stong 'jug zhes gdags der dus bzhi/ /dus phyis mkhas 'ga' rtog pas bzhag /'phros don dus rtsis mdzod sogs nas/ /se gol gcig la drug cu bzhi/ /phyes cha dus mtha'i skad cig la/ /de brgya nyi shu de'i skad cig/de 'dra drug cur thang gcig de/ /sum bcu'i yud tsam de sum cu'i/ /nyin zhag gang de sum cu'i zla/ /bcu gnyis zla bas lo gcig 'gyur/ /de bzhin stag sna'i mdo las ni/ /bal mkhan mkhas pas ral bal gyi/ /lwa ba ring thung snyoms pa zhig /'dren pa'i yun ni skad cig thung / /de brgya nyi shu skad cing ring / /de drug thang gcig de sum cu/ /yud tsam pa ste de sum cu/ /nyin zhag gcig tu yang dag bshad / /yang ni mig 'dzum gnyis thang gcig /de bzhi mchog dka' de bcu drug /dus tshod gcig ste re re bzhin/ /yud tsam gcig ste de lhag mtshungs/ /'di la nyin mo'i yud tsam cha/ /bco lnga grib tshad la rten cing / /mtshan mo thun gyi cha la brten/ /ming yang so sor gsung ba mthong / /gzhan yang 'chi med mdzod dang ni/ /tshig gi gter las 'di skad ces/ /mig 'dzum bco brgyad mthar gnas de/ /sum cu cha shas de sum cu/ /skad cig yin ste de bcu gnyis/ /yud tsam zhes grags de sum cu/ /nyin zhag gcig de bco lnga/ /phyogs ste phyogs gnyis zla ba gcig /de gnyis dus tshigs de gsum la/ /bsgrod gcig de gnyis lo ru bshad/ /dus kyi mtshan nyid cha shas gang / /rnam grangs tha snyad de ltar brtan/ /'di ru bshad bya lo gcig gi/ /dus kyi nges pa bstan pa de/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'jig rten khams/ /le'u nyid las brtan pa dang / /gzhan yang bka' dang bstos cher/ /dus drug dus lnga dus bzhi dang / /gsum dang gnyis su bzhag pa gang / /dang po gso byed yan lag brgyad/ /'dul lung myang 'das mdo nas bsten—/ /nag zla sa ga dpyid gnyis yin/ /snron dang chu tshod sa ga gnyis/ /gro zhun khrums ni dbyar zla gnyisaske/ /dbyu gu smin drug ston zla gnyis/ /mgo zla rgyal zla rgun stod de/ /mchu zla sbo zla rgun smad do/ /'on kyang 'dul las mar ngo sngon/ /'gro bas sbo zla'i bcu drug nas/ /nag pa zla ste dpyid zin cing / /tshul des lhag rnams mtshungs rim sbyor/ /gnyis pa 'dul las dus tshigs lnga/ /'di ni mar ngo sngon 'gro bas/ /tshes dbu bcu drug de phyi ma'i/ /bco lnga zla ba'i rdzogs mtshams bzhag /yar ngo sngon 'gro'i sngon zla phyed/ /nur gyur zla ba'i ming de bzhin/ /des shes spyir btang smin drug zla'i/ /bcu drug nas rtsam sbo zla yi/ /bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba bzhi/ /dgun gyi zla ba bzhi ru bzhag /sbo zla'i de nas chu stod de'i/ /bar gyi zla bzhi dpyid du 12

grags—/ /de nas gro zhun bco lnga'i bar/ /zla gcig dbyar gyi dus su nges/ /de mthar tshes sa bcu drug pa/ /nyin zhag gcig ste dbyar thung ngu/ /de'i sang nyin bcu bdun nas/ /smin drug zla ba'i bco lnga'i bar/ /zhag gcig ma tshang zla ba gsum/ /ring po dbyar zhes gsung pa yin/ /gsum pa sman dpyad gzhung dang ni//'dul btus mdo rtsa so thar mdo/ /nyi snying gser 'od dam pa dang / /myang 'das rgya nag 'gyur rnams las—/ /dgun dpyid dbyar ston dus bzhi la/ /zla ba gsum gsum nyid du brtan/ /bzhi pa 'dul ba'i me tog 'phreng / /mngon pa rtsa 'grel las dpyid dbyar/ /dgun ste dus tshigs gsum du mdzad/ /sos ston dpyid dang dbyar khong bsdus/ /sangs rgyas pa rnams dus dang po/ /dgun nas rtsam ste yin zhes gsungs / /de rnams dus bzhi las gzhan pa/ /nag zla nas brtsam dpyid byed mthun/ /dus bzhi lo mgo tha dad pas/ /dpyid rar mgo rgyal mchu rim sbyor/ /rgya nag yul du da lta'i bar/ /dpyid ra mchu zlar bzhag par snang / /'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku/ /bod rje me dbon skabs su ni/ /lo gsar dpyid ra rgyal zlar mdzad/ /rgyal nag gtsug lag gzhung mthun min/ /dgongs pa yang ni der nges zhes/ /dam pa che gyur mang pos gsungs/ /gang ltar dpal mchog dus 'khor lo/ /gdan bzhi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs/ /mthun par rten 'brel zla ba yi/ /thog ma rgyal yin the tshom med/ /'jig rten mig gyur sngon chen pos/ /sbo zlar dpyid rar brda' chad mdzad/ /spyir ni dpyid ra sogs 'phags yul/ /skad du dkon mdo nya skar ming ske//'byung ba lo tsās bod yul gyi/ /brda' mthun bsgyur ba mang rtogs so/ /lnga pa dus gnyis nyi ma yi/ /lho byang bsgrod pa las gdags ste/ /rgya gar shar phyogs sogs yul 'gar/ /bgrod te lo ru 'dod kyang snang —/ /de tshe mgo zla lo gsar nyid/ /'chi med seng ge'i mdzod las kyang / /ri dwags mgo dang lhan cig pa—/ /zla ba lo yi dang po yin/ /bshad de rig byed smra ba'i lugs/ /lo yi thog ma mgo zla ru/ /'dod mod stag zla dang dpyid rar/ /nam yang 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /de ltar lo gcig bye brag gi /dus kyi rnam dbye mdor bstan byas/ /bzhi pa dus de rnams kyi gzer/ /mthar thug mnyam nyid mdor bshad pa/ /go la'i 'gros dang sa tshig dbang / /gcig tu nges pa ma yin kyang/ /bod yul dbus 'gyur nyi ldog dang / /mthun par mkhas rnams myong rtsis mdzad/ /de yang mi 'dra du mar mthong / /skabs 'dir sngon rab mkhas gsung ngag /rim brgyud ma nyams lag myong rtsis/ /bdag gi rigs gnas slob dpon che/ /kye re'i mkhas mchog 'jig rten mig /bzhed pa nyi bar cha can gang / /skar 'byung dbyug tshes shar ba na/ /'khrig khyim sum gcig nyin ring mtha'/ /skar skyon dbyu gur dbang mtsho shar/ /gzhu khyim skar mdun mthar mtshan ring / /yang ni skar drug dbyug zhes lnga/ /byang mtha' la bsnam ston mnyam dang / /der bsnan lho mtha' der bsnan dpyid/ /mnyam dang der bsnan nyin ring 'char/ /spyir ni bshol med dbyar zlog nas/ /khyim 13

zhag dgu bcu rdzogs ston mnyam/ /de nas rim bzhin dgu bcu'i mtshams/ /dgun ldog dpyid mnyam slar dbyar ldog /'on kyang nyi ldog nur dang rtag /'dod sogs mkhas gong man ngag bzhin/ /zhib mo lag rdzis ri mos te/ /'dir ni char tshad mtshon tsam mo/ /nyi mas lho byang bsgrod bzhin du/ /zla rang de ldog mthar thug pa/ /mnyam dus nyi ma'i shul nyid du/ /zla rang yang ni mngon par 'jug /de ltar mthong ba yang shes bya/ /zhib par 'god pa'i cha la sogs/ /kho bos dpyad gzhi byas bzhin du/ /yi ge dang ni ngag las so/ /mnyam pa'i dus su 'char ba'i gza'/ /bstan pa dang ni ri ṣi ste/ /de nyid char nub zhag dbus su / /mnyam pa'i dus nyid 'byung ba yin/ /dpyid mnyam la ni bstan pa ste/ /de ni go la'i byang mthar mngon / /ston mnyam ni ri ṣi gang / /go la'i lho mthar 'char nub byed/ /ri ṣi 'char skabs zhag bdun cu//nad sel brgyad ldan 'gyur bar grags/ kha cig the bdun brtan par 'dod/ /de ni mun sprul nyid du nges / /brtan pa skar ma 'bring po'i tshad/ kha dog ser shas che ba ru/ /yod zhes 'phags chen rgyal ba'i sras—//kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung las so/ /lnga pa skar gnas gza' spyod yul/ /khyim gyi rim pa gang zhes na//rgyu skar re la rkang pa bzhi/ /skang re chu tshod bco lnga ru/ /khyim re rkang pa dgu yi tshad/ /rim pa de yi bsgrod pa ste/ /lug khyim tha skar bra nye dang / /smin drug rkang pa dang por spyod/ /glang khyim smin drug rkang gsum dang glu/ /rnar ma mgo yi rkang gnyis yin/ /'khrig khyim mgo phyed lag rdzogs pa/ /nab so'i rkang pa gsum yin no/ /karkaṭa ni nab so'i mtha'/ /rgyal dang kag ni tshang ba'o/ /seng ge la ni chu bra rdzogs/ /sbo yi rkang pa gcig yin no/ /bu mo sbo yi lhag gsum dang / /me bzhi nag po'i phye yan spyod/ /srang khyim me bzhi'i lhag gnyis dang / /sa ri sa ga'i rkang pa gsum/ /sdig par sa ga'i rkang pa mtha'/ /lha mtshams dang gi snron rdzogs pa/ /gzhu khyim snub dang chu tshod tshang / /chu smad rkang pa dang por ldan/ /chu srin chu smad rkang gsum dang / /gro zhun mon dre phyed yan no/ /bum par mon dre'i phye man dang / /mon gru khrum stong rkang gsum yin/ /nya la khrums stod rkang lhag gcig /khrums smad nam gru yongs su rdzogs/ /de ltar khyim gyi chu tshod kun/ /sdom pas stong dang brgya phrag drug /nyi shu tham par gyur pa ste/ /yul gyi longs spyod zhes su grags/ /lug sogs bcu gnyis khyim gyi ming / /legs sbyar skad brjod lug mi ṣā/ /bṛ ṣā bhaḥglang me thu na/ /'khrig ste karkaṭa sbal pa/ /sidha seṅge ka r+sā zhes/ /bu mo ru la srang yin no/ /bṛṣ+ṭaka sdig dhā nu gzhu/ /chu srin ma ga ra bum pa/ /kum+bha nya la nī na'o/ /khyim la rā si zhes su brjod/ /de nas drug pa khyim tshogs der/ /gza' rnams legs skyes skar dus tshad/ /bsod nams stobs dang ldan pa'i gza'/ /sgra gcan gdong pa srang gi khyim/ /'char ba'i thog ma nyid du skyes/ /mjug me nya yi mtha' ru'o/ /nyi ma karkaṭa nab so'i/ /rkang pa bzhi pa'i thog mar skyes/ /kha cig skye skar me bzhi zer/ /gong nyid rgyud dgongs 'khrul pa med/ /des ni khag gi zla ba 14

yang ne/ /srang khyim tha skar mtshan mnyam dus/ /skyes nas de phral cha bri bas/ /'dul sogs mar ngo sngon 'gro dang ske//smin drug zla ba lo mgo ru/ /bzhag pa don des yin skad kyang / /dus 'khor gzhung 'grel las lug khyim / /tha skar rkang dbu tshes gcig la/ /zla skyes yar ngo sngon 'gro dang / /zla mgo yin gsung de nyid bzung ske/ /de bzhin seng khyim mchu yi dbus/ /mig mar skyes shing sdig pa'i khyim/ /lhag mtshams rkang pa gnyis rdzogs mtshams/ /lhag pa skyes shing bu mo'i khyim/ /sbo rkang rdzogs mtshams phur bu skyes/ /'khrig khyim lag rdzogs pa sangs skyes/ /gzhu khyim thog mar spen pa skyes/ /gzhu rdzogs tha mar gdeng can skyes/ /de bzhin bum par ri byi dang / /glang du brtan pa skyes par gsung / /de ltar gza' skyes khyim ye le/ /skar tshad khams le'i don bzhin du/ /bdun pa khyim gyi zhing bdag ni/ /lug sdig dmar po glang srang dkar/ /'khrig pa bu mo sngon po'o/ /sbal pa zla ba seng nyi ma/ /gzhu dang nya la phur bu nyid/ /chu srin bum pa nag po'orka/ /khyim bzhin taskal 'char ba yi/ /bdag po yang ni de kho na/ /rang khyim khams mi thun pa'i gza'/ /zhugs tshe de dang rtsod par gsungs/ /de yang dmar po sngo sangs rtsod/ /de bzhin phur bu dkar po dang / /nag po dang ni ke ru'o/ /nyi ma'i zhing du ke ru dang / /zla ba'i zhing du nag po zhugs/ /de gnyis phan tshun rtsod par grags/ /brgyad pa de ltar lo zla zhag /kun gyi rtsa ba srog ces dbugs/ /de yang dge dang dge min gyi/ /las kyi nus pas tshe yi tshad/ /ji bzhin dbugs kyang thung ngu ring / /bar ma nyid du rnam par bzhag /de yang mi yi skyes bu gang / /dar bab nad med rang bzhin dbugs/ /dbyung gnas rngub pa gcig byas pa/ /de nyid rtsi gzhi rtsa bar bzung / /de ltar mi yi dbugs gcig la/ /nyis khri chig stong drug brgya ru//phyes pa'i cha gcig lus skyes zhes/ /shig sogs phra mo'i dbugs gcig gyur/ /des mtshan mi yi dbugs gcig ni/ /phra rnams zhag gcig nyid du grub/ /mi yi sum cu'i dbugs ni ṅgha/ /yi dwags kyi ni dbugs gcig yin/ /dkar nag phyogs gnyis mi'i zla gcig /yi dwags tshun gyi zhag gcig go/ /mi yi chu tshod gcig gi dbugs/ /lha yi dbugs ni gcig tu 'gyur/ /tshul des mi yi lo gcig ni/ /lha de rnams kyi zhag gcig gyur/ /'dir gsungs mtshun dang lha yi zhag /'di ni phyi rol pa'i grub mtha'/ /rig byed lam pas bzhag pa dang / /mtshungs pa nyid du kho bos mthong / /mi yi nyin zhag gcig gi dbugs/ /lha ma yin gyi dbugs gcig gsung / /des na rag rtsis mi yi lo/ /bcu gnyis lha min zhag gcig go/ /nus pa'i dbugs ni mi yi lo/ /gcig dang mtshungs pa nyid du ldan/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i lo/ /gtso bo yi ni dbugs gcig bzhed/ /skabs 'dir nus dang gtso bo zhes/ /gzugs khams mchog dang gzugs med mchog /skyes bu'i ming ni rnam 'gyur du/ /yin par 'jig rten mgon des bshad/ /'on kyang srid pa sum cu gcig /gsung pa'i skabs kyi tshe tshad dang / /dbugs kyi skabs 'dir gsung pa gang / /dngos su 15

mthun par ma gyur pas/ /'dir ni rig byed smra drang ched/ /de mthun rnam grangs can gsungs par/ /bdag gi rnam rtog nyid du shar/ /rgyas dpyad gzhan du smra bar bya/ /de ltar 'phros don bcas bshad nas//'di ru bzung bya'i snying po ni/ /'dzam gling mi yi skye dgu'i dbugs/ /dus rtsis kun gyi rtsa ba nyid/ /de yang nyin zhag 'phrugs gcig la/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu/ /chu srang chu tshod tha dag pa/ /'di las rnam par 'byung shes byos/ /da ni dgu pa chu srang dang / /chu tshod mtshan nyid bshad bya ste/ /bdag cag ston pa rdo rje can / /gang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /dgongs pa bla med sngags kyi rgyud/ /bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje las//chu tshod sum cu so gnyis dang / /dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhir gsung / /bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba las /thun brgyad pho ba bcu drug dang / /chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ /dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhir dran/ /rgyud chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /mig 'dzum drug ni cha shas gcig /rim pas drug gyur skad cig la/ /thang gcig dang ni chud zang 'gyur/ /chud zang sum cu yig lci dus/ /de bcu stong gcig de nyer drug /chu srang gcig gi tshad du bzhed/ /chu srang drug cu chu tshod do/ /chu tshod brgya ni thun gcig yin/ /thun brgyad nyin zhag gcig tu 'gyur/ /chu tshod de yi gzhal tshad kyang / /rgyud de nyid las 'di skad gsungs/ /zangs ma srang ni bcu gnyis las/ /snod ni dpang du sor brgyad dang / /rgyar ni sor mo bcu gnyis las/ /legs pa nyid du brdung bar 'gyur/ /gser ni 'os rgya dkar gyi rtsa 'bras ma ru mgo nag gi ming se sum cu la/ /sor drug pa yi tshad dag tu/ /thur ma legs par brdung nas su/ /thur ma de yi bu ga ni/ /zangs ma'i gnad la dbug par byaglu/ /chu ni snyog ma med pa las/ /srang ni drug cu'i tshad du bya/ /srang 'di'i chu tshod tshad yin no/ /zhes gsung rgya gar rgyal po rnams/ /tshul de lta bu'i dus brtag cing / /chu srang snod la ri mo bgo /chu snod khengs mdzad chu tshod bzhag /de mtshams dbyu gu'i brda' yi bsnun/ /thun chen rnga bo ches mtshams 'dzin//des na chu tshod dbyu gu zhes/ /ming yang don des btags par zad/ /ma hā tsi nar nyin mtshan yun/ /za ma dgu bcu rtsa drug bshad/ /za ma re la chu srang ni/ /phyed bcas sum cu so brgyad yin/ /dbugs su bsil na za ma rer/ /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lngar 'gyur/ /nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus su ni/ /so sor za ma zhe brgyad 'char—/ /gzhan yang stag sna'i mdo la sogs/ /bka' dang bstan bcos 'ga' zhig tu/ /chu tshod rnam grangs lag len cha/ /'dra min tsam las don gcig grub/ /'dir ni kun la grags che gsal/ /dpal mchog dus 'khor rgyud chen dang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma dbyug gam/ /gdan bzhi'i rgyud nas brtan pa dang / /'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan gang / /mig gsum 'chang ba'i stobs po che/ /rgyud kyi ming can dbyangs 'char mas/ /bshad bcas mtshungs par ldan pa nyid/ /rang gzhan snyoms pa'i dbugs gcig nas—/ /drug rdzogs rang 'khor nas bud srang / /chu srang lnga la dbugs sum cu/ /dbugs brgya brgyad chu 16

srang sum cu/ /chu srang drug cu rang 'khor tshad/ /rdzogs 'phral chu tshod nyid du 'pho/ /spyir ni sum brgya drug cu'i dbugs/ /chu tshod gcig gi yun tshad ste/ /chu tshod 'khor lo tshad drug cu/ /de la sum stong drug brgya srang ske/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dbugs/ /nyin zhag gcig mtshungs ring thung med/ /'di la dus kyi chu tshod zhes/ /dus rnams kun gyi gzhi ru dran/ /lhag ma yul tshes dbyu gu yang / /'di la bstos nas btags par shes/ /'di ru 'phros su lnga bsdus skabs/ /dbugs gcig ldang tshad la bzhag pa'i/ /cha shas rjes su grags pa gang / /dbugs cha bgo tshul mdor bstan na/ /dper na 'dod cha lta bur mtshon/ /se gol myur rtogs bcu gsum yun/ /dbugs gcig rgyu ba'i tshad dang mnyam/ /des na cha gcig se gol gcig /gang zhig ri ro lta bu yang / /sbal mkhan ma yi rab drangs 'phang / /'khor lo rtag 'khor drug cu bdun/ /skyes bu'i dbugs yun gcig dang sbyar/ /de bzhin ri mkha' ri cha yang / /'phang rtsal ldan pas mtshams pa'i mda'aske/ /bskyur ba'i goms pa bdun brgya bdun/ /bgrod yun dbugs kyi ldan tshad gcig /gom re dbugs kyi cha dang sbyar/ /tshul des gzhan yang shes par bya/ /'di la da dung spror mod kyang / /nyer kho mtshon byed de tsam mo/ /mkhas par gyur pa 'ga' zhig gi /rtag pa'i longs spyod gnas bzhir mdzad/ /de tshe chu srang gcig gi cha/ /ri mkha' ri dang ri dus dbye/ /gnas lngas sgrub dang gnas bzhi gang / /srang yan gtad nas khyad mi 'byung / /gnas bzhir skabs re cha lhag kyang / /lhag ma'i gzugs nyid mtshungs par 'char//gzhan yang gnas gsum gnas drug sogs/ /chu tshod yan chad skyon med nyid/ /phal che gcig tu 'grub 'gyur te/ /de tshul zhib mo shes kyang bya/ /de nas bcu pa zhag mtshan nyid/ /khyim zhag nyin zhag tshes zhag ste/ /rgyas pa zhag gsum rnam dbye'i skabs/ /zhib mor bstan mod 'dir mdo tsam/ /de yang lo gcig rnam par bzhag /de la zhag gsum dbye ba yin/ /khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu la/ /nyin zhag sum brgya re lnga dang —//tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig yod/ /rim pas zhag tshad ring 'bring thung / /khyim zhag nyi ma bar pa yi—//chu tshod drug cu srang nga gnyis/ /dbugs bzhi cha shas brgya re brgyad/ /zhag re spyod de de sum cu/ /khyim rer gnas pas khyim zhag zhes/ /bstos che las legs par bzhag /nyin zhag 'jig rten yongs grags bzhinaske/ /'pho mtshams nam langs nas nam langs/ /de srid chu tshod drug cu ste/ /lhag chad med par rtag tu spyod/ /de ltar khyim zhag nyin zhag ni/ /nyi ma sgyu skar 'khor lo gcig /yongs su spyod de rkang pa yi/ /'gros bzhi rdzogs pa'i tshad kyi ste/ /'gros bzhi 'khor phyed ma dor ba'i/ /snga rkang shar la phyi rkang lho/ /'khor phyed dor gyur snga rkang nub/ /phyi rkang byang du rnam par bzhag /tshes zhag zla ba'i dkar nag cha/ /bco lnga 'phel dang sgrib pa yi/ /yun tshad re la dbyug nga dgu/ /srang gsum dbyugs bzhi cha bcu drug /rnam kun bar mtshams med spyod kyang / /res 'ga' rkang pa 'phel 'grib dbang / /nyin zhag lhag chad 17

btags pa ba/ /ston yang tshes zhag lhag chad med/ /zla bas tshes zhag nyer bdun la/ /rgyu skar 'khor lo spyod yun gang / /nyin zhag nyer bdun ma lang tsam/ /de la rkang pa'i gros bzhi rdzogs/ /'gros bzhi ril por tshes bsres te/ /bcu bzhi bgos pas thob pa'i nor/ /mnyam tshe snga rkang bdun spyod shar/ /phyi rkang bdun gyi lho ru brtag /thob nor mi mnyam snga rkang nub/ /phyi rkang byang du brjod pa yin/ /zla nyi'i 'gros la gza' lnga bzhin/ /dngos su phyir ldog sogs med kyang / /bshol 'char phyir ldog rjes mthun du/ /mkhas mchog bus gsungs legs bshad rtogs/ /spyir ni dus rtsis kun rtsa ba/ /nyi ma yin te grib ma'i gzugs/ /ring thung mthar thug dang mnyam gnyis/ /sa tshigs gcig tu 'char nub yul/ /tha dad mngon sum gyur pas na/ /'dod dang dbang dus yun nges bzungs/ /rkang pa'i mtshan nyid shing grib kyi/ /nges pa ma snyed rtsis mkhan zhes/ /ming la gzugs brnyan tsam du bas/ /tshul 'di nan tan rtogs bya'o/ /skabs 'dir khyim nyi tshes kyi zhag /ring thung bar khyad zhag pa gang / /de yang zla ba ma lang bar/ /nyin zhag gtso bor bzung ba yin/ /zla ba lang nas tshes zhag gtso/ /nyin zhag sum cur ma lang yang / /zla ba nya nas nya yi bar//tshes zhag sum cu'i zla ba rdzogs/ /de phyir 'dul mngon rjes 'brang rnams/ /rags rtsis lo rer zhag drug 'dor—/ /zhib par zhag lnga de re rer/ /rjes 'brang dbyug gu zhe brgyad dang / /chung chung nyer gnyis zhag mi thub / /dor te shel zla'i rgyu 'di yin//lor lang nyin zhag tshes zhag las/ /khyim zhag kho na gtso bor 'gyur//ci phyir khyim zhag ma thim bar/ /lo yang rdzogs par nus pa yin/ /lo gcig sum brgya drug cu'i zhag /'jig rten pa dang brtan bcos las/ /grags che'i zhag kyang don des bstan/ /skar rtsis ri mo'i gnad mtha' dag /zhag gsum rnam dbye las 'byung bas/ /ji bzhin shes bya dam pa yin/ /'phros 'byung gza' rnams kyi ni zhag /dpal mchog rgyud nas gsungs pa gang / /zla ba yi ni zhag bco lnga/ /lhag sangs nyi gsum zla ba drug /mig dmar zla dgu phur bu'i lo/ /drug dang spen pa'i lo bco lnga/ /sgra gcan dgu ste lo zla zhag /de rnams sdom pas mi yi lo/ /so dang phyed bcas zla ba gsum/ /gza' rnams kyi ni nyin zhag phyedaske//zhag de gsum bsgyur phyed bcas pa'i/ /zla bcu lhag pa'i lo go drug /de la bu lon lo gsum dang / /phyogs gsum bsnan pas mi lo brgya/ /phyed gnyis zhag ste lo nyis brgya/ /zhag gsum nyis stong zla ba gcig /bcu gnyis zla lo des lo brgya/ /mi lo bzhi 'bum sa ya gnyis/ /gnas gnyis 'og ma bcus bgos nor/ /steng gi phung por sbyangs ba'i lhag /lo grangs 'bum phrag nyer gcig dang / /drug khri'i dus kyi phyed du gsungasasko/ /de ni gtso dbugs stong brgyad brgya/ /dbugs rer chig stong nyis brgya lo/ /'pho chen gcig la lngas bgos nor/ /de snyed mi lo rtsod ldan dus/ /nor de gnyis gsum bzhis bsgyur ba/ /gnyis ldan gsum ldan rdzogs ldan tshad/ /lo rdzogs de rnams kyis ni mthar/ /gza' rnams stong pa la zhugs shing / /slar 18

yang nges pa skye ba zhes/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa de yi gsungs/ /de yang gza' rnams kyis ni zhag /rang rang dkyil 'khor tshad yin te/ /de'i phyed la zhag phyed zhes/ /rags pas 'dul rnams drangs phyir dgongasaske/ /zhib mo yang ni rgyud nyid las/ /nyi mas khyim zhag zla bas tshes/ /sgra gcan gyi ni tshes zla dang / /gza' lnga yi ni nyin zhag gi/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag gsungs pa nyid/ /zhag zla lo yi grangs dril bas/ /ma nor ji bzhin bde bklag tu/ /rtogs par 'gyur bas des shes bya/ /de nas bcu gcig res kyi gza'/ /bdun dang lhag bcas ming rnam grangs/ /nyi ma sdu ra dang ra biḥ 'od gzugs nyin byed 'od stong 'dzinaske//'od kyi sgra gcan mes sbyin skyes/ /dbyig gi khu ba rta bdun pa/ /zla ba tsan+d+ra dang po mo/ /tshes bdag rgyur skar bdag cha gter/ /rgyu skar mu khyud gsum 'ga' dang / /shar gyi thig le ku muta gnyen/ /mig dmar la ni maṅga la/ /lus dmar sa skyes sa lha'i bu/ /rtsib ldan 'od zer dgu pa dang / /'khyog pa dang ni bkra shis so/ /lhag pa bu sna zhes su grags/ /zla ba'i bu dang thod ldan skyes/ /lus gcig gser ldan tshim byed skyes/ /rgyal ba'i bu dang rab dga' 'o/ /phur bu bṛ hasma ti ste/ /'phar ldan lha yi slob dpon/ /rtsub ldan shin tu gsal ba'i cung / /shes ldan tshig bdag 'tsho byed do/ /pa sangs bru kri ya zhes bya/ /lha min bla ma ngan spong bu/ /sbyin byed khu ba snyan ngag mkhan/ /bcu drug 'od ldan tshig brgya'i dbang / /spen pa sha rnabyu ra ste/ /'od zer bdun pa nyi ma'i bu/ /dal rgyu tshangs skyes mi zad mig /gshin rje'i ba dan zhi 'gro'o/ /gzhan yang nyi nas spen pa'i bar//rta dmar rta dkar can dmar po/ /sngon po sna tshogs gtsug phud skyes//dkar po nag po zhes kyang grags/ /sgra gcan la ni rā hū la/ /mgo bzlum seng ge mo yi bu/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal nye 'phar 'gro/ /mun can spyang nyi sprin las rgyal/ /'jug ma la ni a na la/ /me dang dus me zhes bya'o//ke tuḥl ni mjug phod dang //du ba mjug ring sbrul can dang / /gtsug phud can dang skra gnyis pa//steng 'gro gdengs ka can zhes so/ /brtan pa la ni brtan gnas dang / /sgru ba dang ni rkang steng bu/ /yot+ta na sa di zhes bya/ /du ba mjug ring / de bas rnam grangs gzhan ma mthong / /ri byi ri ṣi a gasna/ /bum pa skyes dang mdza' bo'i bu/ /rlung thob zos dang sar ldan bcom/ /rgya mtsho hub gcig bdud rtsis sbyin/ /ri bo 'phen dang lho mthar rgyu/ /chu lha'i sras po bden tshig grub/ /ke ta ka yi khyim bdag dang / /chos can bdag po zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang gza' rnams skyes skar las/ /me bzhi skyes sogs yang shes bya/ /de ltar gza' rnams so so'i ming / /dus nyi zla brtan ri ṣi las/ /gzhan yang ming gi rnam grangs brgyad/ /lhag bcas skabs 'dir mdor brtan byas/ /res gza' bdun po i 'i brdar/ /gcig nas drug bar nyi bar nas/ /pa sangs bar yin bdun pa thig /spen pa'i ri mor yongs su grags/ /res gza' zhes pa'i ming don ni/ /tshes sam nyin zhag la re mos//lhag chad bar mtshams med pa ru/ /dbang byed pas na res gzar grags// 19

res gza' bdun po kha cig gi /sangs rgyas rab bdun sprul bar smra/ /spyir ni bod 'dir gza' pho'i mtshamasaske/ /bzhed tshul mi 'dra ma byung bas/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa sngon rnams kyi/ /res gza' nyin zhag spyod pa'i lugs/ /gza' gnas ri mo'i de 'das pa/ /phyi ma rnams kyi da ltar mdzad/ /'on kyang phul byung legs bshad can/ /gang yin de yi rjes 'brang nas/ /de nas spyi don bcu gnyis pa/ /tshes kyi nges pa bshad bya ste/ /de yang mdor bstan grangs ming dbyangs/ /khams dang 'dod yon na tshod do/ /grangs ni dkar dmar phyogs gnyis la/ /yon tan dbang gi lnga gsum nges/ /ming ni dga' bzang rgyal stong thos/ /phyogs re lnga gsum bco lnga 'khor/ /dbyangs ni a i ṛ u bla/ /phyogs rer dga' dang mtshungs par ldan//khams ni mkha' rlung me chu sa/ /dbyangs kyi rjes su 'gro ba nyid/ /'dod yon sgra reg ro gzugs dri/ /gcig nas nya bar lan gsum 'gyur/ /na tshod gang 'char dbyangs kyi sba/ /lhag rim gzhon dar rgan nub 'gyur/ /zhib par dkar phyogs bco lnga la/ /dbyangs yig mthar gnas ha bcas dang / nag phyogs bco lngar gong de nyid/ /ring por byas nas 'char ba dang / /gzhan yang karka ṭa nas rtsam/ /mtshan mo 'phel ba zla drug la/ /de bzhin ka sde tsa ṭa pa/ /ta sde pa spa ṣa sha bla/ gsal byed mtha' nas lugs ldog par—/ /dbyangs thung drug po lugs 'byung nyid/ /a i ṛ u lo e rnams/ /gsal byed yi ge rer rim zhugasaske/ /chu srin nas tsam nyin ring ba/ /drug la pā t+pā ḍā shābla/ de nas rim par skyo spa ṭā/ /rtso krā sde mtshan lugs 'byung nyid/ /'thug por dbyangs ring lugs ldog drug /aḥlī u rī yī ā sbyor/ /'di la'ang na tshod byis sba sogs/ /gong du bshad bzhin rim par sbyor/ /tshul 'di bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel las/ /gsal gsung 'di ru mdo tsam bstan/ /des kyang ci rigs mtshon nus mod/ /zhib par gzhan du rtogs par bya/ /'phral 'kho tshes zhag longs spyod ni/ /res gza' bdun gyi aṅgi'i 'og /gnas pa'i chu tshod srang sogs laske/ /tshes long zhes su ngos 'dzin no/ /'phros byung tshes kyi lhag chad zhes/ /brjod par rkang pa 'phel 'grib skabs/ /rtsa ba tshes zhag gcig longs spyod/ /chu tshod nga dgu chu srang gsum/ /dbugs bzhi cha shas bcu drug ste/ /de la rkang pa 'phel ba yi/ /dper na tshes gcig lhag brjod skabs/ /'phel rkang dbyug lnga rtsa lang la/ /bsnan pas dbyu gu re bzhir 'gyur/ /drug bcu'i nyin zhag chu tshod rdzogs/ /dbyug bzhi lus la lhag zhes brjod/ /des na tshes gcig snga ma dngos/ /phyi ma chu tshod bzhi rdzogs mtshams/ /tshes gnyis sleb kyang gcig zhag shes/ /tshes grangs chad tshe rkang 'grib pa/ /dpen na tshes gnyis chad pa'i tshe/ /tshes gcig chu tshod gnyis lta bur/ /rtsa lang dbyug gu lngas bri ba'i/ /nga bzhi bsnan yang nyin zhag tshad/ /dbyu gu drug cu ma ldang bas/ /tshes gsum longs spyod nas dbyug bzhi/ /bsnan pas tshes gnyis chad zhes grags/ /don du tshes kyi ngo bo ni/ /lhag dang chad pa med zhes bya/ /de nas bcu gsum rgyu skar gyi/ /rnam grangs 'di 20

ru bshad bya na/ /de yang yongs su grags pa yi/ /rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad du nges/ /de ming bod 'dir sngon dus su/ /rgya nag nas 'gyur brdar bzhag par/ /smin drug snar ma mgo dang lag /nabs so rgyal kag shar skar bdun/ /mchu bra sbo dang me bzhi dang / /nag pa sa ga sa ri lho/ /lha mtshams snron snub chu stod smad//byi zhun gro zhun nub skar yin/ /mon bra mon gru khrums stod smad/ /nam gru tha skar bra nye byang / /kha gcig gro zhun byi zhun zhes/ /'don mdo 'di ni snang brgyad nas/ /gsung bzhin pa ste mdo de ni/ /rgyal ba'i smon lam mthu'i byung shes/ /de yang dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /phyi dang nang gi gnas gnyis kar/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad yang yang gsung / /'on kyang lag rtsis skabs kun tu/ /byi zhun gro zhun khongs su bsdus/ /rgyu skar 'khor lo nyer bdun nges/ /'khor lo'i thog ma tha skar dang / /tha ma nam grur yongs su bzhag /de rnams skar rtsis aṅgi'i brda'/ /gcig ni dbyug gu'i ri mo ste/ /de bzhin go rim ma 'khrul bar/ /bsgrang bas nyer bdun nam gru thig /gnas lugs ri mo de ltar yang / /da lta lag rtsis lag len du/ /gcig ni bra nye gnyis smin drug /rim bgrangs thig ni dbyug gu yin/ /ji phyir sngon dus yan lag lnga'i/ /res gza' skar ma 'das mar bzhed/ /gza' la gza' bdun rtson 'dzin sogs/ /mi shes pa'am ma byas pas/ /dpang po med pas 'dod ma 'cham/ /phyi dus res gza' da ltar gyur/ /skar ma mig shes dbang po'i yul/ /ma 'khrul re 'grogs zla skar la/ /sgom ma nus pas da lta'i bar/ /'das pa nyid du gnas pas na/ /gcig pa tha skar thig le la/ /ngos 'dzin byed pa gnad des yin/ /rgyu skar de rnams ming 'phags yul/ /legs sbyar skad kyi brjod pa na/ /thog ma dbyu gu āsh+yi na/ /de nas rim bzhin bha ra ṇa/ /kārki ka dang ro hi tī/ /mārga shir+ṣa dang a tra/ /suzir dang saud+dha dang / i sh+yi ṇa dang mā gha dang / /pūrba phal gu ni zhes dang / /urta ra phalgu ni dang / /praphil dgu ni dang rtsatra/ /swā tiḥdang ni be+e sha ṣa/ /u nu ra dhā dang rdzuṇa/ /mu la sur+pā ṣa dha dang / ut+ta rā ṣa nye zhes dang / /a bhi dzi ta byi zhun ste/ /bhā wa ṇa zhes gro zhun no/ /gzhang rom bzhin dha niṣ+ṭhaske/ /shā ta sgyi ṣa zhes bya dang / /purba bhā dra pā da dang / /ut+ta ra bhā dra sā da/ /he wa ti zhes nam gru'o/ /de ltar sgyu skar nyer bdun ming / /bod kyi yul gru tha dad kyi/ /'dra min brda' ru bzhag pa gang / /dgos pa spang phyir 'dir brjod na/ /tha skar la ni dbyu gu dang / /bra nye sgyid bu snar bi'u rdzi/ /mgo la smal po lag pa'ang zer/ /nam so rgyal stod rgyal rgyal smad/ /skag wa mchu brar sta che chung / /rta pa rta'u zhes kyang ngos/ /sbo khra me bzhir bya ma dang / /nag par bya bu byi'u'o/ /sa gnyis gnam thong gong dang 'go/ /lha mtshams lag sor snron ldeg gu/ /snub la sogs pa gru sogs dang / /g.yang sogs yang ste chu gnyis la/ /bra bra dang ni bra phul yang / /byi zhun bya ze'am bya chu/ /gro zhun bya sbo mon dre la/ /bya gzhug mon drer sgrog zhes bya/ /khrums gnyis shes pa yas mas zur / /phyi rtse lug gu smi yang skad/ /nam grur shes pa de rnams ni/ /gtsang 21

dang mnga' ris yul skad yin/ /bod chen mdo khams byang 'brog pas/ /'dra min tha snyad bra nye la/ /spun gsum mchu ba sbo phu ron/ /me bzhi nag par khra bya rog /sa gnyis sgo nga sgong skog dang / /lha mtshams dar dang snron gdub bu/ /snam gru chu smad la skyal sa/ /zhun gnyis mon gnyis la gsal zhing / /bon spur sgrog grags kha cig tu/ /mon gnyis sgrogs stod sgrog smad dang / /khrums gnyis se stod se smad grags/ /nam gru'i ming la srab mda' 'dod/ /de dag yul skad tha snyad de/ /'phags yul mkhas pas byas pa'i ming /mngon par brjod pa'i gzhung rnams su/ /legs par ltas nas shes par bya/ /gzhan yang skar chen nyer brgyad kyi/ /thun mtshams dbang byed skar chung re/ /yod zhes 'phrul rtsis lugs mthun pa'i/ /bstan bcos mchog las 'byung yang mthong / /skar chen rnams kyang shugs che chung / /yod pas zla ba dang phrad tshetso//'grogs yun ring 'thung 'byung ngo zhes/ /rgan dag rim pas rgyud las 'ong / /de nas bcu bzhi sbyor ba zhes/ /nyi zla dag pa'i ri mo gnyis/ /bsres la sbyor ba zhes gsungs te/ /dkyil 'khor tshad gang nyi shu bdun/ /de skad ming gi rnam grangs ni/ /rnam sel mdza' bo tshe ldan dang / /bskal bzang bzang po shin tu bskrang / /las bzang 'dzin pa zug ngu dang / /skrang pa 'phel ba nges pa dang ske//kun 'joms dga' ba rdo rje dang / /dngos grub shin btung mchog gam dpa'/ /yongs 'joms zhi dang grub pa dang / /bsgrub pa dge ba dkar po dang / /tshangs pa dbang po 'khon 'dzin no/ /de dag legs sbyar skad du ni/ /rnam sel nas ni khon 'dzin bar/ /su da na dang asta dang / /a yurmi dang su dha ka /bha dra a kaṇ+ḍa ka dang / /kad+ma pu dang dha ra dang / /sha l+ya gaṇ+ḍa thrat+ta dang / /ni yar sarba dā ra ṇa/ /a nan da dang badz+ra dang / /sidhi ā pat+ta bī ra/ /pra marde na shirnyi dang / /sirnyi sā dha shu bha dang / /pi ta brah+ma in+d+ra/ /a rata zhes su rim shes bya/ /skad dod rgya dpe tha dad par/ /cung zad 'dra min yod par mngon/ /sbyor ba nyer bdun aṅgi ni/ /thig ni sel ba gcig mdza' bo/ /rim des nyer drug mkhon 'dzin du/ /shin tu mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed/ /'ga' zhig gcig la rnam sel dang / /thig le mkhon 'dzin nyid brjod de/ /de yang 'das dang da ltar bar/ /rgyu skar skabs bzhin shes par bya/ /de ltar sbyor bar grags de dag /ngo bo'i ngos 'dzin mkhas rnams kyi/ /bzhed pa mi 'dra mang mthong yang / /de las tha dad cha bzung ba/ /nyi zla gnyis kyi rgyu skar cha/ /zung gcig phyogs dus spyod pa mi/ /phan tshun nang gi phrod nyid la/ /sbyor ba zhes su gdags gsung ba/ /'di la 'gal ba'i cha mang po/ /ma mthong re zhig de ltar bzung / /de nas bco lnga byed pa la/ /'pho dang mi 'pho sdom pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bcu gcig mchis na yang / /'pho byed bdun gyi ri mor mdzadaske/ /'pho ba'i byed pa bdun gyi ming / /pa baṃ ba ma paṃ kauwaṃ/ /tai ti lo dang gi ha dzam/ /pā ni rdza dang bisbyi ste/ /legs sbyar skad yin bod skad du/ /gdab pa byi sba rigs can dang / /til bsdung khyim skyes 22

dpun ma dang / /biṣ+ṭi mjug phod zhes bya'o/ /iṅka'i ri mor gcig la ni/ /gdab pa gnyis la byis sba yin//rim des drug pa la spun ma/ /bdun pa thig le bi ṭi ste/ /de rnams tshes res cha gnyis byas/ /cha re byed pa res spyod de/ /dkar nag tshes gcig cha phyi ma/ /gdab pa gnyis snga byis sbas spyod/ /gnyis phyi rigs can gsum gyi snga/ /til bsdung phyi cha khyim skyes so/ /bzhi lnga dpun ma bzhi'i phyi cha/ /biṣ+ṭi rgyu ba'i skabs yin te/ /de bzhin tshes lnga'i lnga cha nas/ /nag po'i bcu bzhi'i snga cha'i bar/ /dkar nag phyogs rer lan bzhi ste/ /zla gcig phyogs gnyis lan brgyad 'khor/ /mi 'pho rtag pa'i byed pa bzhi/ /legs sbyar skad du shasku ni/ /sā da tsā tuḥdang na ga /ki sru gi ṇi zhes bya ba/ /bod skad phur bu rkang bzhi klu/ /mi sdug pa ste go rim bzhin / /nag po'i bcu bzhi phyi cha dang / /bco lnga'i snga phyi dkar po yi/ /tshes gcig snga cha rnams la ste/ /'pho med zla re lan re 'char/ /biṣ+ṭi king kang rgyu dus dang / /cha mthun pas na gnyan pa yin/ /de ltar gza' tshes skar ma dang / /sbyor ba dang ni byed pa la/ /legs sbyar skad du rim pa bzhin/ /gra ha ces dang ri thi dang / /nak+ṣa ces dang yo ga dang / /ka ra ṇa zhes bya ba ste/ /yan lag lnga ru yongs grags shing / /lnga bsdus zhes kyang brjod pa yin/ /de la yang ni phral 'khog ba'i/ /go don kha shas bshad bya ste/ /deng sang lag rtsis nyid kyi skabs/ /gza' yi aṅgi'i 'og dbyu gu/ /tshes langs grags pa'i ri mo de/ /nam langs nas spyod da lta ba/ /longs spyod des rdzogs tshes kyang 'pho/ /tshul de gsal bar lta ba na/ /mkha' ror tshes longs snga ma'i dbri/ /de lhag da lta longs spyad bya/ /da lta 'das bsres tshes gang de'i/ /longs spyod tshad kun tshangs bya ste/ /de rdzogs de ma thag par med/ /phyi ma'i tshes longs tshugs pa yin/ /de lta'i yun du tshes nyid la/ /'char ba'i rigs dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /tshes la rgyu bar nges rnams sbyar/ /'on kyang dus tshod rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po'i tshes la mi sbyor ste/ /de ni nyin zhag rjes 'brang mang / /de phyir zhag de'i dus la nges//deng sang de 'dra kha cig gis/ /tshes la sbyor ba bab chol yin/ /dper na lag g.yas lpags pa ru/ /g.yon gyi sha rus 'grig min ltar/ /'dra rung khungs srol tha dad par/ /gcig tu nges par bsre ma dgos/ /des na so so'i gzhung lugs dag /ma 'khrul spyad pa nyid shes bya/ /de yang byed rtsis tshes longs nas/ /'das lo mang bzhin nyung skyon 'byung / /de la man ngag bzhin dbyug bsnan/ /de bzhin byed rtsis nyi ma la/ /mang cha yod pas dbri bar bya/ /skar ma la ni zla skar dang / /nyi skar dag ste zla skar la/ /zhag re dbyu gu mtsho dbang dang / /nyi ma'i zhag gcig longs spyod bcas/ /de la rkang dag re gza' yi/ /longs spyod kyis dman res 'grogs te/ /de yang nyi ma'i zhag gcig tshad/ /chu tshod bzhi dang srang nyer gcig /dbugs lnga ri dus cha zhes gsum/ /tshes kyi dkyil 'khor nyid la'o/ /tshes 'khyud sgra gcan 'jug pa brtag /res 'grogs tshes kyi skar ma ni/ /'phral du brtsi bya'i gtso bo ste/ /re gza'i 'phrod chen nyer brgyad dang / / 23

'grub sbyor bsregs sbo 'chi sbyor dang / /zung sbyor dang ni bkra shis nyi/ /mthun nyi sbyor nyi 'phel nyi dang / /'jigs nyi rtsub nyi mi 'phrod nyi/ /gtan spang chud rgyal bdud rtsi rnams/ /zla skar longs spyod gnas kyi ston / /nyi ma'i skar mas dus sbyor dang / /dus bzhi dus phran mtha' dag ste/ /zla skar bzhi dang nyi nyid kyi/ /mche gdong mthong pa shes pa dang / /gza' lnga ke ru sgra can dag /'char nub 'gros phyogs 'jug thebs yang ske/ /nyi mas spyod pa'i skar ma la/ /brtags nas 'grub pa 'ba' zhig dang / /dbyangs 'char nas gsungs 'khor lo'i rigs/ /phal che yang ni 'di la brten/ /des na dus rtsis kun gyi gtso/ /zla ni'i skar mar yongs shes bya/ /de ltar zla yi skar ma yi/ /dbyug srang dbugs dang cha shas gang / /longs spyod ri mo 'das par 'dod/ /lhag ma da lta nyid spyod rgyu/ /gsal brtags skar ma'i longs spyod des/ /mkha' ror 'phrin lhag da lta 'char/ /da lta 'das bsres skar ma gcig /longs spyod tshes kyi yun tshad yin/ /tshes 'khyud rtsing pos da ltar rloms/ /zhib mos rab tu 'das pa rtogs/ /sbyor ba dag gi longs spyod gang / /'char nub 'das dang da lta ba/ /yun tshad gsal bar blta tshul bcas/ /skar ma'i longs spyod tshul dang mthun—/ /'on kyang sbyor ba'i tshul zhag rer/ /chu tshod re gnyis srang zhe gsum/ /dbugs lnga ri dus cha bcu dguske/ /spyod zhes slob dpon dam pas gsungs/ /sbyor ba kun 'joms shin tu btung / /mkhon 'dzin gsum ni yongs su rtsub/ /sel ba gsum dang zung ngur zhi/ /shin tu skrang dang skrang la drug /rang rang longs spyod thog ma'i gnas/ /yun de'i chu tshod rtsub pa yin/ /'jam rtsub dus rer so so yi/ /las de la ni shis par bshad/ /byed pa'i ri mo de lta zhes/ /snga phyi'i mkhas pa thams cad mthun/ /tshes grangs gnyis bsgyur thub pa bgos/ /lhag gnas gcig 'phri phyi byed 'char/ /de la gcig bsnan tshes phyi ma'i/ /snga cha'i byed pa nyid 'char 'gyur/ /gsal brtags res gza'i tshes longs gcig /da lta 'das bsres yongs rdzogs tshad/ /gnyis su dbyes pa'i phyed cha la/ /byed pa re yi spyod par dran/ /longs spyod lnga mar byed pa lnga / /lhag mar byed pas phyi mas so/ /kun la zhib mor longs spyod ni/ /chu srang dbugs chas bsre dang dbri//rang rang 'khor los gzhal ba yis/ /tshad la gsal bar brtags pa'o/ /de ltar lnga bsdus longs spyod la/ /'das dang da ltar bzhag pa ni/ /nam longs phan chad 'das pa dang / /tshun chad da ltar nges par bzung / /sngon dus mkhas pa che kha cig /tshes longs dbyu gu 'das pa dang / /nyi ma'i dbyu gu da ltar ba/ /'dod pa dag kyang gsal bar mthong / /ri mthu blta dang don la dpyad/ /kun la 'di ni shes bya'o/ /deng sang ri thu brjod pa mang / /sngon gyi yi ger li thu yod/ /rgyal nag skad yin rgyal srid rer/
