/tshig zur mi 'dra bsgyur bar grags/ /de nas bcu drug 'phrod bshad pa/ /dang po gza' skar khams shes bya/ /gza' la pa sangs spen pa sa/ /zla ba dang ni lag pa chu/ /nyi ma mig dmar gnyis po me/ /phur bu sgra gcan rlung du 24

grags / kha cig khu ba dkar po zhes/ /pa sangs chu yi khams yin gsungs/ /karma snar ma lha mtshams sgron/ /chu smad zhun gnyis mon gre sa/ /mon gru nam gru khrums smad dang / /chu stod lag snum skag rnams chu/ /smin drug bra nye sa ga rgyal/ /mchu bra khrums stod bdun gyi che/ /tha skar sa ri nam so mgo/ /me zhi nag pa sbo rnams rlung ske/ /de ltar gza' skar dus tshes kyi/ /yul dus lhan cig 'joms pa'i 'phrod/ /spyi dang bye brag rnam pa gnyisaske/ /spyi la gza' skar dag gi khams/ /sa nang phrad pa dngos grub sbyor/ /sa chu lang tsho sa me bsregs/ /sa rlung mi mthun sbyor ba nges/ /chu nang phrad pa bdud rtsi sbyor/ /me chu 'chi sbyor chu rlung ni/ /mi 'phrod pa yi sbyor bar shes/ /me nang phrad pa 'phel 'gyur sbyor/ /me rlung stobs ldan sbyor bar 'gyur/ /rlung nang phrad pas phun tshogs te/ /rags pa'i tshul du de ltar bshad/ /bye brag zhib par thun mong dang / /thun mong ma yin rnam pa gnyis/ /dang po drang srong bdun gyi lugs/ /'phrod chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad ming / /go rim ma chug 'di ltar ste/ /kun dga' dus dbyug dul ba dang / /skye rgu'i dag dang gzhon bya rog /rgyal mtshan dpal be rdo rje dang / /'chi gdung grogs yid 'dod 'gal me/ /rtsa bton 'chi bdag mda' grub mdung / /bdud rtsi btun shing glang po stag /zad pa g.yo brtan 'phel ba'o/ /de rnams rgyu skar zhun gnyis phyes/ /nyer brgyad gyur dang res gza' bdun/ /'phrad rim 'phrod nyer brgyad lan bdun/ /nang gses brgya dang go drug 'gyur/ /de yang 'phrod dang karma'i ming / /thog mtha' smos bzhin bar gyi rnams/ /go rim ma nor grang ba yi/ /'phrod rnams lug 'byung nyid du ste/ /nyi ma tha skar 'phrad kun dga'/ /bar rnams rim shes thar nam gru/ /'phrad tshe 'phel ba nyid du rdzogs/ /tshul des lhag ma shes byas nas/ /mgo nas snar ma'i bar zla ba/ /skag nas rgyal bar bkra shis 'phrod/ /me bzhi sbo bar lhag pa dang / /lha mtshams sa ga'i bar phur bu/ /chu smad chu stod bar dkar po/ /mon gru mon gre spen pa'o/ /nyi 'phrod kun dga' nas zla 'phrod—/ /kun dga'i bar skar bzhi'i khyad/ /gza' bdun bar du des ltas kyang / /tshul 'di tshegs med nyid shes 'gyur/ /gzhan ni shog khra dang ri mos/ /bstan mod 'di ni de dag la/ /ma ltos 'phrod skar ming go rim/ /shes pas bde blags rtogs par byas/ /bsregs sbyor skar ma mchu sa ga /lag snrub mon gre snar chu stod/ /res gza' bdun dang rim 'phrod pas/ /der 'gyur drang srong gzhung las so/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa/ /dpal mchog rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'phrod/ /nyi ma me bzhi zla gro zhun/ /bkra shis dbyu gu lhag lha mtshams/ /rgyal phur spa she spen snar ma/ /'grub sbyor bdun ste snying stobs mtshon/ /gza' bdun rim sbyor snar ma ni/ /lha mtshams smin drug mon gru dang / /dbyu gu mgo snar mi bzhi rnams/ /phrad pa 'chi sbyor bdun pa'i cha/ /gza' dang tshes 'dzoms bsreg sbyor ni/ /dkar nag phyogs gnyis dag gi tshes/ /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu tshes gsum/ /drug gnyis tshes bdun go rim bzhin/ /nyi zla mig lhag phur 25

sangs spen/ /'phrad pas bsregs tshes rdul du go/ /gzhan yang nyin zhag res gza' des/ /sna drangs dus sbyor phyed rer gza'/ /'char 'gyur nyin thun bcu gnyis la/ /thod rgal tshul du drug mtshams bskor/ /mtshan mo lnga mtshams bskor bas spyod/ /'char rim ngag 'di'i bde klag nyid/ /de ltar thun phyed gza' 'phrod ming / /bar skabs phug slob 'chi med pas/ /dge la bdud rtsi'i thun mtshams su/ /bsgrags kyang rtsa ba'i khung gi gsal/ /deng dus kun gzigs dam pa che/ /gtsug lag snang bas bram ze yi/ /rtsis gzhung rgya dpe dngos gzigs par/ /thun mtshams tha dad ma 'khrul ming / /nyi 'char zla ba bdud rtsi nyid/ /mig dmar nad dang lag rked pa/ /phur bu dge ba spa sangs g.yo/ /spen pa nges par dus zhes te/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud chen las/ /gza' brgyad klu brgyad mnyam sbyor ba/ /ces brtsub sgra gcan rigs ldan gang ske/ /gzhan dus 'char dang rang dus 'char/ /gzhan dus thun phyed spen pa yi/ /chu srang tshad nas 'char ba dang / /rang dus nyin brgyad mtshan thun brgyad/ /thun la re gza' sna drang ste/ /go rim bzhin 'char spen pa'i mthar/ /thun gcig rigs ldan sgra gcan dus/ /de tshe gza' btung gyis ston mo/ /khyad par smad dpyad bya ba spang / /spyir ni drag gzar dge min las/ /zhi gzar dge ba'i las grub bshad/ /rgyud las rigs ldan dngos bstan pa'i/ /shugs kyi thun mtshams dus sbyor phyed/ /phrod gza' gsal bsten des na 'dir/ /blang dor mi nor ched du smras/ /de rnams dpal mchog rgyud nas te/ /gzhan gyur sngags rgyud kha yar dang / /'byung rtsis gzhung nas mang 'byung ba/ /'dir smos ma lang gzhan du brtag/ /'on kyang phral 'kho tsi na'i gzhung / /lo dang zla ba'i 'phrod la brten/ /zla nag grags pa zla ba'i mgo/ /'dzin tshul mi mthun pa yi ni/ /lag rtsis 'dod pa tha dad snang / /'dir ru lugs mang mi 'khrul phyir/ /ngos 'dzin tshul nyid gsal bshad na/ /dper na gnam lo byi rta shar/ /de tshe rang zla byi rta zla'i/ /gong gi gsum pa phung zla dang / /mas kyi gsum pa rab chad de/ /des na bya yos zla ba nag /de bzhin rigs 'gre glang lug lor/ /khyi dang 'brug gi zla ba nag /stag sprel lo la phag sbrul zla/ /bya yos lo la byi rta'i zla/ /khyi 'brug lo la glang lug zla/ /phag sbrul lo la stag spre'u yi/ /zla ba nag ste de la yang / /ra ba bzhi'i stod 'bring bzhi'i sgang / /tha chung bzhi yi zla ba smad/ /khyad par du ni nag pa yin/ /tshul 'di rtsis mkhan gsar bu pa/ /kha cig lo mgo bzung tshul gnad/ /ma shes gcig la gcig 'khrul ba/ /mthong bas de rnams rmongs gsal phyir/ /skabs 'dir ha cang 'jug min yang / /lhag bsam dag pa kho nas bkod/ /gzhan ni gnam lo the 'phrad kyi/ /lo nag zhes kyang brjod pa yod/ /skar rtsis la ni tshes lhag chad/ /spang bar bkra shis zla bar grags/ /spyir btang rten 'brel tshogs pa kun/ /'phrod dam sbyor sgrar bzhag rung bas/ /tshig yang don mang 'jug mod 'dir/ /lag rtsis skabs grags mtshon tsam mo/ / 26

de nas bcu bdun stobs khyad ni/ /res kyi gza' dang rgyu skar gnyis/ /dbang ldan bdag po'i bstan bcos las/ /res 'grogs rgyu skar stobs che grags/ /de phyir rig byed 'dzin rnams kyi/ /tshes la yon tan gcig gis brgyan/ /gza' bzhi rgyu skar yon tan brgyad/ /dus sbyor yon tan bye bar 'dod/ /da lta lag len byed pa kun/ /res gza' gtso ru 'dzin par mdzad/ / 'on kyang gza' skar stobs mthun shesaske/ /tshes skar skar ma stobs che zhing / /sbyor ba byed pa byed pa gnyan/ /khyad par bisbyi sgra gcan rigs/ /de rnams yan lag lnga spyir btang / /stobs kyi khyad par dbye ba ste/ kha cig king kang rā hū la/ /gza' dang skar ma dus tshod tshes/ /byed pa sbyor ba nyi ma rnams/ /go rim bzhin gong stobs che zhing / /'og ma nus pa chung zhes smra/ /de tshe king kang rā hū gtso/ /dpal mchog rgyud las rnam pa gzhan/ /zhi drag gza' rnams phyogs gnas stobs/ /rnal 'byor ma dang drag po dang / /biṣ+ṭi gang du rgyu ba'i stobs/ /shugs bstan rlung dang thun phyed dngos/ /sgra gcan phyogs su 'char ba'i stobs/ /rtsa ba'i sgra gcan sgyu skar la/ /bkod pa lto dang lta phyogs stobs/ /de sogs g.yul dang rgyal rigs ched/ /rgyal bas sgyu ma'i ltar gsung shing / /de rnams las ni rtsa ba yi/ /sgra gcan phyogs stobs kyi mchog tu bshad/ /des na sgra gcan 'khyud skar dang / /de yi snga phyi gdong tshugs sogs/ /skar rtsis gzhung la 'di gnyan pas/ /blang dor ma 'khrul nges par gcesaske//tshul des gza' lnga'i 'khyud pa dang / /mche ba gdeng tshugs mthong ba sogs/ /phyogs cha gnod pa yod med pa/ /mkhas pa'i gsung pa'i gzhung la 'jug /gzhan yang dbang phyug chen po yi/ /legs gsung dbyangs 'char gzhung las kyang / /khyims dang gza' sogs stobs rnam grangs/ /du ma gsungs pa yang shes bya/ /'dir ni ming tsam kho na ste/ /rgyas par gzhung dang ngag las blang / /gzhan ni dus tshod mtshon cha'i so/ /dus sbyor mchog tu stobs che gsung / /de sogs stobs khyad spyi mig gsal/ /las dang bstun te shes bya'o/ /da ni bco brgyad dus sbyor gyi/ /go don mdo tsam nyid bshad na/ /rnam grangs gzhan du rgyud rgyal poske/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'phreng ba dang / /dgongs pa lung ston dang sdom 'byung / /rnams nas nang gi rnal 'byor mtshon/ /'pho ba zhes pa brda' yi bstan/ /de yang 'pho chen nyi shu bzhi/ /nyin dang mtshan mo mnyam pa'i dus/ /nyin mo bcu gnyis mtshan bcu gnyis/ /'pho chen re la dbugs kyi grangs/ /brgya phrag dgu re rgyu ba yin/ /de la 'pho chung bzhi ru dbye/ /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbugs/ /'pho chen re la mgon po re/ /nyin gsum mtshan gsum nyid du 'khor/ /mgon po bzhi ni g.yas dang g.yon/ /mnyam gyur rtsub dang 'jam po srog /rim bzhin pad+ma mgon po dang / /las dang rin chen rdo rje mgon/ /'pho chung lha mo bzhi yi rlung la/ /steng ngos khur tshos sna dbus mchu/ /rgyu rim gos dkar sgrol ma dang / /spyan ma bdag mo nyid du 27

gsung / /'pho chen nyer bzhi 'pho chung ni/ /dgu bcu drug tu dbye ba ste/ /de ni nyin zhag 'phrugs gcig tshadaske/ /nyi khri chig stong brgya drug srog /de ltar 'dus sogs dgongs pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i man ngag las/ /yum chen nyer bzhi'i rtsa la rlung / /'pho chen nyer bzhi'i nyid dang sbyor/ /de yang 'pho chen re re la/ /dbang dang longs spyod 'jug pa gsum/ /cig char nyid du 'char ba ste/ /de ltar 'pho ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /du ma gsung pa shes slad du/ /skabs 'dir cung zad 'phros pa ste/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum mnyam sbyor phyir/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis phyi rol du/ /mkha' la bcu gnyis khyim 'khor lo/ /nyin zhag gcig la 'char nub dbang / /sa la dus kyi sbyor bar 'gyur/ /khyim gyi gnas lugs nges pa yi/ /nyi ma gang la nges pa'i khyim/ /des drangs lasnaḥzhes dus sbyor/ /bcu gnyis tastul rim par 'byung / /de yang lug 'khrig seng srang gzhu/ /bum pa mi mnyam dus sbyor drug /sna bug g.yon nas 'bab pa'i rlung / /dbus steng sna gshog rnya ba 'og /rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga bskyed rim/ /mkha' rlung me chu sa rim pa/ /de la 'char gza' sgra gcan zla/ /lhag pa pa sangs ke ru yin/ /glang bal bu mo sdig chu srin//nya ni mnyam pa'i dus sbyor te/ /sna bug g.yas nas 'bab pa'i rlung / /'og dang rka ba 'gram steng dbus/ /rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga bsdud rim/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i ste/ /de la 'char gza' spen phur bu/ /mig dmar nyi ma dus me'o/ /gzhan yang dus sbyor mtshan nyid ni/ /g.yo dang brtan dang mnyam pa gsum/ /lug dang kar+ha srang chu srin/ /g.yo ba bzhi yin brtan pa ni/ /glang dang seng ge sdig pa bum/ /gnyis mnyam bzhi ni 'khrig bu mo/ /gzhu dang nya ru kun tu grags/ /de ltar yongs su shes byas nas/ /phyi ru nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus/ /dus sbyor nyin drug mtshan drug ste/ /dus sbyor re yi yun tshad ni/ /rags par dbyu gu lnga lnga yin / /de ltar yongs su shes byas nas/ /phyi ru nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus/ /dus sbyor nyin drug mtshan drug ste/ /dus sbyor re yi yun tshad ni/ /rags par dbyu gu lnga lnga yin/ /dus sbyor re dang 'pho chen re/ /mnyam ste dbugs stong brgyad rgyar 'gyur/ /dbyug gu 'pho chung tshad du rdzogs/ /des na sum rgya drug cur nges / /da dung cung zad gsal bshad na/ /mkha' la khyim gang 'char ba'i yun/ /de srid de yi dus sbyor yin / /khyim re la ni rkang pa dgu/ /skar ma bzhi la skar ma gcig /rkang re char yun dbugs nyis brgya/ /des na skar bar gcig rdzogs yun/ /rags rtsis dbugs ni brgya phrag brgyad/ /de ltar 'phel 'grib med 'char yang / /nyin mtshan ring thung skar 'gros dbang / /nyin mtshan ring po thur thag tshe/ /chu tshod sum cu rtsa drug yun/ /de la dus sbyor bdun dang ni/ /dbyu gu gcig gi lhag gyur tshad/ /de yi lhag ma dus sbyor lnga/ /dbyug gu gcig gi dman pa nyid/ /de ni mtshan dang nyin mor ste/ /dbyug gu nyer bzhi'i yun la dmigs//gang de dbyug lnga'i dbugs tshad kyi/ /rnam par brtag ste bzhag pa yin/ /'on kyang rgyud las srang tshad 28

skabs / /nyin mtshan ring po'i thur thag dus/ /lhag chad med par dus sbyor drug /gsal bar bzhag nyid nges par bya/ /nyi ma snga phyi'i dus sbyor gyi/ /chu srang mang nyung 'byung ba yang / /go la'i 'gros lam dbang las te/ /rnam pa gzhan du sems ma 'khrug /de ltar so drug nyer bzhi'i dbyug /gangs can byang phyogs tshad la ste/ /lhag ma kai la sha dbus dang / /sham+bha la dang rgya li bod/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi dbyu gu'i tshad/ /gong ma la ni rim pa bzhin/ /chu srang sum cu re 'phrogs pas/ /yul bdun nyin mtshan mthur rag tshad/ /bder rtogs 'di ni rgyud 'grel las/ /dngos dang shugs kyi brtan par snang / /de yang khyim gyi 'khor shugs ni/ /bdun pa'i dbu shar bdun dbu thim/ /bdun phyed shar tshe bdun phyed nub/ /shar nas bdun rdzogs nub bdun rdzogs/ /de mthar sdig skar khyim drug rdzogs/ /de 'phral bdun shar gong bzhin 'khor//dpe na tha skar nub ma thag /nag pa shar nas thon pa yin/ /nabs so nam mkha'i gung du gnas/ /lhag rnams rig pa de yi brtag /dus sbyor skar ma mi mnyam yang / /rkang pa mnyam pas de ltar shes/ /spyir yang nam mkha' go la'i gnas/ /nyer bdun cha bgos cha re la/ /dum bzhir chad pa'i dbus nyid du/ /rgyu skar gnas te dper brjod na/ /nabs so nas ni rgyal bar gyi/ /nam mkha' dum bzhi snga ma gnyis/ /nabs sos dbang de phyi ma gnyis/ /rgyal dbang rgyal nas skag gis bar/ /snga gnyis rgyal ste dum bzhir rdzogs/ /mig skar sogs kyang tshul de yi/ /brtag par bya ste res 'grogs zla/ /gza' lnga kun la shes bya yin/ /phyis dus skar rtsis lugs gnyis la/ /gsar sbyor gtam 'ga' ming tsam nyid/ /rjes bzlos las gzhan mi spyod paske//de la yang 'di legs bshad 'gyur/ /deng sang kha cig 'byung rtsis lugs/ /tho rengs nam langs stag yos sogs/ /rim par sbyar bzhin dus sbyor yang / /de mthun bsgrang bar byas mod kyang / /lan gcig phyogs mthun 'grigs srid rung / /kun tu 'grigs pa ma yin pas/ /mkhas pas byas pa'i re'u mig gam/ /lhag par ri mos gtan phab gces/ /tastul ri mos rtsa ba ni/ kha cig nye bar gzhan nyid dag /mdzad mod de dag ri mo'i skabs/ /shes phyir 'di ru ma spros so/ /taṅgāl zhing dag khyim bdag mtshungs/ /dbyangs 'char rgyud nas dus sbyor gcig /de phyed sum cha dgu cha dang / /bcu gnyis sum bcu'i char bsil gang ske/ /stobs kyi rnam grangs mang gsung ba/ /gzhung de nyid las rtogs kyang bya/ /'dir ni go don yid yul du/ /bkod thabs tshig nyung don gsal gdams/ /dus sbyor yon tan 'bum phrag zhes/ /thun mong gzhung nas shin tu bsngags/ /de ltar yongs grags gtso bo ni/ /nyi ma'i dus sbyor nyid yin la/ /zhor byung zla ba'i dus sbyor gang / /lha chen bstan bcos dbyangs 'char las/ /gsungs pa deng sang mkhas pa dag /zla snyi zhes su 'don de ste/ /zla ba bcu gnyis khyim dkar la/ /gang la gnas pa de'i dus sbyor/ /tha dad ming gis ston pa yin/ /de yang zla bas lug gi khyim/ /skar ma tha ma nang bra nye/ /smin drug skar ma gcig 29

yan la/ /spyod skabs zla ba'i dus sbyor ming / /sra kha pi'am byes bsgrod zer/ /des 'gre glang la rang yul gnas / /'khrigs la 'chi ba sbal par rgod/ /bu mor 'bar ba srang dge ba/ /sdig pa mi gnang gzhu mi mthun / /chu srin byed pa pu pa ta/ /bum pa la'o nya khyim ni/ /'byor pa zhes su gdags pa ste/ /de ltar ma nor shes par bya/ /mdor dril zla bas khyim re la/ /rags rtsis zhag gnyis cha bcas bsgrod/ /'di la zla snyigs zhes pa ni/ /cung zad 'gyur ma bde bar mngon/ /des na zla ba'i dus sbyor la/ /zla ba'i rigs ldan brjod pa 'thad/ /de ltar dus sbyor las 'phros gtam/ /cha shas tsam zhig smos pa ste/ /des ni rnam grangs slob pa'i mdo/ /don tshan bco brgyad bsten zin no/ /de nas sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung / /kun mkhyen mgon po mchog de yi/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis brdar mdzad de/ /de dang sbyar ba'i rig pa rtsis/ /rgyal ba nyid kyi yang dag gsungs/ /don ldan don chen rten 'brel ming / /grangs kyi go rim 'di lta ste/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa dang / /tshor ba sred pa len pa dang / /srid pa skye ba rga shi'o/ /'di ltar lugs 'byung 'khor ba'i chos/ /lugs las bzlog pa myang 'das rgyu/ /de nyid phyi rol khyim zla zhag /dus de rnams la sbyar ba ste/ /khyim zlar 'char tshul zla ba'i skabs//gong du bsten bzhin nges par bya/ /'dir ni zhag la spyod pa'i tshul/ /de yang mnyam dang mi mnyam zla/ /chu srin la sogs mnyam zla drug /sum sogs mi mnyam zla ba drug /mnyam la yar ngo g.yon skye ba/ /lug 'byung spro ba srid rten 'brel/ /mar ngo g.yas pa 'chi ba ste/ /lugs bzlog bsdud pa zhi rten 'brel/ /mi mnyam la ni de go bzlog /mar ngo g.yas dang yar ngo g.yon/ /lugs 'byung lugs bzlog tshul de yi/ /zhag rer rten 'brel re re ste/ /de la 'di ltar mtshon par bya/ /lo mtshams zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshes gcig ma rig gnyis 'du shes/ /gsum la rnam shes bzhi ming gzugs/ /lnga la skye mched drug reg pa/ /bdun pa tshor ba brgyad sred pa/ /dgu len bcu srid bcu gcig ni/ /skye dang bcu gnyis rga shi'o/ /bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga ni/ /gang de'i tshes gsum bzhi lnga la/ /'char ba'i rten 'brel de ji bzhin/ /slar yang ldabs te bkod pa ste/ /des na 'dir ni rnam shes dang / /ming gzugs skye mched dag yin no/ /skabs re yar ngo'i zhag lhag ste/ /bcu drug byung tshe reg pa bsnan/ /chad nas bcu bzhir song ba na/ /bco lnga bton bshul reg pa sbyor/ /de bzhin 'og ma kun la yang / /rig pa 'di yi 'gro shes bya/ /spyir btang rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs nyid/ /mar ngo sngon 'gro mchu zla'i dbu/ /rgyud nas rgyal mchu'i 'tshams gsungs paske/ /bcu drug dmar phyogs tshes gcig nges/ /de la rten 'brel ma rig pa/ /gnyis la rga shi gsum skye ba/ /bzhi srid lnga len drug sred pa/ /bdun tshor brgyad reg dgu skye mched/ /bcu pa ming gzugs bcu gcig niske/ /rnam shes bcu gnyis 'du byed do/ /bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga la/ /rang tshes gsum bzhi lnga bzhin 30

steske/ /'dir ni skye srid len pa rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du sbyar ba yin/ /mar ngo lhag chad tshe gong bzhin/ /bsnan nam 'brid la sred pa sbyor/ /de nas chu zla'i dkar dmar gyi/ /tshes gcig gnyis kar 'du byed nyid / /lhag ma dmar phyogs tshes gnyis la/ /ma rig gsum la rga shi yin/ /bzhi skye lnga srid drug len pa/ /bdun sred brgyad tshor dgu reg pa/ /bcu la skye mched bcu gcig pa/ /ming gzugs bcu gnyis rnam shes 'gyur/ /bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga par/ /ma rig rga shi skye ba'o/ /dkar phyogs lhag chad gyur pa na//bsnan 'phri gong 'dra ma rig sbyor/ /nag po'i tshes gnyis rnam shes te/ /gsum la ming gzugs bzhi skye mchedaske/ /lnga reg drug tshor bdun sred pa/ /brgyad len dgu srid bcu skye ba/ /bcu gcig rga shi bcu gnyis paglu/ /ma rig pa ru 'gyur ba yin/ /bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga ni/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa'o/ /dmar phyogs lhag lam chad pa'i tshe/ /'dir ni mtshor bas bsnan 'phri bya/ /de ltar rgyal dang mchu gnyis kyiske/ /legs mtshan lhag ma'i zla ba dag /mnyam mi mnyam kun dkar dmar gyi/ /tshes gcig la ni zla ba khyim/ /so so'i rten 'brel gang yin 'char/ /de nas rim tsam bcu gnyis kyi/ /lhag ma'i zhag dang chad lhag zhag /rten 'brel sbyar tshul gong dang mtshon/ /blo gros cung zad ldan pa kun/ /de yi de bklags nyid rtogs kyang / /'on kyang blo gros gsar bu bar/ /da dung cung zad gsal bshad na/ /sbo zla'i tshes gcig rnam shes yin/ /yar ngo lugs 'byung mar ngo bzlog /lhag chad dkar phyogs la sred pa/ /dmar phyogs la ni srid pa sbyor/ /nag zla ming gzugs nas dbu tsam/ /dkar phyogs lugs bzlog dmar lugs 'byung / /yar ngo lhag chad skye ba dang / /mar ngo lhag chad len par 'gyur/ /sa ga skyed skyed lug 'byung bzlog /lhag chad dkar srid dmar rga shi /snron la reg pa lugs bzlog 'byung / /lhag chad ma rig dang skye ba/ /chu stod tshor ba lugs 'byung bzlog /'jug 'byin rga shi 'du byed nges/ /gro zhun sred pa lugs bzlog 'byung / /lhag chad rnam shes dang ma rig /khrums zla len pa lugs 'byung bzlog /lhag chad 'du byed ming gzugs so/ /tha skar srid pa lugs bzlog 'byung / /bsnan dor skye mched dang rnam shes/ /smin drug skye ste lugs 'byung bzlog /ming gzugs reg pa ā ga ma/ /mgo ni rga shis lugs bzlog 'byung / /bklag thabs tshor dang skye mched 'gyur/ /zla lhag yod tshe phyi ma la/ /snga ma ji bzhin ldabs te bkod/ /rang lugs zla bdag 'phar ba'i tshe/ /zla lhag 'byung ngo gzhan ma 'dzin/ /dpal mchog rgyud dang 'bral pa ru/ /rten 'brel ji ltar 'char ba'i tshul/ /rab tu gsal ba gsung bzhin du/ /rang bzo bcos ma mi 'os pas/ /des na dang ba'i sems kho nas/ /'dir yang zhib mor bshad pa yin/ /shin tu gsal spel yi ge dang / /shog khra gzhan du shes par byos/ /blo ldan gzu bor gnas kun kyang / /'di las gzhan du mi phyogs mdo/ /deng sang kha cig khyim slebs la/ /rten nas rten 'brel bkod pa ni/ /re zhig dpyad pa'i gnas su bzhag /31

'on kyang gong nyid 'khrul pa med/ /kha cig blo gros gsar ba'i gtam/ /sgang tshad rten 'bra mthun par bsgrig /da lta de yi rjes 'brang mang / /bdag cag gis ni btang snyoms mo/ /de ltar rgyud don ji bzhin duske//zhag gi rten 'brel bshad zin nas/ /da ni dus la sbyor ba'i tshul/ /taṅgāl gang la bab pa yi/ /de de'i rten 'brel 'char ba ste/ /chu srin ma rig sogs gong bzhin/ /spyir btang skar rtsis nas dus sbyor/ /'byung rtsis las ni dus tshod zhes/ /gnyan bzhin dus kyi rten 'brel yang / /shin tu sno bar rig pas rtogs/ /gzhan yang bod snying yi ge 'garate/ /rten 'brel lo la bkod pa yod/ /der slan phyis 'byung yi ger slad/ /cung zad zhugs pa klog mthong nas/ /mkhas pa kha cig mi 'gu zhing / /phyogs der 'dor bar 'dzad mod kyang / /dpal mchog rgyud dang 'grel pa las/ /dbyangs dang na tshod dga' sogs pa/ /lo phyogs zla bar sbyar ba'i mtshon/ /rten 'brel lo sbyor pu yi 'gog /des na ma rig byi ba'i lo/ /'du byed glang dang rnam shes stag /ming gzugs yos la skye mched 'brug /sbrul reg rta tshor lug srid pa/ /sprel len bya yis lo srid pa/ /skye ba rga shi khyi phag steske//rgya nag lo ming 'phags yul du/ /rnam kun med ces brjod mi bya/ /kha cig gzhung rnying la gshe zhing / /rang bzo ngo bor 'phyar 'di mtshar/ /de ltar rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtsis/ /thun mong ma yin sangs rgyas gzhung / /de la lhag par mos pa yi/ /cung zad spros ste bstan zin no/ /de nas de rnams spyi yi don/ /phyi sbyor ba'i tshul ji 'dra/ /phyogs gang cha shas mdo tsam zhig /don la gzhol phyir 'dir smra na/ /spyir ni theg pa phyogs kun las/ /phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin/ /nang bzhin phyi rol snang ba ste/ /de dag dag pa gzhan du gsungs/ /khyad par dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ /'jig rten phyi dang nang bcud lus/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gzhan/ /gzhan las zhib pa'i tshul du bstan/ /'di ru nyer 'kho'i phyogs mtshon ni/ /khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus/ /dbu ma dag pa ye shes khams/ /rtsa kun la ni rnam par khyab/ /phyi rol mkha' yang de bzhin ste/ /a wa dhu ti dung can ma/ /sgra gcan dus me ma ning khams/ /ro ma dang ni rkyang ma gang / /dkar dmar thig le 'dzin byed rtsa/ /nyi ma zla ba thabs shes rab/ /der brten rtsa ba'i 'khor lo drug /'byung lnga ye shes khams bcas drug /gtsug gtor la ni rtsa 'dab bzhi/ /thun mtshams bzhi yi rnam par mtshon/ /dpral bar rtsa yi 'dab rtsa drug /tshes grangs bco lnga ye shes bcas/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /ye shes cha las dbyu gu bzhi/ /snying khar rtsa 'dabs rnam pa brgyad/ /thun brgyad yang ni gza' chen brgyad/ /lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu bzhi/ /dbyu gu drug cu stong pa bzhi/ /'di las dus sbyor bcu gnyis bcas/ /gsang ba'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis par/ /dkar dmar bcu drug phyogs so gnyis/ /yan lag tshig chen 'khor lo gang / /bcu gnyis zla ba nyid du mtshon/ /32

de la 'dab ma sum cu re/ /zla ba re yi zhag dang mtshungs/ /nying lag tshigs 'khor drug cu ste/ /zhag gcig gis ni dbyu gu dang / /re rer 'dab ma drug ldan pa/ /sum brgya drug cu dbyu gu'i dbugs/ /phyi rol de bzhin nang du ste/ /skar rtsis mtha' dag rtsa yi gnas/ /mchog tu thig le 'khor 'das srog /srid dang zhi ba myang 'das kun/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems gyi 'phrul las grub/ /de yang kun rdzob rgyu thig le/ /chu dang me khams dkar dmar gyi/ /dngas ma spyid thig e wam dang / /a haṃ phyi rol nyi zla yin/ /phra rags rgyu rlung 'dus pa'i khamasaske/ /sgra gcan dus me thig le nyid/ /rtsa tshogs la ni thig le'u khams/ /sna tshogs rgyu ba rgyu skar tshogs/ /dkar dmar 'phel 'grib rol pa las/ /yar mar lho byang phyogs bsgrod pa/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid tsha grang sogs/ /rnam pa du ma ston par byed/ /khu rdul rlung rnams dbu ma ru/ /yongs 'jug gnas mthun skabs yod bzhin/ khams drug dus tshigs zla drug mthar/ /zla nyi la ni sgra gcan 'jug /mdor na snod bcud chags 'jig dus/ /'phel 'grib bde dang sdug bsngal ba/ /legs nyes mtha' dag thig le yin/ /byed las nyid du rgyal bas gsungs/ /khyad par du ni rlung gi las/ /mtha' dag stobs dang ldan pa ste/ /rtsa dang thig le'i bya ba yang / /ma las rlung gi byed pa ste/ /des na de kun bdag po yang / /rlung nyid du ni rab tu nges/ /gnas skabs phyi nang rgyu ba'i dbugs/ /skar rtsis kun gyi rtsa ba 'grub/ /g.yas nas rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /drag gza' lnga yi rang bzhin dang / /g.yon nas rgyu ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ /zhi gza' lnga yi rang bzhin nyid/ /rgyu ba'i dbang gi de ltar ste/ /spyir ni srog thur nyi zlar gsungs/ /gza' rnams rgyu ba'i khyim tshogs kyang / /lte ba'i g.yas g.yon rtsa 'dab ma/ /drug cu bcu gnyis pad+ma'i tshul/ /'dab bzhi lte lnga khyon drug cu/ /'dab dang lte ba las 'pho chung / /lnga ste sdom pas 'pho chen gcig /de ni dus sbyor cig ste de/ /g.yon g.yas mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /sngar bshad bzhin te de las khyim/ /zhag dang zla ba lo la sogs/ /phyi rol dus kyi bya ba kun/ /rlung gi bsgrod pa nyid las grub/ /srid gsum skye 'jig 'khor 'das chos/ /kun kyang rlung gi mthu las so/ /de rnams rgyud dang 'phags 'grel gzhung / /mkhas pas ji ltar bkral ba bzhin/ /go bde nyung ngu'i ngag gi ni/ /cung zad tsam zhig smras pa'o/ /da dung 'di ru 'phros pa'i gtam/ /gdan bzhi dus 'khor rgyud dgongs bzhin/ /dam pa'i zhal lung rim brgyud pa/ /slob dpon gsung las 'di skad thos/ /skyes bu dar bab snyoms pa'i dbugs/ /nyin zhag gcig la rgyu ba'i grangs/ /phyi rol rag rtsis lo gcig gi /chu tshod tshad du 'gyur ba yin/ /g.yas g.yon 'pho bas yar mar ngo / /lho byang bsgrod pa gnyis dag ste/ /bcu gnyis grangs kyi khyim dang ni/ /zla ba dus sbyor de grangs 'gyur/ /bcu gnyis thun re dbugs kyi grangs/ /zla gcig chu tshod stong brgyad brgya/ / 33

'pho chung dbugs grangs dbyug sum brgya/ /drug bcu nyin zhag drug la 'char/ /khyad par nyi ma'i 'khor lo gang / /zla ba bshol du grags gyur pa/ /gza' tshogs stong 'jug slar nges skyes/ /kun gyi rtsa ba ye shes rlung glu/ /sna nas rgyu ba'i dbugs gcig la/ /dum bu sum cu so gnyis dbye/ /de yi cha gcig ye shes rlung / /de bsags 'pho chung gcig gi mthar/ /bde 'byung rkang bcas ye shes rlung / /de bzhin phyi rol nyin zhag drug /ye shes dbugs kyi dbyug gu'i grangs/ /bde 'byung dang ni rkang bcas 'bab/ /nang du 'pho chen gcig gi mthar/ /nga drug rkang bcas ye shes dbugs/ /phyi rol zla ba gcig gi tshe/ /dbyug gu nga drug rkang bco lnga/ /zhag gcig mtha' ru ye shes dbugs/ /drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga ste/ /phyi rol lo gcig mtha' ru niske/ /drug brgya don lnga ye shes dbyug /mkha' ros zhag dril bde 'byung cha/ /bcas ste lo gcig zhag bshol yin/ /de rgyun nang du zhag gsum khongs/ /dus sbyor byed bcas so gnyis su/ /stong phrag bco brgyad ye shes dbugs/ /phyi rol du ni lo gsum khongs/ /phyed bcas so gnyis zla ba'i mtshams/ /ye shes dbyug gu stong brgyad brgya/ /mkha' ros dril nor zhag sum cu/ /de ni zla gcig bshol du grub/ /de rgyun nang du zla ba gnyis/ /zhag lnga mtshams su nyin zhag gnyis/ /ye shes dbugs kyi zhag lhag 'gyur/ /phyi rol lo grangs re lnga'i mthar/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam bshol zla ba/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i tshad du longs/ /rgyun dpe lo brgyar ye shes dbugs/ /lo gsum mchog gsum tshad bzhag gsungs/ /slob dpon gsung gi gces pa'i phyir/ /skabs 'dir don la 'byor bas bris/ /yang ni bdag gis rnam rtog tu/ /lte ba'i bar 'dab rtsa 'khor gang glu/ /bcu gnyis khyim dang dus sbyor ba/ /rtsa ba'i lo skor nyid dang ni/ /phyi 'khor rgyu ba'i rtsa drug cu/ /'byung dbye lo rgan drug cur mthun/ /de bzhin gtsug lag 'phrul rtsis las/ /shing me chu lcags phyogs rim yang / /dus 'khor shar rlung lho me dang / /byang chu nub sar gsungs dang mthun/ /dbus kyi sa yang dus 'khor las/ /ri rab nyid ste nam mkha'i khams/ /de la sogs te rnam grangs 'ga'/ /mthun par bsgrigs su rung mthong mdo/ /'on kyang bsdus te 'chad skabs 'dir/ /dogs slang tsam las rgyas ma sprosaglu/ /de ltar thun mong rig pa'i gnas/ /skar rtsis dag la gzhugs pa dang / /thun mong ma yin gdul bya gang ske/ /mos pa tha dad bzung ba'i phyir/ /bdag cag ston mchog sangs rgyas kyi/ /nang dang gzhan du rab sbyor ba'i/ /phyi yi dus kyi 'khor lo che/ /legs gsung de la gzhol 'dod pa/ /rtsis pa gsar bu'i blo can laske/ /kun tu phan par byed pa'i gtam/ /spyi don rnam grangs slob pa'i mdo/ /cung zad tsam zhig bshad zin no/ /su zhig skar rtsis ri mo la/ /zhugs pas thog mtha' kun tu ni/ /go don 'khrul med ngo sprod gces—/ /gzhan ni rnam pa tsam du zad/ /de phyir thog mar rnam grangs mdo/ /blor chud slob dpon gsung ngag las/ /brda' don tshul bzhin go gyur tshe/ /des kyang mkhas nus sbyin par byed/ /su gang go don ma 34

'phrod bzhin/ /tshig tsam la ni sbyor 'dod byed/ /ne tso'i bklag brdar nyid du gyur/ /de bas don la reg par bya/ /tshig tsam yang ni mi 'dzin zhes/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel mi brtsi gang / /ches rmongs phyugs 'dra'i skye bo nyid/ /de bas rig lam 'dir gus bya/ /yin lugs sems la ma nges pa'i/ /bri sub ri mo cher rkyen yang ske/ /thal bar srin po'i shul rjes 'dra/ /de bas don la mtshon par bya/ /chos kun zung 'jug ma shes par / /thun mong gtsug lag spang byed ni/ /rab rib mig gi gzugs brnyan mtshungs/ /de bas rten 'brel don shes bya/ /sems can las su ma rtogs pa/ /gza' skar bde 'bras kho na la/ /zhen pa mu stegs byed pa nyidaske/ /de bas sems kyi las shes bya/ /nang gi de nyid mi shes par/ /phyi rol skar rtsis mkhas gyur kyang / /gnag rdzi rgad po'i tshul la 'jug /de bas rnal 'byor yongs shes bya/ /tshe 'di'i khengs grags kho na'i dbang —/ /thun mong rig par 'beb pa ni/ /khe bun byed pa'i tshogs pa ste/ /de bas lhag bsam dag pa bya/ /bka' la dngas ba ma thob pa/ /tha snyad rig gnas cher 'byongs kyang / /gnas skabs phar rtsal mkhas pa bzhin—/ /de bas chos la rab dad bya/ /sangs rgyas thob 'dod sems bskyed kyi/ /ma zin sgo gsum ngal kun yang / /don med byis pa'i rtsed mo nyid/ /de bas byang chen rgyur bsngo bya/ /de ltar bshad na rings shig b.raske//'dzad par mi nus 'dir des chog /skabs 'dir don la sbyor ba'i slad/ /cung zad tsam zhig smras pa yin/ /de skad tshe rabs kun tu dga' ba skyes/ /ma rmongs rig gnas yongs la dbang 'byor che/ /rtsis gzhi rnam grangs slob mdo nor bu'i sgrom/ /'dir spel dge bas sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces rig pa rtsis kyi 'jug sgo rtsis bya skar rtsis kyi mtshan nyid la slab pa rnam grangs mdo bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o//'dir smras pa/ slob dang sras gyur 'phags pa'i sa/ /ji bzhin brnyes pa skyes bu yang / /shes bya rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /yang dag mkhas par ma sbyangs na/ /kun shes go 'phang mthon po gang / /dus der mngon par mi thob pas/ /rig pa'i gnas la mkhas slab zhes/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba mchog gi gdamasatso/ /des na rab tu brtson pa'i blo/ /le lo'i skyon gyi ma slad par/ /chos la chos bzhin gus pa yi/ /rig pa'i gnas la 'bad par bya/ /chos bzhin dad pa ma thob par/ /thun mong rig gnas cher sbyang yang ske/ /mu stegs byed kyi mkhas pa bzhin/ /thar la 'jug par mi nus kyi/ /gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /ldog med yid ches dad pa brten/ /de yi bka' la rab dang ba'i/ /dam chos bsrung ba'i lhag bsam can/ /gang gi spyod pa mtha' dag kyang / /thabs mkhas dge ba'i rgyur gsung na/ /thun mong rig gnas bya ba kun/ /thar 'jug chos spyod bzang po mchog /de ltar khong du chud pa yi/ /rig pa'i gnas la gzhol bar bya/ /gzhan ni pha rol phyin theg pa/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu ring zhes smod/ /des na thun mong rig pa kun/ /de bas yang ni cis mi smod/ /yang dag 'bras bu myur 'dod pas/ /don sgom nyid la 'bad 35

par 'os/ /nges don rtogs pa'i rig gnas la/ /spyod kyang rten 'brel rgyan du mdzes/ /de ma rtogs pa'i gang zag gi /rig pa'i gnas kyang spang cha min/ /nang gi yang dag 'jog pa la/ /rtse gcig dag kyang gzhol min cing / /rig pa'i gnas kyang mi slob pa/ /de ni dal 'byor chud zos 'gyur/ /de phyir rig gnas rtsis kyi sgor/ /'jug pa dang po'i blo can rnams/ /mkhas mdzad gzhung rgyas tshig rling zhing / /don mang 'thor thabs blta bas ngal/ /'ga' zhig nyung ches don ma tshang / /kha cig grong rtsis ma dag gtam/ /de yi rtsis pa gsar bu la/ /phan pa dga' ba nyid gyur cing / /des na rnam grangs slab pa'i mdo/ /spyi chings sngon 'gro go don gzhung / /khyer bde gzhan nas mdzad pa zhig /ma mthong bas na dus 'di ru/ /bdag gi blo gros bzang po yi/ /mkhas pa'i gsung las legs btus te/ /tshig nyung don mang rnam dag nyid—/ /gzhan la phan pa kho na yi/ /lhag bsam ut+pal ston zla ltar/ /cig tu dkar bas bkod pa 'di/ /rtsis mkhan rnams la ches grags bzhin/ /rtsis la gzhug pa gsar bu rnams/ /yid mi 'khrug pa ngal so'i stegs—/ /sngon med legs bshad spel legs pa/ /tshes gcig ngag gi dbul sel gtams/ /rang dbang mdzad med rin chen rgyan/ /phun tshogs legs bshad nor bu'i gter/ /don gnyer rnams la skyes bu sbyinaske/ /'di ltar phyin chad byung ba na/ /'di yi mthu ru shes par gyis/ /de skad bskal bzang tshe ring lha yi bya—/ /mkhas dbang gser rir cung zad bsnyen pas kyang / /don ldan rig gnas nor bu'i sgro gshogs brtas / /'di ko blo ldan 'dun par mdzes gar spel/ /'di bgyi dge mthu mkha' mnyam sems can la/ /kun tu phan pa kun tu bzang po mchog /dpal ldan 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i go 'phang gang / /ring min myur ba nyid du reg gyur cig /de ltar rig pa rtsis la 'jug pa'i sgo sngon du 'gro ba rab tu byed pa ri mo'i gnad grangs kyi gnas skar rtsis kyi tshan nyid ste spyi don rim pa gsum du byas pa le mtshan 'di nyid rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mtha' rnga chen chu khyi'i lor skabs gnyis pa yan yi ger bkod pa byas kyang bar skabs le lor gyur pa'i 'phro skabs gsum pa nyid slar shing glang gi lo chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu 'od zer bdun pa dang bi rdzi lhan cig tu spyod pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po'i snga thun skabs su grub par shar phyogs kong yul ljon pa klung bsam gtan spyil bur rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'i legs par sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ 36

tshog /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ji ltar gnas gyur dus kyi dzes pa rjes su dran pa bskyed pa legs bshad sa bon tsam smos pa nyung ngu don gsal rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti sidhi dzī rā dza ku ru rgyu/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che ji ltar gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa rjes su dran pa bskyed pa legs bshad pa bon tsam smos pa nyung ngu don gsal rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba / bla ma rin po che dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal kun bzang dus kyi 'khor lo phyag 'tshal lo jo bo 'phags pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs rjes bzung zhig byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal kun ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma che/ /kun bzang dang po'i mgon der phyag byas nas/ /rgyal bstan rin chen gnas gyur dus nges pa/ /dad pas rjes dran ched du 'dir brjod bya/ /de yang bdag cag gi ston pa mtshungs pa mi mnga' ba/ /mtshungs pa'i zlas dben pa 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs gnas gcig pur gyur pa shākya tog shākya thub pa chen po gang mi mjed 'dzam bu'i gling gi 'gro ba rnams rtsod ldan gyi dus la spyod cing tshe lo brgya par thub pa na dga' ldan gyi gnas nas gzigs pa lngas sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su zhugs shing sku bltams pa dang / khyim na gnas pa dang / rab tu byung ba'i spyod pa dang / bdud bcom zhing mngon par sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'da' tshul sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis su ston par mdzad pa ni/ rgyud bla ma lasaglu/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dgyes rol dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes yongs su grags par gyur pa de lta las/ /sku bltams pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa rnams kyi lo yi nges pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas lugs nyid kyi rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed 37

gzhung mi mthun pa mang zhing mya man las 'das nas ci tsam song gi dus kyang tshul de dang 'dra bar snang zhing / de bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji tsam gnas pa'i yun tshad kyang dgongs pa'i dbang gis rnam grangs du ma can du 'byung ste/ 'dul ba lung phran tshegs dang / gser 'phreng can gyi rtogs brjod/ mdo sde bskal pa bzang po/ sprin chen po'i mdo/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo 'grel/ mdzod 'grel rnams mthun par bstan pa dngos dang btags pa lnga brgya re byas pa lo stong du gnas par gsung ba dang / snying rje pad dkar nas/ dngos stong btags pa lnga rgya dang / chos nyid rang ngo mi g.yo tha dad snang ba'i mdor stong lnga brgya dang / byang chub sems dpa' zla ba snying pos zhus pa'i mdo dang da lta'i dper lo nyis stong byas pa mang yang sum stong byas pa mdo zhes dam pa mchog dag gi gsungs pas nges pa nyid dang —/ byams pa lung bstan gyi mdo thar lo'i 'gyur dang / dbyig gnyen gyi gnod 'joms dang / mche sde'i 'bum ṭika sogs su lnga stong bshad pa sogs mi yi gdul bya spyir btang gtso bo dang / mi ma yin phal pa dang bcas pa'i snang ngo la dgongs shing / gzhan du mi ma yin chen po klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i gnas dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas rnams su ni sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bskal pa chen po 'di ma rdzogs bar chos kyang nub bar mi 'gyur bar klu yi rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor gsungs pa sogs kyis mtshon pa dang / theg chen nges don 'khor lo gsum pa'i nang tshan gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po dang / sngags bla med sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sems dpa' las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yid bzhin rnam par bkod pa'i rgyud las/ sems can kun gyi tshogs chen po/ /ji srid rnam par gnas de srid/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa rgyun mi chad/ /grol ba'i chos kyang nub pa med/ /zhes sangs rgyas mya ngan las mi 'da' zhing dam pa'i chos kyang nub pa med par gsung ba dang / gzhan yang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad nges pa can dang / nges pa med pa dang / nub pa med par gsung ba sogs mang du byung ba'i lung tshig rgyas par 'dir ma spros la/ de ltar bstan pa'i gnas tshad de dag gi steng nas sngon chad dus ji tsam zhig song snyams na/ de yang 'dod pa mang du byung ba kun/ mdor bsdus te bstan na/ rnam grangs gzhan bkod pa dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa de gnyis so/ /de'i dang po la spyir ni bod yul kha ba'i ljong 'dir grags pa'i bstan rtsis rnams/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs la brten pa dang / ma brten pa gnyis su 'du zhing / de yang ma brten pa'i phyogs la o rgyan gyi slob dpon ma hā gu ru'i rnam thar rnams su gdul bya'i mos ngo dang mthun pa'i 'das lo mang nyung sna tshogs pa dag snang ba phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par dka' yang da lta'i grags che ba'i thang yig dag tu mang nyung gnyis kyi mang ba ni/ de bzhin 38

gshegs pa zhi bar gshegs te/ gu ru rin po che bod yul nas lho nub srin po 'dul phyir phebs kyi bar loglu/ sum stong bdun brgya dang nyi shu tsam 'gro ba thang yig kha cig gi dgongs pa dang / nyung ba la lo sum stong chig rgya dang drug la reg nyer song ba thang yig phal che'i bzhed pa ste/ de gnyis phyin chad kyi lo da lta'i bstan rtsis grags che ba dag dang bstun te bsnan pas rag rtsis su bzhi stong dang drug brgya lhag chotsam 'gro ba'am/ yang na bzhi stong dang nyis brgya'i khongs su gnas par snang bas de ltar thang yig las byung ba bstan rtsis lugs gnyis dang / de bzhin bzhi stong chig brgya re gcig (4161)'das pa 'phags mchog chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' chems kyi lugs dang / lo bzhi stong dang nyag ma re dgu (4069)'das pa rdzogs chen sems phyogs la shin tu mkhas pa rta ston gzi brjid dpal gyi bzhed pa dang / sum stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu rtsa bdun (3887)ni nel sa paṇ+ḍi ta yi lugs dang /sum stong brgyad brgya bdun cu rtsa brgyad (3878)'das pa jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha yi lugs su grags shing gangs can gyi dge bshes stod lung pa jo bo tshul khrims/ gsang phu zhang tshe spang chos kyi bla ma snar thang pa rig pa'i ral gri sogs mkhas pa mang po'i bzhed pa ste/ /bod snga rabs kyi rgya nag gi gab rtse mkhan rnams kyi yang 'dod pa 'di dang mtshungs par gnas zhes kha cig nas gsung pa de dang / sum stong brgyad brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga (3875)'das pa ni rgyal po'i gtam gyi lugs kyi bstan rtsis gang bdag nyid chen po dpal sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal bzhes te grags che ba dang / sum stong bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa gsum pa (3723)ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i lugs/ sum stong dang bzhi bcu (3040)lhag nges 'gro ba dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel gyi lung bstan pa'i li yul lugs kyi bstan rtsis dang / rgya nag thang tha dzung rgyal po'i yig tshang dang bstun pa'i lugs la nyis stong bdun brgya bcu zhe dgu (2749)ste mang ba dang / nyis stong drug brgya gya dgu (2689)'das pa nyung ba ste gnyis dang / rgya nag gi yig tshang tsan+dan jo bo'i lo rgyus las byung ba'i bstan rtsis la yang mang ba nyis stong lnga brgya drug cu re brgyad (2568)lon pa dang / nyung ba ni nyis stong bzhi brgya dgu bcu go gcig pa (2491)ste lugs gnyis dang ske/ nyis stong bzhi brgya lnga (2450)bcu tsam 'gro ba rgya nag chos 'byung da lta gsar byung la brten rags rtsis su dpyad pa dang / nyis stong nyis brgya brgyad cu rtsa lnga (2285)'da' par 'dod pa ni bal po'i lam rtsis dang / siṅga la yi nyan thos tshogs nas shing bu bskyur ba'i lo rtsis dang bal po paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrī dang kha che bsod snyoms pa ma hā maṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī rnams kyi bzhed pa mthun pa'i bstan rtsis dang /nyis stong nyis brgya nga gnyis (2252)ni rdzogs chen snying thig mkhan po rgyal ba zhang ston gyi bzhed pa'i bstan rtsis de dag gi sngar phan chad mthong ba rags pa ni de ltar thang yig gi gnyis te gcig tu 39

sdom pas 'dir rnam grangs bcu'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs la brten pa'i bstan rtsis ni/ de la yang rgyal bas bdud rtsi brnyes nas de yi lo phyi mar dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud gsung zhing lo de nas 'das lo bzung ba dang / mya ngan 'das pa'i lo de'am de yi snga mar rgyud gsungs shing mya ngan 'das pa'i lo dang mthun pa'i 'das lo ste lugs srol gnyis byung ba'i/ snga ma'i phyogs la sum stong dang bzhi bcu zhe dgu (3049)'das pa ni 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal ba'i rtsis kyi 'khrul sel du grags pa'i lugs dang / /nyis stong lnga brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga (2575)ni rwa 'bro'i rjes 'brang bar skabs kyi dus 'khor mkhan phal che ba dang / bye brag ni 'di skad ces bya ste/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston rin chen grub/ bo dong 'jigs bral dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs/ de ltar rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs shing rta dang / gzhan yang rgyal bstan gsal byed ji snyed pa/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal dang rtogs ldan/ sgra pa ni bzang 'jam dbyangs chos mgon po/ nyag phu bsod bzang tshur phu 'jam dbyangs che/ thil pa kun rgyal paṇa chen byams pa gling / byang bdag grags bzang rgya phrug dkon rin pa/ /mkhas gyur ri bo dga' ldan pa/ /dge legs dpal dang chos skyong bzang / /rig 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan la sogs te/ /de ltar phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /mkhas gyur spyod ldan dam pa mang po dang ske//rje btsun chen po sgrol ba'i mgon pos kyang / /rnam grangs tshul du 'di nyid bzhed kyang snang / /zhes soglu/ /de rnams nang khul du lo khyad cig tsam re las gzhan khas len mthun pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyis stong sum brgya dgu bcu go gnyis (2392)'das pa rdo rje gdan du nyan thos rnams kyi shing bu bskyur ba'i grangs dang / kam po che'i gling na mgon po'i rgyud bzhugs pa'i lung bstan las byung ba'i lo tshigs ram shing gi rgyal rabs dang bstun nas grub thob o rgyan pas rtsis pa dang / nyis stong sum brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi (2374)tsam lon pa ni rgya dkar gyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus dag dang mthun jo nang rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyis bzhed pa ste/ de rnams kyi lo dag yang / 'dir ni brtag sla ba'i ched du rgyud gsungs pa nas brtsam pa'i lo sogs ma yin par spyir btang bzhin sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo nas bsgrangs bar byas pa ste/ gal te rgyud gsungs pa'i lo dag bsnan par byas na bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'am rtsa bzhi gang rig bsnan bas rtogs par nus pa'o/ /lugs phyi ma'i phyogs la nyis stong bdun brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu (2799)'das lor gyur pa gdan dus kyi rtsis gzhi mkhan po 'brug pa pu re sha ma ti'i bstan rtsis dang / nyis stong drug brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis song ba pad dkar zhal lung du grags pa phugs lugs kyi bstan rtsis steng kong po 'bum rams pa yang 'di'i rjes su 'brang nas khong rgya gar phyin pas bal po paṇ+ḍi ta ku su ma rā dza dang / dbus 'gyur bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bisnud pa zhes dang 'phrad cing 40

de dag gis kyang tshul 'di 'dod kyi yod skad pa'i sgrub byed bcas smra ba dang / nyis stong drug brgya bcu dgu pa (2619)ni mkhas grub g.yung ston badz+ra shrī lugs su grags pa mkhas pa kha cig nas bu ston chen po'i bstan rtsis thun mong min pa 'di yin zhes kyang sgrogs shing / gang ltar phyi ma'i skabs su 'byon pa'i kam 'brug gi mkhas pa'i dbang po dag dang dam pa mang pos kyang bzhed par mdzad pa dang / nyis stong drug brgya bcu bdun (2617)'das pa dwags po paṇ+ḍi tar grags pa'i bstan rtsis dang / nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa lnga (2435)lon pa sems dpa' chen po rang byung zhabs kyi bzhed pa dang /nyis stong sum brgya drug cu re brgyad (2367)tsam song ba ni chags lo gsum par rin chen chos rgyal dang glu/ 'das lo nyis stong sum brgya bco lnga (2315)ste sa skya'i bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa dang nyis stong nyis brgya dang nyag ma bcu drug (2216)'gro ba rong pa ngag dbang grags pa dang / nyis stong chig brgya bco lnga (2115)'das pa ni rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang po'i bzhed pa ste dus 'khor gyi phyogs su bslan pa da lta yan mthong lam du spyod pa la nang gses phra mo rnams/ bzhag nas rags pa ni rnam grangs bcu gsum ste de tsam mo/ /de ltar bstan rtsis 'dir mod tsam re smos pa'i rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun po de dag rnams mdzad pa po'i gang zag dus snga phyi dang mchog dman la dbye ba ma byas par 'das lo mang rim bzhin sngon du byas te bkod pa yin la/ 'das lo'i rnam grangs su gyur pa de rnams thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo de nyid nas rtsam ste da lta rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i blo ngan lcags bya yan chad 'das lor byas pa ste/ slad nas rnga chen chu khyi man rim pas bsnan 'os su shes par bya'o/ /gzhan phra mo nas gzhal na bstan rtsis 'dir smos pa dang bcas pa'i sum cu lhag nges shes pa nyid kho bos mthong mod/ de dag las sngon gyi skabs su dus 'khor gyi phyogs la ma brten pa ni/ jo bo rje dang sa skya pa'i zhal bzhes kyi srol 'dzin ches mang zhing / bar skabs su dus 'khor mkhan spyir btang gi 'dod pa dang g.yung ston badz+ra shrī bzhed pa yang ci rigs pa dang / da lta phyi ma'i skabs 'dir ni pad dkar zhal lung zhes phug lung su 'bod pa 'di yi rjes su 'brang ba kho na shas che'o//des na bstan rtsis gzhan dag ni rnam grangs su smos pa dang / rang rang nyi tsher spyod pa tsam las yongs grags su 'dod cing bzhag pa ni mang du mi snang ngo / /de rnams kyi tshul rnam par bzhag pa rgyas pa ni phal che ba zhig sngar mkhas pa rnams kyi yang yang sgrags pas yi ge mthong sla ba nyid dang / gzhan ni 'dir nyung ngu'i ngag gi brjod pa'i skabs su zhib mor brir ma longs pas slad nas gzhan du ci rigs pa spro bar 'dod do/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i mdzad pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas bzhin/ /rgyal bstan gnas tshul 'di 41

bzhes su yi gzhal/ /mthun min snang ngor don dam rgyal ba rnams/ /mya ngan mi 'da' dam chos char nub yangasaske/ /de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab ngo bo nyid/ /mdo rgyud nas bshad dam pas yang yang gsungs/ /'on kyang ma nges lnga ldan sprul sku'i tshul/ /mchog gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa dang / /smon lam dbang gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyang / /nges bzung mdzad tshe de yang su yi 'gog /bskal pa'i grangs tshad dus kyi go rim dang / /sangs rgyas 'byon dka' dam chos gnas dka' zhes/ /mun bskal sgron me'i bskal par yongs bzhag cing / /rgyal ba tha dad gdul bya mngon sum pa/ /rnam dag lung dang rig pas thun mong ngoraglu/ /rgyal bstan char nub gnas tshul tshad mar grub/ /des na bdag cag 'dren par thub dbang gi /bstan pa'i gnas tshad 'das lo ji tsam zhig /ji bzhin gtan la dbab par bya ba na/ /mkhas gyur dam pa mang po'i bzhed pa'i gzhung / /mi mthun du ma nyid du gnas gyur gang / /gdul bya'i bsam pa skyo bskyed spro bsrings slad/ /de dang de lta'i gdul bya rang rang gi /shes ngo nyid du bden par grub so zhes/ /dam pa'i dam pa 'ga' zhig gis gsungs na/ /de yang legs bshad mchog tu nges par khums/ /'on kyang 'khrul med gtan tshig brtan po dang / /dpal mgon dam pa'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rang 'dod ji bzhin bstan rtsis brjod pa yang / /'gal ba'i skyon du gyur par mi sems mdo/ /de ltar grangs med gtan tshig pad+ma'i brtan 'phreng / /bdag blo'i skyed tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan du snang / /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa brjod pa nyung gsal rin chen sgron me las bstan rtsis kyi rnam grangs ji snyed pa bkod pa'i skabs de dang po'o/ /a tha/ grub pa kun mkhyen kun la sman/ /shākya tog la phyag byas nas/ /rang gi 'dod bzhin bstan pa'i rtsis/ /rnam par dag pa brjod par spro/ /don gnyis pa rang gi 'dod pa'i bstan rtsis rnam par bzhag par bya ste/ /de gang la ston te byas zhe na rgya bod du rgyal bstan gsal byed 'phags pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i gsung bstan rtsis/ ji snyed pa yang nges pa'i sgo nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi 'dul ba'i lung dang mdo sde rnams su dang / dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang / gzhan yang sngags khyad par mchog tu 'phags shing dri ma med pa rnams nas zla ba dang lo yi nges pa gsal bar bstan pa dang / de bzhin rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen por snang ba pad+ma ka ra dang / ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta bye ma la mu tra dang / lo tsā na be+e ro tsa na rnams kyi gsung dri ma med pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams la brton te/ byas pa ste de 'phags yul gyi lo rgyus khung ldan gzhan dang bstun pa 'chad du rung ba'i gnas kyang mthong mod/ 'on kyang dkar rtsis ri mo rnam par dag pa'i lam nas gzhal ba na/ bod yul gyi dus 'khor ba spyi dang khyad par rgyal bas 42

lung brtan pa'i shing rta chen por gyur pa dag gi bzhed pa dang shin tu mthun par gyur pas na gzhan dag the tshom chung zhing tshul de legs par rtogs pa yi skabs 'di nyid du de bzhin brjod par bya ste/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid dga' ldan gyi gnas nas mdo rgya che rol pa nas ji ltar gsung bzhin/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga yum gso sbyongs la gnas pa'i lhums su rgyu skar rgyal nub pa'i dus sbyor la zhugs pa yi lo ni sna tshogs dbyig zhes shing mo sbrul yin la/ de yi sa ga'i sgru bar gza' gnas dbyug nyer drug chu srang bco lnga/ ril po bco brgyadaske/ cha shas brgya dang lnga/ nyi skar gcig chu tshod drug chung chung nyer dgu/ tshes bco lnga'i gza' dag par thig dang / tshes dbyug drug nyi ma dag par skar gnas gnyis dang / chu tshod zhe gnyis/ res 'grog zla skar bco lnga dang / chu tshod zhe drug 'char ba yin la/ de nas zla ba bcu lhag bcas yongs su 'das shing bcu gnyis la nye ba zil gnon zhes me pho rta yi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro res 'grogs zla ba'i skar ma rgyal dang ldan cing rgyal 'char ba'i dus sbyor rkang pa dang por bab pa'i skabs su lum+bi tshal du sku 'khrungs te/ de yang sa ga'i sgru bar/ gza' gnyis dbyug gu bzhi bcu zhe bdun chu srang bcu drug ril po bcu bzhi cha shas brgya dang bcu bdun/ nyi ma'i skar gnas thig chu tshod bco brgyad tshes brgyad kyi rtsis res gza' dag sa la gza' gnas gsum/ tshes longs zhe dgu/ nyi ma dag par skar gnas gcigadabyug gur bzhi res 'grogs zla skar bdun/ chu tshod nyer bdun yod/ rgyal ba dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar du bzhugs shing nyer dgu pa dngos po zhes shing pho khyi yi lo/ de yi smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nam gyi cha stod du grags 'dzin mar sras kyi sa bon bskrun zhing nam gung rgyu skar rgyal 'char ba gzigs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas rnams la phyag mdzad de khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung / de ltar rab tu byung nas zla ba drug gi bar lam tshol bar drang srong sna tshogs bsti ba'i gnas su de rnams kyi lam gyi dka' thub dang mthar thug srid rtse'i ting 'dzin mtha' dag kyang yud res mngon du byas te ljongs dang grong brdal du rgyu zhing gshegs pa'i tshul yang bstan par mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo sum cu pa na tshod ldan zhes shing phag gi lo sa ga'i tshes brgyad la chu klung ne rañdza ra'i 'gram du dka' thub la zhugs te lo drug gi bar du gcig pu dang gnyis su med par mnyam par bzhag go/ /de yi mthar dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa dpa' bo zhes lcags 'brug sa ga'i nya la byang chub shing drung du gshegs te srod la bdud btulaske/ nam gyi gung du rdo rje zla ba dang rdo rje sgra gcan snyoms par zhugs pa'i skabs mnyam par bzhagazla ba sgra gcan las grol la khad skad cig ma cig gi thogs pa tho rengs skya rengs 'char ba rgyal rnga brdung ba'i tshod du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de ma thag tu gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyi ched du 43

brjod pa dang bcas me tog gi char spus nub tsam phab so/ /de ltar zla ba sgra gcan gyi bzung ba'i skabs su sras sgra gcan 'dzin yang yum gyi mngal du lo drug bzhugs nas dus der btsas shing / de yi btsas ston gyi skye bo kun dga' bar gyur pas na kun dga' bo btsas so/ /de yang sa ga zla ba 'di yi sgru bar gza' gnas gsum chu tshod sum cu/ srang nga bzhi/ ril por nyi shu cha shas so bzhi/ nyi sgrur skar gnas gcig chu tshod bcu drug chu srang so gsum/ de yi tshes bco lnga'i gza' dag gza' gnas la bzhi/ chu tshod lnga bcu/ nyi dag skar mar gnyis/ dbyu gur so gcig tshes 'khyud skar mar bcu drug dbyu gur gcig res 'grogs skar mar bco lnga/ dbyu gur bcu gcig sgra gcan bul bar skar gnas nyer gsum chu tshod bco brgyad/ gdong skar gsum/ chu tshod zhe gcig dus me'i skar mar bcu bdun/ chu tshod bcu gcig ste man ngag bzhin sbyangs dor gyi lhag skar gnas thig dang chu tshod po so brgyad shar bas myong rtsis ltar bzhi cha gcig 'dzin pa yin no/ /gzhan mdo sde mya ngan 'das pa chen po dang / bod sngags rnying pa'i bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang dang rgya nag hā shang bsam gtan mkhan rnams mthun par sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad la sangs rgyas par bzhed pa dang / rgya dkar gyi slob dpon dā ri ka sogs ma rgyud smra ba pos ni mar ngo'i tshes bcur sangs rgyas par 'dod pa dag kyang shes par bya dgos la/ 'dir bshad pa ni dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud 'grel 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa'i dgongs pa ste/ de yang dri med 'od kyi dbang le'u yi skabs su/ 'phags pa'i yul 'dir dkar po'i tshes gcig la sogs pa cha bco lnga'i mthar nag pa'o tshes gcig 'jug pa sa ga nya'i skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te zhes dang / sngags gzhung khyad par can gzhan nas kyang 'byung ltar ro/ /de ltar sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun 'das pa na tshangs pa chen pos gsol ba btab bzhin yul wa ra ṇa sir bden pa bzhi yi chos kyi 'khor lo dang por bskor zhing glu/ de nas rim par bya rgod phung po'i rir bka' bar ma mtshan nyid med pa shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa dang / gsum pa ma la ya dang gyad kyi yul la sogs pa'i gnas sna tshogs par phyir mi ldog pa nges don snying po'i theg pa ste gdul bya'i dbang po dang mtshams par 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bstan par mdzad pa yin la/ 'khor lo gsum gsungs pa'i lo 'di tsam zhes dam pa 'ga' zhig gi grangs nas smos kyang rnam pa tsam las ji bzhin dpag par dka' zhing / spyir yang theg pa'i go rim las dus snga phyi kho nar yang 'dod mi nus te gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /de ltar theg pa gsum bstan par mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo bdun cu rtsa dgu bzhes shing / sangs rgyas nas lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga la 'khod pa dga' dbang shing byi'i lo dpyid zla 'bring po nag pa'i tshes bco lngar lho phyogs shrī dhā na ka ṭa kar dpal 44

mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas sogs sngags bla med kyi theg pa mtha' yas pa gsung pa ste/ de yang 'phags 'grel dri ma med pa'i mdo gong gi lung gi 'phros su/ de nas chos kyi theg pa gsum bstan par mdzad nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa nag pa'i nya la/ shrī dhā na ka ṭa kar chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug gi rnam par dbye ba'i mtshan nyid dang / de'i steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar kyi dkyil 'khor drug gi rnam par dbye ba can dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par spros so/ /zhes dang / 'phags 'grel der rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi lung drangs pa yang /bya rgod phung po'i ri chen por/ /theg pa chen po bla na med//shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cheraske/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dam pa dang po dpal ldan rgyud/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i nya la gsungasaske/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /tshes bco lnga'i nyin zhag de la yang bdud 'joms 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dus sbyor dang ldan pa'i skabs su ste tshul de ni dpal nā ro tā pas mdzad pa'i dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel par rtsa rgyud kyi lung drangs par yang / mdun gyi nya ba zla ba te/ /rgyab kyi nya ba nyi ma la'oske/ /g.yon gyi mun can gdong pa la/ /g.yas kyi mjug mar gnas pa na/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal ba/ /zhes bya bdud ni 'joms pa'i dus/ /der ni ston pa shar gyi zhal/ /rin chen seng ge'i khri la bzhugasaske/ /zhes 'byung ba nyid do/ /des na shing byi'i nag pa'i sgru ba gza' gnas gcig tshes dbyug po bdunaske/ srang nyer drug ril por bco brgyad/ cha shas don gsum/ nyi skar nyer lnga/ dbyu gu so lnga/ de yi tshes bco lnga'i rtsis yan lag lngar/ zla skar bcu gnyis/ dbyu gi nyer lnga/ nyi skar nyer drug dbyu gu lnga bcu sgra gcan gdong skar nyi shu/ chu tshod dang bdun/ dus me'i skar ma bdun/ chu tshod nyer bdun mchis so /'dir bstan pa'i ri mo rnams rtsis 'phro lugs gzhan gyi bgyir yod kyang 'phral du yid ches sla ba'i phyir deng dus grags che ba'i pad dkar zhal lung gi lugs su byas pa yin no/ /de yi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya seṅge shar du zhal phyogs pa'i mdun chung zad byang shar du nye bar zla ba sku rgyab nub lho nub nye bar nyi ma g.yas lho shar lhor phyogs pa'i dus me g.yon byang nub byang nye bar sgra gcan gnas pa nyi ma phyi dro seng ge'i dus sbyor la dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen por mngon par sprul/ 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa dang / lha chen bcu gnyis sogs lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs dang / chu bo sri ta'i byang phyogs grong bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gi mi'i 'gro ba skal ldan dpag tu med pa 'dus pa'i dbus su phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku rgyal po zla ba bzang pos zhus pa'i ngor gsungs pa yin la/ der rgyud 'di ma zad rgyud mtha' dag gsung nas phyag na rdo rje la gtad pa yin cing mi dang mi ma yin pa grangs las 'das pa 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ lo de'i phyi ma 45

dgongs lo brgyad cu nye bar bzhes pa khro bo zhes shing glang sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nam gung la gyad kyi yul rtswa can du gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su lhag ma med par gshegs par gyur ste de ni mdo sde myang 'das las gsal bar gsung bzhin rang lugs su bzhag la/ rgya nag bsam gtan mkhan rnams kyang zla tshes mdo myang 'das kyi 'di dang mthun par snang yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo'i tshad gzhan spyi dang mi mthun par don dgu ngo mthong du byas so/ /yang smin drug zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la mya ngan la 'das par byas kyang mi 'thad pa med cing legs par bshad pa'i cha can du snang ngo / /gzhan ni smin drug zla ba'i tshes brgyad nam gung la chos kyi skur gshegs zhes rgya gar gyi slob dpon tshul khrims skyang dang paṇa chen shākya shrī bzhed pa yin la/ bod kyi mkhas mchog bu ston sogs kyi yang 'di nyid khas blang / yang kha cig nas dpyid 'bring tshes bco lnga la mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa dang / kha cig chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lnga yang yin par 'dod pa 'byung ngo / /gang ltar ston pa'i dgung lo'i tshad ni thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngo nyid du ni brgyad cu kho nar gsung ste theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod 'dul ba lung phran tshegs las kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa ni na tshod brgyad cu lon te sku bsgres 'khogs gtugs par gyur te zhes dang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i nub mor kun tu rgyu rab bzang la bka' stsal pa/ /rab bzang ngas ni na tshod nyi shu dgu lon te/ /rab tu byung nas lo grangs lnga bcu lhag gcig tu/ /dge ba gang yin ci zhes gsal bar byas gyur cig /zhes gsungs pas kyang mtshon la/ de bzhin nyan thos 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi dbyar gnas gnas pa'i go rim rnam par bzhag pa na/ bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa lo brgyad cu gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang / bye brag bshad mdzod las/ rgyal ba de ltar brgyad cu la/ /thub mchog dam pa mya ngan 'das/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / theg chen nas kyang de rnams dang mthun par 'byung ste/ ji skad du mdo sde'i dbang po gser 'od dam pa las/ sku tshe brgyad cu zhig thub ste/zhes dang / snying rje pad+ma dkar po las kyang / sku tshe'i lnga cha btang bar bshad pa dang / gzhan yang mdo sde mang po nas mthun par sku tshe'i tshad brgyad cur bshad pa ste de ltar rgyu yi theg chen nas dang / theg chen sngags nas kyang / sgrol ma ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa las/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten la brten nas/ /rkang gnyis mchog gi bstul nas ni/ /lo ni brgyad bcur bzhugs mdzad de/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i gnas su gshegasaske/ /zhes 'byung bas na/ rang lugs su 'jig rten grags sde ltar gyi dgung lo brgyad bcu las mang ba dang nyung ba dag 'dod par mi bya'o/ /gzhan dus 'khor gsung ba'i dus kyang dam pa 'ga' zhig nas/dri med 'od las zla ba bcu gnyis zhes dus tshig gis bstan par brten/ sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo der bzhed pa yod kyang lung tshig de ni rgya nag sogs su ṭi'u yan sngon gyi rgyal po rnams rang rang gi rgyal 46

thabs thob pa'i zla ba de zla ba dang por bzung ba bzhin/ rgyal ba yang chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal thabs mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i zla ba zla ba'i dang por byas bcu gnyis pa nag zla ji snyed pa'i mthar dgongs pa las/ lo de yi phyi ma kho nar bzhed mi dgos pa gong du bshad ltar rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' nye ba'i skabs su bka' chems kyi tshul du gsungs pa nyid do/ /dus 'khor gyi 'das lo yang rgyal ba sangs rgyas pa sogs nas ma yin par sprul pa'i gzugs sku mi gnas zhi ba chen po'i tshul bstan pa nas bsgrang ba ste/ de yang gong du drangs pa'i lung dang / sham+bha lar 'jam dpal gyi chos bstan pa'i dus lung bstan pas kyang gsal ba ste/ ji skad du khams le'u yi 'grel par rtsa rgyud kyi lung drangs par/ lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i los/ /drang srong rnams ni smin don du/ /'jam dbyangs mi bdag grags pa ni/ /sham+bha la zhes bya bar 'byung / /zhes dang / bsdus rgyud nyid las kyang / lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i los/ /drang srong rnams ni smin don du/ /'jam dbyangs mi bdag grags pa ni/ /sham+bha la zhes bya bar 'byung / /zhes dang / bsdus rgyud nyid las kyang / lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i lo yi gsal bar mi bdag grags pa sham+bha la zhes bya bar 'byung / zhes pa dang / ye le'i 'grel par/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyang mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya nas 'byung zhes pa ste/ rgyud dang rgyud 'bral gyi tshig tshad mas grub pa las so/ /tshul 'di la rje rang byung zhabs kyi/ rgyal bas brgyad bcu'i bar dag tu/ /sems can rnams la chos bstan nas/ /dam pa dang po'i dpal ldan rgyud/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i nya la gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di la bar skabs kyi bstan rtsis mkhan kha cig mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo phyi ma nas sgrang ba yod kyang mkhas pa chen por gyur pa rnams mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo nyid nas bsgrang bar mdzad pas/de la ji skad du/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa'i lo/ /de ni 'das lo'i thog ma yin/ /zhes smra ba 'thad pa nyid stetso/ 'dir yang tshul des rig par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba lo brgyad cu la mya ngan 'das pa'i phyi lo zad byed zhes me stag lor 'phags yul dbus 'gyur du nyan thos rnams kyi dbyar gnas pa'i skabs su bka'i bsdu ba dang po byas shing / lho phyogs ri bo'i bi ma la swā bha war 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje dang /'jam dpal dang / byams pa sogs byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag bcu'i theg chen bsdus pa dang /de dang dus mtshungs par byang phyogs sham+bha lar/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje zla ba bzang pos rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa byang chub sems pa'i tshogs dang lha dang klu yi rgyal po rnams kyi dbus su thugs las phyung te rgyud bsdus shing glegs bam du yul bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug so so'i skad du bkod par mdzad cing / rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor lha yi bzo bos 'du byas te bzhengs shing skye bo mang po dngos grub mchog la bkod/ de yi 47

phyi ma rab byung me yos la 'phags yul dgra bcom pa 'od bsrung gi 'phags pa kun dga' bo la bstan pa yongs su gtad de lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das shing / de bzhin sham+bha lar gsang ba'i bdag po zla ba bzang pos dpal mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel bshad stong phrag drug cu pa sogs dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa stong phrag drug pa yang lo 'dir mdzad pa ste/ bstod 'grel gzhung tshig rang gis kyang mtshon par nus la/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud bstan nas nyin zhag kha shas te/ rgyud lasaglu/ sham+bha la zhes rab tu grags pa'i kā lā par ni dpal ldan rgyal po nyi ma 'ga' zhig gis/ lha yi dbang po rab mchog mi yi bdag por bzhag nas khyod ni rang gi gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ zhes nyin zhag kha shas kyi sgra ni lo gsum yin par gsung ba dang / 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi dgongs pa bzhin rtsa rgyud bstan nas lo hril po gnyis kyi skabs su rgyud bsdus shing sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo hril po gnyis rgyud bstan nas lo gsum phyogs gsum lon pa'i dus rab byung me yos lo der sras sa yi snying po'i sprul pa lha yi dbang po khrir bkod de gsang bdag zla ba bzang po rang nyid gang nas 'byon pa'i gnas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po lha dbang ni sa yi snying po yin par gsung na sras sa yi snying po ni rdo rje snying po dang gcig par rgya bod dam pa phal che bas bzhed cing / de yang sa yi snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad las/ sa yi snying po snying po che/ /rdo rje snying po rnam par 'dren/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ste—/ des na kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa yang chos rgyal 'di'i mdzad dam snyams pa ni bdag gi rnal 'byor rtog pa'o—/ /bod sngags rnying pa'i gzhung rnams su lag na rdo rje'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su rdo rje snying por yang gsung mod/ de ltar lha dbang nas rim par sa bcu'i dbang phyug so so'i sprul pa'i sku/ gzi bajid can dang zla bas byin dang / lha yi dbang phyug dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / lha yi dbang ldan te de rnams kyi lo brgya phrag re rer zla ba bzang po bzhin rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan par mdzad do/ /de ltar lo drug brgya 'das pa na 'phags pa smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs 'jam dpal grags pa 'phrog byed seṅge'i khrir 'khod de chos bstan de lo du mas lhag pa'i brgya phrag gi bar chos rgyal snga ma rnams dang mthun par rtsa ba'i rgyud gsung zhing de yi rjes su nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa 'dul byar gyur pa'i mi dang mi ma yin dpag tu med pa'i ngor bsdus pa'i rgyud bstan pa ste/de yang dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal rgyal po grags par gyur te byang chub sems dpa' seṅge'i khri de la chos lo brgya'i bar du bstan par mdzad do/ /de nas lo brgya rdzogs pa'i rjes la de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyi stobs kyi drang srong rnams kyi yongs su smin pa'i dus su gzigs te zhes sogs gsung ba las chos lo brgya'i bar du bstan par mdzad zhes dang / de nas lo 48

brgya rdzogs pa'i rjes la zhes pa ni da ltar snang ba'i glegs bam rnams su 'gyur khyad tsam yang med par thams cad mthun na rjes kyi tshig sgras rtsa rgyud bstan nas lo brgya tham pa'i skabs su bsdus rgyud bsdus pa ma yin pa dang / de yi rjes kyi lo grangs ji ltar 'os pa zhig tu bsdus pa'i rgyud bsdus pa shin tu gsal ba dang / de bzhin rigs ldan rnams kyi lo grangs brgya la sogs pa yang sku che'i tshad ma yin par chos bstan pa'i lo grangs su 'phags 'grel gyi lung 'di'i grub par snang ngo / /don de yi rang byung zhabs kyi bstan rtsis skabs 'jam dpal gyi lo brgya phyung zhes dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pas rtsa rgyud bstan par lo brgya la/ bsdus rgyud bstan par yang lo brgya 'jug pas 'jam dpal gyi chos bstan pa lo nyis brgya yin no zhes gsungs shing mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs pas kyang 'jam dpal gyi dus lo brgya mdzad par grags te 'byin 'jug /de dag mi 'thad pa'i phyogs bzung ba mang yang da lta'i rtsis mkhan rnams rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang rgyal dka'i dgung lo lhag par ring bar 'dod pa'i phyogs las ni 'di ngos ches 'thad cing rigs pas bdag kyang de yi phyogs du 'jug mod/ 'on kyang bsdus rgyud gsungs pa'i yun lo brgya rangs so ni don gyi rnam grangs gzhan gyi dang 'phags 'grel du yang ma gsal bas mi byed la/ 'dir ni rgyal po 'jam dpal grags pas chos bstan pa'i lo grangs spyi dang mthun par lo brgya dang de nas kyang gdul bya drang srong rnams 'dul zhing smin pa'i dus kyi ched du lo sum cu'i bar du bzhugs te de srid du rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan par mdzad nas so gcig pa dbang phyug me glang gi lor dpyid sbo zla'i nya la drang srong rnams drag po'i tshig gi 'dul bar dgongs nas spyo bar mdzad cing / nag pa zla bar rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu'i rjes su bzung nas ka lā pa yi lho phyogs ma la'i tshal dbus su dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas dpal mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud las phyung ba bsdus pa'i rgyud le'u lnga pa bstan pa dang —/ bsdud pa po yang 'jam dpal rang nyid kyi mdzad nas drang srong rnams yun ring por ma thog par phyag rgya chen po grub pa yi zla ba de'i phyi ma sa ga'i nya la ye shes mchog gi sku brnyes par gyur/ de yi tshe sras 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sku pad+ma dkar po seng ge'i khri la bkod de chos bstan par dbang bskur nas 'jam dpal nyid kyi zhing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gnas su gshegs so/ /de ltar 'jam dpal gyi chos bstan pa'i dus lo brgya ni chos rgyal nyid dang / de yi rjes su phyi rol gyi drang srong rnams 'dul ba'i dus gtso bor gyur zhing yongs su smin pa'i dus kyi ched du sku tshe tshad ji tsam bsrings ba'i yun bcas rags rtsis su rigs ldan gyi mdzad pa'i khongs su bsdu 'os par snyams so/ /de nas sras rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od stong phrag bcu gnyis pa la sogs mdzad cing lo brgya yi bar du chos bstan nas de yi rjes su sa bcu'i dbang phyug so so'i sprul 49

sku'i rim pa bzhin du bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang / bshes gnyen bzang po dang / phyag na rin chen dang glu/ khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nyi ma grags pa dang / shin tu bzang po dang / rgya mtsho dang ni rnam rgyal dang ske/ rgyal dka' dang / nyi ma dang / sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla 'od dang / mtha' yas dang / sa skyong dang glu/ dpal skyong dang / seng ge dang / rnam par gnon pa dang / stobs po che dang / ma 'gags pa dang /mi'i seng ge dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / 'khor lo can te grags pa nas 'di'i bar la nyi shu rtsa lnga'o zhes 'gro ba'i bla ma rabs dang dam pa 'ga' yi bzhed pa dang gzhan rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma zhig gi rigs ldan nyer drug tu dgongs shing / de yang rdo rje gdan sa bho ṭa paṇ+ḍi ta tsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyi rgya mtsho dang rnam rgyal gnyis su mdzad ste/ a dza rtsod pa bcu gnyis pa/ zhes rigs ldan bcu gnyis pa rgyal dka' yin pas gsal la/ tshul 'di lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dam pa slob dpon chen po a bha ya dang / rdo rje gdan pa snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa yang yin par grub/ 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ti tsan+das lha yi dbang po dang drag po'i 'khor lo gnyis su gsung zhing / bod du rwa ba sogs skyes bu chen po mang zhig gi ni rigs ldan mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal gnyis su mdzad la/ rgyal ba rang byung zhabs kyi ni/ gnam su dbye ba gang yin mi gsal yang rigs ldan grangs nyer drug tu mdzad doske/ /de dag kyang rgyud las/ sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya pa phyag na 'khor lo 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa 'khor lo can sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i khongs su bsdus pa dang ma bsdus pa'i khyad par dang / gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrangs pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar zhes pa yang gdan nyer lnga por 'jam dpal grags pa grangs pa dang ma bgrangs pas de ltar 'byung ba yin la rigs ldan gyi tha ma lha yi dbang po dang drag po'i 'khor lo gnyis ni 'jam grags pa la sku tshe stod chos rgyal dang sku tshe smad rigs ldan du grags pa bzhin 'di la yang sku tshe'i stod du lha yi dbang po dang sku tshe smad kla klo bcom pa na drag po'i 'khor lo mtshan sgrogs par nges so/ /gang ltar pad+ma dkar po nas 'khor lo can gyi bar rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga'am rtsa drug po de rnams thams cad kyang phal che rags par lo brgya brgya chos bstan par mnyam zhes sngon gyi dam pa mchog rnams kyi bzhed cing de las da ltar rtsis mkhan phal che bas me mkha' rgya mtsho ni rgya mtsho rnams rgyal dang rgyal dka' yab sras kyi chos bstan pa'i dus yin gyi/ de yang rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas chos bstam/ zin nas lo brgyad brgya 'das pa na me mkha' rgya mtsho dbu tshugs shing de nas lo brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyi chos bstan pa'i dus dang / de nas nyis brgya nyer gcig gi bar rigs ldan rgyal dkas chos bstan pa yin la/ de dag bsdom pas gsum gyi lhag pa'i bzhi brgya'i lo tshogs su 50 rtsi

'gyur pa me mkha' rgya mtshor brjod pa'o/ /zhes jo nang mkhan chen phyogs pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba dang ske/ yang dus 'khor ba bar skabs phal che ba dang / da lta yang kha cig gi ni 'jam dpal gyi dus rdzogs pa nas lo brgyad brgya 'das pa yan mthun la/ de nas lo brgya rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyi chos bstan pa'i dus dang / de nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis rigs ldan rgyal dka' yi chos bstan cing / dus der nyung ngu byed pa mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rtsis so nyis brgya nyer gcig po rgyal dka' yi chos bstan pa'i lo lhag bco brgyad dang nyi ma dang / sna tshogs gzugs kyi lo gnyis brgya zla 'od kyi chos bstan nas lo gsum 'das pa ste/ de nas rab byung dang por tshugs par 'dod cing de la rang rang gi thugs bzhed bzhin 'grel chen gyi tshigs kyang de yi rgyab skyor du 'dren no/ /lugs de gnyis kyi rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang 'dir snga mas me lug lor rigs ldan rnams gnon khrir phebs par 'dod pa yi da lta lo bco lnga lon pa dang phyi mas shing 'brug lor rigs ldan ma 'gags pa khrir 'khod par byas pas de nas lo bco brgyad da lta'i lcags bya yan la song ngo / /yang me mkha' rgya mtsho la lag pa gdengs can zla bas sbyangs pa'i dgos pa ni mkhas par gyur pa kha cig gi lo mtshams der spyir 'das lo nyung ba'i slad dang lo tshogs snga ma'i zla bshol gnas der stong pa dang gsal bzhag tshol tshe ri mkha' ri yi lhag dang chu ro'i lhag ma rnams stong bas de nas brtsam na sla ba la dgongs so smra yang / de ni byed pa'i rtsis 'phro nyi tshe kho nar dpyad de bzhag par snang la/ rang lugs ni rtsis 'phro dang bcas par zhib tu dpyad de mtha' chod rgyas par slar gzhan du 'chad par gyur la/ 'di ru rang lugs kyi me mkha' rgya mtsho'i dus kyi nges pa re zhig 'di ltar ste/ rigs ldan chen po 'jam dpal grags pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing du gshegs nas lo bdun brgya 'das pa brgyad brgya pa'i dbus dmar ser can me mo sbrul la rigs ldan shin tu bzang po seng ge'i khrir 'khod cing / de nas lo nyi shu rtsa bdun lon pa nyi sgrol byed shing sprel lor rgya dkar nub phyogs su kla klo zhugs shing me mkha' rgya mtsho'i dbu tshugs/ de nas lo bdun cu rtsa gsum 'das pa gser 'phyang me mo bya la rigs ldan rgya mtsho 'phrog byed khrir 'khod nas lo brgya'i bar du chos bstan par mdzadaske/ der rjes su dbang phyug me mo glang lor rigs ldan rnams par rgyal ba dang dmar ser me sbrul la rgyal dka' 'am ma pham pa sde kun nas lo brgya re chos bstan pa spyi ltar las ma pham pas chos bstan nas lo bdun cu 'das pa da lta skar rtsis mkhan la grags che ba'i rab byung dang po tshugs pa yin la/ de nas lo sum cu song ba me glang la ma pham pa'i sras rigs ldan nyi ma khrir 'khod de chos bstan pa'i dbu tshugs te / de nas da lta la thug gi bar rab byung bcu gcig 'das bcu gnyis pa'i steng nas blo ngan zhes lcags bya yan lnga cu rtsa lnga song zhing / /rnga chen chu khyi 'di nyid lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'i steng du gnas pa ste khyon 51

rab byung bcu gnyis lcags bya yan gyi lo tshogs gcig tu bsdom pas lo bdun brgya dang nyag ma bco lnga sogs la/ de steng chu khyi sogs lo lnga bsnan pas rab byung bcu gnyis rdzogs nas bcu gsum pa sleb pa yin no/ /de ltar rab byung bcu gnyis kyi lo tshogs grangs kyi rigs pa dang / skyes bu chen po lha'i mig brnyes shing ye shes kyi gzigs pa can gyi gsung bsgros kyi cha las byang phyogs bde 'byung gnas cha bsags kyi pho brang seng ge'i gdan la rigs ldan nyi ma nas sna tshogs gzugs dang / zla ba'i 'od dang mtha' yas dpal skyongs dang drug gi brgya brgyar chos bstan zin nas/ da lta rigs ldan chen po seng ges chos bstan nas lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga 'das pa'i skabs yin zhes rang lugs su rnam par bzhag par deng dus kyi bstan rtsis mkhan grags che ba dag gi 'dod pa dang rigs ldan nyi ma phyin gyi chos bstan pa'i dus lo sum cu'i snga phyi tsam las ha cang gi 'gal ba can yang ma yin mod/ 'on kyang 'di la cung zad zhib mor bgyid dgos pa yang yod pas slad nas spro bar bya'o/ /yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyi bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen por/ lha min gyi 'jug pa kla klo'i gnas tshad dub sbyor gyi dbugs kyi grangs dang mnyam par lo stong dang brgyad brgyar gsung nas lo de yi steng nas sngon chad lo stong dang chig brgya nyag bco brgyad 'das shing / /da dung lo drug brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis yod do/ /de yi mthar slar yang 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku rigs ldan chen po lha yi dbang po'am drag po'i 'khor lo can gyi lha min kla klo mtha' dag 'jom par byas te 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di nyid rdzogs ldan la bkod par mdzad pa rgyud las ji ltar gsung bzhin nyid do/ /de yi tshul zhib par sa bon tsam sngar gzhan du bkod pa zin pa dang slad nas kyang 'chad par 'gyur ba las shes so/ /de ltar rang lugs kyi bstan rtsis gnad rnams gsal bar nyung ngu'i ngag gi bshad zin ste tshul 'di la rnam par dag pa'i yon tan yan lag brgyad dang gsum bcas ldan pa ste/ de yang zor yang ba'i phyir bsdus don tshul du tshigs su bcad de brjod pa ni/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ kun khyab 'gro ba'i nyi ma dpe med pa/ /lha chen kun gyi spyi bo'i nor bu yi/ /nyin re bzhin du zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ /nyer bsnyen lha yi lhar gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /ma 'gris yongs kyi bshes gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /shākya tog gyur don kun grub pa nyid/ /dga' ldan gnas nas gzigs pa rnam pa lngas/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhum su zhugs pa'i dus/ /rgya che rol pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin par/ /sa ga zla ba'i rgyal nub dus sbyor dang / /slar yang bcu gnyis la nye zla ba'i mtharaske/ /sku bltams lugs mthun yan lag dang por grub/ /bltams pa'i zla ba dpyid tha dus tshes brgyad—/ /'dul ba'i lung dang mya ngan 'das mdor gsungs/ /'khrungs skar rgyal du rin chen tog las bshadaglu/ /mngon sum 'dir 'char yan lag gnyis par yin/ /khyim nas khyim med rab du byung ba'i dus/ /52

nam gung sgyu skar rgyal 'char de yi tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag mdzad pa/ /ji bzhin gsal byed yan lag gsum par gyur/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dus zla ba sgra gcan gyi/ /nam gyi gung zin tho rangs skabs su grol/ /rnam par dag pa ri mo'i lam nyid nas/ /'di ru gsal 'char yan lag bzhi pa'o//dus 'khor gsung tshe gza' bzhi gnas pa'i tshul/ /nā ro pas mdzad mdor bstan 'grel pa ru/ /dus 'khor rtsa rgyud lung tshigs don ji bzhin/ /'khrul med 'dir mchis yan lag lnga pa yin/ /nyan thos dbyar gnas grangs dang theg chen mdo/ /du ma dgongs don mthun par thun mong ngor/ /thub dbang dgongs lo brgyad cur gsung pa nyid/ /'phri bsnan med 'grig yan lag drug par sems/ /bslad med rdzogs chen bab lugs rgyud gzhung dang / /bstan bcos kun mthun sangs rgyas myang 'das lo/ /shing mo glang nyid nges par brtan por mdzad/ /ji bzhin 'dir 'bab yan lag bdun pa yin/ /'das lo'i grangs kyang sngon gyi dus 'khor mkhan/ /phal che nyid dang khyad par rgyal ba yi/ /rnam 'phrul shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhed pa ste/ /rang bzlog ma bslad yan lag brgyad par nges/ /de ltar bstan rtsis rnam par dag pa yi/ /yon tan yan lag brgyad dang ldan gyur pa/ /'di lta gzur gnas blo ldan 'ga' yod na/ /yid ches skye ba'i gnas su bdag gi brjod/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i bstan 'dir lo yi grangs/ /ci tsam song zhes rtog na 'di lta ste/ /sangs rgyas lhums su bzhugs nas da lta'i bar/ /mi lo nyis stong drug brgya nga bdun song / /bkra shis lum bi'i tshal du sku bltams nas/ /gnyis stong drug brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug lon/ /gang gi bdud rtsi brnyes shing chos 'khor lo/ /bskor nas nyis stong drug brgya nyer gnyis song / /lho phyogs so ba brtsegs pa'i mchod rten du/ /dus 'khor rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis song / /gsang bdag zla ba bzang po'i ngor gsungs nas/ /mi lo nyis stong lnga brgya don brgyad yin/ /rtsa can gyad kyi yul du rgyal ba yi/ /gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings bsdus gdul bya'i don/ /yung 'bru lta bu'i sku gdung rgyas gyur pa/ /de nas nyis stong lnga brgya don bdun 'das/ /rgyal ba zhir gzims rjes su sras slob 'phags/ /rnam mang byon tshul gzhan du yongs shes bya/ /thub chen zhir gshegs lo brgyad chu sprel steng / /rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas o rgyan yul bltams par/ /sngags rnying bslad med gzhung kun mthun par mthong ske/ /de bzhin thub pa gshegs nas lo nyer brgyad/ /lon tshe skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥzhes par/ /gsang bdag mthu yi rig pa 'dzin sde snod/ /tan+t+ra glegs bam legs par bab pa yin/ /rgyal ba zhir gzims sum brgya drug bcu'i lo/ /shing mo glang la dhā na ko sa ru/ /lha bu sems lhag can zhes mi pham mgon/ /rdzogs chen ston pa dga' rab rdo rje nyid/ /'khrungs par bslad med snying thig bas gzhung kun/ /mthun pas 'khrul pa'i dri ma nam yang med/ /sangs rgyas gshegs nas bzhi brgya thams pa'i lor/ /sangs rgyas 53

nyid mtshungs dpal mgon klu sgrub 'khrungs/ /de nas brtsams te theg chen slob dpon ni/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug grags rnams rim par byon/ /'das lo lnga brgya'i steng gnas shing sprel lor/ /'bras bu
