sngags kyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje thod 'phreng mtsho gling pad+ma'i dbus/ /byon zhes rig 'dzin gdung bsgrub rgyud nas gsungs/ /'das lo bdun brgya lon rjes sham+bhar/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi nyi ma'i shing rta'i ngor / /dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud las bsdus rgyud bsdus/ /lo de nyid la longs sku'i zhing du gshegs/ /'jam dpal gshegs nas mi lo bdun brgya dang / /nyer bdun 'das pa shing pho sprel gyi lor/ /byed lo me mkha' rgya mtsho zug de nas/ /da bar chig stong chig brgya bco brgyad song / /de yi nang tshan rab byung dang po nas//da lta rab byung bcu gnyis pa yi nang / /blo ngan lcags bya yan chod 'das pa'i lo/ /brgya phrag bdun dang nyag ma bco lnga lon/ /rnga chen chu khyi 'char ba 'di la sogs/ /rim pas snga ma'i lo la bsnan byas ste/ /tshul des brgyal bstan lnga stong gnas zhes na/ /gnyis stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa gsum lhag /gal te mdo sde zla snying lung ltar na/ /ma 'ongs gnas tshad bzhi brgya nyer gsum gyur/ /'on kyang zla snying dgongs pa sgang lo dang ske/ lnga stong phyed lor byas na phal cher mtshungs/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i ngang tshul ches ngoms 'di/ /lnga stong phyed lor mdzad pa nyid du dgos/ /'on kyang skye rgu'i bdag mo rab byung bas/ /thub bstan lnga brgya nub snga'i rgyur gsung yang / /bstan 'dir mngon par spyod pa gsang sngags kyi/ /rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum phrag ches mang po/ /byung ba'i mthu las rgyal bstan rin chen yang / /lnga brgya phrag gcig ring du bsring 'gyur zhes/ /rnam dag tshad thub lung las gsal 'byung na/ /de tshe lnga stong lnga brgya yongs su rigs//dus 'khor bstan pa snga ma'i gnas tshad la/ /lhag ma rag rtsis bdun brgya tsam du mthong / /de mthar lha yi dbang zhes 'khor lo can/ /seng khrir chos bstan dgongs lo lnga bcu pa/ /zad byed lo mthar drag po'i dpung bcas kyis/ /ngan 'gro lha min kla klo bcad mdzad nas/ /'dzam gling skye dgu'i 'gro la rdzogs ldan gyiske//dga' ston bzang po 'gyed pa'i dbu tsam zhing / /bla med sngags bstan 'ga' yang gsal bar byed/ /kla klo bcom nas 'khor lo can 'khor bcas/ /rang gnas kai la sha ru gshegs byas te/ /mi lo lnga bcu'i mtha' ru rigs ldan gyi/ /byin gyis brlabs pas 'khor na gnas pa yi/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /tshom bu'i tshul du phyag chen mchog grub 'gyur/ /tshul 'di la yang me mkha' rgya mtsho'i yun/ /rgyal kas rtsis gzhi mdzad pa'i dus kyi sgrar/ /'khrul nas rigs ldan gnyis kyi sku che'i tshad/ /nor ba de spang 'di ni dag ldan yin/ /yang ni me mkha' rgya mtsho'i lo tshogs la/ /lag pa gdengs can zla bas sbyangs pa'i dus/ /rgyal dka'i dgongs lo gya gnyis bzhed pa yi/ /kla klo'i gnas tshad stong dang brgyad brgya la/ /rgya mcho'i rnam rgyal nas brtsom drag po'i bar/ /brgya phrag bcu drug rigs ldan grangs grub des/ /gnyis 54

brgya ma tshang sngon du drag po byung / /'gal ba de spang 'di ni dag ldan yin/ /kla klo 'joms dus zad pa me stag dang / /drag pos chos bstan dgung lo lnga bcu par/ /rgyud nas gsung bzhin rang bzos ji bder spyod—/ /de spangs pas na 'di ni dag ldan yin/ /de skad byed pa dag pa'i lo las brtsams/ /'khrul 'gal rang bzo'i skyon spang dag pa yi/ /yon tan gsum dang ldan pa'i legs bshad kyang / /skabs 'di ji ltar nus de gsal byas so/ /'khor lo can sras tshangs dang lha dbang gi /sa yi 'khor lo rgyab dang bdun skyongs nas/ /tshe yang stong dang brgyad brgyar gong du 'phel/ /bstan pa rin chen de lhag ma yang / /chig khri dgu stong brgyad brgya'i bar gnas pa/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen dang / /don yod lcags kyos cha bsags 'jug par gsungs/ /de ltar rgyas bstan gnas gyur dus nges pa/ /rnam par dag 'di sngon nas grub pa nyid/ /dam pa rnams nas legs par mkhyen bzhin du/ /bdag gi las kyi bgo skal 'jog par shes/ /de yang rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos chos kyi rje/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na lasaglu/ /bdag blo'i stobs kyi gzhal ba ma yin na/ /'khrul ba'i dri ma rab tu nyung bar nges/ /'di bzhin gzhan gyi gsal byas ma mthong bas/ /sngon med legs bshad brjod la nyes pa med/ /gal te 'khrul pa'i cha shas mchis srid na/ /bdag blo'i skyon te mkhyen ldan rnams la bshags/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bsam gyi mi khyab yang / /gnas dus 'dir dgongs bstan pa'i yun tshad gang / /ma 'khrul gsal ba nor bu'i me long ngos/ /sra phab gzugs bzhin rgyal ba nyid mthu'i snang / /ces so/ /de ltar rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa brjod pa nyung gsal rin chen sgron me las/ rang lugs kyi bstan rtsis rnam par dag pa bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /da ni rnam grangs shes slad dang / /legs par bshad pa yang mthong bas/ /byed lo me mkha' rgya mtsho yi/ /nges pa 'ga' yang 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang mkhas shing dam pa mchog tu gyur pa 'ga' zhig gi byed pa'i lo me mkha' rgya mtsho'i nges pa rnam par bzhag pa du ma mthong ba de dag gi don sa bon tsam 'dir brjod na/ /chag lo gsum pas rigs ldan khyab 'jug sbas pa'i dgongs lo nga gcig skabs kla klo'i ston pa sbrang rtsi'i blo gros byung bas me mkha' rgya mtsho'i dbu dus der tshugs par gsung ba dang / rje btsun chen po sgrol ba'i mgon pos rigs ldan nyi ma grags seng ge'i khrir 'khod pa tsam ma kha'i yul du kla klo lhag par dar zhing 'phags yul nub phyogs su gsar du 'phel bas sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyang dus 'di tsam du byung bar mngon zhes gsung ste tshul 'di 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig gi mdzad pa'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos rgya dpe las/ lo brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'jam dpal grags pa'i rjes brgyad brgya'i lo steng nas sbyang bar byas pa gzigs gsung ba yang 'di dang gnad gcig tu bab 55

par rtogs la/ grub thob o rgyan pa rin chen dpal ni 'jam dpal grags pa'i rjes lo brgyad brgya lon pa na me mkha' rgya mjo'i dbu tshugs/ rigs ldan nyi mas chos bstan nas lo nyer gsum pa'i skabs zhag gnyis kyi lhag pa'i 'das lo nyis brgya nyer gcig rdzogs/ de la bsre bya rab byung me yos shar/ me yos de nas drug cu skor gsum lo brgya dang brgyad cu gong gi lo dag dang bsres pas me mkha' rgya mtsho shar ba bsre bya rab byung dang po tshugs par bzhed ste/ de da lta'i rtsis mkhan gzhan rnams kyi ni rab byung bzhi pa yin la gang ltar dus der ma ga dha ru kas bcom nas paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bod du byon pa yin zhes gsungs te rab byung de nas da lta'i bar drug cu skor brgyad 'das dgu pa rdzogs nye ba'i skabs te gzhan gyi rab byung bcu gnyis par bzung ba 'di nyid rtogs dgos so/ /rgyal ba rang byung zhabs kyi 'jam dpal grags pas chos bstan pa'i lo brgya dang bcas pa'i brgyad brgya na rigs ldan shin tu bzang gi chos bstan pa'i cung zad kyi sngon tsam nas me mkha' rgya mtsho'i dbu tshugs/ de nas lo nyis brgya rdzogs skabs rigs ldan rgyal dka' khrir 'khod de yi lo nyi shu lon pa na rtsis lo nyis brgya nyer gcig bzhag te rtsis gzhi mdzad pa dang rab byung shar ba dus mtshungs/ /de la bsnan rgyu drug bcu skor gsum lo brgya dang brgyad cu sbyang bya'i ming can du mdzad pa ni kla klo rdo rje gdan du zhugs te yul dbus kyi bstan pa nub pa nub pa'i dus su rgyal ba'i lung bstan par bzhed pa sogs lhag ma grub thob o rgyan pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par gnas so/ /sa skya bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis ni 'jam dpal grags pa'i dus lo nyis brgya yin la de dang bcas pa'i lo brgyad brgya'i khongs su me mkha' rgya mtsho yang rdzogs par 'dod la de la bsre bya'i rab byung dang po ni/ da lta spyi la grags pa'i rab byung dang po nyid dang mthun cing / de tshe rigs ldan mtha' yas kyi chos bstan pa'i dus yin par dgongs shing 'jam dpal grags pa'i rjes kyi rigs ldan rnams kyi chos bstan pa'i dus lo drug cu re mtshungs par bzhed pa'o/ /dpal mkha' spyod dbang po'i zhal snga nas ni 'jam dpal gyi dus nas lo brgyad brgya lon pa na da lta spyi'i rab byung dang po 'di shar ba yin la 'das lo nyis brgya nyer gcig brgyad brgya'i khongs su bsgrangs bar mdzad pa snang ngo / /de ltar me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'dod tshul grags che ba gnyis ni gong du rang lugs bstan rtsis kyi skabs su drang ba dang / skabs 'dir smos pa drug dang / gzhan du 'khrul sel dang —/ gdan dus kyi lugs dang bcas pas khyon du rnam grangs bcur mthong la/ 'dir smos pa drug las rgyal ba rang byung zhabs dang rje btsun chen po sgrol ba'i mgon po'i dgongs pa dag rags rtsis su mthun la de ni gong du zhib mor byed zin pa'i bstan rtsis las lo drug cu skor dag gi dman pa tsam ste 'di yang 'phags yul gyi gtan tshigs mang po zhig dang 'grig pas khungs ldan du rtogs mod/ de lta na yang 56

rang byung zhabs kyi dgongs pa 'chad par 'dod pa mkhas pa chen po kha cig rang byung zhabs kyi bzhed tshulaglu/ deng gi lag rtsis pa spyi dang gza' skar lung ston tshul ches mi mtshungs pa zhig 'byung bar snang bas de la skye bo'i ya kha spang ba skad mdzad nas 'das lo grangs gzhan du kyog dgos byung 'dug kyang rang byung zhabs kyi bzhed pa'i lo bdag me mkha' rgya mtsho sbyangs bzhag gi mtshams ma nor bar rgyud kyi rtsis 'phro sbyin pas gza' skar lung ston tshul sogs mi mthun pa gtan nas mi 'byung yang / ston pa'i 'khrungs lo dang me mkha' rgya mtsho'i bar lo yi nges pa snga phyi cung zad spyir btang tsam dang rang bzhed khyad par dbye ba ma nges pa dang / lo dag nas sbyangs byar dgongs te gsungs pa sgra ji bzhin sems pa byung na 'khrul pa dang / me yos la rtsis 'phro bsre rgyu shing byi la bsre bar dmigs pa sogs ni mkhas pa'i thugs dbyings nas rmongs pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa yin la/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī khro los gsung bzhin shing byi lor bod yul gtsang du phebs par snang yang / grub thob o rgyan pa dang rje rang byung bas me yos lor bod yul mthil dbu ru phebs pa la mdzad pas rags zhib tsam du gyur zhing / lar lag rtsis ri mo la skyon med phyin gtam rgyun tha dad dam rags rtsis sam dgos pa'i dbang gi lo tshigs snga phyi cung zad nur bar de tsam gyi skyon du bzung ma dgos par nyid nas kyang rtsis 'phro 'grig par dgongs gtan tshigs spos pas kyang gsal mod/ 'on te 'dir mang du mi smra yi logs su dpal rang byung zhabs kyi dgongs bzhed yang ji nus zhig mos pa'i stobs kyi 'chad par 'dod la/ lar gyi lo yi skor grangs snga phyi tsam las rnam grangs mang zhig zhib mos byas pa 'di nyid du 'jug pas rgyal ba de yi dgongs par gyur pa yang blo gros zab mo thob pa rnams kyi gzigs pas gsal ba'o/ /me mkha' rgya mcho'i nges pa gzhan rnams kyang mdzad pa po 'phags pa'i sar bzhugs pa dang / tshad ma'i gtam dang ji rigs 'bral zhing 'phags yul gyi dam pa'i ngag sgros can rnams ni dag snang sbyang ba'i yul du bya zhing kun tu gshe bar yang mi bya'o/ /da ni 'phros su deng gi rtsis mkhan spyi la grags pa'i rab byung skor ji snyed song ba'i so so'i dus kyi nges pa sangs rgyas par gzhan du spros bzhin dang 'dir sa bon tsam du grags che ba'i skyes bu kha cig gi dgongs lo'i tshad dang / sbyar te go bder bshad par bya ste/ de yang rab byung dang po shar ba na lo chen rin chen bzang po dgong lo bdun cu thams pa/ jo bo rje nga drug pa/ khyung po rnal 'byor so brgyad/mar pa chu stag lo pa'i nyer drug rgyal ba 'brom nyer gsum pa yin la/ de bzhin rab byung gnyis pa shar ba na myi la sa 'brug la 'khrungs pa'i drug cu thams pa/ pu to pa nga bdun/ rje sgam po pa dgongs lo dgu pa'o—/ /rab byung gsum pa shar ba na/ sa skya'i rje btsun grags rgyal dang / zhang gi gdan sa ba mnyam med 57

shākya ye shes rnams 'khrungs/ sa chen gyi nga drug phag mo grub pa dang karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa dgongs lo so brgyad/ kaḥthog dam pa bde gshegs kyi lo bcu bzhi/ sa skya'i rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo dang dpal stag lung thang pa'i lo drug pa/ 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi lo lnga lon pa yin no/ /rab byung bzhi pa la rgyal ba lo ras kyi dbon tsā ri ras pa byang chub 'bum sku 'khrungs/ dpal 'brug pa gtsang pa rgya ras dgongs lo zhe bdun pa/ sa paṇa nyer drug gter ston gu ru chos dbang lo brgyad pa/ karma pa dgongs lo bzhi pa'o/ /rab byung lnga pa shar ba na tshal pa bka' rgyud lha ri ba badz+ra nā tha 'khrungs/ grub chen o rgyan pa'i so brgyad/ sa skya chos rgyal 'phags pa so gsum/ rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza'i dgongs lo gnyis pa'i skabs yin no/ /rab byung drug pa shar ba na/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje dgongs lo zhe bzhi/ bu ston so brgyad/ jo nang kun mkhyen so drug kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer nyi shu thams pa'o/ /rab byung bdun pa shar ba na/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rin chen dang / lha ri grags pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad dang / zhwa dmar ba mkha' spyod dbang po gter ston dri med lhun po sum cu so brgyad/ shar tsong kha pa rje blo bzang grags pa so gcig bo dong kun mkhyen 'jigs bral bcu gsum/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po dang rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan drug pa/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs lo bzhi pa'o/ /rab byung brgya pa shar ba na/ phug pa lhun grub rgya mtshos pad dkar zhal lung gi 'das lo thog mar byas/ chag lo gsum pa rin chen chos kyi rgyal po sku 'khrungs/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po dgongs lo nga bdun pa/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal ba nga drug gter ston rat+na gling pa'i zhe lnga/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel po bdun/ karma mthong ba don ldan gyi sum cu rtsa gnyis/ paṇa chen shāka mchog nyi shu thams pa/ chos rje go rams pa bcu dgu pa/g.yo ru gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal bcu drug pa'o/ /rab byung dgu pa shar ba na/karma cod paṇa 'dzin pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog sku 'khrungs/gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i nga brgyad/ gtsang smyon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nga drug dbus smyon kun dga' bzang po lnga bcu thams pa yin no/ /rab byung bcu pa shar ba na/ sgam po bkra shis rnam rgyal lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa/ zur mkhar mtsho byed blo gros rgyal po lnga bcu nga dgu pa/ 'phrang mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer lnga bcu thams pa/ mi pham pa pad+ma dkar po bzhi cu zhe gcig pa/ rig 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan dgongs lo bcu drug pa/ karma dbang phyug rdo rje bcu bzhi pa'o/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa shar ba na jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa rin 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po bzhi bcu zhe gsum/ sgam po nor bu rgyan pa'i so dgu/ karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje nyer gsum/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dgongs lo bcu thams 58

pa'oglu/ /rab byung bcu gnyis pa shar ba na/ sgam po sprul sku bzang po rdo rje nga gnyis pa/ yong dge gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje dang byang bdag pad+ma 'phrin las kyi zhe bdun/ tre bo chos kyi dbang po so lnga/ karma pa bcu gcig ye shes rdo rjes dgongs lo bcu gnyis pa yin no/ /da lta'i cha khyi 'di nas lo lnga 'das pa/rab byung bcu gsum pa shar ba na/ kun mkhyen si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dgongs lo zhe brgyad pa/rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs dgongs lo bzhi bcu/ 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che rgyal dbang 'phrin las shing rta dang dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba yi dgongs lo sum cu thams pa/ karma cod paṇa 'dzin bcu gsum 'byon par gsungs pa'i mtha' ma bdud 'dul rdo rje'i dgongs lo bco lnga'i steng du sleb par 'gyur ba ste skyes bu chen po de rnams sku tshe brtan par gyur cig /'dir smras pa/ de ltar dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog /dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud chen las/ /phyi yi dus 'khor skar rtsis gsungs pa'i skabs/ /rnam par sbyangs dang nges par bzhag pa yi/ /byed pa'i lo dag me mkha' rgya mtsho zhes/ /dgongs pa don dang ldan pas gsung ba dang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi 'grel par legs bkral yang / /zab brling rdo rje'i tshigs su gyur pas ni/ /bod yul 'dir byon mkhas pa'i dbang phyug che/ /skyes mchog mang pos 'dod tshul du ma dang / /'phags yul du yang bdag nyid chen po mchog /'ga' yang bzhed pa tha dad gnas par mngon/ /'phags chen go 'phang nges brnyes dgongs pa ni/ /'dod tshul spyi dang ltar snang ma mthun yang / /dgongs pa can rnams gdul bya 'ga' zhig ngor/ /bden par 'gyur bas dag snang bskyed par bya/ /gzhan gyur so skyes rtog ge'i rtog dpyod kyi/ /rigs gras pho tshod dag gi bzhag pa dang / /gtam rgyun ma dag pa'am ma nges pa/ /grags pa'i rjes 'brang skyo ma snga btson dang / /khungs med brdol thabs smra ba yang mthong na/ /don gyi snying pos dbyen pas dor byar nges/ /de phyir dag dang ma dag mtha' gnyis ni/ /blo ldan dam pa rnams kyi rab dpyad 'osaske//'dir ni sa phyogs yangs pa'i yul ris kun/ /dngas ba'i me long ngos su zhugs pa bzhin/ /mkhas bzhed rnam mang glegs bam du ma yang / /bdag blo gsal bas tshig nyung don mang bsdus/ /gzur gnas blo ldan mgu ba'i dga' ston du/ /tshe dbang nor bu dpal des rol rtsed yin/ /de bzhin rab byung dus kyi nges pa yang / /don gnyer blo gsal dang bas blang bar mdzod/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa brjod pa nyung gsal rin chen sgron me las/ me mkha' rgya mtsho'i nges pa du ma 'phro bcas bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /de skad rnam dag rgyal bstan gnas pa'i tshul/ rgyal bka' bla ma'i gsung rten 'di bgyis par/ /legs mchis 'gro bsngo kun mkhyen myur thob shog /nyes bshags dge bar dbugs dbyung rgyal bas stsol/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po 59

che ji ltar gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa rjes su dran pa bskyed pa legs bshad sa bon tsam smos pa nyung ngu don gsal rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal bstan lnga brgya phrag drug pa la 'jug shing rtsis lo rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i blo ngan lcags bya mdzad par nye zhing rnga chen chu khyi 'char bar phyogs pa dbyu gu zla ba'i sher phyogs rgyal ba sum cu rtsa gsum nas 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs pa'i dus chen la thang 'brog 'dol rtse mor dbu btsugs te cung zad re bris pa'i mthar smin drug gi nya ba'i dmar phyogs ches bcu rgyud rtsis kyi nyi ma me zhi'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la kong yul smad gu ru'i gnas chen lkog 'phrang gi mdun chu klung chen po ro hi ta yi 'gram sngon lha btsad pos bzung ba'i yul gtam snyan glang mkhar rdo rings kyi ngogs su grub par bod chen mdo khams dbus 'gyur du chos smra ba'i go sar skyes shing gdod ma nas rnal 'byor par gyur pa tshe dbang nor bu'i legs par sbyar ba ste slar yang rnga chen gyi lo de nyid du zhus dag legs par bgyis pa'i ri mo nan tur gyi grogs ldan 'ga' zhig rang gi slob ma ma dhe pra blo gros rab rgyas pu gyiḥzhes pas kyang byas pa ste tshul 'di la 'bad pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mchog tu gus pas zhugs shing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge'o//dge'o//dge'o//sarba maṅga lo//

༄ga /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skar rtsis kyi 'phro nges par dag pa rtag pa'i longs spyod man ngag grub pa'i go 'byed ches bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ na mo gu ru wa/ na maḥshrī ka la tsakrā ya/ mi shig bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ru/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog ma lus stong gyur te/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba yongs kyi nyer 'tsho'i dpal/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /kun rdzob gza' tshogs 'pho ba bcu gnyis rlung / /don dam dbu ma'i thig ler yongs thim nas/ /'pho med bde chen rtag rtsen stong 'jug mkhan/ /jo nang kun mkhyen rgyal de'i dge legs stsol/ /rgya bstan yongs rdzogs gzigs pa chos kyi spyan/ /nam yang ma smad blo chen rgyal ba'i sras/ /skar rtsis rtag spyod shugs kyi stong 'jug nyid/ /gsal mdzad bu ston zhabs la snying nas 'dudaske/ /don dam nyin byed byin gyis rig pa'i gnas/ /pad dkar rgyas gyur de yi dri gsung gi /nyer 'tsho ra yig gnyis pa kye ri ba/ /gang gi bka' drin dran bzhin 'di na ko /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor gyi/ /rgyud don rnam par dag pa grub pa'i mtha'/ /ji bzhin rtogs par 'dod la rtsis 'phro gang / /stong dang skye ba'i ngang tshul shes bya mchog /de yang dkyil 'khor bdag po bla ma'i mthus/ /tshul de rang stobs nyid kyi legs rtogs mthar/ /mkhas pa gzhan gyi legs bshad glegs bam yang /mthong bas sgro 'dogs chod nas stong 'jug tshul/ /rang gi dran pa'i gsos dang gzhan dag la/ /phan slad rnam grangs tshig tshogs spros bskyungs nas/ /snying po'i don gang rnam par gsal ba nyid/ /nyung ngu'i ngag gi 'di ru bkod par bya/ /de yang lo yi dang po rab byung gi /ngos 'dzin mi mthun rnam pa gsum mthong yang / /bdo dang 'phags yul sngon rabs mkhas pa rnams/ /bzhed pa gcig phyir me yos nyid du bzung / /de yi thog ma zad pa sbo zla'i mthar/ /gza' dgu rgyu skar rdzogs mthar longs spyod pas/ /de tshe rtsis 'phro med pa stong par dag /de la stong 'jug che zhes mkhas pas bzhag /stong 'jug nyid la nges pa skye ba'i tshul/ /me yos lo rdzogs sbo zla'i gnam stong gi /gza' nyi bar sa tshes kyi rkang pa nyid/ /sa 'brug nag pa'i sgru gsum nyid du nges/ /de ltar lo grangs dbang yul brtsegs pa'i mthar/ /bshol bcas nyi ma'i sgru ba rtsis 'phro stong / /bshol bcas nyi ma dag pa'i lo de nyid/ /brtsi bya kun gyi rtsa bar bzung bar bya/ /lo de nyi mas bsgyur bas drug cu skor/ /mthun gyur rab yung nag sgru slar yang stong / /dbang yul lo gang ri mkha' ris bsgyur bas/ /spyi zhag ri mkha' ri yi cha stong zhing / /rig byed sdebs sbyor gnas su so 61

gnyis 'char/ /de tshe gza' sgrur longs spyod gzhan kun stong / /dbyu gur mkha' me gza' gnas dbang pos bzung / /tshogs su rtse mo cha ru zhe gnyis yod/ /tshogs cha ling rtse bzhin bcu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /rtsa ba 'di las gzhan du 'dzin ma dgos/ /dbang yul ri mkha' ris bsgyur gnyis kyi mthar/ /gza' gnas bzhi las dbyug bcas tshes longs stong / /spyi zhag re bzhi'i gnas kyang thig ler dag /dbang yul ri mkha' ri yi lan bcu bzhi/ /bsgyur ba'i lo mthar zla sgru kho na las/ /gza' tshes nyi ma gcig tu stong ba yin/ /bcu bzhi bsgyur lo gsum gyi yongs bsgyur bas/ /lnga bsdus stong pa nyid du dag par 'gyur/ /gong du smos pa'i tshogs cha zhe gnyis kyis/ /ling rtse nyid kyang de ru thim pa yin/ /bsgyur zin lo de gnyis kyi spel ba na//drug cu skor dang thun par lnga bsdus stong / /phug pa'i nyi ma'i rjes su tshogs cha btsal/ /de phyir re mig zhe dgu nyid du grub/ /lnga bsdus stong pa'i lo de sgra gcan gyi/ /ling rtse dang por byas nas rim bsgrangs bas/ /tshes dang zla ba'i mtha' ru lnga bsdus dang / /lhan cig sgra gcan nyid kyang stong par 'jug /zhib mor bshad pa'i tshul de yid bzung nas/ /'phrul ldan rig pas lhag rnams bde blag go/ /bkra shis dam pa srin mig lag pas (851)byab/ /lha yi bla mas lag mig thub par (722)'dud/ /dal 'gro'i gter mdzod gzhon nu thub pas bsrungs(769)/ /zla ba'i sras po ri brag phyogs su ( 107)bzhugasaglu/ /sngo sang yon tan sdebs sbyor rig byed mkhas(463)/ /gza' tshogs dag pa'i 'khor lo de ru bskor/ /de la lo gnas nyi shu rtsa gsum ste/ /zla ba dag pa'i gnas ni nyer gsum yod/ /gza' tshogs mtha' dag stong par 'jug pa'i lo/ /'di las dman gyur gzhan du nam yang min/ /rnam par dag pa nges dag 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /rnam gsal ling tshe dang por 'char ba'i gzugs/ /stobs mchog rkang pa gdengs can zla bas brgyan/ /bkra shis dad pas 'dren byed thub par bltas/ /sgra mkhan sdeb sbyor lag gdeng mig ni mdzes/ /dal 'gro mkha' khams 'dod yon yongs su spyod/ /khu ba 'khrig pa dbang po bsgrod pa gang / /zla bu mda' gdeng srin po'i 'dod yon rol/ /de lta'i yid 'gyogs rdzu pa rkang ni/ /rtsa ba stong zhag 'phrul 'khor shes pas 'grub/ /'di la rmad byung skyes mchog mang zhig gi /rgyud 'grel nyid las gzhan gyur btang snyoms mdzad/ /skabs 'gar blo ldan 'ga' yi dpyad byas kyang / /stong 'jug chu gter che las brgal ma nus/ /phyi ma'i dus su blo chen gzhon dpal bas/ /gzhan rjes 'jug min rtsi 'phro gsar pa phyung / /lnga sgra drag gsum stong 'jug lo yi gnas/ /bcu bdun byas pa yi ger gtan la phabs/ /de yang ke ru lhag sangs sgru ba ka /nyi sgrur cig phyir de stong nges par mdzad/ /tshul des spobs skyes srid bsgrub ltar grags des/ /lhag sangs myur 'phro btsal ba'i gser 'khor ngoms/ /de tshe lha yi dbang pos gdan dus zhes/ /zho thung rus pa'i rtse brgya mngon par 'phyar/ /bdag ni rtsis rig rab byed gdan dus 62

bcasaske/ /kye ri bar thos de yi slobs rgyun yin/ /stong 'jug rang blo nyi rjes spyi zhag 'phro/ /gza' sgru lhan cig btsal byas tshogs cha ril/ /sgra drag zhi gyur dag pa'i lam bzang de/ /srid bsgrub snyems dang bdag gi thun mong thob/ /de ni dpal mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rig gnas bla rabs byin rlabs mthu las yinaske/ /mi chos mngon rlom gyis mi drang po'i ngag /de la mkhas rnams logs so brjod par nges/ /'bad 'di rgyud don nyid la 'jug 'dod cing / /des kyang dpal mgon bla dgyes phyir yin/ /'di ni rang gi 'bad byas dag pa'i tshul/ /cha shas nyid las stong 'jug zhib mo gang / /mkhas gzhan bkod zin mthong bas bdag ngal gyi/ /yi ges ci bya 'dod rnams der shes kyi/ /rang dang skar rtsis slob ma yid gzhung pas / /rgyud rtsis ched du nges dag 'bad bgyis kun/ /don ldan rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /des kyang 'gro kun 'jam dpal dbyangs 'grub shog /zhes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mig dmar shing byi sbo zla'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba dang por shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal byang kong nyang kha ljon pa klung bsam gtan spyil por rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus rang gi rtog pa ji bzhin bkod pa'o//dge'o//dge'o//dge'o//a tha/ rnga chen lo la rang 'dod kyi/ /nges dag phug bzhed mthun mthong nas/ /re mig sna 'ga' bris na yang / /'dir ni khyer bde nyid bkod bya/ /dang po nges dag lo yi gnas/ /skar rtsis kun gyi rtsa ba nyid—/ /nyi sgru dang ni bshol dang bcas/ /thig le chen po'i lo nas brtsams/ /dbang po dus kyi dor byed mtharaske/ /slar yang nges dag thig ler che/ /de la khyim gyi bsnun pa'i sar/ /nam mkha' rlung ri yongs bsgrangs bar/ /thog ma dang ni mthar stong ste/ /drug cu skor dang mthun par 'khor/ /rim pa de yi 'gros nyid kyi/ /lhag ma gzhan rnams shes bya ste/ /de yang stong 'jug ri mig lo/ /zla dag la sogs dkyus bzhin paraglu/ /lnga sgra spyi zhag gza' lnga rnams/ /rang rang cho ga gang yin gyi/ /bsgrub pas rtsis 'phro stong pa la/ /stong 'jug zhes bya btags pa yin/ /gang zhig stong 'jug gcig byung nas/ /slar yang lo grangs der stong 'jug /de tshul shes nas stong chen bar/ /go rim ma nor legs par bzung / /gang zhig stong 'jug ri mo'i tshul/ /ji bzhin ma rtogs rtsis 'phro'i gnad/ /nam yang shes par nus min pas/ /tshul 'di nges par 'bad bya yin/ /de ltar nges dag tshul 'di la/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa yis/ /'bad pa'i dge ba mchis kun kyang / /'jam dpal pad dkar ma pham pa/ /kun tu dgyes pa'i phyir du bsngo/ /des kyang mgon khyod myur 'grub shog /zhes pa yang rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gsum la zhugs pa me yos kyi dpyid gsum shing kha 'bus skabs bod yul dbus 'gyur lha ldan 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang 'dabs bsam grub pho brang du sngar bris pa las zor yang bar gtan la phab par byas pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 63

o ṭ+wāste/ dus gsum dus med ston pa po/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo/ /dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma la/ /yan lag lnga yi phyag byas nas/ /blo gsal rig pa 'dir 'jug la/ /khyer bde rtsis 'phro gsar spos bya/ /rab byung bcu gsum 'char ba'i lor/ /spos pa de ni 'di lta ste/ /byed pa'i rtsis kyi lnga bsdus la/ /rab byung la sogs 'das pa'i lo/ /nyi mas bsgyur la nag pa sogs/ /'das zla bsres pa gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma mig bug mig brgyan/ /dbang ros bgod nor steng du sbyin/ /tshes zla rnam par dag pa'o/ /lhag mas zla bshol nam byung rtogs/ /zla dag gnas gsum steng rim bzhin/ /bzung dang gzung me mkha' dbang gi /bsgyur la steng nas rim bzhin du/ /zla ba nor rtse phyogs rgyan la/ /mkha' ro mkha' ro thub pas sgril/ /de ni gza' yi sgru wa dag /zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma mig /'og gzugs bsgyur la me rtses rgyan/ /dus gnyis bgos lhag cha shas gnas/ /thob nor steng sbyin rgyal ba bsres/ /klu lag gis bgos lhag ril po/ /zla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin/ /mig phyogs klu dbang lag phyogs bsgyuraske//steng nas nyer drug dang zhe brgyad/ /so gsum lnga dang gcig gi brgyan/ /'og nas 'dod ro mkha' ro dang / /mkha' ro 'khor los sgril ba yis/ /nyi sgru rnam par dag pa 'char/ /phyi sgru sgrub phyir snga sgru la/ /bsgyur byed byin sogs spyi ltar ro/ /de nas nyin re'i rtsis 'jug phyir/ /gza' sgru chu tshod bug mda' dang ske/ /chu srang yon tan dbugs gnas mtsho/ /nyi sgru dbyug mtsho srang zla mig /dbugs mda' 'dod pa'i cha shas dgu/ /gang rtsi ches bsgyur gza' nyir sbyin/ /gnyis ka'i bar pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /ril por tshes bsres yid kyi bgo /bsnyed nor bzung ni mi mnyam zhing / /thig mig mtsho rnams mnyam pa yin/ /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung / /zla rkang ri mo rtsegs byas pas/ /dbang 'byung mda' chu g.yon 'khrig gzugs—/ /de ltar bgrangs ba snga rkang dang / /de ldog bgrangs ba phyi rkang yin/ /gnyis ka sdom pa yid kyi gnasaske/ /snga rkang gnas bdun zos zin sdoms/ /phyi rkang gnas bdun gza' rgyu sdom/ /sdom zhes rkang gnas bsre ba yin/ /de yang thog ma go bde'i phyir/ /ma nus bgos pa'i lhag ma la/ /bse rgyu 'dod pa bdag 'char mda'/ /zung dang khyim shar phyogs sdom zhing / /me dang drag por tshes sdom la/ /rgya mtsho phyogs la bu ga bzung / /mda' dang bu gar lag mig ste/ /ro dang nor la rgyal ba yin/ /drang srong de nyid stong pa thig /rkang bzung gang la bab pa de'i/ /gdong mas cha shas bsgyur ba yin/ /ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur/ /bsgyur byed rkang pa gar babs de'i/ /gtso bo yin pas 'phro bsnan skabs/ /de don yid la dran de bya/ /de la dus khyim kyi thob nor/ /yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang ske/ /yang lhag ros bsgyur dbugs yin no/ /yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod de/ /snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang 'phriglu//de nas gza' bar longs spyod la/ /nor mnyam bsnan la mi mnyam phri/ /nyi bar gnas gnyis gcig 64

la ni/ /skar mtshams chu tshod 'byung chus sbyangs/ /ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la sbyangs/ /sbyang shul 'khor phyed lhag na dor/ /dor na byang bsgrod ma dor lho/ /lhag ma'i skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur/ /chu tshod bcug la 'byung me zlas/ /thob pas nyi rkang bzung bar bya/ /ro mtsho bse ru snga rkang ste/ /de ldog rtsegs pa dus kyi gnas/ /snga phyi zos dang mawos sdom/ /yas grangs gzugs mda' dug ma dus/ /mig chu phyogs la me drag sdom—/ /stong la stong pa rnam par dag /rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur/ /ma zin tshe na dang pos bsgyuraske/ /'byung me zla bas thob pa'i nor/ /yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin/ /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang —/ /dus bsgyur dbus su shes pa ste/ /'dod pas bsgyur thob cha shas yin/ /snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phri—//gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du/ /byang bgrod bsnan la lho bsgrod phri/ /gza' dang nyi ma dag pa yin//zla skar phyed la nyi dag gcig /chu tshod gnas su rtag longs spyod/ /mtsho dbang dag ni tshes kyi grangs/ /gang la bab des bsgyur la byin/ /tshes 'khyud zla ba'i skar ma yin/ /de la gza' longs man gyi sbyangs/ /res 'grogs zla skar dag pa 'grub/ /nyi zla bsres pas sbyor ba dag /byed pa tshes grangs 'khrig pas sgyur/ /gzugs dman ri'i bgos pa'i lhag /phyi ma byed pa yin pa ste/ /gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa lnga/ /yan lag lnga ru bzhed pa yin/ /des na lnga bsdus zhes su bya/ /de ltar blo gsal gsar bu lo tshogs kyi/ /ri mo'i ngal ba spang phyir rtsis kyi 'phro/ /gsar du spel ba 'di ko rnal 'byor pa/ /gang gi kun rtog blo yi zer ma yinaske/ /dge bas mi shes dri ma yongs gsal nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgyas pa'i gnas thob shog /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ṭ+wāste/ rgyal ba yongs kyi rab bsngags thub dbang rgya mtsho'i gter/ /dbang bsgyur ut+pal rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'chang ba po/ /snying rje'i chu gter las 'khrungs pad dkar phyag rgya can/ /rgyal ba'i bdag po rgyal dang sras der phyag byas nas/ /dpal mchog dus 'khor phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi/ /phyi yi dus 'khor skar rtsis gangs can 'dir/ /mkhas mang bzhed srol mang yang 'dir rnam dag /rgyud don rgyal ba'i bka' la yid ches kyi/ /mos thob dam pa'i zhal lung nod pa yi/ /des na rnam dag rgyud dgongs rtsis kyi 'phro/ /legs par gsar spos rab byung 'dod pa'i mgo/ /me yos rab byung nas rtsam grangs pa'i lo/ /nyi mas bsgyur la nag pa'i zla ba sogs/ /'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis 'og ma de/ /lag pas bsgyur te bug lag rgyan byas nas/ /dbang dus thob pa steng sres zla ba dag /lhag mar mkha' gzugs shar tshe rim pa ltar/ /snga ma dang ni ngo thog bshol thon shes/ /gza' sgrur bsgrub phyir zla dag gnas gsum bzhag /steng rim zla ba gzugs me mkha' mdas bsgyur/ /gzugs dang klu me phyogs kyi mdzes byas nas/ /'og nas mkha' ro mkha' ro ris dril dor/ /lhag ma gza' sgru rnam par dag pa'o/ /zla dag gnas gnyis steng 65

ma mig gis bsgyur/ /steng ma rgyal ba'i 'og ma me rtses rgyan/ /'og ma dus gnyis bgos thob steng ma bsre/ /steng ma klu lag bgos dor lhag gnas gnyis/ /gza' rkang ril cha'i sgru wa dag pa'o/ /zla dag gnas lnga steng ma mig dang phyogs/ /klu dbang dang ni lag pa phyogs kyi bsgyur/ /steng rim dus (26)mig dang klu mtsho (48)ma rtse (33)//dbang (5)po dag dbogazugs (1)rgyan 'og nas yar//'dod pa dus dang mkha' mtshams mkha' mtshams skar/ /dril dor lhag ma nyi ma'i sgru wa dag /snga sgrur rang rang bsgyur byed ma nor sbyin/ /zla ba phyi ma'i sgru wa rim char 'gyur/ /yang ni rgyud 'grel grub pa'i rtsis/ /gdan dus thun mong lugs bzhed pa/ /bshol 'phro bsgyur bgod 'dra min kyang / /don la gnad gcig zla 'phro mthun—/ /de na gong gi zla dag de/ /gnas gzhi steng rim gzugs(1)/ gzugs (31)me/ /mkha' dbang (50)mkha' (80)klu'i bsgyur byas la/ /zla ba (1)mtsho dbang (54)mda' mtsho (45)dang / /mkha' (120)gnyis brgyan la mas nas yar/ /ri mkha' (707)ri dang mtshams (6)mkha' (60)mtshams/ /mkha' (60)mtshams ri bos (7)dril dor lhag /gza' sgru rnam par dag pa'oske//gnas gnyis steng ma mig (2)gi bsgyur/ /steng 'og rgyal (24)ba bug dus (69)rgyan/ /'og ma dus (126)nyis thob pa'i nor/ /steng sbyin klu lag (28)gis dor ba/ /ril cha'i sgru wa dag pa'o/ /gnas bzhi steng rim mig (2)phyogs (10)dang / /klu dbang (58)ma nu'i (14)bsgyur byas la/ /dus (26)mig bug (29)lag dus (66)mtsho dang //klu rtses (38)brgyan la mas nas yar//ri ro (67)mkha' (60)ro mkha' (60)ro dang / /'khor (27)los dril dor nyi sgru dag /snga sgrur rang rang bsgyur byed sbyin//phyi ma rim char myur 'grub po//yud gcig skabs su shu r+ghaṃ bha waskyo/gser gtsug myur rtsib bde lag rtogs 'dod na/ /spyi zhag gzhung bzhin sgrub byas nas/ /gnas gsum so sor mkha' me sbyin/ /'og nas ri mkha' ri dang ni/ /chu ros dril snyed steng mar sbyangs/ /sbyang tshe mi nor mtshan ma bkod/ /de nas nyi 'byung sme spar gza'/ /mtshan med kun la mkha' me dang / /mtshan can skabs su bug lag ster/ /rang 'khor dril dor rnam par dag /de yang rme ba lug ldog pas/ /mtshan med rnams la gsum 'phri dang //mtshan can skabs su gnyis sbyangs bas//lhag ma nyi ma'i rme bar 'gyur//sarba maṅga lo/shu r+ghaṃ/byed rtsis gnas drug thab pa'i lag len 'od dkar po/ swāste/ dpyod ldan mgu ba bskyed pa'i rdzas/ /mkhas pa mchog gi phyag bzhes yin/ /ma dag byed rtsis yongs spangs te/ /rnam dag byed pa'i rtsis grags pa/ /gnas drug bsgrub pa'i rim pa gang / /'das pa'i lo grangs zla dag rnams/ /bsgrub tshul spyi dang mthun pa la/ /gza' nyir zla dag gnas drug bzhag /gza' yi sgru wa bsgyur byed ni/ /zla ba 66

gzugs me mkha' dbang po/ /thig dang klu dang mtsho sbrul dbang / /steng nas rim bzhin gnas pa'o/ /bsgyur nas rtsis 'phro gang yin sbyin/ /'og nas ri mkha' ri dang 'dod/ /dus dang mkha' ro mkha' ro dang ske/ /thub pas dor lhag gza' sgru'o/ /nyi ma la ni mig dang phyogs/ /klu mda' bse ru yon tan dang / /mkha' 'khrig gyis bsgyur de yi rjes/ /rtsis 'phro gang yin ma nor ster/ /'og nas rim pas ri ro dang / /'dod dus mkha' ro mkha' ro dang / /skar mas 'dor ba'i lhag ma ni/ /nyi ma'i sgru wa rnam par dag /gza' la rtag tu longs spyod ni/ /dbugs yan spyi dang mthun pa ste/ /gza' thig dbyug gur bu ga mda'//srang me dbugs su chu gter la/ /'dod chags thig le ri mkha' rir/ /klu mkha' mig tu dran par bya/ /nyi mar skar gnas dbugs kyi bar/ /rim par mkha' chu zla mig mda'/ /'dod nags nor lha'i ri bo ru/ /yon tan bsgrod par brgyan par bya'o/ /de ltar gza' dang nyi ma yi/ /sgru wa ci ltar bsgrub tshul dang / /rtag spyod longs spyod rtsa ba rnams/ /nges byas lhag ma tshogs cha shas/ /spyi ltar res gza' res 'grogs skar/ /nyi skar sbyor byed yan lag lnga/ /gsal ba'i blo yi ma nor bar/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pas don ldan 'gyur/ /de skad rin chen mchog gis blos/ /grub pa'i mkhas rnams dga' byed kyi/ /gzhung don man ngag go bde sladaske/ /'di bkol dge legs rgyud 'phel shog /zhes pa yang rnal 'byor pa ā yubyin+d+ra ma ṇi'i bris pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ bla ma mkhyen rab dbang phyug la/ /phyag 'tshal zla gzhol nges pa bshad/ /khyim zlar 'das zla rim bsres nyid/ /gnas gnyis tshes zla'i ched 'og ma/ /bzhis spel mkha' me zlas btsal nor/ /gnyis rnyed gyur tshe lhag ma ni/ /gnyis sam yang na thig ler 'gyur/ /thig le 'char tshe 'das zla de'i/ /'tshams su bshol zla rdzogs pa yin/ /lhag gnyis shar na 'das zla de'i/ /dbus su bshol zla rdzogs pa ru/ /mkhas mchog bu ston yab sras kyi/ /bzhed zhes gtan tshig lung rig bcas/ /rnam dpyod yangs bas 'bad de bsgragasaske/ /phyogs snga zla 'phro thig shar tshe/ /'char ba'i zla ba de ka dang / /gnyis shar zla ba de'i phyi ma/ /bshol bar 'dod rnams dga' par snang/ /gzhan ni thig 'das zla dang / gnyis shar 'char zla de lhag zhesak+ṣi/ /rtsis mkhan 'ga' yi 'dod pa ste/ /blo ldan legs bshad gang yin zung / /bshol dang shol gyi zla lhag chad yang / /bod rtsis kha cig gis dpyod mod/ /rgya bal du ni zla bshol la/ /nasta zhes te stong par 'dod/ /zla de'i dus tshes bzang ngan kun/ /stong pas blang dor chung zhes smra/ /de rnams legs par thob pa'i mthus/ /smras las rang bzo tshod dpog min/ /des kyang blang dor gsal ba yi/ /mkhyen rab dbang po myur 'grub shog /zhes pa 'di yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i na tshod ldan snron zla'i dkar tshes dga' ba gnyis par skyid rong phu di wi ku lha mo sgang ṭar skad cig mar bris pa dge'o//dge'o// 67

'od snang rab 'byed las/ zla nyi mthar gnas sogs sho lo ka gcig gi skabs su dogs pa'i gnas kha cig 'di ru dpyad na zla ba dang nyi ma sgra gcan gyi 'dzin nas ji srid ma btang gi bar de tshes gang la byed zhes na/ dang po gzhan lugs dgod pa ni/ kha cig gi zhag bco lnga la byed zhes dang / kha cig gi zhag bcu drug tu 'dod pa dang / kha cig gi tshes de gnyis ka la mi ltos pa ye shes kyi cha yin zhes kyang zer skad la/ de yi 'dod pa dang po ni mi 'thad de/ zla ba cha shas bcu drug yin pa kun nas gsungs ba dang ske/ cha shas bco lnga la gnas pa'i skabs su sgra gcan gyi 'dzin par rtsa rgyud kyi lung gi gnod pa dang /da lta skar rtsis kyi lag len byed pa phal che bas kyang bco lnga'i tshes long rdzogs ma thag par zla 'dzin 'byung bar lung ston dgos pa zhig byas pas kyang 'phral du gnod par 'gyur la/ 'dod pa gnyis pa yang mi 'thad de/ dkar phyogs kyi cha bcu drug pa nag phyogs kyi tshes gcig tu 'gyur ba yang ma yin cing ske/ nag po'i tshes gcig la zla ba sgra gcan gyi 'dzin par gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa yang mi 'thad de/ /ye shes 'ba' zhig pas dbang byas pa'i zla ba'i cha'am tshes gud du yod pa ni lung la yang med cing / mkhas pa rnams kyis yang ma byas pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ zla ba la cha bcu drug yod pa rags pa'i cha bco lnga pa rdzogs/ phra ba'i cha bcu drug pa yi gang ba gang yin pa skad cig da lta ba yi dus de dang sgra gcan gyi mtha' de gdong mjug gi dkyil 'khor de gnas yul dus gcig tu 'dzom pa na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sgra gcan du zhugs par 'gyur zhing / zla ba sgra gcan las sgrol ma thag par nag po'i gcig la phyogs pa yin zhes bya'o/ /don des dam pa kha cig gi bco lnga'i longs spyod dbyu gu'am drug 'phrin las pa'i mtshams su 'dzin par ston pa yang kho bo'i 'dod pa 'di yi phyogs nyid legs par bshad par snang la/ gong gi tshes rdzogs mtshams su sgra gcan zhugs pa dang 'di gnyis kyi gnad don yang gzhan du 'chad par 'dod do/ /des ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yang cha bcu gnyis kyi cha re la chi stong brgyad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'i longs spyod du dbyes pas lhag med dag ste/ de bcu gnyis kyi gsal bar byas pa'i nor chig brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis dang srang lnga bcas ste/ de yang nyi ma phye sa las dbyu gu bcu gnyis srang srog zung dang ri bro'i 'char 'phrin las te/ des rnam par dag pa yi/ de ltar nyi ma'i longs spyod cha shas de lta bu'i mthar yang dag par gnas pa dang / zla ba'i nag phyogs kyi gang ba mthun 'jug bcu drug gi cha dang de gnyis longs spyod mtshungs par lhan cig tu 'grogs pa dag sgra gcan gyi mtha' yi longs spyod gnas yul dus gcig tu 'dzom pa na nyi ma sgra gcan la 'jug par 'gyur ba yin cing gzhan ni ma yin pas nyi 'dzin nyung zhing dpyad dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang des yin par rtogs la/ /gnad zhib mo de lta bu shes na nyi 'dzin gyi tshul la yang mi rmongs pa yin no/ /des na nyi 68

ma sgra gcan las grol pa'i tshe dkar po'i gcig la 'jug pa yin gyi/ ji skad du/ dus 'khor rtsa ba'i da las—/ dkar po nag po'i tshig mtshams la/ /tshes grangs gnyis kyi dbus su ni/ /zla ba nyi ma rnam 'joms paske/ /sgra gcan 'jug pas tshes grangs so/ /zhes dang / bsdus rgyud las kyang / nag dang dkar ba'i tshig mtshams dag la nyin dang mtshan mo'i dus su nyi ma dang ni zla ba 'dzin zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin pa ste/ de yi gnad nang du yang re rkyang gi 'pho ba gcig shos 'gag ma thag pa dang gcig tu 'pho ma rag gi tshig dbus der dbu mas dbang byas pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi cha rgyu zhes pa'i gnad dang mthun par 'di yang dkar nag gi phyogs dang po gang yin pa rdzogs ma rag pa dang phyogs gnyis par reg ma rig tshig dbus der zla ba dang nyi ma la sgra gcan 'jug par kun tu gsung pa yin la/ de lta bu'i tshig mtshams ma yin par sgra gcan gyi gdong 'jug nyi ma dang zla ba'i dbus su gnas mal bcas kyang sgrib par byed pa ma yin no/ /rgyas par man ngag dang gong du ci rigs bstan pa las kyang shes so/ /gsum pa rtsod pa spangs ba ni/ de ltar zla dkar nag rer cha bcu drug nges par dbye tshe zla gcig la tshes zhag sum cu so gnyis su 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do snyam na mi 'jug ste/ dbugs phyed bcas so gsum cha ye shes rlung rgyu yang gnas skabs 'pho ba bcu gnyis nang du bsdu ba dang mthun zhing / gong du zla ba cha bco lnga rags pa dang / bcu drug phra bar khas blang ba bco lnga'i longs spyod kyi cha kun tu rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bcu drug gi longs spyod zhib par zur du phyes pa tsam yin te/ phra ba'i cha de sgra gcan gyis kyang longs spyod pa'i dus su zla 'dzin 'byung zhing de yang zla 'dzin zla ba drug re'i mtshams las mi 'byung ba yang bcu drug gi cha longs phra bas yin no/ /gzhan bco lnga'i longs spyod la gnas pas zla ba 'dzin na zla drug mi dgos par de bas kyang myur du 'dzin cing nyi 'dzin yang mang du 'byung 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /des na cha bcu drug par rgyu mtshan des shes shing rig pa dang / lung gi yang grub pa gong du drangs ba rtsa rgyud dang bsdus rgyud kyi tshig dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi 'grel chen las khyim bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid dang cha bcu drug gi bdag nyid du rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / zla ba'i cha bcu drug gi bdag nyid do/ /zhes sogs yang yang 'byung bzhin dang / he badz+ra 'grel pa rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa las/bco lnga skad cig tsam du stong pa 'bab par byed de/ zla ba'i bcu drug pa ji lta ba de bzhin du rnam shes par bya ba yin gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par 'bab par byed pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes pas kyang zla ba'i cha bcu drug phra bar yang bstan cing / de bzhin mdo rgyud bstan bcos chen po phal che ba nas zla ba cha shas bcu drug pa'i bdag nyid can du gsung ba dang / nyin zhag rags pa'i dbang las cha bco lngar grags bzhin gsungs pa dag la blo ma rmongs par bya'o/ /zhes pa yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus cung 69

zad dpyad de smras pa'o/ /bkra shis/dus rtsis kun gyi rtsa ba gang / /dar bab nad med snyoms pa'i dbugs/ /de la ye shes can gyi lasaske/ /dbye bas zhag gsum rnams su 'gyur/ / 1 de yang nyin zhag gcig longs spyod/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dbugs/ /de la ye shes can zhes bya/ /rags 'bring phra bas dbye ba yis/ / 2 rags pa sum cur bcad pa'i nor/ /dbugs ni bdun brgya nyi shu'o/ /dbugs de drug gi bgos pa'i nor/ /brgya dang nyi shu chung chung yin/ / 3 de ni drug cu'i bgos lhag med/ /nor bu gnyis byung chu tshod de/ /dus 'khor 'grel las zhag re'i rtsa/ /gnyis ro 'gag zhes don 'dir dgongs/ / 4'bring du so gnyis phyes pa yi/ /nor du dbang ri bro ba 'char/ /de la drug cus spyad pa'i nor/ /drag po dang ni rkang pa tshes/ / 5 yang na bcu gnyis gyis bgod nor/ /nga drug rkang pa yon tan 'char/ /de ni 'pho chen 'pho chung mthar/ /'bab pa'i ye shes cha yin no/ / 6 'phra ba phyed lhag so gnyis kyi/ /bgo ba phyed phyir gnyis 2kyi bsgyur/ /phyed (1)bsres drug cu rtsa lngar (65)'gyur/ /bgod bzhi dbugs kyang gnyis (2)kyi bsgyur/ / 7 gong gi bgod pas lhag bzhi bcu/ /thob nor drug brgya re bzhi 'char/ /lhag ma nyer drug gis bsgyur nas/ /re lngas bgos pas 'dod cha brgyad/ / 8 thob nor drug brgya re bzhi ste/ /zhag gcig ye shes dbugs grangs yin—/ /drug gi bgod pas lhag ma bzhi/ /thob nor brgya dang bcu drug gcig / 9 slar yang drug cus bgos pa yi/ /lhag srang lnga bcu nor phyug cig /cha shas gong gi brgyad nyid bzhag /zhag gcig ye shes cha de rnams/ / 10 zla ba gcig ste sum cus bsgyur/ /gong bzhin rang 'khor gyis bgos pas/ /dbyu gu nga lnga srang nyer gnyis/ /dbugs thig 'dod cha drug tu 'char/ / 11 zla gcig dbyu gu rkang bcas te/ /bcu gnyis gyis bsgyur lo gcig ste/ /de yang gong ltar dril ba yi/ /zhag gnas drag po dbyug gur bzhi/ / 12so drug srang dbugs lnga 'dod bdun/ /de dbugs lo gcig ye shes cha/ /de bsags zla ba phyed so gsum//mtha' ru zla gcig bshol phra ba/ / 13 'bring por zla ba so gnyis mthar/ /rags pa sum cu'i mthar zla bshol / /gza' skar zhag gsum stong skye kun/ /rtsa ba ye shes cha 'dis byas/ / 14yang ni chu tshod zhes bya bske/ /dus dang yul du dbye ba ste/ /dus ni nyin zhag gcig gi yun/ /dbyug gu drug cu gong gi dbugs/ /15 yul ni rgyu skar nyi shu bdun/ /dus kyi chu tshod kyis bsgyur bas/ /chig stong drug brgya nyi shu thams/ /gza' rnams de dag la spyod do/ / 16 da ni zhag gsum dngos dbye ba/ /rtsa ba nyid dang gzhan rnams so//dang po nyi mas dkyil 'khor gang / /de la'ang yul dang dus gnyis te/ / 17 thog ma yul gyi zhag gsum niske/ /lo gcig mkha' dus me yi bsgyur/ /de ni khyim gyi zhag grangs yin/ /de la gong du bshad bzhin pa/ /18 tshes zhag bcu gcig chu tshod bzhi/ /chung chung so drug dbugs la lnga/ /'dod yun der bsnan tshes 70

zhag gis/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa 'char/ / 19 de ltar tshes zhag dag pa de'i/ /tshes zhag drug cu thams cad pas bsgyur/ /de la chu tshod bzhi bsre bya/ /slar yang drug cu thams pas bsgyur/ / 20 de la chu srang so drug bsre/ /de yang drug gi bsgyur bar bya/ /dbugs lnga bsres pas bsgyur/ /der kun bsres tshes bsil zhes grags/ / 21 slar yang lhag med dag phyir de/ /('byung me zla lo la/ khyim zhag re myur dag srang du mig byin 'grub/yib par i'o/0(0phro1(5(12(25(840)o swāsti/ bdag cag gi ston pa da ga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'dzam bu gling du gshegs su cha ba sku bltams pa las mi lo brgya yi snga bar gtsang rigs kyi lha rnams bram ze rgan rab tu sprul te rig byed kyi gzhung klogs shing / da ste lo brgya na lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyi yongs su brgyan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'byon par 'gyur ro zhes sogs bsgrags par byed do/ /des na rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rab byung lo yi dang por rnam pa gcig tu ni des bzhag par gsal te/ ci phyir kho bo'i gtan tshig 'dir rab byung de nas go dgu skabs su rgyal ba lhums su zhugs shing / brgya thams pa zil gnon me rta'i steng du bltams pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas kyang dga' ldan nas rgyal bas gzigs pa lnga yi lhums su zhugs par dgongs te sgrags pa na lha rnams kyi bzhugs par gsol yang ma gnang zhing / bdud rtsi rtogs par 'dod pa'i lha rnams yul dbus kyi mi ru nying mtshams sbyor cig par bka' stsal te/ de tshe bar snang gi lha rnams kyi da ste lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sgrags pas rang sangs rgyas rnams bdag cag gi sems can gyi don bya mi dgos kyi sangs rgyas myur du 'byon no zhes wa ra ṇa ser zhi bar gzim mo/ /de ltar mi lo brgya ni dga' ldan nyin mtshan gcig gi bzhi cha ste/ chu tshod bco lnga dang / lo bcu gnyis ni chu tshad gnyis kyi yun no/ /rigs byed smra ba'i dus sku bltams pa las lo brgya yi snga bar byas pa'i khungs rong zom pa chos kyi bzang po'i gsung zhig tu yod zhes sna bar son pa las dngos su rang gi ma mthong bas gtan tshig gi dkyus su bri ma btub/ lo brgya byas pa nges par yod pa bden tshe 'di yang khungs che ba zhig tu rtogs dgos so sarba maṅga lo/nyi ma ldog pa'i tshe nyi bar la/ skar mda' chu tshod mda' chus sbyangs/ skar gnas stong na dbyar nyi ldog 'khor lo phye na/ dgun nyi ldog lhag ma chu me mig gzugs la/ snga dro nyi phyed dgong mo dang / nam phyed stod dang mtho res ldog kha che zla mgon gyi lugs so/ /'dod pa bsres te mkha' mes bgo /rkang pa 'das pa'i khyim byin/ dgur longs dgun nyi nyin phyed ldog gsum long dbyar rnams phyed ldog bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che lo (mi lo chen 1) (stong gcig brgya 2) (stong lnga brgya 3)71

(gnyis stong 4) (gnyis stong lnga brgya 5) (gsum stong 6) (gsum stong lhag 7) (bzhi stong 8)(bzhi stong lnga brgya 9) (lnga stong 10) (lnga stong sum brgya 11) (lnga stong lnga brgya 12) tshe yar 'phel bdun brgya'i bar sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa dang / nub pa med par gnas pa rnams so (4351)rgod ldem pas gte ston skabs kyi 'das lo (380)bsnan mo stag yan (4231)song /o swāsnyi/ grub pa kun mkhyen kun la sman/ /'gro ba'i bla mar phyag byas nas//'phags yul gyi ni pa tra zhes/ /rgya nag ri thur brjod pa gang / /de nyid sbyor dang bkrol ba'i tshul/ /mdo don nyung ngu'i ngag gis soglu/ /bris gzhi dkar shog srab thug dran/ /dri ma nag tshag snum ma gos/ /'jam mnyen dang ba btsal byas nas / /gong khug 'phred stebs ci bde ba/ /che chung rang gi blo dang bstun/ /de la tshal lam san rtsi yi/ /gzhung thig gdab nas steng 'og bcad/ /yang na 'phreng rer re mig gsum/ /shog byang ngos lnga sum cu rdzogasaske//dog na 'phreng rer re mig drug /shog ngos gsum la sum cu rdzogs/ /gsum dang drug yang dper brjod yin/ /de las mang dang nyung yang rung / /gang ltar re mig sum cu'i mtshams/ /zla ba'i bshad pa byed grub kyi/ /sgru gsum sgra gcan bul gdong 'jug /gza' lnga'i dal myur dag pa rnams/ /bri yul sa tshod 'os pa dang / /de bzhin lo bshad mgor mchod brjod/ /ci tsam bri ba'i dkar shog bzhag /re mig dngos gzhir byed rtsis zhes/ /rgyud rtsis iṅka mtshal gyi bri/ /man ngag grub pa'i iṅka rnams/ /snag tshas sngon srol bzang ltar bkod/ /tshes kyi lhag chad gyur pa na/ /chang la re mig zur pa spangs/ /re kha'i ngos bcar hor yig ge /chad bris de khong gza' skar bkod/ /lhag tshe re mig gnyis 'dus dbus/ /lhag bri de nyid ma bde tshe/ /re mig 'og ma'i gdong du bkod/ /byed grub gnyis dkar de bzhin bya/ /byed grub tshes rtsis mi mthun skabs/ /tshes gnas dmar nag iṅka rtsegs/ /mthun tshe byed grub gang gtso bkod/ /des ni byed grub gza' mi 'chol/ /go rim mthun par 'char ba yin/ /bkod lugs gzhan gyi gza' tshes 'chol rgya nag 'byung rtsis lugs nyi ma/ /sngon byung spyi yi srol nyid dam/ /zhib rtsis gser gyi gtsug lag bzhin/ /nyi ma'i kha byang so sor gdags/ /gza' skar 'phrod sbyor spyir btang dang / /khyad par dus 'khor rgyud dgongs bkod/ /bod du sa bdag zin phung dang / /rgya bal res gza' mig dmar 'dzem/ /rgyu skar sgra gcan gdong 'jug gnas/ /nges par 'dzem zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /bod kyi de la yid rtog nyung / /rang lugs 'di la blang dor gzab//

༄ga /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag go la legs par bshad pa nyung gsal rnam dag kun bzang 'od snang rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ a tha swāsti/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag go la legs par bshad pa nyung gsal rnam dag kun bzang 'od snang rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba / dpal ldan bla ma bcom ldan 'das kun bzang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang bde ba che/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin ye shes spros bral chos kyi sku/ /sgyu 'phrul dus 'khor dpal ldan bla ma 'jam dpal pad+ma skyes/ /rdo rje rnon 'chang de la rtag 'dud phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobasaske/ /dus 'khor rgyud dang 'phags 'grel don ci bzhin/ /ma nor legs par gsungs pa'i shing rta cheglu/ /dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar bka' drin mchog /snying nas bsam bzhin gus pas yongs btud de/ /bdag cag ston pa thabs mkhas des/ /dpal mchog dang po dus 'khor lo/ /'jig rten khams kyi dbyibs tshad tshul/ /ji ltar gsung ba de yi don/ /mkhas rnams bzhed pa'i tshul cha shas/ /rnam grangs gyur pa yang mthong mod/ /'dir ni rang gi 'dod pa nyid/ /mdor byas sa bon tsam kho na/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /rnam par dag pa'i gzhung rnams la/ /brten nas gang gi dgongs pa'i don/ /ci tsam nus te brjod par bya/ /spyir ni skra rtse gcig kho ni/ /khyon tsam mkha' la gnas sems can/ /tshad bzung mdzad mtha' dus nam yang / /med par ston mchog de yi gsungs/ /de bzhin sems can bsam pa las/ /rdzas gcig la yang tha dad par/ /mthong bzhin 'jig rten snang ba yang / /du mar mtshungs med mgon pos bshad/ /don des rig byed smra rnams dang / /sangs rgyas pa yi gzhung gzhan dang / /sngags rgyud dus 'khor la sogs par/ /'jig rten rnam grangs can du gyur/ /de las dpal mchog dang po ni/ /rig byed gzhung la yid brtan pa'i/ /tshangs ri skye ba tshogs rnams dang / /gzhan yang phyogs re'i sngon zhen la/ /zhugs pa'i blo ngan gzhigs slad du/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum dag pa dang / /sbyar de 'jig rten khams 'di nyid/ /rags rtsis dpag tshad 'bum bzhir gsungs/ /gang de'i gdul bya'i blo ngo ru/ /stong pa mkha' dbus gdod ma nas/ /rang bzhin ye shes kyi rang gdangs/ /'od gsal mi shig phra ba'i rlung / /thig le chen po 'gyur ba med/ /stong pa chen po yi ge lnga/ /thig le stong pa yi ge drug /rnam pa kun ldan 73

rnam pa med/ /nam mkha'i dbus su kun gyi gzhi/ /stong dang ye shes khams las byung / /srog thur rang bzhin ljang sngo'i rlung / /brtan g.yo kun gyi go skabs 'byed/ /de yi phyogs bzhir 'od zer bzhi/ /nag dmar dkar ser 'bar ba che/ /shar lho byang nub go rim bzhin/ /gnas pas brtan g.yo'i khams kun bskyed / /'od zer nag po mnyam gnas rlung / /de la gyen rgyu 'di ltar 'od zer nag po mnyam gnas dang gcig tu byas pa ni ha mkhas pa gzhan gyi 'dod pa ltar te kho bos ni khyab byed gcig tu byed pa 'thad cing lhag ma rlung drug yang des skyed cing bdun pa ni ma ning du gsung pas ser po 'bar ba'i dbang po'i gzhu dang nag po 'bar ba'i khyab byed gnyis kar la 'jug par kho bos 'dod/ khyab byed sogs gyen rgyu khyab byed dad gyur rus nyal tsang pa gzhu las bya drug yin la nor sbyin ni bdun pa/ /drug dang nor las rgyal ste bdun/ /de ltar brgyad kyi rang rang las /stong par rdul phran cha shas tshogs/ /bsdud 'dzin smin dbyibs las kun byed/ /thog mar stong pa'i rdul zhes pa/ /cha med btags pa de dang ni/ /mnyam byas yang zhing g.yo ba can/ /rdul phran rang bzhin rlung du gnas / /der ldan dmar glog 'od dkar char/ /ser po dbang pa'i gzhu ru gyur/ /de rnams rim pas mkha' la ni/ /rlung rdul 'dab 'byor rlung gi dal/ /lo ka'i rten du chags de bzhin/ /me yi rdul las me dal dang / /chu rdul chu dal sa rdul pa/ /grub pa'i snying po rdo ru gyur/ /rlung me chu sa de rnams zhing / /dpag tshad bzhi gsum gnyis gcig 'bum/ /rang rang 'og gi zheng tshad ste/ /mtha' skor zheng ni gsum 'gyur ldan / /dkyil 'khor gcig nang gcig chug kun/ /srab 'thug stong phrag lnga bcur mtshungs/ /sgo nga phyed gshag 'tshal pa bzhin/ /ri gling las gzhan stong ngos mnyam/ /sa dkyil dpag tshad 'bum gcig pa'i/ /tshangs gnas lhun po'i dkyil nyid de/ /rdo sbom dpang du 'bum phrag gcig /rtsa ba thad kar stong bcu drug /mtha' skor 'gram stegs zheng dang dpang / /stong phrag gcig gi kun tu bskor/ /lhun po rmangs nas rje sbom tshul/ /stong phrag lnga bcur gyen du 'phags/ /de steng stong phrag nyer lnga'i bar/ /gdeng kha'i tshul du phyir gyes shing / /de nas chig khri gdeng ka phyir gyis pa dang nyi khri ngos mnyam pa 'di ni lugs gzhan gyi gnya' shing 'dzin dang don gcig tu 'bab ngos mnyam rngams/ /steng mnyam dpang tshad lnga khrir ldan/ /der brten lhun po'i rtse mo lnga/ /dbus rtsa gong phyed rtse de phyed/ /dpang du stong phrag bco lnga pa/ /rwa bzhi'i zhing de'i phyed cha nyid / /rtse mo dbus las cung zad dman/ /lnga ka 'dab 'byor shin tu mdzes/ /bshos bzlum rtse brag ltar du gnas/ /rgyu ni rin chen lnga las grub/ /in+d+ra ni la pad+ma dmar/ /chu shel karka ta markata/ /rmangs nas rtse mo'i bar du ste/ /phyogs bzhi tshangs las cung zad g.yon/ /de nas de bar mdog mtshungs su/ /kha cig 'dod ltar mdzes pa'ang snang / /rtsa ba 'khor sa nas phyi rol/ /zla ba'i gling dang sbrang rtsi'i mtsho/ /'od sngon ri ste rim pa des/ /'od dkar dmar dang mad+dha yid 'dzin ra/ /ku sha dge ba'i gling zho dang ni ṣāṭā mtshan mo 74

'am rtsi shing can nam tshang tshing can ri/ /mi 'am 'o ma nor bu'i 'od/ /khrung khrung chu dang dro na bra 'o ri/ /drag po chang dang bsil ba'i ri/ /kun kyang shin tu bzlum por mdzes/ /gling mtsho ri rnams kha rgya zhing / /dpag tshad brgyad brgya dang gya brgyad/ /rgyang grags gsum dang gzhu chig stong / chig brgya bcu gcig sor bcu gcig /nas lnga skye tshe brgyad du mnyam/ /ri drug la ni kha khyer tshul/ /dpag tshad so gsum rgyang grags gcig /gzhu 'doms drug brgya dang re drug /khru do tho gang nas drug 'phyar/ /ri drug dpang tshad rgyud 'grel par/ /shugs brtan nyid las dngos mi gsal/ /des na bzhed mi mthun mang yang / /'dir bshad las gzhan gya tshom mo/ /de yang ri drug phyi ma las/ /nang ma'i dpang tshad lhag par 'phags/ /lhun po'i phye man lnga khri ste/ /de nas nyis stong bor ba'i lhag /drug gis phyes pas dpag tshad ni/ /brgyad stong nyid du dag pa'i cha/ /gong gi nyis stong lhun po dngos/ /de nas brgyad stong drug brtsegs pa/ /ri drug so so'i tho khyad ste/ /de yi dang po 'od 'od sngon ri ste gzhan du gshol mda' 'dzin dang gcig par sems la gang ltar rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar dpag tshad bzhi khri brgyad stong sngon ni/ /man+d+rar ste lta na sdug ma dpag tshad bzhi khri thams pa gnyis pa lhun po'i ming can gang / lta na sdug pa mad+dha ra/ /rim ni ṣaṭa sre seng ldeng nag la sum khri nyis stong nor bu'i 'od ste rta sga can la nyis khri bzhi stong / rto ṇa ste rna 'dud pa ma chig khri drug stong des brgyad stong bsil ba'i rim bzhin mu khyud 'dzin dang don gcig go /'og ma ni/ /bsil ri'i dpang tshad nyid du bzung / /de yi rtsa ba nas phyi rol/ /stong phrag nyer lnga sa dkyil phyed/ /khor yug tshul skor 'dzam gling che/ /dum bu pad 'dab ltar bcu gnyis/ /shar lho byang nub go rim gling / /bzlum po zur gsum zla gam dang / /gru bzhi 'bur gyur stong phrag grangs/ /ri klu gza' phyogs dpag tshad ldan/ /phyogs gling kha dog 'byung khams dang ske/ /dag sbyor nag dmar dkar ser 'dod/ /de bzhin ri drug phyi nas rim/ /dkar dmar ser nag 'ja' sngon sbyar/ /chu mthar me'i bzhi ri bdun pa/ /dpang du bdun khri lnga stong rigs/ /lcags len lo ha rdo rje che/ /rdo sol mchog rtsa rta gdong can/ /'bar ba'i rtse mo chu gter khams/ /bras las mi 'da' rab btung byed/ /lhun po'i rtse nas gyen du srid/ /mkha' rim lha nas dpag tshad 'bum/ /snod kyi 'jig rten legs grub cing / /nang bcud sems can rim tshags 'tshams/ /skar gza' g.yo 'degs ci yang rlung / /nyer grub mi yi dus tshogs ston/ /spyir ni gzhom med 'od zer drug /dbus zung bdun gyi snod bcud lasaske/ /mtha' dag stobs dang ldan byed cing / /go la'ang de yi rang bzhin no/ /rgyab kyis sa rdo sa rdo skan ma gsum char la sbom phra gnyis gnyis phyes pas drug dang dbang po'i gzhu bcas bdun yin no/ /skar sbom phra/ /dbang po'i gzhu ste bdun des bskyed/ /g.yon dang g.yas dag de'i char glog /chu me sgra chen dus 'da' nyid/ /lhag mi sangs phur ke ru spen/ /zung bdun rim pas grub zhes gsung / /de ltar 'od snang 'jig rten 75

khamasaglu//tshad dbyims mdo tsam bshad zin to/ /de nas snang srid sems can rnams/ /ji ltar gnas tshul bshad bya ste/ /gzugs med gzugs dang 'dod lha'i gnas/ /mthos dman rgya khyon che chung tshad/ /rgyud 'bral 'gyur lugs rig khyad kyi/ /cung zad mi mthun 'byung na yang / /phyis 'byung mkhas dbang kha cig gi /bshad 'di 'thad mthong de 'di lta//chos bzang tshangs 'das dpal dang ni/ /dkar po'i bskal pa gzugs med gzugs/ /gtsug tor gdong pa'i tshad la'o/ /zad par mkha' rlung me chu sa/ /'dod lha drug yang zad pa ni/ /sgra gcan nyi za'i 'bras mgrin par/ /'on kyang lo tsa'i zhe 'dod 'gyur/ /de dang mi 'gal rang bzhed du/ /bzhag tshe gtsug tor cha bzhi yi/ /'go ma nas brtsams mgrin drug cha'i / /steng bar gzugs med gzugs de 'og /lnga cha 'dod lha 'thab bral man/ /drug cha rdzogs 'tshams ri rab rtse/ /dbus ma sum cu rtsa gsum ste/ /gong du rnam par rgyal khang bzang / /mtha' skor lta na sdug pa'i grong / /ra ba 'bo bdun de'i phyogs bzhir/ /tshal bzhir sa bzhi bzang po bzhi/ /lho nub chos bzang lha mdun pa/ /byang shar yongs 'du dpag bsam shing //a mo nirka'i rdo leb bcas/ /gnas de rnams su nye dbang dang / /dbang po 'dza' bshes 'khor 'bangs ldan—/ /phye mtha' snod sbyin gsang ba'i gnas/ /khyad par ri rab rwa bzhi'i rtser/ /gnod sbyin gsang ba sa yi bdag /lag na rdo rje can gyi grong / /lcang lo can zhes sngags bdag tshal/ /des na rgyud kun bdag po bzhugasaske/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gnas yin no/ /lhun po rtse lnga dbus ma'i 'gram/ /phyogs bzhi'i stegs steng rgyal chen bzhi/ /de thad bar snang steng chig stong / /dbus 'bur tshul mtho 'og chig khri/ /rim gzhol rta gdong ri bo'i bar/ /skar gza' rgyu ba'i go la yin/ /nang gi gling drug longs spyod pa/ /rang 'od bdud rtsi 'bras bus mtsho/ /mun pa las spyod 'dzam gling che/ /bden bral dum bu las gzhan mi/ /'dzam gling chung ngu mchog gi sa/ /'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung ba'i yul/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'khrungs sangs rgyas gnasaglu/ /mi rnams skyo shas nges 'byung 'phel/ /las rnams mthu myur shin tu grub/ /de sogs khyad 'phags gling 'di nyid/ /lho byang nyi khri lnga stong tshad/ /shar nub tshang thig gis bcad dbus/ /ri bsil chu rgyun dkar por nges/ /tshangs gnas lho phyogs 'phags pa'i yul/ /lte ba dbus gyur rdo rje gdan/ /gzhom med byang chub shing gi brgyan/ /byang phyogs cha gnyis sham+bha la/ /lho ngos phal dang byang ngos mchog /kai la sha dbus ka lā pa/ /sprul sku chos rgyal rgyun mi chad/ /lhun po'i rmangs sam sa steng nas/ /mthur gzhal sa dkyil phyed dgos pa'i/ /steng ma gnyis byas rin chen snang / /phyed gong lha min 'og ma klu/ /phyed 'og bsegs ma'i dmyal yi dwags/ /de bzhin chu dkyil dgos steng 'og /bye ma 'dab chu grang dmyal gnyis/ /me gnyis mi zad du dang me/ /rlung gnyis mun pa mun pa che/ /khab rtse'i dmyal yang phyi mar gnas/ /lha min 76

gnas tsam khab rtse'i bar/ /thad dkar sa dkyil rgya tshad du/ /gnas kyi gtso bor gsung ba las/ /'khor yul tshad ni de lhag go/ /de bzhin steng gi lha gnas yang / /mtha' bral yan rgya rgyud 'grel par/ /gsal ma gsungs yang mkhas 'ga' yi/ /sa gzhi'i tshad dang mnyam bzhed snang/ /de yang gtso dang khor yug gi/ /rnam grangs gong ltar kho bos rtogs/ /de ltar snod dang bcud gzhal byed/ /tshad dang dus kyi nges pa gang ske//tshad ni phra rab phra mo'i rdul/ /skra rtse skye rtse lus skyes dang / /nas 'bras sor mo'i bar brgyad 'gyur/ /bcu gnyis sor mtho de nyid khru/ /de bzhin gzhu 'doms de gnyis stong / /rgyang grags de bzhin dpag tshad yin/ /srid gsum bskal pa'i tshe tshad dus/ /srid rtse gnas rtsam rgyal chen bar/ /bskal chen bzhi dang 'bring bcu drug /chung drug rim 'og re re 'phrog /mi ni nges med sa gnas gsum/ /bskal chung chu yi gnyis so 'bring / /mer gnas mchog yin lhag bskal che/ /khab rtse 'jig rten sdud pa'i tshad/ /bskal pa'i yun ni dpag tshad gcig /mchu zheng shin tu mnyam pa'i dong / /yong gang skra rtse mi lo brgyar/ /nyag re phyung zad zhag gcig yin/ /zhag des rim bgrangs lo brgya ni/ /bskal pa chung ngu'i yun tshad 'gyur/ /bskal chung zhag byas des grangs lo/ /brgya yi bskal pa 'bring po ste/ /de nyid zhag byas lo brgya mchog /mchog bskal zhag lo brgya bskal chen/ /de yang dpag tshad dong skra rtse/ /ci tsam de yi sdeb brtags grangs/ /thig le dgu dang de na mig /mda' me nor bro klu mtsho klu/ /me chu 'khrig ro mkha' nor klu/ /klu mig dbang phyug yon tan no/ /de brgyas bsgyur ba thig bcu gcig /grangs gzhan gong mtshungs gnas so gcig /mi lo de snyed bskal chung zhag /des grangs lo brgya bskal chung yun/ /mi lo'i grangs bcas thig bcu bzhi/ /bgrod pa ri ro kha ro lag /dbang po 'byung ba klu drang srong / /thub pa rgya mtsho mig kha ri/ /bu ga me bro nam mkha'i mig /bde 'byung grangs su 'gyur ba yin/ /de sdeb bskal 'bring mchog cha yi/ /mi lo'i grangs kyang rim shes bya/ /bskal lo dus rtsis kun rtsa ba/ /'byung 'jug dbugs yin dbug drug srang / /chu srang drug cu chu tshod de/ /drug cu zhag gcig sum cu'i zla'i/ /bcu gnyis lor longs de 'dra ba / /bcu gnyis lo bskor de lnga rgan/ /de yang rlung gi dus dang ni/ /dkar dmar phyogs dang bsgrod pas bzhed/ /rim pa lo de las sa ru/ /rdzogs ldan gsum gnyis rtsod ldan dus/ /slar gnyis gsum rdzogs 'grib 'phel bskal/ /grangs nas nges pa kun des sbyin/ /mthar ni 'jig rten bsdud pa'i tshe/ /brtan g.yo las rlung kyi nus pas / /chu yi me nyams des sa rdo/ /mthu bral chu yi nang du thim/ /'dres pa'i rlung gi chu skam gyur/ /rlung tshogs nam mkha'i dbus yal stong / /stong ye las 'phrul lo ka'i khams/ /bskyed bsdud de ltar yang ston byedaske//dngos grub mchog gyur gling bdun pa/ /las sa 'dzam gling chen po 'dir/ /'jig rten gnas pa de srid du/ /mtshan nyid lhag nye spyod byed pa/ /go la zhes bya bzlum bskor dang / /sgang gshong sbum khong sa 77

phyogs 'od/ /mtho ris 'dzin sogs don mang bas/ /des na legs sbyar skad nyid bzhag /de yang rlung lam rwa shi khyim/ /bcu gnyis sgang gzhong mtshon cha'i rtsibs/ /lhun po'i bcu cha gcig lhag rngam/ /dbus 'bur mtha' gzhol gdugs kyang 'dra/ /bsil ri rta gdong bar khyon mkha'/ /dpag tshad bdun khri lnga stong la/ /gling gang nyin mtshan mnyam lam nas/ /bltas pas lho byang mnyam mi mnyam/ /spel khyim bkod pa 'od ma'i gzhu/ /pad 'dab bzang ltar drug drug nas/ /go rim lhun po dbus byas shar/ /phyed g.yas lug khyim dbang ldan glang / /byang phyed dang po 'khrig gnyis pa/ /karka ṭa ste rlung seng ge /nub phyed bu mo phyed g.yon srang / /bden bral sdig pa lho byed nub/ /gzhu dang phyed shar chu srin khyim/ /me zur bum pa shar phyed nya / kha dog lug dang bu mo dkar/ /nya dang srang dmar sdig bum nag /glang seng ser la kar 'khrigs sngo/ /gzhu dang chu srin ljang khur 'dod/ /de rnams lho byang zhol 'bur las/ /bkod pa shin tu bzlum por khyir//re rer mtha' bskor dpag tshad ni/ /gsum 'bum bdun khri lnga stong ldan/ /thad dkar chig 'bum nyi khri dang ske/ /lnga stong kun kyang yang dag mthun/ /khyim spyod sgyu skar nyi shu drug /phyed gnyis gcig sdoms nyer bdun ni/ /khyim la zer bzhin 'pho med skad/ /skar ma re la skang pa bzhi/ /dbyes pas rkang pa brgya rtsa brgyad / /khyim rer rkang pa dgu yi tshad/ /de la gza' rnams phan tshun 'gros/ /sgru wa ri ṣi tog bshams tshul—/ /go rim khyim la sgyu skar tshogs/ /de nas gza' rnams nges pa rnyed/ /nyi dkyil thad dkar dpag tshad stong / /bzhi brgya rtsa drug rgyang grags gcig /zla dkyil stong dang brgya phrag gnyis/ /dpag tshad lnga bcu'i tshad can steng / /lha gnas kyi brgyan lha lam brten/ /dal myur rkang pas nyi mas lo/ /zla bas zla rer skar khyim spyod/ /de las nyi tshes khyim zhag thon/ /de yi dkyil 'khor yul dus rtags/ /longs spyod mtha' dag ston pa yin/ /sgra gcan gdong mjug dkyil 'khor mchog /gcig dang bdun par 'khod khyim byed//de 'bral lus mkha' mtshungs rlung rdul/ /rab dngas dra ba gzhu ltar gnas/ /rgyu skar dang ni gza' gzhan rnams/ /bsod nams stobs dman g.yon bskor te/ /stobs dang ldan pa bsod nams che/ /sgra gcan 'gros ni g.yas bskor mjug /zla gnyis mthar gnas phra ba'i cha/ /sgra gcan mtha' dang der 'dzoms pas/ /dkar dmar snang gang gnyis spangs su/ /bden gnyis rten 'brel bzhin 'jug byed/ /gza' skar mtha' dag nyin zhag yun/ /khyim tshad lhag chad bar med sgrod/ /shar nyin nub mtshan gung thun tshe/ /byang myur lho gling 'dir nyi shar/ /nyi khyim dang po lug spyod dus/ /de tshe gling 'dir nyi shar skabasaske//khyim gyi go rim ma 'chol gnas/ /lhag ma tshul de bskor bas shes/ /nyi ma gnas pa'i khyim phyed kyi//skar ma zla ba rangs pas bzung / /nyis lug zla bas nag pa ste/ /gzhan rnams de yi rig pas rtog /dus bzhi'i zla ba'i ra ba bzhi/ /dbyar dgun nyi ldog ston dpyid mnyam/ /gling 'dir mnyam pa dpyid kyi dus/ / 78

shar dbyar byang ston nub gling dgun/ /zhib mor ldog mnyam mkha' dus me/ /bcu gnyis dum bu'i sum cu thob/ /gling dbus chu gter bzhi cha'i nang / /lnga khri nyi lam lho byang zhing / /byang bsgrod brgyad khri drug stong dpang / /lhun po'i rwar snyegs dbyar nyi bzlog /de'i bdun lho bsgrod dgun bzlog mer/ /reg gang bdun khri lnga stong ldan/ /mnyam tshe brgyad khri lnga brgya ste/ /chu gter cha gcig phyi mthar 'gro/ /lho dbus tshangs par chu srin lug/ /sbal srang khyim sleb de ma thag /dgun bzlog dpyid mnyam dbyar ldog dang / /ston mnyam rnam 'byung sa 'di ru/ /de rnams de las zhag du ma'i/ /sngon 'char mkhas rnams myongs rtsis mdzad / /gzhan yang lhag mar gyur pa gang / /mkhas rnams lung rig rtog dpyod kyi/ /gsal byed rab tu grags gyur pa/ /'jig rten grub pa bzhin shes bya/ /de ltar dus 'khor 'jig rten khams/ /go la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul/ /rgyud dgongs 'phags 'grel don ji bzhin/ /ston mkhas rje btsun mchog rnams la/ /snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /rab tu gsal bar byas pa yin/ /des na grags pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /bskyar te bzlog pa kho na min/ /rigs pas gsar rtags 'ba' zhig gi /lung dang 'gal ba yang ma byas/ /mtha' spang dbu ma la gnas gtam/ /'di ko bla ma'i byin rlabs ngos/ /bdag ni pha rol 'gro ba na/ /shes bya 'di yang rang lus la/ /nub med spyod ldan dga' byed phyir/ /yi ge yid bzhin rtsas su bzhag /gal te bdag blos 'khrul gyur na/ /rten 'brel snod bcud gzigs pa yi/ /mngon shes lnga ldan mkhas la bshags/ /des kyang dge ba'i dbugs dbyung stsol/ /legs par bshad pa 'phags pa mchog gi gsungasatso/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od zer mthu la rten/ /snang ba'i gnas lugs rab rib med pa ru/ /rab tu gsal bar byed gang rmad du gyur/ /'di bgyis dge ba'i cha shas tsam mchis de kun kyang / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun tu mkhas pa'i mchog dang phul/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs skye dgu'i sgron me skyes bu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun bzang kun dpal rgyal ba'i go 'phangs 'gro bas myur thor shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'jig rten khams go la legs par bshad pa tshig nyung don gsal kun bzang 'od snang rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni bod yul nyi 'og gi rgyal khams su skyes shing phyogs kun tu chos smra ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i chu rgyun chad pa med pa'i dpal gyi shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal byang kong nyang kha rang byung rgyal ba pad+mas byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas ljon pa klung du rnga chen chu khyi'i lor bkod pa'i 'phro chu phag gro zhun zla ba nyi ma seṅge'i khyim du gnas pa dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po la tshangs pa rgyas pa'i bu ro hi ta yi rlung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ngogs bod yul gyi pad+ma rtsegs pa lho kong po yi thig le gtsang po mgo dgu zhes chu klung ljon shing ra bas yid dga' ba'i tshal du go la'i bskor bcas grub par sbyar zhing slar yang rtsis mkhan rnams 79

kyi rab byung bcu gsum bgrang ba'i me yos shar ba lo de dus 'khor lugs kyi rdzogs su nye zhing gnam byung sa 'brug gi dpyid kyi dpal mos mdun nas bsu ba sbo zla'i sher phyogs la bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi ngogs su zhu btags cung zad dgos pa rnams kyang rang blo'i steng nas legs par bgyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo bha wan+tu/ /

༄ga /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams rten dang brten par bcas pa'i tshul dpe'u ris legs par bkod pa'i kha byang nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams rten dang brten par bcas pa'i tshul dpe'u ris legs par bkod pa'i kha byang nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba/dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bo lhag pa'i lha 'jam dpal dpa' bo dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu 'jam par gyur yang srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcom la ches cher rtsub/ /kun nas bsnyan pa'i dbyangs kyis zhi bar gnas par ma lus gnyid las blangs/ /kun khyab spros bral ye shes rgan yang 'gyur med gzhon nu rtag brtan sku/ /kun bzang dpa' bo srid zhi yongs dpal dus kyi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'jig rten gzhan du rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog nyid brnyes gyur yang / /zhing 'dir thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po 'khor lo gsum pa'i don/ /gsal phyir rgyal sras tshul ston 'jigs med shing rta smra ba'i bdag /'jig rten mgon po de la'ang phyag 'tshal rtag tu byin gyis rlobs/ /dus 'khor rgyud nas phyi nang 'jig rten khamasaske/ /sbyar gsungs dgongs don mkhas bzhed du ma las/ /'dir 'di dpal mgon bla ma dam pa'i mthu'i—/ /bdag gi blo la snang ba'i rang 'dod nyid/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las bdag po yi/ /'chad par 'od zhes bka' gnang bzhin/ /cha shas 'di ru brjod pa la/ /rgyal ba'i bdag pos dbugs dbyung stsol/ /de yang gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings chos kyi khams ye shes kyi phung po lhun grub 'dus ma byas snying po gsal g.yo ba med bzhin ye shes rtsal gyi rlung phra ba ches phra ba shin tu phra ba g.yos pa las gzhom du med pa rang byung gi sgra yig sngags gi skye gnas su shar ba las go 'byed pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang rig pa ye shes kyi rlung gi rang bzhin rten dang brten par byed pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ljang ba dang / sngo ba'i 'od zer steng dang 'og gi cha shas can snang zhing / de las mched pa'i 'od zer mdun du nag po dang g.yas su dmar po dang g.yon du dkar po dang / rgyab tu ser po ste/de yang phyogs dang kha dog go rim mi snang bzhin snang ba'i cha gzhom pa dang / gzhig par mi 'gyur ba rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i gdangs las de ltar du grub cing / 'od zer de rnams mthu brtas pa'i 81

dbus kyi ljang ba dang sngo ba nyid lus can kun gyi srog dang thur sel gyi ngo bor smin pa de yi phrin las can du snang zhing / de dang lhan cig mdun gyi 'od zer gyi mnyam gnas sogs rlung bdun dang / ma ning gi rlung nor las rgyal dang brgyad ste snga ma dang bcas pas rtsa ba dang yan lag bcu yi bdag nyid can no / /ye shes dang 'du 'bral med pa ye shes kyi snying po can brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bcu dang srog tu grub cing phrin las kyi byed pa por rang byung lhun gyis grub par snang ngo / /de yang rgyud dang sa bcu pa'i 'grel par mdun gyi 'od zer gyi rlung bskyed par shas che bas de ltar las don du ni thams cad du cha shas kyi khyab cing kun tu gnas pa dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du yang ste/ de tshe mnyam gnas dang rus sbal ni mdunaglu/gyen rgyu dang rtsang pa ni g.yas/ khyab byed dang lhas byin ni g.yon/ klu dang nor las rgyal ni rgyab kyi 'od zer dang shin tu mnyam zhing / de ltar rlung rnams kyi 'byung ba'i khams kun bsdud pa dang / 'thas pa dang smin pa dang / gsal ba'i las kyi dang po khams lnga'i rang bzhin bag la nyal cha med pa dbang po'i yul las 'das pa nyid rdul phra rags kyi tshul du khyab byed dang / lhas byin gyi gong bur bsdus shing /de klu dang nor las rgyal gyi bsdus pa'i gong bu rnams 'thas par byas te gyen rgyu dang rtsang pas bsrub pa'i tshul gyis gcig tu sbyar nas sbyin par byas/ de mnyam gnas dang rus sbal gyi rlung gis bsrub ste smin pa rnams dal so sor bzhag cing ri gling dbyibs gsal bar byed pa ste/ srog thur gyi de thams cad kyi grogs go 'byed cing stobs su 'gyur bar byed pa yin no/ /de ltar rlung gi dkyil 'khor grub pa dang lhan cig phra bar mnyam pa la rags pa go rim gyi tshul du g.yas kyi 'od zer las glog dang / g.yon gyi 'od zer las char rgyab kyi 'od zer las dbang po'i gzhu grub cing / gong gi rlung rnams kyi nus pas glog gi cha bsags pas mthar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dang char gyi rgyun las chu yi dkyil 'khor dang /dbang po'i gzhu las sa dang sa sbom/ de las rdo dang rdo sbom/ de nas skar ma phra mo dang sbom po rnams rim par byung zhing / de bzhin g.yas dang g.yon gza' yi dkyil 'khor lnga phrag gnyis dang mdun gyi mthu'i khyim gyi go la rlung lam rnams kyang rten 'brel gyi mthu'i grub par gsungs so/ /'dir rlung gi bsdud mthas smin gsal byas pa'i las can/ de yang mdo phal po che nas 'jig rten khams chags pa'i skabs su rlung rnam grangs mi gcig pa mang pos 'jig rten grub par byed pa gsungs pa yang 'di dang gnad gcig cing / de bzhin mdo der me'i dkyil 'khor yang cha shas brtan la/ mngon pa las me'i dkyil 'khor med kyang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sprin las char rgyun gyi rgya mtsho chen po grub yang 'di dang mthun pa'i phyogs dang / gong gi rlung bdun mdun gyi 'od zer nag po kho na la bzhag pa ni phyogs dang chas bdun tshan du dbye nas nyi shu rtsa brgyad du mdzad pa'i skabs de ltar gsungs pa las gzhan ni rlung 82

cha thams cad la khyab cing 'od zer drug ka la ldan pa gong du kho bos brtan pa yang rgyud 'di'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i legs bshad kyi skyes su snyams so/ /de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams grub par gyur pa na/ nang du lus la khru bzhi yod pa bzhin phyi rol du'ang 'jig rten khams dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi'i bdag nyid can du gsung zhing / de yang rlung gi dkyil 'khor mtha' skor du dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang glu/ thad dkar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi dang / rngams su 'bum phrag gnyis yin la/ de'i nang du me'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skor dpag tshad 'bum phrag dgu dang / thad dkar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed gnyis pa/ de'i nang du chu'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skor du dpag tshad 'bum phrag drug dang / thad dkar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis rngams su chig 'bum/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skor du gsum 'bum dang thad dkar chig 'bum/ rngams su 'bum phyed pa'oske/ /dkyil 'khor de rnams gcig gi nang du gcig chud pa sgo nga bkas pa'i tshal pa ltar ste/ srab thug tu 'bum phrag phyed phyed mnyam par gyur pa'o/ /sa dkyil kyi lte bar tshangs thig gi steng nas g.yas g.yon du dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad re bzhag pa khyon du stong phrag bcu drug ri rab lhun po'i rtsa ba'i rmangs yin la/ de'i phyi rol 'khor yug tu dpag tshad stong phrag gcig rgya dang rngams su mnyam pa 'grams steg dang ne/ de'i phyi rol gling drug dang / ri drug mtsho drug rnams kyi rims pas bzlum por bskor ba'i kha zheng rags rtsis su dpag tshad dgu brgyar gsungs kyang zhib mor ni dgu brgya ma longs tsam ste 'og tu 'chad 'gyur gyis shes par bya la/ ri drug la kha khyer gyi tshul du phyir 'phyar ba ci rig pas gong gis tshad las lhag pa tsam mo/ /de ltar ri drug gi phyi ma bsil ri'i rtsa ba nas ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtsho la thug gi bar phyogs kun tu sa yi khor yug gnas pa ni 'dzam gling chen po dum bu bcu gnyis su snang ba ste 'di la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi nam mkhar go la'i khyim yang go mnyam pa bzhin sa dum bu bcu gnyis kyang mnyam par mdzad mod/ /'on kyang dus kyi 'khor lo rang gzhung du yang gling bcu gnyis las gtso bo bzhi bye brag tu smos pa yi gtso 'khor yod par grub cing / de'i tshe gling dbus kyi gsum gnyis tshad g.yas g.yon du byed pa 'thad par go /de ltar dum bu bcu gnyis so so'i dbus su shar gling gsum la dpag tshad bdun stong zla ba phyed pa lta bu rlung dbyibs kyi mtshon pa dang / lho gling gsum la brgyad stong gru gsum gyi rnam pa rtse mo chu gter phyogs sa me dbyibs kyi mtshon pa/ byang gling gsum du dpag tshad dgu stong zla ba lta bu chu dbyibs kyi mtshon pa dang / nub kyi gsum du dpag tshad chig khri dbyibs gru bzhi pa yi mtshon pa ste/ 'di yang mkhas pa kha cig gi 'bur du dod cing gyen du 'phar ba'i dpag tshad kyi tshad du bzhed kyang mngon 83

gsum gyi gnod pas/ rang lugs su dbus kyi mtshan ma de rnams cung zad kyi 'bur du dod cing sa yi khyon der chu gter gyi lag gi ma bcad cing sa yi phyogs gcig tu 'bral bar gnas pas skye bo phal pa rnams kyi yang rgyu 'phrul du rung ba'i bzhi la bzhag go /ri rab lhun por gyen du dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig gi bdag nyid can steng gi 'khor yug tu 'bum phrag phyed gnyis dang / thad dkar khri phrag lnga yod pa rgyu dang 'bral pas gsal bzhin phal cher 'dod pa mthun cing / ri rab rwa lnga'i rnam bzhag dang / ri drug gi dpang tshad mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang du gnas ste/ 1 de yang lo tsa ba chen po shongs ston dang mkhas pa bsod nams 'od zer bas/ ri rab kyi rtsa ba'i dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang steng gi lnga bcu'i khyon khong stong gi cha yin la/ phyi rim gyi 'khor yug stong phrag gcig ni ri rab kyi ngo bo zom shing lta bu gnas pa'i srab thug gi tshad dang / rwa lnga ni phyogs kun tu mu khyud ltar bskor ba rag 'gag gi chu 'phyang bzhi steng nas steng du rgya je cher song nas brtsegs pa'i rwa thams cad kyi steng ma'am phyi ma dpag tshad stong phrag bcu bzhi mthur du 'phyang bar bzhed la/ mkhas mchog bu'i bzhed pa yang 'di dang mthun pa la ri rab kyi nang khongs stong ni mi legs pa/ 'grel chen las/ 'khor yug de'i phyi rol rwa bzhi'i khongs skyibs kyi gnas su gling drug dang ces sogs dang / 'dir lhun po'i 'og gi cha la tshang ba'i gnas nas phyogs thams cad du dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad dang 'khor yug gi gcig go/ /dpag tshad stong phrag dgu'i phyi rol dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug gi bar du gling drug la sogs pa rnams gnas so/ /zhes pas ri rab rin po che sna lnga gar bu'i rang bzhin la 'khor yug gi stong phrag gcig ni de'i rtsa bar rmang gi 'gram stegs lta bur bskor ba la dgongs shing / ri drug nang ma las phyi ma rim pas mtho ba'i bsil ri dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong gyen du longs pa'i rtse dang rwa phyi ma 'byar bar bzhed la/ 2 ri drug dang ri rab bcas rtsa ba phra la stod rim pas sbom pa dkar yol lta bu yin zhes kyang gsung ngo / /da lta'i dus su mtshur lugs pa tsam las gzhan thams cad kyi 'di kho na ltar 'dod par snang la/ 3 dus phyis mi bdag pā ras gong gi de la nang 'gal gyi skyon yod pa mkhyen pa de'i skyon sel du ri rab kyi steng thad dkar rgya dpag tshad 'bum sa dkyil dang mnyam par byas pa ni rgyud tshig dang dngos su 'gal bas mdzub mo la tsher ma zug pa'i skyon sel du mdzub mo gcod pa lta bu'i rigs par gyur to/ /de yang rgyud las/ dbus na lhun po gang gi steng du khyim gyi 'khor lo skar bcas nyin dang mtshan mo 'khor ba ste/ zhes gsung pa 'dir gza' skar go la rnams ri rab kyi bya skyibs 'og tu chud pa sogs mi 'thad pa'i cha shin tu mang bar ma zad rgyud tshig 'dis 'dod pa snga ma nyid la yang gnod byed ston par shes so/ 4 rdo rje gdan pa tsā mi lo tsā was ri rab kyi rwa bzhi rtse mo mthur du bstan 84

cing glu/ de'i steng dbus kyi rwa gyen du 'grengs par dgongs pa dang / 5 paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ti tsan+d+ras phyogs bzhi'i rwa mthur bstan tsā mi'i ltar la/ dbus kyi ra ni lhun po rang nyid la 'dod pa dang / 6 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal bas ri rab rdo rje rtse lnga gyen bslang lte ba phyed man sa 'og tu nub pa lta bu yin par dgongs pa dang / 7 rje ār+ṣa mā las rtsis kun btus pa'i rgyas 'grel du gzhon dpal gyi de dang cha mthun nyid dang / yang rang bzhed thun mong ma yin par rdo rje'i steng gi rwa yi rtse mo las dbus ma srog shing gi tshul dang gzhan bzhi ni phyir dgyes pa'i cha gdugs kyi sham bu ltar
