steng dbus bzhi la mthur du 'phyang thabs yod pa zhes gsungs pas dgongs pa'i mthil spyad dka' yang phyi ma bi bhu ti'i bzhed pa dang phyogs mthun dang rdo rje'i ri ni mu khyud dang cig pa la rtse mor rta gdong lta bu'i me 'bar dgongs soske/ / 8 rwa pa rnams ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi ka ba la sba phub kyi lte ba tol nas brtsegs pa lta bu'i steng mnyam pa la ra lnga mdos kyi gtor khu gtsugs pa ltar 'dod pa dang / 9 mkhas pa shāka mchog pas ri rab gyen langs dpag tshad 'bum spyi dang mthun pa la de steng phyogs bzhi'i ra dpag tshad stong phrag bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar snyegs pa'i khongs seng 'dod lha bzhi dang gzugs khams rnams gnas shing dbus rwa la dpag tshad 'bum yod pa'i rtse mo'i sbubs su gzugs med bzhi yod par 'dod pa dang /10 jo nang rje btsun mchog gis dus 'khor maṇ+ḍal bshad pa'i skabs su ri rab dpag tshad 'bum phyed kyi bar rtsa rtse phral sbom can gyi gyen 'greng dang / de mtshams nas ri rab gdeng ka'i tshu du rgyal je cher stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du gyes shing de'i steng du ri rab kyi ra lnga stong phrag nyer lnga pa me long gi steng du bshos bu bzhag pa ltar mdzad pa dang / 11 e pa mkhon ston gyi ri rab kyi rwa rdza ma la lung 'dogs pa bzhin phyogs bzhir yod par byas shing / 12 chags rin po che chos rgyal gyi ri rab kyi rwa phyogs bzhir sems can gyi rwa ltar gdeng par 'dod pa dang / rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi ri rab kyi bang rim rwa pa'i 'dod ltar la phyogs kyi ra bzhi rag gi pad sder gyi 'dab ma'i rtse'am rin po che'i zur ltar gyes pa'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gyi lte ba bzhin dbus kyi rtse mo mngon par 'phags pa dang / ri drug gi dpag tshad dgu brgyar mchu zhengs mnyam par dgongs so/ /de ltar gzhan gyi bzhed pa rag rim mod tsam bkod par byas pa'o/ /a tha/ de nas rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa ni/ ri rab kyi steng gi rgya dpag tshad stong phrag lnga cu dang rtsa ba'i tshad dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang 'khor yug dpag tshad stong 'gram stegs kyi tshul du 'dod pa rnams spyi dang mthun pa las rtsa ba nas gyen du dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu'i bar ri rab cung zad sbom du song ba la/ don stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar gdengs 'da'i tshul du gyes shing / /de steng 85

dpag tshad khri ngos mnyam pa'i rngams dang / de yi steng du thad dkar stong phrag lnga bcur mnyam pa'i dbus stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga dbus kyi rwa yi rtsa ba dang phyogs bzhir rwa yi skye gnas stong phrag phyed dang bcu gsum la rwa lnga ka dpang du stong phrag bco lngar mtshungs zhing / dbus ma rtse mo rim pas 'phel zhing rwa bzhi'i rtse mo rgyan bshos pad zlum ltar je phrar gyur pa thad dkar 'grengs shing 'og bzhi'i phyi dngos dpag tshad chig khri'i rngams dang shin tu mnyam par gnas shing steng du dpag tshad chig khri lnga stongs longs pa na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas dang / de yi gzhi las rwa yi rtse mo dpag tshad lnga bcu re gyen du 'phags pa ste/ zheng du thad dkar dpag tshad stong phrag re yod pa gzhan du ri rab kyi lcog bzhir grags pa dang gnad cig go/ /dbus su yang bzhi las maṇ+ḍal gyi rtog byung ba bzhin rwa rtse dang mtshungs pa'i dpag tshad lnga cu rtse mo'i tshul du yod ces 'chad pa yin no/ /mtha' skor gyi ri drug yang ri rab kyi phyed cha stong phrag lnga bcu'i mtshams nas stong phrag gnyis dor ba'i lhag drug gi bgos pas stong phrag brgyad re thob pa phyi ma las nang ma'i mtho khyad yin la/ de la steng du ri rab phyir gdengs pa'i khar chig khri ngos mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ ri drug gi steng du gnya' shing ltar gnon pas gzhan nas gnya' shing 'dzin du gsung pa dang / don gcig tu 'gro ba dang / nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug gi skabs su rwa lnga'i skye gnas stegs bu dang mtshungs pa las kyang chig stong gi steng thad du rgyu bas na des kyang gnya' shing 'dzin par grub bo/ /de bzhin 'od sngon ni ri rab la thong lcags kyi khyud pa ltar gnas pas bshol mda' 'dzin dang glu/ mad+dha ra ni mtshon sna brgya rtsas bkra bar byas pa ltar mdzes pa lta na sdug dang / ni ṣaṭa ni rtsi shing can dang / tshang tshing can dang / mtshan mo la yang 'jug pas ri de seng ldeng gi nags tshal mun pa thibs pa lta bu'i g.yogs pas/ seng ldeng nags dang / nor bu'i ri ni rin po che las grub pa'i brag rta'i rna ba'i phyi ngos kyi dbyibs lta bu'i gtam pas rta na can dang / yang na lta na sdug dang cha mthun pas blta na yin par yang 'dod/ /dro ṇa ni bra bo'am gzhal byed ste 'phags yul gyi bra zangs las byas pa ltar stod kyi cha cung zad nang du 'dus shing / kha khyer nang du bzlog pas ri nang ma la 'dud pa ltar gnas pas rnam 'dud pa dang / bsil ri ni ri nang ma rnams la mu khyud kyi phyi ma'i tshul du mdzes par 'khod pas dang rta gdong 'bar ba'i ri dang mu khyud ltar mtho dman shin tu mnyam pas na mu khyud 'dzin du thad pa yin la/don du yang de las mi 'da'o/ /lhun po'i 'gram stegs dang 'grel ba'i gling dang / de yi phyi 'dabs su sbrang rtsi'i mtsho/ de mthar 'od sngon gyi ri ste gling tsho ri rnams gnas tshul dang zhing gi tshad zor yang phyir kho bos sngar bkod zin pa'i kun bzang 'od snang gi tshigs bcad drangs pa/ zla ba'i gling dang sbrang rtsi'i mtshoske/ /'od sngon ri ste rim pa des/ /'od kar ma dang mad+dha ra/ ku sha zho dang ni ṣaṭa ri/ /mi'am 'o ma nor 86

bu'i 'od/ /khrung khrung chu dang dro na ri/ /drag po chang dang bsil ba'i ri/ /kun kyang shin tu bzlum por mdzesaske//gling mtsho'i ri rnams kha rgya zheng / /dpag tshad brgyad brgya dang gya brgyad/ /rgyang grags gsum dang gzhu chig stong / /chig brgya bcu gcig sor bcu gcig /nas lnga skye tshe brgyad du mnyam/ /te de rnams la kha 'khyer tshul/ /dpag tshad go gsum rgyang grags gcig /sa/zhu 'dom drug brgya dang re drug /khru do mtho gang nas drug 'phyar/ /zhes pa ltar shes par bya ste/ ri de rnams kha khyer zhes pa'i skabs ri lnga'i kha khyer phyir 'phyar zhing / gcig steng du phyur ba gong du bshad pa de dran dgos so/ /phyi rol du gnas pa'i ri bo mngon pa sogs su phyi lcags ri 'khor yug tu grags pa'i tshad myur 'dzin gyi phyed cha dang mu khyud 'dzin dang mnyam par 'dod pa dag snang la/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud dang slob dpon chen po bi ma las ni gnya' shing 'dzin dang mnyam par mdzad pa dang / mdo phal po che las phyi'i 'khor yug dang 'khor yug chen po srid rtse la nye bar shugs bstan du mdzad pa yang mthong mod/ /'dir ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs kyi phyi rol du gnas pa'i ri bdun pa'am rdo rje'i ri bo yang bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos me dkyil la ngos bzung nas/ de yang chu dang kha da chad du mnyam pa dang / chu las cung zad kyi gyen du 'phags pa dang ske/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar du bskal me 'bar bar bzhed pa yang yod la/ gang ltar rdo rje'i ri bo me 'ba' zhig las rdo yi bsdus pa ma mdzad kyang / 'dir ni chu dang me yi mtshams su rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ri bo de dpag tshad stong phrag bzhi yi bar med dal gyi me yi reg bya 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba dang rdo rje nor bu'i rang 'od gcig tu 'dres pa lcags sol me nas phyung ba lta bu mchog tu 'bar ba'i me g.yo ba med pa dang / de nas stong phrag bzhi'i bar mes g.yogs shing rtse mo 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ de ltar stong phrag brgyad nang gi bsil ri dang mtho shin tu mnyam pa mu khyud ltar gnas shing mchog tu che ba'i chu gter gyi phung po bras las nam yang mi 'da' bar skem par byed pas rta gdong me yi ri bo zhes bya ste/ rdo rje'i ri bo de nyid srab thug gi khyad par ri drug gi srab thug dang mtshungs pa'i de las thug pa yang rung laske/ gang ltar ri de sgong kogs bzhin chu yi 'og bzhi kun tu khyab par ma zad/ gyen du yang stong phrag lnga'i lhag pa'i bdun cu'i bar longs bar rje puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i dgongs bzhed bzhin 'dir yang byas te/ tshul de 'thad pa'i rigs pa mang bas so/ /gong gi 'bar ba'i rang bzhin stong phrag brgyad kyi steng nas rim pas ri'i kha dog yal mdangs kyi ser ba dang / shas cher nam mkha'i kha dog dang 'dres pa'i sngon por snang ba srab thug la dpag pa'i kha khyer yang nang gi ri ltar phyir 'phyang ba'o/ /'di la blo gros kyi snang ba thob pa gzhan nas chu dal dang me dal mtshams su sa yi rang bzhin rdo khams kyi ri bo mi legs so snyam pa 'byung srid kyang sa yi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su chu gter chen po drug gnas pa gdon mi za ba bzhin 87

'dir yang chu dkyil kyi mthar rdo rje'i ri bo yod pa skyon du mi 'jug go/ /de yang rdo rje'i ri bo tshul 'di lta bu rig bzo'o snyam na de ma yin ste/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgya mtsho'i lhas zhus pa'i le'u las/ rgya mtsho'i chu ni mang mod kyi/ gdon mi za bar skam pa'i dus yod do/ /bskal pa 'jig tu nye ba na/ nyi ma gnyis shar na chu mig dang rdzing ka kun skams so/ /nyi ma gsum shar ba na/ chu phran thams cad skabs mo/ /nyi ma bzhi shar ba na chu bo thams cad skams so/ /nyi ma lnga shar ba na/ rgya mtsho chen po yang lnga cha 'bri'o/ /nyi ma drug shar ba na sum gnyis 'bri'o/ /nyi ma bdun shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po yang skams so/ /ri rab lhun po yang rnyil / rdo rje'i mtha' la thug gi bar tshig cing 'bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa yang dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i ri bo 'di la 'dod dgos so/ /de gang gi shes zhe na/ mdo der dge tshul tshul khrims bsrung ba'i le'ur/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i gting yang rdo rje yin la/ mtha' ma yang rdo rje'i ri yi bskor ste/ chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab yang / /mi 'grib mi ldud pa ltar/ tshul khrims kyi rgya mtsho yang de dang 'dra ste/ 'dul ba rdo rje lta bu'i ni gting byas/ chos sngon pa'i ris ni mtha' ma bskor/ mdo sde bzhi chu bo bzhin 'babs kyang 'phel ba yang med/ 'bri ba yang med do/ /rgya mtsho ci phyir mi ltud ce na/ mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal mes rgya mtsho skams pas de yi phyir/ rgya mtsho'i chu mi ltud do/ /chu bo bzhi rtag tu 'babs pas ni ming 'grib so/ /zhes gsungs pa yi rdo rje ri yang dus mtha' bskal pa'i mes tshig par bzhed na/ me dkyil las rdo rje'i ri gzhan med tshe 'jig rten gyis mes 'jig rten kyi me ji ltar bsregs bsam dgos shing de ltar 'dod mi nus so/ /gzhan yang rgyud dang 'grel par gza' skar rnams kyi khyim ri rab kyi steng du 'khor bar gsungs pa dang / nyi ma byang bsgrod kyi mthar thug pa'i tshe lhun po'i rwa la reg cing lho bsgrod kyi mthun drug pa'i tshe rdo rje'i ri la reg par 'dod pa dang / rgya nag gi yul sngon shang ton dang / da lta pi king du grags pa'i byang phyogs su khing cha zhes pa'i yul du dbyar nyi ldog pa'i skabs mtshan mo'i yun ja yun tsam las mi 'byung bar grags pa dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las nyi ma char nub lhun po'i rtse mor byed par gsungs pa dang / ri brtsegs mtho dang brtsegs pa chen po dag gi rtse mor nyi zla 'khor bar gsungs pa sogs kho bo'i lugs 'di la legs par bshad pa 'gyur ba yin gyi/ de yi rgyu mtshan zhib mo nyid gzhan du 'chad par spro la/ 'dir brir mi longs mod/ 'on kyang khings cha'i yul du dbyar nyi ldog skabs sngar gzhan gyi bshad pa'i 'jig rten khams bkod gang la yang de 'grig par mi nus shing / ri drug rgyar dpang mtshungs par byas na 'grig tu rung ba ltar snang yang / nyi ma byang bsgrod kyi mthun 'jug skabs/ kai la shar nyin mo dbyu gu so drug dang mtshan mo nyer bzhi yod pa dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud dang rgyud 'grel nyid dang lha chen po'i bstan bcos dbyangs char ba 88

las kyang gsung pas na de dang mi 'grigs mi mdzes par shes so/ /de bzhin stong phrag bdun cu rtsa lnga'i mtshams su ri rab kyi rwa skye par bzhed pa rags rtsis yin pas mi 'gal yang zhib mo'i tshe nyi ma byang bsgrod kyi skabs nyi ma'i gdung byed ra dang mtshungs par reg pa sogs dang mi 'grigs pas 'dir zhib mor byas pa dang / kho bo'i 'dir ri drug gi 'od sngon dang lhun po'i gdengs ka phyir bskyed pa yi ri rab kyi rked mtshams grib gzugs chung ba'i gnas de byang phyogs khengs cha'i phyogs su khel bar 'dod pas na sus kyang glen ka byar med do/ /ri drug gi nang tsho drug gi kha zheng dpag tshad dgu brgyar nye ba yod bzhin zabs su yang de bzhin byas na mi 'gal te/ gzhung gzhan du rol mtsho'i don zhing la rol btang ba'i chu bzhin gsung ba dang shin tu mthun mod/ 'dir chad 'os mang yang yi ges 'jigs pas ma spros soglu/ /de ltar ri rab dpag tshad 'bum gcig gi steng du 'dod gzugs gzugs med kyi gnas ri rab kyi mgrin gdong gtsug tu tha snyad bzhag pa dpag tshad 'bum gyi bdag nyid can du gsung bzhin 'di la yang dpyad pa dang bcas bshad pa mang du yod mod kyang / 'dir tshig zor yangs ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad de mdor bshad pa/ ye shes le'ur rgyal ba'i sku yi tshad/ sor lnga lhag pa'i khru lnga'i tshad du mdzad/ /'jig rten khams dang dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i skabs/ spyi mthun mdzes sku khru bzhi'i tshad du gsungs/de la mgrin sor drug dang gdong bcu gnyis skra dbang sor drug gtsug gtor de khongs bsdus/ mgrin sor drug la 'dod lha rig bzhi dang / gzugs gnas tshangs ris mdun na 'don bcas drug /gdong la tshangs pa che nas mi gdung bar/ /skra dpang gzugs nas gya nom 'og min dang / /gzugs med mu bzhi'i gnas su gsal bar gsungs/ /thun mong tshad 'dir gtsug tor 'jog pa'i cha/ /sngags rgyud gzhan du mgo dang spyi gtsug zhes/ /tha dad bgrang ba'i tshul dang gcig par snang / /phyis byung mkhas 'gas spyi mthun rdzas 'di dang / /rgyal ba'i sku tshad gsungs pa gcig bsres nas/ /mgrin sor bzhi la lha nas drug bsdus pa/ /mkhas kyang mi mkhas rnam 'gyur 'don mi za/ /gong du mgrin dang skra dpang sor drug re/ /phyi nang dag sbyor bcas gsung nor 'khrul med/ /'on kyang mdzes pa'i cha dang rgyud dgongs pa/ /blang tshul nyid kyi mgrin dang skra yi dpang / /gtsug tor rnams su sor mo bzhi re dang / /gdong sor bcu gnyis pa ste de rnams kyi/ /sor re'i gnas su lha gnas re bkod pa/ /kho bo'i rtog pa nyid ste mi 'thad med/ /gtsang ma'i gnas spang lha bu dbang phyug che/ /gnas pa'i 'og min sangs rgyas kun sangs rgyas/ /de ni gtsug tor nor bu'i gnas nyid du/ /dpal mchog rgyud dgongs yin pa kho bos rtogs/ /sngon chad ma grags brjod dang grags rjes min/ /'di ko legs bshad nyid du rang gi sems/ /zhes so/ /'og min gyi gnas gzugs khams gtsang ma'i steng du yod pas de ma yin pa'i 'og min mdo la ra gshegs pa nas gsungs 89

pa de mkhas pa mang dag gi gzugs khams kyi 'og min steng der yod par dgongs pa shas che yang gzugs khams kyi 'og min steng du gzugs med mu bzhi dang / de yi steng thun mong gi lus kyi spyi bo'i gtsug gam thun mong ma yin pa gtsug tor nor bu'i gnas su 'og min 'dod pa 'di nyid dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i tshigs bcad nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa'i dgongs pa bzhin bdag gi yang dag par 'dir bshad pa yin na gzu bor gnas pa'i blo can rnams kyi dngas su blang bar 'os/ brtson pa mi ldan blo gros dman na yang / snyigs ma mtha' la thug pa'i dus 'di ru/ /rgyud don ji bzhin 'chad pa'i blo 'di ni/ /sngon byon dam pa'i mthu las bdag gi min/ /mngon pa 'og ma sogs su gzugs med mu bzhi'i gnas mkha' khams su bying ba yi gang du 'chi ba'i gnas de yi nam mkha' las de bas gnas phyogs su bcad pa gzhan du mi bzhed pa ni nyan thos bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa yin la/ gzhan theg pa chen po'i mdo dang khyad par sngags kyi rgyud sde mang por gzugs med kyi gnas na mkha'i rim pa 'jig rten sde tshan du bkod pa yang yang gsung ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa gcig tu mthun par snang la/'dod pa'i gnas bzhi dang gzugs dang gzugs med kyi rten gzhi na mkha'i ming a ti bkod pa'i rgyud la sogs par ming tha dad du gsung ba de tshul rgyas par 'dod na gu ru pad+ma dang bi ma las mdzad pa'i gzhung rnam dag pas der blta'o/ /'dod khams kyi gnas 'og ma gnyis ni rdo sbom gyi rang bzhin ri rab lhun po la rten pa ri rab kyi rtse mo steng ngos su sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas/ de yi dbus su 'chi ba med pa'i grong khyer lta na sdug /dbang po'i pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang bcas yod la/ /de yang 'dir brjod pa'i ri rab rwa lnga'i dbus rtse dpag tshad lnga cu gyen du phyur pa'i shar gyi char dbang po'i pho brang yod la/ dbang po shar phyogs su gnas par gsungs pas kyang mtshon cing / gzhan thams cad du ri rab kyi dbus su lta na sdug yod par gsung ba dang / 'gal lo zhes na ma yin te/ dper na 'dzam gling gi dbus ma ga dha yi mthil byang chub shing drung yin la/ de dang nye ba wa ra ṇa si yang ma ga dha yin par mi 'gal ba bzhin no/ /ri rab kyi rwa bzhi'i rtse mor gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i pho brang yod pa mngon pa mdzod nas lcogs bzhir lag na rdo rje gnas par gsungs pa dang shin tu mthun la/ de yang a bhi ko sha las / phyogs mtshams brtsegs pa bzhi la ni/ /lag na rdo rje gnas dbus na/ /zhes pa/ dbus na 'og ma'i tshigs shugs ma rdzogs pas yar drangs ba las rgya dper dbus kyi skad dod dh+ya ma 'og ma'i tshig rkang mgor yod pas/ uṣitabadz+rapāṇibhiḥzhes par/ lag na rdo rje rnams kyi gnas/ /zhes kyang rung la/ des na 'di ni gnod sbyin gsang ba sa yi gnas lag na rdo rje can gyi khab khyad par ba 'jig rten thun mong du grags shing snang ba'i lcang lo can gyi ngos 'dzin yang 'di la byed dgos shing / der lag na rdo rje'i gtso 90

bo bzhi ni shar lho nas rim pas tshangs pa dang / tshangs chen dang / drag shul can dang / rdo rje gtum po gos sngon can bzhi ru rgyud kyi rgyal po thal 'gyur gyi 'grel par 'byung ngo / /gnod sbyin gyi bdag po lag na rdo rje yi sras rna mas kyi thu bo rdo rje'i sde dang / gzhan yang dpung bzang dang / sogs sras stong phrag gcig mnga' ba lha yi rgyal po chen po'i tshul du snang ba des rang gis gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa la gdugs tshod gsol bar bstan pa yang lhun po'i rwa rtse brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang 'di yin par shes soske/ /gnod sbyin gsang ba pa yi gnas der lha phal pa rnams rgyu bar mi bzod cing / bdud dang / dbang po dang / nye dbang kun kyang gnod sbyin gsang ba pa'i rigs la ches 'jigs par blta zhing gsang ba pa de rnams kyi mi ma yin drag shul dregs pa can mthu shin tu che ba yang gsod par byed pas tsaṇ+ḍa te gtum po'i sgra dang / grong khyer gyi phyi rol gdol pa gnas pa bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum gyi phyi rol gyi char brtsegs pa nyid dang rtsub 'gyur tshal lta bu dang / ro ldan gyi sgras mi yi gnas su rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad dang bcu drug rnams su yang nye bar spyod pas gtsang sbra'i lha rnams kyi me bar yang byed pa zhig go//gsang ba pa yi rigs de rnams lha ma yin dang lha yi gnas su rgyu ba na lus lha mthu bo che rnams kyi mthong mi nus par sbed pas na/ gsang ba pa zhes thun mong gi ngor des kyang brjod du rung ba dang / gnod sbyin gsang ba po de rnams kyi bdag po ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba gsum la spyod pa gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gsang ba po yi rigs de thams cad kyang gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsang rigs gzungs sngags rnams kyi bdag mdzad pa/ sngags 'chang rnams bsrung zhing / gdugs pa can 'dul bar byed pa sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las byed pa po chen po ste/ de la snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon lag na rdo rje dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gang / /sngags 'dzin dam pa 'ga' yi tha dad byas/ /mkhas bzhin mi mkhas ngang tshul ston 'di ci/ /thub dbang mir bltams mi mchog mi'i seng geglu/ /pad 'byung srin po'i rjer sprul srin po 'dul/ /lag na rdo rje gnod sbyin sde dpon che/ /gdul byas 'dul byed mi rnyog yongs shes byos/ /zhes so/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi byang phyogs rnam thos sras kyi pho brang ri rab rwa yi rtsa bar gnas pa la lcang lo can du grags pa de na 'jig rten thun mong gi gnod sbyin mthu bo che mang du gnas shing / gdul bya'i gtso bo gnod sbyin gdugs pa rnams yin pas gsang ba pa yi gnas dang cha mthun gyi lcang lo can du gsungs pa de/ de la bod kha cig gi gsang ba'i bdag po'i gnas kyang 'dir 'dod pa dang / de bas yang rnam mang thos pa'i bu yi khang brtsegs steng mar gsang bdag bzhugs par bzhed pa ni skabs su de ltar yang 'byung mod/ dus kun tu rig pa ma yin te gsang ba'i 91

bdag po yang lha yi rgyal po'i tshul du bzhugs pa gong du smras pa ltar ste/ de 'jig rten rig pas kyang pho brang gi steng shod du mi 'os par mthong na/ de gsume ba po skyes bu dam pa yin yang shin tu gu dogs pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /gzhan yang da dung shes par bya ba lcang lo can 'jig rten thun mong ngor de ltar dang /thun mong min pa ni 'dzam gling nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul de yi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi snang ngor zhing khams lta bur shar bzhin rigs sngags spub pa rnams kyi ngor snang ba'i lcang lo can yang de 'dra la/gsang ba'i bdag po'i gnas lcang lo can dngos ni sangs rgyas don dam par sangs rgya ba'i gnas de kho na ste nang gi ro ldan yang der 'jug la/ drag po'i gdul bya la mos pa'i ngor rgyud gzhan du 'khor ba yongs sgrol gyi dur khrod dang / me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod zhes su gsung pa de yin no/ /lcang lo can gyi sgra don bshad bya gzhan 'ga' yang rtogs rung 'dir smra ma dgos pas na bzhag go/ /sngags rgyud don gnyer 'dod rnams rgyud bdag po/ /lag na rdo rje snying nas gus byar 'os/ /'on kyang deng dus nye 'tshe zhi la re/ kha tsam yi dam byed las de tshul dkon/ /de nas lcang lo can la dpyad mi byed/ /phal cher spros bral mkha' khyab ngang du klod/ /'ga' yi ngal gso'i gnas dang gcig tu byas/ /de de yin mod de de ci ltar yin/ /dam pa rnams kyi thugs su rtag gsal mod/ /yi ger bkod pa bdag gis ma thong bas rang gi rtogs tshul mdo tsam 'dir smras te/ /blo dman rnams la phan par 'dod pa yin/ /deng sang sgra shes don gzhal dkon na yang / /mgo bzlum thal rig gis snyems gar mkhan 'ga'/ /yi dam ya ma ri la byed zhes na/ /de yi ye shes dkyil 'khor dgugs pa'i tshe/ /gzugs sku'i bzhugs gnas de la'ang mi sems sam—/ /de skad dgos slang kyal ka nyid du gsol/ /zhes so/ /yang mdo rgyud rnam dag dang bstan bcos khungs ldan mang por rgyal chen bzhi'i pho brang gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mor yod zhes yang yang gsung ltar 'dir gnya' shing 'dzin gyi ngos 'dzin gong du song bzhin rgyal chen bzhi'i pho brang ri rab kyi rwa lnga skye ba'i rmang bzhi'i rwa bzhi'i bar stegs su yod par 'dod pa yin la/ gzhan ri rab bang rim bzhi par pho brang yod zhes mngon pa rang lugs su 'thad kyang gnya' shing 'dzin rtser 'grigs pa'i go skabs nam yang mi rnyed de bang rim bzhi dang thad mtshungs tsam la byed na gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mor yod pa ma yin pas kho bos bshad pa 'di las gzhan du lo brgyar spyad kyang mi 'grig go/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi'i rigs can ni lhun po nas me dkyil la thug gi bar go la'i khyon gyi gza' skar kun dang / ri drug gi kha khyer gling bzhi'i dbus kyi gangs ri dang gzhan yang gang brag nags tshal grong dang grong brdal rnams su yang gnas par gsung ste/ de yang ri drug gi kha khyer la gnod sbyin gser khang dang / stobs ldan dang /'jug sred dang / grags dpal dang / ri 'deg dang / mchog sred drug gtso bo ste de yi sde ris dang 92

bcas pa'i grong khyer gnas pa dang / phyi rol lcags ri lta bu rdo rje'i ri rtser yang gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rigs kyi gnas khang pa dang khang brtsegs du ma yod par rgyud gzhan las so/ /lha ma yin gyi gnas pa dkyil gyi rngams kyi bzhi cha gong dang / bzhi cha gnyis par klu'i gnas su dus 'khor da lta'i 'gyur tshul 'dir bzhugs kyang / rje puṇ+ḍari kas/ steng du klu dang 'og tu lha min mdzad par slob ma mkhas par grags pa rnams kyis de yig nor du bzung yang ma yin te rang bzhed thun mong min par snang la/ rig pa'i sgo nas ni de yang mi 'thad pa med do/ /gzhan du ni sa dkyil phyed gong lha min zhes pa lte ba'i cha dang phyed 'og klu'i gnas 'khor yug gi char kyang 'gal ba cher ma mthong ngo / /sa dkyil phyed man gseg ma'i dmyal ba ste yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas kyang / de yi khongs su rje 'brug pas bzhed pa ni legs bshad nyid du bzung ngo / /de ltar sa yi bu ga'i gnas rnams su 'gro ba gzhan gsum dang sa yi steng du mi rigs rnams yongs su 'khod pa 'dzam gling las kyi sar gsungs shing / /de las bye brag tu 'dzam gling chung ngu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byon cing sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan yod pas na sngags pa du mas yongs su bsngags pa'i gnas so/ /de yang 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di yi dbus dngos bzhir 'dzam gling gi ri chen po bzhi'i nang tshan gangs can ste hi ma la dpag tshad sum brgya'i 'khor yug can brgya gyen du phyur te gnas shing / /de yi shar nub tu chu mgo ri del byas nas chu bo shī ta rgya mtsho dug can la 'bab pa ste zhib mor phyes na gangs can gyi shar phyogs nas shīta cig shar phyogs kyi rgya mtshor bab pa dang / gangs can gyi nub phyogs nas shīta cig nub kyi phyogs mtshar bab pa yin no/ /hi ma la de'i phyogs bzhi'i char rwa bzhi'i rnam par ri bo ke ta ra'i ming can bzhi yod pa lho phyogs de da lta mnga' rir gangs ri chen po ti ser grags pa 'di yin zhes kho bos smra'o/ /rig byed kyi gzhung las chu bo gaṅgas lho phyogs kyi gangs ri phug nas yul dbus 'gyur du 'bab par gsungs pa yang 'dir 'thad pa nyid do/ /des na bod kyi ti si 'di gangs can gyi rwa ke ta ra yin na/ gangs can ma yin pa yang min la hi ma la dngos mdzod dang phal chen dang sham+bha la yi lam yig nas gsung pa dngos byang phyogs su yod na bod kyi ti sir de yi bshad tshod rnams ma tshangs pas skyon du mi 'gyur zhing / da phyin lugs 'di sa skya dang bka' rgyud kyi mkhas pa rnams rtsod pa med par thugs bag phebs par 'os/ ti se gangs can gcig tha dad/ /mkhas rnams 'bel mchid rgya che yang / /dngos don sngon med legs bshad 'di'i/ /don yod lcags kyu'i mthu las so/ /sa dkyil 'og gi cha chu dang me dang rlung dal la grang ba dang tsha ba dang mi bzad pa'i dmyal ba gnyis gnyis drug /rlung dkyil gyi cha 'og mar rdo rje'i khab rtse'i dmyal ba ste bdun dang / gong gi sa dkyil du gseg ma'i dmyal ba bcas brgyad yin no/ /dus kyi 'khor 93

lo srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig tu gsung ba gzags med bzhi/ /gzags khams bcu drug 'dod lha drug gi rir ra meganas dang bcas nyer drug de steng lha min/ mi/ byol song / yi dwags dmyal ba rnams bsdoms pas sum cu rtsa gcig yin no/ /gzugs khams gnas ris bcu drug tu gsung pa ni 'dir gtsang ma'i gnas kyi shin tu mthong bstan nas gya snom snang de dang don gcig tu dgongs pa'i phyogs yin la/ 'di la gzhung gzhan du shin tu dang gya nom don gcig cing snang ba dang mthong ba don gcig yod zhes lo tsā ba chen po be+e ro tsa nas gsung bar grags pa dang mthun la/ gzhan kha che bye brag smra ba yang gzugs khams gnas ris bcu drug tu 'dod de/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don dang tshangs chen gcig tu bgrang ba'o/ /de yang lha yi gnas dang / sa 'og mun 'gro'i gnas rnams rgyar zheng sa dkyil dang mnyam pa ni/ /gnas kyi gtso bo la dgongs pa yin cing / 'khor yug ni steng gi lha rgyal chen sde bzhi'i rigs me dkyil la thug gi bar dang mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i char byol song gi rigs du mas kun tu khengs pa'i rig pas mtho ris dang ngan song gi gnas kyi lhag ma gzhan rnams kyang de ltar shes dgos so/ /srid pa bcud kyi sems can de rnams kyi tshe tshad kyang gzugs med bzhi steng ma bskal chen bzhi nas 'og ma re res 'phrin las pa'i nam mkha' mtha' yas su bskal chen gcig gi che'o/ /gzugs khams kyi gnas bcu drug gi steng ma 'og min gyi tshe bskal pa bar ma bcu drug thub pa/ 'og ma la re re 'phrin las pas tshangs ris su gnas pas bar bskal gcig thub po/ /'dod lha drug gi steng ma gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi tshe bskal pa chung drug dang ske/ 'og tu rim pas phris pas rgyal chen sde bzhi'i tshe bskal chung gcig go/ /klu dang dmyal ba dang po ni bskal pa chung ngu'i tshe dang / dmyal ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa bskal pa bar ma/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa mchog gi bskal pa/ drug pa dang bdun pa bskal pa chen po/ brgyad pa 'jig rten khams bsdud pa'i tshad du gsungs so/ /mi rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa'i dus kyi rags rtsis tshe lo brgya pa'i dbang du mdzad cing / lha ma yin dang / yi dwags kyang / rang rang dbugs tshad kyi lo brgyar gsungs te/ de yang mi lo bcu gnyis lha ma yin gyi zhag gcig de sum cu'i zla ba/ de bcu gnyis kyi lo/ de brgya yi tshe tshad du byas pas mi lo bzhi 'bum sum khri nyis stong gi lha ma yin gyi tshe tshad dang mi yi zla ba gcig yi dwags kyi zhag dang ske/ de sum cu'i zla ba sogs gong bzhin byas pas mi lo sum stong thams pa yi dwags kyi tshe tshad du don gyi gsung bar gnang ngo / /de yang dus 'khor nas gsung pa bskal pa'i tshad ni/ gzhu 'dom stong phrag brgyad ni dpag tshad kyi tshad yin la/ de lta bu'i chu zheng mnyam pa'i dong / skra rtse chu zheng mnyam pas yongs su bskang nas lo brgya brgya na skra rtse re re phyung pa yi skra rtse thams cad zad pa'i tshe zhag gcig tu byas nas zhag twe ṭ+wāṃ ba dang lo bsgrang tshul ji ltar gyi lo brgya rdzogs pa'i tshe na bskal pa chung ngu yin la/ bskal pa

chung ngu des zhag dang zla ba lor byas nas lo brgya lon pa na bar gyi bskal pa dang / bar bskal zhag tu byas nas bsgrang tshul de ltas lo brgyas mchog gi bskal pa/ mchog bskal zhag gcig tu byas pa'i lo brgyas bskal pa chen por gsung ste/ bskal pa de rnams kyi yun tshad mi yi lo grangs la sbyar ba'i rtsi tshul zhib pa ni mi bskyod zhabs kyi dus gzhi gsal byed dang / rje pud+dha ri ka'i dngos slob 'brug pa lha blo zhes bdag gi rtsis rig rgyud pa'i bla ma des kyang 'chad thabs gsal bar rgyas par bkod snang la/ kho bos kyang sngar gzhan du 'chad zin pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thog mar bskyed cing bar du gnas pa'i tshul rag bsdus su bshad zin la/ mthar 'jig rten bsdud pa'i tshul ni nang lus kyi de nyid dang mthun par 'byung ba rnams phan tshun nus pa 'khrugs shing shed shor bas sa ni chur zhig cing thim/ chu ni me dang / me rlung la/ de yang nam mkhar thim nas stong pa chen po'i ngang du gnas shing slar yang sngon bzhin kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su grub par yang gyur to/ /'jig rten bsdud pa'i tshul 'dir sa bcad tsam ste 'di la sngar gzhan gyi rgyas par bshad pa ma mthong bas slar zhib mor spros de logs su 'chad pa yang 'dod do/ /de yang 'jig rten 'di ni gdod nas ma grub bzhin rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i rang gdangs su 'gog pa med par rten 'brel gyi rol par snang zhing / gdul bya rang gi mos bsam blo rig tha dad pa la rgyal ba thabs la mkhas pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas gang la gang 'dul du ma dag pa'i shes pa bzlog pa'i don dang / log pa'i zhen pa sun phyung ba dang / gang la yang zhen pa med par rten pa dang / dbang po khams dang mtshams par spro ba bskyed pa dang / 'gal 'bral rang ngos ma grub par bstan pa dang / zhen yul ma grub pa sgyu ma ltar 'gal ba med par gsung ba sogs 'byams klas pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin la su zhig gi gzhalaske/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma nas ji ltar gsung ba rnam grangs du gyur pa dag rang mos pa'i gnas gang yin pa de blangs bas de bzhin gyi don grub pa nyid du gyur mod/de ltar na yang nges pa'i don sngags kyi theg pa ste/ sngags rgyud chen po nas 'jig rten khams cha shas dang gsal bar bstan pa ci rigs bzhugs pa las/ gzhan las rnam grangs du gyur pa phyi nang gzhan gsum dag sbyor rgyas par 'byung ba dpal mchog dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs 'di yin pas de la yang mchog tu gus pas bzung bar bya ba'i gnas so/ /de skad gsang sngags gsar 'gyur rgyud/ /kun gyi spyi bo'i gsang mtha'i rgyud/ /gnyis med dpal mchog dus 'khor lo/ /phyi nang gzhan du legs gsung ba'i/ /rgyud dang sa bcu pa'i 'grel par/ /phyi yi dus 'khor 'jig rten khams/ /rnam dag mkhas mchog rnams bzhed tshul/ /rnam mang gcig dang du ma nyid/ /ma 'dres legs par mthong ba'i mthus/ /rnam par spyod 95

pa'i lde mig thob/ /shes rab gsal ba'i sgo phyes nas/ /'thad pa'i rin chen bdag gir byas/ /des na bdag mkhos ngan pas gzhan gyi gshul du gzhol 'os yang / /blo yi rta rgod kha lo rten par ma bzod rgyud 'grel gyi/ /gzhung du 'jug par mthong nas rang 'dod lam du gar ba 'di/ /gnong par gyur mod bzod par snying nas gsol gyi skyon ma mdzad/ /gang du bdag gi legs par bshad pa'i cha/ /mchis kun sngon rab dam pa rnams kyi byin/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mthu rlabs kho na las/ /bdag gi bgyi ba cung zad yongs ma mchis/ /nyes par gyur kun bdag ni byis pa'i sems/ /blo rmongs skyon gyi bslad las gzhan gyi min / /de kun spang gyur rnams la mthol bshags na/ /sgrib med tshangs pa'i dbugs phyung stsal du gsol/ /rgyud dang 'grel don gzhir bzhag mkhas gsung legs pa'i cha gyur kun las btus/ de na sngon mkhas kun gyi legs bshad yin mdo phyogs gcig 'di ru ste/ de yang mgon po mchog gyur rnams kyi brtse bas bdag la bgo skal mdzad/ de phyir rab gus phyag byas bcas 'dir 'bad dge mchis mgon rnams dgyes phyir bsngo/ zhes dus 'khor 'jig rten khams rnam pa gdags pa'i dpe'u ris bgyis pa'i kha byang tshul du gsal byed kyi yi ge tshig don gsal bar rang 'dod ji bzhin byas pa zhig cis kyang bgyi bar 'os zhes rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gangs ri'i khrod du skye ba'i phreng bar snang bar mdzad pa dpal karma pa bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' mchog dang /'jam dpal dpa' bos byin gyi brlabs pas dpal ldan dpa' bo zhes su mtshan gyi snyan sa rgod pa gang gi sprul pa'i sku gyur gtsug lag mchog tu dga' ba'i zhal snga nas nan gyi bka' yi gnang bzhin rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus skyes bdag gi lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por mtshur mdo bo'i gtsug lag khang du cung zad bris pa'i 'phrod rgyal ba dam pa lo ras kyi sgrub gnas dbu rir jo nang kun mkhyen mchog gi dus chen dga' ba gnyis pa'i thun bar du grub par sbyar ba'i reg gzig las slar go bde phyir skabs 'gar tshig sna cung zad bsring bar byas pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 96

༄sto /'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag legs bshad nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba skal ldan snying gi pad+mo 'dzum par byed pa bzhugs/rnam shes kyi me long la shes rab kyi pir gyi bris pa'i legs bshad nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba skal ldan snying gi pad+mo 'dzum par byed pa shugs 'byung chu 'bab tu ta ler brjod pa rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas blo yi rol gar so/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dpag tshad khri phyed gsum phyir gdeng ba'i khar chig khri ngos mnyam par gnas pa ni/ ri drug gi steng du gnya' shing ltar gnon pas/ gzhan nas gnya' shing 'dzin du gsungs pa dang do gcig tu 'gro ba dang / nyi ma byang bsgrod kyi skabs su bar stegs kyi steng du rgyu bas na/ de yang gnya' shing 'dzin par grub so/ /de bzhin 'od sngon can ni ri rab la thong lcags kyi 'khyud pa ltar gnas pas gshol mda' 'dzin dang / mad+dha ra ni tshon sna brgya rtsas bkra bar byas pa ltar mjos pas lta na sdug dang / ni ṣaṭa ni rtsi shing can dang / tshang tshing can dang / mtshan mo la yang 'jug pas ri de seng ldeng gi nags tshal mun pa thib pa lta bu'i g.yogs pas seng ldeng nags dang / nor bu'i ri ni rin po che las grub pa'i brag rta'i rna ba'i phyi ngos kyi dbyibs lta bu'i gtam pas lta sna can dang /dro ṇa ni bro bo'i gzhal byed ste 'phags yul gyi bra zangs las byas pa ltar kun tu zlum zhing stod kyi cha/rim pas nang du 'dus zhing ri nang ma la 'dud pa ltar du gnas pas rnam 'dud pa dang / bsil ri ni ri nang ma rnams la mu khyud phyi ma'i tshul du mjos par 'khod pas na/ mu khyud 'dzin du 'thad par snyam la don du yang de las mi 'da'o/ /rgyud dang 'grel pa las gza' skar rnams kyi khyim ri rab kyi steng du 'khor bar gsungs pa dang / nyi ma byang bsgrod kyi mthar thug pa'i tshe lhun po'i rwa la reg par bzhed pa dang —/ mdo phal po che nas nyi zla 'char nub ri rab kyi rtse nas byed par gsung ba kun kho bos byas pa'i lugs 'di la 'thad kyis/ mkhas pa gzhan dang gzhan dag gi byas pa rnams la ci ltar 'gyur soms zhig 'dir ni dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud dang 'grel pa nas gsung pa ltar nyi ma byang bsgrod kyi mthar thug pa'i tshe/ dpag tshad brgyad khri lnga stong gi mkha' la rgyu ba'i tshe ri rab kyi rwa'i rtsa ba'i cha la reg pa yin cing nyi ma de las stong phrag bcu gcig 'bab ste lho bsgrod kyi mthar thug pa'i tshe/ lhun po'i bar stegs kyi brngam rdzogs pa rdo rje'i ri dang tshad mtshungs pa yin la/ 'di la snga rabs dam pa mchog gyur mang zhig gi stong phrag bdun cu rtsa lnga'i mtshams nas rwa lnga stong phrag nyer lnga'i tshad can bshos zlum 97

bzhag pa ltar bzhed pa ni gnas skabs rags rtsis kyi dbang du mdzad par snang bas skyon du mi 'gyur mod / gzhan deng sang mang phug pa lhun rgyal ba sogs zhig ri rab kyi rwa mthur 'phyang yin zhes ri rab kyi kha khyer dang / bsil ri mtshams sbyar te phyogs zlum skor la rwa ru 'dod pa ni rgyu mtshan med par smras pa ste/legs sbyar gyi skad du thong kha zhes pa dud 'gro'i ra'am/ ri'i rtse ste shas cher gyen du phyogs pa zhig la 'jug cing / rdo rje'i ra sogs mtshon cha'i rtse lta bu la ma 'gal mod/ de la rgyu mtshan med par rang 'dod 'ba' zhig gi kha khyer zlum skor ma zhig la rwa zhes brjod pa ni snying pos dben pa nyid do/ /'di la deng sang dus 'khor ba phal cher 'dod pa mthun par gnas pa'i ri rab kyi 'dod tshul 'khrul gzhi gang gi byed zhe na/ steng du rtse mo rnams ni lnga ste/ sa'i steng gi gnas la zug pa rnams ni phyogs rnams kun tu 'khor yug dang ni zhes gsung par/ sa'i steng gi zhes pa ri rab lhun po'i steng gi rgya la shar dang nub dang lho dang byang gi cha la ji srid pa la stong phrag lnga bcu pa bzhi gnas kyi steng gi rgyal ba'o/ /zhes steng gi rgya tshad la sa gzhi gsung pa de ma dran par ni sa dkyil gyi sa gzhir sems de ri rab rdo rje rtse lnga yi rwa rtse mo thur bstan du 'dod pa dang / steng gi rtse mo rnams ni lnga ste zhes pas ri rab kyi ra rtse mo gyen bstan du gsung ba de ma go bar/ ri rab kyi bya skyib nas ra skyes shing phyogs rnams kun tu 'khor yug zhes pa'i sgra la 'khrul te/ ri rab kyi ra rag sder gyi chu phyang lnga brtsegs pa bzhin 'dod pa ni 'khrul pa'i rnam 'gyur mi bzad par bstan pa nyid du shes par bya dgos lar phyogs rnams kun tu 'khor yug zhes pa ni ri rab kyi 'gram stegs la dgongs pa yin ste/ de yang 'grel chen las/ de yi phyi rol du 'khor yug gi rwa bzhi'i nang du bu ga'i gnas la gling drug rnams dang zhes pa nas kha ba'i ri la rwa can zhes bya'o/ /mkhas pa puṇ+ḍa ri ka chen po kha cig gi reg go zhes pa'i sgra ni bong tshad mnyam pa la bong tshad de reg go zhes pa ltar yin/ gsung pa ni don la 'thad cing 'dir yang 'bab pa nyid do/ /nyi ma stong phrag don lnga nas gya drug bar 'bab 'dzeg can yin na/ gya drug gi skabs su rwa la reg gsung pa las med pas/ don lnga nas rwa skye ba jo nang rje btsun mchog gi yang lugs 'dir cung zad mi mdzes par snyam/ ri rab kyi steng rwa lnga'i rtse mor grong khyer 'god pa ni tshad ma'i khung dang mi 'bral zhes dam pa mi bskyod pas kha cig gi gsungs kyang / de la khungs med pa ma yin te/ ri rab kyi lcog bzhi lag na rdo rje'i pho brang dang dbus su rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang yod par mngon pa sogs nas gsung na/ de mkhyen bzhin du 'di la ci phyir 'gog der yang ma zad ri rab la lcog bzhi'am rwa bzhi yod pa'i tshad mar sngon lo paṇa chos kyi rgyal sprul pa'i sku'i zan yang bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rim gsum rtser lcog bzhi mdzad pa de/ lcog bzhi lag na rdo rje bzhi la gtad/ zhes pa dang / rwa bzhi'i dod mchod rten dkar dmar sngo nag bzhi yin par 98

gsung pa dang / der yang ma zad paṇa shākya shrī bod du byon byung ba'i dus tsam du gzheng pa'i mchod rten gyi bra'i steng zur du ri rab rwa yi mtshon don cog gi rnam par byas pa ches mang na rwa gyen gdeng dang grong khyer lnga tshom gyi dpang po 'dis kyang 'grub ste/ /ci'i phyir rgya gar gyi paṇa chung kha cig gi gzhung ngam ngag 'gros dang / bod ston mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gyi rigs gras kyi rtog gzo byas pa la dpang po 'chol ba las nges pa don gyi sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa 'di rnams la ni yid ches kyi dpang po mchog tu cis mi bzung / de yang dus 'khor lugs dang mi 'bral snyam na/ bsam yas kyi bkod pa mngon pa dang mthun shas che ba ltar srid kyang / sngags rgyud rnying pa khungs dang ldan pa rtsa ba dang 'grel bshad mkhan gyis 'jig rten khams mdzod dang mthun pa dang mi mthun ci rigs pas bzhag na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi grub mtha' bye brag bla med nang khul gyi dus 'khor rtsa 'grel du mi gsal ba dag kyang kha bskang na yang skyon du mi sems te/ rgyud mdo yi shes rgyud rgyud kyi shes zhes sngags shes rnams kyi sgrog na 'di la su zhig gi skyon btags/ de yang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas ri rab 'bum phrag gcig gi steng du yod pa tsam las dus 'khor nas ma gsung na lta na sdug pa'i grong rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang tshal chen po bzhi sogs mngon pa dang ma 'dres par dus 'khor rang lugs kyi ci ltar bzhag legs par soms zhig de la sngags rgyud gzhan dang mngon pa dang ma 'dres pa'i dus 'khor gyi lha gnas legs bshad tshul dang mthun pa smra ba po byung na bdag kyang de yi rjes su 'brang bar byed kyang / de ltar 'chad nus pa bod 'dir da lta su yang med pa'i phyir/ de na kho bo'i lugs 'di ni rang gzo nyung zhing legs par bshad pa'i cha du mas rgyan pa yin na blo ldan phrag dog med cing gzu bor gnas pa yod na dngas bas blangs bar 'os so/ /rdo rje'i ri bo ni me'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la 'jug pa ni shin tu ma yin te/de yang dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ ba tshu'i rgya mtsho'i 'khor yug las g.yas dang g.yon du me dang rlung gi 'khor yug 'bum phrag gnyis su 'gyur ste zhes sogs/ me'i dkyil 'khor dngos la 'khor yug gi sgras yang yang du bstan cing / gal te me dkyil dpag tshad bdun khri lnga stong gi tshad/ ri rab gyen du 'greng dgos na/ rlung dkyil yang de mtshungs sam/ de las lhag pa yod dgos te/ de yang 'khor yug gi sgra mthun par gnas pa'i phyir/ rang lugs su mi 'dod de ri bdun pa rdo rje'i ri ni me'i 'khor yug gi cha shas su yod cing / 'on kyang de las rdo rje'i brag rta'i gdong pa lta bu las me 'bar nas/ me dkyil gyi khyon du gnas dgos yang 'di ni ri bdun pa yin no/ /de yang 'grel chen las/ rdo rje'i ri dang bcas pa'i ri bdun dang / rdo rje'i ri ni rta gdong gi me'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje ni/ ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i phyi rol du'o/ /zhes gsung pa ltar 'dod dgos te/ rdo rje ni rdo rje pha lam las grub pa'i ri bor 'thad do/ /de yang rgya 99

mtsho'i lhas zhus pa'i le'u las/ rgya mtsho'i chu ni mang mod kyi/ gdon mi za bar skam pa'i dus yod do/ /skal pa 'jig tu nye ba na/ nyi ma gnyis shar na chu mig dang rdzing kha kun skam mo/ /nyi ma gsum shar ba na chu phran thams cad skam mo/ /nyi ma bzhi shar ba na chu thams cad skam mo/ /nyi ma lnga shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po yang lnga cha bri'o/ /nyi ma drug shar ba na sum gnyis bri'o/ /nyi ma bdun shar ba na rgya mtsho chen po yang skam mo/ /ri rab lhun po yang snyil/ rdo rje'i mtha' la thug gi bar tshig cing 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung pa yang / dus 'khor nas gsung pa'i rdo rje'i ri bo 'di la 'dod dgos so/ /de gang gi shes zhe na/mdo der dge tshul tshul khrims bsrung ba'i le'ur/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i gting yang rdo rje yin la/mtha' ma yang rdo rje'i ris bskor te/ chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab kyang mi 'grib/ mi ldud pa ltar tshul khrims kyi rgya mtsho yang de dang 'dra ste/ 'dul ba rdo rjes lta bus ni brting nas/ chos mngon pa'i ris ni mtha' ma bskor / mdo sde bzhi chu bo bzhin 'babs kyang 'phel ba yang med/ 'grib pa yang med do/ /rgya mtsho'i spyi phyir mi ldud zhe na/ mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal ba'i mes rgya mtsho skam pas de yi phyir/ rgya mtsho'i chu mi ldud do/ /chu bo bzhi rtag tu 'bab pas ni 'grib so/ /zhes gsung na/ rdo rje'i ri yang dus mtha' bskal pa'i mes tshig par bzhed na me dkyil la rdo rje'i rir 'dod na me yi me ci ltar bsreg don som zhig gu/ 'on kyang ye shes kyi me yi las kyi me sogs bsreg par nus mod kyang / 'jig rten gyi mes me bsreg pa'i tshul ma byung bzhin 'dod mi nus so/ /gzhan rig byed kyi gzhung du nyi ma'i chung mas khyo yi gzi brjid ma bzod nas/ rta rgod ma'i gzugs kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bros shing yib par/ rgod ma kha yi ming su 'dod pa dang / rig byed yongs grags su de lha chen po dbang phyug gi rang gi bstan bcos tshigs mi mdzes par ngo tsha nas rta gdong gi me la dor ba ci rigs tshig cing lhag ma long zhig pas khyab 'jug phag pa'i gzugs byas te blang ba'i de ni/ rta gdong ni rdo rje'i ri rta'i gdong pa lta bu'i kha nas me byung ba phal cher gyi 'dod ltar yang yin gyis/ me dkyil gyi sa khyon du gnas shing me 'bar bas dbyer mi phyed pa ltar snang bas me dkyil kyi khong su bsdu dgos pa yang yin no/ /de ltar nyi ma bdun 'char nas 'jig rten bsdud pa sogs mdzod dang mthun shas che bas theg dman gyi lugs so snyam na/ gong du lung drangs pa'i mdo 'di theg chen mdor shing rta jo zhal dag gis chen pos bzhed bzhin gnas pa dang / dus 'khor lugs 'di 'jig dus nyi ma bdun khas blang min ji ltar yang 'dir gsung pa'i rdo rje'i ri ni gcig tu khas blang dgos so/ rdo rje'i ri ni me yi 'khor yug dang gcig dang bye brag pa gnyis kar grub ste me yi dkyil 'khor spyi la rta gdong gi mer mi brjod ste 'grel chen du me yi dkyil 'khor lo ni rta gdong can no/ /zhes ma gsung la/ rdo rje'i ri ni me yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes kyang ma gsung bas gong du 100

brjod pa nyid de rgyas par phros pas chog go/ /gal te zlum skor mchu 'phyang la rwar 'dod na/ bum pa'i mchu 'phyang la bum pa'i rwa dang maṇ+ḍal gyi 'gram la maṇ+ḍal gyi rwa zhes 'dogs chog mod/ de lta rgya bod kyi mkhas pa sus kyang ma byas na deng dus/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i ri rab kyi rwa yi 'dod tshul 'dir ches che ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyi mi brtag par 'jug pa ni shin tu ya mtshan pa'i gnas so/ /rwa pa snga rabs rnams dang chag lo gsum pas byas pa'i ri rab kyi rwa yi rnam pa de ni gzhan rnams kyi 'bad pas bkag kyang tso/ da lta'i yongs grags kyi 'dod tshul 'di las ni ches legs mod/ 'on kyang 'grel chen du bsil ri la rwa can du gsung pa rwa skye mtshams de yi thad tsam du dgongs nas phyir skyed par snang yang gzhung gi dgongs don ni rwa de nas phyir bskyed pa'i gnas ma yin ste/ ri rab steng gi rwa bzhi'i phyi mtha' dang bsil ri'i phyi mtha' shin tu snyom zhing 'grig pas na rwa can zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni de yin no/ /ci'i phyir 'grel chen nyid du lho me'i 'khor yug la reg nas de phyogs su dum bu bdun par thob ste/ ri rab kyi ra la reg nas gangs ri'i steng du 'gro bar byed zhes pas kho bos gong du bshad pa nyid las sems gzhan du 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /gzhan ni deng dus tshig des 'khrul gzhi skyes te bsil ri dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong gyen du 'phags nas ri rab kyi kha khyer dang sgrigs pa spos dong kha chod sprad pa lta bur 'dod pa ni ya cha'o/ /dus phyis byung ba'i rtsis kyi bstan bcos chen po rtsom pa pos kyang spos dong kha chod lta bu de ma bzhed nas rang gi blo gros kyi lang tshos gsar du rnyed par rlom pa ri rab kyis steng du dpag tshad 'bum du byas nas sa yi dkyil 'khor dang mnyam par 'dod pa ni gza' skar go la thams cad ri rab kyi bya skyibs 'og tu chud cing / gza' skar ri rab kyi steng du bsgrod pa'i rgyud tshigs de dang dngos su 'gal ba sogs sgo du ma nas rang nyid mkhas par sgrogs pa la mi mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur mi zad pa bstan pa ste snga ma rnams kyi 'dod pa las kyang tha chad par song ba'o/ /yang rgyud 'grel du rā yi nang khong bu ga rnams su ri gling mtsho drug po rnams yod par gsung bas 'di'i bu ga na khong gseng la ngos bzung dgos shing rwa yi phyi mtha' nas rtsam lhun po'i khor yug gi mtshams bar ri drug gi gseng bar du gling dang mtsho drug yod pa las steng nas rag 'gag gi mchu 'phyang lnga rtsegs lta bu dang mtshams sbyar dgos pa'i shes byed ni gtan nas med do/ /kun tu 'khor ba'i sgra tsam ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa phyogs kun tu 'khor ba zhes pa la phyogs su rdo rje'i rwa yod par 'dod pa las rdo rje'i rwa zlum por bskor ba ma yin pa bzhin 'dir yang lhun po'i phyogs kyi mtshams su rwa rnams yod pa la 'dod dgos kyi lag gdub ltar zlum skor dgos pa'i shes byed med do/ /des na skyog po ma yin pa'i blo can gyi kho bos bshad pa 'di la legs par rtogs shig gzhan yang rdo rje'i mchog gi ri rnams te zhes 'byung bas spyir yang ri brgyad ka 101

la rdo rje'i sgrar bzhag ste gsung pas yang rtogs so/ /nyi ma la de yi 'od zer mchog tu tsha ba gdung byed dang / dkyil 'khor gnyis las dkyil 'khor ni go la'i tshad dbug gis bcal nas bzhag pa la thad kar dpag tshad stong dang bzhi brgya rtsa drug rgyang grags gcig gi tshad du gsung ba dang / mngon pa sogs nas dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig tu gsung te gang ltar de la dro zhing smin par byed pa gdung byed kyi 'khor lo dpag tshad nyi khri lnga stong gi tshad can ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag pa'i mthar dpag tshad stong phyed dang bcu gsum gyi kun nas bskor bas de ltar 'gyur bar mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis gsung bzhin de ltar don la shin tu 'jug pa dang / des na ri rab kyi rwa la yang gdung byed des reg shing gangs kyi ri bo'i steng du gdung byed kyi khyab par byed pa la rags rtsis kyi nyi ma der bsgrod pa tsam du mdzad pa gzhung gi tshig don dang / lho phyogs kyang me yi khor yug gi cha dang po'i bar du 'gro bar gsung ba yang gdung byed kyi cha dang po'i bar khyab pa'i don ste/ lho bsgrod kyi mthar thug tshe nyi ma me rlung gi bzlog ste gyen du bskyod pa dang / nyi ma byang sgrod kyi skabs su chu rlung gi bzlog nas thur du 'bab pa yin zhes kho bo'i rnam par rtog pas gsar du bzhag pa ste don du yang 'gal ba'i cha cung zad yang med doske/ / da dung gzhan yang dpyad par bya ba na gling drug la gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams mi yin pas khyab zhes smra yang / de yang mi'am ci dang khrung khrung drag po'i gling zhes brjod bzhin/ mi'am ci dang / khrung khrung dag mi ru ci ltar 'gyur yang bsam bya dang / rgyud dang 'grel par ni rang 'od kyi 'tsho zhing bdud rtsi 'bras bu za ba longs spyod pa sar gsung pa las/ mi yin par bshad pa ni med do/ /yang snar thang pa dang bo dong pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po kha cig gi rnga yab kyi srin po mi'i rigs can yin no gsungs pa yang spyir tshangs pa'i srin po dang / klu yi srin po dang / mi ma srin sogs ches rtsub zhing de rigs 'joms pa'i nus pa can sgra yang sor bzhag kyang bye brag srin po'i 'gro ba rkang tshugs pa la ni bden bral zhes rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams nas lha min gyi rigs su bsdus na/ gal te'i mi'i rgyud du srin po'i rigs zhugs pa byung na yang lha min gyi 'jug par bsdu dgos so/ lhun po'i steng gi rwa lnga po bzhi las cung zad gyen du 'bur bar 'dod pa yi rwa rtse dbus ma'i cung zad tsam gyi mdun shar gyi char rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang yod par byas na 'gal ba ma yin te/ shar phyogs dbang po zhes kun tu grags bzhin dang /dbus kyi rwa rtser sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa yod cing / de dang nye bar lha rnams spro ba bskyed cing dbugs dbyung bar byed ba'i chos kyi rnga bo che ngo mtshar ba de yang gnas pa'o—/ /gzhan yang da dung rgya cher shin tu spror yod kyang 'dir dogs sel sha chas kyi tshul du re zhig de tsam mo/ /zhes skyes bdag gi lo sbo zla'i dkar kyi phyogs thob pa dang por snang gsal gyi mdangs dang 102

dga' ba gnyis par thun mtshams su cung zad zhig bkod pa ste rgyal khams pa des so/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /dbus kyi rwa rtser rdo rje rtse dgu pa yod pa dang / ri de la lha'i drang srong chen po bye bas bsam gtan byed pa sogs/ bai ro'i snyan rgyud rdo rje zam pa chen po'i stong thun du shin tu gsal ba dang / 'dra 'bag lhad med rnams nas kyang 'di'i tshul cung zad yod pas des na rang gzor ma sems shig /

༄ga /bod du dus 'khor skar rtsis kyi lugs srol ji snyed byung ba kun gcig tu gsal bar byed pa kun mdzes nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal ba yongs kyi rab bsngags thub dbang rgya mtsho'i gter/ /dbang bsgyur ut+pal rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'chang ba po/ /snying rje'i chu gter las 'khrungs pad dkar phyag rgya can/ /rgyal ba'i bdag po rgyal dang sras der phyag byas nas/ /dpal mchog dus 'khor phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi/ /phyi yi dus 'khor skar rtsis gangs can 'dir/ /mkhas mang bzhed srol ma 'dres gsal ba ru/ /nyung ngu'i ngag gi kho bos 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang go sla dpyad bde phyir/ /rtsis lo rab byung bcu gsum pa'i/ /thog ma nag zla'i sgruwa rnams/ /ma nor gsal bar phye ba ste/ /de la rtsa ba dang 'phros pa/ /rtsa ba rnam dag rgyud nyid dang //'phros pa mkhas pa'i man ngag lugs/ /byed dang grub par grags pa yi/ /dang po rnam dag rgyud nyid du/ /tshig don gsal bstan de ji bzhin/ /lag len bgyis la byed rtsis zhes/ /rtsis gzhung kun gyi ma ma de'i/ /zla bshol rgyud nas bzhis bsgyur te/ /mkha' me zla bas bgos na yang / /lag len bde phyir man ngag tu/ /gnyis kyi bsgyur nas re lngas bgos/ /des na 'dir ni zla phyed kyi/ /lhag ma nyi shu rtsa dgu yod/ /gza' nyi gnas gsum steng rang gnas/ /bar dbyug 'og ma skyon sel cha/ 1(39(5 24(33 26(59phro17 de yi steng gcig bar so dgu/ /'og lhag lha 'char gza' sgru'o/ /cha shas so gsum ril nyer bzhi/ /zla sgru'i ngo bo tshes rkang yin/ /skar gnas nyer drug bar zhe dgu/ /'og ma bcu bdun nyi sgru'o/ /nyi sgruzhib rtsis su gnas lngar/ /rtsod dus thams cad mkhyen 'gas bzhed/ 26phro48phro33phro5(1 de la skar gnas gong dang mtshungs/ /dbyug gur gcig dman srang so gsum/ /srog dbang 'dod char zla ba nas/ /de ni grags che khung dang ldan/ /yang ni mkhyen dbang bu ston gyis/ /byed rtsis thun min snyan rgyud rgyun/ /chad med kye ri paṇ+ḍi ta/ /yab sras la babs lugs de yi/ 1phro5'phro56phro5phro37(624sko33 26phro46phro34sko0phro82 /gza' sgrur gcig dang nga bzhi dang / /nga drug lnga dang dus ri me/ /nyi sgrur nyer drug dang zhe drug /so bzhi mkha' dang nyer gnyis so/ /'di dang mtshur phu ba kha cig /grol zhing rgyal pos byas rtsis bzhi/ /phyogs mthun na yang rtsa ba'i gnad/ /lag len mi gcig par shes bya/ /spyi don gnyis pa dus 'khor gyis/ /'grel par grub pa'i ming tsam la/ /rten nas bod yul gyis mkhas pa/ /du mas rang rang rtog pa nyid/ / 104

grub rtsis 'dod pa man ngag lugs/ /gnas lnga rang rang gnas gyur steng / /de nas chu tshod chu srang dbyugs / /de 'og ri mo lhag med khyad/ /gza' yi cha shas ri mkha' ri/ /nyi ma'i cha shas re bdun nyid/ /phal cher lag len mthun pa yi/ /'dir yang de bzhin shes bya ste/ /thog mar rgyud kyi rtsis 'phro nyid/ /grub pa'i rtag longs kyis bsgrub pa/ 2(0dze7phro0(6 25phro33 25(59phro5(84sko0(13 /gza' mig dbyug thig chu srang ri/ /srog mkha' cha shes drug gza' sgru/ /nyi ma'i skar gnas de nyid dang / /dbyug bug mda' dang mtsho me srang / /dbugs mkha' ri dus 'char nyi ma/ /'di ni mkhas pa'i mkhas pa che/ /bu ston zhabs kyi mkhas dga' byed/ /byang bdag grub rtsis snga rtsom dang / /mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen po yi/ /bzhed kyang 'di ste dang po'o/0(51phro50phro3(159 24(30 0(36(16(0(48phro6 /gza' thig chu tshod nga gcig dang / /chu srang lnga bcu srog yon tan/ /cha shas bug dbang zla gza' sgru/ /nyi mar thig le dbyug so drug /srang du bcu drug srog thig le//cha shas zhe brgyad nyi sgru ste//mkhas mchog 'gos lo gzhon dpal gyi/ /'khrul sel lugs te gnyis pa'o/1(54sko57phro4phro358 24phro33 26phro11(5(4sko37(5/gza' gnas gcig dang dbyug lnga bzhi//chu srang nga bdun srog chu gter//cha shas klu dbang yon tan ni/ /gza' sgru 'bru che yin te nyi ma la/ /gnas drug byas pa'i skar nye drug /dbyu gu bde byed chu srang lnga/ /srog bzhi steng ma reg bdun 'char/ /ri rtse 'og tu 'dod char lnga/ /de ni 'bras rtsis rgya rtsa mkhanaglu/ /brgya phrag lugs ste gsum pa'o/ 2phro0phro6(8phro134 24(33 24dze51(33(0(54 /gza' bsgrod dbyug thig srang du ro/ /srog mig cha shas mtsho me gzugs/ /nyi sgrur nyer lnga dang nga dgu/ /so gsum dang thig nga bzhi ni/ /byang bdag rang bzhed nor bu'i 'phreng / phyi rtsom 'phro ste bzhi pa'o/1mo55(27(4sko358 24sko33 26(31(8(5(go /gza' sgrur gcig dang nga lnga dang //nyer bdun bzhi dang nor dbang rtse/ /nyi skar dus mig dang zla me/ /klu dang dbang po dang bug mtsho/ /'di ni tshur lugs grub pa'i rtsis//mthun min nyid te lnga pa'o/1(52phro41(2(524 2'phro39 26(9(37phro3phro45/ri bong can gza' lag dbang dbyug /zla mtsho srang ste srog tu mig /cha shas mtsho lag mda' gza' sgru//nyi skar nyer drug dbyug gur dgu//so bdun srang ste dbugs su gsum//cha shas zhe lnga nyi sgru ste//deng sang ches grags zhal lung zhes/ /phug pa'i lugs ste drug pa'o/1phro54phro1phro23 24(69 26(29(46phro3(37 /gza' gcig chu tshod lnga bcu bzhi/ /srang du zhe lnga srog tu gcig /cha shas nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ /skar gnas dus mig dbyug bug mig /dus mtsho srang ste srog yon tan/ /ri bsgrod cha ste nyi sgru 'di/ /bsgrub brgyud mnga' bdag 'brug pa'i srol/ /gdan du lugs te bdun pa'o/ /de ltar grub rtsis rnam grangs bdun/ /snga phyi byung dus go rim bzhin/ /ma 'chol legs bkod de rnams kyis/ /ril cha mang zhig 105

rgyud ltar la/ /byang pas do gcig de mthun byas/ /cha shas steng nas 'khrul sel gsum/ /zhal lung la ni bcu bzhi chad/ /gdan dus sum cu rtsa drug lhag /bshol 'phro bgos kyi nyi shu dang / /byang pas gcig gi mang ba mdzad/ /phug pas bzhi chad gzhan rnams mthun/ /gdan dus pas kyang mtshungs tshul snang/ /lo zla'i nges 'dzin kun mthun la/ /'khrul sel rab byung shing byi dang / /hor zla gnyis pa nag zlar mdzad/ /'jug bde'i khyad 'dir spyi mthun byas/ 261 /rgyud kyi sgra gcan zla mtshams mig /'khrul sel de la zla gcig bsnan/ /spyi zhag dang ni gza' lnga'i 'phro/ /gdan zhal 'gos gsum rtsis 'phro'i dbang / /cung zad tsam gyi mi 'dra yod/ /gzhan kun rgyud kyi rtsis 'phror 'jug /des na rnam dag rgyud nyid nas/ /gsungs pa'i rtsis 'phro 'di lta ste/ /rab byung nyi rdzogs 'dod pa'i dbur/ 0phro31(619 /spyi zhag gnas gsum ri mkha' ri'i/ /chu ru rtsa zla bro ba ste/ /bar ma mtsho mtshams 'phro zla rtse/ /steng ma gza' gnas thig le'o/ /gza' lnga bkra shis mtsho ri me/ 37rirtog ldan la ni zu bu rgyal/ 2491 /lha yi bla mar bde byed swo/3211 /lha min bla mar me mig 'dod/ 1323 /dal 'gror zla mtsho zla dbang po/ 5141 /rgyud kyi byed pa lo 'pho yang / 6phro58(57(3(75 gza' gnas 'od zer dbyug klu dbang / /chu srang thub dbang dbugs yon tan/ /cha shas zla rir shes par bya/ /gong gi sgru wa tha dad pa/ /kun kyang lnga bsdus lag len mthunaglu//'on kyang nyi skyes khyim sbyangs skabs/ /rgyud don skar drug rkang gsum la/ /phyis 'byung du mas blos dpyad kyis/ /'dir ldan myongs rtsis yin no lo/ /phugs lugs nang khul nyid du yang / /snga phyir 'dra min mang byung mod/ /de rnams phal cher skar gnas lnga/ /dbyug gu mda' mtsho (45)dang mda' me(35)/ /me rtse (33)dang ni me mig (23)dang / /nyi ( 12)dang dus (6)su byas sogs yod/ /de bzhin gza' lnga'i skyes khyim yang / /rgyud dang 'dra min byas pa'ang mtshar/ /gza' 'dzin 'byung skabs sgra gcan dbyug /zhe lnga dor ba 'phags pas gsungs/ /de la jo zhal gyis gdong 'jug /'gos kyi sgra gcan rtsa bar 'phrin/ /nye dbyug myos byas dman mdzad mtshungs/ /gzhan rnams nyi dam rang bab byas/ /nyi zla 'jug dus da lta kun/ /tshes longs rdzogs ma thag 'dod mthun/ /'on kyang mchog dgas tshes nas dbrisaske//de yang 'jig rten mgon pos lnga/ /don de mkhas mchog bus kyang ste/ /ut+ta ra bas dbyug dkyil nasarka/ /bcu cha srang 'khor sum chas sbyangs/ /rgya cher grags pas dbyu gur bzhi/ /bsnan sogs la 'grigs skyon sel nyid/ /zab gnad sbas zol lag len mang / /de yi rtsa ba'i gnad gang yin/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyi mkhyen par nges/ /gzhan ni rkun pos mun khrod rdzas/ /cha med lag pas dpyad bzhin byas/ /gang zhig tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung / /rgyud dang 'bral par dngos bstan gyis/ /rtsis 'phro sgrub tshul cho ga la/ /ma dag byed pa'i rtsis zhes smad/ /'grel par grub rtsis la bsngags gsung / /mthong bas rang rtog gi 106

'bad gzhung / /lhag med ri mo'i 'phrul tsam la/ /shin tu rnam dag grub rtsis zhes/ /bka' las lhag pa'i bstan bcos 'di/ /ci zhes da dung bdag blo dges/ /ci kyang nges dag rtsis 'phro 'di'i/ /chog ches rung tsho kho bo yis/ /rang 'dod grub rtsis rnam grangs zhig /sngar nas ci rig 'chad zin yang / /rgyal gsung rgyud la gus ches pas/ /smras de gzhan la bzod kyang gsol/ /ci phyir rgyud la cher gus yang / /gzhan du bdag ni mi mkhas rmongs/ /des na mkhas gsung la blun pos/ /skyor 'byin mi 'os pa yin no/ /'on kyang 'di snang lo 'dod min/ /rgyud kyi don la 'jug gam zhes/ /thun mong bstan bcos dpyad pa 'dis/ /bdag la kun tu nyes gyur med/ /skar rtsis man ngag rnam grangs gyur de rnams/ /zlos skyar tsam min kun gyi rang gzhung mthong / /mthong nas zhe 'dod phyogs snga ji bzhin go/ /don de ma 'dres gsal bar 'dir bkod byas/ /de skad rtsis kyi gzhung mang rgya chen yul ljongs can/ /ji bzhin rnyog med bdag blo'i me long phra mor chud/ /tshul de gzhan la mdzub btsugs nyid du bsten 'di'i dges/ /'gro kun mkhyen rab dbang phyug myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni sngar bal yul mchod rten bya ri kam sho ma'i zhig gso'i skabs rnam 'dren mkhyen pa'i gter chen smra ba'i dbang phyug kun gzigs gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba'i zhal nas dang po'i blo can la phan pa'i slad du gangs can 'dir byung ba'i skar rtsis kyi rnam grangs kun phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa zhig bgyis na rung zhes bka'i gnang bar brnyes pas yid drangs shing / nye bar la stod ding ri ba rig gnas sku gzugs bris 'bur tshad ma dang skar rtsis la rab tu sbyangs pa'i blo can blo gros rab rgyas kyi bkra shis lha rdzas kyi me tog bcas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor yul dbus gtsang gi mtshams ya 'brog dkar mo gling skyid mtsho ne'u sing du rab byung bcu gsum pa'i rab myos lcags rta nyin byed bu mo'i khyim du brtsen pa khrum zla'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis par rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus yang dag par bkod pa'o/ /dge'o//dge'o/ /

༄ga /rig gnas rtsis kyi man ngag dri med 'od snang rab byed kun mdzes nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ma naḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ lha mchog rnams kyi cod pan gyi/ /gang gi zhabs rdul gus mchod pa/ /kun mkhyen de la legs btud nas/ /nyung ngu'i byed grub gsal bar byed/ /rab byung la sogs 'das pa'i lo/ /nyi mas bsgyur la nag po sogs/ /'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis kyi/ /'og ma lag bsgyur bug bsgrod ster / /de la mda' ros rnyed steng sbyin/ /gang des zla ba dag par 'gyur/ /zla dag gnas bzhi steng nas mar / /1phro31(50mo80 'od skar can dang gzugs yon tan/ /mkha' dbang dang ni thig nor lhas/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgyur ba la/ /2phro0phro7(1 mig dang nam mkha' dang ri bo/ /'og ma ri bong can gyi brgyan / /7(60phro60(706 de nas ri mkha' ri dang ni/ /drug cu mkha' ro thub pa yi/ /dril nas dor ba'i lhag ma gang / /de 'dir res gza'i sgru wa yin/ /2(1 gnas gnyis mig dang gzugs kyis bsgyur/2'phro33 rgyal ba dang ni me rtse ster/ /28(126 dus nyi dang ni klu lag gis/ /dril nas dor lhag cha shas tshogs/ /2(10phro58(6 mig phyogs klu dbang dus kyi ni/ /zla dag gnas bzhi rim par bsgyur/ /26(48(33phro11 steng nas nyer drug klu mtsho dang / /so gsum bde 'byung rim par brgyan/ /27phro60(60phro13 'og nas 'dod pa dang mkha' ro/ /mkha' ro dang ni 'khor lo yi/ /dril dor byas pa'i lhag ma ni/ /rgyud lugs nyi sgru rnam par dag /de ltar sgru gsum bsgyur byed gang / /sbyin pas phyi ma'i zla sgru ra 'gyur/ /bsgyur byed tshar grangs bcu gnyis sbyin/ /phyi lo'i nag sgru rnam par dag /gshol byung tshe na bsgyur byed ni/ /tshar gcig slar yang bsnan pas 'grub/ /tshes re'i nges pa 'tshol ba na/ /gza' tshes nyi ma'i tshes re yi/ /rtsa ba'i longs spyod gza' tshes la/ /thig le rtsa dbang yon tan dang / /chu ri rig byed nyi ma la/ /thig le rig byed zla mig rnams/ /tshes bsgyur zla nyi'i sgru bar sbyin/ /ril por tshes sbyin chu zlas bgoske/ /thob pa mnyam dang mi mnyam brtag /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang bzung de'i/ /sngun ma'i cha shas bsgyur ba la/ /dus nyi'i thob pa chu tshod lhag /drug cu ri mkha' ri yi bsgyur/ /rked pa bsrang dang cha shas te/ /'di dag snga rkang zos sdom sbyin/ /phyi rkang gza' bya sdom la dbri/ /de nas res gza'i longs spyod du/ /thob pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dor/ /nyi ma gnas gnyis gcig la ni/ /khyim gsum sbyangs bya ma ldang na/ /'khor bsre lhag na 'khor byed dor/ /lhag ma skar gnas drug cu'i bsgyur/ /chu tshod bsres la mda' yon zlas/ /108

thob pa 'das pa'i khyim rnams yin/ /des ni nyi rkang bzung nas slar/ /rgyu zhing yod pas lhag ma bsgyur/ /mda' yon zlas rnyed chu tshod lhag / mkha' bro dus dang 'dod pa yi/ /bsgyur rnyed srang dang cha shas te/ /'di dag snga rkang zos sdom sbyin/ /phyi rkang gza' bya sdom la dbri/ /de nas gza' nyi'i longs spyod du/ /rim min sbyin zhing rim par sbyangs/ /des ni gza' tshes nyi ma dag /nyi ma gnyis bkod gcig gi ni/ /dbyu gur mtsho mda' tshes bsgyur sbyin/ /res gza'i longs spyod rnams kyis sbyangs/ /'khor lo dor lhag zla skar yin—/ /nyi ma zla ba bsres pa la/ /'khor lo dor lhag sbyor ba ste/ /tshes la mig bsgyur gzugs dman pas/ /thub pas bgos lhag byed pa'o/ /de ltar lan gcig dag pa la/ /phyi ma'i longs spyod bsnan pa ni/ /gza' tshes nyi zla'i tshes re yi/ /rtsa ba'i longs spyod so sor sbyin/ /de la nyi rkang 'phel 'grib ni/ /chu srang drag po yon tan dbugs/ /'dod pa'i cha shas bcu gcig rnams/ /gzhu dang chu srin khyim du sbyin/ /karka ṭa dang 'phrig par der/ /srang bdun srog bzhi cha bdun rnams/ /sdig pa dang ni bum pa sbyin/ /glang dang seng ge'i khyim du dor/ /srang gcig srog lnga cha brgyad rnams/ /nya dang srang gi khyim du sbyin/ /lug dang bu mo'i khyim du dor/ /res gza' la ni khyad par du/ /ril por tshes sbyin chu zlas bgos/ /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung —/ /rang thad rkang pa'i gnas de nyid/ /thob pa mnyam na snga rkang bdun/ /thad kar sbyin zhing phyi rkang dbri—/ /mi mnyam na ni de las bzlog /cha shas drug cus bsgyur ba la/ /dus dang nyi mas thob chu srang / /drug gis bsgyur las snyed pa dbugs/ /'dod pas bsgyur te 'dod pa'i chas/ /rkang pa me nas drag po'i bar / /thob pa mnyam na bu lon te/ /mi mnyam na ni nor yin no/ /'on kyang rkang pa bdun pa la/ /spyod tshe dbri bsnan mi bya zhing / /brgyad par rim pa gsum du sbyar/ /de ltar byas na phyi ma yi/ /gza' tshes nyi ma'i skar mar 'gyur/ /'on kyang zla skar 'pho ba'i mtshams/ /tshes kyi rjes su 'gro 'gyur zhing / /sbyor ba byed pa sngar bzhin zhes/ /mkhas pas legs par bshad pa la/ /brnyed ces rgyal bstan shing rta mchog /gang gi gsung nyid kho nar bris/ /de ltar yan lag lnga yi rtsis/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i sras thu bo/ /'jig rten mgon po mi yi gzugs/ /rab shes rngog gi gsung ji bzhin/ /rtsis 'phro rgyud nas gsung bzhin la/ /lag len man ngag rgyun la brten/ /legs par bkod la nyes med sems/ /nyes na kun mkhyen mchog la bshagasaske/ /legs par bshad pa mchis gyur na/ /'dren mchog bla ma'i mthu las te/ /de las dge mchis 'gro ba kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas thob shog /zhes yan lag lnga'i rim pa 'di yang skar rtsis mkhan spyi la grags pa'i rab byung skor bcu gnyis 'das shing bcu gsum pa nyid 'das lo'i dang por byas te dkar po zhes pa sbrul gyi lo nyi ma seng ge'i khyim du spyod pa'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po la 'phags yul gyi mu khyun k+ṣe trar 'bod pa glo bo zhes pa'i yul stod smon thang rgyal po'i khab tu don gnyer 109

can du ma'i ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i legs par bkod pa sarba maṅga lo/'di ltar mtshur phu ba kha cig dang / glo bo'i phyogs su nyi ma byed pa dang / gza' grub par byas te byed grub thun mong zhes bsgrags pa byung la da lta'i skabs kyi dus bzhi sogs kyang de dang nges par 'grigs pas mi 'thad pa med pa mthong la/ spyir ni deng sang dus snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'tsho ba long khyab chung ba'i skabs 'dir tha snyad rig pa skar rtsis sogs kyang tshig tshogs ri tshogs mang pos sems g.yeng bar mi bya ste don grub phyin tshig tshogs dang ri tshogs nyung ngu'i chog shes par byas nas dam pa'i chos rim gnyis kyi nyams len la rtse gcig tu 'bad pa kho na gal chen du shes par byos shig ka lja wat+taskyo swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo at+ma ko3ham/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i/ /mdun du rlung me thod sgyed steng / /āḥlas thod pa dkar dmar ba/ /nang du shaḥlnga bdud rtsi lnga/ kha chod zla ba kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'bru gsum mtshan zhing rlung gi g.yos/ /skyon sbyangs las ye bdud rtsi bsdus/ kha ṭ+wāṃ zla ba 'od zhu 'dres/ /bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /o āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ dze tse/ rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lhag pa'i lha/ /bdag med rnal 'byor bskor kyai rdo rje/ /'byung po kun 'dul gsang bdag mthu rdo rje/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can che/ /dpal ldan rdo rje nag po gur gyi mgon/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug gzi ldan zhal bzhi pa/ /e ka dza ti 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /las mkhan lcam dral pu tra ming sring gsum/ /srog bdag chen po beg rtse lcam bral sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po rjes dran pas/ /ma thog myur du spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la dgyes par bzhugs / /rnal 'byor sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog spos me dri chab zhal zas dang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos kyi khams/ /sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol ta ghan sogs/ /phyi nang gsang mchod bskang rten sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /dngos dang yid las skyes gyur kun bzang sprin/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam rgya chen 'di/ /mchod do 'bul lo thugs dam rgya chen dgyes pa bskang / /bdag la mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsol/ /o āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni dharma pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la s+thā na pā ti shā sa na rak+ṣi ta sa pā ri wa ra i dam ba lirto kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba puts+tsha la li ta ku ru hoḥ sarba sirnyi me pra yats+tshan+tu swā hā/ skye med spros bral gdod ma'i gshis nyid las/ ma 'gags cir yang snang ba sgyur ma'i 'phrulatso//rtsa gsum chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshul/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor ston la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtsa gsum chos skyongs yid bzhin nor bu la/ /de ltar mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ston grub rtags myur du phyungs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub/ /khyad par 'di nas mthar thug sangs rgyas bar/ /chos dang mi mthun 110

bar chad kun zhi zhing / /sa lam yon tan nyams med gong du 'phel/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu rdo rje sems dpa'i sa/ /gegs med myur du thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes gtor 'bul khyer bde 'di ni/ se dkar rigs kyi snying po 'dar mi rje btsad po dad 'byor shes rab phun tshogs pa zhabs drung nor bu dpal 'byor dang / blo bzang bkra shis sku mched kyi gsung gi bskul ba la brten nas mdo khams kaḥthog lhor 'od gsal lha rigs tha shas su skyes pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jigs med grub mchog dpa' 'os sa bya sbo zla'i tshes nyi shu'i thun skabs cig la gang dran smras pa sarba maṅga lo/sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du r+ghaṃ las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sistim me pra yats+tsha/sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ shrīḥyaḥku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ma hā sa ma ya sa twa/ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ston pa bcu gnyis ni/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ 1 'od mi 'khrug pa/ 2 'jam dpal 'jigs skyobs/ 3 gzhon nu rnam rol/ 4rdo rje 'chang chen/ 5 gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan/ 6 drang srong khro rgyal/ 7 gser 'od dam pa/ 8 brtse ba'i blo gros/ 9 'od srung sgres po/ 10 mngon rtogs rgyal po/11 ston pa shākya thub pa rnams/ 12 āyurīshamaṇipusbyabarayānashāsanadharayanamaḥtshe dbang nor bu bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /namaḥkasmrashāsanān+tapuṣ+ṭadzagadrwamakabadz+rasatwaprabalāya / /karma bstan pa mtha' yas 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /111

(gza' bsrung ) o badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣanī lam wa ra dha ra rā dzñā sa ya te swā hā/o ke ta ke ta ra hu la gza' kha tra ru tra ye swā hā/ ma tra ru tra ru tra ye ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ rtu bu li rtu li ting dhī sum̐ bhi su su me me shig shig khrol khrol swā hā/ man+t+ra 'di 'chang ba po bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la gza' gdong rgyu skar gyi gnod pa las mi tshugs par srung shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ o sarba bi dh+yā swā hā/r+ghaṃ bud+dha bhaskyorakapyahridayamitai m+bha mañdzushrīhridayamihaṃ hriḥ ar+ya.awalokiteshwarasuhridayamitaiḥ dheḥbadzatikyāpyahridayamitai.armāṣetsaturluṇ+ḍahridayānāmarkye.an+yatarmahridayam̐dzapat+t+waṃ / swakasukade watayogikṛtābāglitāmebartsitāshutidhāritā.asamānapratibhānatāsarbatrabābidzayita.abh+yatasañtsabhidzñātasirgyatihrotsan+d+ramaṇ+ḍalamargya.ashiṣapad+mosamasharīram̐hridayāk+ṣarātsāmah+ye.atamadak+ṣaram̐dhayat+t+waṃdraradadzhaibyabhidzñādzñārnasirgyati/gar dbang rdo rje'i gter lung las/ nus rig 'dzin chen po nus ldan rdo rje bde gshegs gis 'dus pa rtsalaske/ ldan rdo rje'i sku lus mtharaḥ rigs sngags 'chang ba pad+ma' rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma bde chen gling pa/mtshanaḥ de la dad 'dun gtsug gi nor de gnyis ka nas rjes su bzung zhing grub mtha' 'dzin pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ bu'i tshul: zhi ba'i tshul na rdo rje sems dpa' zhes kyang bya: zhes so/ sarba a pa na ye bzlog bzlog bh+yo bh+yo: oṃ mu ram̐ mu ram̐ sum̐ sum̐ rmi lo sum̐ ṭ+wā hā/ da lta'i rmi lam ngan pa thams cad dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed steng du bzlog bzlog bh+yo bh+yo sgyur cigaḥ swāsti/ rgyal kun 'phrin las rgyal ba'i 'khor lo'i bsgyur—/ /rgyal mchog pad+ma rgyal por phyag byas nas/ /mang rong mthu ldan brag bdud lcam dral zhes/ /dregs gyur de mchod nyung gsal 'dir bkod bya/ /r+ghaṃ trīḥ rgyal ba shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsdus pa'i dpal/ /gzi bajid 'od dpag med pa pad+ma 'byung / /gang gi byin rlabs gzi byin dus 'dir stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sidhi r+ghoṃḥ.auḍiyānon+tabamañdzubadz+rapyasādhanadzñānabarardanamabartatesma/o rgyan nas byung ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swāste/ o rgyan nas byung ba'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka bh+yaḥ khyab bdag kun bzang 'od chen 'od gsal ba/ /drwa gcod mun sel mchog gyur mchog gi bdag /sangs rgyas kun yab rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gtso/ /'jam mgon bla mar gus 'dud gus phyag 'tshal/ /o rgyan nas byung rgyud chen las/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gang / /de la snying nas gus pa yi/ /'di ru 'bad de brjod par spro/ /de yang rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob lung nod dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos 'di ltar nyams su len par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod 112

nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ snying khar zla ba'i steng du me dmar ser/ /'od 'phros sbyangs nas bdag nyid ho ru ka /rma gyi 'od kyi mdun du bla ma dang / /'jam pa'i rdo rje dkyil 'khor spyan drangs so/ /bla ma yi dam la phyag 'tshal/ /mchod pa kun gyi mchod par bgyi/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rje yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyiraske/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyid nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ongs spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhad+ma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā shu r+sā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/stong pa'i ngang las rang rig me dmar ser/ snang las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje r+ghaṃ/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spro bgegs rnams bcom/ bsrung ma drug gi phyogs rnams bcing bar gyur/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ griṇ+ḍi griṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ griṇ+ḍa pā ya greṇ+ḍi pā ya r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza rdzu r+ghaṃ phaṭaske/lan gsum/ oṃ trī gha ghā ghā ta ya bhā ta ya sarba duglen r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra tī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ me dhe ni badzi bha ba bhad+dha r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra rgyu baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra rgyu yo r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ saṃ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lāṅka rdu rdu r+ghaṃ/ bsrungs ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dngos grub gnas/ /dur khrod chen po keng rus dang bam ro/ /skyes bu mdung gi phug dang n+ya gror dpyangs//khā dang 'ug pa lce spyang sgras khyab pa/ /mi bzad 'jigs rung skyi zing yid bsgyur bar/ /rnal 'byor thob rnams dga' bas spyod pa skyong / /'khor ra 'khor yug dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro srin po sha za'i tshogs pho mo/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas rdo rje gshin rje che/ /ro langs 'bum phrag du mas kun tu bskor/ /de nang o ḍi ya na rdo rje'i gnas/ /chos dbyings pho brang chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus/ /pad dkar 'dab brgyad zla nyi brtsegs gdan steng / /rang rig rma yig snang de yongs gyur pa/ /mchog gi ral gri me mtshan ye shes 'bar/ /'phro 'dus don gnyis rgyal kun gsang gsum bsdus/ /de las bdag nyid bcom ldan gshin rje gshed/ khams gsum rnam rgyal 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /sku lus rtsa zhal gur gum dar ma'i mdog /g.yas zhal sngo dmar g.yon gnyis ljang dang ser/ /steng zhi rab dkar phud lnga me tog 113

thod / /mgon po sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod paṇa can/ /gzhan kun cher khros mche brtsigs spyan gsum dmar / /'jig dus me ltar skra khams gyen du brdzes/ /bcu gnyis phyag ldan g.yon rnams mda' gzhu dang ske/ /pus sto thod khrag zhags pa ut+pa la/ /g.yas rnams rdo rje ral gri 'bar ba dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags kyu sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ /gnyis kyi dbang phyug che lpags stod g.yog 'phyar/ /'jug sel lpags pas sku smad sham thab dkris/ /tshangs pa'i mgo can thod phreng se ral kha/ /lha min mgo bo rnams kyi do shal byas/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i mgo bcad dbu rgyan mdzad/ /'dod dang dga' ma g.yon brkyang zhabs kyi mnan/ /'jigs pa'ang 'jigs byed liṅga gyen du rgyas/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan phyag drug gi spras/ /ye shes rang 'od kun tu 'bar ba'i dbus/ /nyi ma bye ba 'bum gyi gzi 'phros pa/ /srid gsum bdag po bcas pas blta tsam yang / /mi bzod che ba'i che mchog sku ru gsal/ /oṃ sum bha ni sum bha r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ o kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ o kṛṇ+ḍa pā ya kṛṇ+ḍa pā ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ o a na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ o shrī mañdzu badz+ra āḥhūm̐ me hūm̐ rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ phyi rol chos 'byung mdun zur nas g.yas bskor/ /dbyangs can skra can nye ba'i skra can ma/ /dkar ljang ser mo mdzes sdug gegs khro'i nyams/ /chags pa'i rnam 'gyur dar gyi smad g.yogs grol/ /mgo phreng me tog rgyan spras g.yas brkyangs kyi/ /seng ge la gnas ral gri thod pa dang / /mda' gzhu lcags kyu zhags pas phyag dkyil brgyan/ /rang 'od 'khrig dbus gtso la phyogs te bzhugs/ /lha tshogs de rnams spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar rtsu sngon po/ gtso bo'i lte ba oṃ dmar ser/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros 'og min chos kyi dbyings stug po bkod pa or rgyan rdo rje'i gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor phe oṃ he he he ku mā ri ka bi mughi sma ra sma ra pra ti ta na swā hā/zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ mchod pas mchod dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim o yo ga shurnyo sarba dharma yo ga shurjo3haṃ/dkyil 'khor gsum 'dres slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas pa dzi/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu me sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ o badz+ra u da kaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa rgyu su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur nang gi dbang bzhi rdzogs/ gtso 'khor thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa' dmar pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī mañdzu badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra pāju pra tits+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra dhu spru aḥhūm̐rka/badz+ra a lo ke āḥrgyu/ badz+ra gadhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai we rgya āḥr+ghaṃ/ badz+ra shaja āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyed 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /114

sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyal rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /zhes pas bstod/ bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar ram/ o āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho hrīḥ byin gyis brlabs la gtso sngags mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ btags pa gsum dang 'khor rnams la re res 'bul/gsang mchod 'bul ba lha mo rnams dang snyoms par zhugs par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes phyag rgya bcings/ skabs 'dir lha sku la sems mnyam par ci nus su bzhag de rjes bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mañdzu badz+ra āḥhūṃ me r+ghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dngos grub thams cad byed pa ste gtso bor bzla'o/ /gzhan yang / oṃ badz+ra tikyā ba ra da muḥswā hā/ sngags dang po'o/ /oṃ ma hā rā ga badz+ra rā ga ya hoḥ sngags gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ āḥkro dhe ka ya man+ta ka rdu phaṭa/ sngags gsum pa'o/ /me/ thugs kyi snying po yi ge gcig pa'o/ /oṃ sum bha ni sum bha rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭaske/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍi pā ya kṛṇ+ḍi pā ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ o a na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ phreng ba'i sngags nyid du don gyi bstan no/ /de rnams ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas dang 'gog bzlas su ci nus 'bad do/ /oṃ wāka bā de ni bā rtsa me ni yats+tsha swā ra susti ma hā shwe re swā hā/ dbyang can ma'i'o/ /o bhin da ya ā dzha he ku mā rī ke swa hā/ skra can ma'i'o/ /o he he ku māri kle sha tshe da ya/ ā dzñā nam sma ra/ pra ti dzñā swā hā/ nye ba'i skra can ma'i'o/ /de ltar lha mo rnams kyi sngags kyang ci rigs su bzla'o/ /mchog gi ye shes bskyod pa'i rdzogs rim yang ji nus bsgom par bya ste de yang khams gsum rdo rje gsum du dag pa'i phyir lte ba'i pad+mar pad+ma'i snod du rdo rje'i
