rang bzhin ral gri 'bar ba'i yu ba'i dbus dang rtse mor me dag gi mtshan pa la yid rtse gcig pas srog dang rtsol ba bkag te gzhom med nā da'i rang sgra yi ge 'bru gcig rdo rje bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yi mtha' gnyis kyi 'pho ba 'pho med dbu ma'i dbyings bde ba'i thig le chen por thim nas zung 'jug 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du bsgrub pa'i rim pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /thun mtshams la 'jug pa na/ rang gi snying gi 'od zer gyi snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur pa bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / de yang rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ dbyings der ji gnas mnyam par bzhag slar lha skur ldang / dge ba bsngo/gtor chog ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ yi las rlung / ra las me/ āḥlas thod pa phyi dkar nang dmar yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du r+ghaṃ rgyu a dzi khaṃ las sha lnga/ sum̐ lo me paṃ tai las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos/115

me 'bar/ rdzas khol nyes skyon sbyangs/ steng du khaṭ+wāṃ ka hūṃ mtshan dkar po las bdud rtsi bab khaṭ+wāṃ yang 'od 'dres/ slar yang steng du zla bar r+ghaṃ āḥ.oṃ las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bcud bsdus 'bru gsum zla bar 'dus/ de yang bdud rtsir thil 'dod dgu'i sprin 'dzad med rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ be+e oṃ he he he ku ma ri ka bi mut+ta sma ra sma ra pra ti ta na swā hā/ thugs kyi rdo rje dmar pos dbu brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ srin po dang sha za dang / zhing skyong ba rnams dang / rdo rje gshin rje ro langs 'bum phrag bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas ni srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po ma lus pas bskor ba skad cig gi spyan drangs/ mdun du bzhugs par gyur pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ lha rnams kyi ljags r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas gtor ma'i bcud rnams gsol te dgyes shing tshim par bsam la/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ groṇ+ḍi griṇ+ḍa rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa pā ya kṛṇ+ḍa pā ya hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mañdzu badz+ra i rda ba ling groṇ+ḍa bṛṇ+ḍa sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hṝ sh+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ho/ zhes pas ye shes 'khor lo rnams la dang / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa/ un+ma da a pasma raske/ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i me bha ling kṛṇ+ḍin+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tshan+tu swā hā/ ces pas 'byung po spyi la ste de ltar lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun sogs kyi 'bul lo/ /yang ar+ghaṃ nas shabha'i bar gyi nyer spyod dang / 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul/ 'dud nyi shu'i bstod/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sogs kun 'grub shog /yig brgyas bzod par gsol/ 'dod don gsol gdab bkra shis brjod/ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs su gsol bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab bo/ /gzhan yang mchod pa/ phyag bskor/ kha zas/ spyod lam nyal ldang gi rnam 'byor la yang spyi ltar bslab par bya'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dpa' bo yi/ /dbang phyug tshul du bla med rgyud/ /o rgyan nas byung mchog bsgrub che/ /'di la ngo mtshar cir yang thob/ /byin rlabs nus mthu dpag med gzhung gang der/ /dngas ba'i yid kyi bsgrub tshul brjod 'di la/ /nyes mchis bshags so dge ba'i dbugs dbyung stsol/ /bsod nams 'gro kun 'jam dpal 'grub phyir bsngo/ /ces pa o rgyan nas byung ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rje btsun tā ra nā thas rgya dpe nas gsar du bsgyur ba'i gzhung las bod du byas pa'i sgrub thabs ye nas med pas mos pa'i stobs kyi yi dam lha la gsol ba btab ste byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba thob nas rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos nyes skyon zad pa zad byed kyi lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por gangs can sa yi thig le dbu ru skyid smad lung rig smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug bye ba'i 'byung khung dpal gsang phu ne'u thog 'phags ma rtsod 116

rgyal ma'i drung du grub par sbyar ba dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/dpa' bo rin po che la stsal ba bzhugs/ /klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi las byang rtsa 'phreng gi bzlas pa ni phyi nang gsang ba'i sngags spyi dril du yin 'dug lags/ de yang oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gsum ni bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po ste phyi nang / o r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃḥ.āḥ.e yo ram̐ waṃ lo bcu ni bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum bcu ste nang gi dang / trīḥmaḥha ri ni sa ra tsa trī yaḥbacu ni mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu ste gsang ba'i snying po ste/ tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥni lha dbang du bsdus shing las la bcun pa'i sngags su mngon/ des na bde spyi dril gyi sngags kyi dbang du ci ltar mtshams pa las dmigs gsal gyi grangs bzung ma dgos/ nang sgrub kyi snying po 'di ni mkha' 'gro thod rgal du bsgrub pa ste shin tu rno zhing myur bar bzhed/ dus rgyun chags su bzlas pa'i gtso bo ni yig 'bru bco lnga pa ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥmaḥha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya dza r+ghaṃḥ zhes dang yang na/ o r+ghaṃ trīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥ zhes kyang bzla ba ste de gnyis rgyun bzlas la khyad med pas gang bde gtso bor bzla ba lags kha sing dpe ma bzhugs pas phyag tu 'bul ma thub shing da lam khams nas byung ba'i klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi cha lag gsang ba ye shes kyi skor phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sgrub thabs las byang dang bcas pa las mtha' dbang bsgrub yab thugs rje chen po'i phyi sgrub dang bsgrub thabs gnyis/ kun gyi kha bskang gtor ma'i las rim/ rta phag yab yum gyi gsang bsgyeb/ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi bsgrub dang 'bral ba dang de rnams kyi kha bskang ba kho bos byas pa rnams da lam phul yod pa nged rang la dpe cha theb yod gshis rtag tu phyag dper mdzad pa dang / smon lam gtad rgya bya nas phul ba lags pas nyams bzhes yang dag par mdzad par zhu/ gzhan snying thig yang bzhi'i skor ni bklags lung las bla ma yang tig gi dbang dang khrid thob phyin bi ma snying thig gi dbang khrid nges par thob/ mkha' 'gro yang thig gi dbang khrid thob pas mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang khrid thob pa'i go nges par chod pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag len lags/ 'on kyang lung rgyun ni tha dad du zhu ba'i srol ka byung 'dug pa yang dgongs mtshor bsnyi bar zhu/ snyigs dus 'dir sa thag nye ba'i bla ma rnams la bka' chos gsan snga yang dam tshig bsrung shin tu dka' gshis chos thob pa las kyang dam tshig gtso ba dgongs mnga' ltar gyi slad nas bka' chos gsan bzhed bla ma rnams la brtag dpyad nan tan byed pa shin tu gal che bar snang /deng sang dus kyi dbang gi chos 'bral re zhus zin rjes bla ma des kyang slob ma'o zhes chos brgyad kyi brgyag ste thub thub sogs slob ma la rtag tu bsnyas par byed pa yang bla ma mtshan nyid mi ldan pa'i rang gzugs te deng sang de 'dra byed pa yang ches mang bar mthong mod/ nged rang gi bla ma'i gnas la ni de 117

'dra ye med do/ /de dag yang sems la 'char tshul lhug par gsol ba sarba maṅga lam̐/yang gcig la lags/ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni sgrub khog nas 'byung ba de ka'am yang na sngon 'gro yi skabs su bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de ka yang byas chog pa yin lags/ de yang skyabs 'gro gang du 'don ni kha cig gi mtshams bcad grub nas 'don pa dang / kha cig gi thog ma nyid nas 'don pa sogs snying ma nang khul du yang mi 'dra ba kha shas 'dug kyang lugs 'dir ni skyabs sems sngon du byed pa phyag len lags/

wā /chos rje rin po che ā+oṃ nas zhus pa'i sman sgrub kyi dris lan/chos rje rin po che dzñā na'i mtshan can gyi me 'brug lor dpal mi rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung gi shangs zab phu lung du bdud rtsi sman sgrub zla ba gcig gi ring bka' brgyad rang shar gyi sgo nas grub pa mdzad dus/ rgyal mchog rin 'dzin chen po la dogs gcod dri ba zhus pa ni/ lags/ dogs gcod snyan du gsol bar/ sman sgrub kyi skabs/ sa chog sta gon rnams dang / bri zhing rgyan bkram pa'i bar sgrub chen khog dbub sor bzhag ngos/ khyad par dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lding khri la thod pa lnga'am dgu kha sbyor gyi nang du/sman rnams khrol bur blugs nas tshon skud kyi bcing /dar gyi skud par gzungs thag btags pa bsham pa'i steng du gdugs dang phyogs mtshams rgyal mtshan dang 'phan sogs bkram/mtha' skor mda' gri phur pa tshon skud sogs bras/ dngos gzhi las gzhung bsrang dzab kyi rjes su/ sman srung spyan 'dren nas bzlas pa'i bar btang nas bzlas pa gsung mi chag dang / de rjes tshogs dang gtor chog rnams byas pa'i khrol bu bdun phrag gcig sgrub rjes/ sman rnams btags nas dar gyi sgye 'ur bslug pa thod par bcug ste gong bzhin bdun gcig phye la sgrub/ de rjes phye ma la mar dang bu ram gyi brus te lde gur bya ba'am ril bu gang ris byas te slar yang bdun gcig sogs sgrub pa'i rim pa gong bzhin byas rjes/dngos grub blang ba sogs rjes rnams gzhung bzhin bya ba de ka lags sam/ khyad par gyi phyag bzhes man ngag gi yang tig ji ltar lags pa'i bka' stsal spyi bor phebs tshogs dang / phran bu rim pa gnyis kyi yon tan dang / sbyor sgrol lag len gyi gdeng gang yang med kyang / las 'di lta bu bgyid dgos pa'ang rje dam pa nyid kyi phrin las kyi 'jug pa las gzhan med gshis/ sngar gsol ltar phran ji srid 'tsho'i bar du blta sgrub dam pa nyid kho na'i rnam thar skyong rgyu lags pas ji ltar bgyid tshul thams cad brtse bas gzigs pa'i phebs tshogs spyi bor stsol ba mkhyen rtse lags/ zhes zhus pa'i bka' len rgyal dbang rig 'dzin chen po'i phyag bris ngo ma las 'di ltar/ ye shes gzhon nus byin rlabs las kyi 'phro/ /dus su smin pas bdud rtsi sman sgrub bka'/ /rang kegs lo la zab lung pho brang du/ /babs par gyur 'di'i ngo mtshar su yi snyon/ /ji ltar phebs don gyi lag len gong du bkod pa de ka nor 'khrul ye nas mi 'dug la/ phye ma'i skabs/ mtshan bzang bud med kyi lag len byas pa'i chang sna nas 'bras gro rgun 'brum chang lnga yi khu ba byas te bu ram mar gyi phye ma sbol te gzhung ltar na de lding khri khar snod du blug pa'i 'og nas mar 119

me'i drod kyi long dgos par bshad kyang / nam dus dang sa khad tho bas lag tshod zin dka' zhing / lag tshod ma zin na mi yong bas/ des na phye ma chang bur mar gyi sbol ba de nyin grib mtshams du skam thag chod par byas na lag len bde zhing khrol bu sgrub pa lag len rgyas pa'i skabs su yin la/ de tsam ma cog na/sman khrol bu byin brlab tsam byas nas phye mar thag /sgrub pa dngos gzhir mtshams shin tu dam zhing nyin mo dpon slob kun dril dang / mtshan thun re mos kyi dzasra ma chad pa gal che la/ sman khang gi ngog der lha dbang brgya byin dang / rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi sku brnyan yang ku sha dang lhan du bkod pa phyag len lags/sman dri zhim po dang / 'od 'khyug sgra snyan sogs legs pa'i mtshan mar nges/ du ba 'thul ba sogs byung tshe de ma thag dngos grub blangs/ spyir bka' brgyad gzhung bsrang ba las/ lag len mkha' 'gro snying thig ltar gang bde gnang na rung bar mngon/ kun tu bkra shis snyan pa rgyas par shog maṅga lo/('di nas ma dpe ldeb ma bdun chad )kyi sras su nges pa yang dag bzung bar bya'o/ /lha sras khri ral yab kyi nyer dgu chu rta lor 'khrungs/ bcu bzhi la yab gshegs/ lo der khri la bzhugs skyid rtag lo dang por ming btags/ rgyal srid rgya nag gi yig tshang ltar na lo nyer gnyis byas me 'brug la gshegs zer yang bod spyi yi lcags bya la gshegs pa mthun pas de tshe rgyal srid lo nyer bdun byas pa'o/ /lha ral pa can 'di ni chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skye bar nyang dang chos dbang gnyis ka'i gter lung skye 'phreng du gsungs te/ de yang khri srong lde btsan sku gshegs pa'i de ma thag sum cu rtsa gsum dbang po brgya byin gyi sras lha dbang 'od mtha' yas zhes su 'khrungs nas mi lo bcu drug 'das pa na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po cher srid zhu mchog tu bgyid pa'i slad/ slar yang rang gi rigs sras kyi rgyud du bltam par byas dgos pas de rtsa gsum pa'i chu tshod gcig gi yun 'das par 'pho tshul ston par shes to/ gnod sbyin dar ma u rum btsan shing lug lo pa skyes nas zla ba gnyis nas yab gshegs/ nar son pa na gcen gyi 'u shangs rdo yi gtsug lag khang gzheng pa na grogs stobs kyi dar mas kyang 'dri yi gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs/ nyer bdun lcags bya la rgyal srid thob nas lo gcig 'jig rten phal spyod rnal ma dang / de nas sdig pa'i grogs pos skyod cing nag phyogs gdon gyis bskul nas tshul ngan la spyod pa zla ba drug dang / de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'tshe ba kho na lhur len pa zla ba phyed bdun byas nas lo ngo sum cu phag lor shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lhas lung dpal gyi rdo rjes nyag phran 'phrul 'khor gyis lnga pa'i lam du brdzangs/ rgyal po be'u dar ma lnga lam du btang ba'i lo gtan tshig kha cig tu lcags bya dang chu khyi dang / yang shing glang dang me ltag byas pa yod kyang snga ma gnyis mi 'thad la phyi ma dag rung yang dkyus su bstan pa nyid khungs su 120

che'o—/ /lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje 'di ni tsā na ku mā ra'i slob ma dpal gyi ming can brgyad kyi ya gyal yin par yongs grags dang / lo bcu bdun par spa gro stag tshang du gu ru pad+ma'i zhal mjal zhing mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rjes su bzung / yi dam lha dang bla mas bdud 'dul dpa' bor lung bstan par lhas lung du grags/ lha sras mu rum sku gshegs ma thag tu skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyar ba yin zhes bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bka' rgya mar gsal bar gsungs pas/ de tshe me stag gi me yos gang rig tu 'khrungs dgos la/ rgyal po sdig can sgrol dus dgung lo nga brgyad tsam du phebs pa dang / khams su bla chen po dge ba rab gsal gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i kha skongs kyi dge slong rgya nag nas hwa shang gnyis 'bad pas btsal ba'i grogs kyang mdzad cing / dus phyis gnam lde 'od srung la sman bla bde gshegs bdun gyi mdo chog gi lung byin par yang bshad pas sku tshe lo brgyad cu lhag nges zhig bzhugs par snang ngo ske/ /gangs can 'dir rgyal bstan rin po cher bya ba bla lhag tu mdzad pa po khyad par 'phags pa gcig ste bka' drin rnam pa kun tu dran nas rtag tu phyag bya ba'i gnas so/ /sa gnas 'phags chen rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku/ sa skyong mtho ris mdzes rgyan mi yi lha/ /rgyal bas lung bstan rgyal bstan 'dren pa po/ /rgyal sras rgyal blon rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /dam chos yun ring gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin la ches brtson pa/ / dpal gyi rdo rje la sogs 'jigs med lha/ /dpal chen rnams la gus pa cis mi bskyed/ /ces so/ /bod rje lha btsad po'i rigs dri ma med pa bu'i dar ma la slas kyi btsun mo gnyis mnga' ba'i chung ma 'tshe spang bza' btsad mo 'phen la lcags bya lor mngal du chags nas chu khyi 'char ba na/ khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa/ chung mas 'phrog gam bsad par dogs nas mal rtse dang mtshan mo mar me'i phreng bas bskor nas bsrung bas mtshan yang 'od srung du chags/ 'di spyod lam legs shing ngang tshul bzang bas de skabs blon 'gas khri ral gyi sras yin par yang byas skad/ /'od srung bltams pa'i lo phyi ma rgyal bo be'u gshegs skabs sna snam bza' la khye'u zhig byung ba blon po rnams la brtan pas skyos ma thag so yod pa the tshom yang yum gyi bka' btsan pas brtan du chug smras pas mtshan yang yum brtan du chags nag phyogs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i sdig blon rnams kyi rgyal po gshegs rjes kyang bstan la 'tshe ba rtsam rung rgyal po'i skabs ltar ngag mi btsan zhing mi ring bar lus tshal pa du mar mngon du zhig nas dus byas pa sogs bzod dka' mi srid 'jigs rung gi phal cher kha dag pas mi rnams bsngags zhing / chos la dkar ba'i blon po rnams kyi yang bskul bas shing glang lo mthar chos la 'tshe ba'i 'phro chad/ me stag la 'od srung dang yum bstan yang rten gyi spyan sngar skyabs 'gro blangs nas dkon mchog rten la mchod pa byas/ rgyal bu de nyid nar son nas gnam lde 'od srungs kyi dbus g.yo ru 121

bzung ske/ sman bla'i mdo chog la yi dam snying por mdzad cing dkon mchog gsum la gus pa chen po byas/dgung lo re gsum dang zhe dgu dang po dgu byas pa mthong yang / phyi ma 'thad par sems/ de yi btsun mo cog ro gza' rgyal mo la yab kyi nyer bzhi shing bya lor sras dpal 'khor btsan 'khrungs/ yab gshegs pa'i phyi lo lcags glang la rgyal sar 'khod/ blon po 'bro gtsug dgra lha snang dang cang 'a pho gnyis kyi byas/gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ gab rtse mkhan bsam rgyal gyi sa lug la gshegs zer bas dgung lo so lnga'oske/ /gling rje ge sar du grags pa yang gnam lde 'od srung nas 'di yab sras kyi rigs la byung bar mngon la/ rlang gi a mes byang chub 'dre bkol gyi sbyin bdag ge sar gyi byas shing / byang chub 'dre bkol rang nyid gu ru pad+ma'i sprul pa dang / ge sar khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sprul par khas blangs zhing / ge sar lo gya brgyad thob pa'i lung bstan mdzad tshul rlang gi po ti bse rur yod pas/ ge sar nam byung gi dus des shes pas de las dus snga ba dang phyi bar ma sems shig rnying ma kha cig gi ge sar mnga' bdag sprul par 'dod pa rlang gi tshig ris dang mthun rung bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla mas ge sar skyes bu rdo rje legs pa'i rnam 'phrul du gsung ba don la gnas par nges shing bod khams bde ba'i phyir mnga' bdag khri srong gi bka' lung ngam smon lam gyi mthus rdor legs mi yi srid pa bzung bar byas na 'gal ba can yang ma yin no/ /phyis byung lo rgyus 'chad pa po mang zhig gi a mes byang chub 'dre bkol 'di gu ru pad+ma bod du bzhugs dus kyi dngos slob yin zhes gsungs yang / gu ru pad+mas ru glang dpal gyi seng ger lung bstan paske/ khyod glang gi mi rgyud skal ldan la/ /nga yi thugs rjes khyab par byed/ /khyod ni skyes bu skal ldan yin/ /khyod lha rigs glang gi mi rgyud la/ /byang dang chub ces bya ba yi/ /mi'u khyad par 'phags par yong / /de ni nga yi thugs kyi sras/ /zhes lung brtan cing byang chub 'dre bkol gyi gu ru pad+mas sbas pa'i chos snyed par yang bshad pas gdul bya spyir btang ngor bod du bzhugs dus kyi dngos slob ni ma yin par go la/ byang chub 'dre bkol lo brgya dang brgyad me 'brug zla ba'i bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcur gshegs zer la/ de la sras bzhi yi gnyis pa gnyan thog a khrom ste/ de nas mi rabs drug pa yon chen rgyal ba skyabs/ de yi sras glang lha gzigs kyi phag gru bzung ba'i thog ma rje spyan snga ni phag gru gshegs nas lo drug pa shing lug lor 'khrungs nas dgung lo so bzhi pa 'brug lo phag gru gdan sa mthil gyi khrir phebs lo nyer bdun bzhugs/de rjes shing lug lor spyan snga'i gdung dbon rgyal ba thog rdug khrir phebs/ de nas rim pa bzhin dbon rgyud rgyal po sde'u gdong par grags pa'i zhabs drung nor bu zhes pa'i bar rim gyi byung nas deng dus gdung rdzogs te rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang du'o/ /zhes zhor du 'phros la/ da ni dkyus su 'jug ste/mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi khabs su btsun mo chen chung gnyis la sras re re byung ste chung ma 122

'chims bza' btsun ne la gcen khri bkra shis rtsegs pa dpal dang chen mo sna snam bza' legs btsun la gcung skyid lde nyi ma mgon bltam/ gcen gyi gtsang nyang stod rgyal mkhar rtse bzung / de yi btsun mo cog ro bza' mgon dpal la sras dpal lde 'od lde skyid lde gsum byung / de la smad kyi lde gsum du grags / gcen dpal ldes cog ro bza' 'ba' re khab du bzhes pa la gcen 'od dpal lde dang gcung dharma tsakra gnyis yin/ 'od gsal lde gung thang du phebs par gur ston dpal mdzes kyi byas pa'i yi ger yod zer/ gzhan mang zhig gi ni dpal lde gung thang du phebs zer yang mi 'thad par mngon/ gung thang mnga' bdag nor bu ldes mdzad pa'i rgyal rabs su dpal lde'i sras dmar po btsan du gsungs pas de tshe 'od dpal lde'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su byed dgos/ de nas gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rabs ring zhig tu byung ba rnam grangs mdor byas nas 'dir smras pa/ 'od gsal gung thang phebs sras 'od zer lde/de nas rim bzhin bde spyod lde dbang lde/ btsan lde de sras gsum mnga' gcen 'od lde/ 'di dang li la'i sku tshe smad dus mtshungs/ de sras rim pas dbang phyug lde skyobs lde/ mgon lde btsun lde de yi btsun mo ru/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gcen mo nyi 'bum ste/ /de la chos rgyal 'bum sde mgon zhes bltams/ /de sras gsum gyi bar ma rin chen bzang / /de sras chos skyong lde ste gung thang du/ /chags pa'i gdung rabs gsum dus yin zhes/ /gu ru'i lung dang 'di nyid mthun par 'grig /chos skyong lde sras bkra shis lde zhes pa//gter ston rgod ldem chos bdag nyid mtshungs yin/ /de nas phun tshogs lde dang bsod nams lde/ /lha dbang rgyal mtshan mnga' bdag rnam rgyal lde/ /bsam lde kun dga' blo gros kun bzang grags/ /bsam lde phyi ma de sras bsod dbang lde/ /de ltar mched dang khri rabs ma bgrang bar/ /yab sras rkyang bgrang rgyal rabs nyer gsum mthar/ /rab byung bcu pa'i lcags pho sprel lo la/ /gtsang pa rgyal po'i dpung gi gung thang blang / /gu ru'i bsngags pa gung thang rgyal po'i gdung / /gangs can bsod nams bgo bas de tsam gyuraske//de nas nyer gcig lo 'das lcags sbrul la/ /o rod dpung gi gtsang pa'i rgyal srid blangs/ /lcags sbrul de nas da lta'i shing glang bar/ /mi lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga song / /zhes so/ /mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyi rnam thar lo rgyus su gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rigs las 'khrungs par bzhed cing / de yang mnga' bdag rnam rgyal lder sras mang du byung ba'i thu bo dam pa nor bu lde glo bor yun rings bzhugs dgos byung skabs kyi sras 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan yin zhes gsung zhing / de la sras bdun byung ba'i gcen mnga' ri paṇa chen ni/ rtsod med kyi gter ston chen po ste sku tshe ril po dge slong gi bcas pa lhur blangs shing / gcung legs ldan zhes mnga' ris 'dzin du grags pa yang gter ston yin laske/ sras pad+ma rgyal po zhes byon rung de nas gdung ma 'phel/ sku mched bar pa kha cig gi rgyud da lta glo bo 123

ma thang gi dbon rgyud rgyun phra mo gnas pa 'di rnams yin zer bas de tshe gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rigs su rtogs dgos so/ /dpal lde'i sras gcung dharma tsakra'i rgyud lha rtse ba gla lung rtsa gor ba klu rgyal ba spyi pa rnams yin par grags/ lde gsum gyi 'bring pa 'od lde la sras bzhi byung zhing / de yi rgyud gtsang rong dang glu/ yar lung dang / khams kyi gtsang khar yang yod skad/ chung ba skyid lde 'dzad rta nag tu phog sras drug byung ba'i rgyud sogs lde gsum gyi gdung rigs de skabs ches mang ba 'phel te yod ces smras so/ /yang mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras chung ba skyid lde zhi ma mgon byon mnga' ri phyogs su phebs/ /pu rong du sku mkhar nyi ma gzungs bcigs/ de grub pa'i zhal spros mnga' gsol gyi skabs su nam mkha' nas lung brtan pa'i sgra 'di skad du/ sems can spyi mthun las la legs grub pa/ /nyi ma zhes bya de yi grogs su ni/ /pu rong zhes byar bod kyi rgyal khab byung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma deng 'dir sharaglu/ /zhes kun gyi thos par grags pa dang / /gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i ltas ngo mtshar can mang du byung /de la sras stod kyi mgon sum du grags pa byung ste/ rig pa mgon/ bkra shis mgon/ lde gtsug mgon/ che ba rig pa mgon gyi mar yul 'bru sha'i bar dang / 'bring pa bkra shis mgon gyi zhang zhung ya rtse dang bcas pa chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyi zang dkar sgo gsum bcas bzung zhes 'di ni khungs dang ldan pa steske/ gzhan gu ge dang pu rang gnyis su mgon gnyis phog pa de ni ma yin no/ /bkra shis mgon gyi sras srong nge dang 'khor re gnyis/ srong nges gu ge dang / 'khor res pu rang bzung / /srong nge 'khor re'i ming dngos gzhi drang srong lde dang 'khor lo lde yin zhes mnga' ri gung thang du dpe hrul ka ni ka rnying par brdzang ba zhig tu 'dug pa 'thad des du snang / drang srong lde yi sras nā ga ra dza dang / dhe wa rā dzar grags/khong gi paṇ+ḍi ta kha shas spyan drangs lo chen rin bzang sogs rgya gar du brdzang bas bstan pa la ches phan/'on kyang deng sang lo rgyus thams cad du de ltar grags mod/ de tshe lha bla ma de lo brgya'i brgya la nye ba zhig bzhugs dgos te/ jo bo bod du phebs skabs lo chen brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes pas lha bla ma de bas bsgres pa zhig nges par dgos pas so/ /lha bla ma lug lo pa don brgyad bzhugs zhes mnga' ri gung thang rgyus su drangs bas de tshe lha bla ma dang lo chen lo khyad gcig las ma byung zhing / lo rgyus der nā ga ra dza dang —/ de wa rā dza rab tu byung bas byang chub 'od dang zhi ba 'od yin zer ba sogs/ lo rgyus khung ma da dung btsal dgos par snang / sku tshe smad rang gi rgyal srid gcung 'khor rer gtad de/ yab sras gsum ka rab tu byung / yab la lha bla ma ye shes 'od du grags/ 'khor re'i sras lha lde/ de la sras gsum/ da lta'i lo rgyus spyi bar pa byang chub 'od yin smra la/ des jo bo rje bod du spyan drangs ba sogs bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che/ gcung 'od ldes kyang paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na shrī sogs spyan drangs/ 'od lde'i sras rtse ldes rngog lo rgya 124

gar du brdzang ba sogs bstan la phan par mdzad/ de yi sras rab lnga pa'i skabs gdung gcig ya rtser gyis—/ rgyal rabs brgyad lhag byon nas sangs rgyas bstan par gus nas mchod pa byung / de nas gdung rdzogs te mon gyi blon po ba li rā dza bya bas rgyal srid thob pa da lta dzum lir grags pa 'di yin/ pu rang du gdung rabs ring du byung zhing mthar rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang du gdung rigs kyi rgyud rdzogs pa yinaglu/ zhes zer/ zhang zhung gi mthil gu ger gdung rab rim can byung ba'i tha ma mnga' bdag pad+ma blo bzang bkra shis te/ de rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i tha la nye ba chu phag lor gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod bsngo rten bla ma khag la phul ba nged kyi bskal ba kong yul gtsang po mgo dgur sdod skabs sde pa gzhung brgyud de byung / de nas gu ge'i gdung rgyud chad de sras mo gnyis kyi tha chung mar yul la dwags rgyal— po'i khab du bzung bar sras gnyis mnga'o/ /mar yul bdag po rig pa mgon la sras mang du byung ba'i rgyud la dwags rgyal po yang yin zer la/ rtsod pa med pa ni mnga' bdag stag sham can/ de yi rigs brgyud da lta stobs 'byor gyi shin tu dbul yang 'bras ljong nub ri gro shod sogs su thor bu yod pa rnams so/ /lha rigs chos skyong rgyal po'i gdung / ji snyed byung ba mdo tsam du/ yid ches deb ther mang po dang te/ bstun nas bris pa 'di na kwa zhes so/ /mnga' bdag khri yum brtan gyi sras khri lde mgon/ de sras rig pa mgon/ de sras rdo rje 'bar/ de la sras gnyis gcen khri dbang phyug btsan/ gcung khri ba/ gcen gyi sras lha btsad po lo tsā na ye shes rgyal mtshan ste legs sbyar shin tu byang bas kha rag smyos kyi lo tsā yang khong rang gi slob ma yin/ jo bo ma phebs gong / lo nyi shu'i skabs tsam la paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma gsang ba byon pa na zhabs lugs grol thig sogs bsgyur ba'i lo tsā mdzad khri dbang phyug btsan dang khong yab sras kyi sku rigs su khams nas dbus gtsang mi lnga'am bcus sdom rgyun blang nas bstan pa phyi dar dbu tshugs pas bka' drin yang che ba yin/ gcung khri par sras bzhi'i tha chung bho dhe rā dza yin/ jo bo bsam yas su phebs skabs dang khong dus mtshungs/ de yi rgyud lha btsun sngon mo zhes bsam yas dbu rtse nas 'chi bdag srog 'khor gter nas 'don pa de dang lha 'bri sgang pa sogs mang du byung bar snang / 'dir bshad pa ni lo rgyus khung ldan las drangs ba ste/ ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sras khri pa byas pa sogs kyi mgo rmongs bar mi bya'o//yum brtan gyi rgyud bsam yas dang / rdo dang / 'on sogs dang / khams phyogs su yang mang du yod par grags pa dang / kong po rkyen rgyal po yang yum brtan gyi rgyud yin/ dang po e lha rgya ri ba kha cig gi 'od srung gi brgyud par mdzad kyang / gzhan mang zhig lha 'bri rgang pa'i rgyud par smra'o/ /spyir gnam lde 'od srung dang / khri lde yum brtan gyi rgyud pa mang du byung bar grags kyang / mnga' ri dbus gtsang rnams su da lta ji bzhin ngos zin pa ni thor bu 'dir smos pa tsam las mi snang ste nyung ngur zad do/ /bar 125

khams ngom shod a nu zhes mang du yod pa rnams mnga' bdag gi rigs su gnas mod/ dge slong karma chags med kyi mdzad pas yul phyogs de yi yig tshang ngam ngag rgyun nyid la rtags 'os dang / mdo khams smad gtsad po ur gyi rigs ni mnga' bdag pad na legs kyi sras zur byung zhig gi rgyud yin zhes grub thob chen po karma pak+ka'i gsung du nges pa'o/ /kwa ye sngon rabs bzang po'i gtam nyid dang / dam pa'i lugs srol 'phags pa'i nor bzang po/ /ya rabs dra ma'i gdung rigs dri med rnams/ ston gzhug me tog bzhin du gyur 'di skyo/ gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'di ru/ /bskal bzang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /thub dbang nyi ma'i ring lugs ji bzhin pa/ /'dren mdzad chos rgyal rnams la cis mi bsngags/ /gang gi gdung rigs rin chen gser gyi 'phreng / /rim byon rgyal ba'i bstan par lhag bsam thugs/ /zhum med 'chang thub gyur pa mi'i seng ge /dam pa rnams la bdag blo cis mi 'jug /de bas de dag rnams la gus pa'i blos/ /snying nas rtag tu bsngags pa'i brjod pa'i gtam/ /smras pa 'di yang don med ma yin ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa spel la bsngags pa yin/ /zhes so/ /bod 'dir bstan pa phyi dar du grags pa dge 'dun 'dul ba'i sde snod byung ba yang grub thob o rgyan pas phag gru yi rgad po zhig gi ngag rgyun la brten bstan pa snga dar nyams nas phyi dar bar lo nyer lnga'i sum cu tsam mdzad pa dang / rje btsun lag 'phreng bas chu glang lo la dbus gtsang gi mi bcu las klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ mkhan bu gru mer dang bcas pa mon mkhar 'bras bur phebs pa 'di phyi dar gyi thog mar klu mes rnams 'dod gsung zhing / mkhan chen dharma shrī yang nyin snang du phyi dar 'das lo 'di dang mthun par byas te lcags bya nas lo nga gnyis 'das pa'i chu glang yin no/ /bu ston chen pos dbus kyi rgad mo zhig gi ngag rgyun la brten lcags bya nas phyi dar gyi bar bdun cu'i don gsum dag tu bzhed pas/ phyi ma ltar na chu bya dang snga ma byas tshe lcags rta yin dgos so/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi lcags bya nas bar stong bdun cu don bdun pa stag la bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu yin par bzhed pa dang / sa skya'i bla ma dam pas ni/ rgyal po bka' chems las/ dpal zhes bya ba'i dge slong gi /sdig can rgyal po sgrol bar 'gyur/ /de nas lo skor brgyad kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la dgongs te/ lcags bya nas bstan pa bar stong lo bskor brgyad byung bas/ de la lo rgan gcig dang lo rkyang po brgyad ste/ khyon dgu bcu go brgyad yin la/ sa khyi la phyi ltar byung bar bzhed/ nel pa paṇa chen smon lam tshul khrims kyi lcags bya nas lo brgya dang brgyad kyi bar 'dul bstan ma byung bas phyi dar thog ma sa bya yin par bshad do/ /de ltar 'dul bstan dge 'dun gyi sde phyi dar gyi lo grangs 'dod tshul rim pa lnga las snga ma ni/ grub thob o rgyan sa lug lor yar lung du byon skabs ral pa can mthong nas de yi 126

bar lo nyis brgya dang bcu bdun song bar dgongs pa'i lug lo 'di ni karma pak+shi gshegs pa'i chu lug de yin par snang bas/ chu lug de nas yar la bgrang bas rje spyan snga 'khrungs pa'i shing lug bar brgya dang dgu/ de nas yar phag gru 'khrungs pa'i lcags stag bar re lnga/ de nas jo bo rje bod du phebs pa'i chu rta bar re brgyad/ de rnams dril ba'i lo mngon sum pas dpyad mi bzod yang 'on re lcags bya nas nyer lnga'i sum cu lhag tsam na phyi dar tshugs tsho/ shing bya'i chu 'brug lor 'dod dgos pas der bla chen po rang nyid rab tu byon pa'am/ des mkhan bu skyong ba'i dus lta bur bzung na 'dul bstan dbu brnyes par song bas rung bar sems so/ /gnyis pa ni klu mes kyi dngos slob sam/ de nas yun ring ma song ba'i yi ger gsal na khungs che zhing / dbus gtsang gi mi lnga'i bcus bla chen po rang nyid la sdom pa blang bar byas tshe dus snga phyi 'grig rung de lta min na 'dod pa gsum par dpyad bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ kha cig gi lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshong btsun shes rab seng ges dge 'dun gyi sde gnas gzhi tshugs pa la dgongs skad kyang / klu mes kyi bla chen po'i slob ma mtshur shes rab mchog la sdom pa blangs bar klu mes kyi dngos slob ba shi gnas brtan gyi smras pa dang / gzhan yang klu mes dang sum pa ni dus mtshungs par ba shi gnas brtan gyi 'di skad du/ bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po klu mes shes rab tshul khrims dang sum pa ye shes blo gros gnyis kyi dang po kho nar klung shod 'byim pa'i lung du gnas btsug pas ma tshug ste/ de nas bya yi lo la mo ra sgyes btsugs zhes bris yod par snang zhing / 'brom ston gyi dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la jo bo bsu bar bskul ba'i yi ger/ dang po'i dge slong lugs 'byin dpon btsun chen ye shes blo gros dang / zhes gsungs pas snga dar chu glang lor byas tshe 'di skabs jo bo bod du chu rta lor phebs skabs lo dgu bcu lon cing de gong dge slong bsgrub pa'i lo tshigs kyang lon dgos pa bsgrangs na brgya dang bcu lhag tu nges par 'gyur bas klu mes kyang sku tshe yun rings bzhugs par grags pas sum pa yang de mthun sku tshe yun rings bzhugs na las 'grig dka' bar shes shing / gong gi mkhan rab nyid dang / lo grangs spyi gtang gi dpyad na phyi dar dbu sa stag nyid du mi 'gal te/ de yang bla chen po'i dngos slob kyi mkhan bu kha shas gtsug lag khang rtsigs pa'i nus pa med kyang chu glang lor phebs/ de nas lo nyer lnga lon pa'i sa stag lor/ byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi mthu chen po mnga' ba klu mes dang sum pa sogs byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing /gtsug lag khang rgya cher rtsigs par byas na 'thad par rig go /bzhi pa ni/ re zhig lha sar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde ma tshugs pa la dgongs zer/ lnga pa/ klu mes kyi bya lo la mo ra bsnyel gyi gnas gzhi brtsigs pa la bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo mgor 'khrul ba yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu chu 127

glang gi lo yin na lo chen rin bzang rab tu ma byung ba'i lo bcu bdun gyi gong dang / sa stag yin na rab tu byung nas lo brgyad 'das te lo chen gyi rnam thar khri thang dzñā nas bris par sa sta la 'khrungs nas bcu gsum lcags rta la rab tu byung bar bshad pas so/ /gang ltar 'brom gyi phyi ltar du bzhed pa'i sa stag de nas lo drug cu rtsa bzhi 'das pa chu rta la jo bo rje mnga' rir phebs/ skar rtsis pa rnams kyi rab byung dang po tshugs nas lo bco lnga song bar shes so/ /de yang phyi dar la 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun gsum byung ba sde pa gzhi yod smra 'ba' zhig pa snang zhing / de las stod 'dul ni ha cang 'phel ba ma byung bar mngon la / smad 'dul du grags pa'i mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho nas brgyud pa 'di nyid gong du bshad pa'i chu glang gi lo la dbu bsnyes pa stag nas dar bar gyur te/ rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi bar mi lo nyis brgya dang don gnyis ring dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul dge slong rnams sdom rgyun 'di kho nar brten pa shas che zhing / bka' gdams kyi dge bsnyen 'brom dang / dge slong khu rngog gnyis sku mched gsum glang ri thang pa sha ra ba snar thang pa sogs mtha' yas pa dang / bka' brgyud kyi 'byung khung chen po dwags po lha rje dang khams pa mi gsum 'bri stag 'brug pa sogs kyi mtshon bsgrang bar dka' ba dang / rnying ma yi zur chen 'dzam 'gro ba'i mgon po kaḥdam pa bde gshegs sogs 'byams klas pa dang / gzhan du mkhas grub khyung po rnam 'byor yang rdo rje gdan pas lung bstan pa la brten glang ri thang pa la bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / bka' gdams gsar par grags pa gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'dul 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug nor mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho yi gdungs tshob shar tsong kha pa chen po yang smad 'dul gyi sdom rgyun 'dzin par grags pas mtshon no/ /yun ring du ches dar bar gyur zhing da lta yang sdom rgyun ma chad par gnas pa 'di ni rgyal bas mtha' 'khob bod yul 'dul bar thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku u pā sgyu ya bho dhe satwa yi smon lam gyi mthu'i rgyun ldan du byin gyis brlabs par nges pas snying nas gus pa chen pos rtag tu phyag bya ba'i yul lo/ /'dir 'phros pa/ sngon dus kyi skye bo bskal bzang shes rab dang brtson 'grus mchog dang ldan pa mang zhing / chos 'dul ba la shin tu mkhas par sbyang ba 'dul ba'i mkhan po chen po kha skong dad pa'i dge slong yang blang dor gyi don gsal bar byas te 'bad pas rgya nag nas hwa shang dag 'gugs par mdzad pa sogs dri ma med pa'i lugs srol lhur len pa de yi slob tshogs chos 'dul ba la mkhas pa spyi dang bye brag dbus gtsang mi bcu sogs bzhugs bzhin pa'i mdun sar shin tu rmongs pa'i ngang tshul gyi chu gtor ma dang der bas las sdom rgyun du 'dod pa yang mi nus te/ de ltar byas par grags pa 'bra gnyis kyang skyes bu dam pa yin par snang bas de skabs kyi mkhan po nang phan tshun phyogs kyi bslad pa'i gtam rgyun chags pa zhig tu zad kyi log rtog spangs te de dag la yang 128

dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs bar 'os so/ /bar 'dul du grags pa ni bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal gyi rnam 'phrul paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī rab byung gsum pa'i nang shing byi la bod du phebs nas lo bcu bzhugs pa'i ring bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sogs bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong ji snyed pa zhig byung / de las stan gcig gi rtag bzhugs 'dzin pa rdo rje dpal dang / dbang phyug dpal gnyis las dge 'dun tshogs sde bzhi 'phel ba la brten 'jig rten mgon po jo nang pa dang mkhas mchog bu ston sogs phyis byung gi dam pa mang po zhig gi sdom rgyun de la brten par mdzad pas rab tu dad pas 'dud par bya'o/ /phyi dar bstan zhes 'dul bstan nub pa slar/ sos te dge 'dun tshogs gyur cung byung ba las/ gos hrul nang du gser gyi sku brnyan bzhin/ /sngags bstan ma nub gnub so zur gyi mtshon/ /don bsgom snying po a ro'i ring lugs la/ /dpal ldan jo bos bsngags pa yang yang mdzad/ /zhes so/ /jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i skabs snying po don rgyud kyi bstan pa byang chub sems kyi man ngag 'dzin pa/ mang yang grags che ba a ro ye shes 'byung gnas yin la de yi bstan bcos theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor la tshig snyan don bzang zhes mchog tu dgyes shing / a ro'i slob ma zang dkar mdzo khur la yang gus pas phyag mdzad pa dang / a ro'i yang slob sba bsgom la kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi bogs bton nas don dam byang chub sems kyi bogs 'jam dpal dang byams pas 'don par dbugs dbyung ba dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu to ba chen pos sba sgom la sems phyogs kyi man ngag legs par gsan cing dus phyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur pa na de dam pa'i chos rnam dag nyid du dgongs te/ yi dam du mdzad pa sogs sngags kyi bstan pa rnam dag ma nub pa rgyu mtshan du ma dang bcas shing / 'on kyang so skye kha cig bdud kyi byin gyis brlags sor spyod pa re zung byung ba jo bo byon pa nas zhi ba detshibaka' drin gyis khyab pa yin no/ /zhes pa yang 'dir 'phros pa'o/ /de skad chos kyi rgyal po rtsad po'i rab/ /bstan pa phyi dar dus kyi ngang tshul bcas/ /rang gzo'i skyon med gzhung mang mthong las btus/ /'on kyang skyon mchis spyan ldan mchog la bshags/ /dge mchis 'gro la yongs su bsngo ba'i mthu'i/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa bka' drin rab dran nas/ /de yi dgongs pa bskangs phyir dam chos la/ /legs spyod 'jig rten mgon po myur 'grub shog /zhes lha btsad po'i rabs dam pa'i chos ci ltar byung ba'i rim pa mdo tsam smos pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gnyis rdzogs par nye ba kro dha zhes shing mo glang gi lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum par shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal kong yul nyang kha ljon pa klung bsam gtan gyi khang nur snang gsal gyi mdangs su bkod cing slar yang deb ther khung btsan khul kha shas mthong ba la brten rang blos dpyad pa'i zhu dag kyang cung zad bgyis pa ste/129

da dung rgya nag thang gi deb ther 'gyur dag pa zhig mthong na dpyad par 'os pa ni yod la/ bod du byung ba'i deb ther la ni 'dir gong du dpyad byar byas pa phran bu nyid las 'ga' yang med par sems pa'o/ /dge'oske//dge'o/ /chu phag lor kong po chu bo g.yas 'khyil nas chag nag gnyen pa ngag dbang gi gsung rtags lan/lar ni 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal rang bzhin yin/ /lhag par snyigs ma'i dus 'di ru/ /las mtshan che ba'i khur 'dzin rnams/ /ci ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /dman rnams 'gug na drag pa 'khong / /drag pa 'gu na dman rnams 'khong / /gcig shos 'gu na gcig mi 'gu/ /'jam tshe kun gyi brnyas par byed/ /rtsub byas kun dang 'khon 'gras 'gyur/ /lus ni che ba'i sar gnas kyang / /sems ni mi bde tsher ltar rtsub/ /ji ltar byas kyang mi bde 'di/ /'khor ba'i spyi mtshan yin lags so/ /de ka'i ngang du zhag zla lo/ /nam song cha med yud kyi zad/ /rgas par ma tshor skra dkar skyes/ /'chi bdag bdud po gam du slebs/ /de tshe mnga' thang dpal 'byor yang / /mi rtag tshong 'dus ltas mo 'dra/ /snyan pa'i gtam yang brag char yal/ /dal 'byor thob pa'i snying po gang / /des na tshe 'di'i snang ba la/ /cer cer bya rin mi chog ste/ /sgyu ma lta bur blta bar 'tshal/ /'jig rten 'di snang blo ldog pa'i/ /dam chos snying na zug pa niske/ /deng sang 'byung bar dka' mod kyang / /dal 'byor snying po len pa tsam/ /mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas bsgomaske/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma ru/ /bya'o snyam pa gang yin der/ /dad gus ldem rgyang ma shor bar/ /sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus bskyed/ /gzhan yang dag snang kun la sbyangs/ /dal khoms cung zad nam yod dus / /shes na sems kyi dge sbyor blta/ /gzhan ni kha 'don bzang spyod dang / /phung po gsum pa yang yang bklagasaske/ /khyad par dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /thugs kyi yang snying yi ge drug /dal ba med par rtag tu bzlosaglu//rang gi nus pa ci yod kyi/ /bstan dang 'gro la lhag bsam 'bad/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa yi//snying po len thabs de rnams te/ /gal chen thugs la bzhag par 'os/ /de skad phyogs med bya bral ba/ /gtad med smyon pa gu yangs po/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i kha 'khyal yin/ /snyan par 'dug na thugs la bzung ske/ /mi mdzes na yang bzod par rigs/ /de ka 'dus pa'i sde rnams la/ /lo 'di dang ni sang phod laske/ /cung zad yang ni 'dzer bar rtogs/ /zlog thabs dge ba'i rim gror 'bad/ /sgo nor god kha mang ba de—/ /lar ni spyi yi 'tshub cha dang / /bye brag yul lha gzhi bdag de/ /khros pa'i 'tshub 'gyur du shes pas/ /bka' klog gsang gsol 'bad na dge /sarba maṅga lo/badz+ra ru tro pa kra ma na mo/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i 'phrin las yong 'dus dpal/ /rdo rje drag po pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /rgyud par bcas pa'i sras gyur rig pa 'dzin/ /pad+ma yongs 'dus las kyi rdo rje zhes/ /130

ming gzhan tshe dbang nor bur grags pa des/ /snyigs dus 'gro la gnod cing 'tshe byed pa'i/ /ma rung yid gzugs gdug pa can rnams la/ /bsgo ba'i lung 'dir sus kyang 'da' ma byed/ /deng 'dir dad ldan sbyin pa'i bdag po ni/ /lhas sbyin bsam 'grub 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gnod sdug 'tshe ba'i bsam pa kun spang la/ /zhi ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cig /lhag don rdzong dkar rgyu ba'i 'dre spyi dang / /khyad par gza' rgyal srin mo btsan bdud nag /thar pa rgyal mtshan la sogs 'dre khyod rnams/ /sbyin bdag 'di la 'tshe bar ma byed cig /phan pa'i grogs kyi nas/ rdo rje dmyal ba'i gnas su 'tshod ta reglu/ /de bas bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /pad+ma he ru ka yi bka' la nyon/ /de sras bdag gi lung las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ ā+oḥr+ghaṃ: badz+ra r+ghaṃ: yak+ka r+ghaṃ: rak+ka hūṃ: du ma tri: a ya ma du ru tsa sha sha: sā lā māḥ r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa: zhes pa sprel zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu la ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba'i skye tshal nas khrag 'thung rig pa 'dzin pas springs pa'o//bod thang mgon stod la sngar gnang ba / /khyod ni rgyal bas rmad byung gsang sngags kyi/ /'byung khung chen por dgongs te byin gyis rlabs/ /bsgrangs yas bskal pa mu med pha mtha'i sngon/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa/ /drang don thar par gyur nas sngags rim la/ /zhugs tshe gsang mtshan legs ldan nag por btags/ /dbang rtags ga da byin pas sangs rgyas su/ /lung bstan yang dag brnyes la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tsha grang bkres rmongs gnas su 'gro ba rnams/ /smin phyir de lta'i tshul du nyer bstan mtharaske/ /mtho ris 'jig rten dbang po ches cher 'bar/ /dregs rnams 'joms slad ma haṃ ka yi rigs/ /la 'i bdag po drag shul spyod pa can/ /'od na gnas pa'i lha chen thams cad kyang / /bran kol nyon mongs rang rgyud spyod tshul gyi/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje bskul der bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa/ phyis de la 'jog par gnang ba yin 'dug('di nas ldeb ngos gcig chad 'dug )mi dbang sku zhogs su/ phran rig pa 'dzin pas phul/ 7rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs la/ /mchog gus las skal ldan pa yis/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i dpal rgyas pa/ /mi dbang chen po'i zhabs drung du/ /zhu ba dengs dus snyigs ma'i rang shugs kyi/ /dam sri 'gong po rtsal rgyas pa'i/ /bod khams bde ba 'phrog pa la/ /mi mchog dpyod ldan thugs re skyo/ /spyir yang sum bcu kha ral gyi/ /dus kyi tshad ni sum brgya ste/ /gcig ni dge ba can gyi dus/ /gnyis ni skar ma mdangs can 'ong / /gsum ni mi bde chol bur 'khrugasaske/ /des na deng dus gsum par sleb/ /stod hor dag kyang 'phyo yang nye/ /de rtags bya mtsho grag tu 'gyuraske/ /dmar po ri la srin bya 'bab/ /bsam yas kha dog gser gyi bsgyur/ /byang chub chen po srog zhu bgoske/ /gzugs med lha 'dre bswo sgra 'byin/ /lha sar bud med ltas ngan skye/ /hor gyi dgra lha ngag bcad 131

bzhugs / /has po ri la lha khang rtsegs/ /khra 'brug rlung gi shing chen snyil/ /mi kun sbas yul yid smon byed//de sogs spyi yi dus rtags dang / /bye brag stod hor 'byung nges rtags/ /mkha' nas mi sdug sgra skad ni/ /'jigs su rung pas skye bo ('ji nas ldeb ngos gcig chad 'dug )༄ga /skar rtsis yan lag lnga'i lag len byed grub sbyi nor klags tsam gyi rtogs pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ ston mchog sangs rgyas de sras mchog /gsang bdag 'jam dpal pad dkar can/ /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi byin gyis rlobs/ /lnga bsdus byed dang grub pa'i rtsis//gang la 'jug kyang spyi yi don/ /lag len yid la nges pa'i gnad/ /nyung ngu'i ngag gi 'dir gsal bya/ /'das lo gang yin bcu gnyis ( 12)kyi/ /bsgyur ba mi gsal khyim zla yin/ /zla de gnas gnyis 'og ma nyid—/ /gnyis bsgyur sngon gyi bshol 'phro bsres/ /re lnga'i (65)bogs nor steng mar byin/ /des ni gsal bar tshes zlar 'gyur/ /re lnga'i (65)lhag mas zla bshol du/ /dus kyi gnad kyang rtogs pa yin/ /zla dag de las byed grub kyi/ /lag len gang 'dod sgru gsum bsgrub/ /de la sngon gyi rtsis 'phro bsres/ /rang gnas 'khor tshad lhag byung dor / /byed grub sgru bas bsgyur ba las//lnga bsdus lag len gcig tu mthun//'on kyang gza' nyi'i rkang gnas cha/ /sgru ba'i gnas dang mthun par byed/ /sgru bas bsgrub la gnas mang nyung / /du mar byas dang rtsa ba nas/ /bsgrub tshul 'dra min ches mang po/ /skar rtsis ri mo ji bzhin don/ /nges par rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yi/ /mdzad pa'i lag len mthong brgyud dang / /zhal gdams yi ge gzhan du ni/ /zhib mo nyid du rtogs bya ste/ /'dir ni 'jug bde zor yang phyir/ /dper brjod nyid du gnas bzhi pa/ /grub grags man ngag lugs byas gza'/ /byed grags rgyud lugs kyi nyi ma/ /tshogs bsam ril po dang cha shas/ /sgru ba ka gsum bsgrub pa'i tshul/ /dang po zla dag gnas bzhi bzhag /steng nas rim pas gzugs gzugs me/ 1(31phro40(80 /mkha' dbang mkha' nor gyis bsgyur la/ /cha shas srang dbyug rang gnas gang / /mas yar ri mkha' ri mkhas dus/ 7(60(60phro707 /mkha' dus thub pas bgod dor lhag /gza' sgru yin no yang zla dag /gnas bzhi steng nas rim pa bzhin/ 2(10phro58phro6 /mig phyogs klu dbang bro bas bsgyur/ 27phro60(60(13 /mas nas 'dod pa dang mkha' ro/ /mkha' ro skar mas dril dor ba'i/ /lhag ma nyi ma'i sgru bar smin/ /zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma mig 2(1 /'og ma gzugs bsgyur dus ( 126)nyi'i bgod/ /thob nor steng bzhug klu lag gis/ /bgod lhag tshogs dang 132

cha shas te/ /gza' rkang yang grags tshes rkang ste/ /zla ba'i sgru ba kar shes so/ /so so'i sngon gyi rtsis 'phro rnams / /zla dag bsgyur nyin skabs brgyan rnams/ /yang na sgru ba grub nyin la/ /byin ste de tshe 'khor lhag dor / /de ltar sgru gsum la bsgyur byed/ /nyid byin phyi ma'i gza' sgru ra 'gyur/ /bsgyur byed tshar grangs bcu gnyis gang / /sbyin pas phyi lo'i nag sgru ra dag /gshol byung tshe na bsgyur byed ni/ /tshar gcig slar yang bsnan pas grub/ /tshes kyi nges pa 'tshol ba na/ /gza' tshes nyi ma'i tshe re yi/ /rtsa ba'i longs spyod gza' tshes la/ /thig le rtsa dbang yon tan dang / /0phro56(3phro404chu ri rigs byed nyi ma la/ /0phro4phro21(6(3 thig le rig byed zla ba mig /rtse mo dus rnams tshes bsgyur la/ /gza' dang nyi ma'i sgru bar byin / /yang na bde blag nyid kyi ched/ /rtag long re mig bkod la byin/ /gza' nyi'i sgru bar rtag longs dag /sbyin pas gza' nyi bar mar grags/ /tshogs sam ril por tshes grangs bsres/ /mtsho ( 14)zlas bgos la thob pa'i nor/ /snyed pa mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /gza'i chu tshod man chad du/ /snon brid dgos pas mi brjed bzungs/ /de yang chu zla ma long nas/ /rnyed pa med kyang mnyam pa yin/ /grangs gnas gcig dang gsum mi mnyam/ /gnyis dang bzhi ni mnyam pa ste/ /rnyed nor de las mang mi srid/ /bgos pa'i lhag ma gang shar de'i/ /tshes rkang gar gnas ngos bzung la/ /rkang 'dzin de gyis rkang sdom bris/ /sdoms cha rkang pa'i ngo bo ni/ /grangs gnas lugs ldog snga rkang bdun/ /lugs 'byung phyi rkang bdun yin te—/ 5(5phro5(4(3(2(1 1(2(3(4mo5(5phro5lnga lnga lnga bzhi gsum gnyis gcig /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga lnga lnga/ /de'i snga rkang zos zin dang / /phyi ma gza' rgyu sdom zhes pa/ /don gnad gcig pas rkang sdoms dbyug /nyi shu lnga las mang mi srid/ /rkang 'dzin zla ba ( 1)dang myos ( 13)byed/ /shar na rkang pa'i dbyug lnga (5)sdom/ /de bzhin mig dang nyi mar( 12)bcu/ /me dang (3)drag por bco lnga sdomasaske/ /rgya mtsho'i (4)phyogs ( 10)la bcu dgu dang / /mda' (5)dang bu (9)gar nyer gnyis teske/ /rtse mo (3)klu (8)la nyi shu bzhi/ /thub (7)par nyer lnga stongs par (0)thig /rkang sdoms rngun mas cha shas bsgyur/ /dus ( 126)nyi'i dgos nor yang dag rgyu'i/ /chu tshod nyid yin gong cha'i lhag /mkha' (60)ro de nas ri mkhas (707)ri'i/ /rim bsgyur dus nyi'i rim gos nor/ /chu srang dang ni cha shas yin/ /rkang mtshams ma 'das snga rkang la/ /gnas tshe yang dag rgyu chu tshod/ /gong gi rkang sdoms dbyug gur bsres/ /phyi rkang la gnas yang dag rgyu'i/ /rkang sdom la sbyang de las gcig /phabs pa drug cu'i bsgyur byas la/ /chu srang gis sbyangs de lhag gcig /'bebs pa ri mkha' ri'i bsgyur la/ /rkang chas bu lon rnam par sbyangs/ /tshul de'i rkang longs dag par 'gyur/ /de nas gang gi thob nor nyid/ /dran byas gza' bar longs spyod du/ /mnyam bsnan mi mnyam dbri ba ste/ /des ni tshes gza' phyed dag 'gyur/ /133

de nas nyi dag don du ni/ /gong gi nyi ma bar ma nyid/ /nyi ma phyed dag zhes kyang de/ /ming gnyis byung yang 'dir don gcig /de yang nyi ma'i rkang rtsis ched/ /nyi bar gnyis bris gcig la ni/ /nyi ma'i skyes khyim sbyangs bar bya/ /sbyangs tshul bod kyi skar rtsis pas/ /rtog gzo mi 'dra mang byas kyang / /'dir ni rnam dag rgyud don bzhin/ /6(45 skar drug chu tshod zhe lngas te/ /ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan (27)te sbyangs/ /'khor lo bsnon min ji ltar yang / /sbyangs shul 'khor phyed lhag na'ang dor/ /'khor lo 'dir ni nyer bdun ste/ /rgyu skar grangs yin 'khor phyed ni/ /13(30 de'i phyed skar gnas bcu gsum dang / /chu tshod sum cur shes par bya/ /'khor phyed dor ba'i nyi ma der/ /dgun nyi ldog nas byang bsgrod tshugs/ /gang zhig ma dor nyin dbyar bzlog /lhor bsgrod tshugs pa'ang don la reg /sbyangs lhag skar ma drug (60)cu'i bsgyur/ /chu tshod bcug la dbang (535)yon zlas/ /bgos thob nor gyi nyi rkang bzung / /de yang nyi rkang snga phyi gnyis/ /6phro4(1 1(4phro6 snga ma drug bzhi gcig yin la/ /phyi ma gcig bzhi drug shes bya/ /rkang 'dzin gcig ( 1)dang lnga (5)la drug /gnyis (2)dang bzhi la bcu yin no/ /gsum (3)la bcu gcig sdom pa ste/ /rkang 'dzin stong na nam mkha' (0)sdom/ /gong gi nyi bar bsgyur dgos lhag /rkang bzung rngun mas bsgyur byas la/ /sngar bzhin dbang ( 135)yon zlas ( 1)bgos nor/ /yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod ste/ /de lhag drug cu'i bsgyur srang bcug /bgos byed gong bzhin bgos nor srang / /de lhag bcu gsum gyis bsgyur nas/ /bgos nor nyi rkang cha shas sogs/ /gza' nyi'i sgru ba gnas lnga par/ /nyi zla'i rkang pa gnyis ka la/ /srang lhag drug gis bsgyur bgod nor/ /dbugs de de 'og cha shas mthun/ /de yang nyi ma'i snga rkang la/ /gnas tshe bsnan la phyi rkang dbri/ /lag len gong gis tshes rkang dang / /mthun pa'i rigs pas shes par bya/ /nyi ma'i rkang 'jog longs spyod de/ /gza' nyi phyed dag longs spyod du/ /nyi ma 'khor phyed dor tshe bsnan/ /ya dor tshe na 'phri ba yin/ /des na gza' ni rnam par dag /longs spyod chu tshod nas cha shas/ /ming yin steng nas gza' skar ma/ /longs spyod bdag po'i sa yin no/ /zla skar ched du nyi dag gnyis/ /gcig la mtsho dbang tshes gyur gang / /dbyug gur ster la 'khor lo der/ /des ni tshes 'khyud zla skar yin/ /de la res gza'i longs spyod kyi/ /sbyangs bas res 'grog zla skar dag /nyi zla dag pa gnyis bsres nas/ /rang 'khor dor lhag sbyor ba'o/ /tshes grangs gang yin gnyis kyis bsgyur/ /gcig gis 'phri lhag bdun gyis dor/ /de yi lhag ma phyi byed yin/ /snga byed de yi shugs kyi rtogs/ /skar rtsis yan lag lnga zhes pa/ /gza' dang tshes dang skar ma dang / /sbyor ba dang ni byed pa ste/ /tshes ni gza' yi longs spyod yin/ /lnga bsdus lag len byed pa rnams/ /yi ge 'di yi tshig don dag /rgad mos ma ṇi 'don pa bzhin / /khar byang sems su chub pa bces/ /thun min sngags kyi man ngag ni/ /rang stobs kho nas blang mi 134

rung ske/ /nges par slob dpon zhabs brten ste/ /zhal lung brgyud pa ma chad nyan/ /thun mongs phyi yi rig pa rnamasaglu/ /rang gi blang ba ma 'gag yang / /blo mthu ches rmad phul byung las/ /de yang slob dpon bsnyen nyid bzang ske/ /de skad skar rtsis gsar bu par/ /phan phyir tshig don gsal ba 'di/ /bgyis pa'i dge tshogs mchis gyur kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gro shog /ces pa rang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rab byung nyi ma'i chu phag gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po brgyad kyi thun bar kha shas su sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/sto /rgyud dgongs lo 'pho dgun 'bring rgyal nya zla ba'i dang por bzhag pa'i tshul nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badz+ra pi ṭha ḍā ki nī sa mu tā ya/ rdo rje gdan bzhi rnal 'byor kun spyod rgyud/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / /rdo rje gtsug lag la sogs tshad ma yi/ /rgyud sde mang por mthun par gsung ba bzhin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa pad+ma sam bha was/ /rgyal gyi zla ba lo 'pho'i mtshams su bzhed/ /'on kyang mar ngo sngon 'gro byed pa na/ /mgo zla'i bcu drug lo yi 'pho mtshams snang / /ci phyir sa ga mar ngo sngon 'gro'i tshe/ /nag pa'i bcu drug nas tsam dus 'khor gyi/ /'grel chen dgongs don yin zhes dus 'khor gyi/ /mkhas gyur mang pos sgrogs na su yis rgol/ /dus 'khor nyi khyim 'pho dbang nag pa'i zla/ /dang por zhag kyang rten 'brel thog ma ni/ /rgyal zla nas brtsam rgyud dang 'bral pas bstan/ /des kyang rgyal zla dang po'i bsgrub byed gyur/ /gzhan gyur 'ga' zhig mchu zla mo mgo dang / /kha cig dbo zla kha cig snron zla dang / /kha cig smin drug kha cig mgo zla de/ /de dag lo 'pho zla ba'i thog ma ru/ /yin zhes smra ba de rnams dgos dbang gi /rgyal bas rnam grangs can gsungs su yis 'gog /gzhan yang dus drug dus bzhi'i rnam bzhag dang / /zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i sngon 'gro sogs/ /mna' chog da chog ji bzhin mkhas pa'i srol/ /rang rang ma 'khrul spyod na don ldan yin/ /'on kyang rang lugs lo mgo rgyal zla du/ /gtan tshig tshad ma'i rgyud sde mang po dang / /grub pa'i slob dpon mang po'i zhal lung gung / /mthun pas yid ches gnas su khas blang byas/ /de la dgag bzhag spang ba'ang bgyid yod mod/ /de lta na'ang de tshul btang snyoms mdzes/ /de skad rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu yis/ /shes bzhin drang por nyung gsal ngag gi smras/ /de la dge ba'i cha shas mchis pa rnams/ /blo ldan rnams kyi dgongs pa bskang ba dang / /blang dor gnas la 'khrul pa mi 'byung zhing / /kun rdzob bden pa rten 'brel bzang po'i cha/ /gong 'phel phun tshogs rdzogs ldan dpal 'byor gyis/ /pha ma'i rang bzhin 'gro kun 'tsho bar shog /ces pa yang rnal 'byor 135

pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos rkong yul shing lo'i tshal gu ru'i gnas chen lkog 'phrang du/ rab nyi chu khyi sbo zla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum par smras pa sarba maṅga lo/na mo bha wa te pradzñā pā ra mi tā ye/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na pa ri pu ri kā ye/ tar+ya thā bishu ti smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ rgya dpe dngos las rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bus bsdus so/ lcug kye ta ta la tsu kye/ lo ha lo/ma hā lo ha lo/ a la tsa la ta la swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'dod khams bdag pos phul ba'i rigs sngags mdo sde myang 'das nas gsung ba'o/ / purbapoṣādis+thāpabyi/ shar nas rgyal zla la sogs bzhag gdan bzhi'i rgyud rtsis 'khrul med rgya dper bzhugs bzhin pa yin/

dzo+o /rig 'dzin grub pa'i rtsis kyi rtsa don grub pa nor bu'i ljon shing phun tshogs snye ma rab tu rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs/o swāste/ na maḥshrī kā la tsakra ya/ rig drug khyab bdag bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /srid zhi'i spyi dpal bla mar phyag byas nas/ /man ngag grub pa'i mthar brten skar rtsis kyi/ /rtsa ba dus 'khor nas gsung rtsis 'phro nyid/ /bdag gi rnam par dpyad pa'i yul 'di la/ /mdzes pa'i rnam par gyur pa mang mod kyang / /rgyud don rgyal po'i rgyan du 'os pa ni/ /drang (207)srong mkha' ri dag pa de nyid la(25)ske/ /slar yang drang srong mkha' ri yongs bkod pa/ /rin chen phreng ba bzhi brgya (400)bsgrang ba'i saraske/ /don grub nor bu'i do shal yang dag zhig /rnyed pa'i dga' ston skal ldan gyur rnams spyod/ /de 'di skar rtsis ljon shing rtsa ba ste/ /phun tshogs rgyal gsung rgyud don ji bzhin pa/ /mdzes brgyan rin chen grub pa'i snye ma 'di/ /legs bshad yid bzhin rab tu rgyas byed yin / /'di ko sngon gyi rig byed da lta yi//yon tan gnas su drangs bas nam mkha' mdzod/ /longs spyod klu dbang dag gi 'gengs par nges/ /srang la nor bu cha dgu bteg byas shing / /cha shas drang srong mig gi dus tshod bltas/ /'di ni bā ra'i rkang pa nyid du thob/ /tshogs bsags bkra shis rtags kyi ri mo la/ /cha shas dbang bsgyur yon tan nor lha'i bu/ /sngon rabs lo rgyus drang srong bsgrod dran nas/ /lag pas chus gter bcus shing 'dir 'dren pas/ /thub pa stengs bzhugs de nyid zla bas gdan/ /ngo mtshar 'di ni rdzun med nyid du mthong / /mchog gi rkang par mā sa cig phul bas/ /dri med 'od mchog gsal bar the tshom med/ /arka de nyid dbyug gi ri rtse la mig phyogs bsnan pas mkha' dang ri rgya mtsho/ /mda' chus dor lhag lhag des stengs sbyangs bas/ /rgyud kyi rtsis 'phro gsal gyur ta la la/ /'di yi nyi ma ji bzhin de 'char tshe/ /stobs kyi rgyal po sgra gcan longs spyod du/ /dbang po rgya mtsho ster dang 'phrog pa'i gnad/ /gang yin gsal bas nges shes skye bar nges /rtog ge mngon rlom can la cha med kyang / /mchog gyur rnams ni 'dir dgyes gdon mi za/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bka' las lhag pa ci/ /mtshungs pa yang med des na des gsung rgyun/ /de la bdag ni snying nas gus pa yi/ /de yi rtsis 'phror sems nas 'bad 'di bgyis/ /ngal byas de yang don med ma yin par/ /rnam par rgyal ba 'gro ba'i bla ma che/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma shākya thub pa yi/ /go 'phangs nyid la 'gro 'dren rgyur gyur shog /zhes pa yang rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus bal yul mchod rten 'phags 137

pa shing kun gyi nyams gso srog shing 'dren pa'i dus rabs 'dod kyi dpal gdong chu bya'i mtha' phal kun zla ba'i dmar phyogs dga' ba gnyis par ba yul tsha shod bha ga ta pa zhes su bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'oske//grub rtsis kun mdzes nor bu'i me long bzhugs so/ /o swāste/ na mo gu ru we/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na maḥshrī ka la tsakra ya/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs rje 'jug pa las/ /grub pa'i rtsas lugs kun la khyad par mchog /kun mjes nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba/ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i rtsis de dge gyur cig /rāk+ṣak+ṣa zhes dga' dbang ngam mig mar/ /'das lo rim bsres bcu gnyis dag gis bsgyur/ /gnas gnyis 'og ma lag pas spel shol 'phro/ /rgyud dang mthun byas des na nyer gnyis byin/ /de la gza' tshes nyi ma'i sgru ba bsgrub/ /gra ha'i sgru bar gcig dang nyi shu dang / /nyer gnyis bzhi dang gcig brgya zhe brgyad brgyan/ /tshogs cha tshogs la nor lha cha shas gter/ /surta'i sgru war mkha' dang chu gter dang / /me dang rig byed dang ni mkha' dbang sbyin/ /lo bdag sgra can gza' lnga'i rtsis 'phro rnams/ /rnam dag rgyud nas 'byung nyid kho nar spyod/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma'i thugs rje las grub pa'i—//skar rtsis kun mdzes nor bu'i me long gang / /blo ldan rnams la rtsa ba'i sa bon 'di/ /mthong ba rtsam gyi bde bklags nyid du 'gyur/ /tshul 'di gzhan 'gran khe grags sgrogs phyir min/ /rgyud don gu ru'i bstan pa'i rgyan du dmigs/ /lhag bsam gyis 'bad dge des 'gro kun gyis/ /blang dor gsal ba'i sgron me 'di rgyas shog /zhes pa yang dpal rig pa 'dzin pa smras pa sarba maṅga lo/na mo gor+ṣa nā tha shrī me/ 'phags pa'i yul na thub pa'i rgyal tshab che/ /rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag grub pa'i dbang phyug chog /brgyad bcur grags las deng dus phrin las rgyun/ /ma nub 'phags pa'i yul du rgyas pa ni/ /shar phyogs nag po'i rjes 'brang tsār+ya pa/ /lho ru klu grub gdul bya dharmā pa/ /nub ni la wa'i drol 'dzin ba lin+ta/ /byang phyogs gurte'i rjes 'jug a te pa sa yang zer dzo ki mang / /thub dbang drag por bltams nas brgyad cu cig /lcags 'brug lo la chos kyi dbyings su rnal/ /de nas brgya dang bcu la rgyal bstan gyi/ /gtad rab bdun rdzogs bzhi brgya lon pa na/ /mgon po klu grub 'jig rten sgron mar byon/ /dgu brgya 'das skabs 'khor lo gsum pa yi/ /dgongs don mthar thug smra ba thogs med byon/ /de yi gcung po slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang / /bod rgyal tho tho ri dang dus mtshungs 'dod/ /dbyig gnyen slob ma phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /de yi slob mar gyur pa chos skyong bya/ /'phags mchog chos grags de yi slob ma yin/ /de dang bod yul rgyal po spyan ras gzigs/ /srong btsan zhabs dang dus mtshungs mkhas rnams 'dod / /des na rgyal ba 'das nas lo stong dang / /lnga brgya nyag ma brgyad na srong btsan 'khrungs/ /de yi 138

rig pas dzo ki dbang phyug che/ /ba glang bsrung ba'i mgon po gang de yang / /sangs rgyas 'das nas lo stong phrag gcig dang //brgya phrag lnga pa'i khong du 'khrung bar shes/ /ci zhes chos skyong slob ma mkhas pa ni/ /de wa shā ma bya bas lho phyogs su//'gro don skyong nas pa la wa ha na//bya ba'i rgyal po de yang chos kyi brtul//rgyal po 'di dus ba bsrung mgon po yang / /byon pa yin zhes mkhas mchog kyis bzhed pas/ /srong btsan sgam po'i sngon rtsam byon pa ru/ /des rtogs nus te de phyir bsrung mgon ni/ /'khrungs nas da lta'i bar du lo stong dang / /brgya 'das nyis brgya'i khongs su gnas par mngon/ /mgon po 'di nyid sems can 'bum phrag brgya//mkha' spyod zhing du gshegs par ma gyur bar//sku yi bkod pa bskal ldan gdul bya la//'gog pa med par mngon sum snang bar mdzad//༄ga /tsi na gser gyi gtsug lag 'byung rtsis sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig shin tu gces pa bzhugs so/ /o swāste/ rgyal kun yab tu gyur kyang byis sba'i gzugs/ /mtshan dpes rab rgyan phur lnga me tog thod—/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od 'phros 'od chen po/ /ma rig mun sel sgron me mchog der 'dud/ /tsi na'i khab nas gser gyi gtsug lag rtsis/ /'dir 'dren mkhyen ldan sngon du byung rnams dang / /deng dus gangs can 'di na mkhas pa'i phul/ /gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba gang de rgyal/ /'phags yul skar rtsis pa ṭa ni/ /lo re bzhin du spo dgos ltar/ /tsi na'i li thu yang zhib mor/ /lo re bzhin du bsgyur bar shes/ /des na bod 'dir lo gcig ltar/ /'pho med brtag pa'i li thu 'di// /'ol phye tsam las phal cher 'khrul/ /ma 'khrul ri mo 'di ltar bya/ /rab byung bcu gsum sogs 'das lo/ /nyi mas bsgyur la 'das pa'i zla/ /rgya nag sa yi dpyid ra ba/ /hor zla dang po la sogs bsre/ /'dir ni 'phags yul rtsis dang bstun/ /nag zla la sogs rim par ste/ /gnas gnyis 'og ma lag pas bsgyur/ /ri rtse (37)bsres la dbang dus kyis(37)ske/ /bgos nor steng byin zla dag pa/ /de ni thig le me (30)yis bsgyur/ /gnas gsum 'og ma rtse bro (563)dbang / /bar mar thub (7)pa rtsis phror byin/ /ri mkha' (707)ri dang chu(6) ro yis(4)glu/ /bgos pa'i nor gyi steng sbyangs lhag /gnas lngar bkod la rim pa bzhin/ /rtsis 'phro bde 'byung (11)dang dbang po(4)/ /'dod yon (5)dang ni thub pa (7)dang / /ri bong (1)'dzin rnams ma nor byin/ /de nas rim bzhin nyi ma (12)phyogs(10)/ /sme (7)spar (8)res gza'i (7)'khor lo yi/ /bgos lhag nyi ma 'byung ba dang / /sme ba pā kon res gzar 'gyur/ /gcig (1)shar 139

'brug nyi thig (0)shar yos/ /lhag ma go rim des shes bya/ /'byung ba dgu thig shing gcig gnyis/ /me'o bdun brgyad chu bar shes/ /sme ba dgu'i spyad lhag ma yi/ /slar yang bcu la 'phri bar bya/ /'phri byed lhag ma med gyur na/ /bgod (7)byed nyid kyis phyogs la (0)sbyangs/ /de lhag dgu nas cig gi bar/ /lug bzlog nyi ma'i sme bar shes/ /mi gcig thig zin pā bkon no/ /res gza' skar rtsis nyid du gcig /nges pa lan gcig rnyed pa nas/ /phyin chad nyin zhag bsgrang na'ang 'grub/ /'on kyang re bzhi'i cha rdzogs che/ /tsi na'i lugs kyi zla ba chung / /'phags yul zhag mi thus yod pas/ /nyi ma 'byung ba smre pā bkon/ /tshes kyi chad lhag ltar min par/ /skar rtsis mkhan gyi res gza' bzhin/ /lhag chad med par 'grel chags su/ /ji srid bar du 'khor ba yin/ /des na gtsug lag 'phrul 'byung rtsis/ /rgya nag lugs gyur 'byung po'i rigs / /nyi mar sgyur ba'i rigs mtha' dag /'di la brten nas bya ba gces/ /dus tshod sme ba pā bkon yang / /de bzhin rig pas bde blag 'gyur/ /de skad tsi na'i yul nas byung ba yi/ /rtsis gzhung rnams la med du mi rung ba'i/ /nyi ma 'byung ba sme na pā bkon dang / /skar rtsis lugs dang thun gyur res gza' bcas—/ /phyis dus rnam dpyod ldan pas rnyed pa nyid/ /legs bshad khyad par can du shes bzhin pas/ /'di ru gsal phyes dge bas bdag sogs 'gro/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dpal go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa sngar shing glang lor bkod pa'i rtsis 'phro 'jug pa bde phyir rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos lor spos pa 'di yang rnal 'byor rgyal khams spyod pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rab myos lcags rta dbyug gu zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi zla ba gnyis pa gza' skar bzang po la bod yul dbus 'gyur gyi lho phyogs lo re dkar po'i sa yi thig le sbyor rabs kyi skyed mos tshal du bkod pa ste dge'o/ / 140

༄sto /skar rtsis la nye bar 'kho ba grangs kyi rtsom byed rtsa ba drug pa'i mngon brjod gzhung chung ṭi ka dang bcas pa til gyi me snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i nga ro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'di skad du/ khams yul grong khyer 'gro gnas tshor/ /sdeb sbyor 'dod lha dga' byed pa/ /mo'i sras legs ldan 'byor pa ste/ /grangs rtsa drug gi mngon brjod ming —/ /rtsa bar mi mang des na 'dir/ /rig byed pa dang sangs rgyas gzhung / /gnyis ka la grags rung mthun brda'/ /bdag blos gsar du deng 'dir bzhag /de la nyes par mi sems shing / /gzhan nas 'phri bsnan yang ma byed/ /phra mo 'di tsam smras dge yang / /rigs drug rdo rje 'chang thob shog /zhesapa'ang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu'i smras pa'o/ /a tha/ gzhung chung 'di la klad kyi don/ /gzhung dang / rjes so/ /klad kyi don ni phyag 'tshal ba dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/ dang po ni bdag cag gi ston par phyag 'tshal ba dang / ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /bdag cag gi ston pa la phyag 'tshal ba la/ sangs rgyas ni sgrib gsum dri ma dang bcas pa sangs/ /sku gsum ye shes ma lus shing lus pa med par rgyas/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdud bzhi bcom skal drug dang ldan/ /srid zhi gnyis ka las 'das pa ste/ /rgyu nyon mongs/ 'bras bu lha bu/ rgyu phung po/ 'bras bu 'chig ste bdud bzhi bcom pa dang / rgyu sbyin sogs phar phyin drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang 'bras phyin drug gi go rim bzhin/ dpal dang grags pa dang gzugs bzang ba dang brtson 'grus dang / ye shes dang dbang phyug ste skal ba drug go/ /shākya thub pa ni shākya phod pa dang nus pa ste/ dus der rgyal rigs dregs pa can rnams zhi bar byed pa na thub pa'am/ yang na shākya ni 'dul bar dka' ba mtha' dag dang / thub pa ni 'dul byed rmad byung ba don du yang rung ste/ phyag 'tshal ba ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan shes shing snying nas mi tshad pa'i gus pa chen po dang ldan pas de'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyi thal mo spyi bor sbyar zhing yan lag lnga sa la phab ste phyag byas pa'o/ /ma byon pa ni 'byung 'gyur te go sla la/ sangs rgyas ni snga ma dang 'dra zhing / drug pa ni bskal pa bzang po pa 'dir sangs rgyas brgya phrag bcu'i dang po'i drug pa'o/ /seng ge ni 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i don dang / nga ro ni log par smra ba 141

mtha' dag zil gyi gnon pa chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong spro ba ste/ de la phyag 'tshal ba ni gong dang mthun / skabs 'dir grangs gnas drug brjod pa la bskal bzang sangs rgyas drug pa la phyag 'tshal ba ni gnas skabs nyams mtshar ba dang / don du ma 'ongs sangs rgyas de la mos pa'i bag chags bzhag nas tshogs gnyis rgya cher bsags pa'i phyir ro/ rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ de nas grangs kyi brda chad gcig la sogs pa sngon du song ba'i brdar yang rung la/ 'dir phyag 'tshal nas tshig gi mtshams sbyar ba yin no / /'di skad du ces pa ni dngos gzhir 'jug pa'i tshig go/ /don gnyis pa gzhung dngos la rtsa ba dang 'phros don gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ khams yul grong khyer 'gro gnas tshor/ zhes khams ni sa chu me rlung mkha' dang ye shes te drug go/ /yul ni nang du mig nas yid kyi yul gyi bar du yang rung mod/ 'dir ni skar rtsis dus sbyor skabs su yul drug tu gsung pa 'phags yul/ bod/ li/ rgya/ sham+bha la/ gangs ldan zhes kai la sha ste drug go/ /gangs ldan lho byang dus sbyor tshad tha dad du byas pa yod kyang yul gcig nyid las mi bzung ngo / /grong khyer ni yul dbus 'gyur gyi grong khyer te/ gnas bcas/ gnyan yod/ wa ra na se/tsam parna/ rgyal po'i khab/ yangs pa can dang drug go/ /'gro ba ni ngan song gi 'gro ba gsum ste dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / mtho ris kyi 'gro ba gsum ste/ mi lha min lha dang drug go/ /gnas ni rigs drug gi gnas dang lus kyi rkang mthil/ gsang gnas/ lte ba/ snying kha/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo drug kyang ngo / /tshor ba ni mig lus rna ba sna lce yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshor ba'i bar ro/ /sdeb sbyor 'dod lhag dga' byed pa/sdeb sbyor ni mdo rtags sna tshogs pa las/ sdeb sbyor gyi 'dod pa du zhig drug go/ /'di lta ste/ go ta ma dang / ra ma yin dang / maṅga lam̐ dang / so so pad tsa la dang / ka si tsa li ya dang / a ra shi se na zhes bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dod lha ni/ rgyal chen bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan / 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de drug go/ /dga' byed ni khyab 'jug 'jug pa bcu las rā ma gnyis yod pa'i/ snga ma ni sa steng 'dir rgyal rigs chos bzhin gyi khrims la ming spyod pa rnams 'joms shing bram ze rnams la phan par ston pa ya ma asna'i bu dgra sta dga' byed dang / phyi ma ni laṅka'i yul sde 'joms par byed pa rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu dga' byed de 'dir ni khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa drug dga' byed snga ma dgra sta dga' byed la 'dzin dgos kyi/ de dag gi gtam rgyud lo rgyus mang yang 'dir rgya mi bskyed do/ /me'i sras legs ldan 'byor pa ste/ zhes pa me'i sras sam me'i bu ni gzhon nu gdong drug gi ming ste de ni lha mo dbu mas lha chen po'i khu ba dang 'dres pa'i rang gi rdul drang srong me lha bsod snyoms par rdzu ba'i khar blug de tsha ba'i reg byas gdung nas rgya mtsho'i chus kha bshal nas der khye'u zhig byung ba skar ma smin drug la gnas pa'i lha mo gzhon nu ma drug gi so sos nu ma bsnun par 142

'dod pa na/ gzhon nu des kyang lha mo de rnams mgu ba'i phyir gdong drug sprul nas nu zho btung bas de la gdong pa drug yod cing / gzhon nu gdong drug ni me lha'i kha nas skyes pa'i bu yin pas de'i brda'o/ /legs ldan ni legs sbyar du bha ga wan zhes sngon gyi 'jig rten mig byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan la bcom ldan 'das dang / 'jig rten gyi lha la legs ldan zhes su mi nor ba'i ched du bsgyur bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs su skal ldan zhes kyang rung ngo / /sangs rgyas la pho rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i yon tan drug mdu' zhing / lha chen po rnams la 'jig rten thun mong pa'i yon tan drug ste/ de yang dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ bsod nams kyi tshe stobs brtson/ /rdzu 'phrul bskal bzang gzugs mchog nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa de rnams bsod nams kyi mthus rigs mthun grub par gyur pa la yang ji rigs yod rung / lha chen po rnams la ni khyad par du gyur pa ste tshe bskal par gnas pa dang / stobs kyi mthu ldan lha min sogs pha rol gnon pa dang / btson pas bka' thub grub pa'i dmod pas ngo mtshar ba du ma ston pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi 'jig rten 'phel 'grib nus pa dang ske/ bskal bzang ni ral gri sogs thun mong gi dngos grub chen po kun rang dbang du spyod cing sngags kyi nus pa thun mong mtha' yas pa sbyin par byed pa dang / gzugs mchog ni 'dod dgu cir yang bsgyur ba rnams so/ /'byor pa ni bsod nams kun gyi gzhir byas te/ tshe dang / blo gros dang / dpal dang / gzi brjid dang / dbang thang dang / snyan par grags pa la 'dod pa dang / yang rin po che dang / 'bras bu dang ske/ phyugs dang / 'khor g.yog bud med/ rigs de bgrang tshul yang yang 'dir de tsam mo/ /gnyis pa 'phros don ni/ /grangs rtsa drug pa'i mngon brjod ming / grangs rtsa ni gcig nas dgu'i bar bcu yi rtsom byed de grangs gnas thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa ba yin pas de yi nang tshan du gyur pa'i drug pa ste/ grangs gnas gong du 'phros pa drug dang ma nor ba'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar mi mang zhes drug gi mngon par brjod pa'i brda' rtsa ba ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang 'grel pa gnyis kar drug gi brdar dus dang ro dang / /de dang 'grel ba mtshams dang bro ba yang sbyar bas rnam grangs bzhi tsam ste ha cang mi mang la/ de'i dus ni dgun stod/ dgun smad dpyid sos ka dbyar ston te drug yin la/ mtshams ni thun mtshams drug la yang 'jug ste/ de la dus gsum dang dus bzhi dang mtshams bzhi sogs kyi brdas 'khrul dogs che la/ ro ni bro ba dang don gcig cing / kha ba dang mngar ba dang / skyur ba dang / bska ba dang / tsha ba dang / lan tshwa ba dang drug go/ /yang skar rtsis mkhan rnams kyi grangs kyi brdar ma byas kyang 'jig rten khams le'u tshigs bcad brgya nga gnyis par grangs kyi brda' chad 'od zer la mdzad pa ni kha cig gi bcu gnyis dang ske/ bdun du 'dod pa dag kyang mi 'thad la/ yang sngar bzhed na sngon po dang nag po gcig tu byas pa 143

yang mi legs te/ rlung drug 'od zer drug gi bdag nyid can du rgyud las yang yang gsung bzhin 'dir ni drug tu 'dod dgos la/ nges par lngar bzhag dgos na ljang khu ni sngon po'i bag la zha bar byas na rgyud gzhan dang mthun cing dag sbyor byar yod kyang / grangs kyi brdar bzhag skabs gong gi bshad pa nyid las gzhan du mi 'os so/ /des na 'dir/ rig byed pa dang sangs rgyas gzhung / gnyis ka la grags rung mthun brda'/ bdag blos gsar du deng 'dir bzhag zhes pa de yang dus kyi 'khor lo gsung pa'i grangs kyi brda' 'di rnams phyi rol rig byed pa dang mthun par gsung pa 'ba' zhig ste/ dper mtshon na gcig gi brdar gzugs zhes pa ru pa'i sgra te rang bzhin la 'jug cing / de yang rig byed pa'i gang zag gi bdag cig pu pa/ rtag pa rang dbang can du 'dod pa'i gcig pu pa'i mtshan nyid der snang la/gzhan nang pa'i gzhung lugs ltar na gzugs gcig kho nar ci ltar 'gyur ltar dga' rnams soms shig /'dir drug gi sgrar tshor ba bzhag nas gong du nang pa'i gzhung ltar bkral yang / phyi rol pas ni gang zag gi brda' bdag rtag pa skyes bu tshang pas rang dbang du spyod pa zhig la 'dod de 'on kyang tshor bar grags pa grangs gnas drug ni mthun pas yin no/ /des na dam pa ri dwags dbang po kha cig gis nyer bzhi'i brdar rgyal ba la/ langs gshegs su gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas nyer bzhi yin par bzhed pa dang ske/ bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun du 'dod pa sogs ni dpa' chen stag gi mgur nas byi la'i skad 'byin lta bur gyur pas mi legs so/ gzhan phyis byung rtsis kyi bstan bcos kha cig tu he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs grangs brdar bzhag pa yang mi legs te/ de rung na dus 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad dang /lha chen bcu gnyis kyang / grangs de dag gi brdar byas na mi 'thad par ga la 'gyur/ de ltar gzhung du yang med cing sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi kyang ma byas so/ /don dpe na 'dir ni phyi rol rig byed kyi gzhung dang sangs rgyas pa gnyis kar grags pa'i rung mthun gyi brda' grangs gnas drug gi bsgrang bya la mi rmongs shing mi 'khrul ba'i phyir sbyar du rung ba'i mngon brjod ji snyed pa las 'dir rnam grangs bcu gcig gam/ skal ldan legs ldan tha dad du byas na bcu gnyis tsam zhig sngar gzhan gyi mdzad pa ma mthong yang bdag gi blos gsar du bzhag cing dus 'khor nas gsung pa'i brda' lnga dang bcas pa'i khyon bcu drug ste/ de dag 'dir gsal bar bkod pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bstan bcos brtsam pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni de la nyes par mi sems shing /gzhan nas 'phri bsnan yang ma byed/ zhes gdams pa ste/ des na bdag gis bgyis pa 'di ni phyi nang gi gzhung lugs phyogs snga yang cha tsam longs shing sangs rgyas pa'i thun mong dang khyad par ba'i sde snod kyang cung zad mthong thos go bas na tshigs su bcad pa nyung ngu 'di la ni nor 'khrul med pas na nyes par mi 144

sems pas rtsam zin pa'o/ /gzhan nas 'phri bsnan yang ma byed/ zhes pa ni thos bsam chung ba'i grong rtsis gsar bu ba kha cig gi kho pas 'di lta bu zhig brtsam 'dug pa ngas kyang rung ngo snyam nas mi 'bral nor 'khrul du gyur pa mi gtsang ba'i chu blang nas dag byed du sems pa ltar byung na mi legs snyam pa las gzhan dgag pa med do/ /gnyis pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ phra mo 'di tsam smras dge yang / /drug pa rdor 'chang thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes pa ni/ tshegs chung la ha cang gi dgos pa mi che ba'i gzhung phra mo 'di tsam zhig brjod pa'i dge ba yang btang snyoms su mi bzhag par byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo zhing don mchog dang ldan pa'i bstos gzhan ni dge ba bsngo/ ci nas kyang rigs zhes pa'i don te/ des na phra mo 'dis kyang blo gsar gyi sems dga' ba bskyed pa dang / grangs gnas mi 'khrul ba la cung zad phan par srid pa'i dge ba 'di yang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi rgyas btab ste rigs drug gi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi go tsho 'phang thob pa'i phyir bsngos pa'o/ /rigs drug ni rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang /ral gri te lnga dang / de thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'bras bu rgyas 'debs kyi ngo bor yang smin pa rdo rje 'chang ste gsang chen rigs gcig rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag tu gyur pas so/ /zhes pa nas smras pa'i bar gyi sbyar byang ni rtsom pa po su yin 'khrul pa mi skye zhing gang yin rtogs sla bas des khungs che chung ci ltar 'gyur yang bzhag bde ba'o/ /de ltar grangs gnas drug gi mngon brjod rtsa ba dang lhan cig par 'grel pa yang brjod pa 'di ni ha cang gi dgos pa mi che yang nyams dga' ba'i ngang ku re lag dal gyi rol rtsed bsgyur ba ste/ bskul ba po ni/ rang gi slob ma skar rtsis la ches byang ba dpal ma dge slong karma dbang rgyal dang / khyad par rig gnas du mar mkhas gyur ding ri shar lung ba dge bsnyen 'jam dbyangs blo gros rab rgyas pas lo shas kyi gong nas grangs gnas drug gi mngon brjod dgos tshul gsol ba dran nas rgyal khams kun tu rgyu ba rnal 'byor spyod pa des mnga' ris mar yul stod waṃ le bde chen rnam rgyal du chu sprel mgo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis par bris pa ste tshegs chung 'di 'dra yang bstan chos chen po ltar rtsa 'grel bcas yin gyu gyu bar byas nas gzhan dag gad mo 'chor ba'i rgyur brtsam pa yi ge pa ni rdzong phug sku skye tshe dbang bstan 'dzin kyis a la la ho/dge'oske//na maḥshrī ka la tsakrā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /cha med kun 'gro dus led dus bzang poske/ /rnam kun mchog ldan 'khor los bsgyur rgyal che/ /ston mchog sgyu 'phrul sras der mgos phyag 'tshal/ /1 sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /gcig bsdus rnga yab sismyo'i pad+mo las/ /nyer bltam gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung / /mgon des bdag gtsug rgyan du rtag mdzod cig / 2 bdag snying ge sar 145

'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /dran chos dngas ma'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa ba'i bla mas rtag tu dgyes rol shog / 3 gang 'dir bskal bzang rnam 'dren gtso bo ni/ /bcom ldan lha yi lha mchog shākya'i tog /byang chub shing drung gshegs nas bdud brtul zhing //yang dag mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa nas/ / 4nyis stong drug brgya nyer dgu 'das pa'i lo/ /dkar po sa sbrul hor zla bcu gcig pa/ /mgo zla dmar po'i phyogs gang nya ma'i nyin/ /nyin tshad rgyud lugs chu tshod nyer lnga la/ / 5 chu tshod bcu bdun spyad zin lhag brgyad kyi/ /mtshams su mtshun rje'i phyogs dang nye ba nas/ /rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil 'khor lnga cha gcig /srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sgo ru 'jug /6 phyi rol de bzhin nang du khams drug ldan/ /rol dang bcud len gnyis spong sgo ru 'jug /gzhan du mtha' gnyis g.yo ba mnyam nyid sgor/ /rten cing 'bral 'byung dngos rjes tshul du 'jug / 7 de tshe las bsags mtha' dag stobs ldan ste/ /kun rdzob la gzhol dge ba'i tshogs rnams kyang / /zla 'dzin 'bum dang nyi 'dzin 'bum phrag brgyar/ /'gyur tshad rgyal ba'i gsung yin bslu ba med/ / 8 des na dge ba'i las yid spro ba'am/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dman la sbyin btong dang / /khyad par 'chi nges srog bslu sāts+tsha gdab/ /lha sgom sngags bzla sgo gsum nyes pa bshags/ / 9 rdo rje'i rnal 'byor stong nyid don bsgom sogasaglu/ /'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas dge la 'bad/ /de yang sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed byang chub chen por bsngo/ / 10 nyi 'dzin 'di ni 'thing bar dka' ba yi/ /sgo yig shes ldan rnams kyi bag 'dzem mdzad/ /ji bzhin thog tu khel bar ma gyur kyang / /dge ba skul la sdig pa yod ma yin/ / 11 ngo tsha shes pa 'phags pa'i nor yin yang / /chos nyid rtogs pas 'dir snang mi zhen pas//bstod dang smad la de tsam 'ching ba med/ /des na gza' 'dzin yi ge sbyar ba 'di/ / 12 thog tu ma khel gyur kyang bag tsha med/ /thog tu khel yang de la spro sam ci/ /de bas ci bde mnyam nyid yangs pa'i klong / /bya bral rnal 'byor de yi khyad chos yin/ / 13 gzhan phan lhag bsam dung dang ku mud ltar/ /gcig tu dkar bas dge bskul yi ge 'di/ /sbyar la dge mchis mtha' yas 'gro ba la/ /bsngo bas kun kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas/ / 14 bzung 'dzin 'pho ba'i rlung kun yongs bcom nas/ /'pho med dhu tir dag pa ye shes rlung / /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po 'od gsal sku/ /ku tu bzang po ji 'dra de thob shog / 15sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāsti/ rje btsun rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po mchog /dang po'i sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med bde chen gling pa mchod/ /mgon po kun gtso mchog gyur de/ /dus 'dir rig 'dzin grub pa'i dpal/ /rje btsun pad+ma ma ṇi yi/ /theg gling bstan pa'i nyi ma la/ /lan grangs 146

'ga' bzung bsngags pa yi/ /rdo rje'i gsung de snying dbus su/ /bzhag nas de yi dgongs bskangs slad/ /de nas brgyud pa'i chos zab mo/ /nyan blo skyes nas sems dpa' che/ /rje btsun rat+na bha dra gang / /legs bsnyen dam chos phung po yi/ /rgyun bzang thob pa'i bka' drin snyed/ /de yang pad 'byung bde chen gling / /dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bdag ni mi shes byis pa ste/ /'phags chen dgongs pa'i rol rtsed la//gnong pa'i lam du gyur pa kun/ /mthol bshags 'di phyir sgrib med shog /stobs 'byor go bas dregs pa dang / /thos bsam bsgom pa'i mngon rlom kun/ /bzung nas dam chos ston pa yi/ /bla ma'i zhabs la mgo bo yi/ /gus pas rtag tu phyag byas pas/ /bde chen gling pa dgyes gyur shog /bla ma'i skyon ni bzung bya min / /bla ma'i yon tan bzung bya yin/ /bla ma'i yon tan dran bzhin du/ /rig
