pa 'dzin pas de skad smras//sarba maṅga lo/ a tha/ rje bla ma dam pa rat+na bha dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la dge legs su mdzod cig da lam gong ma 'jigs bral nam mkha'i gsol 'debs rje bla ma rang nyid kyi rnam thar 'phro mthud/ nged la smon lam dang bcas pa/ gter mgon phyag bzhi'i glegs bam rnams 'byor bka' drin chen pos khyab/ /da lam bdag gi bla ma bka' drin can sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs su bal ṭaṃ rgyan drug dpal bzang nyi shu phul ba dang / 'tshams 'dri lha gos ja gshag tshal bcas zla 5tshes 2la yul mdo khams sgang lnga'i dbus kaḥthog gi mnga' ris su gzhan drin mi 'jog par rang dbang gi chos smra ba'i ded dpon yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu gdugs ltar du mdzes pa'i khyu mchog gzod ma nyid nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa yin nges chen por slob ma rnams kyi sgro btags pa tshe yi dbang po don gnyis nor bu'i gzi 'od can 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sde dpal kun tu rgyas pa zhes ri kha ba can gyi ljongs su ma zad rgya bal kun tu rlung ltar grags pa des rigs dang skye ba'i go sa sogs mngon mtho'i dpal gyi khengs pa yongs su bskyung nas rtsa ba'i bla ma pad+ma bde chen gling pa dang karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho gnyis kyi dgongs rdzogs dam pa'i chos kyi che bar dmigs ste 'jang g.yang ri'i bla rabs gsum pa sbas pa'i tshul can rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rin chen bzang po'am dkon mchog bzang po yi mtshan can gang gi zhabs la phyag byas te dpral ba btug bzhin du phul ba ste rgyud ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la 'jug pa'i rgyu gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ 147

rog /rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa gsal ba nor bu'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste sid+dhi rastu/ rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa gsal ba nor bu'i 'od snang zhes bya ba/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa kun mkhyen kun la sman/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /bla med yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thub la rtag tu phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus nges pa/ /mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa'i ngag /nyung la don tshang nor bu yi/ /'od snang lta bu 'dir spro bya/ /mgon po thugs rje che des 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la sman pa'i ched gzigs nas/ /chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /sna tshogs sprul pas sems can don chen mdzad/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshul/ /thun mong zhing du srid pa ji srid ston/ /bdag cag ston pa shākya'i rgyal po mchog /dag zhing zas gtsang sras po 'jig rten mgon/ /don kun grub pa bkra shis rgyal ba'i gnas/ /phun tshogs dpal mdzad dpal mnga' dpal ldan des/ /gang du bltams dang gang du byang chub reg /chos 'khor bskor dang gang du myang 'das pa/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab phyir/ /mdzad pa'i dus kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gcig dang du ma sgyu ma'i rtogs brjod bzhin/ /bka' lung bstan bcos rnams nas ji snyed gsungs/ /de bzhin rgyal bstan rin chen gnas pa'i yun/ /ji tsam pa yang dgongs pa can gyi ni/ /rin chen bka' dang bstan bcos che rnams las/ /du mar gsungs pa kun la'ang phyag byas nas/ /thog mar bstan pa'i rtsis gzhi dam pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi chos sku chos dkon mchog /kun rdzob tsam du gdul bya'i bsod nams bzhin/ /bri gang yun tshad dngos shugs du ma ru/ /gsung kun bdag blo phra mos bsdu dka' yang glu/ /mkhas gyur gzhan gyi gsung gi rjes nyid dang / /gtsug lag mchog nas rang gi rnyed bcas gang / /rag rim tsam zhig 'dir 'chad spobs pa skyes/ / 1 de yang theg chen bskal pa bzang po'i mdo/ /nyan thos gser 'phreng rtog brjod lung phran tshegs/ /bstan bcos blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel/ /dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi mngon mdzod rang 'grel du/ /rgyal bstan dngos dang brtags pa lnga brgya re/ /phyes pa chig stong nyid du mthun par gsungs/ /sprin chen mdo yi shugs bstan lung de yang / /lo grangs stong gi phyogs su bsdu 'os la/ /yang na rnga bo che yi mdo lung ltar/ /phyi ma'i dus su smra yang 'gal ba med/ / 2'dul ba lung gyur phran tshegs kyi 'brel pa/ /slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyi mdzad pa las/ /rgyal bstan dngos nyid lo grangs stong gi bar/ /tshul bzhin nyid du gnas par yongs su dgongs/ / 3 bod 'dir mya ngan 'das pa'i mdo nyung ngur/ /grags pa bstan pa'i gnas tshad shas che zhig /myang 'das 159

rgyas pa nas byung dum bu der/ /chig stong chig brgya 'phros bcas gnas par gsungs/ / 4mdo sde snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/ /bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi smon lam dbang / /bstan pa dngos gnas stong dang gzugs brnyan tsam/ /btags pa ba gyur lnga brgya gnas par gsungs/ / 5 byang sems zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo/ /da lta glegs bam snang 'dir gnyis stong nges/ / 6 li yul chos kyi gnas tshul lung bstan pa / /'phags pa dgra bcom dge 'dun 'phel ba'i gsungs/ /rnam grangs can mthong 'on kyang phyis byung gis / /mkhas pa phal ches nyis stong nyid du bsgrags/ / 7 rang ngo mi g.yo tha dad snang ba'i mdor/ /lung rtogs dus rim gnyis stong lnga brgyar gsungs/ /de bzhin slob dpon pad+ma'i ngang tshul dang / /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis kyang bzhed par snang / / 8 yang ni zla snying zhus mdor sum stong du/ /bshad zhes dam pa mchog gyur dag gi gsungs/ / 9 ting nge 'dzin mchog rgyal po'i mdo las ni/ /mi lo gnyis stong dgu brgya dang brgyad bcu/ /dus kyi rtags bcas dngos bstan gsal ba dang / /shugs bstan gsum stong lhag tsam nyid du byas/ / 10 slob dpon chen po dzñā na badz+ra gyi/ /la ra gshegs 'grel snying po rgyan zhes par / /rang thad gnyis stong mdzad kyang rnam grangs khungs/ /gzhan gyi bzhi stong bzhag pa gsal bar phyes / / 11 byams pa lung bstan mdo las rgyal ba'i bstan/ /lnga stong gnas gsungs de yang gsum stong ni / /bstan pa dngos dang chig stong gzugs brnyan pa/ /chig stong ring bsrel 'phrin las nyid du dgongs / /de tshe dam chos nyan thos 'dul ba'i rtags/ /'dzin pa nyid ni 'di yang bzhi stong shes/ / 12mya ngan 'das chen mod yi bar pa dang / /da ltar sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa las/ /bstan pa bar med mi lo bzhi stong dang / /slar yang lnga brgya phrag gcig gsal bar bstan/ / 13 da lta phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan gnas pa'i tshad/ /yongs su grags che lnga brgya phrag bcu zhes/ /'bras dus rtogs dus lung dus rtags tsam dus/ /dus rer lnga brgya phrag phyes mi yi lo/ /stong phrag lngar bzhed de yi dpang po'i gzhungs / /slob dpon chen po 'dzam gling rgyan gyur pa/ /dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi sher phyin rgyas bsdus spyi/ /khyad par nyi khri'i 'grel grags gnod 'joms dang / /de yi rjes 'brangs slob dpon mche sde yis/ /rgyas pa 'bum gyi bka' 'grel gnod 'joms dang / /slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa yis/ /'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal po'i 'grel pa rnams/ /mthun bzhin gangs can mkhas kun rgya cher gleng / /'jigs med zhabs kyi brgyad stong 'grel pa dang / /de bzhin thub pa dgongs pa'i rgyan las yang / /lnga stong nyid dang lnga brgya yang ni phyes/ /rmad byung dam pas lung rtogs dus spyi las/ /bzlog pa lung chos rdzogs char dgongs par sems/ /gong bstan lnga stong bka' la brten mod kyang / /bod 'dir bka' yi lung dngos 'dren pa nyung / /'dir ni sangs rgyas la bstod brgya lnga bcu/ /dpa' bos mdzad la dga' byed snyan pa yis/ /'grel der bstan pa lnga stong lor gnas par/ /sangs rgyas bka' drangs bod sngags rnying pa las/ /gzhan gyur bka' dngos rnyed dkas phyin chad 'di/ /kun gyi spyi nor mdzod zhes kho bos smras / / 14 bod sngags rnying pa bka' ma khyad 'phags chos/ /yang dag grub pa'i stong thun lo rgyus su/ / 160

thub bstan mi lo lnga stong dang sum brgyar/ /gnas gyur bcom ldan rgyal bas gsungs zhes drangs/ / 15de bzhin snga 'gyur o rgyan gu ru'i gter/ /zol zog bsre bslad med pa kha cig tu/ /rgyal bstan lnga stong nyid las sngags kyi mthus/ /mi lo lnga brgyar lhag par gnas yang gsungs/ /de yang thub bstan rin chen rdzogs pa'i dus/ /phal cher tshe lo bcu pa'i dus nyid du/ /dgongs pa gdags lung mkhas pas bkod pa dang / /rgyal ba nyid gsungs byams pa lung bstan mdo/ /bla med rtse mo gsang ba sgra rgyud dang / /de 'grel dri med bshes mdzad phal cher mthun/ /'grel der snyigs ma'i bskal pa bar ma gsum/ /rnam bzhag spyi mthun khyad par bkod yang mthong / / 16 zag zad gsum rig 'phags pa dgra bcom pa/ /dga' ba'i bshes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/ /tshe lo bcu nas yar 'phel brgya pa'i skabs/ /'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas/ /dngos byon chos gsung bslab 'bog de yi bstan/ /tshe lo drug brgya'i bar gnas bdun brgya'i skabs/ /thub pa'i ring bsrel kun bsdus mchod sdong mdzad/ /de la phyag bskor thub la bstod byas te/ /gnas brtan 'khor bcas lhag med mya ngan 'das/ /de srid thub bstan rin chen mchog gnas shing / /de rjes sangs rgyas phyi ma byon gyi bar/ /rang sangs rgyas pa bye ba bdun 'byung gsungs / /de rnams sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sde snod mchog /thun mong spyi yi dgongs par gyur par yi/ /'dzam gling mi yi gdul bya spyir btang dang / /mi min phal gyur bcas la snang bar nges/ /snying rje pad+ma dkar po chos nub tshe/ /gdung gi sangs rgyas 'phrin las kun mdzad gsungs/ /de ni 'phags pa dga' bshes lung bstan ltar/ /yar 'phel stong dang bdun brgya'i rjes su'am/ /'on kyang bdag blos byams pa lung bstan mdor/ /ring bsrel 'phrin las gsungs pa'i phyogs nyer sems/ /gang ltar de ni lha klu mi'i dam par/ /snang bzhin rtag tu 'gro la phan bder mdzad/ /mi min che gnas klu rgyal rgya mtsho'i khab/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan gnas rnams su/ /bskal 'di ji srid sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /gnas zhes rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor bshad gsungs/ /klu gnas rgya mtshor sngon byon sangs rgyas kyi/ /gtsug lag khang gnas 'dul ba lung nas bshad/ /dga' ldan gnas su bskal 'di'i mthun 'jug bar/ /rgyal bstan nub med rig pas yang ni grub/ /gdul bya mchog gi snang ngor rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mya ngan mi 'da' chos kyang nub med ces/ /nges don mdo sde gser 'od dam pa dang / /rdor sems sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud nas te/ /gzhan yang sngags rgyud rnams nas rgyal bstan gyi/ /gnas tshul nges pa can dang nges med dang / /nub med dgongs sogs dus bskal dbang po yi/ /go rim bzhin du gsungs yang shes par bya/ /thun mong phyi rgyud bla med pha rgyud 'ga'aglu/ /sbyin len yod rgyur bstan yang de srid gnas/ /bla med ma rgyud nub med dus gsum du/ /dpa' chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyibazung bar grags/ /sngags rnying rnams kyi bla med mthar thug rtse/ /shin tu zung 'jug rmad byung mchog bzhed der/ /rdo rje snying po'i brtsas gsum zhing 'di ru/ /ya thog lo mthar yas nas bcu pa'i bar/ /bzhugs shing khyad 161

par ston mchog thub pa yi/ /bstan la 'dzam gling 'di ru snying po'i bstan/ /dar nub bdun mtha' tshe lo bcu pa'i dus/ /sgron me ltar gsal 'phrad tshad dbyings su grol/ /bar khug tshe lo yar 'phel gyur ma thag /brtsas gsum 'jig rten 'di nas gzhan du bab/ /zhing der yang ni snying po'i bstan pa mchog /dar nub bdun ste bcu bzhir spyod par gsungs/ /snying po'i bstan pa 'dzam gling 'di dar nub/ /zung bdun lo grangs rtsa rgyud nas gsung pa/ /dril bas mi lo bzhi stong dgu brgya byung / /de ni lnga stong nyid dang shin tu nye / /'on kyang sangs rgyas chos dbyings gshegs pa nas/ /snying po'i bstan pa 'grib dus dang po yan/ /lo grangs ci tsam rgyud kyi dgongs pas brtags/ /de tshe lnga stong lnga brgya nyid du sems/ /bod sngags phyi mas bla med rgyud mthun 'jug /rtse mo zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po mchog /bzhed gyur don ldan dpal mchog dus 'khor nas/ /'jam dpal gyis phyung 'jig rten khams le'ur/ /chu bo shī ti'i byang phyogs sham+bha la/ /seng ge'i gangs khrod yul chen cha bsag tu/ /mi lo chig khri dgu stong brgyad brgya'i bar/ /dam chos rin chen nub med gnas par gsungs/ /de mthun 'phags pa don yod lcags kyu yi/ /cha bsag 'jug par yang ni gsal bar bshad/ /thub bstan rin chen gnas tshul de rnams ni/ /thun mong thun min gdul bya rgya cher dgongs/ /nyi tsher thun mong theg chen sngags ci rigs/ /'byung 'gyur skyes mchog dam pa kha cig gleng / /gang ltar thub bstan rdzogs nas tshe yar 'phel/ /brgyad khrir rnam 'dren lnga pa byon par gsungs/ /de yang thub chen mya ngan 'das pa nas/ /lo grangs bye ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun par/ /mgon po byams pa byon pa'i dus nyid du/ /bka' dang bstan bcos ches las gsal bar bshad/ /de ni lha yi tshe tshad thun min gzhung / /sangs rgyas pa yi mngon mdzod nas gsung ba'i/ /dga' ldan gnas pa'i tshe tshad mi lo'i grangs/ /ji bzhin nyid du 'char ba kho bos rtogs/ /'dren pa de yul tog ldan rigs bram ze/ /yab ni tshangs rab yum ni tshangs ldan ma/ /dga' ldan nas 'phos zla bcur lhum zhugs te/ /me tog bzang rgyas drang srong lhung bar bltams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lha mo mda' gdong ma/ /nges 'byung lhas sprul mchod sdong brda yis bskul/ /rab byung nyin zhag de mthar rdo rje'i spor/ /klu shing dbang po'i drung du rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de tshe 'dzam gling 'di ni rdzogs ldan mchog /dus skabs gcig tu rin chen gnyis kyi mdzes/ /rkang gnyis rab gtso mchog de sangs rgyas pa'i/ /nyi ma de la 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dung la sogs/ /dge slong nyid gyur 'bum phrag go drug tshogs/ /bdag cag ston pa'i snam sbyar nyan thos kyi/ /sku gdung la brten dgra bcom thob par gsungs/ /byams pa'i bstan la thub pa'i snam sbyar gyi/ /mdzad phrin 'di yang thub bstan nyid du grub/ /spyir yang sangs rgyas phyi ma'i gdul bya rnams / /snga mas smin dang sa bon theb pa ste/ /'phrin las bstan rgyun gcig pa dam pa'i chos/ /nub pa med ces phyogs gcig de la dgongs/ /de ltar bdag cag 'dren pa thub dbang gi /dam chos rin chen bstan pa gnas pa'i tshad/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa skye bskyed spro bsring slad/ /bka' dang bstan bcos che las du mar bzhag /de de gdul bya rang rang shes ngo ru/ /bden par grub zhes dam pa che 'ga' dang / /162

khyad par 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla mas dgongs/ /gang de legs bshad nyid las gzhan ci zhig /spyir ni rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mkha' bzhin yangs/ /rgyal bstan gnas tshad 'di zhes su yi gzhal/ /thun min snang ngor don dam rgyal ba rnams/ /nges pa lnga ldan nyid las gzhan yod min/ /'on kyang ma nges lnga ldan sprul sku'i tshul/ /mchog gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa dang / /smon lam dbang gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad yang k+ṣi/ /nges bzung tshad ma 'di la su yi 'gog /sangs rgyas byon dka' dam chos gnas dka' zhes/ /bstan pa'i grangs tshad dus kyi go rim dang / /sangs rgyas kyis stong mun pa'i bskal pa dang / /sgron bskal gdul byar mngon sum tshad ma nyid/ /bstan yun lo grangs dgongs gsung byis pa'i blos/ /rtogs dka' rgyal bas bstan mtha' snyigs dus rtags/ /lung bstan phal cher mngon gyur 'dis thub bstan/ /nyi ma gzhud nyer dog nas snying phrig 'dar/ /phul byung rin chen mchog gyur thub bstan 'di/ /mjal dka' bskal pa du mar da res tsam/ /sems can rnams kyi bdag 'dzin ma zhig bar/ /srog zhes lhan skyes nyid du rang shugs grub/ /de ltas srog la de tsam mi 'phangs kyis/ /thub bstan dam chos 'phang ngo gces par gzungs—/ /bdag lta snyoms chung byis pa'i rang bzhin yang / /sangs rgyas la gus chos phyir srog mi 'phangs| /des na thub bstan rtsa lag che rnams kyi/ /rgyal bstan lan brgyar bzung bar cis mi mdzad/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas brtsams rgyun mtha'i bar/ /sangs rgyas mtshan nam des gsung tshigs bcad gcig /ched du'ang lus srog lan brgyar btang nus shing / /'phags dgyes las la 'khor ma yug 'bad shog /bdag 'bral 'gro spyi khyad par log sred can/ /'dul dka' rnams la bdag dge yongs bsngo'i mthu'iglu/ /kun kyang rdzogs sangs rgyas la mi phyed dang / /tshogs gnyis rlabs chen bra bo myur khengs shog /kun bzang 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i smon lam bzhin/ /kun tu bdag gi rlabs chen byang chub spyod/ /mchog tu sangs rgyas chos rnams gcig char 'dzin/ /mchog gyur rgyal ba brnyes la rtag spyod shog /de skad sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa'i yun/ /brjod pa'i mdo la dam chos rin po che/ /snying nas dad dung gces blos shugs 'byung tshig /tshe dbang nor bu dpal des smras pa yin/ /zhes rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa gsal ba nor bu'i 'od snang las/ rgyal bstan dam chos rin chen yun ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul rnam grangs ma 'dres par bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /de nas rgyal bstan rin chen gnas pa yi/ /yun tshad steng nas sngar 'das lhag spyod lo/ /ji snyed dam pa rnams kyi bzhed pa'i gzhungs/ /ma 'dres gdul ba thog mar brjod par bya/ /de yang bstan tshig gzhan la brten pa dang / /dpal ldan dus 'khor gzhung la ston pa gang / /dang por gtan tshig gzhan la brten pa ni/ /grub gsungs rgyal rabs mkhas pa'i gtam las te/ /o rgyan slob dpon ma hā gu ru yi/ /rnam thar gdul spyi nye tsher bcas dgongs pa'i/ /mos blo dang mtshams brgya ches phyogs gcig tu/ /gzhal dkar gyur yang bdag mos shugs bltas pa/ /mngon slad 'dir mtshon lho brag gnam skas gter/ /phur pa bka' ma'i lo rgyus bcas phyogs mthun/ /rags rtsis thub dbang gshegs nas da lta'i bar/ /mi lo 163

bzhi stong brgyad brgya nyag bcu gnyis/ /lugs 'di'i bstan lo lnga stong lnga brgyar dgongs/ /des na bstan lhag bdun brgyar gnas pa'o/ /gzhan ni dag lta thun mong spyir grags gyur/ /thang yig dag las sangs rgyas zhir gshegs nas/ /gu rus srin yul 'dul 'phebs bar gyi lo/ /mang ba sum stong bdun brgya nyi shur reg /nyung ba sum stong chig brgya drug bcur nye/ /de nas da bar mchog ldan bstan rtsis lo/ /bsnan na bzhi stong drug brgya re gnyis sam/ /yang ni bzhi stong dgu bcu rtsa bzhir gyur/ /de la 'dod tshul gzhan dang zhib mo'i gnas/ /bgyi 'os mchis pa slar la spro bar bya/ /'das lo bzhi stong chig brgya re drug lo/ /song ba 'phags mchog srong btsan bka' bkol lugs/ /'das lo bzhi stong bdun bcu don bzhi pa/ /rdzogs chen sems phyogs mkhan po rta ston bzhed/ /sum stong brgyad brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis ni/ /'dul 'dzin nel pa paṇ+ḍita yi 'dod/ /sum stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa/ /snga rabs chos rgyal rnams kyi rtsis pa'i rgyun/ /dge ba'i bshes gyur dam pa mchog mang pos/ /de tshul yang nas yang du gsal byas shing / /phul byung jo bo mar me mdzad dpal gyi/ /bzhed kyang 'di nyid yin no zhes su bsgrags/ /bod sngon rgya nag 'byung rtsis 'das lo yang / /mthun par gnas zhes kha cig dag gis zer/ /sum stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu gtam gyi lugs/ /bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan sa skyas bzhed/ /'das lo sum stong bdun brgya nyer brgyad pa/ /grub brnyes ras chung rdor grags gsung gi rgyun/ /sum stong nga bzhi dgra bcom dge 'dun 'phel/ /lung bstan la dpag li yul bstan pa'i rtsis/ /rgya nag thang rgyal tha dzung yig tshangs su/ /bar khyad drug cu skor gcig byas pa yi/ /mang ba nyis stong bdun brgya lnga bcu bzhi/ /nyung ba nyis stong drug brgya go bzhi song / /de bzhin rgya nag yig tshangs tsan dan gyi/ /jo bo'i lo rgyus las byung bstan rtsis yang / /mang ba nyis stong lnga brgya don gsum lo/ /nyung ba nyis stong bzhi brgya go drug song / /nyis stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga tsam/ /rgya nag chos 'byung gsar byung rtsis la brten/ /nyis stong nyis brgya dgu bcu song ba ni/ /bal po'i lag rtsis sing gling shing bu'i rtsis/ /bal po paṇa chen bud+dha shrī zhes dang / /kha che paṇa chen shākya rnams kyi bzhed/ /nyis stong nyis brgya nga bdun lon pa ni/ /rdzogs chen snying thig mkhan po zhang gi dgongs / /de ltar thang yig lugs gnyis gcig bsdom ste/ /rags gyur rnam grangs bcu bzhi de rnams so / /gnyis pa dus 'khor phyogs la brten pa ni/ /de yang rgyal bas bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i lo/ /de yi phyi mar dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /gsungs shing de nas 'das lo bzung ba dang / /zhi ba'i dbyings su mya ngan 'das pa'i lo/ /de'am de yi snga lor rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /gsungs par bzhed nas mya ngan 'das lo dang / /mthun par byas pa'i lugs srol gnyis byung ba'i/ /snga ma'i phyogs gyur sum stong nga bzhi'i lo/ /'gos lo gzhon dpal bzhed gyur 'khrul sel lugs/ /nyis stong lnga brgya brgyad cu tham pa ni/ /dus 'khor rwa 'bro'i rjes 'brangs phal che ste/ /bye brag mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston zhabs/ /kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa/ /bo dong 'jigs bral dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs/ /de ltar rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs shing rta dang / /gzhan yang rgyal bstan gsal byed ji snyed pa/ /jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal dang 164

rtogs ldan/ /sgra pa nam bzang 'jam dbyangs chos mgon po/ /nyag phu bsod bzang tshur phu 'jam dbyangs che/ /thil pa kun rgyal paṇa chen byams pa gling / /byang bdag grags bzang rgya 'phrug dkon rin pa / /mkhas gyur dge legs dpal dang chos skyong bzang / /rig 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan la sogs te/ /de ltar phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /mkhas gyur dpyod ldan dam pa mang po dang / /rje btsun chen po sgrol ba'i mgon pos kyang / /rnam bzhag tshul 'gas 'di nyid bzhed kyang snang / /'das lo nyis stong sum brgya go bdun ni/ /rdo rje gdan gyi nyan thos shing bu'i grangs/ /mgon po'i rgyud lung ram shing rgyal rabs lugs/ /bod kyi grub thob o rgyan pa yi rtsis/ /de bzhin nyis stong sum brgya don dgu pa/ /'phags yul gtam zhes sgrol mgon zhabs kyi bsgrags/ /lo dag de rnams gzhan gyi go bde'i slad/ /rgyal ba zhi bar gshegs nas bsgrang ba yin/ /de yang rgyud gsung nas tsam lo brtag na/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yang ni zhe lnga sogs/ /bsnan pas rgyud gsung nas brtsam lo dag gang / /dam pa rnams kyi bzhed de bde bklag 'gyur / /lugs srol phyi ma'i phyogs su gyur pa yang / /nyis stong brgyad brgya dang ni nyag ma bzhi/ /song ba gdan dus rtsis gzhi smra pa po/ /'brug pa lha dbang blo gros zhes pas bkod/ /nyis stong drug brgya nyer bdun phug gzhal lugs/ /kong po 'bum rams pas kyang de mthun smra/ /nyis stong drug brgya nyer bzhi g.yung ston dang / phyis byung kam 'brug mkhas dbang bzhed kyang snang / /nyis stong drug brgya nyer gnyis song ba ni/ /dwags po paṇa chen gsum pas gsal bar byas/ /'das lo nyis stong drug brgya ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bo dong mchog gi bzhed/ /nyis stong bzhi brgya bzhi bcu thams pa'i lo/ /sems dpa' chen po rang byung zhabs kyi dgongs/ /nyis stong sum brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum ni/ /chag lo gsum pa chos kyi rgyal pos 'dod/ /nyis stong sum brgya nyi shu thams pa gang / /sa skya bla ma dam pas 'chad par mdzad/ /nyis stong nyis brgya nyer gcig 'gro ba ni/ /rong pa ngag dbang grags pa zhes byas so/ /nyis stong chig brgya nyi shu thams pa ni/ /zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po'i thugs su 'khrungs/ /dus 'khor phyogs brlan hang gses phra mo rnams/ /gzhogs pa'i rags pa rnam grangs bcu gsum ste/ /gong gi bcu bzhi po dang lhan cig tu/ /bsdom pas rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyur/ /bstan rtsis de rnams mdzad po dus snga phyi/ /gang zag mchog dman dbye ba ma byas par / /'das lo mang rim sngon byas nyung phyi mtha'/ /go rim bzhin du legs par bkod pa yin/ /de yang rgyal ba myang 'das lo nas brtsams/ /rtsis lo rab byung nyi rdzogs me stag na/ /'das pa'i lo yin rab byung bcu gsum 'di/ /phyin chad rim bzhin 'das lo la bsnan bya/ /sngon dus dus 'khor rjes su 'brang min pa'i/ /bstan pa'i rtsis gyur dpal ldan jo bo dang / /bdag nyid sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bzhed pa/ /blo ldan rnams la shin tu grags che zhing / /bar skabs dus 'khor rjes 'brangs spyir btang dang / /mkhas grub g.yung ston bzhed de shin tu mang / /des dus phug lugs rjes 'brang kho na yi/ /bstan rtsis lugs gzhan 'dzin pas dben par gyur/ /de ltar bdag cag 'dren pa thub dbang gi /bstan pa'i gnas tshad steng nas lo ci tsam/ /mkhas gyur dam pa mang pos bzhed pa'i gzhung / /rnam 165

grangs du ma nyid du gnas gyur gang / /rang gi ci tsam mthong ba phal che ba/ /phyogs gcig 'di ru bsdus te bkod pa yin/ /de rnams phal che don med ma yin te/ /legs par bshad pa'i 'byung khungs nyid du nges / /de yang rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon che/ /grub pa rnams kyi dgongs te gsungs pa dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyi tshad mar gyur bstan tshig /'phags yul gtam gyi sbyor bar brten rnams la/ /dad bskyed gus pas thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /rtog ge rig pa'i tsher ma rnon po yis/ /legs gzhal snyan ngag sdeb sbyor bzang rnams yang / /bdag blo'i rgyan du spud las gzhan ci zhig /de phyir bstan rtsis grangs mang ut+pa la/ /pad+mo rnam par rgyas pa'i 'phreng ba 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyi sgra 'dzin mgrin pa'i rgyan/ /ci bder spyod pa'i dga' ston kho bos byas/ /zhes rgyal bstan gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa gsal ba nor bu'i 'od snang las rgyal bstan dam chos rin chen gyi yun nas lo grangs ci tsam song dam par rgyur pa rnams kyi bzhed pa du mar gnas pa so so ma 'dres par bkod pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /

rog /sra rtsi bya thabs rdul med me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/o ṭ+wāsti/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa/ /'jam dpal rgyal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig sku gsung thugs rten dang / /mchod pa'i yo byad la 'jug pa'i/ /pra rtsi'i gdams ngag mkhas gyur pa'i/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin 'dir bkod bya/ /dpa' bo zar ma'i mar khu ni/ /gos dkar mngal du yun ring por/ /snyoms 'jug zag med bde ba bskul/ /rdul med rang skem nus pa'i tshad/ /de nas rgya skeg tshig khu ni/ /bsil byed chu yi rba la bzed/ /shing gi bcud ni tsha ba'i chu/ /yun dang thun tshad zhal las shes/ /'od byed pa la'i khu ba dang / /tshwa la bcas te nas tsam brdung / /mar khu'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /tshwa la nas tsam rim par blug /ma 'ju bar du bkol ba gnad/ /tshig par mi bya shin tu gces/ /de nas lan gcig sngar mngal bzhug /byin nas las la sbyar ba na/ /don kun 'grub pa'i nor bu ste/ gsal 'tsher 'od du 'bar bar 'gyur/ /phyis nas las la bkol 'dod na/ /mā la ki yi 'khyud par bya/ /lag len 'di ni nor 'khrul med/ /mkhas pa'i rgyud pa ma chad par/ /mthong myong can gyi lag khrid yin/ /des na gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /bden rdzun lag len byas tshe shes/ /'od dang 'od zer 'phro la ltos/ /deng sang 'gro rnams brtson pa dman/ /lag 'khrid phran bu 'di dag yang / /nub par nye na gdams ngag mchog /don gnyer skye bo nyin skar 'dra/ /kye ma snyigs dus nyid du 'gyur/ /lhag bsam yod na 'bad par rigs/ /de skad tshe dbang nor bu'i ste/ /blo ldan tshogs la ram mdar sgron/ /'di skad tsam cig bris pas kyang / /rgyal ba'i bstan la phan gyur cig /pra rtsi bya ba 'di yi kyang / /dkon cog rten la legs byas shog /zhes pa yang don grub kyi lo sgron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi zad pa gnyis par tsub ri khrod du smras so/ /sarba maṅga lo/༄ga /dbyangs can sgra mdo'i dbye ba'i gzhung gsal rin chen 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ na mo bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba pa lham hi ta di wā swa ra sus+t+ya/ brda' sprod pa dbyangs can mdo las rjes 'bral dbye ba'i gzhung gsal rin chen 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba/ bla ma lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab mchog 'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs gyur dbang phyug gi /rab spros mche ba'i rtse las nyir snang mtsho byung lha mo ni/ /rab mdzes srid gsum sdug gu kun bcud bsdud 'dra'i sku/ /rab snyan dbyangs can ngag gi dbang mos rtag tu bdag bsrungs mdzod/ /rab 'byor rang bzhin bzang po thugs bskyed shar ri'i spor/ /rab dkar 'phags ma'i zhal bzang zla dkyil mngon 'phags pas/ /167

rab gsal brda sprod 'od dkar 'bum du 'dzag pa gang / /rab rgyal srid 'dir blo ldan ku muta yongs 'dzum byas/ /sngon goms mkhyen blo kun gsal 'gram pa'i ngogs/ /thugs bskyed skya rengs bzang pos nyer bsus pa'i/ /rdul med chos can bcu gnyis khyim bdag can/ /mtha' yang chos snang 'phro ba rje btsun mgon/ /yid kyi shing rtas 'phags yul brda sprod nor/ /phyogs 'dir 'dren mdzad ba la bha dra mched / /lhag bsam zong gis sgra rig nor bu che/ /thob nas 'gro ba'i dbul sel 'dar lo rgyal/ /rig gnas ma rmongs 'jam dbyangs rjes 'gro yang / /zur phud lnga spang ngur smrig bla gos klubs/ /yid mtsho bzang po'i rat+nas yongs khengs pa/ /kye ri pan chen yab sras bka' drin dran/ /gang mthus dbyangs can brda sprod tshul/ /phyogs tsam snang bas rjes 'bral tshogs/ /dbye tshul slad med gsung gi rgyun/ /de yang 'phags yul brda sprod par phul du byung ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyi zhal lung rgyun ma chad pa bram ze'i rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ba la bha dra dang go ku la na tha mi shra mched kyi se ston 'dar pa lo tsā phun tshogs lhun grub la dbyangs can mdo mdzub khrid ston pa'i gsung rgyun ji lta ba kye ri paṇ+ḍi ta yab sras las 'ongs ba las / 'dir rjes 'bral dbye ba'i tshul ni/ de la rtsa ba dbyangs can mdo'i brda' chad kyi bya bar kha skong mdo bdun gyi gsum par/ gang zhig ita gyi ming can de dbyi ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ de ni rkyen dang bying gang la rjes 'bral de dang de dbye ba las/ itā ces brda' bzhag pa ste/ de yang itā kyi sitā la ru ka'o/ /rukā byin / de yang sā ṇi las/ kritā dang kirā dag las dang po tha ma dag go/ /zhes pas dngos stan don rukā byings mthar phyin/ de'i khyad don gyi ka phyis/ brjod don yin pas u phyis kisra yang ngo zhes pas kisra yongs su phyis/ rtags kyi don la dang po'o/ /zhes pas dang po'i gcig tshig si byin/ /ha sa khrisra la si dbyi'o / /zhes pas si 'jig/ idra zhes pa grub/ de bod skad du 'gro ba'o/ /zhes pas te rjes 'bral rnams mi gnas par 'gro ba'i don no/ /de ltar dbyi bar bya ba'i rjes 'bral la yang gsum ste/ bying dang / rkyen dang ske/ rnam 'gyur gyi rjes su 'bral ba'o/ /zhes pas te rjes 'bral/ dang po bying gi rjes 'bral la yang /dbyangs dang / ha sa dang / dbyangs dang / ha sa lan cig pa gsum mo/ /thog ma dbyangs la/ a ā/ i sī/u u/ o ā+o/ ri li te bcu'o/ /dang po a ni/ spyi khyab tu/ byings mtha'i a yig brjod don yin pas dbyi'o//zhes dang / dmigs gsal ḍa la bha ṣa lta bur āt+ma/ rna las sa rasma pa da mi 'jug pa'i bying mtha'i a ni/a nu/ dadha jir dag gi ata'o/ zhes pa'i khyad don gyis phyis/ gnyis pa a ni/ ata ita 'gro ba la'o/ zhes pa'i khyad don gyis phyis/ /gsum pa ita rna/ ita 'gro ba la mumra 'o/ /zhes pa'i khyad don gyis/ bzhi pa khri ni / ata yīr 'gro ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i khyad don/ lnga pa u ni/ ur 'gro ba las krā ste iṭa yang na'o/ /zhes khyad don/ drug pa u ni/ ud 'gro ba la yang na'o/ /zhes khyad don bdun ba e ni/ gam kha yi gzhung 'grel skabs ma dgos pas bzhag brgyad pa kho ni/ lu sogs dang ota 'gro ba las so/ /zhes pa'i khyad don/dgu pa ri ni/ rita kyi ma yin no/ khyad don gyis phyis/ bcu pa li ni/ ita 'gro ba dang puṇa sogs la nga'o/ /zhes khyad don yin pas phyis/ gnyis pa ha pa'i rjes 'bral gyi dbye ba la/ de yang ka nga nya ṭa ṣa ṇa sa ma 168

brgyad la sogs pa las/ dang po ka pa ṇi las/ ka 'gro ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i khyad don gyi phyis/ gnyis pa nga ni / a nu dāt+ta jir dag gi ata 'o/ /zhes khyad don/ gsum pa gnyis nyid dang swa ri ra'i gnyis ka'o/ /zhes khyad don/ bzhi pa ṭa ni gzhung 'di'i dper brjod du ma dgos gsung / lnga pa ṣa/ ṣa a ba la bhita rnams kyi ang ngo / /zhes khyad don/ drug pa ṇa la gnyis te/ aṇa gyi ṇa/ pā ṇi las iṇa yan no/ khyad don/ dāṇa kyi ṇa / pa ṇi las/ dāṇa la gal te bzhi pa'i don la'o/ khyad don ni/ bdun pa sa ni/ dbyangs don yin pas phyis / brgyad pa ma/ pa ṇi pa las/ ma 'gro ba rnams kyi thung ngu ngo / /zhes khyad don/ gsum pa dbyangs dang ha sa lhan cig pa'i rjes 'bral gyi dbye ba la/ ir nyi ṭu ḍū sogs la/ dang po ir ni/ ir la yang na'o/ /khyad don gnyis pa nyi ni/ nyi ir 'gro ba la da lta rang rag 'o/ /khyad don/ gsum pa ṭu/ ṭu 'gro ba la a thu'o / /khyad don/ bzhi pa ḍū ni/ ḍū 'gro ba las de 'das pa tī maka 'o/ khyad don gyi phyis/ da ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rkyen gyi rjes 'bral gyi dbye ba la/ pi sogs kyi rjes 'bral dang / mo rkyen gyi rjes 'bral/tshig sdud rkyen gyi rjes 'bral/ de phan rkyen gyi rjes 'bral/ ti sogs kyi rjes 'bral/ krir kyi rjes 'bral lo//dang po pi sogs kyi rjes 'bral la yang / spra sogs dngos dang bar rkyen ā ga ma'i rjes 'bral gnyis so/dang po la yang / i dza sha ṭa pa rnams so/ /dang po/ si yi i ni/ brjod don/ si la a 'od zhes pa'i khyad don gyi phyis/ si'i i ata'o/ zhes pa'i khyad don gyis phyis/ /gnyis pa dza ni/ dzas i'o/ zhes drag don yin pas phyis/ gsum pa sha ni/ shas la'o/ zhes khyad don gyi phyis/ bzhi pa ṭa ni/ ṭa i na'o zhes pa'i khyad don gyis phyis/ lnga pa nga ni/ nga 'gro ba la'o/ zhes khyad don gyis phyis/ drug pa ni/ sa rjes 'bral yin pas phyis/gnyis pa bar rkyen ā ga ma'i rjes 'bral la bzhi/ ka ṭa sha ma ka ni/ ka rjes 'bral yin pas phyis/ ṭir ā ṇi dang kir dag dang po dang tha ma dag tu'o/ /zhes pa'i khyad don yin pas phyis/ ṭa yang ṭir sogs 'dra/sha ni/ a bya sogs pa la sha ru'o/ /zhes pa'i khyad don gyis phyis/ ma ṇi/ pā ṇi ma 'gro ba la tsa'i tha las pha rol lo/ /zhes pa'i khyad don gyi phyis/ gnyis pa mo rkyen gyis rjes 'bral la sa ste/ sa rjes 'bral yin pas phyis / 'dar los as las so zhes khyad don gyi phyis/ is nis la nis kyi sa ha pa is las si dbyi'o/ /zhes khyad don gyis phyis zer/ gsum pa tshig sdu kyi bar rkyen sogs kyi rjes 'bral la/ nya ka ṭa nga nya ni na la'o—/ /zhes khyad don gyis phyis gsung yang na hā ar bsgyur ba yin pas mi 'bral/ rjes 'bral yin pas phyisaske/ yang na gong du ka yi dbyi tshig ṭir dang nyir dag sogs kyis so/ /ṭa ni/ is/ mi ster na ṭi dang kirwa dag ste ka ltar phyis/ is ster na/ ṇar u ṛr las so/ /zhes pa'i khyad don phyis/ bzhi pa bde phan kyi rkyen gyis rjes 'bral du/ u ri nya ṇa ṭa ṣa ḍa sogs las/ u ni u rir dag las num mo/ /zhes khyed don gyi phyis/ ri yi/ tshig des phyi'o/ /de bzhin nya dang ṇa dag kyang / dbyangs dang po'i nya ṇa 'gro ba la 'phel ba'o / /zhes pa'i khyad don gyis phyis/ ṭa dang ṣa yang / ṣaṭa ur rir las so/ / 169

rdza /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang yang kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor zab gsal snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa r+ghaṃ/ /rdo rje 'dus ma byas dbyings gdod nas rang bzhin mi 'gyur bdag /rdo rje zab gsal rang 'byung 'du bral las 'das mi shig pa/ /rdo rje rnam kun mchog ldan kun tu bzang po bde ba che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun bdag de la rtag skyabs mchi/ /rgyal kun thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /khyed zhabs phyag 'tshal de sgrub thabs/ /phyi nang yang gsang kho na yi/ /nyams su len tshul 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ don dam par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi 'dzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid spyi dpal chen po gsang chen rigs gcig gi ngo bor yongs su grub pa nyid yin la/ kun rdzob tsam dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i dus na/ gang zhig nga yi ming thos pa tsam gyi 'tshams med duḥkha'i las la spyod pa dang / sngags kyi dam tshig nyams chags zhig ral du gyur nas rdo rje dmyal ba chen por skye ba'i sdig ltung sgrib pa can rnams de ma thag par byang zhing dag par gyur cig /nyes pa can de rnams kyi rtsar bdag gnas nas de yi sgrib pa mtha' dag bsal te thar pa mchog la bkod par gyur cig zhes smon lam btab cing dam bcas pa yi shin tu 'dag par dka' ba'i sdig ltung sel bar ches cher mchog tu bsngags pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de yi yang snying yi ge brgya pa zhes mtshan cung zad bsgyur bas he ru ka sogs lha rab 'byams kyi yig brgyar 'gyur ba sngags rgyud mang po nas bsngags shing sngags kyi man ngag la zhugs pa kun gyi spyi nor snying gi thig le dam par gyur pa de ltar yi ge brgya pa'i gzhung rab 'byams las/ 'dir ni dam tshig nyams chags thams cad skong ba'i lung bshags pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dri ma med pa zhes bya ba las 'di skad du/ de nas dus der dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid sku mtshan gyi me tog la dpe byad bzang po'i 'bras bu'i brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa mnga' ba gzhan yang dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi dbang bskur bar dar dkar dang ba ti dang / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang / gdan yang byang chub sems dpa' brgyad stobs chen glang po cher sprul pa brgyad kyi rin po che'i khri rkang btegs pa'i steng na pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan du/sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa shin tu lham me/ shin tu lhang nge/ lhan ne/ nam mkha'i 'ja' 'am 170

me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par gsal la dngos por ma grub pa ciga'og min chos dbyings kyi pho brang nas mngon sum du byon te bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po'i spyan sngar 'dug te 'di skad ces zhus so/ kyai ston pa kun tu bzang po khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa thams cad kyi nyams chags sor chud par bya ba'i don du na rag dong sprug rnal 'byor gyi spyi khrus 'gyod 'tshangs kyi cho ga bshad pa 'di ni rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/ rnal 'byor pa snga rabs 'das pa rnams kyi lam chen po/ da ltar gyi rnal 'byor ma rig pa rnams kyi mig 'byed pa/ ma 'ong pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi 'dren shul ste/ rnal 'byor pa spyi lam 'di lta bu bka' stsal pa thugs rje che la ngo mtshar che lags so/ /de bas na bdag gis kyang yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kyi yang snying / nyams chags dang rtogs sgrib thams cad sel bar byed pa 'di brjod kyi/ rnal 'byor rtog sgrib dang nyams chags can/ bsog 'jog dang bag chags can rnams nyon cig bka' stsal pane/ o badz+ra satwa sa ma yā/ ma nu pa la yā/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a wa rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ shrī yo ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badzi bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ 'di dag dus gcig tu lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na nyams chags thams cad bskongs te ngan song thams cad las thar par 'gyur roske/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis yi dam du bcas nas 'don na tshe 'di la/ yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam par dgongs nas bsrung skyob mdzad la/ tshe 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras nyid du gdon mi za bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / phyogs bcu nas lhag pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyi dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la brkyang phyag lan stong du 'tshal zhing 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying / nyams chags dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa'i yi ge brgya pa bka' stsal pa ngo mtshar che a la la ho/ kun tu bzang pos rdo rje sems dpa' la bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' khyed kyi gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi don du nyams chags dang rtog sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs yi ge brgya pa bshad pa legs so/ /de bas rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis yi dam du bcas nas 'don na/ mi de tshe 'di la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam par dgongs nas bsrung skyob mdzad la/ tshe 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi dam pa nyid du gdon mi za bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor pa thams cad la phan gdags shing nyams chags dang rtog sgrib thams cad yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyal por brjod pa legs so legs so/ /zhes ste de ltar rgyud spyi dang bye brag du mar bsngags pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa nyams su len pa'i tshul ci snyed pa las/ 'dir bcud du dril bar byas pa rnal 'byor snying po phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi rim pa ste lnga'o/ /de la yang dang po phyi bya rgyud ltar spyir bsgoms te 171

nyams su len pa ni/ mtha' yas pa mkha' mnyam gyi sems can kun snying khongs su bcug nas de rnams bdag dang lhan cig dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su zhe thag pa nas song ba'o snyam pa dang / spyi bor yang rdo rje sems dpa' re re bzhugs nas bdag gi ji bzhin sdig sgrib sdug bsngal sbyangs yod snyam pa'i mos 'dun thun gyi thog mthar dung pa re bya/ dngos gzhir rang gi lus tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bo'i steng mkha' na rin po che sna tshogs rab tu mdzes pa las grub pa'i khri steg bu de stengs them pa gsum brtsegs la khri rkang brgyad rdo rje rin chen pad+ma ral gri dang mtshams sna tshogs rdo rjes spras pa/ steng bad gsum rim steng ma mngon par 'phyar zhing gdong rngams rgyas pa/ khri yi steng ngos su 'khor lo rtsib stong dang / 'og tu pad+ma 'dab stong gi gzugs brnyan bkra ba/ khri rkang gi bar mtshams su khri 'degs kyi tshul du byang—chub sems dpa' chen po nye ba'i sras brgyad glang po che'i gzugs su sprul pa mjug nang du byas shing gdong phyir phyogs pa mche ba drug pa kha dog thal dkar la dpral ba nas sna yi rtse mo'i bar sid+dha ra'am iṣ+ṭa go ba ltar dmar ba rin po che mchog tu gyur pa sna tshogs dang gser gyi dra bas kun nas lus g.yogs pa de rnams kyi spyi bor sngon gyi smon lam thugs rje chen po tshad med pa'i mthu las grub pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i gzugs can la ngo bo rang rang gi rigs bdag de bzhin gshegs pa yang te mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas brgyan pa brgyad gnas pa'i khri steng du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan gyi khebs pa'i dbus nyi ma dang zla ba rab tu rgyas pa'i gdan la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yi ge'i rnam par gyur pa'i hūṃ dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mchog dkar ba las kyang ches ches dkar ba ston ka'i zla ba 'bum phrag gi gzi brjid zil gyis gnon pa zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gsor zhing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa' skyil krung can mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku zhi ba'i tshul can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis kun tu mdzes pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i chas su zhugs pa ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla bar ri med pa'i steng du r+ghaṃ yig dkar po shin tu 'tsher ba de yi mthar zla ba la gnas pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng gsal btab cing ngag tu bzlas pas zla ba yig brgya hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i cha ba spu'i bu ga khyad par du zhal dang mdzod spu gtsug gtor nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la khyab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i tshogs ma lus pa dgyes par byas de dag rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i cha gang gi gnas rnams nas tshur zhugs thugs ka'i zla ba yig brgya hūm̐ yig rnams la thim de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun chu mig nas chu rgyun bab pa ltar byung / de yang r+ghaṃ yig las bab pa thugs/ yig brgya las gsung / zla ba las bab pa sku/ de gsum gyi rdo rje sems dpa' sku lus cher khengs nas ma shong lud pa'i tshul gyis sku yi cha kun dang zhabs 172

g.yas pa'i sha sen gyi bar nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bar ma chad par byung byang chub sems dpa' glang po che'i gzugs su sprul pa'i steng du bab/ de rnams kyi spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po nor bu rin po che'i tshul du gnas pa las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba dang cig 'dres bar ma chad par bdag sogs mtha' yas sems can rnams kyi spyi bor babs te/ de lus kyi phyi nas khyab cing bkrus pas 'dzin chags kyis kun nas dkris pa'i dri ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig lus kyi gos kyang nyil gyi zhu ba bcas shing khyad par spyi gtsug nas lus kyi nang du zhugs pas bdud rtsi reg ma thag nyon mongs dug gsum gyi rang bzhin sha khrag rus pa dang lhan cig 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dud khu sol khu 'ja' tshon sngo dmar gyi rnam par che ba rnams kha sna bshang lam/ 'bring ba rnams mig rna ba sen bar / chung ba rnams skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon nam yang ldang du med pa sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song / der yang ye shes kyi rang snang bskal pa'i chu me rlung rnams kyi sbyangs nas rdul phra rags tsam yang med par lhag med du stong zhing rang lus dngas shel gyi bum pa rnyogs pa med pa'i chu rgyun gyi bkang ba ltar lus dang bdud rtsi gnyis kas phyi nang mi sgrib par sa le sing nger bsam la yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzlas pa'i skyon ha cang gi skad che chung dang tshig dal myur dang / khyad par du 'bru lhag chad du ma song bar gtsang zhig dag par bzla ba'o/ /gzhan yang nad sel ba la bdud rtsi lus nang du zhugs pas nad thams cad rnag khrag chu ser gyi rnam par bshang lam gang na ba nas thon par bsam pa dang / gdon la shig sro sdom sdig sbal sbrul rnams ye shes kyis brdas te sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song nas sbyangs ba sogs gong ltar shes par bya'o/ /thun mtshams ngal bso ba'i skabs su mchod pa dang bstod bshags kyi mthar gdan gyi glang po che byang chub sems dpa' brgyad du gyur te rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim rin po che'i khri rkang yang pad+mar thim/ rdo rje sems dpa' pad nyi zla gdan bcas rang gi spyi bor bstem pa tsam mam/ 'chad 'gyur nang sgrub gyi dmigs pa sbyar ba'am/ yang na dmigs med du bzhag pa ci bder bya zhing gang ltar rjes dge ba byang chub chen por nges par bsngo'o/ /de ni rdo rje sems dpa'i phyi'i sgrub pa gsal bar bstan pa ste skyes mchog badz+ra thig le rtsal gyi chos 'di'i bsrung ma mdzod la nyams su len pa rnams kyis grogs gyis shig sa ma yā ithi/da ni gnyis pa nang spyod rgyud ltar rdo rje sems dpa' rang gi lus kyi gnas su bsgoms te nyams su len pa ni/ thog mar gong du bstan pa ltar bya rgyud ltar sgom bzlas ci ltar rigs pa'i mthar mchod bstod bshags pa'i rjes thog nyid du rdo rje sems dpa' rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar byon klad pa dung khang gi gnas su dar cig bzhugs te thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i r+ghaṃ yig dkar po'i mthar yig brgya dkar po'i 'phreng bas bskor ba ste/ de gsum las 'od zer byung / rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams la sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ slar yang 'od zer des sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i mi dge ba'i las spyi dang bye brag sdom pa gsum gyi nyes 173

ltung dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs tshur 'dus thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim par bsam yi ge brgya pa ci rigs bzla ba'o/ /de nas dud khang gi rdo rje sems dpa' mgrin pa'i dbus su byon cing / de ma thag tu sku mdog dmar por gyur/ thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dmar po yig brgya dmar po'i phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa mtha' dag la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ slar yang 'od zer des sems can thams cad kyi ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i mi dge ba'i las spyi dang bye brag sdom pa gsum gyi nyes ltung dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs tshur 'dus thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim par bsam la yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa ci rigs bya'o/ /de nas mgrin pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' mar snying khar byon ma thag tu sku mdog mthing kar gyur/ thugs rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar rtsu yig mthing nag yi ge brgya pa mthing kas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa mtha' dag la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'phul/ slar yang 'od zer des sems can thams cad kyi yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i mi dge ba'i las spyi dang bye brag sdom pa gsum gyi nyes ltung dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs tshur 'dus thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim par bsam la yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya'o/ /de yan rang gi sgo gsum sdig pa gang spyad pa'i gnyen por dmigs gsal sgom na gnas de dang de gtso bor byas na legs pa'o/ /de nas snying kha'i rdor sems mar lte bar byon/ gser gyi pad+ma dang nyi dkyil la bzhugs pa'i sku gser gtso ma'i kha dog lta bu zla ba'i rgyab yol can thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor la gnas pa'i r+ghaṃ yig ser po yi ge brgya pa'i phreng ba kha dog ser po ste de gsum las 'od zer 'phros phyogs dus kyi sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa sku gsung thugs dgyes par byas 'od zer des sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i mi dge ba'i las sdom pa gsum gyi nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs mtha' dag pa sbyangs tshur 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ de lta bu'i 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas spyi khyab gnas 'di gtso bor byas te yi ge brgya pa nus tshad du bzlas la mthar sngags kyi 'od zer rab tu 'tsher bas bdag gi lus 'di yang 'od kyi gong bu blta ba mi bzod pa gcig tu gyur par bsam la gsang bsgrub la 'jug gam dmigs med du bzhag ci bder bya la thun mtshams la 'jug na dge ba rdzogs byang la nges par bsngo'o/ /de ni nang spyod rgyud ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa ste chos 'di'i bsrung la gza'i dge bsnyen smug nag 'od 'phros mdzod la nyams su len pa rnams kyi grogs gyis shig sa ma yā mṛthi/ gsum pa gsang ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde ltar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su nyams su len pa ni / rang gi lus snang sems kyi rtogs tshogs kun gdod ma nyid nas rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid du gyur/de lta bu ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i rkyen gyi zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' shin tu 174

dkar zhing dngas pa mtshan dpes rdzogs pa'i sku rdor dril snyems tshul gyi 'dzin cing rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa nor bu bsam 'phel las grub pa'i rin po che'i rgyan brgyad dang dar dkar po gser gyi ngang ris can gyi stod g.yogs tshig gi smad dkris sogs dar gyi chas lngas mdzes pa/ gdan pad nyi zla ba dang rgyab yol yang zla bas byas pa ste/ de ni dam tshig sems dpa'o/ /de'i thugs kar rang ji 'dra ba'i sku 'od zer lnga 'phro ba ni ye shes sems dpa'o/ /de'i thugs kar kun rdzob rgyu yi thig le zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa/lte bar gzhom du med pa'i rtsu yig dkar pos spros pa ste ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ /gong gi hūṃ yig las yi ge brgya pa phreng ba mu tig bstar la rgyus pa lta bu'i bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug brgyud nam mkha' la thon / de yang gcig las gnyis 'chad kyi tshul du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags sgyu skar bkram pa ltar nam mkha'i khams khyab par 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa 'phags pa'i tshogasartsom lus pa la sngags phreng las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi yongs su mchod/ sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa bskang nas de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi rang bzhin yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng gi rnam par thugs zhal gtsug gtor mdzod spu nas thon te spros pa'i sngags phreng rnams la dbyer med du zhugs tshur byung sngags kyi phreng ba rnams gcig tu 'dres te gtsug gtor nas mar zhugs/ slar yang dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas thon te sngags kyi phreng ba gong bzhin grangs med pa 'phel/ khams gsum rigs drug gi mkha' mnyam sems can gyi gnas kun khyab sngags phreng des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las mdzad de sems can so so yi sdug bsngal ma lus par bsal mi dge ba'i las nyon thams cad zhi bar byas / de rnams sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sa la bkod te sngags kyi phreng ba rnams tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres te mu tig bltar la rgyus pa ltar rang gi snying kha nas tshur hūṃ yig la sib sib thim par bsam la yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzlas pa la 'bad pa bya zhing / thun mthar rnal 'byor bzhi pa la 'jug gam yang na dmigs med kyi ngang dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba sogs gong dang mthun no/ /de ltar rdo rje sems dpa' gsang ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sde ltar sems dpa' gsum rtsegs kyi nyams su blang ba'i tshul zhib mor bshad pa ste chos 'di'i bsrung ma dpal ldan gnyen gyi lha mo re ma ti'i mdzod la nyams su len pa rnams kyi grogs gyis shig sa ma yā mṛthi/ zab rgya/de ltar sgrub thabs gsum rtsa ba'i man ngag dkyus su bstan pa de kho na'o/ /yang cung zad rgyas par mos na man ngag gi zur 'debs khyad par can 'di rnams sbyar bar bya ste/ de yang phyi bsgrub skabs sdig pa sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa ni gzhung bzhin pas 'grub/ nad sel skabs spyi bo nas sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rgyun rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' las bab pa'i bdud rtsi de reg bya tsha ba'i nad la bsil ngar che ba/ grang bar tsha ba rlung la mar khu lta bu'i snum bcud can/ dri bsil dro ba yang / ga bur/ se'u 'bru/ dza ti/ gur gum/ lcong zhi sogs nad sogs so sor 'gro ba'i mtshan nyid can 175

dang / nad rnams kyang tshad par kha dog dmar ser rnag khrag chu ser gyi rnam pa/ grang bar sngo skya mchil rnab gyi rnam pa 'dra ba/ rlung nad sngo nag dud rlang gi tshul du nad kyi gnas dang dbang po ba spu'i sgo sogs ji ltar 'os pa nas thon 'og gzhi rim pa dgu rgyud rlung nad gser gyi sa gzhi'i gting du yal thim / tshad pa chu dkyil kyi gting dang / grang ba me dkyil gting du yal thim/ nad nam yang ldang du med par bsam ngang yig brgya mang tsam bzlas shing / yang gong ltar bsgom pa ldab la bya'o/ /gdon sel gyi skabs spyi bo'i bdud rtsi ngo bo de nyid la rnam pa khro chu khol ma lta bu 'bar ba'i me lce dang bcas shing khro chu'i zeg ma khro bo'i gzugs can gdon so so'i gnyen po pho gdon la gshin rje gshed/ mo gdon la badz+ra he ru ka gza' la phyag rdor/ rgyal por rta mgrin nam gur drag klu la mkha' lding / rbod gtong la gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba'am gdugs dkar mo/ 'gong bsen la sgrol ging dmar po sogs su snang ba me stag 'tshub pa lta bu'i gdon bgegs rnams rang gzugs ji bzhin pa de brdas/ bdag gi ba spu dbang po'i sgo spyi dang khyad par 'og sgo gnyis rkang pa'i sha sen bar nas phyir thon khro bo rnams dang ye shes rlung drag pos stong gsum 'jig rten gyi pha rol du bskrad/ der yang phung po ye shes kyi me rlung chus sbyangs sems nyid bde ba chen por thim te gnas par bsam/ de yang lus kyi nang du gdon gzugs sro ma tsam la khro bo nyung kar tsam/ shig tsam la khro bo nas 'bras tsam gyi rigs 'dre lus kyi phyir thon nas yang gdon gzugs las gnyen po khro bo rnams bdun 'gyur tsam gyi che ba bsgom dgos so/ /de ltar gdon bskrad zin nas bum pa tshad ldan chus khengs pa ltar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin khro chu khol ma des lus khengs/ ba spu nas de'i zeg ma phyir 'phros pas bsrung yul ji tsam par khro chung rdo rje'i gur me dpung gi bsrung 'khor nang bdud rtsi khro chu'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dbus su gnas par bsam nas yig ge brgya pa bzla ba la 'bad/ des steng gdon klu nad byad kha rbod gtong sogs rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i man ngag dam pa yin la/ nad gdon zhi ba kho na'i ched bzlas pa yin na thun gang yin gyi phyed bshad ma thag pa'i dmigs pa dal gyi ldab cing / /thun phyed man spyi bo'i rdor sems rang la bstem nas rang lus skad cig gi rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ rang gi snying kar sngags 'khor gsal btab/ de las 'od zer mchod sprin 'phros sras slob rtsa gsum kun mchod/ tshur 'dus tshe 'phags tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas nad gdon so sor phan pa'i bdud rtsi gong bzhin byung ba bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs snying ka'i sngags 'khor dang lus sngar nas bdud rtsis khengs pa la thim pas chang la phab theb pa ltar bdud rtsi de rnams kyi yon tan nus stobs gong nas gong du 'phel bar bsam bzhin yig brgya 'bad de bzlas/ thun mthar 6thun mong gi rdzogs rim 'og nas bshad pa'i 'od gsal 'jug ldang byas la dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /de ltar phyi bsgrub skabs su nad gdon sel ba'i dmigs rim nye bar 'bog ba'i man ngag khyad par lhan thabs tshul du gsal bar phyes pa ste/ chos 'di ma gza' dam can la gnyer du gtad do nyams su len pa rnams kyi grogs mdzod cig sa ma yā zab rgya/176

de nas nang bsgrub gyi skabs gtso 'khor du bsgrub par 'dod na/ phyi bsgrub kyi bsgom bzlas mthar rdo rje sems dpa' gdan rin po che'i khri rkang glang po che bcas sku chung gsal rang gi spyi bo nas mar dung khang du byon der rin po che'i khri rkang pad gdan la thim/ pad+ma 'dab stong 'dab brgyad du gyur/dbus kyi ge sar ze'u 'brur nyi zla kha sbyor gyi gdan/ 'dab ma shar dang shar lhor rdo rje/ lho dang lho nub tu rin po che/ nub dang nub byang du pad+ma/ byang dang byang shar du ral gri/ phyag mtshan de rnams phred nyal gyi steng zla ba'i gdan re re dbus su rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dang / phyi rim 'dab brgyad kyi zla gdan la gdan gyi glang po che brgyad rang rang gi ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' brgyad du gyur te de yang shar nas g.yas bskor gyi byang shar bar sa snying/ byams pa/ kun bzang / nam snying / spyan gzigs/'jam dpal/ sgrib sel/ phyag rdor rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs kun gtso bo ji bzhin par thugs kar sngags 'phreng bcas gsal btab cing gnas so sor gtso bo'i kha dog sgyur te sgom pa bzhin 'khor rnams yang de dang mthun par gsal ba'o/ /mthar thun bsdu tshe 'khor rnams gtso bor 'dus shing gtso bo'i 'od zer gyi rang lus 'od kyi gong bur byed pa nyid do/ /gsang sgrub skabs su lha dgur spro na gdan gong bzhin la zla bar gnas pa'i r+ghaṃ yig rdo rje rtse lngar gyur pa de rdo rje sems dpa'i sku grub pa dang lhan cig nyi ma dang 'od zer ltar chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du 'khor rnams kyang skad cig tu gsal ba'oske//bzlas pa'i skabs nus na 'khor rnams la yang gtso bo bzhin sems dpa'i gsum rtsegs su bsgom rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng gyen du 'phro ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhun ma lta bu shas che ba'i 'od zer kha dog lnga dang ldan pa snying kha nas phyir 'phros/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar phog de rnams thugs ka nas bdag gi ji bzhin pa'i sngags 'phreng 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod pa dang sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus 'khor so so'i thugs ka'i hūṃ la zhugs nas slar 'phros rang gi snying ka'i hūṃ la thim par bsam pa steske/ de tsam mi gcogs tshe 'khor re mos su bya la/ de yang mi nus dub na 'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad cing so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bdag gi snying ka'i sngags 'khor la phog pas bskul ba'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng gyen du 'phros par bsam pa tsam las gzhung dmigs kho nas chog pa'o//'khor gyis sems dpa' brgyad sku mdog phyag mtshan tha dad par mos nas dri med bshags rgyud nas gsung ba na raka dong sprug ltar yin la/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir ni gsang chen rigs gcig gi rang gzugs rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom pa nyid mi legs pa med de/ thun mthar 'khor gyi gdan phyag mtshan zla ba rnams so sor thim/ sems dpa' brgyad gtso bo'i thugs kar thim par bsam la rjes spyod dkyus bzhin gang 'dod la 'jug pa'o/ /dri med bshags pa'i rgyud du gdan glang po che brgyad sprul gzhir bcas bstan pas lha dgur sgrub pa 'di nyid khung mchog tu che ba yang yin no/ de ltar nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub skabs man ngag khyad par ba zur 'debs tshul du gsal bar bshad pa ste chos 'di ma gza' dam can rnams la gnyer du gtad do/ /nyams su len pa rnams kyi grogs mdzod cig sa ma yā 177

zab rgyaḥde nas don bzhi pa yang gsang bla na med pa'i rgyud sde ltar snang grags rigs gsum rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par la bzla zhing 'od gsal du zhugs pa'i rim pa ni/ de yang rdor sems sems dpa' gsum brtsegs gong ltar gsal ba'i hūm̐ yig rdo rje zla ba'i 'od zer gyis snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus kyi khams thams cad khyab par byas/ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gdod nas rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing / srid pa bcud kyi sems can thams cad mtha' dag rdo rje sems dpa'i sku dang / 'byung ba skye 'gro'i sgra skad thams cad yi ge brgya pa sngags kyi rang sgra/sems can rnams kyi rtogs tshogs kyi rol pa mtha' dag gdod nas 'gyur ba med pa chos nyid kyi rol rtsal du yin nas yin bzhin ngo shes pa dran pa ma nyams tsam du rang 'bab lhug par bzhag la yi ge brgya pa 'gog bzlas sogs bzla lugs yid la ci ltar 'dod bzhin pas bsgrang ngo / /de ltar bsgom bzlas ci ltar rigs pa'i mthar 'od gsal du bsdu ba ni/ r+ghaṃ yig rdo rje zla ba'i 'od zer rnams rim pas spros ye shes sems dpa'i sku lus khengs/ de yi sku shin tu 'tsher ba'i 'od zer gyi rang gi lus khengs rang lus blta bas mi bzod pa'i 'od zer 'bar bas snod bcud thams cad khyab/ des snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad khu ba'i tshul du bcud kyi sems can rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin la thim/ de thams cad bdag dam tshig sems dpa' la thim/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs thams cad kyang rang la thim/ rang gi gdan rgyan na bza' yang sku la thim/ sku yang snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/de yang gong ltar/ de zla ba / de rdo rje/ de hūm̐ yig la thim/ r+ghaṃ yig khog pa mgo dang / de zla tshes/ de thig le/de nā da/ de shin tu nas kyang phra ba rta rnga brgya stong tshal pa'i bar du sems bzung la mthar stong pa nyid rnams mi rtog pa'i ngang du yun ci gnas su bzhag /slar yang yi se/ brgya pa'i sgras skad cig gi lhar ldang zhing snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gsal btab/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa yang nas yang du bzlas te bya ba yang shin tu gces pa'i lam rim mo/ thun 'jog pa na bsgom bzlas kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo zhing smon lam bzang po yang rnal 'byor kun gyi mthar ma chad par bya'o/ /de ltar yang gsang bla na med pa lam khyer gsum pa thun mong rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang bcas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul gsal bar phyes pa ste/ chos 'di ni dpal ldan sngags kyi bsrung ma rdo rje ra gdong mas bdag tu mdzod la nyams su len pa rnams kyis grogs gyis shig sa ma yā authi/ zab rgyaḥd ni lnga pa de ltar phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi nyams len kun gyi spyi don ngo bo kho na nyid rang byung rdzogs pa chen po rtsod bral thig le nyag gcig tu blang ba ni de yang rang rig ye shes ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi mtshan nyid can la ngo bo ni ming gi ma mtshon pa dpe dang bral/ blo las 'das shing stong pa med/ mi stong pa med/ ye shes med/ 'khrul pa med/ rnam rtog med/ nyon mongs med/ 'khor ba med / myang 'das med/ don dam med/ kun rdzob med ste/ mdor na bsam brjod dpe mtshan rtag chad 178

bdag gzhan gyi mtha' thams cad dang bral la/ rang bzhin du 'khor ba myang 'das ye shes 'khrul pa/gsal ba stong pa bde ba sdug bsngal gyi kun rdzob don dam rnam pa thams cad du shar zhing rnam pa du ma la longs spyod pa ste/ thugs rje yi de ltar ngo bo rang bzhin yang ya ma bral/ phyogs su ma chad/ ris su ma grub par gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyi zung 'jug nyid du rig pa'i ngo bor rdzogs pa ste/ de ltar ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje zhes pa yang mdor dril na rang sems kyi ngo bo spros bral gyi gshis 'di la gang gis kyang mtshon bral stong sang nge ba'i rang bzhin gdangs gsal ma 'gags par rang rtsal du snang ba lha sngags su wal ler shar zhing / de ltar bskyed rim zhes lha sku bsgom pa'i gsal cha dang / don dam ngo bo stong pa gnyis kyang gsal stong res 'jog ma yin par stong gsal zung 'jug sku dang ye shes dbyer med kyi ngo bo gang shar sems kyi rgyan dang rol par lhun gyis grub pa thugs rje chen po ste yang rang rig gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa la dmigs 'dzin cher gtad re dogs blo bcas kyi ma rnyogs par bzo bral rang ngo la gnas na gnas chug 'gyu na 'gyu chug gang la yang dgag sgrub med pa rig pa rang bab cha med kun 'gro ru mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ de las gzhan pa'i ched gnyer gyi sgom bya med la 'khrul snang yengs rkyen gyi dbang du ma song bar rang bzhin chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o/ /de kho na nyid bskyed rdzogs dbyer med gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen por nyams su len pa'i tshul gsal bar phyes pa ste chos 'di'i bsrung ma gcig shur dur khrod bdag po ma ning ma hā ka las mdzad nas nyams su len pa rnams kyi grogs mdzod cig sa ma yā ithi zab rgyaḥrigs rnams kun bdag gsang ba mchog /rigs gcig dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /sgrub thabs zab mo 'dir bshad pas/ /'gro kun bde 'bras myur thob shog /bde chen rdo rje kun gyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rmad byung / /bde myur thabs mang bskal bzang 'dren mkhas de yi srog dam tshig /bde bar spyod phyir rgyal gyi rab bsngags zla med 'dzab sngags mchog /bde mchog 'di la 'gro kun snying nas gus pas yongs spyod shog /de ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nyams su len pa'i tshul phyi nang gsang yang de kho na nyid rnal 'byor lnga dang zur 'debs gnyis bcas dum bu bdun zab gsal snying por dril ba 'di ni rang lo nyi shu'i bsgrang bya'i dkyil nas 'phar ba shing sbrul gyi lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes bco lngar bod yul dbus 'gyur dbu ru khra 'brug byams pa mi 'gyur gling du rnal 'byor ma ye shes gsal sgron gyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bkod pa la der mi gsal sbas pa'i tshul du gnas pa rnams slar yang gsal bar phyes pa'i zhib mor rang lo lnga bcu'i sner zin pa rab myos lcags rta'i lo chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la gtsang nyang ro gnas gsar rtsigs zhes sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu dpal rnal 'byor rab tu dgyes gyur rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyis sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig dge'o/ / 179

a+yo+o /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blang ba'i cho ga snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /swasta / rin chen byang chub sems mchog skyed mdzad pa/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas la phyag 'tshal / /sems bskyed rtag tu blang ba'i cho ga ni/ /khyer bde ngag 'don snying po 'dir spel bya/ /de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la gnyis kyi thog mar rten khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhi/sa bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung te/byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yisaske/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa thabs khyad par can gyis tshogs bsags pa ni/ spyod 'jug nas gsung pa'i yan lag bdun pa'am/ bzang spyod kyi lan lag bdun pa gang 'os bya la/ de yang bzang spyod nas gsung pa ni/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten naske/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gi ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dngas bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yi/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dang / /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lags rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byugs pa gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyis/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyi/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gi ni / /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyi kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gi so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags 180

brnyes / /mgon po de dag bdag gi thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gi thal mor rab sbyar gsol bar bgyis/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gi ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gi byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des / /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod do / /gnyis pa dngos bzhi la yang gnyis kyi dang po byang chub la blo sbyongs ba ni/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang / /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /ltos pa med par btang bar byed/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /nam yang nyer mtsho'i rgyur yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' btug pa'i/ /sems can khams ni rnams kun tu/ /thams cad mya ngan 'da' bar du/ /bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyu yang shog /zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa cho ga brjod pa ni/ dgongs gsol sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung te ji srid byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i slab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang / /rim ba bzhin du bslabs par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas dam bca' ba ste cho ga dngos so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la'ang gnyis kyi/ dang po rang gzhan dga' ba bskyed pa ni/deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to/ /da ni bdag gi ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog pa mi 'byung de ltar bya/ /zhes pa rang / /bdag gi de ring skyob pa thams cad kyis/ /spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /zhe pas gzhan dga' ba skyed do/ /gnyis pa smon lam gdab pa ni / kun nas dge ba bzang po spyod pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyis/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par gyis/ /zhes don sems zhing brjod par bya'o/ /de yang byang chub sems pa'i bslab pabyu la 'jug pa rnams byang sdom gyi chog ga 'di ltar nyin re bzhin bslang zhing / de bzhin thun gsum du yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs sems rgyas bsdus gang nus dang /de rjes phung po gsum pa'i mdo bklags pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa 'di yang rtag tu 'bad pas kha don du bya ba ste/ oṃ na ma s+t+ri ya dhe kā nam/ sarba ta thā ga tā māṃ/ sarba tra a pra ha ti ha ti bā s+t+waṃ/ 181

dharma / tā bā li māṃ/ e a sa ma/ sa ma sa man+ta to/ a nan+d+ra bāsti sha sa māṃ/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa/ bi ga tā rā ga budha dharma te/ sā ra sā ra/ sa ma bā la ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na/ ma hā wa ra nā/ lak+ṣa ṇi/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ na sā ga re swā hā/ de ni sdom pa'i nyes ltung dag cing byang chub kyi sems khams gang nas gang du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad byang chub snying po'i 'bras bu la/ /'gro rnams gzhol bslad sems bskyed pa'i cho ga /snying po tsam 'di bris pa'i dge ba yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs pa skong bar shog /ces pa yang zha lu ba dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa 'dzin pa rin chen 'jam pa dar gyi bskul ba la rten nas/ deng sang phal mo che la khyer bde 'di lta yi shin tu phan par mthong bas rig pa 'dzin pa sangs rgyas 'bang tshe dbang nor bus sa pho rta yi lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal ba lhum zhugs kyi dus bzang por gu ru rgya ma khri khang pho brang yang rtser thun gcig la rang gi sug pas su bgyis pa ste maṅga lo/ jayan+tu/ /༄ga /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rim pa lnga tshig nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o badz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /rigs rnams gcig bsdus gsang ba che /rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /dang por gus pas phyag byas nas/ /de yi bsgrub thabs snying po'i don / /mdo tsam 'di ru bshad par bya/ /de yang gsang sngags kyi theg pa la mos gus rnam par dag pa thob cing rim pa la zhugs pa'i sgrub pa pos rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len pa'i tshul la lnga ste/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho na nyid do/ /phyi kri ya ltar ni/ rang lus tha mal du gnas pa'i spyir bor pad zla la gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing / dril bu rked par 'chang ba / zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs can/ zhi ba'i tshul thams cad kyis rgyan pa'i thugs kar gsung sku yi ngo bo r+ghaṃ yig brgya zla ba rnams gsal btab la/ de'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras slob 'phags tshogs thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus te thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku lus khengs te sku'i cha thams cad dang zhabs g.yas kyi mthe bong nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / bdag dang sems can rnams kyi spyi bo nas babs/ lus nang zhugs 'khor ba thogs med nas bsags pa'i nad gdon dang / gtso bor sdig sgrib zhes ltung dri ma rten sha khrag rus pa dang bcas thams cad nag nur te thon/ sa 'og tu song / der yang me rlung gi sbyor bas sbyang bar bsam la yig brgya ci nus su bzlas ba ni phyi'i bsgrub pa'o/ /nang u pa ltar nyams su len pa la/ spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' de mar byon/ rang gi dung khang du bzhugs pa'i sku yi 'od zer dkar pos bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs bar bsam la yig brgya ci nus bzlas/ de nas mar byon mgrin par rdo rje sems dpa' sngags 'phreng sa bon bcas dmar por gyur/ 'od zer dmar pos gong bzhin ngag gi sdig sgrib 182

sbyangs bar bsam nas yig brgya bzlas/ de bzhin snying kar lha sngags sa bon 'od zer sngon pos yid kyi sdig sgrib gsal cing / lte bar rdor sems ser po'i 'od zer gyi rim pas sgo gsum char gi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rang lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par bsam la yig brgya bzla ba ni nang gi bsgrub pa'o/ /gsang ba yo ga ltar nyams su len pa ni/ rang lus 'od kyi gong bu de yang stong par gyur/ de yi ngang du zla ba r+ghaṃ yig rdo rje rnams grub cing de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems dpa' zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung phyag rdo rje dril bu snyem tshul gyi 'dzin pa/ zhi tshul longs sku'i rgyan yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang / de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ de las sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i 'od zer 'phros pa yi rgyal ba mchod cing sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs bar bsam la yig brgya ci nus su bzla ba ni gsang ba'i sgrub pa'o/ /yang gsang bla med kyi rgyud sde ltar nyams su len pa la/ 'di ltar snang tshad thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ sna bar sgra ru grags tshad thams cad yi ge brgya pa'i sngags/ sems kyi yul gyi dran rtog thams cad der 'dzin gyi shes pa rtsis gdab dang bral ba chos nyid rol par la zla ba ste/ de ni gnas skabs su lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag bar dor 'jigs pa'i gzugs dang mi snyan pa'i sgra 'khrul pa'i snang ba mi 'byung bar lha sngags mthong thos dang chos nyid mngon du gyur pa dang /mthar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'grub par byed pa sngags bla med thams cad kyi spyi chings su nyams su len tshul te yang gsang gi sgrub pa'o/ /de kho na nyid a ti yo ga ltar nyams su len pa ni/ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten srid pa bcud kyi sems can lha skur gyur pa la thim zhing / de dang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun rang la thim/ rang ye shes sems dpa' la thim / de zla ba/ de rdo rje la thim/ de hūṃ yig nā da'i mthar stong par gzhil cing mthar oṃ badz+ra sa twa r+ghaṃ gi sgras lha skur ldang / de ltar lha sngags su shar ba'i sems nyid kyi ngo bo ngos bzung thams cad las 'das pa'i stong pa nyid ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin la/ de lta na yang snang cha go ma 'gags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang lus snang snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lo shar ba ni bskyed rim gyi cha ste/ de gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa gdod ma nyid nas 'dus ma byas rang byung gi zung 'jug smra bsam brjod bral rig pa'i ngo bo ste/ de rang ngo shes bzhin rtag tu skyong ba'i ngang yi ge brgya pa bzla ba'am/ mi bzla yang rung ste/ de ni rdo rje sems dpa'i don gyi bsgrub tshul te/ de kho na nyid kyi bsgrub pa'o/ /'on kyang dmigs bskor 'di rnams cung zad spros te nyams su len na kho bos sngar bkod zin pa'i yi ge las rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang thun gyi tha mar skyabs sems dang mthar bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab pa ni theg pa chen po'i spyi tshul dang spyod lam tshogs su bsgyur ba'i rnal 'byor rnams la'ang bslab par bya ste/ nyams su len par nus na chos tshul 'di nas kyang tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi sa la nges par sbyor bar the tshom med pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rmad byung yi dam lha yi gtso/ /rdor sems sgrub thabs ches 183

zab pa/ /'di ru bshad byas dge ba des/ /mkha' khyab sems can ma lus kun/ /kun bzang rdor sems myur 'grub shog /zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi rim pa nyung ngur byas pa 'di yang / gangs can sa yi dkyil 'khor la dbang bsgyur ba mi yi lha chen po mchog gi sras mo byang chub sems ma dge ba'i dpal du mas yongs su brgyan pa bde ldan sgron ma gang gis gsung gi snang ba dang / nye bar dam pa'i chos la 'dun cing rnam par dkar ba'i lang tsho rgyas pa dga' bzhi mi yi bdag po'i yum bsod nams lha sgron gyi nyams bzhes ched du bskul ba'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i skyes bdag gi lo zhal gsar du 'char ba rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa la 'phrul snang gtsug lag gi 'dab me tog rnam par bkra ba'i skyed mos tshal du thun mtshams gcig tu grub par sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/

༄ga /lam zab mo bla bsgrub skor gyi rdo rje sems dpa' phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi bsgrub pa mchog tu zab pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ rgyal kun thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag /khyed zhabs phyag 'tshal de bsgrub thabs/ /phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid/ /cung zad 'di ru ston par bya/ /de la phyi ltar bya rgyud ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste / rang lus tha mal spyi bor pad dkar zla ba rgya che ba'i steng du r+ghaṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhi 'dzum sdug dang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan yongs su rdzogs pa zhabs brkyang bskum rol pa'i 'dug stang can g.yas pa'i the bong rang gi spyi bor reg pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du rgyu dkar po rab tu 'tsher ba'i mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa g.yas su hrang hrang 'khor ba'i 'od zer phroṃ la 'dus nas r+ghaṃ gi thig le la rgyud de 'od zer yar 'phros rdo rje sems dpa'i gtsug tor nas thon te phyogs dus rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams la dgyes mchod phul zhing thugs brgyud bskul nas byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od zer rab tu bsdus nas rdo rje sems dpa'i gtsug nas zhugs te/ thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim pas hūṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun rab tu babs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku lus bdud rtsis rab tu khengs nas zhabs g.yas pa'i sha sen bar nas bdud rtsi ngang nar gyi babs te rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus kyi nang khengs pas nad thams cad snag khrag chu ser/ gdon thams cad shig sro sbal sbrul/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu sol khu dang 'ja' tshon sngo dmar gyi rnam par rang gi chu lam dang rtsa lam ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon nas dbang chen sa gzhi dgu rim 'og tu song nas nam yang mi ldog cing rang lus bdud rtsis them me nem mer khengs te dper na shel bum 'o mas gang ba ltar bsam ngang yi ge brgya pa skad gsang snyan pas ngag snyan du bzla bar bya'o/ /i bīḥnang spyod rgyud ltar du nyams su len pa ni gong gi rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgom pa de nyid rang gi tshangs bug nas mar byon te dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de bde chen 'khor lor dar cig bzhugs nas bdag gi lus sgrib thams cad sbyang bsam ngang yig brgya bzlas shing / de nas slar mgrin par byon nas bdag gi ngag sgrib sbyang ba dang / mthar snying gar byon nas yid sgrib sbyangs te rdo rje sems dpa'i sku thugs ka'i zla ba dang sngags 'phreng la thim/ gsung sngags phreng yang thugs kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig la thim/ de yang 'od du yal nas rang lus 'od phung du lam gyi gyur te skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur blug sku byon pa ltar krang gi gyur pa'i sku yi ba spu thugs ka dang mdzod spu nas 'od zer rab tu 'phros nas rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus lus pa med pa la mnyes mchod 'bul zhing thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas bdag dang sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs zhing dngos grub thob par bsam ngang 185

yig brgya dag gtsang si sil bzla bar bya'o/ /mṛthiḥ gsang ba rnal 'byor rgyud ltar nyams su len pa ni/ de ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum tha mi dad par shes ngang / thugs ye shes kyi klong du rang gi snying pad+ma dkar po kha phye phral lta bu'i ge sar ze'u 'bru'i steng thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan la rang rig rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal tshon gang ba gcer bu rgyan med kyi thugs kar kun rdzob kyi thig le zla ba dngas pa sen gang ba'i steng du/ don dam thig le rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar sa bon dngas ma hūm̐ du bsam mthar yig brgya mu tig gi phreng ba lta bur ngang gyi li li 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba 'khor ba las 'od zer gyi gong ltar rgyal ba mchod pa'i spro bsdu byas nas/ khyad par sngags phreng gi 'od zer rig drug gnas su phog pas de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal ma lus thams cad sang sbyangs de thams cad kyang sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur nas phyir mi ldog par bsam ngang yig brgya bzlas pa'i skyon bral du bzla bar bya'o / /i bīḥ de nas yang gsang bla med kyi rnal 'byor ltar nyams su len pa la/ de ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor du rang las phyi nang snod bcud snang srid thams cad sgyu ma'i rol rtsal nyid du shar bzhin / gzugs su snang ba'i lha 'dre mi sogs rigs drug rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /rten dang brten par snang ba'i sgra thams cad yi ge brgya pa'i rang sgra rtog tshogs mtha' dag bzung 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral ba phyam brdal chos sku'i ngo bo mnyam nyid bde ba chen por la zla zhing / mdor na dag ma dag zhes pa'i tha snyad dang bral ba rnam kun mchog ldan kun tu bzang po'i chos nyid du lam khyer bar bya ste/ de ngang du yi ge brgya pa shub bu'am 'gog bzlas dang rdor bzlas sogs gang rung bya ste/ zab pa'i man ngag go/ /i bīḥ de ltar phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi ngo bo kho na nyid rang byung rdzogs pa chen po rtsod bral thig le nyag gcig tu nyams su blang ba ni/ de yang rang rig ngo bo la ming gi tshon dpe dang bral/ blo las 'das shing stong pa med/ mi stong pa med/ ye shes med/ 'khrul pa med/ rnam rtog med/ nyon mongs med / 'khor ba med/ myang 'das med/ don dam med/ kun rdzob med ste/ mdor na bsam brjod dpe mtshan rtag chad bdag gzhan gyi mtha' thams cad dang bral la/ rang bzhin du 'khor ba/ myang 'das ye shes / 'khrul pa/ gsal ba/ stong pa la sogs thams cad byung zhing / rnam pa du ma la longs spyod pa ste/thugs rje yi de ltar ngo bo rang bzhin kyang ya ba bral/ phyogs su ma chad ris su ma grub par zung du 'jug zhes tha snyad du gdag ste/ de ltar ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje zhes pa yang / mdor dril na rang sems kyi ngo bo spros bral gyi gshis 'di la gang gi yang mtshon bral stong sang nge ba la gdangs gsal ma 'gag par rang rtsal du snang ba lha sngags su wa ler shar zhing / de ltar bskyed rim zhes lha sku bsgom pa'i gsal cha dang / don dam ngo bo stong pa gnyis yang res stong res gsal lta bu ma yin par gsal stong zung 'jug gdod nas dbyer med kyi rol par shes pa ste/ gang shar sems kyi rgyan dang rol par la zla ba ni gnad do / /186
