bya rab byung dang po nas da lta bcu gnyis pa'i mjug chu khyi 'di yan gyi lo grangs yin la/ da lta chu khyi 'di nas lo lnga 'das pa'i me yos ni rab byung bcu gsum pa shar ba yin na phyin chad bsnan 'os thams cad de ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu 'bru mang po zhes pa sa stag nas brtsams da lta'i bar gyi rgyal ba'i ring lugs pa chen po skyes bu dam pa grags che ba kha shas pa'i 'byon lo rnams dus kyi nges pa gsal ba'i slad blo ldan rnams kyi dran pa'i gsos su kaḥthog sprul skur grags pa'i rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i rnga chen chu khyi gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs tshes bzang dga' ba gnyis pa la kong yul ljon pa lung gi ri bo'i khrod du bris pa ste dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/214

༄7ོ/ /ar+yabishiṣ+ṭabalokiteshwarasusādhakaparipradhārnagibhirasaṃgrahamaṇ+ḍamyurbasamān+d+rasubhaṣita.alpaprakāshasid+dhikā.ā+odayarat+nakāraṇ+ḍanāmabidzaharam̐/༄ga /'phags mchog srun ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs yongs gces zab bsdus snying po'i don khrid legs bshad nyung ngu rab gsal dngos grub 'dod 'byung rin chen za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /o ṭ+wāsti/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs yongs gces zab bsdus snying po gsal ba'i don khrid legs bshad nyung ngu rab gsal dngos grub 'dod 'byung rin chen za ma tog zhes bya ba/ bla ma mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gtso mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /sangs rgyas mtha' dag bskyed pa'i yab mchog ste/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas kun sras thu bo'i tshul/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nor bu dmigs med snying rje'i bde chen thabasaske//pad+ma dmigs bcas stong chen shes rab ma/ /nor bu stong chen 'gyur med yig lnga wam/ /pad+ma thig le stong pa yig drug e/ /dbyer med rten brten srid zhi shes shes bya/ /bden gnyis chos rnams kun gyi stong pa'i gzhi/ /chos nyid kun 'gro byang chub sems zung 'jug /sangs rgyas nor bu pad+mar phyag 'tshal 'dud / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rin chen gter/ /yongs su gnas gyur za ma tog bkod pa'i/ /sgrubs thabs mdo rgyud kun gyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /'phags pa'i bka' lung grub gyur gyis nyams skyugs / /kun gyi bcud bsdus bla ma'i zhal gdams gang / /rang myong dang bstun 'jug sla don che nyid/ /skal bzang 'gror la legs bshad gsar pa'i gtam/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal dngags kyis 'dir bshad byaske/ /de yang ris su ma chad pa'i mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon po/ bye brag gdul dka'i gdong dmar bod yul 'dul mdzad lhag pa'i lha skal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi man ngag smar khrid las brtsam ste rgyud sde rgya mtsho nas gsungs pa'i yi dam rang gi mos pa gang 'dod kyi khrid rim du sbyor bar rjes su gnang ba'i spyi gzhung chen po la/ zab don mtha' dag gi snying po btus te legs par bshad pa gang / nyams su len par 'dod pas 'di ltar bya ste/ de yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid gsum mo/ /dang po la/ spyi dang / khyad par/ thun mong ma yin gsum las/ dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ mi rtag 'chi ba/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigasaske/ thar pa'i phan yon rnams byang chub lam gyi rim pa spyi dang mthun par 'bogs nas/ dad dang nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa bskyed pas/ dkon mchog rin po che la skyabs su 'gro bar bya 215

ste / rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs gzhi rin po che las grub pa 'khod snyoms lag mthil ltar brdal ba la/ rang gi g.yas g.yon du tshe 'di'i pha ma/ mdun rgyab mtha' bskor du 'gro drug sems can mu med pas bskor zhing kun kyang skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pa mthun pa/ steng gi nam mkha' yi gnas su bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas/ chos dge 'dun/ byang sems/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rgyu skar bkram pa ltar them mer ne mer khengs pa la/ bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su rtse gcig gi 'gro bar bsam nas skyabs 'gro brjod de/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa'am gzhan yang skyabs 'gro'i tshig gang 'os bya rung mod/ gnyis pa ni 'di ltar mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa drin che ba'i pha ma 'ba' zhig yin pa la/ 'di dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi btson dong du 'khyams pa rnams la snying re rje/ de dag bor nas bdag nyid gcig pu'i zhi bde don gnyer ni shin tu mi rig pa khrel med ngo tsha bral ba'i spyod pa ste/ des na lhag pa'i bsam pas de dag la phan pa rgya chen po bdag gis btags shing / khyad par bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la cis kyang bkod par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rmar khrid khyad par can nyams su blangs nas tshe 'di nyid la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par bgyi'o bsam nas skyabs yul rnams dpang por byas te sems bskyed pa ni/ shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /zhes pa don la dmigs bzhin du brjod/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /ces pas tshad med pa'ang ci nus bsgom/ rang gzhan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las myur du thar par 'dod na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed zhe thag pa nas bya zhing / dbugs btang rngub skabs bdag gi dge tshogs sems can rnams la btang zhing / de dag gi sdig pa bdag gi blang nas sbyang bar bsam pa ni nyin re bzhin thun dang thun skabs rnams su ma chag cing ma brjed par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku de ka 'khor los bsgyur ba rgyal po'i chas su bzhugs pa'am/ ngo bo bla ma rnam pa 'od dpag med dam spyan ras gzigs lta bu blo ngor gang bde zhig gsal ba de sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyi ngo bor gyur cing rang la bka' drin che ba'i sgo nas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag la lhag par yang rgyud sde mtha' dag nas gsungs pas de ltar nges pas/'di nas byang chen snying po'i bar du rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che las skyabs gnas re sa blo gtad gzhan su yang ma mchis pas sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing / bdag lus tshe bsod longs spyod gtan gyi 'dun ma yongs su skyabs gnas khyed la 'bul lo/ /legs nyes ci mdzad khyed rang mkhyen no snyam pa'i kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin blo gtad ling skyur gyi bzhag la/ ngag nas yang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la 216

bdag phyag 'tshal/ mchod do sdig pa bshags so/ /dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bla na med pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o//bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod cing don bsam/ bla ma'i gnas bzhir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i/ o ā:r+ghaṃ hoḥ dkar dmar mthing ser gsal btab ste/bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dus gcig sbyang ba'i 'dun pa rtse gcig gi yig brgya ci nus bzlas pas/ bla ma'i sku yi cha dang yi ge bzhi las/ ngo bo ye shes/ rnam pa bdud rtsi/ rang sgra yi ge brgya pa'i sgra sgogs pa'i rgyun bar ma chad pa bdag gzhan rnams kyis spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdisdig canag sgrib nyes ltung dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa nag nur ru ru bu ga dgu skra sen ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'thon/ de dang lhan du nad gdon bar chad bgegs rigs rnams kyang sang sang 'thon/ lus shel sgong dri med ltar dngas par bsam/ khyad par dngos grub thams cad 'dus pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor du yid ches pa'i dad gus phur tshugs drag po dung dung pa yang yang byas shing bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so//bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol 'debs so/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /skyabs mchog kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa dang / pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ bla ma rang mkhyen no/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes pa gdung ba'i shugs dos drag la yun ring bar bla ma'i mtshan nas kyang gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma'i gnas bzhi'i yi ge las/ oṃ las oṃ dkar yig drug dkar pos bskor ba byung / bdag gi dpral bar thim/ bum dbang gi sbyang smin thob gsum mngon du byas/ de bzhin āḥlas āḥdamar yig drug gi bskor ba snga mar ltar mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang gi dang / hūṃ las r+ghaṃ sngon sngags phreng snying khar thim pas/ shes rab ye shes lte ba'i hoḥlas hoḥser sngags phreng bdag gi lte bar thim pas dbang bzhi pa'i sbyang smin thob gsum mngon du byas par bsam la/ gsol 'debs la 'bad cing / mthar bla ma rang gi tshangs bug nas mar byon/ snying khar zhugs shing / de yang 'od du yal te/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang bdag gi sgo gsum dbyer med bsam ngang cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar skyar gdab kyi ci nus bsgom/ rjes su dge ba bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab cing lam bsgom par sogs bya'o/ /rnam dkar lam kun rtsa ba dad pa ste/ /bskyed par gal che 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / /mngon mtho nges legs tshul bsam nges 'byung gi /skyabs su 'gro ba tshul khrims kun gzhi yin/ /sems bskyed ngo bor theg chen byang sdom 'du/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sde snod gzhung / /des na sngon 'gror grags pa'i gnas 'di gsum/ /sdom gsum nyams len bcud 217

yin 'bad par rigs/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim gnyis / dang po la/ mngon sbyang lnga la brten nas rang nyid yi dam kun 'dus su bskyed pa/ spyi bo rigs bdag bla ma kun 'dus/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dam pa'i chos kun 'dus/ mkha' khyab bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ rjes bsdud 'pho ba 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ o su bha wa shurnyo sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyolhahaṃ/ zhes pas gzung yul phyi don gyi chos thams cad bar snang 'ja' ltar yal zhing / oṃ ma hā shu r+sā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes pas nang phung khams dbang shes bdag 'dzin gyi tshogs nam mkha' dag pa'i dbyings ltar dwangs te/ yul yul can gyi 'dzin pa med pa rnam par rtog gsum spros bral stong nyid kyi ngang du ji gnas su bzhag de chos nyid stong pa nyid la mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /'di rdzogs rim dngos kyi skabs stong nyid rgyas 'debs zhes phal che bas 'gog kyang ske/ bskyed rim skabs su che thang du ma bcas te gsungs pa yin pas tshul 'di nan du bsgom dgos laske/ deng sang gi phal che'i blo ngor bzhag pa'i stong nyid mngon byang 'di tsam gyi rgyas 'debs su shor ba'i nang tshan du yin mod kyang / bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gi zin na rgyas 'deb su shor ba'i nang tshan de yang ma yin par go dgos/ de ltar stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje dung ba zhig skyes pa'i rkyen la brten sems dag pa zla ba'i gzugs su gyur pa ni sku zla ba la mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng thad du srog gi rlung dag pa las yi ge hriḥyig dkar po gsung yig 'bru la byang chub pa'o/ /de yang /yid gnas su dag pa mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma'am ut+pal dkar po rgyas shing yid 'ong lhun chags pa hriḥyig gis mtshan pa zhig zla ba la gnas par gyur pa ni thugs phyag mtshan la mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /de gsum las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa rnams la gsung mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bsal 'od zer tshur 'dus thim pas zla pad trīḥyig ro mnyam du 'dres nas zab gsal bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin sku yongs su rdzogs pa me long ngos su lha sku'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar sku gcig gis wal gyi snang ba ni sku yongs rdzogs la mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /sku yi rnam par rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dbyibs kha dog thams cad pa'am/ yang sgrub thabs rnams nas ji ltar sku gcig bzhin pa'i 'phags pa'i sku yi rnam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am zhal gcis phyag bzhi pa dang / bcu gcig zhal rtsa phyag bcu pa dang phyag sum bcu rtsa brgyad bcas pa dang / phyag stong spyan stong bcas pa sogs dang / spyir yang thugs rje chen po'i rigs/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal rgyal po lugs/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs/ bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs/ bcu gcig zhal pad+ma'i phyag bcu gcig zhal rdo rje snying po rab tu 'joms pa/ bcu gcig zhal don zhags/ sna tshogs dbang po sogs dang / don zhag zhal gcig phyag brgyad pa/ don zhags zhal phyag bzhi dmar po dang ser po/ don yod lcags kyu/ don yod nor bu/ thugs rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu/ yid bzhin nor bu'i 'khor lo/ seng ge sgra/ yi ge drug pa/ kha sar pa ṇi/ su 218

kha wa ti/ sems nyid ngal gso/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / spyan ras gzigs gsang ba 'dus pa/ spyan ras gzigs pad+ma dra ba/ spyan ras gzigs bde mchog yi ge bdun pa sogs dang / thugs rje chen po pad+ma nyi zla 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu/ yang snying kun 'dus/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho la sogs te/ de bzhin spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa phrag du ma 'phags yul gyi gzhung tshad mar gyur pa da lta yang mang du mchis pas/ de dag rang blor gang bde ba bsgom pa las phyogs ris nges bzung med la/ der ma zad yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha gang yang rung bas des na phyogs 'di yi dam thams cad kyi rmar khrid yin zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rtsis su mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan te 'phros kyi don du brjod pa'o/ /de ltar yi dam rab 'byams gang 'dod bsgom par bya ba la/ 'dir deng sang yongs la grags che bas 'jug sla shing bsgom bde ba/ khyad par 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po'i gsung bod kyi pha chos snying por gyur pa'i byin rlabs khyad par rmad du byung ba thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bur grags pa'i bsgom rim dang mthun par bshad pa bya ste/ de yang gdan gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma rab tu rgyas pa dang nyi zla'i gdan steng du bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar la 'od zer dpag med 'phro bas zla ba bye ba grags med kyi gzi brjid 'phrog pa zhal gcig rab tu zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ spyan gnyis pa la 'dom gang thad tsam du gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis dang po gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar sbub stong gi tsin+ta ma ṇi 'chang ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas shel phreng dang / g.yon gyi 'og mas pad dkar ram ut+pal dkar po yu ba nas 'dzin zhing snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i phyed thor tshug phyed sku rgyab dang dpung khar sil mar 'phyo ba/ ri dwags pags pas nu ma g.yon bkab cing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa du mas spras pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chas su bzhugs pa lta bu mtshan dang dpe byad kyi shin tu rdzogs par rgyan pa'i sku mtshar sdug blta bas chog mi shes pa bskal pa rgya mtshor bltas kyang ngom pa med pa/ ba spu'i sgo re re na yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho mu med grangs 'das rdzogs paske/ 'od dang 'od zer grangs med mu med mkha' mnyam du 'phro ba/ de yi dpral bar oṃ dkar / mgrin par āḥdamar/ snying kar r+ghaṃ mthing gi mtshan par bsgom zhing / de ltar sku yi rnam pa ma gsal bar du thog mar thun chung la grangs mang ba dang / rim pas yun ji ring du gsal btab/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu nam mkha'i khams khyab par 'phros shing / spyir sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad dang / khyad par rgyud sde bzhi drug gi dkyil 'khor lo'i tshogs ma lus lus pa med par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te bzhugs pa la yid las de ma thag par sprul pa'i kun bzang mchod sprin mkha' khyab spros pas mchod nas/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥrtsu baṃ hoḥzhes pas bdag la zhugs/ gnyis med du 'dres/ rab tu dgyes shing rtag par byas pas/ bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs yi dam kun 'dus kyi skur gyur pa la yid gnyis med par rtse gcig gi gsal snang brtan por 219

bzung bar bya ste/ de yang / bdag gi ming rus bla btags kyi zhen pa med par bdag rnam pa ma 'gyur spyan ras gzigs kyi sku yin/ ngo bo ma 'gyur spyan ras gzigs dngos te/ khyad chos yi dam mtha' dag 'dus pa rang yin cing / de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyang bdag la rdzogs pa'o bsam pa'i nga rgyal drag tu bzung / de ltar sku yi rnam par shar ba de yang / snang bzhin du stong pa ye shes kyi sku ste/ gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /zhes pa'i don rjes su dran pa ni rnam dag gi rtsa ba ste/ gzhan yang sku mdog zhal phyag rgyan phyag mtshan gyi dag pa yang bsam par bya'o/ /spyir btang bskyed rim gang dang gang bsgom yang / rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ dag pa dran pa 'di gsum gal che ba'i gnad dam pa yin pas nan tan du bsgom mo/ /gong du bshad pa'i mngon rtogs 'di jo bo rje dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i man ngag yig drug gi sgrub thabs kyang 'dus par brtan pa yin la/de bzhin 'phags pa'i sa bon dang sku mdog phyag mtshan dmar po rtsa phyag thal sbyor sbub stong can du bsgyur bas rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / de la yum rdo rje phag mo 'khyud pa thugs rje chen po nyi zla pad+ma dang / yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar po thal sbyar yum can byas pas ye shes 'od mchog la/ de dmar po thal sbyar dbang du pad+mo 'dzin pas pad+ma rgyal por 'gyur zhing / spyir yang spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrubs thabs thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bur yid bzhin nor bu yig drug 'gro 'dul 'di nyid la mdzad cing / yi dam spyi yi dmar khrid kyang de la sbyar bas 'dir yang de bzhin bkod pa snang bas rtsa ba'i thugs rje chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi snying ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros rang bzhin rnam dag 'og min zhing nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa gdan gsum tshang pa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i mtha' bskor du phyogs bcu rab 'byams spyi 'dren shes rab dbang bskang ltung gi bla ma'i rigs su gyur pa rnams dang / dgongs brda' snyan khung lta spyod rtogs pa bslab gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs dang / gzhan yang dus gsum du byon pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa rnams skad cig gis byon te bzhugs pa la/ gong bzhin yid kyi mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing / o sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru a gi ṣiñtsa tu rma/ zhes gsol ba btab pas o swā i ha a gi ṣiñtsa rdu/ zhes 'od dpag med kyi bdud rtsi bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang /dri ma dag chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam par rgyas pa 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan de la rtsa ba yan lag brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du zhugs pas rigs bdag 'od dpag med bla ma kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsamaske/ gsum pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu'o/ / dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su snying pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad zla ba dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs gnyis med ye shes ngo bo phyag mtshan gang rung gi rnam pa la/ 'dir pad+ma'am ut+pal dkar po nas 'bras tsam gyi 220

dbus su yungs kar tshad kyi zla ba'i lte bar trīḥ la yig drug spus bris pa lta bus bskor ba ste/ o ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/ zhes be+eḍūr+ya dkar po'am ser po'i kha dog ltar 'bar ba'i hrīḥ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rgyal ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams klas pa nas lung rtogs dam pa'i chos ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa glegs bam gyi rnam par rang sgra dang bcas pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gong ltar mchod/ mthar de rnams yi ge drug pa'i rnam par gyur nas rang gi snying ga'i trīḥ yig sngags 'phreng bcas pa la thim par gyur pas/ sngags gcig la dam pa'i chos thams cad 'dus pa'i nges shes drag po bskyed/ 'on kyang re zhig de tsam ma nus shing nyung bar dga' na/snying pad dkar zla ba la/ trīḥ yig sngags 'phreng bkod pa ste/ de ltar ni pad zla ye sems dang / trīḥ yig ting 'dzin sems dpa' yin la/ 'di khyer bde zhing byin rlabs chen po'i rgyun dang ldan pas legs pa yang yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying pad zla la trīḥ yig bkod pa'i 'od zer gyi gong bzhin spyan 'dren mchod te/ de rnams yig drug rnam par trīḥ la thim pas/ de gnas 'gyur te dus gsum du byon pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i yum gyur shes rab phar phyin yi ge drug ma rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs canaske/ bdag bskyed dang mtshungs pa las lha mo'i mtshan nyid 'jo sgeg mtshar sdug gi ngang tshul du mas spud pa'i sku mtshon gang pa de ye shes sems dpa' byas pa'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gong du bshad ltar bsgom pa ste/ 'di yang bla ma'i man ngag dmigs gnad shin tu zab cing ma sbas pa zhig gok+ṣi/ /gzhan rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang pad+ma rgyal po sogs la ni ye sems ha ya gri wa dang / dzñā na dhak+ki ni bsgom pa sogs khyad par ba rnams kyang shes par bya la 'di yan bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal snang ji nus bsgrub dgos kyang / de ltar mi nus pa'i dbang btson dman pa'i rigs kyi ni rnam pa gsal mi gsal la ma bltos pa lha de ltar yin no bsam pa'i mos 'dun gyi dran pa rgyun chags su rten pa tsam las 'os med cing | de yin ni bskyed rim gyi gzugs brnyan gyi gzugs brnyan tsam ste/ deng sang skabs de tsam gyi go mi chod ka med du grub pa 'dis rung ba yang zhir bcas snang la/ the tshom med pa'i dad gus brtan pos yod na des kyang dngos grub chen po thob nus pa yang yin par bshad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ thog mar snying ga'i sa bon la yid bzung zhing sngags 'phreng klags thabs su yig drug ring thung ran por lan kha shas bzlas/de nas bdag yi dam kun 'dus yin pas bdag gi bzlas pas yi dam kun 'dus kyi bzlas par 'gyur/lus kyi srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong dang skra nyi khri chig stong ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi yang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bor gnas pa re re nas yig drug gi sgra re re rgyun chad med par byung / rang dang lhan cig par spyi bor bla ma kun 'dus kyi gsungs pas bla ma kun 'dus kyi bzlas/ des rgyal ba rnams thugs rgyud khul nas byin rlabs dang / thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa bsal dngos grub thams cad thob thugs rje chen po'i skur bsgyur nas yig drug rgyun mi chad par sgrogs pa dang / phyi snang ba kun thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi 'od mdangs/ 'byung bzhi 221

rdul phra rab re re bzhin nas kyang yig drug gi sgra sgrogs shing / de bzhin sangs rgyas byang sems slob bcas 'phags tshogs nam mkha'i khams kun khengs bar bzhugs pas kyang bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad do//sngags kyi sgra rgyun nam mkha'i khyon yongs su khengs shing dus khams de ji srid du chad pa med par sgrogs par bsam ngang yi ge drug pa ji nus su bzla'o/ /de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mi ldan pa bye ba phrag brgya bzlas pa las/ dmigs pa gsal ba'i grangs nyung ngu'i phan yon che bas ji bzhin gsal ma thub kyang mos pa lam khyer tsam gyi sgo nas 'bad pas yang nus pa bla lhag tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa rjes bstud la / 'pho ba dang / 'od gsal ste/ dang po la yang gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes 'bral las/ dang po sku yungs 'bru ltar 'pho ba/ sbyor ba sku rdo rje sgrib byed lus kyi mi dge gsum 'gyod bshags bsdam/ srog skyobs/sbyin btang / tshul khrims blang / dngos gzhi gdod nas spyan ras gzigs yin pa la yin bzhin sku yi 'khyer so mi 'bral ba'i rjes/ rang lus phyi 'phags pa'i sku stong ra pad+ma'i 'dab ltar srab pa nang dbus dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan yar sne spyi gtsug tu ha re zug pa'i steng thad du bla ma 'od dpag med la lha yi dang bu mo ste byang chub sems dpa' sems mas bskor ba/ de yi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu byung / rang gi snying thad dbu ma'i dbus ye sems mtshon gang 'od kyi gong bur gyur par phog dbu ma'i lam nas rgyang thon 'od dpag med la thim/ 'od dpag med kyang 'ja' lam nas yud kyi bde ba can du bzhu rang lus lha sku'i snang cha yang dmigs med ngang du bzhag de las ldang tshe thugs rje chen po'i skur gsal dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /gnyis pa gsung yig 'bru'i tshul du 'pho ba ni/ sbyor ba gsung rdo rje sgrib byed ngag mi dge bzhi 'gyod bshags bsdam/ bden smra mthun byed/ bsngags brjod/ zhi des smra ba blangs / dngos gzhi gdod nas sgra kun yig drug rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs su gnas bzhin lam du khyer la/ rjes dbu ma'i mas snar trīḥ yig shel ltar dngas pa sran rdog tsam la gong ltar bla ma 'od dpag med kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas trīḥ la reg dbu ma'i lam rgyud trīḥ 'od dpag med la thim 'od dpag med bde ba can du gshegs par bsam la dmigs med ngang du bzhag gsum pa thugs 'od gsal du 'pho ba la sbyor ba thugs rdo rje'i sgrib byed yid kyi mi dge gsum 'gyod bshags bsdam/ nor la chog shes/'gro la byams pa/ las 'bras la yid ches su bya/ dngos gzhir sems nyid gdod nas chos skur gnas pa yid ches pas/ lha sngags snang grag chos kun sgyu ma lta bu sems kyi rol par grub cing sems nyid skye 'gag gnas bral rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i ngang nyid du lam du khyer zhing / rjes su thugs 'od gsal du 'pho ba zhes 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba'i sgo nas 'od gsal ma bu zhal mjal ba de nyid do/ /de ltar 'pho ba'i man ngag 'di 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po'i bka' byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha zla med pa ste/ khrid rgyun ches nyag phra ba'i de mi nub pa'i ched du rgyal po lugs kyi khrid don tshangs pa 'dir 'pho ba gsum du bsgril te bstan pa yin la/ gzhan dang ma 'bral yang 'pho ba 'di kho na khrid can rang rkang thub pa cig ste/ des na chos 'di la bod kyi pha chos khyad par can gyi zhen gyis/ shin tu gces shing 222

rtsis su byas nas nyams len 'bad par byos shig gnyis pa 'od gsal bsdud rim ni/ lha sngags bskyed rim gyi thun bsdu ba la phyogs pa'i skabs su phyi rten kun nang brten pa la thim/ de yang rim pas 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ spyi bo'i bla ma yang rang la thim/ rang yang snying ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la/de yang ting 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de sngags 'phreng / de sa bon/ de thig le dkar po yung 'bru tsam gyur cing ske/ yang je phra je phrar gyur te/ mthar skra shad brgya stong tshal pa tsam nas yal bar bsam/ stong nyid spros bral gyi rang ngo la ci gnas bzhag de las ldang tshe snying rje chen pos oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes pas skad cig gi thugs rje chen po'i sku sgyu ma lta bur gsal btab/ 'di bskyed rim gyi rdzogs rim ste skyar kyin yun ring du bsgom na 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i rgyu mchog tu 'gyur ba la/ bskyed rim gyi rjes bstud dngos ni 'di yin gyi 'pho ba gsum rdzogs rim rten brten pa ste 'di gnyis gang rung res rjes bsdu byed mod/'on te 'pho ba dang go rim bzhin sgom yang 'og ma rgyal po lugs kyi bsgrub thabs nas gsung pa'i bstud rim yin pas 'bral zhing thugs 'od gsal 'pho ba'i nang tshan du 'du bas legs pa yang yin noglu/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i dge bas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phangs thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pas bsngo ba smon lam btab/ de bzhin dus kun lha yi snang ba sngags kyi rang gdangs dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ phyag dang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang / gtor ma dang chab gtor dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal phul ba la sogs pa dge ba'i bya ba thams cad bya zhing / rdzogs rim zab mo yang bla ma'i man ngag bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /rgyal ba rab 'byams bsgrangs gzhal mi nus shing / /kun kyang ngo mtshar rmad byung 'ba' zhig las/ /gdul dka' 'dul la lhag par dam bcas pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bod kyi lha skal gyur/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos tshul grangs mang zhing / /gsang rig gzungs sngags nus pa rmad byung yang / /bklag sla 'dzin bde phan yon zla med pa/ /dam chos yig drug bod kyi chos skal mchog /tshul 'dir bsam nas gangs can 'gro ba rnams/ /dad gus spros pa lhag par 'phel yang rig /lha gcig bsgom pas sangs rgyas kun rjes dran/ /sngags gcig bzlas pas dam chos kun bklags byas/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas kun gyi thugs gsang sku'i/ /rin chen gcig tu 'khyil ba'i za ma tog /phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi cher bsngags pa/ /spyan gzigs bsgom bsgrub snying nas 'bad 'os yinaske/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /don gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim la/ bsam gtan gyi rten bca' ba/ ci ltar skyong tshul/ spog chog sems nyid sku dang ye shes zung 'jug chen por ngo sprad pa/ gegs bsal ba/ nyams ngos bzung ba dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la lus gnad/ dkyus thun dang bskyed rim mu mthud yin na skyabs sems gong gi mthus la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nan tan du bsgom pa'i mthar/ lus bsam gtan chos bdun rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung ngam/ de ye nas ma bcogs na sems dpa'i skyil krung bya/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gam khu tshur brla bzhag dpung mgo phyir bskyed/ sgal tshig 223

bsrang / lce rkan la sbyar/ so mchu rang sar bzhag /mig blta stangs bcas 'chu ldan du byas te/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ de rjes rlung rang 'bab du bzhag rang gi mdun khru gang ngam khru phyed de tsam sogs ci bde bar/ gzhi mthing nag mi che tsam ril zlum zhig bzhag te/ mig phyed bkab phyed bltas kyi de la tsham tshum med par g.yo med bzhag sems sngar byas phyis spyod da lta'i bsam zhig med par rang bab la ma yengs pa'i rtsi yod tsam byas la/ de ka'i ngang la bcas bcos gang yang mi byed cing / /rnam rtog brang brang 'phros kyang rjes bstud mi byed par/ /kho yi ngo rtsir gyi bzung la rang bab du bzhag /las dang po pa sgom dang thog ma nas sna sun med par thun chung la grangs mang bar byas te bsgom/ yang skabs su rang gi dpral ba'i dbus su spyan ras gzigs tshon gang 'od skor bcas pa dang / sna rtser hrīḥdakar dbug gi 'gro 'ong can dang snying dbus su zla ba dmar skya sen gang sar mi zhig thig le yungs kar tsam gsal ba steske/ de gsum gang rigs dang / de bzhin du mig sna rtse'i bar snang du blta ba dang / mig btsum pa dang /nyin mo nam mkha' sngo mthing dang mtshan mo mun pa nag mthing la blta nas yang bsgom cing / gang bde ba de gtso bor byas la ma yengs par bya/ ha cang gi rnam rtog mang ste sun pa ltar snang na/ sngar phan rnam rtog yod kyang ngo ma shes pas len par gda'/ da bla ma'i man ngag la brten bsgom gyi sna zin pa'i snga ltas me 'bar sngon du ba byung ba lta bur rnam dog mang bar ngos/ zin pa snyam spro ba bskyed/ rim pas rnam rtog je nyung gi mthar rtog med ngang du gnas pa ni sgom gyi sna kha zin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong bshad sems 'jog spyi khyab rtsa ba lta bu la bye brag sgrim pa ni/ dpe rgyal khrims kyi nyan par tim mar gzhongs pa bskur nas 'dzag na gsod zhes bstigs pa'i sems lta bu ste/ don du rnam rtog gi 'phro rbad rbad gcad te ma yengs pa'i shes pa rtse gcig tu sgrim pa'o/ /bar ma ni/ dpe glang rdzi'i glang skyong bar 'jam rtsub ran pa bzhin/ /sems ha cang mi slod par rang bab tu ma yengs par byed pa'o/ /klod pa ni/ dpe rgya mtsho'i rdzings nas bya rog btang ba ltar sems ci bder bzhin rang ngo bskyong ba'o/ /de gsum gang bde gtso bor bsgom nas rig pa'i rang ngo skye 'gag gnas bral/ dbyibs kha dog sogs kyi ngo bo gang yang ma grub pa'i stong pa/ stong pa stong par yang ma chad pa'i stong nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i byang chub sems ma yengs par skyong ba ste/ go rim khrig khrig ni med la gang zag gi blo dang bstun pa'o/ /mdor na dus thams cad du rnam rtog gang shar wal po rjes med kyi sems nyid stong gsal ngang la ched 'dzin bral ba yul med rang ngo shes pa/ thibs la ma rmug pa grim la gnyan po'i ma slad pa/ rig la rtog par ma 'gyus paglu/gsal la yengs pa med pa/ 'bel le/ shig ger/ mnyam bzhag dus rgyun du skyong ba ni dam pa'i mthar thug ste/ 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po'i bka' thugs chos nyid 'od gsal 'pho ba'i man ngag gi snying po yang mdo don du bstan pa 'di yin no/ /gzhan yang blta stang gyen 'thur du phyogs pa dang / kha thon mang nyung blag cor gyi sgra sogs sprel nas dang / tshogs dbyen gyi sar 'gro ba dal 'bral sna tshogs dang / sems dga' bde gya nom pa zug rngu nyon mongs skyes pa'i skabs rna4sa su rig pa rang bab du 224

skyong nas nyams blta bar bya la/ nyams bzang ngan rkyen thog tu 'dres mi 'dres la dga' ba dang mi dga' ba'i blo ni mi bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems nyid ngang la rang gnas shing / skye 'gag gnas pa'i mtha' yi dben cing / rang rig g.yo ba med pa/ gnas 'gyu la sogs chos kun sems nyid kyi ngo bor mnyam shing tso/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ma rtsal lhun rdzogs rang rig cho 'phrul du rang ngo shes pa 'di ka la chos sku'i rang zhal 'jal zhes bya/ de las gzhan pa'i chos sku zhig tshol du med la/ de yang sems nyid smra bsam dpe brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i stong pa nyid chos sku/ rang mdangs go ma 'gags par chos thams cad 'char rung gi gsal ba sprul sku/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bo zag med bde bar snang ba longs sku/ de thams cad kyang dbyer mi phyed la gcig tu ma bral ba'i gshis lugs ni ngo bo nyid sku ste de ni don dam pa'i nor bu pad+ma ste ma ṇi pad+me yin la gzhan yang / 'gyur med don dam bde chen mkha' khyab nor bu rin po che stong gzhi chos nyid kyi pad+ma'i za ma tog tu bzhugs pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad gsang ba chen po ste e waṃ ā hi ā li kā li rdo rje pad+ma nyi zla dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang po'i sangs rgyas seng ge'i khri sogs gdan gnyis/ thabs shes zhi lhag stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i chos ma lus thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ste/ ma ṇi pad+ma zhes bya la/ oṃ yig snang ba thabs kyi ye shes lnga/ r+ghaṃ stong pa shes rab kyi ye shes lnga ste/ shes bcu'i bdag nyid can du shes par bya ste/ de dag ni zab cing brling ba'i don bla ma'i man ngag gi zhib par ngo sprad do/ /de yang gnas skabs lam du byed pa ni tha mal gyi shes pa la rtog med rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa 'di ka zab mo nang don du grags pa kun gyi snying po dbu sems/ zhi gcod/ zab gsal/ phyag rdzogs mtha' dag gi ngo sprad kyi snying po de ka ste/ de ngo shes bzhin ngo 'phrod par byas la dus kun ma yengs mi sgom pa'i skyong tshul dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ngo sprod pa'i ngo bo ji bzhin mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gegs sel ba la mkhas dgos te mdo tsam ni/ bying na/ lus gnad bsgrim zhing blta stang spor ba dang bsil ba la brten/ rmug na/ bla ma'am rten khyad par can la phyag bskor bya/ /'thib na rig pa ngar btags cing phaṭaḥ mang du brjod/ 'phro na/ lus gnad shes pa klod cing blta stang phab/ rgod na/ sgrim klod rnam rtog ar gtad gsum gang gnad du 'gro ba der bya/ 'thor na/ lha sku yig 'bru la sems bzung / gzhan yang sems bde ba la mi chags/ gsal ba la mi zhen/ mi rtog pa la dga' bar mi bya la de rnams spang ba ma yin gyi/ dgag sgrub dang spang blang med par ma bcos bzo med rang rig rang grol du lam khyer bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ sgom la 'jug pa dang po'i skabs su rnam rtog ri gzar gyi chu rlabs bzhin bar ma chad pa ni g.yo ba'o/ /de nas rim pas rnam rtog cung zad tsam dal ba rong gi gzhung chu lta bu ni thob pa'o/ /rnam rtog 'phro ba nyung zhing rtog med gnas pa shas che ba dal 'bab kyi rlung chu lta bu ni bsgom pa'o/ /rkyen drag po med tshe phal cher rtog med ngang du 'byams pa gaṅga rgya mtshor 'dres nye ba lta bu ni rten pa'o/ /rkyen gyi mi brdzi bar ma zad rkyen gyi ngo bor gsal btab pa rgya mtsho'i klong lta bu ni mthar phyin pa ste nyams rig pa lnga'o/ /gzhan yang 225

gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du shar ba gnas pa'i nyams sam rtse gcig rnal 'byor dang / 'gyu ba sems kyi rol par stong pa mi g.yo ba'i nyams sam spros bral rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor de gnyis kyi nor bu pad+ma'i don dpe'i zhi lhag nyams su myong ba dang / chos dang chos nyid ro mnyam du myong ba mnyam nyid myong ba mnyam nyid mnyam sam ro gcig pa'i rnal 'byor/ chos kun bya rtsol med par rig pa'i rang rtsal rdzogs pa ni lhun grub nyams sam sgom med rnal 'byor te rnal 'byor 'di gnyis kyi ma ṇi pad+me'i don zhi lhag zung 'jug dpe yi 'od gsal tshul bzhin rtogs nas don gyi 'od gsal la 'jug ste zung 'jug gi sku thob par byed pa'o/ /de dag snying por brjod pa tsam las mngon rtogs rgyas pa ni gzhan du btag go/ /de ltar 'dir bstan pa'i rdzogs rim don tshan lnga la zab mo'i phyogs kyi rdzogs rim mtha' dag gi man ngag gnad du 'dus par dgongs dril du bstan pa yin la/ 'on kyang gnas lugs zab mo'i mngon rtogs dpe klog tsam kho nas shes nus pa ni ma yin pas thog mar bla ma nyams rtog gi rgyan pa ma nor ba'i bzang po la btugs nas log blta dang mnyam 'grogs ye nas ma shor ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor shes pa'i dad pa/ ji mdzad legs mthong ji gsung tshad mar bzung ba'i gus pa/ dgyes pa bsgrub cing mi dgyes pa spang pa'i mos pa/ lus srog la bab kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dam tshig mi btang ba'i dung ba ste/ /mtshan nyid 'di bzhi dang ldan pas bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdabs pa'i rgyud la nyams rtogs kyi yon tan yar zla ltar skye ba yin zhes/ /rgyal ba'i bka' lung man ngag thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i yang bcud dam par gsungs pa yin pas/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor du bzung nas gsar ngad ldem gyang ngos lkogs su ma song bar rang sems dpang por bzhag ste zhus dag pher ba zhig ji srid 'tsho yi bar du dgos par ma zad byang chub ma thob par du nga spyod pa'i 'dun pa bzung ba yin gyi/ /spyir yang sangs rgyas go 'phang thob zin nas bla ma la bsten dgos pa ma yin yang / bla ma dor ba ma yin pa'i tshul bstan du 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi spyi bor 'od dpag med bzhugs pa lta bu ste/ des na slob ma la gnas pa rnams kyi bla ma sgom dgos pa smos ma dgos so/ /des na byang chub don gnyer gyi thog mar bla ma ma nor ba bzang bar rtsal nas bar du mos gus kyi gzhi bzung / dam tshig srog phur gtsug nas mthar son par byed pa rang gal che'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor bas sun pa dang / 'di snang la zhen pa chung ba/nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan pa/ lhag bsam snying rje rgya che ba/ /rnam dkar bsgrub la brtson 'grus brtson pa/ dka' thub la zhe bcad dam pa rnams kyang lam mchog bsgrub pa la nges par gal che zhing gces pa'i chos so/ /de ltar 'dir lam gyi gnad don sa bon ming smos tsam las zhib rgyas bla ma'i zhal las blang bar bya'o/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo sngags dam pa'i chos/ /kun gyi gnad bsdus rgyu lam 'bras bu'i chos/ yongs ma khyab pa zab gsal dbyer med ste/ de don gtan la 'beb byed thabs kyi sgo/ /du mar 'char rung gcig tu 'dus pa'i bcud/ /'phags mchog bsgrub thabs bskyed rdzogs lam 'di rmad / rmad byung snying po'i gdams pa rdzogs rim chos/ rgyal ba sras bcas kun shul bsgrod gcig lam/226

lhan skyes ye shes sems dpa' nyid chos kyi sku/ rang ngo ji bzhin ston pa'i man ngag gnad/ don bsdus don tshang zung 'dril spro na rgyas/ bcang bde nyams su blang bde khyad 'phags chos/ 'di ko tshe dbang nor bu'i blo dpal las/ legs byung skal bzang yid gsos bdud rtsir byin/ rtog ge'i blo dang tha snyad tshig skam rjes/ ma 'brang don bsgom snying por dril mdzod kyi/ zhes pa'ang smras so/ / spyi don gsum pa rjes la/rgyun gyi spyod lam dang / 'pho ba dang / bar do'i rnal 'byor gsum ste/ dang po ni/ ldang ba'i skabs su 'phags pa la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas rol mo sngags sgras bdag sogs ma rig gnyid las slang ste skad cig mar rang nyid 'phags pa'i skur wal gyi gsal btab snod bcud thams cad rang dang rtse gcig sgrogs par bsam la yig brgya ā li kā li rten 'brel snying po tshar bdun nam gsum brjod/ skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs pa la oṃ na mo maspru shri ye swā hā/ na maḥ su shri ye swā hā/ na maḥ u ta ma shri ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzla ste ldang phyag bya/ sngags de'i rkyang phyag re dang phyag gsum byas na/ sde snod gsum thos bsam bsgom gsum byas pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam shing des nyin re bzhin phyag gsum re byas na mthong lam ye shes tshe 'dir skye zhing de srid mi dang mi ma yin 'byung po rims kyi gnod pas mi tshugs par bsrung bar gsungs so/ /gos bgo ba ni/ 'bru gsum gyi gos ngo bo bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa la/ rnam pa lha'i dar zab pañtsa li kar gyur pa de bdag nyid 'phags pa'i sku bla ma yi dam kun 'dus skra ba spu srin bu'i tshogs kyang thugs rje chen por bzhugs pa la bgo bas de dag rab tu dgyes te sems can thams cad kyi tshogs rdzogs par bsam/ bza' btung longs spyod pa na 'bru gsum gyi byin rlabs gong ltar byas/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar bza' btung 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas bdag nyid thugs rje chen po bla ma yi dam sogs gong ltar dang / der ma zad sems can thams cad 'phags par gsal ba'i sku lus phyi nang du thugs rje chen po'i bye brag rang dang mtshungs par bzhugs pa la/ bdag gi snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bdud rtsi tshogs 'khor phul zhing thams cad kyi bdag dang lhan gcig tu longs spyod pas dgyes shing tshim par bsam zhing / mthar dge ba byang chen du bsngo ba sogs bya/ gnad 'di ma shes phan chad zas zos pa byol song kha zas za ba ltar la gnad 'di shes shing 'bad pas nyams su blang na zas kham gang skom hub gcig yang tshogs 'khor re bskor bar 'gyur bas dkor sgrib dag tshogs rdzogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can bla na med pa thob pas shin tu gal che'o/ /lus kyi zag rdzas 'dor ba'i skabs su spyi bo bla ma las bdud rtsi bab pa bdag 'phags pa'i sku yi bdud rtsir 'dres te phyir bab nas bshang lci dri ma za ba'i mi ma yin thams cad kyi thob ste ngom zhing tshim par bsam la mchil ma la/ o a kle sma ra dzi / ha re bh+ya swā hā/ lud pa la/ oṃ a khre ra ā ha re bh+yaḥṭ+wā hā/ snab la/ oṃ bhi gha na a ha re bh+yaḥswā hā lus kyi dri mar/ oṃ a ma la ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ dri chen la/ oṃ a bhi sba ā ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ dri chu la/ o mū tra a ha re bh+yaḥswā hā/ de za ba rnams kyi thob par gyur cig zhes 227

pas bsngo ste/ de yi phan yon ni dpag tu med pa yod de nyin re bzhin dmu to ba 'bum 'bum kha zas kyi tshim par byas pa dang mnyam par gsung bas 'bad de bya'o/ /yang 'gro ba'i skabs su rang phrag pa g.yas kyi thad nam mkha' la pad+ma'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba tshad zung las 'das pa'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod sdong rtse mo 'og min chen por snyegs pa'i steng du bla ma 'od dpag med la bla ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bum pa'i dbus 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs rgyud sde rab 'byams yi dam ma lus pa bskor ba/ bam rim rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs dang / de dag gi bar mtshams su gsung rab glegs bam bgrangs 'das yod pa/ de bzhin bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rigs lnga dang / gzhan yang dkon mchog gi rten tshogs kyi zhing du gyur pas phyur bur gtams pa/ de las cung zad rim gyi dma' ba'i mchod sdong bstan pa'i gong mtshungs kyi pad+ma'i sa gzhi yongs su khengs pa la/ thog mar phyag 'tshal sngags bcas 'gro phyag gsum 'tshal mthar/na mo bha ga wa te rat+na ke tu ra dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne ma hā rasne rasne bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas bskor ba gcig byas pa yang dpag tu med pa byas par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi de la bskor ba'i tshul gyi 'gro bar bsam pa ni gom gang 'dor bas yang bsod nams phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa'i thabs bla na med pa'o/ /sdod pa na/ thang stong ngam/ gnas khang gang yin kyang rung / bde ba can gyi gnas zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su rin chen khang bzang la pad+ma'i snying por bdag 'phags pa'i sku gsal ba'i ngang du sher snying snying po lan bdun nam gsum brjod de gnas par bya'o/ /gnyid log pa la/mal du tsog bu'am/ seng ge'i nyal thabs gang bder byas la/ rmi lam 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dran 'dun drag po yang yang dang bla ma la gsol 'debs phur tshugs su nan shin tu che bas gdab cing spyi bo'i bla ma snying kar byon nas ye shes sems dpa'i dbu rgyan/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgya kha zlum pa bum sku ltar gyur pa bla ma dang ye shes sems dpa'i 'od kyi snying nang khengs te rim gyi ched de lus nang dang lus kyi mtho phyi nang srid kun khyab der bsdud nas snying ga 'od kyi khengs pa la sems gtad/ gal te snying gar ye shes sems dpa' zhal phyag can mi bsgom tshe hrīḥyig bla ma dang ro mnyam ste bla ma'i sku bsgom pa'i khyad par roske/ /gzhan gong gi bskyed rim gyi rjes bsdud kyang spog chog tshul du ring por bsgom a/ thog mar rmi lam mthar 'od gsal gyi dge sbyor yang dag pa skye'o/ /'di rnams spyod lam tshogs su 'gro ba'i man ngag khyad par can yin pas blo la bzhag ste bsgom par gces shing / gzhan yang chos spyod bcu la ci nus su 'bad pa dang / sbyor dngos rjes kyi chos bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pa sogs kyi rgyur gyur pa che phra ji 'dra zhig la spyad kyang rung mthar dge ba byang chen ched du bsngo zhing / theg pa chen po'i smon lam bzang po spyod pa'i ngang tshul rgya che bar gdab pa yang shin tu gal che ba yin pas dus kun tu ma brjed cing ma chad par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na tshe ring nad med pa dang longs spyod dbang phyug phun sum tshogs la/ dgra 228

dang chom rkun dang me dang chu la sogs pa mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa dge zhing las su rung la/ chos dang mthun pas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa'i snang ba de dag mi 'char bar rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'am/ de'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas bsus nas po ta la'am bde ba can du pad+ma la rdzus te skyes nas/ skye ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni rab bum pa ltar 'chi ba zhes zhi lhag zung 'jug gi nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'byams shing thug po'i 'od gsal rgyun chad med par 'char ba ni de las gzhan pa'i 'pho ba mi dgos te chos sku lta bu rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba zhes bya la/ 'bring bskyed rim gyi ye shes phebs pa'i mthar thug pa yan skyed kyi nus pas mkha' spyod kyi gnas gang 'dod du 'pho nus la—/ dam tshig bskyed pa'i rim pa ye shes dag pa'i mngal du 'jug btub longs sku zung 'jug gi 'pho bar grags la/ de gnyis gnas skabs lam du byed pa ni gong gi 'pho ba gsum yang yin no/ /de las gzhan pa rlung sems sgra sogs la brten pa sprul sku'i 'pho ba ste/ de ltar bsgom pa ni/ 'dir rang nyid 'phags pa'i sku phru ma phus btab lta bur gnas pa'i bu ga dgu hriḥ'od zer 'bar ba dgu'i bkag cing /lus dbus lte 'og sor bzhi mtshams nas chos 'byung phyi dkar nang dmar ba zur lte 'og mkhal khungs gnyis su phyogs shing / rtse mo gshang bar du zug pa'i dkyil 'od kyi sbu gu sngo skya drang thil yas na je sbom gyi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i sgor zug pa zla ba'i kha chod can de steng bla ma kun 'dus bzhugs pa snying ka'i 'od lam dbus su ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa bde ba'i dbang gi trīḥdakar po gsal kyang rung la/ lte 'og chos 'byung gi nang du rang sems ngo bo thig le'i rnam pa kha dog sngo dmar tsa na ka yi 'bras bu tsam bsam la/ bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab mthar rmeng ro lan gsum bsal nas 'jam rlung cung zad gcig zung ste phyir btang ba dang phaṭa kyi sgra bcas lte 'og thig le'i dkyil nas ti la dkar ser yung 'bru tsam thon 'od kyi spu gu'i dbus rgyud snying ka'i yi dam 'am trīḥl g.yas su bskor zla ba'i dbus nas thogs med du 'thon/ 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar zhugs te gnas/ 'jam rlung bzung nas phyir btang tshe snga ma ltar lan bdun 'pho/ de ltar rlung nang du sngar las yun ring tsam gyi thon te r+ghaṃ zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas 'od dpag gyi ka'i thig le bdun gcig tu gyur te zla ba la thog pa med par bab trīḥl g.yon du lan gsum bskor lte ba'i thig le'u dbus su thim par bsam la cung zad bzhag yang sngar ltar 'pho ba dang 'bebs pa rnams mang du byas la rtag 'thon par sbyangs/ mthar thun bzhag skabs 'od dpag med las tshe yi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa trīḥdang thig ler thim cing mthar lus khengs bla ma yang rang la thim 'od sbug gi yas na zlum po tshigs 'gags par bsam lte 'og gi thig sems bzung ste yig drug brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas 'pho ba'i log non dang tshe bsgrub pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /nam zhig 'chi rtags tshangs nas dus la bab pa na chags zhen spangs zhing mi dge ba bshags pa dang / bla mar mos 229

gus gnad du bsdun pas gsol 'debs ting nge 'dzin dbang ci nus su blangs/ de nas dmigs pa'i gzhi snga ma lta bu la ti la dkar ser rigs bdag thugs kar thim mthar bla ma'i sku las 'od dpag med kyi sku chung ngu zhig 'thon pa'i thugs kar gong gi thig le de 'dzin zhing rgyangs kyi bde ba can du gshegs nas gtso bo 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim/ de ltar lan kha shas dang / mthar thig le sngo dmar phaṭaḥkyi sgra drag po bcas 'phar snying ka'i lha sku'i trīḥdang lhan gcig slar yang phaṭa kyi sgra dang bcas shug drag tu phar zla ba'i kha kheb yang 'phar nas 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar zhugs pas/ 'od dpag med nam mkhar yer gyi lding ba dang / chos 'byung 'od sbug yang 'ub kyis 'od dpag med la thim pas 'od dpag med gyad kyi mda' 'phang ba ltar skad cig gi bde ba can du bud+dha a mi ta bha'i thugs kar 'phos te ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ de 'dra lan kha shas kyi 'pho nus par gsungs la/ sngar mtshams med spyad pa'am so thar gyi pham ltung phog pa yin yang / bla ma'i mos gus ldem rgyang ma shor bar gsol 'debs la brtson shing / bla ma dgyes pa'i gnas zhig yin na/ 'pho bas nges par dag zhing ngam mtho ris su skye bar nus la/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas dge ba gzhan 'bad kyang dam tshig sel yod cing bshags pas ma byang ba la ni/ 'pho ba thebs pa'i re che dang bral gyis gang gi yang mi bzlog ste brag ri zhig pa'i sbab rten du med pa ltar mar gyi zang thal lo/ des na 'pho ba theb cing bde 'gro 'dod pa rnams dam tshig la rab tu brtson par gces so/ /'pho ba'i mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag ni 'dir brjod kyi ga la lang / 'dir dang po'i blo can la phan slad dmigs rim cung zad spros te bkod par byas so/ /gsum pa ni/ spyir 'khor ba'i chos mtha' dag bar do yin mod/ bye brag tu bar do rnam pa drug dang ske/ rnam pa bzhi dang / rnam pa gsum du bzhag pa mang yang / don gyi snying por rang bzhin bar dor 'du zhing / der sgro 'dogs gcod pa'o/ /spyir ni dus kun tu nga 'chi ba yin/ da lta bar do'i snang ba yin/lam yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams chen po yin pas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ sems can la snying rjeske/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa rnams brtson pa chen pos 'khrul pa'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi btang bar 'od gsal chos sku ngo shes par bya dgos snyam pa'i zhe bcad drag po'i dran pa rgyun chags su brten nas rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhag 'chi dus kyi 'byung ba'i thim rim snang phyed thob pa nyer thob rnams blor bzhag ste ngos bzung gi 'dun pa dang / khyad par gzugs snang thams cad 'phags pa'i sku sgra grags thams cad yi ge drug gi sngags/ 'gyu rdogs thams cad thugs chos nyid kyi rol par shes shing /dgra gnyen gyi yul la chags sdang gi zhen pa chen po dang / pho mo la mig ser gyi 'dzin chags rang rgyud pa rnams spangs shing bdag gzhan snod bcud thams cad snang stong grags stong rang stong shar grol 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu'i blo dang spyod lam thams cad ma bral ba gal che'o/ /der bar do lam byed kyi chos kyi gnad thams cad 'dus pa'o/ /spyod lam tha mal gyur pa'i lcags khams la/ /thabs la mkhas pas tshogs bsgyur bcud len thebs/ /mdzad med byang chub gter du longs spyod pa'i/ /rin chen 'di ltas don 230

gnyis dbul ba bral/ /rlung sems rten 'brel 'dus mkha' lding gis/ /bde chen gsum brtson gnas sgrod ngo mtshar phul/ /rang sems bar ma dor 'khyams yun rings de/ /bde chen btsan sa da ni bzung bar rig /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /de ltar thugs rje chen po'i rmar khrid las brtsam te man ngag du ma yi snying po btus pa'i gzhung bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rim pa'i stong thun yi dam rab 'byams la 'jug pa'i spyi khrid khyad par can tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma lus par bsgrod par 'dod pa'i gang zag gcig la chos gcig gi chog pa rim gnyis sbyor dngos rjes su tshang ba tshig nyung don rgya che la khyad par 'phags pa'i chos yin pas thar pa byang chen don du gnyer ba rnams kyi 'di la 'bad pas nyams su len par mdzod cig slar yang gdams pa nyams len dang bral na pusto brgya la bskyar sbyang byas bshad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar g.yo zhing / mkhas pa'i nga rgyal seng ge ltar dregs kyang 'chi ba'i dus la bab tshe phan par mi 'gyur bas nyams su blangs ba shin tu gal che la/ spyir thos bsam kun bsgom la gzhol ba'i chad kho na yin cing / deng dus snyigs ma tshe yi lang tsho dman pa'i skabs 'dir 'jig rten gyi bya ba smos kyang ci 'tshal bstan pa la lhag bsam 'ba' zhig ma yin pa'i chos brgyad dang 'dres pa'i thos bsam za zi lasaske/ bla ma'i mos gus ldem rkyang ngos lkog med par rtse gcig gi bsgom bsgrub kho nar 'bad pa zab zhes kyang snying por gdams pa'o/ /de ltar mdo rgyud yongs kyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /nor bu pad+ma'i sgrubs thabs rmad byung gang / /nyung ngu'i tshig gi don mang gsal byed dang / /sngon med bshad dang bskyar bzlos yang min par/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi dga' ston gzhon nu'i tshul/ /thogs med bstan med glegs bam nang nas te/ /legs par bshad kun bla ma'i mthu las yin/ /tshul 'di 'gro 'dren don yod lcags kyur semasaske//'on kyang nyes pa'i cha kun bdag blo yi/ /gnong pas dpang gyur rnams la bzod gsol na/ /nyes med gnang zhing dge legs yon tan du/ /dbugs dbyung thugs rje mnga' ba rnams kyi rtsol/ /tshul 'di lhag pa'i bsam pa kho na yi/ /'bad pa bgyis las byung ba'i dge ba gang / /yongs su bzlum ste nam mkha'i mthar btug pa'i/ /jo bo sems can rnams kyi don du bsngo/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su rnam grol byang chub sems/ /bral smin yon tan yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs/ /ji 'dra'i go 'phang de la myur sbyor shog /zhes 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrubs thabs yongs gces zab bsdus snying po gsal ba'i don khrid legs bshad nyung ngu rab gsal dngos grub 'dod 'byung rin chen za ma tog zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshul 'di lta bu la mos pa'i skal ba can rnams la sman pa'i ched du bgyi 'dun ldan cing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gyur pa mang po'i ring nas bskul ba dang / nye bar rig pa'i gter chen kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi ring lugs dri med 'dzin pa gtsang rong 'bras yul skyed mo'i tshal gyi sde snod 'dzin pa mkhyen rab bstan pa dar rgyas la sogs pa'i lung rig smra ba chen po du mas gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen la brten gu ru'i sgrub gnas gtsang g.yas ru lha ldang brag gi 'dab kham bu lung mtsho rgyal sgrub phug tu rab byung nyi ma'i me 'brug nag zla'i tshes lnga nas brgyad kyi mthun skabs su cung zad 231

bris te grub par shākya'i dge bsnyen rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sde dpal kun tu bas sbyar ba te/ slar yang 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul gar skye ba'i phreng bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bste gnas pa la gnas pa'i 'og min stod lung mtshur mdo bo yi gasdo la yi rtse mor lo de ka'i sa ga zla ba'i yar ngor rang blo la ci thad pa thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul gyi zhus brtag bgyis pa'i snga ma'i yi ge pa ni dad gus brtson pa'i nor ldan dge slong kun bzang nges don gzhan phan dang / khyim ni dge tshul shes rab bstan 'dzin gyi bgyis pa kun tu dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig dge'o/ /dge'o / /gang gi thugs rje chen po'i khri bka' yig cha 'di yi steng nas nyan pas rgyal po lugs dang rmar khrid bzhi yi rgyun gcig tu thob par cha 'gyur lags/ rmar khrid gzhan thob pas khrid 'di thob pa'i go ni mi chod kyi/ des na khrid yig 'di ka'i steng nas zhal lung smin por nyan bsgom gyi yan la gdod rang gi nyams su blang zhing gzhan la 'chad spel 'gro ba'i don rgya che la rgyun mi chad par bgyis 'tshal lo/ /don bzang snyed par 'dod pa'i skye bo rnams/ /don ldan rin chen gter sgo 'di phyes la/ /don mchog gtan gyi 'dun ma grub pa yi/ /don grub rgyal ba'i go 'phangs myur 'dzeg mdzod/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /dge'o—//dge'o/ /o swāste/ sham+bha la'i chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga ste sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa lasaske/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa zla ba bzang po/ sa'i snying po'i sprul pa lha dbang chos rgyal gsum pa gshin rje mthar byed kyi sprul pa gzi brjid can/ chos rgyal bzhi pa sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sprul pa zla bas byin/ chos rgyal lnga pa shes rab mthar byed kyi sprul pa lha'i dbang phyug chos rgyal drug pa pad+ma mthar byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs/ chos rgyal bdun pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa lha'i dbang po rnams dang / rigs ldan dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rigs ldan gnyis pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa pad+ma dkar po/ rigs ldan gsum pa gshin rje gshed kyi sprul pa bzang po/ rigs ldan bzhi pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa rnam rgyal/ rigs ldan lnga pa blos gros mi zad pa'i sprul pa bshes gnyen bzang po/ rigs ldan drug pa gtsug gtor 'khor lor bsgyur ba'i sprul pa phyag dmar/ rigs ldan bdun pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprul pa khyab 'jug sbas pa/rigs ldan brgyad pa bgegs mthar byed kyi sprul pa nyi ma grags/ rigs ldan dgu pa phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa shin tu bzang / rigs ldan bcu pa blo gros rgya mcho'i sprul pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rigs ldan bcu gcig pa shes rab mthar byed kyi sprul pa rgyal ka rigs ldan bcu gnyis pa rdo rje snying po'i sprul pa nyi ma/ rigs ldan bcu gsum pa pad+ma mthar byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs/ rigs ldan bcu bzhi pa byams pa'i sprul pa zla 'od/ rigs ldan bco lnga pa mthu chen gyi sprul pa mtha' yas/ rigs ldan bcu drug pa stobs che'i sprul pa sa skyong / rigs ldan bcu bdun pa zla ba'i 'od kyi sprul pa dpal skyong / rigs ldan bco brgyad pa dra ba can gyi sprul pa seng ge/rigs ldan bcu dgu pa mi g.yo ba'i sprul pa rnam gnon/ rigs ldan nyi shu pa 'od dpag med kyi sprul pa 232

stobs po che/ rigs ldan nyer gcig pa 'dod rgyal gyi sprul pa ma 'gag pa/ rigs ldan nyer gnyis pa spob pa rtsegs kyi sprul pa mi'i seng ge rigs ldan nyer gsum pa dbang phyug sngon can gyi sprul pa dbang phyug chen po/ rigs ldan nyer bzhi pa gnod mdzes rgyal po'i sprul pa mtha' yas rnam rgyal/ rigs ldan nyer lnga pa 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa drag po 'khor lo can rnams so/ /bkra shis/gnyis stong gnyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rdzogs chen mnga' bdag sprul sku zhang gi dgongs/ de la sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya drug cu tham pa na rgya dkar rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs o rgyan thor cog can gyi yul dha na ko sha'i gling zhes bya ba na sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje byung zhing /des bstan pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gtad nas chos nyid zad par gshegs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo lnga brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi lon pa'i dus dang / slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi shrī sidha la bstan pa gtad nas chos nyid zad par gshegs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad brgya dang sum cu lon la/ de bzhin slob dpon chen po shrī sirnyas tsā na pu tra la bstan pa gtad pa'i dus su sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas dgu brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi lon no/ /rgyal ba dzñā na pu tras bi ma la mi trar bstan pa gtad skabs sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa bzhi song zhes rdzogs chen snying thig gi bab lugs chen mo las brda' brgyud gnas 'byed bdun ma zhes slob dpon chen mo bi ma la dang / lo tsā ba ka cog gi bsgyur ba nas 'byung ltar ro/ /slob dpon bi ma la mi tra dang / jimanga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan bsam yas dbu rtse'i sgo mdun du mjal phrad mdzad pa na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang dgu bcu tham pa lon zhes dang / yang dpe kha cig tu stong dang brgyad cu tham pa yang snang ngo / /de skabs bi ma la lo sum brgya bzhes te/ dgung snying glang du 'dod do/ /slob dpon chen po de gdul bya thun mong gi snang ngor bod du lo bcu gsum bzhugs nas thog mar rgyu yi theg pa dang / lo bcu 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gsung zhing mthar rgya nag po'i yul lci ba thub pa'i ri la gshegs so/ /bi ma la rgya nag bzhugs nas lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga nas nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po rang rgyud rnam par dag nas mi ma yin gyi rdzas dang yo byas blangs nas/ zhwa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs su gsol ba'i nang du rdzogs chen snying thig gi skor rnams ke'u tshang sgo khang gi yang steng dang ka ba'i bsam le gsum gyi khong gseng du sbas so/ /de nas lo brgya na ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gter nas bton te/ /de tshe sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang sum brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad lon no/ /'di yi ge gzhan kha cig tu nyang ban gyi byi ba'i lo dgun zla tha chung du gter du sbas la ldang mas 'brug lo ston zla 'bring po'i nya la bton par gsung ba yang byi ba nas 'brug gi bar lo brgya shin tu 'grig go /ldang mas gter blangs nas lo bco lnga bar rang gi nyams su blangs zhing / de nas rje btsun la man ngag rnams grangs bdun snang / de nas lo gsum zer yang gzhan du lo bco lnga yang gsung la/ gang ltar ldang mas lce btsun gdams pa'i snod 233

bzang bar gzigs nas kha rag tu nya drug zla bar dpe brgyud yongs su rdzogs par gtad/ /de yi dus sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo chig stong sum brgya brgyad cu rtsa brgyad song ngo / /lce btsun gyi gter dpe rnams yig mkhan lnga yi bshus shing zhu tig nyang dpal 'byung gis grogs mdzad nas len drug mdzad/ snod ldan gyi slob ma btsal yang ma rnyed pas/ skor gsum man ngag brgyud bcas byi lo dpyid ra'i nya la lang 'gro chad pa stag 'dra'i gong dang / gsang ba snying thig skor 'brug lo dgun ra'i stong la 'u yug nub ma'i brag seng ge 'dra ba dang / yang gsang bla med rnams spre lo dgun zla tha chung nyi ma rlung bar du chud pa'i dus su bya bral gyi phu brag dkar them pa dang / skor gsum phyi mo rnams sle mtshan gsum gyi ri la gter du sbas shing / lce btsun grub pa ma thob gong du lo bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / grub pa thob nas kyang lnga bcu ste khyon brgya dang nyer lnga bzhugs so/ /lce btsun chen po me snang bar gshegs nas lo sum cu na rong gi lce sgom nag pos chang 'gro chad pa kha nas skor gsum gyi gter kha thon/ de nas lo lnga bcu song ba na zhang ston bkra shis rdo rjes 'o yug nub ma'i brag nas gsang ba snying thig gis skor gter nas thon teske/ de yi dus sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya drug cu rtsa brgyad lon par dgongs so/ /bi ma la bod du phebs pa nas 'di yi bar gyi lo grangs bla ma dam pa rim par byon pa yi gsung sprul pa'i sku zhang ston bkra shis rdo rjes bkod pa ltar te/ 'di la yi ge cung zad mi 'dra ba snang yang ske/ gzhan yid ches phyir da lta dpe rgyun mang du gnas pa las btus pa yin la/ zhang ston de me glang la 'khrungs lo nyer gcig me bya la gter ston zhes snga 'gyur gyi gzigs pa yangs po rnams kyi gsung zhing ske/ gter me bya la bton pa ni zhang gi dngos slob ston gyis byas pa'i yi ger yang snang bas yid ches kyi gnas so/ /de tshe sangs rgyas kyi 'das lo gong gi stong dang lnga brgya re drug song ba ni/ chu byar yong bas de la so drug 'bri'am nyer bzhi bsnan na me bya dang 'grig la/ 'phrin las pa'i phyogs de 'thad shas che bar sems so/ /me bya de nas lo zhe gcig 'das pa'i sa stag la/ zhang ston de gnyis kyi sras nyi ma 'bum 'khrungs shing / lo der ding ri glang 'khor dam pa'i gdan sa ba phyar chung gshegs pa dang / bder gshegs rdor rgyal gyi phag grur dgon pa mdzad pa rnams dus mtshungs par shes so/ /des na gong gi me bya de nas da lta'i me stag bar la lo drug brgya dang sum cu song bas/ de lo stong dang lnga brgya re brgyad la byin pas nyis stong chig brgya go brgyad/ de la nyer bzhi bsnan pa na/ nyis stong brgya nyer gnyis dang so drug phrin las dpag na gnyis stong chig brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi 'gro'o/ /234

gag /sgra yi gnas brgyad go bder mdor bstan bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsnyi/ na mo gu ru pad+ma dhe wan sā ra ru tse ye/ kun khyab 'gro ba'i snying dbus rtag gnas pa/ /kun la phan bde byed po kun tu bzang / /'char nub bral ba'i nyi ma dam chos kyi/ /'od zer kun tu 'phro der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /tshe 'dir shes rab slob dpon zla med mgon/ /pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i spyan snga bkra shis kyi/ /'byung gnas mchog gyur bde chen rnam par rgyal/ /thar gling 'dren pa mchog des dge legs stsolaske/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi shes bya'i gnas/ /mtha' dag bslab zhes rgyal bas gdams/ /de phyir kun mkhyen thob pa'i phyir/ /rig gnas kun la 'jug par bya/ /khyad par don gnyis mtshon pa'i phyir/ /legs sbyar sgra yi rig pa ste/ /de phyir rkyen 'gyur ting sub kyi/ /sub la rnam dbye rnam grangs brgyad/ /ngo bo bya byed dgos ched dang / /'byung khung 'brel pa gnas bzhi dang / /kun la gcig gnyis mang tshig re/ /'bod phyir sde tshan dang po ldab/ /de rnams brda' sprod gzhung rnams su/ /dpe ru brjod pa sna tshogs mdzad / /sngon rnams shing la dper brjod mang / 'dir yang go bder de bzhin bya/ /shing dang shing dag shing rnams ni/ /rnam rtags kyi don dbye dang po'i gcig tshig dang / /gnyis tshig mang tshig rim bzhin te//'og ma kun la de bzhin sbyor/ /khyab gnyis pa shing la rlung gi bskyod/ /shing gzhogs las sogs bya ba'i dpeske/ /gsum pa shing gi byed pa po'i grub pa'i mtha'/ khang pa byas/ /gi mthar sa yig byed sgra yin/ /bzhi pa sbyin pa'i snod/ rkang thung la chu drangs/ /dgos ched kyis ni dpe ru bstan/ /shing las me tog 'bras bu 'byung tso/ /lnga pa de zhing ltung ba 'byung khungs dpe ru 'gyur/ /'bral tshig rnam dbye drug 'brel la pa'i sgra/ /dpe na shing gi sdong po dang / /rtsa rtse'i me tog 'bras bu sogs/ /kun la drug sgra gi zhes sbyor/ /bdun rten du gyur pa'o/ / pa shing la bya gnas zhes/ /gnas bzhi'i dpe ru mdzad par snang / /brgyad par skye shing la sogs pa/ /thog mtha' gang yin 'bod tshig sbyar/ /kun la ngo bo nyid dang ni/ /dag dang rnam sogs rim pa bzhin/ /rnam dbye dang po'i skabs bstan ltar/ /sbyar bas rnam grangs nyer bzhir 'gyur/ /de yang rnam dbye gnyis pa dang / /bzhi pa bdun pa'i la yig ni/ /gnod pa dang ni phan pa dang / /btang snyoms rnams su bstan pa yin/ /byed pa dang ni 'bral sgra dag /phan tshun nor 'khrul 'byung bas na/ /de gnyis phan tshun ma nor bar/ /legs par bzung zhes mkhas pas gsungs/ /'jam dbyangs thu ma'i gsung las ni/ /drug sgra gi kyi gyi 'i yi/ /rnam gsung de mthar sa sbyar na/ /gsum pa'i sgrar gsung ji skad du/ /de nyid la ni bcu pa sbyar/ /byed pa po ru shes par bya/ /khyad par gi sogs gang yin de'i/ /'og tu las dang bya ba'i sgra//dngos po gang yin de nyid la/ /phan dang gnod pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /byung na gang gi dngos po der/ /byed tshig nges par dgos zhes gsungs/ /'phags yul rnam dbyer nyer bzhi'i sgra/ /bod du mdor bsdus 235

de tsam ste/ /'di yang ji bzhin rtogs pa na/ /don mang gsal bar byed pa yin/ /gang zhig gser gyi ri bo la—/ /gnas 'gyur 'dab chags gser gyi mdog /de bzhin mkhas par brten byas na/ /blun po dag kyang blo gros skyes/ /de skad legs par sbyar ba lha yi skad/ /brda sprod phyogs su gyur pa'i tshig 'di yang / /mkhyen rab dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /drin las rang gi nus pas nam yang min/ /des na legs par bshad kun bla ma'i mthu/ /nyes kun bdag blos nongs pa kho na yin/ /'di bshad dge bas jo bo sems can la/ /bsngo mthu'i kun mkhyen myur thob rgyur gyur cig /de ltar rnam par dpe dbye ba gnas brgyad kyi go bde mdo tsam 'di ni gtsang la stod grom pa dpal gyi sa skya dang ha cang gi mi ring bar dam pa sangs rgyas kyi dngos slob skyo don ye shes bla ma yi bste gnas ra sa spang lung gi bya 'dabs kye re rig gnas lding du ma hā lo tsā ba bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung la ji ltar snang ba bzhin rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i chu glang gi lo dbyug gu zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa la bris pa phyis tshig sbyor cung zad bcos par byas pa ste dge legs su gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ /

༄ga /'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad snying po rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yid bzhin mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ susti/ na mo gu ru mañdzu badz+re bh+yaḥ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad snying po rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yid bzhin mchog sbyin ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab mi shig rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /'pho bcas dri ma dang bcas 'jigs tshogs lta/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor mtha' dag 'jig mdzad dpal/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjes rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /gang gi sgrub thabs snying po ni/ /rgyun khyer tshig nyung don gsal ba/ /yid bzhin mchog sbyin rin chen gang / /spel bas rgyal ba dgyes gyur cig /de yang bcom ldan 'das dpal khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob bla ma'i zhal lung legs par nos pa'i sgrub pa pos gang gi rnal 'byor rgyun gyi nyams len la gcig tu brtson par bya ste/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ dur khrod du dbugs bral gdan la 'dug par mos nas 'di skad do/ /rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i snying dbus pad nyi la gnas pa'i rgyu yig nag po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma mi skyod pas dbu rgyan pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs ma lus pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥn mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo badz+ra lha ra wa sgyeḥ rnam rtog dra ba rab gsal zhing / /ye shes rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' ba/ 'jam dpal khro bo dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje 'dzin bcas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra lā su rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra mā l+ya tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra gi n+ti hriḥ oṃ badz+ra ni dhi āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe r+ghaṃḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke trīḥ oṃ badz+ra ghadhe āḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong bskyed par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bder gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid thob par shog /oṃ swa bha shud+dha sarba dharma su bha wa burnyophor+ghaṃ/ stong ngang chos 'byung dkar dmar kha gyen bstan/ /dbus rgyu sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu//phyogs mdog lte mthing la gnas r+ghaṃ 'od zer//rdo rje sa gzhi rwa gur bla bras gtam/237

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ /de dbus thod skam bzlum ra sgo gcig pa/ /phyi nang sa gzhi khrag zhag keng rus gdung / /g.yang bzhi bla bra rgyu rlon lda ldi brgyan/ /dbus phyur rtse mo rdo rje rin chen tog /phyi rol gtum drag la sogs dur khrod brgyad/ /shing me chu srin ri bo mchod rten brgyad/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu brgyad ma srin dang / /sha za gshin rje ro langs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /lang long ha ha ku co brag cha bcas/ /lhang lhang 'bod rgyu yid bsgyur sna tshogs spyod/ /bya gcan rnam mang 'thab 'khrug nga ro 'don/ /g.yo med gar byed ro langs dang keng rus/ /mdungs skyon shing dpyangs mes tshig sha rus khrag /klad pa thor dang dum bus khebs pa dang / /grub pa'i rdzas dang yo byad mchod pa'i rdzas/ /du mas yongs khengs sgrub po dang grub pa/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dpa' rnams rang dam spyod/ /'ga' ni thod rnga sgra bcas dga' gar rolaske/ /de dbus yo las rlung dkyil du ba'i mdog /de steng sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab steng lter/ /re las nyi stong a thung zla ba la/ /dhīḥlas ral gridhīḥmatshan yongs gyur pa/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dmar ser mtshan dpe rdzogs/ /ral gri ut+pal la gnas pusti bsnams/ /zhi sgeg rgyan spras thor gtsug zur phud lnga/ /rdo rje'i gdan gyi bzhugs pa'i thugs ka ru/ /āḥyig gnyis pa las skyes nyer gnas r+ghaṃ/ /'od kyis de bzhin gshegs byang khro yum bcas/ /drangs thim 'jam dpal zla bcas nyi mar thim/ /tsha zer 'bar pas dpag tshad 'bum khyab gyur/ /de las 'od 'phros rgyal gsung dbyangs gsal sngags/ /rang sgra bcas thim rgyu mthing 'od lnga 'bar/ /'od kyi sangs rgyas thugs ye phyag mtshan tshul/ /drangs thim rdo rje nag po rtse lnga gdeng glu/ /gshegs khro rdo rje'i sprin 'phros sdang gdug bcom/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sar bkod zhing khams sbyangs / /sangs rgyas sras bcas snang srid khro bo'i sku/ /mtha' dag gcig 'dus bdag nyid bcom ldan 'dasaske/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad che/ /mun ltar ches gnag ngam za'i sku ru gyur/ /o trīḥsbyiḥwi kṛ tā na na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ /zhal dgu rtsa zhal mthing nag ma he'i gdong / /sngo rno rdo rje me 'bar rwas phyogs mnon/ /rwa'i g.yas zhal gsum sngo dmar ser ches khros/ /g.yon gsum dkar dud nag po mche gcigs dpa'/ /rwa dbus bar zhal dmar 'jigs srin po'i gdong / /zhal nas khrag 'dzag ha ha phe zhes bzhad/ /steng zhal 'jam dpal spyan gsum 'dzum khro ser/ /zur phud lnga ldan byis pa'i rgyan bzang sprasaske/ /khro zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ /drag rgod rtsa dang phaṭa sgra gnam du 'bod/ /dgra bgegs sha dang rkang tshil zas su za/ /khro gnyer rab bsdus 'bar smin 'khyog por bcus/ /dmar zlum spyan gsum sdang mig blta zhing bzlog /skra ser gyen 'bar smin rdzi sma spu me/ /'jigs 'das lha kun sdig mdzub kyis sdig byed/ /mi bshad zhal rnams mche bzhi ljags 'dril ba/ /'jigs rung 'brug stong lta bu'i 'tshams rngam sgra/ /gad rgyangs chen po'i bdud sde'i snying 'phrig 'gas/ /sku lus che rags yan lag nying 238

lag kun/ /sbom thung hrag 'grang lang tsho la bab pa/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ /rab rgyas liṅga gyen du bsgrengs / /rtsa phyag thugs kar 'phyar tshul gyi/ /rdo rje gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /lhag ma sum cu rtsa gnyis phyag /g.yas rnams 'phang mdung gtun shin dang / /chu gri rtse gcig sta re mdung / /mda' dang lcags kyu dbyugs kha ṭ+wāṃ/ /'khor lo rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /tho ba ral gri te'u chung 'dzin/ /g.yon rnams tshangs mgo phub rkang pa/ /zhag gzhu rgyu ma dril bu lag /ro ras skyes bu gsal zhing gzer/ /me thabs bdud rtsi'i bkang thod tshal/ /sdig mdzub phan rtse gsum rlung ras/ /mtha' gnyis glang lpags khrag 'dzog gon/ /gyad stobs brkyang bskum bcu drug zhabs/ /srid gsum g.yo 'dar g.yas brgyad kyi/ /mi dang ma ho glang bong bu/ /rnga mo khyi lug wa skyes rnams/ /g.yon rgod 'ug pa khwa ne tsho/ /bong khra bya chen skyeg bzhad gnon/ /de 'og tshangs dbang khyab 'jug drag /tshogs bdag gdong drug nyi zla bskyil/ /gcer bu rus rgyan khrag zhal thal chen byug /gtum chen 'jigs rung thod skam lngas dbu brgyan/ /khrag zhag brgya phyed rgyu mar ldan do shal/ /gdug pa'i klu chen sbrul nag mchod phyir thogs/ /sprul pa'i pho nya pho mo dpag med 'phro/ /'jigs dus me ltar drag 'khrug me klong bzhugs/ /srid gsum gtsos kyang lta bar mi bzod pa'i/ /shin tu rmad byung khro bo'i sku ru gyur/ /de yi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ /de yi thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' r+ghaṃ nag po/ /mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po sa yi snying po/ /rna bar dzi sngon po phyag na rdo rje/ /sna la khaṃ ser po nam mkha'i snying po/ /lce la gam dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug /dpral bar kai ljang khu sgrib pa rnam sel/ /lte bar si dkar po kun tu bzang po/ /spyi bor oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ /thugs kar r+ghaṃ sngon po thugs rdo rje rnams su gyur/ /de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer mkha' dbyings thams cad du son pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ o trīḥsbyi wi kṛ ta na na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā r+ghaṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ ghadhe/ nai we h+yeske/ zhes sbyar bas mchod/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ ya man+ta ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pasane/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a gi ṣ+peñtsa r+ghaṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur lus kyi nang thams cad gang ske/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad dbang bar byas/chu'i dang ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭi lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra lha ra wa rū pa badzi ā r+ghaṃḥ de bzhin du/shajaske/ ghadhe/ ra sa/ spar+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra lha ra wa dharma dha tu badzi ā r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā su sogs gong bzhin dang / /gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel 239

la mtshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ bsnams par mdzod/ /mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu ma/ /dges pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol du gsol/ ho/ chags pa med pa'i chags pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta su dza badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3r+ghaṃ/ rgyu dur khrod rgyan gyi legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ste badz+ra su bha āt+ma kohwahaṃ/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas bde ba sgom par mos la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra su bha wa āt+ma kophohaṃ / zhes brjod do/ /nang mchod 'dus byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabasaglu/ g.yon mtheb srin gyis lce la bzhag oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ brjod/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra su bha wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ de nas rdzas dmigs bcas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru / ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra mā ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ trīḥsbyi wi kri ta na na phroṃ phaṭa/ o ya man+ta ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ mthar bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyi khams gsum kun/ /gzhal yas lhar gyur 'od zhu bsrung 'khor la/ /de yang gzhal yas de yang rang nyid thim/ /rang gi zhal phyag rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la/ /de yang 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings su zhugs/ /slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis sku ru ldang / /dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ mig tu k+ṣ-i/ rna bar sgro/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gi dpral bar ski/ lte bar saṃ rnams kyis rgyas btab par gyur brjod cing bsam la dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na lag len ltar gtor ma bshams la/ byin rlabs bsdu na/ nang mchod skabs ltar dang / rgyas par bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las yo las rlung / ram̐ las me/ kai las mi mgo sgyid bu gsum la a las thod pa/ de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga'i steng du bi ra shu mu las bdud rtsi lnga dang / k+ṣe ma da ya las ye shes lnga rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas zhu ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam pas rang gi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar bab pa'i rkyen gyis bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsir zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ o āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ mang du brjod/ rang gi mdun du khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad 'khor lo'i tshogs ma lus pa bzhugs par gyur/ de rnams kyi ljags r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'od zer gyi sbu gu'i gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ sngags gsum ka'i snying po'i mthar/ sarba gisnan na sha trun mā ra ya i dam bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ o badz+ra lā su hūm̐ sogs kyi mchod snying po'i mtha' 240

'bru gsum btags la nang mchod phul/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes pa nas/ dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nasaglu/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /zhes pa'i bar gyi 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyongs rnams la 'bul/ gsum pa phyogs skyongs rnams la 'bul te rang gi snying kha nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las khro bo lcags kyu zhags pa thog pa dpag tu med pa spros te phyogs skyongs thams cad bkug par gyur/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ sarba gisnan na sha trun mā ra ya i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ r+ghaṃ da sha di ka i rda sarba duṭaṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥphyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ brgya byin sogs mtshams brgyad dang / dbus kyi g.yas su tshangs pa/ g.yon du sa yi lha mo rnams rang rang 'khor tshogs dpag med kyi bskor de bzhugs par gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas khro bo phur bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ da sha di ka a dī ni sarba duṭaṃ badz+ra tī ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ grub pa'i dngul chu'i bcud kyis reg pa nas/ khams rnams gser du gyur pa ji lta bar/ /rdo rje phur bu'i reg pa tsam gyis kyang / /phyogs skyongs 'khor bcas gshin rje gshed du gyur/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ma twe'i gdong pa can gcer bu liṅga gyen du sgrengs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyi brgyan pa/ rang rang gi bzhon pa'i steng du g.yon bskyangs gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ nas rgyas btab par gyur gyi bar gong ltar/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa nas chu'i dngas ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hriḥ ya ma ya ṣ+ṭiḥ wa ru ṇa ya wi/ ku be ra ya kri/ i shwa na ya ta/ asna ye.a/ ni h+ye na/ wa ya we na/ brah+pha ye r+ghaṃ/ ba sun dha ra ṇa ye phaṭa/sarba bhu te bh+yoḥha ha hi hi r+ghaṃ rgyu dze tse phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa gang rigs kyis phul la/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥ zhes sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shaja'i bar gyi mchod/ trīḥsbyi mthar 'bru gsum brtags la nang mchod 'bul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo 'dul dka' 'dul mdzad pa/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'dudaske/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'phrin las bcol/ bzhi pa gshen rje chos rgyal la 'bul te/ mdun du ya las chos kyi rgyal po mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i cha byad rdzogs pa thod dbyug dang zhags pa thog pa gcer bu liṅga bsgreng zhing g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ma ho la gnas pa'i g.yon du tsam las tsa muṇ+ḍi nag mo khros pa'i cha byad can tri shul dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor 241

oske/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros lho phyogs sa 'og nas chos rgyal yab yum spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha gshin rje gshed rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe nas shabha'i bar gyi mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aḥbhi ṣiñtsa tu me/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung bum chus bskur/ sku gang nyes skyon dag yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa res dbu brgyan/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar kā la ru pa sā mā s+t+waṃ zhes dbyug pa'i phyag rgyas dam pa bzhag oṃ kā la ru pa sarba bhisnan sha trun mā ra ya i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ oṃ trīḥtsa muṇ+ḍa sarba sogs sbyar te lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shardo'i bar gyi mchod/ /'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul//'chi bdag dam can gshin rje ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag brnyan de/ /ma gshin 'byung po'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin zhes sogs 'phrin las bcol/ slar yang 'jig rten 'das pa dang / /'jig rten pa thams cad la dmigs mchod pa bsdus pa zhig byas la bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha
