tshogs rnams dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang / de'i sdong grogs mdzad cing bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang yid la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang / yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ o badz+ra r+bha ra wa sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra yuḥ oṃ ka la ru pa sa pa ri wa ra gats+tsha/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /bdug pa 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rung pa rnams tshar gcod shog /gzhan yang smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang du brjod do/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul 'gog pa med pa'i rang gzugs 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che kun mkhyen rgyal ba bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta mchog gi zhal snga nas kyi bka' yi bskul ba la brten/dpal chen po rje btsun ra lo snga phyi'i mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ji bzhin par kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje dpal 'bar gyis khro bo shing glang nag zla'i nyer lnga mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus su rkong yul mthil rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba 'brug chos lding du bkod pa dge'o//sarba maṅga lo bha wan+tu/242

༄ga /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ na mo gu ru we/ dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /'jam dpal khro bo la phyag 'tshal/ /de sgrub rgyun gyi rnal 'byor mchog /snying po tsam zhig bshad par bya/ /de yang dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas dur khrod du dbugs bral gdan la gnas par bsam la 'di skad do/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed gsal ba'i snying dbus pad nyi la gnas la r+ghaṃ yig nag po las 'od 'phros/ bla ma mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs ma lus pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo badz+ra hai ra wa bh+yaḥ rnam rtog dra ba rab gsal zhing / /ye shes rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' ba/ /'jam dpal khro bo dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje 'dzin bcas phyag 'tshal lo oṃ badz+ra lā su r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma l+ya ṭ+wāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra girti trīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke trīḥ oṃ badz+ra ghadhe aḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyeraske/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi bral zhing ske//chos kun mnyam nyid thob par shog /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma su bha wa shur+sāphohaṃ/ /stong ngang chos 'byung dkar dmar kha gyen bstan/ /dbus rdu sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu/ /phyogs mdog lte mthing la gnas r+ghaṃ 'od zer/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur bla bras gtam/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ /de dbus thod skam zlum ra sgo gcig pa/ /phyi nang sa gzhi khrag zhag keng rus gdung / /g.yang gzhi'i bla bra rgyu rlon lda ldib brgyanaske//dbus phyur rtse mo rdo rje rin chen tog /phyi rol gtum drag la sogs dur khrod brgyad/ /shing me chu sprin ri bo mchod rten brgyad/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu brgyad ma srin dang / /sha za gshin rje ro langs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /lus ngag rnam 'gyur du mas yid bsgyur spyod/ /bya gcan 'thab 'khrug ro langs keng rus gar/ /mi ro 'phyar skyang sreg gtub glad khrag sha /rus dum 'thor khebs mchod grub rdzas yod 243

khengasaske/ /rnal 'byor grub rig dpa' rnams rang dam spyod/ /'ga' ni thod rnga sgra bcas dga' gar rol/ /de dbus yam las rtsom chen dkyil 'khor steng / /pad nyi'i gdan la a thung las skyes zlar/ /dhīḥlas ral gri dhī mtshan yongs gyur pa/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dmar ser mtshan dpe rdzogs/ /ral gri ut+pal la gnas pu ste bsnams/ /zhi sgeg rgyan spras thor tshugs zur phud lnga/ /rdo rje gdan gyi bzhugs pa'i thugs ka ru/ /āḥyig gnyis pa las skyes nyer gnas r+ghaṃ/ /'od kyi de bzhin gshegs byang khro yum bcas/ /drangs bsnyim 'jam dpal zla bcas nyi mar thim/ /tsha zer 'bar bas dpag tshad 'bum khyab gyur/ /de las 'od 'phros rgyal gsung dbyangs gsal sngags/ /rang sgra bcas thim r+ghaṃ mthing 'od lnga 'bar/ /'od kyi sangs rgyas thugs ye phyag mtshan tshul/ /drang thim rdo rje nag po rtse lnga gdengs/ /khro chung rdo rje'i sprin 'phros sdang gdug bcom/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sar bkod zhing khams sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas snang srid khro bo'i sku/ /mtha' dag gcig bsdus bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das/ khams gsum rnam rgyal kun tu khro bo'i dbang / /'jigs pa'ang 'jigs mdzad gcig pu dpal chen po/ /shin tu nag po'i gzugs 'chang ngam za ba/ /dbu dgu rtsa zhal ma ho che ches khros/ /rdo rje'i ra rnon sngo sangs me 'bar bas/ /phyogs kun rab gnon rwa yi g.yas g.yon du/ /gsum gsum zhal ldan g.yas sngo dmar ser khros/ /g.yon dkar dud nag che gcigs dpa' ba'i gzhal/ /ra dbus srin gdong rab gzhad khrag 'dzag zhal/ /ha ha be+e sgrog de steng 'jam dpal zhal/ /ser 'dzum zur phud lnga ldan me tog thod/ /kun kyang spyan gsum khros pa'i zhal thams cad/ /khro gnyer rab bsdus dmar bzlum sdang spyan ldog /rnam par 'gyur zhal drag rgod r+ghaṃ phaṭa sgra/ /gnam 'go mche bzhi ljags 'dril mi bzad zhal/ /dgra bgegs rkang glang sha tshil zas za zhing ske/ /'brug stong 'jigs rlung sgra bzhin bzod dka' yi/ /gad rgyang drag pos bdud sde'i snying 'gem byedaske/ /skra ser gyen brjes 'bar sbyin 'khyog por bcus/ /smin rdzi sma spu me stag ji bzhin 'tsher/ /sku lus che rag rdo rje gsus po che/ /rab rgyas liṅga gyen bsgrengs lang tshorawāb/ /yan lag nying lag sbom thung hrag shing mkhrangs/ /'jigs 'das lha kun sdig mdzub gyis bstigs byed/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che/ /dang po gnyis kyi gri thod thugs kar 'dzin/ /mtha' gnyis glang lpags khrag 'dzag gos su gyonaske/ /lag g.yas 'phang mdung gtun shing chu gri dang / /rdo rje rtse gcig dgra sta mdung ring mda'/ /lcags kyu dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga thod ral rdo chung 'dzin/ /g.yon rnams tshang mgo phub rkang dang zhag zhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa ro ras dang / /gsal shing gyis phug skyes bu me 'bar 'thab//bcud thod sdig mdzub 'phan rtse gsum rlung ras/ /gyad stobs rkyang bskum bcu drug zhabs g.yas brgyadaglu/ /mi dang ma ho glang po rnga mong khyi/ /lug wa zhabs g.yon rgod 'ug khā ne tsho/ /bong khra bya chen ri 244

skegs gzhad rnams rdzis/ /de 'og bdud bzhi gdong drug la sogs pa/ /'jig rten dreg pa'i tshogs rnams bsgyel zhing gnon/ /srid gsum g.yo 'bar dbang byed shin tu gtum/ /gcer bu khrag zhag thal byug rus rgyan spras/ /'jigs rung thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing / /mgo rlon brgya phyed sgyu mar ldan do shal—/ /klu rgyal gdugs pa sbrul nag mchod phyir thog /sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spro/ /'jigs dus me ltar drag 'bar 'khrug mo'i klong / /lta ba tsam yang mi bzod sku ru shar/ /thugs dkar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ting 'dzin hūṃ mthing rtag gsal 'bar bstan gyur/ /mig tu k+ṣi dkar po sa yi snying po/ rna bar dz+re sngon po phyag na rdo rje/ /sna la khaṃ ser po nam mkha'i snying po/ /lce la gi dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug /dpral bar ski ljang gu sgrib pa rnams sel/ /lte bar saṃ dkar po kun tu bzang po7/ /spyi bor oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ /thugs kar r+ghaṃ sngon po thugs rnams su gyur/de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer mkha' dbyings thams cad du son pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ hriḥsbyi wi kri tā na na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā r+ghaṃ/ de bzhin dhu pe/ a lo ke/ ghadhe/ rna wi tre zhes sbyar bas mchod/ /bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ o sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ su ra ta ste/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad dbang bar byas/ chu'i dang ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi spyod pas dbu brgyanaske/ dzaḥr+ghaṃḥbaṃ r+ghaṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs la/ hri sbyiḥlan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra lā su sogs sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra su bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ nang mchod 'dus byas la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥbyin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi lce la bzhag oṃ aḥrgyu oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra bhā wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ thugs ka nas yid kyi rigs ma mā ma ki spros/ snyoms par zhugasaske/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ hūṃ/ dur khrod rgyan gyi legs brgyan pa'iske//zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni//spros med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i//ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga pu ti badz+ra su bhā wa at+ma kolhahaṃske/ de nas bzlas pa'i man ngag snying kha'i 'jam dpal thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i nyi gdan la r+ghaṃ mthar sngags 'phreng mdun nas g.yas skor 'khod pa gsal btab la 'phro 'du ji ltar rigs pa bcas te—/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ma rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ trī:sbyi wi kri ta na na rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/zhes sngags gsum ci nus dang skabs su/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥyang ji rigs zla bar gsung mthar/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyi khams gsum kun/ /gzhal 245

yas lhar gyur 'od zhu bsrung 'khor la/ /de yang gzhal yas de yang rang nyid thim/ /rang gi zhal phyag rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la/ /de yang 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings su zhugs/ /slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis sku ru ldang ske//dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ mig tu k+ṣi/ rna bar dzi/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gi dpral bar skiske/ lte bar saṃ rnams kyi rgyas btab par gyur brjod cing bsam la dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/byin rlabs bsdus pa nang mchod skabs ltar dang / rgyas par bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las yo las rlung ram̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum la a las thod pa de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga'i steng du bhi ra bu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga k+ṣe me da ya las ye shes lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam pas rang gi zhal du zhugs yum gyi khar bab pa'i rkyen gyis bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsir zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥrgyu ha ho trīḥmang du brjod/ rang gi mdun du khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs mdzad 'khor lo'i tshogs ma lus pa zhugs par gyur/ de rnams ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gu'i gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ sngags gsum ka'i snying po'i mthar/sarba thasnan sha trun ma ra ya i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi rgyu phaṭa/ lan bdun gyi 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra lā gye r+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum la btags la nang mchod 'bul/ dur khrod rgyan gyis bstodaglu/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /zhes pa'i bar gyi 'dod don gsol ba btab/ /lhag ma phyogs skyong dang gshin rje chos rgyal la 'bul tshul ni gzhan du bstan par ltar bya'o/ /de ltar 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi/ /go 'phang sgrub byed rnal 'byor lam/ /shin tu khyer bde don gsal 'dis/ /bdag gzhan dpal der myur 'grub shog /ces pa yang 'gro mgon dpal ldan 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che kun mkhyen rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta mchog gi thugs kyi dgyes pa sgrub pa'i slad du rnal 'byor pa a yu rī sha ma ṇi'i bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 246

༄ga /dpal rta mchog nag po'i dbang bshad yid ches dam pa'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ma hā gu ru hā ya shrī wa r+ghaṃ/ rgyal kun gsung 'dus rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /mtsho skyes bla ma rnam rol gar rgya'i 'phrul/ /rta mchog nag po dbang drag 'dus pa'i gtso/ /de yi dbang bshad mdo tsam 'dir spel bya//slob ma rnams gral la 'khod nas khrus dang bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor bcas grub nas/'o da lam 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gsang ba bla na med pa dpal rta mchog he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la yid spro ba'i phyir lo rgyus mdo tsam 'chad na/ de yang rgyal ba chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med pa'i ngang du gdul bya'i snang ngor gang la gang 'dul gyi sku gnyis su ston te/ gti mug can la zhi ba/'dod chags can la zhi ma khro/ zhe sdang can la khro bo'i skur ston par mdzad cing / de yang rta mchog pad+ma dbang chen po 'di nyid ci ltar byung zhe na bskal pa sngon byung gi dus der bdag 'dzin srid pa'i ma tram̐ ru tras lha mi'i bde ba yongs su bcom nas ngan song 'khor ba'i sgo chen po dbye zhing 'jig rten 'khrug par gyur pa de nyid 'dul ba'i don du dpal he ru kar phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma lus lus pa med par bsdus te/ dpal rta mchog pad+ma dbang chen po'i skur bstan nas ru tra dregs pa'i sde 'khor ma lus bsgral zhing thar pa'i gnas su bkod do/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings me ri 'bar ba dang / lcang lo can dang / mā la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gnas rnams su khrag 'thung khro bo rol pas gsang sngags bla med rgyud sde ji snyed du gsung bar mdzad pa dang / bar du nub phyogs o rgyan gyi gnas su klu rgyal gti mug can rnams 'dul ba'i don du rdo rje phag gdong rta gdong du ston te/ klu rigs ma lus dbang du bsdu ba dang / gzir mnan cing bzlog pa la sogs gang 'dul gyi 'gro don skyong mthar klu rigs thams cad mkha' spyod dpa' bo dhā kir gyur te/ o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro'i gnas gsang sngags 'byung ba'i khungs chen por gyur/ de yi rjes su mi 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba dang rigs drug yongs kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs ba'i phyir du 'od dpag med mgon rta mchog de nyid o rgyan sirtsa'i gnas dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du u dum wa ra 'khor lo khri 'phang bzhi pa'i snying por rang byung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi skur snang nas/ thog mar o rgyan gyi gnas su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i tshul gyi gdul bya bskyangs/ bar du dur khrod chen po rnams su spyod pa mdzad cing ma mo mkha' 247

'gro dbang du bsdud mthar lha klu mi dang mkha' spyod dbyings kyi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi drung du phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa chos sgo grangs las 'das pa thams cad gsan sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul bstan cing yi dam gyi lha dang mi gnyis par gyur zhing / de nas gdul bya 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar sku lnga mtshan brgyad sprul pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa bstan te gang la gang 'dul gyi chos 'khor bskor zhing / khyad par 'dzam gling rgya dkar nag li bal la sogs yul gru du ma dang / sgos su rgyal ba gzhan gyis 'dul bar dka' ba'i byang phyogs gdong dmar bod kyi gnas 'di nyid du zhabs kyis bcags shing gzugs can gyi mi rnams thugs rje chen po dang / bud med rnams rje btsun sgrol mas 'dul bar mdzad cing / mi ma yin rnams dpal khro rgyal rta mgrin gyi sgo nas btul ba dang / de bas shin tu mi srun dam sri gza' klu rgyal bsen gyi rigs chos mdzad la bar chad byed pa rnams bsad gzir gnon pa'i ched du gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba yang gsang dpal 'jigs byed yang 'jigs par byed pa'i rta mchog nag po skur bstan cing / gdug pa can de rnams gnad nas gzir zhing srog 'phrog par mdzad cing ma 'ongs phyi ma'i don la dgongs te mnga' bdag mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs rnams la chos spyi dang bye brag dbang chen gyi sgrub bskor dpag tu med pa dang / khyad par dbang chen gnod sbyin nag po'i man ngag gter du ma dang / lhag tu phyogs bzhi dbus lngar gter kha lnga sbas shing / de dag gi nang nas snying po yang gter gsang ba khyad du 'phags pa nag po thugs kyi sgrub skor 'di nyid mnga' bdag yab sras mtsho rgyal gsum la gdams te bsam yas mi 'gyur ba lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtser gter du sbas shing phyi ma'i dus su lha sras dam 'dzin gyi skye mthar/ gar gyi dbang phyug ye shes rol pa rtsal dang 'phrad par smon lam btab ste sbas shing / gter bdag bsrung ma'i tshogs la gnyer du gtad doske/ /de nas snyigs mar 'gro don gdul bya dus la babs pa bzhi bcu kha ral skabs su/ snang rtse skyo yi lha khang nye ba na rig pa 'dzin pa gar dbang zhig po gling pa'am/ dpal khrag 'thung mgon po zhes bya ba de nyid kyis dgongs lo nyer lnga sa pho sprel gyi lo la gter nas spyan drangs te las skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'khod par mdzad pa ste/ de lta bu'i chos bka' de nyid khyed rang rnams go sla ba'i phyir du brgyud pa'i mtshan grangs ni/ chos sku 'od dpag tu med pa yab yum/ longs sku rta mchog yab yum/ sprul sku pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ gsang ba'i dgyes bde mkhar chen gza'/ mnga' bdag chos rgyal yab sras/ gter bton zhig po gling pa/ grub thob bkra shis tshe brtan/ rig 'dzin gter gzhad snying po/ grub chen pad+ma nor bu/ stag ras pa o rgyan skal bzang / des tshe dbang nor bu bdag la'o //yang na zhig po gling pa nas/gar dbang pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen pad+ma blo gros/ mtshan ldan pad+ma 248

rdo rje/ kun bzang khyab brdal lhun grub/ stag ras o rgyan bskal bzang / des bdag la'o/ /de lta bu'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams ni/ sangs kyi brgyud pa ma zhig /rig 'dzin gyi gral ma nyams/ dam tshig gi sel ma song glu/ rdo rje yi zam ma chag /byin rlabs kyi sprin ma nyams pa ste/ des na sngon du slob dpon gyi bya ba dang ske/rjes su slob ma'i bya ba gnyis yod pa la sngon du slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ skabs 'dir slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la babs pas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang gi dngos gzhi la 'jug par bya'o/ /rgyal ba rab 'byams lha yi rdzing bu nas/ rgyal ba'i dbang phyug rta mchog nyin byed 'phyo/ /rgyal ba'i sras dbang pad 'byung zer brgya 'gyed/ /rgyal mchog rol pas gdul bya'i pad sdong dbye/ /sangs rgyas kun 'phrin nam mkha'i slong po che/ /log 'dren ka shi'i rna 'gem dbyar rnga'i sgra/ /he ru ka dpal gar chen sprin lcugs ma/ /rta mchog thugs rje'i sgra dbyangs kun tu mdzes/ /byin rlabs rmad byung yan lan brgyad ldan chab / /dbang bzhi'i chos chog ma dros rdzing bu che/ /legs bshad yan lag rba rlabs kun tu g.yo/ /smin grol gdengs can yid bzhin nor dbang 'dzin/ /dem ltar dbang chen rta mchog nag po yi/ /dbang gi mtshams sbyor the tshom 'di bris pa'i/ dge bas 'gro kun ho ru ka chen po/ /yan lag bdun gyi go 'phang la 'khod shog /zhes dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang mi gnyis pa rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje yi gdung 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba'i bkas bskul ngor sngags smyon pad+ma gar dbang 'gro 'dul rdo rje rol pa rtsal gyis spu bo smug 'debs su bris pa'i yig ris mgon pos bgyis pa dge'o/ / 249

wā+o /kun rig bdag skyed rgyun khyer snying po rab dkar phan bde rgyas pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swā ste sismyu/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun rig rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'i lus ngag yid gsum la dus gsum du 'bral gyur gyi 'gro ba mi dang mi ma yin pa spyi dang / khyad par du gson byang / gson bsngo/ gshin byang gshin bsngo skyabs 'jug re gnas zhus pa'i sems can ma lus lus pa med pas thog drangs/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzungs te snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma la skyabs mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la ྾ chos la ྾ dge 'dun la ྾ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs mchi'o/ /dpal mgon ྾ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bha wa shud dho sarba dharmā swa bhālwa shurnyo3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i lkog mar hriḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lce yi thad ka'i 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rgyu las rdo rje rtse lnga pa de lce la thim pas/ lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ o badz+ra dzi hāḥ lag pa gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po re re de zhu ba las rdo rje'i lag pa/sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ de nas rang gi shes pa rgyu du gyur/ hūṃ gi sgras gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub brtan par mdzad/ rdo rje'i rigs thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa rang nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang ske/ mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis gdug pa rnams kyi rgyu ma drangs nas zhal du gsol ba/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs dang /250

mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na larka ma hā badz+ra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba bi dra ba bi dra ba sarba a pā yā/ nā sha ya nā sha ya ha ra ha ra pra tsā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha wa shud+dha sarba dhad+ma su bhā wa shurnyophohaṃglu/ chos kun stong pa nyid du gyur/ /skad gcig pad zla'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rang rig oṃ yig dkar por shar/ /de yang 'khor lo o dkar mtshan/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod sems can sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus 'khor lo oṃ yongs gyur/ /kun rig rnam pa snang mdzad ni/ /dkar po mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhal bzhi phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krungs/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyi brgyan / /'od zer mtha' yas mu med 'phro/ /lag mthil a a las zla ba/ /hūṃ a mtshan la dbyangs 'phreng bskoraske/ /a ā/ i khri/ u u/ ṛ rī/ lo lī/ e i/ o au/ a aḥ sor mo oṃ hūṃ tram̐ trīḥ.aḥ rigs lnga yab lnga yum lngar gyur/ oṃ a rgyo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma/ sa ra spa ra a nu pra bilco sarba dharma/ a r+ya nā nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma/ badz+ra añdzali/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra bad+dha tra tha/ oṃ badz+ra a we sha ya aḥ.aḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dhi ḍo me bha wa sha to me bha wa/ hri bā ya me a dhe tiṣ+ṭha sarba sirnyi me pra yats+tsha r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭa oṃ musbyi baṃ/ oṃ sgri ta sgri ta sarba a wa ra ṇa ni r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba a wa ra ṇa ni r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tshid+dha tshid+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni r+ghaṃ phaṭa /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ oṃ budha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ o pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa trī/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te de nas ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol bar byed zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang —/ sdud pa mang po'i 'phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i bcings pa las rnam par bkrol te bde ba so sor thob par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad la phan par mdzad pa'i phyir bzhugs su gsol//thams cad du chos thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs tu gsol swā hā/ ma no rat+na tra yā yā/ oṃ argyu te bi dza ya/ sisnyi sid+dha swā hā/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra walha ya swā hā/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i o yig dkar po'i mthar rtsa ba'i rig pa 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyi bdag gzhan 'gro ba spyi dang dmigs yul sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs bar bsam la ma yengs ba'i ngang du sngags bzla'oske/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wadhe/ sarba dur ga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar ha te/ samyaka saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud+dha bi shudhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud dhe 251

swā hā/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shudhe bi shudhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shudhe swā hā/ sbyongs ba'i rgyal po rig pa'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar rtsa rig tshar gcig dang / o sarba bid sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das rig pa 'khor dang bcas pa yi sems can thams cad 'khor ba ngan song las 'don pa dang / myur du mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bden pa dang / gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyisaglu/ 'di ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'i lus ngag yid gsum la dus gsum du 'bral gyur gyi 'gro ba mi dang mi ma yin pa dang spyi dang / khyad par du gson byang gson bsngo/ gshin byang gshin bsngo skyabs 'jug re gnas zhus pa'i sems can ma lus lus pa med pa'i ngan song gsum gyi duḥkha dang khams gsum gyi las nyon sdig sgrib thams cad skad cig ma da lta dus 'di nyid du dral bar gyur ciga.o sarba bid sarba a ba ra na bi sho dha na ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi sbo ṭa ya sarba a pā ya/ ban dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba a pā ya ga te bh+yaḥ sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ban dha traṭa/ sngags dang phyag rgya de yis mthus/ /sems can de rnams sdig pa zad/ /rnam shes dri med a dkar po/ /de yang rdor sems gzugs gyur nas/ /oṃ sarba bid sa pā ri wā ra sarba pu dza me gha sa mu dra sa pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ//mchod pas bcom ldan yongs mchod cing / /kun gyi ched du bsngags pa'i tshig /e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir bdag cag ngan song sbyang / /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /zhes brjod 'od dpag med zhing du/ /gshegs nas 'phags mchog sa brnyes gyur/ /de ltar thams cad rig pa'i phyag rgya dang / /sngags bzlas byin brlab dkon mchog bden pa'i mthus/ /dge ba bsngo ba'i dmigs yul 'gro de rnams/ /myur du rnam grol byang chub che thob shog /'jam dpal dpa' bo ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag gis ni rjes su bdag slob cing ske//dge ba 'di dag thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i/ /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa'i/ /sems can kun gyi don 'grub phyir/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bshags/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ.oṃ āḥrgyu/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba 252

chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye rgu kun la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /bdag cag rnams dang / yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar gyur cig 'di yang rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu zhes pa'i bya bral rgyal khams pa dkar po de yi rang lo bcu phrag lnga la nye ba'i bar dad ldan nye tshe ba'i gson gshin skyabs 'jug bsngo rten ji rigs blang bar la la dag bsngo smon ji bzhin gyi rgyas ma thebs pas yid gnong ba dang dngos po byung ba yang dge ba'i rgyu tshogs kho nar dmigs rung / skabs 'gar de ltar ma gyur ba sogs sgrib pa'i rgyur gyur pa rnams sbyangs shing blo gtad 'gro ba mi bslu ba'i lhag bsam dung dang zla ba ku muta pad rtsa ltar kun tu dkar bas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyangs ba/ thams cad rig pa'i rig pa rtsa ba'i sngags du phyur bcu yin/ bye ba phrag rgya rim gyis bsgrub par yid dam bcas te de yi thog mar bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa gsang ba sbyin pa'i rings lugs chos grwa chen po shel dkar mngon dga'i 'dus sder dung phyur gcig gis dbus sa ga zla ba nas mdzugs par rtsis pa'i skabs kun rig bdag bskyed rab dkar phan bde rgyas pa'i ched ngag 'don khyer bde'i tshul du mnga' ri gung thang khyung rdzongs dkar po'i 'dabs za 'og phug tu dkar po'i lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por sbyar ba ste 'bral gyur 'gro bas thog drangs sems can thams cad rnam dkar byang chub mchog gi 'bras bu myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig ngag 'don 'di ni rang nyid gcig pu'i rgyun khyer kha thon nam/rtsa rigs dung phyur bsags pa'i skabs sngags 'gro che phyir las gzhan du mi bya la/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i rig pa oṃ sho dha ne man bsags pa yang dung phyur bsgrangs na ma gtogs gzhan du sla chos dbang gi de ltar byas na bka' yi chad pa 'byung bar nges pas rgyun chags sngar srol ltar rtsa rig kho na la 'bad par bya ba shin tu gces so/ /kun gyi snying dbus byang chub sems mchog brtan/ /kun la phan pa 'ba' zhig lhur blang ba/ /kun bzang rgyal sras spyod pa'i rjes slob cing / /kun rig rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur bsgrod shog /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /kun tu dge legs 'phel/ shin tu bkra shis so/ /swa ste/ thams cad rig pa'i sngags kyi phan yon shes pa'i slad du rgyud tshig 'di yang skabs su brjod par bya ste/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyongs ba rgyal po zhes bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams 253

cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi snying kha nas phyung ngo / /oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud dhe swā hā/ rig pa chen mo 'di bshad ma thag tu sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi rgyud kyi 'chings pa thams cad rnam par bcad de/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyangs so/ /sdug bsngal mi zad pa rnams rab tu zhi te/ skye bo mang po rnams bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /zhes dang / lha yi dbang po gzhan yang mdor na dran pa tsam gyis kyang bsod nams chung ba'i sems can rnams ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las bde blag tu rnam par grol bar gyur pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba dur ga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar ha te/ samyaka saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tabya tha/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'o/ /zhes dang / lha yi dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyongs ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i gsang ba'i snying po 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang yang rung bas/ ming tsam nyan tam/ bcangs sam/ klags sam/ bris nas kyang mgo bo'am gtsug phud dam/ dpung pa'am mgul du btags te 'chang na/ tshe 'di nyid la dus min gyi 'chi ba brgyad dam/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang 'bral ba'i rmi lam gyi rnam pa'am/ ngan song dang 'bral ba'i mtshan ma de dag thams cad rmi lam du yang mi 'byung na/ dkyil 'khor du ji ltar ba bzhin du zhugs la zhugs nas kyang dbang bskur nas snying po yang bzlas brjod byed cing sngags kyi don yang sgom pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag la ni sdig pa gang yang nye bar mi 'gyur / ngan song du 'gro bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'am bud med dam lha 'am klu'am gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am byol song ngam/ yi dwags sam sems can dmyal ba las sogs te/ gang yang rung ba shi ba'i lus dkyil 'khor du bcug la/ dbang bskur na sems can dmyal bar skyes na yang de ma thag tu rnam par thar nas lha'i ris su skye bar 'gyur roglu/ /lha'i rigs der skyes nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid mngon sum du byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsnyen bskur ba la sogs pa yang byed/ phyir mi ldog yang 'gyur/ rgyud nges pa can du yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su yang skye/ sgrib pa gsum rab tu spangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs sam/ lha'i rigs sam gzhan gang yang rung bar bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i dbang po mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan pa dang bde ba thams cad myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa rnams rgyud kyi tshig ste/ de ltar sngags kyi yon tan phyi ma ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba'i duḥkha mtha' dag gsal ba yi/ tshe 'dir yang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad zhi zhing ring du 'tsho ba tshe yi dngos grub thob par byed cing / mthar thug 'chi 254

med rtag brtan byang chub mchog gi 'bras bu yang dus ring po min par 'grub pa ste phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /phan yon ma shes par sngags bzlas na/ nus pa bul la phan yon shes nas bzlas na nus pa mchog tu myur ba yin pas phan yon shes nas sngags bzla ba shin tu gal che ba yi skabs 'dir rtsa rig dang sngags kyi phan yon rgyud nas phyung ste bkod pa'o/ /rgyal gsung sngags kyi mthu ni tshad bzung med/ /tshe rabs gtan bde bsgrub pa yid bzhin dbang / /bsam 'phel nor bu mchog gyur rig pa 'di/ stag par bzung nas 'gro don cher spyod shog /ces pa yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus so/ /sarba maṅga lo/

rog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs gso smyong dang 'brel ba bklag chog thar gling bgrod pa'i gru rdzing dam pa/o swaste/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhe satwa bh+yaḥ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs gso sbyong dang 'bral ba bklag chog thar gling bgrod pa'i gru rdzing dam pa zhes bya ba bla ma thub dbang 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab dag pa bde chen nam mkha' la/ chos kyi sprin bzang thugs rje'i gru char can/ srid pa'i tshad sel thar dbang sman 'bru kun/ rgyas mdzad mgon po bla mar dang por 'dud/ rab dkar zla ba 'bum gyi mdangs 'phrog cing / /rab mdzes lta bas bskal par chog mi shes/ /rab yang brtse spyan gdul byar rtag tu gzigs/ /rab mchog 'jig rten mgon por phyag 'tshal nas/ /gang gi sgrubs thabs 'phrin las bzang po'i rgyun/ /dam pa mang pos lan brgyar gsal mdzad na/ /nyin snang gnas bzhin snang gsal btegs pa ltar/ bdag gis yi ge'i ngal bas ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang bslab gsum rgyal mtshan 'dzin rnams dang / /khyim pa dad ldan byang chub sems 'chang 'gas/yang yang bskul gang re ba bskang ba'i phyir/ sngon gsung bskyar bzlos tshul 'chad dge gyur cig 'di ltar 'khor ba sgrol ba'i gru ches rnyed par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi rten phun sum tshogs pa ni brgya lam res 'ga' u dum wa ra'i me tog shin tu rnyed par dka' bas rten bzang po 'di lta bu thob pa nyid don med stong las kyi chud zos su ma song bar snying po len pa cis nas kyang gal che la/ de yang tsheg chung zhing 'jug bde la don che ba mngon par mtho ba mtho ris kyi yon tan dang / nges par legs par thar pa gsum gyi 'bras bu mtha' dag thob par byed pa'i lam bzang sdom pa gsum ka la 'jug cing bslab pa gsum gyi gzhi 'dzin pa gso sbyong gi cho ga 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs la rten pa dam pa mchog gyur mang po'i gshegs shul byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad pa bsnyung gnas kyi cho ga dpal mo lugs su grags pa 'di la ci nus su nges par 'bad par bya ste/de la thog mar sangs rgyas kyi dus khyad par nya stong brgyad lta bu tshes bzang po la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang byi dor gtsang sbra legs par byas la dkon mchog gi rten ci 'byor 'os pa bshams pa'i drung du de nyid lnga pa'i skabs su bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bum pa mchod gtor yang dus 256

'dir bca'o/ /de nas nyams su len bya cho ga'i tshul bde gzhung grags che ba rtsa ba lta bu ni rgyal sras thog med bzang pos mdzad pa de yin la/ der sa bcad sdom ma mdzad pas dam pa mang pos yang de mthun dang glu/ kha shas nas spyi 'dra'i sa bcad tsam dang / dam pa kha cig nas rgyud sde rigs mthun gyi cho ga'i brda' dang sbyar nas/ rgyal sras pas mdzad pa'i gzhung don la sdom de nyid bcu drug tu byas pa ni rtsa ba dang mi 'gal bar 'phral rnam pa gsal ba ltar snang bas 'dir yang skyid grong lo ts+tsha ba ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa de blo la babs pa de dang phyogs mthun du bkod pa'i sdom tshig ni/sngon du gtsang khrus maṇ+ḍal spyi bshags dang / /gso sbyong bslab pa dngos gzhi nyid dang bzhi/ /bcas bshams sbyor ba bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang / /de bzhin mdun bskyed bzlas pa bcas te bzhi/ /thun mtshams phyag mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol/ /gtor 'bul smon lam gdab pa rnams te bzhi/ /mnong bshags gzungs bsgrub khrus chu'i byin rlabs blangs/ /gshegs bsdud bsngo ba bkra shis rjes bzhi'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gso sbyong gi sdom pa len par 'dod pa rnams thog mar gtsang mar bya ba'i phyir khrus bgyid pa'i de nyid ni/dang por thal mo sbub sor sbyor ba las gung mo gnyis rtse mor byas shing sor mo gzhan rnams kyang rtse mo cung zad ma reg pa pad+ma kha 'bus pa'i rnam pa pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya de snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ pad+ma ta bha wa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas pad+ma sems dpa' 'am rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas bzhin pas gdong pa kha dang yan lag legs par bkru'o/ /gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal de nyid ni/ gso sbyong la 'jug pa rnams 'dus te thog mar brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni rang mdun ta la'i srid tsam gyi mkha' la rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi skur snang mdo yi steng sogs tho phyi kun tu nam mkha'i gnas su sgyu skar ram 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa bzhin rang gi rtsa ba yan lag gi bla ma gzhan dang brgyud pa'i bla ma spyi dang bye brag pa yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs ma lus pa dang mkha' 'gro'o chos skyong bcas mngon sum bzhugs pa la mos pas skad cig gi gsal btab te de la bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis gus pa chen pos gsol ba btab par bsam te/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams ma lus parak+ṣi//bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyongs bsrung ma'i tshogs kun kyang / /gnas mchog 'di ru byon la byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig /bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs 257

so—/ / sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /byang sems 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rje btsun 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drin can 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes gnas mchog sogs tshig rkang dgu po 'di 'og gi tshigs 'tshams rnams su yang rim pas sbyar/ bsdu na bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po man gyi tshig rkang brgyad po'i thog mthar sbyar ba dkyus su bris ltar nyid kyis 'grub/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang rnams kyang /gnas mchog sogs 'gre'o/ /grub mchog dge slong ma dpal mo dang / paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu dang / paṇa chen ye shes bzang po rnams kyang / gnas mchog sogs 'gre/ paṇa chen bal po pe nya dang / byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan dang / grub thob nyi phug pa chen po rnams kyang / gnas mchog sogs 'gre/ srul pa rdo rje rgyal po dang / zhang ston dgra 'jigs pa chen po dang / mkhan chen rtse 'dul ba chen po rnams kyang /gnas mchog sogs mkhan chen bde ba can pa dang / byang sems chu bzang pa chen po dang / chos rje shes rab 'bum pa rnams kyang / gnas mchog sogs/ chos rje rgyal sras thogs med dang / sems dpa' chos kyi rin chen dang / byang sems bsod nams rin chen rnams kyang / gnas mchog sogs/ sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog dang / chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan yang ske/gnas mchog 'di ru sogs/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po dang / skyes mchog ye shes rgya mtsho dang / /rgyal tshabs rin chen rgya mtsho yang / gnas mchog sogs/ snying po blo gros rnam rgyal dang / 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang phrin las dang / rje btsun kun bzang dbang po yang / gnas mchog sogs/ rtsa ba rgyud pa'i bla ma dang / rgyal khams grub thob ma lus dang / mched grogs chos mdzad gong ma rnams kyang / gnas mchog sogasaske/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / mthu ldan chos skyongs bsrung ma rnams kyang / gnas mchog 'di ru byon la byin gyis rlobs mdzod cig bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon po/ sangs rgyas/ rgyal tshab/ byang sems/ kun mkhyen/ rje btsun/ chos rje/ drin can 'gro ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes gdungs shug drag pos gsol ba btab ste 'di ni rgyal sras thogs med kyi dngos slob brag dkar sems dpa' chen po yab sras kyi gsung rgyun byin rlabs kyi mched du bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skang te bkod pa'o/ /de nas chos pas gsal btab pa'i gong gi tshogs zhing rnams kyi spyan sngar maṇ+ḍal phul ba dngos ni/ rin po che'am shing gi maṇ+ḍal gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya bzla bzhin pas rdul g.yas bskor du phyis shing dri bzang po'i chu'i chag chag gdab/ 'bru 258

'am me tog sil mas tshom bu bkod cing / o badz+ra bhu mi āḥr+ghaṃ/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ o badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri boske/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ 'phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug pa ma/ snang gsal ma/dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' dag tshang shing yid du 'ong ba 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnam dang yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang skyabs gnas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /zhes maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma legs par phul zhing bsdu na tshom bu bco lnga pa'am bdun pa yang rung gi/ sa gzhi spos kyi byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yi/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod pa shog /gzhan yang slob dpon su tsā ti ta dang / snyog med dpal gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi cho gar 'byung zhing spyir rgyud tshig tu bzhed pa'i tshig bcad ni/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs dang / /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /blo yis blang nas bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsolaske/ /yang a mo gha'i dkyil mchog nas/ zhing khams khyad par 'phags pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di/ /dus gsum bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /bla med dkon mchog la gsum dbul bar bgyi/ /bzhes shing bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yang maṇ+ḍal sngags kyi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gu ru lo ka nā tha de wa ḍā ki ni rat+na tra yā ya i rda maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥr+ghaṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog med nas da lta la thug gi bar sdig pa mi dge ba'i las spyi dang / bye brag sdom gsum gyi nyes ltung gi tshogs ci yod pa rnams gnong zhing 'gyod pas tshigs 'di rnams kyi mthol zhing bshags par bya te/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs te phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang 259

chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang / de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal bar bgyis pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang / pha dang ma la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang /mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang / grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang / dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang / gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la bskur ba btab pa la sogs pa/ mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig pa dang nyes pa dang / ltung ba'i tshogs ci bgyis pa dang /bgyid du rtsal ba dang gzhan bgyid la pa rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ mi sbed do/ /phyin chad sdom par bgyid lags so/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde la reg par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang ske/ skabs 'dir phung po gsum pa'i mdo yang legs par bklags so/ /de nas skyabs yul dkon mchog thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la thim/ de rang gi spyi bo gtsug nas mar byon bdag dang gnyis su med par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag bzhi pa bslab gzhi gso sbyong yan lag brgyad kyi sdom pa len pa de nyid ni/ de'i tshig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsungs 'phags gzhung dngos ni/rgya gar skad du/ po ṣa dha su yo gra ha na bi dhi/ bod skad du/ gso sbyong rang gi blang ba'i cho gabacom ldan 'das don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing / byed pa byas paglu/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'aske/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can rnams kyi/sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang /nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs pa bya 260

ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par byas pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyis pas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /dzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o//skyon ni mang po mnyam brten pa/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan chen po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang 'phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de ltar srog gcod la sogs spang / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang bskrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces bya'o//gang phyir dge ba ma lus gso ba dang / /rnyed pa'i sdig pa 'di yang zad byed pa/ /de ni gso dang sdig pa dag byed phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gso sbyong zhes su gsungs/ /gso sbyong rang gi blang ba'i cho ga rdzogs so/ /paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ de thog mar gso sbyong gi bslab rgyun ma chad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la legs par nod nas rjes su nya stong brgyad dang bcu bzhi sogs dus tshes bzang por dkon mchog gi rten yod na de ston par mos shing glu/ med na gong gi tshogs zhing sdom pa blang zin rjes bar ma bsdus la/ de'i spyan sngar gso sbyongs kyi sdom pa rang gi blang ba ste/ de yang thal mo sbyar nas tshig gis don la yid gzhug bzhin 'di skad du/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /zhes pa ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa'i mgor sbyar te gso sbyongs kyi tshig srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog gi bar lan gsum dag par brjod pas sdom pa skye ba'o/ /gzhan kha cig gi blang bar bgyi'o yan tshar gsum/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya sogs tshig bcad rnams tshar gcig gi chog kyang zer/ yi ge kha cig tu dengs nas srog gcod mi bya zhes par de tshe srog gcod mi bya bsgyur ba rten khyim pa lta bu'i bsnyung gnas bzung nas tshig rnams la 'dod pa tsam snang yang gzhan mang pos ma bsgyur zhing gong du dus mtshams brjod ma thag pas dengs nas zhes pa nyid legs so/ /sdom pa slob dpon la blang ba'i skabs su las gzhan du slob dpon dgongs gsol mi dgos/ /gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang ba dang btang ba'i dus mtshams ni nyan thos bye brag pa rnams kyi nyi ma ma shar ba'i gong du blang nas sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar zhes skya rengs gsal bas mun pa'i dbal cha nyams pa na 'dzam gling shar lho'i ri chen rnams kyi rtse mor nyi ma 'char bas de'i dus su btang ste nyin zhag phrug gcig las gzhan par gso sbyong gi sdom pa dngos mi skye zhing nyin mtshan so sor 261

bzung ba dag legs spyad tsam las dngos min par 'dod pa mngon pa mdzod rtsa 'grel du ltar dang /mdo sde pa rnams kyis da nang nyi ma ma shar nas ma nub kyi bar nyin mo'i cha dang / nyi ma nub nas sang nyi ma ma shar bar mtshan mo'i cha ste nyin mtshan so sor yang sdom pa dngos skye bar dgongs so/ /gso sbyong bzung btang de dag ni gtso bor dge bsnyen la dgongs shing rab tu byung ba'i phyogs la yan lag brgyad kyi bslab bya rtag tu gzhir gnas shing / gso sbyong gi nges pa khyad par ba nyin zhag gcig tu bzung ba mang ngo / /spyir ni gso sbyong zhes rab tu byung ba dang / ma byung ba gnyis ka la yod pa'i rab tu ma byung ba'i gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa nyin zhag gi mtha' can ni bsnyen gnas dang / ji srid 'tsho'i bar bzung ba ni go mi'i dge bsnyen te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar kun tu rgyu sems can ring bstan pa la thog mar 'jug pa'i sdom pa blang tshul nyid dang / 'phags yul slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi bzhin no—/ /go mi ma yin pa'i gso sbyongs yang zla ba gcig gi dang lo gcig gi sogs ji snyed pa'i zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad nya stong dus su bsrung ba'i sdom pa slob dpon la dus cig car du len rung ba jo bo rje'i bzhed zhes mang zhig de ltar phyag len mdzad pa byung zhing / de la mkhas pa kha gcig legs spyad tsam rung la sdom pa dngos 'bog par mi 'gro zhes su ngas kyang gong gi nyan thos bye brag pa mdo sde pa ltar sde pa'i ltar sde pa so so'i 'dod pas mi 'gal lo/ /'on kyang slob dpon la lan gcig bzung ba des chog shes nas nya stong brgyad sogs nam blang 'dod pa'i dus su so sor gso sbyongs rang gi blang bar ma byas na mi rung ste khrums zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar gyi gso sbyongs yang nang re bzhin blang dgos pa mkhas mchog bu ston zhabs kyi gsung bzhin nges par bya la/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs kyi theg chen sngags nas ston pa gso sbyongs 'di yang nang re bzhin blang dgos pa de dang mthun/ sde snod 'og mar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa gso sbyongs kyi brdar bzhag pa de ni so thar sdom pa phyi mas snga ma 'jig phyir rab tu byung ba'i phyogs kyi bzung bar mi nus kyang / theg chen sngags nas bshad pa'i gso sbyongs yan lag brgyad bskung bar gnas pa dang bcas pa ni bzung tu rung bar rgyud gzhung de'i dgongs par bstan pa rgya bod dam pa chen po rnams kyis bzhed pa mthun pa gnas pa la/ phyis kha cig nas rab tu byung bas gso sbyongs rgyud tshig de brjod 'os mi 'os mthing bslad byas kyang don la mi rig te rnam par 'khyams pa'o/ /de yang tshul khrims kyi phung po'i mdor/ rigs brgya sngon du song ba yin/ nyin bzhin du gso sbyongs blang / zhes pa dang / don zhags rgyud nas yang de dang mthun par gsungs pas so/ /des na 'dir bstan pa'i gso sbyongs ni dge bsnyen gyi blang na sdom pa gsar thob dbul pos nor bu gsar rnyed lta bu yin la/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs kyi ni sngar nas thob pa'i nor bu 262

bsam 'phel slar yang byi dor byas shing rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod pas 'dod don lhag par 'grub pa'i dpes mtshon te phan yon che chung gi khyad kyang yod do/ /de nas gso sbyongs 'di ni so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa gsum ka la 'jug pa mdo sngags thun mong pa ste khyab che zhing phan yon mang ba yin la/de yang gso sbyongs yan lag brgyad tshul bzhin blangs shing ma nyams pa bsrung ba yi thun mong gi phan yon rnams shes na bslab bya gzhi mthun pa'i dbang gi khyad par gyi yon tan yang ngang gi rtogs pas na khyim pa rnams kyi so thar gyi gso sbyongs bsnyen gnas 'ba' zhig nyin zhag gcig gi mtha' can bsrung ba'i phan yon yang gnas ljog gi mdo las/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu klung chen po lnga dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu bum pa'i grangs kyi bzung bar nus kyi bsnyen gnas kyi phan yon gyi tshad bzung bar mi nus shing /'dzam bu'i gling gi gang ba'i dgra bcom pa la rin po che la sogs pa'i yo byad thams cad byin pa'i bsod nams kyi/ bsnyen gnas kyi bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /zhes spyir bstan cing / bye brag gnas skabs su mtho ris mngon mtho lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs thob par yang gong gi mdor/ bsnyen gnas gtsang ma lan cig bsrung bas kyang /'dod lha drug gang ris su skye bar gsung ba dang / gdags pa'i mdor/ brgya byin gyi go 'phang tshegs med du thob pa dang / klu sgrub kyi bshes spring las kyang / /dgra bcom tshul khrims rjes su byed pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad po 'di dag dang ldan na/ /gso sbyongs 'dod spyod lha klus yid 'ong ba/ /skyes pa bud med dag la rtsol bar bgyid/ zhes pa rnams so/ /khyad par du nges legs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang mjal ba'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa yin par yang / byams pa lung bstan tshigs su bcad pa las/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang / /de bzhin zla shi tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul wa yi zla ba la/ /yan lag brgyad legs mnyam gzhag cing / /bsnyen gnas gso sbyongs byas nas ni/ /nga yi bstan la lhag pa yin/ /zhes gso sbyongs kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas byams pa 'dzam gling du sangs rgyas rgyal ba'i tshe/ de'i 'khor lo du 'dus te 'bras bu thob par gsung ba ste/ des ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rang gang mos pa'i zhing du skye bar smon pa yang 'grub par bstan pa yin no/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu yang nyan rang tsam ma yin par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dngos thob par 'jig rten gdags par/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shā ri'i bu dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod du/ /bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang / /tshes brgyad dang ni gnam stong la/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa bsrungs/ /nga nyid ji 'dra de 'drar 'gyur/ /zhes shā ri'i bu'i gsol ba/de bzhin gshegs pas de las bzlog te/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang zhes pa nas/ nga nyid ci 'dra de 263

'drar 'gyur zhes pa ste/ de ltar lan gcig ma yin par gsung ba dang / kun tu rgyu sen rings kyi zhus pa'i mdor/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po gnyis kyi rgyu yang gso sbyongs yan lag brgyad pas 'grub par bka' stsal ba sogs yang yang bsngags par mdzad pa yin la/ lung khungs te rnams kyi dngos don ni dus bzang so sor sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran nas bsnyen gnas bslab pa brgyad gtsang mar bsrung ba tsam la dgongs shing / de la phan yon tshad med pa de lta bu yod par shes na/ 'dir bstan pa'i gso sbyongs bsnyung bar gnas pa'i sdom pa gsum ka la 'jug pa gang zhig bskyed rim gzungs bzlas sogs dang 'bral ba de yi phan yon ni thog mar bstan pa rnams las myur ba dang / rab tu bde ba dang khyad par du byas pa sogs brgya stong du mas lhag par gyur pa nyid du rtogs dgos so/ /'dir spyan ras gzigs gdong bcu gcig pa'i gzungs kyi phan yon yang / gzhung de las 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi snying po 'di ni de ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba lags so/ /lan gcig ston pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus par yongs su byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad bshad pa bzhin du nan tan du bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum khrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba lags na/ bzlas brjod bgyid pa dang / ji skad bshad pa bzhin du bsgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ zhes dang / su zhig bdag gis slad du tshes bcu'am/ bco lnga la smyung bar bgyis te sdom pa yang dag par blang nas chos bzhin du yongs su dag par bgyis te/ sems rtse gcig tu yongs su dran par bgyis nas/ rigs sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba brnyil bar 'gyur lags so/ /zhes dang / la la zhig cho ga bzhin du sbyor ba bgyid na/ de dag gis sug par sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs zhing yang / de nyid las gang la la zhig gdugs mtshan du rigs sngags 'di klog pa dang /'don pa dang 'dzin par bgyid na bdag gis de dag gis smon lam ci mchis pa yid bzhin du 'grub par bgyid lags so/ /zhes gso sbyongs mtshan mo gcig tu bzung yang rung ba shugs kyis bstan pa'o/ /gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i mdo dang sngags rgyud spyi dang bye brag rnams su phan yon dngos dang rigs mthun shugs bstan rnams kyang thos pas spro ba spel bar bya la/ gang ltar dang po'i blo can rnams la sdom pa 'bog pa'i thog mar blo bcos te nges 'byung gi bsam pa bzang po bskyed du gzhug cing / bslab gzhi yan lag brgyad 'dzin tshul yang ci nus bshad pa ni gal che'o/ /sdom pa blang zin nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gzungs bklags par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo oṃ a mo 264

gha shī la/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki te/ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ hrīḥtre+e lo kya bi dza ya/ a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hri ha r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ste gzungs de gnyis lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bzlas par bya'o/ /de ltar bklags pa'i phan yon ni don zhags kyi gzungs mdo de nyid du 'di skad ces 'byung ste bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi mdo la tshul khrims yongs su dag pa chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po'i dri mang po lus la byung zhing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten grags pa 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig nyi ma re re bzhin gzungs 'di dran na ni de ni rtag tu tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gang zhig tshul khrims nyams pas bsnyung ba byas te 'di bzlas brjod byas pa tsam gyi mdo la tshul khrims yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims mang po dang ldan par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa yang dran par bya'o/ /smon lam bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig nyon mongs pas tshul khrims 'chal ba las byung ba'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig 'phags pa dge ba'i tshul khrims kyi skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /nyon mongs pas mi rdzi bar rnam par grol ba'i bde ba gnas par gyur cig /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyi/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur cig /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /zhes brjod do/ /lnga pa mchod bshoms kyi de nyid ni/ gong du bshad pa'i gnas khang du ji ltar 'dzom pa'i rten dang / khyad par thugs rje chen po gdong bcu gcig pa'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs zhig 'dzom na shin tu legs shing /gang ltar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos byugs pa'i steng pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar poske/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dkar/ byang ljang / mtshams bzhir mdzes tshon ste/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir zla gdan la kha dog gong mthun gyi tshom bu dbus kyi rgyab ngos su tshom bu dmar po chung du gcig 'tshams kyi 'dab mar tshom bu ser po re bkod/ gtor ma 'das gtor gcig bya/ cha gsum gtor ma dang 'di'i sgos kyi chos skyongs chu bdag wa ru ṇa dang / yul bdag la yang gtor ma bshams/ bsdu na spyan ras gzigs kyi mchod gtor dang sangs rgyas byang sems spyi dang chos skyongs spyi ste mchod gtor gsum mam/yang 'das gtor gcig pu'i chog par gsungs/ gang ltar gtsang sbra shin tu che ba bya zhing klu gtor bshams tshe ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma 'byor na klu sman btab/ bum pa yang mtshan ldan gtsang ma rgyan gyi 265

mdzes par spras pa rgyun 'bab chu bum rdzas nyer lnga sbyar bas sum gnyis ba bkang / thog mar 'phags pa'i gzungs ring gis bgegs bskrad la bkod/ drug pa sbyor ba skyabs sems tshogs bsags pa'i de nyid la/'o skol rang sku tshe sngon ma la bsod nams kyi gtso bor gyur pa'i dge ba rgya chen po bsags pa la brten nas tshe 'dir yang dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnam par dag pa thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir spyir gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba spangs shing / sgo gsum gyi dge ba la 'bad par bya dgos/ de'ang nam 'chi cha med da lta nyid du 'bad par bya'o/ /shi nas ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal myong 'gyur la bsam te/ chos spyod rnam par dag pa 'di lta bu la pha mas thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jug par bya snyam du sems skyed par zhu zhes 'tshogs yod na bskul/ med na mi dgos/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i byang chub kyi sems drag tu sgom la/ bdag sogs khams gsum sems can nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying por ma mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro'i chos skyongs bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes skyabs 'gro drug skor yang bya/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyi/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa lang / /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum gyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blangs/ gnas yo byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ na mo sangs rgyas dang / chos dang /dge 'dun rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ske/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs las/ dmigs pa'i bstan 'di tsam las brten gnas pa'i phyogs 'dir 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad byon zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa bde ba can lta bu rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa dang /gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdo rje rin po che seṅge'i khri dang rin po che pad+ma la sogs pa gdan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa phyi nang thams cad du 'phags pa 266

kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po yongs su gang ba/ rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid can sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung bar gyur cig ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar rgyur cig nam mkha'i mtha' gtug pa'i zhing khams thams cad gang zhing rgyas par gyur cig dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig o sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra a wat+ta ya a wat+ta yo hoḥ.oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ rol chen dang bcas/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sa ra pra madha na ye ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te samyaka saṃ budha ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re ma hā te dza badz+re ma hā bir+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra ma hā bo dhī madz+dza pa sam kra ma ṇi sarba karma a wa ra ṇi bi sho dha ni ye swā hā/ zhes tshar gsum bya/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di yang lha'i zhing khams gnas khang lha'i gzhal yas khang rin po che'i rang bzhin me tog sna tshogs kyi mdzes par spras pa mchod rdzas rnams lha yi nyer spyod dang bdud rtsi/ rang nyid skad gcig gis thugs rje chen po lo ka na thar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla steng trīḥdakar po mtshan pa rang gi mdun phyogs su byang chub kyi shing mtho khyad dang ldan pa yal ga lo 'dabs 'bras bu'i tshogs rab tu rgyas shing rin po che'i me tog du mas rgyan pa gdugs dkar 'khyil ba'i rtse mor 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i pad+ma ge sar ze'u 'bru'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir pad zla'i gdan re dang / de'i phyi rol du pad zla'i gdan phreng ba ltar mu 'khyud du mas bskor bar bsam la/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i trīḥlas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang bka' sdod dang bcas pas bskor ba spyan drangs nas dbus kyi pad zla'i steng du brgyud pa kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang tha mi dad pa'i spyi bor 'od dpag med pa bzhugs pa phyogs bzhi'i pad zla'i gdan la sangs rgyas rigs bzhi dang / de'i phyi rol gyi gdan la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ de'i phyi rol gyi gdan la sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi tshogs/ de'i phyi rol gyi gdan la dam chos dkon mchog gi tshogs/ de'i phyi rol gyi gdan la dge 'dun dkon mchog gi tshogs/ de'i phyi rol du gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa dam chos bsrung ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs par mos la de rnams kyi spyan sngar rang gi lus zhing gi rdul rnyed du sprul zhing bdag dang lhan cig par mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad kyis kyang phyag 'tshal ba sogs dge ba'i las la yang dag par 'jug par bsam la pad+ma kha 'bus lta bu'i thal mo spyi bo'i snying khar sbyar la snying nas mos gus kyi shugs 267

drag po bskyed/ oṃ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas/ /nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen rtses rab dgongs nas/ dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs 'tshal/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang //bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud//sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas mchog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs ri dgas skrag gyur pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' ltar/ /bde gsal mi rtogs stong pa'i ngang / /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyobs pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nasaske/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa'iske/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug gtor thams cad skyobs—/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od bsrung sked / shākya thub pa gi te lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs rin chen)guser bzang mya ngan med/ /cho bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs thu yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing / spyad pa spyad tshe na yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang 268

po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drug khri lnga stong la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag stong 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong / /spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong / /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par sprul nas ni/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs rnyed pa'iske/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir spro na brgyud pa'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gang gi sgrub thabs gso sbyongs rgyud pa yi/ /bla ma rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' spyod grub gtso dge slong dpal mo'i zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog paṇ+ḍi ta zla gzhon/ /ye shes mchog brnyes dpal ldan ye shes bzang / /'jam dpal grub pa bal po pe nya ba/ /spyan ras gzigs dngos zla ba rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /mngon shes mchog brnyes grub chen nyi phug pa/ /'phags nor gyis phyug dpug ston rdo rje rgyal/ /bsdu dngos bzhi'i bdag zhang ston dgra 'jig che/ /dri med bslab gsum rgyal mtshan rtse 'dul ba/ /tshogs gnyis kyis phyug mkhan chen bde ba can/ /don gnyis phun tshogs byang sems chu bzang ba/ /lung rtogs kyis phyug chos rje shes rab 'bum/ /rgyal sras mchog gyur thogs med bzang po'i zhabs/ /byang chub sems gnyis rgyas pa chos rin chen/ /gzhan phan sems dpa'i stobs ldan bsod rin pa/ /sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol chog zhabasaske/ /lung rtogs rig pa'i rgyal mtshan rdo ring dbon/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun maphyo snying po'i zhabasaske/ /rgyal tshab ye shes rin chen rgya mtsho zung / /bstan 'dzin blo gros che dang 'phrin las dpal/ /thugs rje'i gter chen zla med kun bzang dbang / /byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /de ltar 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /bsgom bsgrub bslab rim bka' brgyud bla ma la/ /mi phyed snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /slob dpon bzang po mig 269

gis 'bras bu bzhin/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes/ /dam pa'i tshogs gyur yongs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /kun gyi thugs rjes rtag tu bzung ba yi/ /brtse ba'i phyag bskyangs bdag gi spyi bor bzhog /zhes pa cung zad sdus pa ste rgyas par ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa nyid shes par bya'o/ /phyag 'tshal rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang phyag 'tshal ba'i gzung 'di ma chad par bya ste/ de yang / oṃ na mo mañdzu shrī ye swā hā/ na maḥsu shrī ye swā hā/ na maḥ.ut+ta ma shrī ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyi nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs zhing la dmigs te brkyang phyag gsum bya ste des ni sde snod gsum thos bsam bsgom gsum byas pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam zhing des nyin re bzhin phyag gsum re byas na mthong lam ye shes tshe 'dir skye zhing de srid mi dang mi ma yin 'byung po nad rims kyi gnod pas mi tshugs par bsrungs par gsungs so/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzang po spyod nas 'byung ba ni nges par gal che de de ni ji snyed su dag nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes so/ /dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog gdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byor yid kyi sprul nas 'bul/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyi bzhes su gsol/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga / /sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /so so skye bo la sogs pa/ /dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang / /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / /blo yi bye brag ji ltar bar/ /che chung thun mong theg pa yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yi/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa/ /thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas/ /ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi/ /'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /yang / dpal mos mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags ni/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal kun bral nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /gang yang bdag gis dus kun tu/ /sdig pa bgyis pa gang gyur pa/ /skrag pas rmi 'drar bshags bgyid cing / /deng nas brtsam te 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rje yi rang / /'khor lo bskor zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bgyi zhing rka/ /skyabs gsum la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa rnams brjod/ bsdu na phyag 'tshal skabs sbyar gyi 270

rjes su bdun gang rung re'i chog la/ rgyas par ni mchod 'phreng maṇ+ḍal sogs gong nas 'byung ltar skabs 'dir bya ba rgyal sras pas bzhed pa dang / spyan ras gzigs sgrub thabs 'phags gzhung rgyud kyi dgongs par yang snang bas legs la/ ma byas kyang de rnams bdun khongs su 'dus pa dang lugs 'dir skyabs 'gro nas tshad med sgom te bdag bskyed la 'jug par yang bstan pas cho ga chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /yan lag bdun yang go rim bzhin cho ga skabs thob tshig so sor sdebs pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug sogs dam pa mang pos mdzad pa yang legs mod/ yang rang gzhung ma 'dres so sor bsrang ste rim par klags kyang mi legs pa ni ma yin no/ /bdun pa bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i de nyid ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang / sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang / bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang / chags sdang med par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te/ tshad med pa bzhi drag tu bsgom/ oṃ swa bha wa shudhaḥsarba dharma swa bha wa shud sgo3haṃ/ zhes pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong zhing / de bzhin nyid las mi 'da' bar bsam mo/ /yang / oṃ shu n+ya tā dzha na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas gzung 'dzin gnyis ka yang stong par bsam mo/ /stong pa'i ngang las sam ljang khu las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte ba la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trīḥdakar po bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ jo bo'i skur gyur pa rnams 'od du zhu ste sngar 'phros pa'i 'od dang 'grogs nas tshur 'dus te trīḥde gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar trīḥyi mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa lta bu byung nas/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par byon nas trīḥl thim pas skad cig gis pad+ma hriḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar ches dkar ba zhal bcu gcig gi rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang / g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang —/g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams zhi 'dzum sgeg cing ral pa dmar ser mdzes shing 'khyil ba/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gcig shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa khams ser gyen du sgreng ba/ de'i spyi bor rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa zhal dmar po mgrin pa dang bcas dbu skra bung ba ltar nag cing gtsug gtor mngon par 'phags pa'o/ /zhal so so'i kha dog dpal mo'i gzhung nas dbus ljang khu dang dmar bas phye ba bzhes pa tsam las mi gsal ba bla ma gong ma rnams kyi tsaṇ+ḍa go ma'i gzhung dang mthun par mdzadaske/ gzhan su dha na ma lar bzhugs pa'i sgrub thabs rgyud kyi dum bu dang 'phags pa klu sgrub dang grub 271

thob ka ma la go ma'i gzhung dang 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam pos mdzad pa dang / lha btsun nā ga ra dza'i thugs dam rnams kyi zhal gyi mdog dang rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba yod/ rtsa ba'i phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas bgrang phreng / gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa g.yon gyi gnyis pa na gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs/bzhi pa na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin rnam par bcang ba/ phyagastothams cad kyi mthil na zhi ba'i spyan re res spras pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug gtor dang / rtsa phyag brgyad kyi phyag mtshan 'di dang mtshungs/ gzhan rgyud kyi dgongs pas lha btsun nā ga ra dza'i thugs dam la rtsa phyag drug dang / 'phags mchog srong btsan zhabs kyi rtsa phyag bcu dang grub thob ka ma la go ma'i gzhung du rtsa phyag bcu gnyis sogs bcu gcig zhal phyag stong rnam grangs lugs mi 'dra ba yin no/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyi bzhengs shing / ras bzang po'i sham thabs dang / nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ske rags can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub dpung rgyan can/ ri dwags kyi lpags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa la sogs pas rgyan cing / mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur / de'i thugs kar gser gyi pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams khyad par ri po ta la nas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal la sangs rgyas dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur du ma byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pas bskor ba skad cig gis spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa la bzhugs par gyur/ o pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs nas/ snying kha'i trīḥlas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥrgyu swā hā/ zhes pas me tog ma dkar mos me tog dpag tu med pas mchod par bsam/ de bzhin du dhu pes bdug spos ma sngon mos bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me ma dmar mos mar me/ gadhes dri mchog ma ljang khus dri mchog ne we t+yas zhal zas ma ser mos zhal zas/ shabhas rol mo phul nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams hriḥl bsdus la/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen me tog la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ /gzhal med khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /zhes pas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa//yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med rnam nges pa/ /gzi brjid rgyal 272

po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa dang / /phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dang / chos sku nam mkha' lta bu sogs/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/mchod bstod rgyas par spro na gzhan yang bya la/ rgyun du ni de tsam bde'o/ /de nas dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon r+ghaṃ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par thim baṃ gyis ye shes pa bstan par gyur/ hoḥzhes pas ye shes pa dam tshig pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/mgrin par āḥdamar po/ /snying khar r+ghaṃ sngon po bsam la/ o āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs su mos pa bya'o/ /yang snying kha'i trīḥ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od dpag med kyi gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te/ mchod pa lnga phul nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sangs rgyas spyan mā ma ki gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams bdud
