rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa byon nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni 'khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku 'khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃ/zhes gsungs zhing spyi bo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag nas ye shes kyi chus lus gang zhing chu lhag ma yar lud pas rtsa zhal gyi gtsug tu bla ma'i ngo bor 'od dpag med dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon par don yod grub pa/ ltag par rnam par snang mdzad rnams kyis rgyan par bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' jo bo'i sku mtshon gang ba cig gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' trīḥdakar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas thugs rje chen po dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas jo bo'i go 'phang la bkod nas tshur 'dus shing thugs kha'i trīḥl thim/ de bzhin du spro bsdu gnyis po 'khor bar bsam zhing sngags bzlas so/ /yang spro bsdu'i ngal na snying kha'i zla ba la gnas pa'i trīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng ba bkod la gzungs zla ba'amaske/ ma mchuglegs shing gi rnam pa shel ltar dngas pa la gzungs sngags dbu g.yon bstan gser gyi kha dog lta bur dmigs la/ tabya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ snyi ri dhi ri/dhu ru dhu ru/ ir+bhe wer+bhe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pā nā ye swā hā/ zhes bcu gcig zhal gyi snying po ste dpal mo'i gzhung dngos gzhir de las ma bstan zhing / tsaṇ+ḍa go ma'i gzhung du zla bya'i sngags gang yin mi gsal—/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung du mgrin sngon gyi gzungs dang pad+masmiṣa bzla bar gsungs/ 'dir byang sems yab sras kyi mdzad pa'i phyag len du mdun bskyed skabs su bstan pa'i gzungs ring tshar gcig gis sna 273

drangs shing snying po brgya dang bdun bzla bar bzhed la/ thugs rje chen po'i yang snying yi ge drug pa yang ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ 'on kyang cho ga 'di'i bzla bya'i gtso bo bcu gcig zhal gyi rtsa sngags gzungs ring dang / snying po gzungs thung dag yin pas de la nges par 'bad dgos so/ /gzungs ring 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas mtshams med pa lnga byas pa rnams kyis kyang 'grub par 'gyur ba 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dam bcas pas the tshom mi bya zhes rgyud kyi tshig ste/ dpal ldan jo bo rjes kyang 'phags yul du gzungs sngags ji snyed pa las gzungs 'di ni byin rlabs lhag par myur ba yin zhes bsngags par grags so/ /de ltar gzungs bzlas pa'i mthar / bdag gi ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bzhugs pa mchod bstod mdor bsdus zhig bya dge ba bsngo slar ye shes pa rang la zhugs/ brgyad pa mdun bskyed kyi cho ga gzungs bzlas bya ba'i de nyid ni dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las saṃ ljang khu las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte ba la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trīḥdakar po bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te jo bo'i skur gyur pa rnams 'od du zhu ste sngar spros pa'i 'od dang 'grogs nas tshur 'dus te hriḥl thim pas hriḥde gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar hri'i mtshan pa gcig tu gyuraske/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu byung nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par byon nas hrīḥl thim pas skad cig gis pad+ma hriḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog ston kha'i zla ba ltar ches dkar ba nas 'phro ba'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes pa'i bar gong gi bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ de'i dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa shar du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can/ lhor tram̐ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can gshegs pa gzhan gsum g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil dkrung gi bzhugs shing sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs gu na noglu/ /'tshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bum pa bzhi grub par gyur/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i trīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams spyi dang khyad par bde ba can dang gru 'dzin nas 'od dpag med dang bcu gcig zhal la spyan ras gzigs sku'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus lus pa med pas bskor ba skad cig gis spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i pad+ma 'dab 274

ma 'bum dang ldan pa la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams rang sngags phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs pa nas mchod bstod dang dbang bskur gyi bar bdag bskyed skabs ltar la ye shes kyi chus lus gang bar gyur zhes rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs ma byas kyang chog byed par spro na ye shes kyi chu'i lus gang zhing chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas gtso bo la 'od dpag med du gyur pa sngar gyi de la thimaske/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la rang rigs kyi dbu brgyan par gyur zhes brjod par khyad par ro/ /gzungs sngags bzla ba'i skabs bdag bskyed ltar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs la spro bsdu gtso bo dang /ma lcogs tshe thugs ka'i hriḥl sems bzung zhing skabs su bdag mdun gnyis ka'i phyag sor las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang zhing yi dwags rnams tshim par bsam la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya dzñā na sā ga ra/ bai ro tsa na/ bhū ha rā dzaḥya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyak+shi bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.arta te bh+yaḥ samyakle budhe bh+yaḥ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ ma hā sa tā ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ o dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ir+bhe wasne/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me wa re/ i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa la ma pā nā ye swa hā/ zhes gzungs rings de nyid brgya dang rtsa brgyad dag par bzlas so/ /thugs rje chen po zhal phyag mang po bsgom par mi nus tshe zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsgom par dge slong ma dpal mo'i zhabs nas gsung pa yis bdag mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' zhal phyag gnyis legs par sems shing / thun mtshams rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jug che bar shes so/ /dgu pa bdun dang bstod phyag gi mchod pa de nyid ni/ dang po yan lag bdun la/bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang slob ma g.yog dang bcas shing mgron thabs kyi lha gsar du yang 'dus par bsam ste/ oṃ/ phyogs dus kun khyab nas spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar gong du bstan ltar dang / de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i gtsug tor can/ /phyag gis mthil nas bdud rtsi'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags bkres skom nad kun sel mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bye brag bcu gcig zhal/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni dkar la mdzes/ /ljang dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /zhi ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbus ljang g.yas dmar g.yon zhal dkar/ /dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon ljang zhal/ /spyan dkyus ring zhing zhal bkra ba/ /'dzum bcas zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro zhal nag po spyan gsum pa/ /mche gcig skra brdzes sma ra ser/ /steng zhal dmar po gtsugs tor ldan/ /bcu gcig zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid thugs chud thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /thugs rje rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /yi dwags bskres skom sel mdzad mchog sbyin phyag /phyag g.yas 'khor lo bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyi ma 275

gos pad+ma bsnams/ /ril ba spyi blugs nyon mongs dri ma 'khrud/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis 'bral mda' gzhu bsnams/ /rnam thar brgyud ldan khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tshad med phrin las kyis—/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun nas bsags/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo chos sku nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa la/ /gzugs sku 'ja' mtshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang / /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'khrugs pa dang snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /rin chen 'od 'phro ri rab mu khyud dang / /'od dpag med dang rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /mthu stobs chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang skyong zla 'od gzhon nu yul 'khor skyongs/ /don zab dgongs 'bral kun 'dri chos 'phags dang / /blo gros ngag yangs don dam yang dag 'phags/ /yon tan 'byung gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma spyan ma mā ma tī/ /gos dkar gdugs dkar rnam rgyal ma tsun de/ /dug sel rigs byed dbyangs can ma nor rgyun/ /'od zer can ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shā ri'i bu sogs nyan thos mchog brgyad dang / /yan lag 'byung sogs gnas brtan che bcu drug /gzhan yang rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi/ /'phags pa dgra bcom rnams phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs rnyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas sras dang slob gyur 'phags tshogs kyi/ /zhal mthong byang chub sems bskyed bslab gzhi blang / /sangs rgyas bstan bsrungs dkar po'i phyogs gyur pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs phyag 'tshal ci rigs dang / mchod rdzas rnams slar yang rgya cher byin gyis brlabs pa bya ste/ de yang bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/me tog gdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo dang gzhan yang 'phan gdugs bla re rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang med pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu rgya nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam zhing dus zhing khams ji srid du gnas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swa hā/ nas/ shabha swā hā'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas shing / o sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra a warta ya a warta ho oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin phabs/ mchod yon 276

phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /o gu ru lo ka na tha de wa ḍa ki ni tri rat+na sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra sa pha na ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ swa hā/ de bzhin zhal bsil la/ pa ju pū dza me gha sa mu dra sogs/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sil snyan gyi bar/ puṣ+pe pū dza me gha nas shaja pū dza'i bar gyi 'bul lo/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig 'bulaske/ spro na/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /rin chen bla re yid 'ong rgyan dang bcasaske/ /chen po nyer spyod bde ba sgrub pa yang / /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /o badz+ra bi ta na āḥhūṃ/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /lha rdzas las byung sna tshogs mdog dang ldanaglu/ /ba dan yid 'ong phyogs bcur g.yo ba yang / /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dbul bar bgyi/ /o badz+ra pa tā ka āḥrgyu/ 'jig rten 'di'i phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can//'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra ts+tsha tra ya āḥr+ghaṃ/ 'jig rten 'di ma phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan nor bu'i tog gi sprasaske/ /bdud kyi dgra las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra dh+wa dza āḥrtsu/ zhes sogs mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed pas mchod/ sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas//rang bzhin kha nas ma mtho 'am/ /bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin pa/ /gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gis steg /nongs pa lags pas bzung du gsol//'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid/ /rjes su yi rang ba ni/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal so'i bde ba dang / /sdug bsngal can rnams bder gnas la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa/ /de la rjes su yi rang ngo / /lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /nges par thar la yi rang ngo ske/ /chos 'khor bskul ba ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /'gro 'di mdongs par mi 'god phyir/ /bskal pa grangs med gzhugs su gsol/ /bsngo ba ni/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te/ /dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang / /des ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /ces yan lag bdun gyi mchod/ de nas slar yang bstod pas mchod pa ni/ /bdag gi ye shes pa mdun gyi 277

gtso bo la bstem/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang sangs rgyas kyi 'phags pa/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes spyan dang ldan pa rnams mdun du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rang gi lus mar me gcig la gnyis mched lta bur 'phel ba'i lus grangs med pa lus re rer mgo grangs med pas 'phags pa'i zhabs ngos su 'dud cing kha grangs med nas lce'i dbang po de nyid kyis 'phags pa la snyan par bstod cing sems can thams cad kyang bdag dang spyod lam mthun par rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas btud par bsam la phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs phyag bcas gong du bstan ltar byas rjes mnyam nyid mi g.yo lta bu rgyud tshig rnam par dag pas bde bar gshegs pa spyi la bstod pa zhig sngon du gtong na legs par nges so/ /de nas bye brag 'jig rten mgon po bstod pa/ de yang mkha' khyab kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dkon mchog kun sku'i rnam pa thams cad kyang thugs 'jig rten mgon po'i ngo bor 'dus shing ji snyed pa ni sku'i rnam 'gyur yang mtshungs par ston pa dang mdun bskyed 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs ka nas 'jig rten mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis bstod tshig dang mthun pa zhig mdun gyi pad zlaru bzhugs par yang mos shing de rnams la gus pa chen pos bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba'i ngo chen rang gi spyi bo'i thad du dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad par bsam la bstod tshig ni/ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a wa lo ki shwa rā ya gik+ṣu shrī ne re stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dge slong ma dpal mos bstod pa zhes bya ba/ o 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis bstod pa po/ /lha yi gtso bo bdud dang tshangs pas bstod pa po/ /thub pa'i rgyal mchog bstod pas grub par mdzad pa po/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs dpag med sku ste sku bzang 'dzin pa po/ /bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas dbu brgyan 'dzin pa po/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bkres skom sel ba po/ /phyag g.yon gser gyi pad+mas rnam par rgyan pa po/ /dri zhim ral pa'i 'phreng ba dmar ser khyug pa po/ /zhal ras rgyas pa zla ba lta bu mdzes pa po/ /spyan gyi pad+ma mchog tu bzang ba po/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar dri ngad ldan pa po/ /dri med 'od chags mu tig tshom bu 'dzin pa po/ /mdzes pa'i 'od zer skya rengs dmar pos brgyan pa po/ /pad+ma'i mtsho ltar phyag ni dngar bar byas pa po/ /ston ka'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan cing gzhon pa po/ /rin chen mang pos dpung pa gnyis ni brgyan pa po/ /lo ma'i mchog ltar phyag mthil gzhon zhing 'jam pa po/ /ri dwags lpags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa po/ /snyan cha gdub bus sgeg cing rgyan rnams 'chang ba po/ /dri ma med pa'i pad+ma'i mchog la gnas pa po/ /lte ba'i ngos ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa po/ /gser gyi ska rags mchog la nor bus spras pa po/ /lta zur dkris pa'i ras bzang sham 278

thabs 'dzin pa po/ /thub pa'i mkhyen mchog mtsho chen pha rol phyin pa po/ /mchog brnyes bsod nams mang pos nye bar bsags pa po/ /rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga nad sel ba po/ /gsum thar mdzad cing mkha' spyod spyod pa ston pa po/ /lus can mchog ster bdud dpung 'khrugs las rgyal ba po/ /gser gyi rkang gdub sgra yi zhabs yid 'ong ba po/ /tshangs pa'i gnas sa bzhi yi dben par mdzad pa po/ /ngang pa'i 'gros 'dra glang chen dregs ltar gshegs pa po/ /yongs rdzogs nye bar bsags shing bstan pa gnyer ba po/ /'o ma'i mtsho dang chu yi mtsho las sgrol ba po/ /gang zhig rtag tu tho rangs langs nas gus pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la sems byed cing / /bstod pa'i mchog 'dis dag cing gsal bar bstod byas na/ /de ni skyes pa'am bud med yin yang rung / /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ dge slong ma dpal mos li kha ra shing 'phel du bstod pa rdzogs so/ /bstod pa oṃ 'jig rten mgon po nas kun 'grub 'gyur bar tshar bdun nam nyer gcig brjod bzhin phyag bya'o/ /bcu pa gsol ba gdab pa de nyid ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bdag la dgongs su gsol/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag skyes bu dam pa rnams sku tshe ring zhing 'gro don 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad bde zhing dam pa'i chos la spyod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs dngos grub kyi tshul du bcu gcig zhal gyi mdun du bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten mgon po de nyid rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug nas snying khar thim pas bdag kyang 'phags pa'i skur sngar bzhin par gyur/de nas bcu gcig pa mchod gtor 'bul ba'i de nyid ni/ 'das gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying po/ tabya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra sogs dang / nye snying yi ge drug pa'i mthar/ oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/zhes pa lan gsum gyis 'phags pa la phul/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' spyi la dmigs te oṃ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ga ṇa sa ka la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇ+ḍaṃ a bya nut+pan+da twata oṃ āḥrgyu phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas phul ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ skyon gyi ma gos dang / nam mkha'i mthar gtugs chos 279

dbyings yongs khengs pa/ /rdul cig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes shing / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yik+ṣi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can la bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /ces phrin las bcol/ de nas chos skyongs dang cha gsum la phyogs skyong 'byung po bgegs rigs spyi ste de rnams la gtor ma dang cho ga 'di'i sgos bsrung du grags pa chu bdag wa ru ṇa yi klu gtor dang / gnas gzhi yul bdag bcas la rang rang gi cho ga shes na shin tu legs pas des bsngos/gal te dang po'i blo can lta bu cho ga de rnams mi shes pa'i mi nus tshe gtor ma so sor bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyi rim par byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro'i sngags rgyas mgron de dang der dmigs te bsngos/ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ oṃ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin bsgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bu bzhin bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong bsrung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung 'jig rten skyong / /'phags pa'i bka' sdod mthu bo che/ /gzhan yang 'byung po bgegs rigs bcas/ /yul bdag gnas bdag grong bdag yang / /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyi phrin las thun mong du bcol/ sarba lo ka gats+tshaḥs gtor mgron 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs/ spros pa chung na mdor bsdus de tsam gyi rung ba'o/ /gtor ma gsum bshams pa la yang gi dkyus su bshad pa'i gtor 'bul de kas 'grub la/ 'das gtor gcig pur byas na 'phags pa dang byang sems spyi la phul pa de kho nas chog pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa smon lam gdab pa'i de nyid ni/ thog mar byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i mchog bstod bsdus pa zhig btang rag gi tshul du phul de nas/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus te/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dam tshig la gnas shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes 'gyur zhing / /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces smon lam btab/bcu gsum pa lhag chad bskang ba'i de nyid ni/ri thog mar me long la lha'i gzugs brnyan shar ba 280

la bum chu blugs shing / 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis 'khrus gsol bas/ /'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma kun bsal nas/ /dri bral sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sku khrus gsol/ spro na ji ltar bltam pa sogs khrus chog rgyas pa dri phyis na bza' 'bul ba'i bar bya/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag las dang po par gyur cing / sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag chad gyur pa dang / gtsang sbra chung ba la sogs pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed la bzod par gsol gyis/ bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ o pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma sa twa twe no pa/tiṣ+ṭha dṛ dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sikhyi m+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shri ya/ ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta/ pad+ma mā me muñtsa/ pad+ma bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ā/ zhes ci nus sam lan gsum brjod/ klu grub dang / tsan+d+ra go mi'i gzhung du o badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyid du bstan mod/ de bla ma gong ma rnams kyi pad+ma sa twa zhes pad+ma'i rigs kyi yig brgyar mdzad pa yin/ des ni gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gyi rgyud gzhung du grags che bar rdor sems dang he ru ka'i yig brgya las gzhan mi gsal yang rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya yi dam rab 'byams su kha bsgyur ba'i khungs bod sngags rnying ma'i rgyud du gsal bzhin 'di rigs de'i man la brten par nges so bcu bzhi pa yi ge drug pa'i sgo nas gzungs sgrub khrus chu'i byin rlabs lan pa'i de nyid ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rgyu/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa ye shes kyi rang gzugs 'phags pa gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa gsum ka yang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sras dang btsun mo'i rnam pa can/ rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar ba/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das yi ge drug pa sku mdog ston zla 'bum ltar dkar ba/ nu ma g.yon ri dwags lpags pas bkab pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang / ut+pal dkar po 'dzin cing / pad zla la zhabs rdor skyil gyis bzhugs pa/g.yas su sras nor bu 'dzin pa ser po phyag 'og ma g.yas mtheb srin bar yid bzhin nor bu dang /g.yon rin chen lcug ma bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bab pa/ g.yon du yum yi ge drug ma gtso bo ji bzhin la lha mo'i 'jo sgeg spyan gnyis ka yang gtso bor 'dud tshul pus mo phyogs gcig pad zla'i gdan la gtsug te gnas pa/ de rnams kyi phyag g.yas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bdag sogs sems can rnams kyi spyi bor 281

bab lus phyi nang med pa lan gsum du bkrus pas dang pos nyon sgrib dag /gnyis pa shes sgrib dag /gsum pas skye med chos sku thob par bsam la/ dung zhal gyi chu la gzungs bum gyi chu thig bsres te gdong dang kha lan gsum du bkrus shing yig drug bzlas nas bum chu lan gsum 'thung / de nas gtso bo yum sras rnams rim par rang gi spyi bor thim pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur cing cung zad mnyam par bzhag pas ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ rgyal sras thogs med pa'i gzhung du 'di bkod par mdzad pa rtsa ba'i khung jo bo rje'i man ngag dang 'bral bar snang bas de dang bstun te cung zad gsal bar phyes pa yin la/ bla ma gzhan nas gtso rkyang dang phyag gnyis par mdzad pa sogs mi 'gal yang ske/rgyal sras pa'i rjes su 'brang phyin de'i gzhung dang mthun par byas na legs par sems so//bco lnga pa bskyed rim gyi nyer ldog 'jug ldang gi de nyid ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i lha la dmigs te/ thugs rje'i phyag na pad+mo yis/ /yid kyi pad+mo kha phye nas/ /rin po che ltar gshegs nas kyang / /tshur byon thugs rje chen po mum/ /zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam la rten yod na de la brten bzhugs rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya nyin phyi ma'i rjes su mchog gi skabs yin na me tog gam/ rdul mtshon gyi tshom bu bsdu gzungs sgrub kyi bum chu 'chad 'gyur ltar spyod par bya'o/ /de nas bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni/ snang srid dag pa'i zhing dang thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur pa rim pas dam tshig sems dpa' la thim/ de yang zhal phyag gzhan rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bsdus/ de yang rang gi snying ka'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / de ting nge sems 'dzin dpa' hriḥyig la 'dus/ trīḥyang thig le dkar po yung dkar tsam du gyur/ thig le yang je phrar stong pa'i dbyings su yal te dmigs med spros bral gyi ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de las ldang tshe skad cig gis thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku sgyu ma ltar snang zhing spyod lam kun lha sngags snying rje'i rnal 'byor dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /bcu drug pa dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo zhing bkra shis mtha' rgyas kyi de nyid ni phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang /byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag gis gso sbyongs kyi tshul khrims bslab cing bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la rten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du 'phags pa gzi brjid 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig dge ba 'di'i myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba cig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /'jam dpal ji ltar maphyo cing dpa' ba dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su 282

bdag slob phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas der mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang / /thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bkang / /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bsngos pa yis bsod nams dam pa mtha' yas gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed phyir/ /kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub te/ /ngan song rgyud rnams ma lus stong par shog /ces dge ba byang chub tu bsngos/ bsdu na tshig bcad thog ma gsum dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bsngos pa yis sogs tshig bcad gnyis tsam gyis chog la/rgyas par ni bsngo smon gzhan yang brjod do/ /de nas bkra shis pa'i me tog gi snod mdun du bkram shing snyim par bzung la/ ston mchog dam pa lha ma'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye rgu kun la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /bdag cag rnams dang yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas rnams mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar gyur cig ces sbyor dngos kyi cho ga'i mthun bar rnams su bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig de tsam bde la/ rjes gtang rag cho ga dang 'bral ba'i skabs su ni grags che zhing /283

khung dang ldan pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs gzhan yang ci tsam mang bzhin legs pas rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas mchod gtor rnams phyogs gtsang ma'i gnas su btang / yang longs spyod par 'dod tshe sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs par bya ste/ sngags ni oṃ de bya en+da sa ma rnyi rgya na pra ṇa ne swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyi sngags nas spyad pas dngos grub kyi rdzas su 'gyur bar gsung pas de ltar gces so/ /gong du gzungs kyi bsgrub pa'i bum chu de ni byin rlabs nus mthu chog tu che ba yin pas gtsang sgra chen po byas te/ skye bo'i rgyu 'grul dben pa'i ri mthon po'i rtse mo dang / yang mang du rgyu ba'i la chen rtse 'am 'dus 'dor gtsang shing mtho ba'i stegs bu'i khar rde'u dkar bzang po spungs pa'i snying por rdul tshon lha mtshan tshom bu ma god blugs gzungs sngags bzlas nas bum pa'i chu bran la cho ga bzhin thugs rje chen por bsgom nas brtan bzhugs shis brjod byas pas/ ri mthong ba dang / lam der rgyu ba dang / rdzing rlung phog pa kun ngan song las grol ba sogs dgos pa phan yon chen po dang ldan par gsungs so/ /yang mi ma yin dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i rten gnas su gong bzhin rde'u dkar po'i bcas sam/ me kyang rung la gzungs bsgrub kyi chu gzungs sngags bzlas shing smon lam bzang po bkra shis kyi 'thor ba'am/ yang mi ma yin de la dmigs bkru byab kyi cho ga ji bzhin byas pas der gnas kyi duḥkha zhi zhing mthu stobs rgyas nas yul phyogs de dge zhing shis par 'gyur ba dang / mi ma yin drag shul rtsub 'gyur can gyi gnas su yang de bzhin byas pas gdug rtsub chung zhing zhi ba byang chub sems skye bar shes so/ /yang klu gtor btang ba dang klu gta' bsdams pa dang / char 'bebs pa dang / da ltar gter bum 'jug par grags pa rnams la ni 'di yi gzungs bsgrub kyi chu lag len ma nor bar spyad na 'bral zhing ches 'jug pas mchog tu shis pa yin no/ /gzhan yang nags tshal thug po'am shing rkang cig dang rdzung bu'am yur ka dang / zhing sa dang khang khyim sogs su bum chu 'thor bas der gnas 'gro ba la phan cing bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /lhag tu chu klung chen por blugs na sems can mang por sman cing de yang yi dwags chu sbyin gyi chu la bsres nas btang bas chu sbyin phal las phan yon 'bum 'gyur du che ba yi gong ma rnams dmigs gsal skabs su bab tshe gtso bor spyod la 'di ni rtag tu lag len du btab par bya ste/ des ni chu de myongs pa'i yi dwags rnams las zad de dag pa'i gnas su skye ba dang sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par 'gyur ba yi byed pa po rnams nad med pa 'byor pa rgyas pa 'chi ba bslus te tshe ring por gnas shing nam zhig dus kyi 'chi ba'i tshe bzang po'i gnas su 'jug cing smon lam gyi 'tshams sbyar na bde ba can du nges par skye ba sogs phan yon tshad med pa yod do/ /khyad par mi'am byol song sogs gang yang rung ba dus mthar gyur pa'i phung po gong bur gnas pa'am/ /dur khrod du rus pa'am skra dang dri ma sogs la gzung sngags bzlas 284

shing bum chu'i 'thor bas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa las nges par skyabs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nad gdon gyi zin pa la yang gzungs chus bkru byab bsrung ba dang / bum chu ring du brten pas duḥkha las grol bar nges so/ /mdor na gzungs bsgrub kyi chu la gzungs sngags kyi phan yon ji snyed bshad pa yi nus pa cha 'thun yod pas des na rang gzhan gyi 'jams des gtsang ma'i sgo nas khrus bya ba dang khongs su btung ba sogs nye bar spyod pas sdom pa gsum gyi pham ltung dang 'tshams med pa'i las la spyad pa sogs tshe rabs brgya stong du mar bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams nges par dag pa dang yang ba dang / ches srab par 'gyur bas 'gro ba'i don la ci nus su spyod par bya'o/ /de yang bsnyung gnas kyi cho ga dpal mo lugs bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrubs bod du mdzad pa rgyal sras thogs med kyi yi ge gtso bor snang la/ de rjes snga phyir grub mtha' tha dad kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas brtsams pa shin tu mang mod/ rgyal sras thogs med sogs dam pa snga ma rnams kyi bum chu'i khrus byed pa tsam las/ gzhan ma bstan pa ni de skabs rigs mthun gyi rgyud shes pa mang zhing lag len mthong rgyud kyis rtogs sla ba la dgongs te lhod yongs su bzhag par snang bas/ 'dir yang brjod bya tshig tshogs mang pos yi ge gzhan bslad kyi dogs snying nas bri dka' ba byung rung phyi ma da lta'i dus su bsnyung gnas mkhan rnams kyi gzungs bsgrub kyi chu'i 'gro don byed tshul yid rtog tsam yang mi byed pa mang bas des na gzhan la phan pa'i lhag bsam kho nas rgyud don bla ma'i man ngag rig pas kho bos phyogs cha tsam zhig snang bar byas pa ste phyin chad gsal bar gyur pa kun yi ge 'di'i mthu ru lta bar byos shig de ltar gso sbyongs bsnyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga 'di la ni sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bya dgos te/ des ni sa ga zla ba'i dus chen lta bu la mtshon na/ tshes bcu gcig la sbyor ba bco lnga la dngos gzhi/ bcu drug gi snga char rjes chog ste/ dang po sbyor ba'i nyin nyi ma ma shar gong du khrus dang sdom pa blang zin par byas nas cho ga la 'jug nyin phyed ma yol yan la kha zas blang bya 'bras gro nas gsum gang yang rung ba'i bshos dang —/ dkar mngar yang rung ste phud 'phags pa la mchod cing 'phrog ma ma bu la yang byin nas ran par gdan cig tu spyod/ kha zas mi 'os pa ni sha khrag sgog tsong gi rigs dang la phug sran ma til rnams spangasaglu/ skom yang bag med ma yin par rung mthun du spyad/ dngos bzhi'i nyin mtho rangs sam nam langs nas khrus dang gso sbyongs blangs nas lus bsnyung bar gnas pas zas skom 'bru gcig gam chu thig tsam yang nges par spangs dgos la/ mchil ma yang mi mid par bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gis gsung ba nus na de yang shin tu bzang / ngag smra ba bcad de cho ga yang yid kyi dang gzungs bzlas yang yid kyis byed par bla ma byang chub sems dpa' yab sras rnams kyis bzhed/ de yang don zhags phyin drug gi 285

tshul khrims dag pa'i gzungs bstan pa'i mthar gzungs 'di bsnyung bar byas te gso sbyongs yan lag brgyad pa bzung nas mi smra bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig dran par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i don dang / rgyud sde spyir 'jug pas legs kyang sher brtson dman pas yid bzlas skabs gzungs lhag chad du gyur na mi rung bas lhag chad spangs te skad shub bus dag par bzlas na legs par sems so/ /de yang rgyud chung 'gyur dag par/ tshig gzhan mi brjod par bzlas zhes gsungs pa dang / tshul khrims kyi gzungs gong gi tshig gi 'phros su/ de nas don yod zhags pa'i snying po bzlas brjod bya'o zhes 'byung bas kyang spyi dang mthun cing mi 'gal ba yin no/ /gang ltar sdom pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin pas bla ma dang sangs rgyas la mchog tu gus shing sems can la byams snying rje dang ldan par byas shing lha'i snang ba dang gzungs sngags kyi sgra la sems ma yengs par bzhag pa rnams shin tu gal che ba nyid do/ /nyin phyi ma gtang rag gi gso sbyongs kyi sdom pa blangs ba bzhag sde cho ga gzhan tshar gcig btang nas spyod lam la 'jug par bya ste/ khyim pa yin yang nyi ma der 'jams des gtsang ma'i spyod pa la gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga de nyid bcu drug gi sgo nas sbyor dngos rjes tshang lan bdun bar ma chad par blang bas bsgrub pa'i bsnyen par gyur te gzungs kyi las tshogs rnams bsgrub pa la dbang ba don zhags mchim 'grel du bshad cing gzhan la bsnyung gnas kyi sdom pa 'bog par yang sngon du bsnyen pa de ltar them dgos zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung gis rgyun las so/ /thugs rje chen po'i bsgrub pa gso sbyongs dang 'bral ba 'di'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa sngags phyi rgyud spyi dang bye brag pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang zhes/ /mtshan tsam lan cig thos pa kho nas kyang / /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la nyer 'god par/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi mgrin gcig bsngags/ /des na 'di yi sgrub thabs gzungs sngags dang / /'phrad pa'i dal 'byor rin chen rnyed dka' 'di/ /thob dus de yi snying po len pa'i phyir/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pas cis mi bsnyen/ /srid zhi las 'das byang chub snying po dngos/ /'dis 'grub rgyal bas yang nas yang bsngags na/ /zhi 'bras tsam dang gnas skabs mtho ris kyi/ /mngon mtho'i dbang phyug 'grub par smos ci 'tshal/ /des na tshegs chung don che don bzang po/ /'dul mdo sngags bcas thun mong ngo mtshar chos/ /de la gus pas bdag gis 'bad smras pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro kun spyan ras gzigs thob shog ces 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal gyi bsgrub thabs gso sbyongs dang 'bral ba 'di ni ring mo nyid nas ngur smrig 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gyur du mas yang yang bskul zhing / /khyim spyod byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can mang pos kyang sngar phyir yang nas yang du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsungs rgyun phyag len gsal bar bod yul gyi ljongs waṃ le bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso lha btsun na ga ra dza'i thugs dam 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig 286

zhal gyi sku brnyan dpal jo bo rjes rab tu gnas pa'i legs par mdzad pa'i drung du dpal rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i chu rgyun chad pa med pa'i dpal gyis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i dpal gdong chu bya dpyid ra dbo zla'i tshes bco lngar dbu brtsam te dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i snga mthun dang por grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa dge slong shes rab bstan 'dzin no//dge'o//dge'o//rog /spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs ni/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan tsam thos pas kyang glu/ /duḥkha kun sel seng ge sgrar btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer 'di bshad bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog oṃ swā bhā wa shurto sarba dharma su bha wa shurjo3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa'i seng ge'i steng / /rang rig trīḥlas 'phags pa seng ge sgra/ /dkar po zhi mdzum sems pa'i skyil krung can/ /tshangs skud ru dwags pags pas phrag g.yon skabs/ /'od dpag med pa gtso bor gyur pa yis/ /rigs lngas dbu brgyan ral pa thor cog can/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa gdan la bsten/ /g.yon gyi snyan thad pad dkar ral gri'i mtshan/ /g.yas su tri shul rgyal rigs sbrul dkar dkris/ /g.yon du pad+mar thod pa me tog bkang / /bdag nyid 'phags pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ /'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' bkugs/ /dam ye dbyer med rang dang gcig tu gyur/ /snying kar zla steng trīḥyig dkar po'i mthar/ /sngags 'phreng 'khor bas 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje gcig tu bsdusaske/ /bdag gzhan 'phags pa'i sa la 'khod par bsam/ /oṃ āḥtrī:sidha nā da rgyu phaṭa/ zhes ci nus bzlasaglu/ thun mtshams su lha sku mi dmigs par bzhag cing dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo/ spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ /byin rlabs rgyun ldan tshig nyung don gsal ba/ /brjod 'di dge bas 'gro kun sdug bsngal las/ /yongs grol 'phags mchog go 'phang myur thob shog /zhes pa yang don du gnyer ba rnams kyi ngor/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bal yul kā ṇa'i ngogs mchod rten lnga bsgrigs su chu sprel nag zla'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa la bkod pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /287

༄ga /'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs gzhan phan thugs rje'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ kun khyab 'od zer rab 'bar rgyal ba'i gtso/ /kun tu 'jig rten mgon der phyag byas nas / /gang gi sgrub thabs snying po khyer bde ba/ /gzhan la phan pa'i slad du 'dir sdeb bya/ /kye ho dal 'byor rin chen rnyed dka' zhing / /nam 'chi cha med mi rtag tshul la sems/ /las 'bras bslu med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /thar ba'i phan yon bsam bzhin chos bsgrub 'tshal/ /ji srid snying po byang chub bar / /sangs rgyas la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la yang mi phyed dang / /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /bdag gtsug 'jig rten mgon po rdo rje sems / /sngags 'khor bdud rtsi'i bdag gzhan sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭhaḥdṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shri ya ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me mūñtsa badz+rī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ mthar ni rdor sems rang la gnyis med thim/ /sgo gsum gcig 'dres rang rig ngo bor a/ /mdun gyi mkha' la bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /de la bdag lus tshe bsod 'byor kun phul/ /snying nas mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma'i gnas gzhir yig 'bru rdo rje bzhi/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hriḥdakar dmar mthing ljang la/ /yig drug gis bskor bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ /dbang bzhi'i sbyangs smin 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ /mthar ni bla ma rang gi spyi bo nas/ /snying gi dbus byon dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ /o su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ 'di ltar gnyis bsdus chos kun stong pa yi/ /stong nyid spros bral chos dbyings chos kyi sku/ /de don ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje yi/ /rang gzugs zla ba rgyas pa'i rnam par shar/ /de steng gsung gi rdo rje yi ge hriḥ /bde chen pad+ma dkar po'i snying por mtshan/ /'od 'phros khams gsum sgo gsum sgrib kun sbyangs/ /rgyal kun sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer 'dus/ /yongs gyur dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po ni/ /rab dkar ston zla bye ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing / /'od zer bye ba dgu khri 'phro ba'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung rdo rje'i 288

gdan / /pad zla la bzhugs zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs dar dang rin chen brgyan/ /phrag g.yon kṛṇ+ḍa sa ra'i lpags pas bkab/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bdud rtsi'i tshims/ /snyan thad rab rgyas pad dkar 'dab brgya'i rtsa/ /thugs kar g.yon pa'i mtheb srin dbus su 'dzin/ /ba spu'i bu ga re rer rgyal ba'i zhing / /tshad med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sku la rdzogs/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/ 'phags pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs ngos rigs bdag /sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med/ /dmar gsal rab mdzes mchog gi sprul sku'i chas/ /chos gos gsum gsol mtshan dpe mchog tu 'bar/ /rdor skyil mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin/ /'od zer mkha' khyab gtsug gtor ltar mi mngon/ /oṃ a mṛ ta pra bha a mṛ ta hūm̐/ 'phags g.yon rang mdangs khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar/ /khro chas spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu mtsher—/ /phyag g.yas gtsor 'dud g.yon pas be con dkar/ /gtso dang dbyer med nyi dang 'od ltar gsalaske/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ha ya gri wā ya/ na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ tabyā tha/ oṃ hriḥku lu mu lu nī la kar+sā hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bad+dha bad+dha/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ ha ha ha ha/ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa trīḥr+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 'phags pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥrtsu gsum las/ /'od 'phros mkha' khyab sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha yi tshogs/ /skad cig mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs shing / /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi yongs mchod nas/ /dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥs bdag la gnyis med zhugs/ /slar yang 'od 'phros rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs/ /spyan drangs mchod byas 'od dpag med par thim/ /snying dbus zla steng trīḥmathar yi ge drug /lung rtogs chos kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rdzu/ bdag nyid rang mdangs khro bcas rigs bdag gi /yig drug bzlas pas bla ma yi dam lha/ /de bzhin lus kyi srin bu ba spu skra/ /rtsa rlung thig le kun las yig drug ldir/ /phyi yi 'byung ba sa chu me rlung rdul/ /sems can rigs drug khams gsum ma lus pa/ /nam mkha'i khams gang sangs rgyas byang sems kyang / /bdag dang lhan cig yig drug bzlas par gyur/ /o ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/ thun mthar bdag gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyi/ /snod snang zhing khams bcud kyi sems can kun/ /'phags pa'i skur gyur de yang rang la thim/ /khro bo che yang bdag gi lus la zhugs/ /mkha' khyab rgyal rnams spyi bo'i bla mar 'dus/ /de yang gtsug nas snying ga'i trīḥl thimaske/ /rang lus zla ba yig drug trīḥthig ler/ /thim yal spros bral ye shes ngang du bzhag /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/slar yang yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgras/ /stong ngang lha sku sgyu ma lta bur shar/ /de ltar bskyed bzlas rdzogs bsgom dge ba'i mthu/ /kun kyang 'jig rten mgon po 'grub phyir bsngo/ /zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa ste skabs dang po'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas—//rdo rje'i bzlas pa mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' myur 'grub byed/ /rdo rje lta bu'i don la blta// 289

kun tu g.yo ba'i sems 'di nyid/ /g.yo med cig tu bcing bar bya/ /'jur bur bcing pa'i sems gang zhig /lhug pa nyid du slod par bya/ /'dzin med yengs med dran pa'i ngang / /rang bab klong du rtag skyong bya / /sngon bsu rjes dpyod gzo bcos spang / /rang grol dbyings su bzhags par bya/ /sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ /skye 'gag gnas cig tha dad stong / /mtha' bral ngang du la bzla zhing / /bsgom med don la goms par bya/ /zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rdzogs rim gyi skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /'jig rten mgon po dus kun tu/ /yid dang mi bral spyod lam bslab/ /lhang tshe 'phags mchog mkha' 'gro yi/ /rol mos ma rig gnyid las bslang / /'phags pa'i phyag gi bdud rtsi yi/ /khrus byas sgo gsum dri ma dag /bzod dang tshul khrims dag pa'i gos/ /rang nyid 'phags pa'i sku la 'gos/ /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyid/ /bdag nyid lha ru gsal la mchod/ /g.yas mkhar dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum/ /bzhugs la gus pas bskor ba bgyid/ /gang du sdod kyang bde ba can/ /rin chen gzhal med khang rang bzhin/ /nyal tshe bla ma snying khar byon/ /rmi lam 'od gsal ngos zin bya/ /dbu ma'i lam las tshangs pa'i sgor/ /'phar 'jug r+ghaṃ phaṭa sbyor bas 'pho/ /snang kun sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bar dor ngos bzung dge sbyor skyongs/ /snang grags rig pa 'phags pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs su lam khyer bya/ /zhes pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rnal 'byor gyi yan lag spyod lam rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bslab pa'i rim pa ste skabs gsum pa'o/ /de ltar 'phags mchog sgrub thabs kun gyi snying po'i bcudaglu/ /tshig nyung don gsal man ngag brgya phrag sgo 'phar kun/ /cig char phye ba'i lde mig snying gi nor bu rin po che/ /'di ko skal ldan skye bo'i tshogs la ci dgar spel/ /dge des nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /'gro kun 'jig rten mgon po yi/ /go 'phang mchog la myur ba nyid/ /thob pa'i rgyu ru yongs su bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di yang gzhan la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyi 'jig rten mgon po la gsol ba btab pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba bzang po dang bcas rab byung skor bcu gsum gyi skyes bdag gi lo chu stod zla ba phyi ma'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum par dpal ldan mtshur bu'i nub phyogs rgyal ba lo ras yab sras kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas byang dbu ri lo ras kyi sku gdung mchod rten rin po che'i drung du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba'o//dge'o dge'o// 290

rog /bhagawaṃ.ār+yaparamalokanāthasusādhayaghad+dhabobh+yostarapoṭalanāmabidzahar/ /༄ga /bcom ldan 'das 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs snying po byang chub mchog gi gru 'dzin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo lo ka nā thā ya/ /rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs/ /mtshan tsam 'dzin pas phyir mi ldog 'god / /spyan ras gzigs dbang sangs rgyas kun gtso/ /de la snying nas rtag par phyag byas/ /de bsgrub sngon rjes sems bskyed dang / /snying rjes chu sbyin bcas khyer bde/ /rang gzhan thar mchog 'grub pa'i phyir—/ /bkod la yid 'ong kun 'jug shog /de yang thun rnams kyi dang po dang 'bral bar gdeng dang kha lag bkrus/ dang po sems bskyed blang ba ni/ phyag sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'gro zhing / sems can thams cad la byams snying rjes khyab par byas nas/ sangs rgyas la snying thag pa nas mos gus dang thob 'dod kyi 'dun pas thal mo sbyar la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltaraske/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang —/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyi sdom pa blang / de ltar sems bskyed pa la rang gzhan dga' ba bskyed cing smon lam gdab pa/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to/ /da ni bdag ni ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /bdag gi de ring skyobs pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs nyid dang niske/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stong par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag su bzhugs pas/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'jig rten mgon po'i bsgom bsgrub ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swā bhā wa shurnyolhahaṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na 291

badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams stong pa'i ngang las rang rig pa/ /'gro la snying rje rol pas yi ge trīḥ/de nyid yongs gyur bdag nyid 'jig rten mgon/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung skyil mo krung / /pad zla'i gdan dang zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas 'dra'i zhal mnga' zhing / /pad+ma dkar po rgyas 'dra'i spyan ras gzigs/ /phyag na mchod sbyin pad dkar 'dab brgya mdzes/ /zhi tshul rgyan rdzogs yid du 'ong ba'i sku/ /spyi gtsug sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyur oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ /'od 'phros rgyal kun spyan drangs bdag la thim/ /badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥthugs dkar pad ma 'dab drug lter/ /zla steng hri mthar yig drug 'khor/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/ 'od kyi rgyal mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs/ /cir snang 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /zhes brjod/ de'i don sems bzhin yig drug ci nus su bzlas/ thun mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ trīḥ skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje spyan gyi 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod/ chu sbyin skabs 'dir gtong ba 'am/ mi btang na lha sku rdzogs rim du bsdu ba ni/ snang srid zhing khams 'phags kun rang la thim/ /rang yang snying ga'i pad zla yig drug hrīḥ /rim bsdus thig le nyag gcig stong par thim/ /slar yang lha sku sgyu ma lta bur grub/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ de nas rdzogs rim dngos la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ rang rig gsal stong chos nyid 'dus ma byasaglu//rang bab sgom med yengs med ngang la bzhag /dus gsum rnam rtog spro bsdu blang ra bral/ /skye 'gag gnas min 'di ni 'jig rten mgon/ /zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes 'bral snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyis yi dwags dang bar do'i chu gter btags pa la/ yi dwags kha zas kyi dri tshor bar mi nus pa rnams la/ kha zas ma byas pa'i nang snga bar sen bar gyi dri ma yang dag par byas shing snod dri ma med par chu shin tu gtsang ba bshams la/ bdag nyid 'phags pa'i skur gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar yang 'phags pa skad cig gis gsal ba'i phyag gi mthil nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi yi dwags thams cad kyi bkres skom sogs duḥkha mtha' dag sel bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hrīḥ.o ma ṇi pad+me rgyu/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas/ /khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /oṃ dza la mi rda sarba pre ta bh+yaḥṭ+wā hā/ zhes sngags tshar re dang lag g.yas kyi chu dum re sbrengs/ g.yon pas sngags re'i mthar se gol gcig kyang re gdab la/ tshul des grangs ci nus su bsag gzhan ma grub kyang yi dwags chu sbyin 'di tsam cig phan yon la bsam ste rab tu 'bad par bya'oglu/ /de nas yi dwags gzhan la snod gtsang mar 'bru 'am mchan nam phye'am khur ba'am zan ril sogs gang 'byor bshams la/ thog mar su ru pa'i gtor ma ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rdzogs pa'i sangs 292

rgyas gzugs mdzes bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis yi dwags rnams bkres skom zhi zhing sdug bsngal sel bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gi gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i gter du byin gyis rlabs/ na maḥsu rū pa ya/ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te/ samyak+shi bud+dha ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ san+ta ra pa ya san+tar pa ya/ sarba pre ta rna swā hā/ zhes pa bdun gyi mthar lag g.yon gyi se gol gsum byas shing / phyi ru dengs shig klag lta 'dod pa rnams/ /'jig rten khams gnas yi dwags thams cad pa/ /rnams la bdag gi gza' ba ster bar bgyi/ /mchog gsum bden pas tshim mgu rgyas thob shog /'di rkang pa gsum klag bde phyir legs sbyar las bod skad du bsgyur ba dang / rkang pa gcig tshig bcad kha skongs su sbyar ba ste gzhan yang smon lam bzang po btab/ 'di zas ma zos gong kho nar byas pas yi dwags thams cad la 'bras bra'o che re re byin par 'gyur zhing / phan yon tshe ring ba dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / phyi ma bde ba can du skye ba sogs mang du gsungs so/ /de nas kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma btang ba ni/ rdzas dang byin rlabs gong ltar la/ lag g.yas kyi gtor ma'i snod la reg nasaske/ gzi brjid tshad med dbang gyur 'od zer rnam par rgyal ba'i shugs kyi gzungs 'di bklags te/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te o saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra r+ghaṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyi mthar se gol gdab/ de rjes de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'jam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod mthar gtor ma'i rdzas gtsang sar dor te tshar mang du btang na snod du chu dang rdzas yang yang bshams te sngags dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gong bzhin byas te grangs tshad ci nus su bsags pa'o/ /'di ni snga gro 'am dus nam du yang rung ste/ phan yon ni/ phyogs nas lhag pa'i yi dwags gaṅga klung gi bye ma khrag khrig brgya stong snyed so so nas kha zas yul ma ga dha'i bra bdun bdun thob pas tshim zhing / yi dwags nas mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur la/ gtor ma btang ba po yang tshe ring bsod nams 'phel/ sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa myur du rdzogs/ mi dang mi ma yin pas 'tshe mi nus shing sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snyed mnyes par byed pa'i mchog 'gyur ba sogs mang du gsungs so/ /de ltar yi dwags chu sbyin mtshan gsum ste grub na gsum ka dang / ma grub na re re cis nas kyang ma chad pa gal che bar bya'o/ /de nas bar do'i gtor ma btang na/ rdzas kha 'bar ma'i skabs ltar bshams la/ mdun gyi mkha' la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa gsal zhing / de'i byin rlabs kyi bar do'i sems can rnams zas skom gyi tshim zhing sgrib pa dag par bsam la/ sngags kha 'bar ma ltar gong bzhin lan bdun dang / na mo rat+na tra 293

yā ya/ oṃ kai ka ni kai ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/sarba karma pa raspa ra ṇi me sa twa nañtsa swa hā/ ci nus bzlas mthar/ bdag gis bshams pa'i rdzas 'di sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs mthu'i/ bar do'i sems can kun sdug bsngal yongs bral bde dang ldan/bar do ngo shes lha dang bla ma rjes dran de yi byin gyis brlabs/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ngos zin bar dor zung 'jug sku thob shog ces smon lam btab/ bar do'i 'gro ba chu sbyin yang thad rung gtso bo dri za ba shas che bas gong gi cho ga'i rdzas phye mar gyi bsur btang na legs pa kho bo'i rnam rtog go/ /de ltar chu sbyin tshang bar btang na spyi dang / re re las mi btang na de yi mthar chos sbyin bya ste/ de yang / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyongs chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa na/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge sbyongs dag /sdug bsngal kun las nges grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las la kun byung ba/ /ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang chad du gtor ma btang phyir ram/ /rgyun chags spyod lam gyi skabs su yang ste/ /'bab chu'am/ gdeng ka rdzings bu/ lu ma lta bu dang phrad pa na der 'dug la/ /bdag mdun 'phags pa phyag nas bdud rtsi bab pa gong bzhin gsal btab ste/ /gtsang sbra byas pa'i lag g.yas kyi 'khyor ba chus bkang nas ye shes skar mda'i sngags bklags shing khyor chu de chur dor ba lan bdun bya'oske/ /de yi phan yon sangs rgyas kyi gzigs pa'i yi dwags ma lus pa re re yi lha yi gza' btung ma dha yi bra bdun bdun thob pa dang / chu de 'thung ba'i 'gro ba kun kyang bde 'gro thob pa sogs mang du gsungs pas ci nus su 'bad par bya la/ skabs 'dir gong gi chu sbyin grub mtshams gtor chu bsags pa'i snod du ye shes skar mda'i sngags tshar re dang / chu snyim pa re byas la lan bdun blugs te/ de phyi rol 'bab chu sogs su dor na gong du bshad pa'i phan yon thob phyir lag len du btab par bya'o/ /ye shes skar mda'i sngags ni/ oṃ r+sā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta spa ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi/ du ru du ru/ hri da ya dza la ni rgyu/ zhes so/ /de ltar sbyin pa'i bya ba gang byas kyang mthar sbyin pa rnam par dag pa'i gzungs bklags par bya la/ de ni 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 294

o a mo gha pā sha/ ma hā dā na pā ra mi tai/ pa ri pū ra ya hūm̐/ da ra da ra/ bi bi da ra bi tsi treḥ sarba sa twa u pa bho ga /sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā dā na pū dza me gha/ pra bar ta ya/ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra ya/ tā ra ya/ ma hā pad+ma ni r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'i don yod zhags pa chen po'i snying po ste/ gang gi yung 'bru tsam yang sbyin pa byin te/ dran pa tsam gyi lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na mchod sbyin sbyin pa rnam par 'phrul pa chen por ni shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes don zhags phyin drug gi bzung nas te/ sbyin pa'i dge ba nyams pa med pa spel phyir bklags na shin tu legs pa'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥzhes pas bdun gyi bcom ldan 'das rang gi dpral bar tho sarba gats+tshaḥzhes se gol gtogs nas gtor mgron gshegs/ yi ge brgya pa lan kha yar gyi nongs pa bshagasatso/ bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa sogs kyi dge ba bsngo/ smon lam btab/ bkra shis brjodaglu/ de nas spyod lam kun 'phags pa'i khyer po dang mi bral bar bya'o/ /grags che rkang tshugs cho ga gsumaske/ /gcig tu bsdu tshul sngon med 'di/ /'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs mthu'i/ /grub las gzhan gyi nam yang min/ /de ltar gzhan phan bsam pa kho nas/ /bdag gi yang ni 'bad bgyis dge des/ /mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa kun/ /'jig rten mgon po myur 'grub rgyu gyur shog /zhes pa'ang mnga' ri mu khun k+ṣe tra'i rje 'bangs rnams dang / gtsang dbus ru bzhi'i char rang slob sbyin bdag nang rje rnam par dkar ba'i blo ldan du mas kyang bskul ba dang / nye bar zha lu ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen 'jam dpal don 'grub kyi nan tan bcas shing / lhag tu 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs rje'i rol gar 'gro ba'i ded dpon rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal chen po karma pa bcu gsum pa'i zhal snga nas de ltar 'bri bar 'os so zhes bka' yi gnang ltar 'gro ba mang po la phan pa'i lhag bsam kho nas tshegs chung don che tshig nyung gnad zab dgos pa mchog dang ldan pa'i gzhung rang gi 'dod ltar rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rab byung bcu gsum pa'i skyes bdag gi lo gsar du 'char nye ba mgo zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa la gnyal rmad gra 'or du ze regs 'phral mar btab nas 'jig rten mgon po'i pho brang mtshur gyi garnyo lar yi ge gnyis par bkod cing / slar yang mnga' ris mang yul byams sprin gyi gtsug lag khang du/ chu spre'u sa ga'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis par bsnanam 'os kha shas sbyar ba ste 'dis kyang 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyu rlabs po che 'grub par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ / 295

༄ga /thugs rje chen po lo kai shā ra'i sgrub thabs/oṃ swāsti/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams gyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur grub shog /oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swā bha wa shudho3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma kauphohaṃ/ chos kun gdod nas bdag bde stong pa nyid/ /de don ma rtogs snying rje zla ba'i gzugs/ /'pho bcas rlung dag 'gag med yi ge trīḥ bde ba chen po pad dkar sdong bu bcas/ /rdo rje gsum dngos de las 'od 'phros pas/ /kha mas gsum sgrib sbyangs sku gsum byin brlabs bsdus/ /yongs gyur 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs/ /rab dkar zla ba bye ba'i 'od 'phrog cing / /mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngom rdo rje'i sku/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum zhi ba'i lta stangs can/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin bdud rtsi'i yi dwags tshim/ /g.yon pas pad dka' 'dab stong yu ba 'dzin/ /ral pa dmar ser thor tshugs lhag ma 'phyang / /ri dwags pags pas phrag pa g.yon bkab cing / /dar dang rin chen zhi ba'i tshul rgyan rdzogs/ /sems dkyil zla gdan zla ba'i rgyab yol mdzesak+ṣi//ral pa'i ngos su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/mchog gi sprul sku mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs//gnas gsum rdo rje gsum dang thugs kyi dbus/ /pad dkar zla steng trīḥdakar yig drug bskor/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ yi dam kun 'dus bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /bla ma kun 'dus spyi bor 'od dpag med/ /thugs ka'i sa bon yig drug chos kun 'dus/ /bdag gi ngag nas yig drug bzlas pa'i tshe/ /nang gi srin bu phyi yi ba spu dang / /skye 'gro sems can 'byung ba'i rdul phra rag /de bzhin mkha' mnyam sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs/ /kun gyi yig drug sngags kyi sgra dbyangs ldir/ /thun mthar snod bcud gzhal yas lha'i rang bzhin/ /kun 'dus bdag thim nam mkha'i rgyal ba sras/ /'od dpag la thim de yang rang la thim/ /rang yang sa bon thig le stong par yal/ /slar yang sngags sgras bdag nyid lha ru ldang / /snang grags rig pa 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /khyer so gsum ldan sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang / /yengs med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog du bsngags pa desaske/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang por spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi rba 296

rlabs 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces pa 'di yang dpal chen chu bo ri pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor pa don grub rgyal mtshan dang / dad gus kyi lang 'tsho brtas pa grwa phyi smin grub sde pa dag gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sa 'brug gnam lo gsar 'char rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gtsang gi stag tshal rig 'dzin grub pa'i bsti gnas maṅga la ku ṭar smras pa sarba maṅga lo/༄ga / bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo'i skub thabs bsrung bzlog man ngag gi khyad par can tshig nyung don gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la yang mi phyed dad/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid thob par shog /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /hūṃ las rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / dra ba bla bra gur khang dkrigs pa'i dbus/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bdud 'dul gyi/ /mchod rten lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems gdugs dkar poske/ /oṃ gyis mtshan las 'od 'phros sems can bsgral/ /'phags mchod sangs rgyas kun gyi gtsug tor nasaglu/ /gdugs dkar rigs sngags yig 'bru dpag med pa/ /spyan drangs tshur 'dus oṃ mtshan gdugs la thim/ /de nyid yongs gyur rgyal kun byin rlabs mthu/ /gcig bsdus gzhan gyi mi thub gdugs dkar moske/ /rtsa ba'i zhal gcig spyan gsum khros pa'i nyams/ /phyag g.yas sdig mdzub rtse la ka na ka'i/ /'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa drag tu bskor/ /phyag g.yon pha lam rdo rje rtse dgu 'dzin/ /yan lag dbu stong bzhin 'gyur sna tshogs can/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs phyag stong mtshon cha 'phro/ /sku lus kun tu rnam 'gyur ma nges pa'i—/ /bye ba brgya stong spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs/ /sna tshogs rgyan spras sna tshog na bza' can/ /rdo rje skyil krung me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /steng gi mkha' la rin chen mchog tu mas/ /yongs spras gser gyi yu can gdugs dkar 'khyir/ /rigs sngags pho nya pho nya mo 'gyed cing / /mchod pa'i sprin gyis 'od zer 'phro mdzad ma/ /sangs rgyas ma lus kun gyi dbang skur ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rim gro'i yulaske//'jig rten skyong ba kun gyi cod pan gyi/ /zhabs la btud de mchod bstod bka' bzhin du/ /nyan par byed pa rig sngags thams cad kyis/ /'khor los bsgyur ba chen po'i sku ru gyur/ /de lta'i gnas 297

gsum o āḥr+ghaṃ gsum las/ /'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / /dbang gi lha rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ kun bzang mchod sprin gyis mchod puts+tsha ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho dam ye dbyer med gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma yo shri ye r+ghaṃ/ zhes pas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag yar lud spyi bor rigs kyi bdag /rnam snang dkar po byang chub phyag rgya can/ /mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbu brgyan cing / /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang gi lha dang bcasaske/ /rang nyid la zhugs byin rlabs rgyas par gyur/ /rang gi snying khar zla steng o dkar po'i/ /mtha' mar sngags 'phreng 'khor zhing 'od zer las/ /mchod pa'i sprin byung sangs rgyas 'phags tshogs mchod/ /rdo rje phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi gnod byed rnams/ /dgug cing bzir mnan bskrad pa'i sbyor ba sogs/ /sna tshogs las kyi gdugs pa tshar gcod cing / /khyad par khro bo mi g.yo mgon po yis/ /phur bus gdab nas gnod byed meg med brlag /de bzhin rdo rje'i gur khang phyi rol du/ /pha lam 'khor lo rtsibs stong drag 'khor zhing / /gnam lcags ral gri rdo rje phur bus gur/ /ye shes chu me rlung gi bsrung 'khor gyi/ /gnod byed byad ma bdud bgegs log 'dren rnams/ /phye mar thag cing rdul phran cha med du/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings su yal bar bsam/ /tabya thā/ oṃ ā na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai ra/ bai ra/ sau me/ sau meske/ sarba bud+dha a rnyiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ sarba ta thā ga ta usnri ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭaḥrgyu ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/zhes snying po nyid ci 'grub du 'bad pas bzla zhing / de nas thun mtshams su ar+ghaṃ sogs pas mchod/phyir bzlog chen mo rig sngags rgyal/ /gzhan gyi mi thub stobs chen ma/ /gdugs dkar chen mo sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems pa'i tshogs bcas bstod/ mthar ni snang srid chos thams cad/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor gyur/ /de dag rten dang brten par bcas/ /lha mo'i thugs ka'i oṃ la thim/ /de yang khog pa mgo bo dang / /zla phyed thig le nā dar thim/ /nā da chos nyid 'od gsal ba/ /spros bral ye shes ngang du zhugs/ /slar yang rang nyid skad cig gi /bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gyur pa'i/ /gnas gsum oṃ āḥrgyu gis mtshan/ /snang grags kyis bsdus chos thams cad/ /don dam rang bzhin spros dang bralaske//snang cha sgyu ma lta bu ru/ /ye shes lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /gdod nas rnam dag ngang la bzhag /dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /'phags ma gdugs dkar 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /zhes bcom ldan gzhan gyi mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bsrung bzlog gi man ngag khyad par can tshig nyung don gsal 'di ni rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rnga chen chu khyi lo smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gang ba'i dus bzang por 298

kong yul ljon pa lung bsgrub grwa'i bsam gtan spyi bor bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni shākya'i dge tshul shes rab bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya su dza ya/thun mtshams su bzung med yang ci nus bklag par bya la/ spyi sgrub thabs 'di cho ga'i chings bla med du bkral bar ma zad lha sngags kyi ngo bo yang bla med rgyud nas phyung ba yin pas rgyud sde 'og mar bzhugs pa las khyad par 'phags shing byin rlabs nan ltar ches pas sgrub thabs 'di 'bad pas bzung bar bya'o/ /ka lja wad+dhaskyo n+tu swā hā/ dge'o/ /rog /bka' 'dus bhing po'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs/o āḥr+ghaṃ/ skye med rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /'gag med rol pa rgyal ba sras bcas la//gsol ba 'debs so mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /dbang bzhi chu bo'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /1 'og min rnam dag dur khrod chen po nas/ /che mchog he ru ka dpal chen gtso dgu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /2 ye shes las dang mkha' spyod gnas yul nas/ /rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag yongs bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /3 chos dbyings klong las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngang / /gang 'dul sprul sku dpal mgon 'khor bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /4zhes pa 'di ni nor bu rtsegs zhol nasaske/ /bka' 'dus snying po yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /mchod pa yid bzhin nor bu 'phrengs ba ces tshe dbang nor bu'i zhal nas gsung pa bzhin/ /yi ge'i rig byed nor bu blo gros so/ / bka' 'dud sgrub brgyud phyogs bcur rgyas par shog sarba maṅga lo/༄ga /rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag 'jam dpal zhal lung gi 'pho ba nyung gsal ye shes dgongs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badz+ra mañdzu shrī ye/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yi/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog 'di bsgrub par byed/ / 299

sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar ni bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma 'jam dpal dpa'/ /he ru ka dpal dkon mchog gsum spyi dpal/ /de la skyabs mchi mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi'i bdag byin rlobs/ /bdag lus mi dmigs 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sku/ /lte smin kha sna rna mig gtsug hūṃ mthing / chu lam sum dkar bshang lam k+ṣu yig dmar/ /kun kyang 'od zer dang bcas sgo dgu 'gegs/ /rang gi phung khams rigs lnga yum bzhi'i dngos/ /dbang yul sems dpa' sems ma'i rang bzhin nyid/ /spyi bor rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /rdo rje rtse dgu 'od zer lnga 'phro'i lter/ /chos kyi dbyings ngo rdo rje rtse lnga dkar/ /lte bar zla steng thig le dmar ser zlum/ /tsa na ka tshad zab gsal dbyer med dngos/ /'od zer sna lnga rab tu 'phro zhing 'barasto/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo snang ba kun/ /rang gi sems snang thar ni hril rjes kyi/ /snying ga'i thig le la thim de dhu ti/ /rdo rje gnyis ra dbus ma rgyud nas lter/ /thig le la thim 'khor lo gtso bo'i skuske/ /rdo rje rtse dgu de yang rtse lnga pa/ /de thig ta la bdun srid mkhar 'phang nas/ /je phra mthar ni 'od gsal stong nyid ngang / /'dzin med mnyam bzhag chos sku thob mos shing / /de ngang zab gsal lha sku longs spyod rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor dpag med sprul nas sems can kun/ /sangs rgyas sar bkod sprul sku'i nga rgyal bzung / /de ltar 'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhal lung mchog grol ba'i thig le 'pho ba'i man ngag gang / /bsgom pa'i nus pas tshe 'dir sku gsum gyi/ /'bras bu mngon gyur 'jam dpal dbyangs thob shog /'dis ni dbang rab tshe 'dir 'bring bar do/ /tha ma rig 'dzin grub nas skye ba bdun/ /tshun chad grol zhes 'jam dpal gyis gsung pas/ /som nyi med pas bsgom bsgrub la 'bad gces/ /tshul 'di shes nas bla ma'i man ngag ltar/ /smra bar byed po tshe dbang nor bu ste/ /dge des srid 'gro 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skemasaglu/ /byed po 'jam dpal bdag gis myur thob shog /ces pa yang gtsang ru lag gdod dga' bkra shis rtse yi sde pa pad+ma tshe brtan gyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus shing stag chu stod zla ba bden bzhi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la grom pa rgyang du bris pa'i yi ge pa rang gi slob ma blo bzang dar rgyas so//maṅga lo/grol thig 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs ring rgyud khrid brgya'i rgyun ltar las 'dir ni nye brgyud du/ rdo rje sems dpal 'jig med gsang ba sbyin/ /bsod nams mchog gyur zla ba rgyal mtshan pa/ /nam mkha' rin chen chos sku lha dbang grags/ /sgrol mgon ye shes rin chen rgya mtsho'i ste/ /snying po mtha' yas blo bzang tshe brtan dpal/ /tshe dbang nor bu rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so zab lam 'pho ba yi/ /tshe 'dir sku gsum 'bras bu thob byin rlobs/ /brgyud pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yod kyang 'dir de ltar bde'o/ /zhes pa yang lha rtse yi blo gsal rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang dpal 'byor gyi bskul ba'i ngor gong gi 'phros su smras pa maṅga lo/ / 300

gag /rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyi mdzad pa'i lam gang shar ma'i 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu tra ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras la kun gyi yab/ kun gyi ngo bo kun gyi 'phrin las pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje spyan ras gzigs/ /de las gzhan min mtsho skyes bde chen gter/ /dbyer med sgyu 'phrul rol rtsed gangs can mgon/ /ye shes rdo rje sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog /mtshungs pa mi mnga' mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag /dpal ldan sprin sgra'i zhabs la spyi bos mchod/ /de yi gsung rab zab la rgya che las/ /mchog tu gces pa rdo rje'i gsung tshig gsum/ /zab dgu'i man ngag kun gyi bcud phyung ba/ /phyag rgya chen po'i yang zhun thig le gang / /yongs su grags che kun gyi rtogs dka' ba/ /rin chen gter 'dra de don gsal ba'i phyir/ /lde mig lta bur bdag gi blo nus kyis/ /ji tsam nus te 'bad las bshad par bya/ /'dir dam pa'i chos mchog tu zab pa gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po zhes yongs su rlung ltar grags pa nyid la/ rgya bod kyi slob dpon grub pa dang mkhas pa ches mang bas gdul bya'i blo ngor dang rang nyid mos pa'i dbang gi phyag rgya chen po'i bstan bcos tshig don gyi rnam grangs rgyas bsdus bsam gyis mi khyab pa spel zhing / chos thams cad kyi snying po lta bur phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor yin zhes grags pa ltar/ man ngag dngos bstan gyis don la yang de ltar gnas pa nyid yin laske/ de dgongs don ma lus pa 'dus shing rdzogs rim gyi gnad spyi'i don mtha' dag kyang bde klag tu rtogs par bya phyir/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul du grags shing grub pa dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes rgyal ba'i sras 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje gang gi zhal snga nas phyag rgya chen po'i don mtha' dag nyams 'og tu chug nas mkhyen bzhin gyi gsung rdo rje'i tshig rkang gsum pa 'di nyid rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba btab pa'i 'dod don gtso bo mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po thob par bya ba yin phyir bkod par mdzad pa yin la/ de lta na yang phyis kha cig gi rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor bas mdzad par bzhed de don la mi 'gal rung gnas skabs su ma rtogs pa'i skyon te/ tshig rkang gsum po stod 'brug gi phyag chen gsol 'debs la yang yod cing / mkhas grub chen po sogs bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis kyang 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi gsung du bzhed la/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyugs rgyal sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs kyis kyang gong ma na rim gyis gsung mu mthud yin par zhal gsal cing don la'ang de ltar nges mod/ des na de 301

ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi lta ba'i gnas lugs/ lam bsgom pa'i skyong rim/ mthar thug 'bras bu shar tshul bstan/ de yi don nyung ngu rab gsal gyi tshul gyi 'dir brjod par bya ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i gzhung bkod pa de'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang / /lam gang gar la spang blang med pa dang / /snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'o/ /de la rdo rje'i tshig dang sems ni/ gzhi lta ba'i gnas lugs bstan te/ 'di la gnyis/ phyag rgya chen po'i spyi gzhi ngos bzung ba dang / bye brag lta ba'i gnas lugs bstan pa'o/ /dang po la yang dngos dang 'phros don gnyis las/ dang po la/ sems nyid ces pas ni gzhi phyag rgya chen po bstan te/ rdo ha las sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das phro ba/ /zhes pas so/ /de nyid spyi gzhir bzhugs tshul ni/ de yang sems nyid gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa stong gsal 'gag med chos dbyings kun khyab chen po'i ngo bor sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bzang ngan dang 'pho 'gyur bri gang med par rtag khyab lhun grub tu bzhugs pa de la theg chen thun mong pa nges don snying po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams su ni khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i rigs zhes kyang brjod la/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang / 'gyur ba med pa'i chos yongs grub chen por yang bzhed de/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ dag pa dwangs pa 'od gsal pa/ /mi 'khrugs 'dus ma byas pa nyid/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ste/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na sems can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes dang / ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas te/ 'dir lung khungs su smos pa'i mdo bstan bcos gnyis ni mdo lugs phyag chen gyi gzhung du'ang bzhed par snang ngo / /thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa ltar na/ phyi rgyud du bdag gi de kho na nyid dang / thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems sogs dang / nang rgyud bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams su ni/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus sogs su mi shigs thig le dang / ma rgyud bde mchog tu mi 'gyur thig le dang ske/ gnyis med dus 'khor ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid du brjod pa sogs te/ ji skad du/ lus can snying la gang gnas pa/ /rang byung zag med ye shes gzugs/ /mi shigs thig le bde chen no/ /nam mkha' lta bur kun khyab pa/ /mi gnas chos sku'i rang bzhin yin/ /zhes dang / /bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi/ /thig le gcig la 'gyur med pa/ /de sgom byed pa'i skyes bu la/ /nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dam pa dang po'i rgyud tshig 'phags 'grel dri med 'od du drangs par/ phra rags rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya 302

chen por phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / /khyad par 'di nyid kyi rgyud gzhung du bzhed pa dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud las/ sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /e waṃ lus kyi lte bar gnas/ /de nyid lus gnas ye shes che/ /rnam rtog kun spangs de nyid grub/ /ces dang / brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams kyis ni gzhi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i gzhan du gzhi rgyud dam rgyu'i rgyud du'ang grags pa de nyid bstan te/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi byed pas 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir kun gzhi'i spyi gzhir grags pa'o/ /de ltar na 'dir sbyangs gzhi dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag gi bzhugs tshul la/ mdo sngags so so'i ming btags kyi dbye tshul go don tsam brjod pa yin la/ de yang spyir phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor 'di nyid dngos bstan jo bo nā ro pa dang mnga' bdag mi tri pa sogs kyi bzhed pa ltar ma rgyud phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po nyid yin mod kyi/ /'on kyang phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i sgra tsam ni 'khor 'das spyi la'ang khyab cing / khyad par 'di nyid snying po'i mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad dang /khyad par bla med kyi rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying po rim pa gnyis pa'i rim pa gnyis pa rdzogs rim mthar thug bzhi pa'i ye shes lhan skyes kyi bde ba stong gzugs dang ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i bde stong rnam pār mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid la zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po zhes brjod pa yin pas srid zhi kun khyab kyi ye shes thams cad kyi spyi gzugs yin phyir ma
