rgyud phyag rgya bzhi tsam du ma zad pha rgyud rim lnga sogs dang /ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim dbyibs sngags chos gsum/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim lnga/ dpyid thig sogs du ma dang glu/ gnyis med kyi sbyor ba yan lag drug sogs mthar thug 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim thams cad kyi lam gyi gnad 'ga' re ma gtogs thog ma'i gzhi dang / 'bras bu'i skye bo thams cad kyang 'dir don gyis 'du ba yin no/ /de ltar yang bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ de yi rang bzhin rang bzhin med/ phyag rgya chen po zhes ni brjod/ zhes dang / dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ rnam rtog sgom pa las 'das pa/ /phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde/ /zhes dang / dgyes rdor 'grel chen las/ las dang chos dang phyag rgya che/ /dam tshig zhes bya 'od gsal nyid/ /zhes sogs mang zhing / 'di nyid kun gyi rtse mor gyur pa yang gsang ba grub par/phyag rgya chen po rnams sgom pa/ /de yi gong na gzhan med pa'o/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod du phyag rgya chen po las lhag pa'i/ rnal 'byor kun la mchog med do/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa 'phros don la yang gnyisaske/ gzhi las grol 'khrul du snang tshul dang / dogs pa spangs pa'o/ /dang po la/ de ltar kun gzhi 'dus ma byas dbyings gshis cir yang ma grub pa skye med stong chen nam mkha' lta bu de las/ rtsal gang 303

du'ang 'char ba 'gag med kyi rtsal snang blo bur kyi rnam rtog sprin ltar byung ba de nyid lhan skyes ma rig pas rgyu dang / kun btags ma rig pas gnyis snang du 'dzin pa'i rkyen las lus snang sems gsum du bag chags te rang ngo la sgrib pas dug lnga dug gsum sogs rten cing 'bral 'byung gi mthu brtas pa las 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i chos su grub la/ de nyid lam phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag la gnad du bsnun pas 'khrul pa'i dri ma dag nas rang bzhin rang ngo shes na myang 'das sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba nyid / brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib/ /de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal la bstod pa las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /rnam rtog de dang bral bas na/ /khyod nyid rtag tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dogs pa spangs pa ni/ kha cig 'di snyam du/ rnam 'grel las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba/ /zhes dang / bden gnyis las/ sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa'i/ /sgro btags rnam pa can rtog yin/ /zhes bshad cing / gong du'ang sems dang rnam rtog dang glo bur gyi dri ma rnams khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyur bshad bzhin du/ dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams rnam rtog chos skur bzhed pa ci snyam na/ bden mod kyi/ de ni sems dang / rnam rtog dang / chos sku rnam ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa lag pa'i ltag rgyab ltar gnas pas/ de nyid rang bzhin shes pa'i gdams pa'i thabs kyis zin na chos skur grol ba las dgongs pa yin te/ mnyam med sgam po pas/ sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum/ /ye nas lhan cig skyes pa de/ /gdams pas gcig tu sbyor ba la/ /lhan gcig skyes sbyor mi zer ram/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyal ba rgod tshangs pa'i ro snyoms sgang dril du/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog 'di rnams lung ma bstan yin te thabs kyi zin na sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro/ /rang gar spyad na 'khor ba'i rgyu mi dge ba bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyal dbang rjes rnam rtog gi rang bzhin shes tsa na/ gang shar rnams chos skur khrol lo lo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin te/ 'di ni rnam rtog tu ma zad dug lnga dug gsum sogs nyon mongs ye shes kyi rgyur bshad pa la yang mtshungs te gang dang gang gi rang bzhin shes pa'i thabs kyis zin na de nyid ma spang rang sar grol bas de dang de'i 'bras bu ye shes su shar ba yin no/ /de skad du yang brtag gnyis las/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gi 'ching gyur pa/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /ces so/ /'on kyang thog mar rnam rtog gi sgras smos pa tsam ni blo rtog pa can rnams rnam rtog la byed kyi sgom nas rim gyis rtog med la/ dkri ba'i thabs su yang dgongs te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rnam rtog bag chags kyis bcing la/ /thog mar rtog pa'i cho ga bstan/ /rnam rtog rang bzhin shes pa na/ /mi rtog pa la 'jug par bya/ /zhes 304

gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de bzhin du tha mal gyi shes pa zhes gsungs pa yang sems nyid ma bcos pa'i don las tha mal rang ga ba ni ma yin te/ bram ze chen pos/ de ring phan chad tha mal yin/ /rang rgyud pa yi tha mal min/ /don gyi tha mal ye shes che/ /zhes gsungs pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa la yang lta ba'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang / 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni lhan skyes zhes pa ste/ de la lhan skyes ni/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ zla ba'i kun dga' nyi ma'i rab gsal dang / /me yi tsha ba rlung gi mgyogs pa dang / /snying rje dga' ba skye bo che rnams kyi/ /gzhan la phan pa lhan skyes rang bzhin yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ zla ba la sogs pa'i phyi'i dngos po de dag la yang rang rang gi yon tan de dag ye nas rang chas lhun grub tu gnas zhes pa ste/ don du de dang de'i rang bzhin yin la/ de bzhin du gong du bshad pa'i sems nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i gzhi dbyings 'dus ma byas pa de la'ang rang rig bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyid gdod ma nas lhan gcig tu skyes pa ste/ de'i rang bzhin du gnas pa nyid/brtag gnyis las/ rang bzhin lhan gcig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /zhes gsung pa ltar yin la/ de nyid lta ba'i dngos gzhir gyur pa ni/ de yang sems nyid gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i dbyings stong gsal 'gag med de yang ye nas stong pa phyam chad ma yin te bde gshegs snying po'i rigs rgyun chad pa med pa so so rang rig pa'i ye shes zung 'jug lhan skyes mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen pos khyad par du byas pa'i rig cha de yang ye nas gzhi dbyings dang 'du 'bral nam yang yod ma myong la/ glo bur bzung 'dzin gyi cha rnam par stong zhing gos ma myong bas/sgrib pa med pa'i rang rig rang gsal smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i rang ngo de la snang srid 'khor 'das/ kun rdzob don dam/ bdag gzhan bde sdug rtag chad mtha' dbus/ yod med yin min—/ rnam shes ye shes sogs gnyis su 'dzin pa'i blo rtog dmigs pa'i mtshan ma thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i ye shes rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral bas dum bu ris su ma chad cing / dus gsum gyi rnam rtog bzang ngan spong len dgag sgrub sogs kyi bsgyur bkod cis kyang ma slad par sems nyid kho rang gi ngo bo ci lta ba'i gnas tshul lam yin tshul rang ngo shes pas thag chod pa de la ni/ lta ba skyon med phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pa zhes bya ste/ rdo ha las/ rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /de las gzhan zhig sus kyang rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de la ni ye nas sku gsum rang chas lhun grub tu gnas te/ sems nyid kho rang gi gshis skye ba med pa chos sku/ gdangs 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ rtsal cir yang 'char ba sprul sku/ de gsum ga yang ngo bo dbyer med du lhun gyis grub pa ste/ gzhi lta ba'i gnas skabs nas sku gsum rang chas su med na lam nyams su blang yang 'bras bu sku gsum du 'char pa med 305

pas gshis thog tu sku gsum ye nas bzhugs tshul de ltar rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang ngo phrod pa/zhes pas/ ji ltar bshad pa'i gzhi don lta ba'i gnas lugs de nyid rang gi rig thog tu rang ngo 'phrod pa ste ci lta ba bzhin ma nor bar rtogs par 'dod don gsol ba ste/ lhan skyes rang ngo phrod pa ni spyir rang gi bsags sbyangs dang khyad par bla ma'i byin brlabs 'jug pa la rag cing / de yang mos gus kyi gsol ba btab pa la rag las pa'i phyir/ brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / zhi byed chu klung gi rgyud las/ brjod bral lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyangs ba'i lag rjes dang / rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan brten pa rmongs par shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /dang zhes pa ni 'byed pa dang sdud pa'i sgra yin pas/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum du phye ba'i dang po gzhi lta ba'i gnas lugs de nyid gud du phyes nas/ de rtogs par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i byin gyis rlobs de nyid yar bsdud pa'i sgra'o/ /tshig rkang dang po'i don bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i tshig rkang gnyis pas ni las sgom pa'i skyong rim ston te/ 'di la gsum las ngos bzung ba/ de ji ltar bsgom tshul gyi skyong rim bshad pa/ de las sa lam sgrod tshul lo/ /dang po la yang lam bsgom dgos par bstan pa dang / lam dngos bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de yang lam sgom pa'i gzhi sems nyid ni dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ste/ de nyid dri ma dang bcas pa'i 'dam rdzab kyi nang du gnas dus dang / byi dor byas te nor bu'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur dus thams cad du'ang nor bu'i ngo bo la bzang ngan dang 'pho 'gyur du snang ba ni med mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'dod don gyi 'bras bu rtsol ba la nor bu ngo shes par byas te bkru sbyangs sogs byi dor la 'bad pas nor bu'i rang bzhin mngon gyur du byas te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor mchod cing gsol ba btab pa sogs bya dgos pa de bzhin du/ sems nyid rin chen 'di yang 'khor 'das lam gsum ba gang gi char gnas dus kyang ngo bo la bzang ngan dang 'pho gyur du mi snang ba ni chos nyid kyi gshis lugs yin mod kyang /'bras bu mngon gyur kyi sangs rgyas thob pa la/ sbyangs gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i sbyangs bya blo bur kyi dri ma rnams sbyongs byed lam gyi rnam pa du mas dri bral du byas te sbyangs 'bras sku gsum mngon gyur du bya dgos pa yin te/ rdo ha las/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu rtsol bar mdzad pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang don 'di la dgongs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de la lam gyi sgra tsam ni/ 'jig rten lha mi nas bla med theg pa'i bar theg pa che chung mdo sngags so so'i rim pas spong 306

sbyong bsgyur ba'i rnam pa ji snyed pa de dang der 'jug mod kyang / 'dir ni de dag las ches khyad par du gyur pa snang srid chos sku lam byed kyi skabs yin phyir sngar bshad pa'i lta ba'i gnas lugs de nyid rgyud la goms 'dris su byed pa'i thabs kyi rnam pa de dag la lam zhes tha snyad btags pa tsam yin no/ /gnyis pa ji ltar sgom tshul ni/ gang shar la spang blang med pa zhes pa'i tshul gyis ste/ de ji ltar skyong rim bshad pa ni/ rgyal ba rgod tshangs pas/ zhen log mos gus rkang dang mgo /zhes sogs gsung pa ltar skyong thabs kyi yan lag thams cad tshangs pa'i sgo nas sgom dgos la/ de ltar yang lam sgron las/ zhi gnas yan lag rnams nyams na/ /lo ni stong phrag dag gi kyang / /ting 'dzin rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ de ltar na tshe 'di snang gi 'khri ba btsan thabs su chod pa'i skyes bu snod ldan nges 'byung gi blo can des byin brlabs gdams pa'i bcud dang ldan pa'i bla ma nyams myong can zhig la zab lam 'di nyid kyi gdams skor tshang la ma nor ba'i smin grol gyi lam yan lag dang bcas pa mtha' rgya chod par zhus shing thun mong thun min gyi sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs ba la rtags thon du 'bad/ khyad par 'di nyid byin rlabs kyi lam sa yin gshis byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur thob nges kyi mos gus drag pos bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rtsal thon du 'bad pas thugs yid 'dres te gong du bshad pa'i lta ba skyon med sgrib bral du rtogs pa na/ de nyid kyi rgyun skyongs phyir dben pa'i gnas su ri btsugs pa bzhin sgrub pa'i sa sde btsugs te rnam g.yengs dang 'du 'dzi sogs bsam tan gyi tsher mar gyur pa thams cad spangs te lam dngos ji ltar nyams su len tshul ni/ de yang rgyud pa so so'i phyag srol gyi bab las/ lta thog nas sgom pa ngos bzung ba dang / bsgom thog nas lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i lugs gnyis snang yang /'dir ni sngar bshad pa'i lta ba de nyid rgyud la goms 'dris su bya ba tsam las dmigs bcas mtshan 'dzin blo bzo bcos sgom ni ci yang byar med pas sems rang bab bzo med du skyong ba kho na yin la/ de la yang gang zag gi dbang po'i bye brag sna tshogs pa'i skyong tshul tha dad mang yang / 'dir spyi mthun zhi lhag gi skyong tshul mtshon tsam zhig smos na/ de yang dang po zhi gnas mtshan bcas la nges pa rnyed nas mtshan med mchog gi zhi gnas bskyangs tshul ni/ bka' brgyud gong ma dag gi bzhed pa ltar/ ma yengs/mi bsgom/ rang bab gzo med du bzhags pa gsum ste/ sems yul rkyen gyi rjes su yengs med so mar bzhags pa dang / ha cang sgrim grags pas bcings pa lta bu ma yin par rang bab lhug par bzhag pa dang —/ rnam rtog dang dran rig spang gnyen lta bur ma song ba'i rang rig rang gsal du bzhag pa ste/mdor na sems nyid kho rang gi gshis ji ltar 'dug pa de ltar du ma bcos so mar bzhag pa yin la/ de ltar mi gnas par rnam rtog zhig tol gyis shar yang kho rang ngo shes tsam bya ba kho nas chog gi de nyid 307

spong 'gags sam/ tshur sgom la bkug pa'am/ gnyen po bsten pa sogs ci yang mi bya ste/ de dag gang byas kyang bsgom ma bcos bzo med du skyong ba'i gnad dang 'gal bas/ thabs gzhan btsal na phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom du mi 'gyur te/ bram ze chen pos/ 'gro rnams bsam gtan rtsol bas slad/ /bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /yongs su skad cig mi 'dod pas/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing /til+li pa/ mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing / /ma yengs mi sgom rang bab bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar yun du bskyangs pas gang zag gi blo rim ji lta bar zhi gnas kyi nyams gsum rim can du 'char ba'i 'gyur la/ de las zhi gnas mthar thug rgya mtsho rlabs bral ltar gyur pa na lhag mthong du na spar dgos te/ spar tshul/ rgyal ba lo ras kyi/ gsal cha med pa'i zhi gnas lteng po/ sgom yun ring yang don mi rtogs kyi/ /lta ltang rig pa'i ngar dang ldan pas/ /thun chung phro la 'thud cing bsgom cig /zhes gsung pa ltar dang / khyad par mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos bla ma rang sems dbyer med du bsres te rig pa gsal ngar dang ldan zhing 'grus par bsgom pas ji zhig ltar la mgo shub phud pa ltar gu yangs chal te sems nyid ngo bo sgrib bral du rjen lhag gis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du/ lha bsgom phan tshun 'bral ba dang / /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa gnyis/ /'dzom na rtogs pa 'char ba lags/ /sngar 'gris kyi mi dang de ru phrad/ ces gsungs pa ltar 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa lhag mthong ni/ de ltar sems nyid kyi rang ngo mthong ba nas lhag mthong du na 'phar ba yin zhing / de las sngar lta ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar mngon sum rtog med kyi ye shes yod med yin min rtag chad sogs gang gi mthar yang ma lhung zhing gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med du myong zhing shes kyang smra bsam shes brjod/ dpe mtshon blo yul las 'das pa rang rig rang gsal yul med chen por rjen ce re/ rang dngas snyog bral nam mkha' dngas pa'i dkyil lta bu gsal hrig ge shar ba 'di la lhag mthong zhes ming du btags la/ 'di nyid rtag tu rang dang 'du 'bral med kyang mig gis mig rang ma mthong ba ltar bla ma'i gdams ngag dang byin brlabs kyi rtsis ma zin pas ngo ma shes pa yin cing / de ltar rang ngo mthong phyin chad ni tha mal ling skyur du ma btang na gnas 'phro gang yang lhag mthong ngam phyag rgya chen por ma gyur pa ni gang yang med par gsungs te/ lo ras kyi/ tshogs drug yul du ci shar kyang / /yid kyi 'dzin pa ma zhugs na/ /thams cad rang snang rang grol yin/ /dbyer med rtogs pa'i sgom chen kun/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang ji tsam du rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas sems bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang du gnas pa ni zhi gnas sems kyi ngo bo rang gsal yul med sgro bkur dang bral ba rjen lhang nge mthong ba ni lhag mthong zhes gsung yang don du snang thog rtog thog nyon mongs sogs gang gi thog tu yang zhi lhag zung 'jug tu 'gro ba zhig dgos par 308

gsungs te/ gnas cha gcig pu ni nyan rang dang lha gnas rnams kyi ting 'dzin dang thun mong pa yin phyir sngags kyi dbang bzhi pa'i lam dngos ma yin pa dang / khyad par gnas nyams la zhen 'dzin yod pa ni phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom du mi rung ste/ phyag chen ni snang srid chos sku lam byed kyi skabs yin pas/gnas 'gyu gnyis la bzang ngan dang spang blang byed pa lta zhog rnam rtog nyon mongs na tsha sdug bsngal sogs rkyen bzang ngan thams cad kyang cir snang phyag rgya chen po gang shar bzo med chos sku blo 'das chen por ro ma snyoms na lam gang shar la spang blang med pa'i dgongs pa thog tu mi phebs pas so/ /de la lam gang shar spang blang med par skyongs tshul dngos de rang ji lta bu snyam na/ kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyi phyag chen zin bris las/ rnam par rtog pa'i nyon mongs pa ji lta bu skyes kyang mi spongs shing /de'i dbang du mi btang bar gang shar de nyid bzo med du bzhag skye ba'i skad gcig de kar ngo shes par byas pas de rang ma spang gnas su dag pa'i stong pa nyid du 'char zhing / tshul des 'gal rkyen thams cad lam du khyer bar nus pas rkyen lam du slongs pa zer/ rnam par rtag pa nyid rang gi ngo shes pa tsam gyi grol bas spang gnyen dbyer med du rtogs pa 'di ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bzlog pa'i sgom pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rang gi sems nyid kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje lhag par skye zhing / lus ngag yid sems can thams cad kyi ched du bskyed pa'i rim pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyi bya bas 'da' yang / shes rab kyi tshul des bden par zhen pa yongs su sbyangs ba'i dbang gis sngags kyi zin pa'i dug spyad pas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba ltar ro/ /tshul 'di lta bu'i nyams len la dgongs nas lam gang shar la spang blang med pa zhes gsungs so/ /zhes pa ltar min no/ /'on kyang phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung mdo lugs ltar bzhed pa'i dbang du yang / lam gang shar la spang blang med pa'i tshul 'di skyong dgos te/ rgyal ba ma pham pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pas bsal bzhag dang spang blang med pa don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas so/ /gzhan yang de dag gi tshe mnyam rjes dang nyams rtogs kyi dbye ba mdo tsam ni/ de yang rnal 'byor chen po rnams la ni rtag tu yengs 'khrul med phyir mnyam rjes 'dres pa'am bsgom 'khor yug ces bya la/ bsgom chung gsar bu rnams bsgom dngos skyong tshe mnyam bzhag dang / spyod lam rnam bzhi'i skabs rjes su tha snyad 'dogs shing ske/ de bzhin nyams rtogs shan 'byed kyang sa mtshams tho dman gang du yang rung ste/ gang byed kyi dge sbyor de nyid bsgom gyi ngo bo dang mi 'dre bar spang gnyen tha dad dam/ bsgom bya sgom byed du snang ba ni nyams yin la/ de gnyis tha mi dad par dbyer med ro gcig tu shar zhing thag chod pa ni rtogs par 309

bzhed do/ /gsum pa sa lam bsgrod tshul ni/ de ltar 'di nyid kyi yongs rdzogs gol pa dang shor ba'i gegs dbang du ma song bar tshul bzhin bsgom pa na rgyud gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i lung gi dgongs pa rje zla 'od gzhon nus gsal bar mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa rnams kyang yar zla'i 'phel ba ltar 'char zhing rdzogs la/ de dag gi nang tshan du thun mong mdo lugs kyi lam lnga sa bcu rnams kyang shugs kyi rdzogs par gsung ste de yang sngon 'gro thun mong pa blo ldog bzhi bsgom pas tshogs lam chung ngu dang thun min skyabs sems dang bsags sbyangs gnyis kyi tshogs lam 'bring po bsgrod cing / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshogs lam chen po thob par gsungs/ de nas rnal 'byor bzhi'i rtse gcig chung 'bring che gsum du sbyor lam ngos 'byed bzhi dang / spros bral gsum gyi mthong lam dang sa dang po rab dga' nas drug pa mngon gyur gyi sa'i bar thob par gsungs te nyan rang dang thun mong gis sa rnams so/ /ro gcig chung ngur sgom lam dang sa bdun pa 'bring dang chen por sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa non cing / bsgom med chung 'bring gnyis su sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin non par gsungs te byang sems sa bcu pa rnams dang skal pa mnyam pa'o/ /bsgom med chen por bcu gcig kun tu 'od dang bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma ste thun mong ma yin pa nang gi sa gnyis skad cig skad cig la bsgrod nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa yang nges par mngon du byed par gsung ste 'bras bu mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi sa thob pa'o/ /slob lam dang mi slob lam gyi khyad par ni nam sa lam gong du bgrod rgyu yod pa'i bar ni slob pa dang / bgrod rgyu med par mthar thug pa'i tshe ni ma slob pa'am mthar phyin pa'i lam zhes bzhed par snang ngo / /de ltar yang mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ mi gang ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'dzin pa ni/ /chos 'dzin de dag gang du song ba yang / /shin tu spyod pa zhi zhing yid rab zhi/ /rab tu dga' dang dri med 'od byed dang / /'od 'phro sbyangs dka' mngon du gyur pa'i sa/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo legs pa'i blo/ /chos sprin sa bcu po yang thob par gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing/ de bzhin rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi bgrod tshul kyang / rgyud gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa las/ seṅge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mi g.yo rtse gcig dngas pa'i shes pa gsal/ /rang rig ye shes khongs nas sad par byed/ /bzod pa brtan pos ngan song sdug bsngal spongs| /gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /spros dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag chen po las/ /bsam gyi mi khyab ting 'dzin rtsal du 'char/ /drod thob nas ni skye la dbang ba min/ /gsum pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ bsgom du med pa'i nyams len brtson pa las/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong / /ma btsal lhun grub chos mchog chen po'i ngang / /zhes so/ /gzhan yang de dag gi nang tshan 310

ci rigs par byang phyogs so bdun rnams kyang 'dus shing sbyor tshul rgyas par snang ste 'dir ma spros la/'on kyang bzhi rim rnams kyi sa 'byed rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myongs dang sbyor tshul mdo tsam bshad na/mnyam bzhag la ji tsam 'dod par gnas thub pa ni rtse gcig tha mal gyi shes pa rang ngo shes shing gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs pa spros bral/ 'khor 'das gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa rig thog tu grol ba ro gciganges shes dang bag chags kyi dri ma thams cad dag pa bsgom med du bzhed cing / yang rnam rtog gi rang bzhin mi rtog par 'char ba rtse gcig stong nyid du 'char ba spros bral/ mnyam nyid du 'char ba ro gcig blo 'das su 'char ba bsgom med ces kyang bzhed la/ yang / rtse gcig gnas 'gyu dbyer med/ /spros bral 'khrul grol dbyer med/ /ro gcig snang sems dbyer med/ /bsgom med mnyam rjes dbyer med du bzhed pa sogs du ma zhig snang zhing de dag kyang chung 'bring chen por phye bas rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su bshad pa sogs du ma zhig mchis kyang / 'dir ni rkang 'dzin tsam las rgya cher ma spros shing ske/ shes par 'dod pa dag mchis na stod smad kyi rgod tshang pa rnam gnyis kyi gsung sogs las rgya cher rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar lam gyi chos rnams bsdus don tsam du smos nas/ de gang gi rgyud thog tu 'byor ba'i 'dod don gsol phyir dang zhes pa'i sgra ni sngar bzhin la/ byed sgras gud du phye ba ni lam gyi yon tan rnams so/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang gnyis pa'i don bkral zin to/ /gsum pa rdo rje tshig rkang gsum pas ni mthar thug 'bras bu shar tshul bstan te/ de la snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar zhes gsungs so/ /de'i don bshad pa ni/ de yang dad brtson skal pa can gyi rnal 'byor pa sbyangs stobs can des gnas lugs gzhi'i phyag chen gyi rang zhal mngon du mthong nas/lta sgom lam gyi phyag chen sogs byin spyod pa'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pas nyams len gnad du bsnun pas goms pa klong du gyur ste bsgom med chen por phyin pa de'i tshe/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i phyag chen sku gsum mngon gyur du 'char ba zhes bya ste/ de yang gdod ma'i ye shes 'pho 'gyur bri gang med pa khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rang chas ye khyab tu bzhugs pa de nyid/ rnal 'byor pas lam nyams len gyi thabs gnad zab mos yin lugs yin bzhin bskyangs pas dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag gi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur pa na nyi ma'i rang bzhin la mun pa gnas pa med pa la blo bur lhan skyes kyi dri ma yang ma spangs rang sar dag pa ni chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan dang / de bzhin du gnas lugs ji lta ba dang shes bya ji snyed pa thams cad lag mthil du kyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar gzigs shing mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrib med du mnga' ba'i phyir mkhyen pa gnyis ldan du'ang bzhed la/ de nyid kyi rang mdangs ye shes lnga'i rol pa 'gag med du 'char ba las sku dang zhing khams sogs longs sku nges 311

pa lnga ldan rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor dbyings kyi mtha' klas par 'char zhing / chos longs gnyis kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rtsal las gdul bya'i chu snod ji snyed pa dang 'tshams par 'dul byed sprul pa'i zla gzugs bzo skye byang chub mchog gi bdag nyid nam mkha' rab 'byams srid pa ji srid du 'byung ba ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i rnam par rol pa mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes grags pa nyid de sku gsum so so'i mtshan nyid do/ /de dag gi yon tan gyi khyad par ni zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan dang / dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad du grags pa rnams mnga' ba ste/ de la yan lag bdug ldan ni/ ji skad du/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rje'i yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ces pa rnams teglu/ de dag las longs spyod dang kha sbyor dang bde ba chen po'i yan lag gsum ni longs spyod rdzogs sku'i khyad chos yin la/ snying rjes yongs su gang ba dang / 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa dang / 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag gsum ni sprul sku'i khyad chos dang / rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag gcig pu nyid ni chos sku'i khyad chos yin zhing / sku gsung thugs dang rdzu 'phrul kyi dbang phyug kun 'gro dang 'dod pa'i dbang phyugaci 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang gnas kyi dbang phyug brgyad po de ni longs sku kho na'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs yin no/ /de ltar 'char ba'i rgyu ni lam gyi skabs su rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes stong nyid phyag chen bsgom pa'i 'bras bu dngos ni chos sku dang / rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs te de las shar ba'i ye shes snang ba'i cha dang / bskyed rim zab mo bsgom pa sogs kyi rgyu 'bras las longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / de'i yan lag gam thabs kyi char sems bskyed smon lam sogs rnam par dag pa byas pa'i 'bras bu ni sprul skur 'byung la/ de dag kyang ya bral res 'jog lta bu ma yin par phyag rgya chen po'i rtsis zin pa'i thabs shes zung 'jug 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por 'bad pas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i gdod ma'i sa la bstan srid zin par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar yang rgyud bla ma las/ thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang ske/ /yang dag blang pa mchog nyid do/ /rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin/ /dang pos sku ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /zhes gsungs la/ gzhan du/btsun mo rdo ha las/ /smon lam snying rje'i stobs kyi gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'byung / /zhes kyang gsungs so//mdor bsdu na/ da lta sems nyid kyi gshis gdangs rtsal gsum la de tshe sku gsum du brjod pa nyid do/ /de bas na de ltar lta bsgom spyod par mthar son pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rnams la ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sku gsum gyi rol par mi shar ba 'ga' yang med de/ 'di ltar dngos med stong pa'i chos thams cad ni skye med chos sku'i rol par dang / gsal dngas snang ba'i chos 312

thams cad ni 'gag med longs sku'i rol par dang / rang rig pa'i rtsal snang du 'char ba'i chos thams cad ni gnas med sprul sku'i rol par 'char zhing / snang srid bcud du snang ba thams cad kyang sku dang zhing khams ye nas 'du 'bral med pa'i rol pa dag pa rab 'byams chen por 'char bas na snang srid sku gsum du 'char ba zhes gsungs te/ de la byin gyis rlobs ces pa ni/ de ltar mngon du gyur bar 'dod don smreng du gsol ba ste/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos bsrung dang bcas pa'i skyabs yul rab 'byams thams cad la'o/ /de ltar gyis na gzhi lam 'bras gsum mam lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi yon tan thams cad ni rtsa rgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las 'byung dgos la/ de yang snod ldan slob bu'i mos gus kyi byed pa dri ma med pa'i gdung shags gsol 'debs la rag las pa de'i phyir/rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni dad pa kho nas rtogs bya yin zhes gsungs shing / de dag kyang rgyud du ma las—/ yi dam lha bsnyen dung phyur ya las bla ma'i gsol 'debs tshig gcig byin rlabs che bar gsung pa ltar 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras yis rdo rje nyid kyis 'di lta bu'i man ngag gi gnad phur zab mo thugs nyams su chud nas rang nyid kyang lam de nas rdo rje 'chang gi sar gshegs shing / bdag nyid legs su 'dod pa'i rjes 'jug thar pa don gnyer rnams kyang lam 'di la 'bad pa brgya phrag du mas rtsal du 'don par rigs so zhes che thang du mas nan tan du gdams par mdzad pa 'di nyid de rdo rje'i tshig rkang gsum pa'i don rags rim bshad zin to//'dir smras pa/ gdongs lnga rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i mthus/ /mi 'jigs nga ro bsgrags pa'i rjes/ /wa skyes 'khun sgra 'byin pa 'di/ /rigs pa min mod 'on kyang 'dir/ /dam pa'i gsung gi dbyu gu yis/ /bskul las go ba'i rnga sgra 'di/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i legs bshad las/ /ji tsam dpogs bzhin bdag gi sgrags/ /ji lta'i gnas lugs ma rtogs shing / /ji snyed shes bya shes min pas/ /tshig don 'gal dang ma 'grel zlos/ /nyes kun mkhas grub tshogs la bshags/ /gal te bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /dam pa'i gsung gi rjes 'brang mthus/ /don ldan legs bshad cha mchis na/ /dge des bskul ba po dang bdag /mkha' khyab pha ma 'gror bcas kyi/ /gzhi yi gnas lugs phyag chen rtogs/ /lam gyi rnal 'byor bzhi mthar son/ /'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur shog /de skad smra ba gur smyon nā tha ste/ /rgya ras ye shes rdo rje'i gsung gi mdzod/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i mkhyenalhags lde mig gis/ /phye ba'i 'phro 'di 'thud ces mchog sprul skus/ /rmongs la g.yar khral bka' yi zhags pas cing / /de phyir skal bzang blo yis go myong rtogs/ /mi ldan na yang gus bzhin spro bzhin bris/ /de yi mchog sprul dgyes pa'i rol mor mdzod/ /ces pa ni sbyar sbyangs du smos pa ste/ri khrod chos rdzong du 'brug lo rgyal zla'i tshes bzhi dge ba la'o//sarba sirnyi m+me pra yats+tshaskyo/maṅga lo/313

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsten yig snying po rab tu gsal ba grub pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ dam pa mchog gi bka' mchid la ji ltar stsal ba bzhin/ gang nyid sku'i skye 'phreng du mar dus kyi 'khor lo la ches sbyangs shing chos kyi bdag por byas pa'i bag chags sad pa'i dbang gi sku tshe 'dir dus kyi 'khor lo la rab tu dgongs pa brtan pa ni bka' drin mchog tu che la/ don du yi dam lhag pa'i lhar yang gsang ba'i bdag po dang rdo rje phag mo dang dus kyi 'khor lo rnams yin par rtogs pa yang rang gi shar tshul gsol ba dgongs pa'i dbyings su 'jug pa dang / de yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen bsgrub bgyid pa ni spyir yi dam gyi lha rnams ngo bo'i sgo nas khyad par ma mchis kyang rnam par gdul byar gyur pa'i 'khor gyi rten 'brel dang / de bzhin gshegs pas rig sngags kyi byin rlabs tshul la brten te gdul bya'i snang ngor 'jam rtsub kyi rnam par shar ba yang yod rung / bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo ni khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje sems dpa' ho ru ka'i rigs srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po mtha' dag gi gnyen por gyur zhing 'jam la byin che zhing bkra shis pa yin na gang gi snying po rnam bcu dbang ldan sa phyogs bsrung sogs la che thang du mar 'bad par byed pas kyang rtogs par nus la/des na de'i dkyil 'khor du gsung bsnyen gnang na legs par khum la/ de yang thog mar bza' tshes skar ma sbyor ba byed pa legs pa zhig la dbu btsugs te yig brgya maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs zhag kha shas ji ltar rig pa dang / de nas bsrung ma drug cu dang rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya yi mchod gtor cho ga la zhag bdun phrag las mi nyung bar nan tan tu byas shing / de nas nyi ma gnyis gsum tsam bdud bsreg pa dang bsrung 'khor dang bcas rkang pa bcu drug pa dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa ji ltar rig pa bzla ba las grangs tshad kyi nges bzung ni ma dgos kyi/ 'on kyang dngos gzhi bsnyen pa'i skabs su thun 'go rnams su bsrung 'khor gyi cho ga ngag nas bklags pa'am/ de min yid kyi gsal gdab na yang shin tu rung la thun gyi thog mtha' ci bder bdud bsreg pa dang rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang bcu drug pa dang bdud rigs rnams kyi mgo yi phreng ba'i sngags rnams lan kha yar bklags nas bsrung 'khor gyi bsnyen mtshams zur du bya ma dgos la thun dngos gzhir oṃ dang swā has thog mthar byas pas rnam bcu dbang ldan kho nas bzlas pa dpal jo nang pa yab sras kyi phyag bzhes te/ de yang gdan thog gcig tu 314

bsnyen chen bye ba re res gtong ba'i srol bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma kun bzang dbang po yan chad rgyun ma chad pa yin la/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni sngar thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor la brtan pa yang mang du byung rung / phyis su ni thugs dkyil dang rtag tu lha dgu kho na la brtan pa shas che shing / de yang bzlas pa'i skabs su bram ze'i skud pa 'khal ba bzhin le lo dang snyoms las kyi dbang du ma shor tsam las nyi ma re re bzhin bzlas pa grangs tshad 'di tsam zhig bya snyam pa'i yid dam bca' nas 'jur por sgrim pa'i mi bya ste/ ci phyir tshul de lta'i rkyen la brten rlung khams bskyed de khams 'dus kyi kag sogs 'byung zhes bla ma gong mas gsung zhing / rang gi myong bas yang grub na de phyir nyin re bzhin thun gyi yun tshad sgrigs su bcud pa las bzlas pa'i grangs tshad rang rtsis las phra mo tsam la mi 'jur ba'ang rang re'i gong ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun lags/ ji ltar dgongs mnga' bzhin/ sngags bzla tshul skyon lnga'am drug spangs pa'i ngag bzlas kho na ni thun mong las rab 'byams 'grub rung / ral gri sogs dngos grub bsgrub pa la ni bskyed rim gyi sa ma thob na ngag bzlas pa kho na tsam gyi 'grub mi nus par gsung lags/ mchog tu lha sku gsal snang sgrub pa dang / de yang thog mar lhan skyes kyis sku lta bur brtan pa thob pa na lhag ma zhal phyag gi rnam grangs can mang po yang tshegs med du 'grub mi nus par gsung lags—/mchog tu lha sku gsal snang sgrub pa dang / de yang thog mar lhan skyes kyis sku lta bur brtan pa thob pa na lhag ma zhal phyag gi rnam grangs can mang po yang tshegs med du 'grub par gsung ba ni shin tu 'thad par snang ste/ de yang spyan dbus ma lta bur gsal snang thob na spyan lhag ma gnyis tshegs sogs zhi gnas kyi yon tan cha ci rigs skye na lhan skyes lta bu yongs rdzogs cha med kyi gsal snang thob na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin khyad par ba 'byung ba ni rang gi myong bas kyang grub la/ sbyir ni bskyed rim la rten te rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsam gtan bskyed pa ni sngags kyi grub mtha'i zhi gnas dngos yin la/chung ngus 'grub pas mtshon par nus la/ de yang bskyed rim gyi lha sku cha med du gsal snang ma thob kyang sku yi cha shas re la gsal snang thob kyang rnam rtog ngang gi 'gog pa de yang las dang po'i bskyed rim lha sku'i cha shas gang rigs cig las sems gzhan du mi 'gro ba ni gnas pa'i cha dang / lha sku la sems gtad pa brjed de rnam rtog gsum gyi bskyed pa ni 'gyu ba mngon sum par snang zhing / de ltar gnas pa dang 'phro ba mtha' dag gi 'char gzhi dngos dang dngos min gyi khas len smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa skye med so sor rang rig pa ye shes kyi spyod yul du 'char ba 'gag med ste/ de ltar skye med la 'gag med kyi rtsal dang ldan zhing / 'gag med la skye med kyi ngo bor gyur pa de ni/ rgyu yi theg par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / phyag chen pas gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes pa dang / rdzogs chen 315

pa rnams kyi ka dag rig pa chos sku zhes su btags la tshul de go ba dang nyams myong rtogs tshul rim par gyur pa'i sgo nas rdzogs chen gyi nyams bzhi'am phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor bzhir bzhed par snang la/ de yang skye 'gag gnyis med rig pa'i gnas lugs ji bzhin pa yang dag pa'i go ba'am myong bas brtan la ma phebs pa'i rnam rtog dang bral ba'i gnas cha 'ba' zhig ni tha dang 'gyu rtog gi kun nas bskyed pa ni srid pa'i cha de/ /des na gnas 'gyu phyogs re bas srid zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis las ma 'das shing / de yang so sor rtag min 'gog pa'i bye brag gam de yi rgyu tshogs khyad par can du 'gro ba'i gnas cha ni srid 'das zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i rgyu tshogs su 'gro yang rang bzhin gyi gnas cha tsam so sos bas ni zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i gyur yang mi 'gro la/ kha cig ni srid rtse'i gnas skabs kyi bde tsam rnyed pa dang / kha cig ni btang snyoms lung ma bstan du 'gyur ba shas che la/ 'on kyang sngags kyi bskyed rim sogs la brten te bsgrub pa'i zhi gnas ni goms nus che chung ni ji ltar yang sngags lam bde ba dang myur ba dang rdo rje theg pa'i byin rlabs rmad du byung ba'i mthu la brten byang chub kyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu 'gro zhe sngags mkhan grub pa rnams kyi mgrin cig tu sgrogs pas yid ches pa'i gnas dang / de yang bskyed rim gyi sa ye shes phebs pa yan chad thob phyin lhag mthong yang 'grub pa yin la/ lar ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rgya bod kyi sngags mkhan ches che ba rnams kyi zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung 'jug tu gdod ma nas bzhugs/ tshul gcig la lam nyams su len pa'i skabs kyang zung 'jug tu nyams su blangs ba ni bde zhing myur ba yin la/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu dam pa sku gnyis kyang zhi lhag zung 'jug gi rang 'bras yin no zhes gsungs pa yang gal che ba'i gnad du snang la/ de ltar re 'ga' thog ma nyid nas zhi lhag dbyer med du bstan pa dang res thog ma zhi gnas lhag mthong gi spu ris zhib mor dbyes te tha dad du gsungs pa rnams cig char dang rim gyis la dgongs kyang don du 'gal 'dur gyur pa ni cung zad kyang med do/ /de dag kyang skabs kyi 'phros su gsol zhing / da ni dkyus kyi don la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang bskyed rim rnam pa cha med 'grub nas gsal snang dngos gsar du bsgrub dgos pa shas che zhing gang zag dbang po'i rim pas rnam pa cha med 'grub pa dang gsal snang 'grub pa dang gnyis lhag gi yong ba yang yod la/ de yang lha sku'i stod smad g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams gcig shos gsal dus gcig shos mi gsal na smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ cig shos cung zad mi gsal na yang las dang po'i bskyed rim cha shas can yin la sku lus rgyan phyag mtshan dang bcas cig char du dran pa tsam gyis gsal theb cing / de yi ngang la yig drug stong phrag 'don pa'i yun tsam yengs ba med par gnas thub na bskyed rim gyi sa rnal 'byor dang po'i thob pa yin la zhi gnas la brtan pa'ang ci rigs thob par bzhed do/ /de rnams nyid 316

lta bu'i ni mkhyen bzhin par lags kyang dam pa rnams ni rgyud kyi don rgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal lung la gtso bor mdzad pa shas che bas 'phros kyi tshul du zur tsam smos pa lags na de ltar dgongs pa'i dbyings su 'jug pa'ang 'tshal la/ gzhan yang sngags lam thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i snying por gyur pa ni bla ma'i mo gus gnad du bsnun te/ yi dam gyi ngo bo bla ma dang / bla ma'i ngo bo yi dam du dbyer med byed pa'i kho thag chod pa zhig dang / de yang rang rig gsal stong 'dzin med brjen par shar ba 'di ka chos kyi sku ste rang gdangs rnam par thams cad pa yi dam lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par shar ba yang sngags kyi bla med kyi grub mtha'i 'dod yin pas gal che ba dang / de lta bu'i don ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dang / snang grags gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rmi lam gyi gzugs brnyan dang sgyu ma bzhin lam du 'khyer ba dgos pa yang sngags shes rnams kyi yang yang du gsung ltar lags/ gzhan yang thun gyi thog mthar sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang pa dang thun gzhug tu dge ba bsngo zhing srod thun gyi mthar lha sku 'od gsal du gzhig te/ snying gar thig le yung dkar tsam la sems bzung nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa dang —/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i spog chog tu 'gro bar gsungs so/ /zhes pa'ang yongs kyi 'dren mchog 'gro ba'i mgon po kun mkhyen chos rje sprul pa'i sku rje btsun 'brug pa dgyes pa'i maṇ+ḍal ched du rgyal khams pa ā yur+ya sha ma ṇi'i phul ba maṅga lo/

༄ga /nar ma'i rnal 'byor tshul sa bon tsam du smos pa thar pa'i shing rta 'dir mchis so /rgyal kun ye shes rang gzugs nyid//snyigs dus 'gro la phan phyir sku//ston pa rdo rje slob dpon che//rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam mang chos kyi don dril nas/ /nar mar thun bzhir nyams len pa/ /spros med snying po yang dag gtam/ /tshig tshogs kyung ste the tsam smra/ /dal 'byor mi lus bskal pa brgyar yang snyed par dka' ba de/ da res kho na rang cag gi thob pa 'di chud ma zos par gtan bde'i lam rkang tshugs thabs shig ci nas kyang 'tshal lags/ thar lam yang dag par bsgrub pa de'i gegs ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mdor dril na/ tshe 'di snang gi bya ba la chags te 'khor ba blos mthong nas bstod snyan zas nor dpal 'byor mnga' thang 'khor 'bangs la zhen nas chos bsgrub pa de gal chung du shor/ de'i ngang la 'chi khar brang lag 'thab pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang / gzhan yang gzhan gyi stobs 'byor la 'gran pa'i byed pa dang / mi dga' ba'i dgra bo rnams gzhom pa'i bya ba sogs 'di snang las la zin med chu'i gnyer ma 'dra ba de sangs dus med cing / chos sang byed gnang byed kyi ngang du shor te 'chi ba thog babs su byung tshe 'gyod dgos pa dang / phal cher chos bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa gang nyams su blang 'dod pa yang gegs su gti mug nyid che ste/ gti mug gtso bo gnyid dang phral du btang snyoms lung ma bstan pa/ le lo snyoms las bag med/ rtse dga' rnam g.yeng la 'jam pa mtha' dag spangs ste/ de'i ngang du mi tshe zad pa nyid lags shing / de dag yang rtsa ba dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma shes/ mi rtag 'chi ba dran ma thub pa dang / las 'bras la 'phrig ma tshud cing nges shes ma shar ba yin pas/ dus kun tu dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba yid la sems zhing mi rtag 'chi ba de lhang lhang rtag tu dran dgos so/ /de dran bzhin las 'bras spang blang zhib par gal che lags/ chos theg chen thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas byang chub kyi bsam pa rnam par dag pa shin tu gces shing / dge ba 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa che phra gang bsags kyang rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde thar 'dod ma yin par nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad gtan bde'i sa la bkod pa'i phyir du bsngo ba gces so/ /de yang dge sbyor gang la yang thang lhod med pa gal che bas/ des na dus kun tu rgyun gyi rnal 'byor thun bzhir bcad cing le lo btang snyoms du ma song bar bya ste/de la thog mar tho rangs skya rengs shar ba'i dus su gnyid har sad phral du 318

gnas lugs nyams len gyi zin bzhin byas la rang lus yi dam lha'i sku chu zla 'ja' tshon lta bur bkrong gi bskyed pa'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan yab yum lham mer gsal btab nas/ rlung ro dgu sprug gsal rjes dbugs dbyung 'jug gnas gsum oṃ āḥrgyu gsum du shes par byas te tshar nyer gcig las mi nyung bar byas pas de nyid dbugs gang rgyu rdo rje'i bzlas par 'gyur zhing tshe bsring ba'i yang mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de nas yig brgya ā li kā li tshar nyer lnga las mi nyung bar mthar rten 'brel snying po tshar bdun bcas bzlas pas de nyin bzlas pa yig drug gcig brjod pa yang gaṅga rlung gi bye snyed grangs su gyur nas phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab bo/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya yig drug gang lcogs bklags shing rjes su bstod bshags mang du bya/ de nas lha yi bu skya rengs la phyag 'tshal zhing byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan sngags sogs brjod cing byang sems bslab par nyams chags byung ba bshags na nges par dag par gsungs so/ /de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal btab ste kha tsam ma yin par snying nas mos gus gdung pas gsol ba 'debs dbang bzhi blang mthar bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med bsres la mnyam par bzhag des ni bslab pa gsum gyi nyams pa thams cad dag cing mchog dang / thun mong gi dngos grub dpag med thob bo/ /de rnams ni gal chen du lags pas brtson pa dang / thun dngos gzhir thog mar yi dam lhag pa'i lha gang yin de yan lag bzhi gsal ba'i ngar dang ldan cing / sems dpa' gsum brtsegs 'phro 'du bzhi gang yang rung bar/ rtse gcig ngang du bzlas skyon lnga spang ste 'dzab brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzlas shing yid gzhan du ma yengs pa gal che/ de yang sngags dag pa gcig dang ma dag pa khri/ yengs nas 'bum bzlas pa dang ma yengs nas gcig bzlas pa phan yon mnyam par gsungs so/ /de rjes yig brgya a k+ṣa rten 'brel snying pos kha bskang / mchod bstod bsdus pa gcig byas/ de'i rjes su rlung bum pa can sbyor ba bzhi ldan dang / de tsam mi nus na 'jam rlung la 'bad cing rtsa 'khor kun nas gang bar dmigs te tho rengs dus 'di bsgom pas de nyin sems bde shas che bar 'gyur la dge sbyor 'phel/ des na bka' rgyud pa rnams kyi yang bdud rtsi'i ril bu tho rengs bzhes pa'i srol ni don 'dir dgongs pa ste ci'i phyir zhe na rtsa rnams steng par gnas pas so/ /de'i mthar lha sku stong nyid na dar gzhil nas mi dmigs yang dag gi don la blo bzhag gong de nas nam skya seng ma langs bar seng ge'i nyal stabs spyo rmi lam 'od gsal ngos bzung bar bya'o snyam pa'i ngang las gnyid log ste dge sbyor shugs kyi 'od gsal zin na de mchog tu gyur la/ mi zin na shes pa 'jur ba'am man ngag kyang bya'o/ /de nas thun gnyis pa nam langs phral lus lha skur sngar ltar ldang la gos bgos chab blang khrus byas te/ yig brgya ak+ṣa tshar gcig gi mthar yan lag bdun pa dang byang chub nyung 319

bshags klag cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang kun rig 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ 'jam dpal/spyan ras gzigs phyag rdor/ seṅge sgra/ mi g.yo ba/ sgrol ma'i gzung sogs gang shes klags/ de mthar gtsang sbra shin tu che ba dang bcas te gtor ma btang / de nas bas bsur kyang bsngo/ de rjes yi dam gyi bskyed rim gcig skyar rgyun bsnyen gang cog su bya zhing / skabs 'dir 'jig rten gyi don gnyer dgos cha gal che na ngag bkrol la/ gzhan yang dpe lta ba gsung rab bsgrogs pa yi ge bri ba sogs gang dgos bya la/ de kun kyang dge sbyor ma yeng rig pa'i ngang nyid ma bral ba ni gal che/ phyag bskor gang byed kyang sangs rgyas yid la byed cing de dag gi gzungs kyang ston na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pas shes par bya'oske/ /de nas gung tshigs la bab dus zas tshogs 'khor du byin gyis brlabs te kha zas bdud rtsi nang lus ltar gsal la bza'/ de rjes bshags pa dang mdo bsngo 'phags pa yon sbyangs ba'i gzungs ci rigs su bzla'o/ /gung tshigs dus 'phrog ma ma bu la gtor ma bsngo ba ni ston pa'i rjes su 'jug pa kun gyi dgos par gsungs pas bya/de nas thun gsum pa nyi ma phyi cha la gal chen mi bya thug med kyi las yod na ma gtogs lus kyi phyag bskor ram/ khyad par lta stang g.yo med/ ngag bsnyen bzlas sam srog rtsol/ yid kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len gzir ba gal che lags/ nam mkha' dwangs ba'i dus snga dro phyi dro gang rung bar gzigs stong gsum gang bde yi thod rgal blta bar bya zhing / dus rgyun du nyon mongs rang gar ma shor bar gang shar 'bur 'joms/ ci shar gdong ded/ rig pa rang sab/ mi spro mi bsdu/ mi sgom mi yengs bar rig pa rang so tshugs par tshogs drug snang ba kun lam du khyer ba ni gal che'o/ /mdor dril na bka' rgyud pa'i gsungasaske/ bla ma la mos gus yengs med kyi dran pa/ sems can la snying rje/ de rnams rtag tu gal che shos lags—/de nas nyi ma'i mdangs bsdud la nye tsam nas bdag bskyed lha yi rnal 'byor gcig gsal btab la/ bsrung ma spyi dang khyad par rang gi mgo ba'i lha bsrung la gtor mas dgyes par byas la 'phrin las bcol te srog sngags kyang cung zad re bzlas yang rung ngo / /de nas zer bsdud dus sher phyin dang /sngags bzlog yang bzlog sogs kyang bklags thal deb kyang bya'o/ /de nas thun bzhi pa srod thun skabs su gur drag phur pa/ phyag rdor/ rta nag seng gdong sogs lha drag po'i bsnyen pa gang rung ngam/ mi lcogs na rang nyid rdo rje gro lod du bsgom r+ghaṃ dbyangs kyis kyang chog la phur bzlas cung zad re byas kyang legs so/ /de mthar rang nyid rda gtum mo'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin a shad me 'bar la dmigs pa rtse gcig pas tsaṇ+ḍa li'i rnam 'byor la brtson par bya'o/ /mthar phung po tshogs 'khor sogs dang smon lam rnam par dag pa gang mang dang / khyad par bde chen zhing smon lam ma chags par bya/ mthar lha sku stong 320

nyid du bsdus la/ gzhog g.yas sa la phab te rmi lam ngos zin par bya'o sems shing nyams len dang ldan pas nyal lo/ de ltar thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gang la yang / thog mar 'gro bar phan phyir sems bskyed pa dang glu/ thun mthar bsngo ba smon lam bzang pos rgyas btab pa gal che lags/ thun dngos gzhir bskyed rdzogs ya bral du ma song bar bces shing / dus kun byin brlabs kyi rtsa ba yin pas bla mar dad mos gsol 'debs dang ma bral ba/ yi dam bsgom bzlas dang ma bral ba/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma mi chags par 'bul lo/ /bya ba gang yang tshod yod kham spyod rtog chos su ma song bar legs par rtags zhib nan tan du spyod cing / bag yod pa dang gdams ngag gsang sgrogs su ma song ba/ nyams rtogs kha khyer la ma shor ba/ dag snang la ldem rgyang med par gal che'o/ /thun bzhi'i nyams len yang res grub res shol du ma song bar bya 'tshal/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di rnams ma chags par bya/ chos spyod bag chags rang grol dang bar do rtsa tshig kyang kha 'don bya zhing yid dang 'dres par bya/ des bar do zin par 'gyur cing spyir da lta gnyid thug po'i 'od gsal phal cher rtag tu zin na bar do zin pa la tshegs med la/ de ltar med na bar do'i bag chags deng sang du sbyang pa gal che'o/ /gsang sngags chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni dam tshig nyid yin pas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag bla ma gang la yang dam tshig ma nyams par shin tu gal che/ thog mar dbang lung ma zhus sngon du bla ma la brtag dpyad legs par btang ba las/ rjes su mdzad spyod ji ltar snang yang dag snang sbyang ba las log lta mi rung ngo /lar dad pa ha cang skye ma log blta ma shor na nyes pa chung / rang gi dbang lung thob phyin chad bla ma de sku che rung / chung rung / btsun rung mi btsun rung dam tshig ni nges par bsrung dgos so/ /cung zad re nyams na yang de ma 'gyod tshang bshags pa stobs bzhi ldan pas sbyang ngo / /de ltar byas pas sa lam gyi yon tan myur du rdzogs par gyur ro/ /lar dad pa dang dam tshig ldan pa'i mi de la bla ma'i byin rlabs dbang med du rtogs yon tan mi 'dod na yang skye/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin bzhin du 'du/ 'dod don thogs med du 'grub/ 'di dang phyi ma bde 'bras mchog bsnyes par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang tha snyad kyi rig gnas snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag sman dpyad/ bzo rigs kun kyang thar lam gyi cha rkyen las dngos ni ma yin/ don dam pa gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rang rig rjen pa rang ngo la mi g.yo bar ni shin tu gal che ba lags so/ /a ho/ rang rig ngo bo gdod nas ka dag kyang / /'dzin rtog zhen pa'i sprin gyis sgrib gyur te/ /rang ngo ma shes sdug bsngal 'dam du byings/ /'khor ba'i btson dong 'di la yid re sun/ /des na da lta dal 'byor ngal stegs 'dir/ /cung zad gnas dus snying nas nges 'byung blos/ /rang rig gdod ma'i 321

rgyal sa gang yin de/ /ci bzhin dri bral ngo bor blta re 'tshal/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba bka' drin sangs rgyas las—/ /ches lhag rdo rje slob dpon bstan byas te/ /le lo med par bskyed rdzogs don la dril/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nar ma'i rnal 'byor 'bad/ /mi tshe rnam g.yeng ngang du ma shor bar/ /gtan bde'i sar snyigs mdzod zhes snying gi gtam/ /smras pa'i dge bas 'gro kun chos brtson nas/ /rdo rje 'chang chen tshe gcig nyid 'grub shog zhes thun bzhi nar mar nyams su len tshul mdo tsam 'di ni/ lcags sprag gi sde ba lta bu tshe ring don ldan nam/ kun bzang rang grol dbang po'i gsung gi bskul ba'i ngor mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs gser ldan dgos su lha rigs su skyes pa'i rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu karma rin mchog dga' dge ba'i dpal gyi lug hor zla drug pa'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bzang nyer lngar gang shar skad cig mar bal bod mtshams kyi grong grwa phu chos gling lha khang du bris pa'o//'di ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yin la/bsgrub pa la zhugs tshe bsnyen yig so so len thang ltar bya'o//dge'o//322

༄sto /ye shes mgon po sde bdun gyi gtor 'bul snying por dril ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhugs so/ /snod gtsang mar ci 'byor ba'i mchod rdzas ja gad dam chus brlan pa bshams nas 'di skad do//oṃ su bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā su bha wa shusgo3haṃ/ rang nyid ho ru kar gsal mdun/ rlung me thod sgyed bhardzo 'am nang / /sman gtor sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /ma dag kun sbyangs las dam ye/ /dbyer med bdud rtsi mkha' khams khengs/ /dam can dgyes bskyed nus ldan gyur/ /oṃ ldirgyu ha ho trīḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lin+ta rdu spyiḥthaḥ oṃ aḥrgyu/ 'byung bzhi rim rtsegs bskal me rdo gur dbus/ /dur khrod thod mkhar rdo rje brag stengs su/ /pad zla nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan/ /gral thabs bdun bsgrigs steng du mthing ga rgyuske/ /yongs gyur dbus dmar rgyud mgon legs ldan nag /de g.yas phyag drug gur mgon gdong bzhi pa/ /g.yon rim phyag bzhi tshogs bdag trag shad nag /kun kyang rang rang yab yum sras 'khor bcas/ /gsal nas 'bru gsum thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas mchog chos dbyings zhing khams dang / /gnas yul dur khrod rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med gyur/ /rgyu dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po/ /ma hā ka la mthu bo che/ /legs ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /ru tra pho mo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid/ /sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol mchod/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chags bshags//thugs dam gnyan po bskong gyur cig /nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /sgo gsum gus bstod par bgyis/ /grub pa brgyad dang 'phrin las bzhi/ /rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ shri ma hā ka la rgyu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ badz+ra rak+ṣa na tha ma hā ka la sa pā ri wa ra e rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/bhun dza ho/rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pi pa to a ta tra ma sa ma ye swā hā/ ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog la sogs/ /phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ /sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tshaskyo su hā/ zhes brjod gtor ma gtsang sar btabs/ zhes mgon po sde bdun gyi gtor 'bul snying por dril ba 'di yang rgya gar gyi yul kha che'i mnga' ris su rtogs pa la dwags rgyal po'i sras mo chos bzhin du spyod pa khri lcam nor 'dzin dbang mos bskul ba'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus mnga' ris smad glo bo'i ri spug bsam gtan gling du sa bya hor zla yar tshes brgyad kyi thun skabs su smras 323

pa'i yig rigs ni shākya'i dge slong rig lung rgyud sde smra ba'i dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'o//dge'o//༄ga /ye shes mgon po legs ldan trak+ṣa kyi 'phrin las rgyun khyer snying po bzhugs so/ /dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su ye shes mgon po'i bris sku mchod rdzas ji snyed bshams la bdag bskyed lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du song nas/bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dur khrod chen po'i dbus su 'byung bzhi'i ri rab bcas pa'i rtse mor byang chub las bhardzo 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang rgya khyon tshad med 'jigs shing rngams pa'i rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi gdan la re las dug sdong ram gyi mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las/ bdud mgon legs ldan nag po dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ g.yas shwa na yu kha'i gdong shel mig gyen du phyogs pas dgra bgegs la zug cing bla 'gugs pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang mche gcigs ljags 'dril rkan sdebs hūṃ phaṭaḥ gad yo nga ro drag po sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis dug sdong dang bdud zhags/ g.yon gnyis khram shing thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsum brtsegs gsol zhing thod skom gyi dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ bdud rta nag po chibs shing rngam brjid drag shul che ba/ de'i g.yon du dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti dang / mtha' bskor du shwa na drug seng gdong mon pa mon mo dpal mgon bdun cu lha dmag 'bum sde ma srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas gsal ba'i snying kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ r+ghaṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur byon srog bdag ma rung ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso//drag po'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku//rdo rje ma hā ka la ste//lha chen lcam dral spyan 'dren gyis//gnas 'dir mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e h+ya nyi/ ma hā ka la trak+kad sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ.ar+ghaṃ nas shari'i bar brjod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul la/ hūṃ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing / /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzaḥ: baṃ hoḥs dam ye bsre zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur/sku gang dri ma dag rigs bdag mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan par gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la trak+ka ma hā ka la sirnyi tro yam̐ du na dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ urgyu ma hā ka la sa pā ri wa ra i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ ye shes mgon po 324

'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyi gtor ma phul/ yig brgyas bzod par gsol/ 'dod don gsol ba btab bo/ /de ltar rtag tu mchod na 'go zhing 'phrin las thogs med 'grub pa dang 'di phyi bar do'i bar chad sel lo/ /zhes mi phyed dad gus can 'tsho mdzad mi rje tshe brtan bkra shis rdo rje'i gsung gi bskul ngor rig sngags 'chang ba tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos lcags kyi khrums zla'i tshes bdun la sbyar ba maṅga lo/dge'o//sto /dpal nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sku brnyan rang byung bod thang mgon por bstod cing 'phrin las gsol ba'i tshig zeng bzhed don lhan gyis grub pa'i dbyangs rtses pa bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru ma hā kā lā yā/ khams gsum las 'das sgrib gsum dri ma spangs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ched/ /sa gsum dbang bsgyur drag po mig gsum tshul/ /'jig rten gsum mgon nag po'i sku snang ba/ /ma hā de wa'i sras po ma mo'i rje/ /lha yi lhar gyur bdud rnams kun gyi bdud/ /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang dang ldan pa po/ /bcom ldan nag po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan las la ches dbang bas/ /gdug pa can kun drag tu sgrol bar mdzad/ /'khor ba rgyun gcod thar ba'i lam spel phyir/ /legs nyes stang 'dzin bka' yi bya ra mdzad/ /mi thung gel ba'i gzugs 'chang dpa' brjid sku//mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan cing / /ga bur phreng rgyus khrag 'dzag do shal byas/ /gdeng can dbang pos brgyan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog mun pa'i g.yung drung mig sman/ /thig les lan brgyar byugs kyang mtshon min pa'i/ /ches gnag rab snum 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'khrugs/ /sbrang rtsi'i kha dog bcu gnyis nyi ma yi/ /gzi 'phrog spyan gsum nas 'bras rgyas 'dra'i gzugs/ /'bru tshugs gzigs shing nyag rno mtho ba yi/ /shangs nas rdo rje'i glu dbyangs ju sgra 'byin/ /dpal chen dpa' bo che la bdag phyag 'tshal//zhal ras 'gram du 'bar ba'i phreng ba bzhin//dmar ser me skar 'phro ba'i rgya mdzes shing //smar smin lag tshom glog stong 'gyu bas mtshon/ /rgod ma'i me 'dra gyen 'dar thor tshugs skra/ /rigs kyi cod pan mi 'khrugs rgyan rdzogs sku/ /bdud 'dul ting 'dzin phyag rgya can gyis rgyan/ /khro chags bzhad nyams tshem phreng mche ba rtsigs//myu gu mjos par byas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /baṃ ro'i steng nas 'gro phror 325

tshom bzhin zhabs/ /mnyam gnas stag gi pags pas sham thabs dkris/ /rdo je'i yu ba byas pa'i gri gu g.yas/ /bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i thod pa phyag g.yon gyi/ /thugs kar steng 'og tshul du 'dzin byas shing / /ga da zur brgyad rdo rje'i mtshan pa yi/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ka ni g.yon gyi gru mor 'chang / /dpal ldan mgon po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /nag po khyod ni bcom ldan sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs rjes rnam par sprul pa kho na las/ /rang rgyud dregs par nam yang ma gyur mod/ /thabs la mkhas pas tshar gcod khro bor ston/ /ma rung gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /rnam bzhi 'phrin las rol pa 'jam klas kyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor bzhi skyong bar mdzad/ /legs ldan drag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa lnga brgya mtha' ma'i dus/ /mi srun gdul dka' 'dul la sangs rgyas kyi/ /rmad byung phrin las thams cad khyed kyis bsgrub/ /dga' 'joms lha min kun gyi rigs kyi nad/ /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing che/ /grub pa brgyad cu kun gyi mnga' bdag dpal/ /thar pa mchog kyang yongs ster bcom ldan 'das/ /nag po che la snying nas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar nag po che la rab gus pas/ /phyag 'tshal mchog bstod gsol ba btab pa'i mthu'i/ /rig pa 'dzin bdag byang chub snying po'i bar/ /nag po chen pos bu bzhin skyongs mdzad nas/ /ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar mi gtong zhing / /der skye las kyi rgyu yang khyod kyi mthu'i//rnam pa kun tu nyams shing gcod byas nas//dge ba'i las la yongs su bzhug tu gsol//skye kun mtho ris phun tshogs yon tan bdun/ /lha ma'i lam mchog 'phags nor yon tan bdun/ /ma nyams tshangs pa'i gnas su skye 'gyur zhing / /skyes ma thag tu mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /sdom rgyun gsum thob bcas pa ma nyams shing / /pha ma mkhan slob bla ma la gus mchod/ /khyad par mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /ci dgyes las la spyod pa'i grogs mdzod cig /bskyed rim phra thig rdzogs rim chos nyid don/ /brtson pa lhod med nyin mtshan kha sbyor du/ /bsgom par nus shing lus ngag yid gyi gegs/ /mtha' dag bla ma nag po che mthu'i zhi/ /sa lam yon tan 'bri med yar zla ltar/ /'phel bas las bzhi lta stangs bcu gnyis dang / /grub pa chen po brgyad sogs thun mongs kyi/ /dngos grub kun kyang 'bad med nyid 'grub mdzodaske/ /khyad par thun mongs ma yin phyag rgya che/ /mi 'gyur bde chen gnas lugs rdo rje'i gnas/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med thugs klong du/ /bdag sogs 'bral bcas 'gro kun yongs grol nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba ci tsam pa/ /ma lus 'dren pa'i dpa' bor yongs grub nas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa bskangs bar shog /snying nas 'dod don gsol ba btab pa 'di/ /sras mchog 'phags pas bskor ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun dang rdo rje nag po chen po yiske/ /bden pas bslu med gegs med nyid 'grub shog /ces dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa dang gsol ba 326

'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni bal yul du bod thang mgon po zhes rdo las rang byung du grub par yang bzhed cing /kha cig gi mgon po klu sgrub kyi phyag gis bsgrun par yang 'dod la/ gang ltar sngon ye rang dang nye ba'i ri bor phul la ḍo zhes pa'i rtse mor yod pa nam mkha' la 'phur ste bod thang du bab par bal yul kun tu grags gyur de la mchod gtor dang lhan cig snyan dar phul ba'i ngos su shing khyi snron zla'i tshes bcur dpal rig pa 'dzin pas brjod pa dge'o//dge'o/

༄ga /rtsis mgon lha chen dpal 'bar gyi skub thabs 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so / /oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyer bsrung phyir/ /smon lam dbang gi sprul pa'i sku/ /rtsis mgon lha chen dpal 'bar la/ /gus pa chen pos phyag byas nas/ /de ba'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las gang / /mdo tsam bdag gi 'dir bshad bya/ /mdun du bris sku sogs rten dang mchod gtor bshams/ phyag rdor sogs rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo gang rung zhig gi bdag skyed sngon du 'gro bas nang mchod dang /gsang mchod byin gyis rlabs/ de nas yo byad la thor/ naḥm san+ta bud+dha ya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na rdu phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shusgo sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ gnas khang gzhal med khang du gyur pa'i dbus su a yig las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ju ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥrgyu oṃ badz+ra dhu pe lhargyu oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥrgyu oṃ badz+ra ghadhe urgyu oṃ badz+ra nai wi bya āḥrgyu oṃ badz+ra shari āḥrgyu nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ru pū ru su ru su ru/ a wat+ta ya/ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ swa hā/ rol mo'i byin dbab pa/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ni ta/pra rā ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba burnya k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pratsā pa ra mi ta na da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya sasto ṣa ni r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ/ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ stong par gyur/ a thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ r+ghaṃ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥrgyu ho/ ci mang brjod/ de nas bskyed pa'i lha ni rten yod na de nyid dang med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha' sgom pa ste/ oṃ swā bha wa shu sarba dharma swā bhā wa shusto3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang /phyi rol du dur khrod chen po'i bskor ba'i dbus su pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan gsum la r+ghaṃ yig mthing nag gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su legs ldan lha chen dpal 'bar ma hā ka la sku mdog skug nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ g.yas tsan+da gyi beng phyar zhing / g.yon na srin mo'i gang gi mdung ring 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i g.yas na mgon po beng ma mthing nag phyag na tsan dan gyi beng rtse nor bus spras pa/ beng stod nas me 'bar zhing / beng smad nas chu phrug pa/ nang nas lha dang lha min gyi dmag tshogs 'gyed pa'o/ /g.yon phyogs su mgon po gri gug sku mdog mun pa ltar 328

gnag pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa dgra snying dron mo phar bzhin pas bkang ba 'dzin pa gsum ka'ang 'kha gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba brtsigs shing ljags skyod pa/ zhal gyi gra nas khrag 'dzag sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing gsus 'khyil che ba dar nag gi 'jol bor/ gser gyi ske rags can/mi lpags kyi stod gos dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs byas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs pa'o/ /mdun du rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bh+yoḥlas 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yog dang re ldes smad dkris pa nyi zla dang seng sbrul gser gyi dril bu/lcags sgrog sogs rgyan dang / khri baṃ nad skyal mtshon grug ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha dang bcas pa srin po'i bong bu'i dmar ga'i steng na btsan skyil gyis bzhugs te rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rol ba/ rgyab tu gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar nag gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / sku grol ba/ mgo 'phreng dang rus pas rgyan cing mi spags dang stag lpags gsol la/ de la sogs pa mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / srid pa pho rgyud dang mo rgyud thams cad lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar rgyu/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/dur khrod chen po brgyad dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza/ r+ghaṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs ma hā kā la gshegs/ /'jigs byed bstan bsrung yongs kyi gtso/ /zag med dbyings nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā ka la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka la sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdza r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstem/ slar yang 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzi bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya grisne rda/ ar+ghaṃ ṭ+wā hā nas shāri'i bar gyi mchod/rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa ma ya sma ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha sa ma ya rak+ṣaskyo/ zhes pas dam la bzhag oṃ ma hā ka la sa pā ri wā ra a bṛ ta ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ zhes lan bdun dang / spro na lha so so'i snying po'i mthar ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa dang / sha sa nas kyang 'bul/ spyir a ka ro lan gsum gyi stabs/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur cing / /dreg pa gsum gyi lha dang bdud/ /'dul phyir legs ldan nag po che/ /mched gsum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing / /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /329

thugs kar sngags 'phreng gsal btab la/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la gu ṇa trī da r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa gtso bo'i snying po'oske/ /oṃ ma hā kā la rak+ka du beng ni dzaḥdzaḥ beng ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa r+ghaṃ phaṭa/gri gug go/ oṃ tri ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu ti swā hā/ na maḥtri ma hā ka lasga ni sha ya na mo yo gi nī ṭ+wāṃ/ tabya thā/ oṃ hi li nyi li ke te ke ti tsi ti ni tse swā hā/zhes mgon po rnams kyi spyi sngags so//oṃ tī se li ka prad dza la/a mo gha hriḥha rdu phaṭa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i snying po'o/ /slar yang phyi mchod nang mchod 'bul/ /rgyu nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /dmar chen khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang / /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / rus pa rkang klad bsres pa'i gsol/ /zhun chen gsal ba'i sgron me dang / /rdo rje rang byung dri chab dang / sha chen sna lnga'i zhal zas dang / /rkang gling thod rnga snyan pa'i sgra/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kha bkang nas/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /'bru bcud stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman/ /dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi//don snying sha rus gtor chen bshams/ /de bzhin tshe 'dzin khrag gi rgyun/ /bhad+dha lcang lo khrag gis bkang / /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mthun pa'i rdzas su bzhes par mdzod/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /zhing chen bla re 'phan gdugs dang / /rgyu rlon lda ldir snying 'phreng dpyangs/ /keng rus sna tshogs ri ltar spungs/ /sha khrag dri bsur rgyun mi chad/ /sna tshogs brgyan gyi mchod pa 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang dang bcas la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub pa mdzod/ bstod pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdugs pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri khug g.yasaske/ /g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /drag po mi gdug gtum pa'i sku/ /lha yi dmag dpon chen po ste/ /lha min g.yul du pham mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje beng khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /dga' tshal mdzes pa'i lha mo ni/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i sku/ /dgra bgegs sha dang khrag la rngam/ /rdzong mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul/ /rgyu dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phangs cher mtho zhing / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe legs brtan nas/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyas par mdzod//khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi//nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod 330

nams rab rgyas nag /thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las bcol/ rjes yig brgya dang / /bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ /smon lam spyi dang mthun/ bkra shis kyi cho ga rgyas par bya'o/ /lha chen dpal 'bar rtsis mgon mched/ /sgrub thabs bka' lung rgyun chad med/ /dam pa'i gsung las btus 'di rmad/ /tshig tshogs med kyang byin rlabs yod/ /dge mchis 'phags mchog nag po che/ /mchod pa 'gro kun dga' bar shog /ces pa yang don gnyer can mang pos nan gyis gsol ba btab pa dang / khyad par slob ma dad pa can rgyal khab kyi gtang 'dzin byed por zhugs pa sde pa tshe dbang 'gyur med bsod nams legs 'phel zhes pas bskul ba'i ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus me yos dbyug zla'i tshes bzang por gdan thog gcig tu spel ba dge'o/ /dge'o/ /spyir rtsis mgon gyi sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum sogs rnying lugs glegs bam che ba yod 'dug kyang bka' lung rgyun da lta mi snang la/ 'di ni rgyud pa rgyun ma chad pa nges par jo bo rje'i lugs la bsre bslad med pa nyid bshad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ brgyad ldan chu yis ngom pa na/ /ba tsha'i khron pa su yi bru/ /tshad 'gyur dgyes pa'i rgyun yod na/ /yig nag la sred ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/khog /lha mo tsa'i'i sgrub thabs/oṃ ṭ+wā ste/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sna tshogs pa//gang 'dul der ston lha mo la//phyag byas gang gi sgrub pa'i thabs//mdo tsam 'di ru bshad par bya//de yang sngags kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig gi bcas pa la gnas pas lha mo 'di yi lung nod pa'i sngags pas ras bris yod na bkram/tshom bu la gtor ma sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bshams la bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal nas mchod rdzas byin gyis rlabs/mdun gyi rten yod na de dang med na mkhar lha bskyed/bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las me rlung 'khrug pa'i gur khang 'jigs su rung ba'i klong du khrag mtsho 'khol ma'i dkyil du keng rus kyi ri rab/de steng thod mkhar zur gsum pa'i nang du chos 'byung dmar nag 'bar ba'i lte bar pad nya'i steng ba chen bsnol ba'i gdan la yi dam gyi sa bon las 'phros pa'i hriḥyig 'bar ba'i ral gri yi mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ye shes dang 'jig rten las kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi nus mthu gcig tu bsdus trīḥyi mtshan pa'i ral gri la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha mo tsaṣ+ṭi ka 'bar ba'i gdong pa can sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa me yi phung po lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gi bkang ba zhal du 'dags shing thugs khar bzung ba/ dbu 331

skra ral pa thor tshugs gi rtser rma bya'i gdong sgro chun pos mdzes pa/ thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon gyi do shal snying gi phreng ba dang bcas pa rus pa'i rgyan drug spras shing mi glang gi ko rlon gyi stod g.yogs shing / re lde dang stag sogs kyi smad dkris pa/ sbrul nag giske rags can zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon rkyang gi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de yi g.yas g.yon du ro langs nag mo gnyis las la 'gyed pa'o/ /de yi mdun zur du kai las khu gdong ma nag po g.yas gri gug gi gnod byed kyi snying drangs nas gsol ba/ g.yas su rdza las spyang gdong ma dmar mo g.yas gri gug gis gnod byed kyi mgrin pa nas khrag drangs te gsol ba/ g.yon du shaṃ las khyi gdong ma sngon mo g.yas pa gri gug gi spyi bo nas klad khrag drangs te gsol ba/ lha mo de gsum ka yang khro zhing gtum pa phyag g.yon gyi bsgrub bya'i gzung nas bzung zhing sbrul dang rus pa thod pa skam rlon gyi rgyan dang g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yog stag lpags kyi sham thabs can me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su ro gdan la zhabs gnyis bsgrad cing sku las sprul pa'i khro mo dpag tu med pa 'phro bzhin du bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyab tu rdu las bka' bstod las mkhan rā hu la sku mdog dud kha g.yas gri gug gi rtse nas skyi mdangs phro zhing g.yon mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bsnam paske/ spyi gtsug tu bya rog zhal dang sku smad sbrul 'jug can lus kun mig gi khengs shing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso 'khor kun gyi dpral mgrin snying khar oṃ dkar āḥdamar rgyu mthing gi mtshan pa/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ mthing las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang ri rab kyi byang phyogs bdud rtsi'i chu mig rdzing bu'i 'gram dang ri bo po ṭa la nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul sogs gnas yul dag pa nas lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ r+ghaṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gisaglu/ /tshur gshegs lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /bdag gi thugs dam gnyan skong na/ /dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsolak+ṣi//shrī de wi dz+wa la mu khi sa pā ri wa ra e gye hi oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyi gdan phul/ dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ rda ye gnyis su med par bstem/ yang rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shari'i bar gyis mchod/sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣiñtsa me/ ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi oṃ badzi bha wa a gi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ces gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag mthu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu yi lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang /'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyi dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī de wi dz+wa la mu khi ni ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ shrī de wi dz+wa la mu khi ni pa bye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ añtsa ma rna/ prok+ṣa rna/ oṃ shrī de wi dz+wa la mu khi ni puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ shrī de wi dz+wa la mu khi ni dhu paṃ āḥr+ghaṃ oṃ shrī dri wi dz+wa la mu khi ni di paṃ ā rdu/ oṃ shrī de wi dz+wa la mu khi ni gar+ghaṃ āḥrgyu/ oṃ shrī de wi dz+wa 332

la mu khi ni nai wi bya āḥrdu/ oṃ shrī di wi dz+wa la mu khi ni shalda āḥrgyu / zhes phyi mchod dang / oṃ ma hā ka la de wi waṃ hri rgyu phaṭaḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/zhes pas nang mchod dang / r+ghaṃ dpal ldan lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /lha min mu stegs tshogs 'joms shing / /nad kyi bdag mo drag shul can/ /srog la dbang bsgyur khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan phyi nang gsang ba'i tsaṇ+ḍi ka /bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i gsang ba'i yum/ /'khor bcas rnams la bdag gi mchod cing bstod/ /yid la bsam pa'i gtong grogs mdzod du gsol/ /cung zad rgyas par spro na/ trībade chen 'du 'bral med pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur bcom ldan ma/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi yol ba/ /sprul pa'i skur ston lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /dmar gsal bskal me'i 'od 'phrog khros pa'i gar/ /bdud dang mu stegs mtha' dag pa/ /tshar gcod ral gri thod pa'i phyag rgya can/ /bskyang brkum zhabs kyi gdug pa'i tshogs rnams brdzis/ /skam rlon thod 'phreng rus pa'i rgyan drug spras/ /mi glang stag lpags sprul nag ske rags bcings/ /ral pa thor gtsug rma bya'i mdangs kyi brgyan/ /'dod khams bdag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bh+yoḥ dug gsum 'joms mdzad sku gsung thugs las sprul/ /bya spyang khyi gdong snying khrag rus zan ma/ /bka' sdod khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /phra men las byed 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /sngon gyi dam tshig ji bzhin sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sa skyong kun/ /chos bzhin khrims ldan rgyal khams bde zhing skyid/ /bdag gi 'dod don 'phrin las kun 'grub mdzod/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ shrī tsaṇ+ḍi ka sa ma ya ha na ha na rdu phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag gtor chog tsam yin na 'dir gtor 'bul la 'jug bzlas brjod byed par 'dod na/ skabs 'dir bya ba ste lha mo'i snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i trīḥdamar sngags 'phreng gi skor ba gsal btab la/ bdag mdun spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bcas dzab ni/ oṃ trīḥtsaṇ+ḍi kā/ snying kha la rak+ṣa/ a yak+ṣa se na/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ rgyu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ zhes gtso mo'i sngags te ci nus su bzla'o/ /'khor spyi sngags ni/ oṃ ka kā mu khi nī kai swā hā/ khu gdong ma'o/ /oṃ dzasbu ka mu khi nī rdza ṭ+wā hā/ lce spyang gdong ngo //oṃ shwa na mu ṣi ni shwe swā hā/khyi gdong ma'o//bzhi snying gcig tu dril ba ni// trīḥ rdzaḥbi mu tam bi an/a mu kai ma ra ya hūṃ r+ghaṃ rgyu/ ha ha ha/ na mo bha ga wa te ro ḍa ya/ sha r+ghaṃ mā ra yā/ a gats+tsha dzaḥdzaḥswā hāḥ zhes lan gsum bzlas/('di nas ma dbe zhog ngos gcig chad) 333

༄gi /rdzogs chen bka' yi bsrung ma gza' bdud chen po'i mchod chog yid bzhin lhan grub bzhugs so/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ/ gnod sbyin chen po gsang ba'i gtso/ /bcom ldan phyag rdor la btud nas/ /de 'phrul rdo rje theg bsrung gtso/ /drang srong chen po'i gsol mchod bshad/ /de yang dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas drang srong chen po mchod par 'dod na/ gnas dben zhing gtsang ma yid dang mthun pa'i dus khyad par can la sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rten rdzas mchod rdzas spyan gzigs ci 'byor ba dang / khyad par dmar gtor dgu bskor tsa ra'i khrag ma dā na yāḥbarlan pa bshams nas/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod rdzas byin gyis rlobs cing / khyad par gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ ā r+ghaṃ gis gtor ma sha khrag gi ri dang rgya mtshor bsam la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ mang du brjod/ mdun du rten rdzas stong par sbyangs/ khrag mtsho thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su tri las gza' bdud rā hu la smug nag mgo bo dgu pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang sbrul zhag 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhus dgra snying gzir ba/ lus kun mig gi gang zhing ro smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas can gza' dang gdong mo rgyu skar sogs 'jigs byed dregs pa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rgyu las 'od 'phros lho nub kyi mtshams laṅka pu ra'i grong khyer dang rgyu phyogs nas gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs/ spyan drangs par bsam zhing / rnga dang dril bu thod gling la sogs pa dkrol zhing bsur chen gyi dud pa btang nas 'di skad do/ /r+ghaṃ/sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bcas nag po mthu bo che/ /gza' chen sde brgyad rgyu skar btsun mor bcas/ /tshur byon tshur byon gnas 'dir gzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ hri shag tu ram̐ na ge tsi ta tra ma ma yong za gh+raḥha ho yo ge sha la dzaḥdzaḥbha lin ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ke ta ke ta ra hu la/ tsa ra ka khyab 'jug chen po/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ byi nu ra tsa/ bdud po reg ti ljang sngon chen po/ du ba mjug ring / gdong mo bzhi dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā ti/ lha chen po brgyadaske/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar ci shu rtsa brgyad/ lha ma srin snang srid sde brgyad dang bcas zhal du bha lin+ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhes brjod pas gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung gtor ma la phog te gsol bas shin tu mnyes par bsam la/ hūṃ/ chos skyongs chen po 334

gza' bdud 'khor bcas la: bha ling gtor mas thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi sman gyi thugs dam bskang : sil snyan rol mos thugs dam bskang : gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang : ba dan bla res thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyen po bskang nas kyang : bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang : re ba thams cad bskang ba dang : nad rnams thams cad zhi ba dang : gdon rnams thams cad med pa dang : chags che nyams nga bzlog pa dang : 'khor bsrung rkyen bzlog bar chad bzlog: r+ghaṃ/ gza' mchog chen po rā hu la:sku mdog dud kha 'jigs pa la: dbu dgu phyag bzhi rngams pa'i tshul: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dud kha dbus:bar ma g.yas ljang g.yon dmar zhing :dbus ni mthing nag 'jigs pa ste:steng zhal dbus dmar 'dzum pa la: g.yas mthing g.yon dmar ha ha rgod: steng na nam mkha' bya rog gdong : kun kyang zhal gdong spyan gsum bsgrad: phyag bzhi g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis: chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags 'dzin: 'og ma gnyis na mda' gzhu bsnams: sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil ba ste: mgo lus med pa mig gi gang : las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung : gnyer du dam can rnal 'byor skyongs: dam tshig can la bdag bstod do: hūṃ/ khyed kyi bka' nyan gdong mo bzhi: gza' brgyad lha brgyad klu brgyad dang :sde brgyad sgyu skar nyi shu brgyad: 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyu/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: sid+dha rgya mcho1re mtsho gling du: nam mkha'i gza' rnams dam la btags: bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs bzhin tu phrin las mdzod: yar stod sham po gangs kyi ra ba ru: rig 'dzin chen po ku ma ra dza dang : rdzogs chen rnal 'byor klong chen rab 'byams kyi: ye shes thig le'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: sngags bdag gza' rnams thams cad yongs 'dus nas: so sor gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma byas sam: rnal 'byor tshe srog sring bar ma byas sam: bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par ma byas sam: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin
