las mdzod: skabs 'dir bzlas par spro na cung zad bya/mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥ bris sku yod na de la bstim zhing / med na rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar gshegs nas/ dge ba 'di yi bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /nad gdon mi mthun gnod pa'i tshogs zhi zhing / /dam can rgya mtshos bu bzhin legs skyongs nas/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /ces brjod/ lha sngags kyi rang lus bsrung zhing mthar dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung yongs kyi gtso/ /drag shul mi srun gnod sbyin ra hu la'i/ /gtor tshogs khyer bde dri med 'od zer gyis/ /bzhed pa ci bzhin sbyar bas 'gro phan shog /ces drang srong chen po'i gtor chog 'di 335

ni gtsang la stod byang lha rtse chos sde'i rab 'byams pa dad gus mchog dang ldan pa blo bzang smon lam rgya mtshos nan gyis bskul zhing gzhan la yang phan par mthong bas rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus kun dga' snron nya'i tshes nyer gsum gyi thun skabs su grub par sbyar ba dge 'o//maṅga lo/༄sto /dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i mchod smrin dpag bsam smon pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ suste/ gsang ba'i bdag por phyag byas nas/ /ma mo'i sgrub thabs snying po bri/ /dben par sku rten mdun mchod rdzas/ /ci 'byor bshams la bdag lhar gsal/ /mchod rdzas re yam̐ khaṃ gi sbyangs/ /oṃ āḥrgyu gis bdud rtsir gyur/ /rang mdun khrag mtsho me rlung 'tshub gur dbus/ /kai las lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod rtsalaske/ /smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri ne'u le/ /rdo rje'i gshog ldem mi lpags re lde'i gos/ /nyi zla seng sbrul ma mo'i chas kun rdzogs/ /drel rta rkang gsum la zhon 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi/ /gnas yul dur khrod rang gi bzhugs gnas nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs mdun gyi ma mo la/ /thim nas dbyer med brtan par bzhugs par gyur/ /raklo du ra durnying bh+yoḥ kha kha du ra durnying bh+yo: ho ra du ra durnying bh+yoḥrdo rje'i ljags kyi gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas ma mo 'khor bcas dgyes zhing tshims/ oṃ ma hā ba lin+ta kha ram̐ khā hi/ yo gi ni kha ram̐ khā hiḥ ḍā ki nī kha ram̐ kha hi/ ste pa bha ga ta a ka sa ma ho/ tabya thā/ ru ru bi tiṣ+ṭha bad rnyo si/ ma mo raklo tsit+ta kha rakla bh+yoḥbh+yoḥswā hā/ bh+yoḥ sangs rgyas stong gis bstan bsrung ma/ /'phags pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ma/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje rab brtan gshog rgod ma/ /smad byung ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor dang bcas la gus pas bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa'i don/ /'phrin las bzhi dang grub pa mchog /ma lus thogs med grub par mdzod/ /zhes zha lu ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sdom btson 'jam dpal chos mchog drung dang / drung rams pa byams pa rgyal pos kyang bskul ba'i ngor gtsang ru lag zhal lu rgyan gong byang chub dge gnas su srin po snron zla'i sher phyogs tshes lngar rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sbyar ba dge'o/ /maṅga lo/336

༄ga /dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i bka' sdod ging chen srog gi spru gri'i mchod bstod 'phrin las lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba'i snyem glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /a tha/ bcom ldan 'das ho ru ka gu ru pad+ma badz+ra ku ma ra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dpal chen po'i bka' sdod gying chen 'khor bcas nye bar bsnyen pa mchod bstod kyi rim pas 'phrin las mtha' dag thogs med 'grub pa'i man ngag du/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' thod 'phreng rtsal gyi go 'phang brnyes zung 'jug grub dbang nub nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs kyi zlos gar dmung po gter ston byang chub gling pas dpal thang srin mtsho'i lho nub brag bya khyung mchu can nas bton pa'i kun bzang thugs gter las drag sngags sgron me'i ging sgrub kyi bstod bskul mngon rtogs su gsung pa'i dgongs don gtso bor byas te bstan pa 'di la/ gnas gtsang ma yid du 'ong bar mchod bskang bstan rdzas ci 'byor dang khyad par phud rgod tu dhe ram̐ ba ling mang sa bsangs bsur mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed bshams la/ bsang sbyangs rgyas pa'am bsdu na/ oṃ a bṛ te rgyu phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ su bha wa shusgo sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyolhahaṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyi bsangs sbyangs byas nas/ oṃ lha ha ho trīḥ ci mang brjod nas byin gyis rlabs la/ rang nyid dpal chen por bskyed pa'i mdun du ging 'khor bcas gsal ba'i ljags r+ghaṃ las rdo rje'i spu gur gyur pas gtor mchod kyi bcud drangs shing gsol bar dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra sā tu dhu sa ma yā ya rgyu ram̐ baṃ ging dzaḥ dun bh+yoḥ oṃ dza r+ghaṃ baṃ ho tro tre na tri me ne sa mā ya sā dhu tri dza dzaḥ sa pā ri wa ra ba lin+ta e rda gyisna gyisna bhurdzo hoḥ a rnyi pra ma ti sa ma ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lin+ta pāñtsa ka ma gu ṇa pra tits+tsha swā hā/ zhes lan bdun mthar/ badz+ra sa dhu sa ma ya rak+ṣa tsit+ta baṃ nan/zhes btags la phul bas dgyes shing tshim te 'dod don 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par bsam la bstod 'phrin las snyan dbyangs rol mo bcas te 'di skad do/ /rdu spyoḥ bskal bzang zhing 'dir phyogs dus rgyal kun gyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung / /ho ru ka des dus 'dir byin gyis rlobs//hūṃ dza bh+yoḥya/ dpal gyi bka' 'bangs dregs pa bsam gyis mi khyab las/ /dgra lha'i sde dpon gnyan po sku lha gsang ba zhes/ /'dzam gling skyes gcig lha yi dge bsnyen dam tshig gi/ /dpal ldan gsang mtshan badz+ra sa skyo thig le rtsal/ /nges don 'og min stug 337

bkod bcom ldan rnam snang drung / /ye shes rdor legs dag pa chos sprin sa la bzhugs/ /gdul bya'i don du mi mjed 'dzam gling laṅka'i yul/ kha ya u dzā la na bcom 'das gsang bdag mdun/ /dam tshig rdor legs tshul bzung rab tu dga' ba yi/ /sa la rab bzhugs dpal chen mchog gi dgongs pa bsgrub/ /rgya gar rgya nag li bal bod kyi yul sogs par/ /gtsug lag dben khrod sbas yul zab gter gnas rnams suk+ṣi/ /bcom ldan 'das mchog sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /bka' 'bangs las kyi tshul snang shel ging rdo rje legs/ /sprul pa rnam 'gyur mtshan grangs dpag gi mi lang zhing / /rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin skyong la rab tu brtson/ /khyad par gtsang shangs 'u yug dbu ru zhwa lha khang / /kong yul bar li sbas rdzong pad bkod dga' ba tshul/ /kaḥthog gro lod btsan rgod ri sogs bod khams kyi/ /yul bdag gter bsrung mu bdud klu tshogs sras/ /dam tshig rab brtsan nang du bkra shis snying nye 'jams/ /phyi ru mi srun dpa' gtum brno myur drag shul can/ /srog gi spu gri ging chen gnod sbyin rdo rje legs/ /khyung gshog 'bar ba sku mdog ljang 'tsher sug gi mdangs/ /khro chags gzhad zhal mche bzhi drag gcigs tshems dkar snyoms/ /spyan gsum sdang mig me 'od skar 'khrug smin ma 'khyug /sma rtsol gser mdog glog g.yo sku la 'ja' 'od 'khyil/ khams nag skra gseb dud phyur dar dmar 'gyings thod bcings/ /zab ber mthing gi gong lag le brgan cha ga 'bar/ /man kra'i ral kha gyen rjes spyang dkar slog pa gsol/ /gser ka phra men rked 'ching dar sna rgya lham bsnams/ /me rlung dbus bzhugs me rlung dpag med 'bum du 'phro/ /phyag g.yas gzi yi rdo rje rtse dgus dgra bgegs klad pa 'gem/ /theg dgu'i bstan pa bsrung mtshon rang rtags mtshan char ngoms/ /snying thig snying la 'chang nas dam nyams blo bur du/ /gsod phyir snying zhag khrag 'dzag g.yon gyi chang par 'dzin/ /chibs su gdong lnga g.yu ral 'phrul gyi gshogs pa 'baraske//rin chen rgyan spras spu gseb nor bu'i char pa 'phro/ /bya khra klad lding lcags spyang bdun gyi phyi nas 'brangs/ /mdun g.yas g.yon 'phar khyi dom dred gcan gzan 'tshub/ /'jigs pa'i nga ros lha srin dregs pa dbang du bsdud/ /gtum pa'i gad rgyangs cher sgrogs sa gsum g.yo zhing 'dar/ /rang sngags drag po'i zhing bcu ma lus phye mar 'joms//dmod pa'i mtshon chas dam nyams snying khrag yud skem byed//de yis bka' sdod blon po dus bzhir rgyu ba yi/ /mi bzod pho nya drag shul cher ldan ging chen bzhi/ /gshog rgod 'bar ba stag thi dbur gsol stag ber mnabs/ /stag mo grus ma la gzhon g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis kyi/ /btsan zhags mda' dar 'phen zhing bdud zhags sbrul ltar 'khyug /tho rangs rgyu nas dgra srog dmar po yud kyi len phyir rgyu/ /gtsang bu lha rje chibs su rnga mong ga pa chibs/ /spyang dkar thul pa za 'og sngo khra'i gong lag gsol/ /phyag g.yas khram shing g.yon pas sba lcags klad la skor/ /nam nyi gung 338

yol pho srog mo srid rku phyir rgyug /gnam the dkar po sku la dar dkar ral kha gsol/ /'jig rten khyab 'gro 'phrul ldan byi la ga pa gzhon/ /ral gri lcags kyu thogs nas gri gug dus rgyu nas/ /pho log glang thabs btang nas dam nyams blo bur gsod/ /dmu btsan rdo rje bse to bswe yi mda' gzhu 'gengs/ /sho del mthor zhing rab 'khyug glog dmar la bzhon cing / /skar mda' rol khrid rnal 'byor gsar bu'i drod tshad myul/ /sngags pas bskul tshe rang la rang nyid tshig bzhin du/ /ri klung med rgyug dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod la brtson/ /lhag par dar bab la 'khu dam nyams gsod la rngam/ /yang gcig gnod sbyin ging bdud rdo rje legs pa yi/ /sprul pa dug gsum rang mdangs rnam 'gyur mi bsrun pa/ /dgra srog gcod pa'i bshan pa gdug pa'i rtsal 'chang ba/ /mdun dang g.yas g.yon dag na rgyu ba pho nya'i tshul/ /mon pa snying 'phrog dud kha zhe sdang las skyes gyur/ /ral brjes thod pa'i 'phreng rgyan mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol//ru mtshon g.yang chen g.yab mos lha srin dmag dpung bsdud/ /dgra la gag ldog 'brum btang kha nas tshad rim 'khro/ /sgrol mon rak+ta kha 'bar dmar nag nga rgyal skyes/ /ral brdzes thod pas dbu brgyan dar nag 'gying thod bcings/ /zhing stag dregs pags gos gyon ral gri lcags kyu yi/ /dam la 'khu rnams 'gug gtub blo bur dri thabs btang / /myes mon 'thom pa sha zan sngo nag gti mug skyes/ /bdud ral sprin 'thib dmar nag thod bcing sprel lpags gsol/ /dur khrod chas rgyan lcags kyi dbyugs tho glog zhags thogs/ /myos 'thibs nad kyi dam nyams dgra bo gzir bar byed/ /ging chen gting gi shul gnon gnam sman gang dkar ma/ /phrag dog las grub sku mdog rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /res 'ga' khams nag ral pa sprin dmar nam mkha' bkang / /ljang nag ber chen ral kha gyen phur glog 'od 'tshub/ /rlung gi dreg mo myur mgyogs shugs ldan chibs su chibs/ /sbrul zhags nad skyal bsnams nas dgra la mdze shu btang —/ /de ltar ging chen gtso bo 'bral med lhan skyes dgu/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung dam la ches dung rgyal bstan skyong / /gzhan yang ging chen 'bar ba'i mched dpung grogs gyur cing / bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma badz+ra ho ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar rdzogs chen don snying yang phur sgrub pa po'i/ /grogs su khas blangs g.yar dam gnyen po'i ba ga /mthu rtsal rmad byung dge bsnyen dregs pa can nyer gcig /lha klu bdud btsan dbang chen bcu drug dmag dpon bzhi/ /bswe lcags dung skyes las mkhan ta ki ra tsa che/ /pho bdud nyi khri chig stong 'dre dmag bye ba dung / /mo rgyud 'dzam gling srid pa'i brtan ma mo bcu gnyis/ /skyong ma bcu gnyis g.ya' ri gangs ri ma bcu gnyis/ /srid pa'i ma mo bdun dang phugs bdag chen po dgu/ /sman phran 'bum bcas rgyal bstan sngags bsrung dam can tshogs/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan sna tshogs dbang rtags cod pan can/ /dam tshig srog ltar 'chang nas rlung ltar thogs med rgyu/ /dpal gyi bka' bzhin 339

nyams pa bdun sgrol sku dgra 'dul/ /zhing bcu sgrol zhing dam tshig nyams pa phye mar brlag /bye brag ging chen bka' las mi 'da' drag shul 'khor/ /rta dmag sum brgya drug cu srog bdag the'u rang stong / /za byed mche gshog 'chang ba sna tshogs cho 'phrul can/ /lha srin sde brgyad yul lha bsam gyi mi khyab du mas bskoraske/kye/de ltar dregs pa'i gtso bo shel ging gnod sbyin che//rdo rje legs pa khyung gshog 'bar ba thig le rtsal/ /khyod ni bstan pa bsrung phyir las kyi tshul snang yang / /dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi byin gyis brlab byas shing / /gnam lcags 'bar ba a su ra yi brag phug tu/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal mjal dbang bskur thob/ /rang srog mdangs gsol phul nas dam nod gsang ba'i mtshan/ /dbang rtags thob cing sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dam yang bcas/ /de 'og bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs rje'i phrin las chig bsdus dpal/ /gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rig 'dzin bye ma mu tra shī la mdzi yi/ /dpal chen yang dag phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tsheske//dkyil 'khor bka' yi bsrung mar mnga' gsol gying du bkol/ /de 'og pad 'byung bod yul gdul byar gshegs pa'i dus/ /dam can mthu ldan mnga' gsol spu gri dbang yang bskur/ /sbas yul dben gnas zab gter brgya rtsa gnyer du gtad/ /chos mdzad skyongs shing gu ru'i rgyud 'dzin bsrung mar brkos—/ /khyad par slob dpon zangs gling gdul byar gshegs pa'i skabs/ /nam snying mtsho rgyal lha sras rnams la yang phur gyi/ /dkyil 'khor zhal phyes mthu ldan kun kyang phur bsrung bkol/ /de tshe gying chen khyod kyang dpal chen bsgrub pa'i grogs/ /rdzogs chen snying thig 'chang ba'i sku tshe bsring skyobs byed/ /dpal 'byor mnga' thang chab srid phun tshogs spel ba dang / /dgra 'dul bgegs gzhom rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bsgrub par khas blangs bro bor dam tshig gnyen po bzhin/ /ma g.yel dran mdzod gnod sbyin rdo rje legs pa skyongs/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nas 'bod do shel gyi thig le rtsal/ /tshur byon 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir ma g.yel da tshur byon/ /rnal 'byor g.yar dam can gyi grogs su da tshur byon/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' lung ji bzhin snyigs dus 'dir/ /dpal chen rgyal ba'i gdung tshob rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang che/ /gter ston bla rabs spyan sngar zhal bzhes dam bcas bzhin/ /gnad nas bskul cing 'bod do tshur byon da tshur byon/ /gdung zhing gus pas bsten na la 'i srin po yang / /pha ma las kyang lhag par byams pas skyong byed na/ /kye/ khyod ni dam tshig 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog dgra lha mchog /bsngags na dam ldan sgrub mchog srog ltar ci mi skyong / /gdung bas 'bod do srid gsum gnas rten gar bzhugs kyang / /mngon shes stobs dang dam tshig gnyen po dbang gi ni/ /skad cig myur mgyogs yid ltar dzu 'phrul mthu chen po'i/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir byon cig sa mā dzaḥ bstan pa bsrung phyir 'bar ba'i 340

gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /sngags kyi dam tshig can la gus pas thal mo sbyar/ /skyes mchog khyed la mthun rdzas mchod pa'i bye brag ni/ /dngos su 'byor bshams yid la skyes gyur kun bzang sprin/ /dpag gi mi long mkha' khams yongs khengs 'dod dgu'i char//sngags rgyas byin rlabs phyi nang gsang mchod bla med sprin/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos sogs 'dod yon chogs/ /'bul gyis dgyes bzhes rgyal ba'i bden mthus thob gyur cig /rten rdzas man dal rak+ta dri bzang gis byugs pa/ /sku gzugs srog yig rgod mda' snyug rgod stag gzigs ras/ /dar dkar rin chen bla rdo dril bzang phur ma can/ /'byung po'i bya thod sngags kyi 'phreng bas yongs sprud dang / /sku mkhar rten rdo rtsa ra'i cit+ta dbang po lnga/ /za 'og ra yi rgyal mtshan ra skyes khams pa sogs/ /spyi dang bye brag gsang ba'i rten rdzas dngos 'byor dang / /mos pas bsam nas 'bul gyis dgyes bzhes 'phrin las mdzod/ /mchod rdzas a mṛ ta dang rak+ta ba ling ta/ /shing thog gur gum dkar gsum mngar gsum gser skyems dang / /sha sna khrag sna gtsos pa'i rlangs dang bsreg pa'i bsur/ /rtsi shing bsur sogs ci 'byor 'bul gyi dgyes bzhes mdzod/ /rten gtor gta' gtor rgyun gtor 'grogs gtor nar ma dang //phugaskyems 'bul lo dgyes bzhes phrin las thogs med mdzodaske/ /de ltar bsgrub rten mchod bskang dam rdzas dngos 'byor dang / /khyad par yid kyi mos par kun bzang mchod sprin gyis/ /gying chen 'khor bcas thugs kyi dgyes pa yongs bskang nas/ /bdag sogs sgrub pa po la yal gi sor stsol cig /rgyu rgyo/ skyes mchog khyed ni yid lus thogs med mngon shes ldan/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin dam tshig gnyan bsrung mel tshe byed//bdag cag 'khrul pa'i rgyar chud bag med mi shes rmongs/ /le lo snyoms las byings 'thibs bag chags 'thug /khyad par snyigs ma'i dus skyes nyon mongs shugs che hrag /dge ba'i 'dun par 'char dka' cha shas tsam 'char yang / /dam pa'i tshul bzhin ma gyur las ngan 'dam du byings/ /theg chen sgor bzhugs sdom gsum nos kyang nongs pas gos/ /dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag nyams chags gyur pa kun/ /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags/ /rdzogs rim lta ba bskyed rim sgom pa klong ma gyur/ /spyod pa'i rtsal dman rje khol sngags grangs rtags ma them/ /gdeng med ar gtad khro dbang snyad chung las sbad bskul/ /rtags med ngang thung the tshom yid chad shi pa sngas/ /mchod bskang bsgrub brten yo byad rdzas ma tshang ba dang / /mchod gtor dus 'das gtsang sbras ma thon 'bag btsog gos//phrin las bsgrub pa'i btang rag 'bul bar ma byas shing //bdag blo ngan pas bag med nyes par song la sogs/ /bsrung ma dam can thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa—/ /snying nas gnong zhing 'gyod pa chen pos mthol bshags na/ /nyes ltung sgrib pa'i tshogs kun byang zhing dag gyur nas/ /bdag cag rnams la 'di phyi bar dor dge ba yi/ /dngos grub tshang dbang yid 341

bzhin mchog gi g.yar dam nyid/ /da lta nyid rtsol rnam bzhi'i las kun thogs med mdzod/ /yang dag don la snang srid 'khor 'das chos thams cad/ /chos nyid rig pa'i ngang gdang yin par ma shes nas/ /gnyis snang rtogs pa a 'thas dbang gyur gnyis med dbyings/ /mngon du ma gyur 'khrul pas sbags pa mthol lo bshags/ /rgyal ba rang gi bstan pa bsrung phyir dregs pa can/ /tshul bstan bstan dgra zhing bcu 'dul mdzad par/ /ma shes 'jig rten dregs pa rang rgyud par bzung ba/ /ye shes gying chen dgongs pa'i dbyings su bzod par gsol/ /yang dag don la lha med 'dre med chos thams cad/ /gzhi med rtsa bral rang bzhin 'od gsal mi 'gyur ba/ /bde gshegs snying po ka dag ye shes chen po la/ /ma rtogs spros pa'i tshig rjes 'brang kun dag gyur cig /gying chen dam can gtso 'khor dpung dang bcas pa la/ /de ltar mchod bstod bskang bshags gnyan po phul byas nas/ /sgyu ma tsam du rnal 'byor bdag cag 'dod pa'i don/ /mthu ldan dam can khyod la 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /o rgyan pad+ma badz+ra rtsal dang gnyis med pa/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal chen nam mkha' snying po yi/ /thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul snyigs dus 'gro kun sgrol mdzad mgon/ /dri med rdo rje gzi bajid skye ba'i phreng bcas shing / /de yi bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel ba'i chos kyi rgyun/ /cha shas bcas te dam ldan chos mthun spyod gyur pa/ /gang du gnas kyang ging chen tshogs kyi bu ltar skyongs/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub/ /'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug gshis ngan glo bur ba/ /ye 'brog dus min 'chi ba ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang chab srid gzi brjid dang / /snyan grags zas nor rkang bzhi mtha' dag rgyas par mdzod/ /mkhas btsun che dgu mtshan bzang bud med dang / /mi min mi sogs brtan g.yo'i dpal kun dbang bsdus cig/mchog tu 'khrul rtogs zhi zhing nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas//snang grags rtog tshogs rang rig bde chen dbyings dbang bsdus/ /gang zhig zhi ba'i gdul byar ma gyur bsgral zhing bcu/ /sku dgra lnga dang sngags kyi nyams pa bdun gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi la 'tshe byed drag po'i tshogs/ /ma lus mengs med thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par mdzod/ /khyad par gying chen khyod la gnyer gtad sa cha 'dir/ /chos khrims bcas la 'gal byed gdug pa'i sems 'chang ba/ /slob bu dam 'das bran 'khor khengs log khas blangs dor/ /mdza' bo mna' zan nye gnas snying ring mthun gnyis dbyen/ /snying gces grogs bslu phra mas dkrug sbyor ngan rjes phyogs/ /'gro mgo bud 'jug ngos bshags lkog lab gsang tshig 'char/ kha dkar zhe gnag bstan pa'i bla 'tshong gtam ngan spel/ /dam tshig g.yo rgyus ngos lkog phyag rdzas 'phri gzhogs sku/ /mthos gnon phrag dog zur zad bskur 'debs mi /la sgrogs/ /bstan dang bla ma'i sku dgrar rim gro bsrung bzlog mkhan/ /snga dgra lag byas phyi dgra yid 342

bsam da lta'i dgra/ /do rdo ya bzung 'gras bcol byed pa 'di rnams dang / /dmag jag chom rkun mtshon dug sbyor ngan 'chang gyur zhing / /chags che nyams nga kog sri ltas ngan rbod gtong sogs/ /mdor na sa cha 'di ru chos khrims 'gal byed cing / /dam can la sdang thar pa'i bgegs byed dam sri rnams/ /ri rtse mtsho gting srid gsum gang na gnas gyur kyang / /pho nya'i tshogs kyi rang dbang med khug lha dang phrol/ /gzugs phob byad gzhugs myor chug rdul rlog sha khrag rus/ /lhag med gying chen dregs pa'i tshogs kyi rol par gyis/ /dam la 'khu zhing sdang na pha ma mched kyang rung / /sgral ba'i zhing gyur dam las 'gal rnams sgrol la shog /bcol kyang mi gsan ring yang rgyug par mi mdzad na/ /gying chen mthu rtsal che zhes ming gi ji phyir phan/ /rang gi zhal bzhes dam kyang 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram/ /tha tshig dus las ma g.yel ring rgyug da srog gcod/ /chos kyi khrims 'gal slob bu dam nyams sran khengs log /lo zlar ma bzhag do nub las kyi pho nya'i tshogs/ /rngam pas rla khug srog gcod dbugs bsdus hur thim gsod/ /bsad rtags don snying blangs ma yal bar khyer la shog /skyengs dred 'dzem dang log rdug 'byams gsum ma byed par//phrin las ma g.yel mdzod cig badz+ra sa ma ya/ rdu skyo/ dam can khyed rnams dpal gyi pho nya chen po ste/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung mtshan tsam 'dzin kyang spyi bo ru/ /khur nas bzhed don bsgrub par dpal gyi spyan snga ru/ /dam bca' ji bzhin thar pa bsgrub pa'i grogs ma g.yel/ /bdag cag pad+ma'i rgyud 'dzin yang phur sgrub po ste/ /bsgrub pa'i sde 'dir 'dus pa'i dam ldan rnal 'byor la/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod dam can gyi bdud tshogs rnams kyi/ /rtag tu mi 'bral bu bzhin brtse skyongs phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag byang chub mchog gyur 'od dpag med/ /ji bzhin go 'phang mchog la ma 'khod bar du ni/ /dam can rnams kyi grogs mdzad thar pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi/ /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med nyid du 'grub gyur cing / /bar chad byed pa'i gzugs can gzigs med tshogs ma 'dus/ /zhi zhing dbang bsdud bskrad gzir mnan bsad drag po yis/ /tshar bcad nam yang ldang ba'i go skabs med pa ru/ /mthu ldan dam can rnams kyi phrin las shugs phyung zhig /khyad par sngags kyi dam tshig ma nyams rnam dag pa/ /yar zla ji bzhin 'phel rgyas 'phrin las dam pa mdzod/ /dam rdzas ba ling dza gad 'dod yon 'di bzhes la/ /gal 'gal bcol pa'i sa 'phrin las 'di rnams ma g.yel gyis/ /de ltar sgrol cing dam can rgya mtshor 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de rgyan dang grogs su khyod ngoms na/ /khrel med gzhung ngan le lo snyoms las ma mdzad par/ /bsgrub pa'i sde 'dir rdo rje slob dpon dam ldan gyi/ /'du ba rgyas shing rdzogs chen don sgom dpal chen po'i/ /bsgrub grwa rgyal bstan ji srid bar du gnas gyur cig /snga bdag dam can sprin bzhin 'du nas rnam bzhi'i las/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag 343

cag skye srid ma rdzogs bar du rdo rje yi/ /bsrung ma rnams kyi legs pa mtha' dag stsal gyur cing / /khyad par dam tshig nyams med ched skyongs mi g.yel bar/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum thig le rtsal rdzogs dbyings grol mdzod/ /de ltar ye shes las kyi gying chen po/ /dam can rgya mtshor mchod bstod bgyis pa'i mthus/ /dam can dgyes nas rnam bzhi'i las kun 'grub/ /bkra shis phun tshogs dpal kun rgyas gyur cig /de ltar rtag tu mchod bstod la brtson na rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs pa med cing ji 'dod pa'i re ba yid bzhin du bskang bar byed do/ /ces gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje legs pa yi 'phrin las lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba'i snyem glu zhes bya ba 'di ni bod yul stod mnga' ris bal bod sa yi mtshams mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi mdun du sa bon tsam zhig bkod pa la dam can rang nyid dgyes pa'i tshul gyi bskul bar mdzad par brten rang lo sum cu rtsa gnyis lon pa chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcur gung thang nub ri kun gsal sgang po cher tshe ldan gyi sh+lau ka brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa zhig bkod pa las slar de yang tshig sna cung zad bsrings nas dbang po rdo rje'i sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa bdun du byas pa ste rdo rjeskyag 'thung gi rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu dpal 'byor rab tu dgyes pa'i rdo rjes brjod pa'i yi ge pa bod chos rgyal mes dbon gyi gdung rgyud mang yul bdag po'i rigs las mnga' bdag stag sham can gyi sras rgyud dad pa'i nor can pa bsod nams chos 'phel gyi bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 344

༄ga /rdo rje phur ba'i bsrung ma'i mchod byang nyung dril 'phrin las kun 'grub bzhugs so/ /oṃske/ mchod rdzas gang 'dzoms ram̐ yo khaṃ gi bran zhing oṃ āḥrdu gi byin gyis brlab nas rol mo 'brug ltar dbyangs bcas pa 'di skad do/ /rgyu dzaḥchos dbyings phyogs bral me ri 'bar ba nas/ /ye shes rig pa'i rgyal po ho ru ka /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras/ /rig 'dzin 'bum dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /bh+yoḥ dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje phur pa'i bsrung mar dam bcas pa/ /pho bdud mo bdud dge bsnyen bstan ma'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas te 'dir byon dzaḥ dgyes bzhugs dam tshig dang 'bral phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mos pas mchod 'bul bzhes/ /chos bzhin 'dod don re ba bskang du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ki li ki la ya dza:hūṃ baṃ hoḥka tang ka ye: dza ye bi dza ye: a dzi te a pa ra dzi te: ma ra sa na pra mar ta na yeḥ sarba bigha nam baṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ badz+ra ki li ki la ya shā sa na rak+ṣa sa ga ra sa pā ri wa ra i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā ti khā nyiḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta kha hiḥ r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba yongs kyi phrin las dpal/ /chig bsdus rab 'jigs dpal chen rdo rje 'chang / /phur bu yab yum khro bcu khra thabs bcasaske/ /rnal 'byor sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgyu bh+yoḥ phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bar 'khyams la gnas shing / /khrag 'thung dpal chen mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang / /spyi bor blangs te gus pas bka' bsgrub par/ /zhal bzhes phur bsrung rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sho na spyang 'phar wa khyi'i gdong pa can/ /bdag nyid chen mo re ti dzi dza dzu/ /sa yi bdag mo ya de bswe phag phyin/ /ma bdud sde dpung 'khor bcas la gus bstod/ /bswe lcags dung ging las mkhan ṭāki nag /thang lha rdor 'bar shel ging rdo rje legs/ /lha yi dge bsnyen dregs pa nyi shu gcig /pho bdud nyi khri chig stong bcas la bstod/ /dpal chen bka' sdod dbang phyug ging lang 'bar/ /mkha' 'gro ma sring gdab phur sgo skyong ma/ /pho nya sa bdag 'bum yang mkha' 'gro tshogs/ /rang rang sprul 'khor bcas la bstod par bgyi/ /'byung po sna yon nor bdag mthu bo che/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis srid pa chags pa'i lha/ /rje yi mgur lha ri dbang chen po dgu/ /dkar phyogs bstan bsrung gzhi bdag rnams la bstod/ /gzhan yang gnam skas klu bdud rtse chen btsan//ldang lha mched gsum beg rtse lcam bral sogs/ /phur pa'i zab gter gnas kyi bsrung ma che//mthu 345

ldan dge bsnyen rnams la gus pas btud/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las bcol ba'i las/ /chos dang mi mthun nad gdon 'gal rkyen zhi/ /chos mthun tshe bsod zas nor nyams rtogs rgyas/ /lha 'dre mi gsum gang zag che btsun bsdus/ /mi dang mi min bar chad ngan pa bzlog /chags che nyams nga mi dge 'jigs tshogs 'thul/ /ltas ngan ye 'brog blo bur dgra la bsgyur/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs thal ba'i rdul du brlog /zhes 'di yang sngags smyon tshe dbang nor bu'i bod chen smar khams rgyal ba'i bste gnas bdud rtsi mthil du shing 'brug nag zla'i tshes nyer dgu la gang dran skad cig mar bris pa sarba maṅga lo/dge'o/dge'o/ /༄ga /ngo mtshar dpal gyi ri bo 'bri gnyan spen ne ri bkra'i gnas bdag dgra lha chen po'i mchod bstod mdor dril 'dod don lhan grub dpag bsam ljon pa bzhugs so/ / rgyu bh+yoḥ mi mjed 'dzam gling byang phyogs gangs can bod/ /mdo khams sgang chen gsum gyi bskor ba'i khyud/ /gser gyi 'dren pa'i chu klung dal 'bebs ngogs/ /rang byung pad+ma'i sbas gnas bkra shis ljongs| /re khe dam pa chos kyi phyugs pa'i sa/ /tsub 'gyur drag rtsal ldan pa yul gyi lha/ /du ma gnas pa'i dbus na ri yi dbang / /bde chen rtag chad spen ne ri bkra zhes/ /su ma ste'u so lhun po zur bzhi brjid/ /rtse mo'i dbal po tshangs pa'i g.yul sar snyegs/ /dbal khra nub bstan pha rol dmag tshogs gzhom/ /ngos su lha las babs pa'i rgyan gyis bkra/ /chu 'dzin dbang po'i gzhu yi rab tu gtibs/ /sprin gyi myu gu dung gi khu 'phang 'gril/ /bya gcan gsung sgrogs dbyar gyi rnga sgra 'dir/ /rkang drug ri dwags sman gyi glu snyan len/ /ngogs su g.ya' spang brag mtshon nag khrig tshal/ /bya gcan ri g.yu 'bu srin rtse bro khrab/ /'dab ldan yid dga' ston skyes rab tu g.yur/ /mkha' dbyings lding khyim nyi zla'i thig le mtshar/ /skol chen spyi pa lha yi skyed mos tshal/ /gdug pa'i gnod sbyin mang po 'du ba'i yul/ /'bri gnyan sdo du drag shul che ba'i ri/ /bag gro byin chags skyi za rngams pa che/ /ri phran rtse mo chu yi 'bebs pa'i phu/ /sna ru'i byin rlabs rmad du byung ba'i gnas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i pho brang ste/ /lha srin sde brgyad sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i ljongs/ /zhing skyong mkha' 'gro mang po btags chags grogs/ /mkha' spyod grub thob 'ga' yang rab bzhugs pa/ /zab mo'i gter mchog mang du mchis pa'i sgrom/ /ngo mtshar du mas spras pa'i ri bo de/ /lha chen dpal 'bar bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog ste/ /sku mkhar rin chen pha lam las grub nang / /sprin 346

dkar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur dkrigs dkyil/ /tshangs sras gzhon nu'i gzhal yas de dbus su/ /mthu ldan zhing skyong dgra lha dkar po che/ /gsang mtshan dpa' brtan rdo rje 'gyur med rtsal/ /rdul dkar dmar rings mdangs kyis rgyan 'dri'i sku/ /tshangs sras gzhon nu sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /lha yi rgyal po rgya 'dre 'byung po'i dgra/ /bgegs chen tshul snang yul pa'i dbang po che/ /brjid pa'i sku la mdzes pa'i nyams khyugs pa/ /dpal 'bar dpa' bo de yi cha lugs ni/ /sun+da'i zhal la ba sang mdangs 'tsher spyan/ /pad+ma'i zhal sgo mu tig 'phreng 'dra'i tshems/ /lhun sdug zla rang la 'dren dar dkar gyi/ /thod dang 'jol ber gser ha g.yu g.yung bkrags/ /gtsug na nor bu me 'bar dgos 'dod spel/ /spu gri'i rgod 'phru rtse ldem zla bral che/ /dar sna'i cod pan gangs ri'i sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /snyan 'gul phyag zhabs rin chen rgyan 'thug 'khrol/ /dbang drag rdo rje rtse lnga mgul du 'chang / /sra brtan mchong gi rgya byi'u sku la bstar/ /shel gyi mgul gab dpa' rngams stag shams dkris/ /dar ljang nor bu'i mchil lham zhabs su bzhes/ /phyag g.yas phur pa dar sna'i cod paṇa can/ /klad la bskor cing rgya 'dre 'byung po 'dul/ /g.yon na mchong mdung be+eḍūr dpal 'bar la/ /ru mtshon dkar rgyan lha gnyan dmag dpon mdzad/ /chibs rta ngang ser rlung gi gshog lding can/ /spyi gtsug nor bu yan lag 'brug pa 'bar/ /rngog rngar lho sprin bu gar nad rlangs 'thul/ kha sna mtshon chas gang zhing thog ser 'bebs/ /spu la me skar bu yug grogs su 'grogs/ /ze rnga'i gseb nas sbal sbrul mang po sprul/ /rmig bzhi lcags byas rlung gi 'khor los brgyan/ /mgyogs rtsal nyams ldan dgra la smyo 'bog gtong / /dar stan 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i lhag phran la/ /gser sga mu tig sngo dmar phra gzer can/ /shel yob rin chen gong thed glo nan sbrul/ /byas zhon stong khams yud bskor 'byung khro brdzi/ /stag gdong g.yas byas dgra lha ser ltar 'grim/ /gzig shub g.yon bkra wer ma glog ltar 'tshub/ /sprul pa'i pho nya mang po sprin ltar gtibs/ /rang gzugs seng dkar nga ro 'brug ltar ldir//mdza' grogs mtsho sman phyug mo 'od ldan ma/ /sras mchog dpa' bo chen po sangs rgyas skyabs/ /zhang blon lha btsan dkar po bu mo ljang / /mdun 'dod wa ti rgyal ba dge bsnyen dkar/ /phyag gnyan lwa yi dbang zhu klu btsan dmar/ /dpung zla ci rang seng khrom drag shul gnyan/ /bka' 'khor lha gnyan klu sman btsan bdud gtong / /bsam gyi mi khyab bran g.yog du mas bskor/ /khyed sngon bcom ldan shaka thub phyag rdor che/ /'phags mchog rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang / /khyad par slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar srog snying mdangs gsol phul nas kyang / /dam bzhag phur pa'i dal du dbang bskur nas/ /ming btags bro bor zab gter bsrung mar bkod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs bzhin/ /dam bca' gnyan po'i tshul las ma 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs dang mchod sbyin slad/ /stong 347

khams 'jig rten gang du bzhugs kyang rung / /mngon shes mthus stobs rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ni/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir skad cig yud tsam gyi/ /'bri gnyen spen ne rgyal btsun sras blon 'bangs/ /ma thogs myur ba nyid du byon nas kyang / /sna tshogs pad+ma rin chen spungs pa'i khrir/ /dgyes shing brtse ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /dngos dang yid las skyes gyur mchod pa'i sprin/ /bsam gyi mi khyab kun bzang bkod pa'i brgyan/ /sna tshogs 'thug por spel ba'i rdzas chen po/ /rnam par sprul pa'i mchod sbyin 'bul gyis bzhesaske/ /rtsi shing dri bsung phye mar ba lin+ta/ /bya gcan ri g.yung gzugs 'gros dar zab ras/ /dkar dngar klu sman rin chen spyan gzigs sogs/ /phyi mchod 'bul gyi dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes/ /zan g.yu gser skyems chang rgod bdud rtsi'i sman/ /stag ras gzig ras mdung dar go mtshon bzang / /sba smyug thang dkar shugs rgod 'phyar dar sogs/ /nang mchod 'bul gyis phrin las sgrub phyir bzhes/ /sha tshil rus pa'i tshogs chen rak+ta che/ /nyams pa'i gzugs ling bsgral ba'i bdud rtsi lnga/ /bstan 'che'i srog dbugs bla srog mdangs la sogs/ /gsang mchod 'bul gyi bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes/ /khyad par snang srid kyis bsdus chos rnams kun/ /gzhan du ma yengs rang rig gshis kyi mdangs/ /lhan skyes ye shes bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ /dbyer med rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul dgyes mdzod/ /de ltar spen ne ri bkra'i gnas kyi bdag /mthu chen sta ma stes po gnyan gyis rje/ /phag gdong gnas ri'i rngog mar rtag chags shing / /zhing skyongs dpa' bo dregs pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /drag shul dge bsnyen rdo rje 'gyur med rtsal//btsun sras blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'jeb cing snyan pa'i tshig gi rab bstod cing / /dgyes mdzes rnam par dgyes pa'i mchod 'bul nas/ /pad+ma'i zab gter phyi yi gnyer 'dzin pa/ /khyod la bdag gi 'phrin las bcol ba'i las/ /gsang sngags bstan 'dzin dam ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun glo bur ye 'grogs dgra gdon bgegs/ /mi nad nor nad nyer 'tshe mi 'byung zhing / /mtha' dmag sa g.yos me chu mtshon bskal nyams/ /'gal rkyen 'jigs tshogs mtha' dag med pa dang //tshe bsod zas nor mnga' thang gzi brjid bkrag /dpal 'byor rigs chos rgyud 'dzin rab rgyas brtan/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo legs rtsi 'bru sman/ /bkra shis legs tshogs yon tan kun 'phel zhing / /snyan grags rab skyed lha 'dre mi che btsun/ /'dod don longs spyod ma lus snying sgul bsdus/ /mtha' mi hor sogs dmag tshogs gyur pa kun/ /dpa' kong zil gyis non la bdag dbang gis/ /gsang sngags don gyi bstan pa la smod cing / /mtha' dmag rgya 'dre 'byung po dam sri'i rigs|/'gong po ma rung log pa'i tshe srog stobs//hur thum thal ba'i rdul du brlag par mdzod//rgyu bh+yoḥkhyad par rig 'dzin pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /bstan pa'i ngo bo gsang chen rnying ma yi/ /bstan pa 'grib 348

med dar rgyas yun ring gnas/ /sbas yul kun du nub med rab 'phel zhing / /yul khams bde legs bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /dam ldan skyes bu'i chab srid dpal du 'bar/ /gdul bya 'bri med 'dzam gling yongs khyab cing / /'dod don lhun grub dpyid du rgyas par shog/ces bod chen por rtag chags shing sbas yul ljang gi gnyer 'dzin cing o rgyan pad+mas zab gter nyer lnga yi bsrung mar bkod pa'i dge bsnyen spen ne ri bkra'i gsol mchod tu rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis kho bos 'char snang dang brtsan nas mdzad pa las bsdus te gnas so chen po nyid rang la gus 'phrin sgrub pa'i ltas 'ga' shar bas bskul nas sho lo ka so dgu po 'di tshe dbang nor bu karma bstan pa mthar rgyas kyis chu stag phag zla'i tshes bcur yul gle nang du sbyar ba'i yig ris rang gi bgyis pa'i bkra shis par gyur cig he te maṅga lo/༄ga /dpal stag lung thang pa'i bstan srung jo mo sbrag btsan gyi gsol mchod 'dod don yid bzhin ljon pa bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru te ru kaḥ dpal stag lung thang pa'i bsrung ma jo bo sprag btsan gyi phrin las mdo dril zhig bstan par bya ste/ dus dgongs mor gsang gtor mchod rdzas gang 'dzom bshams la rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te thog mar dregs pa zil gnon o rgyan pad+mar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ r+ghaṃ trīḥ snang srid zil gnon dbang drag rta mchog dpal/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas thod 'phreng rtsal/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes deng 'dir byin gyis brlobs/ /oṃ āḥrgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes bzlas byin dbab/ de nas dregs pa rang rgyud pa yin pas mngon rtogs mi dgos la spyan 'dren pa ni/ kye/ yul la mtshan gsol dbu ru byang phyogs sprag /gnas la mtshan gsol lha rigs g.ya' gangs can/ /bdag por mtshan gsol dge bsnyen rdo rje 'bar/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nas 'bod do gdung bas byon/ /khyod sngon mi rje lha rje khri srong gdung / /'brong rje btsan po nyang za khri btsun bu// mtshan sdug mi pho jo bo thang lha 'bar/ /tshe 'phos smon lam stobs kyis lha btsan che/ /skyes pa'i rdo rje kun skyob dpal bo cher/ /jo bo sprag gi btsan du mtshan gsol te/ /rnam dkar las dang yab kyi smon lam mthus/ /bsgrub rgyud bka' 'bangs gyur khyod 'bod do dzaḥ dbyar gsum gnas pa sprag gi na mo che/ /ston gsum gnas pa'i sa ni rgyal sgo brag dgun gsum gnas pa 'dod 'jo seng gling grags/ /dpyid gsum glang jul grib lung srin gdong sna/ /rtag par gnas pa phod kyi g.ya' gangs can/ /lam rtse'i gnas ni seng lcam dkar mo'i rtse/ /dben pa'i sa ni myang khrom brag dmar che/ /gang du mchis kyang 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /kye/ phod kyi skyes bu jo bo chen po khyod/ /'jig rten sgron ma shākya thub pa ches zla 349

'od gzhon nu'i lung bstan mdzad pa'i tshe/ /mi ma yin gyur rgyal ba'i zhal yang mjal/ /phyis dus gdong dmar 'di ru zla 'od zhal/ /dwags po lha rjer gyur pa'i bstan pa la/ /gri'u lung dpal gyi yang dgon lhun shes kyis/ /byams pas btul byas gsang ba'i mtshan yang gsol/ /khyad par kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du/ /pad 'byung dngos gzugs phag gru'i mtshan 'chang des/ /sgyu 'phrul rol pas khyod nyid rjes su bzung / /mi thub stobs chen 'dul zhes ming yang btags/ /de rjes seng glang stag lung yang dgon du/ /grub chen thang pa bkra shis dpal spyan sngar/ /khyod gzugs dngos bstan srog phul dge bsnyen bsgrub/ /smin gral bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bcug /thang pa'i rigs dang zab chos 'dzin gyur rnams/ /bsrung skyob lus grib ltar du 'grogs par chad/ /de rjes rje btsun grags pa dpal chen por/ /bsnyen bskur zhus zhing bstan bsrung khas su blangs/ /gzhan yang rim byon bka' brgyud bla ma yi/ /dam la gnas nas khyod nyid thar pa'i sar/ /'god byas chos skyongs rnams kyi rno mdil du/ /chad don g.yel ba med par dgongs mdzod la/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir ma thogs myur ba nyid/ /sprag btsan rkya dgu ban bcu phyi nang blon/ /'khor bcas 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sna tshogs pad+ma dar zab brtsegs pa'i khrir/ /bde bar bzhugs nas dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston/ /mchod pa'i zas zo bsgrub pa'i rtags bzang ston/ /'phrin las gang bcol thogs med myur 'grub mdzod/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa pra ma ni dhā ra dhā ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa pā ri wa ra rgyu rgyu tse tse hri hri dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ kye/ dge bsnyen khyod 'khor bcas pa dgyes mchod rdzas/ /dngos su 'byor bshams khyad par rang rig pa/ /dri bral sangs rgyas don dam bden mthu yi/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'bru gsum snod yangs par/ /dpag med kun bzang sprin phung mdzad bral rdzas//rgya cher bkod de khyod la 'bul ba ni//dgyes pa'i dam rdzas zur gsum rtse rgyal 'bul//mthun rdzas dkar dngar khu ba thug pa 'bul/ /'dod yon lnga dang gsang sprin phyi mchod 'bul/ /gser skyems gzugs 'gros 'bru bshos nang mchod 'bul/ /sha khrag rus bsur bha lin gsang mchod 'bul/ /rten rdzas sku 'bag srog yig bla rdo 'bul/ /spyan gzigs gsob shun dar ras go mtshon 'bul/ /mngon spyod las gyur dgra bo'i bla srog 'bul/ /mdor na lha btsan 'khor bcas sems dbang yul/ /rab bde tshim byed mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /khyad par chos nyid ma skyes brjod bral gshis/ /sna tshogs ma 'gag rnam rtog chos sku'i mdangs/ /ma 'dres kun khyab nyag cig thig le'i rtsal/ /stong nyid gsal dwangs ro mnyam 'bul dgyes mdzod/ /khyed cag sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs ji bzhin rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyis/ /chos mthun bsam dgu yid bzhin 'bad med par/ /myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las grogs mdzod cig /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa pra ma ni dhā ra dhā ra sa ma yā dzaḥdzaḥ sarba puts+tsha āḥrgyu/ rdo rje 'bar ba a dzaḥli 350

sa ma yā dzaḥdzaḥm māḥm māḥru ru bh+yo bh+yoḥ kha khāḥ khi khiḥ khu khuḥ dril drilaḥ tsaṇ+ḍa pra ma ni dhā ra dhā ra sa ma yā dzaḥdza—/ i dam bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ kye/ dge bsnyen rdo rje kun skyobs dpa' bo che/ /gzhan gyi mi thub stobs can 'dul ba khyed/ /rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum mdzes/ /snag snum lcang lo sil bkram zar bu 'phyang / /dbu la zhwa dmar phod 'phru dar ban brgyan/ /zhwa 'dab phud can 'brug sgras dga' gzugs bsnol/ /dar zab sna bza' 'khor gsum dpa' chas rdzogs/ /rin chen rgyan spud rat+na'i mgul gab bkrag chibs rta rag pa sngo nag rlung shugs can//gser sga dar stan phra men yob byas zhon//phyag g.yas sba lcags phyag g.yon mdung dar dkar/ /phrag bkal g.yu mthur gser srab skyogs kha bsgyuraske//sprul pa g.yas stag g.yon gzig mdun spyang rgyug /klad du bya khra rol rta stag lag 'brang / /rgyab na dung pho dung mo rgyan spras mdur//mthu yon dpa' rtsal stobs nus ldan la bstod//kye/dge bsnyen drag po'i tshul ni khrag rul mdog /mdung dmar g.yas 'phyar dgra snying g.yon pas rol/ /go mtshon dpa' chas btsan rta dmar zhur zhon/ /bstod do bcol ba'i phrin lan myur 'grub mdzod/ /khyod kyi gsang yum klu bdud 'dus pa'i sman/ /gur dkar bcu drug na tshod gser g.yus brgyan/ /mda' dar me long thogs nas sman sha chibs/ /sgrub mchog ming gcig ltar du skyongs la bstod/ khyod kyi dpung grogs rgyab rten a jo che/ /dgra lha rdor legs zangs rmog khrab gsol dmar/ /rdo rje mdung dmar bsnams nas bra nag zhon/gus pas bstod do phrin las ma g.yel mdzod/ kye/ khyod bran las byed ru 'dren klu bdud btsun/ /mthing nag bdud kyi zhags pa nag po 'debs/ /g.yas ru gnyan btsan gnyan stag btsan zhags dmar/ /g.yon na yul btsan char rje shwa rdel dkar/ /lha btsan ni ra ser po sba lcags bsnams/ /klu btsan rdo rje 'bar sngo sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /blon po ba yan char rje gzhu sbrang dmar/ /kun kyang rang mdog gos rgyan chibs rtar zhon/ /dpa' chas go mtshon sna dgu lus la brjid/ /phyag g.yon mdung dar phrag bkal srab skyogs bsgyur/ /gzhan yang phyi blon bdun brgya nyi shu dang / nang blon sum brgya drug bcu la sogs pa'i/ /lha klu gnyan bdud btsan sman yul lha'i tshogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul sde 'khor grangs med bcas/ /las byed dregs pa'i tshogs la bdag gis bstod/ /mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /hoḥde ltar brag btsan yab yum sras 'khor la/ /mchod cing bstod nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor chos mdzad byang chub sgrub pa po/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mi mthun 'gal ba'i rkyen/ /blo bur ye 'brog nad gdon byur ltas ngan/ /dgra gdon bgegs kyi bar chod zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe bsod gzi nus stobs snyan grags dpal 'byor/ /spel zhing nyams med gong 'phel rgyas par mdzod/ /lha 'dre mi chen rgyal blon btsun mo 'bangs//mnga' thang zas nor bdag gis dbang du bsdus//bdag la log lta dgra jag chom rkun zhi//351

brung rkun mna' zan bran slob ngo dam log /bka' 'gal thugs dkrug tshod yod mgo bskor brnyas/ /chos kyi khrims 'gal dam tshig ngos lkog mkhan/ /myur sgrol snying khrag rlangs ma yal bar hub/ /tshe bstung srog chod drod dbugs bsod nams bsdus/ /lo zlar ma 'gyangs zhag dang za ma'i nang / /brag btsan 'khor bcas nus pa ci 'dug lta/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam dus la babs so sa ma yā/ /tsaṇ+ḍa pra ma ni dhā ra dh+wa raḥ dgra bo ma ra rbad rbadaḥ zhes mchod bstod phrin las kyi gzhung legs par bsrang zhing / gzhan yang 'di yi gsol kha rbad bskul sogs shes na gang dgos 'byor zhing /rgyun gyi chos skyong yin na bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor man ngag gsang ba'i yig chung ltar bya zhing / rjes kyang gshegs su mi gsol bar rten la bsnyim nas gnyer gtad bya rang bzhin mgron thabs ltar ni gshegs su gsol nas bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam spyi dang mthun par bsangs gtor mchod rdzas gtsang sar 'bul lo/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog/ /sgyu rol phag gru thang pa yab sras kyi/ /dam la gnyer bzhag bstan bsrung sprag btsan zhes/ /snying nye bkra shis nus mthu nus ldan gyur de yi/ /dgyes bskong mchod pa'i phrin las byang bu ru/ /mi shes mkhas 'dod tho co rtog ge yi/ /ma sbag bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung ci lta/ /ma 'khrul zab 'dus tshe dbang nor bus sbyar/ /gsar rnying chos tshul bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bzhin/ /kun kyang ro gcig shes ldan lces myong la/ /phyogs der zhes nas nyi shar dbyugs brdungs dpesaske/ /chos spangs rang ngal ngan 'gro'i rgyu ma bsags/ /rta rgan rtsa ltar 'chol pa'ang bcos min te/ /bung ba'i bcud ldan chos kun don blangs 'tshal/ /'di yang grags 'dod mtshar g.yem ched bgyid minaske/ /rten 'brel phran dang bskul ba don yod phyir/ /'di bris dge bas rgyal bstan rab gnyan zhing / /khyad par dpal ldan stag lung thang pa yi/ /bstan pa 'grib med 'phel rgyas yun gnas brtan/ /bstan bsrung mthu rgyal gdul bya gtan bde shog /zhes khro mo shing 'brug hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi nub mor rmi lam snang bar sprag btsan chen po bdag gi mdun du lhag nas bzhon pa las bab bzhin nga yi rkang par phrag byas te dga' gus tshul bstan pas gsol mchod zhig bri bar snyam tshe/ dpal ri bo chen po'i mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa bstan 'phel gyi bka' yi bskul bar mdzad pas mchog tu spros nas sprang ban tshe dbang nor bus mdo khams lhun po'i chos grwar sbyar ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ badz+ra ki ri ma ma sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ rbad sngags/ r+ghaṃ ma ni shu dhā ra dhā ra dzaḥ 'gugs sngags/ kha dur rak+ka rbadaḥ tshe'i srog la rbad rbadaḥsha la rbad rbadaḥ khrag la rbad rbadaḥ rus pa la rbad rbadaḥ dbugs la rbad rbadaḥrtsa la rbad/rbad sngags so//r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ sbas pa'i yul ljongs lho bod sa yi mtshams/ /pad+ma dkar po'i chu klung 'dus pa'i mdo/ /rdo 352

rje brag btsan sku mkhar mtho brjid nang / /shan pa srog zan dmar po chen po ni/ /mi sdug srin gzugs byu ru lhun po'i mdangs/ kha nas me 'bar sna nas dud pa 'thul/ /mig nas khrag 'dzag ral pa smug nag g.yoske/ /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdeng kha dug rlangs 'khyug /bse khrab ber dmar mi g.yang gser sked bcings—//btsan gyi sho rdel thog ser bu yug 'tshub/ /bya ru ru mtshon dar dmar sprin ltar gtibs/ /phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar glog gyu 'phyar/ /g.yon na lcags kyi mda' gzhu drag po bzung / /grub la btsan zhags a long lcags kyus brgyan/ /rta dmar rlung gshog la zhon stong khams nyul/ /'khor du klu bdud btsan rgod 'bum 'bum bskor/ /khyod ni dbang chen rta mgrin sprul pa yin/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma thod 'phreng bka' 'bangs lags/ /sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag gi sku lta ste/ /de ring spyan 'dren gnas 'dir myur du byon/ /khyod dgyes mchod sprin bsangs bsur rnga rol sgra/ /sha khrag dmar gtor phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs/ /'bul gyis dgyes bzhes bdag dang mi 'bral 'grogs/ /dkar po dge ba'i bsam don myur du 'grub/ /bar chad dgra bgegs rdul brlags phrin las mdzod/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang nyid spu bong se gong du phyin skabs lho btsan nag po des gus pa'i zhabs tog phul zhing / rmi lam gyi snang bar rang gzugs bstan ltar tshe dbang nor bus shing sbrul zla ba dang po'i tshes drug la bris pa dge'o//rgyu bh+yoḥ mi mjed 'dzam gling thig le rdo rje gdan/ /byang phyogs ri bo nag po bcu gsum mtshams/ /lha ldan shar lho sbas yul pad+ma dkar/ /nye ba'i gnas chen ma yi ku lung zhes/ /ya mtshan rā ma sha ra'i gnas kyi cha//lho nub sbas lung brag skas ljon pa'i tshal//gnyer 'dzin zhing skyongs dpa' bo dregs pa che//mgron thang bdud po chen po zhes bya ba/ /drag shul can khyod gnas la ma nges kyang / /khyad par rlung chu drag 'bebs tshang tshing nag /gdug pa'i gcan gzan ma rungs 'dre srin tshal/ /spra spre ri dwags rtse bro khyab pa'i gnas/ /gzugs can mi rnams rgyu bar dka' ba der/ /khyod kyi sku mkhar ri bo tsit+ta'i dbyibs//rtse nas mar bltas mtsho dkyil nor bu 'dra/ /rtsa nas yar bltas rgyal mtshan sgong 'phyar 'dra/ /lan nas bltas tshe dpal gtor bshams legs 'dra/ /'dra gsum don gcig ri bo de 'dra'i nang / /bdud mkhar zlum po lcags byas kha bad g.yu/ /mchong gi sgo byas gser gyi gzer gyis gdams/ /nang na rol pa bdud kyi skyes gcig po/ /phyi ltar dge bsnyen btsun pa'i cha lugs can/ /mdog sgrug bswe thebs mkhar sil lhung bzed 'chang / /nang ltar lcags kyi mi pho ral pa can/ /dar nag bod zu ral gri zhags pa bsnams/ /rta nag la zhon 'jig rten khyab par nyul/ /gsang ba klu bdud gcer bu zangs kyi mdog sdig pa'i mgo can phyag g.yas spu gri dang / /g.yon pas tsit+ta'i sku smad sbrul du 'khyil/ /gdug pa 'brug dang dug sbrul nag po chibs/ /lus la mig brgya dug gi rlangs pa 'thul/ /'khor du srog bdag klu bdud stong gis 353

bskor/ /nyin mo rtse shar dmar thag zer la rgyu/ /mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od dang zer la rgyu/ /mun 'tshub srod gung nag po'i mdangs la rgyu/ /sprin nag dkyil dang rlung nag 'tshub ma'i sna/ /glog 'od thog ser drag po'i gdong la rgyu/ /khyod ni mi bsrun drag shul chen po ste/ /sngon tshe sangs rgyas pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /bar du 'khrul zhig tshul khrims 'bum pa dang / /gter ston nus ldan bdud 'dul rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs srog gi snying po phul/ /da dus sgrol ma bsang chab khrus chu ri/ /mgul du sngags 'chang tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /mdun du rang gzugs ci bzhin bstan nas kyang / /srog snying mdangs sol mngon sum phul nas ni/ khas blangs dam bca' gnyan po ji bzhin du/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir skad cig myur du byon/ /dgyes bzhugs 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod/ /byin gyis brlabs pa 'dzad med phyi nang gsang //dkar mngar sha khrag bsang bsur sman raka gtor/ /g.yag bya ra lug gzugs 'gros la sogs pa/ /'bul bzhes bdag gi bsam don yid bzhin du/ /'grub cing sbas yul 'di ru gsan pa yi/ /skye 'gro bde skyid char chu dus su 'bebs/ /lo legs nong 'phel 'khrug rtsod mi bde med/ /khyad par gsang sngags bstan pa nub med rgyas/ /sems can kun kyang bde dga' la spyod cing / /phyi rol mtha' dmag sogs dang bdud kyis byin/ /brlabs pa'i gang zag gnas 'dir mi btang zhing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar gnas phrin las mdzod/ /zhes brag skad shing lo'i tshal gyi sgo bsrung mgron thang bdud kyi gsol mchod 'di ni bskul ba'i ngor la phyogs kun du rgyu zhing ming yongs su grags pa tshe dbang nor bu grags pa rdo rjes sna tshogs dbyig zhes shing sbrul zla ba dang po rgyal nya'i tshes bcu gnyis la sbyar/ ma nus kog po kha rgyab phyir thabs/ ma mthong mthong brdzu mi shes mkhas 'dod ni ma lags shing / o rgyan thugs rjer brten nas mthong tshul bzhin du bgyis pa lags/dge'o//rgyu bh+yoḥ spang ljongs ljon shing rab mdzes brag ris dkrigs/ /rin chen khang bzang garnyo lha khang mdzes pa'i dbus/ /shel ging chen po ra dza ging ka ra/ /dkar dmar gzhon nu gser gyi ha ri yi/ /chos gos gsol zhing dbu la bse zhwa bgos/ /phyag na sba lcags dar brgyan shel 'phreng 'dren/ /sngon na pho nya mang po mdur zhing rgyug /g.yas g.yon sprul pa'i las mkhan mang po 'gyed/ /rgyab na 'khor gyi dmag dpung nyi li li/ /rta dang drel gyi rgyug 'dang brang se brang / /rgya dar ja yi khal 'gal nyi li li/ /kun kyang sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs rin chen mdzes pa'i stan la bzhugs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dkar dmar bsur/ /spyag rgod mda' dar me long shug rgyal sogs/ /'bul bzhes khyod sngon pad+ma thod phreng dang / /rig grub gter ston rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam dang ma 'gal bdag grogs mdzod/ /de dus ri bo bya khyung ldem mgul du/ /sngags 'chang tshe dbang dpal gyi nor ༷ 354

bu nyid/ /'od gsal ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa'i drung / /drod nyul slong tshad cho 'phrul cher bstan tshe/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gzir nas dam bzhag srog gi snying po phul/ chos rgyud 'dzin bstan bsrung bar khas blangs te/ /dam la ma 'da' rig 'dzin bdag cag gi /'khor bsrung rkyen bzlog bar chad mtha' dag sol/ /chos skyong sna 'dren mdzod la sdang dgra thul/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las thogs med grub par mdzod/ /tri ra dzaḥ.i rda bha lin+ta khā hi/ zhes pa dpal be'u lung du gra 'khor rnams nad kyis gzir zhing rang yang sems rgyud 'khrug tshe gzar gcun gyi gdon gang yin ngos bzung bas tshes lnga'i tho rangs la ging pa rnams rang gzugs bstan te srog gi snying po phul nas na ra kan gyi bro bor nas cung zad mchod sbyin byas pas dge bar mthong nas tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba lags/dge'o//

khog /brag dmar zan yang mi 'gyur lhan gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma chos skyongs pe har rgyal po yi gsol mchod 'dod don yongs 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /badz+ra ma hā gu ru ru tro pa kra ma na mo/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi bka' yi dbang / /mthu chen dregs pa bsam gyis mi khyab las/ /rmad byung tshang gi srog bdag sder can gyi/ /mchod gsol phrin las khyer bder 'dir spel la/ /lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing / /dam can bsrung ma'i thugs dam dgyes gyur cig /de la thog mar gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar bla ma yi dam chos skyongs chen po'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs phyag len ltar bshams la/ thog mar dregs pa zil gnon phyir rang nyid drag po spyi bor gu ru zhi ba bsgoms la las byang 'dzab bcas grub par byas nas ting nge 'dzin de dang gnas bzhin mdun bskyed kyi dang po byin dbab pa ni/ hūṃ/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs rmad byung o rgyan rje/ /nam mkha' rang bzhin pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /'dir gshegs byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ rgyu hūṃḥ de nas mchod rdzas rnams/ swā bhā wa zhes brjod pas dngos por 'dzin pa sbyangs shing / rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las ram̐ yam̐ khaṃ 'phros pas ma dag pa thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus/ rgyu las gtor snod chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang du oṃ aḥrgyu las gtor ma 'dod dgu phun tshogs 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod chen po bsrung ma'i thugs dam bskang tshim nus pa ldan par gyur/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang / /oṃ aḥrgyu ha ho trīḥzhes pas byin gyi rlabs so/ /de nas chos skyongs 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni/ /tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangasaske/stong dang rang mdun dbus dang phyogs bzhi ru/ /rgyu las rin chen mchong dung gser byir g.yu/ /gzhal yas lhun mdzes brjid ldan yangs rgya che/ /'jigs rung dur khrod bkod pas yongs brgyan pa'i/ /pho brang phyogs dbus pad nyi dgra bgegs steng / /dzaḥyig lnga las 'od 'phros zhing bcu bsgral/ /tshur 'dus dbus su thugs kyi brgya byin che/ /mthing nag mi sdug gar dgu'i nyams bsgyur zhing / /dar nag 'jol ber dom slog sku la gsol/ /dbu la dom lpags prog zhu rin chen brgyan/ /zhags pa spu gri thogs nas glang chen la/ /zhon cing mon bu pu tras chibs sna khrid/ /me glog rol khrid thog ser pho nyar btang / /bskal rlung dud sprin nag po 'khrig dbus bzhugs/ /mdun du gnod sbyin srog bdag yang le ber/ / 356

dmar khros mdung dmar btsan zhags dgra la 'phen/ /bse khrab rmog gon rta dmar rlung shugs chibs/ /dam nyams dgra bo sgrol ba'i las la brtson/ /gtso g.yon yum chen sharnyi ro zan dmar/ /khrag zhag gis byug dar gyi ang rags gsol/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas bharnya ru/ /tsit+ta 'dzin nas g.yo byed 'tshub dbus bzhugs/ /sprul pa dge bsnyen gzhon nu dar ber dmar/ /shel 'phreng mgul brgyan sdig 'dzub zangs gri gdengs/ /blon po srog bdag bya ra ber skug gsol/ /dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar nas seng dkar zhon/ shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po pu tra nag ('dir ma dpe spreb bu gabyug chad 'dug)g.yon stag dang spyang ka'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /blon po ru tra dar nag ral ka gsol/ /gri gug 'dzin nas drel nag rta ru gzhon/ /de dag phyi rol phyogs mtshams bka' yi blon/ /sha khrol khyi khrol khol po 'dzin sdem so/ /skyo sangs 'bag seng mon bu a tsar sprel/ /dge slong mkhar bsil sngags pa phur thogs dang / /bud med ral sprug skyes pa gri thogs pa/ /brgya brgya la sogs 'khor tshogs dpag med bskor/ /gnas gsum oṃ lha'irgyu dkar dmar mthing spras/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus chos skyong 'khor bcas bkug bsam la thog mar bzhengs su gsol ba ni//rgyu/nam mkha' mtha' las chos kyi dbyings nyid klong //rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul rab 'byams dpag med gar/ /yongs bsgyur sangs rgyas bstan dang gtsug lag gnas/ /skyong mdzad tshang ging 'khor bcas sku bzhengs shig /de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag dam bsre'i rim pa ni/ /r+ghaṃ/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas: ting nge 'dzin gyi bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i chos skyong ni: gnod sbyin rgyal po sde lnga 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung ba'i skyes mchog khyod: thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i don ched du: chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu mar sku bzhengs shig: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad khyod: thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sku lnga rgyal po yab yum sprul blon 'khor: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dza:rgyu baṃ ho:a la la ho: e h+ye hi bha ga wan ang ku sha sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ :/ ma tram bsgral ba'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir: kha bub gan rkyal byi chings gdan du bsnol: rin chen sna lnga'i ri rab gzhal yas brtsegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi mdzes par spras: ma chags lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: bstan bsrung rgyal po 'khor bcas brtan bzhugs gsol: pad+ma a be sha ya a: badz+ra tri du ru rgyuḥ badz+ra a ti tiṣ+ṭha ka ra sha sa ma ya kha bsgyur dkar po a be sha ya s+t+waṃ: a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ rgyu/ 'jig rten las la grub pa'i dregs pa can: rgyal po chen po sku lnga'i skur bstan pa: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: rgyal po sde lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a kar+ṣa ya/ a be sha ya: ha ho ha ra ti ho: dam tshig 357

bdud rtsi oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ sa ma ya sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ trīḥṭhaḥzhes pas byin gyis rlabs nas gtor mar bran la/rgyu/skyes mchog dgra lha dpe har 'khor bcas dgongs//sngon tshe gsang bdag pad 'byung khros pa'i skus//dam bzhag tha tshig gnyan po dran mdzod la/ dam ldan bdag grogs ci bcol phrin las mdzod/ /badz+ra dri dur rak+ṣa yak+ṣa rgyu/ /sarba pañtsa a sbo ta khā hiḥ zhes bdud rtsi phul bas sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po rjes su dran nas bka' las rtag tu 'da' ba med par bsam/ de nas mchod bskang bstod pa'i bya ba ni/ hoḥdregs pa'i sde dpon sder chen 'khor bcas la/ /mchod yon me tog spos me dri zhal rol/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos 'dod yon che/ /phyi mchod 'bul bzhes dgyes bskang phrin las mdzod/ /rak+ta'i ar+ghaṃ dbang po'i me tog bkra/ /tshil dud sprin 'khrig zhun me'i nyi 'od brdal/ /mkhris chab mtsho 'khrug dmar zas ri bo brjid/ /dung chen 'brug ldir nang mchod 'bul dgyes bzhes/ /nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod pa bdud rtsi'i sman/ /zhing bcu lhag med bsgral ba'i rak+ta dmar/ /'dod dgu phun tshogs 'byung gnas ba lin+ta/ /dbul bzhes dgyes bskang ci bcol phrin las mdzod/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchod bskang rten sgrub rdzas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dngos 'byor yid sprul dang / /khyad par rmad byung bla med sbyor sgrol gyi/ /mchod pas bskang ngo rnam bzhi'i phrin las mdzod/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo gtor mar gtad de/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi ljags rgyu las rdo rje'i spu gu'i bcud drangs pas tshims zhing dgyes par bsam la/ sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ badz+ra yak+ṣa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dun ting dun ting khā hi/ yak+ṣa nag po khā hi/ sha khrol hu ru khā hi/ khyi khrol hu ru khā hi/ tsi ta ba ta khā hi/ 'dzin po ru tra khā hiḥ sdom po chang rgyud khā hiḥ ru tra ru tra khā hi/ go ro tsa na khā hi/ rak+ta tshul pa khā hi/ sha rgyud snying rgyud khā hi/ dbang po sna lnga khā hi/ sha ma ru tra khā hi/ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hoḥ pu dzaḥbadz+ra du ru hoḥ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig gis phul nas bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ /rgyu/ o rgyan pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi bka' yi 'bangs/ /mthu stobs dregs pa'i rtsal shugs zla med pa/ /tshangs pa'i ging chen chos rgyal dpe ha ra/ /sku lnga yab yum sprul pa blon 'bangs 'khor/ /ru 'dren bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ /dngos yid las skyes mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod/ /bsam gyi mi khyab rang rang mkho mgu rdzas/ /sngags rgyas byin gyis rlabs pas thugs dam bskang / /sum brtsen rnam rgyal khang par co 'dri ba'i/ /rin chen ba gam sum brtsegs dbang po'i gzhus/ /lan brgyar khyud pas mig stong yid srub blangs/ /sku rten rmad byung mkhar gyi thugs dam bskang / /mig sman zhun mas byug pa'i bzhin ras la/ /ku mud gnyan gyi spyan gsum rab tu 'tsher/ /sa 'dzin dum bur chad pa'i mche ba bcigasaske/ /zil gnon sku 'bag gsob kyi thugs dam bskangs/ /dbyar skyes rnga gsang 'bum gyi khengs 'phrog pa'i/ /'dzin ma g.yo 'bar nus pa'i rol mo'i sgra/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yid du rab 'ong zhing / /358

bstod tshig snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi ྾ ka dag gnyug ma'i gnas lugs lha lam la/ /'gag med rim gnyis nyin byed rab tu 'bar/ /chos kun byar med rang mdangs zer brgya 'phro/ /mnyam bzhag ro gcig lta bas thugs dam ྾ rdul dkar phung po bye ba'i mdangs 'dzin zhing / /mig mi 'dzum pa'i lag 'gro la 'phya ba'i/ /sna tshogs srog chags rgyan ldan yid 'phrog rtsen/ /mthun pa'i dkor nor rdzas kyi thugs ྾yongs 'dus ljon pa la khu rkang thung che/ /rma bya'i mgrin par 'khrul pa'i yal 'dab 'thib/ /lha jings 'bigs 'dra rtse rgyal shugs shing ni/ /lta na rab tu sdug pas thugs ྾ lto 'gro'i dbang po la 'gran gnyan lhags shing / /ldem ldem sgeg mo'i 'gros kyi dper gyur cing / /khyug khyug sprin gyi myugs ma ltar khyug pa'i—/ /sba smyug bkra shis rdzas kyis thugs ྾ brgyan lon nyams med mchog chen adar+sha/ /yid snang gzugs brnyan 'phos nas ma 'dres dang / /rnyog bral skog gyur spang blang legs ston pa'i/ /sra brtan khu khog khye'us thugs ྾ bla yig srog rten dngul khab lhang tsher rdo/ /sku gzugs sngags byang tsakra mthun pa'i rdzas/ /phyinang gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /chos 'khor skyong mdzad 'khor bcas ྾ dar zab gcan gzan sna tshogs rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /rin chen dkor cha sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i chas/ /go sra mtshon rno rngam brjid phyag cha yis/ /pe har rgyal po 'khor bcas ྾ gzhan yang 'dod yon lha mo rgyal srid bdun/bkra shis rtags rdzas ri gling nyi zla sogs/ /lha klu mi yi longs spyod mtha' yas pas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ྾ gsol kha sku mkhar srog 'khor mdung zhags dang / /bse yi khrab rmog dar dmar 'jol ber thod/ /bya khyi rta dmar tsa ra mthun rdzas kyi/ /srog bdag gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs ྾de ltar rten mchod bskang ba'i rdzas gyur rnams/ /khyod bsngos mchod gtor la sogs 'dir 'byor dang / /ma 'byor 'jig rten khams nas mos blo yi//blangs nas 'bul bas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /thugs dam bskang bas dam can dgyes pa'i mthus/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun kun zhi zhing / /rtag tu mthun dgu 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /hoḥ chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni mi mkhas ma rig las nyon dbang / rdo rje theg lam spyi yi dam tshig dang / bsrung ma'i thugs dang 'gal kun mthol zhing bshags/ /mthun rdzas ma tshangs mchod tshogs zhan pa dang / /'bag btsog gos shing dus kyi mchod gtor g.yel/ /phrin las sgrub pa'i btang rag ma grub sogs/ /'gal ba'i las gyur ma lus mthol zhing bshags/ /bsnyen sgrub ma rdzogs las sbyor phrin las rings/ /dam nyams zhing bcu snying rjes sgrol ma nus/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtogs rang khar spyad pa'i las/ /bsrung ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags/ /hoḥ khyad par 'khor 'das chos kun mnyam nyid la/ /rgyal ba thabs mkhas 'gro don sgyu 'phrul sku/ /dpag med yongs shar bsrung ma'i 359

tshul snang bar/ /rang rgyud dregs par bzung ba mthol lo bshags/ /yang dag don la rgyal ba kun tu bzang | /ma rtogs 'gro ngor rgyal po pe ha ra/ /gzhan du ma grub rang sems rig pa'i 'phrul/ /rang ngo ma shes 'khrul gyur mthol lo bshags/ /rang sems chags sdang rmongs pa'i rang shugs kyi/ /rang grib don du rgyal bsen shar ba la/ /ma rtogs phyi nas 'dre bgegs byung rlom nas/ /bsrung bzlos kyi bkar ba mthol lo bshags/ /rnam dag spros bral gnas lugs ma rtogs par/ /kun rtogs blo yis lha mchod 'dre brdungs shing —/ /phan gnod re dogs bdag 'dzin zhags pas bcings/ /de kun byar med klong du mthol lo bshags/ /yang dag don la rigs kyi sangs rgyas lnga/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor skyong phyir rgyal po lngar/ /sku sprul dug gsum sha rus khrag rol bar/ /log mthong srin por bzung ba mthol lo bshags/ /gtsug lag chos skyong rgyal po pe har khyed//pad+ma thod 'phreng bka' 'bangs 'phrin las bdag /dam tshig g.yel med 'chang ba'i dam can che/ /rmad byung rdo rje theg bsrung mchog gyur te/ /bdag cag mi mkhas nyon dbang 'drer bzung nas/ /log rtog shar ba thams cad mthol bshags shing / /mdor na bdag sogs yang dag don ma rtogs/ /'khrul dbang gyur pas khyod thugs dang 'gal las/ /ma lus zhi thugs klong du rtag bzod gsol/ /bdag la 'di phyi'i sgrib par ma gyur cig /mthol zhing bshags pas las kun byang dag nas/ /dri med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /khyed ni pad+ma'i bka' las 'da' med yang / /bdag cag ma rig dbang gi 'ga' gyur las/ /lha mi'i dam tshig ma snyoms phog thug dang / /ral chod rtsing spyod gyur rnams mthol zhing bshags/ /don dam ngo bor lha dang 'dre ma grub/ /bshags bya bshags byed mtshan ma kun bral yang //kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bshags pa na//mnyam nyid klong du dag cing tshangs par stsol//de nas dbyangs bcas bstod pa'i rim pa ni/ /r+ghaṃ/ mtsho pad las 'khrungs snang srid zil gnon mdzad/ /mtshungs med rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /o rgyan pad+ma drag po thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rigs kun khyab bdag bla mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdu/ rig pa'i rgyal po dregs 'dul he ru kaḥ rtog tshogs khams las sde dpon sngags kyi bdag /dregs pa'i tshul gyis zhing bcu sgrol mdzad pa/ /'jig rten mchod bstod tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dregs pa dbang chen rgyal po yongs kyi gtso/ /dpal chen rta yi rnam 'phrul tshangs pa'i ging //ho ru ka yi bka' 'bangs mthu stobs can/ /chos rgyal pe har 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /ngo bo gcig las sprul pa bsam yas shing / /khyad par ye shes rang mdangs sku lnga snang / /dpag med 'phrin las sku mdog phyag mtshan 'chang / /chos 'khor skyong mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtso mchog brgya byin rdo rje klu 'brug 'dul/ /mthing nag dom gyi rlog pa srog zhu gsol/ /sdom bsnun phyag rgya bsgyur nas gnyis 'thung gzhon/ /gnod sbyin chen po khyod la gus pas bstod/ rnam 'phrul sku gsung yon tan phrin las 360

rtsal—/ /pu tra dgra lha skyes cig shing bya can/ /pe har mi bo che ste sku yi gar/ /cir yang ston par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde chen dga' bzhi'i gnas der gsang ba'i yum/ /lhan skyes dhākhri'i rigs kyi yum chen lnga/ /sharnyi ro zan ro langs gser spu gri/ /mdzes byed pad+ma smin dkar ma la bstod/ /dge bsnyen dgra bcom bzhon nu mon bu dang / /mi ring srin bu la sogs sprul pa lnga/ /yang sprul bsam gyi mi khyab rtogs tshogs khams/ /yongs 'char rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung la bstod/ /dbang gi rigs las mi bsrun ma rung sku—/ /shan pa srog len gnod sbyin yang le ber/ /sna tshogs mtshon thogs dam nyams dgra bo sgrol/ /pad+ma'i bstan pa nye bar bsrung der bstod/ /gzhan yang chos skyong rgyal po'i bka' yi blon/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrub mdzad pa/ /srog bdag bya ra mig gcig thang nag dang / /grags ldan pu tra nag por gus pas bstod/ /za 'og stag seng rgya bya spyang ki yi/ /rgyal mtshan rngam pa'i tshul 'dzin pho nya dang / /dgra bcom sngags nag stag shar bud med nag /ru 'dren bzhi bcas dam tshig dbang gis bstod/ /gtso bo'i thugs las sprul pa'i las byed pa/ /dom gyi mgo can mi ring sngo skya 'bum/ /mtshon cha 'bar bas dgra bo'i lus srog 'phral/ /'jigs byed drag po'i tshogs la rab bstod do/ /kun kyang 'jigs pa'i sku la rngam pa'i gsungs/ /gshis nyid g.yo med chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /zhen med sgyu ma'i ngang tshul snying rje'i thugs//gtum chen gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yang 'khor 'bag seng rgya mon a tsar sprel/ /sha khrol khyi khrol 'dzin sdom khol po dang / /rgyal phran stong sde dregs pa bye ba 'bum/ /kun kyang dam tshig dbang gi bstod par bgyis/ /'khor bcas mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob sa lam bar chad sol/ /rgyu sbyor dad ldan sbyin bdag 'gal rkyen bzlog /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med grub par mdzod/ /de nas gsol kha gser skyems 'bul zhing bcol ba ni/ /rgyu/ /dbyings nyid dpag par dka' ba'i klong chen por/ /rab 'jigs mthing nag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /brgya byin yab yum sprul blon 'khor bcas pa'i/ /zhal du gser skyems dza gad bcud mchog 'bul/ /gsol lo mchod do dgyes pa ru mdzod cig /pu tra yab yum sprul blon 'khor bcas pa'i/ /zhal du gser skyems zhes dang /gsol lo sogs 'og tu 'dre'o/ /shing bya yab yum sprul blon 'khor bcas pa'i/ /zhal du ྾ gsol lo ྾ pe har yab yum sprul blon 'khor bcas pa'i/ /zhal du ྾ gsol lo ྾ gnod sbyin dmar po yab yum 'khor bcas pa'i/ zhal du ྾ gsol lo ྾ blon 'bangs skyo sangs ru 'dren 'khor bcas pa'i/ /zhal du ྾ gsol lo ྾ rgyal phran stong sde dregs byed grangs med pa'i/ /zhal du ྾ gsol lo ྾ hoḥ chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas ma pa yi/ /dgyes mdzod dgyes nas bdag gi 'dod pa'i donaske/ /thogs med yid bzhin re ba yongs bskang ba'i/ /bsam 'phel nor bur khyed kyi mdzad du gsol/ /361

zhes phud phyogs bcur gtor/ hūṃ/ o rgyan pad+ma'i bka' 'bangs dge bsnyen che/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor skyong ba'i mnga' bdag po/ /che btsan zla med ging chen pe ha ra/ /yab yum sprul 'khor bcas pa mchod bstod nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /dam ldan bdag cag slob dpon sbyin bdag bcas/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen 'jigs pa brgyad bcu drug /nad gdon blo bur ye 'brog kun zhi zhing / /tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags stobs nus gzi/ /brjid rnams rtag tu nyams med gong 'phel rgyas/ /lha 'dre mi rje blon 'bangs che btsun mkhas/ /dregs ldan ma lus bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ /snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid sems shing / /da dgra thad lang mtshon dug sbyor ngan bshams/ /lhag pas khyad bsod dman pas brnyas bcos shing / /mnyam pas 'gran sems gdug pa shar ba dang / /mthun gnyis dbyen byed ngos shags lkog lab sgrogs/ /bran 'khor snying ring kha dkar zhe nag cing / kha nang snying phyi dam tshig ngos lkog byed/ /za tshe thod dkar za thon rjes nag mkhan/ /bsgral ba'i zhing gyur de dag lo zla bar/ /ma bzhag zhag dang za ma'i nang du sgrol/ /brang shogs snying long snying khrag hub kyi thob/ /smyo 'bog brgyal ba'i nad kyi thal bar rlog /dam can dam la ma 'da' sā mā yā/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod//khyad par bdag gi 'khrul rtog kun zhi zhing / /'khrul med nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas//rang sems rig pa'i klong du kun dbang 'dus/ /bzung 'dzin rtog pa lhag med rtsad nas gcod/ /mdor na bdag ni rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar/ /chos min 'gal rkyen bar chad kun bzlog cing / /chos gnas chos bzhin spyod pa'i grogs mdzad cing / /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob phrin las mdzod/ /rgyu bh+yo/ khyod la g.yar dam zur tsam smos pa na/ sngon tshe pad+ma ho ru gsang ba'i bdag lha ma'i dge sbyong legs ldan nag po yi/ /spyan sngar srog snying phul bas dam tshig nos/ /khyad par 'chim bu gnas dang has po rir/ /rgyal kun ngo bo gcig 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /drag po me phreng rtsal gyi spyan snga ru/ /rang gnad srog snying mdangs gsol phul nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang pad ma'i rgyud 'dzin rnams/ /bu ltar skyong ba'i khas blangs bro yang bror/ /gzhan yang brag dmar dge gong zan g.yang gnas/ /rnams su rdo rje dbyings dang bder 'dus kyi/ /dkyil 'khor mchog tu bcug nas dbang yang bskur/ /dam tshig rdo rje bdud rtsis rgyas btab nas/ /ma 'ong sangs rgyas thob par lung yang bstan/ /phyi ma'i dus gyur tha mar babs pa'i tshe yang bskyar tshul du pad+ma'i rgyal sras mchog /gar gyi dbang phyug r+ghaṃ nag me 'bar rtsal/ /gter bzhad snying po pad+ma klong gsal snying / /bdud 'joms rdo rje la li ta badz+ra/ /rnams kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin//bsnyel ba med par rdo rje theg pa'i bstan/ /nyams med phyogs dus kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas/ rtag brtan snyan pas srid gsum g.yo nus shings/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe sra brtan par/ /nyams med 362

yun ring gnas pa'i phrin las mdzad/ /ngo 'jo'i tshig dang zas ngor ma 'brang bar/ /rab gnyan srog kyi ka ba rdo rje'i lam/ /g.yel ba med par khyod kyi dran mdzod la/ /zab gsang bla med a ti rdo rje'i snying / /ma hā sirnyi'i ring lugs gang yin pa/ /'dzin skyongs spel ba'i skyes bu dam pa yi/ /'phrin las thogs med khyod kyi grub par gyis/ /gal te 'das na sngon tshe rgyal ba yi/ /bka' yi dmod pas sdig par mi 'gyur ram| /sngags 'chang bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe bsrings dpal bskyed 'dod dgu'i bsam don bsgrub/ /keg sri byur dang ltas ngan skal ngan sel/ /mthun tshogs thams cad 'bad med 'grub par mdzod/ /rlung rta dar zhing bsod nams rgyas pa'i dus/ /lhas ma skyon kyang 'dod don yid bzhin 'gyur/ /khyod mchod bstod pa'i re ba gang yin pa/ /bsod nams rlung rta nyams rgud gyur kyang rung ske/ /g.yel bar dor med rtag tu bsrung skyob cing / /'dod don yid bzhin bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra sā mā yā dzaḥsarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tsha tu hoḥ zhes 'phrin las bcol lo/ /de nas lhag chad kha bskang ba ni hoḥ rtsa gsum bsrung ma sbyi dang khyad par du/ /chos rgyal 'khor bcas mchod bstod bstod bgyid pa//dam rdzas ma gtsang phud nyams 'phri gzhog dang //byin gyis ma rlobs tshig gi brjod zur log /ting 'dzin ma gsal sngags la skyon gyi zhugs/ /phyag rgya chad dang nor 'khrul byung la sogs/ /bsrung ma chen po'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /mthol bshags gsol bas bzod mdzod sgrib dag shog /oṃ badz+ra shri he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya/ zhes sogs ho ru ka'i yig brgya a li ka li rten 'brel snying pos lhag chad bskang ngo / /de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ /hoḥ chos rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /de ltar mchod bstod gsol btab don grub nas/ /da ni chos dbyings gnas dang gtsug lag khang / /zan g.yang mi 'gyur brag dmar bsam yas su/ /pe har 'khor bcas da gshegs sha ra ra/ /rgyal po da ni rang gi gnas su gshegs/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /bkra shis bde legs bsam don sgrub nas gshegs//pad+ma drag po me phreng spyan snga ru//zhal bzhes ci bzhin dam las 'da' med par//mchod sbyin 'dod don re ba yongs bskang nas/ /da ni rang rang gnas su gshegs par mdzod/ /badz+ra muḥsarba lo ka gats+tshaḥ rtag tu chos skyong rten zhing rten yod na 'khor gyi dregs pa badz+ra mu/ sarba gats+tshas gshegs shing / gtso bo 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig sogs pas brten par bya zhing / de nas lha rdzas me tog bzang po'i char bcas bkra shis brjod pa ni/ oṃ/ rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs rje'i mkhas klong nas/ /phrin las 'dus pa'i sprin phung pad+ma 'byung / /byin rlabs char gyi gdul bya smin par byed/ /'dren mchog bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /zhi khro'i gar bsgyur ma dros rdzing bu las/ /mchog mthun lam gsum shing rta'i rgyun bzang pos/ /skal ldan tshad gdung sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra 363

shis shog /dga' bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dpag bsam shing / /phrin las rnam pa bzhi yi yal 'dab rgyas/phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i 'bras bu mchog tu g.yur/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog dam nyams zhing bcu'i klad pa rab 'gems pa'i/ /mi zad mngon spyod lce 'bab drag po'i thun/ /thogs med 'bebs par byed pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /rdo rje bsrung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gsang chen snying po ring lugs tsan+da la/ /dri ltar chags nas bstan pa nyer bsrung zhing / /bkra shis mthu rtsal rmad du byung gyur pa/ /pe har 'khor bcas rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zhes dang / gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod cing las kyi rjes spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad du/ /che btsan rigs sngags grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang ma rung snying 'gas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas drag po pad+ma thod 'phreng gi/ /gangs smongs gtsug lag bsrung mar mnga' gsol ba'i/ /chos skyong chen po pe har gsol mchod pa'i/ /cho ga yid la gang 'dod re ba'i don/ /yongs 'jo byed 'di kho bos legs par smras/ /gong ma'i tshig zur bcos dang mdzad byang bsgyur/ /dum dum btus nas bsgrigs pa'i tshul ma 'dresaske/ /rgyal ba pad+mar mi phyed gus pa'i blos/ /de yi bstan par cung zad 'dres pa'i mthus/ /yid la gang shar thol byung nyid du smras/ /nor dang 'khrul pa'i skyon gyis gos srid na/ /mkhyen ldan rgyal ba'i spyan sngar yongs bshags pa'i/ /legs gyur dge bas bstan dgra tshar chod cing / /bstan pa nyams med dar rgyas rtag brtan shog /ces chos skyong rgyal po pe ha ra yi gsol mchod 'dod don yongs 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ /don gnyer can mang pos bskul ba dang / /nye lam du ga'u lha sding bla ma rin po che'i sku tsha/ /shākya dge tshul slob bzang rin chen bstan 'dzin gyi nan gyi bskul ngor/ rig sngags 'chang ba kaḥthog stag ras grub dbang pad+ma ma ṇi'i skye bar rlom pa lha btsun tshe dbang nor bu grub mchog dbang po sde zhes ming gzhan du karma rin chen mchog tu dga' ba dge ba'i dpal gyis mnga' ris mang yul gung thang rgyal po'i pho brang khyung rdzong dkar po'i lho nub gter gnas brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba'i ngogs ri 'dabs dgon du me lug hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes gnyis gsum gyi thun skabs su cung zad re bris shing tshes bzhi 'byung po 'du ba'i nyi ma la chos skyong dgyes pa'i mtshan ma dang bcas te grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa yang rang nyid kyi bgyis pa sarba maṅga lo/364

rikhog/rigs mtshun lha bsrungs gnyan po rdo rje brag btsan gyi gsol mchod 'dod don lhan grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ na maḥshrī ho ru ka ya man+ta ka tsa ra ṇa ya/ gang zhig mun pa'i gling gi skyes gcig pu rdo rje brag btsan yab yum sras bcas mchod par 'dod pas gtsang zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su mchod pa'i yo byad sha khrag gi gtor ma dza gad bsang bsur rol mo tshang bar byas shing rang nyid 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed lta bu lhag pa'i lha yi nga rgyal bskyed la/r+ghaṃ/rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid//bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi 'byung gnas che/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /byin rlabs nus pa'i mthu byin dus 'dir stsol/ /oṃ lhargyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rgyu/ ho ru ka dpal yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /'jigs byed khro bo kun gyi spyi dpal mchog /bcom ldan dpal chen ya man+ta ka yi/ /dregs pa'i gnyen po stobs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /skye a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma tha bhardzo r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ de nas 'dir yab yum sras gsum 'jig rten gyi dregs pa rang rgyud kyi tshul du mchod pa na mdun du skad cig tsam gyi byon par bsam ste rnga dang rkang gling bshugs pa'i sgras gzi byin bskyed la spyan 'dren ni/ /r+ghaṃ dzaḥbh+yo ya:dpal chen 'khor lo bde mchog dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje dpa' bo dpa' mo ho ru ka /gdul bya'i don du rgyal bstan bsrung ba'i phyir/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal dang so sha'i gling / /khyad par gshin dong sa 'og mun gling na/ /bcom ldan ya man+ta ka'i bka' stod tshul/ /las dang tshe la dbang bsgyur drag shul can/ /'chi bdag mun pa'i skyes gcig yab yum sras/ /dam ldan bdag gi gdung bas spyan 'dren na/ /sngon tshe dpal gyi spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ /rnal 'byor dam ldan phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ /ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥbh+yo: bod yul dbu ru srin rir srin mgon nag /yab yum 'khor bcas dam la da tshur byon/ /dra ba blo yul sprin 'dzin klo btsan nag /yab yum 'khor bcas dam la da tshur byon/ /kong yul rgya lar dong bdag bshan pa che/ /yab yum 'khor bcas dam la da tshur byon/ /ku lung dga' tshal rnga sgrar bdud kyi mgon/ /yab yum 'khor bcas dam la da tshur byon/ /ljon klung brag sker rdo rje brag btsan zhes/ /yab yum ྾ stag tshang zhing skyong dbang phyug dgra 'dul che/ /yab yum 'khor bcas ྾ tsha ba ban ri sgro brag lha btsan dkar//yab yum 'khor bcas dam la ྾ btsan rgod ri bkra rdo rje dbang drag rtsal/ /yab yum 'khor bcas ྾ gzhan yang 'phrul ldan skyes bu chen po khyod/ / 365

rgya gar dur khrod gnas yul chen po dang / /bod yul dbus gtsang gtsug lag sgrub gnas che/ /gangs ra rdzong chen sbas yul ljongs la sogs/ /gang du bzhugs kyang 'jam dpal gshin rje dang / /pad+ma dbang chen gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng spyan sngar dam bcas bzhin/ /dam tshig can gyi grogs dpal mgon byed slad/ /rnal 'byor gdung ba'i sems kyi 'bod lags na/ /ma thogs myur ba skad cig yid mgyogs ltar/ /tshur byon tshur byon mun pa'i skyes gcig pu/ /yab yum 'khor bcas gnas 'dir da tshur byon/ /dgyes pas pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dam tshig gnyen po bsrung phyir phyag kyang 'tshal—/ /khyod mchod phyi nang gsang ba kun bzang sprin/ /bla med rol pa sbyor sgrol rmad byung rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mdzad med nam mkha'i mdzod/ /'bul lo dgyes bzhes 'dod don 'phrin las mdzod/ /me tog bdug spos la sogs nyer spyod rdzas/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos 'dod yon tshogs/ /sman gtor rak+ta sha chang bsangs bsur dang / /shug glu rkang gling rnga rol rngam snyan sgra/ /'bul 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /bdag cag dam ldan 'phrin las thogs med mdzod/ /khyad par dmar gtor dgra bo'i ru pa ni/ /gzas po'i dbang po don snying srog dbugs mdangs/ /bla tshe srog tu dmigs nas 'bul bzhes rol/ /brnag pa'i dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyangs sgrol/ /ya ma rā dza mun ti khrag rgal mun rtse sa ma ya dza dzaḥ e rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta pi pa ho/ sarba sha r+ghaṃ ma rā ya tsista khā hi/rgyu bh+yo ya/mun pa'i gling gi skyes cig ya mtshan che/ /lha cig mtshan mang rnam 'gyur du ma'i sku/ /khyod kyi yab ni ral pa tshar dgu ste/ /mthing nag phyag gnyis khri shing sbrul zhags bsnams/ /lcags ral tshar dgu zhal nas dug rlangs thul/ /dug sbrul la zhon gshin rje 'bum gyi bskor/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sdang byed dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyangs sgrol/ /skyes mchog yum ni srin mi su bdar ma/ mthing nag phyag gnyis ral gri sbrul zhags gdengs/ /spyi gtsug g.yu ral zhal nas nad rim 'phro/ /stag mo la zhon ma mo 'bum gyi bskoraske/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sdang byed dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyangs sgrol/ /dregs pa gshin rje ma mo 'dus pa'i sras/ /dong bdag bshan pa lag dmar mun pa skyes/ /rdo rje brag btsan rdo rje dbang drag stsal/ /sku ni mun pa dpral spyan gcig zla ba/ /zhal na tshems gcig nyi ma me 'od 'bar/ /phyag na spu gri sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams/ /chu glang dmar zhon 'khor du srog bdag 'bum/ /lha srin dregs pa stong sde brgyad kyi bskor/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes dang / /sdang byed dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyangs sgrol/ /khyod yum srin mo nag mo gri thod can/ /srin mo 'bum bskor rlung nag 'tshub mar rgyu/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sdang byed dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyang sgrol/ /de ltar 'chi bdag yab yum sras 'khor bcas/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /skyes 366

mchog rdo rje brag btsan rnam 'gyur yang / /ma nges phyi ltar yul lha zo dor tshul/ /dung rta shel mi mdung dar nor rgyal bsnams/ /rin chen go ldan dregs byed stong sdes bskor/ /nang ltar btsan rgod srin gzugs dmag chas can/ /mtshon thogs rta dmar la zhon 'dre dmag bskor/ /gsang bar lha chen gnod sbyin dmar tsher sku/ /dar dmar thod ber nor bu lcags kyu bsnams/ /zhabs la bse lham stag mo grub ma chibs //rang 'dra'i sprul dang btsun mo sras blon bskor/ /re 'ga' khros tshe dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs//mi rgod lpags gsol sbrul gyi thod gdengs can/ khra bdud 'bum skor sdang dgra rtsad nas gcod/
