/de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i sprul tshogs rnams/ 'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sdang byed dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyangs sgrol/ /r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ mun pa'i skyes bu phyag brnyan rdo rje legs/ /snying sdug brten ma bka' 'khor dge bsnyen dang / /las byed rol pa skya bdun gdong dmar ma/ /sde dpung bka' nyan bran g.yog yang 'khor bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sdang byed dgra bo lo zlar ma 'gyangs sgrol/ /r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ de ltar dam can yab yum sras 'khor la/ /mchod cing bstod nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rjes 'brang rig 'dzin gyis/ /rigs rgyud rgyal bstan 'dzin skyongs spel nus pa/ /che btsan grags ldan rgyun mi chad pa dad/ /slob rgyud mkhas btsun bzang po 'ba' zhig pas/ /yul dbus mtha' khob kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas/ /bdag cag dpon slob mos mthun 'khor bcas kyis/ /yid la bsam pa'i 'dod don lhun 'grub par/ /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs/ /yar skyed snyan pa'i dung bsus grags pa yis/ /ba dan srid rtser 'phyor la lha 'dre mi/ /che btsan dregs tshogs mos bzhi dbang du bsdus/ /bdag cag sde rigs dam ldan 'khor bcas la/ /mngon gyur sbyor tsub lkog gyur bsam ngan mkhan/ /sdang zhing gdug par byed pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /lo dang zla ba ma 'gyangs zhag za mar/ /tshe stung srog chod snying phyung thod pa 'brogs/ /klad pa snying khrag bsres la ljib ljib gsol/ /bsad rtags don snying da lta khyer la shog /gsol yang mi gsan bcol kyang mi mdzad na/ /dam can dregs pa brten pas ci zhig bya/ /blo bur hur thum dgra srog mi gcod na/ /mthu rtsal nus pa che zhes su la ngom/ /laṅka'i srin kyang gus pas mchod bstod pas/ /pha ma ltar byams bcol ba'i las kyang mdzad/ /lha khyod rje btsun bla ma'i 'jig rten gyis/ /rigs rus bskyed byed cho btsun yin zhes dang / /yul gyi lha dang rig 'dzin rgyud bsrung zhes/ /mchod bstod rtag tu dung bas mnga' gsol na/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 'phrin las ci mi mdzad/ /ma yel ma yal 'chi bdag yab yum sras/ /sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru/ /khas blangs dam ldan ji bzhin sgrub pa po/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang dben gnas gnyan gyi bsrung mar zhen pa'i don 367

gnyer 'ga' yi bskul ba dang / rang re'i rigs rus bskyed byed cho mtshun gyi ngo bo yin zhes kyang thos pa la rten nas gsol mchod rgyun khyer kyi tshul du rkong yul gyi mthil dur khrod pad+ma rtsegs pa dang mtshungs pa chu bo g.yas 'khyil gyi sgrub sde gtsang po mgo dgur chu phag sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i thun bar gcig tu dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i brjod pa bkra shis dge legs kyi rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga lo//༄ga /mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi zhing skyong gter bdag mkha' 'gro rgya dkar ral gcig ma yi 'phrin las rab dga'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ma hā gu ru badz+ra ru tro pa kra ma na mo/ rgyal kun bskyed byed ye sangs rgyas pa'i dngos/ /rig kun khyab bdag bla med bla ma che/ /mchog kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rig pa 'dzin/ /'gro kun 'dren byed mtsho skyes rdo rjer 'dud/ /gang de'i bsgrub pa'i gnas dang zab mo'i gter/ /rgyud 'dzin skyongs la g.yel med nyul le ma/ /bal bod mtshams kyi zhing skyong dhāk+ki'i gtso/ /gangs sman rgyal mo'i mchod sprin 'dir bkod do/ /gnas dben gtsang mar rin chen brdar ba'i phye/ /dkar dmar dza gad sbyar ba'i bā lin+ta/ /gru 'dab bzhi pa nyi zla nor bu'i brgyan/ /mchod pa'i bye brag ci rigs kyis bskor bshams/ /de nas rnal 'byor bde ba'i gdan la 'dug /sngon 'gro skyabs sems yan lag bdun grub nas/ /oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurjo3haṃ/ skad cig dran rdzogs pad nya'i gdan stengs su/ /rang nyid gsang bdag pad 'byung gsal ba yi/ /thugs kha'i ju las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ /mchod rdzas skyon gsal yon tan rgyas byin brlabs/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho hrīḥ stong ngang mdun mthar rin chen gzhal yas dbus/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte bar zla steng la/ /ma las brtse ldan rgya gar ral gcig ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis lhun sdug gangs ri'i mdog /zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan spyan gnyis zur mig g.yo/ /dpral bar ye shes thig le spyan gcig brgyan //cher sgeg zhal ras dung so g.yu smin 'khyugs/ /bcu drug na tshod mthong dran bde ba bskyed/ /yid 'phrog mthon dka'i ral pa gtsug bcings pa'i/ /rtse mor bsam 'phel dbang gi nor bu spras/ /lhag ma mthur 'phyang zur phud lnga ru mdzes/ /gser g.yu mu tig spel ba'i dbu rgyan bcings/ /rab mtshar sbrul gyi gdeng ka gsum gyis brgyan/ /snyan gong g.yas g.yon chu skyes dkar 'tsher bzhad/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu'i 'gro ba'i yid dbang 'gugs/ /g.yon thod bum ril sgrub la dngos grub stsal/ /sku stod rin chen rgyan 'phreng dar paṇa g.yo/ /smad g.yogs mthing khra rat+na dar chings klubs/ /rma bya'i sgro mdangs thul pa 368

'ja' ltar bkrags/ /gser dngul phyag gdub lcags sgrog zhabs gdub 'khrol/ /nor bu spung khrir zhabs gnyis 'gyings gar bzhugs/ /phyogs 'dabs bzhi la mdun nas g.yas bskor du/ /phrin las bzhi bsgrub lha sman chen mo bzhi/ /zhi mdzad dkar 'dzum mda' dar me long thogs/ /dpal bskyed ser bzhad nor bu bum pa bsnams/ /dbang mdzad dmar chags lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin/ /sgrol byed nag khros khri shing nad rkyal gdengs/ /'khor du rang rang rigs mthun 'bum sde dang / brtan ma gzhi bdag lha klu btsan bdud bskor/ /gzhan yang lha sman chen mo'i yab dang yum/ /klu rgyal nor skyongs klu sman 'od ldan ma/ /ming po lha btsan bka' nyan dge bsnyen sogs/ /rang rang bu smad khyo grogs mdza' gshes bcasaske/ /dpag med sprin phung 'thib pa ltar gsal zhing / /bdag mdun thugs kha'i 'od zer lcags kyu yiske/ /rang bzhin gnas dang byang shar rgya mtsho'i gling / /ri rab zom dang rdo rje gdan gyi spo/ /bal bod sa mtshams mang yul dpal 'bar ri/ /gzhan yang grub pa'i gnas yul sa gsum khams/ /gang du bzhugs kyang jo mo 'khor dang bcas/ /skad cig myur ba nyid du spyan drangs gyur/ /ma ma de wi re ma ti bh+yoḥs ma yā dza dzaḥ bh+yoḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs jo mo rgya dkar ma/ /'dod dgu bsgyur ba'i 'phrul mo che/ /chos kyi dbyings su ral gcig ma/ /byang shar mtshams nas dpal 'bar ma/ /rdo rje gdan na re ma ti/ /bal bod mtshams gyur mang yul ri/ /dpal 'bar gnas na zhing skyongs ma/ /yab yum mched 'khor ming po dang / bka' nyan las mkhan bcas pa kun/ /sngon tshe thub chen gsang ba'i bdag /bar du dbang chen pad+ma 'byung / /tha mar gter grub mchog rnams kyi/ /spyan sngar khyod kyi gzugs bstan cing ske/ /srog phul g.yar dam blang ba bzhin/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir byon nas kyang / /dgyes pa'i zhal ston grub rtags phyung / /bcol ba'i las mdzod dngos grub stsol/ /bh+yoḥm ma de wi e ka dza ṭi ri ma ti sa pā ri wā ra a gad tsha sa ma yā tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥho/ /'dir bshams pad zla nor bu'i khrir/ /jo mo 'khor bcas dgyes bzhugs gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir thal mo sbyar/ /gus pa'i yid kyi mchod par bgyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin gyi//mchod pa kun bzang rgyan gyi sprin//dngos yid las skyes nam mkha'i mdzod/ /dpag gis mi long chos dbyings khyon/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bde chos/ /mā dā na dang skyo dhe ram̐/ ma hā bā lin a bṛ ta/ /thabs shes bde stong dga' bzhi'i gros/ /nyon mongs rang grol chos dbyings klong / /rnam par dag pa'i mchod tshogs kun/ /dpal 'bar zhing skyongs dh+wa ki ma/ /'khor dang bcas la 'bul lags kyi/ /dgyes bzhes rnal 'byor phrin las bzhi/ /thogs med lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ma ma ṣe ṭa pā la di wi ni sa pā ri wā ri ar+ghaṃ pa bye puṣ+pe a lo ke gan+de rna wi bya shalda pūts+tsha urgyu/ ru pa shari gan+de rā su sparnye dharmā puts+tsha uhūṃ/ sarba pāñtsa 369

a mṛ ta rak+ta kha kha khā nyi/ a ho ti ta bho rnyi tsista gu h+ya puts+tsha hoḥ khyad par gtor mchod sngags rgyas byin brlabs ste/ ma ma ru lu/ la la/ li li/ ta ta/ te te/ ma ma/ ti ti/ ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥ shrī dz+wa la ṣe ṭa pā la de wi sa ma yā dza dzaḥ i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā gyi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul te mnyes par bsam/ bh+yoḥ gdod nas rnam dag skye med chos sku'i ngang / /'gag med 'od gsal lhun grub sgyu 'phrul gar/ /kun khyab thugs rje rten 'brel rol pa'i klong / snang srid 'byung lnga yum gyi mkha' klong dbus/ /bde chen dpa' mo zhing skyongs mkha' 'gro'i tshul/ /las mdzad sman cig jo mo rgya dkar ma/ /sna tshogs cir yang ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam ldan skyong mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshangs sras dbang mo gsar du dgyes pa'i sku/ /bde chen bcu drug lang tsho rab tu sgegs/ /mthong dang dran pa nyid nas bde ba 'bar/ /lhan skyes pad+ma'i rgyal mo khyod la bstod/ /rab dga'i rgyud mang snyems pa phrog pa'i gsung / /sbyor ba drug cu mgrin pa'i tasbu ra/ thos pa nyid nas dbang med tshangs dbyangs 'gugs/ /yid 'phrog dbyangs ldan rgyal mo khyod la bstod/ /mig stong ldan yang skyengs byed mkhyen pa'i dbang / /rmad byung rgyal ba'i bka' dang de 'dzin la/ /g.yel med bu ltar brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ /bden don mngon gyur rgyal mo khyod bstod do/ /mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab pa na/ /ci ltar re ba'i 'dod don gang yin pa/ /thogs med stsol mdzad yid bzhin lha mo che/ /'gro ba'i re bskang rgyal mo khyod bstod do/ /khyod sngon rig 'dzin pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /gsang ba'i ldem mdzad bka' yi gnyer 'dzin bskos/ /rgyud 'dzin skyongs bar zhal bzhes dam tshig can/ /sman cig rgya gar lha mor gus pas bstod/ /bka' nyan las byed rigs kyi lha mo bzhi/ /'khor du sman mo brtan ma yul sa dang / /lha klu gnyan bdud 'brog mo gza' dang btsan/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas la bdag gis bstod/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / /dam ldan chos mthun dpung grogs g.yel med cing / /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med 'grub pa dang / /sa 'dir gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgyas shing / 'chad nyan bsgom bsgrub nyams med gong du 'phel/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'bras bu myur du smin/ /bka' btsan byin che yun gnas phrin las mdzod/ /sarba sidhe me pra yats+tshaskyo ye swā hā/ de nas mchod bskang bshags pa'i las/ /bskang ba'i gtor ma brgyan ldan dang / /mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor ba/ /bshams shing dbyangs snyan rol mo bcas/ /rgyu bh+yoḥ 'dzam gling dbus 'gyur byang gi phyogs/ /bod yul lha ldan lho nub mtshams/ /mang yul skyid rong bkra shis ljongs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan dpal 'bar ri/ /mtho ba gung sngon dbyings su snyegs/ /srid pa'i gangs ri shel ltar 'tsher/ /'ja' sprin na bun mgur chur 'khril/ /khu 'phang sbrang char rgyun mi chad/ /spu sdug bya rigs gsung snyan sgrogs/ /ri dwags mang po khyu ru rtse/ /gcan gzan nyams rtsal stobs 370

ldan rgyu/ /dri bzang spos kyi nags tshal bskor/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor spyod par rgyu/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros brda' skad sgrogs/ /de 'dra'i gnas mchog ya mtshan na/ /zhing skyong brtan ma chen mo bzhugs/ /jo mo rgya dkar zhes bya'o/ /sku la de ni ci gsol na/ /mdzes sdug rma bya'i thul pa gsol/ /dbu la sbrul gyi gdeng ka'i brgyan//phyag na rin chen mchog phur dril/ /chibs la de ni ma nges kyang / /phal cher dre'u kha dkar zhon/ /'khor du sman phran 'bum dang bcas/ /skad cig re la srid gsum nyul/ /dam tshig can la stong grogs mdzad/ /dam nyams snying srog 'bral bar byed/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung / /zab mo gter gyi gnyer mdzad ma/ /ya mtshan lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /khyed kyi thugs dam bskang bar gyi/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul rdzasaske/ /mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim spos/ /snang gsal mar me bsung ldan chab/ khams gso bltag zhib zhal zas che/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra/ /yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa 'di/ /bskang ngo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang gzugs sgra dri ro reg /'dod yon lnga ldan chos yid tshim/ /lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni//rin chen lnga dang dar zab lnga/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum rtsi sman bcud/ /klu sman shing tog sna tshogs pas/ /gnas bdag jo mo 'khor bcas kyi//thugs rje chen po phrin las mdzod/ /rma bya'i sgro mdangs dar zab gdugs/ /byang chub shing lo rlung g.yeng pa/ /sa la ma lhung blang ba dang / /'bod pa'i g.yab dar brten pa'i rdzas/ /rin chen shel rdo srog shing sogs/ /lha mo'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul/ /gzhan yang sku gzugs sngags byang dang / /dmar dar me long shel 'phreng rnams/ /lha mo'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul/ /g.yar dam gnyan po des bskang cig /nang gi dbang po sna lnga dang / /bdud rtsi'i sman dang rak+ta dmar/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas bā lin+ta/ /sbyor sgrol gā ṇa tsakra sogs/ /bla med gsang ba'i rdzas mchog gi /re ti 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang bsgom bsgrub ting nge 'dzin/ /dkar po dge ba'i las gyur pas/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ /jo mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rang rang mthun rdzas dpag med pas/ /mtshan bzang dhā ki'i thugs dam bskang / /rdo rje ral gcig thugs dam bskang / /lha sman chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /bstan ma chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /sman phran 'bum yongs thugs dam bskang / /mched 'khor bran bcas thugs dam bskang / /yab gcig klu rgyal thugs dam bskang / /yum gcig klu sman thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang jo mo chen mo yi/ /ming po bka' sdod mdza' grogs tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /bskang rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /kun bzang rgyan spring las byung ba/ /gang la gang 'dod mthun pa'i rdzas/ /thogs med 'phro bas thugs dam bskang / /g.yag lug ra dang 371

mkha' lding tshogs/ /zal le 'bri yi tshogs kyi bskang / / thugs dam gnyan po des bskang nas/ /rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa dang / /chags che nyams nga dgra la bsgyur—/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan pa spel/ /zas nor lha 'dre mi gsum bsdus/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ /bcol ba'i las kun myur 'grub mdzod/ ho/ /zhing skyongs mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor ma rig ma rtogs pas/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs dang yan lag gi//dam tshig nyams pa gnong 'gyod mthol zhing bshags/ /che zhes dpal ldan re ma ti/ /gnas gter skyongs phyir klu dbang sras mo'i tshul/ /sman cig jo mo rgya gar skur ston pa/ /don dam rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid yin pa la/ /gdul bya 'dul phyir thabs mkhas mdzad gyur pa/ /ma rtogs dregs par bzung ba mthol lo bshags/ /mya ngan 'das kyang bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched/ /'jig rten tshul snang legs nyes gtang 'dzin zhing / /bka' 'khor bran g.yog mi srun gdug pas bskor/ /khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal kun mthol zhing bshags/ /dam rdzas ma gtsang phud gtor dus las g.yel/ /mchod rdzas rgya chung byin brlabs ma nus shing / /cho ga ma dag sngags dang phyag rgya nor/ /ting 'dzin ma gsal bzlas pa'i grwa zur nyamasaske/ /le lo rkyen dbang bying mugs 'thib pas myos/ /rnam g.yeng dbang gyur khas blangs dam dang 'gal/ /de sogs 'gal 'khrul nyes ltung ci mchis kun/ /sngags nag jo mo 'khor bcas spyan sngar bshagasaske/ /gtsang rig lha rnams mi dgyes las gyur pa/ /mi gtsang thab gzhob 'thab 'khon ku co dang / /dam nyams yug pa mdze grib gos pa dang / /me rnal zas gos spyod pa byol nyog pas/ /bsrung ma mi dgyes las su gyur pa kun/ /mthol zhing bshags so brang zhing dag gyur cig /bsgrub pa'i yul ljongs dben pa'i gnas rnams su/ /sa chu rdo shing gnyan por gyur pa la/ /ma shes rko dkrugs bslog bcad byas pa dang //yi mthun thugs dang 'gal ba'i las gyur kun/ /brtan ma 'khor bcas spyan sngar mthol bshags kyi//bzod bzhes gdug sems zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni ji snyed mkhyen pa'i mthu med pas//lha sman yab yum lcam dral bka' 'khor bcas/ /brten cing mchod la rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas/ /ma 'dzom phyi nang mchod pa 'dres pa dang / /gtsang the 'dres sogs rigs dang mi mthun pa/ /mchod rten rdzas su bgyid par gyur pa dang / /'bag btsog dris 'bag nyams dang tshogs 'dres sogs/ /'gal ba'i las kun lha sman 'khor bcas kyi/ /spyan sngar gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol bshags kyi/ /bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /gzhan yang lta ba ma rtogs klong ma gyur/ /bsgom pa 'phel 'grib nyams rtogs rtsal ma rdzogs/ /spyod pa la bzla shan 'byed tshul ma mkhas/ /'bras bu spang len re dogs song ba dang / /mdor na 'bras bu'i theg pa sngags phyi nang / /thun mong sde snod rnam pa gsum po yi/ /372

gnas lugs nyams len bslab spyod 'gal gyur kun/ /gtang 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa la / /gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags bzod par bzhes/ /sgrib med tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /zhing skyongs mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /spyan sngar smrengs shing bshags pa 'di gsol bas/ /'gal 'khrul nyes par gyur pa yongs byang ste/ /ma dang mkha' 'gros bu ltar skyongs nas kyang / /las bzhi'i 'phrin las gang bsam thogs med cing / /sa lam yon tan rang ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /ye shes rlung g.yos dbu ma'i mdud pa bkral/ /bde chen khams ti yongs khengs nas/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi yon tan kun/ /lhan skyes mkha' 'gro'i nus pas gdengs thob stsol/ /mdor na rnam mkhyen byang chub chen po'i sar/ /bar du skye ba gar len yang / /sngags bdag ma mos rtag tu bsrung ba dang / /mi mthun kun zhi mthun dgu 'bad med 'grub/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas/ /dbang drag nus pa'i brtul shugs mtha' ru phyin/ /nor 'khrul mi mnga' rgyal ba'i mkhyen ye rdzogs/ /bu slob dar rgyas smin grol grogs mdzod cig /don dam ngo bor chos kun rang rig gdangs/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gzeb las yongs 'das pas/ /bshags dang bshags byed so sor mi dmigs shing / /mnyam pa'i rang bzhin ye nas cig par gnas/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du rgyu 'bras chos/ /'gag med byed spyod nyes par gyur pa kun/ /gnong 'gyod drag pos gtang 'dzin spyan sngar bshags/ /dag tshangs ye shes mkha' 'gros dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod yig brgya ak+ṣa da kha bskang / /rjes su mngon brjod ched du bskul ba dang / /mgron thabs rkyen sel ched du mchod pa na/ /bsrung skyobs 'phrin las bcol nas gshegs su gsol/ /rgyun du bsrung mar brten na 'khor gshegs shing / /gtso mo mi gshegs rten la gnyis med bstem/ /dkor nor longs spyod gnyer gtad bcol gtam bya/ /mchod pas gang bsam phrin las 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyun du dam tshig mi yug mdze bshan dang / /nyams pa can dang ro grib bong grib 'dzem/ /gtsang spra la 'bad 'thab 'khon 'thab gzhob spang / /bsang gtor dus su mi chag rtag tu 'bul/ /mdor na gsang sngags dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung / /rdo rje slob dpon snying srog ltar du blta/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs gtor gyis bskang bya//des ni 'di phyi kun tu bde 'bras thob//de ltar bal bod sa mtshams pad+ma'i gnas/ /mang yul dbus su ri bo dpal 'bar zhes/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde phal po che/ /lung du bstan pa'i gangs ldan de nyid kyi/ /bsrung ma ri ti zhing skyong lha sman du/ /snang ba'i mtshan du jo mo rgya dkar zhes/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung rmad byung de nyid kyis/ /gsol mchod bskangs bshags phrin las nar ma'i rgyun/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs rjes snang ba yi/ /gang shar shugs 'byung ma bcos gnyug ma'i tshig /'bol rtsom mgrin pa'i tasbu ra yi dbyangs/ /dam can dgyes pa 373

bskang phyir 'dir spel dgos/ /bsrung ma'i mthu nus dpal du 'bar ba yi/ /rgyal bstan nub med yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /der 'dzin skyes bu'i tshe bsod rab gnas brtan/ /lung rtogs sprin bral nyi ltar gsal gyur cig /ces mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi gter bdag mkha' 'gro'i phrin las rab gsal rgyud yang bya ba 'di nyid gnas de yi gtsug lag khang gi rim gro pa bkra shis don grub kyi bskul ba dang / dhāk+ki nyid kyang dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa la brten nas/ mdo khams kaḥthog rdor gdan gyi lho phyogs su skyes pa'i 'od gsal lha rigs kyi btsun pa tshe dbang nor bu yid 'ong legs smra rgya mtsho'am/ ming gzhan du karmā rin chen mchog tu dga' ba dge ba'i dpal zhes pas pra sa gaḥr grags pa me lug zla bco lnga la tshes bzang por rtsa gsum sgrub pa'i 'tsham mal du gang shar ma bcos chu bab su thun skabs gcig la rdzogs par bris pa dge'o//dge'o//sarba maṅga lo dza yaskyo/ ༄ga /'bras ljongs stag rtse'i gsol mchod/r+ghaṃske/ rang byung rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /thugs rje chen pos byin rlabs sbas pa'i yul/ /dpal gyi 'bras mo ljongs dang skyid mo lung / /yon tan phug dang rgyal chen khyung lding gi/ /mdzod lnga stag rtse sku lha dpal rdzong dang / /se rin gangs chen mu le gangs btsan sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag dang / /sgo bsrung 'phrang bsrung dam can pho nyar bcas/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ /'dir gshegs phyi nang gsang mchod gtor ma bzhes/ /dam can rnams kyi ci bsam 'dod pa'i don/ /thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /r+ghaṃske/ pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan ni/ /btsan gyi jag pa dmar po zhes/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal/ /yab yum sras blon mched 'khor bcas/ /sngon tshe pad+ma rta mchog pad+ma dbang / /bar du gnub chen yab sras dang / /phyi nang sgrub bsnyes skyes mchog gis/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bca' bzhin/ /skad cig yud kyi 'dir gshegs la/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dam rdzas gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las ni/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las/ /mtha' dag thogs pa med pa ru/ /skad cig nyid la 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ tri sum̐ tri/ kye/rgyal ba'i bka' nyan nges don bstan pa la/ /rnam par dad pa nyang stod ru mtshams lha/ /dge bsnyen bzang ra dkar po go mtshon can/ /rtse gsum ne'u 'dzin nas rta dkar zhon/ /mched sras btsun mo blon po 'khor dang bcas/ /rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyi bka' bgos ltar/ /'dir gshegs phyi nang gsang mchod gtor ma bzhes/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor ci bsam 'dod pa'i don/ /thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ / 374

bh+yo/ dpal ri bsam lding ri dgu 'dus pa'i rtse/ /jo mo phur thang rin chen rtse dgu'i dbyibs/ /shel gyi gur phub sprin dkar 'ja' tshon bkra/ /gnas bdag ma mo rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ /phyi ltar sman mo mda' dar me long bsnams/ /nang ltar rnal 'byor ting shag nor bu bsnams/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /chibs su sha rkyang rus sbal mgo dgu chibs/ /'khor bcas dam ldan rnal 'byor sgrub po'i grogs/ /ma thogs myur ba nyid du da tshur byon/ /sngon tshe mkha' 'gro seng ge gdong can dang // pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' ma nyams par/ /'dir gshegs rin chen spung gyi gdan la bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig gcig pas phyag bya zhing / /('di nas ma dpe ldeb ma gcig chad/)

khog /mnga' ris mar yul sku lha mched gsum gyi gsol mchod 'dod don kun 'grub lha yi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /r+ghaṃske/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje phrin las kun/ /gcig bsdus mtsho skyes pad+ma badz+ra rtsal /'gran pa'i zla med che ba'i che mchog de'i/ /bdag cag rnams la byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ āḥrgyu badz+ra sa ma ya gu ru pad+ma sidhi r+ghaṃ/ rdu bh+yoḥ mi mjed 'dzam gling byang phyogs pur rgyal bod/ /rnam gsum stod gyur mnga' ri ti se'i nub/ /mar yul ljongs su gnas bcas lha chen po/ /mthu ldan sku lha zhes grags mched gsum ni//gcig ni skyid ljongs gcig ni khu nu dang //gcig ni mar yul rong gi ri la ste/ /rigs ni che btsun lha dang drang srong bdud/ /ma sangs gnyan las 'chad pa klu gnyan tshul/ /gcig ni dar dkar thod bcings mdung ring dang / /mig 'phreng rnams nas rta dkar gzi mig chibs/ /gcig ni dar nag thod bcings ru mtshon dag / /gser phur 'dril zhing bra nag rgur 'gros chibs/ /gcig ni dar khra'i thod can mdung dar dang / /bswe yi ga'i bsnams nas rta sngon zhon/ /gsum ka gcig dang 'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mnga' rir bzhugs tshe sku la mched gsum dang / /bar khams phyogs su 'bangs rje mched gsum grags/ /rgya nag khri sgor skyes bu mched gsum ste/ /yid ltar mgyogs pas skad cig 'dzam gling nyul/ /mi brdzu dgu brdzu cho 'phrul sna tshogs bdag /rang rang btsun mo sras blon ru 'dren dang / /'khor g.yog bran dang bcas te ma lus kun/ /sngon tshe gsang bdag pad+ma he ru ka /khyad par dpal chen rdo rje gro lod kyi/ /dbang bskur dam bzhag sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bskos/ /de tshe rang rtags srog phul dam bca' blangs/ /de rjes rig 'dzin grub thob du ma yi/ /spyan sngar sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dam yang bcas—/ /sngon gyi dam bca' ji bzhin ma g.yel bar/ /khyed mchod bdag gi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /skad cig yud tsam 'dir gshegs dgyes bzhugs la/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman g.ya' gangs chuske/ /shing sna'i dud pa phye mar 'brang rgyas dang / /g.yag lug ra gzugs 'bras chang g.yang dkar sha /ja chang gser skyems rin chen phye ma sogs/ /dngos 'byor ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yi/ /nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs pa 'di/ /'bul gyi dgyes bzhes bdag cag sbyin bdag bcas/ /gang zhig mi shes dbang gis khyed rnams kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal kun mthol bshags bzod bzhes la/ /'dir 'dus bsrung skyobs tshe bsrings dpal yang bskyed/ /mchod yon dpon g.yog rtag 'grogs bde zhing skyid/ /376

bsam don yid bzhin 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal khams spyi yang nad mug mtshon 'khrug zhi/ /gangs can rgyal po'i tshe bsod dbang thang 'phel/ /chos bzhin khrims spyod rgyal khams bde skyid rgyas/ /rgyal blon bla slob kun kyang mdza' zhing gshis/ /thams cad dga' bde dpal gyi yongs 'tsho zhing / /rtag tu bkra shis don grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes mnga' ris mar yul sku lha mched gsum gyi gsol mchod 'dod don kun 'grub lha yi rol mo zhes bya ba 'di yang gnam sa'i dbang phyug dga' ldan pho brang gi stod mnga' ri skor gsum gyi phrin las kyi byed por dbang bskur ba sgar dpon dad pa can mchong rgyas zhol khang ba badz+ra bi dza ya dang / rong dkyil stod pa pu ṣ+yo lasgra dag gis gsung gi bskul ba la rten dpal gdongs chu bya rgyud rtsis kyi dbyug zla'i dpar tshes dga' ba gsum par ma pham khrus sgo shar du bho ṭa dzo gi ha ri nā thas skad cig mar smras pa dge'o//dge'o//༄ga /bzhes 'bod nyams pa'i srog gcod spu gri 'bar ba bzhugs/ho dgongs su gsol lo/ ho dgongs su gsol lo/ ho dgongs su gsol lo/ dgu ldan rgyal ba rtsa brgyud bla ma/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam zhi khro/ /ldan zhing sngags kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ /'dir byon dgongs pa gnad nas bskul lo/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus tshom bu dgu rdzogs/ /yi dam bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor dgu ldan/ /mkha' 'gro phag khros gsang ye'i lha tshogs/ /'dir byon dgongs pa gnad nas bskul lo/ /bla ma zhi drag phyi nang gsang ba/ /yi dam dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu/ /mkha' 'gro seng gdong bdud 'dul drag mo/ /'dir byon dgongs pa gnad nas bskul lo/ /ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /dpal mgon ma ning yab yum sras 'khor/ /zhing skyong legs grub yab yum sras 'khor/ /e ka tsa ṭi ma mo 'khor bcas/ /'di byon dgongs pa gnad nas bskul lo/ /bde mchog rnam sprul dur bdag yab yum/ /las byed dregs pa 'bar ba spun bdun/ /khro gtum ging chen rdo rje legs pa/ /'dir byon dgongs pa gnad nas bskul lo/ /sde dpon sum cu dregs chen bco brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad rgyud bsrung gnyan bsrung / /gnas bsrung gter bdag phyogs skyong zhing skyong / /'dir byon dgongs pa gnad nas bskul lo/ /khyed rnams thugs rje thugs dam gnad nas bskul te/ /gal 'gag g.yel med phrin las myur 'gyogs bsgrub rgyur/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang bla ma'i sku la sdang byed/ /chos min kha phyogs chos mdzad bsgrub la 'tshe mi/ /gtsug lag dge 'dun bla ma'i nor la rngams mi chos mdzad longs spyod ri khrod yo byad rlom mi/ /bla ma'i phyag rdzas 'phri gzhogs zur du bkod mi/ /dkor cha 377

'phrog bcom 'jab dang blang kun byed mi/ /bka' 'das bka' brku dbang chod tshod yod byed mi/ /ngos shag klog lab tho cho rdzun ham byed mi/ /'gro mgo bud 'jug kha nang snying phyir rgyu mi/ /ngo log rgyab stan mna' zan khas blang dor mi/ /snying nye'i grogs bslu gsang 'chal ngan sgrogs byed mi/ /grwa 'khor blo log dam tshig ngos klog byed mi/ /chang bcad lkog 'thung ngan mtshang 'geb res byed mi/ /khrims la mi gnas spyod ngan rjes su phyogs mi/ /sgrub pa'i gegs byed kha dkar zhe nag byed mi/ /log lta sdug 'chang chos kyi khrims 'gal byed mi/ /bstan dang bla ma'i sku dgrar bsrung bzlog byed mi/ /dpon slob mthun gnyis phra mas mi mthun bkrug mi/ /dge ba'i blo bshol mi dge'i log lam bskul mi/ /legs na mi dga' nyes na dga' bar byed mi/ /dgra jag chom rkun dmag gros sbyor ngan 'chang mi/ /bsam ngan dug sbyor gshom shing mtshon rtse brtad mi/ /ri khrod dben pa gtsug lag dgon sde bcom mi/ /bdag dang yon bdag bar sel 'gal rkyen gzhug mi/ /chos mthun la sdang sgom dgra log par bsgyur mi/ /bla mar 'tshang bru log lta ngan dpyad byed mi/ /mdzad spyod 'phya khrel log mthong sgro bkur 'debs mi/ /skur brdo las rgya log g.yem rigs la snyegs mi/ /le'u lha log chung ma snying ring byed mi/ /bde tshig khyad du bsad nas g.yel bar bor mi/ /bdag la rbad 'dre rbod gtong byed mi rnams dang / /nyams pa bdun btogs zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo/ /khyad par slob bu dam la log pa rnams kyi/ /tshe srog bla dbugs snying dang snying khrag bcas pa/ /thams cad skye brgyud dang bcas lhag lus med par/ /lo zlar ma 'gyangs do nub dung skad 'di dang / /mnyam du bzhes shig rol cig kha kha khā hi khā hi bzhes/ bzhes/ bzhes/ zhes grong rgyu'i sngags nag tshe dbang nor bu zhes sdang rdo rjes/ dpal be'u lung du chu stag sbrul rta'i nyer dgur bris pa'i dge legs 'phel bar shog /bkra shis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dgon sde grwa tshan mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi tshe dbang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig sarba puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye ṭ+wā hā//378

tshog /rgya nag hwa shang gi byung tshul grub mtha'i phyogs snga bcas sa bon tsam smos pa yid kyi dri ma dag byed dge ba'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bcom pa 'od srung chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nye bar 'dzin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu 'dul mkhas sgyu 'phrul sras de yis/ /gdul bya rnams kyi mos bsam dang mthun par/ /theg pa'i thabs tshul bsam gyi mi khyab bstan/ /kun kyang thar par gzhol mdzad 'dir rmad byung / /'phags yul badhe bal por bha tan+ta/ /bod du btsun pa rgya nag hwa shang zhes/ /tha dad ming las don du ldog pa cig /kun kyang thub bstan rjes 'brang kho nar zad/ /'on kyang bod yul 'di na mkhas rmongs phalaske/ /phyogs snga ma long tshig tsam la zhen nas/ /hwa shang grub mtha' mu stegs byed pa yi/ /tshul dang 'dra bar 'gog 'di chos spang nges/ /sprul sku lo paṇa mkhas pas yul dus la/ /dgos pa khyad 'phags yod pa la dgongs nas/ /dgag sgrub tshul tsam mdzad la mngon zhon te/ /bdag gi chos spang sgrib bsags ma gyur cig /bod 'di snga phyi kun tu nyan thos kyi/ /sde pa bzhi las yod smra kho na las/ /sdom rgyun gzhan rnams bkag pa rtsod pa'i rgyur/ /dgongs las sde pa gzhan rnams skyon can min/ /des na chos mig rdul bral ma thob par/ /chos rnams mtshan nyid shin tu rtogs dka' bas/ /thub bstan theg chen chos tshul sna tshogs par/ /dad gus bskyed pa'i yul las gzhan ci zhig /'on kyang chos kyi gnad rnams la 'chugs par| /dam pa'i zhal lung rgyud ldan nyan pa las/ /rtsal bshad blo bzos chos kyi gnad nyams pa/ /de tshul ring du dor bar rgyal bas bsngags/ /de yang ma hā tsi na zhes/ ma hā ni chen po dang / tsi na la yi ge bsnan na don sna tshogs su 'jug par snang yang kha cig gi yid yang bsgyur mod/ gzhan yang gsal ba dang / sna tshogs dang / /ri mor yang 'jug pa'i skabs yod mod kyang bod rnams kyi 'dod rgyal gyi ming rgya nag zhes su btags pa der sgyu 'phrul sras po'i bstan pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i btsun pa'i ming du hwa shang zhes spyir brjod cing de la bye brag tu sngon theg pa che chung mtha' dag dar kyang da lta'i skabs phal cher rgyu yi theg pa chen po dang /bya spyod sogs sngags rgyud thun mong tsam la spyod pa shas che zhing / de la nang tshan 379

bye brag tu da lta bod kyi 'dod pa dang cha mthun par zab mo lta ba/ rgya chen spyod pa nyams len bsgom pa'i srol rgyun dang gsum yod par grags mod/ de la dang po zab mo lta ba'i rgyud pa ni/ ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon mthing mig can/ 'di zla grags kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin skad kyang zla grags yin par dka'/ de nas rje legs ldan 'byed/ rje pradzñā rasmi/rgya nag slob dpon dzñā na shrī/ rje 1 na ma dhi/ de nas rgya yul grags che ba 'phags yul kyi shing rta chen po dang dod mtshungs pa hwa shang ṭi ce dā shi thā wang ste tshul khrims dang byang chub kyi sems dang shes rab dang mngon par shes pa chen po mnga' bas 'dul bya gdul ba la lhag par mkhas pa yul de'i mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba'i mi ma yin yang bkar btags nas chos skyong bar bskos shing rgya nag gi sa skyong ba chen po/thi gur gyi rgyal rab gnyis dang / pus rgyal po wan dhe'i gtsug gi nor bur bkur ba yi phrin las dpe med pas dge 'dun gyi gnas chen po gnyis dang / chung ba gsum cu rtsa drug 'debs par mdzad cing chos las skyes pa'i slob ma yang rgyud pa'i srol 'dzin pa sum cu rtsa gnyis sdom pa thob pa chig khri bzhi stong —/ chos kyi 'bral thob grangs med pa bskrun par mdzad cing / /gsung rab rin po che'i spyi 'chings du dus tshigs lnga dang 'jug sgo brgyad zhes rnam par bzhag cing / de yang dus tshig lnga la sdong po bkod pa'i dus ri dwags tshul gyi dus/shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i dus/sher phyin gyi dus/ myang 'das gyi dus dang lnga ste/ sgo brgyad ni/ ton med cig char 'jug pa'i sgo/ ci yan man rim gyis 'jug pa'i sgo/ bī mi gsang ba thun min gyi sgo/ de bzhin ma nges pa'i sgo/ sde snod kyi sgo/ rig pa'i sgo/ rnam par dbye ba'i sgo/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo ste brgyad do/ /gzhan yang chos dbyings 'jug pa sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ /'di rgya nag tu byung ba'i dus ni wan gi nas yun mi ring tsam/ rgyal rabs gsum gyi mthar chen po thang la rgyal khams 'jags pa yin par snang bas slob dpon thang zan tsang las mi thog gcig tsam gyi snga ba kho nar nges so/ /de ltar slob dpon chen po de yi rgyud 'dzin sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ba'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa pa ṭang an tsun ce h+pha ru wa tsun ce/ rung yang thi'an kung tsung ce nyin ṣi tsun ce/ de nas rim pas thi'an thi' tsung ces rgya nag lho ki'ang nan gyi phyogs su dar ba dang / rgya nag byang ṭung yu'un gyi phyogs su ṭi ce yab sras nas/ dhī pun h+phu zhun dā shi'/ yun hu wa ṭi yan dā shi'/ ṣi'an shi'u h+pha tsa dā shi'/ching li'ang cheng ku'an kwa shi'/ ku'i haṅga cung mi dā shi'i/ de nyid grangs su byas pa'i mi rabs nyer gcig pa lu an phu tha'i h+pha shi'/ zhes ri bo rtse lngar rje btsun byams pa dngos su mjal nas chos nyan par grags pa dang / de yi slob ma yi ki'ang ṭin li h+pha shi'/ de nas yu we chu'an ṭin ching kwa shi'/ de nyid the ba'i mi rabs bzhi pa da lta rgya nag rgyal po'i pho brang po'i king gi phyogs su hwa shang yongs kyi bla ma zhan 380

kwa ku'an ku'ang wen hwa shang zhes yod par grags la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ 'di bar slob dpon rabs bzhi bcu thams pa byung ba yin zer gang ltar rgya nag tu da lta dar rgyas che ba'i skabs su snang / gnyis pa rgya chen spyod pa'i srol 'dzin ni/ ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyal ba mi pham pa/ slob dpon thogs med| gcung dbyig gnyen/ slob dpon dharma rak+ṣi ta/ slob dpon nan+daḥ slob dpon dul ba bzang po'am/dul ba lha yang zer ba dgung lo brgya dang drug bzhes pa'i skabs su rgya nag yul nas lo tsā na chen po thang zan tsang ste thang sde snod gsum par grags pa mkhas pa chen po de yi thugs de la ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa ni bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' yang 'dir rgyas par brir ma longs la/ dus ni bod kyi rgyal po 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po dang rags rtsis su mtshungs te/ thang gi rgyal rabs gnyis pa thang tha dzung rgyal po'i rigs kyi gcung yin par yang grags/ de yi slob ma ṣ+ṭan ṭang h+pha shi' de nas khu'i ki h+pha shi'i/ de la gong du zab mo lta rgyud du bshad pa'i yun hu wa ṭi yan dā sha'i dang / ṣi'an shi'u sogs nas shing rta gnyis chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pa skad do/ /gong du bshad pa'i dul lha dang dul sde rgya nag chos 'byung du cig par mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/lo rgyus gzhan du dbyig gnyen nas 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ des mchog sde/ des dul ba'i sde zhes pa ni rgyal po seng ge lnga pa'i skabs su byung ba yin la thang zan tsang gi bla ma dul lha ni rgya gar gyi rgyal po go bi tsan+d+ra'i skabs su grags che bar gyur pa'i slob dpon yin par snang ngo / /gsum pa nyams len bsgom pa'i rgyud pa ni hwa shang bstan 'dzin mkhan po tsung men du grags pa'i sde tshan rnams ste/ de yi rgyud pa'i rim pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bstan pa'i gtad rab kyi tshul las 'byung ba ste/ de yang ci ltar zhe na mkhas mchog bu ston dang 'gos ku ma ra shrī sogs kyi chos kyi deb ther rnams su yang bkod par mdzad pa dang / rgya nag gi lo rgyus su yang de dang mthun par snang la/ de ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/dgra bcom pa 'od srung la bstan pa gtad/ des dgra bcom pa kun dga' bo/ /des dgra bcom pa nyi ma'i gud pa dang / dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can gyis dgra bcom pa nyer sbas/ des dgra bcom pa dha dhi ka des dgra bcom pa nag po/ des dgra bcom pa legs mthong dang / bi bha ga gnyis dgra bcom pa bi bha ga nas/ des btsun pa chen po ban n+de/ des btsun pa chen po burtse mi tra/ des dgra bcom pa rtsibs log des 'phags pa su na sha ta des 'phags pa/ des phag pa sta skad/ des 'phags pa ma shi ba/ des 'phags pa chen po klu sgrub/ des 'phags pa ar+ya de wa/ des 'phags pa ra hu la/ des saṅga nan+de 'phags des dge slong dgra bcom pa gha la sha des ku ma ra ta/ de sha ya ta/ des ba su bskyo/ des mngon ta/ des ha ka li ka sha des dge slong seṅge/ zhes pa yan rgya bod kyis gtad rabs yi ge mthun/ de yan chad rgya nag 381

chos 'byung du 'byung ste/ dge slong seng ge nas 'phags pa bha sh+ya sidha/ des bi shwa mi tra/ des pra tsā dhā ra des bho dhe dharmot+ta ra ste byang chub chos kyi bla mar grags pa de yan chad rgya gar du byung la/ de nas bho dhe dharmosta ra yi rgya dkar du bi shwa mi tra phyi ma la bstan pa gtad nas thog mar rgya nag lho phyogs rgyal bu'i pho brang ki'ang nan du rgyal po li yang u dhe'i gam du byon/ rgyal blon rnams la dam pa'i chos ci rigs pa 'chad kyang zab don ston pa'i gdul byar ma gyur dgongs te rgya nag byang phyogs su yo gur du phebs pa'i lam gyi ki'ang klung chu gter ltar mi bzo pa 'phyo ba'i steng du 'de bu'i rtswa 'dabs ma lnga pa zhig la zhabs rnam par bkod de rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs pas chu klung der dmag dpon zhig gru la zhon te 'gro bas tshul de mthong nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ de nas yu gur gyi yul du zho'u len zi dgon par re zhig sbas tshul gyis bzhugs/ mthar rgya nag gi hwa shang hu'i khe dang yu gur gyi btsun pa gsum gyi nye bar bsnyen te slob mar gyur de las don rgyud kyi bstan pa ni hwa shang hu'i khe gcig pur gtad de bdag gi gtsang klung brgal dus brdzis pa'i 'dam bu lo ma lnga yod pa'i rten 'brel gyi khyod las cig rgyud kyi gtad rabs lnga pa nas mang por 'phel/ de yang tshugs thub kyi sde pa lngar 'gyur zhes bka' stsal nas yul der mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan cing / slar yang rgya gar du byon te skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang pos mjal ba sogs don du gdos bcas kyi phung po rnam par dag ste 'chi ba med pa'i sku brnyes pa zhig go//de yang slob dpon chen po 'di rgya nag yul du phebs pa'i skabs ni rgyal po li yang u dhe'i dus su yin par snang na li yang udhe nas rgyal rigs gsum gyi yun mi ring tsam byas pa'i rgyal rabs brgyad tsam byung zhing de yi mthar chen po thang gi rgyal rigs kyi dbu bsnyes par grags pas de tshe bod kyi la so gnam ri srong btsan gyi mes 'brong gnyen lde ru rgyal por gyur pa'am rgyal por gyur nye ba'i skabs tsam yin par sems so/ /gang ltar slob dpon de yi rgya nag tu slob ma'i mchog bstan pa gtad pa'i gnas hwa shang hu'i khe da tsu chan shi' yi bstan pa gtad pa'i slob ma ni seng tshan ki'an ṭi chan shi' yin la/des hung bzhin dā man chan shi'/ des lu tsu hu'i ne nga dā ki'an chan shi'i sde de ltar hwa shang chig rgyud mi rabs lnga song ba hu'i ne nga nas srol 'dzin mang du 'phel ba las/ rang tshugs thub pa'i bka' babs ma lnga byung ste lin gyi dang tshi dung dang yun man dang we'i yan dang / h+pha yan dang lngar gyes pa las da lta'i skabs su ni lin gyi tsho dung gnyis las phyi ma gsum gyi rgyud 'dzin ni med skad la/ de yang deng sang grub brgyud kyi bstan pa grags che ba lin gyi nas rgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ gong gi lū tshu hu'i hwa shang nan po hu wa'i bzha' chan shi' dang / des yi tsu dwa'u yi chan shi'/ des pe ṭa mi 'o'u ṣing chan shi'/ des hu'ang 382

po'i ṣi yun chan shi'/ des lin gyi iṣā'an chan shi'/ de nyid the ba'i mi rabs sum cu/ rtsa bzhi pa ni da lta grub brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed du bzhugs pa'i slob dpon thi yo'u me'i ming ting chan shi' 'tsho zhing bzhes pa khong la thug pa'i bar dharmo nas brgyud rabs/ bzhi bcu zhe bzhi byon pa yin no zhes/ /rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang gi me 'brug lor rgya nag yul gyi lo tsā wa ching gir gur nā tha sha ra ṇa bkod pa'i rgya nag chos 'byung / las 'byung la de ltar na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rjes su da lta'i bar brgyud pa rab bdun cu rtsa gsum ste/ nyi ma'i gung pa dang legs mthong yang na bar byas pas bdun cu rtsa gcig go/ /rgya nag chos 'byung du nyer sbas kyi slob ma nyi ma'i gung par bshad pa ni/ sde pa tha dad kyi 'dod tshul lam phal cher lo rgyus ma dag pa nyid do/ /gang ltar bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam grangs su byas pa de rnams mchog tu gyur pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan nas da lta la thug gi bar bstan pa'i gtad rabs kyi rjes su 'bral zhing rjes su mthun pa bsgom pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo chad pa med par bskar ba byin brlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams shing myong bsgom pa'i yon tan thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i rgya nag hwa shang gzhan las mchog dang phul gyur pa zhig go//bod sngags rnying pa'i man ngag kha cig gi khungs su sprul pa'i sku rgya gar bdun brgyud dang / rgya nag bdun brgyud zhes bsgrang ba'i rgya nag bdun brgyud ni tsung men du grags pa 'di yi sde tshan kho nar nges la/ de yang slob dpon dharmosgyu ra ma bsgrang ba hwa shang hu'i khe nas ma hā ya na'i bar don brgyud kyi bla rabs bdun byung ba la sprul pa bdun brgyud du rnam par bzhag gi sems shing / lo paṇa bka' yi thang yig las/ bcom ldan 'das sku mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus: chos kyi tha ma dri bas the tshom bcad: mya ngan 'da' ba'i gzhung 'di bstan pa yin: dpe don mang po 'od srung nyid la gsungs: de nas dharmosgyu ra la sogs nas: rgya nag sprul bdun brgyud pa brgyud pa'i tha:hā shang ma hā ya na nyid la thug: 'od srung cig car 'jug pa phal chen sde: mkhan po dharmosgyu ra li brgyud ni: shar gyi phyogs su rgya mtsho rgal nas phyin/ rgya yul li kun zhes bya'i yul du slebs: zhes dang / bo ti dharmoskyo ra'i brgyud 'dzin ni: tha ma hwa shang ma hā ya na'i gzhung : cig char 'jug pa yongs su rdzogs pa yis: dpe don mang po mdo sde'i gzhung la thug:de dag 'dod gzhung yi ge yod pa dang : dharmosta ra'i rgya lung chen mo rnams: ci yang byar med man ngag snyan khung brgyud: zhes sogs gsungs pas kyang nges pa bskyed par snang ngo / /hwa shang ma hā ya na bod du byung ba'i dus ni rgyal rabs sogs lo rgyus mang zhig tu khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku tshe'i tha mar yin par bshad kyang de skabs kyi lo rgyus mi 'dra ba mang zhing grub mtha'i dbang gi bslad yang ci rigs bsres par rtogs mod/ des na lo rgyus khung dang ldan pa kha cig tu ma hā ya na bod rje mes ag tshom can gyi sku 383

tshe'i tha ma la phyogs pa'i skabs su bod du byon zhing / lha khri srong lde'u btsan sku nar ma son pa'i dus su bod blon chos la gnag pa rnams kyi rgya nag tu brdzangs bar grags pa 'di don la gnas par mthong zhing ske/ de skabs blon po chos la dkar ba rba gsal snang sogs kyi bla mar bkur zhing bsgom lung zhus pa dang —/ myang ting 'dzin bzang pos kyang hwa shang la bsgom lung zhus par lo rgyus kha cig nas gsungs na de yang 'di skabs nyid du mngon/ /des na slob dpon ka ma la shi la dang rtsod par byed pa po ni hwa shang ma hā ya na'i slob ma'i skabs tsam du 'grig la/ 'on kyang sku tshe ring du bzhugs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs gcig pa yin srid pa'i gnas tsam du gnang ngo / /gzhan bod kyi rje bo 'od 'phro'i sa la bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i bsam gtan mig gi bsam gtan 'grel las hwa shang tan+tu yin gyi grub mtha'i rnam par bzhag pa de yi mkhan chen po nyu shu rtsa lnga gyi gsung lung du drangs nas zhib mor bshad par mdzad pa ste/ dgos pa ni rdzogs chen dang cha 'dra bas mi nor ba'i ched du yin par gsung ba dang / hwa shang gi chos de yang yang dag pa'i lam du bzhed pa'o/ /lung khung mkhan chen nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam byung ba ni mkhan 'ba' zhig bsgrang ba ni min nam snyam mo/ /de nas hwa shang zhes pa gong du bstan bzhin spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin par ma zad sgos theg pa chen po dang de yi nang tshan nas kyang bho dhe dharmadhā ra'i rjes 'brang tsung men ni bka' 'khor lo gsum pa nges don snying po'i mdo sde la brten pa'i don bsgom kho na la phyogs par 'dod cing / lam gyi ngo bo ni mdo lung 'ba' zhig go zhes mkhas pa'i mkhas pa mchog gi gsung mod/ des na mdo yi rang lam cig pu'i ni dbang rnon yang bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyi mthar byang chub chen po brnyes pa las gzhan ma yin no snyam na/ de yang mtha' gcig tu 'gog par mi nus ste phyis byang chub gi mkhas pa'i dbang po'i deb ther du rgya gar gyi slob dpon ye shes grags pas mdzad pa'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i lung 'di skad drangs te/ pha rol du phyin pa la mngon par brtson pa'i dbang po rab ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bsgom pas so so skye bo'i gnas skabs nyid na phyag rgya chen po dang nges par ldan pa yang dag par rtogs pas phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags nyid dang / zhes gsungs pas phyogs 'di la mi 'jug pa yang ma yin gyi/ de bzhin nges don snying po'i mdo sde mya ngan las 'das pa chen po rgya nag 'gyur las/ de bas na shin tu thabs mkhas pas mdo sde 'di la brtson 'grus du/ nan byas na skyes bu de ni ring por mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang mdo lam rang gi bsgom rim khyad par bas dus yun ring por mi thogs par sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i go skabs ni yod par go dgos so/ /de yang brtson pa khyad par can gyi bskal chen drug cu sogs kyis tshogs bzlum par nus na/ shes khyad 384

par can bsgom pa rmad du byung bas tshogs lhag par bzlum nus pa yang rgyu mtshan du mas shes par gyur pa'o| /'on kyang mdo lam 'ba' zhig gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'grub par gsungs pa mtha' dag dgongs pa can ste don du ni phal cher 'phags lam sa brgyad pa dang mthar thug bcu pa las lhag mdo lam 'ba' zhig gis nam yang bsgrod par mi nus la/ de nas nges par sngags lam la 'jug dgos kyi mi 'jug pa yang mi srid ste/ 'di ni mdo nas gsal bar ma bshad pa don nges pa'i grub mtha' ru rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi legs par bkral bzhin pa'o/ /des na tshul des mdo lam gyi sangs rgyas thob pa med na sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa dang ci ltar 'gal snyams na de ni skyon yod pa ma yin ste thog mar tshogs sbyor gyi lam mdo lam 'ba' zhig pas bsgrod nas sa dang po thob pa'i skabs su sngags lam la 'jug par shas che zhing gal te tshul ston gyi dbang gi sa brgyad pa'i bar du mi 'jug pa dag yod srid kyang sa brgyad pa nas gzhan rkyen la ltos pa ma yin par sngags kyi ngang tshul rang stobs kyi shes bzhin du 'jug tu yod pa yin pas des na mdo lam du sngags la 'jug dgos so zhes ma bstan kyang sa brgyad pa yan chad nas ngang gi shes pa'i dbang gi lam ma tshang ba dang chad pa'i go skabs med la/ gzhan yang thog ma'i 'jug sgo mdo sngags gang yin kyang rung mthar sngags la gzhol dgos pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob tshe mdo sngags tha dad kyi sangs rgyas dbye ru med pa'i phyir de ltar dgongs te gsungs pas skyon med pa'o/ /lar tshul 'di rgya cher bshad du yod cing dgos pa yang che rung skabs 'dir ni dogs bslang zur tsam de las spros ma dgos so/ /gzhan yang 'di ru brjod par bya ba sngon chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i skabs su ton men du tse ya man zhes su grags pa ni rgya nag gi skad de/ bod skad du cig car du 'jug pa dang rim gyis su 'jug pa zhes yin par snang la/ de yang cig char 'jug pa ni thos bsam gyi bya ba gzhan gtso bor mi byed pa rnam pa kun tu bsam gtan don bsgom lhu ru blangs pa ste/ da lta yang rgya nag tu bstan 'dzin mkhan hwa shang tsung men rnams tshul de kho na yin 'dug la/ bod 'dir yang yang btsun pa dang khyim pa ris su med par sems khrid nod do zhes thog ma nas zab mo nang don la gzhol bar 'dod pa phal cher 'di rnams kyang de dang cha mthun pa las gzhan du ma dmigs so/ /rim gyis 'jug pa rnams ni thos pa'i shes rab kyi phyi yi sgro 'dogs bcad cing de nas bsam pa'i shes rab kyi nang gi sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang / de nas bsgom pa'i shes rab kyi bar gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa ste/ /thos bsam sgom gsum la rim gyis 'jug par bzhed de| rdzogs chen nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las spyod pa bdun rim can du gsung ba dang gnad gcig go/ /de yang tshul 'di gang zag dbang po'i khyad par gyi gdod nas cig char dang rim gyis 'jug par grags pa 385

las rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang ṭi ce dā shi' thā wan gyi 'jug sgo brgyad du grags pa'i grub mtha'i nang tshan de bod du byung nas de ltar grags pa ni ma yin no/ /des na sngon rgya gar mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho yi rjes su 'brang ba badhe chen po ye shes dbang po la sogs pas shes rab gsum bsgrags mar mdzad pa la brten rim gyis pa dang rgya nag mkhan po ma hā ya na'i rjes 'brang rnams kyi bsam gtan kho na la gzhol bas cig char bar grags pa shes par bya'o/ /'di la kha cig 'di snyam du sems te hwa shang gi lta ba rnam par dag pa ma yin par sngon lha btsad po byang chub sems dpa'i skabs su rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma shī la dang bod kyi sba ye shes dbang po dang dpal dbyangs sogs dam par gyur pa rnams kyi bkag par mdzad pa dang / phyis kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ga' yi yang 'gog par mdzad na tshad mar ga la rung snyam na spyir yang rtsod pa byung tsam gyi dam pa'i chos ma yin par mi 'gyur te nyan thos sde pa tha dad pa dang theg chen sems tsam rnams bden rdzun dang rang rgyud thal 'gyur rnams cig gi cig la rtsod kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam dag nyid du nges pas kyang grub la/ sngon lha btsad po'i skabs su ma 'ongs brtsod pa 'byung bar dgongs nas nyan thos kyang gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba las gzhan 'jug par ma gnang zhing sngags nang rgyud thun min rnams kyang shin tu gsang ba chen po'i sgo nas spyod pa las thun mong bsgyur bar ma gnang ba dang / de bzhin rgya nag hwa shang gi lta bsgom la de skabs nyid du skyon gyi cha shas yod par gzigs pa dang / lhag tu ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus na lta bsgom de la brten nas 'khrul pa mang du skye ba dang grub mtha' phan tshun sde ris kyi rtsod pa'i mi nges pa chen po 'byung ba sprul pa'i sku lo paṇa chos rgyal de rnams kyi mngon shes rgya chen pos mkhyen cing gzigs nas 'gog pa gor ma chags kyi hwa shang gi lta bsgom de gtan nas nor te 'gog pa ni ma yin par shes so/ /de skabs kyi dgag sgrub kyang rtsod ngor khas blang ba shas che ste ci phyir hwa shang gi 'dod gzhung du spang bya 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog tu khas blang ba dang / bsgrub bya mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ci la yang mi rtog mi sems mi dpyod mi dmigs pa la bo gzhol bar 'dod pa dang ci yang mi dran zhes 'byung ba yang rnam rtog la dran pa'i ming btags pa ste don du rnam par mi rtog pa nyid dang sgra don gcig zhing yang dag pa'i dran pa nyams pa la zhugs pa ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin lam gyi grogs tshul khrims snying brtse yi spyod lam bsdu dngos bzhi rnam dag la spyod pa yin zhes grags na de tshe bod yul gyi nang don 'jog bsgom pa spyi mi 'dod pa yang khyad chos sngags lam gyis brgyan pa yod na ma gtogs gzhan bsgom rim sems kyi 'jog stangs ni hwa shang gi 'dod pa de nam yang bzlog par mi nus te/ ci phyir nang don 'jog bsgom gyi gzhung las yid la mi byed pa dang mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad mi bsgom mi yengs rnam par mi rtog pa'i 386

ngang la bzhag zhes pa yang gong du brjod pa nyid dang tshig don gnyis ka nas mi mthun pa med pa'i phyir roske/ /des na bod yul 'dir don bsgom pa rnams la grags che ba rgya gar gyi gzhung la ma na sa'i man ngag spyir btang dang / rgya nag mkhan po'i bsam gtan gyi 'jug sgo gnyis phal cher mi mthun pa med do/ /gzhan phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung dngos gzhi chen po sa ra ha yi dwo ha yi dgongs pa ni don bsgom gyi gzhi snga ma dang mthun pa las byed par gyi chos spyir mang du yod mod kyang skabs 'dir 'chad 'os pa'i snying po ni 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po'i ye shes rdo rje'i gsung lasaske/ sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo shes pa dang / lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang / snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes rtsal ba 'phags bod kyi phyag rgya chen po bslad med kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa'i bshad par snang la/ tshul de lta dwo ha yi dgongs pa bslad bral dang / rdzogs chen sems phyogs kyi man ngag tshad ldan dag gnad gcig tu 'bab pa las tha dad du 'dzin par mi nus so/ /'on kyang dus phyis byung du gang zag chos la dbang za bas rang bzo bsre bslad mang pos sngon gyi man ngag rnying pa rnams 'tshongs 'dus kyi 'o ma las kyang zong che bar byas pa mang dag mthong na de rnams kyi ngang tshul ni nyes pa chos kyi gnad bcos te phyin ci log gi g.yang sar 'phyan pa bdud kyi gsang tshig tu gyur pa dang / legs pa srin bu'i shul rjes kyi yi ge'i gzugs ltar snang ba dag la dpyad par mi nus shing dpyad par byar yang mi long bas dus snyigs ma'i ('di nas ma dpe ldeb bu gcig chad 'dug)shig 'dir gdams pa bya'o/ /spyir ni rgya nag gi yul du hwa shang dang zin shing dang gzhu ston ste lugs srol gtso che ba gsum dang / gzhan yang grub mtha' rnam grangs du ma zhig yod par snang ba las ha shang ni nang pa sangs rgyas kyi grub mtha' bslad med dang / gzhan phal che ba phyi rol grangs can gyi grub mtha' sogs dang cha mthun zhing / kha cig ni kla klo'i grub mtha' dang 'dres par yang snang ngo / /de ltar rgya nag hwa shang rnams 'phags yul gyi grub mtha' las ci ltar gyes pa'i tshul dang / rgya nag bstan 'dzin mkhan rnams kyi lam rim la dpyad pa dogs bslang sa bon dang bcas pa 'di ni rba bzhed yi ge khung ldan las rgya nag mkhan po'i 'dod pa dang / ka ma la shī la slob mar bcas pa'i gsung mchid la legs par brtags pa dang / de bzhin gnub rin po che'i bsam gtan mig gi 'grel la yang zhib mor bltas shing mkhas pa'i mkhas pa 'jigs med smra ba'i dbang po kha cig gi hwa shang gi grub mtha'i skyon yon dbye ba cung zad mdzad pa dag mthong zhing thos pa dang / dus phyis rgya nag lo tsā ba ching gir gung gis byas pa'i rgya nag chos 'byung mthong bas rkyen byas gzhan yang bod 'di na 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen po'i gsung man ngag khungs dang ldan pa'i rigs grags che ba phal mo che zhig kyang mthong rang gi 387

skal ba dang mtshams pa cha shas ci rigs yang thos/ dpal mgon bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa la brtan tshig don gyi cha la cung zad dpyad par nus pa'i blo mthu yang thob pas skyo ma snga gtsan dang grags pa'i rjes 'brang kho na tsam ma yin par rang stobs kyi rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mthu la brten tshul 'di yang brjod pa yin na legs par bshad pa'i cha ni ci rigs bsod la nyes pa bshad pa'i skyon ni nyung ngu zad par sems la/ des na 'di nas bsnan par 'os pa ni mchis la dbri bar bya rgyu ni med do/ /de skad rnam mang grub mtha' rgya mtsho 'i khams/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab bsrub shing la/ /lhag bsam nor rgyas bsrub thag gis bskrun pa'i/ /legs bshad zla ba gzhon nu dus 'dir bshad/ rgyal bstan nyan rang theg la mi smod na/ /theg chen 'jog bsgom smod pa smos ci 'tshal/ /bdag gis gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di rnams kyang / rang bzo rig pa kho nas gsar bsgrub min/ /tshad ma'i lung mthong der dpyod shes rab kyi/ /ma 'khrul nges pa thob nas brjod pa ste/ /sngon chad tshul 'di ha cang mi gsal bas/ /sngon med legs bshad smra la 'gal ba ci/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gtad rab 'phags pa'i rgyun/ /mang byon phyir mi ldog pa snying po'i mod/ /legs 'grel don bsgom bslad med chos dam par/ /tshe rabs rtag tu sdig bsags ma gyur cig /brgyud pa'i bka' med gtan tshig lung gis dben/ /chos brgyad sgrib shing chos su bcos pa yi/ kha shas zhag gi sangs rgyas thob bo lo/ /rdzun chos de 'dra spyod la snying rje skye/ /ltar snang mdzes byed lung gi phreng spel yang / /zab gnad snying po ltar bcos snying pos dben/ /gsang ba'i don 'phyar 'bras bu ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ /chos tshul de 'dra mthong tshe yi mug ldang / /tha snyad rtog ge'i gnas la sbyang brlom zhing / /don bsgom snying por log rtogs dpyad pa mkhan/ /zab don mchog gi skal ba mi ldan pa/ /mkhas rlom rmongs pa de 'drar skyo ba skye/ /theg chen par rlom theg dman so thar gyi/ /sdom pas yid bcings theg chen so thar gyi/ /sdom pas yid bcings theg chen snying po'i gtam/ /thos tshe ljags srin rna bar 'brug sgra bzhin/ /lugs ngan de lta bu la bdag mi gus/ /bag med spyod pa sngags la ma g.yer te/ /ngo tsha khrel med tho co'i spyod pa can/ grub par rdzu nas rang gzhan bslu byed pa/ /de 'dra'i ngang tshul mthong tshe snying nas khrel/ /bla ma yun ring la bsnyen pa'i las/ /mi 'bung gdams tshig re zung thob lo yi/ /blo khengs rnal 'byor thob khul stong bshad mkhan/ /bzang min bzang bsdu mang 'dir bdag mi rangs/ /deng sang snyigs kyi mthar thug pas/ /phra mor gyur pa'i skyon ni che ru 'dzin/ /skyon gyur che la mi smod dga' bas 'jug /lugs ngan de lta brjod na zad pa ci/ /de dag phal cher bdag sems ma dag skyon//kho nar srid mod des na sems dri ma/ /dag byed dbu phyag rdzogs pa chen po'i lam/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal lung thob pa gang / /chos brgyad rnam g.yeng kyis dbyen ri khrod du/ /ma nor 'khrul med brtson 388

pas bsgom byas nas/ /ji bzhin gnas lugs thob pa'i gdengs thob te/ /rang sems dag pa'i 'khor lo 'khor bar shog /'gro la phan phyir ma dag grub pa'i mtha'/ /tha dag bdag blo bzang pos nyer bcil te//rnam kun grub pa'i lam bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /mtha' yas 'gro la rtag tu ston par shog /rang gi rnam rtog ji bzhin ngag gsang pos/ /lhag bsam dag pas brjod pa'i tshig 'di la/ /gal te nyes pa'i cha shas mchis pa rnams/ /'phags tshogs spyan sngar bshags so nyes med stsol/ /gang zhig dge ba'i cha shas mchis pa kun/ /pha ma'i rang bzhin mkha' khyab 'gro ba la/ /bsngo mthu'i kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gnas dam pa/ /ring por ma yin myur du thob par shog /de srid tshe rabs rtag tu dam pa'i chos/ /mtha' dag mi spong rang dbang chos bzhin spyod/ /ma nor 'khrul med snying po'i don 'dzin pa/ /yid bzhin bde ba'i nor ba ༄rtag spyod shog /ces pa 'di yang ri kha ba can gyi smongs 'dir hwa shang gi grub mtha' rnam par dag dang ma dag dpyad pa mang du mthong bas des na hwa shang gi phyogs snga rang gi ci ltar thos shing rtogs pa'i tshul cung zad tsam brjod pa yid kyi dri ma dag byed dge ba'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba phyogs med ris med kyi rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sde dpal kun tu rgyas pa yi dbus ri nag po'i dkyil kong yul ljon pa lung gangs ri 'od ldan dang nye ba nags klung gi bskor ba'i bsam gtan gyi spyil por dga' dbang ngam mig dmar yang brjod pa shing pho byi ba'i lo snron gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong karma shes rab bstan 'dzin dang rab byung ye shes dpal 'byor zung gis bgyis pa dge'o//dge'o//sarba maṅga lo// 389

gag /gsang chen rdo rje theg mchog bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lo rgyus rab bsdus sa bon tsam du smos pa legs bshad bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bder gshegs rgyal ba yongs 'dus spyi dpal kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo dri bral gdod nas rang byung stong nyid ye shes mkha'/ /rang bzhin dpag yas cho 'phrul du ma 'od gsal yangs pa'i klong / /thugs rje mnyam nyid tshad med brtse chen bde gnyis yongs rdzogs dbyings—/ /dbyer med don dam sku gsum brgyud ldan bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i bsgrub chen brgyad/ /rgyud lung man ngag zab mo'i gdams pa mchog /rgyud pa dgongs brda' gtad rgya bkrol snyan khungs/ /babs tshul lo rgyus sa bon tsam 'dir bkod/ /de yang 'dir grangs med byang chub sgrub pa mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa las/ /ches 'phags 'bras bu sngags las kyang ches bsngags/rmad byung 'di phyir bar do gang rung du byang chub chen po thob pa'i nye lam nang pa thabs rgyud rdo rje theg pa'i bye brag bla med rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor yongs gtso bo bsgrub chen bka' brgyad du grags pa'i bab tshul lo rgyus spyi dang bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mdor bsdus grags che ba'i lo rgyus dang bstun cung zad sa bon tsam du 'dir ston pa la/ de yang gsang chen snying ma'i lo rgyus skabs su/ brgyud pa ldan dang bdun ldan lnga ldan gsum ldan sogs du mar ston pa las/ 'dir lnga ldan nam drug ldan gyi sgo bdun smos teske/ de la sku gsum rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig brdas brgyud pa/ mkha' 'gro gnyer gtad rgyas brgyud pa/ grub thob rnal 'byor byin rlabs rgya bgrol brgyud pa/ skal ldan rje 'bangs gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa/ gter ston bla rabs smon lam gter chos brgyud pa dang drug las/ dang po/ ngo bo gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i ye shes rnam kun mchog ldan rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral skye med gshis lung gnyug ma g.yo med ngang du/ rang bzhin gdang gsal ma 'gags cir yang snang ba sna tshogs pa yi dus der/ thugs rje rig pa rang byung gzhi yi gnas su yang dag mngon par byang chub kun tu bzang po zhes ye sangs rgyas pa'i dgongs pa de las ma g.yos g.yo ba med par mnyam nyid ngang du gnas bzhin sku dang ye shes kyi rol pa 'byams klas par snang ba 'od gsal gzhon nu bum pa can sku zangs thal thig le nyag gcig klong du dpyod bral thams cad mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid du gnas shing de yi 390

rang ngo rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i snang cha gnas chos dbyings dbus mtha' phyogs mu bral bar 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khang des mtshon dbyibs las 'das pa'i mkha' la/ ston pa rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo chos nyid bya rtsol spros bral sku can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi mes bde bar gshegs pa'i bdag nyid 'khor 'das spyi dpal kun tu bzang po la/ 'khor ye shes cha shas mdangs las snang ba rigs lnga'i rgyal ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par rgya mtshos ston pa las gdul bya gdul byed ma yin pa rang snang mnyam nyid du shar ba lhun grub gdod ma'i rang ngo la/chos smra bsam brjod bral chos nyid don dam bstan pa'i snying po yang dag dgongs pa mngon du ston par byed cing / dus 'pho 'gyur dang bral chos nyid g.yo ba med pa'i ngang du gnas so/ /de yi ngang las gzhan ngo gdul byar yang dag pa'i thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa dpag gi mi langs chos 'byung dbyings kyi zhing dur khrod me ri 'bar ba/ ston pa phun sun tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po kun tu bzang po rang byung don gyi he ru ka gzhon nu dpa' bo yab yum zung 'jug gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rol pa'i 'khor lo mtshan dpe du mas brgyan pa cir yang snang ba'i sku/ gdul bya gdul byed rang rang rigs kyi gtso bor ston pas mdzad cing / bla na med pa'i rnal 'byor du/ dpal gsang 'dus mi skyod/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ 'jig byed dgra nag dang /gdong drug gshed dmar/ sgyu ma chen po/ kyi rdo rje/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pha ma gnyis med du ma'i skur snang ba dang /khyad par zhi ba sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'dus pa dam pa rigs brgya/ rdo rje dbyings dkyil/ bde gshegs rigs lngaske/ de nyid rigs gsum/ gsang chen rigs gcig par ston pa dang / de bzhin khro bo sgyu 'phrul dra ba he ru kar shar ba bsgrub pa bka' brgyad phal chen po/ sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/gsung sma dbang chen rta mgrin thugs yang dag bde gshegs snying po/ yon tan bdud rtsi che mchog bde ba'i 'khor lo/ /phrin las phur bu rdo rje gzhon nu/ mngon rdzogs ma mo ho ru ka 'jig rten dregs pa kun 'dulaske/ drag sngags stobs ldan nag po/ gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos te/ gtso bo dgu shar zhing / de nyid sku gsung thugs kyi cho 'phrul dpag yas tshad bzung mtha' las 'das pa'i rang bzhin can de la gdul bya mchog tu dag pa yi chos sku dag pas longs sku/ ma dag par sprul sku cir yang snang zhing / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rang gdangs sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa me long gi gzugs rnyan lta bu'i ngang nyid du/ gtso 'khor kun kyang gang la gang 'dul zhi ba khro bo zhi ma khro yi rnam 'gyur grangs med ston zhing / chos phun sum tshogs pa drang nges theg pa phyi nang gsang ba de spyi dang / khyad par gsang ba 391

sngags kyi rdo rje theg pa rnams dang / bye brag tu bde gshegs 'dus pa chen po'i spyi rgyud lnga dang / sgos rgyud bcu yan lag sgrub lug so so'i rgyud dpag tu med pa rnams gsungs te/ dus phun sum tshogs pa rang do thog mtha' byar med dus bzhi mnyam nyid rang byung dag pa chen po'i dang / gdul bya 'jig rten 'di yi sngon rol dang / mngon par chags pa'i dus dang bdud kyi rgyal po 'jigs byed drag po ma tram ru tra 'dul ba'i dus sogs su bstan par mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das yab dang yum sras 'khor gzhal yas khang mngon par phyung nas chos nyid kyi rang sgra bskul/ gsung rnams gdul bya'i don du ston pa las/ nges pa ni nyi ma dang 'od zer lta bu gtso 'khor zhi khro rab 'byams rigs mthun rig 'dzin byang chub sems dpa'i tshul snang ba kun tha mi dad pa thugs dgongs pa gcig tu mnyam zhing chos ston bya ston byed so sor ma gyur bzhin ston pa'i tshul tsam la rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas gnyis pa rig 'dzin rig pa brda' brgyud ci ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul dag pa'i 'khor lo zhing / lha tshogs thams cad chos nyid dbyings mnyam pa'i klong du bsdus te gdul bya thun mongs spyir mi snang bar gyur tshe/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi ngo bo dang gnyis su med cing / sku yi zhal tshab/ gsung gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bcom ldan thams cad kyi thugs/ rig pa'i ye shes rang rtsal gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo de la mtshan gyi rnam grangs su/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje'i rig 'dzin rdo rje chos mchog dang / rdo rje drag po rtsal/rdo rje thod pa'i phreng ba can/ rdo rje snying po/ thugs kyi rdo rje/ mi yi thod pa can la sogs mtshan grangs du mar 'chang ba de nyid kyi bcom ldan 'das kun bzang dpal chen he ru ka yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam 'gyur/ gsung gi brda' thugs kyi dgongs don ma lus lus pa med par rgyud kyi rang bzhin du gtan la phabs nas/ thugs su rab tu bsdus shing 'khor rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyi thugs kyi ye shes/rang mdangs rtsal las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mngon rdzogs kyi rig 'dzin chen po brgyad dang / gzhan yang sa la gnas pa/ tshe dbang / phyag rgya/ lhun grub sogs kyi rig 'dzin/ byang chub sems rgyud bsdu ba'i ched du rab tu 'dul nas/ rig 'dzin rdo rje chos mchog ston par bzhengs nas rig pa 'dzin pa de 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshom bu'i dkyil du byas nas/ rang rang tshig mtshams sbyor ba dang bcas te mi mngon rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su rgyud rnams thog mar ngag ru bsdus so/ /de nas slar yang 'og min lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i gnas mchog tu gsang gsum bdag po'i rig 'dzin rdo rje chos gtso 'khor byang sems rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang thabs gcig tu snang bar byas te/ de'i tshe rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yang dag snying po gdul bya rnams la mngon par 392

'char byed rgyun mi chad par ston pa'i btsas su/ gsang bdag rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje chos dang / rig 'dzin brgyad la sogs pa'i/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen pos sku gsungs thugs kyi brdas ston pa'i bde gshegs 'dus pa bka' brgyad kyi rgyud spyi dang bye brag lo lor byon pa dang / gzhan yang a nu'i tan+t+ra rtsa ba yan lag ci snyed pa rnams rig 'dzin brgyad dang / gtso mchog rdo rje chos kyi thugs nas phyung zhing ngag tu bsdus pa yang gdul byar gyur pa rnams la yun ring su phan pa'i ched du rjod bya don phyin ci ma log pa ston pa'i ched du brjod byed gdul bya'i brdas 'dren pa'i yi ge gser gyi shog bu la baiḍūr+ya zhun ma yi snang bar byin gyis brlabs shing / bde gshegs 'dus pa'i spyi rgyud lnga/ sgos rgyud bcu bsdu ba dang nyig lung gi chos lnga yang ston par mdzad do/ /skabs 'dir gsang bdag rdo rje chos che ba'i mchog des rgyud rnams yi ger bkod dang dus mtshungs par lha yi gnas yongs 'dus pa rdol a mo li ka'i tshal dang / gnod sbyin lcang lo can dang / khyad par dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal la sogs par gsang ba'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das dregs pa kun 'dul phyag na rdo rjer skur bzhengs nas dregs pa'i rgyud dang /stobs ldan nag por sprul nas drag sngags kyi rgyud rnams gsung bar mdzad pa yin zhes bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal snga nas gsungs te/ shin tu med pa nyid do/ /de ltar mngon byung myang 'das dkyil 'khor thugs gsung yon tan phrin las bzhi dang / 'jigs 'das gzugs su snang ba sku dang mngon rdzogs te dkyil 'khor drug de la 'jig rten dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bsnan pas bsgrub pa bka' brgyad du grags pa ste/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi gtso bo rnams bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal he ru ka sha stag kyang dkyil 'khor 'khor gyi tshul du snang ba rnams kun rdzob tsam du 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i tshul la mtshan gyi tha snyad de ltar kha cig nas mdzad pa yin noske//rgyud de dag gi sdud pa po rig pa'i rgyal po/ rig 'dzin bla ma nyid dkyil 'khor du 'dren pa'i dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhes grags so/ /yang yo ga la la'i lo rgyus skabs su dpal kun tu bzang pos mi mngon dbyings su bstan pa'i rgyud rnams gsang ba'i bdag pos bsdus te/ slar ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga la sogs par gsang ba'i bdag pos ston par mdzad pa'i dus de nyid dang / dregs pa 'dul ba'i dus mtshungs par gsung ba yang gong dang mi 'gal zhing / sgyu 'phrul dpag par dka' ba nyid kyis so/ /de ltar rig pa 'dzin pa zhes chos sku'i rigs la longs sku'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'am/ longs sku'i rigs la sprul sku'i bstan pa 'dzin pas rig 'dzin nam yang na dkyil 'khor so so'i rigs dang yon tan ma lus pa 'dzin pas rig 'dzin dang / chos don ma lus brdas shar zhing yongs su rdzogs pas rig 'dzin brda' rgyud zhes bya'o/ /de nas gsum pa mkha' 393

'gro gtad rgya gnyer gtad kyi rgyud pa ni/rigs dang dkyil 'khor rig 'dzin yongs gtso kun bzang rdo rje chos mchog re zhig mi yi yul du dus la ma bab pas des na/ 'jig rten 'di na mthu stobs che zhing dregs pa thams cad dbang du bsgyur ba/ ma yi ma chen/ rje yi yang rje/ mkha' 'gro yongs kyi bdag mo/rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gtso mo/ 'khor 'das ye shes las kyi mnga' bdag mo/ 'dod do dgu bsgyur ba'i 'khrul can/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mar grags shing / srid pa na u ma dhe wi/ ma mo nyid zla'i phreng ba can/rnal 'byor ma bde ba'i dngos grub/ mkha' 'gro ma kun dga' mo/ rje btsun las kyi dbang mo che dang /gsang ba ye shes rig byed ma zhes/ gzhan du ni smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro dang / rdo rje khro mo rag gdeng ma yang grags pa/ don dam par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo mngon du snang ba/ yum chen kun tu bzang mo shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i thugs kyi ngo bo nyid de la gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde ma lus par gnyer gtad bdag por bsgos nas/ mchog gi rin chen rnal 'byor rnams la brtan pa'i btsas su dngos grub tu byin zhes bka' lung gdams zhing / des kyang 'dzin cing 'chang bar mdzad de/ tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad po rtsa ba yan lag gi skor/ la la ni mi mngon dbyings su rig 'dzin byang sems mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bzung zhing / la la ni o rgyan gyi gsang mdzod rnams su mkha' 'gro ma rigs gsum la 'dzin par gdams shing / la la ni mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod sogs gzhan yang gnas yul rnams su ye shes las kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la gnyer du gtad par mdzad cing / bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag rnams/ mi dang srin po'i thod pa dang rin po che yi sgrom bu ru so sor bzhug par mdzad de/ /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las so so'i rgyas gdab nas bkur zhing mchod par byed cing / de nas mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes las kyi dbang mo che de yi 'khor ye shes dang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus par rgyud rnams gter du sba bar bka' bsgros pas/ dregs pa can rnams gnas la ma 'cham ste/ ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dpag bsam shing la sba bar 'dod pa dang / lha yi ri rab rtse rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang /klu'i rgya mtsho'i gting / bdud kyi mun gling bdud mkhar rtse dgu/ rgyal pos gnam gyi shel mkhar rtse dgu/gshin rjes ri rab 'og lcags mkhar nag po/ gza' yi nam mkha'i mthong nyi zla'i khang pa/ rmu yi smu yul rmu mkhar rtse/ gnod sbyin gyi ri rab byang shar lcang lo can/ srin pos laṅka pu ri srin mkhar dgu rtsegs/bgegs kyi bgegs gling 'dre mkhar skya bo 'od can/ btsan gyi brag dmar btsan mkhar ldem pa'i rtse la sba dgos zhes/ rang rang thob sha byas pa'i tshe gtso mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsang ba ye shes las kyi dbang mo chos dur khrod ri gling bsil ba'i tshal/ 'di bu'i tshal zhes bya ba/ 'dzam gling chos kyi 'byung 394

gnas kyi dbus gling yul po gnyis kyi gtso bo/ gnas nyer bzhi'i snying po dur khrod brgyad kyi mchog tu gyur pa de ru lha srin sde brgyad dregs tshogs thams cad bsdus nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas te bkal stsal pa/ kye hoḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs nyonaḥ gsang sngags zab mo dgongs pa'i snying phyung ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi klong nas gsungs//rigs lnga la sogs 'dus pa'i 'khoragyi nyan//log lta tshar gcod khro bo'i sku sprul nas//'khor gyi khro tshogs rig 'dzin rnams la gsungs/ /bstan pa mi nub yun du gnas bya'i phyir/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi gser gyi glegs bam bris/ /bka'i bsrung ma bdag cag rnams la gtad/ /khyed rnams rang rang 'dod pa ma smra bar/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba 'dir/ /baṃ ro gsar snying mang po gnas pa'i sa/ /gcan gzan gdugs pa can rnams rab tu 'du/ /laṅka 'dab chags mang po sprin ltar gtibs/ /rang byung mchod rten chen po 'di na bzhugs/ /lha srin thams cad 'dus nas byed pa'i sa/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi brtul shugs spyod pa'i gnas/ /gsang sngags zab mo bzhugs pa'i gnas su bzang / /lha srin thams cad 'dus la mchod par byos/ /zhes gsung par lha srin dregs pa kun gnyan nas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal de nyid kyi dbus mchod rten bde byed rtsegs pa zhes rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ tshad chos 'khor lhag pa'i bcom 'das bzhengs pa'i tshad du snang ba/ de yang phyi mchod rten nang gzhal med khang du gyur par/chos rnams ri rab srog shing dpag bsam ljon pa'i dper byas te/zug pa rtsa ba lta bur mchod rten seng khrir bde gshegs sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad la sogs sbas/'gril ba sdong po lta bur bka' brgyad bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud sogs mi yi nor bu bsam 'phel rin chen sna tshogs kyi phras brgyan pa'i sgrom bu ni mchodarten bum pa'i dbus su sbas/ gyes pa yal ga'i tshul bsgrub ste bye brag rgyud rnams gser dngul lcags zangs g.yu bse mchong gzi yi sgrom bur bum pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du sbas/gsal ba me tog lta bur gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sogs shel gyi sgrom bur bum pa'i bra la sbas/ smin pa 'bras bu lta bur gyurapa rang shar rgyud la sogs pa baiḍūr+ya'i sgrom bur chos 'khor du sbas/ 'bras bu'i bcud ltar sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs a ti'i rgyud rnams yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel sgrom bur gdugs kyi dbus su sbas/yang gsang bla med a ti nag po la sogs rdzogs chen snying po'i skor rnams 'od kyi gong bur mchod rten kyi rtse tog la sbas shing rgyas btab ste/ ye shes dang las kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dregs pa mtha' dag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyud sde rnams bsrung bar gnyer gtad cing / de dag gi kyang rgyud sde rnams la mchod bkur bsrung ba rgyun mi chad par mdzad cing rgyud de dag gnas pa'i par cho 'phrul gyi snang ba rab tu 'char bar byed do/ /de ltar chos thams cad bcom ldan 'das rig 395

pa 'dzin pas ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso la gnyer du gtad cing / des kyang bdag gir mdzad de rang rang phyag rgyas btab te mkha' 'gro dregs pa'i tshogs chos kyi bsrung mar brkos shing mdzad med gter du btsas pa dang / bstan pa 'phel phyir rig 'dzin rnams la dus su snang zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i chos rab tu gnas par byed pa mkha' 'gro gtad rgya gnyer gtad rgyud pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas bzhi pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde de rnams mi yul du ji ltar snang ba'i tshul la/ thog mar mi yul du dngos grub rnal 'byor byin rlabs rgya bkrol brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ bcom ldan 'das sprul pa'i sku nye lam sngags kyi theg pa 'byung 'gyur lung bstan zhing / rdo rje theg pa'i chos mi yul du ji ltar snang ba'i tshul la/ gsang bdag kurdzor mi ru snang ba rgyal po in+d+ra sgo dhe dza zhes par/ rmi bltas ya mtshan pa bdun shar zhing / mi mngon rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i phyag gis glegs bam pho brang rtser bab cing / rgyal po grub pa rab tu brnyes so/ /de nas yun ji ltar rig pa nyid na/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings nas rig 'dzin rdo rje chos che ba'i mchog de yi/ thugs kyi ye shes dgu yi rang mdangs las/ mi yul du bka' brgyad rig pa 'dzin pa brgyad/ rig 'dzin gtso mchog rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid bcas dgu ru snang zhing / de nas rig 'dzin chen po brgyad rang grub pa brnyes shing dur khrod brgyad du dgongs pa la zhugs pa'i tshe/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du nyin bzhin thog ser 'khrig cing / mtshan mo'i me 'od glog khyug dbus su/ mkha' 'gro dregs tshogs kyi mchod sprin rol mo du ma bcas phyag skor byed pa de mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis mthun par gzigs shing ya mtshan de/ nam mkha'i lam la rdzu 'phrul gyi mchod rten drung du dus gcig la 'dus teske/ thun mong ma yin pa'i chos bzhugs par shes shing de nyid blang ba'i dus la bab par dgongs pa gcig pas bka' bsgros tshe/ ma hā gu ru rin po che yi zhal nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas yi dam la dngos grub zhu na legs zhes gnang bas/ slob dpon rnams mthun par gha na tsakra rgya che bar bshams te/yi dam la gsol ba btab/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang / chos skyong dam can dbang du bsdu ba'i dgongs pa la zhag bdun song ba'i nub mor mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che 'khor dang bcas pas/slob dpon rnams la/ e ma hoḥ sku ni lhar gsal gsung nyid sngags sgra sgrogs/ /thugs ni mnyam nyid rdo rje lta bu la/ /sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad slob dpon brgyad/ /bka' bzhin ci stsal gsung ni ci ltar nyan/zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon brgyad kyi gsung gcig tu/ e ma ho/ 'dus pa'i 'khor logs mkha' 'gro mang po dang / /bdud dang gshin rje la sogs lha srin rnams/ /bka' bzhin byed na khyed rnams mchod byed pa'i/ /rin chen sgrom rnams da lta nged la byin/ /zhes rtsal bas/ sngon bcom 'das rig 'dzin chen pos ji ltar bsgos bzhin du/ dhā ki'i gtso mo chen po des/ mchod rten nas rin chen sgrom bu 396

brgyad rgya bkrol te/ slob dpon brgyad la dngos grub tu byin te/ de yang / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la lcags kyi sgrom bu/ de bzhin klu sgrub snying por zangs sgrom/ thugs kyi 'byung gnas la dngul sgrom/ phyag rgya rgya chen la gser sgrom/ pad+ma 'byung gnas la g.yu sgrom/ sbyin pa legs sbyar la bse sgrom/ zla gsang la mchong sgrom/ zhi ba snying por gzi sgrom rnams gtad cing / bka' bsrung dregs pa'i tshogs kyi srog gi snying po yang dus der phul lo/ /de yang skabs 'dir lo rgyus 'gar rdo rje phur pa'i chos sgrom rus sa las grub pa de nyid slob dpon 'od zer glang po la rtsal bar bshad pa yang / rig 'dzin rdo rje chos thugs kyi ye shes dgu yi rang mdangs rig 'dzin dgur nges shing / bye brag gu ru rin po ches pra wa ta ster phur pa gsan pa'i lo rgyus bcas/ des na don la gnas par gor ma chags ste/ rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas so/ /de nas rig 'dzin brgyad pos dngos grub brnyes pa'i chos sgrom rdzu 'phrul gyi bsnams nas rang rang gnas su zhal phyes pas gser gyi sgrom bur bdud rtsi sman gyi skor/ dngul sgrom nas yang dgalcags sgrom nas gshin rje/ zangs sgrom nas rta mgrin/ g.yu sgrom nas phur pa/ bse sgrom nas ma mo/ mchong sgrom nas mchod rten/ gzi sgrom nas drag sngags kyi chos rnams byung zhing / rin po che sna tshogs las byas chos sgrom ni mkha' 'gros rgya ma bkrol zhing rig 'dzin rnams kyi ma khro bar re zhig mkha' 'gro dregs pa'i tshogs kyi sngar bzhin du mchod do/ /de nas slob dpon chen po brgyad dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad du bye brag bka' bab dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas sgrub pas rigs kyi dpal chen yab yum zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / de dang mi gnyis par yon tan yongs rdzogs 'dzin gyur rgyal ba'i lung gi pho nya yongs kyi gtso mchog chen po brnyes shing mkhas par gyur to/ /de yi tshe phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs gsung sku'i ngo bo cig bsdus tshe 'od dpag med rdo rje dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid nges par gsang sngags ston mdzad ho ru ka dpal nyid du gyur yang / gdul bya drangs phyir rig 'dzin slob dpon brgyad bla mar brten nas bka' brgyad bye brag gi rgyud lung man ngag ma lus lus pa med par gsan zhing thugs la lon te sgrub ma thag tu lha so so'i zhal gzigs shing rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs bcud thun mong ma yin pa thugs la shar zhing dka' ba'i gnas kun khrol bar mdzad do/ /de yi tshe mchod rten bde byed rtsegs pa nas sngar rgya ma khrol ba'i rin chen sna tshogs kyi sgrom bu de nyid 'don par mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes las kyi dbang mo ches bskul zhing dus la bab par mkhyen nas spyan drangs nas zhal phyes pa bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs pa'i zab chos sngon chad sa steng du ma grags pa de nyid byung zhing / gzhan yang mchod rten de nyid la bzhugs gter lhag ma ma lus par phyag tu bzhes shing / bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gzhon nu dang / rig 'dzin kurdzo ra la 397

sogs pas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rab 'byams ma lus pa'i bka' dbang bsgyur bar mnga' gsol zhing ske/ dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bsgrub pa'i tshul mdzad pas rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa'i zhal rang rang gnyis su med par gzigs te/ tshe dbang phyag rgya che mchog lhun gyi grub pa rdo rje 'dzin gyur brnyes so/ /de yi dus su rig 'dzin chen po brgyad kyi bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos sgo dbye bar gsol ba 'debs pas sngar gyi bka' drin bsab pa'i tshul gyi rgyud lung man ngag yongs rdzogs phul bas/mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin chos skyong rnams kyi rab tu bsngags par mdzad cing gsang sngags kyi ston pa chen por gyur te/ mi yi gnas su mtshan lnga/ mtshan brgyad/ mtshan nyi shu/ mtshan brgyad cu sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas gdul bya 'dul zhing / de bzhin lha yi gnas su gu ru gtsug phud 'od 'phro dang / klu yi gnas su gu ru 'jog po khyung gshog can du snang nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / spyir rigs drug tu gu ru drug tu sprul zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams su gu ru yi sgyu 'phrul dpag gi mi lang pas 'gro ba'i don rgyun mi chad par mdzad do/ /de lta yang ma hā tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad sogs rgyal po dza la bab pa dang /bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / bka' brgyad
