bye brag bcas mchod rten bde byed nas bton pa dang / a nu'i skor sedhenga'i nags tshal du dza la la 'i bdag pos snang bar byas shing / a ti'i bskor rnams dha na ko shar sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yi ston par mdzad/ yo ga de dag las 'phros pas rgyud sde 'ga' zhig ni mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas gsum dang o rgyan gyi ke tshang nas mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ rta mchog pa/ lū hi pa/ birlu pa/ bi na pa/ lwa wa pa/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ ḍosri ho ru/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ la li ta badz+ra/ nag po spyod pa/ su ma ti/ ye shes zhabs/ tsi lu pa/ tilbi pa/ ni gu ma la sogs pas spyan drangs pa'i pha ma gnyis med snying po'i rgyu bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag snyan rgyud bcas snang bar mdzad cing / de thams cad kyang yo ga gsum du yongs su 'dus te/ tan+t+ra'i sde las sku gsung nas 'phros ma yi rgyud dang / thugs las pha yi rgyud dang / yon tan 'phrin las las cha snyom gyi rgyud sde rnams 'byung bar gu ru pad+mas bzhed cing / de yang gsang 'dus dang sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor cha mthun la/ dmar nag 'jigs byed gdong drug dgra nag sogs ni 'jam dpal sku dkyil nyid do/ /de bzhin bde mchog dang che mchog bla med/ dges rdor dang yang dag sangs rgyas thod pa dang rig 'dzin mi yi thod pa'i rgyud rnams lha yi ngo bo gcig par 'dod la/ rang rang gi babs tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ de ltar gdul bya'i dbang gis gsang sngags rgyud bye brag rnams rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rig 'dzin grub thob rnal 'byor rnams kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya bkrol te byin rlabs smin grol chu rgyun rab tu rgyas par mdzad pas/ grub thob rnal 'byor byin rlabs bka' rgya bkrol ba'i rgyud pa zhes so/ /da 398

ni lnga pa skal ldan rje 'bangs gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa zhes/ 'phags yul nas gnyis pa bod yul du ji ltar snang ba'i tshul te/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i mchog gi sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal de nyid thugs rje'i dbang gi bod yul gdul bya dus la son zhing / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i sprul gar chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan 'dren zhus pa la rten nas byon te/ lha 'dre gdug pa'i tshogs kun srog snying blang zhing bkar btags nas/ sku yi rten dpal gyi bsam yas la sogs pa rgya cher gzhengs/ gsung mdo sngags chos rnams bsgyur zhing bshad grwa btsugs/ thugs zab mo bsgom sgrub gyi gra rgyas par mdzad cing / de yi tshe rgyal ba'i thugs bskyed smon lam mthus 'khrungs pa'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga spyi las/ khyad par bka' brgyad kyi thugs sras brgyad dam/ grub chen mi dgur grags pa la / thog mar bka' brgyad nas bye brag sgrub pa'i le tshan cung zad re gnang ba bsgrub ltas khyad par 'phags pa shar ba'i ya mtshan te/ mnga' bdag rgyal po yi tshogs kyi 'khor lo puts+tsha bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas te/ 'dod yon ma spang bar myur du sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud lung man ngag thun mong ma yin pa zhig gnang bar zhus pas/ gu ru rin po ches gsang sngags rdo rje theg mchog ta thā ga ta bi ru maṇ+ḍal ston pa'i dus la bab par mkhyen te/ rgyal po chen po theg chen gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sgo khyad 'phags ston par zhal gyis bzhes shing / de yang thog mar dbang gi smin par bya ba'i phyir/ bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bsgrub pa'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba'i thog mar/ bde gshegs zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor spyi khyab tu dbang bskur zhing / bye brag bka' brgyad grub chen dgu por/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du rang rang rigs brtag me tog gter srang bcu las byas pa re dor bas/ mnga' bdag rgyal po dang / ku ma ra gnyis gtso mchog bdud brtsi'i dkyil 'khor la bab/ nam mkha' snying po badz+ra ho ru ka yi dkyil 'khor bab/ sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor la bab/ rgyal yum mtsho rgyal gyi me tog phur pa'i dkyil 'khor la bab cing / slar 'od zer dang bcas rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor du bab/ dpal gyi ye shes srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor la bab/ dpal gyi seng ge mchod rten dregs 'dul la babs/ be+e ro tsa na stobs ldan drag sngags la bab cing /bcom ldan 'das dpal dgu'i lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga dkyil 'khor me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur mngon sum snang zhing phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi dbang ma lus par bskur zhing / rang rang gi rigs dang 'bral ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs rgyud lung man ngag bye brag so so dang / bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bcas yongs su rtsal zhing / sgrub pa'i gnas kyang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bsam yas dbu rtse/ sku yi gnas sgrag yongs rdzong / gsung gi gnas mchim bu 399

bra dgu/ thugs kyi gnas lho brag mkhar chu/ yon tan gnas yar lung shel brag 'phrin las gnas spa gro stag tshang / ma mo'i gnas yar stod sham po/ mchod rten gnas gnam mcho'o/ /drag sngags gnas brag dmar g.ya' ma lung du sgrub pa gyis zhes bka' gnang zhing / rje 'bangs rang rang bka' babs kyi lha rnams bsgrub pa'i gnas de rnams su bsgrub pas lha zhal gzigs shing grub pa thob pa'i rtags byung na yang yongs grags su/ sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i nyi zla gdan du bting ba dang / phur pa brag la bsnun zhing dgra bgegs gang la gzir kyang reng bar nus/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs spyi bo nas rta skad stong gsum kun khyab sgrogs te srid gsum dbang du 'dus shing tshangs pa'i rgyal pos gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs dgu brgya kun gyis mngon par phul/ nam mkha'i snying pos dbang mo nyer brgyad bran du bkol zhing ske/nyi ma'i zer la zhon te gling bzhi skad cig rgyu nus/ brag la phur pa btab/ ku ma rā yi brag la bdud rtsi bton zhing / sman gyi drang srong lha mos dngos su btud/ mtsho rgyal bsad pa gso nus/ snang srid dregs pa'i srog snying mngon sum blangs shing / phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam brnyes/ dpal yes rtsa rlung dbang bsgyur ma mo dngos su rbad do/ /dpal se dregs pa sde brgyad ma lus bran du 'khol/ bai ro tsa na rdzu 'phrul mngon shes mchog du ma dang ldan zhing dmod pas dgra bgegs sgrol bar nus/ mnga' bdag rgyal po ting 'dzin g.yo med grub cing gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa dang sku tshe'i tshad las phyir lo gsum bsring bar nus shing / bka' med kyi bka' bab grub chen de dag mnga' bdag rgyal po las/ gzhan brgyad sku tshe brgya phrag lhag dang / nyis brgya dang / sum brgya nye ba'i bar tsam re bzhugs nas/ mthar rigs kyi bdag po'i thugs kar phyag rgya che mchog gis sar sku lus 'di'i gshegs sha stag tu nges la/mnga' bdag rgyal po ni dag pa'i snang ngor chos zad snang bas 'jam dpal thugs khar sku gzugs sku bsdus par shar zhing / thun mong snang ngor drug cu re dgu la mya ngan las 'das par grags so/ /de ltar gu ru pad+ma'i thugs sras sgrub chen dgu gtso bor gyur pa'i rje 'bang nyer lnga dang / gzhan yang yer pa'i dngos grub brgya rtsa/ shel brag bsngags pa sum cu/ yongs rdzogs rtogs ldan nga lnga la sogs las skal mchog ldan skyes bu gang zag dam par/ dus de dang ma 'ongs phyi rabs kyi gdul bya ris med don du chos kyi bye brag rgyud lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dus der ston par mdzad cing / de rnams rim bzhin snyan nas snyan zhal nas zhal thugs nas thugs su chud pa'i gdams brgyud chad med du snang bar gyur pas na gang zag snyan khung gis brgyud pa zhes grags shing / de la thun mong ring brgyud bka' ma khyad par nye rgyud gter ma gnyis med zung 'jug snyan rgyud du dbye ba gsang chen snga 'gyur ba'i bzhed par snang zhing bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i skor yang mkhas pa mi bzhis dzñā na ku ma rā la 400

gnang bas/ des sangs rgyas ye shes/ de yi yon tan rgya mtsho la stsal zhing rim par mi nas mir brgyud pa las grub thob dngos grub kyi thos shing / de la myang ral gyis gsan pas bka' gter chu bo cig 'dres su grags so/ /de ltar snga 'gyur gyi skabs der rnal 'byor chen po'i tan+t+ra las 'phros bde dgyes sgyu ma gsang gshin dus 'khor gyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams gu ru rin po ches ston par gyur yang phal cher gter du snang bar mdzad cing / phyis su 'phags yul du grub pa mchog tu bsnyes pa rnams las bod kyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi blangs nas dar rgyas su mdzad pas/ de la sngags gsar 'gyur gdags par mdzad do/ /de nas drug pa zab mo gter chos smon lam gter ston bla rabs kyi brgyud pa'i tshul ni/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po nub med rab tu gnas pa'i phyir du mchog gi bdag nyid ma hā gu ru rin po ches zab mo'i chos thams cad mdzad med gter du sba bar mdzad de/ de las bka' brgyad kyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams gter du/ yongs su grags che ba'i thugs gter lngar gsungs te snying dang 'dra ba phrin las kyi gter bde gshegs 'dus pa rgyal po'i bla dpe de nyid thog mar lo rgyus la lar dbu rtser sbas yang zer la phal cher brag dmar mgrin bzang du sbas par gsung ste/ gang ltar chos khrims 'jig dus su kho mthing lha khang rnams snang gi sku la sbas/ snying khrag dang 'dra ba yon tan gyi gter gtar gsang rdzogs skor lho brag gnam skas can du sbas snying khrag dwangs ma 'dra ba gsung gter rang byung rang shar la stod byang zang zang lha brag la sbas/ thugs kyi thig le bka' brgyad thugs me mon bum thang du sbas/sku gter yang gsang dregs 'dul yar yul 'ching nga bang so dmar po sbas zhes yang gsang dregs 'dul gyi dkar chags su gsung ba dang / gzhan yang gu ru rin po che lho nub gshegs khar khra 'brug tu bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te mnga' bdag mu tig btsas po yab sras rje 'bangs rnams smin grol mdzad de bla dpe glegs bam sum cu so bdun rgyal sras lha rje'i rang skal gnang nas yar lung shel brag tu sbas/ de bzhin rje 'bangs rang rang gi dbang bskal bka' brgyad ji snyed gter du sbas la/ de ltar gtso bo bla gter lnga dang bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho bcas pa'i gzhan yang gter chen phran du btsas pa kun gu ru yab yum gyi mi 'jigs pa'i rdzas dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gnyer gtad bsrung mar bsgos/ /skal ldan rje 'bangs rang rang la smon lam bden tshig gis dbang bskur lung bstan par mdzad nas phyag byas btab ste/chos de dag nam zhig snyigs dus rang rang gdul skal la son tshe/ sngon gyi smon lam bslu ba med par sprul pa'i rje 'bangs rang rang gi thugs rje'i skye rgyud gu ru'i byin gyis rlabs pa rnams byon nas/ de la rtsa ba gsum gyi lung bstan rjes su gnang zhing /mkha' 'gro gter bsrung tshogs kyis bka' rgya bkrol nas gter ston dam pa'i phyag tu bab ste gdul bya 401

thams cad smin grol bla med la sbyor bar mdzad pa de la/ smon lam gter chos kyi rgyud pa zhes su brjod cing ske/ de yang bka' brgya/ bla gter lnga yi thog mar bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskor rnams mnga' bdag rgyal po'i skye ba bcu gnyis par myang ral pa can gyi kho mthing nas spyan drangs/ de nas gsang ba yong rdzogs skor rnams/ myang ral skye ba phyi mar grags shing / spyan ras gzigs sprul gu ru chos dbang gi gnam skas spyan nas spyan drangs/ de nas dreg po rang byung rang shar skor rnams/ sna bsnam rdo rje bdud 'joms skye ba rig 'dzin rgod ldem can zhes dngos grub rgya mtshan des byang zang zang dpal 'bar ri bo che nas spyan drangs/ de nas bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long skor rnams lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi dag pa'i brgyud bdun gyi tha ma pad+ma gling pas mon bum thang nas spyan drangs/ de nas bka' brgyad dregs pa kun 'dul skor rnams 'brog mi dpal ye'i skye ba bcu dgu pa kha rag phug gi gter ston o rgyan bsam gtan bde chen gling pas mching nga bang so nas spyan drangs shing de rnams rang rang lung bstan chos kyi bdag pos skal ldan gdul bya'i tshogs kun smin grol du mdzad do/ /de lnga las gter kha gong 'og zhes bde 'dus gsang rdzogs yongs su grags che zhing / rang shar thugs me yang 'gro don dar rgyas su byung la/dregs 'dul skor ni rten 'brel dbang gis cher 'phel bar ma gyur to/ /rgyal sras rje yi chos skal bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i skor yar lung shel brag tu sbas pa yar rje o rgyan gling pas spyan drangs shing rten 'brel gyi slar yang gter sbas so/ /de bzhin myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po yi rang skal bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho dang dpal mgon bdun cu'i rgyud sgrub thabs/ ma ning dregs pa'i gtso bo yi rgyud sgrub thabs bcas dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang pha 'ong bya rog 'dra bar sbas pa gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos spyan drangs nas ma ning gi chos skor las gzhan shog ser 'bebs pa ma gnang bar yang gter du bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang mtsho rgyal phyag dpe a tsar sa ler bka' bab gnang ba glegs bam nyer bdun ma kung lung du bzhugs pa dang / khye'u chung lo tsā ba'i skal bar mdzad pa zhi khro bka' brgyad 'dus pa bdud ri rnga sgra can du sbas pa dang / de bzhin lang gro dkon 'byung gi bla dpe bka' brgyad kha che bdud rtsi'i phug tu sbas pa dang /4 be+e ro'i phyag dpe bka' brgyad btsan ri rdo rje'i brag la sbas pa dang / mkhon klu dbang gi dbang bskal rgya mtsho nag tu sba bar mdzad pa de rnams ni sprul pa'i gter ston pa byung yang rten 'brel dbang gi ma bton pa dang la la bton kyang yang gter du snang ba dang / 'ga' zhig chos rnams la rdzogs shing yang gter du sbas pa byung zhing / slar sprul pa'i skye bas rim gyis 'don par gyur zhes thos la/ spyir gu ru pad+ma'i gter rnams byams pa byon gyi bar du rgyun mi chad par snang nas 'gro ba'i don bla med du mdzad pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin no/ /bka' brgyad kyi chos sa steng du snang 402

ba gter kha gong 'og sogs kyi smin grol bskyed rdzogs gdams ngag skal ldan so sor rim par brgyud tshul ni du mar mngon zhing ldan/ lnga ldan rnams yongs su tshangs pa khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /'di ltar bka' brgyad kyi rgyud tshul drug ldan lo rgyus sa bon tsam du 'dir smras shing rgyas pa ni rang rang gi gzhung du rtogs par bya la/ lo rgyus la 'dra min cung zad re mngon yang don dam sprul pa'i rnam thar dbang du shar shing / 'dir ni yongs su grags tshul gtsor bton te byas pa'o/ /de ltar bde gshegs rgyal ba yongs gsang lam/ /rdzogs pa chen po bla med snying po gang / /babs tshul mtha' yas rgyal ba'i rnam thar nyidaske/ /bsam gyis mi khyab tshad bzung mtha' klas shing / /gdul bya'i yul gyi dbang khams du ma yi/ /thog pa'i sgo mang rab tu dbye gyur pa/ /byung tshul 'gag med sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor bzhin/ /mtha' gcig ma nges cir yang snang ba'i khams/ /mnyam nyid dang la ma 'dres legs bshad gzugs/ /gar mkhan lus bsgyur 'ja' yi ris mtshungs bkra/ /bla med lo rgyus ngo bo chos nyid gzhir/ /gnas lugs gshis gyur blo rar yongs 'das kyang / /'dul bya'i 'jug ngogs rnal 'byor lam snang tshul/ /rdo rje theg mchog bsgrub chen sde brgyad kyi/ /rgyud pa drug ldan rnam thar rgya mtsho'i khyon/ /zhing 'dir grags pa lam gsum chu rgyun las—/ /bdag blo'i bum par 'jos pa skra rtse yi/ /chu thig tsam du snang gang 'khrul med kyi/ /babs gzhung mthong dang bla ma'i gsung dag las/ /rnyed gang rang gzo'i rnyog mas ma bslad par/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang gi/ /bka' lung cod paṇa spyi bor bcings byas nas/ /bka' brgyad spyi khyab lo rgyus sa bon tsamaske/ /'dir bkod nyes mchis mkhyen ldan la bshags shing / /dge bas gsang chen snying po'i bstan pa nyid / /nub med bskal pa srid bar rab rgyas nas/ /bstan 'dzin sku tshe mdzad phrin nyams med brtan/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun bde chen myur thob shog /zhes pa 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yab cig mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan chen zhi ba mtsho yi skye ba'i tha ma pa rgyal bstan mtha' dag gi sgron me chen po gangs can skyes bu mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bur mdzes pa rje btsun chen po tre+e bo chos kyi dbang po gang gi bka' lung gi cod paṇa spyi bor phebs pa la rten nas/ bka' brgyad kyi lo rgyus sa bon tsam du legs bshad bum bzang zhes bya ba mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs lha rigs su skyes shing gsang sngags nang gi dge slong chen po'i rjes 'brang gos dkar 'chang ba tshe dbang nor bu yis rang byung bde mchog gi pho brang dam tshig 'khor lo rnam par bkod pa stag sna'i gtsug lag khang gi bste gnas ga la ba der me rta dbyug zla'i tshes bzang po lha bab dus chen la dbu tshugs shing thun bar du bkod de dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la grub par sbyar ba'i yig ris pa rang gi slob ma o rgyan blo gros so//dge'o/ /dge'o//dge'o// 403

༄sto /grub byob chen po brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'bri yig shin tu dag cing gsal ba legs bshad gser thur zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'dri tshul la/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ oṃ/ rab tu dge ba'i dpal gyur rmad byung kun/ /rab smin bla med yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rab mchog lha yi lha gyur thub dbang la/ /rab gus dang bas rtag par phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang gi bstan la theg chen sngags lam la brten nas/ /gnyis med 'phags mchog yongs brnyes grub pa'i dbang po ni/ /dkyil 'khor gtso gyur 'phags pa'i 'phags pa ho ru kaḥ rdo rje slob dpon che mchog rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ye shes grub pa'i sku ni phyogs re ma yin te/ /rnam pa thams cad nyid gyur sgyu 'phrul dra ba rol/ /bsam gyis mi khyab byis pa'i blo las 'das par/ /bdag gi dran mod de lta na yang gdul bya'i ngor/ /gnas skabs nyid du gdul bya'i snang ngor dang po yi/ /rnam thar ci 'dra'i tshul la ma 'khrul tshad ma nyid/ /yongs gzigs kun dga' snying pos 'phags yul grub pa'i gtam/ /ji bzhin gtan la legs phab bkod gang 'dir bshad kyi/ /bal bod rgad po'i rna gtam tsam zhen 'khyog pa'i yid/ /skyo ma lnga btsan dbang gyur 'khrul pa'i rab rib mig /gsal 'dod dge ba can kun legs bshad gser thur 'di/ /yid gnyis med gsung grub sku tshad ldan la ltos shig /mkhas kyang tha snyad tshig gi rol rtsed nyid/ /btsun yang bzang rtog mdud pas dkris pa nyid//skyon med yon tan dang ldan grub pa ste//tshul der smon rnams 'di la 'bad par rigs//zhes ched du brjod nas/grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi sku yi snang bsnyan ci ltar bkod zhe na//gtso bo rdo rje 'chang / yi dam mtshon byed khro bo mi g.yo sngon po pus btsug /chos skyong mtshon byed mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ bde'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa de rig ma yin par phyag g.yas dang po gri khug gi mchog sbyin gang rigs gzhan spyi dang 'dra ba bya/ grub thob rnams kyi dang po slob dpon lū hi pa cung zad sku sha skems pa sngo sangs/ mdun du nya yi rgyu lto spung nas zhal du gsol ba/ ral pa'i thor tshug cung zad yod pa brang spu dang bcas pa/ 1 li la pa ni/ rgyal po rnam pa can khri la bzhugs pa/ 'khor blon po dang btsun mo la sogs pas bskor ba'i rnam pa can cung zad yod pa/ 2 birlu pa ni yongs su grags pa bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos dbu rtse brag la me tog gi phreng ba tsam ma gtogs rgyan med pa/ phyag g.yas pa sdig mdzub/ g.yon pa men gyi ra zhal chang gi gang ba 'dzin pa/ 3 ḍom+bi ho ru ka ni/ sku la rus 404

rgyan cha tshang yod pa/ phyag g.yas na dug sbrul gyi lcags 'dzin pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ sku yi g.yon nas yum gyi 'khyud cing / stag la chibs pa/ 4shā wa ri pa ni/ sku sha nag pa/ phyag g.yas na mda' dang ske/ g.yon na 'od ma'i gzhu bsnams pa/ gzhu mchog la phag pa'i khog stod dang khog smad bkal/ rma bya'i sgro mdangs gshib pa'i smad g.yog can/ me tog dang 'bras bu'i rgyan yod pa rig ma gnyis kyang rgyan gos de dang 'dra ba la mda' dong phrag par thogs pa'o/ /5 sa ra ha ni sku sha dkar ba tshangs skud can/ mda' srong ba grub pa'i slob dpon rgas pa med pa de 'dra ba'i rigs yin pas rgas 'khog pa'i rnam pa mi bya'o/ /6kai ka li pa/ dur khrod du bzhugs shing / mdun keng rus nyal ba/ rgyan med pa/ skra co brag sngo sangs mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'o/ /7 sī na pa ni/ nya chen po'i khog pa gshegs pa'i dbus nas thon pa'i tshul gyi/ zhabs gnyis sam gcig nya yi khog nang chug tsam/ phyag gnyis gar mdzad pa'i tshul/sku sha sngo sangs rgyan med cing skra 'dzing pa/ 8 go rak+ṣa ni skra brag pa phyag mnyam bzhag sku sha dkar ba/snyan la mu dra nag po dang / mgul du ra dung brtags pa/ sku lus gcer bu'am/ tsakra kan+ta zhes bya ba 'khor lo lta bu'i bam po gsol ba/ mdun ba glang gi khyu mtshon byed/ 9 tso ram gi pa ni/ skra ral pa'i thor tshug chung ngu yod/ shing drung na gnas shing mnyam bzhag byas pa/ log gcig na phar tshong pa 'ga' zhig gi zong sol bar song ba bri/ 10 bī na pa ni/ dzan ltar du grags pa/ ku ba gsum yod pa'i rgyud can de brdung zhing / thod bcing ba sogs rgyal bu'i rnam pa can bya/ 11 shwarnyi pa ni/ dge slong parnyi ta/ cung zad bgres pa'i rnam pa can paṇa zhu gsol ba/ 12 tin+ta ni/ shin tu rgan po'i cha byed khri thag 'thag pa/ 13tsa ma ri pa ni/ lham bzo ba'i bya ba mdzad pa/ 14khad ga pa ni/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ral gri thog nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ de yi nye skor gcig na/ mchod rten cig gi sgo nas sbrul chen po zhig lus phyed tsam thon pa bri/ mchod rten gyi nang nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rib tsam mngon pa bris na'ang legs/ 15 'phags pa klu sgrub ni yongs su grags pa bzhin nam/ yang na 'di la'ang / sku sha sngo sangs shin tu tshar ba lha lta dbu la gtsug gtor med pa/ dge slong gi cha byad sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka can byas pa don dang mthun cing / ci ste mtshan dpe can gyi sku la mos na ni de 'ja' lus kyi sku yin pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad du byas kyang legs par mngon no/ /16 nag po spyod pa ni/ sku sha sngo sangs phyag na ḍa ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nam mkha' la gdugs bdun rang 'khor dang / ḍa ma ru bdun rang 'khrol/ srin mo 'am ro langs ma la chibs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug stag lpags kyi smad dkris sogs ci ltar rigs pa 'bri'o/ /17 ar+ya de wa ni/ dge slong shing kar+ṇa ra'i lo ma ste shing lo chen po zhig phyag na bsnams pa/ 18 tha ga na pa ni g.yas g.yon phan tshun du grong khyer re 'bri 405

zhing ske/ shing sdong cig la phyed brnyes su bzhugs pa la/ de'i mdun na dge slong zhig 'grengs nas gtam smra ba/ 19 na ro pa ni/ sku sha smug po ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can mi lpags gsol ba'i mi lpags kyi rkang lag gnyis nas phyag gis bzung nas/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa/ 20 byu li pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa lce spyang gi ro phrag par bkal ba/ 21 til+li pa ni/ sku sha sngo nag til brdung pa'i rnam pa can/ mdun du rig mas snod gcig nas til blug pa'i rnam pa can/22 tsa tra pa ni/ po ti rgyab tu khur zhing sod chung zhig lag tu thog pa rab byung gi cha byad can no/ /23bha rgya pa ni/ phag sha dang chang bum mdun du bzhag pa/ tshang skud can skra shad pa bcings pa'i thor cog canaske/ rna rgyan sogs rin po che'i rgyan cung zad yod pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs brags steng lta bu mtho ba na bla ma rnal 'byor pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can cig bzhugs pa'o/ /24 rgyu khan ri pa ni/ phyag dar khrod kyi lhan hrul mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas tshem bur tshems pa/ 25 a dzo gi pa ni/ dur khrod gcig tu 'phred nyal mdzad pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad yod pa'o//26 ka la ka pa ni/ ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad tsam gzugs mdzes pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad cing dur khrod na gnas pa'o/ /27 dhu si pa ni/gzhong pa rnams su gos snying pa 'khrud pa'i rnam pa can no/ /28 kang ka na pa ni/ rang gi lag gdub la blta bzhin 'dug pa/ nam mkha' nas lha dang lha mos mchod pa 'phul/ 29kam sa la 'am/ lwa wa pa ni/pa la rang shong bzhin du brus pa'i kha 'tshams mi 'go rkam pos bskor ba'i dbus na gzim pa/ yang na brag phug na zim me mnyam bzhag mdzad pa byas kyang rung / dge slong gi cha byad can no/ 30 deng gi pa niglu/ snod gcig tu 'bras blug nas gtun shing gi 'bras gru zhing chu la 'khrud pa'i rnam pa can phyogs gcig na chang 'tshong ma zhig yod pa 'bri/ 31 bhad+dha pa ni/ rgyal po'i bu yi rnam pa zhig nam mkha' la dge slong lhung bzed thogs pa 'gro ba la blta zhing / mdun na lha yi bzo bos gtam smra ba/ 32 ten+ta pa ni/sho rtse ba zhig 'bri/ sho rgya gar lugs su byed/ 33 ku ku ri pa ni/ rus pa'i rgyan dang thor tshugs can/pang du khyi mo yod pa 'bri/34ku dzi pa ni/mdun na slob dpon klu grub yod pa/lhag par sba ba skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig 'bri/ 35 dha ya pa ni/ bram ze'i cha byad po ti mang po dang bcas pa/ 36 ma hi la ni/ yan lag sbom zhing sha sul can/ gzhan la lus stobs 'dren pa'i tshul can/ 37 a tshin+ta pa ni/nags nas shing gcod cing shing khur khur nas 'grang pa/ 38 bha ba hi pa ni/ rgyal po'i rnam pa g.yon phyogs nas btsun mos 'khyud pa/ 39 na li pa ni/ pad+ma'i mtsho nas me tog rtsa ba dang bcas gcod pa/40 bhu su ku pa ni/ zhi ba lha ste/ mtha' dge 'dun gyi skor ba'i khri steng nas nam mkha' la cung zad 'phags pa/ dge slong gi cha byad can chos 'chad mdzad pa/ mdog dkar la dmar ba sha nyams rgyas 406

pa'o/ /41 in+d+ra bhu ti ni/ rgyal po'i cha byad la/ bud med glu dang rol mo bro gar byed pa mang pos bskor ba'o//42 ma ka pa ni/ khur pa 'tsho zhing zas sna tshogs pa tshong ba'i don du bkram pa'o/ /43 tog tse pa niske/dbu la thod bcings zhing / tog tses zhing tha rengs brko ba/ 44kam+bha ri pa ni/ lcags mgar khyi las byed pa'i rnam pa can no/ /45 dza lertse ri pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus rgyan can/zhabs phyogs cig rgyab nas dpung par bkal ba/ phyogs gcig bzhengs pa'i pus btsugs/ phyag sor 'dzub mo gnyis rtse sprad/ gzhan rnams bsnol ma'i phyag rgya mdzad nas/ phyag rgya de mgo gzhugs bzlog nas spyi bor 'ching ba/ phyogs gcig nas rig mas brten pa'i phyag 'tshal ba/ 46 ra ru la pa ni/ dur khrod 'dug cing / sku sha sngo sangs yid tsam 'dres pa/ dbu skra brags pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag byas shing dur khrod kyi mi ro la blta ba zhig 'bri/ 47 dharma pa ni/ dge slong bgres po po ti phyag na bsnams pa/ 48 dzha ka ri pa ni/ 'dzo li'i nang du snod chen po zhig bcug nas/ slong mo slong ba'i tshul du bzhengs/ 49 me dhe ni pa ni/ glang gnyis la gnya' shing bcug nas zhing rmo ba'i rnam pa can/ 50 pang ka dza pa ni/ pad+ma'i rdzing bu'i 'gram na/spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang cig yod pa la//dge slong gcig gi mchod pa 'bul ba//kho rang bram ze gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ /'di yi lo rgyus na/ /spyan ras gzigs dang dbang phyug chen po nor ba'i lo rgyus yod pas/ spyan ras gzigs dmar po phyag g.yon pad+ma/ g.yas de kha 'byed pa/ yum gyi g.yon nas 'khyud pa/ sku yi g.yas g.yon du rtse gsum dang thod pa bzhag pa'o/ / 51 dril bu pa ni/ slob dpon nyid rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs rus rgyan stag lpags/ ral pa'i thor tshugs yod pa/ sku lus mi sha kha sngo ba sa/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa la/ yum ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos/ sku mdog dmar mo gri khug dang / thod pa 'dzin pa/ de yang mkha' la 'phur thabs sam/ bde mchog ldan skyes bzhin/g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gang byas kyang rung ste/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa mtshon byed du/ sprin gseb tu bzhugs pa/ 'og phyogs na mtsho lud pas grong khyer gyi phyed tsam sleb pa dang mtsho dkyil na kha sar pā ṇi'i sku phyed tsam thon pa 'bri/52 dzo ki pa ni/rnal 'byor pa gcer bu/mkhar ba thogs shing yo byad rnams/ phyag dbugs rtse la bskyon cing phrag rgyus thogs pa zhig 'bri/ 53 tsa lu ka pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa cig la ḍi sngas su bcug nas nyal ba/ ri dwags kyi lpags pa'i gdan bting zhing / mdun du bsgom zhing bamyur ba'o/ / 54 go ru ḍa pa ni/ smad la shing lo'i gos can/ dbu skra co brag snyim btsug ste bya gshor ba'i rnam pa can/ 55 lu tsi ka pa ni/ bram ze'i rnam pa can las skra dang kha spu rnams 'jab rtses btogs pa'i zed zed pa cig 'bri/ 56 niklu ṇi pa ni/ mal khri la rgyab bsnyes su bsnyes nas zas za ba/mdun du rnal 'byor pa gcig yod pa/ 57 dza yan+ta pa ni/ phyag na ting shags bsnams pa/ gtor ma sna 407

tshogs pa btang ba'i rnam pa can/ 'khor slob ma rdza rnga brdung ba dang / gling bu 'bud pa dang / sil snyan dkrol ba dang / pi wang brdung ba sogs 'bri'o/ / 58 pa tsa ri pa ni/ shing drung gcig na rnal 'byor pa skra brags pa/ nam za ka co ri bya ba/ 'dom dkris gru gsum gcig las med pa/ snum khur phyed tsam za ba/mdun du spyan ras gzigs sam de'i sprul pa dge slong yod pa cig 'bri/59 tsam pa ka pa ni/ rgyal bu'i rnam pa can/ skyed mos tshal gyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ mtha' rnams shing tsam bha ka ste yal ga rnams zlum por skyes pa/ lo ma ljang nag me tog ser skya yod pa/ 60 gik+ṣa ṇa pa ni/ phyag na ku ba'i snod bsnams pa/de'i mdun du mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i rnam pa can skra grol ba/ rus rgyan yod tsam/ chos ston pa'i rnam pa can/grub thob de rang gi so bton nas mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul ba/ 61 dhe la pa ni mar nag gi snod mang po bsham nas 'tshong pa'i tshul dang / kha zas sna tshogs bshams pa/ bdun du paṇ+ḍi ta cig gi chos ston pa'i rnam pa can/ 62 kum pa ri pa ni rdza mkhan gyi rnam pa/ rdza bzo ba bud med dang bcas pa/ 63 tsar+sha ḍi pa ni/ na bza' ma kha li gsol ba/ de la me kha li ni/ rdul gzen 'dra ba'i dkyil na/ mgo 'don pa yod pa/ mi rnams la bcud len de nas shing 'dod gcig gis 'thor tshul byed pa/ mdun du bud med dang byis pa gcig thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i rjes su mi mang po ram mda' ba'i tshul kyi yong ba/ da'i ltag tsa na/brag phug cig na/ dbus su lha gcig dang / g.yas su lha chung ba gcig g.yon du lha mo gcig rnams gdan gcig la sum sgrigs su bzhugs pa bri/ 64 rnal 'byor ma ma ṇi bha dra ni/ bud med rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa nam mkha' la phur ba'i rnam pa/ 'og gi sa gzhi la chu bum chag pa gcig 'bri/ 65 rnal 'byor ma me kha la pa ni/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skra grol ba zhal las ral gri byung ba/ phyag g.yas pas 'dzin tshul/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa bsnams pa cig 'bri/ 66rnal 'byor ma/ ka na kha la yang de dang 'dra ba las/ phyag g.yas na ral gri 'am gri khug g.yon pas rang gi dbu bcad de bsnams pa 'bri ba yin pa las/ 'ga' zhig phal pa'i rnam rtog gi de 'dra 'bri ba mi spro na/ phag mo dbu bcad ma'i bris thang rnying pa 'ga' re la byung ba bzhin/ sku gzugs la yang dbu yod cing ske/ phyag na yang dbu gcig bsnams pa bris kyang mi 'gal/ 'di gnyis car nam mkha' la gar stabs sam brkyang bskum gyi tshul du 'bri/ /spyir rnal 'byor ma 'di gnyis mdzad pa 'dra rung bar byung bas bkod pa'ang /'dra rung bas chog go /67 ka la ka la pa ni/ kha dog sngo nag dur khrod na gnas pa/ de'i mdun tho ba na/ rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can zhig chos gsungs pa'i rnam pa can 'bri/ 68 kan dha li yang / gos tshems byed pa'i rnam pa can la/ mdun du mkha' 'gro ma gcig gis chos ston pa'i rnam pa briske/ 69 dha ru li pa ni/ rtswa thag 'chang ba'i rnam pa can/ 70 u ṭi li pa ni/ mgo la thod bcing shing / 408

lus pa tso la ste/ gso pho thung can gyon pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thor tsam yod pa/ kha spu bzang po can zhig nam mkha' la blta ba/ nam mkha' sprin kha dog sna lnga pa la/ glang po che dang / rta dang / bya la sogs pa'i srogs chags sna tshogs pa 'dra rung gi dbyibs can yod pa/ de dang nye bar ngang pa dngos gnyis 'phur ba/de yi mdun na rnal 'byor pa shing lo thogs pa gcig yod pa/71 ka pā li pa ni/kha dog nag po dur khrod na bud med kyi ro zhig yod pa'i thod brags te phyag na bsnams pa/ lus la rus rgyan cha tshang ba yod paske/ 72 ki ra ba la pa ni/ kha spu bzang ba khro nyams can/ mgo la cod paṇa zhes bya ba/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi ste rtse mo lnga yod pa/ rin po che'i tog can/ skra mtshams la dpa' ba'i dar dpyangs zhes bya ba/ gser gyi 'khyud mo las/ rna ba'i ltag g.yas g.yon na mar dar dpyang 'phyang ba/ ral gri phub 'phyang ba khri la gnas pa/ 73 pa ka ra pa ni/ dge slong gi rnam pa can/ mdun na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bzhengs pa gcig 74 sarba bhak+ṣa pa ni/ mdun na snod chen po gcig na kha zas bzang ngan rnam pa sna tshogs blugs te za ba /75 na ga bho dhe ni/ dge slong gi rnam pa can mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ de'i phyogs gcig gi brag phug zhig gi nang na dge slong mgo la ri dwags kyi ra skyes pa'i rnam pa can gcig 'bri/ / 26 dha ri ka pa ni/ /rus rgyan rdo rje dril bu gzung nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa/ 'khor bud med mang po yang nam mkha' la 'phur te 'gro ba/ 'og phyogs kyi gzhi la grong khyer nas mi rnams slob dpon la blta ba dang / rdo ring gi rtse na rdo yi glang po che yod pa 'bri/ 76 pu ra li pa ni/ dgyes rdor gyi thang ka bkram pa/de'i mdun gyi phyogs na rgyal po'i cha byad can gyi gtam smra ba 'bri/ 78 pa ha na sa ni/ lham yu bcad pa g.yer kha sogs rgyan mang po btags pa gyon pa rgyug pa'i rnam pa can 'bri/ 79 ko lo li la pa ni/ rgyal po'i rnam pa/ skyed mos tshal 'bras bu can gyi shing gi gang ba'i dbus su yod pa/ dge slong gzhon nu mang pos glu dang gar dang khrus gsol ba'i rnam pa can/ shing rnams la bya ko li la ste/ khu dbyugs nag po mang po yod pa/ mdun du dge slong gcig dang gtam smra ba 'bri/ 80 a nam go pa ni/ rtswa khyim zhig na gnas paglu/gzugs mdzes pa gcig gi mdun du dge slong shin tu tshar ba bsod snyoms mdzad pa 'bri/81 rnal 'byor ma lik+ṣ-i ka ra ni/ dur khrod na bzhugs pa skra grol ba/ gri gug thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams shing rus rgyan can nam/ yang na smyon thabs 'bri ba'ang yod/ 82 sa mu dra pa ni/ rgya mtsho rdzing bar snang nas 'gro ba'i rnam pa can la/ khong rang ras kyi thod can/ mdun na grub thob a tsin+ta pa gcer bu ral pa can gcig gis chos ston pa/ 83 bya li pa ni mdun du bzheng pa dang bum pa dngul chu grub pa'i bcud len gyis gang ba/ lcags mang po gser du bsgyur ba'i tshul dang / khong rang bram ze'i cha byad du 'bri/ g.yon phyogs su chung ma/ bu dang bu mo/ gna' ma dang / rta gcig rnams 'bri/ de'i phyogs gang rung zhig tu/ mtsho 409

yi dkyil na brag ri gru bzhi pa rtse na khang bzang zhig dang bcas pa 'bri'o/ / 84 de ltar grub thob chen po brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bris yig so so'i rnam thar dang mthun par sbyar ba/rje btsun chen po sgrol ba'i mgon po'i bzhed pa ji lta ba las rang rtog gi cung zad kyang ma slad par bkod pa'o/ /e ma rgyal ba'i zhal skyin rmad byung ba/ /'phags mchog ho ru ka dpal che ba'i mchog /sku yi rol gar rnam pa thams cad tshul/ /gdul bya'i dpal mgon de dag ngo mtshar che/ /gang gi sku brnyan 'bri tshul nor 'khrul lhag chad rkyen no/ /spang pa 'di nyid 'phags yul gtam la rtag goms gyur/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas mchog de yi gsung gi mthu dpal las/ /slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal bzhed gang 'dir gsal byas/ /gang zhig grub mchog slob dpon che 'di rnams kyi sku/ /'bri sems 'bri ba de mthong dga' sems skyes pa kun/ /byang chen nye lam mchog brnyes slob dpon de dag bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' go 'phang yongs su bskyed par nges/ /gzhan yang 'tshams med spyod dang nyi ma re re bzhin/ /bram ze bsod kyang stobs bzhi yongs su tshangs gyur pas/ /gnyen po kun spyod sngags ldan 'di la 'bad pa naglu//sgrib pa'i phung po ma lus dag la som nyi ci/ /las bzhi lta stangs grub chen brgyad kyang 'dis thob la/ /phyag rgya che mchog gnyer yang der bkod gru chen ste/ /des na ye shes grub pa'i mchog gyur 'di dag rnamasaske/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sgyu 'phrul yongs shes pas/ /rnam thar nyan dang 'bri mched las la brtson pa yi/ /bag chags phyogs la bzhag pas rnam kun dge ba'i 'bras/ /myur ster de phyir 'di la bdag lo dga' ba skyes/ /blo ldan rnams kyang 'di la spyod par gyis shig go /rab dkar lhag bsam dag pas 'bad pa yi/ /rab grub mchog sku'i snang brnyan bri ba'i thabs/ /rab tu gsal dag 'di bgyis mthus bdag sogs/ /rab mchog rdo rje sems dpa' myur thob shog /zhes grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi ngos 'dzin 'khrul pa can skyo ma snga btsan gyi rjes su ma 'brang bar/ grub thob so so'i sgrub thabs dang dbang chog rto ha rdzong rim dang bcas pa'i gzhung slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje'i man ngag me nyag lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i tshad ldan de yi rjes su 'brangs/mkhas pa'i mkhas pa shing rta chen po jo nang sprul sku rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' snying po'i bzhed pa ji bzhin rtag brtan theg mchog he ru ka'i lha khang du log bris su bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin ras bris kyang gnyis tsam mthong zhing / lhag tu rje btsun dam pas mdzad pa'i bri yig dngos ma zhig jo nang gi phyag brdar nyal nyil khrod nas sne chus zos cung zad byung ba zhig kyang rnyed pas/ de nyid dpang por byas rang bzos ma bslad par grub brgya'i mngon par rtogs pa dag cing gsal ba 'di ni/ mdo khams dbus 'gyur 'bri rgyud re khe'i ljongs su skyes pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus/ sbas yul 'bras 410

mo ljongs kyi byang sgo 'bri mtshams gsang sngags ri bo'i dben gnas shing yos nag zla'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyer lnga'i snga char grub par byas pa'i yi ge pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje'o/ /mkhas rlom byis pa'i ngan g.yos ci zhig bya/ /btsun tshug bdud 'dzin dam pos don dam gang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phyogs mtha' dag /myur ster grub pa nyid las su zhig ku/ /des na bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /ma nor sngags kyi spyod pas bdag gzhan don/ /rgya chen yid bzhin nor bu nyid 'grub shog /zhes yang ched du brjod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'orka//maṅga lo/bkra shis/oṃ swā ste si ma rastu/ thub dbang gzugs sku dngos su ma gzigs yang / /sngags lam ma bsten thub dbang longs spyod rdzogs/ /mngon gzigs 'phags pa'i sa la yongs gshegs tshul/ /thun mong 'gro la ston mkhas grub rnams rgyal/ / 1 yang dag don la grub pa 'di dag rnams/ /'ga' zhig rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang gdul bya'i ched/ /'ga' ni rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dgra bcom dang / /byang sems 'phags pa mchog gi sa brnyes shing / / 2 'ga' zhig tsam ni rdo rje theg nye lam/ /mthu nus nyid kyi so skye nyid kyang ngo ske/ /tshul 'di rtogs pas gnas skabs phyogs longs mdo/ /dngos gnas sangs rgyas las gzhan spyod yul min/ / 3 spyir yang bzo sman sngags kyi mtshan nyid dang / /chos nyid don dang grub pa'i spyod yul rnams| /blo yi dpyad par nus pa'i yul min pas/ /bsam gyi mi khyab kho nar shes par bya/ / 4 zhes pa'ang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus so//

༄sha /bka' tha ma don dam rnam par nges pa nges don snying po'i mdo'i dkar chag bsam 'phel nor bu'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo bud+dha ya/ na moḥdharmā yaḥ na moḥsat+ta ya/ dri ma yongs spangs gdod nas rnam dag ye shes khamasaske//rab rgyas dam pa sku gnyis spyi dpal rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chos nyid lus gang ngo bo nyid sku kun tu bzang / /rang bzhin 'od gsal don dam thub dbang der phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi yi seṅge thub pa chen po ni/ /bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi par yongs brjod shākya tog gang gi/ /gdul bya'i dbang skal dang mtshungs bcu gnyis yan lag 'khor lo gsum/ /bskor las shin tu rgyas pa'i sde gyur theg chen ngo mtshar mchog /de yang nges don mthar thug gsal byed ni/ /tha ma phyir mi ldog pa snying po'i gtam/ /phyogs 'di ji snyed mdo sde nyi shu pa'i/ /nges 'dzin shing rta mchog gyur gsung ji bzhin/ /'gro la sman blos bsam 'phel nor bu yi/ /phreng ba dang mtshungs 'dir spel gus pas nyon/ /nges don mdo mchog nyi shu 'di lta ste/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa snying po'i mdo/ /rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs/ /lha mo dpal phreng seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa/ /rnga bo che dang sor mo'i phreng bar phan/ /'di dag snying po'i mdo lngar bstan pa yin/ /lang kar gshegs dang rgyan stug bkod pa'i mdo/ /rab zhi rnam nges 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin/ /sprin chen po rnams snga ma lngar bsnan pas/ /snying po'i mdo sde bcu ru gsungs pa yin/ /de dag steng du stong pa nyid kyi mdo/ /chen po stong nyid sher phyin lnga brgya pa/ /byams zhus le'u dgongs pa nges par 'grel/ /gzungs dbang zhus dang chos yang bsdud pa dang / /gser 'od dam pa de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /yon tan ye shes bsam mi khyab pa dang / /'phags pa mya ngan 'das pa chen po'i mdo/ /bsnan pas nges don mdo sde nyi shu yin/ /de steng theg chen rgyu bzang mdor byas pa/ /blo gros mi zad pa yi bstan pa'i mdo/ /'bras bu yon tan mdo ru byas pa ni/ /rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa sa bcu'i mdoske/ /de dag theg chen spyi don ngo mtshar bas/ /de slad nges don mdo dang dkyus gcig 'dren/ /de lta'i mdo sde nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /'bri klog 'chad nyan bsam bsgom bgyis pa yis/ /dge ba'i phung po tshad bzung mi nus te/ /rgyas pa mdo sde rang rang nas gsal mod/ /spyir ni nyan thos lam pas de yi gzhung / /bskal par 'bad pa'i dge yang byang sems kyis/ /rang gi sde snod dad pas cha shas tsam/ /spyad pa'i dge 412

bas zil gyi gnon gsung zhing / /theg chen la yang thun mong drang don dang / /nges don mchog gyur lo brgyar 'bad pa las/ /nges don mthar thug mdo sder dad pa yi/ /glegs bam spyi bor blang pas byang chub nyeske//grags na lan gcig tsam bklag phan yon yang / /gzugs mchis nam mkha'i khyon du shong mi 'gyur/ /des na dal 'byor tshe ldan 'bras yod phyir/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran yon tan bsam bzhin du/ /nges don mdo sde 'di rnams rab bzung ste/ /mchod 'bul phyag bskor ji nus 'bad pa na/ /dge de 'di dang phyi ma ji srid du/ /mi dang mi min gnod zhi nad dang bral/ /tshe dpal 'byor pa bsod nams tshogs kun rgyas/ /rang 'bras sangs rgyas go 'phang ring min 'grub/ /de ltar rgyal bar gyur pa ma lus dgongs pa'i mthar thug pa/ /drang don min par nges don nges pa'i don gang 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mdo mchog 'jig rten 'di na rin thang bral ba'i bsam 'phel dbang / /tshul der lhag par mos pas rnam grangs dkar chags yi ger bkod/ /de yi dge bas 'gro kun nges don snying po yi/ /chos la mos zhugs de mdo phyir mi ldog mchog thob/ /kun bzang 'jam dpal dang mtshungs byang chub spyad pa spyod/ /kun gzigs ji bzhin rgyal ba'i 'bras bu myur thob shog /ces pa yang phyir mi ldog pa nges pa don gyi snying po'i mdo sde la shin tu gus pa'i blo can rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu phrin las 'gro 'dul gyi don grub zhes pa lug gi lo zhal gsar du 'char bar phyogs pa/rgyal zla'i tshes bco brgyad kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi dus mchod skabs su kong po'i yul gyi bon ri zhes bod kyi rgyal po la snga ba lha gnyan khri btsan po 'phrul thag las bab pa'i ri bo lha ri gyen mtha'i rtse mor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan no dge'o//dge'o// 413

༄gi /bcom ldan 'das dpal che mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa byung tshul sa bon tsam smos pa ma ṇi ka yi don shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥshrī ho ru ka la gu tsakra sam+bha ra ma/ sngags rgyud kyi sgo drug pa rnal 'byor ma yi bla na med pa bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud bshad kyi bka' srol ci snyed ri kha ba can gyi khong 'dir byung ba las grags che ba bka' srol bzhi tsam byon te lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po rgyud par bcas pa lo chen mar do chos kyi dbang phyug lo phangs su rang grags 'byor shes rab/ klog skya ba yab sras te/ lo chen 'di bzhi'i ༄gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gsal bar mdzad pa la/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas bshad pa'i rgyun ring zhig ma byung bar snyam la/ mar do lugs ni 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal yab sras bar du rgyun ma chad la/ lo chung lugs ni dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas rim par glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen dang / dmar dharma ra tsa bar du byung bar grags te/ deng sang rgyun ma bzhugs par mngon/ 'on kyang thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub la bshad srol gsum bzhugs par bzhed pas de'i 'grel gzhung gi rgyun dngos gzhi yang deng dus bzhugs par srid la/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi bu ston rin chen nas brgyud pa'i 'grel chen legs par gsan nas mar do'i bzhed pa shas che ba'i ṭi ka yang mdzad nas spel ba ni/ da lta rgyun bzhugs bzhin pa'o/ /gzhan ni klog skya ba yab sras la brgyud pa gtso ste/ de yang lo tsā ba klog skya shes rab rtsegs sa mal gyo blo gros grags pas bde mchog gi dbang sgrub rnams zhus shing / phyis bal por nā ro ta pa'i dngos kyi slob ma mang por thugs nas dbang bshad man ngag ci rigs pa thob cing / khyad par shri pha ṇa be+e gu pa dpal gdengs ka'i phun sgra can zhes bal po pham mthing par grags pa la rgyud slob bshad man ngag dbang dang bcas gsan nas/ rje sa chen a nan+da garta la legs par stsal zhing / des rtsa rgyud kyi le 'grel dang bsdus don/ de bzhin rgyud kyi bka' 'grel mdzad cing / rje lo tsā ba dang sa chen gnyis ka'i slob ma gnyen phul byung bas gsung rgyun zin ris su btab pa'i rgyud kyi 'bru 'grel mu tig phreng ba zhes kyang bya ste 'bru 'bum du yang grags pa de mdzad/ de la rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo dang grags pa gnyis kyi gsan/ grags pas rang gi dbon 'jam pa'i dbyangs paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bshad par mdzad/ des rang gi slob ma mang yul du 'khrungs 414

pa'i mkhas pa khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan la gsung / des bla ma rin po che blo chen sangs rgyas sras la bshadaske/ des rgyal bzang dpal la bshad/ des spang khar grags pa dpal la bshad/ /des sa bzang paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti dh+wa tsha shrī bha ṭa la gsungs/ des rgyud kyi ṭi ka bsdus pa zhig mdzad/ de la sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi gsan/ des rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa a nan+da bha ṭa la bshad/ des sems dpa' chen po rat+na ke ru la rtsal/ des mkhas mchog bsod nams seng ge dang grub chen blo gros gnyis la gsung / de gnyis ka yi sangs rgyas rin po che la gsung / de nas rim par rgyud zhes thos te/ brgyud pa 'di la bshad pa'i rgyud kun spyod kyi bshad pa yang mchis/ slad mar rgyud pa 'di las byung ba'i bshad pa rnyed srid tshe/lo rgyus rgyas pa zhig bri ba yang 'dod do//de ltar bla med bla ma he ru ka /'khor lo bde mchog dpal ldan sdom pa'i gzhung / /tshe sngon 'phan pa'i las dbang kyi bskul nas/ /snying nas rab mos g.yar dam bgyi blo can/ /de yi lo rgyus nor bu'i 'phreng 'di skad/ /dad pa'i shugs kyi mod la bris pa ste/ /dge bas 'gro kun ho ru ka dpal gyi/ /rgyud sde bshad nyan 'bring klog 'chang ba la/ /skye ba kun tu 'bad med nyid 'grub shog /zhes pa'ang tshe dbang nor bu yi gsang mtha'i rgyud rgyal 'di yi bshad pa zhig thob na snyam pa dung dung pos bskul nas mnga' ri glo bo kyog ra brag phug tu 'gal byed lcags phag gi lo nag zla'i tshes bcur smras pa'o/ /yang dus phyis kyi skabs su rgya dkar slob dpon dpyod 'chang dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku rje btsun nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa dpal sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhal nas spyir sngags kyi bstod tshig don phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje'i gsung bsam gyi mi khyab pa bkod par mdzad cing / bye brag gsang mtha'i gzhung bshad man ngag ji snyed zhig dang / khyad par du 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud nyung ngu len lnga bcu gcig de nyid dpal ho ru ka dpa' bo rnal 'byor rnams dang bsgros te mtha' drug tshul bzhi gtan la phab pa slob bshad snying gi thig le su dang de yi cha rgyan du nges par dgos pa rgya dkar gyi gzhung sdom drug las spyod 'chang nag po chung bas mdzad pa'i sdom pa snying po dang / slob dpon rnam rgyal zhabs kyi mdzad pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i bstod pa sgyu 'phrul chen mo ste/ de rnams kyi rgyun ma chad tsam du da lta bzhugs zhes thos so/ /spyir bde mchog nyung ngu la rgya 'bral bod du 'gyur ba bcu drug tsam dang / bod 'grel yang che phra mang du byung rung / de thams cad rting mar byung zhing mtha' mchod du grub pa dpyis phyin pa rgyal po lta bu ni sgrol mgon zhabs kyi bshad pa/ dpal gsang bdag gi mdzad pa'i 'grel don gtso bor byas te zab dgu'i bcud bsdus nas bkod pa 'di nyid ni mchog gyur yin par mngon pas shin tu nas rtsis su bya ba'i gnas so/ /nyung ngu rgyud bshad rgyu skar 'phreng ba'i dbus gsang bdag man ngag grub thob rgya mtsho 415

yi—/ /legs bshad tshig dril slob bshad snying thig bcud/ /sgrol mchog bzhed pa bcu drug cha can ltar/ /rmad byung 'od kyi rgya bod mkhas mang tshig /kun gyi nang nas yid bzhin dbang ltar gyur/ e ma sngon tshe spyod mdzad rdo rje des/ /gzhung drug tsam yang rgyud bshad ma mdzad de/ /dgongs pa can gyi thugs dgongs lhag ma de/ /grub par gyur ram dpal ldan nag po'i zhabs/ /'on kyang gdul bya'i bsod nams mthu dman pas/ /deng dus phra mor gyur 'di snying nas skyo/ /des na bslu med rgyal ba'i bden nus kyi/ /gzhung de 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang tshe dbang nor bus gang gi 'phro der gdan thog gcig tu smras so//de yang kho bos tshe 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud sde'am ṭi ka thos pa'i thog ma ni dpal phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nyung ngu'i stod 'grel phur bu sa spre'u lo la byang ru lag 'bras spung du nos la/ de nas dpal spyod 'chang sgrol ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa'i slob bshad snying gi thig le gang bla ma mchog la/ lung rgyun bzhugs kyang dpe rgyun ma rnyed pas yun du song bar phyis 'bri mtshams nas skye sngon las kyi glegs bam tshegs med du 'byor nas klag lung yang bag yod lcags glang lo cho 'phrul zla bar thos te/ de rnams chos rje kun bzang dbang po'i zhabs drung du'o/ /de nas srin bu shing yos lor zha lu thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel chen gyi klag lung zha lung ri phug tu dge slong 'jam dpal chos mchog la nos/ slar yang bshad rgyun ched du dus kyi pho nya sa pho rta yi lo yer pa'i mdo ri khrod nyi ma lding du mkhas pa dam pa 'jam dbyangs rdo rje 'dzin par rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi yig cha sbas don gsal ba'i steng nas bshad rgyun 'dzub khrid sngags btu byin rlabs bcas yid tshim par thob/ deng sang ri bo dga' ldan gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pas sa chen dog por gyur kyang lugs de'i sngags chos ji bzhin 'chad par mdzad pa ni/ bdag gi bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kho nar nges par snyed pa'o zhes pa'ang ched du brjod par byas so/ /de ltar rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa'i bka' dang klag lung gnyis ka thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yan des mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi chos 'byung ltar la/ de nas gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po/ rje shes rab seng ge rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal/ rtse pa shes rab bzang po/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos skyong rgya mtsho/dwags po nam mkha' grags/ rje byams pa rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen rnam rgyal dpal bzang / stag lung grags pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ sku skye ngag dbang chos rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs dam chos rnam rgyal/ /'khri chen gzhogs pa blo bzang don yod/ bka' 'gyur ba pan chen sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ rgyud chen rdo rje 'chang rta mgrin phun tshogs/'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/des bdag rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu la'o// 416

༄ga /rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yi lha'i mtshan grangs gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥshrī badz+ra pa je ya/ rgyud rgyal rdo rje gdan dkyil 'khor/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i lha grangs mtshan/ /paṇa chen 'gro ba dga' ba'i gzhung / /ji bzhin 'di na brjod par bya/ /de yang dbus su rnal 'byor nam mkha' dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs sa bon rdu las skyes shing yum ye shes mkha' 'gro dkar mo seng ge'i gdan can no/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo glang po'i gdan can chu yig sum las skyes paske/ nub tu ro langs ma dmar mo khyung gi gdan can/ lhor gtum mo sngon mo mngag gzhug gi gdan can ste me rlung sa yig rgyuyī rdu las skyes shing rang rigs la 'khyud pa'o/ /dbang ldan seng ge dkar ser phyed gzugasaske/mer stag mo dkar sngo/ bde chen bral du lce spyang sngo dmar/ rlung mtshems 'ug gdong dmar ser/chu sa rlung me rtsegs pa'i yi ge las skyes shing / seng phag ma ho rtse spyang gi gdan la gnas pa'o/ /shar sgor mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang sgor mar me ma ser mo/ nub sgor 'jigs byed ma dmar mo/ lho sgor 'phrog byed nag mo/ bzhi ka ro gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo ra'i phyi rol du shin tu dmar ba'i sa gzhi la/ shar du sbos ma 'ju byed ma gsum dkar sngo sor ba/ byang du drag mo khrag 'thung sha za gsum dkar ser dmar bske/ nub tu drag shul/ 'bar ma/ mi sdug gsum dmar ser mthing kha/ lhor thod ma/ rdo rje/ bum pa gsum sngo dmar dkar po'o/ /dbang ldan du sgeg mo ser/ dri chab ma dmar/ mer pi waṃ ma dkar/ me tog ma dkaraske/ srin por glu ma dkar/ bdug spos ma dmar/ rlung du gar ma dmar mo/ mar me ma ser mo/ de yi phyi rim zlum skor gser gyi kha dog lta bu/ dpa' bo nyi shu/ lha mo dang bcas pa ste/ shar dbus keng rus 'jig byed dang / lha mo pad+ma'i dbyings can/ shar g.yas srin po khatā ka/ lha mo ser rnon ma/ shar g.yon sgra zab dang / lha mo sgra zab ma/ byang dbus dril bu'i sna ba can lha mo dril sgra ma/ de g.yas gtum pa'i dbang phyug lha mo pad gdong ma/ g.yon du ser ka'i gdong dang / lha mo pad gnas ser mo/ nub dbus mngal skyes dga' ba/ lha mo dpyid mtho ma/ de g.yas 'jig byed dang / lha mo dga' ba mo/ g.yon du chu skyar gza' dang / lha mo thor cog brgyan/ lho dbus bsgreg pa can/ lha mo dor stab dga' de g.yas cang tel 'dul/ lha mo rnga sgra dga' ma/ g.yon du rnga chen ltad mo che/ lha mo rnga chen rol byed ma/ dbang ldan g.yas su rtsod par dga' ba/ lha mo byin phra ma/ g.yon du lag ring / lha mo g.yo sgrogs ma/ me g.yas/ mche 417

rtsig lha mo 'od rno ma g.yon/ bstan pa 'jig rung / lha mo dal smra ma/ bden bral g.yas zas la spyod pa/lha mo ser skya'i spyan/ g.yon du gdong brgya pa/ lha mo spyan rgyas pa/ rlung gi g.yas su tshangs dbyangs/ lha mo gnyen pa'i lus can/ g.yon du 'jig pa'i sgra can/ lha mo bung bu'i sgra can pa'o/ /skum skor de yi shar sgor khyab 'jug g.yas dpal mo/ g.yon phag mo/ byang sgor tshangs pa/ g.yas tshangs ma g.yon dbyangs can ma/ nub sgor ma lha shwa ra/ g.yas dbang phyug ma/ g.yon gaṅga ma/ dbang ldan du dbang po/ /g.yas bde byed ma/ g.yon rtsom pa mo/ mer lus ngan po/ g.yas nor gyi blo gros/ g.yon 'phrog ma/ bden bral 'byung po'i bdag po/ g.yas la 'i dbang phyug ma dang / g.yon khrag 'thung ma/ klung du klu sbrul mgo brgya pa/g.yas dpal ldan longs spyod ldan ma/ g.yon ut+pal dga' ma sbru mgo gsum ma/ de dag rim pas khyung /ngang pa khyu mchog glang po/ sa srung du mi/ rta chu srin la zhon pa'o//de'i phyir rol rlum skor re mig bcu drug gi shar du/ nag po g.yon du mya ngan med pa/ dbang ldan du 'jig rung / g.yon du rna ba mthong ma de bzhin byang du gtum po dang / bde byed ma/ rlung du 'jig byed dang / rlung shugs ma/ nub tu sgra sgrog/g.yon du sgyu 'phrul ma/ bde chen bral du smyo byed/ 'bar ma lhor thod pa can/ dpal chen mo/ mer khro bo/nag mo/ de nas yang me yi zur thar/ stobs chen dang / rab dngas ma/ lho yi zur mthar/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo ser skya ma nub zur bi bi ta ka dang / tsub mo/ rlung gi zur du gangs brtsegs rna bar rog ma/ nor bdag mtha' ru/ sgrogs pa can dang / skra brtsegs ma/ dbang ldan zur mtha' tshig legs brjod pa dang /rig byed 'jug ma/ shar gyi zur mthar/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang rgan byed ma rnams so/ /de yi phyi rol dur khrod brgyad/ shar du drag tu bzhad pa/ byang du chu lha/ nub tu nye rgyal/ lhor kaul+la gi ri/ dbang ldan de wī ko ṭa/ bden bral du rgyal ba mo/ rlung du rab sbyor te/ de dag tu gdan/ ri bo/ shing / chu/ sgrin/ ro/mchod rten phyogs skyongs/ klu/ grub pa/ rigs ma ste rnam grangs bcu gcig re bshad cing / de ltar dur khrod brgyad du/ dur khrod bdag po/ shar du drag po nag po sogs/ drag po brgyad btsun mo g.yog bcas bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad phyogs dang mtshams su bkod pa ni rgyu 'di dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsung pa'i spyi dang mthun par snang ngo / /de ltar rdo rje gdan bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi rim pa yab bka' dang yum bka'i bye brag tu gyur pa ār+ya de was mdzad pa dang / bha wa las mdzad pa dang / a bha ya ka ras mdzad pa dang /bal po rnam rgyal dbang pos mdzad pa rnams mthong ba las/ 'dir ni paṇ+ḍi ra dza gar ā nan dzi wa bha dras mdzad pa ltar ste/ 'di la da lta bka' yod par mi mngon yang / sgrub thabs gzhan las lha tshogs rgyas par snang bas/ lha grangs ngos zin sla ba'i ched du bkod pa ste/ 'on kyang gzhung 'di la lo tsā ba'i 'gyur ma bde ba cung zad 'dug kyang rgya dpe ma mthong bas dpyad mi bzod do/ /'dir bkod pa'i lha 418

tshogs kyi grangs ni brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad ste/ rang rigs yab bzhi bsnan pas brgya drug cu rtsa gnyis so/ /rtag pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan bzhi pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gi lha tshogs grangasaske//dad pa mchog gi 'dir bkod par/ /dge ba'i tshogs kyi 'gro ba kun/ /dge ba'i dpal la legs sbyor zhing //dge ba'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i gnas//dge ba'i 'byung gnas nyid 'grub shog /zhes pa yang rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus mos pa'i dbang gi drag po khrum zla'i tshes bzang bcu drug par rtag brtan rin chen spungs su bris pa dge'o// 419

༄ga /smon tshig sna tshogs phyogs bsdus bzhugs so/ /oṃ ṭ+wāste/ na mo burnya shākya mu na ya/ phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gnas/ /phun sum tshogs pa kun gyi rtse son pa/ /phun sum tshogs pas 'gro kun rjes su skyong / /phun tshogs mnga' ba thub pa'i dbang por 'dud/ /bkra shis bye bas rgyan pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /bkra shis 'od zer 'bum du yongs spro mdzadaglu/ /bkra shis snang bas sa gsum kun tu khengs/ /bkra shis 'byung gnas rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'dudaske/ /rab mchog sku'i ba spu nyag cig khyon/ /rab mdzes bskal par ltas kyang chog mi shes/ /rab rgyas sangs rgyas zhing khams rdul snyegs rdzogs//rab bkra rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud//yon tan phyogs su 'os pa ma lus kun/ /yon tan char ston mdzad pa med pa'i gter/ /yon tan mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyal ba'i sku/ /yon tan yongs 'chang de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mi shig rtag par gnas pa'i rdo rje'i sku/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung rang bzhin rdo rje tshe/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba rgyal ba'i dngos/ /mi mchog thub pa'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /bzang po'i yon tan gyur pa ma lus kun/ /bzang po'i bdag nyid khyed kyi ma byas med/ /bzang po'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig pas 'gro kun/ /bzang por 'god mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ji snyed mkha' khyab rdul phran g.yo ba yangs/ /ma chags thogs pa med pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ji bzhin rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /ma rig rtsad gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dge ba'i sems kyi kun nas dngas ba yi/ /dge legs rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs tshig 'di yis/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas thub chen la bstod pa'i/ /dge bas bdag gzhan sangs rgyas myur thob shog /zhes pa yang mtshur lha chen 'dzam gling brgyan la snyan dar phul ba'i ngos su rang lugs rgyud rtsis kyi zla ba drug pa nyis rtsegs snga ma'am tshes nyi shu la mtshur gyi gasdo lar rig pa 'dzin pas smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ āḥr+ghaṃsum̐ trīḥ swā hā/ oṃ swāste/ kun bzang bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo nyid/ /mchog tu dga' ba lhan cig skyes pa'i gshis/ 'pho ba kun spang 'pho chen rdo rje'i sku/ /ma sbas rang lhug ye shes mkha' 'gro dang ske//sgyu 'phrul sras po kha sbyor zung 'jug nyid//gdod ma'i gnas lugs zab gsal bde ba'i khams//mtshon byed gzugs sku'i bkod pa ngo mtshar phul/ /go bzlog chags bral sku la chags ldan yul/ /srid grol pad+mo zhi bzlog zla gdan la/ /kun rdzob bden pa mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal/ /don dam bden pa rdo rje btsun mor+sā 'khyud/ /mtha' bral dbu ma chos 'chad phyag rgya can/ /bslab gsum mthar phyin chos gos 420

gsum gyis mdzes/ /rdo rje'i ting 'dzin g.yo med rdo rje'i gdan/ /gser mdog blo bur dri spang chos nyid donak+ṣi/ /mtshan gyi me tog sum cubo gnyis la/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i 'bras bu spras/ /g.yas mas dga' ba bcu drug mtshan gnyis dang / /re rer ye shes lnga sbyar brgyad cur rdzogs/ /ye shes sku la zhing khams 'du bral med/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag /bcu gnyis spros pa'i mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings/ /zhing 'dir gdul byar shākya thub chen po/ /bye ba phrag brgya sprul mdzad tshangs pa'i mchog /'og min zhing mchog 'khor lo bsgyur ba po/ /sa bcu sems dpa'i dbus su rnam snang mdzad/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dbus su he ru ka /nyan thos ngo ru tshangs pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /rnam pa thams cad rnam kun mchog ldan bdag /chos kyi sku la gang gi gzhal du med/ /gzhal med zhes kyang spros pa bral ba'i don/ /ye shes gzugs sku'i bkod pa cir yang snang / /srid gyur skye 'gro zhi ba myang 'das pa/ /'byung lnga zhing khams kun snang sgyu ma'i gdangs/ /lha sku bri 'bur yi ge'i gzugs kyang shar/ /khyad par rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan ni/ /gcig gis phan yon nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /mngon sum bgrang yas mchod las lhag par bsngags/ /bla med sku ni de bas yang mchog ste/ /ye shes snang ba lam me 'di yi mthus/ thar pa'i ded dpon bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /thar gnyer bskal bzang slob mas sa steng khyab/ /nges don snying po'i bstan pa nye bar spyod/ /rgyal bas bstan pa ji bzhin dam chos gtam/ /'khrul med bar mi chad pas 'gro ba kun/ /shākya seng ge'i go 'phang la bkod shog /ces pa yang 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan spren sgra'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i spyi phud rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta'i sde dpal mchog gi thugs dam thub pa yum 'khyud kyi zhal thang gi rgyab byang du bal yul dharma tha la'i rgyal khang du dzo ki tshe dbang nor bus na tshod ldan/sbo zla'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum par bris pa bkra shis/oṃ swāste sirnyi/ kun khyab 'gro ba'i nyi ma char nub spang ba gang / /ma rig mun sel ye shes snang ba rab rgyas pa/ /kun tu mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sras po lha mi'i mgon/ /shākya'i dbang po shākya thub pa de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mtshan thos tsam gyi ngan song sdug bsngal bcil bar mdzad/ /dwangs ba'i sems kyi 'gyur bcas sdug bsngal mtha' dag bzlog /rtag tu rjes dran 'du byed sdug bsngal drung nas 'byin/ /sdug bsngal kun sel sman pa'i rgyal po khyed la 'dud/ /theg chen lam gnas phan yon tshad med mtha' dag kun/ /khyed kyi yon tan rjes su dran las gzhan yod min/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bskal pa bye ba bgrang yas su/ /brjod par nus min yon tan mchog gter khyed la 'dud/ /bdag ni 'gro kun la sman phan bde'i spyi thob phyir/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ma lus ci mchis kun/ /yongs su bstus nas shākya'i rgyal po mchog khyed la/ /mchod par 'bul gyi thugs rje brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /bdag gzhan 'gro bas thogs med nas brtsam da lta'i bar/ /sgo gsum mi dge sdig pa'i las gyur ci snyed par/ /shin tu 421

gnong shing 'gyod pa'i sems kyi mthol bshags na/ /deng nas sgrib med dag tshangs mchog gi dbugs dbyung stsol/ /bdag gi dus 'di nas brtsam byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skye ba ji srid kun tu bdag mthong ming thos dang / /dad cing gus pas yid la sems dang chags khro bsdams/ /kun kyang sgrib med bde chen mchog 'bras rab ster shog /bdag gi yang ni byams pas skyong dang sdang bas bsdams/ /zhen med sgyu mar gnas dang chags sred yul du byas/ /phrag dog yul du byas dang bdag nyid rlom yul sogs/ /mdor na yid yul byas kun byang chub mchog sbyin shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri med snying po mtha' dag pa/ /bdag gi cig char 'dzin ste ris med 'gro la spel/ /bslad med dam chos 'dzin pas sa gsum kun tu khengs/ /khyad par 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa dar rgyas shog /ces 'phrul snang jo shāg la snyan dar lha gos rnam par dkar ba phul ba la smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la bris pa sarba maṅga lo/ oṃ swāsti/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med/ /bdag gi snying gi mgon / /khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag gi tshe dang srog /bsod nams dge tshogs kun/ /khyed la snying nas 'bul/ /nges par bzhes su gsol/ /bdag gi skyid sdug ci/ /blo gtad khyed las med/ /byang chen snying po'i bar/ /'dren pa khyed lags so/ /thugs rjes gzigs mdzod dang / /gzi brjid 'od dpag med/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /dngos zhal bstan du gsol/ /ces 'phrul snang gi rten gtso chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dam 'od dpag med kyi snyan dar dngos su rab byung bcu gsum pa sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po khyed nyid kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa gang / /gzhan steng lta ba mchog /ji bzhin ma nor ba/ /bdag gi rtogs gyur nas/ /tshe rabs tshe rgyud du/ /gzhan steng lta ba mchog /gzhan la rgya cher ston/ /'gro ba ma lus pas/ /lta ba mchog de 'dzin/ /'khor los gsum pa'i gtam/ /kun gyi sgrogs par shog /ces rab byung bcu gsum pa sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga byams pa chos 'khor la snyan dar dngos su rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus spel ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spu long g.yo bzhin du/ /dad pa'i thal sbyar nas/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo la/ /snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /dus 'di nas brtsam ste/ /byang chub snying po'i bar/ /'jam dpal dpal bo yi/ /bdag gi 'dren pa mdzod/ /rig pa'i gnas chen lnga/ /thog med smra ba la/ /bdag gi mgrin dbus su/ /khyod nyid rtag bzhugs mdzod/ /snying gi ge sar dbus/ /mgon khyod rtag bzhugs nas/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab kun/ /gcig car 'dzin par shog /'phrul snang 'jam dpal nga yol gyi sku brnyan snyan dar la sa ga zla tshes bco lngar rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/ 422

oṃ ṭ+wāste sirnyi/ rgyal kun yab tu gdod nas sangs rgyas pa/ /'od zer dpal rtsegs rgyal po lha'i lha/ /slar yang 'gro la brtse bas byang sems tshul/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyod kyi ba spu gcig gi yon tan cha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi bskal pa cher/ /sgrogs kyang mdzad par nus min rgyal ba'i mchog /nam mkha' rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /shin tu nyams thag duḥkhas mnar ba dang / /nyon mongs ches bsdams log par sred can rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyi lhag par brtse bar mdzad/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'dud/ /bdag gi dus 'di nas brtsam byang chen bar/ /srog gi phyir yang mi spangs yi dam lha/ /khyed nyid lags so 'gro kun dge ba'i bshes/ /khyod kyi mdzod cig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /khyed zhal lta bar 'dod tshe rtag mthong zhing / /de bzhin gsung thos 'dod tshe ci 'dod thos/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi nam yang mi bor bar/ /brtse bas rjes su bzung mdzod spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag ni nyon mongs khro chags le los bsdam/ /ngan 'gro duḥ kha 'khor ba'i las bsags kun/ /mgon khyed spyan sngar snying nas mthol bshags na/ /tshangs pa mchog tu dbugs dbyung stsal du gsol/ /dus 'di yang ni bdag gi 'dod pa'i don/ /nges don phyir mi ldog pa snying po'i gtam/ /rang gi rtogs phyir gzhan la rgya cher spel/ /bstan pa 'dzin pas sa chen khengs par shog /de bzhin 'gro ba'i don spyod skyes bu rnams/ /thugs mthun kun gyi dam chos snying po spel/ /dga' bde rgya mtsho'i dpal la longs spyod cing / /sku tshe mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag lhun grub shog /gzhan yang grub pa'i bste gnas mchog rnams su/ /rnam dag grub pa'i sde chen kun tu rgyas/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa mtha' dag nyams/ /dam chos slad med dga' ston 'gyed par shog /bdag nyin mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal kun bral bde ba'i dpal la spyod/ /phyir mi ldog pa 'phags pa'i sa chen por/ /'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang la bkod shog /mdor na bdag dang 'brel gyur 'gro ba kun/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i mthur brten te/ /lus 'di bor ma thag tu bde can zhing / /skyes nas 'od dpag med zhal mthong bar shog /zhes pa 'di yang rab byung bcu gsum pa sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga rgyal ba'i dus chen gsum 'dzom la 'phrul snang bod yul brten gtso 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal la snyan dar phul ba'i logs su rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ mkha' ltar chos sku spros pa med pa las/ /gdul bya'i dpal mgon gzugs sku cir yang snang / /bems po'i gzugs la ye shes lha yi dngos/ /rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyur der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci bsags kun/ /gzi bajid 'od dpag med mgon ji 'dra ba'i/ /go 'phang thob phyir bsngo na dus myur bar/ /'gro ba'i mgon du de 'dra bdag gyur shog /zhes lha ldan ra mo 423

che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i snyan dar du rgyal khams pa rig pa 'dzin pas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi smon lam rgya mtsho'i dpyid/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal la dbang bsgyur ba—/ /'od dpag med mgon zhing 'di'i thub dbang gi/ /bstan la sngags kyi ston pa thod 'phreng stsal/ /snyigs dus mi srun gdugs pa 'dul slad du/ /khros pa'i skur snang che mchog drag po rtsal/ /gang gi byin rlabs mthu yi dad ldan 'di/ /byang chub snying po'i ba ra du bsrung bar mdzod/ /zhes pa yang rgyal khams pa rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge legs su gyur cig /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal kun gsang gsum bdag po dus 'di ru/ /'gro la rjes chags sngags bstan 'dzin pa'i gtso//rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzung gter bdag gling //gang des byang chub bar du dge legs stsol//zhes dang /oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gdul bya'i mos ngo dang / /mthun par 'jug pas snyigs dus gang 'dul gzugs/ /rang bzhin gnyug mar gnas kyang rnal 'byor zol/ /rje btsun bla mas yun ring bsrung gyur cig /zhes pa yang rgyal khams pa rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge legs su gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/lcabacom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi//thugs rje nus pa'i mthu dpal rmad byung bas//gang gi sku brnyan 'di yi dge ba'i mthus/ /dad ldan sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags gzi brjid kun/ /nyams med yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba dang / /khyad par bla med byang chub sems mchog gnyis/ /gong 'phel rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog zhes 'phags ma'i zang ka'i rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pas dge'o//oṃ swāste/ rab 'byams rgyal kun dkyil 'khor ma lus 'char ba dang / /gcig tu bsdu ba'i byed po kun tu bzang / /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /gang gi byang chub snying po'i bar du bsrungs|/zhes dad pa can gyi ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pas so//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ mkha' khyab ye shes rang nyid bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin nyid/ /'pho 'gyur yongs bral rtag pa mi shig rdo rje'i khams/ /bri gang 'gro 'ong las 'das rnam kun mchog ldan sku/ /'gro la rtag tu phan bde stsol mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /'khor lo bde mchog drwa ba sdom pa ho ru ka /lhan skyes rang 'od sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gyur ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma rdo rje phag mo dpal/ /rje btsun yab yum dgyes pa'i gar mdzod bdag byin rlobs/ /bdag gi dus 'di nas brtsams ho ru ka dpal khyed/ /ji bzhin go 'phang ma thob bar du skye kun tu/ /dge ba'i shes mchog rdo rje slob dpon dam pa ni/ /ho ru ka 424

dpal zhabs kyi mdzad cing rtag bsrung mdzod/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten bzang dal 'byor phun tshogs lusatso/ /dbang phyug mchog ldan gzugs mdzes kun gyi yid du 'ong / /mtho ris yon tan bdun dang rnam smin yon tan brgyad/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun rnams kyi rtag par rab phyug shog /rdo rje slob dpon dgyes pa'i las la khor mo yug /rab spyod mi dgyes skad cig dus mtha'i yun du'ang min/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos sangs rgyas las lhag yid/ /bar mtshams med pas rgyal ba mtha' dag dgyes byed shog /smin byed dbang bskur rim bzhin ma lus legs nod cing / /de yi ched du mchod pa'i yo byad tshogs 'khor loske/ /rgyud nas bshad bzhin srid gsum dpal 'byor ches mchod de/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mtha' dag rab 'gyed ha ha sgrog byed shog /dbang don bskyed dang rdzogs rim mtshan bcas mtshan med kyis/ /sa lam yon tan mtha' dag skad cig nyid la rdzogs/ /sa gsum pho nya'i 'du ba ma lus yongs su thob/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun gyi 'khor los bsgyur bar shog /rnam min phung po gnas 'gyur 'chi med 'od gsal lus/ /thob nas sangs rgyas zhing khams rgya mtshor rab tu spyod byas shing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mtha' dag byed pa sogs/ /theg chen smon lam gang btab bslu med nges 'grub shog /ces dbu ru drang srong srin po ri dpal he ru ka bde mchog sku rten la snyan dar ru rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus me yos dbyug zla'i tshes bcur phul ba sarba maṅga lo//oṃ swāsti/ don dam gdod nas 'chi med 'od gsal rdo rje tshe yi bdag /kun rdzob grangs med bskal pa'i mngon nas rgyal gzhan las/ /lhag pa'i thugs bskyed mthu yi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /'chi bdag dpung 'joms 'chi med mgon des rtag srung mdzod/ /mgon khyod lhag pa'i lha ru dam bcas shing ske/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du mi btang na/ /bdag gi 'di phyi kun tu phan bde'i dpyid/ /mtha' dag rgyas par mdzod cig thugs rje can/ /sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo/oṃ swāste/ bcom ldan dus dgra'i gshed cig lha yi lha/ /khro chen yongs kyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dpalaske/ /rtag tu g.yel med thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du bsrung / /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ rgyal ba kun gyi gtsug gtor dbyings las sprul/ /dran pa tsam gyi mi mthun mtha' dag 'joms/ /rig sngags lha mo yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /khyed kyi bdag cag 'khor dang bcas te bsrung ske//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam 'phrul dpal ldan karma ka dang rje 'brug pa//gang gi phyag gi pad+mo nyer bkod byin brlab gzi byin 'bar ba bla ma'i sku/ /'di yi dge mthu'i mthong 425

thos dran reg 'gro ba ma lus mngon mtho nges legs dpal/ /phun sum tshogs gyur ring min byang chub che thob gzhan phan rgya mtsho rgyas gyur cig /ces gzhon nu dad pa can no no dbang rgyal gyi thang ka'i rgyab byang du dpal rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba'o//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ rtag tu zhi ba'i rang bzhin nyid la dmigs med thugs rje ches/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan pa'i phrin las rgyun chad med mdzad pa/ /spros kun yongs 'das phun tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa mi mchog thub pa de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /khyed kyi ba spu gcig gi yon tan sa bcu mgon rnams kyi/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar brjod kyang cung zad 'dzad nus min/ /des na yon tan gter gyur mkha' khams kun khyab chu gter 'dra//dkon mchog 'byung gnas thub chen rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mkha' khams gang du khyab pa'i gnas na yongs 'khod rdul phran gyi/ /g.yo ba tsam yang ma lus gcig char nyid mkhyen rgyu 'bras kun/ /dri med mngon sum sa yi dbang khams bag la nyal bcas kyi/ /don mdzad don grub phrin las rgyun mi chad der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /don kun yongs grub yid bzhin bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po ni/ /bgrang yas rdul brtsegs gyen phyur lhun por gyur pa ci 'dra ba/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi cung zad reg pa'i rgyul phran yang ni der/ /byin gyis rlabs mdzad mtshungs med rdzogs sangs rgyas der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thog mtha' med pa'i dbyings su rang byung yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun tu bzang po dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /thub khyed ngo bo de ste sngon tshe dbang po'i tog kyang bya/ /yang nas yang du sangs rgyas tshul ston mdzad der phyag 'tshal 'dudaske/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas gang ye sangs rgyas dang yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul/ /gcig dang du bral dbyings mnyam dmigs 'dzin yul 'das chos kyi sku/ /gzhi snang sgo las byang chub sems bskyed bskal grangs du mar tshogs/ /bsags par yang ston bsam mi khyab gyur mgon der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i bshes gyur gnod lan phan gdags 'gro ba'i mgon/ /kun tu dge ba'i spyod ldan 'gro la phan bde 'ba' zhig su stsol//tshogs gnyis dngos gzhi phyin drug mdzad pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa//yongs su bskrun mdzad rgyal ba shākya tog der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nam mkha' la ni 'byung bzhi skye dgu mtha' dag yongs brten bzhin/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma lus mi lus lus med kun 'byung gnas/ /rnam kun mtshungs pa mi mnga' rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bo thub dbang nyi mar phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran nas rab tu grub pa'i phyag 'tshal ba tshugs su bcad pa bkra shis rtags kyi grangs dang ldan pa 'di yang skyes bdag gi lo sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i dus nag zla'i tshes bco lnga la sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mtshung gyi gasdo la'i 426

rten gtso thub sku 'dzam gling rgyan gyi snyan dar la dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i bris te phul ba sarba maṅga lo/na mo gu ru tre lo tra de wa ga ni maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos dbyings ye shes klong / /tshad med thugs rje gcig tu 'dus pa'i bcud/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon po'i sku/ /gdul bya'i don du rnam 'gyur cir yang snang / /res 'ga' dpal chen pad+ma ho ru ka /rta yi rgyal pos srid gsum gdug pa 'dul/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i me yi sgrib kun bsregs/ /dbang chen kun 'dus dbang gi rgyal por 'dud/ /r+ghaṃ/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum dbang bsgyur mdzad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /gdug pa'i gnod sbyin tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gnod sbyin skur sprul bdud bzhi yongs kyi dgra/ /khrom/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gdug pa 'dul slad du/ /thugs kyi sprul pa khyung chen ga ru ḍa//myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul glog ltar skad cig khyug /mi bsrun klu rnams yud kyi lhag med brlag /rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi bar chad bsal/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las sgrub phyir pho nya'i tshul/ /thogs med mkha' la rgyu ba'i mthu stobs can/ /khro bo rdo rje'i chu can de la 'dud/ oṃ/ lhag pa'i lha mchog dmar nag 'jigs gsum la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthu stobs kyi/ /bdag gi mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad kun/ /skad cig da lta nyid du zhi ba dang / /tshe bsod dpal 'byor bzang po'i yon tan kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur gong du 'phel/ /dbang drag 'phrin las 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /phyag rgya che mchog dngos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug gnub nam mkha' snying po'i thugs kyi sprul pa rtsa ri ras pa yi gdung dbon rong dkar chos pa drag po lha gsum gyi rnal 'byor pad+ma tshe dbang gi dad pa'i rten yi dam sku thang gi rgyab byang smon lam du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs dus bzang por smras pa dge'o//oṃ swāsti/ dge legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo mchog /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i zhal/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshos rab bsngags pa/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i mgonaske/ /don du rgyal kun gyis 'jug pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon la/ /rnam pa kun tu 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig bla ma'i ba spu gcig /mchod dang rgyal kun mchod mnyam par/ /sngags rgyud rnams nas yang nas yang / /mi rdzun pa des gsung pas na/ /rang la bka' drin gsum ldan pa'i/ /bla ma'i sku brnyan bri ba yang / /rgyal kun 'bri bar cis mi 'gyur/ /legs byas bsod nams nyams med shog /tshe 'di la yang dga' skyid bde/ /dam pa'i chos dang mi 'bral zhing / /legs pa'i lam kun gong du 'phel/ /mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas par shog /tshe rabs kun tu 'phags nor bdun/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun 427

gyis phyug /rnam smin yon tan brgyad thob pas/ /bde nas bde bar bgrod par shog /khyad par nges par legs pa'i lam/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma yi/ /skye zhing skye bar rjes su bzungs/ /dbang thob dam tshig rnam par dag mos gus yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /sa lam yon tan rtsal chen rdzogs/ /mtha' yas sems can 'dren slad du/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces 'phan yul na len+d+ra zhabs drung sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang mi yi bdag po'i sras thu shel thu gung gi khabs su spyod pa lha lcam bstan 'dzin bu khrid kyi thugs dam thang ka'i rgyab byang du ma bcos bzod ma'i rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo dus bzang tshes bcu la smras pa dge'o//oṃ swāsti/ dge legs rin chen ma lus pa/ /ster mdzad dkon mchog 'dus pa'i gtso/ /rtsa gsum spro bsdu'i byed pa po/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog de la/ /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje'i gru'i/ /bdag ni khams gsum 'khor ba las yongs grol gtan bde byang chub mchog /yid bzhin nor bu bde ba'i gnas/ /bde ldan mgon pos yongs gang ba/ /mchog de myur du 'grub par shog /ces rong grags pa yi chos mdzad karma chos 'dzin dpal mo yi mos pa'i rten bla ma'i sku brnyan rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pas bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mthu'i/ /smon lam 'di nyid bslu med 'grub par mdzod/ /pad+ma'i rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rim gro pa/ /rab tu dge ba rgyas par byed pa po/ /bstan thub dad pa can des tshe rabs kun/ /mtho ris yon tan 'phags nor kun tshang shing / /pad 'byung nam snying rnam sprul bla ma mchog /gus snyan dam tshig sel med thugs yid 'dres/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bor yongs shar zhing / /sa lam yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe 'khor thog mar/ /byang chub mchog 'bras lung bstan yongs brnyes shog /ces rang gi rim grol pad+ma rab brtan gyi dge bsgrub kyi dar mtshur phu dus mkhyen gser gdung snyan shal la phul ba'i ngos su rig pa 'dzin pas bris pa dge'oske//oṃ swāsti/ gdod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas rgyal kun spro bsdu'i bdag po pad+ma 'byung / /bde ldan zhing du 'od dpag med dang zhing 'dir thub pa'i rgyal tshab tshul/ /gdul dka' sdug bsngal can la lhag brtse khyad par snyigs dus tha ma'i mgon/ /de la phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs mchi byang chub bar du mgon mdzod cig /ces smar lam sde pa dad pa can sri gcod tshe bdag gi thugs dam thang sku'i rgyab byang du dpal rig pa 'dzin pas bris pa'o//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ che ba'i che mchog kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /dmar nag me phreng gza' klu rgyal bsen gshedaske/ /khro rgyal de yi thugs rje'i mthu byin gyis/ /bdag cag byang chub snying po'i bar du bsrung / /zhes pa 428

yang dpal chen rig pa 'dzin pas so//oṃ swāste/ spyan ras gzigs dbang lhag par thugs bskyed nas/ /dgra 'tshe dbul phongs bar do'i 'jigs skyob phyir/ /rdo rje nag po chen po lha yi lha/ /khyed la 'dud do rtag par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa yang dpal chen rig pa 'dzin pas so//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi dpyid/ /pad+ma thod phreng dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtsoske/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i kun bzang sprin/ /'di 'bul dgyes bzhes dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol //zhes pa sde pa bsod nams rdo rje'i ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pas so//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti sirnyi/ na maḥ ar+ya a tsa lā ya/ srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor mtha' dag shes rab ral gris gcodaglu/ /zhi ba'i mal sa 'dzin kun snying rje'i zhags pas bzung / /'khor bar gnas min chos sku'i ngang nas tsog pa'i zhabs/ /zhi la mi gnas snying rje'i rang bzhin pus gtsug zhabs/ /mtha' gnyis kyis ni nam yang mi g.yo bcom ldan 'das/ /rje btsun mi g.yo khyed la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o/ /gang gi thugs rje'i dmigs yul bkra shis dpal rgyas kyi/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs mgon po khyed dang mtshungs byin rlobs/ /zhes skye ba du mar las smon bzang po'i 'brel pa can hor jing gir gyi rigs gyur dpon bkra shis dpal rgyas kyi dgongs rdzogs thang sku'i rgyab yig tu dpal rig pa 'dzin pas ched du brjod pa'o//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ dge legs rgya mtsho ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus pad 'byung gser gyi sprin/ /gang gi thugs rje'i mthu'i bskrun dus 'di ru/ /skye dgu'i 'dzin mar lhag bsam dge ba'i 'bras/ /rgyas slad tshes bcu'i mchod pa 'di bgyis mthu'i/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi dbul ba yongs sel ste/ /tshogs gsum bang mdzod phyur bur khengs nas kyang / /thar pa mchog gi lang 'tsho rgyas par shog /ces pa yang dpal rig pa 'dzin pas skyes bdag zla tshes la smras pa'o//sarba maṅga lo/r+ghaṃ bh+yo/ rgyal ba kun yum mi pham srid gsum bdag /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo ral gcig ma/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang snying rjes 'gro don mdzad/ /srid par gnas kyang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems/ /gdod nas rnam dag kun tu bzang por nyid/ /skal pa du mar rang rgyud sbyang tshul sten/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir re ti nam grub zhes/ /dmag gi rgyal mo zor rnams kun gyi bdag /skal ldan lha mo khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi 'dod don yid bzhin phun tshogs mdzod//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus 'dus pa'i dpyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i lha yi lha/ /snyigs dus 'gro 'dul gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal ba thams cad las/ /lhag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi bsngags/ /des na gang gi sku brnyan 'bri ba yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mtha' dag bkod pa dang / /ri mor byas pa 'di yi dge ba yi/ /tshe rabs dang ni tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /dam pa 429

mgon gyi rjes bzung bslab gsum gyi/ /yon tan nyams med gong nas gong du 'phel/ /rdo rje 'chang 'bras ring min myur 'grub shog /ces dad pa ldan pa gang gi mos gus kyi gsos su thang sku'i rgyab byang la rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo ar+ya badz+ra pā ti ya/ lhag pa'i lha mchog gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag ni byis pa'i skabs nyid nas/ khyed
