kyi rig sngags mchog la gus/ /rig par mos pa kho nas yang / /bar chad yongs su grol bar byed/ /cung zad tsam zhig bzlas pa na/ /yon tan mtshungs pa med par mthong / /shes bzhin dad cing yid ches pas/ /lha mchog khyed la bdag 'dud kyi/ /'di nas byang chen snying po'i bar/ /skye kun gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ /rigs sngags lan re zung re tsam/ /bzlas pas thogs med sngags grub shog /grub mtshan lta stang bcu gnyis dang / /las bzhi grub brgyad khyad par mchog /tshe dbang phyag rgya lhun grub pa/ /myur ba nyid du thob byin rlobs/ /mchog gsum gsang bdag rtsa ba gsum/ /bden pas de bzhin nyid 'grub shog /zhes gtsang g.yas ru 'jad dpal ldan lding du gru ston chen po'i thugs dam phyag na rdo rje'i sku brnyan la snyan dar dang 'phags yul dwa ha ra'i k+ṣad bzang po spyan gzigs su phul nas rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i smon lam btab pa'o//dge'o//dge'o//na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /tshe dang ye shes gzi brjid 'od dpag med/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i mthu byin kun/ /gcig tu bsdus nas srid zhi gnyis spong mgon/ /mkha' khyab sems can ji srid don mdzad mgon/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni nyams thag 'gro la brtse bzhes na/ /'khor ba'i nags tshal mthug por yongs bzhugs shing k+ṣi//mi mang 'tsher ma rnon pos rab tu rtser/ /nyams thag bdag la brtse bas cis mi gzigs/ /khyod ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon zhes pa/ /'jigs rung srid pa'i 'brog dgon chen po ru/ /skyabs gyur dge ba'i bshes dang mjal dka' ba/ /mgon med bdag la brtse bas cis mi gzigs/ /khyod ni dpung gnyen med pa'i dpung zhes na/ /thar lam bgrod pa'i dge ba'i dpung tshogs chung / /dug lnga'i ar jag chom pos 'joms pa na/ /bdag gi dpung gnyen brtse bas cis mi mdzad/ /khyod ni rgyal ba gzhan las mthu myur na/ /swo dkar rtsas nas da lta skra dkar ba/ /khyod sgom khyod bzlas rtag tu re ltos na/ /bdag la nam 'dod zhal bzang cis mi bstan/ /khyod ni rmad byung phrin las can zhes na/ /ci ltar nus pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad dang / /rtse gcig smon lam drag po btab pa la/ /bdag gi re bzhin dbugs dbyung cis mi mdzadaske//las ngan so skye'i 'dren pa mi mdzad na/ /'phags pa rnams la de tsam ci zhig bya/ /des na bdag 430

gi re ba'i don yid bzhin/ /thogs med 'grub par mdzod cig 'jig rten mgon/ /bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po la/ /phu dud bskur ste rim gro bsgrub gzhed par/ /gegs dang bar chad mtha' dag nyer zhi zhing / /'dod don phun tshogs yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /zhes skyid grong 'phags pa wa ti la rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i gdung shugs kyi gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni aṅgi ra zhes chu sprel lo zhal gsar du 'char ba rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la snyan dar gyi ngos su bris nas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ lha rnams kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu rtses/ /gang gi zhabs mthil rtsibs stong 'khor lo yi/ /rnam par bkra la nyer reg 'jig rten mgon/ /thub dbang nyi ma'i rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun rgyal mtshan gos can gyi/ /nyer bzang lung rtogs chos kun rgyas mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i bstan la ston pa gnyis pa bzhin/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal des bkra shis mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin thu bo rgyal ba'i sras/ /dpal ldan bla ma ye shes grags pa'i sde/ /gang khyed zhi ba'i dbyings su rnal min par/ /zhing 'di gdul bya'i don du sprul pa'i sku/ /bsam bzhin 'jug pa'i yang srid myur byon nas/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan dang bde ba yis/ /dga' ston rgya cher 'gyed phyir rin chen khrir/ /gegs med myur ba nyid du 'khod par shog /rnam 'dren mchog gi yang srid sprul pa'i sku/ /sku tshe brtan cing chab srid mnga' thang 'phel/ /snyan cing grags pa'i sa gsum ma lus khyab/ /legs byas srid rtse'i bar du rgyas gyur cig /ces 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rgyal sras sprul ba'i sku rin po che gang gi gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su thim pa chos sku'i rten mchod sdong rin po cher snyan shal lha gos rnam par dkar ba dang lhan cig tu spel ba'i smon lam du mdo khams kaḥthog gi lho phyogs su skyes shing yangs pa'i rgyal khams su chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa rnal 'byor ā yurīn+d+ra ma ṇi'i zla tshes dge ba la phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ṭ+wāste/ na mo gu ra we/ rgyal bas gsung pa'i chos tshul thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba snying por rgyud rnams kun gyi gtso/ /bdag gi rgyud la 'dom mdzad mgon po mchog /sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge gang / /zhi bar gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs ched du/ /gang gi chos las skyes pa'i sras kyi mchog /tshe dbang nor bu'i rgyal ba'i sku brnyan 'di//'bad pas bzhengs bar byas pa'i dge rtsa des//sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i smin grol rgyun/ /nam yang chad med phyogs dus gnas skabs kun/ /dar rgyas nyams med yun ring gong du 'phel/ /skye dgu kun kyang lam bzang 'dir zhugs shing / /bla ma la mos dam tshig rnam par dag /shes rab mchog gi rgyud don gsal bar rtogs/ /'bad med sngags kyi sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /pha ma'i rang bzhin 'gro kun der bkod shog /ces pa yang rje btsun bla ma sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs zhal thang rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i chu sprel smon zla'i tshes bzang brgyad la snang gsal mar me'i mdangs su bkod pa dge'o//dge'o// 431

oṃ/ kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bsngags bzhin bla ma'i sku/ /'di bris dge bas tshe rabs tshe rgyud du/ /dpal mgon bla ma mchog gi rjes bzung nas/ /ring min rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'grub shog /ces dad pa can dpon tshe dbang rig 'dzin ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pas so//na mo bud+dha ya/rnam snang phyag gi lhung bzed spos kyi chur//legs skyes pad sdong ge sar ze phol gyi//dbus ma nyer lnga brtsegs dkyil mi mjed zhing / /des na 'dren pa ston mchog rgyal ba kun/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya thub pa shākya seng ge la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bskor zhing / /'jam dpal gzhon nu ser mo'i phreng ba sogs/ /sprul sku byang sems nyan thos che rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs/ /nges don bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phags pa sor 'phreng ngo bo zhing 'di'i lho/ /gaṅga'i bye snyed re gnyis 'das par zhing / /thams cad rin chen rgyan zhes 'jig rten du/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad mthong na dga'/ /mngon 'phags brtson pa chen po 'khor bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal ྾ nges don྾ 'phags pa 'jam dpal ngo bo zhing 'di'i byang / /gaṅgā'i bye snyed zhe gnyis 'das pa na/ /'jig rten rtag rab dga' thug zhing mos par /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mos pa rab dga' ba'i/ /snying po nor bu rin chen brtsegs pa yi/ /rgyal ba zhes bya 'khor dang bcas pa la//phyag 'tshal ྾ nges don ྾ho ho rgyal ba yongs kyi yum gyur sher phyin ma/ /kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs gyur ma/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gtso mchog bcom ldan ma/ /khyod zhabs dran pas 'jigs sel rnal 'byor ma/ /yang dag don du rang rig gdod ma'i gshis/ /rdo rje can ma nyid yin 'du 'bral med/ /'on kyang de nyid mngon du ma gyur bar/ /dam ye'i tshul gyi yid la bsnyen byed bzhin/ /bdag gi yun nas lha yi lha mchog ma/ /khyed bsnyen rtag tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs na/ /'dir lta gnas skabs blang dor gnas tsam yang | /mi ston g.yel bar bor ba ci zhig byung / /'jig rten 'dre ngan yi dwags phra mo yang / /gus pas bsnyen na blang dor gnas ston na/ /rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs la bcom ldan mas/ /btang snyoms mdzad na thugs rje che zhes ci/ /bems po'i rang bzhin nor bu 'bar ba yang / /sems can re ba yid bzhin bskang mdzad na/ /khyod ni lha yi lha zhes 'khor 'das mgon/ /grub bzhin bdag gi re ba cis mi bskang / /sgrib pa che zhes g.yel bar bor mdzad na/ /sgrib pa med tshe khyod kyi thugs rje ci/ /bdag gi sgrib ldan skyabs dang mgon med na/ /thugs rje chen mo'i spyan gyi da gzigs shig /las la yid ches bzhin du bden 'bras gang / /btang snyoms bzhag na khyod kyi dam bcas ci/ /mi bzod duḥkhas gzir ba'i skye bo 432

rnamasaske/ /las kyi mthu zhes khyed kyi spangs mdzad na/ /bcom ldan 'das ma tshad med thugs rje can/ /ming tsam kho nas 'gro la ci ltar phan/ /'jig rten lha chen mthus kyang las 'gal zhig /ring du spang bar nus na lha yi lha/ /khyod kyi nus mthu'i 'gro ba'i las ngan yang / /ring spang gzhil ba'i phrin las cis mi mdzad/ /bho lha/ o rgyan yul gyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor gtso/ /lhan skyes ye shes mkha' 'gros 'khor lo bsgyur/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i spyan ras ma btul cig /dag pa ye shes snyan gyi mi gsan nam/ /mkha' khyab mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi mi dgongs sam/ /skad cig rdzu 'phrul zhabs kyi mi bsgrod dam/ /'dir gshegs bdag gi 'gro la phan don du/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag par bsam pa'i don/ /'bad pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa 'di//ji bzhin re ba'i 'bras bu bslu med par/ /dus 'di nyid du gsal bar ston mdzod kye/na mo a mi ta bhā ya/ mkha' ltar kun tu brdal ba'i ye shes 'od kyi snang ba che/ /mtha' yas srid zhi kun gyi spyi dpal kun gyi mgon dang bcud/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med thugs rje rgya mtsho'i bdag /mtshungs pa mi mnga' bde ldan zhing gi bdag por yongs bstan pa/ /kun tu bzang po 'od mi 'gyur ba 'od dpag med pa zhes/ /don dam yang dag mtshan nyid rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /mkha' khyab spros bral chos kyi sku la dmigs bsam yongs bral mod/ /dmigs bsam bral zhes bem stong ma yin rnam pa thams cad pa/ /rnam kun mchog ldan cho 'phrul rol pa dpag yas 'byams klas gyur/ /bsam gyi mi khyab kun rdzob bden pa yongs su 'char ba'i gzhi/ /don dam bden pa rtag pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i bdag po yod dge 'dus ma byas pa gang / /mtha' gnyis yongs spangs 'dus byas sems kyi sbags la de mthun par/ /chu'i gnyen chu bzhin rang gzugs thabs kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba la/ /ches mkhas sna tshogs las dang sna tshogs gzugs kyi de 'brel ba'i/ /'gro kun thar pa gsum la nyer sbyor rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzad/ /ma gha dha yi byang chub shing dbang drung nas byang gi phyogs/ /dpag tshad lnga brgya phrag gcig 'das par ri dbang ke ta ra/ /lha las babs pa'i rdul gyis nyer g.yogs rdo rje'i spo mthon por/ /zag zad 'phags dang lha yi drang srong lha chen mang po yi/ /nyer brten mchog gi gnas de'i bya 'dab nyid du sprul pa'i sku/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzhin dwangs gsal snyog pa med pa'i sku/ /bems po spang yang bems po'i tshul brtan bden gnyis zung 'jug sku/ /chos nyid snang ba chen po gsum brtsegs 'du 'bral ye med sku/ /pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung mnyam bzhag phyag rgya mdzes/ /'dzum pa'i zhal mnga' gtsug tor mngon 'phags lta na sdug pa'i sku/ /'brel 'gyur mchog gi sa la rab sbyor rgyal ba'i sku brnyan mchog /gang der snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gsol ba 'debs/ /de mthus bdag dang 'brel gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus 433

kunaske/ /sdig zad sgrib spang 'phags pa mchog gi sa la myur 'khod cing / /de srid rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs sbyangs bde ldan bkod pa ru/ /'od dpag med mgon mnyes pa'i spyod pa rab brtson shog /ces 'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo ri'i rgyal po ke ta ra yi nub phyogs kyi ri ngogs gnyan por ri rdzongs su grags pa'i rten gtso sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i sku brnyan la gus pas bstod gsol 'debs pa'i tshig snyan dar gyi ngos su/ dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus chu bya rgyud jis kyi dbyug zla'i dkar tshes lnga la bris te phul ba sarba maṅga lo/na maḥ shrī bud+dha a mi ta bha ya/ mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes khams/ /gcig dang du ma'i spros pa yongs bral ba/ /gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od dpag med/ /chos sku dmigs bsam blo yul las 'das yang / /bems stong ma yin bdag med chos dbyings bdag /rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad pa/ /chu zhug chus 'gug pa bzhin 'dus byas 'gro/ /'dul la 'dus byas rnam par sprul gyur pa//gzugs sku bem po'i rnam par snang ba la/ /chos nyid snang ba chen po gsum rtsegs pa/ /gdod nas sku zhing 'du 'bral med pa'i khams/ /ye shes sems mchog bden gnyis zung 'jug gzugs/ /'brel bcas 'gro kun thar gsum la 'god byed/ /sku brnyan tshul shar 'gro ba 'dul mdzad mgon/ /dbus 'gyur byang phyogs dpag tshad lnga brgya'i mtshams/ /ri rgyal ke ta ra 'gram zhang zhung 'gor/ /sngon tshe rgyal bas byin rlabs rang byung sku/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu dang lhan cig tu/ /zhing skyes mkha' 'gros sa 'og nas phyung ba/ /'gro mun sel ba'i nor bu 'od po che/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur 'od dpag med sku bsnyan/ /asma las 'das asma las grub tshul/ /dzamyu chu gser ji bzhin ser dkar dang / /pad zla rdo rje skyil krung mnyam bzhag phyag /zhal 'dzum dbu yi gtsug tor mngon par 'phags/ /mthong thos dran pas mchog gi sar 'god mdzad/ /de la kun tu dwangs gus yang dag pas/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa'i mthu'i/ /gangs can mgon po bskal bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe 'tsho bzhes brtan cing mnga' thang 'phelaske/ /gangs can 'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la spyod/ /bdag gzhan 'brel kun 'od dpag med 'grub shog /ces bod yul stod mnga' ri zhang zhung sa yi thig le khyung lung zhes srid pa'i ma mo chen mo'i pho brang 'dab rol zhing skyes mkha' 'gro la sa 'og bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bebs pa'i bu ga nas spyan drangs pa bon rnams kyi ston pa gshen rab tu 'dod kyang don du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i sku rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs pa nyid du nges pas des na/ de la snyan dang gangs can mgon po rgyal ba mchog gi phyag nas stsal ba'i lha yi reg bya rnam par dkar ba'i ngogs su bstod gsol smon lam 'di yang chu bya rgyud jis kyi dbyug zla'i dkar tshes lnga la bris te phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ gdod nas rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /bri gang spros pa kun las rab 'das mod| /rgyal kun ye shes chos sku'i khams de nyid/ /rnam thar bzhi ldan shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gzugs 434

dang gzugs med nyid du blta ba gang / /rtag chad mtha' ste rgyal ba thabs mkhas des/ /mtha' gnyis spang phyir chos sku'i brda' thabs su/ /rnam par bzhag pa mchod rten zhes su grags/ /don du don dam chos dbyings stong pa nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad pa ste bsam mi khyab/ /des na bden gnyis zung 'jug rang bzhin nyid/ /thugs rten mchod rten nyid la cis mi bsngags/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas 'od bsrung bstan pa la/ /'phags pa che rnams sprul pa'i zlos gar nyid/ /cir yang ston las rigs ngan skyes bu'i tshul//rigs mthun gdul bya mang po 'dren slad du/ /'phags yul byang phyogs nem+bhal yi ljongs/ /ma gu ta yi grong 'dir mngon snang nas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gdul ka'i 'gro ba la/ /sangs rgyas las lhag phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bya rdzi ma dang sras bcas kyis 'bad pa'i/ /mchod rten bya ri kai sho ma zhes bya/ /rgya bal spyi dang khyad par bod yul gyi/ /rten 'brel dge ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa/ /mchod rten de la bdag gi sgo gsum gyis/ /'bad pas dge ba'i rtsa ba skrun pa dang / /khyad par dus 'dir sangs rgyas rjes dran bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i dus chen nyid la ci nus kyi/ /mchod sprin spel dang lhan cig lha yi dar/ /rab dkar tshangs pa'i khye'u'i lding gos bzhin/ /reg 'jam mthong na dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /tsi ti si yi me tog la 'khu ba'i/ /ngos su 'dod don sems kyi rdo rje yis/ /yongs bkod nges par gnas pa'i a k+ṣar /'di'o bden gnyis zung 'jug nus pa yi/ /bslu med nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ga bur thig pa ji 'dra bsil ba'i ri/ kha bas bskor gyur byang phyogs bod kyi yul/ /srid zhi phun tshogs 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /mtha' dag dang ni de 'dzin skyes bu mchog /rgyu skar phreng ba ji 'dra bkod pa'i dbusaske/ /spyi dpal sa ga'i gnyen gyur 'od dkar can/ /ji 'dra 'gro ba'i tshad gdung skyobs pa'i sman/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyur bla ma che/ /ngag gi dbang phyug bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gang sku'i nyer tshe 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /mthun rgud phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal kun rgyas/ /sku tshe rdo rje lta bur 'tsho bzhes shog /mtha' bzhir gnas pa'i dbang phyug che rnams kyi/ /gangs can mgon po mchog la gus mchod cing / /mtha' dmag gdug zhi phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyas/ /kun kyang snyen gshim las la rtag spyod shog /blo bur mi nges nad rims rgyun chad cing / /char chu dus 'bab lo phyug rtag tu legs/ /bod yul 'gro kun bzang po mchog la spyod/ /dge zhing dge ba'i 'khor lo 'khor bar shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan la gnas pa yi/ /dge 'dun kun kyang phan tshun dag snang rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes kun thugs yid mdza' zhing gshim/ /'dus pa dang po ji bzhin mdzes par shog /gangs ri'i khrod du 'khod pa'i skye bo kun/ /mkhan slob dge sbyong pha ma la gus shing / /khrims kyi bdag po'i ngag la gus byed pa/ /dra ma mtho ris las la rtag spyod shog /rgyal khrims las la spyod pa'i gtso rnams yang / /nor la mi sred bdag don 435

gtsor mi 'dzin//ngo skog med par drang po'i las la spyod//chos dang mthun khrims kho nar spyod par shog /mdor na bdag gi skye ba sngon rabs dang / /khyad par tshe 'dir byang chub mchog sems kyi/ /yongs bzung bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam kun//bslu med ji bzhin dus 'di nas 'grub shog /ces rab byung bcu gsum nang gi dngos po'i lo gza' skar dge ba la bal yul shing kun gyi bya 'dab tī ngor gangs can mgon po mchog gi phyag nas stsal ba'i lha'i dar mchod rten chen po bya ri kai sho ma la phul ba'i ngos su rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nam ut+ta ra dz+wa ki ha ri nā tha'i ming can gyi lhag pa'i bsam pas/ rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs brtan gtso bor smos pa 'dod don gyi smon lam sa bon tsam shugs byung lhug par brjod pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong shes rab bstan 'dzin gyi bgyis pa'o//dge'o/dge'o//oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba'i ye shes mkha' khyab chos kyi sku/ /mthong thos reg pa'i yul las yongs 'das modaske/ /bems stong ma yin rnam pa thams cad pa/ /sku gzugs bkod pa brda' thabs cir yang snang / /ring srel ldan pa'i mchod rten chos sku'i brdar/ /rgyal bas gsung bzhin 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /sa bdag mya ngan med pas 'bum phrag brgyad/ /bzhengs las nem+bhal yam bu mdzes pa'i grong / /dbus su gnas pa'i mchod sdong de la yang / /bdag blo rab gus dwangs bas phyag 'tshal zhing / /rab bzang gos mchog 'di phul dge bas yang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad mchog tu brtan/ /rdo rje spun rnams mdza' gshim dgyes rgur spyod/ /so thar byang sems sngags sdom rnam par dag /dad ldan sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa 'phel/ /rgyal khams kun tu nad mug mtshon skal zhi/ /mdor na rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /rgyal ba sras slob 'phags rnams dgyes slad du/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa kun/ /bslu med yang dag nyid du 'grub gyur shog /zhes dngos po'i lo sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la mdo khams re khe ljongs kyi bla ma tshe dbang nor bu'i bris te phul ba dge'o//oṃ ṭ+wāsti/ ho ru ka dpal la/ snying nas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sgrib gsum kun bcom zhing / /tshogs gsum mthar thug pa/ /khyed rang ji 'dra par/ /myur du byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum gyi/ /bden pas de 'grub mdzod/ /tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /mkhas shing don la dga'/ /mchog 'bras myur thob shog /sarba maṅga lo/ shing phag zla 7tshes 24la dngos grub phug nas rje dpa' bo'i skyid grong byams sprin dang 'phags pa'i snyan dar la gnang ba'o//oṃ swāste/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'phrin las yongs bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas thub pa 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /'gro ba'i snying gi mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /nyin byed snang ba de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mgon po khyod kyi sku yi snang snyan tshul/ /bod yul 'gro ba'i mchod sdong yid bzhin dbang / /khyed la lha gos bzang po 'di 'bul mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i sgron me 436

rin chen grub/ /gang gi ring lugs ji bzhin 'dzin pa yi/ /sde chen nyams med gong nas gong du 'phel/ /phrin las dar rgyas bstan 'dzin mdza' gshim shog /ces zha lu ba dge slong rin chen 'jam dpal don grub kyi bskul ba'i ngor tshe dbang nor bus spel pa maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba rab gsal ngo bo rgyal sras tshul/ /rin chen dam chos sgron me rin chen grub/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mkhas pa yongs kyi gtso/ /dpal mchog khyed la 'dud do dpal byin rlobs/ /bdag gi tshe rabs tshe rgyud ji srid du/ /mkhas par dbang 'byor dbang phyug yon tan rdzogs/ /'phags nor bdun ldan ma nor bla mas bzung / /bdag 'brel tshom bu khyed lta bu 'grub shog /ces zha lu mchod rten snyan shal du tshe dbang nor bus bris/maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /g.yar dam ma g.yel gcig /'di nas byang chen bar/ /bdag dang 'bral med 'grogs/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug /thabs lam grogs bzang gyur/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod|/byang chen myur 'grub shog maṅga lo/na mo ma hā mu tra ya/ chos rnams kun gyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gnyug ma lhan gcig skyes/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam pa thams cad pa/ /kun tu de la 'dud do dge legs stsolaske//rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig lam yang dag chos//lhan gcig skyes sbyor gdod ma'i ye shes de//gdul bya'i rgyud la gdams mdzad mkhas pa'i mchog /cig shes kun grol zla 'od gzhon nur 'dud//rgyu 'bras theg pa'i tshul khrims kun gyi mdo/ /ci bzhin legs par gzigs nas gdul bya rnams/ /nyes byas dri mas dben par byin rlabs mdzad/ /btsun pa chen po zla 'od gzhon nur 'dud/ /rgyal ba du ma'i sngon du byang chub kyang / /'gro rnams brtse chen thugs su chud pa yi/ /rgyal sras tshul gyi mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgonaske/ /ston mdzad rgyal ba zla 'od gzhon nur 'dud/ /de ltar mnyam med khyod kyi yon tan ni/ /mkha' mkhas dang mtshungs tshad gzhal ma mchis kyang / /cha tsam bdag blo mos pas bstod gsol na/ /bdag sogs rdzogs chen mgon khyed dgyes su gsol/ /de sogs dge bas bdag gi tshe rabs rtag /'khor lo gsum pa phyir mi ldog pa'i gtam/ /lhur len de yi blta ba ji lta bar/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun dkri ba'i byed por shog /de bzhin bsgom pa phyag chen mgon khyed kyi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin bdag gi rgyud la 'phos//rnal 'byor bzhi yi lam rtsal cig char rdzogs/ /sku gnyis 'bras bu dus 'dir smin par mdzod/ /zhes gangs can bod kyi bka' brgyud mtha' dag pa'i chu mgo sgam po zang lung gi mnyam med lha rje'i sku yi snyan shal dar du dpal tshe dbang nor bus me sbrul chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la phul ba'i yi ge smon lam bgyis pa'i ris byed dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan no// 437

oṃ ṭ+wāste/ rab zhi bde ba chen po 'od gsal ba/ /rab mchog rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes khams/ /rab gyur phyag rgya chen po don dam chos/ /rab tu dge legs 'bar des nges par mdzod/ /srid pa 'di nas dpe zla yongs bral ba/ /thub dbang 'gro ba'i nyin byed 'od chen de'i/ /rgyal tshab pad+ma ka ra gzhon nu'i tshul/ /gnyal smad lha rje de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bsgrangs yas bskal par bsod nams ye shes mthu/ /yongs su smin byed rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i 'gror/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed rin chen las bskrun pa'i/ /rgyal mchog dwags po lha rjer snying nas 'dud/ /gdul bya kun la dga' ba'i dpal ster mkhan/ /yang dag thar pa'i lam gyi bshes gcig pu/ /nges don snying po'i sgron me zla 'od mgon/ /snyi bsgom 'gro ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems nyid gnyug ma lhan skyes rang ngo mchog legs gzigs 'dzam gling grags pa'i bsam gtan can/ /bka' brgyud gtsug rgyan sa bcu'i byang chub sems/ /mgon po zla 'od gzhon nur phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar snying nas khyad bsngags tshig bcad 'di/ /rab 'byams lha gos ngos su spel mthu dang ske/ /gzhan yang rnam dkar dge tshogs yongs sdom nas/ /bdag gi byang sems kyis zin dus gsum du//theg chen smon lam bzang po gang btab kun/ /bslu med phun tshogs nyid du 'grub pa'i rgyur/ /yongs su bsngo na de bzhin 'grub pa ru/ /dpang gyur khyed rnams kun gyi bden par mdzod/ /zhes dwags lha sgam po'i gtsug lag khang chen gyi rten gtso la yag pas gzhengs pa'i sku tshab yid bzhin nor bu'i snyan dar la smon lam du ri kha ba can kun tu kaḥ thog rig pa 'dzin par grags pas phul ba'i yi ge pa dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan no//maṅga lo/swāsteske/rnam kun rgyal ba'i ye shes bim+bi tshul/ kha che rang byung mchod rten ka ni ka /khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig bshags bdag gzhan dge ba rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul rtag par bzhugs gsol zhing / /bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chen rgyur bsngo na/ /byang chub mchog gi bar du dge 'di'i rgyun/ /bsod nams 'dzad med gong nas gong 'phel shog /mdor na rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /theg chen smon lam bzang po btab pa kun/ /bslu med 'grub cing 'brel bcas 'gro kun grol/ /gangs can rje 'bangs bde zhing skyid par shog /ces kha che'i yul gyi mchod rten ka ni ka yi snyan dar du rig pa 'dzin pas phul ba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ dge legs phun tshogs yongs kyi 'byung ba'i gzhi/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mgrin gcig tu/ /nges pa'i don ston rdo rje slob dpon gang / /rgyal kun las lhag thugs rje'i mthu chen du/ /bsngags bzhin dwangs pa'i yid kyi gu ru'i sku/ /ris su bris pa 'di yi dge ba'i mthus/ /rdo rje slob ma rje dbon bzang ldan gang / /tshe rabs kun tu dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs rjes nyer bzung mtho ris yon 438

tan dang / /'phags nor gyis rgyan khyad par rdzogs chen gyi/ /lta bsgom spyod pa mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyasaske/ /kun tu bzang po ji 'dra de thob shog /ces de mo dbon rin po che'i thugs dam thang ka'i rgyab byang du dpal rig pa 'dzin pas bris pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi/ /mkha' khyab gsang gsum rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur zhing / /ma rung gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bcom ldan lag na rdo rjes byin gyis rlobs//gang gi sku gzugs las bzang dad pa can/ /lha dbang don grub kyis bskrun dge ba'i mthus/ skye kun tshe ring dpal 'byor mnga' thang 'phel/ /mtho ris mngon mtho 'phags nor dag gi phyug /nges legs lam ston mtshan ldan bla mas zin/ /lhag pa'i lha khyod zhal mjal gsung thos shing / /yang dag chos nyid bden pa mngon du mthong / /ring por ma thogs rdzogs sangs rgyas 'grub shog /ces rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i brjod pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal kun ye shes 'bar ba'i thig le nyid/ /bde chen dpyid kyi zlos gar rdo rje chos/ /gzhom med gsung gi sgra dbyangs yongs 'dus gzugs/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon rgyal kun gtsoske/ /zhi khro rnam 'gyur gar brgya rol pa'i sku/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro dang bsdu/ /ma lus byed po khyab bdag ho ru ka/ /pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi bkra shis gang / /mkha' khyab gdul bya yongs kyi 'dod 'jo zhing / /khyad par dgongs 'dus gser chos nyams len mkhan/ /su zhig dus 'di nas tsam byang chub bar/ /las bzhi grub brgyad 'bad med lhun grub cing / /khyad par 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don/ /ma nor 'khrul med ston mdzad bla ma mchog /legs mjal smin grol gdams pa'i bum bzang thob/ /rnam dag dam tshig nyams med mchog tu spyod/ /brtson pa rtsam pa stos min bla ma lhas/ /byin rlabs mthu rten gdams ngag thos pa'i mdo/ /'bad med nyid du rgyal ba kun gyi gsang / /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i kho na nyid/ /'ub chub blo 'das ris med rang shar gyi/ /dgongs pa'i mthar thug rtsol med lta ba'i chog /bsam brjod dpe bral nam mkha' lta bu'i don/ /ka dag gdod ma'i gshis lugs mngon gyur rtogs/ /rang gdangs 'gags med 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings/ /ye yin rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rtse/ /sku nyid spyi dpal kun bzang yongs 'grub shog /ces kong yul mchim kyi sa spyod mi yi dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs gyur sngags 'chang ba bsod nams rab brtan gang gi thugs dam bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi zhal thang rgyab byang du rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra'i pho nyar rlom pa zab gter kha byang 'dzin pa thams cad kyi yang tha kaḥ thog sprul skur grags pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i smin drug zla ba la brjod pa dge bar gyur ciga.oṃ swāsti/ chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas kun gyi khams/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sku mchog thod phreng 439

stsalatso//gang gi bkra shis 'gro kun lus la stsol//tshe rabs rtag tu mtshan dpes rgyan par shog/oṃ swāste/ mtha' gnyis mi skyod mnyam nyid ye shes che/ /rgyal kun yon tan rdo rje yid bzhin nor/ /gang gi bkra shis 'gro ba'i dbang por rtsol//skye kun 'bad med phun tshogs yongs 'grub shog/oṃ swāste/ ma chags pad+ma sor rtags ye shes khams/ /srid zhi'i dbang bsgyur rgyal kun gsung dbyangs khams/ /gang gi bkra shis 'gro kun ngag la stsol/ /skye kun tshangs dbyangs yan lag brgyad thob shog/oṃ swāsnyi/ bya ba yongs grub rtsal 'chang sngags kyi bdag /rgyal kun phrin las rig 'dzin kun 'dus gtso/ /gang gi bkra shis 'gro kun rlung la stsol/ /skye kun las chen rab 'byams lhun grub shog /mtha' grol rang shar ye shes sgyu 'phrul che/ /rgyal kun mthu bsdus gtum po me 'phreng can/ /gang gi bkra shis 'gro ba'i sgo lngar 'gro//skye kun gnyis snang las bgegs rgyal bar shog /oṃ swāste/ klong rdzogs bde chen ye shes snying po'i dpyid/ /rgyal kun nus pa gcig bsdus thod pa canaske//gang gi bkra shis kun rtogs rgyud la stsol/ /mi 'gyur bde chen go 'phang myur thob shog/oṃ swāste/ klong gsal lhun rdzogs ye shes rol pa'i gar/ /rgyal kun gzi brjid 'dus pa rta mchog dpal|/gang gi bkra shis 'gro ba'i yid la stsol//don dam rdo rje'i go 'phang myur thob sho ga.oṃ swāste/ lhun grub rdul bral ye shes 'khor los bsgyur/ /rgyal ba kun gyi stobs 'dus rdo rje can/ /gang gi bkra shis kun bzhi'i rgyud la stsol//bde gshegs rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog/oṃ swāste/ /gsung gi rdo rje gzi brjid rta mchog dpal/ /snying rje cher khros he ru ka nag po/ /yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa'i bkra shis gang //sbyin bdag rnams la rtag tu bde legs mdzod//oṃ swāste/pad+ma dbang gi pho nya drag po btsan//sprul 'khor bcas pa rnams kyi bkra shis gang //sbyin bdag 'di yi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen yid bzhin phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ maṅga lo/na mo stu ra ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs mchog khams gsum 'khor ba'i duḥkha sgrol mdzad ma/ /'phags ma sgrol mas bdag shes bcas bsrung mdzod/ /lha mo khyod la gus pa'i gsol 'debs shing / /gang gi sku brnyan bris pa'i bsod nams mthus/ /dad ldan sbyin pa'i bdag mo tshe rabs rtag /mi mthun 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen grub/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas/ /mngon mtho nges legs dpal kun myur thob shog/sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ na maḥ ār+ya pra ti swa ra ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi bla ma 'jam dpal dpa'/ /bskyed mdzad 440

yum mchog bcom ldan 'das ma che/ /so so 'brang ma shes rab pha rol phyin/ /de la phyag 'tshal dge legs dpal kun stsol/ /dad pa'i dpal ldan sbyin pa'i bdag mo yi/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i chu gter las 'khrungs pa'i/ /ston zla so sor 'brang ma mtshan dpe'i sku/ /gegs med bsod nams mkha' la char 'di'i mthusaske/ /sgo gsum mi mthun 'tshe ba'i smag rum kun/ /dge ba'i 'od kyi tshegs med nyer bcom nas/ /dpal 'byor phun tshogs ku muta 'dab ma rgyas/ /dri med dge ba'i rigs rgyud ze'u 'brur mngar/ /grags snyan dri bsung bzang po phyogs bcur g.yo/ /legs spyad rang grub dkon mchog dgyes pa'i rgyur/ /lhun gyi grub pas srid kun mdzes pa'i rgyan//mngon mtho nges legs dpal kun rgyas gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ṭ+wāste/ sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i thugs bskyed kyi/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i 'dren par zhal bzhes pa/ /shākya sirnya lha rnams kun gyi ltas/ /de yi rtag tu dge legs stsal du gsol/ /zhes rig pa 'dzin pas so//sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba yongs kyi phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog badz+ra tī la ya/ /gang gi tshad med thugs rje'i mthu stobs kyis/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la bkra shis mdzod/ /zhes rig pa 'dzin pas so//sarba maṅga lo/rnal 'byor 'jigs med go cha'i thugs dam rje btsun sku snyan gyi rgyab yig zhar byung dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ āḥ gu ru yo ga sirnyi badz+ra ha su r+ghaṃ/ ṭ+wāste/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gang //skye la dbang thob sprul pa'i zlos gar mchog /gzhad pa rdo rje gangs can grub kun gtso/ /gang gi sku bsnyan 'di bris dge ba yi/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpal dang mgon slad du/ /rje btsun mchog gi go 'phang la reg shing / /sems can ji srid bar du phan bde mchog /rgyun mi chad pa'i byed po rgyu gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ṭ+wāste/ kun khyab mkha' mnyam bde ba chen po'i khams/ /yongs grub gzugs sku mkha' la 'ja' mtshon bzhin/ /spros pa bral yang rnam pa thams cad pa/ /gang de bzhed pa rdo rje'i rnam thar nges/ /mgon po de yi gzugs sku'i snang snyan tshul/ /phyis byung rtog brjod zlos gar mang bsgyur yang / /khung ldan gtam dang sngon rabs sku snyan 'ga'/ /mthun pas 'dir bkod tshad mar gyur snyam yod/ /yang dag don la ye shes grub pa'i lus/ /'di lta bu zhes blo yi gzhal nus min/ /mos pa'i snang ngor ji bzhin 'char bas na/ /gang mos bzhin du gsal btab gsol ba thob/ /rgyal gsung chos kun snying po gsang sngags yin/ /de yi mthar thug bla ma'i mos gus te/ /nyin mtshan ngos lkog ldem rgyang med pa ru/ /rje btsun yid dang ma bral gsol ba thob/ /gsol ba 'debs bya 'debs mkhan 'debs tshigs kyang / /rang rig 'od gsal gcig 441

gi cho 'phrul las/ /gcig dang du ma'i dpyad gzhi kho yang stor/ /bla ma rang sems dbyer med mnyam par bzhog /rje btsun mchog gi rnam thar slob 'dod na/ /nam 'chi cha med nyin mtshan skyo shas dang / /'di snang byas pa don med sgyu ma 'dra/ /'khor ba'i chos la zhen rin mi chog pas/ /gtan bde byang chub sgrub la blo phyogs te/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan bka' spyod brtson 'grus kyi/ /las kyi skye srid dus 'dir zad byas nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub rnam par skyong yang 'tshal/ /yang cig dam chos thos shing legs bsam nasaske/ /de don nyin mtshan rtag tu bsgom 'dris shing / /bsdu ba bzhi yi 'gro la phan gdags pa/ /'di yang rgyal sras kun gyi rnam thar yin/ /gang ltar dal 'byor phun tshogs rin chen lus/ /rnyed dka' thob 'di chud zos med pa ru/ /snying po thar pa mchog gi gsos theb pa/ /dam pa'i rnam thar skyong na mkhas pa yin/ /de skad rje btsun sku snyan bris pa'i phror/ /shugs 'byung lhug pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba ru/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu grags pa yi//rnal 'byor gu yang blo bde de yi smras/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ kun nas bzang po'i rang bzhin bde gshegs snying / /gu ru'i thugs rje chab kyi glo bur dri/ /phyogs cha sbyangs pa'i mthu las rnal 'byor zhes/ /gzod nas snang ba don dam rdo rje sems/ /dpal ldan bka' drin gsum rnyed rdo rje 'dzin/ /gang gi 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rjes bzung dam tshig sel med dgyes dgu 'grub/ /'gro phan sangs rgyas bdag gi myur 'grub shog /ces long po gying gi sde pa tshe dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi thugs dam thang sku'i rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/tsho.oṃ swāste/ na maḥ shākya mu na ye/ /sgrib pa kun spangs yon tan yongs su rgyas/ /'jig rten kun tu mtshungs med skyobs pa mgon/ /lha yi dbang po kun gyi gtsug nor gyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la brten lha yi lha/ /mtshan thos tsam gyi ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba las/ /rab bzlog phun tshogs dpal gyur cir yang byin/ /thar pa gsum gyi lam ston cig pu pa/ /bcom ldan 'das mchog sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /bdag cag ston pa rigs mchog shākya'i sras/ /don kun 'grub pa 'gro ba'i nyi ma cher/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud do sbyin pa'i bdag po 'dis/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis dpal kun rgyas gyur shog /ces pa yang dpa' bo mtha' dag gi sde dpon chen po yab sras kyi thugs dam thang ka'i rgyab byang du rgyal khams pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos bris pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ phyogs bcu'i zhing sku sangs rgyas skur bsgrub kyang / /mi mjed 'gro ba'i don du thub dbang gi /nyan thos chen po'i tshul bzung bstan pa'i rtsas/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams kyi bkra shis 465/ /oṃ suste/ thos sgrogs 'phags pa'i go 'phang nyer brnyes tshul/ /'dzin mdzad lha mo yongs kyi mchod pa'i zhing / /ston na rgyal bstan rig 'dzin sgron me mchog /'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams kyi 442

bkra shis mdzod//oṃ swāste/ grangs med bskal pa'i pha mthar byang chub sems/ /nyer skyes rgyal sras mchog gi sar bzhugs kyang / /gang 'dul nyan thos 'gro ngor dgra bcom skur/ /ston gyur gnas brtan rnams kyi bkra shis mdzod//oṃ swāste/ skye rgu rnams kyi bsod nams zhing gyur cing / thub dbang bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i phyiraske/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa la brten 'tsho bzhes pa/ /gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /zhing 'dir thub dbang rgyal tshab rdo rje chos/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /gang gi gdul bya'i gtso bo bden bral gling / /rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri pad+ma 'od/ /gdul bya mos pa'i snang ngor 'char ba'i gzugs/ phyogs 'dir sngags shes dag gi blor snang bzhin/ /rigs ldan kun bzang sgrol ma'i dgongs rdzogs su/ /bzhengs pa 'di yi dge ba'i mthu la brten/ /dmigs yul 'gro ba 'brel bcas thams cad kyi/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs sgrib gnyis mtha' dag byang / kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang / /kun bzang pad+ma thod phreng ji bzhin pa'i/ /go 'phang ring por ma yin dus myur du/ /thob nas mkha' mnyam 'gro don spyod par shog /ces pa yang rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcur smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ṭ+wāste/ lha yi lha mchog bcom ldan 'das/ /pad+ma drag po thod 'phreng rtsal/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon du brten no thugs rjes bzung / /skye tshe ji srid dus kun tu/ /he ru ka yi las dngos grubaske/ /thams cad ma 'bad lhun gyis grub/ /'od dpag med 'bras myur thob shog /ces pa'ang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bla ma mnga' bdag dge slong drung gi thugs dam thang ka'i rgyab byang du srin po rir bris pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste pra dzaḥ bh+yaḥ na maḥ shrī sirnya nā da ya/ oṃ ā trī sirnya nā da hūṃ phaṭaḥ rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed byed yab gyur kun 'byung yum/ /kun gyi sras mchog sangs rgyas kun 'bang sangs rgyas gtso/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor los bsgyur mdzad nam mkha' rgyal po che/ /snying rje'i gter gyur 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ / 1 gang 'dul sprul sku rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /dge slong dge bsnyen rgyal po bud med bram ze dang / /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin srin po klu la sogs/ /sna tshogs gzugs su snang nas 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad/ /2 de lta'i rnam thar rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul las//gzhan gyis ma yin tshangs dang brgya byin sogs kyis ci/ /de ltar byed po 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po gang / /seṅge sgrar 443

gyur sa bdag klu gnyan yongs kyi mgon/ / 3 gang gi mtshan tsam rna bar lhung nas gus gyur pa'i/ /dge ba yis kyang grangs med bskal bsags sdig sbyang na/ /sku bsgom rigs sngags bzlas brtson de bzhin bris sam 'bur/ /sku gzugs rig sngags bzhengs shing dad pas gsol 'debs na/ / 4bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad las grol nas bde ba dang / /mi mthun blo bur nyi khri chig stong las thar zhing / /stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi 'tshe ba zhi bar byed/ /khyad par sa bdag klu gnyan gnod pa kun sel byed/ / 5 de bzhin steng gdon bar gdon byad kha rbod gtong kun/ /'di yi mthu las rang sar bzlog 'gyur the tshom med/ /des na rgyal ba'i gsung la yid ches dad pa can/ /kun gyi 'phags pa 'di yi sku gzugs bri mchod 'os/ /6 gnas skabs su yang de lta'i phan yon thob 'dod kyi/ /mthar thug tshe rabs 'di nas byang chen go 'phang mchog /nam thob bar du dge ba'i 'bras bu zad min te/ /skye kun sa bdag klu gnyan gnod pa mi 'byung bde/ / 7 rigs bzang rgyud du skyes pa'i rten thob gzugs mdzes shing / /rnam spyod shes rab mchog rgyas rin chen dam chos 'phrad/ /ngan 'gro med cing rtag tu mtho ris dpal la spyod/ /ring por mi thog de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'bras bu thob/ / 8 gnas skabs mthar thug phan yon de 'drar bsam byas nasaske/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang seṅge sgra yi sku brnyan gang / /bris 'bur bzhengs shing bsgom bzlas mchod bstod gsol gdab la/ /blo ldan rnams kyi phyin chad 'bad par bya 'os yin//9 'dir ni gser gling pa dang jo bo nā ro pa'i/ /rgyud pa 'dus gyur sa chen kun dga' snying po yi/ /bzhed pa ltar te nye brgyud mdo khams kaḥ thog gi/ /rje btsun klong gsal snying por 'phags pa nges sgra yi/ / 10 yang yang zhal bstan bsgrub thabs bshad pas byin rlabs che/ /bka' gter chu bo gnyis 'dus kho bos khum pas na/ /mngon rtogs ma nor lugs srol tshul bzhin bkod byas pa'i/ /steng du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang g.yas g.yon du/ / 11 'jam dpal gsang bdag de 'og g.yas dang g.yon du ni/ /mgon po klu sgrub pad+ma ka ra klu'i mchod tshul/ /'og tu chu gter dbus na rnal 'byor rgyud don bzhin/ /klu rgyal rang rang chung ma pho brang bcas bkod pa/ / 12 'di ni rang gzhan 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyang sbyin bdag po//'di phyi dge bde thob phyir shākya'i dge bsnyen ni/ /thos bsam lang 'tsho rgyas shing phyag rdzogs don bsgom pa'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa tshe dang nor bu'i blo gros mthu/ / 13 rgya mtsho'i 'jings las shar bzhin ris su snang byed po/ /dge slong blo ldan g.yung drung zhes pas bgyid byas dge gyur cig /'di mthong 'dir gus 'di mchod 'di bri byed pa kun/ /tshe 'dir phyi ma bde zhing bde chen zhing skyes nges/ / 14zhes dad gus dam tshig gi dpal dang ldan pa se dkar rigs kyi thig le bdar mi rje btsad po nor bu dpal 'byor gyi ched du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus 'phags pa'i sku brnyan/ bkod par byas shing rgyab yig tu smras pa ste yi ge 444

pa ni blo dbang ngo //sarba masgo lo/zhal thang 'di bri ba'i tshe klu rnams dga' ba'i char bshims po 'bab pa bcas dge ba'i mtshan ma 'ba' zhig mthong zhing sa bdag klu gnyan gyis brtser ba kun 'di mang du bris na phan yon shin tu che bas bris shig rgyab yig 'di yang dgos don che bas kun la bri ba gal che'o/ /dge'o//dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo/dpag yas bskal pa'i sngon nas dge ba'i 'bras/ /yongs bsdus tshad med spangs rtogs yon tan kun/ /smin gyur zas gtsang sras po lha mi'i mgon/ /thub dbang nyi ma de yi dge legs mdzod/ /gang gi ngo mtshar rnam par thar pa mchog /dad pas bris klog yid la bsam pas ni/ /rlabs chen sgrib byang tshogs gnyis bsam mi khyab/ /des na dge slong blo gsal rnam rgyal gyis/ /mi phyed dad pas yongs bskrun rgyal ba yi/ /sku brnyan 'di bris dge ba byang chub bsgyur/ /yongs bsngo byang chen 'bras bu dus myur du/ /thob nas 'gro kun 'khor ba las sgrol shog /ces pa yang tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos so//maṅga lo/bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /thugs rje nus pa'i mthu dpal rmad byung bas/ /gang gi sku brnyan 'di yi dge ba'i mthus/ /dad ldan sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags gzi bajid kun/ /nyams med yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba dang / /khyad par bla med byang chub sems mchog gnyis/ /gong 'phel rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces zha lu dge slong 'jam dpal gyi slob ma skyid dgu zhes pa'i dad rten 'phags ma'i thang ka'i rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pas dge'o/ /dge'o//oṃ swāste/ rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus mtsho skyes mgon/ /de yi thugs las legs sprul nam mkha' snying / /gang gi sgrub pa'i ngang tshul cha shas tsam/ /gus pas 'di ru bkod par byas so skye/ / 1 ro rkyang dbur 'gags rdor dril bar snang bzhag /snang sems ro gcig phur bu brag la bsnun/ /khyab byed dbang 'dus chos gos nyi zer bkal/ /phra yang mchog brnyes nam mkha'i khams su 'phyo/ / 2 thugs dam dkyil 'khor yang dag mar me dgu/ /steng du dpal chen rgyu ma ltar zhal gzigs/ /nam gru nag mo las kyi phyag rgya mdzad/ /rdo rje mtsho sgron zag med bde chen bskyed/ / 3 khyod ni phyag chen rig 'dzin nyid brnyes pas//skye 'chi mi mnga' mkha' ltar khyab pa'i thugs/ /ma g.yos chos sku'i ngang du rtag bzhugs mod/ /'on kyang gdul byar brtse bas cir yang sprul/ / 4des na khyod kyi sprul dang yang sprul dang / /byin gyis brlab pa bye ba bsgrang yas kyang / /bdag ni mi mkhas ma bsdam mnyam bzhag dben/ /de phyir khyod sprul rjes su ji zhig 'gro/ / 5 'on kyang o rgyan pad+ma lung bstan pas/ /dpang po de yi rjes dpag tsam gyur srid/ / 445

des na tshe dbang nor bu rig pa 'dzin/ /gzugs brnyan phyi ltar dpal chen bsgrub pa'i tshul/ / 6 nang ltar theg chen chos kyi sgra sgrogs shing / /gsang ba rdzogs chen rang skad rnga sgra sgrogs/ /don dam gzhom med nā da'i mtshon byed du/ /rngo'u brdung bar byed pa 'di na ko/ / 7 de yi mdun du las dang smon lam gyi/ /bal yul tsha shod bal mo mi zan ma/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje des byin zhes pa ni/ /rin chen rgyan spras bal mo'i tshul du ni/ / 8 bkod 'di dam can khyod nyid dges 'tshal gyis/ /nyes na bzod zhes bdag cag 'tsho mdzod cig /gang ltar dad pas kun nas blang ba yi/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku brnyan 'di bzhengs dges/ /9 bdag dang 'brel bcas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sgrib sbyang tshogs rdzogs byang chub lam la zhugs/ /gnas skabs las bzhi mthar thug phyag rgya che/ /nam mkha'i snying po ji 'dra bdag 'gyur shog /ces rang gi slob ma'i mthu bo dam pa se ston gyi rigs su 'khrungs pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba chen po dad dam shes rab kyi yon tan rgyas pa kun bzang ye shes phrin las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i thugs dam zhal thang gi rgyab byang du tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge'o//maṅga lo/yi ge pa ni bkra shis rab brtan no//oṃ swāste/ gang zhig phyag rgya che dang rdzogs pa che/ /tshul bzhin ston par nus pa'i bla ma de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi gdung tshob yin/ /rang la bka' drin che bas sangs rgyas gtso/ / 1 gang zhig de yi sku brnyan bris pa na/ /sdig zad bsod nams 'phel zhing ye shes rtogs/ /tshul de khong du chud nas dad pa can/ /bsgrub po kun bzang ye shes rdo rje yi/ / 2 brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi yang zhun ni/ /'gran bral phyag rgya che dang rdzogs pa che/ /legs par nos pa'i yul gyur bla ma ni/ /spyod 'chang nag po'i zhabs dang nam mkha' snying / / 3 dbyer med mtshan gyi byin brlabs kho na pa/ /tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sde/ /gang gi gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i tshul/ /rigs bdag rdor 'chang rdor sems pad+ma dkar/ / 4 g.yas su grub mchog nam mkha' snying po dang / /g.yon du o rgyan gu ru'i lung bstan lasaske/ /dran pa nam mkha'i rnam 'phrul rig pa 'dzin/ /bkra bzang bla ma kun bzang ye shes dang / / 5mdun g.yas kun spangs dge slong gzhan phan pa/ /g.yon du phyag rdzogs rnal 'byor bsgrub pa po/ /ye shes rdo rje rang nyid sbyin bdag tshul/ /bkod 'di'i dge bas byang chub chen po'i sa/ / 6 nam thob bar du tshe rabs tshe rgyud kun/ /mtshan ldan bla mas rjes bzung byin brlabs zhugs/ /yang dag phyag rdzogs rtogs pa'i gdeng thob nas/ /'brel tshad don ldan rdo rje sems thob shog / 7 ces pa yang gangs ri'i khrod na ming yongs su grags pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bris// 446

༄sto /jo nang rtag brtan dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du dge rgyun sbyar ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ mi 'gyur g.yung drung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mi bslu bden pa dam pa'i chos/ /ji bzhin bsgrub pa dge 'dun tshogs/ /rin chen gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/ / 1 gdod nas yon tan mchog ldan dri ma kun spangs bder gshegs thugs/ /skye 'gag gnas bral smra bsam brjod med bsam gyi mi khyab gsung ske/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang mtshan dpes brgyan pa mi shig rdo rje'i sku/ /mu bral mtha' dbus las 'das shākya thub par phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 2 rnam kun mchog ldan stong chen phyag rgya chen po yi ge drug /mi 'gyur bde ba'i rang bzhin thig le chen po yi ge lnga/ /g.yo med zung 'jug e waṃ mnyam nyid bla med rdo rje sems/ /dus kyi 'khor lo de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal dge legs stsol/ / 3 bde 'byung gnas su sa bdag dgu bcu rtsa drug gtsug nor bus/ /legs mchod 'phrog byed yan lag brgyad ldan lha mi'i bla ma che/ /mi mchog tshul gyur chos rgyal rigs ldan rtsa lnga bcu phrag gsum/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rdo rje theg pa'i ston par gus phyag 'tshal/ / 4 si ta'i lho phyogs theg chen bstan pa'i 'byung gnas 'dzam gling rgyan/ /rnam dag lta spyod klu sgrub yab sras thogs med mched/ /rgol ngan tshar gcod phyogs glang chos grags rmad byung slob dpon ni/ /zhi lha zla grags tsan+d+ra go rīr rab tu dang bas 'dud/ / 5 phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo mgon phyogs 'od dpag med//zhing 'dir rigs mchog nyi ma'i rgyal tshab tshul bzung 'phur 'gro'i rgyal//sku gsum rtsal 'chang sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum rdzogs pa'i bdag /'dren pa zla med pad+ma ka rar phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 6 spyan ras gzigs dbang gdul bya'i nye 'tsho yongs byon gangs can mgon/ /mi bdag mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'od dpag med zhal do ger can/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i mnga' bdag lha yi lhar gyur 'gro 'dul mchog /nor bu pad+ma srong btsan sgam por dad pa'i spu long rgyun par g.yo/ / 7 thub dbang bstan pa'i snying po 'khor gsum so so'i dgongs pa'i don/ /ma nor smra ba'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i shing rta dol po zhes/ /chos kyi sprin 'phro sa yi dbang phyug phyag na pad dkar 'chang ske//shes rab rgyal mtshan gang der 'dud do bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs//8 rnam rig lta ba'i srol chags ji bzhin 'dzin mkhas legs bshad gtam/ /gsar du spel mkhas 'gro kun sgrol ba'i spyod 'chang rnam rol mgon/ /tshad med mkhyen pa'i mthu yi mnga' bdag kun gyi bzhed dgongs mched/ /kun nas 447

dga' dpal snying rje chen por grags der 'dud/ / 9 rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan gzhi 'dzin la ston pa gnyis pa ltar/ /bstan pa'i bdag por srid 'dir mtshungs med 'jam dpal dpa' bo gang / /ngur smrig gos kyi g.yib te mi yi zol 'dzin blo bzang po/ /grags pa'i dpal der snying nas yid rang gus pa chen pos 'dud/ / 10 gru 'dzin bdag po'i 'od zer rab spros mi yi srid par snang / /'dzam gling skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan spyi yi 'dren mchog bla ma che/ /thams cad mkhyen gzigs rgyal ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /skal bzang bde ba'i 'byung gnas gang der 'dud do bdag blo 'chos/ / 11 u rgyan rgyal po thor cog can zhes mtsho skyes bla ma ni/ /rgyal ba kun dngos ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /rnam 'phrul dag tu rang gi dam bca' mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /blo bzang ye shes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs la mchod par bgyi/ / 12 skye dgu dge legs ma lus 'byung gnas gcig pu nyid gyur pa/ /rgyal bstan rin chen kho na nyid ste de la sman pa yi/ /bya ba byed po sa skyongs mi bdag po chos skyong ba/ /gang de la yang rjes su yi rang gus pa'i bsngags 'os yin/ / 13 'gro kun bde ba'i lam mchog dam pa'i chos/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i gtso bo 'khor lo gsum/ /nges dang nges don mthar thug ston pa yi/ /mtshan nyid med dang phyir mi ldog pa'i gtam/ / 14mtha' dag smra ba'i 'dus sde ngo mtshar phul/ /mngon mtho dga' ldan nges legs phun tshogs kyi/ /gling der tshogs gnyis mchod sprin 'phro ba yi/ /ngang tshul cha tsam deb kyi tshul 'dir gleng ske/ / 15 zhes tshigs su bcad pas mdun bsus nas/ /gang 'dir rgyal ba hā la'i nyi ma don kun grub pa thub pa chen po 'gro kun 'dren mdzad lha yi lha bla ma'i bla ma gang gi bstan pa rin po che deng dus rab tu rgyas pa'i yul byang phyogs ri kha ba can gyi khong 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bdag gi mdzad pa'i zhing khams bod yul ru bzhi las gtsang ru lag gi cha srid pa'i ma mo nag sman rgyal mo'i pho brang gi ngogs na/ rgyal bas rnga bo che yi mdor lung bstan pa'i skyes bu chen po rmad du byung ba'i mkhas pa rdo rje 'chang a nan+da gar+bha maṅga lo ke ru shrī bha ṭa gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog rtag brtan nges don dga' ba'i tshal lam dga' ldan phun tshogs gling zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po srid rtser 'phyo ba bslab gsum dag pa'i dge sbyong brgya phrag du mas dam pa chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad par sgrog pa'i kun dga' ra ba gang gi rmang bting nas lo brgya phrag gcig dang bdun cu rtsa bdun 'das shing / gangs ri'i khrod spyi yi 'dren pa rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po lag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i sgyu 'phrul bdun pa ngag dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sde dang /'dul ba 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang ye shes zhal snga nas kyi rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin par mdzad cing / gnam bkos bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba 448

mi yi rje chos skyong sa chen po gang gi rnam par dkar ba'i rgyal khrims kyi kha ba can gyi ljongs mdzes par byed pa'i dus skabs rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i dgung yongs 'dzin chu bya'i lo gsar du 'char ba'i skabs su phran mdo khams kaḥthog lho rgyud du lha las babs pa thu yi rigs su skyes shing / o ḍi ya na a tsar+ya ma hā pu ṣe pad+ma ka pā la ma le pa kra mas tshe rabs du mar rjes su bzung ba/ shākya dge bsnyen 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i rig pa 'dzin gyur rgyal khams phyogs med du rgyu ba tshe dbang nor bur grags pa bdag gis/ spyir rgyal bstan ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag la dag snang gi blo mig snying dbus nas rgyas shing ske/ khyad par sngon gnas rjes su 'ol cir dran pa'i bag chags mthug po'i dbang gis gdan sa dam pa 'dir dad gus dung chen pos drang bas phan yon che bar rtogs te/ spyir skye dgu thams cad bde ba'i dpal la spyod pa dang / bye brag de yi rtsa lag rgyal mchog go tam nyi ma'i bstan pa mtha' dag yul dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa'i ched dang / khyad par gangs can gyi bstan pa'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen gzigs bla ma chen po yab sras kyi zhabs pad rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa dang / de bzhin bod yul gyi mnga' bdag dge bcu'i khrims kyi skyong ba chos kyi rgyal po chen po gang gi chab srid brtan cing bde legs 'phel ba'i phyir dang / gzhan yang bdag dang 'brel bcas 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa kun gyi bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa myur du brnyes shing byang chen mchog gi go 'phang la sbyor ba'i ched du dmigs/ chu zla cho 'phrul dus chen gyi yar tshes brgyad la mang ja brgyad sbyar ba'i mu 'thud nas lo 'khor zla ba bcu gnyis kyi nyer gnyis nam byung bar dga' ldan phun tshogs gling ji srid bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor mang ja bzang ba re yong ba'i rtsa bar dngul srang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la nespal gyi di nar sum brgya drug bcu yul lugs kyi bde yang bar gsum ma bzhi skyed du sbyar ba dang / yang gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso bo jo bo phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba shākya mu ne'i sku mdun du tshes 18tshes 20tshes 22rnams la/ mar dkar rtags nyag spor gang gi mchod me kong bkang re dang / thob gzhi gong mthun gyi gzhal yas khang dus 'khor blos blang gi mdun du/ tshes 15/ tshes 3 dang de bzhin bde ba can gyi ye shes mchod rten drung du/ tshes 10tshes 25'bras spung dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten drung du/ tshes 10tshes 25rnams nam 'char du mar me chags med rten rtsa bar nem pā la yi di nar drug cu rtsa gsum/ji srid bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du nyams pa med pa'i brtsas su sbyar ba ste dge legs yon tan 'phel ba'i rgyu phun sum tshogs par gyur ciga.a thā/ khyad par 'phags pa'i chos rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rgyal sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa 449

gcig pa'i lam sa bcu pa'i dgongs 'grel can bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'di nyid rgya bod 'phags grub chen po thams cad kyi gces pa'i zab chos bla na ma mchis pa yin par ma zad/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi rgyud rgyal 'di nyid la dgyes shing nyams bzhes mdzad pa las kyang / gsan pa'i gnas yul jo nang du phyogs rnam pa'i spyan sngar yin la de skabs dus 'khor lhan skyes gser gyi mdog can kyang zhal gzigs la byin rlabs don rgyud kyi chu bo 'dir shin tu 'brel chags pa yin cing / gzhan yang rje rin po che'i rjes su 'brang ba'i skyes mchog dam pa mtshar du mngar ba rnams kyi bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam srol gtsor mdzad pa 'ba' zhig tetso/rang rang gi rnam par thar pas shes shing 'dir yi ge 'brir ga la lang / gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs dang / rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen gzigs lag na pad dkar 'chang lnga pa chen po yi ngo mtshar rmad du gyur pa'i chos dam par ches cher bsngags par mdzad pa'i rgyud sde chen po gang 'di yi cho ga dgon sde chen po 'dir tshugs na gangs can gyi bde skyid rtsa ba rgyal bstan rin po che yongs su skyongs ba bstan pa'i bdag po mchod yon gyi chab srid mnga' thang 'phel ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can la dgongs nas sa dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i sras byang chub sems dpa' tho pa la chi gung sku zhabs nas dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa ste dngul bre chen du grags pa gcig gnang zhing / de yi mu 'thud du bdag gi dngul srang brgya tham pa ste bre chen gnyis/ de bzhin bla ma dam pa kun bzang dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi sku zhabs su bdag gi sbyor drug khrid bka' lan drug dang bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang lan drug tu nod pa'i bka' drin ni gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya tsin+ta ma ṇi'i bkang ste bskal pa'i bar nyin re bzhin phul yang tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi yon du yang dka' mod/ 'on te rang gi sgo gsum gus pas zang zing ji yod kyi spong thag lan du mar bgyis pa las de dag phal che ba mchod sbyin du spel ba'i cha shas dang / dad ldan 'ga' yi phul ba rnams tshogs gong 'phel du dgongs nas dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu dngul bre chen gsum phul bar mdzad de/ khyon dril dngul bre chen drug nespal di nar stong phrag gnyis kye rtsis ldan 'bri ba med nges pa gang / dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga btang ba'i cha rkyen du dga' ldan phun tshogs gling bzang por sbyar ba ste/ de yang dus kyi 'khor lo cho ga rgyas par rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung thugs gsung sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub dkyil thel ba zhig 'dzug thub na shin tu legs par gyur rung / chos sde 'di bshad pa'i grar song ba dang ske/ snyigs ma dus dbang gi sher brtson zhen pa rnams cho ga tshogs che na dka' tshegs chen pos dub par dogs/ cho ga zor yang na chags 'grib mi 'byung ba'i ched du dmigs/ klag dpe yang 'grub sla ba 450

bcas kyi rwa lo gsum pa'i gsung ngag dus 'khor lha dgu'i bsgrub thabs dang / rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa/ tshogs mchod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bcas phyag bzhes sngar rgyun ma nyams pa gzab rgyas su dge 'dun brgya dang sum bcu rtsa drug las mi lhag mi chad pas lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis kyi tshes bco lnga nam shar bar gzhal yas khang du grags par rigs ldan sprul pas bsgrub pa'i dus 'khor dkyil 'khor blos blang mdun du gnang rgyu yin la/ de yang dge rgyun 'di sbyar dus 'bru mar sha sogs sprul dkon pa'i lo skabs su gyur yang / cho ga grwa ba rnams la gsol ja bzhes 'jam tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad bzang po'i thob ldan du bgyis pa yin gyi/ slad mar 'bru sha sogs spus 'bol po byung tshe 'phar gang yin dus 'khor tshogs rdzas su spar te las pa 'di thog tu 'phar 'di btang zhes spyan ltos bzang por phan pa'i phyag bzhes dang / gang ltar gong gsal gyi dge rgyun dngul rtsa bar nyams chags med par dus ji srid sgyu 'phrul sras po'i bstan pa sa phyogs 'dir gnas shing rje bdag nyid chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa yod pa de srid du dge legs du ma 'byung ba'i rten 'brel bzang po'i gzhi rten du dus 'khor lha dgu rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i cho ga tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa 'di nges par gnas pa'i byed po dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi bstan 'dzin skyes bu mkhan slob spyi yi gzigs pas btsa' ba dang / las byed pas kyang do dam lhag bsam rnam par dag gtsang dge bas gnang ngos/ dge 'dun sku drag rnams kyang gal chung ma yin par rgyal bstan rin po cher dmigs pa'i 'gan khur che bzhes bka' drin chen pos cho ga mnyam pa med pa'i mdzad pa skyong bar gsol ba 'debs shing / de bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung mthu rtsal nus pa rmad du byung ba myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa yab yum 'khor bcas dang / khyad par legs ldan nag po trathid lcam dral/gza' mchog ra hu la 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ gnas bdag nags sman rgyal mo la sogs mthu ldan dam can dregs pa can rnams kyi yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dga' ldan phun tshogs gling bshad sgrub kyi sde nyams pa med pa'i 'phrin las dang / de bzhin du 'gro ba mtha' dag gi dge legs 'byung gnas rgyal ba mchod yon gyi chab srid yun du gnas shing bod khams bde ba'i rten 'brel du dmigs sa yi dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga'i rgyun 'di nyams pa med pa'i bsrung ma mdzad nas bar du gcod pa mtha' dag thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlags shing mthun rkyen 'dod dgu yid bzhin du rgyas par mdzod cig zhes dngos don smos zin nas slar smras pa/de ltar mi 'gyur bde chen la dga' bas/ /rnam kun mchog ldan dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam/ /mngon mtho nges legs phun sum tshogs pa'i gling / /bdag skal bzang pos spyod 'di ngo mtshar yin/ / 1 451

rtag brtan 'gyur ba med pa'i bde gshegs khams/ /yin lugs tshul bzhin 'chad pa dam pa'i chos/ /nges don tsam min nges don mthar thug gi/ /chos 'khor gnas 'dir bdag snying dga' tshal 'gyur/ /2 tshul 'dis nye bar drangs nas theg chen mchog gyur sngags kyi rgyud/ /rdo rje theg pa'i mthar thug dus bzhi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po bde ba che/ /gang gi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchod pa'i sprin dpung bzang po ni/ /3 sngon byon skyes mchog rmad byung rje btsun dam par gyur rnams kyi/ /dgongs klong rgya mtsho bskang zhing bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis gang / /rab spel ched du 'bad pa du ma dang bcas lhag bsam gyi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal bzang gsar du bskyed 'di sngon smon las su nges/ / 4 spyir yang gzhan gyi 'dag dka'i sdig tshogs ma lus bsregs pa'i me /byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu dus 'dir stsol byed rmad byung thabs/ /da phyar dpyad ldan bla med rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs 'khor gyis mchod pa//mtshungs pa yod min mtha' dag rgyud sde nas bsngags snying la bzung ske/ / 5 don des gzhung don mkhyen pa kun gyi 'bad pas tshul 'di bsgrub/ /de phyir dpyod ldan rnams kyi mgrin gcig bsngags par 'os lags shing / /bdag kyang tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge bas skye kun yang 'dir 'bad/ /de ltas ring min rnam mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas 'bras thob par shog / 6gzhan yang bdag gi dus gsum bsags yod dge ba'i tshogs ma lus/ /gcig sdom byang chen rgyur bsngo theg chen smon lam btab pa kun/ /bslu med dus 'di nyid nas yongs grub rgyal ba mchog go 'phang / /ma thob bar du mngon mtho'i dge legs yongs la spyod par shog / 7 skye kun rigs bzang mtshan dpe bzang brgyan lus thob kun yid 'ong / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam kun yongs shes blo gros rgyasaske/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mi phyed dad gus mchog tu rtag tu brtan/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshul khrims bslab pa dag gtsang spyod par shog / 8 'gro phan gyur na ma gtogs skye kun chags khro rmongs khrag dog /rnam rtog ngan pa skad cig tsam yang mi skye byams pa dang / /snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms la spyod 'gro ba'i don rgya cher/ /nam yang g.yel med spyod nas 'brel tshogs ma lus 'dren par shog / 9ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab bslab spyod yon tan rtsal myur rdzogs/ /gzung dang spobs pa mtha' yas yongs grub rgyal gsung chos kyi sgo/ /ma las gcig char blo yi 'dzin zhing ji bzhin don 'chad nus/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi dgongs pa ma lus bskang bar shog / 10 khyad par tshe rabs tshe rgyud rtag tu rdo rje theg lam 'phrad/ /rmad byung zab gsal bde lam mchog gyur bcom ldan dus 'khor lo/ /ston mdzad mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla ma dam pas rjes bzung nas/ /smin dbang yongs rdzogs bskyed rim ye shes ches dbang myur brnyes shog / 11 rdzogs rim byed cing cung zad tsam gyi rlung dbur zhugs nas thim/ /zab 452

gsal rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mor mnyams/ /sa gsum pho nya ma'i tshogs ma lus bdag drung rab 'dus nas/ /mi 'gyur bde chen grogs spyod khu rdul rlung dag rdo rje gsum 'grub shog /12 gzhan yang las bzhi lta stangs bcu gnyis grub pa chen po brgyad/ /yongs rdzogs cig char brnyes nas 'gro phan rgya chen po bsgrub cing / / 13 de bzhin bdag mthong thos dran reg gyur 'gro kun sdig zad nas/ /bde ldan 'od dpag med pa'i zhing du btsan thabs 'dren par shog /yang cig bdag gi theg chen smon lam rgya mtsho che gang btab/ /bdag la gus ldan slob tshogs kun gyi legs 'grub tshom bur 'tshogasaglu/ /gal te bdag smod bdag la gnod pa'i sems ldan gyur rnams yang / /sdig pa myur dag bdag gi byang chen spyod pa'i 'bangs byed shog / 14 mdor na tshe rabs kun tu byang lam spyod/ /rang dbang nyid kyi rgyal bstan ci bder spel/ /ma nor nges don mthar thug lhag par 'chang / /don gnyis lhun grub nor bu'i gnas thob shog /ces chos grwa chen po dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du rgyud rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga gang dang sku brnyan rnams la snang gsal dang 'dus sder mang ja sbyar ba'i dod su rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bod yul sa yi thig le lha ldan 'phrul snang gi bya 'dabs su me 'brug khrums zla'i dmar phyogs brgyad la grub par bris pa dge'o//dge'o// 453

༄ga /shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal kong yul smad gnas chen rgya la yi 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi rten rang byung mchod rten gyi dkar chag shugs byung rdo rje'i glu mi 'gyur byin rlabs gzi 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mgrin gcig tu/ /'jam dpa' bo ba spu khung cig gis/ /yon tan bskal brgyar brjod kyang 'dzad nus min/ /des na mgon der snying nas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang des mi mjed zhing 'dir 'dren pa mchog /thub pa'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur pad+ma 'byung / /de las 'jam dpal gzhan du yod ma yin/ /des na shes bzhin de la snying nas 'dud/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs rten mchod rten 'di/ /phyed ni rdo rje ri yi spor nub pa/ /chos sku blo 'das dmigs su med pa'i brda'//phyed ni rang byung 'bur du dod pa ni/ /gzugs sku'i sems can gzhan don byed pa'i brda'/ /de la rim pa gling bzhir brtsegs pa ni/ /dang po lha mi gnyis pa nyan rang dang / /gsum pa theg chen bzhi pa sngags kyi brda'/ /chos 'khor rtse rnon char kheb spang ba ni/ /chos dbyings gsang ba gzhal du med pa'i brda'aske/ /rtse mo'i g.yon du nyi zla kha sbyor dang / /seng khri'i g.yas su dga' 'khyil skum pos mtshan/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i ye shes rang mdangs nyid/ /gdul bya'i ched du cir yang snang ba las/ /rgyang pa'i gnas kyi thugs rten rang byung tshul/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs mdzad cing / /ye shes snang ba rab tu gnas byas nas/ /skal bzang tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i ched du snang / /des na sba dong 'jam dpal sku yi rten/ /chu klung sngags sgra sgrogs pa gsung gi rten/ /rang byung mchod rten 'di ni thugs kyi rten/ /'jam dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rten yin no/ /longs sku nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i mdangs/ /sprul sku gzhan don cir yang snang ba las/ /bems po'i tshul la sems dpa' gsum rtsegs pa'i/ /'jam dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di yang / /ji srid dus kyi mtha' la thug gi bar/ /'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs ched du brten par snang / /des na 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gis/ /'gro rnams thar pa gsum gyi sa bon gang / /nges par bzhag pa'i nus pa mchog ldan par/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /rdo rje'i gsung las nges par grub pa na/ /blo ldan rnams kyi yid ches gnas su 'os/ /'di tshul rgyas par slad nas gter shog las/ /gter spyod yang dag mchog gi ston gyur nges/ /gzhan du rtog spyod rig pa bsgrims po yi/ /sku 454

gzugs phyag mtshan 'dra dpyad kyi gdags yang / /byin brlabs mtshan ka chen po 'byung min te/ /srin bu'i shul rjes yi ge gzugs gyur mtshungs/ /'on kyang dad pa brtan por gnas pa yi/ /'dun pa'i dge ba 'gog pa mang ma yin/ /gzhan gyur gter grub brdzu ba'i zag zog dang / /nag phyogs 'dres brlam 'dre mthong mkhan gyi gtam/ /re zhig mdzes kyang phugs su shis min pas/ /des na chos dang chos min zhib tu spyod/ /de lta na yang deng dus 'gro ba phal/ /chos bzhin spyod las chos min zog po 'grim/ /gser dang ra gan rin thang mnyam par brtsi/ /des na snyigs du 'gro ba su yi thul/ /bsam bzhin snyigs dus skyes 'dir yi mug skyes/ /'on kyang rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dul dka' yi/ /'gro yang bdag gi sgrol bar sems bskyed pa'i/ /go chas smon lam bzang po 'debs las ci//des na bdag gi sgo gsum spyod pa kun//don ldan 'gro kun thar pa'i rgyur 'gro shog /bdag gi chos bzhin spyod dang chos min spyod/ /chos nyid ngo bor sgyu mar ro mnyam zhes/ /rgyal bas gsung na bdag gi dge mi dge/ /kun kyang kun tu bzang thob gsos rgyur shog /'khor ba dbyings 'das ming gis bla dag ste/ /rang rig bde chen dbyings su ro mnyam na/ /ye shes can tshul rtog ge'i spyod yul min/ /des na kun la dag snang 'byams klas shog /phyi nang rig gnas smra ba'i seng ge mchog /thob gyur 'on kyang mkhas rlom dpyad pa yi/ /bsam mi khyab la chos spangs mi spyod par/ /gu yang blo bde'i ngang du rtag gnas shog /de skad chos nyid don gyi gzi 'dod kyang //chos brgyad zhen pa'i dbang gi ma gzi ba'i/ /mdo med seng ge tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /rgya bal bod yul kun tu grags gyur ming / /kaḥ thog sprul sku rig pa 'dzin pa ste/ /o rgyan gu ru'i gsang ba'i ming btags pa/ /'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter bzhad rtsal/ /'bod de rnga chen lo zhal gsar ngom gyi//rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus/ /bzang po gsum par rgya la'i gnas chen du/ /tshig 'di smras pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs kyi gdung 'tshob pa/ /kun rdzob mchod rten dbang po'i sgor mjal nas/ /de la dad pas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shing / /don dam mchod rten bde gshegs snying po yi//blo bur dri spang bde chen mngon gyur shog /sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo/ 455

bka' 'gyur phan khang bcas kyi dkar chag mthong ba don ldan bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste sikhyi rastu/ mkha' khyab ye shes gnyis ldan bral smin mthar thug yang dag rdzongs sangs rgyasaglu/ /'gog bden ngo bo nyid las zhi ba myang 'das mngon lam gyur dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal ba'i sa bon sras gyur lha mi'i tshogs zhing mchog gyur dge 'dun sde/ /bslu med skyabs gyur 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal dge legs stsol/ /gang zhig bsod nams dpal ldan mi yi rje/ /gang gi rgyal gsung bcu gnyis yan lag can/ /gangs ljongs brdas 'dren chos kyi ring srol mchog /gangs can mgon po'i rig sngags 'khor lo bcas/ /byang chub chen po 'grub phyir rnam dkar las/ /legs par bsgrub pa'i ngang tshul tshig chags su/ /sdebs shing dge 'bras nyams med gong 'phel du/ /'gyur bsngo smon bcas cha tsam 'di na spel/ /de yang rgyal ba sku gsum cho 'phrul gyi/ /zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' la yongs su btug /chos sku'i zhing ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /longs spyod rdzogs zhing lhun grub mu mtha' bral/ /sprul pa sku zhing rdul snyed rdul grangs chags/ /de las mi mjed 'jig rten khams zhes pa/ /bye ba phrag brgya stong gsum stong chen po/ /mchog gi sprul pa gcig gi gdul byar shar/ /mchog tu bzod ldan bzang po'i bskal pa zhes/ /sgron ma brgya phrag bcu yi zhing khams ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad phyag gi pad+mo yi/ /ze'u 'bru nyer lnga brtsegs pa'i dbus su sprul/ /'di ru rnam 'dren brgyad cu phrag dang po'i/ /bzhi pa rgyal ba gzhan las thugs bskyed mthu/ /rmad byung lha yi lhar gyur rigs mchog skyes/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas pa shākya thub/ /de nyid gdul bya dman ngor drang don du/ /grangs med bskal pa du ma'i sngon rol na/ /dmyal bsrung shing rta 'dren pa byang chub rigs/ /sad nas rdza mkhan khye'u yangs pa'i mig /skyes pas thub pa che la gus pa'i blos/ /smon pa byang chub mchog tu thugs rab bskyed/ /de nas bskal pa grangs med chig mthar tshe/ /rgyal po'i mdun 'don bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul//zhes gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas la rin chen snying //gang gi spyan sngar 'jug pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /rgyal sras snying rje che ste grangs med pa'i/ /bskal pa gnyis nas rdzogs sangs rgyas lung thob/ /'jug sems bskyed nas bskal pa grangs med gcig /rdzogs tshe bram ze khye'u sprin zhes par/ /gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad/ /dgyes par byed pa'i bya ba la brtson nas/ /bla med don dam byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /rgyal bas grangs med bskal pa gcig 456

gi mthar/ /mi mjed 'dzam bu'i gling du rtsod ldan dus/ /shākya thub par sangs rgyas lung bstan te/ /de bzhin zhing 'dir rdzogs sangs rgyas gsum pa/ /'od srung bstan la khye'u bla mar grags/ /de 'phos dga' ldan gnas su dam pa tog /dkar po zhes pas lha rnams don mdzad nas/ /mi yi gdul byar gzigs pa lnga yi ni/ /gzigs te zas gtsang sras gyur rdo rje yis/ /sa gzhir yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang mchog de gsar du brnyes par 'dod/ /theg chen pas ni grangs med sngon bskal du/ /rin chen tog tu yang dag sngar sangs rgyas/ /slar yang 'dzam gling gdul byar shākya thub/ /mngon sangs rgyas pa'i tshul du bstan par bzhed/ /sngags rgyud thun mong bas ni gtsang ma'i gnas/ /spang ba'i 'og min de na gsang ba 'dus/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas nas zhing khams 'dir/ /byang chub spyod pas sangs rgyas tshul bstan 'dod/ /bla med sngags kyi mthar thug a ti yi/ /gzod ma nyid nas dag pa chos kyi sku/ /shāka thub rang byung ye sangs rgyas pa ste/ /sku gsum lhun grub kun tu bzang por bzhed/ /de ltar rgyal mchog shākya thub pa des/ /'dzamanywang gdul bya'i snang ngor chos 'khor lo/ /rim pa gsum bskor dang po bden pa bzhi/ /bar pa mtshan nyid med pa pha rol phyin/ /tha ma phyir mi ldog pa snying po gtam/ /nges don mthar thug chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /lkog gyur dbang po mchog ngor gsang ba sngags/ /phyi nang rgyud sde bsam gyi mi khyab gsungs/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' lung chos kyi sgo/ /de dag nyid las mi zhan sras kyi tshul/ /rnams kyi bsdus nas gdul bya'i skal ba dang / /mtshams par chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed par mdzad/ /spyir ni bzang po'i bskal par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun gyi bstan pa bsdud bsrung skyong ba po/ /gnod sbyin chen po lag na rdo rjer grags/ /khyad par thub bstan theg chen rigs gsum mgon/ /nyan thos bstan ni 'phags pa gnas brtan pa/ /bcu drug 'khor du dgra bcom mang pos bskor/ /'dzam gling tshe lo mthar thug bcu pa nas/ /brgya phrag 'phel bar bzhugs nas bstan pa spel/ /de yang rgyal ba thub dbang bstan pa mchog /ting 'dzin rgyal po'i rjes 'brang paṇ+ḍi ta/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i bzhed pa lo yi grangs/ /stong phrag lnga yi bar du gnas grags te/ /gang zhig rtswa can grong du rgyal ba mchog /zhi bar gzim nas brgya dang bcu phrag lo/ /yin te phyed lo nyis brgya nyi shur grags/ /de srid rgyal bstan gtad rabs bdun gyis bzung //bka' yi bsdu ba rim pa gsum po yang / /'das lor chig dang brgyad cu de bzhin du/ /sum brgya lon pa'i skabs su rim byung zhing / /de yi theg chen bka' yang ci rigs byon/ /de nas rim bzhin theg chen bstan pa yang / /thob btsun grub rje mched kyi ma ga dhar/ /dbu gtsug sgra gcan bzang pos 'phel bar mdzad//lhag par rgyas mdzad klu sgrub snying po ste//'das lo bzhi brgya lon skabs lho yi phyogs//be ta'i yul du bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs don gtam gyi tshogs/ /rig 457

tshogs bstod pa'i tshogs kyis bstan pa spel/ /theg chen grub mtha' 'chang ba'i shing rta che/ /'dzam gling rgyan zhes ston pa gnyis par gyur/ /khyad par 'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs don mchog /mi pham rgyal bas chos lnga mdzad pa gang / /rgyal ba 'das nas dgu brgya'i lo lon tshe/ /thogs med sa gzhi'i dbang phyug 'khrungs nas spel/ /shing rta chen gnyis de yi rjes 'brang ba/ /theg chen spyod pas 'dzam gling yongs su khengasaglu/ /khyad par bla med sngags kyi theg pa yang / /'das lo bcu gnyis lo skor gnyis song tshe/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i rigs can dra ma lngar/ /siṅga la ri drag shul can rtse mor/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de tshe mi yi rigs can rgyal po dzaḥ /in+d+ra bhu tir dge ba'i rta bdun bcas/ /bka' gtad pusti dbang bskur gsang sngags brnyes/ /de nas klu sgrub snying po byon gyi bar/ /ches cher gsang ba chen po'i sgo nas ni/ /skal ldan 'ba' zhig bdag gi spyod pas na/ /tshom bu 'bum phrag du ma sngon sangs rgyas/ /klu sgrub byon pa nas bzung gsang sngags chos/ /rim bzhin 'gro ba yongs kyi spyod yul gyur/ /rgyal ba 'das nas sum stong zin gyi bar/ /sngags kyi mchog brnyes grangs kyi mi langs byon/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'phags yul byang / /phyag na pad+mo'i gdul bya gangs ri'i ljongs/ /'di ru rgyal ba 'das nas lo nyis stong //lnga brgya so dgu 'das nas bzhi bcu'i bar/ /byang sems kun bzang rnam 'phrul tho tho ri/ /pho brang rtse la spang rkong za tog babs/ /chos kyi dbu brnyes de nas mi rabs lnga/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po byon/ /ra sa 'khrul snang gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing / /dam pa chos kyi srol bka' legs par bstod/ /de yi gdung rabs lnga bar khri srong lde/ /byon nas bstan pa spel phyir 'phags yul nas/ /mtshan nyid sde snod 'dzin pa zhi ba 'tsho/ /sngags kyi rig 'dzin bi ma la mu tra/ /khyad par 'od dpag med par sangs rgyas te/ /zhing 'dir bla mar gyur pa 'phur 'gro yi/ /rgyal sras thor cog can zhes bde ba che/ /zla bral sangs rgyas gnyis pa de spyan drangs/ /bod yul mi dang mi min 'gro ba rnams/ /'dul mdzad rmad du mgon de kho nar byung / /de yi slob ma tshe gcig phyag chen gyi/ /skur gshegs lnga phrag lnga dang brgya rtsa brgyad—/ /la sogs grub pa'i skyes bu grangs med par/ /byon nas bstan pa 'phags yul las lhag gyur/ /de tshe 'phags pa'i yul nas rgyal po de gdung 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas/ /lung bstan gnyis 'das gsum pa khri ral byon/ /de 'das 'og tu 'gro ba bsod nams kyi/ /sde snod 'dzin pa'i bstan pa nyams dmas 'gyur/ /de tshe 'phags pa'i yul nas smre ti zhes/ /byon pa de tshun gsar ma zhes grags te/ /rgyal ba'i sras po mi yi seng ge ni/ /lnga rig gnyis smra du mas bstan pa spel/ /mchog gyur rgyud lung man ngag bdag po ni/ /bla chen 'brog mi'i rgyud 'dzin mkhon ston che/ /sa skya pa zhes mkhas shing grub pa'i gtso/ /gong ma lnga dang de yi thugs kyi sras/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog 'bum phrag du ma yi/ /lung rtogs bstan pa kun tu 458

gsal bar mdzad/ /mchog tu gsung gi rdo rje jo nang pa/ /gsang ba 'dus 'phrul bu ston rin chen grub/ /shing rta gnyis kyi shākya'i bstan pa la/ /bya ba bla lhag mtshungs pa med par gyur/ /sang zhes grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta de yang / /gangs can mun sel shes rab mig tu mdzad/ /khyad par 'phags yul slob dpon zla ba grags/ /bod du skye bzhes lo tsā bai ro ste/ /'byung 'gyur rgyal ba snang mdzad mos pa zhes/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas par zhal bzhes gang de nyid/ /dag pa'i sgyu 'phrul chu nang zla gzugs bzhin/ /bsam gyi mi khyab nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam yang / /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs su/ /spel bar bzhed pas lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dus/ /rgyal ba zhi bar gzims nas lo stong phrag /gsum dang lnga brgya 'das shing nyag ma dgu'iske/ /steng du sleb tshe gangs can bod yul stod/ /la stod shrī sar+sha ta yi yul/ /lum+bi'i tshal mtshungs de ru rgyal ba nyid/ /rgyal sras tshul bzung paṇa chen 'jigs med grags/ /gang de 'phags yul pa rnams mer 'bod pa'i/ /me 'brug lo la sku yi dkyil 'khor shar/ /nges pa'i don la 'phags pa'i spyod yul nyid/ /tshur mthong skye bos blos brtags nus min yang / /gdul bya 'di yi snang tshul dag tu ni/ /ches cher mkhas shing btsun pa'i ngang tshul can/ /khyad par sku gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /byin rlabs chos kyi snang ba bsam yas nas/ /sde snod rab 'byams thugs kyi klong du chud/ /ye shes chen po'i gnas lugs mngon gyur cing / /rig gnas mdo rgyud bka' dang bstan bcos kun/ /dgongs pa rdzogs par 'brel ba'i bstan bcos ni/ /de nyid 'dus pa seng ge'i nga ro sgrog /thub pa'i bstan la ston pa gnyis par gyur/ /rgyud 'dzin slob ma bka' babs nyi shu gsum/ /'jam dbyangs mkhon gyi gdung rigs rnam pa gsum/ /nyi ltar grags pa'i mkhas gnyis sngags 'chang gcig /lo tsā mchog gsum dge bshes chen po drug /yongs rdzogs mkhas pa bcu gsum rtog ge gsum/ /yongs kyi bshes gnyen bcu drug sngags mkhan gsumaske/ /drag sngags 'dzin pa gnyis dang rnal 'byor bzhi/ /shākya thub pa'i gdan sa mkhan po gnyis/ /legs bshad smra ba'i mkhas pa stong phrag gcig /bka' bcu smra bar nus pa stong phrag gnyis/ /phar tshad smra ba khri phrag lhag pa dang / /mchog gi grub brnyes bcu phrag lnga bcas te/ gang gi dngos rgyud slob mar bcas pa yis/ /rgyal bstan lung rtogs dri med srog thud pa/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyur e waṃ bo dong zhes/ /snyan pa tshangs chen 'jig rten bar du skyongs/de ltar bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa yi/ /bstan pa 'dzam gling 'phags pa'i yul mchog dang //byang phyogs gdong dmar bho ṭa'i sngongs 'di ru/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras tshul bzung 'phags rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid rgyud dang 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi/ /bstan pa'i byung tshul sa bon tsam smos nas/ /da lam 'di ru brjod bya dngos po'i don/ /ji lta bu zhig gleng bar bya zhes na/ /de yang 'dzam gling ri dbus kai la 459

sha /chu bzhi'i mgo bo sa gtsang nyams dga' ba/ /rgyal bas lung bstan pad dkar 'chang ba'i zhing / /gangs ri'i smongs zhes mi kun byang chub sems/ /spyan ras gzigs dang 'phags ma sgrol ma yi/ /sprul pa'i spre'u brag srin rigs rgyud las/ /byung bas mi rnams theg chen rigs ldan pa'i/ /yul gling dum bu gsum du bcad pa yi/ /yul dbus dbus gtsang ru bzhi gtsang gi cha/ /la stod lho zhes grub pa mchog gi gnasaske/ /gnam sa 'khor lo pad+ma'i dbyibs su chags/ /ri kun bkra shis rtags kyis yongs su brgyan/ /'brog khyim yul ljongs dkar dmar 'bru sna tshogs/ /rtswa chu shing sogs mthun rkyen 'dod dgu 'dzom/ /'phags pa'i skyes mchog du ma sku 'khrungs shing / zhabs bcags byin rlabs grub pa'i bste gnas mdzadaglu/ /khyad par shrī sar+sha ta zhes pa/ gang de 'dzam gling 'di na dpal gyi ri/ /bcu gsum yod pa'i snying po lta bu ste/ /bkra shis byin chags mchog mthun grub pa'i ri/ /ri rgyud shel gyi mchod rten phreng ba 'dra/ /dpal gyi ri bo de yi byang shar mtshams/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i grub gnas pha drug byang / /myang 'das rgyal ba'i pho brang lha gdong shar/ /bod kyi gangs bzhi ya rgyal bu le'i lho/ /pad+ma'i sgrub phug rgyang gi lho nub mtshamasaske/ /lo chen grags pa'i bste gnas shel dkar ri/ /lung rigs dbyar rnga sgrog de'i nub kyi cha/ /mngon par dga' zhes kun dga' ra ba bzhin/ /'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i snying po'i gtam/ /mi zhum smra ba'i spobs ldan mkhas pa che/ /brgya phrag du ma tshogs pa'i mdun sa der/ /'jigs med grags pa'i dbon rgyud stobs ldan rigs/ /mi rabs kun tu mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ /dpal la spyod pa'i 'phrin las ba dan can/ /spom rom rje dbon zhes pa'i gdung rgyud lus/ /blo gros du ma'i lang tsho dpal 'bar zhing / /bla med sngags la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyi mnga' bdag chos kyi rje/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang po zhes snyan grags can/ /gang gi bka' blon 'bangs bcas lhag bsam gyis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dge 'bras bskyed pa'i rgyur/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab gangs can brdas 'dren pa'iske/ /bka' 'gyur zhes grags glegs bam rin po che/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i bdag po stobs kyi rgyal/ /mi yi dbang phyug chen pos shel dkar du/ /spar du sgrub pa'i dag ther snga 'gyur gyis/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed gang gi mdzad pa las/ /'char ba'i puste brgya phrag chig gi grangs/ /sgrub pa'i dkar shog yon du rdo bcud kyi/ /dong rtser bal ṭaṃ grags pa brgya phrag bdun/ /gdong tshon gser shog che gras stong bam gnyis/ /tshal rtsi'i yon du bal ṭaṃ zhe gcig dang / /dgab shing glegs chab rgyun bcas phun tshogs dang / /'phags pa'i rigs sngags yi ge drug ma yis/ /tsakra mthong thos reg pas grol ba 'di/ /dkar shog bal ṭaṃ sum brgya lnga bcu'i rin/ /phyi yi lāmir gser shog stong bam bdun/ /sa snying btul ma zho gsum se ba brgyad/ /tshon rtsi'i yon du bal ṭaṃ zhe dgu lhag /de ltar bka' 'gyur yig drug tsakra la/ /gzhan gyi mthun rkyen 460

gsos su phul ba ni/ /mngon dga' ston 'khor tshang mas thun mong du/ /bal ṭaṃ brgya phrag g.yas gsum 'khor drug gcig /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor kong po yi/ /shog ldeb nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gsum phul//mngon dga' 'chad nyan bla mas g.yag grus bzhi/ /bla ma mgon rin gser shog zho gsum rin/ /spom rom blon chen tshogs bdag yar 'phel nas/ /gser shog che gras stong bam bal ṭaṃ brgyad/ /bka' bcu ngag tshul bal ṭaṃ sum cu brgyad/ /bka' bcu nam dpal bzang ja chu shog sbab/ /rin dbang nas khal brgya dang bal ṭaṃ bcu/ /gser gnyer drung pa ngag dbang dge legs dang / /bka' bcu bsod grags bal
