ṭaṃ bcu gnyis dang / /mkhas pa chos mdzad gser shog brgya bam gcig /bcu mgon g.yag gcig bcu bkras bal ṭaṃ drug /de sogs dad shugs can gyi 'byor yon dang / /gzhan yang bcu tshigs skabs chang ci rigs pa/ /dad ldan dge sems rgyas pa mang pos sgrub/ /ma ṇi bzhugs pa'i phyi yi gartso la/ /sbubs su bcom ldan rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /g.yas g.yon rdo rje sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor/ /g.yas g.yon gtso bo'i mdun du dol po pa/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i sku brnyan sgo yi gong / /gangs can 'gro ba'i bla ma yab sras gsum/ /sgo 'debs g.yas g.yon dmag zor chos bdag pa/ /phyi ldeb log la rgyal chen sde bzhi bcas/ /bkod legs ngo mtshar shin tu legs sgrub ste/ /de ltar dge las bskyed pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa/ /spom rom blon chen tshogs bdag yar 'phel zhes/ /dpa' mdzangs blo gros 'phrul ldan dge blo can/ /de yi lhag bsam bzang po'i khur blang 'bad/ /do dam 'go mi zhal ngo nor bstan dang / /blo bzang dar rgyas chos 'phel gsum gyi bgyis/ /'du byed mkhas pa bdun dang spar 'debs pa/ /dge 'dun bcu phrag shing bzo lcags bzo sogs/ /khyon du bcu phrag brgyad lhag grangs ldan gyis/ /sgo gsum le lor med par brtson pas sgrub/ /byin rlabs mthu ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rab tu gnas pa bkra shis me tog byab/ /kun kyang 'phangs med dngos po dpang mtho ba'i/ /yon gyi blo yi ra ba khengs par byas/ /de ltar dge ba'i bya ba rlabs chen po/ /'dzam gling ring bsrel can gyi bim pa kun/ /gser gyi g.yogs te mchod pa bgyis pa las/ /chos kyi ring bsrel gsung rab glegs bam mchod/ /bsod nams ches che pha mtha' yas gsungs pas/ /de na rgyal bka' bod du 'gyur ro cog /glegs bam yig drug 'khoralo garnyo la/ /legs par sgrub pa 'di las gang thob pa/ /dge tshogs ma lus yongs su bsdoms nas ni/ /bla med byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de mthu'i dus 'di nas bzung byang chen bar/ /skye kun mi khom gnas spang dal 'byor rten/ /ma nyams rigs btsun mtshan dpe mtshar sdug lus/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan par shog /phun tshogs rnam par smin pa'i yon tan brgyad/ mthun pa'i yul dang skyes bu dam pa rten/ /bdag gi legs smon sngon gyi bsod nams 461

paske/ /chos mthun mthun rkyen ma tshang med thob shog /grogs mchog dge ba'i bshes dang gzhon nu nas/ /mjal zhing rgyal ba'i bstan la rab tu byung / /bshes gnyen bla ma'i thugs kyi dgyes dgu sgrub/ /mi mnyes skad cig tsam yang mi spyod shog /chos kyi gzhi ma tshul khrims bslab pa brtan/ /nyes ltung ma gos tshul khrims phung po rgyas/ /zab dang rgya che'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la//yengs med blo gros thos bsam la spyod shog/thos bsam mthar son sgom pa'i chos la zhugs/ /rnyed dka' shes nas dal 'byor snying po blang / /'chi bas 'jigs nas chos la brtson pa bskyed/ /rgyu 'bras las la yid ches skye bar shog /skyes bu chung 'bring chen po'i blo gros rnams/ /ma nyams thob ste mthar thug gzhan gyi don/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog /thob 'dod bsam pa mthun min mnyes par shog /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems spyan snga ru/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshang cho ga legs blangs te/ /smon pa 'jug sems yang dag bskyed byas nas/ /de yi bslab las nam yang mi 'da' shog /khyad par theg chen sngags kyi sgor zhugs te/ /smin byed dbang gi rim pas yongs smin byed/ /mchog tu bla med dbang bzhi'i sgo gsum snyigs/ /rdo rje bzhi yi rgyu ru smin par shog /dbang srog dam tshig thun mong rigs lnga dang / /khyad par bcu bzhi'i rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i brgyad—/ /yan lag sbom po brgyad byas nyams med par/ /srog las lhag pa gces pa bsrung bar shog /sngags kyi lta bsgom spyod pa rnal 'byor rnams/ /nyams su len pa'i nus pa mchog tu thob/ /stong nyid mnyam nyid brjod med mi rtog pas/ /chos nyid 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par shog /gsang sngags thun mong ma yin lta ba yi/ /chos can 'khor 'das dbyer med bstan phebs nas/ /bsgom pa bskyed rim lus dbon sku rdo rje/ /ngag dben gsung gi rdo rje'i lam bsgom shog /sems dben thugs kyi rdo rje'i lam zin nas/ /tshogs lam rgyu yi sa bcu mngon du byas/ /ye shes rdo rje rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug nyams len shog /sgyu lus thun mong rgyu yi sa bcu gcig /thun min sbyor ba'i lam gyi nges byed bzhi//dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga'i yon tan rdzogs/ /lam gyi sa bcu yongs su bgrod par shog /'od gsal lam gyi snying po nyams blangs pas/ /'bras bu sa bcu'i mthong lam rab dga' thob/ /byang chub lam gyi yan tshag bdun brnyes shing / /brgya phrag bcu gnyis yon tan rdzogs par shog /zung 'jug slob lam 'phags pa'i sa dgu rdzogs/ /yan lag brgyad kyi yon tan yongs su smin/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /lam gyi khyad par yongs su rdzogs par shog /mi slob rjes mthun kun tu 'od la sogasaske/ /bcu gnyis sa yi yon tan phal che rdzogs/ /sku gsung thugs mchog ye shes rdo rje'i lam/ /lam mchog ches cher 'phags rnams rdzogs par shog /mi slob lam gyi mthar thug rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yan lag bdun ldan dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / /rnam pa thams cad sku gsung thugs ye shes/ /mngon byang chub 462

pas 'gro kun don spyod shog /mdor na theg chen rgyu yi gzhi things shing / /bla med sngags kyi lam la yang dag zhugs/ /rgyud mchog nas gsung mchog gi 'bras bu brnyes/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis yongs 'grub shog /gzhan yang thun mong las chen bcu gnyis 'grub/ /grub pa chen po brgyad kyi dngos grub brnyes/ /yon tan brgyad ldan rig 'dzin lus thob nas/ /'chi med lus rten de yi byang chub shog /gal te 'chi srid brtan yang rang bzhin gyis/ /'od gsal chos kyi sku ru yongs su zhugs/ /bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa mchog gi skur/ /bzhengs nas dpag med 'gro don byed par shog /gal te 'od gsal mngon du ma gyur pas//srid par 'khyams na lha dang bla maye//lung bstan la brten bar do rang ngo shes/ /bsam bzhin dag pa sprul sku'i zhing 'jug shog /dus 'di la yang gangs can rgyal khams 'dir/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ris med rab rgyas 'phel/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i dgongs don bzhed dgu 'grub/ /dpal ldan e dong ring lugs nyams med shog /bod yul bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba'i dbang / /zhabs pad brtan zhing sa skyong mi yi bdag /phrin las nyams med chos rnams gong du 'phel/ /skye rgu thams cad bde ba'i dpal spyod shog /de ltar smon lam btab don bslu ba med par 'grub pa'i rgyu mchog tu/ /bde legs kun 'byung zhing dang dam chos brtan g.yo'i bcud gyur chos kyi sku/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de sras slob mar bcas shing bden gnyis rten 'brel mthus//gegs med deng nas rgyud ldan 'di 'grub myur du rdo rje sems thob shog /zhes gangs ri'i ljongs su sku 'khrungs pa'i dbon paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i dbon rgyud mi rje chos skyong ba rje dbon nam mkha' dpal gyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang / rigs sngags yi ge drug pa'i 'khor lo gharjo la bcas sgrub pa'i dkar chags smon lam dang sdebs te spel ba 'di ni gang gi blon po blo gros dad pa'i nor ldan bha ro tshogs bdag yar 'phel gyis nan du bskul ba la brten te/ rgyal ba shākya seng ge sku 'khrungs nas lo sum stong dgu brgya rtsa bdun pa'i steng du slebs shing /dpal dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs 'khrungs nas lo sum brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga 'das pa/ bde 'byung cha bsags kyi pho brang seng ge'i khrir rigs ldan rnam gnon gyi chos gsungs nas lo lngar slebs pa/ rje dbon nam mkha' rin chen gyis mngon dga' btab nas mi rabs bdun la 'khod pa'i lo 'phags yul las stod 'brel ba 'gal byed lcags phag dbyug gu zla ba'i lha babs tshes dmar phyogs bdun gyi skabs su la stod lha gdong gi dgon par mdo khams dbus 'gyur kaḥthog gi lho rgyud du skyes shing skye ba kun tu 'phur 'gro'i rgyal ba pad+ma skyes kyi rjes su bzung mthus mdo sngags kyi don ji bzhin smra bar mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa can rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shar stag bu'i btsun pa bsod nams rab brtan no//dge'o// 463

gag /mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar po'i nye 'dabs kyi nam ling dgon sder rje pa lhas sbyin bsam 'grub kyi smyor 'jags sogs gnang ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ 'khrul spang yon tan kun glin 'bri gang yang bral ston pa che/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma lus kun bskyed brjod dang brjod bral yum/ /gdul bya'i tshogs zhing mya ngan 'das pa'i sa bon rgyal kun sras/ /bla med bla ma 'jig rten gsum mgon dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag don la gdod ma nyid nas rang byung kun tu bzang / /sngags kyi 'og min gnas su byang chub rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad/ /theg chen sa yi bskal sngon rdzogs sangs rgya sa pa rin chen tog /mi mjed bskal bzang zhing 'dir rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya thub/ /bltams pa'i gling mchog gser gyi ljon pas yongs brgyan dbus 'gyur 'tshal/ /ma ga dha yi byang phyogs nyi ma la yi phreng 'dzin pa'i/ /bho ṭa zhes grags phyag na pad+ma 'chang de'i gdul bya'i zhing / /gyur zhing rgyal bstan dri med mchog tu gnas pa'i yul ljongs nyid/ /cha gsum byas pa'i stod la mnga' ris skor gsum grags pa yi/ /mang yul gung thang zhes pa rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /mchog tu gyur zhing 'dzam gling 'di na sa skyongs su yi yang / /'gran med mi rje lhas mdzad chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum zhes/ /bod la bka' drin che ba las kyang ches cher rmad byung ba/ /mchog de'i gdung rgyud gung thang chos rgyal bzhugs nas bka' rtags kyi/ /rgyal khab khyung rdzong dkar po'i nub byang mtshams kyi dben pa mchog /nam mkhar snyegs 'dra gyen phyur rtse mor ling nge chu 'dzin ltar/ /mdzes gyur nam ling zhes bya srid gsum 'di na snyan pa yi/ /ba dan sgrengs bas dpal ldan sa skya zhes grags mkhas shing grub/ /de yi ring lugs dri med 'chang ba'i sgrub sde gang de la/ /rdzong dkar khrims 'dzin mi mchog sde pa lhas sbyin bsam 'grub kyis/ /lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yis/ /zhabs pad rtag brtan theg dgu'i sgron me phyogs mthar kun rgyas shing / /ris med 'gro kun bde dga' cher 'phel mi dbang chab srid brtan/ /pha mar gyur pa'i sgrib byang gyur cing bdag gzhan thams cad kyi/ /'di dang phyi ma'i bde 'bras thob phyir skyes bu chen po'i blos/ /dgon gnas nam ling ji srid bar du dge 'dun lnga phrag lngas/ /lo re bzhin du cho 'phrul chen po rgyal ba'i dus mchog gi/ /dkar phyogs tshes pa gsum bzhi lnga la nyin ltar bzhin du ni/ /stong nyid mkha' la snying rjes spyod ma'i 464

sgrub thabs rtsa bshad lugs/ /rdul bral da lar 'byung ba'i dmar chas yongs byug rten nyid la/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin yongs rten yan lag bzhi ldan cho ga mchog /nyin re la ni lan gsum dag tu mnyes byas mkha' spyod kyi/ /grong khyer 'chi med nyams dga'i gnas su yongs bgrod skal 'jogs shing / /dam can dgyes nas lam gyi bar chad sel phyir zla ba ni/ /byung ngo cog gi nyi shu dgu'am yang na gnam stong laske/ /nag po chen po rdo rje'i gur dang zhal bzhi pa yi ni/ /mchod bskang gsol kha dag gtsang brgya rtsa re ni dus rtag par/ /'dzug pa'i mthun rkyen rdo bcud rnaspa la yi ltang rtse grangs/ /brgya phrag gcig dang zung gnyis gcig gi lhag bcas sbyor 'jags su/ /bgyis pa'i dge rtsa de dang de rig las byung gcig sdoms pa'i—/ /bsod nams gyur kun rnam mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyur bsngo zhing / /gnas skabs su yang skye ba 'di nas mthar thug bar du ni/ /ngan song gnas su mi skye mtho ris bde thob sdig sgrib zad/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag tu bya ba cher byas don gnyis 'grub/ /nam zhig 'chi tshe 'khrul pa'i 'jigs skrag med par bde bzhin du/ /rgyal ba rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' spyod dga' ba'i grong khyer du/ /bsus nas dag pa'i sa la yongs spyod dpa' bo dhāk+ki mchog /rnams dang skal ba mnyam nas he ru ka 'bras rab thob shog /gang du skye dang gnas yul bkra shis dge legs yon tan tshogs/ /rab brgyan tshe ring nad med phun tshogs 'byor pa mtha' dag rgyas/ /mi mthun kun zhi bsam dgu thams cad chos mthun 'bad med 'grub/ /rgyal bas bsngags gyur rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi zhal mjal zhing / /sde snod gsum dang rdo rje theg mchog bdud rtsi'i yongs myong nas/ /rgyal kun gshegs shul tshe gcig nye lam nges gsang snying po'i don—/ /brjod bral lhan skyes gnyug ma ka dag ye shes chen po gang / /dri ma kun spangs yang dag mchog rtogs sku gnyis myur thob shog /gzhan yang gangs ris brgyan pa'i ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas pa mchog /nub med rab tu rgyas shing de 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /thugs yid rab mthun mdza' bcugs mdzad bzang gong bu gcig 'dres shing / /sku tshe nyi zla ltar brtan 'phrin las nyams med kun tu 'phel/ /mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs mtshon dang mu ge'i bskal pa rab zhi zhing / /rgyal bstan snying po la gus mi dbang chen po'i chab srid rgyas/ /skye 'gro thams cad bde dga'i dpal la longs spyod dge mtshan che/ /phyogs dus kun khyab yun nas yun tu rtag par rab gnas shog /ces mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar por skye 'gro mtha' dag bde bar skyong ba'i khrims 'chang mi mchog dam pa gzhung bzang dad gus shes rab la sogs du ma'i yon tan du ma yis yongs su brgyan zhing sde theg pa chen po la las smon bzang pos mthus grub pa'i sde pa kun gsal ba lhas sbyin bsam 'grub kyis bstan 'gro'i don dang rang gzhan gyi sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs ched du nam ling dgon sder phur bu zhes sprel nas bzung dgon gnas ji srid bar du lo ltar bzhin zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum nas lnga yi bar nā ro mkha' spyod kyi cho ga nyin re bzhin tshar gsum re dang / zla ba byung ngo cog gi dgu'am stong la gur zhal gyi bskadza gsol 465

ri rgyu'i mthun rkyen rdo bcud rnaspa la yi ltang rtse brgya dang bzhi lhag sbyor 'jag mdzad pa'i tsam du/ rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi byin rlabs cung zad zhugs par rloms pa'i kaḥgun pa tshe dbang nor bus sa spres cho 'phrul zla ba'i dus bzang tshes bcur gang shar chu smin bdag mchog gi sku tshe 'phrin las nyams med brtan par gyur cigamaṅga lo/

gag /stod mnga' ris mar yul la dwags he mi grwa tshang rjes 'brangs bcas kyi bca' yiga.oṃ swāste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun gyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i khams/ /kun la khyab pa mkha' ltar brdal ba'i sku/ /kun gyi mgon po phan bde dge legs chos/ /kun gyi 'byung gnas bla mar dang po 'dud/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' spangs ma rig spubs las yongs grol zhing / /rang byung ye shes rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag med rab rgyas pa/ /dmigs med snying rjes mkha' khyab sems can kun don rgyun mi chad/ /dam pa sku gnyis spyi dpal rdzogs sangs rgyas der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas kun las ches rmad byung / /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa/ /shākya thub pa don grub lha yi lhar/ /snying nas gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dge legs yon tan phung po'i don snang 'bum/ /srid zhi'i bla na bres pa'i mi'i nyi ma/ /bdud bzhi'i mun pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /ston mchog zas gtsang sras de'i shis pa stsal/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i gzugs/ /gcig gyur 'phags pa'i 'phags pa mig mi 'dzum/ /rgyal kun bskyed yab kun gyi sras kyi tshul/ /lag na pad+mo can des rtag bsrung mdzod/ /'dzam gling gangs can 'di na sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa gdong lnga pa/ /du ma'i dbus na nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ches rmad byung / /sgro gshog rab rgyas rkang rgyan ldan pa nges don nga ros snyems/ /'gro ba'i mgon po 'khor gyi dgrar gyur bka' brgyud pas skyongs shig /mngon par mtho ba'i 'bras bzang kun bskyed cing / /nges legs rin chen ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'jig rten kun gyi rten dang gnas gyur pa'i/ /tshul khrims gser ldan 'dzin ma rgyal gyur cig /ces dang de yang /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku'i zhing thun mong dang /mchog tu gyur pa las/ mchog gi gnas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi zhing / gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho yi phyag gi lhung bzed dri ma med pa spos chu'i rgya mtsho chen po las legs par skyes pa rab tu rgyas pa pad+ma'i sdong po dbus ma thugs kyi dpal be'u'i gnas su kha gyes pa'i ze'u 'bru nyi shu rtsa lnga steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i yas mas bcu gnyis kyi tshig dbus su thun mong mchog gi sprul pa'i sku chen po'i gdul zhing mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya'i khyon ldan de las ri rab lhun po'i lho phyogs gser gyi 'bras bu can gyi ljon shing gi nye bar 467

spras pa dbus 'gyur tshal skal bzang 'dren pa rnams mngon par sangs rgya ba rdo rje'i sa gzhi byang chub shing gi nye bar spras pa khyad par 'phags pa 'dzam bu'i gling zhes yongs su grags gyur der bskal pa bzang po sa 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcu phrag brgya dang rtsa gsum rim par byon par 'gyur pa las rnam 'dren dpa' bo bdun nam bzhi par gyur pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po thub pa lha yi lha shākya tog shākya thub pa chen po gang dga' ldan gyi gnas su sa bcu rgyun gyi mtha' ma la gnas pa'i skyes bu 'dzam gling mi yi 'gro ba tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su 'jam dpal zas gtsang ma dang 'jig rten mgon po sgyu 'phrul sras su bltams nas ser skya'i grong btsun mo dam pa brgyad khri'i dbus su spros bcas kyi spyod pa dang ske/ rab tu byung nas ljongs rgyu ba spros med dang / rna ra dza ri'i 'gram du shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum bskyangs nas thun mong du rdo rje can gyi sa gzhi byang chung zhing dbang gi drung thun mong ma yin pa lha yi bu dbang phyug chen po'i gnas dang / don dam par phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas don dam pa sa gsum pa'i ngor gzhom du med pa'i sgra brtag par rgyun mi chad pa theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / 'dzam gling 'di na thun mong gi ngor chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum/ dang po ni/ gang zag bdag bzlog pa'i ched/ gnyis pa chos kyi bdag bzlog par mdzad cing / gsum pa/ bdag med pa bdag gi pha rol du phyin pa don dam pa chos kyi dbyings bdag po'i bdag phyir mi bzlog pa nges don snying po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad nas thun mong gi sde snod rnams gnas brtan bcu drug la dang / thun mong ma yin pa 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po la gtad de/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po mnga' gsol zhing / mi yi gnas 'dzam gling du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung bar byin gyis rlabs te rtag 'dzin can rnams zhen pa bzlog phyir du rtswa chen drung du gzugs sku'i bkod pa btul ba'i tshul bstan cing / med par lta ba bzlog pa'i ched du mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas thub pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi gsang ba'i bdag po la mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal por gsung zhing / de ni mya ngan 'das nas lo sum brgya drug bcu rtsa brgyad pa na/ rdo rje sems dpa' skur bstan nas sprul pa'i sku rig pa 'dzin pa dga' rab rdo rje la rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud le'u 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi legs par gsungs te khyad par mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad dam bcu gnyis lon pa na dhā na ko sha'i mtsho gling me tog pad+ma'i sdong por badzus skyes sprul pa'i sku rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung gnas su snang la/ sde snod spyi dang rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bar mdzad pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi sgyu 'phrul bsam gyi mi khyab ston par mdzad pa las/ de don snying po'i bstan pa mchog tu gsal bar byed pa gcig ni 468

'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs kyi dngos slob bram ze'i bu bzhi pa'i brda la brten gcig char nyid du rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang nyid la gshegs te zhing khams gzhan du mchog gi sprul pa'i skur yang bstan pa dpal chen po sa ra ha ste mda' bsnun zhabs yin la/ de nas rim par sangs rgyas pa'i grub mthar mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa grags che ba bcu phrag brgyad byon pa'i nang nas bka' bzhi chu bo gcig tu 'dus pa nyi ltar kun tu gsal ba grub pa bye ba'i 'byung khungs dpal ldan ti lo pa dang de sras thu bo nā ro ta pa te gang gi ring lugs byang phyogs 'di ru 'dren pa'i shing rta chen po dpal ldan he ru ka mar ston chos kyi blo gros zhabs te/ de yang byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di 'phags mchog lag na pad+mo can gyi bdag gir bzung ba'i mthu la brten mang bkur nyi ma'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa shākya li tsa wi'i rgyud las 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul gnam gyi dmu thag brgyud lha ri rol pa'i rtse mor babs par grags pa gnya' khri btsan po nas spu rgyal bod la sman pa'i rje btsad po byung zhing / de yi gdung las tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis skabs su dam pa'i chos kyi dbus brnyes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mi'i gzugs su snang ba chos kyi rgyal po lha srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su dam pa'i chos kyi srol ji bzhin pa btsugs/dbon khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su btang bar 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ches chen por gyur ba nas kyang bsngags pa'i yul du gyur par mdzad/ de rjes khri ral pa can gyi yang de bzhin la chos kyi khrims btsan par byas shing / de yi dbon rgyud mnga' ri stod kyi rgyal po rnams nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad cing jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha yang bod du spyan drangs/ rags rtsis su de dang dus mtshungs nyid du dpal dgyes pa rdo rje u pa si ka'i tshul gyi gdul bya'i don mdzad par mar ston chos kyi blo gros kyi bal po pham thing dang / 'phags yul gyi rje mi ti pa la sogs paṇa grub du ma'i zhabs la thug shing / khyad par du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang lag na pad+mo'i sras kyi thu bo nor bu 'dzin pa dang gnyis su med pa'i sgyu 'phrul nā ro ta pa'i byin rlabs don gyi 'pho ba yang dag par thob te gangs ri'i khrod du snying po don gyi bshad sgrub rgyas par mdzad pas mi la thos pa dga' yi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs ba yi grub pa'i chu klung chen po rgyas pa'i dbu btsugs/gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa dpal sgam po pa chen po'i don bsgoms snying pos 'dzin pa'i khyon kun gyi rgyan du bkod cing / de yi slob ma'i mchog dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor zhal gyi bzhes pa dpal ldan phag mo grub pa zhes su grags shing / de las slob ma gdugs thogs rnams kyi nang nas cig char rtogs pa'i gar mkhan gcig pu gnyis su med pa 'phags yul dpal mda' bsnun zhabs kyi gnyen gyur snang phu pa gang gi slob ma na ro ta pa bsam bzhin du sgrub 469

brgyud bstan pa spel ba'i slad du skye ba'i srid pa bzung ba 'gro ba'i mgon po ye shes rdo rje'am gtsang pa rgya ras dang bsgrub gnas la mtshan gsol te dpal ldan sprin gyi rnga sgra can zhes snyan pa 'og min tshangs chen gyi 'jig rten bar du khyab par gyur pa gang gi ring lugs 'dzin pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs dang sa yi rtsi thog bzhin gnas yul dur khrod kun tu khyab par gyur pa nyid las phyi ma'i dus su 'gro ba'i mgon po rang nyid bstan pa'i rgud pa sel ba'i slad du skye ba'i phreng bar byin gyis brlabs pa las rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba kun mkhyen pun+da ri ka /zhes rgyu skar gyi khrod du zla ba ltar gcig tu dkar zhing mngon par mtho ba gang gi yang srid rgyal ba dam pa dpag bsam dbang po'i zhal nas mnga' ri stod du phrin las kyi byed por chos kyi rgyal thabs chen por dbang bskur zhing thar pa'i lam mkhan chos kyi rje bo ngag dbang bzang pos sems nyid chos kyi sku ru ngo sprad pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug o rgyan pa stag tshang ras pa zhes gang gi phrin las kyi bgyi bas 'dus byas shing smon lam gyi stobs rlabs po che dang ldan zhing bsod nams kyi dpung pa nam yang ma smad pas mngon par mtho ba'i lang tsho mchog tu brtas pa lha btsad po seng ge rnam par rgyal ba gang gi thugs bskyed bzang po'i 'phrul las sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan 'brug pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi rgyun mnga' ri stod spyi dang bye brag mar yul phyogs su rgya cher rgyas par byed pa las/ snying por gyur pa rdo rje'i spo lta bu he mi byang chub gling du theg mchog bde chen gi gtso gyur dgon ma lag bsgrub sde'i rigs gyur kun gyi bla ma mkhan slob mdzod 'dzin las tshan che phra lha 'bangs bcas kun gyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa snying po'i don sgrub brgyud kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa la nye bar sems te blang dor bgyid 'os kyi yi ge /de yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid can 'di kho na yin la de yang bstan rtsa dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las shing / de nyid kyang bstan pa rin po che'i srid zhu tshul bzhin du bgyis pa'i sbyin bdag chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal srid la ltos pa las sngar rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje'i gong bu rje btsun 'brug pa rgyal dbang bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs nas phyogs 'dir chos kyi 'phrin las kyi byed por rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku rin po cher dgongs pa yongs su gtad pa de bzhin la deng dus rten 'brel las kyi rgyu bas mar yul gyi rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyongs ba'i go 'phangs la bzhugs dgos byung stabs rgyal po'i pho brang dngos gzhi slebs mkhar du gdan 'jags par gyur kyang chos sde phan tshun dgon ma lag chos gzhis mi ser khral yongs 'bab sa yul dbang ris sogs la rgya'i 'dzin skyongs tshang mar mgo 'dren gnang khyab sngar las lhag tu gnang ba'i zhal bzhes gtan tshigs bzang po bka' drin che zhing de dang mthun par 'dus sde 470

rnams nas kyang dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rkyen 'byor ldan bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sar gyur gshis rang gzhan don gnyis brlab po che bsgrub pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung /lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che mig gi 'bras bu lta bu gces spras su 'dzin cing / thos bsam bsgom pa'i mdzad bzang nyams pa med pas rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par sgrub brgyud dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs pa mig brgyan la phan pa'i sgrigs lam phun sum tshogs pa zhig shin tu gal po cher 'dug pas so sor thar pa'i bslab gzhi dang po tshangs spyod la sgro bskur dang bral ba zhig med thabs med pas/ nag skyon gyi gleng ngan tsam yod rigs la'ang rtsad gcod mthar phyin ngos bshags bsgrub tshul bzhin bgyid rjes bslab gzhi yang dag bskyar ba dang de bzhin ma byung ba rnams gnas dbyung nyes tshabs che chung bstun pa'i rgyang phud shog thod khyi khram sogs gang 'os stong / de mtshungs sku rdzun sogs byung rigs kyang nyes babs dang bstun pa'i chad sgrub 'gel zhing mgo rengs langs shor du ma song ba dang / grwa shag tu bud med rigs gtan nas zhag sdod bya sa med cing / der ma zad snang ba ma zhus par rgyu 'grul kyang byas mi chog yul bab dang bstun gtan nas bkag cha ma thub rung / chang 'di nyes pa'i rtsa bar song gshis bag med du ma song ba'i tshod zin bya/ gzhan yang tha ma kha 'thung ba/dgon gseb du long 'bod rgyag pa/lus chas ya ma zung byed pa sogs mig brgyan la gnod rigs mngon btsan can gyi spyod pa rnams byas mi chog /gtso bor 'don chos spyod/ rgyud gzhung / blo 'dzin sogs sngar rgyun bzang po gang yin nyams chags med pa dang /dbyangs rol mo dkyil 'khor bri thig /dung rgya gling / gar 'chams gtor bzo sogs shes yongs dang bstun las tshan mgo yod pas bting bskul ngos so sos kyang theg pa khur blang gi sbyang brdar la brtson pa che bskyed dang / blo gsal khyad par ba dag nas legs par sbyar ba sgra yi brda sprod dang / snyan ngag skar rtsis sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la bslab sbyang ngos/ bar ma rab byung / dge tshul/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs sdom pa gsum rim can du rgyud la blangs nas phyi 'dul ba'i bslab gzhi gtso bor ston pa'i chos gos rnam gsum dang mi 'bral ba sogs bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa nang byang chub sems kyi bslab byas rgyud sbyangs nas zhi dul bag yod dang ldan pas gzhan gyi 'dren par 'os pa/gsang ba rang bzhin yongs su shes pa lhag par shes rab kyi bslab pas rang gzhan gyis don gnyis 'grub pa zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos shing / las tshan 'go yod rnams nas kyang nye kha phyogs skyor dang rang 'dod 'khon 'dzin gyi dgra phyogs nag 'ded rigs med pa'i bca' khrims kyi gzhung shing drangs por bsrangs nas lar rgya'i 'dzin gras le shor med pa sogs tshang mas 'dod gcig tu dril nas skyabs 471

mgon 'brug pa rin po che nges pa don gyi skyes bu chen po deng dus sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu gcig pu pa gnyis su med pa rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta chen po gang gi bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su gyur nges/ ji skad du/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i lung don dang 'thun pa zhig mdzad dgos rang gzhan mtha' dag 'di phyi kun tu phan bde dge legs kyi brtsas dam par bgyi 'os snying po las kyang snying po thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbus su gzhar yang g.yel ba med par bste 'os dang /de ltar dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams kyi dam pa chos bzhin gyi bca' khrims gong gsal gyi don ltar 'da' ba med par mdzad pa la dge 'dun pa'i sgo lha 'bangs dbang ris bdag thob rnal 'byor dbang phyug stag tshang ras pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du dge ba'i rgyun chos skyongs ba'i rgyal po chen pos legs par sbyar ba'i mthu dpal la bstan snang chen po dang / blon po dang / dmag dpon/ khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyi rim par sbyar ba'i zhing khang ri klung gi sa yul/ dgon gyi rgya khongs sogs mtha' dag zhib mar deb gsal rgyal po rim can gyis bka' tham lhag tu dpal gdong chu mo bya lor mar yul ljongs kyi 'dzin ma chos bzhin skyongs ba'i rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ skyes mchog gong ma rnams kyi zhabs 'degs/rang nyid bgyid 'os bzang pos phrin las dgongs te slad nas rgyal po rim byon gyis rnam dkar bsngags pa'i phyag seṅge rnam par 'gying ba zhes pa'i re kha gsar 'god kyi thams phud mi bdag gi grangs su spel zin nas tshig gi thog mar bsgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srid zhu nyid du rgyas btab pa'i don la phyi nang kun nas blang dor 'dzol med dang / de bzhin rgyas sras rin po che'i rigs kyi gdung 'tshobs pa gzhon nu tshe dbang 'phrin las bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje gang dpal ldan 'brug pas phrin las kyi byed por rdo rje gsung gi dbang bskur mdzad pa de bzhin gang de mar yul phyogs 'brug bstan 'dzin pa rnams kyi skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal skyin du bzung nas gus pa'i srid zhu mi lhod cing nar son gyi la rgya phyi nang kun la mdzod pas gtsos las byed pa pos le shor du ma song ba dang / sku yi bskyed rdzogs nas kyang rgyal ba'i ring lugs spyi dang bye brag sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la sman pa'i ched du bslab pa gsum ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gos kyi mjes pa zhig kyang snying nas 'dun cing smon lam gyi yul du byas pa yin la/ mdor na 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras yab sras kyi rnam thar ci nus slob pa yi zhan lhog chos kyi rkang pa mos gus chos kyi mgo bo dam tshig chos kyi srog rtsa phyag rgya chen po chos kyi don snying snying rje chos kyi mig 'bras su grags ltar dam pa cho sa snying nas dran pa la med thabs med pa nyid dang / gzhan yang chos bsdus pa'i tshul khrims kyi sgo nas dge ba'i las che phra la 'bad pa 472

nyid dang / chos tshul de rnams mi nyams pa'i ched du dam pa'i chos la chos bzhin du 'du shes te rgyal bstan dbu rmog btsan pa'i bya ba dgos pa ni gzhir bcas gzhan 'jig rten snang shas dang ha cang gi 'brel ba yang mi bya zhing / las rgyu 'bras dpang du gtsug te phan pa dang bde ba dang dge ba'i bya bas dgon grong btsun skye mtha' dag la sman pa'i thabs rang 'khos la dpag pa'i gang 'grub ci nas kyang gal chen snying la bzhag 'os su gsol ba ste/ de la tshul bzhin nyan par mi spyod pa dang / las 'bras blang dor la mi brtson zhing de khyad du gsod pa rnams la ni bdag gi gsar du smrengs ma dgos par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol ba'i dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dang / rdo rje nag po chen po sogs 'jig rten skyongs ba mthu ldan bsgrangs kyi mi spyod pa nyid dang bye brag dang bka' brgyud bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang / dam la btags nas bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol ba'i dam can dregs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / yul phyogs 'di yi dge bsnyen bstan ma mthu bo che rnams kyi mi dge spyod pa rnams la bka' yi chad pa drag pos tshe 'dir mi rung sna dgu dang phyi ma mnar med dmyal mes bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du snying bsregs par gdon mi za la/ gong gsal gyi don las 'bras 'dor len tshul bzhin byas rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems rnams nas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing dam can dregs pa can rnams kyi stong grogs yid bzhin du mdzad pas tshe 'dir skyid la phyi mar bde zhing mthar thugs rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ring po ma yin par thob par nges pas des na de don tshang ma kun nas thugs kyi dpe'ur bste ba 'tshal la/ /de la bdag lta 'khos nus dman yang dge ba'i yid kyi smon lam bzang po ci nus su rgyas btab pa yang kun gyi yid la 'jug par bgyis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa u dum tsa wa ra bzhin/ mtshan tsam thos dka' de bas 'phrad pa ci/ /brgya lam 'phrad pas don che zhugs pa rnams/ /gtan bde thob byed 'di la su mi gus/ /rgyal bstan sde snod gsum gyi snying po yang / /bslab pa gsum yin de yang tshul khrims la/ /ma rten ting 'dzin shes rab thob par dka'/ /de phyir tshul khrims bslab pa ci mi 'bad/ /'dul 'dzin re zung las gzhan phal cher chos gos bgos/ /ji bzhin rngo ma thog kyang 'dul pod klog byas nas/ /sngon gyi rtogs brjod la dmigs cung zad bag yod byedaglu/ /des na de brten da dung cung zad gzugs brnyan yod/ /sngon rabs nā ro mar rngog bla ma bsnyen pa'i ngang tshul gang / /rje btsun mi la rgya ras lo rgod rnams kyis zhen ldog dang / /bsgrub tshugs mos gus rnam thar nyid la cung zad ma sems na/ /nges don sgrub srol 'dzin yin zhes ngos gzugs ji ltar 'gyuraske/ /kye ma da ni snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mtha' la thug pas ci zhig rung / /ji tsam 'bad kyang chos bzhin spyod pa'i dge 'dun nyid ni nyung ngur gnas/ /ston 'jug grang reg ji bzhin chos min spyod pa bkag 473

pas mi khegs rgyas/ /da ni thub bstan nyi ma nub rir yol snyam bdag ni mchi ma bku/ /'jig rten mgon po thub mchog khong ni zhi la gnas min 'og min stug bkod du/ /bzhugs mod khyed bstan mtha' la thug pa'i ngang tshul 'di la thugs rje'i spyan gyi gzigs/ /phyogs dus sangs rgyas sras bcas kun dang bka' yi bsgo nas dus 'dir snying po'i bstan/ /rgya cher rgyas par mdzod ces thugs dam bskul lo yol med dus 'dir 'phrin las mdzod/ /kye ma bdag lta nyon mongs tshang tshing dbus gnas gzhan la de lta smra/ /de yang dam pa'i rnam thar min mod lhag bsam dag pas skyon yang med/ /ting 'dzin mngon shes ji bzhin ma thob bstan la sems kyang gzhan phan dka'/ /da ni lang tsho yol nye dben pa'i ri la rtse gcig bsgom re ran/ /'on kyang theg chen smon pa tsam la'ang rgyal bas ches cher bsngags mdzad na/ /bdag gi smon pa 'di'o de yang gegs med nyid du 'grub byin brlabs/ /sa yi phyogs 'dir thub bstan snying po 'dzin pa'i sde dpungs 'thug por bkod/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen par byed la na ro pa dang zhi sbas bzhin/ /kun kyang ngur smrig gos 'dzin nye bar 'khor zhing tshul khrims bslab la spyod/ /gang gi sems kyi rgyud kyang zhi dul lcang shes byams dang snying rje khengs/ /rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang ji bzhin dam pa'i chos la mchog tu dung / /rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen par byed la nā ro pa dang zhi sbas bzhin/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa 'ba' zhig dag gi kun tu khengs bar shog /mi dang mi min gdug pa'i sems ldan kun kyang bdag ming thos pas zhi/ /log sred can yang bdag ming thos pa'i mod la byang chub sems skye zhing / /phan tshun kun kyang mdza' bar blta nas dga' bde'i dpal la longs su spyod/ /nad mtshon mu ge kun nyams rdzogs ldan bzang po'i dus bzhin legs spyod shog /gang zhig mi dge mtshams med sdom gsum nyams chags zhig ral spyod pa kun/ /sdig gyur pham ltung nyes pa'i skyon kun skad cig der zad bdag tshangs gang / /bdag ming thos tsam gyis ste 'gro kun phyir mi ldog pa'i sa mchog thob/ /kun nas kun tu bzang po ji bzhin 'bras bu mchog la myur 'khod shog /mdor na bdag gi sngon gyis tshe rabs nas tsam da lta'i bar dag tu/ /byang chub sems kyis yongs bzung theg pa chen po'i smon lam ji tsam pa/ /de kun yongs zlum mkha' khyab sems can rnams la bsngo bar bgyid bzhin pa/ /thun mong nyid gyur phyam gcig tshom bu gcig gyur rdo rje sems thob shog /ces rje btsun 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa nges pa don gyi 'gro ba'i mgon po pa rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta'i zhabs gang gi bstan pa rin po cher lhag pa'i bsam pa zla ba nor bu chu shel gyi snying po ltar mchog tu dkar bas mar yul ljongs kyi sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la sman par byed pa'i bkod gdams kyi yi ge rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel gyi lo mgo chen gyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum par shar phyogs bod chen du skyes pa yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu chos smra ba'i khur ldan dpal rig pa 'dzin pas mar yul stod waṃ le bde chen rnam rgyal nas bris pa sarba maṅga lo/ dza ya dza yaskyo/ 474

༄ga /klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gis dkyil 'khor lha mtshan gsal bar zes pa ke ta ka yi thig so lta bu bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki ni bh+yaḥ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i me long zhes bya ba/ gdod nas rnam par dag pa ye shes dkyil 'khor spros dang bral| /mi 'gyur bde la 'khor lor longs spyod 'gro kun rgyud la rtag par gnas/ /gzugs brnyan las 'das gzugs brnyan rab shar rjes btags brda' yi tshul//dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi 'gro rnams rtag bsrung mdzod/ /gsang sngags thabs kyi khyab par las/ /bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i dngos//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bkod pa gang //cung zad 'di ru bkod par bya/ /de yang dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba sa yi cho ga dang bcas te de la bzhengs zin pa sngon du 'gro ba la dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dngos thig skud byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /thig gdab pa dang dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / mtshon byin gyis brlabs pa dang / mtshon bkye ba dang / lha mtshan bkod pa dang / lhag chad gso nas byin gyi brlabs pa dang bdun las/'dir phral mkho lha gnas lha mtshan bri ba dang /mtshon gyi kha dog bstan par bya la/lhag ma gzhan rnams ni spyi dang mthun zhing logs su bshad par 'dod do/ /de la dang po bri ba ni/ bsgrub khog lasak+ṣi/ de nas bri ba'i rim pa ni: sa bon chos 'byung thod phreng bskor: de rgyab pad+ma 'dab bzhi dang :rtsibs brgyad thod phreng rim bzhin bskor: zhes pa ltar dbus bskum por bskor ba'i nang nas chos 'byung zur gsum du bcad pa'i ngos gsum la zla gam rang grub tu yongs shing / de yi phyi rim mu khyud la thod skam gyi ra ba bya/ de yi phyi rim me tog pad+ma 'dab bzhi rtse rno rtsibs kyi rnam pa can/ de yi phyi rim mu khyud la thod pa'i phreng ba gong lta bu/ de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad thod ra dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /de la mtshon gyi rim pa ni/ bsgrub khog las/ de yang dbus su chos 'byung dmar: zla gam gsum po mthing nag la: 'dab bzhi phyogs mtshon mchan bzhi mthing ཿོ rtsibs brgyad phyogs mtshon rtsibs mchan dmar: phyi nang mu khyud thod phreng sogs: sgo rdzogs yan chad thams cad ni: rig pas dpag ste spyi mthun bya: zhes pa ltar gzhan rnams rtogs sla zhing 'dab bzhi phyogs mtshon ni/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / 'dab bzhi rtse nyung byas pa'i mtshams mthing ka/ pad+ma de dag gi ngo bo ni rin po che las grub pa sra zhing 'khregs pa yin la/ rtsibs brgyad phyogs mtshon zhes pa ni/ phyogs bzhi gong gi pad+ma dang 'dra zhing /mtshams bzhi ni shar lhor dkar ser 'dres pa/lho nub dmar ser 'dres/nub byang dmar ljang 'dres 475

paspyo/ byang shar ljang dkar 'dres pa ste de rnams kyang sgo mtshams kyi phyed mar bsgos pa ltar ma yin pa mdog nges pa 'dres pa'o/ /rtsibs mchan dmar po dang phyi nang gi thod pa'i ra ba rnams ni kha dog dkar pos khyab pa lha stegs phyi rol brtsigs pa'i nang mtshon pa sgo dang bcas pa ni phyogs mdog tu bya'o / /da ni lha mtshan bkod par bya ba ni/ sku yongs su rdzogs par bri na mngon rtogs gzhung bzhin bkod pas khyab cing / gzhan du phyag mtshan lta bur bkod na dbus su thod khrag las gnas pa'i gri gug rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i yu ba can/ yu ba'i lte bar trīḥ dang rtse mor rta mgos mtshan pa/ gri thod gi steng gi ngos su rdo rje dmar po'i lte bar r+ghaṃḥ smug dang ma dkar gyi mtshan pa/ phyi rim gyi 'dab bzhi shar du thod pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje raḥ haḥ yi mtshan pa dkar po/ lho ru thod pa la gnas pa'i rin po che tsaḥ ri yi mtshan pa ser po/ nub tu thod pa la gnas pa'i pad+ma hri niḥ yi mtshan pa dmar po/ byang du thod pa la gnas pa'i rgya gram yaḥ sa mtshan pa ljang khu/ de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad du/ shar du rdo rje dang dril bu/ lho ru rin chen dang me long / nub tu pad+ma dang glegs bam/ byang du ral gri dang zhags pa ste de rnams phyogs mdogashar lho kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dang nyi ma dmar ser/ lho nub tu rdo rje dang thod pa dmar smug nub byang du rdo rje dang lhung bzed ser ljang / byang shar du ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsi'i bum pa ljang dkar rnams so/ /phyi rol gyi sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu rnams phyogs mdog rim par bri zhing / steng 'og gi sgor gri gug dang phur pa mthing ka dmar smug go/ /gru chad bzhi la mtshams ma thig le kha dog phyed pa can dang —/ mtshon par thig le brtsegs ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i brda' rtags su bkod/gong gi de rnams phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor ste thig ler bkod na gtso bo'i gnas phyag mtshan dang /lhag ma gzhan rnams thig le gong gi kha dog dang bstun zhing yab yum gyi mtshon don brtsegs mar bri'o/ /thig le che chung gi tshad ni gtso bo nyis 'gyur dang / phyogs rnams mthun dang / lhag ma gzhan rnams snyoms par lag len mkhas shing yid gzhungs par rigs sngags bzlas bzhin bri'o/ /'on kyang dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa lha yi mngon par rtogs pa gsal byed dang bcas pa gzhan du 'chad par 'dod kyi zhib mor der rtogs par byos shig de skad klong gsal ḍā ki snying thig gi/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri la 'phral mkho lag len gnad/ /lha mtshan rim pas gsal bar phyes pa 'di/ /don gnyer mchog gi skyes bu'i bskul phyir smras/ /chos nyid gnyug ma dmigs bsam blo yi yul las rab 'das kyang / /rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad ye shes rol par 'char/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug du ma gcig bral dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /brda' thabs cha tsam brjod 'dis dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor 'khar la ya/ /'bri thabs lha gnas mtshon tsam smras pa 'di yang / rgyal ba 476

karma pa yi phrin las kyi mnga' bdag chen po rje btsun dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhal snga nas gang gi gsung gi bskul ba la brten te kong yul ro nyi ta yi rlung 'gram dur khrod chen po pad+ma rtsegs par mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang por rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i so//dge'o//dge'o/dge'o/thug /bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma 'byung ba bla med kyi dkyil chog bdag 'jug gi rdzas tho bzhugs/o swasti/ na maḥ ta ra ya/ bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma 'byung ba bla med kyi dkyil chog bdag 'jug gi rdzas tho la/ thog mar rdo rje dril bu ḍa ma ru nang mchod me tog maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi yi yo byad mngon par 'du byas nas bye brag zhag dang po la gtor snod gcig tu me tog bdug spos dang bcas pa'i gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba sa lha'i mchod gtor/ nyer spyod/ maṇ+ḍal/ mchod pa'i chas/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa nyer spyod nyung dkar phur pa rnams sogs/ zhag gnyis pa la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / dkyil 'khor mchod pa nyer spyod/ maṇ+ḍal/ mchod chas/ sa gzhir lha gnas tshom bu dang mchod gtor/ de yi dbang ldan du/ sa lha'i tshom bu dang mchod gtor/ rjes kyi mchod pa/ bum pa sta gon ched du bum pa'i yo byad rnams 'tshogs pa dang / slob ma sta gon gyi chas so shing / khyor chu/ bsrung skud ku sha rnams so/ /nub gsum pa thig tshon/ de yi mchod gtor/ thig chas/ bum pa bsgrub par bum pa drug bum stegs/ mchod pa dang /gtor ma/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris zin tshe byur gsal ba'i chas zhi drug gi sbyang ba rnams so/ /nyin gsum pa la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed rgya che ba/ gos zung /mchod pa'i gtor ma gsum mam bzhi/ rig pa'i me tog rnams so/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i rdzas dngos laske/ slob ma la chas zhugs gsum mig dar dang me tog bgegs bskrad pa'i yung dkar dam tshig gi chu/ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas/ mig thur rdo rje/ lha ngo ston pa rdo rje'i dbyug gu /dngos gzhi slob ma'i dbang la dbang po dman pa rjes 'dzin rig pa gtad pa'i dbang rdzas me tog gi phreng ba/ rig pa'i bum pa/rin po che'i phreng ba'am dar ras kyi cod paṇa me tog sil ma rnams so/ /dbang 'bring rjes 'dzin bum dbang dngos kyi rdzas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga yi bum chu'i snod thod pa dbu brgyan/ rdo rje dril bu/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu/ mthar bstan/ mig thur me long / mda' gzhu/ las bzhi'i bum pa'i de yi dod gang rigs / rdo rje'i 'jul shugs kyi rdo rje/ gri gug thod khrag cang te'u ut+pal rtse gsum/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lung bstan pa'i slad du chos gos/ rdo rje dril rgya gram su byas pa rnams so/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzas/ rdo rje dril 477

buske/tsagli/ bsgrang phreng / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ rgyan drug sna tshogs rdo rje ma las bzhi'i bum pa/ grub pa brgyad kyi gzugs brten/ sgrol ma'i tsagli/brtan byed bum pa'i chu dang dam tshig gi rgyu/ dri shu la rnams so//de nas bum pa'i dbang grub/ de nas dbang rab rjes 'dzin zab mo'i dbang gsang dbang la/ mig dar chu sogs thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga dang dam tshig gsum/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes rigs lnga dang dam tshig gsum sogs gang 'dra rig ma'i gzugs brtan rnams so/ /dbang bzhi pa la tshig kho nas ste/ rjes kyi maṇ+ḍal bkra shis kyi me tog rnams so/ /de ltar dbang dman dbang 'bri/dbang rab gsum gyi dbang la nyi ma gsum du byas pas nyi ma drug tu 'gyur zhing nyi ma tha ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba ste dbang bskur nyi ma bdun du grags pa'i rgyu mtshan yang don de ltar yin no/ /de ltar sgrol ma 'byung ba bla med kyi dbang bskur ba'i rdzas tho 'di yang kong yul mthil rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang gi bya 'dabs 'brug chos lding du sa ga zla ba'i tshes lnga yi nyin thun bar cig tu spel ba sarba maṅga lo/༄ga /dus 'khor byis 'jug gi dbang rdzas tho yod/bde mchog nag po'i lugs kyi rdzas tho/oṃ swaste sir+ghaṃ/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo de yang dbang bskur gyi sdom pa ye shes rgya mtsho las/ 'jug pa'i dgongs pa ltar tshigs su bcad pa/ slob dpon slob ma yongs brtag gsol btab mchod/ /dus nges sa gzhi brtag sogs sngon btang nas/ /dngos gzhi sa chog dang ni lhag gnas dang / /dkyil 'khor 'bri dang dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / /dbang gi bya ba dngos dang rjes chog ste/ /don bsdus drug gi dbang bskur cho ga grub/ /zhes brjod pa'i don ltar sa bcad gang dang gang du go don du bzhag pa rnams spyir btang rdzas dgos pa rnams dmigs su gsal te so so'i thad du bshad par bya na/ thog mar gsol gdab tu mchod par gsol gdab la maṇ+ḍal 'bru dang bcas pa so shing sta gon gyi skabs su 'byung bzhin pa dang dri bzang gi chu'o/ /mchod pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / bsrung ma drug bcu'i rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma nges pa'o/ /dngos gzhi dang po spyi btang gi rdzas rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams nges par bshams shing cang te'u dang gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag mchod pa'i yo byad bris sku la sogs dgram pa'i yo byad kyang tshogs par bya/ de nas dngos gzhi dang po sa chog la rgyud sde spyi nas gsung pa'i sngon 'gro gtor ma 478

bcog zlum gcig rgyud de'i lugs kyi yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis bsgrags tshar gnyis/ bsrung 'khor gyi mthar bsrung ma drug cu la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma bdun nam gcig sa lha la gcig gzhan zlum gtor bzang po gnyis/ gzhan yang dri bzang gi chu dang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkod pa'i me tog shing thal/ yungs dkar gu gul/ phur pa bcu/ mchod pa bcu gnyis tshar ci 'os 'dang ba bkra shis brjod pa'i me tog rnams te/ nyi ma dang po'i yo byad do/ /gnyis pa lhag par gnas pa la bzhi ste/dang po dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa la dri bzang gi chu dang me tog sil ma/ chu bzhi sogs mchod pa'i yo byad/ spos dang / dkyil 'khor dang bsrung ma drug cu sgos kyi chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma rnams kyang tshang bar bya zhing / shis brjod kyi me tog dang bcas pa'oglu/ /gnyis pa rdzas rnams lhag par gnas pa la/ bum pa bshams pa'i stegs bu dang gdan/ bum pa bcu / dung chos bcu gcig bzung thag dang bcas pa bum pa la so so'i mtshan (ma )'bri ba'am 'dog pa—/ bum pa'i rdzas mtha' dag pa dang lnga tshan lnga ni spyir btang ba'i rdzas ste de rnams tshags su tshud par byaske/thig skud la thig skud kha dog drug pa dang rdul tshon la rdul tshon kha dog drug rdo rje ni rdo rje tshad dang ldan pa de bzhin dril bu tshad ldan te rdzas lnga ka re re la mchod pa bcu gnyis tshar re re dang bcas ma long na mchod pa cig kha bso/ gsum pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa la/ mchod pa nyer spyod lnga/ u dum wa ra sogs 'o ma can gyi shing las skyes pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa srub chags med cing drang ba ma gas pa pags pa ma bshus cing rma med pa dri bzang chus 'grus shing mgor me tog gi phreng ba bcing / so shing dor ba'i gnas ba byung rnam lnga'i byug pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ gru bzhi dri bzang gi chu bdud rtsi lnga bcas sbyar ba/ ku sha che chung gnyis/ lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i bsrung skud dmar po rnams so/ /bzhi pa mal stan lhag par gnas pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba ste de ltar lha gnas bdun ni dkyil 'khor lha gnas bcas pa ste nyi ma gnyis pa'i bya ba'o/ /bar 'dir bsrung 'khor bsgom pa dang mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma brgya phrag sogs ci nus btang ba dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ldan pas rkang pa bcu drug pa dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa ci nus su bzla bar gsung bas de rnams kyi mchod pa dang gtor ma yang tshogs par bya'o/ /spyi don gsum pa dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ni/ thig skud dang / skam thig gi rdul dang mchod pa bcu gnyis byas bcas nyi ma gsum pa'i bya ba'o/ /nyi ma bzhi pa la rdul tshon bkye ba ste/ rdul tshon dang mchod pa bcu gnyis dang sa lha'i gtor ma rnams te thig dang rdul tshon gyi nyi ma 'di gnyis la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ci 'grub bya bar gsung bas de tshe de yi yo byad yang tshogs par bya'o/ /spyi don bzhi pa bsgrub cing mchod pa la bum pa so sor bkram/ nya phyi'i ze snod du bdud rtsi ril bu sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs 479

pa rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du 'dog dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams su ba byung dang dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal kha dog lnga yi ba dan/ sa rgyan/ gnam rgyan/ gos zung / mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas shing gong du bshad bzhin—/ sngon 'gro dang bsrung 'khor gyi rjes kyi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor ma chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma ma tshang ba med pa bshams/ de bzhin chu bzhi bzed zhal maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa sogs gang la gang dgos rnams dang / skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed par gsung bas de tshe de yi yo byad kyang tshogs par byaske/ spyi don lnga pa dbang bskur ba'i yo byad ni/ khrus chu/ maṇ+ḍal/ so shing / khyor chu/ bdud rtsi/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje/ ye shes dbab pa'i rdzas/ lnga tshan gnyis dang sbyar ba'i spos/ me tog gdong g.yog gos ser po/ dung chu/ sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i me tog mig thur de rnams dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yo byed do/ /dngos gzhi rdo rje maṇ+ḍal/ chu dbang la mchod pa bcu gnyis/ bum pa'i chu/ shis brjod kyi me tog cod paṇa la/ dbu rgyan dung chu/ yang rdo rje maṇ+ḍal dar dpyangs la/ dar dpyangs dung chu/ rdo rje dril laske/ rdo rje dang dung chu'o/ /yang rdo rje maṇ+ḍal/ brtul zhugs la sor gdub dang me tog sil ma/ ming la rkang lag 'jor bar gdub bu'am me tog phreng ba dang dung chu'o/ /yang rdo rje maṇ+ḍal rjes gnang la/ dung chu sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khor lo dang / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan no/ /de'i rjes 'brel rjes gnang / spyi khyab kyi rdzas 'khor lo/ dung / spo ste/ dril bu dang / bzlas lung gi rdzas/ bsgrang phreng / byin rlabs kyi lung byin par me tog gi mig thur rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me long mda' gzhu/ rdo dril gyi dam tshig byin/ rtsa ltung bsgrags/lung bstan par chos gos dang bcas pa'i rdo dril/ dbugs dbyung ba la gdugs/ gzengs bstod pa la chos 'khor dang lha yi dag pa/ des byis 'jug kha bskang dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa'o/ /maṅga lo/oṃ susti/ na mo gu ru shrī tsakra sam+bha ra ya/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog spyod 'chang dbang po'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor dbang gi rdzas tho la/ dang po gsol gdab la maṇ+ḍal zhi drag sbyangs ba/ sdig sbyang til me chu/ bsrung skud/ bkra shis pa'i me tog de nas sa lha gnas pa la nang mchod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/nyer spyod sa lha'i tshom bu/ mchod gtor/ nye spyod/ yungs kar/ rol mo/ 'byor na phur bu lnga'am bcu/ tho ba bcas ma 'byor na yid kyi mos pas kyang chog phung po dngos su yod na yungs kar/ gu gul/ me tog dang mgul chings dmar po/ dri bzang gi byug pa/ gang ltar phur pa'i lha la mchod pa'i rdzas rnams so/ /de nas lha slob sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ nyer spyod/ ras bris la brten na skabs 'dir sa chog byed de yo byad gong gi ltar ro/ /bye brag lha lhag gnas la/ bsrung 'khor/ phur ba'i lha la mchod pa nye spyod/ lha gnas rdul thig skam chas/ lha chen rgyu dri bzang khrag chen sbyar ba/ ras bris yod na dri bzang gi tshom bu me tog gang ltar mchod gtor gsum bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen sbyar ba'i spos/ slob ma sta gon la/ bgegs sbyang 480

ba gsum/ sdig sbyangs til/ gnas gsum byin rlabs rdzas/ khrag chen gnyis dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyar nang mchodaglu/ nye spyod/ bsrung skud/ khyor chu/ so shing / ku sha/ de nas gzugs brnyan 'bri bar/ dri bzang / thig skud—/ rdul tshon/ de la nye spyod/ gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor du bsgrub mchod la dkyil 'khor bgegs sbyang ba gsum sdig sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad/ slob dpon gyi chas zhugs/ bum pa la/ bum pa bcu'am gnyis las mi nyung ba lha tshan bum gos/ gzungs thag kha rgyan/ dung zhal/ gzungs thag rdo rje mchod pa/ gtor ma/ bum pa'i steng du thod bza' bcas gang ba'i thod pa/ mchod pa la/ mchod rdzas ji snyedaske/ gos zung / sbyin bsreg dang tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad/ gtor ma gnyis dang gzhan yang spyi gtor sogs ji 'byor ba de rnams so/ /dbang rdzas la sbyangs ba gnyis/ til/ me tog bdud rtsi/ dkyil 'khor du phyag 'tshal skabs rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan/ dam bzhag rgyan drug shis brjod kyi me tog cod pan gyi me tog bum pa dbu rgyan/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dar dpyangs/ gri gug 'khor lo sogs phyan du ma/ dril bu/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu/ brtul shugs kyi rdzas/ thun mong rdo rje/ thun min cang te'u/ thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ tshangs skud/ chu gnyis bcas pa'i nyer spyod/ mthar brtan la/ mchod rdzas/mig thur/ me long / 'khor/ dung / rdo dril/ chos gos te bum pa'i dbang rdzas so/ /gsang dbang la rig ma dang bcas pa'i tshogs mchod/ bdud rtsi/ mig dar/ dbang rdzas thod pa bdud rtsi/ sher dbang la/ mig dar rig ma'i gzugs brnyan nam/ dril bu/ dbang bzhi pa/ 481

༄ga /klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi cha lag gi bskub pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med rdo rje rgya mdud kyi bdag mdun bskyod bzlas bdag 'jug bcas kyi cho ga khrigs chags su bkod pa bzhugs so/ /mi shig mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu'i sku: 'chi med tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig cha lag las/ /tshe sgrub 'chi med rdo rje rgya mdud kyi/ /bdag bskyed bsnyen zhing mdun bskyed bum pa bsgrub/ /bdag 'jug blangs pa'i chog 'grig chu 'babs su/ /gsal bar bkod de dang po bdag bsnyen ni/ /de yang thog mar rang nyid dben pa'i gnas: yar tshes gza' skar bzang la mtshams bsdam ste: smra bcad bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas kyang : dang po skyabs sems yan lag 'bul ba ni: na mo 'chi med tshe yi lha la skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don tshe bsgrub bya: 'chi med lha tshogs 'dir gshegs spyi gtsug bzhugs: gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul:mi dge'i tshogs bshags dge la rjes yi rang : bla med chos 'khor mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge ba 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: de nas dngos gzhi bsgom bzlas rim pa ni: chos rnams dmigs med stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : sems can kun la khyab pa'i snying rje bsgom: de yi ngang las pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : bdag nyid rta mgrin gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu: pad+ma dmar po nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng :tshe dpag med mchog byu ru'i mdog 'chang zhing : dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan daskyil krung bzhugs:'od zer bye ba dgu khri mnyam bzhag steng : rin chen sna bdun bum pa bdud rtsis bkang : dgos 'byung dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can: pang du yum mchog gos dkar dmar mdangs can: phyag g.yas pad 'phreng yab kyi mgul na 'khyud: g.yon pas tshe bum yab kyi snyan thad 'dzin: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med 'od dpung 'bar: ma yengs ka dag rang mdangs lham mer gsal: de yi phyogs bzhir tshe yi lha mo bzhi: g.yas su dkar mo g.yon du ser mo dang : mdun du sngon mo rgyab tu ljang mo rnams: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnam par bsgoms: gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng :trīḥ dmar mtha' mar sngags 'phreng bskor bar bskyed:trīḥ las 'od 'phros bde chen pho brang nas:ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig gnyis med bstem: trīḥ mi 'gyur 'chi med bde chen klong yangs nas: 482

mi shig rdo rje lta bu'i tshe dpag med: rigs bzhi mgyogs ma tshe yi dngos grub bdag: gnas 'dir gshegs la bdag mdun dkyil 'khor bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang mchod yon gsang ba bla na med: rang byung rtsa brgyad steng sbyar bdud rtsi mchog: nyon mongs dug lnga bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang : ro drug bcud ldan gtor ma tshe yi 'brang : 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ gu ru ā yu tshwa na rdu r+ghaṃ dṛḥ dza sirnyi pha la rgyuḥ a ma ra ni rdzu wan ta ye ṭ+wā hā:badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā ju puṣ+pe dhuṣ+pe a lo ke ghadhe ne+e wi bya shari pra tī dza aḥ r+ghaṃ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba lo ta rdu trī thā ya: rang byung 'od gsal lhun grub rgyal ba'i sku: 'gyur med rdo rje lta bu khyod la bstod: 'gag med rol pa chen po rgyal ba'i gsung : tshangs dbyangs dri med don dam gsung la bstod: sgrib med khyab brdal chen po ka dag ngang : bde stong 'khrul med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas tshe 'dzab bzla ba'i dmigs pa ni: spyi gtsug tshe dpag thugs ka'i trīḥ yig dang : bum pa dang ni yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pa yi: bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems: lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin 'byung lnga yi: dwangs ma'i bcud dang lha klu mi yi srog: dz+raḥ aḥmador na 'khor 'das tshe bsod dpal dang grags: thams cad yang yang tshe dpag bum par bsdu:yang ni lha mo rnams kyi bum pa las: 'od 'phros phyi nang snod bcud 'byung ba'i bcud: thams cad bsdus te rang rang bum pa bkang : bum pa rnams nas gtso bo'i bum par byos: tshe yi bdud rtsi chil chil khol ba dang : thal mo snying khar sbyar la rtse gcig gsol ba btab: trīḥ lhag pa'i lha mchog tshe dbang rdo rje'i sku: phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad kyi: 'chi med snying po bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus nas: bdag la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub 455: zhes pas gsol ba btab pas skad cig gis: 'dod pa ltar du gnang bar 'gyur ba ste: tshe yi bum nas 'chi med ye shes kyi: bdud rtsi 'o ma ltar du ngang nar babs: yab yum sbyor mtshams dwangs ma dkar dmar du: bab par shes pa gtad de rang nyid kyi: kha yi nang dang tshang bug mar byung bsam: dmigs pa gsal bas mchil ma mid par bya: spyi bo gsang gnas bar du khengs par bsam: de ltar theb gsum rjes su bdud rtsi'i zer: ba spu'i bu ga dag nas phyogs bcur 'phros: skye 'gro snod bcud dang bcas 'od zhu nas: a dkar dz+raḥljang bkrag mer mer gang nas: 'od zer 'ub 'ub ba spu'i bu gar 'dus: snying ga'i dz+raḥ la thim pas rang nyid ni: bkrag mdangs 'chi med rdo rje'i skur gyur bsam: gsang ba tshe yi yang snying zab pa'i gnad: bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig dril sngags 'di bzlas: oṃ gu ru ā yu dzñā na r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ dz+raḥ dzaḥ sid dhi pha la rgyuḥ a ma ra ni dz+re wan ti ye swā hāḥ 'bum tsho gsum gyi tshe dpag med mgon 'grub: rjes la 483

zhag rer brgya rtsa chag med bzloḥ tshe yi dngos grub thob par gdon mi za: dmigs pa 'phro 'du gsal ba gal che zhing : skabs su gsol btab rig pa gsal ngar bskyed: de ltar 'bad pa'i rtags kyi rim pa ni: nyi zla shar dang phyag mtshan rdo rje brnyed: mkhar brtsigs mchod rten tshwa tshwa gzhengs pa mthong ཿོrol mo sgrag dang bdud rtsi 'thung ba dang : lo tog ston bsdud 'bru la longs spyod byed: go cha gyon sogs rtags mtshan dpag med 'byung : dngos nyams rmi lam dag tu zhal yang mjal: gdams pa gsung ba la sogs 'byung bar 'gyur: de ltar sngags bzlas thun mtshams thams cad du: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po dang bcas rjes: mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ji rigs byas nas kyang : rjes kyi don ni tshe yi lha mo bzhi: tshe dpag la thim de yang rang nyid kyi: spyi bo'i gtsug nas mar thim snying khar byon: ngo bo tshe dpag med la rnam pa ni: 'chi med bdud rtsis bdag lus ldem gyis gang : yang na rang lus gser gyi rdo rjer bsam: spros med bde chen ngang du phyams kyi klod: gnyis pa mdun bskyed dang bum pa dbyer med gcig dril du bsgrub pa ni/ gnas dus gong dang mthun pa la/ maṇ+ḍal dmar po mda' gang legs par gzhengs pa'i steng du tshom bu lnga bkod la/ de'i dbus su rkang gsum mkhar rin po che'i bum pa g.ya' med mtshan ldan gcig gu gul dud pas bdug yungs kar gyi thun brab cing bgegs bskrad la/ de nas nang du chu gtsang bum rdzas nyer lngar bcas kyis sum gnyis bkang / kha rgyan gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa bshams/ de'i shar du rdo rje dang me long / lho ru tshe ril/ nub tu tshe gtor tshe sha tshe chang / byang du tshe mda' dmar po/ gzhan yang tsa ka li mig dar sogs gang 'kho bshams/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa'i gzhan la dbang bskur dang mi 'brel zhing dkyus kyi bdag 'jug kho na tsam dang / spros pa chung na/ bsgrub bum mdun du gtor ma'i ngo bo tshe ril dang / de yi g.yas su bdud rtsi tshe chang / g.yon rak+ta'i ngo bo chu gtsang ma rnams dang / mda' dar tsam gyi chog la/ de ltar rgyas bsdus gang ltar kyang / mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i bye brag gang 'byor bshams par bya'o/ /de nas skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa bdag bskyed 'dzab bsnyen sngon du song nas/ oṃ badz+ra a skṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ oṃ swā bhā wa shurnyoḥ sarba dharma su bha wa shurnyo3haṃḥ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs srog gi sa bon trīḥ yig dmar po las yi ge r+ghaṃ rmogacig spros pas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su babs/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos pañtsa li kas mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan pa/ nang du lha rdzas kyi chu dang / 484

bcud nyi shu rtsa lngas yongs su gang ba/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi rgyan rta bab la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trīḥ las bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog byu ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan pa'i nang du 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ sku stod la dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' klubs shing / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sen mo do/ do shal/ sku reg tshangs skud sogs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa 'ja' tshon ltar gsal ba'i pang du yum gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar gsal phyag g.yas pad+ma'i phreng ba yab kyi mgul na mkhyud cing g.yon pas tshe bum yab kyi snyan thad du 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis med 'od phung 'bar ba'i/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lho ru rat+na tshe dpag med/ nub tu bud+dha tshe dpag med/ byang du karma tshe dpag med/kun kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing rang rang gi yum dang 'khril ba/ tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs lnga de dag gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trīḥ yig dmar po'i mthar sngags 'phreng gi g.yas su bskor bar bsam/ de dag gi phyi rim du tshe yi lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi sgo ma bzhi sogs mdor na rig 'dzin drang srong tshe la dbang ba rnams dang / gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi lo zla zhag dus kyi lha klu gza' skar dang bcas pas sgrub pa po la che'i dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul du bzhugs par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ trīḥ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ r+ghaṃ hriḥ mi 'gyur 'chi med bde chen klong yangs nas: mi shig rdo rje lta bu'i tshe dpag med: rigs bzhi mgyogs ma tshe yi dngos grub bdag: gnas 'dir gshegs la bdag mdun dkyil 'khor bzhugs: dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa la gnyis su med par gyur: slar yang thugs ka'i trīḥ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang mchod yon gsang ba bla na med: rang byung rtsa brgyad stong 485

sbyar bdud rtsi mchog: nyon mongs dug lnga bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang : ro drug bcud ldan gtor ma tshe yi 'brang : 'chi med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ gu ru ā yu dzñā na r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ dz+raḥ dzaḥ sid dhi pha la hūṃḥ a ma ra ni dz+re wan te ye ṭ+wā hāḥ ar+ghaṃ pā ju puṣ+pe dhuṣ+pe a lo ke ghadhe nai wi bya shabhā pra tī dza aḥr+ghaṃḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha lin+ta rgyu trīḥ thaḥ yāḥ rang byung 'od gsal lhun grub rgyal ba'i sku:'gyur med rdo rje lta bu khyod la bstod: 'gag med rol pa chen po rgyal ba'i gsung : tshangs dbyangs dri med don dam gsung la bstod: sgrib med khyab brdal chen po ka dag ngang : bde stong 'khrul med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas pa ni/ bdag nyid rta mgrin gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gzungs thag la brgyud nas song bas mdun bskyed bum pa'i lha'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la phog pas thugs dam kyi rgyud bskul lha'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin brlabs dang thugs rje dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rang bzhin du spyan drangs bum nang gi lha tshogs rnams la thim pas yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur par bsam zhing bzla ba ni/ oṃ gu ru ā yu dzñā na rgyu rgyu dz+raḥ dza sid dhi pha la hūṃḥ a ma ra ni dzi wan te ye swā hāḥ zhes pa brgya stong khri 'bum sogs ci nus su bzlas rjes yig brgya ak+ṣa lnga bcu/ rten 'brel snying po rnams brjod nas/ mchod bstod ci rig pa bya'o/ /de nas mda' dar g.yab cing tshe bskul ni/ hūṃ hriḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po longs spyod rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: gsang ba thugs kyi ga'u nas: snying po thugs kyi ā yu stsol: bdag cag rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: mgyogs ma tshe yi lha mo bzhi: dkar ser dmar mthing ljang ba'i mdog: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: khug gcig rdo rje'i tshe khug cig: sgo srung lha mo phyag rgya bzhi: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: mgyogs ma tshe bdag tshe khug cig: mi 'gyur snying po rdo rje'i tshe: rigs kyi bdag po'i tshe yang thob: spros pas khams gsum bkrag mdangs ldanoḥ bsdus pas thugs srog dz+raḥ la thim: mi 'gyur g.yung drung rdo rje 'bar: bdag cag rnams la tshe dbang bskur: ces pas skabs su bskul zhing / bskul tshar nas tshe bstem zhing sba ba ni/ hūṃ trīḥ rigs lnga bde gshegs tshe dpag med:nyon mongs gsal dag ye shes ngang : tshe 'dir bstem mo bsod nams dpal spyod cig: mi'u rnams la bkra shis shogoḥ 'byung ba lnga yi bdag nyid yum: 'byung bzhi'i khams nas tshe nyams na: yum chen lnga yi dpal spyod cig: skal ldan rnams kyi sgo gsum la: tshe dpag med mgon rigs lnga yi: sku gsung 486

thugs kyi rgyas thob la: bla tshe nyams pa sor chud cig: pad+ma 'khor lo rin chen dang : rdo rje rgya gram phyag rgya las: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rgyas thob cig: 'byung ba tshe srog dpal spyod la: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas: skye 'chi med pa'i don rtogs shog: oṃ āḥ rdu a ma ra ni dz+re wadhe badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā: zhes bstem zhing 'dzab sngags 'di yang ci nus su bzlas pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshe bcud tshe lha zhi khro thams cad dang lha dang drang srong klu dbang 'gro ba mi yi srog dz+raḥ nam mkha' nyi zla 'byung ba'i bcud thams cad bdag dang bum pa la sib thim/ yang 'od du me re re 'dus/ ba spu'i bu ga la sib thim skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku thob pa'i gdengs bskyed/ de ltar 'bad pas nges par thob pa kyang 'gyur ro/ /mthar thun bzhag pa'i skabs su/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bum pa gang ba'i dbus su lha tshogs rnams 'od kyi skur bzhugs par bsam mo/ /gsum pa bdag 'jug blangs pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni dbang mchog dkyus su 'byung bzhin dang / rgyun khyer nyams len snying po'i gnad bcud dril bstan pa ni 'di lta ste/ rang nyid skad cig gi mdun du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la tshe bdag rigs lnga yab yum bcu/sems dpa' sems ma yab bcu drug: khro bo sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba la/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad maṇ+ḍal du 'bul/ sa gzhi spos kyi byugs shing me tog bkramabyu/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yis//'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal pu r+pā tsa me gha sa mun+t+ra spa ra na sa ma ye āḥr+ghaṃ/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mechi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /khyed kyi mkhyen brtse ye shes kyi/ /bdag sogs mos pa'i bu rnams la/ /dgongs pa myur du gtad nas kyang / /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i sku dang pad+ma'i gsung / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang dag thugs/ /rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin te/ /sgo gsum smin par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ rigs lnga yab yum gyi phyag gi bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur mchog rang bzhin rdo rje che/ khams gsum ma lus kun tu phyag byas pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba'i bdag la stsal du 487

gsol/ /ji ltar bltam pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kun gyi dbang bskur ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur ro/ /o na maḥ sarba ta tha ga ta a gi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃ/ oṃ gu ru ā yu dzñā na r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ dz+raḥ dza sid snyi hā la r+ghaṃ a ma ra ni dzi wan te ye swā hā/ a gi ṣiñtsa rdu ā/ zhes brjod la bsgrub pa'i bum pa rang gi spyi bor blangs/ lha mo rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pa ju puṣ+pe dhu pe a lo ke ghadhe nai wibya shari pra ti dza āḥ hūṃ/ sgo ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ tra noḥ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nu ta ra dharmā ka ye ma ṇi badz+ra karmā ka ro bh+yaḥ wa shirnyi kro ta ra dza: khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad/ sarba bigha ni ta krita hūṃ phaṭa: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can snying la gnas/ /sems can ma lus rang bzhin mchog gyur pa/ /spyod byed kyis bskyid bde 'byung ji lta bu/ /deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog gi bkra shis shog /su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/bum pa'i bdud rtsi spyi bo nas zhugs par bsam la lce thog tu myang / de lta bu'i tshul gyi dbang bskur ba'i bum pa bdud rtsi chu rgyun des/ smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/rgyan dang cha lugs kyi dag pa dran par bya/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ 'khor lo lnga yi dag pa dran par bya/ snying kha yan chad gang / yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ skye mched drug gi dag pa dran par bya/ rkang mthil yan chad gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas 'od dpag med pas dbu rgyan par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i tshe bdag rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim pas gzhom pa med pa don dam pa'i tshe rang rig zab gsal spros bral bde ba chen po'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag bdag 'jug skyar ldab len na 'di yan ci nus bsags/ gang ltar grub mthar dam tshig bzung zhing / maṇ+ḍal dang lus 'bul ba bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi mtha' legs par brgyan no/ /tshul de la nar mar 'bad na sdig sgrib zhi sngags sdom dag bsod nams rgyas tshe ring rga bas mi gzir ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye zhing / mdor na 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi/ mthun rkyen mtha' dag 'phel/ tshe dbang rgya chen mchog gi rig 'dzin myur du thob pa sogs gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pas nan tan du bya'o/ /gzhan la tshe dbang rim pa bgyid dgos kyang skabs 'dir bzhugs te cho ga dkyus bzhin nyid do/ /gang ltar mthar bum par bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang gzhan yang mgron thabs su bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyongs bsrung ma sprin gyi phung po gtib pa lta bu mdun gyi nam mkhar mos pas gsal btab ste/ mchod pa rnams kha gso/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ dang nam mkha' 488

mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs te btang rag tshul du mchod cing bstod par bya/ de yang / hūṃ mchod yon brgyad dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun: 'dod yon lnga ldan phyi yi mchod pa 'buloḥ lha mo lnga dang glu gar sman rag gtor: sbyor sgrol dug lnga nang gi mchod pa 'bul: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dga' bzhi bde stong gsal: ye shes lnga ldan gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ gu ru ā yu dzñā na r+ghaṃ rgyu dz+ra: dzaḥsid dhi pha la hūṃ a ma ra ṇi dzi wadhe ye swā hā/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ sarba pu tsa rat+na gu ṇa karma sa ma ye r+ghaṃ/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha lin+ta rgyu trīḥtha ya/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha/ /rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes so/ /de nas nyes pa'i tshogs bzod par gsol ba ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yi ni/ /bgyid pa dang ni bgyid rtsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /yig brgya tshar gsum brjod/ de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod pa/ /dngos grub bla na med pa'ang stsol/ /slar yang gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra muḥ zhes so/ /de yang ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig bsdu bar dam 'ga' yi gzhed kyang sngags bla med spyi dang bye brag skabs 'dir mgron thabs las/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dam ye dbyer med rang gi snying kar bsdu ba dran mchog mgon po'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thig pa lta bu shin tu gces pa'i gdams pa'o/ /de mthar rdo rje dang bcas mda' dar g.yab cing / oṃ sku yi sku ste sku la thim/ /phung po lnga la rab tu thim/ /aḥ gsung gi gsung de gsung la thim/ /ljags kyi dbang po 'amachog la thim/ /r+ghaṃḥ thugs kyi thugs kyi ste thugs la bstem/ /rang byung ye shes thugs la thim/ /nyin mo bkra shis mtshan bkra shis/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis pa/ /skal ldan rnams la bkra shis shog /snying po nyi zla gsal gyur cig /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ dzha na r+ghaṃ he/ zhes bdud rtsi myang / dngos grub tshe yi rdzas gzhan rnams kyang rim pas longs spyod/ de nas thal sbyar me tog bzung zhing / oṃ 'grub par gyur cig rdo rje'i sku ni skye 'chi bral/ /tshangs pa'i gsung ni 'gag med rtag pa rdo rje'i gsung / /spros bral thugs ni dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i thugs/ /'chi med sku gsung thugs dang yang dag ldan pa yi/ /rnga sgra'i rgyal ba 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'grub gyur te/ /bdag cag tshe dang bsgrub pa mthar phyin nas/ ri/rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don la spyod par shog /ces smon lam rdo rje'i tshig lan gsum brjod/ gzhan rtag tu kha thon byas kyang byin brlabs shin tu che ba'o/ /gzhan yang bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya zhing / dkyil 'khor rjes kyi bya ba rnams gsang ba spyi yi cho ga dang mthun par bya'o/ /de ltar 'chi med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /mngon du bsgrod pa rdo rje gsum rang bzhin/ /bsnyen ci 489

pa bdag bskyed bsgrub pa mdun bskyed dang / /las sbyor byin rlabs bdag 'jug rim pa mchog /'khrul med o rgyan rgyal pa'i dgongs gsang bcud/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi bum bzang las 'ong bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skal ldan skyes bu'i 'dod 'jo 'di na rmad/ /tshul 'dir bdag mos zhugs spyod dge tshogs yang / /'od dpag med zhal dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa bkang ba ched kho nar/ /yongs su bsngo ba'i nus pa ci snyed des/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun bcom nas/ /dga' chen mi 'gyur bde ba'i zil mngar gang / /legs myong phun tshogs 'od dpag med ji bzhin/ /ring min nyid thob des kyang mgon dgyes shog /ces tshe dpag med 'chi med rdo rje rgya mdud kyi bdag mdun bskyed bzlas bdag 'jug dang bcas pa'i cho ga khrigs su dran mchog mgon po rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa gang gi zhal snga nas bdag 'jug gi bkra shis brjod pa yan mdzad pa'i 'phro cung zad lhag mar gyur pa'i kha skongs ni/ mgon de'i chos las skyes pa'i sras kyi thu bor dbang bskur zhing phyi nang gi rigs pa'i gnas la blo gros kyi snang ba yang pod spyod pa ri kha ba can gyi phyogs kun tu kaḥthog sprul skur brjod pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje dpal 'bar gyi chu phag gi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes dga' ba dang po la tshangs pa rgyas pa'i bu ro hi ta yi klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram kong yul sa yi thig le 'od kyi dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs par bkod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /badz+ra ā yu ṣe sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo swā hā/ 490

༄ga /dus 'khor brjed byang /oṃ swāste/ dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas man ngag rdzogs rim/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gnad kyi ngo sprod/ /brjod byang tsam cig 'di ru bkod bya/ /gzhan phan rgya mtsho rgyas par gyur cig /g.yas dang g.yas min srog gi rgyu ba/ /a wa dhu tir dag pa'i rang gzugs/ /rtags bcu'i rnal par shar bar gyur ba/ /rnal 'byor can gyi lam du bya'o/ /g.yas rlung sa chu me rlung nam mkha'/ /re re la yang lnga lngar phyes pas/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid du grub ste/ /de tshul 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ /sa rlung lnga la du ba lngar 'gyur/ /ser dkar dmar nag mthing ljang 'char la de bzhin chu la rmig rgyu lnga 'gyur/ /me la me khyer lnga dang rlung la/ /mar me kha dog lnga'am drug ste/ /nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha' lngar snang / /g.yon gyi rlung lnga dbu mar 'gags pas/ /sa rlung gi ni 'bar ba lnga dang / /chu yi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan lngar snang / /me de bzhin la nyi ma lnga dang / /rlung la sgra gcan gzugs 'dra lngar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' la ni thig le lnga dang / /'dus pas thig le chen po lnga 'gyur/ /de ltar g.yas g.yon dkyil 'khor bcu la/ /nang tshan lnga tshan lngar phyes lnga bcu/ /dbu mar dag tshul cha tsam brjod pa'o/ /'di ni rnam 'dren mkhyen rab dbang phyug /si tu mchog gi ring nas gsung dang / /nye bar bal yul sa yi dbang phyug /rgyal ba rab gsal dag gis bskul bzhin/ /dzo ki ha ri nā thas smras so/ / gag /yig med snyan rgyud man ngag tshe'i sgrub pa'i rgyun khyer ngag 'don zab pa'i yang snying bzhugs so/ / na mo r+ghaṃ/ 'chi med tshe yi lha la skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don tshe sgrub bya/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul zhing / /sdig bshags yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rgyal ba bzhugs gsol dge tshogs byang chub bsngo/ /oṃ ma hā shu r+sā ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rol pa'i trīḥ 'od zer 'bar g.yo rgyun gyi dngos snang sbyangs/ /snang srid 'od zhu 'ja' thig bkra ba yi/ /zhing khams rdul kun bral dang dwangs ma'i klong / /rgyu las pha lam rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /chos bdun ldan ster nyi zla'i ga'u dbus/ /stong ldan ge sar ze'u 'brur gsal byed steng / /trīḥ 491

las gsung gi rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon tshe yi bdag /dmar 'tsher zhi ba'i zhal gcig spyan dkyus ring / /shangs mtho zhal 'dzum lta bas mchog mi shes/ /phyag/ gnyis mnyam bzhag mthil na rin chen bdun/ /las grub bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /yongs khengs kha brgyan bskal pa shing gi brgyan/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje lta bu'i skyil dkrung bzhugs/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad ma lus yongs su rdzogs/ /pang du bde byin dmar ser gur gum mdog /mda' dar tshe bum yab stobs gnyis med 'khyud/ /gnyis ka'ang rin thang bral ba'i nor bu dang / /rus pa'i rgyan spras dar gyi chas lnga rdzogs/ /yab yum spyi gtsug rta phag zhal ljang nag /i ha r+ghaṃ phaṭa dze sgras snod bcud g.yo/ /rngog ze me 'bar bar chad gdon bgegs bsreg /yab yum 'ja' 'od zer thig me klong gsal/ /de yi spyi bor yas rim mtho brtsegs tshul/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma pad+ma bde chen nyid/ /pad+ma nor bu gar dbang gter bzhad snying / /mtsho rgyal pad 'byung tshe dpag med yab yum/ kun bzang yab yum gzi brjid 'od 'bar bsgom/ /brgyud pa'i bla mar rtse gcig gsol btab pas/ /thugs las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi/ /tshe bsod srog lus rlung rta dbang thang bcud/ /ma lus lcags kyus bkug nas bla mar thim/ /sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus kyi/ /'khor lo drug po 'chi med dwangs mas khengs/ /'pho bral tshe dbang rig 'dzin mchog grub bsam/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ trīḥ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sikhyi r+ghaṃ pusbyi dzñā na a yu sidhi r+ghaṃ dzaḥ de nyid ngag bcad dmigs pa gsal bar bzlas/ /yang na bsnyen bsgrub las gsum chig dril du/ oṃ gu ru a yu dzñā na r+ghaṃ rgyu dz+ra dzaḥ sirnyi pha la hūṃ/ a ma ra ṇi dzi wen+ta ye swā hā/ mthar ni brgyud pa'i bla ma 'od zhu nas/ /tshangs bug nas byon thugs ka'i trīḥ la thim/ /'chi med dwangs ma'i 'od mdangs rab tu mtsher/ /gzhom bral rdo rje'i sku ru gyur par bsam/ /thun bsdus tshe dpag yab yum yang / /thugs ka'i trīḥ ra thim trīḥ yang 'ja' ltar yal/ /skye 'gags gnas bral rang byung rig pa'i gshis/ /ka dag khyab brdal lhun grub ngang du bzhag /e ma tshe sgrub snyan brgyud yang zab bcud/ /pad 'byung mkha' la gter bzhad nyi 'od kyi/ /bdag snying pad+mo 'dzum byas bag chags de/ /rjes dran bdud rtsi zil mngar 'di na 'gyed/ /bka' dkrug lung rkus tsho dang 'di mi 'dra/ /mi shes grags 'dod che brtsam do zla min/ /bla ma lha yi byin rlabs cung zhugs mthus/ /gzhung mthun man ngag legs par bshad pa yin/ /'on kyang nyes tshogs mchis na bla ma lhar/ /legs bshad 'di phyi'i sgrib tshogs sbyang du gsol/ /legs pa'i dge bas khams gsum 'gro ba kun/ /bde chen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces tshe sgrub sa bya zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bzang bco brgyad la bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 492

༄ga /yang zab dkon mchog sbyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur bklags chog tu bkod pa gu ru'i dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas tshe bdag 'od dpag med/ /'jig
