rten dbang phyug rgyal pa rgya mtsho'i gter/ /kun 'dus bla ma nor bu pad+ma 'byung / /de la btud de dbang chog 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir bla ma'i sgrub thabs thams cad kyi snying khu yongs zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshul la/ yongs zab rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa las/ dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu bskur: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi: rdzas bshams bdag gzhan dbang blangs na: byin brlabs myur 'bebs smin grol 'gyur: dbang gi le'u gsum pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bshams dang / dngos gzhi bsgrubs shing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po yo byad bshams ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad la 'od lnga'i mu khyud dang rdo rje'i 'phreng ba me ri'i bskor zhing lte bar nyi zla rdo rje thod pa'am/ trīḥ yig thig le gang bde bkod la/ de tsam ma lcog na 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus kyi stegs bur lnga tshan bdun gyi bkangs pa'i bum pa rgyan ldan bshams pa'i mtha' skor du dbang rdzas thod pa bdud rtsi/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka shel rdo bsgrub skor glegs bam/gter bsrung gi gtor ma rnams dang gzhan yang mchod gtor sman raka nyer spyod phyi nang gi mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas bshams shing / slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum rdor dril ḍā ru 'thor nas rnams kyang 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub shing dbang bskur ba ni/ de yang gter gzhung las/ rang la dbang len pa dang gzhan la sbyin pa sogs thams cad la mtshams gcod bsrung 'khor skyabs 'gro nas las gzhung tshogs dang bcas pa sgrub bskul brtson par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog ma skyabs sems nas btsam te bzlas pa'i bar rtsa ba'i las byang bzhin bdag mdun byam cig tu sgrus nas bzlas pa ci nus mthar gu ru drag po dang seng gdong ma'i gtor 'bul bzlas pa yang ci rig pa bya la las bum yang rdor sems 'am rta mgrin lta bu bskyed la sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs phud phul/bska5 ba bya/ grub nas 'og tu slob ma la bya ba bzhin ting 'dzin gsal pos bdag 'jug legs par blang ngo / /de ltar bdag 'jug blang ba ni spyir sngags sdom gso ba'i yan lag du nges par dgos gal che bas slob mar dbang bskur skabs kho na tsam ma yin par tshes bcu sogs dus bzang khyad par can 493

rnams su nges par ji nus blang ba yin la/ 'di yi gter gzhung rtsa bar bdag gzhan dbang blang na:zhes dang / rang la dbang len pa dang gzhan la byin pa zhes gsungs pa don 'di gsal bar bstan pa yang yin no/ /de nas slob pa rnams khrus nas phyung bgegs la gtor ma byin te bka' bsgo mtshams bcad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu rnams byas la slob dpon gyi 'di skad/ ces brjod de 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de yi ched du yang zab bla ma'i sgrub thabs dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bskur zhu snyam pa'i rtog pa bsdus te yid rtse gcig mos pa brtan pos bsan par zhu/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des gdul bya'i blo dang mtshams par thar pa'i 'jug sgo dam pa'i chos tshul ji snyed gsung pa la mchog tu gyur pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ de yang spyir byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo rmad du byung zhing khyad par dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso mchog bde bar gshegs pa yongs su 'dus pa'i ngo bo chig dril lam zab mo bla ma'i sgrub pa kho na yin la/ de yang / bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las: lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa bsoḥ bla ma gcig pu sgom pa mchog: ces dang : rgyud chen dra ba las/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi rje: rgyal ba'i man ngag gsang chen rnams: ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas: gtso ru bla ma rdor 'dzin sgom: ces dang : sangs rgyas 'dus pa las: gang gi gdul bya'i yid bzhin du: bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs brtsams te: de nyid don du sus gnyer ba: theg chen bla ma'i sa yin no: kun gyi bdag nyid chen por 'gyur: ces gsungs: nam mkha' che'i rgyud las: tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs snying po yi: don rtog 'dod na bla ma sgrub: ces sogs lung 'byams klas par 'byung ba bzhin bla ma'i sgrub thabs ni mchog dang gtso bor gyur pa ste/ de yi sgrub thabs kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa las 'dir rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen rtse nus gsum cig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs gdod ma nyid nas chos sku kun tu bzang por mngon par byang chub pa nyid pad+ma rnam par bkod pa'i zhing du 'od snang dpag med gangs can mtsho sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang thugs rje'i gdul zhing 'byams klas par sprul pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las mi 'jed 'jig rten 'dir yang bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong la dbang bskur nas lung ston par byed pa po sangs rgyas nus ldan rdo rjer gyur zhing bskal bzang sangs rgyas re re bzhin de yi phrin las mtha' dag gi byed po rgyal ba'i bstan la ston pa gnyis pa lta bur rtag tu sprul bzhin bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la yang srid pa gsum dang 'dzam gling 'gro ba rnams la rgyal ba nyid dang rnam dbyer med pa'i 'phrin las bzhi'i 494

sems can gyi don mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu rin po che lta bu'i gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs te/ rgyal ba de nyid la gangs can gyi rje 'bangs skal ldan las can rnams kyi gsol ba btab par brten zab rgyas kyi chos tshul ji snyed gsungs shing snyigs ma'i don du zab mo'i gter du btsas par mdzad pa las/ 'di ni gter ston chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'am las 'phro gling pas byang rkong rngod ham 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mo nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi skor te/ de yang gter ston nyid nas rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang mchog gi rgyud pa bar ma chad drin can bla ma dam pa'i bar rim par brgyud pa dang / de bzhin rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes sgro brag ban ri pad 'od nas bton pa'i bla sgrub pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi byin rlabs yang rje bla mas gsan pa 'di dang tshig don phal cher mtshungs pa'i phyir chu bo chig 'dres su yang 'gyur zhing / bla ma dam pa de thams cad kyi thugs nyams su bstar zhing byin brlabs kyi chu rgyun chen po ma nub par gnas pa lags/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ gter gzhung las/ e ma hoḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus dam chos yongs snying 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus: theg pa'i yongs rtse rtsod med a ti che: rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sems can sgrol ba'i chos: zhes dang / myang ban gyi zhu lan las kyang rtsod ldan snyigs dus kyi ngang tshul mang du gsung ba'i mthar sdug bsngal de rnams las skyobs pa'i thabs ni kho bo pad+ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad de yi tshe shugs che bas sa steng chos kyi bkang yod pa yang de rnams la dgongs pa yin: khyad par thugs sgrub kun gyi yad gsang dkon mchog spyi 'dus 'di yang myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i sprul pa cig gis snyed nas dus ngan gyi sems can 'ga' zhig la phan par yong : chos 'di zhal phyes pa tsam gyi mtha' dmag phyir bsring nus: sa phyogs der yang lo phyugs legs pa dang rlung 'tshub chung dad 'dun byed pa'i dud 'gro yan chad bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'gro'o: gzhan yang zab gter 'di nyid byin rlabs kyi so ma nyams par dad ldan rnams la dbang lung ston pa na dus mtha'i skye 'gro rnams yid bzhin nor bu snyed pa las kyang 'tshengs che'o:der ma zad 'di nyid 'chang ba dang mchod bstod bsngags pa brjod cing snyan pa thos pa tsam yang bde bar gshegs pa'i sras dam par 'gyur ro: las sgrib thams cad dung dkar phyis pa ltar 'gyur ro:tshogs gnyis kyi bya ba skar tshogs rgyas par ltar 'gyur ro: rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs 'jigs pa brgyad las grol bar 'gyur ro: mdze la sogs pa'i rnam smin gyi nad thams cad srab cing byang ba dang : gcong nad zhwa grum dang mig nad la sogs pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro+oḥ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i 'byor pa drug ldan du 'gyur zhing : bu 'dod pa yang rigs rgyud 'phral du 'phel 495

bar 'gyur ro: mos tshul bzhi'i dbang dang ldan zhing lha srin sde brgyad dpung dang bcas pa'ang phyi bzhin 'brang ba dang bka' nyan par 'gyur ro: tshe zad pa dang nyams pa yang gso nus shing blo gros mi zad pa dang : shes rab phyogs med du 'bar bar 'gyur ro: drag po'i las thams cad 'phral du 'grub shing : dus kyi 'chi ba yang bar do rang ngo rang shes shing bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur: chos 'di la the tshom dang : yon tan 'byung bar mi rigs par blta ba kun kyang thugs rjes zin te las ngan myong rjes su lam sna thar pa la sbyor bar 'gyur ro: des na bsgrub mchod bsgom pa 'di ci smos: zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ thugs bsgrub gzhan las kyang / nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub: nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong : nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin: zhes pa'i don bzhin bla bsgrub thams cad kyi rtsa ba kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song / khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rang re rnams kyi gnas 'di tha mal pa ma yin pa dag pa'i zhing khams 'og min pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen po dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi spyi dpal ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar dngos su gsal ba la/ mi tshad dad pa'i gdung shugs chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ e ma hoḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus bla ma ni: rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog: dpa' bo chen pos rjes su bzungs: dbang gis smin grol dngos grub stsol: lan gsum brjod de/ gnang ba sbyin cing dam la bzhag pa ni/ de ltar yin na te ru ka'i:dal du su zhugs smin par bya'o: bla med yang gsang byin rlabs 'di: gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du:dam med pa la smra mi rung : de phyir snying nas bro bor cig: zhes rdo rje spyi bor bzhag snying khar reg la/badz+ra rak+ṣa si r+ghaṃ sa ma ya i rda na ra kan: zhes rjes zlos kyi slob mas bro bor ro/ /de nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar dbyer med pa la 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas mngon sum du bzhugs pa la skyabs su 'gro zhing nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod par bya/ de'i ched du yang zab bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing bsgrub par bya snyams pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o: rgyud drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: bzod med gdungs pas sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: kun 496

kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum dang / yan lag bdun pa ni/ skyabs yul de rnams kyi spyan sngar thabs khyad par can yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags par bya snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ chos rnams thams cad sku gsum rang bzhin a: gnyis med klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: ma bcos mtha' bral mnyam pa nyid kyis mchodoḥ rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig ngang du yi rang ngo : 'dzin med khyab gdal rol pa'i chos 'khor bskor: 'khor 'das dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: chos dbyings lhun grub chen por bsngo bar bya: zung 'jug kun kyang bde chen mchog thob shog: zhes lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa ni slob ma la las bum gyis chus bsangs gtor la/ oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ: oṃ ma hā shu r+sā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ: bdag gzhan dngos 'dzin gyi rtog pa mtha' dag stong pa de las skad gcig gis pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gdan la/khyed rang rnams rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo lhug par gnas pa de nyid ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar du snang ba'i tshig 'di'i gsal btab bzhin du sgom cig trī: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems bzo med 'di: dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum rin chen brgyan: pad zhwa rgod ldem kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon nas 'khril: phod ka chos gos za 'og ber phyam can: mtshan dpe rab rgyas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mjes: mnyam nyid bde chen 'khyil ba'i skyil krung bzhugs: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: gsal stong thugs rje'i 'od zer kun la snyom: mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin rnam mang 'khrigs pa'i dbus: sku yi sprul pas zhing khams yongs la khyab: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs pa med: bde gshegs kun gyi bkod pa sku la rdzogs:kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zang thal la: bgegs dang bar chad zhes bya'i ming yang med: snang stong sgyu ma tsam du gsal bar bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par ā:thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ slob dpon dang dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi nam mkha'i khams khengs dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus shing lus pa med par spyan drangs/ de thams cad gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par 'od zer dang bcas shing / de yang sku'i byin rlabs thams cad pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru dang til 'bru tsam/ gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad rgya yig 'bru ā li kā li yig bod yid la sogs kha dog sna tshogs dang / thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje'i dril bu dang / pad+ma rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug tho la sogs pa steng 'og bar gsum the mer ne mer til gyi gang bu ltar gang zhing nyi zer gyi rdul 'khrigs 497

pa ltar 'byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos 'dun drag po mdzod cig trīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub cing : byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: bsgrub mchog bdag lo dbang cig bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃḥ.a we sha ya a aḥ zhes ye shes phab pa'i rtags ma byung bar bskyar nas 'beb/ spro na gar khrab dbyangs dang bcas te bya'o/ /mthar tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra kyi rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag nas brtan par bya'o/ /de ltar ye shes dbab pa ni shin tu gal che ba dbang gi rtsa ba la/ rdzas dbang phal che de brten byed du bsgrub pa yin/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi zhu bar skabs phyed pa'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bzhug la/ dbang bzhi rim pas bskul ba yi dang po bum pa'i dbang la/ de yang bskur mkhan gyi bla ma ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku'i bdag nyid/ bskur ba'i gnas ni khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul ni/bla ma'i smin mtshams kyi oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po skar mda' chad pa ltar 'phros/ khyed rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus snang stong pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa byed pa rtsa ba dang / de mtshon byed du rdzas kyi rnam pa bum pa 'di yang phyi bum pa mtshan nyid kun tshang / nang dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas khyed rang rnams kyi dri ma 'khrud cing dbang bskur thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig ces brda sprad la bum pa thog te/ trīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che: byin rlabs klong yangs rang bzhin 'bar: oṃ āḥ rgyu/ sku yi smin mtshams oṃ dkar las: 'od zer skar mda' chad pa ltar: skal ldan bu la gnyis med thim: bum dbang thob nas snang stong bsgom: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: kā ya a gi ṣañtsa oṃ: zhes bum pas dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin/ de yang gter gzhung rtsa bar rdzas dbang bum pa dang / yang 'grel du gu ru'i sku 'bag gsungs pa yang 'dams so can du shes so/ /de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba non/ 'bras bu sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ lam dus bskyed rim ma hā yo ga'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ /zhes don ngo sprad/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ bskur ba po bla ma ni pad+ma 'byung gnas longs spyod rdzogs skur shes pas/ bskur ba'i gnas khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa/ ji ltar 498

bskur ba'i tshul ni/ gu ru'i ljags steng gi āḥ dmar po las 'od zer dmar po mar me'i rtse mo lta bu byung / khyed rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag grags stong gu ru pad+ma'i gsung dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa byed pa rtsa ba dang / mtshon byed du rdzas kyi rnam pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'di yang bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ka yum ye shes mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa dang snyoms par bzhugs pa'i bde sgra dang 'od zer gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs sku'i rtsa gnas rnams rgyud/ rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu dkar dmar byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mkha' gsang las babs/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro cig pa oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ gis byin gyis brlabs pa de lce steng du myong bas dbang bskur thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig byas la thod pa'i bdud rtsi thogs te/ trīḥdakon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdagoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che: byin rlabs klong yangs rang bzhin 'bar: oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ gsung gi ljags steng āḥdamar las: 'od zer mar me'i rtse mo ltar: skal ldan lce la gnyis med thim: gsang dbang thob nas ngag rlung bsgom: pad+ma 'byung gnas gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥ hūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ:wak+ka a sgyi ṣiñtsa a: zhes bdud rtsi byin pa myong / de ltar gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros non/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ lam dus rdzogs rim a nu yo ga ste rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ /zhes don ngo sprad/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ dbang bskur ba po bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas chos sku spros bral gyi bdag nyid can du nges pa/ bskur ba'i gnas khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul ni/ gu ru'i thugs ka'i hūṃ yig sngon po las 'od zer sngon po spos reng gi du ba lta bu byung / khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas yid gsal stong pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa rtsa ba dang /mtshon byed kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'di yang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar shes nas 'dod chags chen po bzhi yongs su bskyed de yas brtan dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar byed pa'i dbang bskur thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig ces brda' sprad nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ka thogs la/ trīḥ dkon mchog spyi 'dus rigs kyi bdag: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs mchog rin po che: byin rlabs klong yangs rang bzhin 'bar: oṃ āḥ rgyu thugs kyi rgyu sngon 'od 'bar las: 'od zer spos reng du ba ltar: skal ldan sems la gnyis med thim: sher ye dbang thob gsal stong bsgom: pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥ hūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: tsit+ta a gi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ zhes kha ṭ+wāṃ ka snying dkar nag mtshams su gtad de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob yid kyi sgrib pa dag sa bcu pa 499

chos kyi sprin non/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ lam dus su a ti yo ga ste byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ /zhes dbang don ngo sprad/ bzhi pa ni/ de yang dbang bskur ba po bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid can/bskur ba'i gnas lnga ni khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba sogs gnas lnga/ ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul gu ru'i lte ba la sogs gnas lnga nas 'od zer chu la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu byung / khyed rang gi gnas de dag tu thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob par mos pa rtsa ba dang /mtshon byed kyi rdzas kyi rnam pa shel rdo 'di yi brda la brten nas ngo sprad pas brda' don thabs shes zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes tshig las 'das pa chos kyi sku ru ngo shes par byed pa dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs su thob par byas byung snyam pa'i mos 'dun mdzod cig zhes brda' sprad la shel rdo thogs la/ trīḥdakon mchog sku gsung thugs yon tan: 'phrin las 'dus pa'i 'od zer ni: nam mkha' chu la 'ja' shar bzhin: skal ldan gnas lngar gnyis med thim: dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs chen bsgom: pad+ma 'byung gnas rang bzhin dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥ hūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: sarba dharma a gi ṣiñtsa ho: 'di mtshon byed rdzas kyang yang 'brel las shel dang rdo rje thod pa gsum la brten nas ngo sprad par gsungs/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag thob bya bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa dang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ lam dus su a ti yang gsang rdo rje snying po rdzogs chen bya rtsol bral ba'i don ka dag lhun grub kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang ba'o/ /zhes don sprad/dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i rgyab brten du srog phur gyi le'u 'don gsungs pa ni 'di ltar ste: de nas pad+ma'i srog phur bstan: sems nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas te: logs nas sgom dang bsgrub du med:rang sems gsal la ma 'gags pa: rang byung rang shar cir yang snang : zhi ba tshe dpag med du snang : 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su snang : khro rgyal dbang chen rta mgrin snang : zhal dang phyag ni spyir yang snang : de dag sems kyi cho 'phrul yin: rang byung rang shar rang sar grol: ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku: ma 'gags rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs: rig rtsal 'gag med sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rang chas ma sgrub 'grub: rang nyid ye nas pad 'byung yin: srog phur le'u lnga pa'o: zhes pa ni dbang bskur thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa ste/ de yang pad+ma'i srog phur zhes pa'i mtshan don ni/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar snang ba de'i snying po bzhin rig pa rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i ngo bo rtag brtan g.yung drung chen po 'khor 'das thams kyi srog tu gnas pa/ de rang ngo tshul bzhin shes pas glo bur bag chags kyi dri ma sangs nas tshogs brgyad gnas 'gyur te bral 'bras chos sku 500

mngon du byed pa ste/ de yi lam gsum bral bzhi cha chos kyi sku dang gdangs dgongs pa shar grol chen po zab gsal bde ba dbyer med gnad du phur ba don gyi mthar thug 'di kho na'o/ /zhes pa yin pa yang shes par bya'o/ /de nas lnga pa mtha' rten rdo rje slobatshodapon bdag po'i dbang ngam/ 'chad dbang ni/ pu ste lung sbyin du grags pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa ste/ glegs bam mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil la a li bcu drug gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ka li so bzhis mtshan pa ste nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor/ de yi dbus su r+ghaṃ dkar po la yang snying badz+ra gu ru'i bskor ba de dag las 'od zer 'phros chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don thams cad badz+ra gu ru dang a li ka li'i rnam par spyan drangs thim par gyur/ badz+ra gu ru dbyangs gsal dang brtan byed yig brgya rten 'brel snying po brjod de/ me tog gtor bas nyi zla a k+ṣa badz+ra gu ru rnams 'od du zhu glegs bam du gyur/ de nas glegs bam thogs la/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo pad+ma 'byung :zab gter thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu 'di: las can rnams la bsgrub bshad ston nas kyang : ma 'ongs don ldan 'gro kun grol bar shog: oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: zhes dang / a li ka li yig brgya rten 'brel snying po brjod cing / gnas gsum dbang bskur nas lag par gtad/ dbugs dbyung ba gzeng bstod pa dang / dung 'bud pa/ dar 'phyar ba sogs/ dngos sam yid kyi sgo nas slob ma'i ngo skal dang mtshams par bsgrub po/ de nas drug pa gter bsrung mkha' 'gro'i srog gtad ni/mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma seng gdong mar bskyed bstem mchod bstod byas nas/ r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig seng gdong ma: nam mkha'i mdog can 'od zer sprul pa 'gyed: mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis ye shes bskyed: skal ldan bu la lus dang grib ma'i tshul: mi 'bral byin rlabs 'phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ḍa ki sing ha mu kha a gi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: gzhan yang phyi nang gi gter bsrung kun gyi skal ldan 'di la bsrung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sbed par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gtor ma gnas gsum lag par gtad pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de nas bdun pa lta ba'i rtsal dbang ni/ dbang gzhung las/gud du sbas pa slar tshig dbang rin po ches don gyi ngo bo bstan pa zhes gsung ste/ des na 'di bskur yul slob ma sngon 'gro thun mong thun min gyi rgyud sbyangs shing sems rnal dbab sor gzhug gi myong ba rjes mthun skyes pa la 'di ston par dgongs nas slar zhes pa'i tshig nus des ston pa yin gyi/ dbang bskur tshul rgyas pa phyag bzhes kyi rtogs dgos la/ 'dir rtsa ba gter gzhung ltar bkod pa ste/ slob mas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ye shes dbab ste/ bu yi snying kar yi ge dkar po sran ma tsam/ ye shes kyi 'od lnga 'phro ba'i stobs kyi lus nam mkhar yod pa bsgom/ bla mas thod rnga sgrog cing / a ni skye ba 501

med pa las: lus ni ye shes lnga yi lus: nam mkha'i klong las rang gsal 'bar: lus med nyams kyi rang ngo ltos: zhes brjod pas nyams skye'o: de nas slob bu rnam snang chos bdun byed du bcug ste/ lta stangs dang rig pa nam mkhar gtod cig byas la/ bu khyod sems kyi ngo bo ltos: ltas pas mi mthong ngang du zhogoḥ khyod kyi rig pa phyogs bzhir thong : btang tshe phyi nang 'gro 'ong med: 'gro bar snyams yang rang gi sems: sems ni ngos bzung 'dzin pa bral: ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal: bu khyod 'di yi rang zhal ltos: 'di zhes mtshan mar ma grub kyang : de don rtogs na rtsal dbang ste: tshe gcig mthar lam bgrod par gyur: rgyas par 'dod na srog phur le'u bshad par bya'o: 'di ni gud du sbas pas sgrub pa nges par byed pa ma gtogs gzhan la mi bskur dam par bya: zhes gsungs pa de rnams tshig na yam ma yin par bla ma myongs ldan gyi slob ma'i rgyud la ngo 'phrod par gdams pa yin gyi/ don des gong gi tshig dbang skabs srog phur le'u 'don zhes pa dang / 'di bshad zhes pa tshig nus che chung 'dir ji bzhin pa go ba tsam du ma zad myong thog tu gtan la phab cing ye shes bskyed par byed pa'i ched du zhib mor bshad zhes pa'i don yin no/ /de ltar 'chad dbang / bsrung ma'i gtor dbang / rig pu'i rtsal dbang rnams go rim bzhin nus pa dang / bsrung ba dang / spel ba'i dbang ste skal ba dang nges pa ldan pa la byin par bya'o/ /de nas rjes dbang gi dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ de ltar yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang bzhi mtha' brten dang bcas pa legs par grub/ de yang chos thams cad kyi rtse mo gsang sngags de yi mthar thug rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de yang gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba ni dbang /dbang gi rtsa ba ni dam tshig dam tshig de yang rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa gsang sngags nang pa spyi ltar dang / bye brag snying por gyur pa bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun pa dang / de yi mtshon byed du gu ru'i sku 'bag sgrub thabs kyi glegs bam rnams mi 'bral bar bcangs ba tshes bcu'i mchod pa la brtson pa la sogs bla ma'i sgrub pa la 'bad 'tshal/ de ltar dam tshig phra rags thams cad nyams pa med par bsrung snyams pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /dang gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang : cha shas yang ni spyad du gsol: lus 'bul/bsod nams 'di yis sogs dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing / lhag chog sogs rjes kyi bya ba las byang bzhin bya'o/ /deng 'dir smras pa/ zab mo'i chos 'di gangs can ri bo'i khongs/ /ris med mtha' grur rlung bzhin grags gyur zhing / /mchog dman du mas chog khrig mang mdzad na/ /bdag ltas ngal ba bskyed pas ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang dbang bskur rab dbye brda' don gnad/ /ma 502

shes rdzas tsam kho na yul yul pos/ /byang chub nye lam rtsa ba smin byed dbang / /'grub par nus min de bas thar 'dod kun/ /nan tan chen pos dbang la brtson par rig /des na yongs 'dzin mgon gyi dgongs bskangs slad/ /dbang mchog ma nor ji bzhin legs bshad 'di/ /mgon po nyid kyi mthu las bdag gis smras/ /dge des mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /sangs rgyas pad 'byung bstan la nyer zhugs shing / /dam tshig rnam dag smin grol bdud rtsir spyod/ /'chi med rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /de ltar dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang mchog bklags pas 'grub pa gu ru'i dgongs gsal zhes pa 'di yang dpal ldan stod 'brug bka' rgyud kyi sdong bo skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i khrir bzhugs shing rang gi slob ma dam pa mang yul skyid rong 'jam gling bla ma o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang pos kho bo'i ngag bsgros zin bris byas 'dug pa de la zhu dag gi legs par gtan la phab par byas pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyis chos 'di nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams la shin tu mkho zhing phan cher mthong nas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang khong drag po lcags sprel gsar du shar nye ba rgyal zla'i tshes nyer gsum gyi thun mtshams su grub par sbas yul pad+ma bkod pa'i 'dab glo lam dkar nag gi dbus rtag brtan rin chen de'u yi rtser bkod pa ste yi ge'i ris byed dge tshul shes rab bstan 'dzin no/ /'dis kyang chos 'dir zhugs rnams/ /grol 'bras mngon du byed pa'i/ /smin byed gsos su gyur nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub shog cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 503

༄ga /gujabhibe+eyabṛn+datrirūlikasaṃgrahasādhanāmaṇikramasarākriyāsmratabin+d+ranāmabidrute/ /rog /bla ma dgongs 'dus rtsa gsum gcig dril sgrub thabs nor bu lugs rgyun khyer bdud rtsi'i thig pa zhes pa bya ba bzhugs so/ /o na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni bh+ya/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus thams cad la/ /gcig dang du ma'i spros bsdu byed pa po/ /dkyil 'khor gtso mchog dpal ldan bla ma la/ /sgo gsum dngas pas rnam kun phyag byas nas/ /gang gi dkyil 'khor dgongs 'dus rtsa gsum gyi/ /rnal 'byor rgyun khyer bsdus las cher bsdus pa/ /nam yang chad med nar ma khos/ /nyams len slad du cung zad 'dir bkod bya/ /de yang dad pa can rtsa ba gsum gyi dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa man ngag bla ma'i zhal lung legs par nos pa'i bsgrub pa po'i dus nyin zhag rer thun drug gam thun gsum du rgyun chad med par nyams su len pa la cis kyang thun dang po las gzhan rnam pa gsal 'debs tshig gyi spros pa mi cog tshe mdor bsdus tsam gyi nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa ni/ kyai/ phyogs bcu'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog bdag la dgongs/ /'gro rnams skyobs pa'i mgon dang dpung mdzod cig /dus 'di nas bzung rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar/ /mgon po mchog gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul/ /nyams chags nyen ltung bsags rnams mthol zhing bshags/ /dus gsum dge bar gyur la rjes yi rang / /bla med theg chen chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad rgyal bas mdzad pa rmad byung ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis dus 'di nas tsam bya/ /'gro ba yongs kyi bla mar bdag gyur cig /gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed/ sngags rdzogs pa'i rim pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ oṃ mkha' khyab 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun/ /skye 'gag gnas bral gdod nas stong nyid dbyings/ /o ma hā shu dzha te dzha na baṃ bha wa r+ghaṃ/ de ltar ma rtogs sgyu 'drar 'khrul pa'i blo/ /'gro la snying rje tshad med kun tu snang / /dharma dha ru saṃ bha wa r+ghaṃ/ stong las rang mdangs snying rje rol pa yi/ /'gro don bskur bzhengs rgyu yi he ru ka /rdo rje sems dpa' pad+ma ra ga'i mdog /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ye shes sku/ /dmar 'tsher sgrib 504

bral me 'od kun tu 'phro/ /dril bu skur brten rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin/ /rdor dkyil longs sku'i chas rdzogs thugs rje yi/ /sprul pa'i zhal phyag rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab/ /rtsirta pad+ma badz+ra hūṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings/ /snang ba'i ngo bo dpal chen rta mchog yab/ /stong pa'i bdag nyid shes rab phag mo yum/ /snang stong zung 'jug yum lnga 'byung lnga'i dal/ /gzhom med bsrung 'khor me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /rang byung gdod nas lhun grub gzhal yas khang / /rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'dab brgyad ge sar steng / /a haṃ thabs shes dpyid thig nyi zla'i dbus/ /gdod nas rang byung rig pa ye shes khams/ /rig 'dus gtso mchos/ gzi brjid 'od dpag med/ /pad+ma badz+ra dmar dkar mthing ba'i zhal/ /sku gsum 'khrul sgrol khro gnyer byams 'dzum zhal/ /theg dgu'i spyan bzlum sdang mig me 'od 'phro/ /bsgrib bsreg sma smin dmar ser ser me dpung 'bar/ /'gyur med dbu skra nag snum gtsug tu 'khyil/ /'gro 'dul dbang mdzad dbang rgyal nor bu'i spras/ /zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs gdung byed bdud bzhi gnon/ /rig drug thugs rjes mi btang phyag drug ldan/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje rtse la shes rab kyi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i bum bzang g.yas gsum phyag /gzhom med dril bu bde can bdud brtsi'i bdud/ khams gsum yongs sgrol kha ṭaṃ g.yon na bsnams/ /zhal rtsibs khral thal zhag dbyugs dbang drag thabs/ /phyin drug rus rgyan klu 'dul sbrul rgyan dang / /stobs bcu las bzhi glang stag stod smad gos/ /nyon mongs rtsad gcod zhing lpags sked du dkris/ /yon tan mthar phyin thod skam lngas dbu rgyan/ /che phran lhun grub rin chen rtse bran 'bar/ /khrag 'dzag mgo 'phreng do shal 'du byed dag /ye shes rgyas gyur rin chen dar sna brgyan/ /'gro don chags thog mi mnga' 'gying 'bag sku/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhi khro spyi dpal mchog /de gtsug rigs bdag 'od mi 'gyur ba dmar/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i dkyil/ /mtshan dpes yongs rdzogs gtsug gtor bltar mi bzod/ /rgyan med gcer bu dwangs gsal rnyog bral bzhugs/ /gtso mchog mdun du lhan skyes gsang ye ma/ /shes rab phar phyin ngo bo mar+ghaṃ ra/ /dmar 'tsher thod rnga dung dmar 'dzin yab 'khyud/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang brkum bde bas myos tshul 'khril/ /nu 'bur gsang rgyas spyan bzlum 'dzum zhal sbyor/ /phyag rgya lnga dang rin chen dar snas brgyan/ /yab yum snyoms 'jug ye shes 'od zer klong / /rgya mtsho gser gyi nyi ma'i dbus su gsal/ /de ltar yab yum gnas gsum rdo rje gsum/ /ngo bo 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje'i lter/ /oṃ dkar āḥ dmar r+ghaṃ mthing gsum gyis mtshan/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil hriḥ dang ma yi spras/ /de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu yi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus pa/ /pad+ma badz+ra yab yum rnam pa ru/ /spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha dang dbyer med 'dres/ /yab yum mkha' gsang rdor pad phroṃ āḥ sa brgyan/ /spubs su 505

zla nyi trīḥ mas spras gnas shing / /gnyis ka'i bu ga yi ge phaṭaḥ kyi dgag /de nas yab yum snyoms 'jug brdas bskul 'gyur/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ ra ho haṃ ra ga ya me/ /de ltar bskul sbyin snyoms 'jug bde ba'i sgras/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha thams cad/ /slar bsdus yab kyi zhal zhugs snying gar zhu/ /yum mkhar dkyil 'khor gyur nas phyir spros pa/ /bud+dha thod phreng yab yum dran bkod shar/ /mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum rtse mo lho/ /pad+ma dbang chen yab yum ro myang nub/ /rig 'dzin thod rtsal yab yum bskyed byed byang / /gu drag yab yum me mtshams bde spyod nas/ /thod dum yab yum bden bral gser sgo'i rtsa/ /rta mgrin yab yum rkang g.yas rtsa chen rlung / /gsang bdag yab yum dbang ldan rkang rtsa g.yon/ /kun kyang rang rang sras 'khor sprul par bcas/ /bu ga sgo mtshams sgo bsrung mtshams ma dang / /rtsa phran bar khyams dpa' bo rnal 'byor sogs/ /ram 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byams klas bsam/ /kun gyi gnas gsum gtso bzhin rdo rje gsum/ /thugs kar ye shes rdo rje rang srog mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros phyogs dus rgyal ba kun/ /spyan drangs dam tshig ye shes ro mnyam 'gyur/ /hrīḥ rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang nas/ /o rgyan pad+ma yab yum la/ /'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /bdag nyid dad pas spyan 'dren gyi/ /thugs rje'i dam tshig dbang gi ni/ /skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol/ /bdag dang gnyis med brtan par bzhugs/ /sku gsung thugs mchog 'grub nas kyang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang / /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wa rā sā mā yā dzā:dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho: e a ri hring hring phem phem/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ: slar yang thugs srog trīḥ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rang bzhin gnas nas gdan gsum dkyil 'khor lha/ /mdun mkhar spyan drangs ting 'dzin gyi mchod bstod/ /deng 'dir mngon par dbang bskur gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa'i/ /dbang bskur mchog sbyin dam pa sbyin/ /oṃ sarba dharma sam bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa r+ghaṃ/ dbang bskur sgrib dag chu lhag yar lud pas/ /'od dpag med sogs rigs bdag kyis dbu brgyan/ /dbang lha la sogs nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /rgyal ba kun kyang rang la dbyer med thim/ /r+ghaṃ trīḥ phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod pa'i rdzas/ /gzugs sgra la sogs dngos por snang dang gzhan/ /khu ba bde chen tshom byed rnam rol ba/ /dam tshig ye shes dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gu ru dhe wa ḍa ki niḥ sarba bhud+dha bho dhe su twa ma hā pū tsa ho/byin rlabs kun 'byung gu ru rje/ /dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i lha/ /phrin las nyer bsgrub ḍā k+ki'i tshogs/ /yon tan rmad byung e ma ho/ /zhes pas dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med pa la mchod cing 506

bstod de dgyes shing tshim par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba bzlas pa/sngags kyi rim pa ni bye brag dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gzhung nas bshad bzhin so so ci ltar 'dod pa dang / spyir btang ni lha rnams kyi thugs kar pad zla nyi ma'i gdan gyi lte bar trīḥ dmar po'i mtha' bskor bzlas pa'i sngags phreng 'khod pa las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/tshur 'dus sa bon la thim/ snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sku 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang / nam mkha'i khams kyang gdod ma'i rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i khengs pas kun gyi 'dzab sngags kyi sgra ldi ri ri bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar bzlas nas bdag la dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab te mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus shing lus pa med pa cig char du thob par bsam la/ yid gzhan du ma yengs par sngags bzlas pa la/ rtse gcig 'bad par bya ste/ de yang / oṃ āḥ rgyu trīḥ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki ni/ sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ a/ zhes spyi dril rgyun khyer snying po dang / o āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki ni e waṃ trīḥ ma swā hā/ de bzhin gtso 'khor gzhan rnams kyang spro na bzla bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi thugs kar bde gshegs zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / zhi ba'i gtso bo yi thugs kar khrag 'thung khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sems dpa' gsum rtsegs bkod pa can lha tshogs de rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ bho dhi chu ma hā su kha dzñā na dhartu a: oṃ ru lu ru lu mai bh+yo hūṃ/ces ci nus su bzla ba yang na rag deng nas dkrug pa'i cho ga rmad du byung ba'o/ /'on kyang bzlas pa'i gtso bo ni thog mar rang gi gang mos sngags cig kho nar bya ste/ de la nus pa thob na lhag ma gzhan rnams kyi nus pa yang shugs kyi thon par 'gyur bas des na blo sna spros pa mang po bor la gang rigs cig dril la 'bad pas don 'grub par 'gyur bas sngags gzhan zhar byung cung zad re bzlas pas chog go/ /de ltar sngags bzlas thun gyi thog mthar kha bskang du a li ka li'i yig brgya tshar bdun re las mi nyung ba bzlas pa ni gal che'o/ /gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ gtso mchog thugs srog 'od zer gyi khams gsum/ snod bcud gzhal yas lha rnams gtso bo brgyad/ de yang gtso mchog yum yab yab yang trīḥrim thim gliḥ yang mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal/ /rtogs bral stong nyid 'od gsal bde ba che/ /ye grol mnyam nyid ngang du ci gnas bzhag /slar yang trīḥ brjod gtso mchog yab yum gsal/ thugs ka'i trī las snod bcud sngar ltar gsal/ zhes rtag chad kyi mtha' gsal zhing sku gnyis smin byed zung 'jug rdzogs pa'i rim pa de ltar la 'bad par bya'o/ /spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod gtor snod bzang por bshams la chu chang bdud rtsis bran cing / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ 507

ta kudhe li ha na hūṃ phaṭa: o swa bha wa gi shud dhe sarba dharma su bha wa bhi shurnyo3haṃ: 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ mdun du yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu brdung pa lta bu'i mchog ma la ba dan ljang khu g.yo ba dang / chang bzung la yam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yi steng du ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba lte ba ram̐ gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rka las thod pa'i skyed so ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi nang du a las thod pa phyi dkar ba nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du dbus su mu las dri chu be+edrur+ya lta bu/ shar du mi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lho ru las rak+ta gser gtso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar dmar dung la pho chos byug pa lta bu/ byang du ma las klad pa dung lta bu/ dbus su na las/ mi yi sha /shar lhor gho las rta yi sha /lho nub tu sku las khyi yi sha /nub byang du dha las ba glang gi sha /byang shar du ha las glang po che yi sha /de ltar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ dpung pa'i 'og tu nyi ma'i gdan steng du zla ba'i kha chod byas pa'i steng du dbus su 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa shar du rdo rje r+ghaṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor rin chen tram̐ gyis mtshan pa/nub tu pad+ma hriḥ sa mtshan pa/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rjes aḥ sa mtshan par gyur/ bdag gi sna bug g.yas pa nas yo hūṃ yo ces pa'i yig 'bru 'phros pa las rlung byung gzhu yi chang gzung gi yam la phog pas mchog ma'i ba dan skyod/ rlung g.yos me'i dkyil 'khor la phog me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams rdo tshan gyi steng du mar bzhag pa ltar zhu zhing 'khol bas nyes skyon thams cad sbu ba'i tshul du phyir lud rlang pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar lha tshogs yab yum bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul zhing / yab yum rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgyun char ltar du bab pas/ ka pā la yi dam tshig gis bdud rtsi la thim ste/ oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ trī āḥ ha ha ho trī: zhes pas phyag mtshan lngas dkrug pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis su med par chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa lta gyur/ slar yi ge phyag mtshan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ste bdud rtsi de nyid kha dog shel dngas ma lta bu la ro sbrang gi rtsi lhad med ltar gyur cing / o āḥrdu ha ho hrīḥ e a ra liḥ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sarba bud+dha bho dhi satwaḥ badz+ra ma hā kro ta/ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ma hring hring hring tse dze dze/ ces pas gtor mgron gyi lha tshogs rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba rnams 'od spung gi gtor ma'i steng du byon nas/bla ma rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i bu ga can dang / yi dam rnams kyi ljags phyag mtshan gyi sbu gu can dang ḍā ki dam can chos skyongs rnams kyi ljags mtshon cha'i sbu gu can la sogs pa rnams mchod rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya la zug pas gsol zhing / so sor 'dod yon gyi longs spyod gang la gang dgyes su rol nas dgyes pa 508

chen por gyur te rnal 'byor pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal bar gyur/ trīḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs rdzas chen po+oḥ dug lnga bsgral ba'i rang bzhin las byung ba'i/ sman raka bdud rtsi ngo bo ba lid+dha/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bla med gtor ma 'di/ /bla ma yi dam zhi khro ḍā ki dang / /bka' bsrungs dam can chos skyongs bcas la 'bul/ /thugs dam dbyings nas bskang phyir bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba ḍa ki ni sarba bud+dha bho dhi satwa/ badz+ra ma hā gro dha shan dhi ka hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya i dam bha ling gu ṇa pu tsa kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bdun sogs kyi rtsa ba gsum la gtor ma 'bul zhing / de nas bka' bsrung rta mgrin nag po la/ o badz+ra ma hā kro ta h+ya snyi wa r+ghaṃ phaṭa: kro ti shwa e ka dza ti bh+yo: phak+ṣa sgyi sa la r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ tri dha rtsa phu traka ya trik+ṣa sa ma ya tsirta hring hring dza dzaḥ i rda bha lid+dha kha kha khā hi khā ti/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul/ gter bsrung btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun la/ na ga tsan+d+ra a ya ma pra dudhe sha na e rda bha lid+dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/zhes lan bdun gyi 'bul/ chos kyi rjes 'brang dur khrod sha za kha mo che la/ bh+yo sha za ḍā ki ni tsirta hring hring dza dzaḥ e dam bha lid+dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas 'bul lo/ de nas rtsa gsum spyi la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang ཿོ ḍā ki dam can pho mo 'gyes gyur cig /bka' bsrung mkha' 'gro chos skyongs tshim nas kyang / /byin rlabs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i/ /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub mdzad gsol/ /de yi mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod ji ltar 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdabs/ /de nas/ badz+ra mu sarba lo ka gats+tsha/ zhes pas gtor mgron lha ye shes pa rnams rang gi snying khar thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la se gol gtog de nas bkra shis bsngo smon sogs rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /de ltar o rgyan gu ru'i zab gsang mdzod/ /thun mong ma yin bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi/ /thun drug nyams len rgyun khyer snying po tsam/ /don gnyer slob ma'i phyed du bdag gi bkod/ /nyes mchis btang 'dzin rtsa gsum ye shes kyi/ /spyan sngar mthol gshags dge ba'i dbugs dbyung stsol/ /legs tshogs dge ba mkha' mnyam 'gror bsngo na/ /pad+ma badz+ra ci 'drar myur thob shog /ces pa yang shar phyogs shing lo'i 'tshal 'chim yul gad pa skya bo'i ljongs su mi yi rje bo bsod nams kyi mngon par mtho zhing bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa la mi phyed snying nas dad pa'i bag chags sad pa khyim spyod sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang dge legs phun tshogs bsod nams rab brtan bzang po'i sde gang gi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor kong yul sa yi thig le bu chu'i gtsug lag khang rang byung 'phags pa'i spyan sngar rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i chu phag sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu'i thun khongs gcig du grub par bkod pa sarba maṅga lo/ 509

༄sha /gu ru drag po me 'phreng can gyi nyam sa len rgyun khyer yang zab rdo rje pha lam/rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thod phreng can/ /gdug pa kun 'dul pad+ma drag po stsal/ /mdog dmar me phreng gza' klu rgyal po'i gshed/ /he ru ka dpal de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de yi 'khor lo gsum gyi nyams len bcud/ /blang ba snying po'i man ngag rgyun khyer du/ /'dir ston rtsa gsum chos skyong btang 'dzin lhas/ /gnang zhing bar chad med par dngos grub stsol/ /bdag mdun dkyil 'khor spros med spros bcas chos/ /gang la 'jug kyang gsal ba gsum ldan gyi/ /ting 'dzin ngar btab ma yengs gtod phur bzungs/ /dus kun nyams len snying po gnad du dril/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /skyabs gnas mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /yang gsang bla med lam zab 'di bsgrub nas/ /'gro kun 'khor ba dong sprugs sems bskyed do/ /r+ghaṃ gu ru yi dam dhā ki gshegs/ /pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /lus ngag mi dge las gyur bshags/ /gsang sngags don la rjes yi rang / /smin grol chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gzhan don bzhugs/ /snying po sems can don phyir bsngo/ /bdag gzhan rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /oṃ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku'i de bzhin nyid/ /āḥ kun snang kun khyab 'gro la snying rje sgom/ /r+ghaṃ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med 'phrin las kyi/ /trīḥ rang sems rgyu yi rgyu dmar 'phro 'du las/ /ram̐ḥ yam̐ khaṃ gi snod bcud sregs gtor dkrus/ /gzung 'dzin bya byed bsam brjod kun bral ngang / /eḥ yam̐ḥ ram̐ḥ sum̐ḥ kauḥ ram̐ḥ r+ghaṃḥ yig gis/ /'byung lnga 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i klong / /bhardzo'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs shing / /ma bcos lhun grub 'od kyi da lar gsal/ /phyogs mtshams ris med stong gsal mtha' dbus bral/ /sna tshogs rnam dag sgyu 'phrul pho brang shar/ /'khor yug dur khrod chen po brgyad ldan zhing / /pad rdor me ri rdo rje'i brag gi bskor/ /de dbus 'khor lo rtsibs bcu e yi klong / /byol song gtso bos btegs pa pad nyi'i dkyil/ /bdud bzhi gza' klu rgyal bsen bcal bkram steng / /rang rig r+ghaṃ dmar 'od kyi don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus bde gshegs kun 'dus khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mdog dmar me 'phreng ye shes rab 'bar sku/ /dbu gsum g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar khro/ /zhal gdangs 510

ljags dril drag po'i rkan sgra sdebs/ /zangs yag mche rtsigs spyan dgu klog ltar 'khyug /sma smin ag tshom bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /shangs nas 'thor rlung snyan nas dud sprin 'thib/ /ral pa dmar ser thor tshugs spyi bor bcings/ /lhag ma 'thur 'phyang zar bus sku rgyab khengs/ /thod skam khrag 'thung rigs lnga dbu la brgyan/ /dbu gtsugs rta mgo ljang khur rta skad sgrogs/ /phyag drug rdo rje tho ba bskal me g.yas/ /g.yon gsum ban khrag lcags sdig lcags phur gdeng / /rdo rje rin chen gshog pa g.yas g.yon bkram/ /thal zhag khrag thig thod sbrul me dpung brgyan/ /glang stag mi lpags rdo rje'i go khrab gsol/ /dra mig lcags kyi sdig pa phra mos gtams/ /zhabs bzhi dor stab dregs pa pho mo rdzis/ /mdun du rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo mthing / /gri gug thod khrag 'dzin nas yab dang sbyor/ /yab kyi rta gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i steng //o rgyan pad+ma dkar dmar bcu drug tshad/ /pad zhu za 'og ber phod chos gos gsol/ /rdo rje thod bum kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor 'khyud/ /mtsho rgyal dkar dmar gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud/ /de yi spyi bor me yi bya khyung lding / /de yi rwa bar rwa me 'bar/ /khro rgyal dpral bar gser 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i dbus/ /oṃ las 'jam dpal ral gri pu sti ser/ /mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /āḥ las rta mgrin dbyug tho thod khrag dmar/ /thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten bum pa ru/ /r+ghaṃ las phyag rdor rdo rje dril 'dzin mthing / /lte bar bde drod pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /me las phag mo rigs lnga gri thod 'dzin/ /gsang gnas gru gsum me dpung 'bar ba'i klong / /r+ghaṃ las me dbal rdo rje tho ba nag /kun kyang ye shes rang 'od 'khrigs dbus bzhugs/ /phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i steng / /bdud 'dul khro chu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /dmar sgrug rab khros rdo rje phur pa sgril/ /sku smad dbal phur bgegs kyi snying khar gzir/ /sgo bzhir rta phag sprel spyang phra men bzhi/ /dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu lcags sgrogs dril/ /'dzin zhing bdud bzhi'i snying khar gar stabs 'khyugs/ /khor yug ke seng dbang phyug ma sring mo/ /'bar ma ging glang mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma/ /gzhan yang ma mgon dam can rgya mcho'i tshogs/ /rnam 'phrul bka' nyan gus sdod tshul bzhugs sam/ /lha tshogs de dag gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan/ /'od 'phros rgyal kun gnas gsum thim byin brlab/ /slar yang 'od kyi rigs lnga spyan drangs nas/ /dbang bskur phyi nang sgrib dag dbu rgyan gyur/ /r+ghaṃ ji snyed rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /sngon gyi thugs dam chen po ni/ /sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba dang / /bdud dang bgegs rnams 'joms pa dang / /'phrin las ma lus bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du/ /drag po chen po drag shul can/ /'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa po/ /dmar nag me yi 'phreng ba can/ /thugs dam dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /dam tshig dbang gi bdag la dgongs/ /dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /gnas 511

'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rje btsun drag po thod phreng stsal/ /khro tshogs mang po sprin ltar gtibs/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /yak+ka me dbal skar ltar 'khrugs/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /bsgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur cig /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sel/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /gu ru badz+ra kro dha bha ga wan sarba ma hā gu ru sa hā yā dzaḥ dzaḥdza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ r+ghaṃ khro rgyal dregs 'joms drag po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /dam ye dbyer med brtan bzhugs gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med de bzhin nyid/ /sman gtor rak+ta sbyor grol mchod pa 'bul/ /ma hā sarba pu dza ho/ r+ghaṃ chos dbyings rnam dag rgyal ba'i pho brang nas/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /snang srid dbang bsdud srid gsum zil gyis mnon/ /bdud sde 'byung po'i tshogs rnams sregs shing 'joms/ /dmar nag me dpung srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar/ /r+ghaṃ gi sgra sgrogs gnam lcags thog tsheg 'bebs/ /drag po khro 'dus dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso/ /pad+ma thod phreng 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bdag sogs thogs med dus nas da bar du/ /ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtog las dbang gi/ /yang dag don dang 'gal ba'i las gyur kun/ /mthol bshags byang dag sgrib med dag tshangs shing / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /o āḥ r+ghaṃ/ kun bzang snang mtha' gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /mtsho rgyal bai ro nam snying rin chen mchog /nus ldan klong gsal pad+ma bde chen gling / /rol pa rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /hūṃ rgyu hūṃ/ ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong / /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs phrin 'dus pa'i dpal/ /rab 'jigs bcom ldan pad+ma gar gyi dbang / /mdog dmar me phreng drag po yab yum sras/ /bka' nyan bsrung ma 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ lha mchog khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /dgra bgegs gza' klu rgyal bsen bar chad kun/ /ye shes rab 'bar mtshon gyi yongs su bsgral/ /ma rig 'khrul rtog 'dzin pa rtsad nas bcad/ /re dogs lha 'dre dmigs med ngang du bcom/ /'khor 'das ye grol chen po'i byin dbang bskur/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ/ aḥ rang nyid drag por gsal ba'i thugs ka ru/ /gser gyi mchod rten bum pa ye shes sems/ /de yi thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /lte bar nyi steng r+ghaṃ dmar pu shad tsam/ /mtha' yar gsang sngags rgyal po g.yas su 'khor/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod thugs rje nus byin bsdus/ /dgra bgegs tshar bcad 'od zer tshur 'dus nas/ /r+ghaṃ la thim pas gzi brjid cher 'bar bsam /thog mar gu ru zhi ba'i rtsa bsnyen ni/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dzha na sirnyi r+ghaṃ trīḥ drag po me phreng rtsa ba'i 512

snying po ni/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ artsig nertsig na mo bha ga wa te r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ a r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ las sngags me dbal sde brgyad srog 'dren ni/ badz+ra hūm̐ḥ yak+ṣa hūm̐ḥ rak+ka r+ghaṃḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ / gnod byed 'byung po ma ra ya rgyu phaṭaḥ bde gshegs khro 'dus drag sngags me dpung ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta sad man kro ti shwa ri badz+ra ki li tī la ya ma hā yak+ka ka la ru pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ sngags sham sde brgyad kun 'dul spu gri ni/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan treg nan e hūr thim dza ma ra ya rbad/ dgra bgegs dam sri briḥ tri rbad thumaḥ da ra ya/ da ra ya/ ma ra ya ma ra yaḥ zhes drag sngags yengs med thog ltar bzlaḥ las sngags skabs su dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du ni/ /bdag nyid drag po'i thugs las 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal kun nus byin bsdus nas rang thim slar/ /r+ghaṃ las 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /phyir 'phros rtse mo steng 'og gur khang tshul/ /steng ma gser 'khor rtsibs stong sdig pas mtshan/ /'og ma me yi rang bzhin rtsibs stong 'bar/ /g.yas g.yon drag tu 'khor ba'i rtse bsnol bar/ /gnod byed rgyal bsen 'byung po'i mgo lus phral/ /phung po me yi ngar gyis lhag med sregs/ /slar yang thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las r+ghaṃ dmar po/ /grangs med 'jig rten kheng 'phros 'od zhu nas/ /yak+ṣa me dbal skur gyur rdo rje dang / /tho bas dgra bgegs byad ma ma lus pa/ /gzir brdung srog srid blangs nad 'da' med bsam/ /de bar dmigs pa yengs med gzir ba yi/ /gnod byed dam sri thal bar brlag gyur zhing / /dregs pas bdag mthong gyur tshe brgyal bar nus/ /sā mā yāḥ de yang dus grangs rtags kyi bsnyen pa ste/ /dus ni zhag grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /zla ba gcig gam gsum dang bdun nas 'grub/ /grangs ni zhi bsnyen thog mar bdun 'bum dang / /rgyun du thun mgor brgya rtsa brgyad re bzla'o/ /drag po'i rtsa sngags khri phrag gsum bzlas pas/ /gnod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad thul bar 'gyur/ /'bum phrag gsum gyis sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /bye ba gsum gyi dpal chen dngos su 'grub/ /sa ya gcig gi rig 'dzin gnas su 'dren/ /mthu dang nus pa yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /mchog gi dngos grub tshe gcig nyid la thob/ /las sngags 'bum khri lnga stong rtags dang sbyar/ /spyi dril 'bru khri bzlas pa'i nus pa ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan yongs rdzogs thob/ /de ltar yengs med grangs tshad sus theb na/ /rnal 'byor dbang po'i khyed kyi tshe 'di'am/ /phyi ma bar do gang rung bud+dha thob/ /rtags kyi tshad ni bsam gyi mi khyab ste/ /thog mar rang la gnod pa'i gdon bslang rtag /lha khang 'bag seng khyi sprel byi la dang / /btsun sngags a tsar skyes pa bud med nag /sbal sbrul nya lcong glang dmar kha 'char 'tshub/ /mtsho khol thog ser mun pa 'khrigs pa dang / /'dzings 'thab brang brdung ngu bshag 'debs pa sogs/ /thog mar lhong tshad cho 'phrul dpag med 'char/ /khyad par bsgom bzlas mi 'dod nyal snying 'dod/ /lha dang bla mar the tshom 513

log lta skye/ /dbang med sems rgyud 'khrul sogs sna tshogs byung / /de la ya nga 'khu khrig kun spang la/ /ting 'dzin ngar skyed ci mi snyam ngang du/ /bzhag pas nam zhig tshe na gdon thul rtags/ /bka' nyan phyag 'tshal srog snying phul sogs bya/ /gzhan yang 'bag seng lha khang sder so bcom/ /sbal sbrul sdom sdig khyi spyang glang dmar dang / /gdon gzugs bsad sogs tshar tshad rtags bzang 'byung / /khyad par tsan po'i mkhar zhugs go mtshon thogs/ /gos dang lus la me 'bar mchil snab 'khol/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje rnyed dang nyi zla shar/ /chu bo brgal dang ri la gyen du 'dzegs/ /gos dkar gyon dang brgyan rtags mkha' la 'phur/ /dar 'phyang dung 'bud rnga brdung mkhar brtsigs dang / /bdud rtsi 'thung sogs ltas bzang dpag med 'byung / /mthar ni bla ma drag po zhal mjal zhing / /dbang bskur lung bstan byin gyis brlabs pa 'byung / /mchog tu sems la nyams rtogs khyad 'phags skye/ /lus la bde ba ngag la nus pa 'bar/ /rang gi tshe tshad gzhan gyi legs nyes shes/ /khyad par bla med rgyud la mkhas par 'gyur//yang dag mchog gi 'bras bus nges bsnyes so/ /de phyir bde gshegs kun gyi thugs srog bcud/ /gu ru'i sgrub pa snying gi thig ler 'chang / /lha sngags ting 'dzin g.yel med bcud phur longs/ /sā ma yāḥ ithi/de ltar bsnyen dang bsgrub pa'i dzaste la/ /yig brgya ak+ṣa rten 'brel snying po yis/ /lhag chad kha bskang bstod tshig mchod bstod bya/ /dus kun bskyed sngags lta ba'i gzer gyis btab/ /snang ba'i lha dang stong pa sems nyid gnyis/ /zung 'jug me long gzugs bsnyan lta bu'i ngang / /rtag chad mtha' bral skye 'gag dmigs su med/ /rang byung rang rig rol pa chen po'i klong / /gu yangs spros bral gnyug ma'i dbyings su klod/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bus sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /bzang ngan spang blangs bral bar mnyam par bzhag /chos rnams thams cad rang sems cig pu'i 'khrul/ /rang ngo shes pas ngo bo nyid du grol/ /yang dag don la lha med 'dre yang med/ /re dgos byar med kun kyang chos skur 'char/ /thob bya thob byed ltos gzhi'i blo yang zad/ /ma bcos gdod ma'i gnas lugs ngang du gzir/ /mṛthiḥ thun mthar snang srid 'od zhu gzhal yas khang / /de yang 'od zhu don gyi lha la thim/ /lha tshogs 'khor rnams gtso bo yab yum dang / /yum yang yab thim yab kyang ye shes sems/ /de nyid rdo rje sngags phreng r+ghaṃ la thim/ /rgyu yang zhabs kyu 'a ha zla tshes rnams/ /rim gyi thig ler thim ste thig le yang / /rim bzhin dmigs med stong pa'i ngang du yal/ /ma bcos mtha' bral ngang du ci gnas bzhag /slar yang skad cig chu las nya 'phar bzhin/ /drag po'i skur gsal rlung sngags dbyer med par/ /rdo rje'i rang sgra chos nyid ngang du 'jug /oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ de ltar chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi/ /spyod lam kun tu yengs med nyams len bya/ /bsgrubs pa'i skabs su dus grangs rtags rdzogs tshe/ /dngos grub blangs chog spyi dang 514

mthun bya zhing / /gzhan yang dkar dmar nye 'du'i dus gnyis gtso/ /'byung po'i nyi ma bcu drug phyed ldan bzungs/ /'char tshe dus kyi mchod pa nyer bzung nas/ /dngos grub blangs pas sirnyi chen po thob/ /bar dor bla ma mkha' 'gros rjes bzung nas/ /mkha' spyod 'og min zhing du nges khrid 'gyur/ /sā mā yā/dus kun thun mtshams gtor mas mchod pa ni/ /bhardzo la sogs rin chen snod nang du/ /ci 'byor rdzas kyi gtor ma bshams byas nas/ /chang ngam chus brlan gtsang chab bran byas te/ /ram̐ yi khaṃ gi dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ gis snod bcud sbyangs spel sgyur/ /snod bcud nam mkha'i khyon khengs 'dod dgur 'khyil/ /gtor ma dpag yas mchod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ dza/ zhes pas zhi ba'i lha tshogs dpag med pa/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i g.yon du spyan drangs gyur/ /krota sa man dza/ zhes pas khro bo'i lha tshogs dpag med pa/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i g.yas su spyan drangs gyur/ /yo ga sa man dza/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor yongs gtso rig pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje slob dpon gu ru zhi khro dang/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyongs dam can pho mo kun/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su spyan drangs gyur/ /de dag rdo rje'i ljags kyi gtor ma'i bcud/ /drangs nas gsol bas dgyes shing tshim bsam la/ /rdo rje'i thal mo gtor mar gtad byas te/ /gu ru zhi grags bde gshegs yongs rdzogs kyi/ /rtsa snying gzhan yang rtsa gsum spyi dril sngags/ /so so'i sham du gtor sngags btags te phul/ /gzhan yang bsrung ma rnams kyang sngags kyi bsngo/ hūṃ bh+yo: du laḥ tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha naḥs pā ri wa ra i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khyi hi khyo hiḥ dharma pā la ṣ+pe tra pa la ni dhi pā ti sba na pa ti bhu mi pā ti sha sā na rak+ṣita sa pā ri wa ra e rda ba ling ta kha kha khy-i hi k+ṣ-i hi/ oṃ āḥ rgyu e rda bha dzita sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha lita kha kha khy-i hi khy-i hi/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yats+tshaskyo swā hāḥ zhes brjod gtor ma btab cing 'phrin las bcol/ r+ghaṃ dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba ni/ /brjid ldan ro mchog brgya dang ldan/ /'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs kyi spras/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i mchod sprin gyis/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskang / /gu ru zhi khro zhi ma khro/ /rnam 'phrul dkyil 'khor bsam mi khyab/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug sgrub bka' brgyad/ /yi dam yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang / /ye shes 'jig rten las kyi rigs/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /ma ning sngags bsrung las mgon nag /gza' dam dregs pa'i gtso bo brgyad/ /sde dpon sngags bdag bstan ma'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma yi/ /bka' dang dam la bzhag pa yi/ /snang srid lha 'dre ma lus pa/ /'dod yon gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /kun kyang dges shing tshim gyur nas/ bdag gi 'dod don re ba kun/ /thog pa med par myur 515

'grub cing / /mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi/ /mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas/ khams gsum snang srid bdag dbang bsdus/ /dgra bgegs byed ma dam sri sgrol/ /nyon mongs 'khrul rtog sdug bsngal sgrol/ /rnam dkar sa lam gong du 'phel/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin ho ru ka'i/ /go 'phang myur thob 'phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ /mgron rnams oṃ āḥ hūṃ gis gshegs/ /gtor ma'i las la rtag brtson na/ /dgra thul bgegs zhi bar chad sel/ /tshe ring nad med ci bsam 'grub/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang ye shes 'phel/ /des na rtag tu brtson par bya/ /sā mā yā/ e ma ho/bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma drag po yis/ /nyams len snying po rgyun khyer zab mo'i don/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i zhal lung las byung ba/ /ye shes mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsal ba'i mthus/ /'khrul nor chug pa'i skyon bral man ngag bcud/ /rnal 'byor rim pa 'di nyid skal bzang rnams/ /bla med lam bzang 'jug ngogs rmad du byung / /dge des 'gro kun 'khrul rtog kun zhi nas/ /tshe gcig nyid la dbang bzhis rgyud smin te/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang nyid thob nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprug par shog /zhes rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rgyal po badz+ra ma ra ḍa ba yi byin gyis brlabs pa/ gser bzang mchog sprul pad+ma stobs ldan dpa' bo rdo rje shugs 'chang snying po rtsal gyis bskul ba dang nye lam du dad pa shes rab kyi nor dang ldan shing rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos pa'i mthu can mi mchog dam pa kun gsal sde pa lhas sbyin bsam 'grub kyi yang yang bskul ngor/ mdo khams kaḥ thog gi lho phyogs stag bu'i nags rdzogs su skyes zhing / rgyal ba kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma'i rjes 'jug tu rlom pa/ 'od gsal lha rigs kyi sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul mchog grub dbang po'i sde yi mang yul gung thang rgyal po'i pho brang gi shar phyogs za 'og phug tu me lug mgo zla'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyer lnga'i gung thun skabs su bris pa'i yi ge pa yang rang nyid kyi bgyis pa'o/ /'dis kyang gsang chen snying po'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas par gyur cigamaṅga lo/r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ nga ni las kyi che mchog drag po'i sku/ /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pas lcags sdig nag po snying nas rtser/ /dpal dang dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /log 'dren gdon bgegs 'dul ba'i dpal du shar/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ rang nyid gu ru drag po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥ rdu artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te rgyu rdu phaṭa phaṭa ā rtsu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭaḥ zhes 'khod pa las 'od zer 'phar 'phros gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po rnams kyi gdug sems zhi zhing sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin 516

rlabs 'dus te r+ghaṃ la thim par bsam la ci nus bzlas/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phren las bstod/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol 'o bshags/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pas 'dzab bstod dang / dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /gu ru drag po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog/ /ces brjod dmigs med ngang du bzhag /shin tu khyer bde bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /drag po ye shes rab 'bar gzhung nas phyungs pa yin/ /sarba maṅga lo/༄7ོ/ /bhagawānashrībadz+ra.ālayasukarmagran+d+rakulishapradz+walanāmabidzahar/bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phur pa'i las byang rdo rje rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ susti/ rdzogs chen zhi khro nges don snying las byung ba'i phur pa'i las byang rdo rje rab 'bar zhes bya ba/ bla ma dpal kun bzang rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje gzhon nu che/ /lhag pa'i lha der rtag tu phyag byas nas/ /gang gi las byang ngag 'don snying po nyid/ /'dir bkod lha des dbugs dbyung byin rlabs stsol/ /de yang sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar: skyabs gnas mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi'o:sems bskyed pa ni/ yang gsang bla med lam zab 'di bsgrub pas: rang byas las kyi mnar ba'i pha ma rnams: sdug bsngal kun bral bde ba'i sa la bkod: 'gro kun 'khor ba dong sprug sems bskyed do:yan lag bdun pa ni/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ: chos rnams thams cad bya rtsol 'dzin bral la: thams cad ro gcig ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: spang blang 'dzin bral klong yang ngang du mched: rang rig chos skur ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: chos gsung bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: rang gzhan dge bsngo tshogs rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: bkegs bskrad pa ni/ r+ghaṃ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogasoḥ nga yi bka' la 'da' ma byedoḥ gal te 'das par gyur pa na: rdo rje 'dzin rgyal thugs khros nas: brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ: groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃ: groṇ+ḍi pā ya groṇ+ḍa pa ya r+ghaṃ: ā na ya ho: bha ga wan bi bya rā tsa r+ghaṃ phaṭa: mtshams bcad pa la lta bas ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra ṭ+wā bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ: stong pa la yun ci rings su bzhag: bsgom pa ni: r+ghaṃ chos dbyings stong nyid dag pa'i ye shes mkha': rgya chad phyogs lhung phral ba'i gnas mchog 'dir:517

chos sku gting gsal bkrag mdangs nyi 'od bzhin: phyi nang med par khyab gdal gzhal yas khang :rig pa rang byung ye shes 'od gsal gyi: rang mdangs lhun grub pho brang 'od gur 'khyil: sku gsum rim gyis brgyan pa'i dkyil 'khor mjes: kun kyang rang rig gzi brjid 'od 'bar klong : snang srid dag snang zhi khro'i rol pa las: ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtog bgegs dang bral: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor ye nas ngang gi gsal: ma rtogs bgegs kyang slar yang rang grol dengs: rgyu hūṃ r+ghaṃ: dzñā na badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ rgyu: bshags pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas: yi dam zhi khro dh+wa ki chos skyong dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gi bag med tshul: sku gsung thugs dang yan lag dam tshig rnams: nyams gyur mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: sā mā yā: a a a: byin dbab pa ni: r+ghaṃ rang snang sgrib med chos dbyings zhing khams nas:chos skur rnam dag dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: rig pa ye shes lha mchog gshegs su gsol: dus kun dbyer med zangs thal byin dbang bskur: yul dang lus sems 'khrul pa'i bar chad sol: stong gsal 'dzin med gdengs thob dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma yā a we sha ya a āḥ mchod pa byin brlabs ni: r+ghaṃ 'jig rten dag pa'i gzhal yas pho brang 'dir: 'dod yon lnga rnams dngos 'byor yid sprul ste: phyi nang gsang sogs mchod pa'i bye brag kun: lha tshogs dgyes bskang mchod sprin byin gyis rlobs: de ltar skyabs sems yan lag bdun/ /bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad bshags pa dang / /byin dbab mchod pa byin brlabs pa/ /sngon 'gro rnam pa brgyad yin no/ /don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la/ lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swā bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyophohaṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rang gdangs lasoḥ rang byung lhun grub kyi gzhal yas khang thig le 'od gong khyab gdal chen po'i klong yangs las rang gsal rig pa'i ngo bo bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum chos sku mtshan ma med pa'i ngang nas zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gsal ba'ang bum sku'i tshul mkhyen pa ma 'gags pa sa le snang la rang bzhin med pa lam me gsal bar gyur: r+ghaṃ 'khor 'das gnyis med chos dbyings mkha' ltar gdal: mchog gi 'od gsal rgya chad phyogs lhung bral: rang byung ye shes lhun grub gzhal med khang : mi 'gyur chos sku'i pho brang nyid du gsal: rnam dag dri med zang thal rin po che: ma skyes gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i klong : sangs rgyas kun mes rang rig chos kyi sku: kun tu bzang po zhal ni phyogs bcur gzigs: yum gyi bha ga bde klong gcig tu 'khyil:sku mchog yid bzhin nor bu rin po che: shes rab 'gag med rang bzhin 'od gsal ba: dngos po'i mtshan ma bral ba'i phyag rgya canoḥ rang byung 'od sku khyab gdal mkha' dbyings su: stong gsal bkrag 518

mdangs thig le'i gong bur smin: r+ghaṃ bdag nyid kun bzang 'od du zhu ba las: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug poḥ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing spyan dgu bsgrad: phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu dang : bar pas rtse lnga g.yon gnyis me dpung dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams mtha' gnyis phur pa 'dril: zhabs bzhi ru tra pho mo'i steng du rdzis: sku smad khro phur rang bzhin dpal chas brgyan: dbu skra gyen brjes khrag 'thung rigs lngas brgyan: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing nag brngam: phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa yab la 'khyud: rgyan cha yab mthun yab yum me dpung bzhugs: de yi phyi rim khrag 'thung bzhi bcu bzhi: bsrung ma bcu gnyis pho bdud nyi shu gcig: ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum dang bcas: mdor na rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: 'jigs rngams 'od zer 'bar ba'i skur gsal gyur: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥ sarba bisne baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: phyogs mtshams pad 'dab bum thod ye shes kyi: bcud kyi yongs bkang bde stong mchod pas bskor: bar 'khyams phyi nang mu khyud sgo rnams dang : khor yug kun tu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bstan bsrung dam can gnas srung bzhi bdag sogs: bka' nyan dkar phyogs mchod 'os sgrub 'os kun: ma lus til gyi gang bu rgyas ltar kheng : mchog mthun dngos grub byin 'bebs tshul du bzhugs: gzhan yang phyogs dus bde gshegs ma lus kun: sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas sprin bzhin 'thibs: mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni: rab 'byams dpag med nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i: zangs thal chen po mkha' la 'ja' 'od bzhin: snang la rang bzhin med pa ra bkrag mdangs gsal: bkra dpung 'ja' 'od thibs se gsal bar bsgom: spyan 'dren pa ni: lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi thugs kar rang rang gi srog yig dang : gnas lnga'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gzhengs nas nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa lta bur zer thag bsgreng ba'i sna la dpung dpung byon par gyuroḥ r+ghaṃ/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : rang gdang rol pa'i cho 'phrul phur pa'i tshogs: 'gro ba'i don du so sor sku phrul ste: yab yum sras dang bcas te gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sā mā dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: rgyu/ rang byung lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas khang : ye nas ma bcos rang babs dkyil 'khor 'dir: ru tra bdud bzhi bam dang nyi zla'i steng : rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: rgyu/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las ni: snang stong grags stong gsal stong rig stong ngang : bde stong dbyer med a thas sdug bsngal bral: rdo rje phur ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: ya mi na mo: mchod pa ni: hūṃ hrī: mchod 519

yon brgyad dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun: 'dod yon lnga ldan phyi mchod sna tshogs 'bul: lha mo bcu drug sman raka bdud rtsi dang : dug lnga ye shes sbyor sgrol nang mchod 'bul: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ:sarba pu tsa ho: rgyu/rnam shes tshogs brgyad dga' bzhi bde stong gsal: phyi nang snod bcud 'dod yon phyi gtor dang :dug lnga phung po sha lnga nang gtor dang : ye shes lnga ldan ting 'dzin gsang gtor 'bul: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya: sarba big nan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ paju puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke ghadhe rna wi bya shab pra tī ts+tsha ā:r+ghaṃ: ru pa shardo ghadhe ra su sparnye pu tsa ā:rdu: oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya: sarba big nan baṃ hūṃ phaṭa: sarba pañtsa a bṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la kha ram̐ khā hi: ma hā bha ling ta kha ram̐ khā hi: bstod pa ni: rgyu/ ma g.yos chos mchog sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /gang la ci 'dul rgyal bas tshul ston pa'i/ /yon tan rdzogs pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /gdug pa mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgrol byed phur pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ju/ kun bzang thugs kyi 'od zer cho 'phrul las: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor shar: mtha' yas dpag med ye shes me 'od 'bar: bar chad sdig sgrib bsreg la phyag 'tshal bstod: r+ghaṃ/ yang dag bla med dkyil 'khor rol pa las: thams cad mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi ngang : spros pas mtha' 'das bsdus pas rang bzhin klong : lhun grub phur pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor tshogs rnams kyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams chags ding 'dir bskong gyur cig: gsol ba gdab pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ thugs dgongs chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong nas ston: rab 'bar bskal pa'i me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong : hūṃ phaṭa drag sngags 'brug stong ldir ba yi: rdo rje phur pa bla brgyud bcas rnams la: gsol ba 'debs so rnal 'byor bdag cag gi+oḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: rang rig rtogs pa'i gdeng dang mi 'bral zhing : mchog mthun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs: de nas 'dzab kyi rim pa la/ thog mar dzab bskul ba ni: r+ghaṃ/ skye med ngang las 'gag med skur bzhengs te:thugs srog r+ghaṃ las grags stong gsung gi sgra: rang byung thugs las lhunagrub dbyings kyi ngang : sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dzab gyis bskul: de nas 'dzab dmigs gsal zhing bzlas pa dngos ni: gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems: de yi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng : thugs srog r+ghaṃ mthar sngags 'phreng bskor ba las: 'od 'phros ma rung gdug pa tshar gcod bsgomoḥ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la ya:sarba bighan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa: bzlas pa ji nus su bya zhing mthar a li ka li rten 'brel snying po yang bzlas la/ mchod bstod dang tshogs bskang yang spro zhing nus na bya'o/ /rdzogs rim ni: r+ghaṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud ye nas gzhal yas lha: bdag gi lus ngag yid kyang lha tshogs kyi+oḥ sku gsung thugs 520

su ye nas gnas pa la: bsgrub dang bsgrub bya las 'das don gyi dbyings: dbyer med ye shes dkyil 'khor rang gsal ngang : hūṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ: zhes lha sngags chos nyid kyi don la mnyam par bzhag cing : rjes su lam du khyer bar bya'o: de ltar bsnyen bsgrub la 'bad pas rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du phyi nang gsang ba'i grub rtags rnams spyi gzhungs dang mthun par 'byung ngo : zab rgya: bsnyen pa them pas las kyi kha tshar bsrung bzlog gi rim pa ni/ rang nyid sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' r+ghaṃ yig gi klad kor du bla ma slob dpon/ khog par rang sems kyi ngo bo dz+ra'am thig le'i rnam pa/ g.yas su bsrung bya pho rigs/ g.yon du mo rigs/ mdun du gang gces pa/ 'og tu rta phyugs yul mkhar sa zhing sogs 'khod pa/ snying ka'i r+ghaṃ gi 'od kyi phyogs bcu'i zhing nas rang dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe 'thor nyams yar ba/ sde brgyad gdug pas brkus 'phrog gzhom pa thams cad a dz+ra rgyu sogs kyi rnam par bkug snying ga'i bsrung bya rnams la bstim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar zhing / thugs ka nas spros pa'i khro bcu/ mtshon cha/ rdo rje sa gzhi/ ra gur/ me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung 'khor gyis 'khor yug ru bcing bar bsam la/ o badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥ sarba big nan baṃ rgyu phaṭa:dz+ra rgyu hūṃ dza: bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā:zhes bzla ba ni bsrung ba'o/ /yang snying / r+ghaṃ las me lce dang sprul pa'i khro tshogs nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin spros/ gnod byed byad ma lha bsrung dang bcas pa rang gshed du phabs te sha zos khrag 'thung lhag ma rnams kyang mes bsreg rdul du brlag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra tī li tī la yaḥ sarba big nan baṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa:oṃ a kro te ka ya ma rā tsa bzlog: oṃ e ka du na bzlog: oṃ ma hā du na bzlog: oṃ sa ga du na bzlog:oṃ rā tsa du na bzlog: o sum̐ tri rak+ṣa du na bzlogoḥ oṃ rak+ṣa ti phor du na bzlog: oṃ hūm̐ trig khri bh+yo:ma ni mā ra ni bh+yo: ma ra du na bh+yo: raklo rak+kan ting ya rak+ka bh+yo: mā ra ya ya ma rā dza tī la ma bh+yo bzlog:bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la gnod par byed pa'i byad phur rbod gtong rbad 'dre sogs 'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bzlog: ces bzla zhing mthar bden stobs spyi ltar brjod de bzlog pa zab pa'i mthar thug pa'o/ /sdom ni/ bskyed dang spyan drangs bzhugs gsol ba/ /phyag dang mchod bstod gsol gdab dang / /dzab kyi bskor ste las rim brgyad/ /dngos gzhi'i bya ba nyid yin no/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang / rjes kyi las rim ni/ zhi khro rang gzhung ltar byas pa kho nas grub mod/ de yang rjes kyi las rim rnams dkyus 'dir bkod na: bskul ba ni: hūṃ/ma bcos lhun grub dbyings rig dbyer med las: rig rtsal cho 'phrul rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs: sprul pa dam can bsrung mar bcas pa rnams: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i sku gzhengs shig: hūṃ/ rig 521

'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs la byon: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod la: dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la babs: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med grub par mdzodoḥ sharnyi/puṣ+ṭi/ wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: chad tho bstan skyong ni: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa dang : lha mi'i gnas dang snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus: sku gsum bka' brgyud rnams kyi rim bzhin du: rgyud gsung gter du sbas bton zhal phyes tshe: spyi dang bye brag bsrung ma thams cad kyi: so so'i sku gsung thugs mchog bstan nas kyang : ji ltar khas blang dam bcas de bzhin du: mchod gtor bzhes la 'phrin las 'grub par mdzodaḥ('ji nas ma dpe 111 — 22༷chad 'dug)mo mo'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan skyong bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /ma mor rang byung rgyal mo gtso 'khor bcas/ /'dir gshegs ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ bh+yo/ 'phrul gyi 'jig rten gangs ri chen po dang / /rang byung gnas mchog rmad du byung ba nas/ /yang dag rgyal ba spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /'jig rten mthun 'jug gdul bya drangs ba'i phyir/ khams gsum dbang bsgyur sprul pa'i skur brtan pa/ /che btsan zla bral gar gyi dbang phyug che/ /lha chen ma hā dhe wa drag shul bdag /u ma dhe wi yum dang lhan cig rol/ /ye shes lnga bdag sku lnga'i tshul snang ba/ /'khor du lo ka mthu chen yongasakyi bskor/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dam can 'phrin las kun/ /thogs med sgrub cing dgra bgegs byad ma dang / /chung srid dman mo ma lus rdul du brlag /rnal 'byor grogs mdzad byis sba'i lha mchog lnga/ /'dir ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas/ /rgyal ba snang mdzad thugs bskyed lha mo yi/ /dbul sel srid bsgrub phyir sprul drang srong che/ /rnam mang thos bu rgyal chen rin chen mang / /yab yum sras dang blon po rta bdag brgyad/ /sde dpon nyi shu stobs chen sum cu gnyis/ /klu brgyad lcang chen gnas pa bcu drug dang / /yul skyong lnga brgya srin mo mched bdun bu/ /ma mo brgyad dang sna tshogs gnod sbyin sde/ /rin chen gter bdag 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel/ /bsgrub mchog longs spyod rgyas mdzad nor lha'i tshogs/ /'dir ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ bh+yo/o rgyan pad+ma'i bka' gsang gnyer 'dzin cing / /zab gter bsrung ma mthu stobs drag shul can/ /btsan rgod chen po 'bar ba mched sde bdun/ /phyi nang gsang ba btsan ging gnod sbyin tshul/ /sprul pa nyer gcig bka' sdod dregs pa'i sde/ /sum brgya drug cu stong dang bye ba 'bum/ /'dre dmag dung phyur grangs las 'das pa kun/ /dam tshig gnyan bsrung chos mdzad rnal 'byor skyong / /mi srun tshul ston btsan rgod 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /'dir ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ hūṃ bh+yoḥ 'dzam gling bod khams skyong bar zhal bzhes shing / /rdo rje phur pa'i bsrung ma mthu rtsal can/ /lha yi dge bsnyen skyes mchog rdo 522

rje legs/ /mched sde sum brgya drug cu lha btsan bdud/ /dge bsnyen nyer gcig mgur lha bcu gsum dang / /bod khams che gnyen drag dgu ri dbang spun/ /srid pa chags pa'i lha rab mthu chen dang / /'dzam gling bstan ma bcu gnyis bran 'khor bcas/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung 'jig rten tshul ston tshogs/ /'dir ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ bod yul gtsug lag chos 'khor bsrung mdzad cing / /slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' 'bang stobs po che/ /tshangs pa lha yi ging chen rtsal gyi bdag /sku rgyal pu tra gsung rgyal dgra lha dang / /yon tan shing bya phrin las pe ha ra/ /thugs rgyal sder chen rdo rje klu 'brug 'dul/ /sku lnga yum lnga blon lnga ru 'dren bzhi/ /'khor gyi rgyal bran stong sde 'bangs bcas dang / /las byed gnod sbyin chen po rtsi dmar sogs/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang khyad par pad 'byung gi /brgyud 'dzin bu ltar skyong ba'i chos rgyal tshogs/ /'dir ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ bh+yo/ gzhan yang ye shes las dam 'jig rten rigs/ /bstan bsrung dam can pho rgyud mgon po'i sde/ /mo rgyud ma mo bka' nyan las byed sde/ /bka' bsrung gter bdag rgyud gnyen dus bsrung ma/ /rnal 'byor mgon skyob yul lha gzhi gnas bdag /rab 'byams mkha' mnyam zhing gi rdul snyed tshogs/ /'dir ྾thugs dam bskang ྾
