r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung ma mgon sde brgyad sogs/ /phrin las mnga' bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /'gres byang / hūṃ trīḥrang byung rgyal ba'i phrin las dkyil 'khor gyi/ /phyi rim mu khyud ye shes me dpung dang / /mi shig rdo rje'i ra ba ye shes kyi/ /rang 'od 'od zer 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang / /dpal chen bzhugs gnas pho brang phyi rol gyi/ /'khor yug yangs pa'i phyogs dang mtshams bzhi ru/ /rang byung dur khrod brgyad gnas der bzhugs pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul sprul bsgyur bsam mi khyab ston che/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro zhing skyong sogs/ /bskang bar 'os pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ trīḥ dur khrod brgyad la gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum/ /lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo 'bum/ /nub phyogs pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'bum/ /byang phyogs karma mkha' 'gro ljang nag 'bum/ /shar lho dam tshig mkha' 'gro gtang 'dzin 'bum/ /lho nub sna tshogs mkha' 'gro khyad par 'bum/ /nub byang thams cad mkha' 'gro 'jig rten 'bum/ /byang shar rgyud 'dzin mkha' 'gro gar bsgyur 'bum/ /rnal 'byor grogs mdzad ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'dir ྾ thugs dam bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ trīḥbasil tshal la sogs dur khrod brgyad de ru/ /tsut+ta la sogs shing chen rnam pa brgyad/ /sgrog pa la sogs mched pa'i sprin spung brgyad/ /thugs rje chu brgyad ye shes me dpung brgyad/ /rang byung rigs brgyad rang grub mchod rten brgyad/ /rtog med bam brgyad de dag la gnas pa/ /mkha' 'gro brgyad dang shugs 'gro 523

chen mo brgyad/ /dpa' bo brgyad dang rnal 'byor chen mo brgyad/ /zhing skyong brgyad dang lha brgyad klu dbang brgyad/ /phra men dge sbyong bram ze brgyad brgyad dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor spyod gyur dbang phyug dang / /ging lang ma mo 'byung po sha za dang / /sa bdag bstan skyong yi dwags ro lang dang / /srin po dri za bya gcan mi srun tshogs/ /rang rang bu smad mdzad bshes gnyen 'dun 'khor/ /spyan 'dren mchod 'bul phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /thugs dam bskang ngo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /rtsu trīḥ 'khor yug dur khrod rol pa'i dam can tshogs/ /thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi rnam 'phrul ba'i/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang / /zhal zas rol mo snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sgra/ /spyan gzigs 'jig rten snod bcud snang srid kyi/ /dpal 'byor longs spyod mdzes sdug yid 'ong rdzas/ /thun mong mchod sprin rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang / /sna tshogs gzugs sgra dri ro re bya chos/ /sbyor sgrol ta na gha na'i dam tshig che/ /thun min 'dod yon rdzas kyi thugs dam bskang / /rang byung bdud rtsi rgyu bsgral rak+ta'i mtsho/ /rmad byung gtor ma zag med bde rol rgyun/ /dam rdzas rgyu mchog chen po rnam lnga dang / /mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan sa le 'bri/ /shel sgong lug dang tsa ra mkha' lding mdangs/ /khyad par rdzas mchog dam pas thugs dam bskang / /dbang po'i me tog bsur chen dud sprin 'khrigs/ /tshil chen snang gsal rak+ta'i dri chab 'khyil/ /sha rus zhal zas ltag sprod dung chen sgra/ /bza' bca' btung bcud rab ldan thabs shes rdzas/ /sha chen lang ling 'bru bcud 'tshogs pa'i rdzas/ /rmad byung bla med tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /khyad par zhen bral gzung mchog 'dzin bral sgra/ /khyab brdal dri dang mnyam nyid ro mchog che/ /gzung bral reg bya rang byung rig pa'i chos/ /rang grol sman mchog bde ba'i dmar chen po/ /brjod bral gtor ma blo bral tshogs kyi sprin/ /rang gsal sbyor ba nyon mongs dbyings sgrol zhing / /brjod bral skye 'gags las 'das ka dag gshis/ khams gsum yongs gol lta ba 'khrul bral bsgom/ /yengs bral lhun grub rang rtsal rol spyod gar/ /mi gnas dmigs bral chos nyid 'bras bu che/ /don dam khyad par mchog gi thugs dam bskang / /thun mong khyad mchog bla na med gyur pa/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam gnyan bskang nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor 'khor 'das kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyam chag ral ba'i tshogs/ /ma lus byang dag sgrib med sor chud nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /'dod don thogs med lhun gyi grub pa dang / /khyad par mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsal dag tshig dang spos dud rol mo'i rgyun bcas/ sman raka sbreng zhing tshogs 'dren bya lug ra gsum cha re bzhin bskang byang dus bstab cing / khyad par rnal 'byor par blta 524

dgongs ting 'dzin dang ldan pas lha tshogs bskang bar bya'o/ /de nas spyi don bzhi pa de kho na nyid dam byang chub sems kyi bskang ba ni/ gzhung las/ dngos po chos nyid ngang pa'i klong du bskang : snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang : gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang : sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang : kun rdzob don dam gnyis med klong du bskang : zhes gsung pa'i don ma 'khrul par/ rab tu rtogs pa/ 'bring du nyams su myong ba/ tha ma yang de yi don yid la byed de/ lus brgyan dang ldan pas phyag rgya gar stabs bsgyur zhing / ngag ca co ma yin par snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi 'di skad du rig pa la ngar btab so/ /hūṃ r+ghaṃ dngos po'i tshogs rnams dmigs med stong nyid mdangs/ /'khor 'das mtha' bral yangs pa sgyu 'phrul rtsal/ /snang bar gyur kun zhen bral chos nyid mkha'/ /stong par gyur pa ye shes rang gsal brdal/ /gsal ba thams cad rang bzhin mtshon bral ngang / /sems nyid yul bral shes rab yangs pa'i klong / /sdug bsngal blos bral mnyam nyid ka dag dbyings/ /bde chen chos nyid 'khrul bral yang dag khams/ /kun rdzob zang zing rtog pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /don dam 'khris bral byar med nyag gcig che/ /'khor ba thams cad rang snang cho 'phrul ste/ /mya ngan 'das kun rang rig ngo bo nyid/ /'khrul pa thams cad sems kyi rtsa ba ste/ /'khrul med don ni rang byung rig pa'i gshis/ /snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus chos rnams kun/ /ma7skye skye bral thams cad skye ba'i bdag /ma 'gags 'gags bral thams cad 'gags pa'i bdag /skye 'gag rtag chad bdag mtshan mtha' bral ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan gdod nas zang thal nyid/ /dpe bsam yid byed blo yi tshogs bral ba/ /tha snyad tshig 'das don dam ngo bo nyid/ /rang bzhin lhun grub rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /thugs rje rol pa shugs byung klong du bskang / /bskang bya'i yul 'das gnyis snang spros dang bral/ /bskang byed blo 'das bdag 'dzin bzung dang bral/ /bskang 'bras rnam smin dmigs bral khyab brdal ngang / /bskang bral skye med ka dag chen por bskang / /sbyor du bral te zung 'jug bde chen ngang / /lhan skyes ro tshig don dam dbyings su sbyor/ /sgrol du bral te sems byung 'khrul pa'i yid/ /sems bral rig pa mnyam nyid klong du bsgral/ /re dog gnyis bral 'khor gsum yongs su dag /ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /nyam chags thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stong gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: a la la ho: zhes dang / oṃ ā:hūṃ: ho dgos su gsol/ chos nyid spros bral rnam par dag pa'i dbyings rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dbus na bzhugs shing dus gsum mnyam nyid khyab brdal du ma ro gcig gi sku dang thig le ye shes kyi rol pa 'byams klas pa rab 'byams su ston pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs zhing gi rdul snyed rgya mtsho khyon gyur dpag gi mi lang rang byung rang shar ngang du byon pa'i 525

bcom ldan 'das bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha dang / khyad par dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras 'khor bka' bstod bsrung ma pho nya las mkhan dam can rgya mcho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams kyi bla med yang dag mchog gi mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang / de kho na nyid tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la brten nas bdag sogs khams gsum rigs drug gi sdug bsngal la 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dam tshig chag nyams zhig ral 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa thams cad kun bzang mnyam nyid phyam brdal chos sku'i thugs klong du bskang zhing sor chud nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub la thogs med du longs spyod pa'i skal ba dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig ma hā su kha dzñā na sidhi sa ma yā a haṃ: zhes gsol la byar med ka dag ngang du chos kun la bzla'o/ /de ltar bshags bskang gi bya ba la rang gzhan gang gi 'jug kyang dkyil 'khor gyi mchod rdzas 'dus pa'i kha zas la sdig pa mi dge bas sbag pa ma yin pa dang / sgrub pa po rnams kyi yang lus ngag yid kyi dreg chos rtsing spyod tho cos 'phyar sgeg bre mo'i tshig sogs chos min mi dge'i spyod pa dang ma 'dres par/ dkyil 'khor gsal ba bzlas pa'i sngags tshig cho ga dag pa/ ting nge 'dzin ma yengs shing / mi dge nyams chags las ngan sngar byas la 'gyod sems phyin chad du sdom pa'i dam bca' drag po dang bcas te lus ngag yid kyi 'gyod tshangs gyi rim par spyod cing / chos kun sgyu ma lta bur zhen 'dzin med pa/ gnyis snang bral ba mnyam nyid ngo bo nyid kyi don la bltas te snang srid bde chen sgyu 'phrul rol rtsal 'gag med gu yangs phyam brdal chen por shes bzhin lha sngags ye shes kyi khams la longs spyod pa las/sems 'khrul rtog lu gu rgyud du sbags pa dang / snang ba gze re chags sdang lung ma bstan dbang du ma song bar yid shes dran pa'i rtsi dang ldan par/ bshags bskang gi cho gar rnal 'byor du byed de/ de yang thog mar rang 'dod khams na'i bsam pa spang la sems can yongs phan sems bskyed bzang po dang ldan pas gzhi bzung / bar du dge ba la dngos zhen med pa/ mthar dge 'bras rnam smin re dgos dang bral ba 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang du dge ba la 'bad pa ni gnad du che la/ de lta bu'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor du spyod pa de ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras su dgongs te byin gyi brlabs shing tshe 'di dang phyi mar si ti gnyis la longs spyod par 'gyur te/ de yang thun mong du/ yid dang mi mthun pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog cing sgrol ba drag sngags mthu dang / lha 'dre mi sogs 'dod dgu dbang du bsdu ba'i byin brlabs dang / zas nor stobs 'byor rigs rgyud mnga' thang snyan grags la sogs mthun dgu rgyas pa dang / mi mthun 'jigs pa nad gdon 'gal rkyen glo bur ye 'brog bar chad rkyen gyur keg ltas ngan pa mtha' dag zhi zhing / khyad par gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nor bar gyur pas na raka chen por ltung ba'i rgyu rnams byang zhing dag pa'i lam mchog rmad du byung ba na raka dong sprug rnal 'byor gyi spyi khrus zhes bya bar grags te/ mchog gi dngos grub du rnal 'byor pa'i tshe rabs kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig chags nyams 'khrul snang thams cad sangs te/ gang zag dbang po'i 526

khyad par gyi tshe 'di phyi bar do gang yang rung bar/ rang sems kyi ngo bo phyin ci ma log pa chos nyid kyi skye ba med pa don dam pa'i bden pa ci lta ba rtogs pa'i ye shes mkhyen pa'i yon tan rab tu rgyas nas byang chub chen po/ kun tu bzang po'i sa lhun gyi grub pa'i rig 'dzin mchog thob par 'gyur zhes rgyal ba rgya mtshos gsungs pa ste rgyu 'bras mi bslu ste/de yang dge ba'i spyod pa la mi dge ba'i dris mi sbags shing cho ga gang la yang zhing dang dngos po bsam pa rnam par dag par byed pa ni yang dag pa'i lam mo/ /de nas spyi don gsum pa cho ga'i rjes kyi spyod pa ni/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las gang 'dod kha bsgyur ba dang / bye brag tu bskul dang chad tho sgo dbye zor 'phang bstan skyong rta bro bsrung 'khor shis brjod bsngo smon la sogs spyi sgos kyi bya ba rnams bsgrub chen khog dbub pra khrid la sogs gzhung dang mthun par zla chos tshar rkyen gyi dbang du ma yin par spyod do/ /e ma dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs kyi yab/ /thugs rje rmad byung 'od dpag med sgyu 'phrul/ /bla med bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /rang byung mtsho skyes pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshos legs gsang gsung rab 'byams/ /gtso mchog rgyud sde bzhi drug sngags kyi sde/ /snying po thabs rgyud rnal 'byor chen po'i lam/ /snang srid dag pa'i phyag rgyar yongs bltas shing / /phung khams rtsa rlung thig le nyer sbyangs nas/ /bde chen 'od gsal zung 'jug rab smin byed/ /yongs bskyed rnam shes lhan skyes dri tshogs kun/ /lhag med rab sbyangs sbyongs bral rang rig gshis/ /gzod nas ka dag gnas lugs gnyug ma'i don/ /mngon 'char sku ye mkhyen tshogs rgyas byed gnad/ /thabs mang dka' med tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam/ /yo ga gsum grags rdo rje theg pa yi/ /lha tshogs sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin//mngon rdzogs bstan bsrung tshul du skur bstan pa/ /dpag med nam mkha'i mtha' klas rgyal ba'i tshogs/ /yongs kyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus dpal chen po/ /rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud lung dgongs bcud kun/ /bka' babs thugs la shar nas snying po'i don/ /man ngag gnad du dril nas rgya bod du/ /skal ldan rnams la yongs su gdam/sa mdzad pa/ /nub med bka' gter snyan brgyud rtsas bzang po/ /'gro don dus la mi yol ston mdzad cing / /khyad par phur sgrub yongs kyi nying khu mchog /bi to ta ma 'bum zhun gsang ba che/ /bar chad yongs gzhom gnam lcags spu gri zhes/ /gu ru nyid kyi thugs dam gsang ba'i lha//rmad byung rmar chos gdul byar thugs brtse bas/ /kun tu bzang mo ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gdams pa'i man ngag yang gsang bla med chos/ /snyigs dus gdul bya'i don du phyi nang gsang / /rgya yi gdabs pa 'gro don dus babs tshe/ /pad 'byung thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i/ /rig 'dzin chen po bdud 'dul rdo rje yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya dkrol nas nyer byon pa'i/ /zab chos yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying gi khrag /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /ma tshangs kha bskang bshags bskang cho ga che/ /na raka dong sprug rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lam/ /rnal 'byor pho mo mchog thun byin brlabs gter/ /rī 527

'dzad med longs spyod rin chen gter gyi khung / /legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston chen po ste/ /bdag blo'i chu gter rmong rnyog dngas pa'i ngog /legs char nor bu'i skal ldan yid bzhin du/ /re ba bskang byed mchog 'di rgyal sa yi/ /legs bsrung gsung rgyud lung man ngag gzhung rnams nas/ /ma 'khrul sa la ma nor 'grel bzang por/ /legs par sdebs dang gu ru'i thugs rje'i mthus/ /bdag blo cung gros tshal nas gzhung don nyid/ /ma 'khrul tshig gi phur pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /rtsa gsum rab 'byams thugs dam bskang byed mchog /lha dang bla ma'i gnang ba thob nas bkod/ /de la nyes tshogs dri ma'i cha mchis na/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror mthol bshags kyi/ /bdag la 'di phyi bar dor sgrib pa yi/ /rgyu ru ma gyur dag tshang dngos grub stsol/ /legs gyur dge tshogs cha shas bcas pa kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can la bsngo zhing / /'gro rnams sdug bsngal 'khrul tshogs yongs spangs nas/ /byang chub yang dag bde chen mchog thob shog /rgyal bstan nub med yun ring dar rgyas shing / /theg mchog 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i chos/ /rab rgyas de 'dzin skyes bu sde dang bcas/ /sku tshe mdzad 'phrin nyams med rtag gnas shog /rmad byung bla med gsang chen bshad sgrub kun/ /phyogs dus kun khyab bri med gong du 'phel/ /lung rtogs yon tan mchog la rab spyod cing / /don gnyis lhun grub 'bad med nyid 'byung shog /ma rig dri mas sbag pa'i sems can kun/ /rig pa ye shes rang ngo rjen mthong nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rab sgrub yul/ /sku dang ye shes mchog gang myur thob shog /srid par 'gro kun sdug bsngal 'khrul zhi nas/ /mnyam nyid rang sa rgyal ba nyid kyi yul/ /lhun grub yang dag snying po'i don de nyid/ /'gro ba kun gyi de ring nyid thob shog /phan dang bde dge bzang po'i rtsa lag kun/ /rab rgyas bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /dkon mchog yongs 'dus pad+ma badz+ra gyis/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma rab rgyas bkra shis shog /bla med lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /rnal 'byor spyod kun 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub/ /mchog lam mthar phyin lhun grub phyag rgya yi/ /rig 'dzin de ring nyid grub bkra shis shog /tshe gcig byang chub gegs med thar pa yi/ /dbang po bde chen ka dag btsan sa nyid/ /'khrul nor med zin gdul bya ma lus kun/ /tshom bu gcig tu rdo rje 'chang thob shog /ces dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang / rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams kyi sgo nas na raka dong sprug 'gyod tshangs bshags dang bskang ba'i cho ga 'di ni/ 7dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs kyi thugs rje rab zlum rgyal ba mtsho skyes rig 'dzin gnyis pa pad 'byung bdud 'dul rdo rje 'dus pa rtsal gyi gdung rigs dam pa rgyal ba'i sras chen po/ nus ldan rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rgyal ba zhes/ myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar snang ba gang de yi gsung gi nan tan chen po dang legs byas kyi me tog bcas bskul bar mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang sbas yul spu bo brag gad ljongs kyi skal ldan gyi skyes bu rnams kyi mgrin gcig bskul ba la brten te/ bstan pa spyi sgos kyi ched du phan 'dun bsam pa yi lha dang bla ma 528

mkha' 'gror gnang ba zhus pas dge mtshan thob mthus/ kong yul brag gsum kyi mtsho dbus dgyes mdzad bde mchog 'khor lo yi pho brang chen po rdo rje btsun mo'i e klong mngon sam du snang ba'i gnas mchog ngo mtshar du mas brgyan pa'i stoskyed tshal mtsho ljongs rgyal ba'i bste gnas zhes drag po'i sku bsnyan rmad du byung ba'i gtsug lag khang chen po de'i drung du/khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen dang mi gnyis pa'i rje btsun mang po'i zhabs la reg pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'am/ las kyi rdo rje drag po 'dus pa rtsal gyis rang lo nyer bdun sna tshogs dbyig zhes shing sbrul hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes bzang por dbu brtsams te/ de yang 'gyod tshang bshags bskang cho ga ni/ rang byung rang shar/ dri med bshags rgyud dang / bde legs 'dus pa'i na raka dong sprug rnams nas btus shing / bskang ba ni rang gi gzhung don ma 'khrul bar blos nye bar bkod nas tshes bco lnga la grub par sbyar ba'i yi ge'i ris byed pa ni o rgyan du blo gros dbang pos bgyis pa ste dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /rgyud gzhung nas phyung pa la gter tshal dang / rang gi brtsam pa la chog shad sbyar yod pas shes par bgyis la su yi ma bcos/ 'di la 'dra min ba(snye dkrug bcos bslad byed pa dang /rtsam gzhi thu na de yi srog rtsa zhing skyong yab yum las mkhan tshogs dang / ma gza' rdor gsum gyis chod cig badz+ra sa ma yā/529

gag /gsang ba ye shes snying gi thig le'i gsol 'debs rdo rje'i thol glu bde chen sprin dpyang bya ba/:trī: bde chen g.yo med rgyal ba 'od dpag med: bde gar snying rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigasoḥ bde ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bde klong yangs pa chen por gsol ba 'debs:bde ster ye shes dbyings bdag mtsho rgyal ma: bde lam mthar phyin be+e ro nam mkha' snying : bde bgros mngon gyur pad+ma bde chen gling : bde gdangs rol pa chen por gsol ba 'debs: bde gsal thabs mchog rta yi mgrin pa can: bde stong shes rab dbang mo phag gi gdong : bde la rtag rol pad+ma sam bha woḥ bde khyab brdal ba chen por gsol ba 'debs: bde mkha' dbang bsdud dhak+ki dhu mang ye: bde dbyings mnyam gnas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug: bde 'gro las bzhi'i dbang mo dhāk+ki bzhi: bde ba rab 'byams chen por gsol ba 'debs: bde dkyil khyed la de ltar gsol 'debs mthus: bde rtsal sprin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub cing : bde shar dga' bzhi'i 'byung ldog dbyings su groloḥ bde grub 'khrul med gtan srid zin byin rlobs: bde snang mngon gyur nyams med gong du 'phel: bde rig tshad phebs skye 'chi mtshan ma zad: bde grol chos zad blo dang yongs 'das pa:bde 'byams kun bzang thig ler ro gcig shog: bde sku gnyis kyis gdul bya'i dpyid ston cing :bde gsung tshangs rngas smon 'khrul zum bsal: bde thugs mkhyen gnyis 'od kyi 'gro mun bskrad:bde rlabs mchog ldan don gnyis 'grub gyur cig: ces pa 'di ni rang lo nyi shu lon pa'i ston 'bru bcud smin dus la bab chu bo'i 'gram du stod skabs tshes brgyad mod la rdo rje mkha' 'gro mi mo'i tshul des bskul ba la rten/ sngags chags lam pa rgan po tshe dbang nor bu'am/ gar dbang bde chen rol pa rtsal gyis sprel zla bcur bgyis pa'o/ /sman mchod: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ phyi ltar du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: nang ltar du regs kyi dhā k+ki sde lnga'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: gsang ba ltar du ye shes kyi dhā k+ki dhu ma gha yo'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: de kho na nyid rdo rje khros ma nag mo'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang mchog gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi dam rdzas bde chen bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la bdag la zag med lhan skyes ye shes mchog gi dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: ma hā su kha sid dhi ho: bdag 'dra tshe 530

dbang nor bu la mkha' 'gros ji ltar stsal ba bzhin bkod pa'o:thug / gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub gzhung rgyun khyer snying po bcud dril dngos grub gter 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥ tsā na ṅgāk+ki dhu ma gha ye trīḥ dmigs med stong nyid lhan skyes chos sku ye shes ma/ /zag med 'od gsal zhing skyes sprul sku dhak+ki ma/ /gnyis med lhun rdzogs sngags skyes longs sku bde chen ma/ /'dzin med ro gcig gsang ye mar phyag 'tshal/ /dhāk+ki nyams len 'bad med dngos grub gter/ /nyams len gsang ye'i sgrub gzhung snying po'i bcud/ /nyams len 'khor lo chig dril 'dir bkod la/ /bla ma dhā k+kis gnang stsol byin gyis rlobs/ /gu h+ya sirnyi r+ghaṃ: de la rim gsum sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes/ /sbyor ba gnas dben yid mthun gtsang ma'i sar/ /ma rdal phyi nang gsang rten mchod bskang dang / /sgrub chas rten 'brel rdzas kun tshogs byas nas/ /dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gnyis las thog mar ni/ /yab brten 'phags mchog bsnyen pa rtags mthong rjes/ /yum brten sgrub dang las sbyor gnyis yin te/ /sgrub pa 'khor lo gsum du nyams len pa/ /dang po bskyed rim lha yi 'khor lo la/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed dang ye shes bkug /gnyis su med byas mchod pa'i rim pa ste/ /de la dang po dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ /trīḥ skye med mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa las: snang ba ma 'gag thugs rje chen po'i yum: skye ba'i cho 'phrul rgyu yi yi ge trīḥ dmar gsal rab 'bar 'od zer kun tu 'phro: de las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng : dur khrod mi bzad rgyu las gzhal yas khang ཿོ chos 'byung dmar nag dbang ba mdog zla gam ldan: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs dbus kyi lte ba ru: pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan steng su: rang rig ngo bo trīḥ yig dmar gsal 'tsher: de las bdag nyid gsang yes mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod gzhon tshul mdzes:spyan gsum mche bzhi cung bcigs khro mo'i zhal: g.yas gnyis phyag mtshan gri gug ral gri dang : g.yon gnyis thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams: thod pa skam rlon rin chen rus rgyan spras: zhabs gnyis bskyang thum pad+ma'i gdan la gzhengs: pad 'dab phyogs bzhir 'degs tshul mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang zhal rnams cung zad khros: rang rtags gri thod rus rgyan gzi 'od 'bar: kun kyang rang 'dra mkha' 'gro so sor bskor: dpa' bo yab rnams sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ ka: mchan khung g.yon bslang phyed skyil gar stabs can: o rgyan dur khrod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: bdag cag mos blo'i 531

tshul du mngon sum snang : spyi bor pad zla'i steng du r+ghaṃḥ dmar las: ngo bo 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma dang : snang mtha' dbyer med rnam pa pad+ma 'byung : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar gsal mdangs: gcer bu rus rgyan zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs: phyag g.yas cang te'u g.yon pa dril bu bsnams: 'khor du bka' rgyud rig 'dzin tshogs dang bcas: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs mdzad par bsgom: thugs kar trī las 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso: rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis poḥ pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba g.yas na 'dren: dbang bsdud phyag rgyas pad+ma dmar po g.yon:dpa' bo'i rgyan rdzogs zhabs gnyis pad nyi'i steng : ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bskyang rkum bzhugs: gzhan yang 'khor du dpal bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sa dang bar snang thams cad g.yo zhing gang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyang : sprin gyi phung po btib pa bzhin du gsaloḥbaka' dang bstan bsrung dam can chos skyongs rnams: rnam 'phrul bka' nyan gus bstod tshul du bzhugs: gnas gsum 'khor lo gsum dbus 'bru gsum las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs bstim: de ltar sngags bskyed/ dam tshig pa gsal gdab nas ye shes ldan zhing gi dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren pa ni/ spos bsreg gtor ma la sman raka steng / bsur chen btang / mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud/ thod pa'i rnga brdung / seng ldan gyi ḍa ma ru bgrol/ rol mo sgrag la 'di skad do/ /trīḥmaḥ mkha' dbyings bde chen pho brang nas: kun rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'gro ba'i don mdzad chags tshul ston: dmar mo gsung gi dhāk+ki ma: gsang ba ye shes 'khor dang bcas: byams pa ma cig bu la dgongs: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: de nas brda' don rtags gsum gyi ldan zhing sngags kyi dhāk+ki rnams dam ye dbyer med du bzhugs par gsol ba ni/ hrī:maḥ dur khrod gzhal yas pho brang 'dir: nyi zla pad+ma ro gdan la: dam ye gnyis med rang bzhin du: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: de nas dam ye gnyis su med par mchod pa'i rim pa las/ dang po phyag gi mchod pa ni/ trī: skye med lhun grub rang byung ba: gsang yes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la: 'du 'bral med par phyag bgyid na: gnyis su med par bzhes su gsol: de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni: trī: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: khyed la mthun rdzas mchod pa 'bul: 'dod yon lnga dang phung po lnga: 'byung lnga'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga: dug lnga'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: phyag rgya lnga dang ye shes lnga: blta bsgom spyod 'bras lnga mchod 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba bla na med: sman raka gtor mchod bzhes su gsol: lta ba'i glu dang spyod pa'i gar: gsang sngags blta spyod mchod par bzhes: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos 532

grub stsol: de nas bstod pas mchod pa ni: trīḥ dus gsum bde gshegs yon tan kun rdzogs shing :'gro ba'i don la thugs rje sprul pa'i sku: smin grol dbang gis 'gro ba smin par mdzad: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: trīḥrnam dag chos nyid ngang las thugs rje'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pas longs spyod rdzogs: 'gro ba'i don la sprul sku bsam mi khyab: dbang chen rta mgrin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:trīḥchos dbyings ye shes che la mnga' brnyes shing :'gro ba'i don mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma:byin rlabs lus ngag yid la gnang mdzad ma: ye shes dhā ki ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gro ba'i don du chags mdangs sku mdog dmar: thugs rjes khros pas gdug pa tshar gcod cing : nyon mongs rtsad gcod gri gug ral gri g.yas: 'khor ba stong mdzad thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon: thabs shes dbyer med pad+ma'i gdan la gzhengs: rigs kyi gtso mo khro mo bzhi yis btegs: mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: trīḥ stong pa'i de nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang : rgyu gcig pas ni rol pa'i sku shar ba: byin brlab bde ster rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i gtso: rang rang 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: bīḥ ye shes dag pa'i ngo bo sprul pa'i sku: sna tshogs gzugs dang sku mdog phyag mtshan 'dzin:'dod pa'i dngos grub ster ba'i thugs rje can: 'khor gyi dhā ki'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: trīḥbastod pas rnal 'byor bsgrub mchog 'khor bcas la: mkha' 'gro dgyes nas byin gyis brlabs pa dang : sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog thob nas: thugs dam bskangs nas nyams chags 'gal 'khrul kun: mthol zhing bshags so byang zhing dag nas kyang : mi dmigs tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol:yig brgya dang rten 'brel snying po dbyangs gsal rnams kyang bya'o//de nas gnyis pa sngags kyi 'khor lo la/thog mar bsgrub pa'i bzlas pa ni: bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas bskyed pa'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du trī:dmar po'i mthar mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yang snying sngags 'dis bskor bar bsgom la/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma su hāḥ ha ri ni sa tsa hri:ya rdu dza: ces pas g.yon du bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dang mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'od kyi lcags kyu dang pad+ma'i zhags pa trī:yig gi rnams thogs pa grangs med pas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs yon tan 'phrin las dang 'gro ba lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kyi tshe bsod kyi dwangs ma rnams bsdus nas thugs ka'i trīḥ la thim pas gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing / slar yang snod bcud gzugs snang thams cad mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin rol pa chen po'i 'dzab sngags ldir ri ri sgrogs bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam la bzlas so/ /de'i thun mtshams su 533

gtor tshogs sbyin bsreg la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub la rtags rnams gzhung nas gsungs bzhin tshang nas rim pa dril sgrub dang khams gsum dbang bsdud ltar du bya'o/ /gsum pa sems nyid stong pa'i 'khor lo ni/ rang dang lha gnyis gnyis 'dzin zhig /rig pa lhag ge rjen ne ba/ /rang babs 'od gsal stong sang nge / /dbyer med gam/sa lugs spros brjod bral/ /rang bzhin snang ba rta mchog yab/ /ngo bo stong pa gsang yes yum/ /dbyer med rtog tshogs ḍākhri'i 'khor/ /ye nas rang dang 'du 'bral med/ /thams cad chos nyid rang rtsal rgyal/ /rtsa khams lha dang rlung khams sngas/sa/ /thig le don dam ye shes che/ /ma skyes gdod nas mkha' 'gro'i dal/ /dbyer med lhan skyes phyag rgya 'grub/ /lus nyid lha ru gsal ba'ang / /mthas min snang stong 'dzin med sbyongs/ /ngag ni rlung gi rang sgra sngags/ /skye med rdo rje 'dzin bral bzla/ /sems nyid rig stong mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbyer med lta ba'i klong du bsgyur/ /rang gsal gdangs gzugs dhā ki'i tshogs/ /lhan skyes bsgom med ngang du klod/ /tshogs drug rang mo mjug ma nyid/ /spyod pa rtsis zin brtul zhugs spyod/ /de ltar byas pas ye shes kyis/ /mkha' 'gro rang dang chig 'grub ste/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnyis/ /ma lus lhun gyi 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ de ltar 'khor lo gsum yengs med nyams su blang ba'i drod rtags thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa byung nas rdzas rnams dngos grub blangs/ rten rnams 'chang nas mi'i mi mthong bar bya/ gzhan yang shis pa brjod/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ rgyun spyod spyi dang mthun no/ /de ltar gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki yi/ /bsgrub gzhung bde gling gter 'byon snying thig mchog /ma bu gnyis sdebs rgyun khyer nyams len don/ /nyung dril bkod 'di 'jug ngogs bcud du che/ /gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang zab mo las/ /'di 'dra'i zur 'debs bya bar mi spobs kyang / /rang gi 'dren pa bde gling nyid kyi sras/ /sna nams ye shes sprul gar rig pa 'dzin/ /pad+ma dbang rgyal gzhan phan lhun grub bam/ /bde chen rdo rje 'od gsal snying po dgyes pa rtsal/ /de yi bka' yi yang yang bskul ba'i tshe/ /rmi lam ḍāk+ki'i snang ba cung zad tsam/ /brnyed mthus gter tshig rang gzos ma snyogs par/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bus sdebs/ /nyes gnong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs kyi bzod bzhes la/ /dge gyur 'gro kun bzang mo'i sar 'khod shog /ces bso lci rong ting ri ljon ra ba bde chen skyed tshal du kun ldan zhes lcags byi lo spre'u zla ba'i tshes bzhi la sbyar ba'i yi ge'i ris byed ni gter chen nyid kyi nye gnas dam pa rdo rje 'phan nam rin chen lhun grub bzang pos bgyis pa'o/ /'dis ni srid kun bde chen mnyam nyid che/ /gsang ba ye shes stong pa'i mkha' klong du5/34/sbyor byas zag bral gdod ma'i rgyal po'i sar/ /myur du 'khod nas gdul bya 'dren par shog /dge'o/ /

dge'o/ /dge'o/ /tshog /gsang ba ye shes bsten bsgrub kyi zur 'debs thun mtshams mdzes rgyan pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sku ma gsal ba kā dis gso zhing / gsung ma dag pa ā dis kha bskang / thugs ma brtan pa yig brgyas bskang ste/ dang po ni/ a āḥ i zhiḥ u u/ ṛ ṛ/ lolo/ e i/ o au/ e aḥ gnyis pa ni/ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ja ḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ gsum pa ni/ oṃ pad+ma su twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭhaḥ sgyu ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yaḥ tsa/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shrī ya ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri dā ya/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥ gzhan yang / ye dharma ho tu pra bha wa/ he dudhe ṣan+ta thā ga to n+ya wa data/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ zhes pa'i mthar/ hriḥ ma/ gsang ba ye shes kyi dhā ki'i lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyobs pa'i nus mthu/ ster ba'i dngos grub/ 'phags pa'i bden tshig la sogs pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab ma mnga' ba lags pas/sgrub pa po rdo rje che ge mo bdag la dus dang rnams pa thams cad du zhal gyi phyogs/ spyan gyi gzigs/thugs kyis dgongs nas/ nam zhig sangs ma rgyas/ byang ma chub kyi bar du/ /nad gdon rkyen/bgegs bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / thun mong du 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang / khyad par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol lo/ /oṃ gu h+ya dzha na dha ki ni kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ wāk+ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi r+ghaṃḥ sarba sirnyi trī: khyad par gyi nge'u chung khrol te/ hriḥ ma bde mchog bde spyod gsang ba'i dbyings klong nas/ /mkha' 'gro kun gtso gsang ba ye shes ma: 'khor bcas brtse bas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba bde chen bdud rtsi'i bcud: bsnyen bsgrub 'dzab kyi mchod 'bul dgyes bder bzhes: sku gsung thugs dngos zag med dga' bzhi'i ro: khyad par mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: ma hā sarba pūts+tsha a la la ho: hriḥ maḥ ma bcos stong nyid gsang ba ye shes ma: ma 'gags rang snang dpa' bo rta mchog dpal: ma spang lhun grub au rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gtso: ma yengs brtse gcig bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: ma thogs myur du dgyes zhal rab bstan te:535

ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i nyon mongs kun sbyangs nas: ma gyur 'gro kun rang rig don rtogs te: ma cig gsang yes khyed dang dbyer med shog: ma skyes gdod nas snang ba'i bcom ldan ma: ma sgrib dri med rang zhal rang mjal te: ma rig gnyis 'dzin sbur dang yongs bral bar: ma yi dbyings nas rtag tu rnal ba la: ma g.yos bzhin du thugs rje rol pa'i gdangs: ma dag 'gro ba'i snang ngor gzugs kyi skus: ma lus 'dren pa'i bdag nyid yongs gyur cing : ma mchog bzang mo'i thugs dbyings kun grol shog: gzhan yang / he ru ka dpal grong khyer du: zhes sogs smon lam rgya cher bya/ gsang ba ye shes bsnyen bsgrub kyi zur 'debs su mthun mtshams mdzes rgyan pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba kho bo'i lcam dga' ba mos bskul ngor dang nyams len khyad du bde chen snying rje ye shes 'od mchog stsal lam klong shar lho'i tshom bur bsrel ba'i grol ye shes kyi sbyar zhing / slar yang smon lam sho lo tha ma gnyis tshe dbang yid bzhin nor bu nas bsab pa'o/ /yi ge pa ni pad+ma skyabs kyis byas so/ /rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rjes bdag ho ru ka dpal grong khyer du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchod pa yis: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus kun: dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /dge'o/ /khog /mkha' 'gro kun gyi yang snying gsang ba ye shes 'khor lo'i bshags bskangs dkyil 'khor kun khyab dgyes byed dri med klong yangs dngos grub mchog gi char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /chos nyid gsang ba dmigs su med pa'i don/ /lhan skyes ye shes 'pho 'gyur yongs bral ba/ /bde chen mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed byed phar phyin ma/ /gsang ba'i bdag mo khrag 'thung yongs kyi rje/ /mi gnas btsun mo lam du byed pa yi/ /gsang chen don gyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi/ /bshags bskang cho ga'i dkyil 'khor rim pa 'dir/ /'jug par 'dod tshe phyi yi 'du ba dus/ /brgyad dang nyer gnyis nya stong bcu yin la/ /dus der nang kyang rtsa khams rim rgyas ste/ /des na rten 'brel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyang rgyu/ /de tshe rnal 'byor tshogs gtor mchod pa'i rdzas/ /gang 'dzom bzang bshams spyan gzigs dag kyang bkram/ /khyad par sman raka bla med mchod bkod nas/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyang gsang skra spyi bor bcings/ /ho ru'i chas bcas bag dro byin chags shing / /dha ki'i las gzhung dzasra bcas yongs grub nas/ /rigs bzang khye'u pho mo khrus byas shing / /dri bzang byug shing rgyan gos gsar pas brgyan/ /dpral bar sin dhu'i thig 536

le bkod byas te/ /tshogs dkyil gar gyis dal bus g.yas bskor du/ /bskor zhing dbyangs tshig ring snyan 'gyur bcas gyis/ /o āḥ r+ghaṃ/ trīḥ maḥ ha ri ni saḥ ra tsa hri yaḥ dzaḥ hūṃḥ sa ma ya shud+dha shudha ā ho: zhes dang dha ki'i yi ge brgya pa ni/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ trīḥ maḥ ha ri/ ni sa dhā ki ni badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra dhā ki ni sa twa twe no pa tiḥ ṭha lha ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid rnyi me pra yaḥ tsa/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shrī ya ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥ rgyu phaṭa: zhes pa ming tshig ma 'dres brgya rtsa las/ /mi nyung khye'u pho mo'i dbyangs snyan bcas/ /rnal 'byor tshogs bcas kun gyi gang mang bzla/ /de rjes rnal 'byor rnams kyi sgo gsum nyid/ /gus pas nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nyes byas rnams/ /'di la gnong 'gyod rab tu drag po yi/ /lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags bsam 'di skad brjod/ /hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo mchog /gsang ba'i bdag po dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso/ /bla med thugs rje'i mdzod 'dzin che ba'i dpal/ /rdo rje slob dpon rig pa 'dzin pa che/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /ma lus bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni gsang sngags zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas/ /'da' dka' rdo rje dam tshig blang bgyid ste/ /ma rig 'khrul pas las dang nyon mongs kyi/ /dbang gyur sku gsung thugs yon rtsa ba dang / /yan lag dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams so 'tshal/ /rang gnongatshu'agyod pa'i sems kyi mthol lo bshags/ /bdag ni thogs med nas 'khrul bag chags dbang / /tshor dang ma tshor nyams chags rgyur gyur kun/ /thugs rje chen po ye shes spyan snga ru/ /bshags par bgyid do tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /'gro spyi pha ma rdo rje spun sring dang / /rang gi lus la brdeg btsog dka' thub bgyis/ /dmad dang bag med tho co 'chal spyod kyis/ /bla ma'i spyan sngar mi mdzes la gyur rgyu/ /sku yi sgrib ma 'gong dang sgeg 'chos spyod/ /zhabs tog ma bgyis ji bzhin lam ma song / /rtsa ba sku yi dam tshig nyams chags rgyur/ /'gal 'khrul gyur kun gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags/ /'gro la sems dkrugs zhe gcod tshig smras dang / /chos smra don sgom rnal 'byor la gshe bskur/ /rdo rje spun sring bla ma'i nye 'khor gyi/ /snyan du tshig rtsub smras dang bka' cher bcag /khyad par bla ma'i gsung bsnyas bka' las 'das/ /bka' gcog log rtog ngan pa'i dbang gyur pa/ /rtsa ba gsung gi dam tshig nyams chag gyur/ /'gal 'khrul gyur kun gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags/ /'gro la bag med gnod sems gdug byams dang / /spyod pa bag med tho co bsgom pa la/ /bying rgod gol sgrib lta ba rtag chad mthar/ /ltung dang lta bsgom yi dam rjes ma dran/ /khyad par bla mar brtse gdung chung ba dang / /thugs dkrug thugs su ran par ma gyur sogs/ /rtsa ba thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag rgyur/ /537

'gal 'khrul gyur kun gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags/ /gzhan yang gsang bar 'os pa gsang sngags rdzas/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi bhan phur rdo rje dril/ /bla med dkyil 'khor gzugs bsnyan yo byad rnams/ /theg dman skal med rnams la bstan pa dang / /gsang bar gnyer gtad rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /spang dang bsgrub par bka' lung gnang ba yi/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsrung mtshams rnams/ /ji ltar khas blang tshor dang ma tshor nyams/ /gsang bar khas blang rdo rje slob dpon mched/ /nor 'khrul gsang spyod rigs su mi rung dang / /bsgrub rten las rgya gsang sngags gsang ba'i tshig /bab chol 'chol pas gzhan la brjod gyur cing / /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mtha' dag kun/ /bdag rmongs mi shes bag med nor dang 'khrul/ /dbang gyur nyams chag ral pa'i rgyur gyur rnams/ /mthol zhing bshags so byang zhing dag gyur cig /'dor na rtsa ba yan lag slob dpon gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam dang 'gal 'khrul zhing / /yi dam lha yi sngags dang ting 'dzin g.yel/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dus mchod gtor ma chag /de sogs phral dang yun gyi sgrib gyur cing / /na raka chen po'i rgyu bsags mtha' dag kun/ /gnong 'gyod drag pos rab tu bshags pa na/ /mi sgrib tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsol/ /hoḥ chos rnams thams cad rang rig nyid las byung / /rang rig stong nyid spros mtshan kun las 'das/ /ma skyes ma 'gags bsam bzhin brjod du med: de nyid dbyings su nyes pa'i skyon bral kyang / /glo bur sems byang dri ma'i rang bzhin las/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du gyur pa yi/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i rgyu bsags thams cad pa/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i dbyings su bshags par bgyi/ /bshags dang bshags bya gnyis gnang 'dzin pa na/ /nges don snying po'i don la nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bshags dang bshags bya dbyer med ro gcig ngang / /dri bral gdod nas dag pa ka dag che/ /bzung 'dzin gnyis snang rtog tshogs yongs dag par/ /lhun rdzogs chos nyid klong du rab tu bshags/ /chos kun lhan skyes sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i klong du dag gyur cig /ces brjod cing rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi don dam lta ba'i klong du bshags dang bshags bya med kyang kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa kun snying nas gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags so/ /de nas tshogs 'khor gyi skabs la babs pa'i tshe/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bla med dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyi nang gsang ba spyi dang khyad par gyi thugs dam bskang ba dang / de kho na nyid don dam rang byung blta bas bskang ba dang gnyis te/ thog mar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyi dang khyad par gyi bskang ba ni/ rnal 'byor rnams chas gos bag dro brjid ldan stag sprod rkang gling rol mo bcas te spos chen bsreg la 'di skad do/ /hriḥ maḥ chos dbyings phyogs bral mkha' klong yangs pa ru/ /dus mnyam rgyun chad med par rtag gsal sku/ /bde bar gshegs gyur sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed yum 538

mkha' 'gro ma/ /dur khrod bdag mo srid pa'i ma mo mchog /gsang ba'i bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dbyings kyi rgyal mo dzñā na dhā ki che/ /yab yum sras 'khor rigs kyi dbang mo'i tshogs/ /gnas yul he ru 'jig 'das dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro bsrung ma zhing gi rdul snyed dpung / /bla med gsang dkyil mu ran skyong bcas dang / /rdo rje slob dpon rig 'dzin rgyud sde 'bum/ /ma lus chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /skur bzhengs thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'dir byon la/ /rang snang dag pa'i mos blos legs bkod pa'i/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /sgo gsum rab dwangs rdul snyed phyag 'tshal zhing / /dag pa'i mchod sprin dpag gi mi langs bar/ /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin kho na nyid/ /rab tu sprul nas mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /mi sgribs tshangs dbang mchog gi dngos grub dang / /thun mong 'phrin las rnam pa sna tshogs sogs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i sid dhi rnams/ /thog pa med par dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dzñā na dhā ki ni sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pa ju puṣ+pe dhuṣ+pe ā lo ke ghadhe nai wi r+ya shabhā pu dza hoḥ rū pa shabhā ghadhe ra sa spar+sha pu dza rgyu/ pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha lo ta khā hi/ bho dhi tsista ga na gu h+ya pū dza a: hriḥ maḥ bka' gsang gsang ba las kyang cher gsang ba'i/ /'gran bral rmad byung bla med ma dkyil 'khor/ /zla gam mkha' la byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs pa'i/ /rdo rje rig 'dzin rgyud tshogs bskang ba ni/ /rig bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas so sor rtogs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rdo rje 'chang / /tshe 'od dpag med mgon po snang mtha' yas/ /dam pa rig brgyas bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /'gro ba 'dul mdzad ngal med thugs rje'i gter/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das/ /'od zer dpal brtsegs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /chags med 'gro don phrin las yongs kyi mdzod/ /zhi khro'i nyams can dbang mdzad dbang gi lha/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gsung mchog pad+ma rgyal/ —/dpa' bo dhā kis bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs phrin dpal/ /zhi khro gar bsgyur rol mdzad rdo rje 'chang / /rang byung 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin gyis bskor thugs dam bskang / /ma rung log 'dren tshar gcod gtum drag sku/ /rab 'jigs che mchog mi yi phreng ba can/ /dpal chen bdud 'dul rdo rje khro bo lod/ /sgrub khro brgyad kyis bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /kun tu bzang mo'i thugs rje'i rol pa las 'gro don bskur snang dus bzhi rgyal ba'i yum/ /bde chen ye shes dhā ki mtsho rgyal ma/ /bod grub nyer lngas bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes brtse ba'i zhal/ /mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug dri med mchog gi sku/ /grub dbang be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ /grub thob rgya mtshos bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /gu ru'i thugs kyi gan mdzod zab gsang mchog /sgo dbye mthar thugs ka dag don gyis gter/ /ston mdzad kun bzang sgyu 'phrul bde chen gling / /gter ston brgya rtsas bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /539

mchog gi smin grol chos kyi cod paṇa nyid/ /spyi blugs bcings byas don gnyis grub pa'i dpal/ /rgyal ba'i sras gyur pad+ma dbang gi rgyal/ /chos bdag rgya mtsho bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /rdo rje slob dpon byin rlabs thugs la shar/ /zab bcud yang dag snying po'i don byan 'byor/ /man ngag lung ston tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ /brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /gdams pa ma lus 'bo zab med pa ru/ /thugs kyi bum pa bzang por yongs gtam nas/ /skal ldan don mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma rje/ /rgyud 'dzin rgya mtshos bskor ba'i thugs dam bskang / /sngon nas smon lam the chog bzang po'i mthus/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor gnyan po gcig drung tshogs/ /gdams pa mnyams mnos dam tshig lu gu rgyud/ /rdo rje mched lcam tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan bskang dam rdzas ni/ /lha rdzas phyi mchod/ hriḥ ma stong nyid ye shes nyag gcig dbyings nyid las/ /chos sku mtshon bral dmigs su med gyur kyang / /snying rje'i rol pa 'od gsol bde ba che/ /gzugs sku lhan zhing sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /me dpung rdo rje'i ra bas gtam pa'i dbus/ /'od zer dmar po rab tu bkrigs pa'i dbus/ /chos 'byung dmar nag zla gam dbang dkyil nas/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs bskang ba ni/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo dus bzhi yongs kyi bdag /ma skyes btsun mo 'gags pa med pa'i dpal/ /yongs khyab bcom ldan 'das ma chen po ste/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba ye shes ma/ /klong yangs brdal ba 'od gsal rab 'byams che/ /gar brgya'i 'phrul can chags med dmar ba'i sku/ /gang 'dul zhi ma khro tshul mdzes pa'i nyams/ /ma rig log rtog dpung 'joms khros pa'i ma/ /chos dbyings bde chen mchog gi phag gdong mo/ /lhan skyes brjod 'das bha ga yangs pa che/ /'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po dbang gi yum//'phrin las mthar phyin ngan 'gro kun sgrol ma/ /'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyi 'khor los rdzis/ /bde ba'i sgra skad srid pa kun tu sgrog /mi bde sdug bsngal gtan nas brlag byed pa/ /thog ma'i sangs rgyas nyid las sngon byung zhing / /ral pa nyag gcig gzhi 'bras nyid dbyings bskyod/ /'khor 'das gyur kun mkha' ru sgrol bar mdzad/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung a la la chen po'i/ /gad rgyang sgrogs pas log rtog dman zil gnon/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /che btsan 'gran zla yongs bral bla med mo/ /dgongs spyod rgya mtsho dpag med bha ga las/ /gang 'dul gzugs sku'i rol pas rtag rol zhing / /'od gsal rab 'byams klongs chen bha ga'i dbyings/ /rig pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi lang 'char/ /chos nyid spros bral lhun rdzogs bha ga'i mkhar/ /sprul pa'i cho rol mu mtha' las klas 'gyed/ /snang zhing srid kun yum gyi bha ga'i klong / /sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho mtha' yas bkod pa'i bdag /rnam 'gyur sku yi dhā ki oṃ skyes dkar/ /gsung gi dh+wa ki baṃ skyes dmar mo'i sku/ /thugs kyi dhā ki hrīḥ las skye nag mo/ /de la 540

sogs te mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /bde chen dkar mo don kun grub pa ser/ /sgra sgrogs dmar mo mtha' ru phyin byed ljang / /khros ma nag mo ye shes chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs gyur sna tshogs sprul/ /bdud 'dul drag mo dam tshig yongs kyi bdag /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin sprul bsam mi khyab/ /ston pa'i bdag nyid bde gshegs mkha' 'gro ma/ /gtso mchog gsang ba ye shes thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang / /trīḥ maḥ blo 'das yongs khyab 'og min chos kyi dbyings / /gnyis snang las 'das phung khams dag pa che/ /rab 'byams bkod pa rdul snyed zhing gi khams/ /bdag sogs mos blos snang ngor gdul bya'i don/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i dbus/ /oḍān dbang gi gnas chen che yi klong / /bde bar gshegs pas rtag tu rol pa'i yum/ /bla med don gyi pho brang chen po der/ /stong nyid zag pa med pa'i dbyings rum nas/ /bde chen yang dag mchog tu dgyes pa'i sku/ /lhan skyes brjod bsam smra ba'i yul 'das pa/ /kun tu bzang mo klong gsal rab 'bar ma/ /gsang ba'i bdag mo ye shes dbang po che/ /sor rtog dbyings shar gsung gi dhā ki ma/ /'gro 'dul chags pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa la/ /rig bzhi'i gtso mo'i 'khor du bskor ba ni/ haḥ shar phyogs bsil tshal rtse mo bde chen nas/ /'gyur med snyems ma badz+ra dhā ki ma/ /skyed skyed chos sku lta ba'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /rdo rje'i rigs yum gsang mtshan bskyed byed ma/ /rnam shes rtsad gcod chu khams rnam par dag /zhe sdang rang grol zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /rdo rje rigs kyis mkha' 'gro grangs med bskor/ /dbang mo me long ma yi thugs dam bskang / /riḥ lho phyogs gad rgyang ro 'dus longs spyod nas/ /'phel byed ma ki rat+na dhā ki ni/ /'gags med longs sku bsgom pa'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /rin chen rig yum gsang mtshan sreg byed ma/ /tshor phung rtsad gcod sa khams rnam par dag /nga rgyal rang grol rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro grangs med bskor/ /dbang mo mnyam nyid ma yi thugs dam bskang / /niḥ nub phyogs pad 'khyil skyed byed sprul dkyil nas/ /'gug byed gos dkar pad+ma dhā ki ni/ /zung 'jug sprul sku spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /pad+ma rigs yum gsang mtshan rmongs byed ma/ /'du shes rtsad gcod me khams rnam par dag /'dod chags rang grol dbang gi 'phrin las mdzad/ /pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro grangs med bskor/ /dbang mo sor rtog ma yi thugs dam bskang / /saḥ byang phyogs ki la gsang ba bde skyongs nas/ /sgrol byed dam tshig karma dhā ki ni/ /mthar thug ngo bo 'bras bu'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /las kyi rigs yum gsang mtshan tsasgri ka /'du byed rtsad gcod rlung khams rnal 'byor dag /phrag dog rang grol drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro grangs med bskor/ /dbang mo bya grub ma yi thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ dbang mo ye shes dbyings la mnga' 541

brnyes shing / /'gro 'dul rigs kyi gtso mor skur ston nas/ /dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer rab 'khrigs dbus/ /'byung khams gnas dag dga' bzhi ye shes dag /mdzes pa'i nyams la cung zad khros pa'i tshul/ /du ma'i rgyan ldan gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur/ /sprul dang yang sprul da ya bye ba 'bum/ /grangs med 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ hrīḥ maḥ zla gam dmar nag gsum brtsegs dkyil 'khor lter/ /pad+ma nyi zla 'bar dkyil baṃ gyi steng / /bde chen chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' klong dbus/ /thugs rje chen po ye shes sems dpa'i sku/ /'gro don 'phrin las mang mdzad khros pa'i dpal/ /pad+ma gsung mchog rdo rje chos rta skad/ /nyon mongs rtsad gcod khams gsum dbang mdzad lha/ /yab gcig dpa' bo rta mgrin thugs dam bskang / /trīḥpho brang thod mkhar dgu rtsegs 'bar ba'i dbus/ /'phrin las bzhi bdag rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i yab/ /nyon mongs rtsad gcod rab 'jigs khro bo'i sku/ /dpa' bo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /raḥ shar phyogs dur khrod zhe sdang me 'bar dkyil/ /'jigs tshul snying rje'i bdag nyid me long sku/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo thugs dam bskangs/ /tsaḥ lho phyogs dur khrod nga rgyal brag 'khrigs dkyil/ /nga rgyal tshul gyi nga rgyal 'joms mdzad khro/ /'jigs tshul snying rje'i bdag nyid mnyam nyid sku/ /rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ nub phyogs dur khrod 'dod chags chu 'khol dkyil/ /'dod chags tshul gyi 'dod chags 'joms mdzad khro/ /'jigs tshul snying rje'i bdag nyid sor rtog sku/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang / /yāḥ byang phyogs dur khrod phrag dog rlung 'tshub dkyil//phrag dog tshul gyi phra dog 'joms mdzad khro/ /'jigs tshul snying rje'i bdag nyid bya grub sku/ /karma rigs kyi dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang / /kun kyang rang rtags khro bo dpal chas rdzogs/ /rigs kyi khro bo grangs med dbus na bzhugs/ /'phrin las mthar phyin thugs rje'i gdugs pa 'dul/ /khrag 'thung khro chen 'bar tshogs thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ hriḥ maḥbla med gsang dkyil chos 'byung zla gam dbus/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa yi/ /phyi rim pad+ma'i 'phreng ba gsum rim du/ /bskor ba'i nang gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /bde chen bkod pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas/ /nye ru ka yi gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ /mkha' spyod thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo yab yum bcu drug bskang ba ni/ /su ri ma la ya yi gnas mchog nas/ /dpa' bo thod dbyugs dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ /dza lan da ra'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo keng rus dpa' mo gtum mig ma/ /o rgyan rang byung gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo keng rus gtum dpa' mo 'od ldan/ /a pur ta yi gnas mchog 542

dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo mche gcigs dpa' mo rna chen ma/ /gro tra sa ra'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo su ra bho dpal mo bsten blo/ /ra mo ra sha'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo 'od dpag dpa' mo mi thub ma/ /de wa ko tra'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor 'od dpa' mo lang dbang phyug /ma la ya yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor sku dpa' mo shing grib ma/ /thugs gsang bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag /snang ba'i rang ngo thabs mchog dpa' bo brgyad/ /stong nyid mnga' bdag shes rab dpa' mo brgyad/ /yab yum 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /pad 'phreng rim gsum bar gyi 'dab brgyad pa/ /ro 'dus longs spyod gzhal yas zhing nye zhing / /tsharjo nye tshan sa spyod gsung dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo yab yum bcu drug bskang ba ni/ /ka ma ru yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor myug dpa' mo sa bsrung ma/ /aut+tha ra yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rngor ral dpa' mo rna chen ma/ /tri shang kun dga'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rab dga' dpa' mo rlung shug ma/ /ko sa la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo dpal r+ghaṃḥ dpa' mo chang 'thung ya/ /ka ling ka yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ dpa' bor rab bzang dpa' mo gtsug phud ma/ /lam po ka yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor bzang dpa' mo rab bzang ma/ /gā dzi la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor 'dzin dpa' mo rta sna ma/ /ho ma la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo spyan mi bzang dpa' mo khu gdong / /gsung mchog bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /snang ba'i rang ngo thabs mchog dpa' mo brgyad/ /stong nyid mnga' bdag shes rab dpa' mo brgyad/ /yab yum 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /pad 'phreng rim gsum phyi yi 'dabs brgyad la/ /brten byed sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'du nye 'du/ /dur khrod nye dur sa 'og spyod sku dkyil/ /dpa' bo yab yum bcu drug bskang ba ni/ /pre ta pu ri'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo stobs chen dpa' mo shugs 'chang ma/ /s+t+waṃ wa de we'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor ring dpa' mo dung skyong ma/ /sa wan ta yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rta mgrin dpa' mo glang sna ma/ /sa'u ra yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo nam snying dpa' mo 'khor go cha/ /na ga ra yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo he ru dpa' mo rab gsal ma/ /sid+dha yul gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo pad gar dpa' mo stobs ldan ma/ /ma rdu ra yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rnam snang dpa' mo 'khor bsgyur ma/ /ku lu ta yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpa' bo rdor sems dpa' mo brtson 'grus ma/ /sku mchog bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag /snang ba'i rang ngo thabs mchog dpa' bo brgyad/ /stong nyid mnga' bdag shes rab dpa' mo brgyad/ /543

yab yum 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /de ltar bla med ye shes mkha' 'gro yi/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas dpa' bo yab dang yum/ /gang 'dul skur snang gtso mchog dpal gyi 'phrul/ /'khor 'das yongs khyab thugs rje snang ba'i gzugs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /cha lugs ma nges du ma ston byas shing / /dam ldan skyong zhing dam nyams sgrol mdzad pa/ /'khor tshogs grangs med bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ spyoḥ gsang chen chos 'byung zla gam eḥ yi klong / /dkyil 'khor dur khrod mi zad gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bzhir gdug pa 'dul byed 'phrin las bdag /ye shes bsrung ma bzhi po bskang ba ni/ /dzaḥ shar phyogs 'gugs byed lcags kyu ma/ /lha mo dkar gsal dbu ni kha ta'i gdong / /lha bu'i bdud 'joms tshad med 'phrin las bdag /badz+ra kai ka ma yi thugs dam bskang / /r+ghaṃḥ lho sgor 'ching byed rdo rje zhags pa ma/ /lha mo ser mo dbu ni phag gi gdong / /'chi bdag bdud 'joms tshad med byams pa'i bdag /badz+ra puk+ka ma yi thugs dam bskang / /baṃḥ nub sgor sdom byed rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /lha mo dmar nag dbu ni khyi yi gdong / /nyon mongs bdud 'joms tshad med dga' ba'i bdag /badz+ra shwa na ma yi thugs dam bskang / /hoḥ byang sgor dgyes byed rdo rje dril bu ma/ /lha mo ljang gu dbu ni 'ug pa'i gdong / /phung po'i bdud 'joms tshad med gtang snyoms bdag /badz+ra hū lu ma yi thugs dam bskang / /pho brang mtshams bzhir gar mkhan las byed ma/ /khro 'dzum lha mo phyed gzugs 'dzin pa mo/ /thugs rje phyed pa'i skur sprul 'gro ba 'dul/ /mtshams bzhi'i lha mo'i thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /shar sgor brtan byed dkar ser phyed gzugs 'dzin/ /lho nub pho nya ser dmar phyed gzugs 'dzin/ /nub byang mche ba dmar ljang phyed gzugs 'dzin/ /byang shar 'joms byed ljang dkar phyed gzugs 'dzin/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro sgo mtshams bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /kun kyang rang 'dra'i sprul pa bye bas bskor/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin mngon spyod tshul bstan bsrung / /ye shes sgo mtshams 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ r+ghaṃḥ trīḥ bla med dkyil 'khor pho brang phyi rol na/ /me dpung rdo rje ra bas bskor ba'i nang / /tshogs brgyad rnam rtog shug las grub pa yi/ /rang byung dur khrod brgyad tshogs bskang ba ni/ /shar phyogs rab 'jigs gtum drag dur khrod nas/ /mi phyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum/ /lho phyogs gad rgyang sgrogs pa'i dur khrod nas/ /gzi ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ser mo 'bum/ /nub phyogs pad+ma 'khyil ba'i dur khrod nas/ /dri med pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'bum/ /byang phyogs ki la sgrogs pa'i dur khrod nas/ /bde chen las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang mo 'bum/ /shar lho rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas/ /mi 'das dam tshig btang 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /lho nub rab 544

tu gtum pa'i dur khrod nas/ /mi thub sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i dhā ki 'bum/ /nub byang rab tu dhu ba'i dur khrod nas/ /kun rgyu thams cad mkha' 'gro log 'dren 'bum/ /byang shar drag shul can gyi dur khrod nas/ /rgyud 'dzin 'jig rten mkha' 'gro las byed 'bum/ /gzhan yang rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po der/ /rang byung mchod rten brgyad na phyogs skyong brgyad/ /shing brgyad zhing skyong chu brgyad klu chen brgyad/ /ri brgyad drang srong sprin brgyad lha mo brgyad/ /ro brgyad phra men me brgyad shug 'gro brgyad/ /nags tshal brgyad la rnal 'byor grub chen brgyad/ /bya brgyad stag gzig lce spyang brgyad la sogs/ /sprul 'khor bsam gyis mi lang grangs med bcas/ /nyin mtshan dus drug khams gsum khyab nyul zhing / /dam ldan yongs skyong dam tshig nyams pa yi/ /tshe srog rol mdzad ma lus 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam bskang ngo 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ trīḥgazhan yang rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha yi tshogs/ /rgyal ba dgongs rgyud rig 'dzin brda rgyud dang / /gang zag snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i rgyud/ /smon lam gter rgyud shog ser tshig gi rgyud/ /bka' babs lung bstan byin rlabs dbang bskur brgyud/ /dus gsum byon pa'i bka' brgyud bsgrub brgyud dang / /zhal mjal gsung thos gdams ngag chos 'brel zhing / /man ngag lung ston rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs/ /rig grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /rgyu trīḥ chos sku skye med dbyings las 'gags med sku/ /'bar ba zhi dang khro sogs dpag med pa/ /kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa'i tshogs/ /lcam bral thub drug sgo ba la sogs pa/ /rdo rje dbyings gyur dam pa rigs brgya dang / /de nyid rigs lnga gsang chen rigs gcig rgyal/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul 'byams klas bdag /yi dam zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /thugs rje'i klong nas khro gar dgu rol ba/ /che mchog yang dag 'jam dpal rta mchog phur/ /bla med dregs 'dul stobs ldan bka' 'khor bcas/ /yi dam khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /gsang gshin dgra 'jigs bla na med pa pha/ /bde dgyes thod gur sgyu ma bla med ma/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bla med gnyis med rgyal/ /rgyud sde rab 'byams yi dam thugs dam bskang / /don gyi dbyings su mnyam nyid ro gcig ngang / /gang 'dul snang ngor grangs med ston mdzad cing / /sprul pa'i glog bsgyur rig kyi zhi khro'i tshogs/ /yab yum sras 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang / /r+ghaṃḥgliḥ 'phrin las kun bsgrub rten 'brel yongs kyi dpal/ /rnal 'byor dam ldan skyongs ba'i mthu mo che/ /bsgrub pa'i drod nyul bar chad sel mdzad ma/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /gdod ma nyid nas bde stong lhan skyes ma/ /rten 'brel gdul bya'i snang ngor zhing skyes tshogs/ /phung khams sbyangs dag sngags skyes dh+wa ki ma/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam 545

bskang / /dbyings dang ye shes bde chen mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnas gsum he ru 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das dang phyi nang rten 'brel las byung ba'i/ /grangs med mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /skal ldan bu la dngos grub myur stsol zhing / /nyams pa'i tshe srog dbugs la mnga' mdzad ma/ /kun tu rgyu gyur mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /thugs dam bskang ngo 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /trīḥbaskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ spyiḥ bskal pa rab 'jigs me klong 'bar ba nas/khams gsum srid pa'i gnas nas ma rungs pa/ /log 'dren gdul pa'i dgra gdon bgegs kyi tshogs/ /'joms mdzad 'phags mchog shin tu khros pa'i sku/ /'jigs tshogs 'jigs byed nag po khro bo'i rgyal/ /zhal ni bcu gcig ha la'i mdangs 'bar zhing / /phyag stong gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phro/ /spyan stongs khro gar 'jig rten kun gang 'gyed/ /me dpung 'jigs sgra rgyu phaṭaḥ sod rgyob kyis/ khams gsum g.yo zhing srid gsum 'dar bar byed/ /sa gsum gdug pa'i tshogs kun brlag byed pa/ /dpal chen 'jigs byed nag po'i thugs dam bskang / /zhing bcu mtha' dmag 'byung po rgya 'dre dang / /rgyal bsen klu gnyan 'gong po gzhob rdul du/ /brlags phyir sprul pa las byed khro 'khor ni/ /ye shes me yi tsha tsha 'khrug pa'i klong / /bde gshegs sku yi bdag nyid gshin rje gshed/ /gsung dbang rta mchog dmar nag khros pa'i sku/ /thugs mchog gsang bdag lag na rdo rje 'chang / /bla med shin tu khros ma nag mo che/ /gdug pa'i srog 'byin yak+ṣa me dbal sogs/ /rab tu mi bzod me ltar 'bar ba che/ /khro bo khro mo grangs med 'khor gyi bskor/ /yab yum sprul bcas ma lus thugs dam bskang / /dmigs med klong na brtse ba'i ba'i snying rje can/ /rab tu zhi bas 'dul min gdug pa las/ /cher brtses shin tu khros pa 'jigs byed nag /khro rgyal rab 'byams rgya mcho'i thugs dam bskang / /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings me 'bar dur khrod chen po nas/ /he ru ka dpal khros pa'i rang mdangs las/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyan bsrung mthu rtsal can/ /ma mgon lcam dral tshogs rnams bskang ba ni/ /nag po chen po 'jigs byed khro gtum can/ /bzlog pas mi bzlog dgra bgegs yongs kyi gshed/ /drag sngags yongs bdag pha lam ma ning nag /ye shes mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskang //sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las ye shes mgon/ /las dang dam tshig sha za mgon po che/ /srog bdud trag shad za klu ma ning nag /yab yum sras 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang / /phyag bzhi phyag drug legs ldan gur gyi mgon/ /tshogs bdag ber nag mi'u thung a 'go ra/ /srin mgon gdong bzhi bya seng 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam bskang ngo 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /r+ghaṃ bh+yoḥ bskal pa rlung nag 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /kun tu bzang mo ye shes tshogs kyi rje/ /rdo rje ral gcig e ka tsakyu 546

ma/ /dbyings kyi ma mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las sprul pa yi/ /ma mo bye ba drug 'bum snying 'phrog drug /gdong bzhi ma mo nyer brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /thugs dam bskang ngo 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /r+ghaṃḥbh+yoḥ rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i me dpung klong shed nas/ /gsang yes khros ma lha mo 'bar gdong dmar/ /tsit+ta dug 'thung gdug pa kun gyi gshed/ /las kyi ma mo 'bum bcas thugs dam bskang / /shan pa srog grub nam gru mched de bdun/ /rang byung rgyal mo dung skyong re ma ti/ /spyang gzhon ngan ne la sogs ma mo'i tshogs/ /thugs dam bskang ngo 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /rgyuḥbh+yoḥ rgyal ba'i bka' skyong dam tshig gnyanachi bsrung zhing / /bstan pa'i bya ra bsgrub pa'i drod 'dzin pa/ /dam nyams bstan dgra'i srog gi spu gri nag /dpa' gtum bdud mgon legs grub rdo rje yab/ /yum chen srin ra baṃ ro pho mo 'khor/ /dregs pa sde brgyad bdud tshogs pho nyar bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan bskang ban dgra nang rgyas sgrol/ /rgyu bh+yoḥ gza' mchog rnam sras rdor legs bdud btsan klu/ /sngags bdag bco brgyad sde dpon che sum cu/ /rdzong btsan mi srun 'bar ba mched bdun dang / /dge bsnyen nyer gcig brtan ma mo bcu gnyis/ /nor lha gter bdag gnas bsrung gzhi bdag gnyan/ /ye shes las 'jigs pho mo ma ning sde/ /zhing skyong dur bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang gyur bstan dgra dam nyams sgrol/ /trīḥbaskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po bskang ྾ trīḥ gsang chen bla med dkyil 'khor mu ran la/ /rnal 'byor grub thob pho mo mang po dang / /dpa' bo tshogs dang dpa' mo mang po'i tshogs/ /dbang mo mkha' 'gro shug 'gro ging lang ka /'bar ma ma sring 'bum phrag yang mkha' 'gro/ /sha za srin po ro langs yi dwags dang / /'byung po brjed byed log 'dren bgegs dri za/ /gdon chen la sogs snang zhing srid rigs drug /bstan skyong la sogs rang rang bu smad dang / /mdza' shes 'khor g.yog bran dang bcas pa rnams/ /thugs dam bskang ngo rang rang 'phrin las mdzod/ /trīḥ bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan bskang dam rdzas ni/ /lha rdzas phyi mchod 'jig rten maṇ+ḍal la/ /skye 'gro'i tshom bu 'dod dgu longs spyod bkram/ /'dod yon spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /rang byung nang mchod sna tshogs gzugs sgra dri/ /ro reg chos mchog sman gtor rak+ta tshogs/ /ya mtshan brda phyag rgya gar bsgyur sogs/ /ma spangs ngo tshar mchod pa thugs dam bskang / /ta na thabs sbyor ga na sgrol dam rdzas/ /chags med mnyams sbyor zag bral bde ba che/ /dmigs med stong par 'khrul snang yongs sgrol ba'i/ /khyad par bla med mchog gi thugs dam bskang / /dbang po'i me tog sha chen du pa'i thin/ /tshil chen snang gsal khrag khris dri yon chab/ /sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra/ /gsang ba smad byung rdzas kyi thugs dam 547

bskang / /mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan mkha' lding bya/ /shel sgong lug dang rtsa ra za le 'bri/ /zhun me sha chen lang ling 'bru bcud bshos/ /sha snying khrag sna bskang ba'i rdzas kyi bskang / /mnyam gzhag me tog rtsal snang shugs grol dri/ /rang rig 'od gsal mar me mnyam nyid chab/ /bde ba'i zhal zas brjod bral stong nyid sgra/ /bsam gtan mchog gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /gsal zhing gzung 'dzin mi gzugs mi rtog sgra/ /nyon mongs dri bral dwangs dri phra slong ro/ /mtha' grol lhun mnyam reg bya blo 'das chos/ /ting 'dzin mnyam bzhag mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /rang la gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/khams lnga rmad byung dug lnga ye shes lnga/ /'byung lnga yum chen 'khor 'das dbyer med par/ /mnyam nyid ro gcig mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /'di ltar lha tshogs bskang bskang gso gso nas/ /thugs dam gnyan po'i dgyes pa des bskong la/ /dam gsang gnyan gyur lo zla zhag dus kyi/ /'gal nyams ral pa thams cad sor chud cing / /cho ga'i lhag chad mtha' dag rdzogs gyur cig bdag gi g.yar dam gnyen po sor stsol cig mthun mongs zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhi/ khyad par phyag rgya che mchog dngos grub stsol/ /de ltar ye shes mkha' 'gro bla med dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa spyi dang khyad par gyis bskang nas/gnyis pa de kho na nyid dam rang byung lta bas bskang ba ni/ rnal 'byor mchog gi 'dra ba'i ngang du/ rgyan dang bcas te phyag rgya gar bsgyur dbyangs tshigs snyan pos/ r+ghaṃḥ gdod nas gnas pa rang rig ye shes che/ /ma skyes blo las 'das pa'i dbyings su bskang / /gdang rtsal sems byung snang zhing srid pa'i chos/ /'gags med mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings su bskang / /don dam brjod 'das bsam du med gyur pa/ stong nyid ye shes chos kyi dbyings su bskang / kun rdzob 'char snang rgyan gyi rol pa che/ /sna tshogs rten cing 'brel pa dbyings su bskang / /'khor ba kun kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i klong / /rang grol ye bzhengs chen po'i ngang du bskang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i rig pa so ma nyid/ /re dogs brdzun 'khris yal ba'i mkha' ru bskang / /r+ghaṃḥ mtha' bral spros med ka nas dag pa yi/ /dmigs med lta ba klong du gyur pas bskang / /yongs 'khrul gzung 'dzin rkyen dang bral ba yi/ /bsgom med bsgom pa chen pos rab tu bskang / /bzang ngan blang dor bral ba kun tu bzang / /spyod pa sgrib bral tshul 'chos las 'das bskang / /mtshan ma kun zad rkyen bral chos kyi sku/ /'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa nyid du bskang / /hūṃḥ dngos snang stong nyid khyab brdal yangs par bskang / /shes rab gting phra gsal ba'i dbyings su bskang / /phyi nang klong gsal rab 'byams chen por bskang / /'khor 'das sku nyid zung 'jug chen por bskang / /r+ghaṃḥ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang / /sgrol ba med de 548

khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol/ /sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor/ /ye sbyor ye grol chen pos thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtogs sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig khams gsum 'khor ba stong gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /a la la hoḥ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ ho dgongs su gsol/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dbyings na bzhugs shing dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas byon pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rang rtsal rig pa'i klong nas rang byon pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma gsang ba ye shes 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rgyud sde theg pa bzhi drug la sogs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bka' bsrung pho nya las mkhan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams kyis bla med yang dag mchog gi mchod pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la brten nas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad khams gsum du 'khor zhing rigs drug gi duḥ kha la spyod pa rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nyes ltung thams cad kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i klong du kha bskang zhing bde chen chos nyid kyi dbyings su sor chud par gyur cig /ma hā sid rnyi sa ma ya aḥ zhes pas bskang zhing / 'di lta bu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshags bskang 'di'i dus su rnal 'byor rnams kyi tha mal gyi tshul bag med pa dang cung zad kyang ma 'dres par rang rig hur phyung zhing rang mdangs kyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba gsum dang mi bral bar mnyam rjes thugs 'phrad du bskyong zhing gang shar zhen 'khris med par rang ngor rtsis zin bzhin bab chags par re dogs med cing dgag sgrub blang dor dang bral bar chos nyid rig pa zangs thal chen mo la bzla ste/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas ni cir snang lta ba gang shar bsgoms pa gang byas spyod pa gang yang 'bras bu chen por grol nas/ dpal gsang ba ye shes kyi lam la byang mthus thugs klong gsal bar chub ste/ gnas skabs su thun mong dang / mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub stsol med du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /e ma bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /rmad byung ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dgyes byed/ /don dam gnyis med mnyam pa nyid gyur pa/ /ro gcig lhun rdzogs dbyings su bshags dang bskang / /yongs su bral kyang kun rdzogs sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /ji bzhin klong nas 'gag med rten 'brel cha/ /rol pa rgya mtsho dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs/ /bskang dang nyes nongs bshags pa'i rim pa ni/ /rab 'byams kun khyab dgyes byed 'phrin las che/ /bdag nyid dri ma yongs su dag byed cing / /dzñā na dhā ki'i mkha' klong yangs dkyil nas/ /dngos grub mchog gi char 'bebs 'di bkod pa'i/ /nyes pa'i rgyur gyur gzhung don 'gal 'khrul nor/ /mchis kun rab gshags mkha' 'gros bzod bzhes shing / /legs gyur dge bas 'gro kun la bsngo na/ /phyam gcig zab mo'i thugs dbyings grol bar shog /de ltar mkha' 'gro 549

kun gyi yangs snying gsang ba ye shes 'khor lo'i bshags bskang dkyil 'khor kun khyab dgyes byed dri med klong yangs dngos grub mchog gi char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni rang gi 'dren mchog rdo rje 'chang dbang gter chen chos kyi rje pad+ma bde chen gling pa de nyid kyi rigs chos kyi cod paṇa spyi bor bcings pa'i bdag nyid chen po rig pa 'dzin pa dpal pad+ma dbang rgyal lam/ kun bzang chos nyid klong grol ye shes mchog gi rdo rje bkas yang yang bskul ba la rten nas/ bla med ma'i dkyil 'khor du rnal 'byor 'dzin zhing rdzogs pa chen po'i lam du zhugs blo tsam du bgyid pa/ phyogs kun tu rgyu ba sngags smyon tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtsho 'am karma bstan pa mtha' rgyas/ /gsang ba'i mtshan/ rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyi gang shar lhug pa byung rgyal du rang lo nyer lnga'i sner 'khod pa'i dus o rgyan chen po'i dgongs bzhed dbyar rar 'dod pa bcom ldan 'das kyi dus 'khor ston pa'i dus chen zla ba'i/ dhā ki rgyu ba'i tshes bzang brgyad la mdo khams 'bri rgyud lci rong bswa ba gsal gyi bla brang yang rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge'i gzugs bsnyan 'char bar byed pa pad+ma skyabs kyi bgyis pa'o/ /dge'o e ma kun tu bzang mo'i mkhar/ /dge'o bdag nyid rig pa rtag tu sbyor/ /dge'o zag med bde ba chen po g.yo/ /dge'o thugs rje'i char gyi 'gro smin shog /he te/ 'di ni thugs kyi klong las rang brdol du shar ba/ dgongs gter rdo rje'i tshig byin brlabs rmad du byung ba can no/ /༄gi /rta phyag khyung gsum gyi 'dzab dgongs bzhugs/drag po dmar nag 'jig gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub thun mtshams kyi bya ba 'dzab gso mchod bstod dngos grub zhu ba ni/ bdag gis bzlas pa'i snying po mi nyams shing gong nas gong du brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med dpag tu med pa yar 'phel bar gyur cig a li ka li yig brgya ye dhar de rnams lan gsum klag la/ ho/ drag po rta phyag khyung gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyobs pa'i nus mthu/ ster ba'i dngos grub/ 'phags pa'i bden tshig la sogs pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga' bas/bdag rnal 'byor pa che ge la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus lus pa med par dus da lta nyid du rtsal bar mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta ha ya gri wa/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ khrom ga tu ṭa phroṃ phaṭaḥ rgyu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ rdu/ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ/ kā ya a gi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ ā+oṃ.ā+oṃ/ wakra a bhi ṣiñtsa ā ā ā/ tsit+ta a sgyi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ rgyu rdu/ ghu ṇa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī trī trī: zhes dbang blang la/ hūṃ/ spros bral blo 'das mnyam nyid klong yangs nas/ /550

rig pa lha mchog chos nyid zhi ba'i sku/ /ma g.yos ngang nas log 'dren gnyis snang bgegs/ /'dul mdzad stong gsal 'dzin bral drag po'i sku/ /gzhengs pas gsung gi rdo rje rta skad can/ /ye shes thugs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /chos dbyings mkhar gnas rab 'jigs rdo rje'i chu/ /dpal chen sprul gar rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs/ /mtshon bral klong nyid mnyam gnas bsgrub med ste/ /rang rig gshis kyi dbyings su 'bral med gnas/ /rang ngo shes pas mnyam nyid ro gcig tu/ /lha khyod 'grub kyang gdul bya mos snang ngor/ /ma dag dngos zhen dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dag pa rab 'byams sku gsum ye shes kyi/ /dkyil 'khor gnyen po lha mchog rta phyag khyung / /mi 'bral rdo rje gsum du khyed sgrub pas/ /ye shes lha tshogs dbyings nas gnas 'dir byon/ /dam tshig lha dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ /mos pa'i blos sprul phyi nang gsang ba dang / /grag stong 'dzab sngags snying po mchod 'bul bzhes/ /blo ldan sku la brjod bral gsung dang ldan/ /ma skyes mi 'gag khyab brdal ye shes thugs/ /mtha' bral yon tan lhun rdzogs rgyan gyi brgyan/ /phrin las mthar phyin phyag mtshan gdeng mdzad pa/ /dam tshig rang snang ha ya gyi wa'i sku/ /ye shes rig pa dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /rang stsal 'du 'phro badz+ra gha ru ṭa: chos nyid dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod/ /de ltar rang ngo dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bsnyen bsgrub mchod bstod dngos grub zhu ba ni/ /'gyur med sku dang tshangs dbyangs 'gag med gsung / 'khrul med thugs mchog re bskang yon tan dpung / /'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med rin chen nor/ /dpag med bsod nams 'phong med zas skom gos/ /'bral med phyag rgya rig chos rgyud 'dzin dang / /bdud 'dul drag sngags nus pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /mi thun 'jigs tshogs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /mthun gyur dpal kun rgyas pas dngos grub ྾ mos bzhi srid kun dbang bsgyur dngos ྾ log 'dren dgra bgegs myur sgrol dngos ྾ khyad par bdag sems 'khrul pa'i dri sangs nas/ /phung khams 'od sku lha yi phyag rgya thebs/ /dpal chen gsung gi bden nus ngag la 'grub/ /rang rig lha khyod gnyis med dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya wāka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma tsa du sirnyi pha la hūṃ dzaḥ a yu dzñā na puṣ+yo sidhi dzaḥ sa ra ma garbe sa ma ti badz+ra sirnyi pha la dzaḥ dzaḥ dge ba 'di yi myur du sgrub mchog bdag /dpal chen dmar nag 'jigs gsum 'grub gyur te/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus thams cad kun/ /de yi go 'phang mchog la 'khod par shog /ces drag po rta phyag khyung gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub thun mtshams kyi bya ba 'dzab gso mchod bstod dngos grub zhu ba'i rim pa don gyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ /rang gi slob ma bso ban pad+ma chos 'phel gyi bskul ngor/ sngags smyon tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyis rang lo nyer gsum lcags glang khyi zla'i tshes bzhir cong rong rdo rje'i brag gong du sbyar ba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /551

dge'o/ /su bha a ti he/༄ga /rta phyag smon lam bzhugs/oṃ swasti/ bcom ldan 'das rta mchog dpal/ /khyed dang 'dra 'gyur shog /dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /khyed dang 'dra 'gyur shog /'jigs byed mkha' lding dbang / /khyed dang 'dra 'gyur shog /yi dam lha mchog gsum/ /khyed dang 'dra 'gyur shog /bdud bzhi'i dpung bcom skal pa drug ldan rgyal/ /rta zhal nga ros 'khor ba yongs sgrol mdzad/ /che ba'i che mchog dbang drag he ru ka /yi dam dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso mchog dpal/ /'od dpag med mgon khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ji 'dra bar/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs gyur par shog /rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs kyi dpal/ /mtha' dag yongs 'dzin lha yi lha chen po/ /gsang ba sa yi dbang phyug rgyud kun bdag /ma rung gdug pa 'joms mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi 'khrugs khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po'i ji 'dra bar/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs gyur par shog /dpal gyi rnam 'phrul rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ /ma rung dregs pa mtha' dag 'joms byed pa/ /mkha' lding dbang phyug thogs med rdzu 'phrul can/ /gang 'dul phrin las sna tshogs ston mdzad pa/ /rdo rje can gyur khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ji 'dra bar/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs gyur par shog /yi dam lha mchog rab 'byams rgya mtsho yi/ /ngo bo gcig 'dus drag po lha gsum sku/ /rta mchog pad+ma dbang dang gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje khyung chen drag shul mthu stobs can/ /lhag pa'i lhar gyur khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ji 'dra bar/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs gyur par shog /zhes pa 'di yang glo bo rgyal mo dad pa can khri lcam nor 'dzin dbang po dang / rgyal po a mgon bstan 'dzin gyi thugs dam thang sku'i rgyab byang nga rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/552

༄sto /thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying tig gi dbang mchog 'gro kun 'dren pa'i lcags kyu bklags pas don grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying tig gi dbang chog 'gro kun 'dren pa'i lcags kyu bklags pas don 'grub zhes bya ba/ bla ma 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal gyur ye shes rgya mtsho'i gter chen po/ /kun gyi tshad med thugs rje'i mthu byin dpal/ /gcig bsdus rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i gar bsgyur ba/ /dpal mgon bla ma spyan ras gzigs la 'dud/ /'khor mtsho las sgrol zhi ba'i ngal stegs la/ /chags med mtha' grol rgyal kun gshegs pa'i shul/ /rmad byung lam mchog rdo rje theg pa yi/ /'jug ngogs lam mchog mthar thug kun gyi dngos/ /rim pa dbang gi bya ba dang / /gzhung don rang blos ci nus kyi/ /'bad pas gzhan phan ched kho nar/ /brjod 'dis 'gro kun smin grol shog /de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang rtsa gsum dril bsgrub kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la/ bsgrub chen gyi rjes mthun tshul dang / byin rlabs nar ma rgyun khyer gyi tshul ste gnyis so/ /dang po bsgrub chen dang rjes mthun pa ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la rten tshom bu'i tshul du 'jug pa gter gzhung rang gi dgongs don gtso bor snang bas de yi gsal byed yig chung cung zad gzhan du 'chad par bya la/ 'dir ni don gnyis pa byin rlabs nar ma rgyun khyer tshul du bshad pa'o/ /de la dang po yo byad kyi bshol/ bar du ji ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul/ mthar byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ yo byad bsags pa dang dkyil 'khor bsham pa'o/ /dgos pa'i yo byad maṇ+ḍal/ til/yungs kar/ gu gul/ bsrung skud/ mig dar/ me tog dud rdzas sha chen bdud rtsis sbag pa rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun nam phyogs gang bder bkod/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i bkang ba/ me long sisnu ra brdal bar chos byung rnal 'byor ma lte ba trīḥ de yi g.yas g.yon mdun du oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ zur drug du yig drug re bris pas kha bkab pa/ rtsa ba gsum tsagli/ dbu brgyan/ phur pa/ gri gug ral gri rnams dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas ngos dang / yi ge bcu pa gser dngul lam rang mdog tshon gyi bkra ba dkyil 'khor rgyab ngos su mdzes par bkram/ bur sprang sbyar ba'i chang gi bum pa/ thod par chu gtsang / 'o ma/cong zhi/ brag zhun dzu hang / sid+dha ra sbyar ba'i phye ma btab pa/ me long g.ya' bral/ rma bya'i sgro mdangs/man shel rnyog med rnams/ dkyil 'khor g.yon du ste/ bkod pa'i go rim 'di ni/ don du ha cang mi 553

'gal bas rnam pa mjes pas byas pa yin la/ go rim dngos ni lag len mthong rgyud dam yi ge gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bshams pa dngos ni gtsang zhing bkod pa legs pa'i gzhi la lha grangs bzhin me tog gi tshom bu yang rung tsam ste/ 'on kyang 'grub na ras bris nyid legs pas de kho na 'bad kyi/ de yang zhi dkyil spyi dang mthun pa'i gzhal yas khang 'od lnga'i mu khyud rdo ra 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can gyi nang du chos skor 'dir rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis byung ba'i gcig ni thugs rje chen po'i rtsa dkyil yang snying 'dus pa dang mthun la/ gcig ni lugs 'di'i bye brag pa rtsa
