gsum gral thabs su bkod pa las 'dir phyi ma nyid bri na/ rtsig pa'i rtsa ba nas cha chen gcig dor ba'i nang du zlum bskor mthen pa'i dbus su'ang bzlum skor cha chen phyed gsum gyi tshad dang de mthar cung zad mdun du phyogs pa'i g.yas g.yon dang rgyab ngos drang por cha chen re dang / cha phran gsum re bzlum por bskor ste/bzlum bskor de mnyam pad+ma dang der mtshams g.yas dmar nyi gdan/ gzhan zla ba bcas shing / g.yas g.yon la baṃ gdan yang bkod/ gdan de rnams la dbus su spyan ras gzigs/ steng gi don rgyab ngos su pad+ma 'byung gnas/ g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du gsang ye'i sku mngon rtogs ltar bris/ de mi nus na phyag mtshan dbus su pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa/ g.yas pad+ma lcags sgrogs g.yon gri thod/ rgyab ḍā dril dang rang mdog gi trīḥ re yang bri/ yang sa bon 'od zer 'bar ba kho nas yang mi rung ba med do/ /de ltar ras bris bkram pa'i dbus khri'u yi khar chu gtsang lnga mtshan bdun sbyar ba sum gnyis bkang ba'i bum pa rgyan ldan bkod/ dkyil 'khor mdun du rtsa gsum spyi gtor/ rgyab tu dam can spyi gtor/ gter bdag dgos gtor/ gzhan yang mchod gtor/ sman raka chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams kyang mtha' skor ram mdun du bsham mo/ /tshogs kyi yo byad yang phyogs gang bde dang / gzhung 'dir khrus bum las bum gnyis su mdzad pas de tshe khrus bum dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar dang las bum slob dpon mdun du ste/de gnyis gcig tu bsdu na gong gi gnas gnyis gang bder dgod/ ras bris tshom bu gang la'ang 'og gzhi 'bor skyong med par ches mnyam shing dbang rdzas mchod pa kun gral 'phreng ma 'khyog par shin tu snyoms par bkod dgos te/ 'di rten 'brel gyi gnad che ba yin pas dkyil 'khor gang dang gang la zhugs kyang bab chol ma yin par rtag tu gzab la bya ba yin pa'i don no/ /gzhan rdor dril ḍā ma ru/'brus gang ba'i snod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs 'og tu dgos pa kun kyang 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub cing mchod pa ni/ thog mar/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gri wa r+ghaṃ/ rang nyid skad cig gi dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi skur gyur/ gtor ma ram̐ yo khaṃ gi ma dag pa thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus/ snod bcud rnam par dag pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa 554

ji 'dod pa'i longs spyod 'dzad pa med par gyur/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ sa byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer phros/ sa yi lha mo sogs srid gsum 'byung po gnas gzhi grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron bkug oṃ pri thi wī sībh+yaḥ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ut+pa te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga ṇa khaṃ skṛṇ+ḍi rda ba lid+dha ye swā hā/ gtor ma dang po sa yi lha mo la phul/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga tathā gong bzhin gtor ma gnyis pa gzhi bdag 'byung po spyi la 'bul/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang zhig sa la brten pa rnams/ /sems can rnams la dge don du/ /byams pa'i sems kyi gnas par mdzod/ /zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab pas de rnams dgyes pas gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs/ sarba bigha bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs gong bzhin gyi gtor ma gsum pa bgegs la bsngos shing bka' bsgo ba ni/ ཿ r+ghaṃ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: lus ngag yid la gnod pa'i bgegs: bar chad 'byung po thams cad kun: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na: thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur: r+ghaṃ rgyu u tsa ta ya phaṭa: hri pad+ma ta krita sogs drag sngags bzlas shing bdugagator rol mo bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ rgyu trīḥ nga ni khro rgyal rta mgrin te: sprul pas 'jig rten thams cad gang : rta skad rngams sgrog bar chad sel: sku yi 'od zer mtshon cha'i gur: me ri 'bar bas phyogs mtshams gcod: ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyi: lha dang 'dre zhes gnyis snang yang : rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin phyir: 'dre bgegs rang gi sems las byung : sems nyid ye nas chos sku la: bgegs dang bar chad ga la yod: thams cad rang grol chos sku'i mtshams: 'di la su yang 'da' ma byed: r+ghaṃ rgyu gnod byed 'byung po pā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa:zhes pas mtshams bcad cing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ gnas yo spyi ltar byin gyis rlabs/ bye brag gi mchod rdzas byin brlabs ni/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru las: 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yi: mchod rdzas 'bag btsog dngos 'dzin sbyangs: rigs lnga 'od zhu byang sems bdud rtsi dang : 'khor 'das rang grol rak+tar bltams: 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor tshogs spung ཿོ zag med dpag yas mchod sprin gyur: oṃ āḥ rgyu/ sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha lid+dha ma hā pū tsa sa ma ye r+ghoṃḥ de nas skyabs sems maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon 'gro'i gzhung ltar bya la/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun bum pa'i lha dbyer med cig char du mngon rtogs kyi gsal btab pa'am/ yang tha dad du mngon rtogs lan gsum bskyar nas gsal btab la spyan 'dren man chab gcig byas na legs zhes snga 'gyur gyi dam pa kha cig gi gsung ltar yang rung la/ de rnams ni bris kyi gzhung nyid legs par bsrang ba 555

'grub pa yin no/ /bzlas dmigs gsal btab nas bzlas pa brgya stong khri 'bum ci nus 'bad cing /bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrub pa yin yang bzlas pa'i skabs dmigs byed phyir thun zhabs kyi cha rnams su rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros bum pa'i lha tshogs kyi rgyud bskul sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa khengs par bsam nas brgya rtsa/ sogs bzla'o/ /'dzab dngos ni/ oṃ āḥ rdzu trīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃḥ badz+ra gu ru ha ya gri wa dhu ma gha ye ha ri ni sa sarba sid dhi r+ghaṃ hri hrīḥ zhes so/ khrus las bum pa tha dad du bcas yod na khrus bum du rdor sems bsgom ste yig brgya dang las bum du rta mgrin bskyed de sngon 'gro gtor ma'i gong gi rta mgrin gyi sngags de nyid bzlas la/ khrus las bum pa gcig tu bsgrub na rta mgrin gyi bskyed bzlas kho nas 'grub bo/ /thun mthar dzab kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing mchod bstod byas/ bum pa'i lha bdud rtsir zhu bas nus ldan dang / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs brtan par dmigs nas 'bru gsum dang yig brgya yang ci rigs bzlas/ tshogs mchod ni skabs 'dir 'am/dbang grub mtshams su bgyid pa gang bde ste 'dir btang na bskang ba yan chad zin par bya ba'o/ /gsum pa byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar bdag 'jug dbang slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin rang gis blang / de ltar mi byed na rgyud gzhan du bdag 'jug bsdu na rig pa'i me tog dor bas 'grub gsung ba ltar bya/ bdag gi rnam rtog la ni bdag 'jug rgyas pa mi nus tshe bla ma'i rnal 'byor ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi gnas bzhi'i 'od zer gyi dbang blang na yang go chod cing legs par sems so/ /de nas gzhan la dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor sgo drung du 'dus te/de la drang don gyi chos ji ltar 'os pa bshad/ til nag sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs su byas la/ 'dir 'dus pa'i slob ma rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad snying kar yi ge kai nag po'i rnam par gnas pa sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur te mdun gyi til la thim/ de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs shing g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na dha smi ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ til me chur dor la/ de yang phyi rol du dor/ de nas yig brgya dang yi ge bcu pa rta mgrin gyi sngags bzlas nas khrus chu byin la khrus bya/ slob ma rnams bla ma dkon mchog la snying nas dad pa bskyed du gzhug la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hoḥ dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas: sku gsum zhing nas bdag la dgongs su gsol:bdag cag khyed la dad pas skyabs su gnas: 'gro ba'i don du smin grol ces sgo phyes: ces zhu/ de la bla mas/ trīḥ dam tshig med pa'i skye bo dang : log lta can gyi mu stegs dang : blo chung nyan thos rang rgyal dang : skal ba med pa ma yin nam: slob bu'i/ ma yin lags zhu/ yang bla mas/ dad gus skal 556

bar ldan lags sam: 'jig rten bya ba 'bor nus sam: sdom gsum dam tshig bsrung nus sam/ zab don yengs med bsgom nus sam: zhes pa'i lan du/ nus par khas blangs/ de nas bgegs la gtor ma sbyin nas drag sngags rol mo gu gul dud pa thun bcas kyi bgegs bskrad/ 'tshams bcad/ bsrung 'khor bsgom/ srad bu dmar po khru bzhi sum khugs la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas la/ rtsa gsum sngags mthar oṃ shurnya me tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sablon swā hā/ zhes pas mgul du gdag skabs 'dir spro ba bskyed phyir chos 'di'i 'byung khungs bla ma'i lo rgyus dbang bskur gyi phan yon rnams slob mar dgos skabs dang rang gi shes nus bstun ji rigs bshad la spros pa chung tshe ma byas kyang chog dbang bskur dngos la chad skyon med phyin spros pa kun 'di'i rigs 'grer 'gyur ba dbang bskur mtha' dag la yang shes par bya ste/ der yang ma zad mkhas 'dod kyi spros pas dbang gi dngos don bsgrib na bdud kyi las su 'gro ba yang rtogs dgos so/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni 'di'i las gzhung gi sngon 'gro ltar ram/ yang 'jug pa bde phyir 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams ci bsags pas/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces bod spyir klog pa sad gnub kyi bka' srol snying sngags bka' ma las kyang 'byung bas rgyud tshig kho nar nges la/ de lan gsum gyi skabs sems gyi sdom pa bzungs/ de bas ye shes gzhug pa de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po bskyed bzlas kyi lung 'bog pa ste/ rgyas par brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab/ bsgom lung gter gzhung khrom chos ltar bzlas lung bcas bya/ 'dir bsdus pa ni/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma byin brlabs can: 'dren pa'i bla ma brtul zhugs can: rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can: rig 'dzin brgyud pa thams cad la: bdag gzhan rigs drug pha ma rnams: mos gus gdung ba drag po yi: gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs: byin brlabs thugs rje'i klong nas zhu: zhes gdung shugs bskyed de rjes shes pa klod par bzhag bcug la/ 'o rang cag rnams thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal la spyod pa'i rgyu rkyen ma rig bdag 'dzin kho nas byas la/ de glo bur gyi dri ma yin gyi sems nyid chos kyi dbyings 'di bri gang las 'das pa nyid de/ des na chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag de lta bu ma rtogs pa'i sems can sgyu ma lta bur snang bar/ rang bzhin snying rje'i rkyen gyi rang rig trīḥ dkar po gcig tu gyur/ trīḥ de las 'od 'phros rgyal mchod sems can gyi don byas snod bcud gzhal yas lha ru bsgyur 'od zer tshur 'dus trīḥ la thim skad cig gi 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs be+eḍūr+ya ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi rtsa phyag thugs kar thal sbyar g.yas 'og 557

dung gi 'phreng ba dang // g.yon 'og pad dkar 'dab brgya'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa zhal 'dzum rab tu zhi ba'i lta stangs can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyi yongs su spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung pad nyi zla gdan la bzhugs pa/ ral pa thor tshugs phyed sku rgyab si bur bsil ba/ spyi gtsug tu gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas gcer bu dkar dmar rus rgyan thor tshugs can phyed skyil cang te'u dang dril bu 'khrol ba de yi spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med pa kun kyang 'od zer gyi phreng ba rab tu 'bar ba gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs kar zla steng trīḥ dkar la yig drug gi bskor ba/ de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas yi ge bcu pa nyer gcig nas brgya stong bar ci nus su shes pa bskyed la rol mo dang bcas te bzlas/ de mthar 'dzab sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i me tog 'thor/ 'phags pa'i bsgom bzlas kyi lung tsam don du gnyer na de yan dkyus bzhin byas pas rig gtad kyi cho ga rgyas par 'gyur la/ skyabs sems man gyi yang lung kho nas legs par grub pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ thod pa nas bdud rtsi byin me long chos 'byung yig bcu bris pa brtan la/ rkang pa gshib ste lang la lus drang po bsrang ba'i spyi bor lag gnyis chos 'byung phyag rgya byas la mig btsum skabs su gar stabs bsgyur/ de rnams mos la lus gnad dkyus mthun tsam gyi yang rung / rang nyid thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi par gsal ba'i thugs kar spyan ras gzigs rang 'dra la sku mdog dmar po pad 'phreng dang pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa de'i thugs kar trīḥyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas/ g.yas su yi dam dpa' bo rta mgrin/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes/ de rnams la 'khor rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtshos bskor bar gsal btab la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma rgya mtsho byin rlabs kun gyi gnas: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod: yi dam rgya mtsho dngos grub kun gyi gnas: gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'phrin las kun gyi bdag: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad soloḥ thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par byin gyis rlobs: dpal chen rta mgrin gsang ye ḍāk+ki ma: snang srid zil gnon bdag la byin gyis rlobs:oṃ āḥ ju trīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ: zhes pas rtsa gsum rab 'byams rang la thim par bsam la/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i dud rdzas bsregs/ rol mo bcas gsol 'debs 'dzab sngags la a be sha ya a btags nas drag tu bskul zhing rig pa gzangs stod shes pa ngar bskyed pas/ ye shes phebs pa'i rtags spyi ltar lus 'bar 'khrab 'dar/ ngag smra rgod sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs/ sems bde gsal mi rtog pa skye ba 'byung bas/ de yi rang ngo zhen med du skyong / ye shes phebs dka' na/ gtso bo'i lte bar g.yung drung 558

dga' 'khyil g.yon skor/ de'i lte bar zla steng trīḥ dang lag bzhir haḥ riḥ niḥ saḥ rnams dmar po/ 'og tu yam̐ ljang gi bteg pa/ yam̐ las rlung g.yos dga' 'khyil drag tu 'khor bas rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho kun sku gar stabs/ gsung a ra li'i gad rgyang / thugs bde ba chen po'i ye shes ci yang 'bar bas snang srid shig shig yom yom sprin ltar 'dus shing / char ltar bab nas rang gi snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / lte ba'i sa bon la thim par dzasra rol rig pa rtse gcig tu bsgrim pas ye shes phebs par 'gyur/ de nas ye shes brtan phyir tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gnyis kyi rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bkod/ ye shes brtan pa'i sngags kyi me tog 'thor te/ 'di ni dbang gi gzhi dgod pa gal yang che ba'o/ /de yan chad kyi sdom ni/ sdig sbyangs khrus bya zhu dang lan/ /bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor skud pa gdang / /chos bshad maṇ+ḍal skyabs sems blang/ /thun mong bsgom bzlas ye shes dbab/ /thun min rdzas byin bskyed gsol 'dzab/ /bskyar dang ye shes brtan byed do/ /zhes so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dngos la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag 'tshal/ a khaṃ bi ra r+ghaṃ/ lan gnyis kyi mig dar bcings me tog gtad/ thal mo sbyar la 'di skad du/ r+ghaṃ/ kun khyab thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: skal ldan bdag cag rab gus 'jug lags pas: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma khyod nyid kyis: bdag sogs 'gro rnams smin par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum zhu/ de nas bla mas/ hoḥsngon bsags las can bu rnams nga la nyon: yang gsang bla med kun gyi sgo phye'i phyi: kun 'dus thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi: smin byed dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs byin par bya: zhes pas bka' gnang /dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu byin la/ hoḥ gsang sngags bla med dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: zhugs 'dod bu rnams dam tshig legs par bsrung : nyams na na rag dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong : dam gnas bsrung na bla med sangs rgyas thob: sa ma ya nā ra kan: sngags de rjes bzlos yang byar gzhugaslob ma rnams dam tshig rnams bzhag shes par byas la/ khas blang ba ni/ hoḥ dpal ldan bla mas gsung ba'i dbang tshig rnams: bdag cag rnams kyi yang dag bsrung bar bgyi: khams gsum rigs drug 'khor ba dong sprug shog: rig pa'i me tog sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas gzung la/ hoḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: yang dag rig pa'i me tog 'di: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: lha mchog rnams kyi lha ngo ston: pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes ras bris nyid dam/ rnam rgyal bum pa'am/de yang mi bde tshe las bum khar rigs lnga'i phyag brgya bkod pa la me tog dor/ lha gang la bab ngo sprad/lha des byin gyis rlabs pa'i me tog oṃ pra tī grosna i me satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes rang rang gi spyi bor bcings par bsam/ slob ma'i mgor bzhag lha dang mthun pa'i ming / pad+ma gu ru dang / de bzhin 559

badz+ra/ rat+na/ bud+dha/ karma gu ru dang / dbang chen mkha' 'gro sbyar ba/ bud med la de rnams kyi tshig mthar ma yi sgra byas pa gdags/ mig zur dngos sam rdo rjes mig thur tshul byas la/ hoḥ ma rig gnyis snang dug lngas 'khor bar 'khyams: glo bur gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i mig phye bas: rang rig ye shes lnga po rang gsal nas: mi 'gyur rig pa'i rang zhal da ltos shig: zhes mig dar dbye/dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par byas pa mngon sum mthong bar bsam la ji bzhin ngo sprad/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi nas/ oṃ na maste r+ghaṃ/ oṃ na mo me r+ghaṃ/ oṃ na mo na maḥ hūṃ/ zhes thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar la phyag lan gsum gsum dngos sam mos pas bya/ de nas khrus bum bsham yod na dang / med na las bum thogs la/ hoḥ rgyal ba'i sku gsum chu yi dri ma bkru: dug lnga dag pa'i khrus byas a la la: sngon gyi rgyal bas ji ltar byin rlabs ltar: sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag gyur cig: oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥ sarba sharnyi ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pas khrus chu byin/ spros pa la dga' na phyin drug khrus dang / chu bo drug nas dad pas bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /yi bar gyi khrus byas na lhag skyon med cing legs par 'gyur la/ ma byas kyang gzhung 'dir lta bur chad pa'i skyon ni nam yang med do/ /de yan chad dkyil 'khor dngos la 'jug pa'i rim pa ste sdom ni/ maṇ+ḍal zhu lan dam chu sbyin/ /bsrung bya shes byas de khas blang / me tog phul nas lha ngos bzung / /me tog spyir bzhag ming yang btags/ /mig dbye dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang / /phyag 'tshal khrus kyi bya ba'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas gnyis pa dbang bskur dngos gzhi la/ /spros bcas bum pa lha sku'i dbang / /spros med yig sngags gsung gi dbang / /shin tu spros med gsang sher thugs kyi dbang / /rab tu spros med de kho na ngo bo nyid kyi dbang ste bzhi'o/ /de yi dang po ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnyis su med pa de yang / mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam la/ des dbang bskur ba'i bya ba kun mdzad par yongs su mos shing 'di skad do/ /hoḥ chos rnams thams cad mi dmigs spros dang bral: ma bcos ngang gsal ye dag ngo bos stong : ma 'gags thugs rje dbyer med rol pa'i rtsal: rig 'dus thugs rje chen po'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ: a gi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes bum pa thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud pas bdud rtsi'i lus khengs chu gyen du 'khyil bas rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yang snying bcud: byin rlabs rang byung pad+ma thod phreng gi: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes dbu brgyan bcing / bla ma'i sku brtan la spyi bor bzhagahoḥ bde gshegs shun gyi ngo bo gcig bsdus pa'i: bcom ldan dpal chen rta mchog rgyal po yi: skal 560

ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbang thob shog oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃḥ a rnyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: phur pa dang rta mgrin gyi sku rten la mgo la bzhag hoḥ mkha' dbyings gsang sngags kun gyi 'byung khungs ma: rgyal ba'i yum gyur gsang ye dhāk+ki yi+oḥ skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: gsang ye mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ a rnyi ṣiñtsa trī: zhes thod pa'i bdud rtsi byin la gsang ye'i sku bstan te dpral bar bzhag hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa'i: bstan bsrung chos skyong gter bdag khros pa yi: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas: 'phrin las kun 'grub chos skyong dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rdu: oṃ āḥ hūṃ swā hā: a rnyi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ: zhes gri gug dang ral gri mgor bzhag pa'i lag tu gtad kyang rung ngo / /gter gzhung du gtor dbang gi sa bcad 'dir yod pas/ 'og tu 'chad bzhin bskur la/ slob ma rjes 'dzin spros bcas sku dbang tsam gyi chog par byed na rjes kyi bya ba bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ /de yang dbang bskur 'di nyid dum dum khrig tu byed par gnang nas sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gang bskur ba'i mtha' rten du gtor dbang bskur don rtogs phyir spros bcas sku dbang mthar sa spyad mdzad pa ste/ des na dbang tshang bar bskur tshe kun gyi mthar sbyar yang mi legs pa med pas gang bde bya'o/ /de nas gnyis pa spros med yig sngags gsung gi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma rnams 'phags par gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' du mas dbu brgyan pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma dmar po/de yi thugs kar yab dpa' borta mgrin la yum gsang ba ye shes 'khyud pa rta mgrin gyi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad steng nyi zla'i dbus su trīḥ yig dmar 'tsher 'od zer 'bar mdo mthar yi ges bcus hre me bskor ba gsal la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dpal dpe'u nas/ snying po 'dzab sngags mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du bskur tshig bzhin yi ge rnam par byon te/ de yang slob ma'i spyi bo'i thad du sleb pa na cha gnyis su gyes gcig sa bon trīḥ dang gcig sngags 'phreng gi yig 'bru so sor thim par bsam nas yi ge bcu pa'i tsaka li bstan cing spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ rang byung chos dbyings rig pas dug lnga dag: sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan dbang thob nas:rang gsal yi ge oṃ gyi dbang bskur bas: dus gsum bde gshegs sku dbang thob par shog: oṃ oṃ oṃ: āḥ ma 'gag mtha' bral brjod 'das tshig: kun khyab rang gsal āḥ yi dbang bskur bas: bde gshegs gsung gi dbang mchog thob par shog: āḥ āḥ āḥ hūṃ rang byung ma bcos lhug pa la: zhen 'dzin med pa'i ngang la shugs kyi grol: 'gyur med yi ge r+ghaṃ gi dbang bskur 561

bas: bde gshegs thugs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ: oṃ ni kun khyab tshad me bzhi dang ldan: snang ba 'dzin med rang shar dbang bskur bas: yi ge oṃ gyi lha yi sdug bsngal skyobs:'pho ltung duḥ kha thams cad zhi gyur cigoḥ oṃ oṃ oṃ: ma ni 'gro drug kun la byams rtse ldan: kun la shugs kyi thugs rje'i rtsal khyab pas: yi ge ma yi bu la dbang bskur bas: byang chub sems kyi rgyud la rlan gyur cig: ma ma ma: ṇi ni 'khor ba'i zhen pa zlog pa ste: rang byung thugs rje'i shugs kyi 'od zer kun la 'gyed: yi ge ṇi yi bu la dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin 'khor ba grol ba'i dbang thob shog: ṇi ṇi ṇi: pad ni 'khor ba'i zhen pa ma lus gcod: dug lnga'i 'dzin spyod ye shes lngar dag pa'i: yi ge pad kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gzung 'dzin zhen pa rang dag dbang thob shog: pad pad pad: me ni 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bsreg byed pa'i: 'khor bas ma gos chos rnams zad pa'i rtags: chos nyid dngos bral 'dzin med dbang bskur bas: bde gshegs kun dang dbyer med sangs rgyas shog: me me me: r+ghaṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa: spros bral sems can kun la yongs khyab bdag: sgyu lus rang grol rgyu gi dbang bskur bas: 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i dbang thob shog: rgyu rgyu rgyu: zhes yig 'bru bcu 'dzab dbyangs dang bcas pas gtad do/ /de nas gsum pa shin tu spros med gsang ye thugs kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ thun mong ma yin par mtshan nyid ldan pa'i nā rī thu ha ri gu ya tsā nar byin gyis brlabs nas bla mas dbang tshig brjod cing dbang bskur kyi bya ba kun des mdzad pa shes dbang spyi yi phyogs ltar gzhung don du snang yang / 'dir lag len du bla ma'i thugs ka nas ye shes mkha' 'gro spros pa des dbang gi bya ba byed par bsam la/ bla mas dbang bskur ba ste chang la bur sprang sbyar ba'i bum pa thogs te /562

༄sto /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer snying po don yongs su grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ kye ma/ dal 'byor rin chen 'di ni rnyed par dka'/ /na 'chi cha med snying nas dran byas zhing / khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i gru la 'bad pas 'jug re ran/ / 1 ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /sangs rgyas la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la yang mi phyed dad/ / 2 bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do//3 dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / 4 oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta tsā na badz+ra su bha wa at+ma kolhahaṃ/ chos kun gdod nas ma dmigs stong pa'i ngang / /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /ma rtogs 'gro la tshad med snying rje yis/ /rang gzugs kun gzhi gnas 'gyur zla ba'i dal/ / 5 nyon yid dag pa gzhom med yi ge rgyu/ /yid shes dag pa bde chen rdo rje'i gzugs/ /gsum las 'od kyi don gnyis lhun grub 'dus/ /yongs gyur lnga bdag ye shes rdzogs pa'i sku/ / 6 rdo rje sems dpa'i ches cher dkar ba'i mdangs/ /zla ba 'bum gyi mtshon min mtshan dpe rdzogs/ /rdo rje'i srog zhu rgyan brgyad chas lngas klubs/ /rdo rje dril bsnyem tshul dgu dpal du 'bar/ / 7 pad zlar rdor skyil rang 'od yum la 'khyud/ /zla ba'i rgyab yol 'od zer mu med 'phro/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum rdo rje gsum du mtshon/ /mgo bor dang po'i sangs rgyas yab yum bzhugs/ / 8 gnas gsum 'od kyi yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /lus med ma lus mi lus bdag la bstem/ /de bzhin rtsa ba yan lag bla ma la/ /spyan drangs gdod ma'i mgon dang gnyis su med/ / 9 snying kar pad+ma la gnas zla ba'i dal/ /rdo rje'i mtshan pa byang chub sems nyid mtshon/ /rdo rje'i lte bar chos dbyings ye shes r+ghaṃ/ /phyi rim oṃ dang badz+ra satwa'i bskor/ / 10 oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ bdag dang bla mas yig drug rdo rje'i sgra/ /bzlas pas bla ma yi dam kun gyi bzlas/ /lhan cig lus nang srin bu skra ba spu/ /kun las yi ge drug pa'i sngags sgra byung / /11 rgyud lnga 'byung gzhi mkha' khyab rgyal ba yang / /bdag dang lhan cig gsang sngags rgyal po sgrogs/ /thun thar snang kun sku'i rdo rjer gyur/ /de yang gzhom med gsung gi rdo rje chos/ / 12 de yang 'gyur 563

med thugs kyi rdo rje sems/ /de yang chos dbyings ye shes ngo bor 'dus/ /spyi bo'i bla ma kun bzang rang la thim/ /rang nyid zla dal de yang rdo rje dang / / 13 de oṃ lugs 'byung mtha' ru r+ghaṃ la 'dus/ /r+ghaṃ nyid thig le nā da'i bar du gzhil/ /rnam rtog gsum bral chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang / /ci gnas bzhag thar r+ghaṃ gi rang sgra yis/ / 14 slar yang dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /snang grags rigs gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /gdod nas yin bzhin rtag par lam du khyer/ / 15 de ltar bla med bla ma rdo rje sems/ /bskyed bzlas rdzogs par zhugs pa'i dge ba kun/ /mkha' mnyam sems can yongs la bsngo ba'i mthus/ /kun gyi rdo rje sems 'bras 'grub par shog / 16 dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrubs thabs nyams len khyer bde snying por byas pa 'di yang don yongs su grub pa dpal kai tshang gi ring lugs pa chen po rgyal tshab bdun pa'i khri la bzhugs pa go shri dkon mchog 'od zer gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rab myong lcags rta smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i gnyal smad dge rir brjod pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 564

༄gi /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang sgrub rgyun khyer gyi man ngag bzhugs so/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa r+ghaṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas/ /de yi sgrubs thabs khyer bde bkod/ /na mo rgyu dkon mchog kun 'dus bla mar skabs su mchi/ /byang chen thob phyir rdor sems bsgrub par bgyi/ /tshogs zhing nam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig bshags dger yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul mya ngan mi mda' gsol/ /dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /ma hā shu n+ya ta tsā na badz+ra su bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ chos dbyings stong nyid 'gro la brtse ba'i sems/ /dbyer med rang rig ngo bo r+ghaṃ tu gsal/ /'phro 'dus dag pa'i zhing khams gzhal yas khang / /dbus su pad dkar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng / /r+ghaṃ las bdag nyid gu ru pas 'byung / /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /dkar tsher rdor dril rgyal po rol pa'i stabs/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi chas rnams rdzogs/ /rang 'od lhan skyes yum dang 'khril sbyor bzhugs/ /spyi dpral mgrin snying lte ba gsang gnas su/ /rnam snang mi 'khrug 'od dpag med lhun grub/ /rin 'byung don 'grub rang 'od yum bcas bzhugs/ /gtsug tor rtse mor kun bzang yab yum gsal/ /rtsa gnas kun tu rdor sems grangs med bcas/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs bdag dang dbyer med bzhugs/ /rang gdangs mchod pa'i lha mos puts+tsha 'bul/ /rdo rje glu mas sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /phrin las che ba'i yon tan rab bsngags bstod/ /tshe rabs thog med nas bsags sgrib pa kun/ /dkyil 'khor lhar bshags sgrib pa med par dag /rang nyid thugs kar lhun grub ye shes sems/ /mtshon gang thugs kar zla steng rdo rje'i lter/ /r+ghaṃ dkar tha mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dgyes bskang thugs rgyud bskul/ /tshur 'dus 'od zer tshul du thugs ka yis/ /hūṃ la thim pas mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /bsam gtan yengs med rtse gcig sngags 'di bzla/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa r+ghaṃ/ skabs su yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas/ thun mthar snang srid 'od zhu gzhal yas khang / /gzhal yas khang yang yab yum sku la thim/ /yum yab gnas lnga ye shes sems dpar 'dus/ /de yang ting 'dzin sngags phreng yi ge r+ghaṃ/ /de yang dmigs med mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal/ /'khor gsum khyab brdal chen po'i ngang la bzhag / 565

de las ldang tshe slar yang lha skur gsal/ /spyod lam kun tu yid dang mi 'bral zhing / /dge ba 'gror bsngo byang chen smon lam gdab/ /de ltar rdor sems bsgrub pa'i man ngag ni/ /rgyun du khyer bde bris pa'i dge ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam rdor sems de ci 'dra'i/ /de 'dra kho nar myur du 'grub par shog /zhes mang yul dpal 'bar gyi sgrub pa ba ye shes rin chen gyi gsol ba gdab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i thun skabs skad cig mar sbyar ba'i yig ris pa ni sprul pa'i sku mchog 'phrin las bstan 'dzin gyi bgyi'o/ /thug /bde mchone dkar po'i tshe sgrub rgyun khyer snying po bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ bklags pas grub pa rgyud rnams kyi/ /rgyal po 'bum pa nyung ngu yi/ /man ngag 'chi med bsgrub pa'i lam/ /de la gus pas 'dir bshad bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig shrī ho ru ka haṃ/ shrī gnyis med ye shes te/ /lha ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du mi gnas pa'o/ /bdag nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i dpal/ /ho ru ka dkar ston zla'i mdog /zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gcigs/ /phyag gnyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud/ /g.yon skum zhabs kyi 'jigs byed nag /g.yas brkyangs dus mtshan dmar mo mnan/ /ral pa'i cod paṇa rab tu mjes/ /rtse mor yid bzhin nor bu dang / /ngos su sna tshogs rdo rje brgyan/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug stag shams dkris/ /pang du rdo rje phag mo yum/ /dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ /skra grol thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan/ /do shal phyag rgya lnga dang ldan/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yas bskum zhabs kyi yab la 'khyud/ /gnyis pa sgeg khro mdzes pa'i sku/ /ye shes me dpung dbus su bzhugs/ /bde chen snang stong sgyu ma'i sku/ /'khor 'das snod bcud rang 'drar gnas/ /bzlas pa ni/ oṃ trīḥ ha ha hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ma ma ā yur puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ/ zhes ci nus su bzlas pa'o/ /de nas rlung bum can bzung / rang yab rkyang ngu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas lha mo lnga thod pa thogs pa 'phros/ khams gsum gyi bcud rnams 566

thod par bsdus te rang gi sna bug g.yon nas blug ste lus gang / lha mo rnams gcig tu 'dres rang la 'khyud sbyor gyi bzhugs par bsam/ yang spyi bor kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dkar po r+ghaṃ gi mtshan pa mgo bo thur bstan/de'i 'od zer gyi 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka nas brgyud spyi bo nas zhugs/'khor lo bzhir dga' bzhi nyams su myong / lus thams cad bdud rtsi rlan drod can gyi gang bar bsam/ /thun mthar lha sku 'od gsal du 'jug zhing ldang / dge ba bsngo smon lam bkra shis bya'o/ /gtor ma sum+bha ni'i bsang / su bha was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho gliḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ dze/ zhes pas gtor mgron thams cad spyan drangs/ badz+ra a ra gli hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ lnga sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan bdun 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ shaja'i bar gyi mchod/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug ma/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /ces bstod/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa un mā da a pasmra ra ḍa ka ḍa ki n+ya da ya i rda ba ling groṇ+ḍaskyo sa ma ya rak+ṣaskyo ma ma sarba sirnyi smre pra yats+tshaskyo ya the pam ya theṭaṃ bhurdzo tha dzi gra tha pi pa tha mā ti kra ma tha ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sathu khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi ka bha waskyo r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas mkha' 'gro spyi la 'bul/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ 'phrin las bcol/ gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/bsngo smon bkra shis yang bya'o/ /de ltar bde mchog dkar po yid/ /sgrub thabs rgyun khyer snying po gang / /smras pa'i dge ba 'di yi kyang / /'gro kun 'chi med mchog thob shog /zhes pa yang rab byung bcu gsum me yos gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa la rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus/ lha ldan rgyal po'i khab phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po dga' ldan khang gsar du bkod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /667

༄7ོ/ /shrī kā la tsa kra ba dz+ra sa twa he ru ka bho ra wa ḍā ki nī dzā lasaṃ nga ra ma hā ma ṇ+ḍa la su sa dha ya pā re badz+ra ra smi sa ma n+ta dz+wa la na mi bi dza ha ram̐/༄ga /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro drwa ba sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mchog gi rdo rje rin po che 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ na mo gu ru bud+dha bho dhi sa twe bh+yo na mo na maḥ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mchog gi rdo rje 'od zer kun tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam kun mchog ldan bde ba che/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung yongs bral zhing / /rtog med ming bral mtshan ma med/ /chos dbyings ye shes de la 'dud/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal chags thog bral/ /spros med don dam brda yi tshul/ /ye shes snang ba dkyil 'khor mchog /shar ba der yang phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sgrib med mchog gi phung khams skye med las dbang po/ /mtha' dag 'khor los bsgyur mdzad bcom ldan sna tshogs dbang / /khams gsum rtsa rlung thig le'i drwa ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /yongs su sdom mdzad dus 'khor sdom pa chen por 'dud/ /brtag pa'i yul las rab 'das rgyal ba'i ye shes sku/ /rtog med bde chen mchog gi bsgrub las gnas gzhan min/ /'on kyang 'og min bar bgrod dngos grub che thob byed/ /ye shes la 'jug brtags pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang rmad/ /des na bden gnyis zung 'jug dbyibs rnal 'byor/ /ma dag snang ba 'gog phyir yang nas yang / /rgyal bas bsngags bzhin dpal ldan shes rab rgyud/ /dkyil 'khor sdom chen sgrub thabs 'dir spel bya/ /de yang skal ldan gyi skyes bu theg chen thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs ba bla ma la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yang dag par gnas shing / dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob la khas len brtan pa lam bskyed pa'i rim pa yi zhal lung rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnang ba legs par thob pas/ las dang dngos grub bla na med pa'i go 'phang mchog la yongs su dmigs pa yi gnas kyang 'tshe 568

ba med cing las dang rjes su mthun la yid tshim pa thob pa'i sa ru dkyil 'khor lha yi dmigs rten dang mchod rdzas gtor ma maṇ+ḍal ma da na dang bcas pa'i kā pā la rdo rje dril bu cang te'u sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du byas te bde ba'i gdan la 'dug nas cho ga la 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas cho ga'i rim pa yang thun mong sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i chos dang / cho ga'i bya ba dngos gzhi dang gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ bdud rtsi sbyangs rtog sbar dang kha dag pa/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin bzung pū dzas byin gyis brlab/ /skyabs sems yi ge brgya pa bsgom bzlas dang / /phyag bcas maṇ+ḍal thun mong sngon 'gro'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdud rtsi lnga yi ril bu dang bcas pa'am ma da na kho na yang ste sbyangs rtog sbar ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'bru drug gi kha dag par byed pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs nas bzung ba/ mchod rdzas bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa/ phyag dang bcas te maṇ+ḍa la yi bya ba bshams/ bkram/ gsol/ bsdu/ bkod/ dbul 'khod pa'i rim pa can dang bskul ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom bzlas rjes dang bcas pa ste/ de ltar don tshan bdun po rnams rgyas bsdus skabs su ji ltar babs pa gsung rgyun ma nyams pa phyag len mthong ba rgyud pa las byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa cho ga'i rim pa dngos la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sbyor ba dag pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bya ba dang / sbyor gzhi dngos dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis bsgrub pa'i thabs te gnyis so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags dngos gzhi bsrung 'khor bsgom/ /rjes su gtor ma phul te gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa yi/ dang po ni/ rang nyid skad cig gi dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chen por gsal ba nas/de nas mchod pa dang sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bdag nyid kyi dngos po dbul ba dang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang /lam la brten pa dang / stong pa nyid la dmigs pa rnams 'chad 'gyur bsgrub thabs dngos gzhi yi sngon du bya ba bzhin skabs 'dir yang bya ba bzhed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dag pas bdag bsrung ba dang /bdud bgegs log 'dren gzhom pa dang / gnas bsrung ba'i don du bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ste gsum gyi/ dang po la/ lha rdzogs par bya ba'i don du sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyong ba/ rigs drug dgod pa/sku gsung thugs ye shes rnam par dag par byed pa dang / yan lag drug dgod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ prargyo pā ya āt+ma ka kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na a rnyi pa te mā ma ka ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na brdza badz+ra a mṛ ta su bha waṃ ku ru ku ru skad+dha dh+wa tu a ya ta rna niḥ su bhā waṃ swā hā/ rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar rang gi lus sbrul shun pa rjes pa bzhin du lan gsum dor te/ rang gi lus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom ste zhi rgyas la'o/ /las gzhan la de 569

mthun dkyil 'khor rang lus de yi kha dog can du bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas dpral bar oṃ dkar po las 'od dpag med dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can phyag g.yas pa gsum na tho ba/ mdung /rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum na pad dkar 'dab ma brgya pa/ me long dang / bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/mgrin par āḥ dmar po las rin 'byung dmar po/ dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas na me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon na gzhu dang / rdo rje'i zhags pa dang / rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ snying khar r+ghaṃ nag po las don grub nag po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang / gri khug dang / rtse gsum/ g.yon na phub dang / thod pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dkar po 'dzin pa/ lte bar ho ser po las rnam snang ser po/ ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo dang / dbyug pa dang / 'jigs byed rdo rje/ g.yon na/ dung dang // rdo rje lcags sgrogs dang / sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/ ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang / gri gug dang / dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang / thod pa dang / tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥ sngon po las rdor sems sngon po/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa dang 'dra bar bsgom/ gsum pa la/ oṃ hraḥsar+pā as+t+ra rā dzaḥ ma ra kle sha an+ta ka ra badz+ra tīkyā du kha myu da mā ma ka ram̐ bi shwa dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing phan tshun lag pas lag pa mnye zhing lag pa dag par bsam mo/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la a i ṛ u '-i/ bar ba'i tshigs la a er ar o al rtse mo'i tshigs la ha ya ra wa la ste dbyangs bco lnga'i bdag nyid kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gang ba cha bco lnga yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ lag pa g.yas kyi mthe bo nas mthe chung gi bar gyi rtse mo'i tshigs la/ lā wā rā yā hā/ bar ba'i tshigs la/ āl au ār i ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs la/ lī u rī i ā ste dbyangs bco lnga'i bdag nyid las grub pa'i yang dag par gang ba'i nyi ma bsam/ lag pa gnyis kha sbyar ba zla ba dang nyi ma'i dbus su r+ghaṃ sngon po bsam ste/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi sa bon/ de dag gis rdo rje rtse lnga par bsam la/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar ba'i mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar bya/ gung mo gnyis mnyam du brkyang ba'i rgyab tu 'dzub mo gnyis phyed 'khyeg pa'i tshul du bzhag ming med 'og tu bskum pa rang gi lag mthil du sa bon sa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcing ngo / /phyag rgya des gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar yan lag thams cad la reg cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ ka ya wāka tsista dzñā a dhi pa te badz+ra kā ya mā ma kā ya wāka tsit+ta tsā na badz+re badz+ra kā ya su bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /oṃ sar+bha ta thā ga ta badz+ra kā ya swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal bzung ngo / /570

bzhi pa ni/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis kyi snying khar reg ste/ oṃ dz+rī trī da yā ya na la/mgo bor oṃ r+ghaṃ si ra se swā hā/ gtsug gtor la/ oṃ trī sha ṣā yi mo ṣaṭa/ yan lag thams cad la o trī ka ba tsā ya r+ghaṃ/ lag pa gnyis kas yan lag thams cad la reg par bya'o/ /mig la o dz+rīḥdz+rīne tra ya wa ṣaṭa/dge ba la g.yon pa dang mi dge ba la g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi se gol gyi phyogs thams cad du mtshon cha dgod cing / oṃ hāḥ as+t+ra ya phaṭa ces brjod do/ /de nas oṃ sar+bha ta thā ga ta hri da ya si raḥ shi khā ka ba rtsa na tra as+t+rabadz+ra ṣa ṭaṃ ga swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung ngo / /yan lag drug po las la sogs pa'i tshul dang / dgongs pa'i skad gzhan gyis kyang snying kha ni lte ba'o/ /de bzhin du snying kha dang / mgrin pa dang / dpral ba dang / gtsug tor la sogs pa ste mgo bo la sogs bzung bar bya'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i don sngar gyi phyag rgyas reg cing / lte bar oṃ dz+rī nā bh+yo na maḥ snying khar oṃ hūṃ hri da yā ya swā hā/ mgrin par oṃ trī spyi nā ya bo ṣaṭa/ dpral bar oṃ trī lā la ḍa ya hūm̐/ gtsug tor du oṃ ཿdz+rī shi khā yi ṣaṭa/ gsang gnas su oṃ hāḥgu t+yā ya phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dgod do/ /gnyis pa la lus la rdo rje bkod nas rdo rje'i skur byin gyis brlab te de yi me 'od kyi bdud sregs pa dang / khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba khro bo chen po'i phur pa bdud bgegs log 'dren la gdab pa ste gnyis kyi dang po/ dang po yi sngon du 'gro ba zhing skyong gnas kyi bdag po rnams la gtor ma btang ba ni/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i gtor ma bshams la/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hraḥphaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ o oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sabra dhasmra su bi shud+dha swā bhā wa sabra dhasmrabla sho dha ya swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra srur+ya sah+pha dhasmyu pra bo dha ka sasba dhasmran pra bo dhi ya swā hā/ oṃ r+ghaṃ badz+ra a na la sabra dhasmyu pra di pa ka sar+bha dhasmyu na pra dri pa ya swā hā/ zhes sngags tshan bzhi yi byin gyis brlab la/ oṃ tse badz+ra a ra li ho dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lnga sh+ya ho/ oṃ kha kha khy-i de/ de nas gzhi gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las/ ra ba dang khang rtsegs bsgom ste/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ raḥ badz+ra tsan+d+ra/ srur+ya rā hu kā la asna yaḥ ka ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na/ badz+ra mā pa ram̐/ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas nam mkha' dang sa sbyar ba skum por snang ba'i mtshams nas ra ba gsum dang / yul 'khor bsrung ba'i don du yul 'alor gyi mtshams su ra ba lnga dang / thams cad du 'og tu mdung dang / steng du mda'i dra ba rnon po/ dbus su rdo rje'i sa yul spyi mthar thug pa'i mtshams su bsgom mo/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ bi shwa kā ya badz+ra ku ṭā gā ro/ ku ru ku ru ṭ+wā hā/ zhes pas rdo rje sa gzhi'i dbus su khang rtsegs steng 'og khru nyis brgya pa'o/ /de'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte ba stong pa'i nang du/ oṃ saṃ bi shwa badz+ra pad me ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa khru bcu gcig pa lte ba la khru bzhi yod pa'i lte bar/ oṃ raḥ badz+ra srur+ya badz+ra srur+ya ā sa na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa'i rtsib bcur nyi ma'i gdan bskyed do/ /gnyis pa la gtso bo bskyed pa dang 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas dbus kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid hūṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i khro bo dbang po rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po/ dbus gnag g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi re re'ang mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar ser du 'dug pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du rjes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa gsum nag dmar dkar ba/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i dpung pa drug drug phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ phyag lhag ma gnyis/ g.yas gnag g.yon ser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser po/mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ ser mo rnams kyi tshigs phreng dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ sor gdub rnams kyi mdzes shing yid 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yas dmar po/ g.yon dmar pos sgrub le ltar na yi dwags sam/ sngags ltar bdud 'dod lha dang / nyon mongs pa dbang phyug gi snying khar g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis mnan pa/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thab can/ mgo bo dang thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba bsam la/rgyan dang phyag mtshan dgod do/ /oṃ haṃ haḥ bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa/ kaṇ+ḍi yor/ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod cing / haṃ haḥ las grub pa'i mi rus las byung ba'i rdo rje rna rgyan gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas la brgyan par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sngags mgo bo'i sa bon so so las phyag rgya so sor bskyed la dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ oṃ aḥka ཿrgya karī badz+ra me kha la/ badz+ra kane+e ki hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa sked pa dang mgul ba la rdo rje'i ska rags dang mgul rgyan/ oṃ ā ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa/ ka ra yor/ badz+ra ru tsa kauṭa r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa g.yon dang g.yas yang phyag len dang / rgyud 'grel las/ sngar gsung pa'i sa bon rnams lus la bkod de/ ces gsung ba lus la rdo rje dgod pa sngar bzhin bya dgos par mngon zhes bod yul rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mkhan dbang chen po des dgongs pa ste/gong du bshad pa bzhin/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la oṃ dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa sogs nas/ rdo rje'i skur bdag nyid bsgom mo/ /zhes pa'i bar 'don cing gsal btab/ de nas/ oṃ r+ghaṃ kro dhen+d+ra haṃ gro dhā rna ādzñā da ya ka swā hā/ zhes brjod de/ khro bo thams cad la bka' bsgo ba po'i khro bo'i dbang po'i nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ha ya ra wa la brtsegs pa bsam ste/ /snying kha nas rtsegs pa'i yi ge las ha hā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtsug tor can ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can dang / gnod mdzes sngon mo sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can gnyis ka'ang zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum na rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza ma hā un+ḍi ṣa urtse di shi raṭ+wāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ hāḥ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sum+bha a rnyo di shi rak+ṣe ku ru ku ru ṭ+wā hā/ zhes sngags kyi bka' bsgos pas rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste 576

'og gi rtsibs la dgod par gyur/ de bzhin du yi yī dang ral gri dang dbyug pa las bgegs mthar byed don grub lta bu dang / dbyug sngon can nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas ral gri dang rdo rje/g.yon phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa/ oṃ yo badz+ra gro dha rā dza a dhi pa la sarba bisnen ka surba di shi ramāṃ ku ru ku ru ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ yaḥ badz+ra gro dha rā dza ni la daṇ+ḍa asne l+lī de shi rak+ṣu ku ru ku ru swā hā/ sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung nas shar dang me'i rtsib la dgod do/ /rje : dang rin po che dang mda' las shes rab mthar byed rin 'byung lta bu dang / 'dod rgyal dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ ro badz+ra kro dha rā dza rdza bha ka duṣ+ṭa pradzñā pratshwan ka dak+ṣi ṇa de shi raṭ+wāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ rāḥ badz+ra kro dha rā dza ḍak+ki rna tretram̐ de shi ramāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung ste lho dang bden bral gyi rtsib la 'god/ wu lha dang pad+ma dang gtun shing las pad+ma mthar byed snang mtha' lta bu dang / mi g.yo ba dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na tho ba dang mdung / g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang me long 'dzin/ oṃ waṃ badz+ra gro dha rā dza mā na ka bī ra ga pad+man+ta ka usgyu ra di shi ramāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ wāḥ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la zhi sha na di shi raṭ+wāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ lce dang chu lam nas phyung ste byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la dgod/ slo l+lī dang 'khor lo dang be con las gshin rje mthar byed rnam snang lta bu dang / stobs po che ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang dbyugs pa g.yon gnyis na dung dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ oṃ lo badz+ra kro dha rā dza stam+bha ka ya man+ta ka pardzi ma di shi raṭ+wāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ lo badz+ra gro dha rā dza ma hā bā la bā bye di shi raṭ+wāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gshang lam dang rdo rje gtsug tor nas phyung ste nub dang rlung gi rtsibs gdan la dgod/ thams cad kyang skra dmar ser gyen du rjes pa/ sbrul rgyan dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pa/ de ltar khro bo rnams sngags kyi bskul re phyogs su dgod pa bu ston rin po che'i dgongs pa khyad par ltar snang la/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub gzhung nas dbang po'i sgo nas khro bo thon phral sngags kyi bskul ba dang / chos rje mkhyen rab pa'i lhan thabs nas snying ga'i sa bon las khro bo gyur ma thag par sngags kyi bsgo bar snang ste don la khyad mi zhugs pas 'dam nga can no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ badz+ra lha ra wa gi ska rā ya ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje shugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la mchod/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang /pradzñān+ta ka r+ghaṃ zhes pas shes rab mthar byed kyi gzhug zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang ya yan+ta ka rba zhes pas gshin rje mthar byed kyi dbyer med du bcing / dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / pad+man+ya ka hoḥ zhes pas pad+ma mthar byed kyi mnyes par byas/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya dang / bisnan+ya ka hi zhes pas bgegs mthar byed kyi de gnyis ro mnyam par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ thugs kar r+ghaṃ sngon po/ lte bar ho ser 577

po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha gshegs/ gshegs ma/ sems dpa'/ sems ma khro bo khro mo'i lha tshogs rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gharnya sogs kyi mchod/ oṃ haṃ ā ho sh+lau phroṃ hṝ rdu r+ghaṃ smṛsgyu.ā khri rī u lī badz+ra ḍāk+ki rkyo/ badz+ra a mṛ ta/ gha ṭi rā gi ṣiñtsaskyo māṃ swā hā/ zhes pas chu'i dbang dang / oṃ i e ro rku oṃ/sar+bha bud+dha/ badz+ra mu ku ṭaṃ/ mā ma pañtsa bud+dha at+ma kai brnya yaskyo r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces pas cod pan gyi dang / oṃ a ā i aḥ ha hā haṃ hāḥ phre hoḥ sar+bha pa ra mi tā/ mā ma badz+ra paṭa bad+dha yaskyo rdu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dar dpyang gyi dang / oṃ r+ghaṃ hoḥ bi dzñā na dzñā na swā bhā be/ ka ru ṇa/ pradzñā āt+ma ke/ badz+ra badz+ra ghan+de/ sa bye ta ra ka yor/mā ma badz+ra satwaḥ sa pra1 da dā ru/ zhes pas rdo rje dril bu'i dang / oṃ a ā au i ar ār o au al āl oṃ aḥ sarba bo dhi sa twaḥ sa bhābyā sasba dā sar+bha ka ma u pa bho gi badz+ra pra te mā ma da daskyo swā hā/ zhes pas brtul shugs kyi dang / oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā sar+bha kro dha rā dzaḥ sa bhār+sā mi tī/ ka ru ḍā/ mu ti ta/ u pak+ṣe/ sasba sa ma tā/ swā bhā bo badz+ra subam̐ ga mi nā ma me da dan+tu r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas ming gi dang / oṃ e waṃ pad+ma badz+ra tsi sno prargyo pā yo/ maṇ+ḍa la a dhi pa tī badz+ra su kha dzñā rna ga mā ma da da tram̐ tsā haḥ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces pas rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba btab pas dbang bdun gyi bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar bsgom zhing / oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta sasta a bhi ṣe ka sasta sgru mi prasto haṃ/ zhes pas dbang bdun thob pas sa bdun thob pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de nas dbang gong ma'i don du/ oṃ oṃ pra1 pā yo/ ka la sha a bhi ṣi kai me da da ṭ+wāṃ rgyu phroṃ phaṭa/ces pas gsol ba btab pas bum dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ oṃ badz+ra satwe na/ badz+ra ka la sha a gi ṣe ke ṇa/ a bhi ṣik+to/ badz+ra su twa su tro/ ā tsa lā bhu mi latrī haṃ/ zhes pas bum dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de nas/ oṃ āḥ prartso pā yo/ gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kai me da da ṭ+wāṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pa gsang dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ āḥ badz+ra swa twa na/ gu he a gi ṣe ke ṇa/ a gi ṣek+to badz+ra satwa yu ba rā dzo na ba sgru mi lolja haṃ/ zhes pas gsang dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal bzang ngo / /de nas/ oṃ rgyu pra1 pa yo/ badz+ra sa twa/ bi shwa mā tā ro/ pradzha dzha na a bhi ṣi kai/ me da da rta r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gsol ba btab pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ rgyu badz+ra su twe na/ pradzñā dzñā ne na/ a sgyi ṣe ka na/ a bhi ṣisto/ di tī ya/ badz+ra dha ro haṃ/ dhad+ma me ghā bhu mi lashā haṃ/ zhes pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de nas dbang gong ma'i don du/ oṃ ho prarto pā ya ād+ma kai badz+ra sa twa ma hā mu dra dzha na/ a sgyi ṣe kai me pra yats+tsha oṃ āḥ rgyu hoḥphaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ hoḥ dhasmra dhā tā k+ṣa ra tsa tut+pā/ a bhi ṣe ke na/ a gi ṣik+to/ badz+ra satwe na āt+ma nā haṃ/ dri tī yo dwa da sha sgru mi lasgo/ badz+ra satwo ma hā ar+shaḥ sa ra ma a k+ṣa raḥ tre+e lokya bi dza yaḥ kā la tsakro bha ka wān e waṃ kā raḥ zhes pas shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang thob pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de ltar dbang bcu gcig gi dbang bskur/ dri ma bag 578

chags dang bcas pa dag par byas nas/ spyi bor rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab ste/ gtso bo dang steng gi rnams la mi skyod pa/ shar dang shar lho'i rnams la don grub/ lho dang lho nub kyi rnams la rin 'byung / byang dang byang shar gyi rnams snang mtha'/ nub dang nub byang gi rnams la rnam snang / 'og gi rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' rnams sprul sku'i cha byad can gyi rgyas btab so/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa sngags kyi bsrung ba ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng gi skor bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ r+ghaṃ kā la tsakra/1 dur dān+ta da ma ka dz+wa ti dza rā mā rā ḍān+ta ka 2 tre+e lokya bi dza ya/ 3 ma hā bī rī rloshwa ra/4 badz+ra hai ro wa/ 5 badz+ra kā ya/ 6 badz+ra gā tā/ 7 badz+ra ne tra/ 8 badz+ra sho tra/ 9 badz+ra kyā ṇa/ 10 badz+ra dzi hwa/ 11 badz+ra dan+ta/ 12 badz+ra na kha/ 13 badz+ra ke sha 14 badz+ra le ma/ 15badz+ra a bha ra ṇa/ 14 badz+ra ha sa/ 17 badz+ra gī ta/ 18 badz+ra dribya/ 19 badz+ra a yu dha ka ra/ 20badz+ra kro dha rā dza a dhi pa ti/ 21 badz+ra ḍā ka 22 badz+ra ḍāki nī dz+wa la pa ri bṛ ta/ 23 shī sgro a gats+tsha/24 badz+ra satā dzñā yā/ sasba mā ra/ bisna/ bi nā ya ka ki na ra/ ki su ru ṣa/ ga ru ḍa/ ghad+dharba/ yak+ṣa/rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ ma hā pre ta kusgyuṇ+ḍa/ a pas+thā ra/ k+ṣe tra pā la/ be tā ḍa/ pu ta na/ duṣ+ṭa nā ga grwa ha da yo ye/ sasba dz+wa ra/ sar+bha byā dhi/ k+ṣu dra u pa dra ba kā ri ṇaḥ sar+bha satā rna/ sar+bha a pi ka ra ra tā stun/sasban dzaḥ shri r+ghaṃ badz+ra saṃ gu she nā dzo n+tu kṛ shā/ 25 ud+dha de shi ga tā nā kṛ jikhri ṣā/ 26 srurba di shi ga tā nā sngo ṣ+ṭadzo ṣ+ṭa/ 27 dakhri ṇa di shi ga tā nā kṛ jikṛ spya/ 28 ut+ta ra di shi ga tā nā kṛ jisngo dri/ 29pardzi ma di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ spya/ 30 bā ya bya di shi ga tā nā sngo rdzu sngo spya/ 31 zhi sha na di shi ga tā nā dzo tre dzo bye/ 32 rna ri t+ya di shi ga tā nā sngo ṣ+ṭa kṛ spya/ 33 āsne ya di shi ga tā nā sngo ji dzo spya/ 34 a rnyo ṇa di shi ga tā nā dzo t+ta sngo spya/ 35 ā kā sha maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā sngo t+ta kṛ byi/ 36 ba yu maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā sngo t+ta kṛ dri/37 te dze maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā dzo ji dzo bye/ 38 to ya maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā sngo ji dzo spya/ 39 mṛ bī maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā kṛ trī kṛ dz+re/ 40 kā ma dhā ru ga tā nā kṛ ji dzo byi/ 41 ru pa dha ru ga tā nā dzo ji dzo spya/ 42 ā rū pa dhā tu ga tā nā sngo ji sngo spya/ 43 kā ya dh+wa tu ga tā nā sngo ji sngo bye/ 44 wāk+ṣiṃ tu ga tā nā kṛ ji kṛ spya/ 45 tsit+ta dhā tu ga tā nā sngo ji sngo dri/ 46 pañtsa skad+dha ga tā nā sngo ji sngo byi/ 47 pañtsa dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ trī kṛ spya/ 48pañtsarmi ya ga tā nā sngo ji kṛ byi/ 49 pañtsa bi sha ya ga tā nā dzo ji sngo byi/ 50 pañtsa karmadri ya ga tā nā kṛ d+ngha sngo spya/ 51 pañtsa karmadri ya bi ṣa ya ga tā nā kṛ ji kṛ ṣ+ṭṛ/ 52 sasba to yat+ta ku tra tsiṅga tā nā dzo trī sngo spya/53 ma hāsma shā ne/ badz+ra asne dz+wa li ta bhū snyi/ ni pā ta ya ni ro dha ya/ 54 badz+ra pā she na/ sar+bha zla dze khu bhad+dha ya bhad+dha ya/ 55 badz+ra shri kha la yā/ sar+bha pā de khu/ ni ro dha ya ni ro dha ya/ 56 sabra sa twe khu ka ya waka tsit+ta u pa dra ba kā ra ra tānan+d+ra/ ma hā gro dha badz+re ṇa rtsoṇ+ḍi ya tsuṇ+ḍi ya/ 57 badz+ra khaṅge na/ ni krin+ta ya 579

ni krin+ta ya/ 58 badz+ra tri shu la na/ bho da ya bhe da ya/ 59 badz+ra karti kā yā/ ha na ha na/ 60 badz+ra bā ṇi na/ bhirnya bhid+dha/ 61 badz+ra tī la kaiḥ ki la ya tī la ya/ 62 badz+ra muṅka re ṇi ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/63 badz+ra tsākri na/ myu da ya myu da ya/ 64 badz+ra kurnye na gid+dha gid+dha/ 65 badz+ra daṇ+ḍi na tā ḍa ya tā ḍa ya/66 badz+ra parlu na/ khyud+dha sbyid+dha/ 67 sārta tri kro ṭi khaṇ+ḍa kri tā shra shā na bhū ā+oṃ/ sabra bhu te bh+yo ba dzi ku ru ku ru/ 68 badz+ra ḍā ma ru ke na/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī rā bā ha yā bā hā ya/ 69 badz+ra ḍā ki ni bh+yo mā ra kā yi kā ru dhi ram̐ ni be da ya ni be da ya/ 70 pañtsa mṛ ta a hā ri tsā bh+yaḥ pañtsa mṛ tai ni ba da ya ni be da ya/ 71sasba badz+ra ḍā ki sa ha taḥ sar+bha satā ṭ+wāṃ shārnyi kai bosbyi kai rak+ṣa ā ba ra ṇa gu gri ste ku ru ku ru rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/72 ces pa 'phreng ba'i sngags rkang pa bdun bcu rtsa gnyis pa ste/ bsnyen pa bye ba dang / sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bcu bya zhing / las so so la bzlas pa 'bum phrag bcu dang / sbyin sreg khri phrag bcu byas pas dngos grub thams cad 'grub la/ rim pa bzhin bklags pa tsam gyis las thams cad byed cing / lan bdun bzlas pas bdud bgegs la sogs pa tshar gcod par gsungs so/ /de bzhin skang pa bcu drug pa yang bzla bya ste/ 'og nas bshad par 'gyur bas rtogs so/ /de nas khro bo rnams la bka' bsgo ba'i sngags ni gong du bshad zin pa ltar yang ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta raṭ+wāṃ tsakra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de nga rgyal bzung la chu bzhi dang lha mo bcu gnyis kyi mchod nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' ba gdul ka 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal zhing / /srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud/ /grub par byin gyis rlabs pa'i bdud rtsis kyang mchod do/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i gtor ma rnams legs par bshams la/ oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki ni badz+ra dhā tī shwa ri ga ga na swā bha wa sabra dra bya bi shwa dha ni sar+bha dra bya bi shwa dha ya hūṃ phro phaṭa/ kyi bsangs/ swā bhā was stong par bsam stong pa'i ngang las yam las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar ba'i steng du aḥ las bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i sgyed bu gsum mam/ yang na gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin du mi mgo rlon pa'i snyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ oṃ mi ka la byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du a i ṛ u lo las byung ba'i rim pa bzhin du dbus su khu ba/ shar du rkang / lho ru khrag byang du dri chu/ nub tu dri chen rnams la a i ṛ u los mtshan pa/ lī u rī zhi ā las byung zhing des mtshan pa'i rlung du glang po che'i sha dbang ldan du ba glang gi sha srin por rta'i sha mer khyi'i sha /dbus su mi'i sha rnams bsam la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyis bskul ba'i rlung gis sdar ba'i mes bzhus te/ de nyid hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjes dkrugs pas de dang bcas pa ro gcig 580

tu gyur pa zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su blta'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis steng du oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje bskyed la gtor ma la bstan te/ o oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sab dhasmyu/ su bi shud+dha/ swā bhā wa/ sabra dhasmyum+bi sho dha ya ṭ+wā hā/ zhes brjod pas sku rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku rdo rje spyan drangs/ des 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sku rdo rje'i bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas gcig tu gyur pa dang / dam tshig gi bdud rtsi 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyang nas skyon med par bsam/ lag pa g.yas pa u las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i gsung rdo rje bskyed de gtor ma la bstan la/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra srur+ya sabra dhasmra/ pra bo dha ka sabra dharmaspra ba dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas gsung rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ gsung rdo rje spyan drangs/ gsung rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bsdus shing de nyid du thim pas rdzas rnams mang por rgyas par bya zhing bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par rtogs shing khong du chud par bsam/ thal mo gnyis ka spun pa'i snyim pa r+ghaṃ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyu dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i thugs rdo rje bsam la reg ste/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sabra dhasgra pra ṭi sa ka sar+bha dhasmrapra dri pa ya su hā/ zhes brjod pas thugs rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ thugs rdo rje spyan drangs/ thugs rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bstus shing de nyid du thim pas rdzas rnams rab tu sbar zhing kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ho las dub me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ho las ye shes rdo rje bsam te gtor ma la bstan la/ oṃ ho sar+bha dhasmra/ badz+ra a sbo ta ka ra/ sar+bha dharmān/ badz+ra a mṛ te ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ye shes rdo rje spyan drangs/ ye shes rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bsdus shing de nyid du thim pas zag bcas kyi dri ma bsal nas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam te gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya la haṃ bsam zhing de yongs su gyur pa las/ pad nyi'i steng du hi'am hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan gyi gzugs su bsam zhing / de las 'od zer 'phros pas mgron gang yin spyan drangs par bsam zhing / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo rnams dang / gtor ma'i mgron ma lus pa spyan drangs zhing de rnams la lha mo zhal nas mas bdud rtsi sten par bsam pa'o/ /yang na r+ghaṃ las ljags rdo rje sbu gu can gyi bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la rkang pa bcu drug pa'i mthar gtor sngags kyi sham bu btags nas dbul zhing / rkang pa bdun bcu rtsa gnyis pas 'phrin las bcol ba'i phyag len ltar ram/ yang na oṃ āḥ hūṃ ho shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra hai ra wa ji ka rā ya sa pa ri wā re bh+ya zhes pa la i rda ba li/man chad btags la dbul khro bo rnams la/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ usnri ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bisnan+ta ka ni la daṇ+ḍa/ pradzñān+ta ka ṭak+ki rā dza/ pad+mān+ta ka a tsa le/ ya man+ta ka ma hā ba la sgyeḥ zhes pa la/ e rda/ ba lo/ ghargyu/ puḥ/ 581

dhū pi/ ak+ṣa rta/ da dā ma he/ te tsā ā gar+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra/ shī tram̐/ i rda/ ba dzi/ grisnan+tu/ bā dan+tu/ pi waskyo/ dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ paṃ tristaḥ sar+bha satā nā shirnyi puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣa ba ra ṇa gu ste ku rban+tu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes btags pas gtor ma phul te/ bstod pas bstod la/ yi ge k+ṣa dang lag pa'i rgyab bstan pa'i se gol spyil gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo haṃ las khro bo rnams la gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /dkyil chog gi dus su thun mtshams bzhir gtor ma byin zhing gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga rdzogs nas bzung ba la sogs pa bya ba gzhan la 'jug par bya ste srung 'khor lo/ /de ltar lugs 'di'i srung ba'i 'khor lo zhing / rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang stobs mtshungs pa tsam du snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa des dgongs nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar mdzad bzhin bkod pa ste/ de yang khro bo'i srung 'khor 'di mkhas pa'i dbang po nyang de'i dus 'khor thugs dkyil dpag bsam snye ma'i yi ge sor bzhag drangs na legs par snang yang / de ni yi ge nyung rung tshig nyung ngur gnas pa ma yin pas 'dir ni ngag 'don rnams bsgrub thabs gzhung chen dngos grub 'dod 'jo ltar bkod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrub thabs mngon par rtogs pa dngos la/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsags dngos bzhi rnal 'byor bzhi/ rjes su mchod bstod gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /zhes pa'i dang po la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ skad cig gis rang dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed sdom pa chen por sa/sal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyu las rdo rje rtse lnga pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros te/rgyal ba sras bcas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par nam mkha'i mthil du spyan drangs nas/ 'od zer nam mkha'i snying kha'i zla ba rdo rje la bstus te/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye dang 'jigs pa med/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sogs kyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas snying kha'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kru dang / sgyu las rol mo ma dang gar ma ljang khu rnga pa ta ha dang / gos bsnams pa/ rje dang / rje dza las dri rā ma dang 'phreng ba ma nag mo dri'al bu'i dung chos dang me tog sngon po'i 'a 'phreng ba 'a bsnams pa/ sgro dang / sbru las bdug spos ma dang mar me ma dmar mo spos snod dang mar me bsnams pa/ m+bha dang / za sbya las s+thā lha bshos ma dang 'bras bus ma dkar mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod dang 'bras sku bu 'dzin pā pa/ ta dang ta las sgeg ma bzhad ma ser mo dbu rgyan dang do shal 'dzin pa'am yang na sngags nas 'byung d+dhā ba sbyaltar rim pa bzhin gos dang / rgyan dang dril bu dang me long 'dzin pa dang / skyu dang sgyu las gye ma dang /'dod ma sngon mo rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dzin pa spros te/ rang rang gi mchod sko rdzas d+dhādang 'dod mas snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bas mchod par bsam ste/ so so'i phyag rgya nang bcas pas/ oṃ rje badz+ra ghadhe ghar+ghaṃ artsa rna ku ru ku ru ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ ༈ badz+ra mā le mā la artsa rna ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ d+dhā badz+ra dhū khepe dhū pa artsa rna 582

ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ rjo badz+ra pra kadī pe pra dri pa artsa rna ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ sbya badz+ra a mṛ te nai bebya pū rdzu ku ru ku ru dhāswā hā/ oṃ sgru badz+ra a k+ṣa te a k+ṣa ta pha la artsa rna ku ru ku skeru swā hā/ oṃ sbya badz+ra lā su wa s+t+ra a bha ra ṇa pū rdzu ku tsāru ku ru swā hā/ o rje badz+ra ha su ghaṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pu rdzu ku ru ku tsāru swā hā/ oṃ smra badz+ra bībya bābya pū rdzu ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ma smṛ badz+ra n+ni h+ye n+ni bya pū rdzu ku ru ku ru swā hā/oṃ spya badz+ra gī ti tre gī ta pu jo ku ru ku ru ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ lji badz+ra kā rā me sasba bud+dha bo dhi satwa dzā kro dhā dī dzā rma badz+ra pu ra ta pū rdzu ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas bhāmachod nas/ thogs med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /chags dang zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /bgyis dang bgyid stsal yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /'phags pa rnams kyi dge tshogs dang / /gzhan yang dge ba thams cad la/ /mngon par dga' bas yi rang ngo / /nyon mongs nad kyi gdung pa yi/ /skye bo bde bar gso bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bdud rtsi yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /ma rtog 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /mya ngan 'da' bzhed spang nas ni/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag tshul gyis/ /bskal pa mtha' yas bzhugs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas slob dpon dbang mchog thob/ /des bstan thabs shes dbyer med ches/ /der gnas dge 'dun rnam gnyis la/ /rab tu dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid rnam pa kun tu 'bul/ /yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bran dang 'bangs su bzung du gsol/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /rang don dri mas ma gos par/ /srid gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /bsam pa rnam par dag pa bskyed/ /bdag dang bdag gis 'dzin pa spang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs smon lam/ /stobs dang ye shes pha rol phyin/ /tshogs gsum don du bsgrub par bgyi/ /sems can bde dang ldan pa dang / /sdug bsngal dang ni bral ba dang / /bde la rtag tu gnas par dga'/ /mnyam nyid btang snyoms bsgom par bgyi/ /sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos te/ /snyan par smra ba'i gtam byas nas/ /don spyod pa yi bag phab ste/ /don mthun gros chen gdab par bgyi/ /lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi las ni rnam gsum ste/ /mi dge bcu po spangs par bgyi/ /bslab pa gsum la sgrib pa yi/ /'gyod dang rmugs pa gnyid dang ni/ /rgod pa dang ni the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po spangs par bgyi/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang dang / /gti mug dang ni nga rgyal ste/ /srid pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa yi/ /nyon mongs bzhi po spang bar bgyi/ /'dod pa'i zag dang srid pa'i zag /ma rig pa yi zag pa dang / /lta ba'i zag ste 583

'khor ba'i rgyu/ /zag pa bzhi po spang bar bgyi/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med/ /smon med mngon par 'dus ma byas/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub par bgyi/ /zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ /bstan g.yo khams gsum po tshig bcad 'dis rnam par dpyad de/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos mi 'gyur/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes pas chos thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum gyi stong pa'i mtshan nyid du lta ba/ 'khor ba'i phung po spang zhing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po bzung ba'i phyir/ chus me rnams nyams par byas/ me dang bral ba'i sa chu la thim/ chu rlung gi skam/ rlung nam mkha' la thim te/ sems can kun gzhi'i rnam shes nam mkha'i khams rnams thams cad pa'i gzugs kyi rang bzhin du bsgom la/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mirta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ra dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a nā bhi sam ska ra dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kohwahaṃ/ zhes brjod pas khams gsum po rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa dngos bzhi la/ dkyil 'khor rgyas mchog dang / las rgyas mchog dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'i dang po la/ rten 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa dang / rten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sngon gyi smon lam rdzogs par bya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don du mngal skyes kyi tshul gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa gsung pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung gi nang du yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa thad kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa/ steng 'og tu rgyu las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang bcas pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ro las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa/ steng 'og tu r+ghaṃ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang bcas pa bkra shis kyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa/ steng 'og tu rgyu las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang bcas pa pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa/ steng 'og tu r+ghaṃ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang bcas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du mi las lhun po chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong drag drug cu dang / steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa de'i dbus su gho las sna tshogs pad+ma ri rab kyi phyed dang mnyam pa'i sum cha lte ba la yod cing / lte ba'i steng du haṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du tsheg drag las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 584

'khor kha dog sngon po nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pas t+na gi yi ger bsgom zhing / de las grul pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rlung nas sgra gcan gyi bar bsam la/ chi de'i steng du r+ghaṃ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du rdo rje sa gzhi la r+ghaṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor nor bu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba can te/ phyi nas rim bzhin/ ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa zlum po sgo brgyad pa nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin gyi rta babs brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rta bab so so la ka ba bzhi'i bar du lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i rtsig pa gsum pa/ rtsig pa 'og ma la glang po che'i mgor seng ges mnan pa dang bar ma dang / steng ma shā la bhardzi kas snam bu btegs pa/ snam bu so so'i rtse mor rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang / rnga yab dang / me long dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dkar se rnams 'phyangs pa/ steng du harmi dang / de'i steng du dbus su bum pa dang / g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang / ka ba'i bsham nas myos pa bsrung pas bskor ba'o/ /rtsig pa'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po rin po che'i 'ching pa rnam par bkra ba/ de'i steng du do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang / me long dang / rnga yab dang / dril bu dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / me tog gi 'phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab las 'phyangs pa'i ba gu li dkar po/ de'i steng du kra ma shīr+ṣa pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dkar pos 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor zhing /sgo khyud dang ka ba'i mtshams su rin po ches spras pa/ sgo'i bar mtshams kyi brtsegs pa'i ngos rnams su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rtsigs pa'i nang du rtsigs pa la ma reg pa'i stegs bu zlum po steng du 'phar ba thog dang bcas pa/ zlum skor phyi nas/ dang po 'og gzhi sngon po'i steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo ljang khu rtsibs brgyad la lte ba'i mu khyud nang mtha' rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nang du 'og gzhi ser po'i steng du rlung gi 'khor lo nag po ral gri'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nang du 'og gzhi dkar po'i steng du me'i 'khor lo dmar po rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du 'og gzhi dmar po'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po pad+ma'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nang du 'og gzhi nag po'i steng du sa'i 'khor lo ser po 'khor lo'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i nang 'og gzhi ljang khu'i steng du ye shes kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba'i mu khyud kyi nang mtha' la gri gug gi phreng bas mtshan pa/ 'khor lo kun kyang lte ba mu khyud gnyis m+bil nang mar phyag mtshan gyi phreng ba dang / phyi ma rnams rtsibs kyi skye gnas su gyur cing / rtsibs rnams mu khyud dang bral ba rtse mo rab tu rno ba bgegs tshogs 'joms pa'i mtshon char gnas pa'o/ /de ltar mkhas grub 'khor lo'i dbus su oṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug 585

pa'i lte ba la/ oṃ āḥ a las zla ba dang nyi ma dang dus me'i gdan/ de'i steng du bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i lha gnyis sgyel ba dang / 'dir bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs gtso bo'i gdan ni zla nyi'i steng du sgra gcan kha dog rin po che mthon kha chen po lta bu gnas pa yin yang / sdom chen gyi gdan ni nyi zla'i steng du dus me byas na legs par rtogs te/ de yang shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser ram lcags sreg dang sa ba'i kha dog lta bu ste/ rgyud rgya mtsho skor drug gi shrī he ru ka bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gdan yang de ltar/ de nyid gzigs pa'i dam pas bkod pa dang / ye me'i tshigs bcad so gnyis par sdom chen gyi mngon rtogs gsung ba na/ zla nyi sreg pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni zhabs kyis 'og na bdud dang dbang ldan zhes pas kyang mtshon/ sa gzhi sgra gcan la yang a na la me yi sgras brtan pa sgrub le'i tshigs bcad brgyad pa'i rkang pa dang por 'byung yang rgyud don rgyud pa'i shes pa'i skabs thob dkyil 'khor 'di chos bying pa gsung dbang gi rgyab zhal dang sbrun na ye shes rdo rje'i dag pa bcas de ltar 'thad par go'o/ /de'i phyi skor snying po pad+ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi 'dab ma dang 'khor lo drug pa'i rtsibs bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang / sgo brgyad mtshams brgyad de lha gnas bdun cu rtsa gnyis po rnams su dbugs bral gyi gdan rin po che'o/ /phyi rol na mchod pa'i sa la pad+ma bum sogs mchod rdzas du mas gang ba/ gzhal yas khang gi sa gzhi dang thog gi dbus sngon po/ shar dang me nag po/ lho dang bden bral dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan dkar po/ nub dang rlung ser po/ phyi nas sa chu me rlung gi khor yug bzhis bskor ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan gyi mtshams su lhalas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / bden bral gyi mtshams su sa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ram/ me dang rlung gi dbus su dur khrod chen po bcu drug gi yongs su bskor ba ni/ shar du mdung gi 'bigs pa/ mer lhag ma can/ lhor ro sregs pa/ bden bral du drag po'i g.yul/ byang du rul bar gyur pa/ dbang ldan du byis pa shi ba/ nub tu rnag gi dri can/nub byang du sbrul gyi zos pa re brgyad mtshan dang po dang de dag gi bar bar du dur khrod gzhan brgyad de rlung g.yas su kang ka le dang / g.yon du kol dha la/ dbang ldan gyi g.yon du ha ha sgrog pa dang / g.yas su drag tu rgod pa/ bden bral gyi g.yon du drag po'i sgra gcan dang / /g.yon du pho ṭa ka ra dang / me'i g.yas su 'jigs rung dang / g.yon du 'jigs par byed pa ni brgyad mtshan gnyis pa ste/ dur khrod chen po bcu drug mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas bskor ba nam mkha'i khor yug la rdo rje'i ra ba dang / de'i phyi rol du 'od zer 'bar bas bskor bar bsam mo/ /sa 'khor gseng ba'i phyed dag pa/ /rga shi gzhu khyim 'gag pa las/ /dri ma med pa la bstud pa'i/ /skye rim rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /'dod gzugs dza ler+ghaṃ ra dang / gang ba'i ri dang o rgyan rnams/ /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /sa dpyil gsang gnas phyed gzhan la/ /skye ba sdig khyim 'gag pa las/ /dri med pa la bstud pa'i rim/ /go dā wa rī dga' dbang phyug /lha me'i mkhar dang mā la ba/ /rlung sogs rtsibs la rim pas ste/ /de ltar ye shes 'khor lo'o/ /chu dkyil lte ba'i phyed dang po/ /srid pa srang gi dus sbyor dag /skye ba'i rim pa 'od byed pa/ /arbu ta dang mumyu ni/ /o tre byed pa'i pa ṭa kai /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi ste/ /chu 'khor lte ba'i phyed phyi ma/ /len pa bu mo rnam dag pa/ /'od 'phro'i sa la 586

sdud rim ste/ /phur gsum las kyi pā ṭa kai /ko sa la dang khā ḍa ni/ /rlung phyogs la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /de ltar sa yi 'khor lo'o/ /chu 'khor snying gi phyed phyi ma/ /sred pa seng ge'i khyim 'gag pa/ /skye ba'i rim pa sbyangs dka'i sa/ /ka li ha ri ke la dang / /zla ba'i gling dang lasbra ka /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /chu dkyil snying gi phyed dag pa/ /tshor ba kaṅka khyim gzhan ni/ /mngon gyur pa la bsdud pa'i rim/ /pañtsa'i yul dang kong ka na/ /hi ma la ya bal po'i yul/ /rlung la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi ste/ /chu'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /me dkyil mgrin pa'i 'khor lo phyed/ /reg pa 'khrig khyim 'gag pa las/ /skye rim ring du song ba'i sa/ /mā tram̐ gri ha pra mā ga /ko la gi ri khyim gyi lha/ /dbang po la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /me dkyil mgrin pa'i phyed gzhan la/ /skyes mched drug dang glang khyim 'gag /mi g.yo'i sa la bsdud rim ste/ /sau raṣ+ṭa dang kha che'i yul/ /gser gling sidha la rnams ni/ /g.yo ba la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /me yi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /me dkyil dpral ba'i phyed dag pa/ /ming gzugs lug khyim 'gags pa ste/ /skye rim legs pa'i blo gros sa/ /na ga ra dang dbang chen drag /sid+dha ki rān ta yi yul/ /shar phyogs la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /rlung dkyil dpral ba'i phyed phyi ma/ /rten 'brel nya khyim 'gag pa ste/ /chos kyi sprin chen sdud pa'i rim/ /ma ru'i yul dang ka ha ra/ /ku lu ta dang mā hā ma la/ /rlung sogs rtsibs la rim pa bzhin/ /rlung gi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rlung dkyil gtsug gtor 'khor lo'i phyed/ /'du byed bum pa'i khyim 'gags pa/ /skye ba'i rim pa kun tu 'od/ /tsa ri tra dang ke la ra/ /gid+dha gzhon nu ma grong rnams/ /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /rlung dkyil gtsug tor byed phyi ma/ /ma rig chu srin 'gags pa ni/ /bcu gnyis pa ste bsdud pa'i rim/ /rdul bral dang ni kong ka na/ /grong gsum shrī haskyo ka /nub byang la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /nam mkha' 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /'di rnams dag sbyor gyi don gal chen yin pas go zhing shes nas bsgom pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gtso bo yab yum mngon byang lnga las skyed pa dang / de'i mngal nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor spro ba dang / spros pa'i dkyil 'khor du sems can la snying rje'i dbang bskur sbyin pa dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i nga rgyal bzung ba dang bzhi'i dang po ni/ dbus su zla nyi sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yar ngo'i tshes gcig gi cha la sogs pa rnams/ a i ṛ u lo/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la/ i rnams g.yon bskor/ mar ngo'i tshes gcig la sogs pa rnams/ lā wā rā yā nā/ al au ār mṛ ā/ lī u rī khri ā/ āḥ rnams g.yas bskor/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor des mtshan pa me long ltu bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu g.yas bskor gyis/ l+la lha yā ṇ+ḍa rgyu l+la smra hra yā t+ta/ sla tshosh+ka nā/ t+ta sgra ja d+dha n+d+ra/ bla bla bla rgyu sma/ skyo ṣ+ṭha ṇ+ḍa sno ṇ+ḍa/ rtso ts+tsha dz+dza sgo snya/ k+ka k+ṣa ga rna ja / g.yon bskor gyis nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa bha ḍa 587

ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ska sha ṣa tha sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nye ḍa ya wa la rnams dpe byad brgyad bcu'i ngo bo rnams su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor des mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so//zla ba'i dbus su r+ghaṃ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /de gsum gcig tu 'dres pa srog gi rlung hi yig dang ldan pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dbyangs rnams kyis thig le gsal byed rnams kyi rnam par bcad pa/ rnam shes gzhom med kyi ha yig srog gi a yig rnams gcig tu 'dres pas haṃ 'grub pa bzhin ye shes snga ma bzhi gcig tu 'dres pa las sku'i cha
