shas yongs su rdzogs pa rnam shes haṃ yig dang ldan pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dpal mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba sdom pa chen po rdo rje 'jigs byed mdzad 'jig par byed pa dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ sku mdog sngon po/ dbus kyi mgrin pa sngon po/ g.yas pa dmar po/ g.yon pa dkar po ste mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/g.yon zhal dkar po/ zhal re re yang mche ba rtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ spyan gsum gsum dmar ser du 'dug pa/ sma ra/ smin ma dmar ser 'bar zhing / dbu skra dmar ser ral pa'i cod paṇa la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje nor bu dang / rdo rje sna rgyan dang / rdo rje mgul rgyan dang / rdo rje gdub bu dang / rdo rje ska rags dang / rdo rje dar dpyang dang /rdo rje'i phreng ba ste/ rdo rje'i rgyan cha can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ /gsum pa dkar po ste/ phrag pa drug /dpung pa bcu gnyis/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dang po bzhi bzhi nag po/ gnyis pa bzhi bzhi dmar po/ gsum pa bzhi bzhi dkar po/ phyag lhag ma gnyis g.yas nag g.yon ser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ /gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/mthe chung ljang khu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste sor gdub rnams kyis mjes shing 'od 'phro ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje/ gnyis par ral gri/ gsum pa rtse gsum/ bzhi pa gri gug dmar po bzhi'i dang por me'i mda'/gnyis par rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bzhi par tho ba/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por 'khor lo/ gnyis par mdung / gsum par dbyug pa/ bzhi par dgra sta'o/ /g.yon gyi nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje dril bu/ gnyis par phub/ gsum par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnam par rgyas pa/ bzhi pa khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum par rin po che/bzhi par pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por dung / /gnyis par me long / /gsum par rdo rje lcags sgrogs/ bzhi par tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas spras pas 'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi 588

glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag g.yon pa gnyis nas phyag tha ma gnyis kyi bzung ste/ 'chi bdag bdud kyi mgo bo dang lhag ma yin gyi thod pa khrag gi gang ba dang lhan cig par sdigs mdzub dang bcas te 'dzin pa yan lag thams cad la thal ba dang /sku sked stag gi pags pa dkris pa/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya yi mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ dbu re re la thod pa rdzogs pa kha dog lnga yi phreng ba can/ klu rgyal ljang khu ral pa'i cod pan du bcing ba/ rnam rgyal sngon pos dar dpyang su bcings pa/ stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag la brgyan pa/ nor rgyal dang dung skyong dmar po dag gi g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag gdub byas pa/mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po dag gis ska rags dang mgul pa brgyan pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po dag gis g.yon dang g.yas pa'i rkang gdub byas pa/ zla nyi dang sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rnam par rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa dmar po'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig lag pa bzhi pa/ lag na me tog gi mda' lnga dang / gzhu dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dkar po'i 'og tu drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ rtse gsum dang ḍa ma ru dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dga' ma dang u mas zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin zhing gdong dman par byas bzhin par bsam mo/ /oṃ haṃ ha/ bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa kau hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pa da yor badz+ra nu pu re rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ baṃ pañtsa ā kā ra ma hā shu n+ya swa bhā wa badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sar+bha i ge bhasma r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ adha bā rī shwa ra badz+ra ad+dha tsad+dha badz+ra paskyo udhe hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āḥ e sasba swa ra e ka tri su ra su bha wa badz+ra ya rnyo sa bī ta skadhe r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣa ཿ dur tan+d+ra a sgyi mā na k+ṣa yi ka ra byā gh+ra tsad+ma ka ṭi r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥ tro shad su ra sasta ti hra swa drir+gha bhañdza na su bhā baid t+ya ku la sha ta si ro sgyir muṇ+ḍa mā la skad+dha ā ba lo rnyi ni skadhewa r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hi hri hu chi pañtsa skad+dha bi shud+dha swā bhā wa shi ra si ka pā la mā le r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣaḥ gro dha badz+ra r+ghaṃ phaṭa oṃ 12 badz+ra khasga rgyu phaṭa/oṃ s+dza badz+ra tri shu la r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra karta ri r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra bā ṇa rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra i gu sha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra ḍa ma ru ka rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra muṅga ra r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ s+dza badz+ra kun ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra daṇ+ḍa rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ s+dza badz+ra par+sha r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoḥphre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra khe ṭa ka hoḥ phro phaṭa/ oṃ hai badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra ka pa la hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ hai badz+ra tsā pa hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra pā sha hoḥ phro phaṭa/ oṃ nā badz+ra rat+na hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra pad+ma hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra sho kha hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra ādar+sha hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ badz+ra shri kha le 589

hoḥ phre phaṭa/ oṃ swā badz+ra tsa dur be da ṭ+wā bhā wa bhāh+ma shi ram̐ hoḥ phro phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣu spyi k+ṣi ṣ+ṭṛ ṣ+ṭṛk+ṣu k+ṣu k+ṣ-ismyu k+ṣ-iḥk+ṣaḥ ha hā hi tī ཿhra : hu hū gli lha haṃ haḥ sarba bisna bi dā ri ta ga dza tsarma pa ṭa an+d+ra rak+ta shra ba ta r+ghaṃ phre/ oṃ rgyu badz+ra dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭā mu ku ṭa bhadhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra bi dza ya na in+d+ra badz+ra paskyo bhadhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ zlo : badz+ra karko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mo bā ma dākhri ṇa kuṇ+ḍal yoḥtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hre hre badz+ra bā su ki shaṃ kha pā lo ba ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ hūṃ badz+ra a nan ta ku li kau mo kha lā karī ka yoḥ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ rtu : badz+ra rak+ṣa ka da ma hā pad+mo bā ma dakhri ṇa pa dā nu su ra yoḥ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de yang sdom chen gyi gtso bo 'di ni kha cig gi khro bo rdo rje shugs yin par 'dod cing / de la phyag rgya rgyan bkod kyi sngags mi bzhed na sogs ni mi legs te/ de yi 'khrul gzhi 'byung ba'i rgyu ni se mo'i tshigs bcad so lnga pa'i 'grel par/ gnyis brtag rgyal ba'i phyag ste sngar gsung pa'i rdo rje shugs so/ /zhes phyag dang phyag mtshan der kha 'phang bar rten lha yi ngo bo der 'khrul pa ste/ lha yi ngo bo ni/ le'u de'i tshigs bcad ni dgu pa'i 'grel par/ dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo he ru ka gtso bo te zhes bstan na rdo rje shugs su 'dod pa des mnyam bzhag des na dus 'khor phyag snyed drug pa dang sdom chen gtso bo gnyis tha dad pa ma yin la/ 'on kyang sdom chen gtso bo he ru ka'o/ /he ru ka rigs drug ma 'dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed du grags pa de yin pas rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka yin gyis/ rdo rje shugs ni mi bskyod he ru ka'o/ /de yang he ru ka kho na'i dbang du mi spyod pa rigs gtso bor bzhag kyang / dus 'khor dkyil 'khor bdag po'i rigs kyi gtso bo ni rgyal ba thams cad bskyed mdzad te rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas he ru ka yang de gtso bor bzung ngo / /nges pa'i don du ni dus 'khor sna tshogs gtso bo dang rdo rje 'jigs byed rdo rje shugs rnams ngo bo tha dad gtan nas ga la yod/ spyir yang ye shes lha la gnyis snang gi dbye ba med kyang / /gdul bya la dgongs te rnam grangs ltar bstan pa ni de ltar go dgos la/ de yang ma zad dkyil 'khor gyi lha gshegs khro sems gsum du dbye ba las 'dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs mdzad ni de bzhin gshegs pa yin cing / rdo rje shugs kyi dngos bstan ni khro bo'i dbang po ste/ de tshe sdom chen sku yi rnam 'gyur yang / rnal 'byor shugs ltar sbom sbom thung ral pa gyen rjes sogs ma yin par/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid grom pa'i nyam can te/ dus 'khor phyag nyer drug dang mthun pa las/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed ni de dang mi 'dra ba'i chos/ zhal gyi nyams tha dad ma yin par bzhi char gcig tu khros shing / sma smin thor lcog rnams kha dog dmar ser byed pa'o/ /yang dam pa kha cig gi tshul de la dgongs nas dus 'khor chos dbyings gsung dbang gi bsgrub thabs su rnal 'byor shugs kyi srung 'khor cho ga grub nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor yang byas te bsgrub thabs dngos la 'jug par gsung mod/ de ni dbang le'i tshigs bcad so lnga pa'i 'grel par/ de nas bdud dang bgegs kyi nye bar 'tshe ba zhi bar bya ba'i slad du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed rnal 'byor la dmigs par bya ste/ zhes pa sogs gsung ba la dgongs yang / 'grel tshig tshig 'bru gnon lugs dbang gi de ltar mdzad pa dang / ma mdzad pa la lhag pa dang chad pa'i skyon gnyis ka med pa ni kho bo'i rnam rtog go /de bzhin rgyan dang phyag mtshan sngags kyi bkod pa ni/ dus 'khor phyag nyer drug pa dang rdo rje 'jigs byed la lhag par sngags 590

pa'i khyad chos yin na/ sdom pa chen po'i cho ga rgyas par dkyil 'khor rgyas mchog dang las rgyas mchog gnyis kar dgos la/ bsdus na gang rigs re re la ma chad pas rung zhing / gtan nas ma byas na khyad chos kyi cho ga nyams pas mi rung ngo / /der yang ma zad sna tshogs gtso bo la yang glang lpags dang sbrul rgyan bor ba'i phyag rgya brgyan bkod gzhan byas na legs zhes dam pa mchog gi bzhed bzhin de ni phan yon lhag po thob pa las cho ga lhag pa'i skyon ni nam yang ma mthong ngo / /de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan ma sna tshogs yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub dang g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / snyan dang / ske rgyan dang / zhabs gdub la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang / thod pa'i dum bu mgo lpags dang / thod pa skam po'i dbu brgyan dang / do shal gyi mdzes pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi bcom ldan dang snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa/ gtsag bo gdan gyi pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad la shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ mer du ba ma/ bden bral du smig sgyu ma/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma/ rlung du mar me ma ste rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma brgyad do/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas cung zad steng phyogs su bskyod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag brgya lnga dang / dum bu'i ske rag dang dril bu g.yer kha'i tshogs dang / mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan pa bcom ldan ma dang mtshungs zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams su thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba brgyad de/ shar du rkang 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang / lhor khrag gi 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang / byang du lci bas 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang / nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis te/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa brgyad yang dag par gnas par gyur pas te/ de dag ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can kyi 'jig rten dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ shin tu dga' ba'i dgra yis rang gi lus la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams dang / nam mkha' la sogs pa khams kyi tshogs rnams dang / skyes bu dang rig ma mig la sogs pa dang / gzugs la sogs pa yul gyi rang bzhin gyi lha yi rang gi ngo bor snang bar gyur pa rnams bzhugs par bya ste slar yang de dag gi rang gi lus la spros nas sna tshogs yum gyi nang du ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du spros nas slar yang khams rnams dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i 591

rnam pa rnams rang gi lus la gzhugs par bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur pa rnams rang gi rigs ma'i pad+ma'i nang du rang gi rdo rje nas spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa bsgom mo/ /dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i bdag po mi skyod pa ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang / gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang / thod pa dang / tshangs mgo 'dzin pa la sher phyin ma sngon mo rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bas 'khyud pa dang / rdo rje dbyings phyug ma sngon mo sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang / gri gug dang / dgra sta dang / g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang thod pa dang / tshangs mgo 'dzin pa la rdo rje sems dpa' ljang khu mi bskyod pa 'dra bas 'khyud pa dag byung / nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag po'i tshul du mi bskyod pa yab yum gtso bo yab la zhugs/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma yab yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la zhugs par gyur/ de nas 'khor gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams gsang ba'i pad+ma las phyir spros te 'khod par gyur pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ rten gzhal yas khang phyung phyi yi gzhal yas khang la thim dbyer med du gyur par bsam gyi bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab so/ /'dir mkhas mchog chos rje bu ston rin po che gang gi gsung rgyun dus 'khor lhan thabs zin bris las/ dus 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs kyi lha tshogs bskyed tshul mang du byung yang / sngags bla med kyi spyi lugs thig le bskyed pa 'thad pa dang / gzhal yas khang mkha' spro byed pa bu ston chen po'i gsung las shin tu gsal yang zin bris mkhan gzhan gyi ma shes so zhes smra bar mdzad kyang / gzhan yang mkha' spro dus 'khor mkhan mkhas pa mang pos ma byas shing bu ston chen po'i bzhed pa yin min yang brtag dgos la/ dus 'khor sgrub gzhung skabs 'di'i tshig rnams ni sgrub me tshigs bcad bcu dgu pa'i 'grel pa sor bzhag du snang ba rgyud 'grel tshig 'ongs pa blags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha thig le kho nas bskyed pa dang gzhal yas khang mkha' spro 'ba' zhig yin yang de gzhan gyi ma shes so zhes phyogs gcig tu 'gog pa ni shin tu mi rung ste/ tshig 'di dag gi don mkhas pa gzhan gyis gzhan dag tu rgya cher bkral ba dag yod pas so/ /'on kyang byang chub sems zla ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa zhes dang / de dag yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa'i tshig gi thig le bskyed par 'byor bar ni sems la/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /zhes byung bar rten gyi don snyog pa gzhal yas khang yin par lhan thabs byed po'i dgongs par mngon la/ gzhan yang bu ston mchog gi slob rgyud rtse thang grags 'byung sogs kha cig gis kyang de ltar byas pas na/ 'dir yang gzhal yas khang dang lha tshogs bskyed tshul 'di lta lhan thabs grags che ba'i dbang ltar bkod pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus 'khor rdor sems kyi dbu rgyan chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid bsgom ste/ de nas 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams bkug nas dkyil 'khor de nyid du bcug par bsam par bya/ de nas rigs lnga yab yum rnams rang gi snying gar bcug nas byang chub kyi sems zhu bar gyur pa rnams rang gi 592

gsang dzeba'i rdo rje nas spros te byang chub kyi sems des sems can de dag rnams la dbang bsgyur bar bsam mo de nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis reg pa'i sems can de dag thams cad zhal gsum pa dang zhal sna tshogs pa dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha'i rang bzhin shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid can mchog gi dga' ba'i bde bas gang bar bsgom mo/ /de nas de rnams kyi rang gi lus kyi phung po lnga k+ṣa k+ṣi ṣ+ṭṛ k+ṣu k+ṣ-i las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga/khams lnga k+ṣa spyi sgyu k+ṣu ༈ las gshegs ma lnga/ dbang po drug k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣar gho k+ṣal k+ṣa las sems dpa' drugayul drug k+ṣu sgyu k+ṣur smyo k+ṣul k+ṣuḥ las sems ma drug las dbang lnga lha k+ṣu lha k+ṣu las khro bo lnga/ bya ba lnga kyā smyu smyu smri k+ṣu las khro mo lnga ste lha so gnyis po rnams skyes bu chen po'i mtshan so gnyis su gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par bsgom ste rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par bsam mo/ /de ni mdor bsdus pas te rgyas par byed na sems can thams cad rang gi snying khar bcug ste byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba lha mo'i pad+mar sa bon re res lha de rnams so sor rdzogs par byas nas spro'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ o su bi shudha dharmā dhā tu swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de/ chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid kyi nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gnyis pa la/zhu ba glus bskul te bzhengs pa dang / de'i mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro ba dang / ye shes dgug gzhugs dang / rgyas gdab pa dang / sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab cing dbang bskur ba dang / rnam dag bsgom pa dang drug gi dang po ni/ de nas/ dpral bar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje āḥ snying khar thugs rdo rje r+ghaṃ/ gtsug tor dang lte ba'i a wa dhū ti'i nang du ho yig bkod te/ de nas ho yig shes rab gtum mo'i me chags pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyi rdo rje can shes rab dang bcas pa ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin du zhu bar blta'o/ /shes rab dang lhan cig ces gsung ba'i phyir/ nus la rnams kyang gtso bo'i yum yin pas zhu bar blta'o/ /sdom chen cho ga 'dir rgyas par zhu ba glu'i bskul rtsa brgyud nas gsungs pa'i spyan ma sogs byed pa nyid bzang la/ cho ga 'bring man chad bsdus brgyud kyi/ lha mo rnams kyis sogs tshig rkang gnyis kho nas kyang legs mod/de yang zhu ba glus bskul bar byed pa po lha mo dang lha yang rung ste/ de rnams nam mkha' na bzhugs pa dang / dkyil 'khor du bkod pa dang / thig le las sprul pa dang / glo bur skad cig mar sprul pa dang / yid snang gi sgra tsam la brten pa sogs rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag tha dad pas ci rigs 'byung yang / 'dir ni phyi ma gsum gang rig tu nges par bya dgos na/ spyan la sogs sdom chen dkyil 'khor du dngos su med snyam pa'i log rtog gi bslad par mi bya la/ 'dir ma zad dus 'khor chos dbyings gsung dbang rang la yang zhu bar glus bskul ba po ni bde bar gshegs pa'i gdan la gnas pa'i spyan ma sogs kyi ma yin cing skad cig tu sprul tshul 'di dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /de nas tshad med pa bzhin du lha mo 'gro ba'i don du bskul ba/ /lha mo rnams kyi glu dag mdzad de bcom ldan khyod ni sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa'o/ /bdag cag bsrung shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā mā ki bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 593

'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs pa bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma dag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces bskul bas stong pa nyid la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das sad de 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas/ zla ba zhu ba de las r+ghaṃ yig sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dpal mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba sdom pa chen po rdo rje 'jigs mdzad 'jigs par byed pa gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ de dang dus mnyam du phre dang / gri gug las sna tshogs yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / gtso bo'i gdan gyi pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad dang / shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lho ru i āḥme dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan dang bden bral du haṃ haḥ rnams las byung ba'i cang ti'u rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ nus ma brgyad dang / de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams la/ hi tī mṛ : hu hū chi skṛ rnams yongs su gyur pa las thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba brgyad rnams dus gcig tu bskyed par bya ste/ dus 'khor bsgrub ler/ nus ma dang rdo rje bzhi yi mtshan ma rnams skad cig gi bskyed par gsung ba nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum snyom par zhugs pas dkyil 'khor lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la bcug ste byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams shes rab gyi pad+mar lha so so'i sa bon gyi yi ge'i rnam par gyur/ de las so so'i phyag mtshan du gyur/ de las so so'i sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur te pad+ma nas spros la rang gnas su dgod/ de ltar dkyil 'khor spro ba'i gzhung tshig 'di rnams bsgrub le'u tshigs bcad lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i 'grel pa ji bzhin drangs pa yin 'dug cing / de la dam pa kha cig nas nam mkhar gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga bdag rnams bzhi rang gi lus la bcug ste zhu nas sngon bzhin lha skur byas pa rnams sngar spros pa'i dkyil 'khor lha bsdus gnas 'gyur dam tshig pa de la ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs par mdzad de/ tshul de rgyud 'grel gyi don ji bzhin par dmigs so/ /gzhan ni phyogs 'dir dus 'khor kyi shing rta chen po bu dom gnyis ka dgongs pa mthun par nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs pa dang dus mtshungs par dkyil 'khor rgyas mchog gi skabs su spros pa'i lha rnams rang gi lus la bcug te slar sngar bzhin spro bar dgongs te/ dus 'khor bsgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jor yang kyang yi ge sngon bzhin no zhes lung 594

drangs pa'i don yang de la dgongs pa'o/ /tshul bzhin du bsgom pa la gnad 'di yang gal che bar mthong bas gzhung tshig rtogs dka' ba'i don skabs 'dir gsal bar phyes pa'o/ /gzhan yang mi bskyod pa dang rdo rje dbyings phyug ma lhag pa'i bdag por gtso bo yab kho nar bzhugs pa dang / yab yum tha dad du bzhugs pa gnyis gdam so can las gcig tu dam bca' ba med la/ rgyal mchog gnyis kar lhag pa'i bdag po ni mi bskyod pa kho nas mdzad pa bu ston chen po'i bzhed par snang ngo / /de yang a āḥ dang rdo rje rtse lnga pa ljang khu dang sngon po las lhag pa'i bdag po mi bskyod pa nas/ 'khyud pa dang i ā dang rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po dang ljang zhu las rdo rje dbyings phyug ma sngon mo nas/ 'khyud pa dag phyung zhes pa nas zhugs par gyur gyi bar sngar ltar brjod/ 'khor lo drug dang sgo mtshams bcu drug lha'i sa bon/ shi skṛ sgro dzi dzi sgro bla shī/ slo shi klu tha hṝ ṣ+ṭṛ po shi m+bi/ 1 sgyi r+ghaṃ dri thu thu dri chidhī/ ṣ+pe dhī thu hṝ dṛ byu dhi dzñā/ 2 bhi sgyu bṛ phu phu bri slo dhī/ slo sgyi phu ༈ sngo phu gi l+lī/ 3 snyisgru skṛ/ byu thu skṛ smṛ rnyi/ tsā tā thu spreḍi thu d+ngha l+lī/ 4 rnyi lha rmi tshu tsū dzī lha rnyi lha lha tshu rmi rmi tshu rnyi lha/ 5 ghi l+lī sngo khya khu spyi kṛ sgyu/ kṛ snyi khya rgyu sngo khyu ghi klo/ 6 nya hā ṇa ṇa ma mā na nā/ ṅka ṅgā nga ngu na hā k+ṣa k+ṣu/ yi ge de rnams yongs su gyur pa las phyag mtshan mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gri gug dang mkha' 'gro la rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams su gyur/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma las phyir spros te so so'i gnas su 'khod par gyur pa ni/ ye shes 'khor lo'i shar du shi rdo rje ma la zhwa rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / lhor sngo rdo rje ma la dzi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du dzi rdo rje ma la ṣ+ṭṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / nub tu slo rdo rje mar shī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / /rlung du bai rdo rje ma la shi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / dbang ldan du dzi rdo rje ma la ṣ+ṭṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du hṝ rdo rje ma la dzi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / mer bhā rdo rje ma la slo rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /sa khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs la/ dhi rdo rje ma la dzñā rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / lhor rjer rdo rje ma byu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du thu rdo rje ma la hṝ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / nub tu rli rdo rje ma la dhī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / /rlung du dzñā rdo rje ma la snyi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / dbang ldan du byu rdo rje ma la trī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du dri rdo rje ma la thu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / mer dhī rdo rje ma la rmi rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /chu khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su/ gi rdo rje ma la zhwa rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / lhor bṛ rdo rje ma la phu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du phu rdo rje ma la dzo rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / nub tu bla rdo rje ma la dhī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / rlung du slo rdo rje ma la bṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / dbang ldan du phu rdo rje ma la bṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du bṛ rdo rje ma la thu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / me mtshams su sī rdo rje ma la gli rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /me khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar du/ rnyi rdo rje ma la ṭī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / lhor skṛ rdo rje ma la byu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du thu rdo rje ma la skṛ rdo rje 'khyud pa dang / nub tu skṛ rdo rje ma la dhi rdo 595

rje 'khyud pa dang / rlung du smṛ rdo rje ma la dhi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / dbang lda du thu rdo rje ma la skṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du dzo rdo rje ma la thu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / mer rnyi rdo rje ma la smṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ rlung khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar du/ rnyi rdo rje ma la ṣ+ṭṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / lhor rdza rdo rje ma la tshu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du tshu rdo rje ma la j-i rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / nub tu lha rdo rje ma la lha rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / rlung du lha rdo rje ma la dzhai rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / dbang ldan du tsā rdo rje ma la dzī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du dzī rdo rje ma la tshu rdo rje 'khyud pa dang / me mtshams su lha rdo rje ma la lha rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ shar du ghi rdo rje ma la kli rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / lhor kṛ rdo rje ma la khyu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du khu rdo rje ma la shrī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / nub tu klo rdo rje ma la l+lī rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / rlung du bhā rdo rje ma la ghi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / dbang ldan du khu rdo rje ma la gro rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du shrī rdo rje ma la khu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / me mtshams su sgyu rdo rje ma la klo rdo rjes 'khyud pa ste/ de ltar na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis las/ shar dang shar lho'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog nag mo/ /thabs dpa' bo rnams ser po/ /lho dang lho nub kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog dmar mo/ /thabs dpa' bo rnams sku mdog dkar po/ byang dang byang shar gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog dkar po/ thabs dpa' bo rnams dmar po/ nub dang nub byang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog ser mo/ thabs dpa' bo rnams nag po'o/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po thams cad kyang gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis cung zad thung ba'i lus can g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan ma dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' bo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po thams cad zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa/ dang po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi shes rab ma'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba/ glang lpags spangs shing mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ lhag ma rgyan dang cha byad bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa ste/'khor lo drug gi lha tshogs rnams shes rab la gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /skabs 'dir sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs la lar dpa' bo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad yin rgyud don dang dngos su 'gal bas shin tu mi legs shing kha gcig dpa' mo yab gtso bor rgyas pa yang rgyud don la mi 'byor bas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams gtso bor byed pa dang / mkha' 'gro rnams zhal gnyis byed pa ni rgyud don rma med yin pa shin tu 'thad cing / sdom chen zin bris kha cig tu dpa' bo rnams ral pa'i thor tshugs la rgyas 'debs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal ras 'od 'phro ba zhes zhal gnyis pa'i sgrub byed du byung rung gzhan du de ltar rig pa yod kyang / skabs 'dir tshig kho na dang mi 'gal tsam las don ji bzhin pa bshad ma nus 596

par mthong ngo / /de yang 'dir yum rnams sbo thung rnam pa can du bstan pa ni shes rab gtso bor byed pa'i don du yum rags pa'i sku dang / gzhan du yum bzhin yab sku bong cung zad chung bar shugs kyi bstan cing / de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mdun zhal ni mkha' 'gro ma la 'o dag byed/ ces pa rgyud kyi tshigs shugs kyis kyang yab rnams kyi rtsa ba'i mdun zhal yum dang kha sbyor mdzad cing mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis zhal ni rang gi yab dang gtso bo la gcig char du phyogs shing yab kyi rgyab zhal rnams kyang gtso bo'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la lhan cig tu blta ba'i don du legs par go dgos la/ lar brin 'thur dang bsgom tshul phal cher tha dad du 'byung ba yang shes par bya'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po'i shar sgor nya rdo rje ma/ shar lho'i sgor hā rdo rje ma'o/ /lho sgor ṇa rdo rje ma/ bden bral gyi sgor ṇa rdo rje ma'o/ /byang sgor ma rdo rje ma/ dbang ldan gyi sgor mā rdo rje ma'o/ /nub sgor na rdo rje ma/ rlung mtshams kyi sgor nā rdo rje ma'o/ /de ltar phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi ljang khu/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi sngon mo/ thams cad kyang sgo mkhyud kyi nang mtshams na gnas pa'o/ /rlung dang byang gi mtshams su ṅka rdo rje ma sngon mo/ rlung dang nub kyi mtshams su ṅgā rdo rje ma ljang khu/ me dang shar gyi bar du nga rdo rje ma ljang khu/ me dang lho'i bar du ngu rdo rje ma sngon mo/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi bar du ha rdo rje ma ljang khu/ dbang ldan dang shar gyi bar du hā rdo rje ma sngon mo/ bden bral dang lho'i bar du k+ṣa rdo rje ma ljang khu/ bden bral dang nub kyi bar du k+ṣu rdo rje ma sngon mo ste/ de ltar brgyad po rnams ni rtsigs pa'i phyi rol sgo 'khyud rnams kyi bar gyi steg bu la yang dag par gnas pa'o/ /de ltar sgo mtshams ma bcu drug gi dur khrod chen po bcu drug la yang dag par spyod pa ste/ thams cad kyang cher khros shing dag mo'i tshul can 'khor lo dang mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ skra gyen la brdzes pa ste/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur lhag ma rnams ni nus ma rnams dang mtshungs pa'o/ /sgo mtshams bcu drug gi mkha' 'gro ma 'di rnams dur khrod kyi bdag mo yin la/ de yang dur khrod kyi bdag mo'i sgra la chags nas sgo mtshams dur khrod dngos su 'dod pa ni mi 'thad pa nges bya ste/ dper na rgyal po chen po'i sgo bsrung skyes bu'i gnas rgyal po'i sgo khang yin yang / de yi rdzas dang gnas gzhi tshang ma sgo khang du yin mi dgos pa bzhin/ 'dir yang dur khrod ni chos dbyings gsung dbang ltar me rlung dbus su yod rung / de yi bdag po gtso bo'i bzhugs gnas dang nye ba'i sgo mtshams yin la/ spyir dkyil 'khor rtsa thig phan chad dur khrod bdag po rnams kyis spyod yul du gyur pa la dgong nas sdom pa che chung / phyag rdor bstod 'grel sogs su de ltar bzhag pa yin zhes mchog tu mkhas pa rje btsun dbang po'i gsungs las 'byung ltar ro/ /da ni rjes 'brang gi lha rnams bskyed par bya ste/phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu la klu rnams gnas pa ste/ phyi rol phyogs bzhi'i sgo yi rta bab bzhi'i ka ba brgyad kyi nang ngos su klu rnams te/ stobs kyi rgyu dang nab pad+ma nag po la lce spyang gdong ma dang mkha' lding gdong mas 'khyud pa shar gyi g.yon dang g.yas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la stag gdong ma dang 'ug gdang mas 'khyud pa lho'i 597

g.yon dang g.yas su me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / rigs ldan dang mtha' yas dkar po la phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong mas 'khyud pa byang gi g.yon dang g.yas su chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po la khyi gdong ma dang bya rog gdong mas 'khyud pa nub kyi g.yon dang g.yas su sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i klu rnams rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la yum rnams pad+ma'i gdan gyi 'khyud pa'o/ /phyi skor dkyil 'khor 'dod yon gyi steg bu la/ shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su dri ma dang phreng ba ma/ lho sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su spos ma dang mar me ma/ byang sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su lha bshos ma dang 'bras bu ma/ nub sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas su sgeg mo dang bzhad ma/ steng du rol mo ma dang gar ma/ 'og tu glu ma dang 'dod ma/ thams cad kyang rang gi ming dang mthun pa mchod rdzas thogs shing / gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha mo bzung ma du ma dang bcas pa'o/ /glu dang gzung ma 'di rnams sdom chen kyis skabs 'dir dus 'khor chos dbyings gsung dbang dang mi 'dra ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa nyis 'gyur brgya nyi shu'i lha la mi 'the bar rtsa ba'i lha ma yin rjes 'brang gi lha tsam yin pas/ skabs 'dir sa bon nam skad cig tsam las bskyed na legs te thob tshod yin 'on kyang spros pa la dgyes pa rnams kyi mkha' spros mdzad pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /dus 'khor sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jor 'grel chen tshigs kyi bzhugs tshul dang mthun slad phyi rol dur khrod la gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi rjes su bzung ma rnams bskyed par gsung yang / 'dir 'dod ma dang phyir 'dod ma med pas gzung ma yang skabs 'dir bkod pa 'brel bar mthong ngo / /gzhan yang phyi rol dur khrod chen po'i gzhi la zla ba la sogs pa'i gza' bcu dang brtan pa dang / ri byi dang / rgyu skar thams cad dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang / cha bcu drug dang / phyogs bcu skyong ba dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / nag po chen po dang / dril bu'i rna ba can dang / skṛ gi ṇa dang / zhing skyong thams cad dang /pho nya thams cad dang / 'phrog ma dang / grub pa thams cad dang / skra dang ba spu rnam par dag pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dang bcas pa rnams dur khrod kyi mthar rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khod pa'o/ /sdom chen ni sgrub thabs kha cig tu phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs bkod pa 'di mi mdzad pa byung rung /sdom chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dngos min yang klu dang gzung ma bzhin phyi rol dur khrod kyi gzhi la bkod pa nges par thad do/ /r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang nor bu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba can pad+ma'i dbus su gnas pa phyung phyir spros phyi yi gzhal yas khang dang dbyer med par gyur/ gsum pa ni/ de nas rang gi snying khar r+ghaṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs 'od zer sngon po 'jigs pa'i sku rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal mche ba phyed brtsigs pa/ sgra drag po sgrogs pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ shes rab dang thabs las rab tu byung ba/ gtso bo'i bzhin du mtshon cha dang bcas pa glang po'i che'i lpags pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ 598

thod pa dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig spros te lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ shrī kā la tsakrā badz+ra hai ra wa bhi ska ra ya sa pa ri wa ra dzaḥ zhes brjod pas de'i ye shes pa'i gtso bo'i lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus bsnun/phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams sbrul zhags kyis bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyi 'jigs par byas te/mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas rdo rje shugs rang gi snying khar bsdu/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakrā badz+ra lha ra wa bhi ska ra sa pa ri wa re/ bh+yaḥ badz+ra ghar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha na la/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhu paṃ/ badz+ra rī paṃ/ badz+ra nai we ju/badz+ra ak+ṣa haṃ/ badz+ra lā sum̐/ badz+ra ha sum̐/ badz+ra wa tram̐/ badz+ra dz+ra tram̐/ badz+ra gī tram̐/ badz+ra kā me pra tits+tsha na la/ rgyu yig dang rdo rje phyag rgyas khro bo rmugs byed kyi dam tshig la gzhug bo dang zhags pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo rengs byed kyi dbyer med du bcings/ ho dang dril bu'i phyag rgyas khro bo khengs byed kyi mnyes par byas/tī dang dbyug pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo shin tu stobs kyis ye shes pa dam tshig pa la ro mnyam par byas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gtso bo yab yum la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med par ro mnyam/ de bzhin du nus ma dam tshig la ye shes ro mnyam thod pa dam tshig la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ ye shes 'khor lo'i lha yab yum dam tshig pa la ye/ sa'i 'khor lo'i/ chu yi/ me yi/ rlung gi nam mkha'i/sgo mtshams bcu drug gi drag mo dam tshig pa la ye shes pa rnams/ klu dang gzungs ma sogs khor yug gi dam tshig pa la ye/ gzhal yas khang dang 'byung dkyil zla nyi'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa la ye shes ro mnyam par bsam mo/ bzhi pa la/ rigs kyi cod paṇa gyi rgyas btab pa dang / sku gsung thugs/ ye shes kyi rgyas btab pa ste gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rigs kyi cod paṇa du rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i rigs las 'byung ba'i lha ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa ljang khu bdud 'dul dang ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gyi rgyas btab/ 'du byed kyi rigs las byung ba'i lha nag po rnams la don grub nag po skyabs sbyin dang ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gyi/ tshor ba'i rigs las byung ba dmar po rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po mchog sbyin dang ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya can gyi/ 'du shes kyis rigs las byung ba'i dkar po rnams la 'od dpag med dkar po phyag gnyis ka ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gyi/ gzugs kyi rigs las byung ba'i ser po rnams la rnam par snang mdzad ser po phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gyi/ ye shes kyi rigs las byung ba'i sngon po rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po bdud 'dul dang ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gyi rgyas gdab/ de ltar rgyas gdab bya drug gi ral pa'i cod paṇa 'dzin pa la rgyas 'debs byed drug gtsug tor dang chos gos 'dzin pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad kyi rgyas gdab so/ /mkhas mchog bu ston ska bas nas rgyud 'grel dang mthun par skabs 'dir rgyas btab pa gtso che bar dgongs pa 599

yin/ lhan thabs sogs phyag len du dbang bskur rjes su mdzad pa gnyis ka mi legs pa med pas ji bder bya'o/ /gnyis bzhi/ de nas gtsug tor du thig le la a las mi bskyod pa/ snying khar sgra gcan la i las don grub/dpral bar zla ba la u las snang mtha'/ lte bar dus me las lo las rnam snang mgrin par nyi ma la ṛ las rin 'byung / gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la i las rdor sems te sku'i rgyas btab/ lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la lo/ snying khar chu la u/ mgrin par me la ṛ/ dpral bar rlung la i/ gtsug tor du nam mkha' la a ste gsung gi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la i/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥsnying khar sgra gcan la hūm̐/ lte bar dus me la ho te thugs kyis rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor a ye shes kyi rgyas gdab ste bzhis rgyas gdab so/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag pa bsgom mo/ /lnga pa ni/ dpral bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon na ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ shes rab dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros/ sku rdo rjes gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas/ slar log te bdag nyid kyi mdun du 'khod pa la/ sku rdo rje 'dzin bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing bkrus nas/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje rnams bcug nas 'di skad brjod do/ /dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces brjod pas ro mnyam par gyur te lus sku rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ de nas mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad la skyes pa'i gsung rdo rje dmar po/ dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas na pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon na nor bu dril bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ shes rab dang bcas pa spro ba sogs sku dang gsung rje ba ma btogs pa sngar dang 'dra ba byas te dbang bskur la/ gsung rdo rje rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bkod nas sku'i gnas su gsung gi zhes bcug nas tshig brjod la/ ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ snying khar thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje nag po/ nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu/ ral gri/nor bu 'dzin pa/ shes rab dang bcas pa spro ba sogs sku dang thugs rje ba ma btogs pa sngar bzhin byas nas thugs rdo rje rnams snying khar sgra gcan kyi dkyil 'khor la bkod de sku gnas su thugs rnga'i zhes bcug pa'i tshig bcad brjod la/ yid thugs rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ de nas rdo rje gsum dbye med gcig tu gyur pa'i nga rgyal bzung ste/ oṃ 600

sasba ta thā ga ta kā ya— wāgyit+ta su bhā wa at+ma ko haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /zhu ba'i chos las thabs rigs gsum gyi byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /rdul dang khu ba'i chos las shes rab rigs drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gsum sngar dang 'dra la/shes rab kyi lte bar ho/ gsang bar sā/ gtsug tor la hā dgod cing / rgyas par byas na sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de nas dbang lha spyan 'dron bzhin dbang bskur bcu gcig rnams bsrung 'khor gyi dus bzhin skabs 'di blang ba yin/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs gong du miru byed 'dir bya la/ rgyas chog gnyis kar sngags kyi phyag rgya rgyan bkod byed tshe la rgyas la dbang bskur dang rgyas 'debs bcas grub pa na byed pa nyid gzigs pa mchog gi bzhed do/ /drug pa dag pa dran pa ni/ lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye ba'i dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can gyur mi yi bdag lo gcig gi ni sna tshogs yum ste zhaṅge la sogs pa rnam par bzhi ni rnam par dag pas so/ /sbyin pa sogs dang phung po 'byung ba yul dang yul can gzhan yang dbang po lnga la sogs pa dang /phyogs dang phyogs kyi stobs dang dpal ldan rgyas sras dbang rnams kyis kyang mig ri lha mo rnam par dag dpal ldan rdo rje can ni thugs kyi rdo rjer 'gyur te —mi bdag dkyil 'khor sku'i rdo rje'o/ /lha rnams 'khor lo a li ka li'i rigs skyes gsung gi rdo rje zla ba nyi ma'i steng du'o/ /de bzhin du ni ye shes rdo rje nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms sna tshogs yum gyi rang bzhin no/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi rdo rje yul dang yul can rnams kyis bsgrod bya min pa rnam pa tha dad pa/ gsung gi rdo rje sems can thams cad rang snying skad rnams bdag gi chos ni go bar byed pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi thugs kyi rdo rje sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rang bzhin mtha' dag pa la gnas/ dri med nor bu lta bu dngos po rnams kyi 'dzin byed gang yin de nyid ye shes rdo rje'o/ /zhes pa'i don dran par bya'o/ /dag sbyor rnam grangs kha shas yod kyang 'dir rgyas bsdus de tsam legs par mthong ngo / /don gsum pa ni/ de nas rang dang shes rab kyi dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ snying khar r+ghaṃ/ lte bar ho/ gsang bar su/ phyi bor hā bkod de shes rab kyis gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las āḥ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ r+ghaṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rang gi gsang gnas r+ghaṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ ā las skyes pa'i pad+mas mtshan par bsgom nas/ yan lag drug dang rdo rje drug kyang bkod de/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal gyis snyoms par zhugs te/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi don mngon du byas pas/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi lte ba'i rtse mo na ho yig ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gtum mo ye shes kyi me gsang gnas kyi g.yas kyi rtse mo nas 'bab pas phung po khams sogs bskul bar byed pa de rab tu 'bar bas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas lnga dang / g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor yum lnga dang / mig sogs dbang po drug dang / gzugs sogs yul drug po thams cad bsregs pa ste/ rlung rgyu ba med cing dbang po yul la 'jug pa med par byas nas/ me de a ba dhu tī nas song ste/ spyi bor haṃ yig thig le'i gzugs can la reg pas haṃ zhu nas thig le'i gzugs kyi dpral ba nas mgrin par 'dzag 601

pa dga' ba dang / mgrin pa nas snying gar mchog dga' dang / snying kha nas lte bar khyad dga' dang /lte ba nas gsang ba'i pad+mar lhan cig skyes dga' ste/ zla ba'i cha bco lnga yongs su gang ba'i tshul du byon par bsgom pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /don bzhi pa ni/ de nas shes rab kyi chos byung sna'i rtse mor yungs kar la sogs pa'o zhes pa'i don rtsa 'khor lo drug ni shes rab kyi chos 'byung / de'i lte ba la a ba dhū ti'i sna'i rtse mo/ yungs kar ni sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi thig le'o/ /sogs khongs nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spro ba bstan te/ /skabs don byang chub sems kyi thig le dga' ba bzhi dang / skad cig bzhi yi dbye bas ji ltar byon pa de bzhin du rgyu mthun pa rnam par smin pa/ skyes bu byed pa/ dri ma dang bral ba'i dbye bas steng du gshegs te/ gsang bar sku yi thig le dang / lte bar gsung gi thig le dang / snying khar thugs kyi thig le dang / mgrin par ye shes kyi thig le'i rim pas gshegs te/ dpral bar dri ma med pa'i thig le de yis sna tshogs pa'i brgyan dang ldan zhing pra phabs pa dang mtshungs pa dus gsum du gnas pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang byung ba me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bar bsgom zhing spro la/de dang dus mnyam du rim pa bzhin du sku gsung thugs kyi thig le las 'od zer 'phros nas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs ye shes kyi thig le'i dbus su ma 'pho ba'i bde ba'i 'od zer gyis reg pas khams gsum po mtha' dag dus gcig car dus gsum shes pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin lha'i rnal 'byor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par spro bar bya ste drang ba'i don to/ de ltar phra thig bsgoms nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod nas nga rgyal bzung ngo / nges don nga yid bzang la'i bca'i nang du khu ba yang dag par sbyor ba las 'pho ba med pa'i bde ba ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar nges pa'i don gyis thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni rdzogs rim bsnyen sgrub bzhi dang sbyor ba lan lag drug gis bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas 'dod pa'i lha yi nga rgyal bya ste/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra satā rna/ dudhan+ta ma ka rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod nas bskyed pa'i rim pa ji nus su mnyam par bzhag pa yin no/ /de rjes mchod bstod bdud rtsi gtor myang rjes chags nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i bar byed zhes lhan thabs bkra shis rab rgyas su gsung zhing don du yang sngags kyi lugs kyi thob pa dang / bu ston mchog gi bzhed pa yin par nges kyang / bsgrub gzhung dngos grub 'dod 'jor 'di'i sa bcad gsal bar ma mdzad pas/ lhan thabs kha cig tu chad par snang yang skabs 'dir rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang ma chad par byas pa kho na legs so/ /des na thog mar lha mo bcu gnyis kyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra lha ra wa giska ra ya sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes kun gyi thog mar sbyar ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghargyu pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhu paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥbadz+ra dri paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai wi h+ye pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ak+ṣa haṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra lā sum̐ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ha sum̐ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra bā ju tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dz+ra tram̐ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra gī te pra 602

tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā me pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod/ rgyas par ni tshigs bcas bsam te bya/ de nas cang ti'u brdung zhing rkang pa bcu drug pa'i sngags kyi bstod par bya ba ni/ oṃ na mo badz+ra satā ya/ na mo bud+dha lha rnyi sa twe bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra gro dha in+d+ra rā dze bh+yaḥ na mo bī shwa ma tre/ na mo bhurnya bho dhi sa tā de wī bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ na mo bha ga wa te kā la tsakra ya/ 1 badz+ra bho ra ba dhī ka rā ya/ 2 ma hā in+d+ra la baṇ+ḍi sha ri rā ya/ 3 mā ro kla sha hri da yā/ r+pān ta si ta rak+ta tsa ra ḍā ya/ 4 kṛṇ+ḍa rak+ta si ta kaṇa ba ya/ 5 nī la si ta sni ta raka ta rdaṣ+ṭa ka rā lo gra bhā ṣa ṇa su khyi ya/ 6 kṛṇ+ḍa rak+ta si ta sa byed ta ra skan dhā ya/ 7 dā da sha bhu dzā ya/ 8 ṣaṭa bo sha ti ka rā ya/ 9 badz+ra khaḍa ga tri shu la/ karti kā bā ṇa/ saṃ ku sha ḍa ma ru ka mud ga ra/ tsakra kun ta/ daṇ+ḍa/ par bru/ badz+ra ghaṇa ḍā/ khe ṭa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la/ tsā pa/ pā sha rad na/ ka ma la/ shaṃ kha/ ā dar sha thi kha lā/ brah+ma shi ro/ ga dza tsar ma lha ta ka rā ya/ 10 byā gh+ra tsar ma ni wa sa nā ya/ 11 skan dhe muṇa ḍa mā lā ba lo bi ne/ 12 shi ra si badz+ra paṭa ṭa mu ku ṭi badz+ra ka pā la mā la/ ar dha tsan dra dha rā ya/ 13 kun ḍa la ru tsa ka kaṇa khri kāme kha lā/ nu pu ra/ bhasma ya rnyo pa bī ta/ shi ro ma ṇi/ ma hā mu dra/ nā ga in dra bi bhu ṣa ṇa ya/ 14badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ saṃ to ṣi ti hri da yā ya/ 15 in dra/ ag ni/ ya ma/ nai ri t+ya/ ba ru ṇa/ bā yu/ ku be ra/ khri sha na/ brah+ma/ biju/ bi nā ya ka kā ra ti ke ya nan di/ ma hā kā la gra ha/ nak+ṣa tra/ k+ṣe tra pā la/ su ra in dra/ a su ra in+d+ra/ pha ṇi in dra/ bhu ta in dra/ na ra in dra/ saṃ stu ra tsa ra ṇa ya/16 zhes pas bstod par bya'o/ /gzhan ni stong pa nyid dang sogs tshigs bcad gnyis so/ /yang na bdud nyi shu sogs kyi bstod kyang legs mod/ 'on kyang 'khor lo sdom pa rkang brgyad sngags kyi bstod pa kho na gtso bor gyur bzhin 'dir yang rkang pa bcu drug nyid khyad par can gyi bstod pa yin no/ /de nas bdud rtsi gtor myang bya ba ni/ thog mar kha chod gsal re rgyas par mchod gtor byin rlabs skabs ltar ram/ bsdu na sngags mtshan bzhi dang ha hoḥ trīḥ yi byin gyis brlab cing / ka pā la lag g.yas mthil du dpral ba rang la phyogs nas g.yon pa'i thebs srin gyi lan gsum grub tshul bcas dbus nas blangs te bla ma la spyi bo'i thad dang dkyil 'khor lha la kha yi thad chos skyong la lte ba nas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas zil gtor byas la/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bzhi dbyer med pa la na maḥde bzhin du mgo bor oṃ dang / mjug tu na ma sbyar la/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la/ zla ba bzang po la/ lha dbang la/ gzi brjid can la/ zla bas byin la/ lha'i dbang phyug la/ sna tshogs gzugs la/ lha'i dbang ldan la/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa la/ pad+ma dkar po la/ bzang po la rnam rgyal la/ bshes gnyen bzang po la/ phyag dmar la/ khyab mjug sbas pa la/ nyi ma grags la/ shin 603

tu bzang la/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal la/ rgyal dka' la/ nyi ma la/ sna tshogs gzugs la/ zla ba'i 'od la/mtha' yas la/ sa skyong la/ dpal skyong la/ dus zhabs mche ba la/ dus zhabs pa chung ba la/ kha phye zla ba mgon po la/ sgom pa dkon mchog bsrung la/ 'bro ston rnam la rtsegs la/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje la/sras dhasmra shwa ra la/ grub thob nam mkha' 'od zer la/ grub thob se mo che nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer la/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer la/ chos rje kun spangs la/ bla ma byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la/ bla ma kun mkhyen 'phags pa la/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub pa la na maḥ yang na bla ma chos sku 'od zer gyi rjes su bla ma kun mkhyen 'phags pa bcug pa'am/ chos je kun spangs nas kun mkhyen 'phags pa bcug kyang chog go/ /bu ston rin chen man chad ni/ lo ts+tsha dhasmo shrī la na maḥ chos rje yon tan 'byung gnas la na maḥ rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags pa la na maḥ shang ston kun dga' dpal la na maḥ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la na maḥ 'jam dbyangs shes rab bkra shis la na maḥ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la na maḥ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la na maḥ mkhas pa byams pa lhun grub la na maḥ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' snying po la na maḥ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho la na maḥ dam pa snying po blo gros la na maḥ skyes mchog ngag dbang 'phrin las la na maḥ grub pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang dbang po la na maḥ rgyal mchog rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu la na maḥ 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang ye shes la na maḥ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la na maḥyang na bu ston chen po nas/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo tsā grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jigs bral dbyangs can dga' ba/rigs ldan rnam grags man 'dra/ de nas/ oṃ bhud+dha ya na maḥ nas sems can thams cad dpal dus kyi 'khor lo gyur pa'i zhal du na maḥ zhes pha'i bar 'og nas 'byung bzhin pa'i sngags kyi mchod/ de ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bdud rtsi'i mnyes shing tshim par gyur nas rang gi lus la bcug ste bdud rtsi myong bas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bdud rtsis khengs/ nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dgyes shing bde ba chen por rab tu bstan par bsam la bdud rtsi myang ngo / /de nas rdo rje'i mchod pa byed pa ni/ /mchog gi phyag rgya skyes pa dang / gsang ba'i phyag rgya bud med/ las kyi phyag rgya tsum+bha na la sogs pa dang / chos kyi phyag rgya de nyid mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde bas mchod pa ni rdo rje'i mchod pa ste/ thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs bzhin snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mchod la nga rgyal bzung / de las byung ba'i byang sems dkar dmar thod par blugs la lha mchod cing rang gi kyang myang bar bya'o/ /zhes bu ston rin po che'i mchod 'phreng mchod sprin rgya mtsho las gsung bzhin mos pas sgrub ste nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags bcas rnam rol phyag rgya bya'o/ /de yang 'di ni thig le'i rnal 'byor gyis skabs su bshad pa dang mtshungs kyi snga ma nyid zlos sam snyam na/ don rigs gcig kyang gong du bshad pa ni lam gyi rkang gal po che rtsa ba yin la/ phyi ma ni sngags chog gzhan rnams nas rjes chags kyis rnal 'byor du grags rgyur 604

thun mtshams kyi lam rim du yang bzhag pa de/ 'dir mchod pa'i skabs su gsang mchod spyi las gsang ba'i gtor gtung khyad par can sgrub pa'i don du bzhed par snang la/ de yang thig le'i rnal 'byor du mi 'du ba ni ma yin kyang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi tshul du de ltar dbyer na mi 'gal ba nyid du go bar gces so/ /tshul 'di yang lhan thabs rnams su dogs bcad ma mdzad pas skabs 'dir cha tsam spros pa'o/ /de nas spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ sngon du dkyil 'khor lha yi thugs rgyud bskul ba bzlas pa'i bya ba dang / mchod cing bstod de gshegs su gsol ba dngos dang /thun mtshams dge sbyor gyis rim pa'o/ /de yi dang po bzlas pa la/ ye shes kyi bzlas pa/ dam tshig gi bzlas pa gnyis las/ ye shes kyi bzlas pa ni srog dang rtsol ba'i rim pas dbang po 'gag par gyur nas ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar du ye shes kyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas dam tshig gi bzlas par thog mar bgrang 'phreng byin gyi brlabs pa la/ bgrang 'phreng gi rgyu phreng skud rdog grangs rnams las so so dang thun par byas la lag g.yas kyi snyim par bzung nas g.yon gyi bdud rtsi/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pas gtor nas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyang pa/ phreng ba stong pa'i ngang las r+ghaṃ dang rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum pa las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ āḥ dang rdo rje ljang khu rtse lnga pa las skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu/ ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can gnyis ka'ang phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum na rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa yab rdo rje'i gdan gyi bzhugs pa las yum pad+ma'i gdan gyis 'khyud par gyur/ de yi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar rdu/ lte bar ho/ thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i dbyangs sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bor gyur pa'i gsal byed brgyad cu ye shes pa'i rnam par dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥhi/ oṃ ā ā+o rī u lī pañtsa dhā tu bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa'i g.yon pa'i thebs srin gyis nang mchod gtor bas dbang skur mchod pa bcu gnyis kyi mchod mthar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ba las bgrang phreng du gyur/mchog gi phyag rgya lce dang phreng bar reg ste las gang yin gyis rol mo la bzhag nas mdo 'dzin phyogs su bgrang bar bya'o/ /de nas ngag bzlas pa ni/ snying kha'i lte ba'i dbus su gnas pa'i thig le phra mo las byung ba'i sngags kyi yi ge rnams 'od zer lnga yi bdag nyid dbu ma'i rtsa 'bab pa yis/ ji srid rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo pad+ma'i nang du zhugs te/de'i kha nas rang gi khar zhugs par byas nas de nyid du thim par bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par bzlas ba bya'o/ /de yang 'dir sngags kyi dgra grogs blang dor shes pa'i sgo nas sngags kyi las drug sngon du 'gro ba'i thugs kyi bzlas pas 'bum phrag drug dang / gsung gi 'bum phrag bcu dang / sku rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag brgya bya ste/ dang po sku rdo rje oṃ dang / bar du lha so so'i ming gi yi ge las lhag pa'i thugs dang gsung gi yi ge dang bcas pa sku rdo rje'o/ /mgor sku rdo rje oṃ dang / bar du yan lag so so'i sngags dang bcas pa la mthar thug rdo rje r+ghaṃ phaṭa sbyar nas bzlas par gsung ngo / /'on te deng sangs byin rlabs mnyam pa med pa'i phyag chen du snying po gtso bor bzla bar snang na de ltar 605

bzlas pa ni/ oṃ hūṃ spyu r+ghaṃ phre r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa dang / oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ho sbyi r+ghaṃ phre phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa ni snying po'o/ /e ṭ+wāṃ trī rtsa lcu r+ghaṃ rgyu hāḥ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// snude rnams dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro sdom pa chen po'i shes rab cha dang bcas pa'i sngags te gang yang rung ba zhig bye bar bzlas pas kyang bsnyen pa'o/ /khyad par 'phreng ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa bde mchog bsdus pa'i rgyud byang du rkang pa brgyad la 'dir thabs sam nyi zla'i dbye bas rkang pa bcu drug tu gyur pa dang / de bzhin nyung ngur rkang pa nyer bzhi pa la 'dir sku gsung thugs sam gu rdul rlung dag pas gsum 'gyur gyi bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa ste de ltar rkang pa bcu drug pa dang / bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa yang ci nus su bklags pa nges par bya dgos te/ de yang rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa ngo bo ni bsrung 'khor gyi skabs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin rkang pa bcu drug ni bstod pa'i skabs su bshad zin pa bzhin bzlas pa bya'o/ /phreng sngags de gnyis gang yang rung gcig la bye ba ste 'bum brgya sems rnams g.yengs phal cher spangs te bzlas shing kha bskang sbyin sreg 'bum bcu bgyis na grub pa chen po brgyad dang / las thams cad grub par 'gyur te bklags pas las thams cad byed par gsungs so/ /da lta'i gang zag sems rnam g.yeng can gyi yang ngag bzlas de tsam grub na bklags pas grub par bka' yang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i las rab 'byams rjes mthun gyi bsgrub par ni nus so/ /de ltar dus 'khor 'phags 'grel las rkang pa bcu drug pa dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa gnyis ka grangs tshad bye bar bshad pa la mkhas pa kha cig gi bsnyen med lta tshe lo brgya pas kyang mi khyol zhes 'jigs sngangs skye ba ni yang dag pa'i go ba dang rnam par dpyod pa mi ldan cing 'phral rtog ge la cung zad cig sbyangs pa'i yus te/ de ltar rtog ge las dang po pa'i rgyas btab de rnam 'byor bsgrub pa po rnams la mi rigs pa nyid do/ /ji phyir las dang po'i ngag bzlas kyi lo zla du mar bsgrub dka' ba yang / /rnal 'byor gsal snang nges par thob pas nyin zhag kha shas su bsgrub nus pa de ma rtogs pa dang / gzhan yang bla ma'i man ngag med par dpe klogs kyi rang khar zhugs pas gnad ma shes pa yin ste/ las dang po'i ngag bzlas kyi ye mi 'grub pa yang ma yin gyi bdag cag gi bla ma man ngag rigs pa rnams kyi 'di ltar bzhed pa yin gyi/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog stod 'grel las 'byung po ba'i sngags kyi bzla lugs de lan gnyis dang gsum du 'dab nas rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang / rkang pa bcu drug gnyis ka'i rkang pa'i grangs ji snyed par thog mthar oṃ dang rgyu rdu phaṭa sbyar te 'bum re re bzla ba las bye ba bgrang ba ste yang dag pa'i gdams par nges pa'o/ /spyir 'grel chen las phreng ba'i sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas na bdud dang bgegs dang / gzhan gyi mi thub pa dang / yi dwags la sogs pa'i bdag po rnams dang gdug pa thams cad tshar gcod par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pas sngags 'di dag kyang gal po che yin par nges par blo la bzung zhing ci rigs pa 'don par bya zhes nges par bya ba'i gnas su bar skabs su cung zad 'phros pa'o/ /gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i skabs 'khor gyi bzlas pa byed par spro na/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ a ā e āḥ ha ha haṃ haḥ phre ho r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ hā hā nyi tī skṛ hṝ hu hū bla : rdu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ slo r+sā dzi r+pā ṣ+pe ṣ+pe shi shī ha hāḥ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ lha dzñā thu byu dṛ hṝ dhi dhī la lā rgyu rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ bla dzñā phu phu bṛ hṝ gi sgyu wa wā rgyu rdu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ smṛ 1 thu byu lnga dzo rnyi rwa ra rā r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ṣ+ṭṛ lha tshu tshu dzi dz+rī rnyi dz+rī ya yā r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ kli klo khu khu gro shrī ghi sgyu ha hā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣu nga ngu ṅka ṅgā na 606

nā ma mā ṇa ṇa nya hā rgyu r+ghaṃ phre phre r+ghaṃ rdzu phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar sngags mtshan dgu po ci ltar 'os par bzla'o/ /gzhan ni sde tshan dgu po de rnams rkang pa bcu drug pa'i mthar btags te bzlas na drag po'i las dang bgegs tshar gcod pa la mchog tu bsngags par de ba'i 'grel pa las gsungs so/ /tshul de yang ci ltar zhes na rkang pa bcu drug pa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra sa tā ya sogs nas/ tsa ra na ya'i bar gzhung bzhin la de mthar sde mtshan dgu yi go rim 'di ltar gdags ste/ ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣu nga ngu ṅka ṅgā na nā ma mā ṇa ṇa nya hā rgyu r+ghaṃ phre phre phaṭa phaṭa/ bla klo khu khyu sngo ṛ snyi sgyu ha hā rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ dṛ lha tshu rtso dzi dz+rī sna sgyu ya yā hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ smṛ ཿ thu byu rje rje rnyi dhī ra rā r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bla dzñā phu phu bṛ hṝ gi gli wa wā rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ṣ+pe smyu thu byu dṛ dz+rī dhi dhī la lā hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ slo l+lī pu pū ṣ+pe ṣ+pe shi shī ha hāḥ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hā hā hi tī ṣ+ṭṛ hṝ hu hū smṛ : a ā i ā ha hā haṃ haḥ phre hoḥ zhes pa ni bdud rigs brgya yi phreng ba'i sa bon te mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba'i sngags kyi tshig go /de ltar mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba'i sngags de rnams dang rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa spel nas bklags na ye le'i 'grel chen las ji ltar gsung bzhin pa ste/ de ni rkang pa re re bzhin dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i sngags yin la/ de nus ma dang dur khrod kyi lha mo'i sa bon dang dz+rel ba ni yab yum gnyis med kyi bzlas par 'gyur zhing gzhan mkha' 'gro ma yi sngags sbyor ba ni las byed pho mo'i tshul du dz+rel ba ste gtso 'khor gnyis med kyi bklag par 'gyur ba yin no/ /tshul de yi sngags kyang 'di lta ste/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ haṃ ka la tsakra hā badz+re hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 1 oṃ du ru dān+ta da ma ka dza ti dza rā ma ra nan ta ka ha badz+re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 2 oṃ tre+e lo kya bi dza ya ā badz+re rdu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 3 oṃ ma hā bi ri shwa ra a badz+re hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 4 oṃ badz+ra bho ra ba haḥ badz+re r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ 5 oṃ badz+ra ka yā āḥ badz+re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 6 oṃ badz+ra gā ta haṃ badz+re r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ 7 oṃ badz+ra ne tra e badz+re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 8 oṃ badz+ra shwa tra hā badz+re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/9 oṃ badz+ra gh+ra ṇa hā badz+re hūṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 10 oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa k+ṣa badz+re hūṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 11 oṃ badz+ra dan ta k+ṣa badz+re r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 12 oṃ badz+ra na kha klo badz+re snyi badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 13 oṃ badz+ra ke sha khu badz+re gri badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/14 oṃ badz+ra lo ma gro badz+re khya badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 15 oṃ badz+ra a bha ra ṇa ghi badz+re kṛ badz+re hūṃ rdu phaṭa/ 16oṃ badz+ra ha sa ngu badz+re rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 17 oṃ badz+ra gī da nga badz+re r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 18 oṃ badz+ra rmi t+ya gha badz+ra klo badz+re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 19 oṃ badz+ra ā yu dha ka ra kṛ badz+re khu badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 20 oṃ badz+ra kro rgya rā dza a dhi pa ti khu badz+re gro badz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 21 oṃ badz+ra ḍa ka klo badz+re l+lī badz+ra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 22 oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī dzā la pa ri bṛ ta lha badz+re rnyi badz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 23 oṃ badz+ra shī r+ghaṃ a gats+tsha tshu badz+re tro badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 24 oṃ badz+ra satwa adzñā yā sar+bha ma ra bisne/ bi nā ya ka ki na ra/ ki su ru ṣa/ ga du ḍa/ gan dharba/ yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/bhū ta/ ma hā pre ta/ kum bhaṇa ḍa/ a sma ra/ k+ṣa ṭa pā la/ be tā ḍa/ pu ta na/ duṣ+ṭa na ga gra ha/ da yod ye/sar+bha dz+wa ra/ sasba byā dhi/ k+ṣu dra u pa dra ba kā ri ṣaḥ sar+bha satā nā/ sar+bha a pa kā ra/ ra tsā stun sabran dzaḥ shī s+t+waṃ badz+ra i ku she na ā kṛ sgyu a kṛ ṣ+pe dz+ra badz+re tshu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 25 oṃ ur dh+wa de shi ga tā nā kṛ 607

ṣ+ka kṛ gyi kṛ badz+ra lha badz+ra hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 26 oṃ pūr ba di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi hā badz+re rdu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 27oṃ dak+ṣi ṇa di ni ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi nya badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 28 oṃ ud ta ra di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi rnyi badz+re ṣ+ṭṛ badz+ra hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 29 oṃ partsi di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi j-i badz+ra tshu badz+ra r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 30 oṃ ba ya bya di shi ga tā nā kṛ rmi kṛ ṣ+pe tshu badz+re j-i badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 31 oṃ ā+o shā na di shi ga tā nā kṛ t+yā kṛ gyi lha badz+ra sgyi badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 32 oṃ nai ri t+ya di sha ga tā nā kṛ rmi kṛ gyi tsā badz+re rnyi badz+re r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 33 oṃ āsne ye dho di shi ga tā nā kṛ ñtsā kṛ gyi shā badz+re lnga badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 34 oṃ a di shi ga tā nā kṛ sgyu kṛ gyi dzo badz+ra hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 35 oṃ ā kā sha maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi kṛ badz+re sh+lau badz+ra r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 36 oṃ ba yu maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ byā kṛ gyi ḍā badz+re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 37 oṃ te dzo maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ byā kṛ gyi ṇa badz+re hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 38o twa ya maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi ṇ+ḍi badz+ra skṛ badz+ra r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ 39 oṃ pri bī maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi kṛ badz+re byu badz+ra r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ 40 oṃ kā ma dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ sgyu kṛ gyi chu badz+re tsho badz+ra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 41 oṃ ru pa dhā dhu ga tā nā kṛ ñtsā kṛ gyi smṛ badz+re rnyi badz+ra r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 42 oṃ a rū pa dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ byā kṛ gyi dzñā badz+re bhi badz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 43 oṃ kā ya dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi pū badz+ra bṛ badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 44 oṃ wāka dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ sgyu kṛ gyi dz+ra badz+re phu badz+ra rdu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 45 oṃ tsita ta dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ ṅgā kṛ gyi bhā badz+re r+sā badz+ra hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 46 oṃ sañtsa skan dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi mā badz+ra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 47 oṃ pañtsa dhā tu ga tā nā kṛ ṅgā kṛ gyi ma badz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 48 oṃ pañtsa in dri ya ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi bhi badz+re bla badz+ra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/49 o pañtsa bi ṣa ya ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi bṛ badz+re phu badz+ra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 50 oṃ pañtsa karma in dri ya ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ gyi phu badz+re bṛ badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 51 oṃ pañtsa karma in dri ya bi ṣa ya ga tā nā kṛ rmi kṛ gyi zhwa badz+re bhā badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 52 o sabra te ya tra ku tra tsita ga tā nā kṛ t+yā kṛ gyi bla badz+re dhi badz+ra hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 53 oṃ ma hā sma shā ne thru badz+ra asni dzo li tā bhū ṭ+wāṃ/ ni pā ta ya/ ni pā ta ya/ badz+re ḍi badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 54 oṃ badz+ra pā sho na/ sabra bhū dze khu/ bhad+dha ya bad+dha ya dṛ badz+re thu badz+ra hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 55 oṃ badz+ra shri kha la yā/ sabra pā de ṣ+pe ni ro dha ya dhi badz+re khyi badz+ra hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 56 oṃ sasba satwe ṣā kā ya wāka tsit+ta u pa dra ba kā ra ra tān tān/ ma hā gro dha badz+re ṇa tsuṇ+ḍi ya tsuṇ+ḍi ya nā badz+re r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 57 o badz+ra khaḍa gen ni krin ta ya ni krin ta ya ni na badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 58 oṃ badz+ra tri shu le na bho da ya dhi badz+re dzñā badz+ra hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 59 oṃ badz+ra gtī ka yā ha na ha na dzo badz+re byu badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 60 oṃ badz+ra ba ṇi na bid+dha bid+dha thu badz+re dri badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 61 oṃ badz+ra tī la kaiḥ tī la ṣ+ṭṛ badz+re dhī badz+ra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 62 oṃ badz+ra mud ga re ṇa ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya snyi badz+re shi badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 63 oṃ badz+ra tsokra ṇa ts+tsha da ya myu da ya dzi badz+re ṣ+pe badz+ra r+ghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 64 oṃ badz+ra kun te na bhin da rnyin da ṣ+pe badz+ra pi badz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 65 oṃ badz+ra daṇa ḍi na ḍa ya 608

tā ḍa ya tā ḍa ya shī badz+re dzñā badz+ra phroṃ rgyu phaṭa/ 66 oṃ badz+ra par pū nā khyun da khyun da ṅgā badz+re ṣ+pe badz+ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ 67 oṃ sa ar dha tri kro ṭi khan ḍi kri thra shā na bhū my-i sar+bha khyu te bh+yo ba lī ku ru ku ru ṅka badz+re r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 68 oṃ badz+ra ḍa ma ru ke na badz+ra ḍā ki nī rā bā ha yā shi badz+re slo badz+ra r+ghaṃ phroṃ phaṭa/ 69 oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yo mā ra kā yi kā ā+oṃ ru dhi ram̐ ni be da ya ni be da ya shrī badz+re dzi badz+ra hūṃ rdu phaṭa/ 70 oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta a nā ri tsā bh+yaḥ pañtsa a mṛ tai ni be da ya ni be da ya dzi badz+re ṣ+pe badz+ra rgyu rdzu phaṭa/ 71 oṃ sar+bha badz+ra ḍā ki nī ha si taḥ sar+bha satwa rna shān te kai sausbyi kai rak+ṣa a ba ra ṇa gusra ti ku ru ku ru slo badz+re shī badz+ra r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/72 sngags kyi rim pa de rnams 'bad pa'i yid kyis rtse gcig tu ci nus mnyam par bzhag ste bzlas so/ /gnyis pa mchod bstod gshegs su gsol ba la/ dang po lha mo bcu gcig kyi mchod pas sngar bzhin mchod/ dus zhabs pa ltar na mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa bcu dang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ces sogs 'dud nyi shu dang / gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro reg dang / reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin du ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ sa bon dang ni gsal ba'i dus med mtha' dag srid par sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnam bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje skyes bu dpe zla med cing thams cad du 'gro spros pa med/brtsegs pa la gnas rna ba sna dang kha dang mig dang mgo ste thams cad nas ni phyag dang zhabs/ 'byung po'i mtha' ste 'byung po'i mgon po srid pa gsum po mchog 'dzin rgyu rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa/ rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gi bsgrod bya mchog bde'i go 'phangs dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ spro byed nus pa'i ngo bo glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi bajid can/ ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bsgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/ bdud rtsis 'chi ba sil zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gi byas pa'i nyams myong mi bzad rnams la mi bzad pa/ gang gi las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de yi 'bras bu de bskyed pa/ 'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma dag kyang cig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam mnyam pa g.yas dang g.yon dang mdun dang rgyab/ steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang / shin tu ring po 609

yon tan med ces yon tan prung bcas bud med skyes pa'ang skyes pa bud med min/ gang zhig kun gyi rten cig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ ces pas bstod do/ /yang na gong du bshad ltar rkang pa bcu drug pa'i sngags kho nas bstod legs pa 'di nyid do/ /de nas gshegs su gsol ba dngos ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'khor lo la nus ma thod pa dang bcas pa rnams thim/ gsang ba'i rtsa 'khor la ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / lte ba'i rtsa 'ukhor la sa'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang /snying ga'i rtsa 'khor la chu'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor la me'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor la rlung gi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / gtsug gtor gyi rtsa 'khor rnams la nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / gsang gnas dang gtsug gtor du dur khrod kyi dbang phyug ma bcu dgu gzungs ma dang bcas pa rnams dang / phyag zhabs kyi sor mo'i tshig rnams su klu dang / rab gtum mo rnams thim/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid kyang cig char ram rim pas 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs par bsam la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag gsum pa thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid sdom pa chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ bdag dang snang ba'i 'khor lo thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma'i drwa ba sdom pa chen po'i sku yi rang bzhin/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi dran rig dang rnam rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa'o/ /rjes bsdud nas thun mtshams la 'jug par skad cig gi lha sku sgyu mar lta bur ldang nas gyer so gsum la zhugs pa 'di ni gal che ba yin rung / dus 'khor sgrubs thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jor gsal bar ma smos pa ni sngags bla med kyi bskyed rim gyi spyi chos su gyur pas sngags mkhan kun gyi shes pa gzhir bcas te ma smos par mngon la/gzhan dam pa rnams kyi dus 'khor man ngag las mi 'byung ba yang ma yin no/ /des na thun mtshams dge sbyor dmigs gsal can me phyin lhar ldang nas khyer so la gnas pa/ 'di thun mtshams rnal 'byor gyi rtsa ba nyid du nges pas ma chad par bya dgos so/ /de nas thun mtshams su maṇ+ḍal gyi bya ba byed na/ mdun du ba byang gi maṇ+ḍal’’ gru bzhi pa bya ste/ tsan dan la sogs pa'i dri bzang pos byugs pa la/ chang gtor ma byin gyis rlobs pa ltar byin gyis brlab pa las/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang srin lag gi blang ste/ sa la chos 'byung gru gsum byas nas de'i dbus su thig le ltar skum por bskor ba'i dbus su ye shes kyi 'khor lo dngas zhing gzugs bsnyan dang mtshungs pa gsal bar bsgom la/ rgyas par byas na chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan la bzhi pa'i rnam dbye byin pa la mgor oṃ dang mthar na ma sbyar nas/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / de nas rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mchod tshul gong du bshad ltar gyis mchod/ de nas oṃbhur+sā ya na maḥ oṃ dharmā ya na maḥ oṃ saṃ ghā ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra satā ya na maḥ oṃ pradzñā pa ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ swa bhā bi ka kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ dharmā kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ 610

saṃ bho ga kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ nirmā ṇa kā yā ya na maḥ oṃ dzñā na badzā ya na maḥ oṃ tsit+ta badzā ya na maḥ.oṃ wāka badzā ya na maḥ oṃ kā ya badzā ya na maḥ oṃ tsa tur bi mok+ṣe bh+yo na maḥ oṃ tsa tur brad+ma bi hā re bh+yo na maḥ oṃ sasta tri shad bho dhi sākhri ka dharme bh+yo na maḥ oṃ tsa tur shī ti sa ha pra dhasmra skadhe bh+yo na maḥ.oṃ sabra dhasmya de sha ke bh+yo na maḥ oṃ rat+na tra yā ya na maḥ oṃ shākya mu na ye na maḥ oṃ kā la tsakra ya na maḥ oṃ nga na pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ shī la pa ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ k+ṣurnyi pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ bībya pā ra mi tā ye na maḥ oṃ dh+yā na pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ pradzñā pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ u pā ya pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ pra ni dhā na pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ ba la pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ dzñā na pā ra mi tā yi na maḥ oṃ skṛ lha tshu tshu j-i dz+rī rnyi sgyu ya yā na maḥ oṃ smṛ lha thu ju lnga dzo rnyi ghā ra rā na maḥ oṃ slo l+lī phu phu sbo hṝ sgyi bhā wa wā na maḥ oṃ ṣ+ṭṛ lha thu byu dṛ dz+rī dhi dhī la lā na maḥ oṃ klo l+lī khu khu kṛ hṝ snyi sgyu ha hā na maḥ oṃ bla r+sā dzi r+pā ṣ+pe ṣ+pe shi shrī ha hā na maḥ oṃ ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣu nga ngu ṅka ṅgā na nā ma māṇa ḍā nya hā rdu r+ghaṃ phre phre phaṭa phaṭa na maḥ oṃ ha hā hi tī skṛ hṝ hu hū smṛ skṛ na maḥ h+la t+yā hra hā smra gla 'i na maḥ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/tsa tsha dza dzha hā/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye ḍā/ pa pha ba bha ma/ pa pha ba bha mā/ ta tha da dha na/ ta tha da dha nā/ ka kha ga gha nga / ka kha ga gha ngu / pa po ṣa sha ṅka/ pa tha ṣa sha ṅgā na maḥ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ka ṣa ya ra wa la/ ṇa snya ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ma bha ba pha pa/ ska sha ṣa tha pa na maḥ oṃ gu ru bhud+dha bho dhi satwa bh+yo na moḥ na maḥ zhes mchod sngags chen chos mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams tshim par bsam shing / rang gis myang bas lus kyi lha rnams mnyes par bsam la bstod pas bstod do/ /de nas sngar bshad pa ltar zhing skyong dang khro bo la gtor ma thun mtshams gsum du sbyin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus 'khor gyi bsgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo yi bsrung 'khor skabs su 'byung ba ltar bya dgos te 'phags 'grel dngos bstan gyi don yin pa dang / rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyi phyag len mthun par gdab pa bzhin shin tu bces pa'i sgo nas ma chad pa gal che ba yin no/ /gzhan du ni bla med sngags chos spyi yi nges pa dang / rgyud rgyal dang po'i sangs rgyas rtsa 'grel gyi mchod chog gi rig pas sdom chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul 'di ltar yang bya ste/ snod bzang por zas bzang dgu sha dang myos byed/ bdud rtsi lnga yi sbags pa dkyil 'khor lha yi gtor ma dang / gzhan yang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma bcas legs par bshams pa rnams chu chang zil 'thor dang byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dh+wa tī shwa ri ga ga na swā bhā wa sabra dra bya bi shwa dha ni sasba dra byā ṇi bi shwa dha ya r+ghaṃ phro phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las yam las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar ba'i steng du āḥ las bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i sgyed bu gsum mam/ yang na gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin du/ 611

mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ oṃ mam ka las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du a i ṛ u lo las byung ba'i rim pa bzhin dbus su khu ba/ shar du rkang /lho ru khrag byang du dri chu/ nub tu dri chen rnams la a i ṛ u los mtshan pa/ lī u rī zhi ā las byung zhing des mtshan pa'i rlung du glang po che'i sha /dbang ldan du ba glang gi sha /srin por rta'i sha /mer khyi'i sha /dbus su mi'i sha rnams bsam la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi bskul ba'i rlung gis sbar ba'i mes bzhus te/ de nyid hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjes bkrug pas de dang bcas pa ro gcig tu gyur pa zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su blta'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje bskyed la gtor ma la bstan ste/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra/ sabra dhasmo/ su bi shud+dha/swa bha wa/ sasba dharmām+bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sku rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku rdo rje spyan drangs/ des 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sku rdo rje'i bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas gcig tu gyur pa dang / dam tshig gi bdud rtsi 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas skyon med par bsam/ lag pa g.yas pa ā las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du ā dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i gsung rdo rje bskyed de gtor ma la bstan la/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra srur+ya/ sasba dhasmyu/ pra po dha ka sar+bha dharmān+d+ra bho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas gsung rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ gsung rdo rje spyan drangs/ gsung rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bsdus shing de nyid du thim pas rdzas rnams mang por rgyame par bya zhing bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par rtogs shing khong du chud par bsam/ thal mo gnyis ka kha sbub pa'i snyim pa rgyu las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i thugs rdo rje bsam la reg ste/ oṃ r+ghaṃ badz+ra a na la/ sar+bha dhasmre pra dī pa ka sar+bha dharmān pra dī pa ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas thugs rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ thugs rdo rje spyan drangs/ thugs rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bstus shing de nyid du thim pas rdzas rnams rab tu 'bar zhing kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ho las dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ho las ye shes rdo rje bsam ste gtor ma la bstan la/ oṃ ho sasba dhasmre/ badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sar+bha dhasmyun badz+ra a mṛ haṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes rdo rje spyan drangs/ ye shes rdo rje'i bdud rtsi bsdus shing de nyid du thim pas zag bcas kyi dri ma bsal nas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gyur par bsam te gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang / /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gi bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byas rnams dang / /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams 612

cad mdun gyi nam mkhar banugs par gyur/ /oṃ ha hā hi tī badz+ra hai ra wa ā kar+ṣa ya a kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bhad+dha ya bad+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hri da yi r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phre phre phaṭa/ zhes pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs/ sngags tsam gyi sgo nas mchod pa bcu gnyis phul te/ oṃ badz+ra gar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nas ka paṃ gyi bar brjod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul bar bye brag tu spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/phyaskargya ā+oṃ las skyes pha'i hi yig tu gnas 'gyur pad nyir r+ghaṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po brtsegs pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi gzugs su gyur pa'i 'od zer gyi gtor mgron spyan drangs ba de rnams la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas kyi ma chod par gyur pa ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas te rkang pa bcu drug pa la gtor sngags btags te phul ba'am/ yang na/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ho rgyu r+ghaṃ phre rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i mthar/ sa pā ri wā ra bh+yaḥ i rda ba dzi/ gar+ghaṃ — puṣ+pe bhu paṃ dri paṃ ak+ṣa ti smyad dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya/ sa pā ri wā raḥshī r+ghaṃ/ e rda/ ba dzi/ groṇ+ḍa tu/ khā daskyota pi waskyo/ dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃskṛstuḥ sasbra sa twa nī/ shisgri/puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣa/ ā ba ra ṇa/ gurnyi/ kurban+tu r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā tī ya tī swā hā/ zhes pas phul/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ o a ā i āḥ ha hā haṃ haḥ phre hoḥ ha hā hi tī dzo hṝ hu hū smṛ bhā hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pas bde chen 'khor lo ma dang / de nas rim par/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la gri gug gi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ bla bla dzi r+pā ṣ+pe ṣ+pe shi shī ha hāḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sa'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ lha l+lī thu byu lnga tsho dhi dhī la lā rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ chu'i 'khor lor pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ bla spyo phu phu bṛ hṝ gi bhā wa wā rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ me ma rin po che'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ smṛ 4 thu byu lnga dzo
