bhi dzā ra rā r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ rlung la ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ skṛ lha tshu tshu j-i ṭ+wāṃ dzhai ༈ ya yā rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ nam mkha' la rdo rjes phyag rgyas/ oṃ klo kṛ khu khya gro shrī ghi tī ha hā r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ slar yang rdor thal kha phye bas dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ha hā k+ṣa k+ṣu nga ngu ṅka ṅgā na nā ma mā ṇa ṇa nya hā rgyu ju phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar sngags tshan de rnams re re bzhin gtso boṅge skabs su bshad pa ltar gtor sngags sprel bar bya'o/ /gtor sngags kyang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags kyis phul kyang rung / phyag rgya yang tha dad med par rnal 'byor pa la phye bas phul kyang legs pa yin la/ 'dir ni rdo rjer shugs bsrung ma drug cu'i gtor 'bul tshul dang cha mthun par byas pa'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor lha ma gtor la 'bul ba'i rim par bde chen 'khor lo'i thams cad pa brgyad ngo bo lha yin rung rnams pa zhal phyag gi tshul mi ston par mchod pa'i sngags bkod nas ci zhig bya snyam pa blo chung dag la skye srid na/ de la bshad na yang yod kyang / dus 'khor 'phags 'grel mchod chog skabs rdo rje bzhi yi brda' thabs chos dung gaṇa ḍi sogs la mchod sngags gsung ba de tshul soms dang / de kho nas dogs pa de spang bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni bde chen 'khor lo'i sngags mtshar phyed bor na mi rung bas sa bon tshang ba nyid dang / thod pa'i ngo bo thabs bde ba chen por gnas shing rnam pa bde chen mchod pa'i 613

rdzas mchog tu gyur pa de la bdag gi mchod rdzas spros te zhugs pas rdzas kyi nus pa cher 'phel ba'i mchod sprin gyi lha tshogs shin tu dgyes pa'i yo byad du gyur par bsgom pa bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gnad dngacha mthun pa yang yin zhes skabs 'dir cung zad 'phros pa'o/ /nang mchod ni/ rgyas par gong du bshad pa'i sngags chen so sor 'bru gsum btags pa'o/ /bsdu na/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ho haṃ rgyu phre hūṃ phaṭa/ kā la tsakrā sam+bha ra sa pā ri wā ra sa pā oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ zhes pas lan mang du mchod/ bstod pa ni rkang pa bcu drug pa'am 'dud nyi shus bstod/ 'dud nyi shu ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dges pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud / /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /'dod don gsol ba ni/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad sdom chen 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ gtor ma 'di dag len cing gsol ba dang / /btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yi/ /'gro la zhi rgyas bsrung skyobs sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dus 'khor sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha yi tshogs la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i kho bo'i rnam rtog bzhin skabs 'dir bkod pa yin la/ de yang rgyud don las/ gzhan du 'da' ba'i skyon ni med par sems so/ /'on kyang dus 'khor chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs kyi gtor chog sngar gyi lag len la tshul 'di yi rigs pa'i rgyas btab ni rim yang mi bya ste/ ci'i phyir snga rabs shing rta chen po'i bzhed srol thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma nyams pa de la mkhas su re ba'i rig pas gsar bsgrub bsre slad kyi mos la dbang za ba de dus nam yang mi rung bas snga rabs dam pa'i gsung nyid 'phri bstan med par bya ba gal che'o zhes snying thag pa nas yang yang smra bya'o/ /bar 'dir chos skyong ye shes pa rnams la'ang so so'i gtor chog bzhin du phul nas/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ sa pā ri wa re bh+yaḥ e rda ba lo/ ghar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dri paṃ/ ak+ṣa tai/da da ma te/ sa pā ri wa ra/ shī r+ghaṃ/ ā gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ i rda ba ling groṇ+ḍaskyo/ khā da ru/ si wa ru/sa pā ri wā ra kaḥ sar+bha satā ā+oṃ/ shārnyi/ puṣ+ṭi/ rak+ṣa a wa ra ṇa/ gusti/ ka ro ru/ i rda pa thā rna/ t+yak+ta bā h+ya maṇ+ḍal bhu ṭ+wāṃ tiṣ+ṭha tu hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams ma gtor ma 'bul/ yul bdag grong bdag la yang / oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ yul gyi bdag po sa pā ri wā ra i rda ba ling zhes gong 614

bzhin dang / oṃ āḥ rgyu/ grong gi bdag po ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ shī r+ghaṃ/ i rda bā ling groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa/ bhu k+ta pi tā tri s+t+waṃ/ kri twa sabra satwa ṭ+wāṃ/ shārnyi/ tsit+t+waṃ/ kri tā a pa ras+thā rna gats+tsha gats+tsha swā hā/ zhes gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra gar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ mi skyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che//mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pa de nyid lngas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khar dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po ྾ 'byung po ྾ yi dwags ྾ sha za ྾smyo byed ྾ brjed byed ྾ mkha' 'gro ྾ ma mo ྾ de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ci snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnom la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /zhes bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ de nas kha zas dang 'brel na kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug la/ ma 'brel na mdun gyi lha la mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub blangs/ rdo rje dril bu bzung nas rdo rje bcings pas/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces pa la sogs pa dang / dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang bstun nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang gi snying khar bsdu/ lag pa'i rgyab stan te se gol brdab pa lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsdu zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya ste/ ji ltar nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs ni shes rab ye shes thob pa 'di las byung gyur pa/ /rnam gsum srid pa la gnas 615

sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las de bzhin 'gyur bar shog /sems can rnams kyi thar pa'i slad du bdag gi thugs kyi rdo mtha' dag pa la gnas pa bzhin/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i mthu las sems can thamayocad nyid rnam dag gi rnam gsum srid pa dag la gnas gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun pa song zhing lam nyams lkepa/ /de dag rnams kyi lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring min 'ong gyur cig ji ltar sangs rgyas mthu yis bdag gi blta ba ni/ /zhi 'gyur de bzhin mi rnams la ni 'gyur bar shog /thams cad du ni ngu ba'i lam la bsten pa yi/ /sems kyi rgyal ba'i thugs rje chen po 'gyur bar mdzod/ /dus 'khor gsang ba legs rtogs dam tshig yongs ldan zhing / /'di ston bla ma'i rjes 'brangs rdo rje spun la sogs/ /phan tshun legs par smra zhing 'khon du mi 'dzin dang / /dam tshig rdo rjes gleng slong ngam gyis gnas par shog /ma rung dam dral ngan pa'i las byed cing / /rnal 'byor ched du mi gnyer skye bo gang / /de dag mi 'grogs de yi mi mthong dang / /rang sdug bla ma rdo rje mchod par shog /rtsod ldan dus su gsang chen ston byed dang / /mu stegs skye bo ngan pa'i lta 'joms shing / /gang de'i lta ba dbyings nas 'don byed pa'i/ /de dag 'dul ba'i ded dpon de byed shog /ces rgyud 'alho dang / don dam bsnyen pa dang / rdo rje snying 'grel nas byung ba'i tshig gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo la/ gang dag steng na bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ /gang dag sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po'i gdon tshogs mi dge thams cad dus su 'chings byed pa/ /de dag thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyongs bar byed gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod de/ dus zhabs pas bshad pa ltar/ oṃ dzñā hri da yā ya na maḥ zhes sogs yan lag drug gi go bkon te lha'i rnams pas langs la/ spyod lam bzhi po thams cad du lha yi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha zas rnams la bdud rtsi ril bu'am/ chang bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pas bsangs gtor byas la/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ phud 'dod pa'i lha dang gtor ma la phul/ de nas/oṃ ha rī tī piṇ+ḍa ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas 'phrog mal chang bu gnyis dang / o dru tī tī a grwa gā saṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi pho nya mo la zas phud kyi chang bu rnams bza' ba'i mtha' ji srid par sa la bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bza' bar bya zhing / tshim pa'i rjes su/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi ukhyuṣ+ṭa ba lo bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ka swā hā/ zhes pas zos pa'i lhag ma 'byung po rnams la byin te/ bsod nams 'di yis rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni bla med byang chub thob par shog ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo drug la tram̐ la sogs pa'i yan lag drug dang / ā ā+o rī u lī aḥ ste rigs ༵༵ rnams dgod do/ /sangs rgyas rnams mya ngan las 'da' ba bzhin 'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal te gnyid log

par bya'o/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ pad+ma can las/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi cang te'u yi sgras pa nyid las blang bar bsam ste/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag byas nas mal nas langs te grub sogs pa bya bar bshad do/ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dbang bskur bzhin du bya bar phyag rdor gyi bshad/ de lta bu'i tshul la gnas pas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa gnyis spyad pa sngon du 'gro bas zhi sogs kyi dngos grub sna tshogs sgrub par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub pas 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten gyi dngos grub mtha' dag dngos su 'grub cing brgyud nas mchog gi dngos grub kyang 'byung ngo / /rgyal ba thabs mkhas thugs rje che ldan des/ /stong pa tsam gyis ye shes mthar thug mchog /bde myur bsgrod pa min gzigs gsal ba lam /dang por brtag dang mthar thug brtag min gyi/ /'gro khams sgribs bzhi'i dri ma nyer gsal te/ /gdod nas yongs grub mi 'gyur bde chen dbyings/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor nyer snang ba/ /tshul 'di sngags shes kun gyi 'jug ngogs nges/ /don des dpal ldan rgyud kun rgyal po mchog /dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo/ /shes rab rgyud kyi dbang po sdom pa che/ /gang gi sgrub thabs bstus min gsal ba 'di/ /rnam 'dren gsung gi 'od dkar gyis bskul tshe/ /bdag blo chu shel dbang po'i chu rgyun gyi/ /rab gsal shing rta ches bzhed gangs can lus/ /dri bral cho ga'i gzugs gang gsal byas sems/ /tshul 'dir bdag gi dag pa'i bsam pa yi/ /'bad pas bgyis mod 'on te gnong ba'i cha ci mtshams mchis pa bdag blo kho na'i skyon/ /dpang gyur la bshags nyes med dbugs dbyung stsol/ /legs par bshad kun bla ma'i mthu ste 'di bgyis dge ba'i tshogs/ /'byams klas sems can mtha' dag pa la bsngo mthus de kun kyang / /gegs med nye lam mchog 'dir zhugs te zung 'jug bde ba che/ /kun khyab rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang myur ba nyid thob shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bsgrub thabs mchog gi rdo rje 'od zer kun tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di ni gcang zhwa lu ri sbug gi bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur pa du mas yun ring po nas bskul bar mdzugs mdzad cing / nye lam de nyid bcu la mnga' bsnyes pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen 'jam dpal don grub kyi gsung gi snga phyi kun tu nan tan chen pos gsol ba btab bzhin pa dang / khyad par 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra yi thugs rje'i mthu las byung ba bsgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan sprin sgra can gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa yongs kyi 'dren mchog 'gro ba'i mgon po kun mkhyen 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta mchog gyur chen po gang gi zhal snga nas kyang tshul de lta myur du bkod par rigs so zhes bka' yi 'khor lo rin po che yi cod paṇa lta bu phebs pa la brten rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen par grags pa ngag gi dbang phyug chen po bu ston rin chen grub kyi gsung dus 'khor sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo yi 'don bya rtsa ba'i gzhir bzhag ste sdom chen gyi cho ga'i tshig ris grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi gsung dang man ngag tshad mar gyur pas kha bkang ste ma tshang ba med pa bklags chog gi tshul du sbyar ba 'di ni yul bod chen gyi 617

dbus 'gyur kaḥ thog rdo rje gdan gyi mnga' ris su skyes shing chos smra ba'i gzugs 'dzin shākya'i bstan pa la tshangs par spyod pa rdo rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i ming can tshe dbang nor bu'am 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i chu rgyun chad pa med pa'i dpal gyi shar phyogs kong po'i yul nyang kha gu ru pad+ma'i gnas chen ljon pa lung du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i rnga chen chu pho khyi'i lo gro zhun zla ba'i yar ngo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen gza' skar bzang la dbu brtsams nas thun skabs rnams su cung zad re bris te mthar khrums zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba thog ma nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la grub par byas pa sarba maṅga lo bha wan+tu/ dbe+e/'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /

rog /dus kyi 'khor lo'i skub thabs nar ma'i rnal 'byor khyer bde bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ na mo gu ra we/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shu n+ya tā dzha na badz+ra su bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang skad cig gi dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ 'byung bzhi ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal prus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar capo dang / g.yas dmar po bskyang pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying khar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang /zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thab can/ phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa dang / sor tshigs rnams kha dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing / me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can no/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / zhabs g.yas skum g.yon brkyang pas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing / dbu skra phyed grol ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/gsang gnas su swā/ gtsug gtor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ lha sku la sems bzhag cing / yang sngags bzla ba na/ oṃ haṃ swa hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sbyangs/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /zhes dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta rol pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung chung nyid rtsa rgyud bla ma gong ma rnams kyi 619

nyams bzhes mdzad pa ji bzhin pa 'di/ na tshod ldan shing phag gi lor dpal mo chos sdings kyi 'dus sder dus kyi 'khor lo'i snying po rnam bcu dbang ldan dung 'phyur 'dzugs pa'i skabs nar ma'i rnal 'byor khyer bder sems te/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par phyungs te mang yul byams sprin du bkod pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sog /'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsgrub dkyil mi shigs bde ba chen po'i thig le kun tu 'asbo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥ shrī he ru ka mdzi badz+ra nā thā ya/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyi bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ lan gsum/ kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing / /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan te ru kar bsgom bya/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla 5'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/rus pa'i rgyan drug gi brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i dpang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa 620

thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas r+ghaṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shri he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shriḥ yam̐/ ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko3bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥrtsu phaṭa/ ces ci ltar rig pa bzlas pa'i mthar/mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang lan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltang dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyi brlab tu gsol/rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo/ /shrī ho ru ko3haṃ/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du r+ghaṃ/ de las 'od zer dang mchod pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs mchod par gyur/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje spyan zhabs pad la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtog pa'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab bsgrub pa/ /de snyed rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag byas/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ho ru ka zhes pa re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swa hā/ oṃ badz+ra pa ju pra tits+tsha ṭ+wā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhuṣ+pe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āḥ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ne be bya āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shaja āḥ hūṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par gyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la 621

gnas par gyur cig oṃ swā bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā su bha wa shurnyo3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor du gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badzi bha ba bad+dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra rtsu saṃ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza dza ra hūṃ yi r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na r+ghaṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ saṃ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ rgyu/ zhes pa ste sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar r+ghaṃ las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa de'i lte bar rang nyid rdo rje khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing ga nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis r+ghaṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis kyi thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'dzin cing zhabs g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa pa ya groṇ+ḍi pa ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bit+yā ra dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bka' sgo bas khro bo rnams kyi bgegs rnams bkug spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ ki la ya ki la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ rgyu rtsu badz+ra tī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro alha pa ya ti sarba bisne kā ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ de rnams tho bas brdung / oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra ki la ya a ko ṭa ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ bgegs rnams stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ de bzhin nyid dang ro cig tu gyur/ uṇ+ḍi 'am/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ci nus re bzlas/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pa ni hi ta dzñā na badz+ra su wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bar do'i rnam shes mam dmar mer ho dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' rten pa/de'i snang ba las chad pa'i yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam de'i steng du ram las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du rgyu las 'khor lo rgyu gyi mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de zhu ba las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor ste/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang drwa phyed shar bu dang mda' yab dang / bzung ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha rnams shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser dbus bsngo ba/ phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa mchod pa'i bkod pa du ma 622

dang bcas shing pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug gi phyi rol du snam bu dmar po'i khor yug la/ rdo rje gshin rje ro langs kyi tshogs rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i gar byed pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang /ri dang / mchod rten dang / grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi yongs su gang ba/ phyi rol du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /rtsigs pa'i phyi 'og mtha' dang / stegs bu dang / sgo'i ya phugs kyi ka gdung la 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa/ nang gi lha rnams kyi dbus su gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ pad+ma dmar pos mtshon pa'i mu khyud rwa ba ka ba gdung thog phugs la sogs pas mdzes pa de'i nang thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa'i mu khyud rā ba ka ba gdung thog phugs la sogs pas mdzes pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gi mtshan pa/ thugs khar gyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ pad 'dab kyi kheb pa'i 'khor lo'i 'og nas mu khyud cung zad mngon pa'o/ /pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ a ā/i khri/ u u/ ṛ rī/ lo lī/ e e/ o au/ saṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa snya ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar skya/ de'i dbus su r+ghaṃ dang baṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūṃ dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa/ gdod nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / de thams cad cig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis cang te'u dang tshangs mgo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs shing rang dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ lha'i gnas rnams su dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa'i lha mo grangs med pa dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ r+ghaṃ e hriḥ ho r+ghaṃ ha/ phung po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa drug gi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ a khaṃ haṃ/ skye mched drug dpa' mo drug gi ngo bor gyur/ lo me paṃ tai khaṃ/ khams lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ ces yab yum gnyis ka la bsam/ 'di shin tu bsdus pa ste 'bru de rnams brjod pas der gyur pa mos pa yin la/'bring po ni sa bon lus la bkod pa/ rgyas pa ni lha bkod pa'o/ /yab kyi thugs kar zla ba la bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge gsum babs/ /yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo dang / gsang bar yang / hoḥ dmar pos mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par bzhugs/ yi ge rnams yum gyi pad+mar babs pas yab yum 623

byang chub kyi sems kyi gong bur gyur/ 'khor gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams langs te/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dang bcas thal mo sbyar zhing / rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang cang te'u'i sgras bskul ba ni/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi lugs/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi gsang / e ma ho bde ba las byung ba/ e ma ho kun tu bzang po'i don/ e ma ho bde bas yang dag 'dus/ e ma ho bde chen dag pa ste/ e ma ho bde ba bde ba'i mchog e ma ho gsang sngags mnyam sbyor ba/ e ma ho thugs kyi spyod pa ste/ e ma ho mnyam nyid phyag rgyar ldan/ e ma ho sgrub pa rmad du 'byung / e ma ho pha rol phyin pa'i sa/ e ma ho rig pa rjes 'jug pa/ e ma ho sna tshogs las chen po/ e ma ho kha sbyor gsum dag pa/ e ma ho rdo rje mnyam sbyor ba/ e ma ho pad+ma rnam 'byed pa/ e ma ho dbang gnyis snyoms 'jug pa/ e ma ho rmad byung mnyam pa nyid/ e ma ho dag pa'i gar chen te/e ma ho shin tu dri med glu/ e ma ho glu yi las sbyor ba/ e ma ho pheg deb mun sel ba/ e ma ho me tog tshogs dga' ba/ e ma ho bdug pa bum pa bzang / e ma ho sgron ma gti mug sel/ e ma ho dri mchog bsril ba ste/ e ma ho rnal 'byor mnyam sbyor ba/ e ma ho sgyu 'phrul mkha' lta bu/ e ma ho gdod nas sangs rgyas gdod nas rdo rje ste/ e ma ho gdod nas rin chen bde ba rab stsol ba/ e ma ho pad+ma gdod nas bris pa ste/ e ma ho sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul pa yin/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad sangs rgyas/e ma ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i sras/ e ma ngo mtshar sems can rnams/ /e ma ngo mtshar lha mo'o/ /de ltar rab tu bskul nas/ bskul ba po rnams dzaḥ dzaḥ ces thig le la thim/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las me las rdo rje dmar ser me gyi mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad slar 'dus te me yig la thim/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal ho ru ka zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal gur gum gzhon nu ltar dmar ser/ g.yas zhal sngo ba dang ser ba g.yon zhal ljang khu dang dmar po/ de rnams khros shing 'jigs pa'i nyams can/ steng zhal dkar po zhi ba'o/ /bad+dha ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / sangs rgyas lnga'i gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa'i thod skam kyi dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pas yum la 'khyud cing / gnyis pa gnyis kyi thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa dang bcas te tshangs pa'i pags pa stod g.yog tu 'phyar ba/ gsum pa gnyis kyi ral gri dang ut+pal/ bzhi pa gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis kyi cang te'u dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ drug pa gnyis kyi mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang g.yon 624

bskum rgyab ma gnyis gar gyi tshul du drag po nag po dang dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan zhing / ral pa'i cod pan la nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ thal ba dang mi mgo'i do shal gyi sku la spras pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gar dgu'i rol ba'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba'i zhal phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis cang te'u dang bdud kyi mgo bo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra grol zhing thod skam gyi do shal can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /thugs 'khor gyi shar phyogs su li ra ma la ya ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ dkar sngo ljang pa'i zhal gsum/ byang phyogs dzā lar+ghaṃ rar ma hā kai ka la dang gtum mig ma/ ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ nub phyogs o ḍi ya nar kai ka la dang 'od ldan ma/dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ lho phyogs athu tar mche ba rnam par gcigs pa dang rna chen ma/ ljang ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ shar lhor gi ta wa rir/ pū ra wi ri dang brtan ma'i blo can ma/ dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ lho nub rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dkar ser ljang zhal gsum/ nub byang de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ sngo skya ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ ljang ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ de ltar thugs 'khor pa rnams phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma ru par ang ku ri dang e ra wā ti/ dkar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum byang phyog o ṭir rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ ljang ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje r+ghaṃ mdzad dang 'chang 'thung ma/ dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sha ma de wī/ ljang ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum/ lho nub lam mā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ nub byang kiñtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dud ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang shar hi ma yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdeng ma/ sngo skya ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ de ltar gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams pad+ma dang / de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar sgo pre ra pu rir/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/byang sgor gri ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ nub sgor sau taṣ+ṭar ta mgrin dang shiṣ+ṭa ṇi dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ lho sgo su war+ṇa di par nam mkha'i snying po dang 625

'khor lo'i go cha ma/ dger sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ shar lho'i grwa nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ /sngo skya ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum lho nub gyi grwa sid+dhar pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ ser sngo ljang nyaba'i zhal gsum/ nub byang gi grwa ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/dkar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ byang shar gyi grwa ku lu tar/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo kar nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ de ltar sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud cing /lhag ma g.yas kyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang cang te'u/ g.yon gnyis kyi thod khrag dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'o/ /yab rnams stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /yum rnams gcer bu g.yon brkyang gi stabs can/ thams cad kyang gtso bo yab yum gyi rig las byung ba'o/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ wi ra yo gi ni kā ya wagyit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3haṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ be+e/ dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ o yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta shrī mdzi badz+ra tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ pa ju pra tīts+tsha su hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ badz+ra dhuṣ+pe āḥ rdu/ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra gadhe āḥ rgyu/ badz+ra ne we bya āḥ hūṃ/ badz+ra shardo āḥ r+ghaṃ/ de nas bstod pa ni/ cang te'u brdung zhing / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi ri sha ya rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalbāsdi san ni bha ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ o dza ṭa mu ku ṭoṅka ṭa ya r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṣ+ṭa ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa na mu kha ya r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ oṃ sra ha bhu dza bha su rā ya r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/oṃ pa ra shu pā sho bya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇi rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bya ghā dzi nāsba ra dha rā mā r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu mrarnya ka ra wa pu ṣā ya r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra bā rā hi waṃ rtsu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a sa ra dzi te tai lokya mra de ma hā bi bya shwa re hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ sabra bhu ta bha yā wa ho ma hā badz+re hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā pa ne a dzi ta bā sham kā ri nai tra bh+ra ma ṇi r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ sho ṣa ṇi kro dhā ni ka rā le ni r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma s+t+ra pa ne mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa tā dzā ye rgyu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā hi ma hā yo gi nī kā me shā rī kha ge hūṃ r+ghaṃ pha/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad do/ /bar 'dir lus dkyil bsgom par 'dod na/ lte bar gtso bo la sogs par 'khor lo gsum gyi lha yab yum lnga bcu bsgoms par bya'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par aḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ lte bar ho/ rang gi snying khar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar ser gyi lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i mam gyis mtshan pa'o/ /yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phe/ oṃ a bhi 626

ṣañtsa tu rma/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gi sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i ka pa las dbang bskur/ sku lus gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / sngon po rnams la mi bskyod pa/ dkar po rnams la rnam snang / ljang khu rnams dang dur kha la don grub/ dmar po rnams la snang mtha'/ ser po rnams la rin 'byung gi dbu brgyan/ de nas go cha bgo bar bya ste/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i snying gar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma ti ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swā hā r+ghaṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su oṃ/ bo ṣaṭa ho nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo phag mo/ /snying khar oṃ haṃ oṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hri me dkar mo rmongs byed ma dpral bar oṃ hring hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug oṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la o phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka yi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan dang /gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /de nas 'dir yang spro na mchod bstod bya zhing / khyad par du bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ griṇ+ḍa griṇ+ḍi r+ghaṃ/ griṇ+ḍa pā ya/ griṇ+ḍi pā ya rgyu/ a na ya ho bha ga wan bit+yā rā dza ya rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha shurjo3haṃ/ yo las rlung / ram̐ las me a las thod pa oṃ tram̐ e khaṃ rgyu las bdud rtsi lnga/ lo me paṃ te baṃ las sha lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas kha dog dmar ser du gyur steng gi nam mkha' la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin de zhu zhing tshim pas/ dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ r+ghaṃ āḥ oṃ brtsegs pa de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems spyan drangs/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu zhing 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ.oṃ sa ma ya shurta sarba dharma sa ma ya shurnyo haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka rgyu ṭha ṭha stam a khaṃ r+ghaṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myong bla ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ 'jam dpal ngag dbang grags pa blo gros bzang / /bde chen rdo rje lha yi 'byung gnas dang / /mi 'jigs 'byung gnas bde ba mgon po'i zhabs/ /lhan skyes rgyal mo snying po mtha' yas dpal/ /mi bskyod rdo rje bde ba'i dbang phyug stsal/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /bka' gnang bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes so/ /bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa sogs 627

bsgom par bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgyu mar shes par bya ste/ de la mnyam par bzhag go/ /byang chub mchog gi dag pa dran pa ni/ 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus dang spyod pa dang sems te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ rab gtum ma/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma rnams so/ /dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi dbang po lnga ni brtan blo ma/mi'u thung ma laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma/ sa srung ma rnams so/ /dad sogs kyi stobs lnga ni/'jigs byed ma/ rlung shugs ma/ chang 'thung ma/ ljang lha mo/ rab bzang ma rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang / brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs ba dang / rnam 'byed dang / dran pa dang /btang snyoms/ yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ma/ 'khor shugs ma/dum skyes ma/ glang sna ma/ go cha ma/ shin tu dpa' mo rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / rtog pa dang / ngag ni/ stobs chen ma/ 'khor bsgyur ma/ brtson chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/dpal he ru ka'o/ /gzhan yang dbang po lnga ni yul lnga dang / /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid lha/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam par sbyor/ /de nyid nyi shu lnga bdag nyid/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /ye shes gzhal med khang bzang ste/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad dag pa/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad du sprul/ /sdang dang bsred pa rab 'joms pas/ /lha mo rnams dang yi dgas 'phreng / /sna tshogs rdo rje bdud gzhom ste/ /ye shes me 'od rnam par spros/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dag pa/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du shes par bya/ /dam pa'i don du dpa' bo'i gzugs/ /ye shes kyi ni 'jam dpal nyid/ /skyon drug dag pas rigs drug nyid/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'phags pa yis/ /zhal dang phyag ni rnam dag pa/ /ma rig 'du byed zhabs kyi mnan/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam mo/ /de nas 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang / /ngag bzlas yid bzlas rnams rims gyis bya ste/ /oṃ āḥ me r+ghaṃ/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ shrī mañdzu badz+ra sgrika oṃ r+ghaṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la sasbra ram̐ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra wā ra hi hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni/ bde mchog spyi dang /jo nang rje btsun gyi yig char oṃ ldu yod kyang yig nor ram 'gyur ma dag pa ra mngon la 'gyur dag par āḥ yig yod pa shin tu 'thad gsang 'dus ltar 'bru gsum sgrom du gzhugs par rtogs/ des na/ oṃ shrī mañdzu badz+ra t+ta ga āḥ r+ghaṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la sasmra ram̐ hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swa hā/ gzhan yang / oṃ shrī man dzu dh+rig a hai r+ghaṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dza la shaṃ ba ra r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa ṭ+wā hā/ zhes lo tsa byang shes 'gyur la rab zhib 'gyur bcos byas pa las 'byung / slad char dpe dngos la rgya skyegs kyi bris pa de dkyus su bzhugs pa las yig chung 'di rnams mi bri/ mthun pa yin na/ de gtso bor bzla bar ma gsungs so/ /'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ka ra ka 628

ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsiṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ka ka la r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi ak+ṣi ye r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ bhan dha bhan dha ka ka la r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba tī ye rgyu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tra sa tra sa ya bi ka ta rdaṣ+ṭa na r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ko bha ya k+ṣ-i bha ya su ra bhe ra ni hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ o bī ra ma tī ye hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ a mṛ ta bha rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba ri ye r+ghaṃ rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥ hraḥ badz+ra pra bha r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/oṃ loṅka shwa rī ye rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dze dze badz+ra di nyi r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhu mats+tsha ye r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa e ku ri ka r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e ra wa ye r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra ti la hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ra we r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā bi ra r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa badz+ra r+ghaṃ ka ra ba sa dhu ti ran+t+ra mā la wa lam+bi ni r+ghaṃ rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhak+ṣi ye r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ griṇ+ḍi griṇ+ḍi su bha tra sap+ta pa pa ta la ga ta bhu dze gi sarba tardza ya tardza ya r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ oṃ sgyu ma de bi ye r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kasgye badz+ra bha tra r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su bha tre+e r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ho ho ma hā bho ra ba r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hā ya ker+ṇa ker+ṇa r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzhai rnyi bi ru bhak+ṣa r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ga na ne r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rgyu rgyu ma hā bha le rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kra ba ge r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ haṃ rad na badz+ra na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro ho phroṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ho ho ha ya gri ba r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇ+ḍi ni ye rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ a ka sha gar+bha karje hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra wismra ṇi ye r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bi ri r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li pad+ma ner te shwa re hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi la ro tsa na r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti ni r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badz+ra sa twa r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bī s+t+ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ bdag bskyed kyi gtor bsngo byas de thun bsdu ba'o/ /min yang rung ste snying kha'i 'od zer gyi snod bcud thams cad nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyang bdag nyid la thim/de yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i bar bsdus/ de yang 'od gsal bar bsdus te stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag go /slar yang rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ/ lte bar hoḥ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' nas rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa ste yab kyi gnas su yang yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yang yab gnyis su med par gyur/ pu dza o a go ra de mā/ ka e kri ko ka la hi bre gyi sau su na si ma ku/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyi phyogs bcing / yab kyi rkang brgyad tshar cig brjod/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin brjod pa grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du rnam 629

par dag go/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba sogs dang / lha mo tshad ma sogs dang / srid pa gsum 'bar sogs smon lam ci rigs btab nas spyod lam la 'jug ste dag pa rnam pa gsum dang ma bral bas so/ /gtor chog ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me/ a las thod pa/rgyu rgyu i trīḥkhaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃ trīḥte rnams las bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lngar gyur/ ha ho trīḥyi ge kha dog dang dri dang ro nus ngan pa sbyangs/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas kha dog dmar ser du gyur/ de'i rlangs pa las byung bas steng gi nam mkha' la r+ghaṃ las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu zhing thim pas dngul chu'i mdog can rab tu bsil bar gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams yongs su gyur pa las r+ghaṃ āḥ.oṃ brtsegs pa o las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sems dang rgya mtsho'i bcud sogs snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad spyan drang / 'bru gsum zla ba dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āphargyu ha ho trīḥ lan mang du brjod/ be+e zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ nas/shaba'i bar gyi mchod/ oṃ a ral+li ho dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya/ ste dri sh+ya ho/ zhes lan gsum gyi spyir phul/ yab yum gyi snying po'i r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa kyi sngon du i me ba sla gyiṇ+ḍi mā ma sarba karma ku ru ku ru zhes bcug pa lan gsum gyis phul/ / oṃ ka ra ka ra ku ru ku ru/ bad+dha bad+dha/ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ k+ko bha ya k+ko bha ya/ hre hre/ hraḥ hraḥ be+e be+e/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa tu dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba me bi ne/ griṇ+ḍi griṇ+ḍi/ pasta pā ta la ga te bhu dza ga sabaṃ ba tardza ya tardza ya/ a rgya ā ka rgya/ hri hri/rnyo dzhai/ rgyu rgyu/ haṃ haṃ/ ho ho/ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/lan gcig gi 'khor lo gsum la phul/ r+ghaṃ bcu gcig gi mthar/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ar+ya nut+pan na tot+ta oṃ āḥ hūṃ phaṭa swa hā/ btags pas bsrung pa'i 'khor lo rnams la phul/ yang ar+ghaṃ nas shari'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis sam gang gi khu ba glus bskul gyi bstod/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsha/ un+ma da/ a ba smra ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i me ba lo griṇ+ḍin+tu/ ma ma sarba sikhyu me pra yats+tshaskyo/ ya the paṃ ya theṭaṃ/ bhudzi tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā rā ta ya sablu khaṃ bi shudha ye/ sa hu yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swa hā/ zhes lan gsum mo/ /rdo dril thabs dang bcas pas/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus 630

dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus par ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyi 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrung / /bsrung bas rtag tu grogs mdzod cing //dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan / /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /nyes pa thams cad med par mdzod/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /r+ghaṃ khro bo bde ba gyes pa yis/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pa sten par byed/ /a la la ho/ a i a/ a ra l+li ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i ā/ a ra lbi ho/ rab dgyes mgon po khyed bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyi gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la ho/ a i ā ra wi ho/ bde ba spang pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyed ma gyur/ /bde ba che yi grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yi mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ /sems can thams cad nad med cing / /zhes sogs smon lam btab/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod/ yig brgyas bzod gsol/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol rnams byas/ yo ga shurnyo'i sngags kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ slar yang bdag bsrung dang smon lam bkra shis gang 'os re bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 631

'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs ches mang yang / /rgyud sde kun gyi rtse mor gyur pa dang / /las tshogs tsam min mchog sgrub gtsor ston dang / /dag bya dag byed rab rgyas dkyil 'khor dang / /rgyud las shin tu gsal bar gsung pa'i phyir/ /sgrub thabs 'di nyid kho na ches mchog ste/ /gsang ldan la sogs rgyud sde 'og mar bzhugs/ /gur las gsung sogs las tshogs lha tsam yin/ /mtshan brjod sgrub thabs bla med lugs byas pa/ /phal cher dag bya dag byed shin tu bsdus/ /'dus pa'i 'jam rdor man ngag gtso che ste/ /rgyud las ha cang gsal bar gsungs pa'ang med/ /ces ched du brjod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po'i gsung kyu ru lugs bklags chog tu rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus phyung te bkod pa yin/ /maṅga lo su dza yan+tu/ /

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi zhing skyong spyi dang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga chen po dngos grub bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /oṃ suste/ na maḥ shrī te ru ka maṇ+ḍa le bh+ya: 'gyur med bde chen 'od gsal mtshan dpe'i lus/ /kun khyab srid gsum mgon po kun gyi bcud/ /kun snang dra ba sdom mdzad kun tu bzang / /bcom ldan btsun mo bcas pas bdag blo srungs/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi /rgyud chen rnams nas legs gsung ba'i/ /zhing skyongs tshogs dang 'byung po spyi'i/ /gtor chen cho ga 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob cing de yi bcas pa la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas gtor ma'i cho ga 'di nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /des ni las dang dngos grub la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khyad par shin tu mang po dag 'grub par 'gyur zhing skye bo mang po dag la yang mchog tu phan pa yin no/ /de la dus ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel na thun so so'i 'jug gi cha dang / lhag par mchog tu bsngags pa nam phyed kyi thun mtshams la yin cing / khyad par gyi dus ni/ dpal mkha' 'gro bde mchog las/ tshes brgyad dang ni khyad par du/ /bco lnga dang ni tshes bcu bzhir/ /grub 'dod rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni/ /'bad pas gtor ma byin par bya/ /zhes gsungs zhing / de dag la yar ngo dang mar ngo'i dbye bas drug dang / spyi gtor chog 'di tshes bcu mchod pa'i yan lag yin la tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis te/ zla ba gcig gi nang du nyi ma brgyad po de dag bsngags la/ lo dus kyi dbang ltar na dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu la lhag par bsngags so/ /de ltar gtor chog chen mo btang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas bzhin du rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya nang mchod blangs te sa gzhi la byugs pa'i steng du thig btab nas chos 'byung bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa bsgom don bzhin rdul tshon gyi bri ba'am/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor sogs yod na'ang legs la/ yang na chos 'byung gi dbus su zlum skor gsum lte ba le tshe dgu dang bcas pa bri ba'am/ de yang ma grub na chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa brtsam mo/ /yang na thig btab nas tshom bu bkod kyang rung la/yang ras bris med cing rdul tshon bri ba mi gcogs na/ maṇ+ḍal la nang mchod kyi chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog gi 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung ngo / /de nas mchod 633

pa'i gtor ma bsdu na gcig gam gnyis dang / 'bring por 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i dgu'am rgyas par lha grangs dang mnyam pa ste/ gang ltar sha khrag chang dang sgog btsong gi brgyan cing zas bzang dgus sbags pa'o/ /de las rgyun gyi lag len du ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po zhig gi gsung jo nang rje btsun dam pas gnang ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa chang gi bkang ba'i steng gtor snod kha zas dang dmar gyi bkang ba re re 'das gtor de ka 'dra ba gcig brgyad po'i phyi rol lho phyogs stegs bu mtho ba la 'jog cing / thams cad ba dan gyi brgyan pa so sor sgos mchod re dang bcas pa'o/ /gal te sgos mchod so sor ma gcogs na chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sogs spyi mthun thun mong du bshams kyang chog par rtogs so/ /mdun du bdud rtsi ka pā la/ rdor dril ḍā ma ru sogs kyang 'du byas la/ shrī ho ru ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod skad cig gi rang dpal he ru ka'i skur gyur par bsam de nas nang mchod bdud rtsi ni/ 'gi gtor ma byin brlabs ji bzhin pas byin gyis brlab/ gnas yo byin brlab/ de rnams la nang mchod 'thor la/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang r+ghaṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi'i brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su a las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las byung ba/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du pā byi/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ hūm̐/de bzhin du dhu pe a lo ke gadhe ne+e we te shardo āḥ hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya a warta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pa nā li te/ badz+ra pra sa ra me ta/ na da sam+bha we ta/ badz+ra dhad+ma hri da ya ni sarnyo ṣa ni r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ ho ho ho/a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags dang / mchod sprin gyi gzungs ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra madra nā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyak+shi bud+dha ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā bibya badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bho dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bho dhi marnyo pa/ saṃ kra ma r+ṇa sarba karma a pa ra ṇi bi shwa dha ni ṭ+wā hā/ zhes sogs ji rigs pa bzlas shing byin dbab so/ /de nas bdag bskyed dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs nas phag mo gtso rkyang 634

ngam dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar rgyas bsdus ji ltar bsgom kyang rung la/ bde mchog zhal phyag mang ba bsgom tshe zhing skyongs gi gtor rgyud dang 'brel che ba yi/ slob dpon nag po zhabs kyi lugs nyid legs shing / gang ltar bzlas pa dang 'od gsal 'jug ldang gi bar du bya'o/ /de ltar mngon rtogs gzhan bsgom tshe sgrubs thabs rnams su shes la/ 'dir lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs tsam bshad na/ skyabs sems tshad med sngon du 'gro bas/ shu n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gi nang du/ yam las rlung / ram las me/ baṃ las chu/ lo las sa/ sum̐ las ri rab brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ hūṃ las bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su rang sems hūṃ baṃ las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po in+d+ra ni la ltar 'bar ba lang tsho la bab cing 'khrang bag chags pa'i sku can/bzhad zhing khro la chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo zhing / mche ba'i myu gu gcigs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor nor bu/ g.yon ngos su zu phyed/ mdun ngos su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyang dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / mi mgo'i do shal dang / thal ba dang / rin po che'i rtse phran dang / mi bskyod pa'i rigs bdag can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ pad nyi'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dang /g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed chen mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o/ /yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ sku mdog dmar mo dbu skra grol ba/ ba spu la sa shing me tog 'dzag pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdig 'dzub gdengs pa/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi do shal can/ zhabs g.yas yab la 'khril zhing / g.yon bskyangs pas 'dod chags chen po'i bde ba la rol pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /o āḥ r+ghaṃ/ be+e/ dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ ho/ yab kyi snying khar oṃ ha/ mgo bor na maḥ hi/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā r+ghaṃ/phrag par bo ṣaḍa he/ mig tu rgyu r+ghaṃ ho/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ/ snying khar haṃ oṃ/ khar hri mo/ dpral bar hro hri/ spyi gtsug tu r+ghaṃ rdzu yan lag rnams su phaṭa phaṭa/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rkang brgyad dam bsdu na/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang / thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa'i/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' sogs byas kyang chog /oṃ trīḥ ha ha hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ces bzla'o/ /mthar rjes gzhig kyi rim pas 'od gsal bsdus la slar 635

yang skur ldang / de nas gtor ma byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ chu chang nang mchod kyis bran/ sum+bhas bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa lta bu/ kha dog sngon po ba dan gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa/ kha dog dmar po 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du āḥ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa shin tu rgya che ba las mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du dbus su na las mi'i sha/ shar du go las glang gi sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las rta'i shalho ru ku las khyi'i sha sha re re'i steng du dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du ni las dri chen/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dngas ma/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su r+ghaṃ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du r+ghaṃ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dzi las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ lhor e mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du āḥ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor āḥ yig brgyan pa/ de'i steng du r+ghaṃ las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'am rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ r+ghaṃ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phogarlung g.yos me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga 'od du bzhu zhing bskol te tha mal ba sbyangs/ de'i rlangs kyi 'od zer steng du 'phros pas oṃ mgo thur du blta ba dang / zla ba dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i rdo rje'i lte ba'i r+ghaṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa dang 'dres pas bdud rtsir rtogs par bya/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'am rdo rje'i r+ghaṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi bdud rtsi la thim ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas mtha' med du sbar/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'ang rdo rje dang zla ba dang oṃ yang lhung ste/ zhu nas kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ yang yang brjod/ de nas gtor ma'i dkyil 'khor sum+bhas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi la/ baṃ las chu khams kyi dkyil 'khor dkar po/ de'i nang du yi las rlung khams kyi dkyil 'khor nag po/ de'i nang du ram̐ las me khams kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po/ de'i nang du lo las sa khams kyi dkyil 'khor ser po'o/ /de rnams gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bral ba/ de'i dkyil 'khor nang ya'i lha rnams 'khor yug rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba'i dbus su saṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /pad+ma'i lte 636

bar nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la rgyu la rdo rje r+ghaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltar na phyag dang po gnyis g.yas ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas 'dzin cing / bsor ba'i rdo rje dang g.yon bshor gyi rnams pa'i thod khraga'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'geng pa/ drag po chen po/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa thams cad kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ ho ru ka'i rgyan dang cha byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'dab ma rnams la shar du phyum las mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang ma dkar mo thal mo'i rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang du be+e las 'bar byed ma ser mo thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa/ nub tu be+e las 'jigs byed ma dmar mo/ snyim pa khrag gi bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lhor phri las g.yo ldan ma'am ngag 'phrog ma sngon mo/ /phyag gnyis gtun shing dang sdig 'dzub can/ bzhi dkar yang skra dmar po grol zhing / mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa/ gcer bu sbrul dang rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi'o/ /de yi phyi rol yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo 'khor yug gsum so sor re mig brgyad dang ldan pa'i phyogs g.yon skor mtshams g.yas bskor gyi gnas pa'i k+ṣe rnams las byung ba'i gnas bsrung zhing skyongs nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams grub par gyur pa ni/ 'khor yug dang por/ rab tu rgod pa shing mchog ka dam pa/ /zhing skyong zhi gdong dril bu chen mor bcas/ /rdo rje 'dzin cing 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas//kol+la gi rir ri rtse la brten pa'i/ /zhing skyongs me zhal dpal chen mo dang bcas/ /'gos bzhur du yum zhi gdong / yab dril chen du bshad/ mi mgo 'dzin cing mi ro'i gdan la gnas/ /dha ra ṇa yul ta la'i shing la brten/ /gcigs bde byed ma dang skra gyen zer/ g.yas pa'i mtshon cha zer/ pa chen po skra gyen 'bar ma bcas//rtse gsum 'dzin cing sidhi dngul chu'i gang ba'i sgod/ sisba ḍi/ /de wi ko ḍir shing mchog bā ṭa la/ /lus chen po rgyu chen yang zer/ ni rna ba chen mor bcas/ /mdung thung 'dzin cing yi dwags gdan la bzhugs/ /bi ra dzar ni a mra la brten pa'i/ /ha har skad dod a sgyi yod zer/ bzhad pa yum ni mer 'bar ma ba dan 'dzin cing shing leb la gnas pa'o/ /oṃ ldu ḍa ru kaṇi'i shing gi drung / /dril bu sgra gcan me yi gdong ma gnyis/ /rdo rje 'phang mdung zer shag ti 'dzin cing phag la zhon/ /ser tata pur skya'i gnas su shing mchog he zer dza ṭi re/ /byin pa chen po dmar ser ma dang bcas/ /gtun shing 'dzin cing yi dgas gdan la bzhugs/ /e le'i grong du a par dzi ti'i shing / /glang po'i rna ba stobs chen ma dang bcas/ /zhags pa thogs pas bong bu'i steng du bzhugs/ /de nas 'khor yug gnyis par/ kha che'i yul du ri bo la brten pa'i/ /'jigs byed spu gu'i byin can zer/ rtsa ba'i byin can yang zer/ chen mo ba glang rna 637

ba ma/ /lag na lcags sgrog nor byin gdan la bzhugs/ /ma rung mya ngam thad la brten pa yi/ /gcigs rim pa mo yang zer/ skad dod gar la zer ba yod cing / pa'i zhal can 'jigs zhal la lhan cig /lcags kyu zhags pa thogs shing ma he zhon/ /spa shing lta bu rā la brten nā ga rar/ /mche spu'i byin pas/ rtsigs chen po ro langs can mar bcas/ /thong gshol 'dzin cing mi mgo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /puṇ+ḍa wad+dhar a shwad tha ya drung / /bum pa'i 'bras bu can dang tsa muṇ+ḍi kum+bhaṇ+ḍi zer/ kha ṭ+wāṃ kha 'dzin mi ro'i gdan la 'gying / /dza yin ta ru khang pa brtsegs pa la/ /ral chug gdod ma/ pa gsum pa bzhin mdzes bzhin dngas ma zer ma dang bcas/ /lug rgyud 'dzin cing keng rus la gnas pa/ /pre triṇ+ḍa pu ra zer ba'ang yod/ ta pu rir u rdu ba ra la/ /dril bu ma zer phag gdong yang zer 'jigs par byed pa glog gi gdong mar bcas/ /gzhal yas khang nas dbyug pa mdung thung 'dzin/ /su pa rang ni shal ma li yi nag /kun mdzes dang ni me lce'i gdong ma gnyis/ /sha chen phung por gri gug mdung thung 'dzin/ /tsā ri tra ru ka rañdza shing la/ /dril bu chen pa ka rañdza gnas ma/ /mdung thung 'dzin cing 'jam 'bral sdong por gnas/ /de nas 'khor yug gsum par/ /o rgyan u ḍi yang zer yul du mya ngan med pa'i shing / /zhing drag po stobs chen skyong sgra can yum ni lha chen mo/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin cing 'dre bdud mnan/ /dza lar+ghaṃ rar gser shing la brten pa'i/ /zhing skyongs bskyed mig skyes yang zer/ pa zhes bya gtum mong bcas/ /gri gug 'dzin cing mi ro bdud mnan par byas kyang chog zhabs kyis mnan/ /k+ṣi ra ka ru sā la'i shing sdong la/ /ri rab chen po 'jig rten ma mor bcas/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing me dpung la gnas pa/ mā 'byung po'i shing zer ya su rir shā kho ṭa shing drung / /zhing skyongs 'jigs pa 'dod pa mo dang bcas/ /mi ro'i phung por rdo rje shag ti 'dzin/ /argyu ka yul de ba da dhā tri zer ru la/ /brtul zhugs chen po srul mo dang lhan cig /thong bshol la de'i dbyug pa zer/ thod pa dang dbyug pa yang zer/ ga ya 'dzin cing seng ge zhon/ /rgyal po'i khab tu ni da mi ka zer lha gnyen gyi shing gcig zin zer me ke shing la/ /rga ba chen mo mi sdug ma dang bcas/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin cing 'khor lor gnas/ /bod yul drag gi phug la brten pa yi/ /zhing skyongs longs spyod lhan cig skyes mar bcas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing yi dwags mnan/ /mā la bar ni sbrang rtsi'i shing gi drung / /sna tshogs skyes pa'i zer/ dbang phyug dbang bskur ma dang bcas/ /ro gdan la bzhugs rdo rje tho ba 'dzin/ /kun kyang las dang mthun pa'i nyams 'gyur dang / /rgyan dang na bza' kha dog 'od zer 'bar/ /yang na phyogs dang mthun pa'i kha dog bcas/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun gyis bskor bar gyur/ /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid 'khor lo'i rtsibs sam re mig sogs so so la bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar sa khams 'khor lo'i sgo bzhir hriḥ be+e hi hoḥ mtshams bzhir/ oṃ gi dzi e rnams yongs su 638

gyur pa las/ /shar sgor phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can/ /rab khros mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan thod pa 'dzin/ /lho sgor zhi ba mo ni dmar mo ste/ /thod pa lcags kyu kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te 'dzin/ /nub sgor gzhon nu ma ni ser mo ste/ /tri shul ba dan gsum pa gzhu dang mda'/ /byang sgor tsa muṇ+ḍi ni sku mdog nag kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa rnge chung chang snod 'dzin/ /byang shar zur du tshangs ma kha dog dkar/ /'khor lo dang ni thod pa mda' gzhu bsnams/ /shar lhor tshogs kyi dbang mo ljang gu ste/ /rtse gsum thod pa bgrang 'phreng la du 'dzin/ lho nub khyab 'jug ma ni nam mkha'i mdog /'khor lo thod pa zhags pa ral gri 'dzin/ /nub byang mtshams su dbang mo mdangs 'od ser/ /shag ti thod pa sdigs 'dzub zhags pa 'dzin/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ /dbu skra gyen du bajes pa/ /stag lpags kyi na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i byang shar nas brtsams te/ /g.yas bskor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad la/ /ā+o i māṃ yam̐ no ṭ+wāṃ baṃ rku rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'byung por dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog chibs/ /phyag na mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa bsnams/ /shar du sa srung bu la dbang po ser/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa phyag gis 'dzin/ /shar lhor me lha lug la zhon/ /dmar po phyag na me thab 'dzin/ /lho phyogs gshin rje nag po ste/ /ma he'i gdan steng dbyug tho 'dzin/ /lho nub srin po sogs skya ste/ /ral gri 'phyar zhing khyi la chibs/ /chu srin la gnas chu lha dkar/ /zhags pa thogs pa nub phyogs su'o/ /rlung lha dung mdog ba dan 'dzin/ /nub byang ri dwags steng na gnas/ /gter bum steng na lus ngan ser/ /rin po che 'dzin byang du gnas/ de thams cad phyag bzhi'i g.yon gyi dang po thod pa bcud kyi gang ba dang / 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i shar nas g.yas bskor gyi/ sum̐ rtsa me rbu phroṃsum̐ shaṃ ram̐ kau rnams mngon du gyur pa las/ shar du nyi ma dmar ser rta mchog dkar po chibs / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshan pad+ma phyag na bsnams/ /zla ba dkar zla dkyil phyed pas mtshan pa yis/ /ku mud 'dzin pa ngang pa la gnas shar lhor bzhugs/ /lho sgor mig dmar dmar po rwa skyes la gnas shing / /g.yas pas gri thung g.yon pas mi mgo bzung ste za/ /pad gdan la gnas gza' lhag ser po bden bral na/ /mda' gzhu 'gengs shing zhi ba'i 'dra bas gnas pa'o/ /nub sgor phur bu ser skya rlung du pa sangs dkar/ /gnyis ka'ang pad+ma la gnas bgrang 'phreng spyi blugs 'dzin/ /spen pa sngo nag rus sbal la chibs rab tu khros/ /dbyug pa 'phyar zhing khu tshur dkur bstan byang sgor bzhugs/ /dbang ldan zur du sgra gcan dmar nag srin po'i lus/ /sprin gyi gseb nas lus stod phyungs te nyi zla 'dzin/ /de dang lhan cig 'jug ring sngon po sbrul mjug can/ /klu gzugs rab tu khros pa ral gri zhags pa 'dzin/ /de dag 639

kun kyang rang gi khang pa'i steng na bzhugs/ /rgyu skar la sogs gdon gyi tshogs kyi rab tu bskor/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs ldan rang gi dam tshig spyod/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i phyogs bzhir g.yon bskor gyis//bre dzi nyu kai mtshams bzhir me ram̐ ṭ+wāṃ yo yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang por tshangs pa dkar po ni/ /zhal bzhi thod pa bzlas 'phreng dang / /spyi blugs pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nor byin phyogs su khyab 'jug nag /phyag bzhi ral gri 'khor lo dang / /thod pa gang de'i dbyug pa 'dzin/ /gshin rjer drag po du ba'i mdog/mdung rtse gsum pa thod khrag dang / /zhags pa bzlas 'phreng phyag na bsnams/ /chu bdag phyogs su gzhon nu ser/ /gdong pa drug ldan mdung thung dang / /dbyig to thod pa bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /dbang ldan sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma la gnas nor 'dzin ma/ /ser mo gos dkar bum pa dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can/ /byin zar me yi dkyil 'khor la/ /me lce 'bar ba'i steng du ni/ /me yi lha mo me lha mtshungs/ /srin por chu lha'i dkyil 'khor steng / /char sprin la gnas chu lha mo/ /mdog dbyibs phyag mtshan chu lha bzhin/ /g.yo ba'i phyogs su rlung dkyil la/ /'tshub ma rlung ras g.yo bas mtshan/ /der gnas rlung gi lha mo ni/ /phyogs skyongs rlung lha nyid dang mtshungs/ /de'i phyi rol gzhal yas khang gi sgo'i g.yas g.yon la/ yi ge phuḥ yig brgyad las klu chen po brgyad/ sgo'i phyi rol gyi 'khyams la lha ma yin dang / lus srul po la sogs pa'i tshogs dang / phyi rol dur khrod kyi gnas la r+ghaṃ rnams las byung ba'i 'jig rten skyongs ba k+ṣe tra pa la brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa grub par gyur pa ni/ dbang ldan gnas su nag po drag po dkar/ khyu mchog la zhon rtsa gsum thod khrag 'dzin/ /rgan byed ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi skor/ /shar du drag po chen po glang chen zhon/ /ser po rdo rje 'dzin cing gdan gnon phyag /rgyal ba ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi bskor/ /me ru lhas sbyin dbyug gu rtse gsum dang / /ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin mar ra skyes zhon/ /nag mo bzang mo la sogs bzhi yi bskor/ /lho ru nag mo sngon mo ma he zhon/ /lag na dbyug pa dang ni mdung 'dzin cing / /zla ba la sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi skor/ /srin por gcigs byed sngo nag mi ro zhon/ /lag gnyis ral gri dang ni phub chung bsnams//mar me ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi bskor/ /mi sdug kha dog dkar po zhags pa thogs/ /chu srin la zhon nub kyi phyogs su gnas/ /drag mo'i gzugs sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi skor/ /rlung du dga' ba las 'das kha dog nag /ri dwags la zhon lag na ba dan thogs/ /thod 'phreng ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi bskor/ /byang du log 'dren lcags kyu nor dbyug 'dzin/ /ser po gnod sbyin mi yi gzugs can zhon/ /ral gri ma sogs mkha' 'gro bzhi yi bskor/ /zhing skyongs gtso bo brgyad la rang mtshungs yum gyi 'khyud cing / /phyag bzhi'i 'og ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar bas bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ 'khor rnams 640

thams cad rang rang gi gtso bo dang 'dra ba las ral gri ma sogs bzhi dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ma ni ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan dang / /gzhu can ma snying gar 'khyud rgya mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang dur khrod kyi gnas su/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi rang bzhin srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar r+ghaṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang /srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyi bskor ba/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad byon par gyur/ phri/ r+ghaṃ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa/ /dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa yi/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /bden bral tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /bsnyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dab dang lam dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang / /khyad par chu la gnas pa yi/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lhas sbyin mnyam du brten pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang 'jigs byed dang / /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed lha mo u mas bstod/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma ste rnal 'byol ma/ /dbang po dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo/ /bcu gsum dbang phyug ma dang ni/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jig byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs can gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gcigs dang thod chen ma/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ /sprul can ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid che/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbyug gtso bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen te/ /rdul med rnal 'byor bskyod pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad kun nas 'dir spyon cig /oṃ kak+ka rte na bablar+ghaṃ no/ khak+ṣa da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭan ha na ha na/ gha gha gha ta na/ che ge mo sharnyi ku ru r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥ swā hā/ zhes rol 641

mo dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya tri sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃn/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya ho/ badz+ra tri sh+ya sa ma ya phaṭa/ zhes dam tshig gis phyag rgya bstan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shalda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo haṃ/ gtor mgron thams cad pa ste srid gsum 'gro ba 'jig rten las ma 'das pa kun kyang dpal he ru ka'i rnam sprul kho nar nges pa brtan por bzung / /slar yang / oṃ bī ni/ badz+ra ṇi hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin thog mthar oṃ dang badzi ṇi r+ghaṃ rtsu phaṭa/ ces sbyar te/ waṃ se/ mṛ tai gi/ mu ra dze/ ha su la su girti/ nirti/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ rī pe/rū pa/ sparnye/ dharma dhā tu/ bar gyi rig ma bcu drug dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ri sgyeḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin pā ju/ puṣ+pe āḥ hūm̐ nas shardo'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos ba med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes de nyid lnga pas bstod/ spros pa la dga' na lha so so'i bstod pa sbyar na yang legs/ bsdu na mi dgos rang gi lag pa g.yon par a li las zla ba/ g.yas par ka li las nyi ma/ snyim pa kha sbyor gyi dbus su r+ghaṃ sngon po/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharma r+ghaṃ/ o sa rasla ra a nu pra sgyiṣ+ṭa sarba dharma hūṃ/ oṃ at+yā na a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma r+ghaṃ/ lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ pad skor bya zhing / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bde pa de yi lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mgron rnams kyi ljags r+ghaṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ a ral+li hoḥ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki n+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dri bye hoḥ zhes pa lan lnga'am bdun la sogs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul/ bar 'di spro na/ oṃ ḍā ki ni s+t+waṃ phuḥswā hā/ oṃ di bi nī phre su swā hā/ oṃ tsu ṣi ni phre phuḥ swā hā/ oṃ rka bo dza phre phuḥ swā hā/ sngags de bzhi po'i mthar/ /oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sogs sbyor/ 'jig rten pa'i lha zhing skyongs 'byung po rnams la so so'i mtshan sngags sam/ yang na lha so so'i sa bon 'bru drug gi bar du bzhugs pa la gtor sngags btags nas 'bul ba ste/ de yang thog mar zhing skyongs thams cad la lhan cig tu dmigs/ lag pa g.yon gtor 642

snod snying gar 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas sdigs mdzub gtor mar bstan nas se gol gtog cing / oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarba yo gi shwa ri r+ghaṃ rdzu dzaḥ swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun la sogs pas spyir 'bul/ de nas bye brag tu/ oṃ āḥ k+ṣiṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swa hā/ la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa dzaḥswā hā/ zhes btags pas gnas srung zhing skyongs bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad re re tshar gsum mam bsdu na lan res 'bul/ de bzhin/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ṭ+wā hā/ la/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha btags pas gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod na gnas pa'i 'jig rten skyongs ba chen po ste zhing skyong drag po brgyad yum bcas mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis la dmigs te gong ltar rkang thon du 'bul/ de ltar gnas bsrung ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba ste/ zhing skyongs rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags kyi rnam grangs gzhan/ oṃ kak+ka nye na nas swā hā'i bar gong du bshad pa de bka' yang yin gsung bas na sngags de kho nas lha tshogs re rer grangs gong ltar skabs sbyar gyi zhing skyongs rnams la 'bul na yang legs pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nang ma'i sgo mtshams su gnas pa'i ma mo brgyad la 'bul ste/ de yang oṃ āḥ hri r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ la a kā ro btags pa'am/ /oṃ bhak+ṣa sarba mo gī shwa rī rtsu r+ghaṃ dzaḥ
