swā hā/ btags pas phag mo la 'bul/ des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'dre'o/ /oṃ āḥphre hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ hi r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ ho r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ gi ju phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ dzi r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ i hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ma mo gzhan bdun gyi sngags so/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor gnyis par gnas pa'i phyogs skyong rnams la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ i r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ āḥ e r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ saṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ yam̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ rnu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ ṭ+wāṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ baṃ rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ rku r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas dkyil 'khor gsum par gnas pa'i gza' dgu la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ sum̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ rtsa r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥme r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ rbu hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ bṛ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ sum̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ shaṃ rdu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ ram̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ ke r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dkyil 'khor bzhi par gnas pa'i lha chen po la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ bre r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ dzi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ ldu r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ kai hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ lo r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ baṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ yo r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa rnams lu gtor sngags sngar bzhin sbyor la/ lha re re bzhin tshar gsum mam bsdu na lan gcig gis phul ba sngar bzhin bya/ dkyil 'khor phyi sgo g.yas g.yon gyi klu chen po brgyad la sogs par dmigs te/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sa ma ya a dhi pa dhi rdzu r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas 'bul zhing thams cad la thun mong du/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsa/ u da/ a smra ra/ ḍa ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i rma ba lo griṇ+ḍi tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣaskyo ma ma sarba sidhi me pra yats+tshaskyo/ ya 643

the baṃ/ ya theṭaṃ/ buñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gra tha/ mā ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba karba yam̐/ sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha/ ma ma sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ ces lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ g.yas thod pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon ba dan gsum gdengs pa'i phyag rgyas btab cing / oṃ ha ho hriḥ swā hā/ ces lan gsum bzlas pas nang mchod byin rlabs kho na gsos/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ lan mang pos g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs thor 'bul/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs mgron thams cad mnyes par bsam/ spro na/zhabs bsil/ phyag phyis/ sor rtsi sogs kyang 'bul ste/ de'i sngags kyang rim pa bzhin/ oṃ āḥ hri pra wa ra sarka ra hūṃ añtsa ma rna pra tits+tsha swā hā/ oṃ hasta pu tsi ye swā hā/ oṃ tasbu ye swā hā/ zhes pas so de bzhin skabs 'dir cho ga rnam grangs rgyas par mos na/ mchod pa gzhan yang mang du stab/ gang ltar mthar rol mo sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ wī ri shā ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpasni sarnyi bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭoṅka ṭa ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṣ+ṭa kā ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa khā ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha pra bhu dza bha su rā ya r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ sar+sha pā sho bya/ ta kha ṭaṃ ga dha ra ṇi rdzu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā bh+ra dzi rna ba ra dha ra ya rgyu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu mrad+dha kā ra wa su ṣā ya rdu rdzu phaṭa/ yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā ra tī baṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ar+ya a pa ra dzi te/ tre+e lo kya hā te ma hā bibya shwa re r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na moḥ sarba bhu ta yā ba he ma hā badz+re hūṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra a sa ni la dzi te pa sham kā ri rna tra bh+ra ma ṇi rdu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na moḥ sho ṣa ṇi gro dha ka rā li r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na moḥ tra sa ni ma ra ni pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na moḥ bi dza ye sam+bha ni sam+bha ni mo ha ni r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā ti ma hā yo gi kā me shwa ri kha ge r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa ste/ de ltar dpal he ru ka'i rkang brgyad gnyis dang /gong ltar/ de nyid lnga pa la sogs pas bstod/ mai/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs te/ /dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa yi/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dab dang lo dang zhing / /khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /snod dang thang dang sa stong dang / /khyad par chu la gnas pa yi/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lhas sbyin mnyam du brten pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang 'jigs byed dang / /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang / /'jigs byed lha mo u mas bstod/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal nyid dang / /mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma ste rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /drag tu sdong dang 'phyang ba mo/ /bcu gsum dbang phyug ma dang ni/ /'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma/ /'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo'i gzugs can gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gcigs dang thod can ma/ /thod phreng phreng can kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ / 644

sprul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi de nyid che/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa/ /sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal po che/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbyug gtso bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ska chen ste/ /rdul med rnal 'byor bskyed byed ma/ /rdo rje dbang mo 'khor dang bcas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing rnams la/ /rab dges zhing skyongs rig mar bcas/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad 'byung po yi/ /tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang / /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /bden bral tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /bsnyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de las sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gang dag ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub can gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs shing / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /legs par thams cad 'grub gyur cig /nyes pa thams cad med par mdzod/ /zhes 'phrin las bcol/ las so so dang 'brel na de dang de'i las la bskul ba drag tu bya/de nas rdo rje'i glu 'di blangs bar bya ste/ 'gro ba kun gyi mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas gyis/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyi mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ /sham du/ sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin//snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol bar byos/ /a re/ gang gi don dam la ni ma bsgom pas/ /de yi sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin te/ a re/ nang dang phyi'i dbye ba med par gyis/ 'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ zhes bya ba dang / rdu/ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yin/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba la/ /rab tu rmongs pa bsten par byed/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā ra l+li ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ /dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i a a ral+li ho/ /rab rgyas mgon po khyed bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes pa'i 645

bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ a i a a a ralbi ho/ bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /'di yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ /o phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gis lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /lha mo tshad ma sogs/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtogs chags pa bcom /khyod kyi dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' dang ni 'dra bar gzigs/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i chus brlan sems la ni/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces sogs 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun gtso bo'i bzod mdzad rigs/ /zhes pas bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /mthar 'theb 'dzub gnyis bkug ste zlum por byas la/ sor mo gzhan brkyang pa mig gi phyag rgya bstan rjes/ pad bskor dang lte bar 'khyud rgya byas la/ 'theb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs te/ o badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mu/ ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag gi dpral bar thim/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bzhag g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ arma tiṣ+ṭha rgyu swā hā/ zhes brjod ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang dang gnyis su med par bsam pa la yid kyis mchod/oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥ sa sarba dharmaḥ yo ga shurnyo3ho/ rnam lnga 'dod skor bya/ o sarba duṣ+ṭa kṛṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa gats+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par mos/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma lam gyi gzhi mdo sogs su bskul/ thams cad kyi sum+bha drag tu bzlas/ nang du 'ongs nas gtor skyel ba la bsangs chu'am nang mchod kyi gtor/ yon bdag la sogs pa gzhan gyi don du gtor ma btang ba yin na mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang / dpa' bo rnams la bza' 646

dang btung ba khyod kyi drangs/ khyed la rtag tu bsrung ba mchog gi sbyor ba dang / yang na 'di la 'dod pa dang ni phun sum tshogs par shog ces pa sogs brjod/ rang gzhan gyi don gang yin kyang thun mong du/ smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing / dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni/ /sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub myur thob shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur cig /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs bcu gnyis su/ /dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol pa yi/ /bu bzhin skyong bas bdag sgrib dag gyur te/ /bde ba mchog gi sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing / /rdo rje dbang mo'i zhabs brtan gyur nas kyang / /btsun mo'i shu tri'i tshogs la longs spyod cing / /gsang ba'i pad+mar rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i/ /zhal mthong de'i ngo bor bdag gyur te/ /'gro ba bde ba dam pas 'phongs rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang / /bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa/ /'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yis/ /bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang / /yun ring 'gro ba'i don sgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang / /gtso bo sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro ba dbang bskur ba/ /srid gsum rdo rje rol par lhan cig de yis go 'phangs thob par shog /rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag gsal nas ho ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /'khor lo yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong / /sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyi 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'di ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog /ces sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rnams nges par gal che'o/ /de ltar rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsung ba'i zhing skyong gi gtor chog rgyas pa dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas bshad pa'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen po 7rje btsun dam pa sgrol mgon zhabs nas tha dad du mdzad cing / de gnyis dkyil 'khor gcig tu sdud pa'i tshul yang stsal ba las 'dir dkyil 'khor gnyis gcig tu dril ba'i 'don cha rje btsun dam pa'i gsung nyid gzhir bzhag kha 'phang phyung zur rnams nas klag chog mar rang bzo 'bad pas spangs te bgyis pa'o/ /'di la gtor dkyil du nag po sogs kho na bkod pa la 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtor ma zhes bya zhing / zhing skyongs yab yum zhe brgyad bkod pa la gnas srung gi gtor ma zhes bya la/ de gnyis sdom 647

pas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rgyas pa'i zhing skyong gi gtor chog rgyas pa yin gsung ste/ de tshe 'dir yang dkyil 'khor gsum don gyi 'dus pa'am/ gal che dkyil 'khor tha dad la mos na rje btsun dam pa'i gsung nyid du blta ba'am/ cho ga 'di nyid steng nas 'byin 'dor byas pas kyang 'grub pa nyid do/ /'di ni sngags gsar 'gyur rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dgongs 'grel ji bzhin ste/ 'di dang sgros mthun bod sngags rnying pa'i gzhung mkha' 'gro'i gtor chog zhes rgya dkar gyi slob dpon rgyal ba dzñā na su tra dang /bye ma la mu dras mdzad pa'i khyad 'phags zhig kyang snang ngo / de ltar gtor ma'i phan yon tshad med par rgyud dang / man ngag rnams su rgya cher gsungs pas 'di la nan tan du byas na 'dod pa'i dngos grub thun mong dang khyad par ba mtha' dag myur du 'grub par nges so/ /'dir smras pa/ sngags rgyud kun nas rab bsngags shing / /'dod pa'i dngos grub rab ster ba/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bla med pas/ /grub 'dod rnams kyi cis mi brtson/ /gtor chog dngos grub 'dzad med bum pa bzang / /rgyud rgyal bla ma'i bla ma gsang mtha'i lugs/ /'di bkod dge mchis mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun/ /don gnyis phun tshogs bde mchog myur 'grub shog /ces bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi zhing skyong spyi dang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga chen po dngos grub bum bzang bya ba 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bar khams lho tsham dkar nag gi dbus rtag brtan rin chen de'ur drag po lcags spre'u lo la bkod pa/ slar yang dbu ru drang srong srin po ri'i rang byung he ru ka'i gtsug lag khang du me yos rab byung bcu gsum dbyug zla'i tshes bcur rang blos zhus dag grub pa'o/ / 648

༄sto /yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu snyan brgyud zab mo las byung ba rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu gces pa shog dril gong khug ma yod:oṃ badz+ra satwa r+ghaṃḥ bla ma rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal nas: de yi man ngag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bri: de yang rgyas pa ni gzhan du bstan par gyur loḥ 'dir man ngag dum bu rgyun gyi nyams len dril nas bstan par bya yi: de la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum ste: dang po skyabs sems spyi dang mtshungs shing : lan lag bdun pa bcas sngon du 'gro la: khyad par bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro rnams dus 'di nas rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang ma thob bar tu skyabs kyi dam par bla ma dkon mchog bzung bar bya zhing : 'gro rnams sdug bsngal mtsho las sgral phyir he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la 'bad de zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang dus 'di nyid du bdag gis thob par bya snyam pa kha zhe med par bgyid loḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang gi phung khams snod bcud thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa la dar cig blo bzhag: de'i ngang las skad cig gis chu las nya 'phar ba ltar rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rang 'od yum bcas kyi skur gyur par bsam la: de yi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas kun bzang yab yum gyi cha lugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsgom zhing : de la gsol ba btab pas yab yum zag med bde ba'i rgyun sbyor mtshams nas babs rang gi spyi bor zhugs dpral ba yan chod khengs pas bum pa'i dbang gi sbyang thob smin pa thams cad grub: de bzhin mgrin pa yan chad khengs pa gsang dbang ཿོ snying ga yan chad khengs pa sher dbang : lus yongs su khengs pa tshigs dbang ste: rang rang gi sbyang thob smin pa thams cad mngon du gyur zhing :mthar bla ma yab yum zla ba ltar zhu nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med par bsam pa thun mgo thams cad du bya: de nas rang lus drang por srang la rlung ro gsal nas: dbugs rngub pa khong du gnas pa:phyir dbyung ba/ phyi na gnas pa ste/ de cha bzhi ring thung shin du snyoms par bya ste: de yang dang por gshis nas snyom par gyur na legs mod: ma goms na snyoms par mi rgyu ba dang : mi rigs la la rtsa rlung khams kyi rgyu ba shin tu mi snyoms pa yang yod pas de dag rim gyi rnam par sbyang ba las: thog ma nan brtsir gyi snyoms blo byas na gegs kyi tshogs su 'gyur bas spangs shing / des na bum can la ma 649

goms pa rnams thog mar rang so la bzhag nas bags kyi nyugs bsring te bslab pa gnad gal po che yin no: mthar rdor bzlas goms tshe g.yo ba bcud du yun je ring je ring du bslab par bya'o/ /de ltar rlung gi gnad nges par byas la: de nas dbugs nang du rngub dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ye shes kyi dwangs ma yi ge oṃ du gyur: sna bug g.yon gyi sgor zhugs shing rlung khong du gnas pa'i tshe: lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du mi shig pa'i sa bon rlung gi ngo bo dngas ma hūm̐ mthing ka las 'khor 'das las dang ye shes rlung kun 'dus/ dbugs phyir dbyung tshe bde ba mchog gi rang bzhin ā:dmar po 'phros te rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam bskang shing sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs nas bde ba la bkod par bsam: de ltar dbyugs phyi nang 'gyu gnas la rig pa ma yengs pa rtse gcig tu bya zhing rnam rtog gzhan gyi bar mi byed par nyams su blangs/ yang skabs su o āḥ hūṃ gi yi ge gzugs su mi sgom par 'bru gsum rngub par oṃ/ gnas pa rgyu/ phyir dbyung ba ā'i sgra dbyangs la yid gzung nas gong gi dang 'di gnyis gang bde spel bar nyams su len/ yang skabs su bsam gtan gyi tshad 'dzin pa'i phyir dbyung rngub gnas oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ du byas pa la 'phreng rdog re re skyur te rnam rtos/ gi bar chod tshe 'phreng ba slar mgo nas 'dren par byas pas dang po rig pa rnam rtog gi bar ma chod pa bcu dang bco lnga nyer gcig sogs rim bzhin brgya phrag dang mthar stong phrag gi bar du rnam rtog 'phro rgod kyi mi gnod rig pa rjen par gnas par 'gyur/ shin tu goms na nyin mtshan 'khor yug bsam gtan la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /mthun mjug bsdu tshe snang srid thams cad 'od kyi gong bur zhu nas rang la thim/ rang lus skad gcig gi lte ba'i r+ghaṃ la thim pa'am/ yang na me long la has btab pa yal ba bzhin dbyings su yal bar sgom la dar cig mnyam par bzhag de mthar phyogs bzhi nas o āḥ r+ghaṃ ho zhes pa'i sgras skad cig gi rdo rje sems dpa'i skur ldang la bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu mnyam par bzhag /gnyid log skabs snying gar thig le rma bya'i mdangs lta bur bla ma'i sku sgom par yid gtad la gnyid log go/ /sang nyin long ba'i dus la bab tshe sngar ltar nyams su blang ngo / /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ /dus kun tu chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu bden med du shes pa ched gnyer gyi sgom pa med kyang / yengs rkyen 'khrul dbang du nam du yang mi shor bar lha sngags ye shes kyi ngo bor lam khyer dang / khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma'i byin brlabs nyid yin pas bla ma la mos gus dang dam tshig la rab tu brtson zhing rgyu 'bras kyi mdor len mi nor bar bya ba gang byas pa kun rang 'dod kyi khris med par gzhan phan gyi snying po rgyal bstan rin po che'i mched dang 'gro la rtag par snying rje'i rtsis zin par bya ba ni gal shin tu che la/ thun mtshams su kun rdzob don dam dge kun mkha' khyab sems can don du zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa' 650

bdag gi dus 'dir skad cig ma la thob par gyur cig snyam nas bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab par bya'o/ /e ma rab zab mkha' 'gro'i snying gi khrag /zab gnyan snyan rgyud yid bzhin dbang gi chos/ /bla ma'i zhal lung byin rlabs ngan pa can/ /yid ches gsum ldan sangs rgyas bseb lam 'di/ /skal ldan mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /tshe dbang nor bu don dam rnal 'byor des/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam dag pas nyer bkod de/ /snyan rgyud yod med yi ger bkod pa la/ /nongs na rtsa ba gsum la mthol bshags shing / /legs gyur dge bas 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gzhung lam 'dir bzhugs te/ /tshe 'di nyid nas zung 'jug thob pa ra shog /ces snga phyir bskal bzang mang pos bskul ba dang / /khyad par mang yul gung thang mches mkhar gyi 'dul 'dzin gnas brtan chen po theg chen mchog la spyod pa pra ma dhi dharmā kirti shrī bha dra yi gsung gi yang yang bskul bar gnang ba ma cog tsam du lha rigs sngags kyi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu'am ming gzhan du na pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed nges gsang grub pa'i shing rta phyogs las rnam rgyal dbang po'i sde zhes pas mang yul nub ris kun gsal sgang po cher sa bya hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzang bcu gcig thun skabs cha shas gcig tu yongs su skal ldan chos snying nas dran pa dad pa can la byin gyis gzhan la gsang ngo ā+o thi:༄pa /auḍiyānādhabamañdzubadz+rasusādhanadzñānabarardanāmabartatesma/ /༄7ོ/ /o rgyan nas byung ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ o rgyan nas byung ba'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ye shes mchog sbyin zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka bh+yaḥ khyab bdag kun bzang 'od chen 'od gsal ba/ /drwa gcod mun sel mchog gyur mchog gi bdag /sangs rgyas kun yab rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gtso/ /'jam mgon bla mar gus 'dud gus phyag 'tshal/ /o rgyan nas byung rgyud chen las/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gang / /de la snying nas gus pa yis/ /'di ru 'bad de brjod par bya/ /de yang rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob lung nod dam tshig la gnas pa'i bsgrub pa pos 'di ltar nyams su len par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ shrī ho ru ko3ho/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du mi dmar ser/ /'od 651

'phros sbyangs nas bdag nyid he ru ka /mam gyi 'od kyi mdun du bla ma dang / /'jam pa'i rdo rje dkyil 'khor spyan drangs so/ /bla ma yi dam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mched pa kun gyi mchod par bgyi/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha barba dharma su bhā wa shurjo3haṃ/ oṃ ma hā shu sgyu te dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rig me dmar ser/snang las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje r+ghaṃ/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spro bgegs rnams bcom/ bsrung ba drug gi phyogs rnams bcing bar gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa rgyu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ groṇ+ḍa pā ya groṇ+ḍa pā ya r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ oṃ trī gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra bī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ me rnyi ni badzi bha wa bharnya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra phroṃ saṃ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza ra rgyu yo hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na r+ghaṃ khaṃ rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ saṃ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dngos grub gnas/ /dur khrod chen po keng rus dang bam ro/ /skyes bu mdung gi phug dang n+ya kror dpyang / /kha dang 'ug pa lce spyang sgras khyab pa/ /mi bzad 'jigs rung skyi zing yid bsgyur bar/ /rnal 'byor thob rnams dga' bas spyod pa skyongs/ /khor ra khor yug dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro srin po sha za'i tshogs pho mo/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas rdo rje gshin rje che/ /ro langs 'bum phrag du mas kun tu bskor/ /de nas o ḍi ya na rdo rje'i gnas/ /chos dbyings pho brang chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus/ /pad dkar 'dab brgyad zla nyi brtsegs gdan steng / /rang rig me yig snang de yongs gyur pa/ /mchog gi ral gri me mtshan ye shes 'bar/ /'phro 'dus don gnyis rgyal kun gsang gsum bsdus/ /de las bdag nyid bcom ldan gshin rje gshed/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /sku lus rtsa zhal gur gum dar ma'i mdog /g.yas zhal sngo dmar g.yon gnyis ljang dang ser/ /steng zhi rab dkar phud lnga me tog thod/ /mgon po sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod paṇa can/ /gzhan kun cher khros mche brtsigs spyan gsum dmar/ /'jigs 652

dus me ltar skra khams gyen du brjes/ /bcu gnyis phyag ldan g.yon rnams mda' gzhu dang / /pusti thod khrag zhags pa ut+pa la/ /g.yas rnams rdo rje ral gri 'bar ba dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags kyu sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ /gnyis kyi dbang phyug che lpags stod g.yogs 'phyar/ /'jug sel lpags pas sku smad sham thab dkris/ /tshangs pa'i mgo can thod phreng se ral kha/ /lha min mgo bo rnams kyi do shal byas/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i mgo bcad dbu rgyan mdzad/ /'dod dang dga' ma g.yon brkyang zhabs kyi mnan/ /'jigs pa'ang 'jigs byed liṅga gyen du rgyas/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan phyag rgya drug gi spras/ /ye shes rang 'od kun tu 'bar ba'i dbus/ /nyi ma bye ba 'bum gyi gzi 'phrog pa/ /srid gsum bdag po bcas pas blta rtsam yang / /mi bzod che ba'i che mchog sku ru gsal/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bṛṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃ rdu phaṭa/ oṃ greṇ+ḍa pā ya groṇ+ḍi pā ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī mañdzu badz+ra āḥ rgyu me r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa sā hā/ phyi rol chos 'byung mdun zur nas g.yas bskor/ /dbyangs can skra can nye ba'i skra can ma/ /dkar ljang ser mo mdzes sdug sgegs khro'i nyams/ /chags pa'i rnam 'gyur dar gyi smad g.yogs grol/ /mgo phreng me tog rgyan spras g.yas brkyangs kyi/ /seng ge la gnas ral gri thod pa dang / /mda' gzhu lcags kyu zhags pas phyag dkyil brgyan/ /rang 'dod 'khrig dbus gtso la phyogs te bzhugs/ /lha tshogs de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ thugs kar r+ghaṃ sngon po/gtso bo'i lte bar me dmar ser/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros 'og min chos kyi dbyings stug po bkod pa o rgyan rdo rje'i gnas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor be+e oṃ ho te he ku mā ri ka bi musnyi sma ra sma ra pra ti ta na swā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ mchod pas mchod dza r+ghaṃ baṃ ho:rang la thim/ oṃ yo ga shurjo sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3haṃ/ dkyil 'khor gsum 'dres slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas be+e/ oṃ āḥ sgyi ṣiñtsa tu me sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka: a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur nang gi dbang bzhi rdzogs/ gtso 'khor thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' dmar pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang la thim oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī mdzi badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra pā ju pra tīts+tsha swā hā/badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ badz+ra dhuṣ+pe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ badz+ra a lo ke āḥ hūṃ/ badz+ra gadhe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ badz+ra ni we t+ya āḥ r+ghaṃ/zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 653

'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /zhes pas bstod/ bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar ram/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha ho trīḥ byin gyis brlabs la gtso sngags mthar oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ btags pa gsum dang 'khor rnams la re res 'bul/ gsang mchod 'bul ba lha mo rnams dang snyoms par bzhugs par bsam la/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes phyag rgya bcings/ skabs 'dir lha sku la sems mnyam par ji nus su bzhag de rjes bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mdzi badz+ra āḥ rgyu rma rgyu rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dngos grub thams cad byed pa ste gtso bor bzla'o/ /gzhan yang / oṃ badz+ra tikyā ba ra da muḥ swā hā/ sngags dang po'o/ /oṃ ma hā rā ga badz+ra rā ga ya hoḥ sngags gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ āḥ kro hai ka ya man+ta ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ sngags gsum pa'o/ /me/ thugs kyi snying po yi ge gcig pa'o/ / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍi pā ya groṇ+ḍa pā ya rgyu rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ phreng ba'i sngags nyid du don gyis bstan no/ /de rnams ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas dang 'gog bzlas ci nus 'bad do/ /oṃ wāka bā de ni bā tsi me ni yats+tsha swā ra swaste ma hā sho re swā hā/ dbyangs can ma'i'o/ /oṃ bhin da ya ā dzñā he ku mā rī ke swā hā/ skra can ma'i 'o/ /oṃ te he ku mā ri kle sha tshe da ya/ ā dzñā rna sma ra/ pra ti dzñā swā hā/ nye ba'i skra can ma'i 'o/ /de ltar lha mo rnams kyi sngags kyang ci rigs su bzla'o/ /mchog gi ye shes bskyed pa'i rdzogs rim yang ji nus bsgom par bya ste de yang khams gsum rdo rje gsum du dag pa'i phyir lte ba'i pad+mar pad+ma'i snod du rdo rje'i nang bzhin ral gri 'bar ba'i yu ba'i dbus dang rtse mor me dag gi mtshan pa la yid rtse gcig pas srog dang rtsol ba bkag te gzhom med nā da'i rang sgra yi ge'i 'bru gcig rdo rje bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yi mtha' gnyis kyi 'pho ba 'pho med dbu ma'i dbyings bde ba'i thig le chen por thim nas zung 'jug 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du bsgrub pa'i rim pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /thun mtshams 'jug pa na/rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyi snod bcud thams cad sgyu ma ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur pa bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / de yang rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ dbyings der ji gnas mnyam par bzhag slar lha skur ldang / dge ba bsngo/gtor mchog ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ yo las rlung / ā las thod pa phyi dkar nang dmar yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rdzu rgyu i yo khaṃ las sha lnga/ s+t+waṃ lo yo paṃ haṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung 654

g.yos/ me 'bar rdzas khol nyes skyon sbyangs/ steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ r+ghaṃ mtshan dkar po las bdud rtsi bab kha ṭ+wāṃ yang 'od 'dres/ slar yang steng du zla bar hūm̐ āḥ oṃ las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bcud bsdus 'bru gsum zla bar 'dus/ de yang bdud rtsir thim 'dod dgu'i sprin mdzad med rgya mtshor gyur/oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho hrīḥ be+e/ oṃ ho he he ku ma ri ka bi mut+ta sma ra sma ra pra ti ta na swā hā/ thugs kyi rdo rje dmar pos dbu brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ srid po dang sha za dang / zhing skyong ba rnams dang /rdo rje gshin rje ro langs 'bum phrag bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas shing srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po ma lus pas bskor ba skad cig gis spyan drangs/ mdun du bzhugs par gyur pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ lha rnams kyi ljags rtsu las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas gtor ma'i bcud rnams gsol te dgyes shing tshim par bsam la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha rdu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bṛṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ groṇ+ḍi pā ya groṇ+ḍi pā ya r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mañdzu badz+ra i rda ba ling groṇ+ḍa skṛhā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya rak+ṣa ho/ zhes pas ye shes 'khor lo rnams la dang / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣas bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsa/un+ma da a sasma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i me bha lin groṇ+ḍaskyo/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra ts+tshaskyo su hā/ces pas 'byung po spyi la ste de ltar lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun sogs kyi 'bul lo/ /yang ar+ghaṃ nas shaba'i bar gyi nyer spyod dang / 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul 'dud nyi shu'i bstod/ oṃ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sogs kun 'grub shog yig brgyas bzod par gsol/ 'dod don gsol ba btab bkra shis brjod/ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa rang gnas su gshegs su gsol bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas btab so/ /gzhan yang mchod pa/ phyag bskor/kha zas/ spyod lam/ nyal ldang gi rnal 'byor la yang spyi ltar bslab par bya'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dpa' bo yi/ /dbang phyug tshul du bla med rgyud/ /o rgyan nas byung mchog bsgrub che/ /'di la ngo mtshar cir yang thob/ /byin rlabs nus mthu dpag med gzhung gang der/ /dwangs ba'i yid kyi bsgrub tshul brjod 'di la/ /nyes mchis bshags so dge ba'i dbugs dbyung stsol/ /bsod nams 'gro kun 'jam dpal 'grub phyir bsngo/ /ces pa o rgyan nas byung ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rje btsun tā ra nā thas rgya dpe nas gsar du bsgyur ba'i gzhung las bod du byas pa'i sgrub thabs ye nas med pas ye shes pa'i stobs kyi yi dam lha la gsol ba btab te byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba thob nas rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos nyes skyon zad pa zad byed kyi lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang por gangs can sa yi thig le dbu ru skyid smad lung rig smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug bye ba'i 'byung khung 655

dpal gsang phu ne'u thog phag ma brtsod rgyal ma'i drung du grub par sbyar ba dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga 7sku/༄gi / dpal rta mgrin gyi gsang sgrub rgyun khyer yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku rdo rje chos/ /dpal chen rta mchog rol par phyag byas nas/ /de bsgrub snying po rgyun khyer 'di bshad kyi/ /'gro kun dga' bde mchog 'phel rgyu ru shog /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub par shog /oṃ su bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bha wa shurnyo3haṃ/ stong ngang pad nya'i gdan la rang rig pa/ /trī dmar yongs gyur khro rgyal rta mchog dmar/ /zhal gsum g.yas ljang g.yon dkar dbus dmar khros/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche rtsigs spyan dgu 'khyil/ /sma tshom smin skra rgod ma'i me ltar 'bar/ /dbu steng mngon 'phags rta mgo ljang nag gsum/ /skad 'tsher rngog gseb me ltar dmyal khams nas/ /tshangs gnas bar khyab me yi dra gur 'khrigs/ /phyag drug sdig mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags g.yon/ /rdo rje mdung rtse gsum pa ral gri g.yas/ /zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum klu brgyad sbrul bzung brdzis/ /thod rlon lnga cu'i do shal thod skam lngas/ /dbu rgyan rus 'phreng drug spras sbrul chun bcings/ /thal zhag khrag byug glang stag mi lpags gsol/ /mgrin pa nas tsam zhabs kyi long bu'i bar/ /rang 'dra'i khro chung khrab byang lta bu'i gtam/ /'jigs dus me 'dra'i dbus su rdo rje ltar/ /brtan bzhugs dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ/ /snying dbus nyi ma la gnas yi ge trīḥ phyi nang me dpung sprul pa'i pho nyas khyab/ /oṃ trīḥ pad+ma ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gro wa hu lu hu lu r+ghaṃ phaṭa: ces ci nus su bzlas/ mjug tu snying po'i mthar/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sā mā ya dza/khaṃ rak+ṣa sā mā ya bh+yoḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya bzlogaḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya btubasaḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya byeraḥkhaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbadaḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbudaḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbad rbud phaṭa/ ya 'byung po mā ra ya dza dzaḥ zhes btags pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥ tig nan dza dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ zhes btang pa yang lan lnga tsam bzla'o/ /mjug tu lha sku rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ a mṛ tas 656

bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dgra bgegs thams cad bkug rdo rje khro bo rnams kyi tshar bcad pa'i sha khrag gi phung po gtor ma dang gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ rdo rje khro bo rnams la snying po'i mthar i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ bhuñdza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa to sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul/ oṃ ha ya gri wa sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shari'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod phul/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung / /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hrī las dbang chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs 'phrin las bcol yig brgyas bshags/ badz+ra muḥ rdo rje khro bo rnams rang gi snying kar thim/ bsngo smon bkra shis sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /rdo rje khro bo rta mchog rol pa yi/ sgrub thabs khyer bde snying po 'di bkod mthus/ 'gro kun nyer 'tshe kun zhi dga' ston rgyas/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i go 'phang myur thob shog /zhes don gnyer can mang pos snga phyir yang yang bskul zhing nyams len snying po la phan par mthong bas rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus skyes bdag gi lo khrums zla'i tshes bcur shangs rgya mtsho phug rdzongs du bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /༄ga /dpal rta mgrin nag po'i lam khyer snying po bzhugs so/ /oṃ ṭ+wā bhā shurnyo sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyo at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /kun snang sgyur 'phrul rig rtsal sa bon trīḥ 'gag med cho 'phrul 'byung rim ye shes mkha'/ /klong du bskal me rdo rje'i gur khang khrigs/ /ral gri 'khor lo mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub/ /dur khrod ches bskor dbus su gzhal yas khang / /gnam lcags las grub 'jigs rung me 'bar ba'i/ /lte bar gru gsum e klong rgyal bsen dang / /gza' bdud byad ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng / /pad nyi 'bar steng rang rig trīḥ nag po/ /skad cig ral gri hriḥ mtshan de las 'do/ /'phros 'dus don gnyis byas te ral gri hriḥ skad cig gnas gyur bdag nyid rta mgrin nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mi sdug gnod sbyin cher/ /khros gzugs phyag g.yas ral gri rdo rje yi/ /yu ba byas pa me 'bar mkha' la 'phyar/ /gnod byed dregs pa'i srog dbugs dum bur bstub/ /g.yon na lcags kyu zhags pas dgra bgegs kyi/ /snying nas 'dren zhing lus stobs 'chings bar byed/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs dregs pa'i snying khar rdzis/ /dar 657

nag ber chen rdo rje'i ris can gsoldo/ /mi lpags stod g.yogs stag gi sham thab dang / /brgya phyed mgo phreng thod skam lngas dbu brgyan/ /klu brgyad sbrul rgyan rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / /lcags kyi ral phyed thor tshugs bcings pa'i bseb/ /rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma me ru 'bar/ /de yi spyi gtsug rigs bdag pad+ma 'byung / /tshe dpag cha lugs mtsho rgyal yum dang 'khril/ /lcags kyi ral phyed thur 'phyang rting sor sleb/ /de las khro chung mang po skar ltar 'khrugs/ /ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar klong gsal/ /gnas gsum oṃ āḥ hūṃ mtshan de las 'od/ /'phros pas dur khrod me rlung 'khrugs pa nas/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med thim/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /che ba'i yon tan rdzogs par rab tu bstod/ /rang nyid rta mgrin thugs kar pad nyi'i steng / /pad 'byung smug nag ral gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /thugs klong nyi steng ral gri gyen lang rtser/ /yi ge trīḥ sa mtshan mtha' mar sngags 'phreng 'khor/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus/ /dgra bgegs tshar bcad rang nyid mthu byin gzi/ /rgyas par bsam la gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /oṃ trīḥ badz+ra gro ta ha ya gyi wa hūṃ phaṭa:zhes pa grangs bsnyen bye ba rtags dang sbyar/ /thun mtshams 'dzab bstod dbang dang dngos grub blangs/ /rjes su dge ba 'gror bsngo dmigs med bzhag /de ltar rta mgrin nag po'i rgyun khyer 'di/ /mi bsrun dregs pas snyigs dus 'gro ba la/ /gnod pa skyobs phyir bskul ngo ma bcog par/ /mdo khams kaḥthog drag po'i khyon skyes pa'i/ /sngags 'chang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /gnas mchog rgyal gyi ku su ma'i tshal du/ /dus tshes bzang por bkod pa'i yi ge'i ris/ /ma ti in+d+ras bgyis pa dge legs shog /sarba maṅga lo/༄ga /dpal rta mgrin nag po'i nyams len rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ /na mo rgyu/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro don byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /stong dang skad cig rang rig trīḥ yongs gyur pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /bdag nyid dpal chen rta mgrin sku/ /mthing nag lcags kyi ral pa can/ /spyi gtsug rta zhal ljang gu 'tsher/ /phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon sdigs 'dzub/ /lcags kyu 'dzin zhing lcags sdig 'phro/ /sku la dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs bdud bzhi brdzis/ /rdo rje'i gur khang dbus na bzhugs/ /ye shes me dpung tshang tshing 'bar/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstem/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 658

mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bstod/ /nyes skyon gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags/ /rang gi snying gar ye shes sems/ /rang 'dra gcer bu mtshon gang pa/ /thugs dkyil ral gri nas 'bras tsam/ /r+ghaṃ mtshan mtha' mar sngags 'phreng bskor/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus dgra bgegs bsgral/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'phrin las bsdus/ /dpal chen dngos grub kun thob bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gyi wa r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ thun mthar snang srid 'od du zhu/ /rang thim rang nyid ye shes sems/ /de yang ting 'dzin sems dpa' ste/ /mthar ni dmigs med 'ja' ltar yal/ /ci gnas 'di du mnyam par bzhag slar yang skad cig lhar ldang nas/ /thun mtshams bya ba rnams bgyid cing / /dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo bar bya/ /zhes mang yul skyid grod 'phags pa wa ti yi rim gro sa shākya'i dge tshul ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi bskul ngor/ /rta mchog dpal gyi man ngag khyer bde rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu spel ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis/maṅga lo/ /

༄ga /gu ru pad+ma'i nā ga bdud 'dul dang ras chung pa'i gtum chung me 'bar ru grags pa chu bo gcig 'dril zab ces gsang ba'i nyams len snying gi dum bu bzhugs so/ /na mo badz+ra dhā ra ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum dbang bsgyur mdzad/ /yid la dran pas bgegs tshogs mtha' dag nyams/ /dngos grub mchog stsol lhag pa'i lha de la/ /phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs snying po 'dir bkod bya/ /dpal gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi snying por gyur pa sngags rnying ma lugs kyi phyag rdor nang bsgrubs sam/ sngags gsar mar gtum chung me 'bar tu rim pa byin brlab rjes gnang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su len pa nyid la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bhāwa at+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun stong zhing / /stong pa'i ngang las sngags kyi sgra/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ de las skad cig rang rig pa/ /rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu khros/ /spyan gsum sdang mig mche ba gcigs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga por/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub bgegs la gzir/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /g.yon bskyang stabs bzhugs sbrul nag brgyan/ /smug nag khyung gi ba spu yi/ /bu ga kun bltams me klong bzhugs/ /'jig rten dregs pa smos ci dgos/ /ye shes lha kun zil mnon pa/ /dam ye dbyer med spyi bo ru/ /bla ma mi bskyod pa yis brgyan/ /dpral mgrin thugs kar oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ /thugs dbus nyi mar hūṃ mthing nag /de las me 'bar lus kyi nang / /g.yas bskor gyis gang sdig sgribs bsregs/ /phyi yi me dang 'dres pa yi/ /dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing / /r+ghaṃ gi 'od zer las grub pa'i/ /gzhal yas rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu bya'o/ /de nas phyag g.yon gyi sdigs mdzub kyi rtser khyung nag sbrul nag po thogs pa bsgom la/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭaḥ gong gi sngags bsham du btags la 'bum phrag gsum bzla'o/ /de nas snod bcud thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom zhing / me dang / bya khyung nam mkha' gang bar spros te gong gi sngags sham bu can la/ hūṃ phaṭa ṣa ṇa ro ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru de ba then byung sa ga na ga'i snying la gzir/gnod byed 'byung po thum ri li li rbad/ ces pa btags la bzla'o/ /de rnams kyi bsnyen bsgrub legs par song nas las sbyor thams cad sgrub tu rung / /thun mtshams thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral 660

bar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ i rda bā lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyi phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtum po khyung chen 'khor bcas kyi/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol ba spyi dang mthun no/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rdo rje mchog /lag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /bris pa'i dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can de 'grub gyur cig /zhes rgyud kyi rgyal po nā ga bdud 'dul nas gsungs pa yi gtum po'i nang bsgrub dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po nyi ma khrag skoms nas gsungs pa'i ras chung pa'i thugs dam snying po gtum chung me 'bar du grags pa lha sngags gnad gcig tu babs cing rgyun yang ma chad pa legs par nos pa yi rang gzhan gyi nyams len rgyur rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i chu sprel sa ga zla ba dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum par gu ru'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen mnga' ri mang yul mtshams su bkod pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/༄ga /dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i bsnyen bskub bhing po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal kun gsang gsum mnga' bdag thugs kyi dngos/ /bdud bzhi dpung 'joms lha yi lha/ /dpal chen che mchog lag na rdo rje yis/ /sgrub thabs ngag 'don snying po 'dir spel bya/ /de yang dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur thob cing gsang ba'i bdag po'i byin rlabs nod pa de yi dam tshig la nye bar gnas pas nyams su len pa ni/ ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /sangs rgyas la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la yang mi phyed dad/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid thob par shog /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ chos dbyings 'od rgasal gdod nas rnam par dag oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rgyu/nam mkha'i dbus su pha lam gser 'khor lo/ /rtsibs bcu'i lte bar rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / /rdo rje'i rwa gur dra ba bla re'i dbus/ /paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la rgyu/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru'i steng / /nyi ma'i 661

dkyil 'khor 'od zer phyogs bcur 'bar/ /de steng rgyal kun ye shes rang rig pa/ /rab tsher r+ghaṃ mthing 'od 'phros rgyal ba mchod/ /sems can sgrib sbyangs tshur 'dus r+ghaṃ la thim/ /de nyid yongs gyur bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje 'chang chen rin chen mthon mthing mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum drag shul can/ /spyan gsum zlum po dmar ser me 'od 'phro/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche bzhi tshems phreng rno/ /dbu skra bskal pa'i me 'dra gyen du 'bar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu mkha' la sor/ /phyag g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub zhags pa 'dzin/ /sdig mdzub rtse dang ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /sprul pa'i khyung chen khra thabs tsha tsha 'phro/ /thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyang / /rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag lpags sham thab dkris/ /klu brgyad sbrul bzung glog lce nor bu'i gtsug /dbu rgyan phyag zhabs sogs pag se ral mdzes/ /ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bdud bzhi dregs tshogs brdzis/ /las dang ye shes khro ba mtha' dag pa/ /dbang bsdud zil gyi mnon pa'i sku ru gsal/ /phyi rim 'dab brgyad steng du rang 'dra ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin brgyad nang gzigs bsrung 'khor mdzad/ /phyi rol rtsibs bcu bdud 'dul khro bo bcu/ /phyir gzigs gnod byed bzlog dang bsad par mdzad/ /kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ gis mtshan/ /me 'bar dur khrod sogs nas rgyal ba kun/ /gsang bdag rnam par spyan drangs bdag la thim/ /bdag ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dus spyi dpal/ /zla med khro bo yongs kyi rgyal po che/ /dregs pa kun 'dul stobs ldan nag por gsal/ /snying khar rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa'i/ /lte bar nyi steng hūṃ yig mthing nag mthar/ /sngags 'phreng gyen lang nang lta me 'od 'phro/ /rgyal kun thugs bcud 'dus pa'i sngags su gsal/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba mchod/ /bdag sogs sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sngags kyi me 'od phyi nang kun tu 'khyil/ /bsrung bzlog bsad sogs las kun byed par bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭaḥ gtso bo'i sngags 'phreng r+ghaṃ la sems gtad cing / /'od zer spro bsdu skabs su ci 'dod bya/ /rjes su snod nang mtha' dag 'og min zhing / /srid bcud sems can rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku/ /kun kyang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ /rang nyid yas mas snying ga'i rdo rjer thim/ /rdo rje nyi ma sngags 'phreng phroṃ la thim/ /r+ghaṃ nyid na da na da stong par yal/ /chos kun rtog med rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /stong pa chen po'i ngang du ci gnas bzhag /slar yang sngags kyi rang sgras skad cig mar/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku ru gyur/ /dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /gsang ba'i bdag po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /de ltar rgyun du nyams su len na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par nges so de 662

skad rgyud don bla ma'i man ngag bcud/ zab dril dpe khyud med par bkod pa yis/ /dge ba ci mchis mkha' mnyam 'gro bar bsngo/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin dbang myur thob shog /ces pa yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rang gi nyams len dang mthun par gsal dag 'dus pa'i ngag gi mig dmar shing byi sbo yi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i thun bar gcig tu gu ru'i sgrub gnas ljon pa klung du bris pa dge'o/ /'di ni man ngag ma sbas gsal bar bstan pa yin pas nyams su lon nges pa 'di'i lung thob pa las dpe 'khyab brdal du mi bya'o/ /sarba kal+ya wadhertse swā hā/༄ga /dpal gsang bdag bsnyen pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor byin rlabs 'od 'bar bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal//dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro don byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gi /me dpung rdo rje'i gur khang dbus/ /pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng / /r+ghaṃ las rang nyid phyag rdo mthing / /khro gtum zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ //rus rgyan dur khrod chas kyi spras/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje me 'bar 'phyar/ /gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po gzhom/ /g.yon pas me yi zhags pa yis ma rung dregs pa 'ching bar byed/ /khro tshul dgu rdzogs me klong 'gying / /spyi bo phrag pa g.yas g.yon na/ /khyung chen dkar dmar nag po lding / /klu gnyan thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan/ /'od 'phros lcang lo can gnas nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs rang nyid dang / /gnyis med brtan bzhugs dgyes par gyur/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng / /rang 'dra'i rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /rgyan med gcer bu mtshon gang pa'i/ /thugs kar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam/ /lte bar hūṃ mthar sngags 'phreng ba/ /bklag thabs 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal mchod dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgral/ /tshur 'dus dpal gyi dngos grub brnyes/ /rtse gcig lha sku'i nga rgyal dang / /thugs ka'i hūṃ la sems gtad bzla/ /oṃ āḥ rgyu pā ṇi rgyu phaṭaḥ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ mthar ni 'od gsal ngang bsdu zhing / /slar yang skad cig lha skur ldang / /thun mtshams dge ba 'gro la bsngo/ /lam khyer gsum la rtag tu spyad/ /de skad mnga' ris gung thang chos rgyal gyi/ /blon brgyud sman khab stod kyi dpon sras ni/ /blo gsal gus ldan tshe brtan lha skyabs kyis/ /gsol ba btab ngor rgyal ba pad 'byung gi /pho nyar rlom pa rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa/ /tshe dbang nor bus bag yod gro zhun gyi/ /dkar phyogs tshes bcur skye re rig gnas lding / /smras pa'i yig ris bkra shis rab brtan no/ /dge'o/ / 663

༄ga /rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs snying gi dum bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /oṃ swāsnyi/ ji srid snying po byang chub bar/ /sangs rgyas la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la yang mi phyed dad/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /o shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ 'di ltar 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /stong zhing bdag med spros bral bde ba che/ /bsam brjod dmigs bcas blo yi yul las 'das/ /gdod nas rnam dag rang bzhin 'od gsal ngang / /skad cig rang rig ngo bo phe yig nag /de las 'od zer mthing nag rab 'phros pas/ /sangs rgyas kun mchod sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus rgyal kun byin brlabs phe la thim/ /phe rak+ṣa ku ru byu/ phyogs kun dug gi rgya mtsho 'khol ba'i klong / /thams cad sbrul las byas pa'i gzhal yas khang / /sna tshogs rin po che yi mdzes pa'i dbus/ /sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen bcal du bkram/ /'byung po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi khar/ /pad+ma nyi ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /phe yig yongs gyur 'chi bdag gshin rje gshed/ /rig pa'i rgyal po dmar nag khrag rul mdog /mi srun gshin rje drag tu khros pa'i gdong / /spyan gsum sdang mig khrag gi mtsho ltar 'khol/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba zang yag gcigs/ /shangs nas bskal pa 'jigs pa'i 'thor rlung 'phyo/ /snyan nas stong gsum 'ching ba'i dud sprin 'thul/ /zhal nas tsha grang 'khrug pa'i dug rlangs 'phyo/ /'jigs dus me ltar dbu skra dmar ser 'bar/ /shin tu mi bzad sbrul gyi gdeng ka dgu/ /'jigs pa'i zhal gdangs mche gcigs glog lce spyod/ /phyogs mtshams kun gzigs zhal nas ig sha sgrogs/ /dbus mar rin po che yi srog zhu bcings/ /bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje 'chang gis brgyan/ /ral pa'i gseb nas khyung chen skar ltar 'khrug /spu gseb sdom sdig sbal sbrul char ltar 'bebs/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang mdor stabs bsgrad/ /sbrul mjug sngon dmar dug rgya mtshor 'khyi pa/ /bcu drug g.yas kyi phyag brgyad gri gug gdengs/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi mgo snying dum bur btub/ /g.yon gyi phyag brgyad sbrul zhags nad rkyal gyi/ /dgra bgegs mching zhing mdze nad bco brgyad 'bebs/ /che ba'i klu brgyad sku yi rgyan du byas/ /rus sbal khog sbub sbrul lpags na bzar gsol/ /dug gi me rlung 'jigs dus bzhin 664

'khrigs dbus/ /rgyab yol ri rab lhun por mdzad de bzhugs/ /dpral bar o las bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal/ /gser mdog phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dzin/ /mgrin par āḥ las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dmar po phyag na pad+ma'i dbyug tho bsnams/ /thugs kar r+ghaṃ las dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu gsor/ /kun kyang spyan gsum phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /nyi gdan la bzhugs rin chen rus rgyan spras/ /rig rgyal snying dbus nyi mar gha ru ḍa/ /gser mdog brkyang bskum sbrul zhags nad skyal 'dzin/ /de yi snying dbus pha lam rdo rje yi/ /lte bar phe yig mtha' mar sngags 'phreng 'khor/ /gnas gsum 'od kyi de bzhin gshegs kun gyis/ /sku gsung thugs byin ma lus gcig bsdus thim/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra su bha wa at+ma kolhahaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ o sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ zhes sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ r+ghaṃ oṃ swā e hāḥ zhes rigs lngas dbang bskur/ oṃ nā ga rā dza e h+ye hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃḥ dzaḥ rtsu baṃ ho/ nā ga rā dza e a ra li hri hri dzaḥ zhes ye shes spyan drangs/ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a la la hoḥ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha r+ghaṃḥ badz+ra sbo ṭa baṃḥ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ zhes dam tshig la bstem/ a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo keghasne/ ne+e wi bya/ shab āḥ r+ghaṃ/ zhes mchod/ rtsa sngags la sman rag gtor sngags spel ba nang mchod ma hā badz+ra yo gi ni a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ ma tri ru tra pra bhañtsakra r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ r+ghaṃ/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas nas byung ba sbyin der 'dud/ /klu gnyen sa bdag dregs pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa la gsal btab la/ oṃ be+e lo r+ghaṃ/ zhes zhi sngags dang / nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+ka oṃ phe lo r+ghaṃ: zhes pa'am/ oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+ṣa tsakra phe lo hūṃ phaṭa: zhes drag po'i sngags te rang bzhin du ji nus dang / gzhan sgang shong 'then gsum gyi man ngag dang ldan par bzla'o/ /thun bsdu na snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su bcil zhing / slar yang sgyu ma bzhin sngar ltar ldang / dge ba bsngo/ smon lam btab/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma sbal sbrul nya sha chang gis brgyan pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ āḥ las gtor snod ka pā la yi nang / /oṃ las gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /r+ghaṃ gi ye shes bdud rtsi bkug cing bstem/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi dang 'dres ha haḥ trīḥ 'dod yon nam mkha'i khams kun khengs par gyur/ /badz+ra sa ma'i dzaḥ zhes 665

pas gtor mgron mdun du bkug snying po'i mthar/ i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khy-i hiḥ btags pa gsum mam bdun sogs kyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shaba'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rgyu/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams shed na: rgya mtsho chen po'i klong yangs dngas pa'i klong : bskal pa'i sbrul nag 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig pa'i rgyal po klu bdud mgo dgu pa: bdud kyi bdud gcig 'chi bdag klu yi bdud: sku ni ri rab ngos la rten: mjug ma rgya mtsho'i gting du 'khyil: dbu ni bar snang khams su 'phyo: zhal nas gdug pa'i sgra skad ni: 'jigs pa ig sha'i sgra yang sgrog: sbrul nag ral pa sprul pa las: sdom dang sdig pa'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: spyan ni drag po hur thum gzigs: mche ba rno dbal dmar nag gtams: klu gnyan sa bdag gdug pa can: ba su rigs drug zas su za: rgyal rigs mgur chu do shal byas: bram ze'i rigs kyi phyag gdub byasoḥ dmangs rigs klu tshogs skyed la dkris/ /rigs ngan gdug pa zhabs 'og gnon: gdug pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan rnams: skad cig tsam la brlag par mdzad: 'jam dpal thugs las sprul pa yi: klu bdud nag po khyod la bstod:ces pas bstod pa'i mthar/ rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun stsol zhing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces gtor ma btab cing 'phrin las bcol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ bkra shis bsngo smon bya'o/ /bsnyen bsgrub skabs su rang ngam mthun pa'i grogs kyis chu gtor klu gtor btang ba yang nges par dgos/ rig pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs 'di ni 'chi bdag srog gi 'khor lo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba/ bka' gter du ma mthun par 'byung bzhin gzhir bzhag man ngag snyan brgyud 'ga' yang da ni chad par nyi na lhag bsam bzang pos ji rigs pa gsal bar byas bkod pa yin no/ /rig rgyal nā gā rak+ka yi/ /sgrub thabs rno la tshan che ba/ /snying gi dum bu ji 'dra ba/ /man ngag dkon nor lhug par spel/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /lus can ma rig nad las grol/ /rang rig 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sku/ /myur ba nyid du thob gyur cig /ces pa yang rab byung bcu gsum me yos gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs bzang po gsum pa la bod yul gangs ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje gdan lha gdan 666

gtsug lag khang chen po'i 'dabs rgyal po'i pho brang du sa yi dbang phyug gnam bskos chos rgyal mchog gi dgongs bzhed bskang slad yi ger rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i bkod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/༄sto /rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs khyer bde bzhugs/oṃ swāste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog/o ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+ma kophohaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las rang sems phe mthing nag /phe yig grangs med 'phro 'dus yongs gyur pa/ /phe rak+ṣa ku ru r+ghaṃḥ rin chen bkram pa'i rgya mtshor sbrul rigs kyi/ /gzhal yas khang dbus sa bdag klu gnyan steng / /rang nyid rig rgyal nā ga rak+ka nag /dbu dgu srin po lta bur ches cher khros/ /sbrul mgo dgu yi gdeng ka dbus ma la/ /rin chen prog zhu mi bskyod rgyal bas brgyan/ /phyag rgya bcu drug g.yas brgyad ral gri dang / /g.yon brgyad sbrul zhags zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i steng du 'khyil/ /ri rab lhun por rgyab yol tshul du mdzad/ /dbu skra'i gseb nas gdug pa'i srog chags 'gyed/ /ig sha'i sgra sgrogs me dpu nga klong du bzhugs/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum rdo rje gsum rang bzhin/ /snying dbus mkha' lding gser gyi kha dog can/ /de yi snying khar pad steng rdo rje'i lter/ /phe la sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ /o phe lo r+ghaṃ/ nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+ka oṃ phe lo rdu: zhes man ngag dang ldan par bzla'o: thun mtshams su dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo zhing / dmigs med du bzhag zhes rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ka yi rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu khyer bde bar byas pa 'di yang gtsang ru lag gi cha/ srad rin chen rtse'i skyed mo'i tshal du rab smyos snron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gang ba la rig pa 'dzin pas sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ /༄ga /dus 'khor ye shes khyung khra rgyud lugs man ngag rgyun khyer ngag 'don snying po bzhugs so/ /swāste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi chos rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 667

bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dbus/ /pad+ma zla nyi brtsegs par k+ṣiṃ/ kha dog lnga pa 'od zhu bas/ /rang nyid mkha' lding mgon po ni/ /lha zhal spyan gsum 'dabs chags mchu/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu brgyan zhing / /phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /sen mo lcags kyu ltar rno ba/ /rkang mthil dpyi bar gser gyi mdog /de nas lte ba'i bar dkar zhing / /de bzhin mgrin pa'i bar dmar po/ /de nas smin bar bung ba'i mdog /de yan kha dog ljang khur gnas/ /gshog pa mdog lnga 'od zer 'phro /klu rgyal rgyal ba ljang khu dang / /rnam rgyal ljang khu'i dbu skra bcings/ /rna cha stobs rgyu pad+ma nag /phyag gdub nor rgyas dung skyong dmar/ /zhabs gdub 'jog po pad chen ser/ /mgul sked mtha' yas rigs ldan dkar/ /de yi lte snying mgrin dpral gtsug /sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil/ /li u ṛ i a yi mtshan/ /thugs kar nyi steng sa bon k+ṣi/ /mtha' mar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor/ /dngos grub thogs med 'grub par bsam/ /oṃ pak+ṣi swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar dge ba bsngo/ de ltar lha yi snyems pa dang ma bral bar bye ba bzlas na rgyud nas ji skad bshad pa'i las 'grub bo/ /zhes pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'dab chags mgon po'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer snying po 'di yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus lcags mo bya yi lo nag zla'i dmar phyogs dga' ba gnyis par klong yul rtag brtan gyi gtsug lag khang du smras pa sarba maṅga lo/༄gi /tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swāste/ tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa r+ghaṃ/ bdag nyid skad cig gi chu la nya ldang ba lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru gyur/ yi ge drug pa ci nus bzlas/ ram̐ yo khaṃ/ tshogs rdzas ma dag pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ ha ho trīḥ swa hā/ tshogs rdzas thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sirnyi pā la r+ghaṃ āḥs pa ri wa ra badz+ra sā mā yā dza zhes pas tshogs mgron dkon mchog rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs ma lus lus pa med pa spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ phyag 'tshal/ de nas tshogs spung la sngags 668

rer bdud rtsi re bran zhing / rtsa gsum spyi dril gyi snying po'i mthar/ sa pa ri wa ra bh+raḥ gha na tsakra puts+tsha kha kha khy-i hi k+ṣ-i hi/ de la mang nyung ji bdar 'os pa dang / de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ āḥ la gong gi tshogs sngags btang te stong phrag lnga ma song gi bar nan tan du 'bul/ mthar yi ge brgya pa la tshogs sngags bh+yoḥdang / gha yi mtshams su nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brgya spel la tshar gang nus cig 'bul/ de rjes oṃ āḥ rgyu/ bla ma rgya mtsho sogs gnam phud spyi ltar 'bul/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che zhes sogs kyi bstod/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi/ sogs kyi bshags/ 'dir ni chos rnams dang / bde gshegs chos la sogs kyi rnal 'byor pho mo rnams tshogs rdzas rnams nang gi lha tshogs kyi 'khor du rol/ de rjes lhag ma/ ram̐ yo khaṃ dang oṃ ha ho hri sogs 'bru drug gi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ a ra li ho sogs kyi yar lhag phu pa/ oṃ kha kha khā hikhā hi sogs lhag ma bar pa dang / oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes par mar lhag btang / de nas nong pa bshags/ tshogs mgron ye shes pa badz+ra muḥ rang gi dpral bar bstem/ 'jig rten pa/ sarba lo ka gats+tshas gshegs su gsol dang / bsngo smon dang bkra shis spyi ltar mang kyin bzang bas rgya cher bya'o/ /de skad sngags bdag ral gcig mas/bdag nyid ngan 'gro las bzlog phyir/ bka' stsal thos pa'i mos nyid du/ /tshogs 'bum bsags pa'i thabs 'di bris/ /nyams snang ji ltar byung bzhin las/ /mi chos rdzun gyi 'dres srid na/ /de la bka' chad drag po phob/ /rdzun med smra la dge legs stsol/ /bdag 'dra sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /rgan yang dam tshig phra ba'i gnad/ /ma shes snying nas skyo ba skyes/ /slad nas de ltar ma gyur cig /ces grwa phra chos gling gi dgon par rab byung bcu gsum pas 'brug gi lor bshol 'don chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur/ shin tu dang / rab tu spros med kyi dbang gong ma gnyis bskur ba'i bar skabs 'phros su ngos nas rje nub dgon pa chen po rig 'dzin dbang rgyal zhabs la gsang ba snying thig gi dbang bskur las khrid rgyun ma thos gshis des na rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rjes mthun gyi yul gnyen po nyid las gtso khrid rgyun la byed pa yin zhes smras shing / dbang gi bya ba grub nas rang gi mal sar slebs skabs/ sngogs kyi bsrung ma yin nam mnyam pa'i bud med zhig dngos su byon nas khyod kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi sngar nas kyang log lta 'di ltas dngos grub mang po zhig phyor pa yin/ khyad par da lam dbang bskur ba'i dus sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma'i sku la 'jug te slob ma dngos grub byin rlabs khyad par can sbyin pa'i dus te/ de dus rdo rje slob dpon yang tha mal rang rgyud kyi rtogs pas ma slad pa dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag rgyu la/ khyod kyi yid log lta 'khrul snang gis bslad par ma zad ngag tu yang smras pas 'di la sgor gsum 'gyod bshags stobs bzhi tshang bas tshogs kyi 'khor lo 669

'bum phrag gcig phral du ma sgrub na mnar med pa'i dmyal bar skal phyed kyi bar du sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong bar 'gyur gyi de la the tshom yod re kan des na tshogs 'khor 'bum phrag gcig phral du bsgrub shig /des dag gtsang du 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba snying gi dbang bskur rnam par dag pa gang la nod pa'i yul de ni rtsa ba'i bla ma dang khyad par med pa nyid du gnas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs te khros pa'i tshul gyis rgyab phyogs nas yal song / tshogs 'bum phral du 'grub par dka' gshis tshogs mchod nyung du 'di yang de phral du rnal 'byor dang po'i las can la rig pa 'dzin par sgro btags pa tshe dbang nor bu'i bris pa sarba maṅga lo/nang gtor 'bul chogan mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni bh+yaḥ ye shes sku gcig rnam pa thams cad gzugs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu byed pa po/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje slob dpon zhabs/ /byin rlab dngos grub rtsa ba der btud nas/ /gang gi thugs dam bskul byed cing / /dngos grub ji snyed thob pa'i phyir/ /nang gi gtor ma khyer bde ba/ /rgyun gyi nyams len 'dir bshad bya/ gang zhig gtsang zhing bzang ba'i rgyu dam rdzas dang bcas pa la spyi bung skos med du byed na gtor ma gcig gi chog la/ bskos can du byed na mgron mtshan gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'bring po ltar na/ lnga tshar re re bdun tshar du gal len ltar bshams/ de yang dus gtor skabs dam rdzas gal che la rgyun du ni dkar gtor sogs ci ltar 'byor bas chog de la nyin zhag de nyid kyi thun gzhan la bdag bskyed sngon du song na/ skabs 'dir yi dam gyi snying po ngag tu brjod nas thun mtshams kyi lha skad cig gis gsal btab pas chog la/ de ltar ma song na bdag skyed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung zhig skabs 'dir rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i rim par nyer spyod dngos su bshams pa yod na sngon du de yi byin rlabs bya/ de nas gtor ma byin rlabs ni byin gyis rlabs pa'i nang mchod rdo rje'i rtse mos gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swā bhā wa shurjo3haṃ/ gtor ma mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /yo las rlung dkyil ljang gu zla gam dang / /ram̐ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum rtsegs/ /de steng āḥ las ye shes ka pā la/ /yangs shing rgya che phyi dkar nang dmar po/ /pad 'dab brgyad mtshan phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar/ /r+ghaṃ saṃ dzi khaṃ r+ghaṃ las sgron ma lnga/ /ba glang khyi rta glang chen mi yi sha /de ni dbus dang mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lnga/ /sum̐ lo me paṃ te las dri chu dang / /dri chen rak+ta byang sems sha chen bcud/ /kun kyang 670

drod ldan rang rang sa bon spras/ /de steng rdu las kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dkar po/ /mgo thur lte dbus r+ghaṃ yig dmar dngas 'tsher/ /rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i rdzas zhu khol/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od bzhin dmar ser 'bar/ /rlangs pa gyen song kha ṭ+wāṃ r+ghaṃ la reg /bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab de rjes kha ṭ+wāṃ ka /byung nas dkrug byas zhu zhing thim pa yi/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi dkar dmar mdangs ldan gyur/ /slar steng oṃ skyes zla dkyil la gnas pa'i/ /oṃ dang r+ghaṃ phaṭa dbus su a k+ṣa'i phreng / /yongs gyur oṃ āḥ rgyu yig dkar dmar mthing / /steng nas steng rtsegs de las 'od 'phros pas/ /snang srid gzugs sgra reg bya'i dngas ma dang //sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i/ /byin rlabs mtha' dag bdud rtsi rnam par 'dus/ /'bru gsum la thim bdud rtsir 'bar 'dzag rgyas/ /de dang zla dal dam tshig bdud rtsi la/ /thim pas gzugs sgra dri ro mthu phun tshogs/ /'dod dgu 'dzad med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /mkha' khengs kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin 'phro gyur/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ༄ga /dkon mchog spyi gtor yid bzhin dpal ster bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo he ru ka /bla ma mchog gi ngo bor 'dud/ /gang zhig bsangs bsur gtor ma yi/ /cho ga spyi 'gro mdor bsdus zhig /dad pa can gyi yang nas yang / /gsol ba btab pa'i ngor smras bya/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhar/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams bsgral slad du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bya/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong ngang rang rig skad cig lha/ /rigs 'dus rdor sems longs sku'i chas/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin mtshan dpe rdzogs/ /'bru gsum thugs dbus r+ghaṃ gis mtshan/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa r+ghaṃ/ zhes ci ltar nus pa bzlas la/ mdun gyi mchod rdzas ci 'byor bar chu chang bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun li ha na ha na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swā bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haṃ/ mdun gyi mchod rdzas stong par gyur/ /skad cig rlung me thod sgyed steng / /a las bhar+ghaṃ stong gsum khyon/ /nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ kha chod zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / kha ṭ+wāṃ mgo thur 'bru gsum 'greng / /rlung me g.yos pas thod rdzas khol/ /mi gtsang dri ma lbu bar lud/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang bcas pa/ /zla ba ye shes bdud rtsir zhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis krug kha ṭ+wāṃ thim/ /bdud rtsi mchog brtan mchod sprin 'khrigs/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ ha ho hriḥ swa hā/ rang nyid yi dam thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ/ /de las 'od 'phros ye shes las/ /mgron rnams ma lus skad cig bkug /mdun mkha' gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ /tse/ gu ru dre wa dhā ki ni badz+ra sa mā dza/ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pu/ pra ti 671

dza hoḥ rgyu/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed bcom ldan he ru ka /rgyud sde bzhi drug dkyil 'khor yi dam lha/ /'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon mtshungs pa mi mnga' ba/ /dus gsum byon pa'i sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /zag zad tshogs zhing rgyal ba'i myu gu mchog /sras dang slob gyur 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /mkha' spyod zhing la dbang bsgyur gsang mdzod 'dzin/ /sngags bdag ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gyur rnams/ /'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung / /dam can chos skyong zhing skyong dregs tshogs rnams/ /'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /skye dgu'i dbul sel mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod/ /dbang bsgyur nor lha gter gyi bdag po rnams/ /'dir gshegs bstan bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /gus pas gsol 'debs mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /khaṃ/ thogs ma med nas pha ma'i rang bzhin du/ /gyur pa mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus par/ /bdag gi dge tshogs byin rlabs rdzas dang bcas/ /bsngo ba kun kyang byang chen myur thob shog /srid nas deng bar nyon mongs dbang lan chags/ /gegs gyur bgegs rigs byung po'i tshogs rnams la/ /bdag gi dge tshogs byin rlabs rdzas dang bcas/ /bsngo ba kun kyang byang chen myur thob shog /srid nas deng bar nyon mongs dbang lan chags/ /gegs gyur bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la/ bdag gi dge tshogs byin rlabs rdzas dang bcas/ /bsngo ba kun kyang byang chen myur thob shog /rgyal khams sa phyogs yul rigs 'di skor du/ /gnyug gnas glo bur lhag pa'i lha 'dre la/ /bdag gi dge tshogs byin rlabs rdzas dang bcas/ /bsngo ba kun kyang byang chen myur thob shog /las dang rten 'brel mthu yi lhag ma'i rdzas/ /mngon par spyod pa lhag ma'i mgron tshogs kun/ /bdag gi dge tshogs byin rlabs rdzas dang bcas/ /bsngo ba kun kyang byang chen myur thob shog /oṃ/ mdor na 'khor ba myang 'das kyis bsdus mgron/ /ma lus mi lus lus pa med kun la/ /bdag gis bshams pa'i rdzas dang dge tshogs kun/ /mchod 'bul sbyin btang yongs su bsngo ba na/ /kun kyang dkon mchog bden 672

pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /bdag gi bsngos la longs spyod des dgyes tshim/ /de yi dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /sgrib gsum dag cing tshogs gsum rdzogs gyur te/ /khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang / /gzi brjid 'od dpag med bzhin myur thob ste/ /slar yang nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub mchog gi sa la bkod phyir bsngo/ /dus 'di nas rtsam byang chen mchog 'bras bu/ /de nyid ma thob bar gyi skye ba kun/ /mngon mtho mtho ris 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug /nges legs bsdu bzhi'i bdag gzhan don la spyod/ /pha ma'i drin lan bla ma'i dgongs pa bskang / /rgyal kun dgyes pa'i las la spyod gyur shog /de ltar mchod sbyin yul gyur mgron rigs rnams/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur tshul/ /bdag gi dpral ba'i gnas nas snying gar thim/ /'jig rten mgron kun rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /bdag gi 'dod don mtha' dag bsgrub par gyur/ /badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la muḥ zhes mkhyud rgya dang / sarba lo ka gats+tsha/ zhes se gol tog dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis brjod/ mchod rdzas gtsang sar phul/ de ltar bsangs bsur gtor ma spyi yi las/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor mchod thabs khyer bde ba/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor tshogs gnyis yid bzhin dpal/ /don gnyer re 'dod bskong ba'i ched du sbyin/ /dge ba des kyang bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /dpal ldan kun tu bzang po nyid thob shog /ces pa yang bod yul stod mnga' ri glo bo yi rgyal po'i sras mo dad pa can 'chi med dpal 'dren dang bde chen dbang mo zung gi ring mo nyid nas yang yang gsol ba btab pa dang nye bar no mo bsod nams dbang mos kyang bskul ba bcas/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus shing glang chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi 'dzad pa dang por ljon pa klung du bris pa sarba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ / 673

༄ga /dam chos sprul sku snying thig rtsa gsum bsrung ma dang bcas pa'i gtor 'bul rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bla ma nus ldan rdo rje 'chang / /dus 'di'i 'gro ngor ba gshegs 'dus rtsal bde ba cher/ /phyag byasar+shasprol sku snying thig gi /dkyil 'khor gtor 'bul khyer bder bkod/ /de yang yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su snod gtsang ma gas grum sbug rdol med par 'bru sogs ci 'byor ba'i rdzas dza gad sam chus brlan la/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir bdag gi gtor ma btang bar bya snyam shing bdag nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa sngon du grub nas/ bdag gi thugs ka'i r+ghaṃ las yi ge e 'phros pas nam mkha' chos kyi 'byung gnas zur drug pa zhabs phra ba/ steng yangs pa blos khyud du tshad du gsal ba'i dbus su pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i gdan dang / de 'og mdun phyogs su gtor ma/ mtha' skor du mchod sprin 'khrigs par bsam te/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshig ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ skad cig mchod gtor rdzas rnams bsreg gtor sbyangs/ /stong ngang skad cig rlung me thod sgyed steng / /āḥ las bhañdza phyi dkar nang dmar ba/ /nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi khengs/ kha chod zla ba de steng kha ṭ+wāṃ bzlog /lte bar rting par oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ gis mtshan/ /rang gi sna bug g.yas rlung hūm̐ dbyibs 'phro/ /rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas dros 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'byung ba'i bcud kun bsdus/ kha chod zla ba kha ṭ+wāṃ dang bcas zhu/ /ye shes las dang dam tshig bdud rtsi 'dres//'dod yon lha mo mkha' khams gang 'phro gyur/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha ho hrīḥ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros pas rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bkug par bsam la/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings rab 'byams dpag gi mi long na/ /bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog yongs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'od dpag med mgon pad+ma 'od 'bar sku/ /rang mdangs gtum drag me phreng khro bo lod/ /gnyis med yum mchog drag mo mtsho rgyal ma/ /phal sgrol khros ma bdud 'dul rdo rje rtsal/ /'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal po phyi nang gsang / /yang gsang yid bzhin 'khor lo lo gyon ma/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms zhi chags khro bo che/ /'jam dpal nag po tshe bdag gshin rje gshed/ /sprul sku snying thig rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha/ /ma lus gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /zab gsang gnyer 'dzin dpal ldan nye ba'i mgon/ /kun dga' gzhon nu sngags srung si na ra/ /bam ro pho mo 674

dregs pa sde brgyad dang / /gza' bdud dug gdong sman cig g.yu sgron ma/ /rol pa skya bdun srin mo gdong dmar ma/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig /rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' 'bangs dam can tshogs/ /ma lus gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka gu ru dre wa dhāk+ki ni sa ma yā sa mu dra sa pā ri wa ra o badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas lha tshogs spyan drangs shing / chos 'byung pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi zla'i gdan la dbus su bla ma pad+ma 'od 'bar rdo rje gro bo lod bdud 'dul rdo rje'i lha tshogs g.yas su yi dam thugs rje chen po phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang lha tshogs/ gzhan yang rdo rje rnam 'joms/ 'jam dpal nag po dang bcas pa/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro ma drag mo bde chen rgya mtsho phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang / gzhan yang sgrol dkar lo gyon ma dang bcas pa steng du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa gsung gi rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang / phyi skor gyi pad 'dab la nye ba'i mgon po yab yum sogs ye shes las kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams bzhugs par bsam la/ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes brjod cing / yang / a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa gtor mgron khams gsum 'gro ba kun kyang bkug nas pad gdan gyi khor yug la 'khod de de dag kyang yi dam yab yum 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ slar yang 'od zer gyi de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ gtor mgron gyi lha tshogs rnams la thim/ thams cad kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ gsum gyis sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab la/ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dzaḥ hoḥzhes pas phyag byas/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa dhak+ki ni maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke ghadhe/ rna wi bya/ru pa/ shardo/ ghadhe/ ra sa/ sparnye/ pañtsa ka ma gu na pra tīts+tsha āḥ r+ghaṃ/ zhes dang / 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod yang 'bul/ de nas lha rnams kyi rdo rje'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gu mchod gtor la zhugs te bcud drangs pas gsol te thugs kyis shing tshim par bsam la/ rdor thal kha phye ba gtor ma la gtad de/ oṃ a mi ta bha hriḥ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rdzu/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lod lo ka sarba sirnyi hūṃ rdu/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ ha hi phe r+ghaṃ bh+yo phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ trīḥ oṃ bud+dha tshwa na dha ki ni sarba sirnyi hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ ma hā ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bibya dha ra ṇa shrī kha le sa ma ye hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ oṃ ya man ta ka rdu phaṭa/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri
