sarba dz+wa ra u pa pra sha pa ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru dre wa dhak+ki ni sarba sirnyi hā la r+ghaṃ āḥ mū la tri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ra i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas rtsa ba gsum la phul/ oṃ du tri sirnya mu kha r+ghaṃ phaṭa: tri hring dzaḥ tri sin na ra ma r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ tri hring dzaḥ sgri triḥ ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri sa ma ya r+ghaṃḥ tri rak+ka ra hu la/ bh+yo pra mo ha/ tsa tri tsa tri shu la ra tsa sa ma ya dzaḥ dharmā gī ṭa sbri na pā la sa ma yā d+mā ra sa mu dra sa pā ri wa ra i rda ba lin 675

ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes pas chos skyongs bsrung ma rnams la 'bul/ tre+e lokya sa twa de wa swa bhā wa i rda bha lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes pas khams gsum 'gro ba spyi la bsngo'o/ /de yang rgyas par sngags re re bzhin gtor sngags btags la btab/ bsdu na gong ltar ram/ badz+ra gu ru dang yig drug khro bo lod rtsa sngags mkha' 'gro spyi dril rtsa gsum dang / zhing skyongs srog sngags la kha hi btags nas 'bul bas grub so/ /de nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso mchog rdo rje slob dpon dpal/ /bde bar gshegs 'dus yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /mchod gtor bzhes la mchog mthun dngos grub stsol/ /sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tsha tu ye swā hā/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ /'dir rgyas par spro zhing shes na bstod pa 'phrin bcol gzhan yang bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol nas/ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes dbyings su gshegs su gsol zhing / sarba lo ka gats+tsha gats+tsha/zhes 'jig rten mgron rang gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /mthar/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /gzhan yang bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o/ /de ltar rtag tu brtson na thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sprul sku pad 'byung gis/ /zab chos snying thig khyad par can/ /sgo brag gter byon de yi gtor 'bul khyer bde ba/ 'di ni gang gi bstan pa'i rim gror dmigs nas bris/zhes dam chos sprul sku snying thig gi rtsa gsum bsrung mar bcas pa'am/ gtor 'bul nyung ngu 'di ni mnga' ris glo dol gyi skal ldan mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ skye ba kun tu gu ru pad+ma rigs bdag tu thob pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus glo bo smon thang rgyal khab tu sbyar ba'i yig ris pa ni sprul pa'i sku rin po che karma nges don chos kyi rgyal mtshan no/ /gag /yang gsang bla na med pa bstan bsrung nyams len rgyun khyer snying po yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dir yang gsang bla med/ dpal 'khor 'das yongs kyi mnga' bdag dur khrod chig shur dregs pa pho mo kun 'dus srog 'chang kun bzang ho ru ka 'chol pa'i khro rgyal ye shes mgon po sme rtsegs nag po'i lam khyer las kyi byang bu ni/ eḥ skye med stong pa'i nam mkha' ni: ma nor ma bcos chos kyi sku: rang bzhin rnam dag lhun grub ngang : oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzha na badz+ra saṃ bha wa at+ma ko3haṃḥ āḥ 'gag med snying rje'i sprin tshogs ni: stong gsal kun snang longs 676

spyod rdzogs: snying rjes sems can kun la khyab: oṃ dharma dha tu saṃ bha wa bi shudhe haṃ: hūṃ rgyu las kun skyed yi ge r+ghaṃ: thams cad 'byung ba'i ngang du shar: gnyis med sprul pa'i skur gsal bsgom: r+ghaṃ e yam̐ ra sum̐ ke ram̐ rgyu bi sha bi shud dheḥ dzñā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍa la e r+ghaṃ: ru tra ti ra baṃḥ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la r+ghaṃḥ.a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal rgyuḥ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal r+ghaṃḥ dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs: rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po ru: ma tram̐ ru tra bsnol ba'i khri: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: hūṃ las me 'od dkar ltar 'khrugs: 'od zer don gnyis byas nas su: rin chen tsan+da ber la thim: skad cig dpal mgon ma ning sku: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis poḥ ru mtshon snying zhag spyan gsum bsgrad: sbrul nag ral pa thod skam gsol: dar nag 'jol ber rngam brjid can: yum chen u ma de wi 'khriloḥ sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar: phyag gnyis shel gri thod khrag bsnams: zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril sbyor 'khyud: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga na gu ya ram̐ sirnyi hūṃ dza: rtsu yab yum thugs las sprul pa'i sras: 'chol pa'i khro rgyal srog bdud sku: spyan gsum brang shar srid gsum gzigs: lhu tshig bzhi la spyan bzhi brgyan: spyan nas khrag 'dzag kha rlangs me: rta nag rting dkar chibs su rol: nyi zla skar chen me 'od 'phro: stag ral g.yas la gzigs shub g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gri khug lcags par thog: lcags gzhu bdud mdas dgra snying gzir: skad cig yud tsam gling bzhir rgyug: bzlog med sngags zlog mkhan gyi gshed: ma hā kā la tri yo ru tra/ nag po dzaḥ tri ling ging ka ra ra tsa su tri dza dza: hūm̐/ g.yas su gza' bdud g.yon dam can: gzhan yang sku las sprul pa ni: mgon po stag zhon rngam brjid can/ gsung las sprul pa bde chen dang / thugs sprul mgon po gri gug dang : yon tan mgon po seng zhon dang :'phrin las mgon po trag shad dang : gzhan yang sprul ba'i 'khor tshogs ni: legs ldan nag po bha ga nag: tshogs bdag chen po dzi lha nag: tshe bdud nag po bya rgod thing : nag po thod 'phreng mkha' lding nag: ta kri nag po grogs po che: 'gro ba kun bzang sring gcig che+oḥ re ti chen mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso: nag po stong dang sha za 'bum: ma mo sa ya gnod sbyin khri: las mkhan bye ba dung phyung rnams:bya nag khyung chen thang bab ltar: mdun du ma yengs yid yul gsal: gtso 'khor de dag thams cad kyi: gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum sgom: 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros: rang rang gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas: dpal mgon ma ning nag po 'khor bcas skad cig yud tsam gyi mdun du byon te: sa gzhi ri bo thams cad yom yom 'gul 'gul: rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad shig shig zing zing ཿོ nam mkha' thams cad char drag rlung 'tshub thog ser 'brug sgra bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra sgrogs shing : blta mi bzod pa'i 677

'od sgo nyi ma 'bum phrag gi gzi mdangs lta bur 'od khyug khyug: tshag sgra chem chemoḥ ye re re: mdor na kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa rlung drag gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas mdun skyed la sib sib thim par bsam 'i/nga : r+ghaṃ bh+yo: sems nyid stong gsal dur khrod gzhal yas nas: thod mkhar sum rtsegs 'bar ba'i pho brang nasoḥ bdud pho bdud mo bkram pa'i dur khrod nas: khro rgyal ma ning nag po gshegs su gsoloḥ shan pa pho mo tshogs pa'i grong khyer nas: me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil pa'i klong dkyil nas: rnam dag dbyings nas 'bar ba'i skur bstan nas: lha chen dpal 'bar dbang phyug gshegs su gsol:hūṃ: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gathegs tshur gshegs lha chen po: ma hā kā la mthu bo che:gsang ba'i khro rgyal stobs po che: ma ning nag po kun kyi rje: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang : gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang : dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas: thugs dam dbang gi gshegs su gsol: r+ghaṃ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang : 'phrin las mgon po sprul par bcas: gzhan yang 'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma hā kā la shrī ga na ghu ya dzaḥ dza: r+ghaṃ dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: rū tra pho mo 'gyel ba'i gdan steng du: gsang ba'i khro rgyal ma ning 'khor dang bcas: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūṃ/ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: skye ba'i cho 'phrul khro rgyal ma ning sku: ma rung 'joms mdzad bdud dpung thal bar brlog: dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo:oṃ shrī ma hā kā la a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ rgyu/ dpal mgon ma ning 'khor dang bcas pa la: so sor mthun pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni: dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul bsam mi khyab: 'byor bas bsags pa'i thugs dam bskang rdzas ni: hūṃ/ thod chen bhad+dha ngas pa'i snod chen du: rgya shug dza ti tsan+da a ka ru: gla rtsi shing kun rgya spos ut+pal sogs: dri zhim spos dang dri gsung 'thul lu lu: ga bur la sogs sman ngad chi li li: 'bru bcud dza gad gser skyem breng se breng : rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ ldems se ldem: bhad+dha rus sna sna tshogs khrol lo lo: sha chen bsur dud ngad pa chil li li: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa breng se breng : ba ching gtor ma'i mchod pa rong se rong ཿོ ma hā me sa la sogs sha sna stong :ma hā rasnyik+ta la sogs khrag sna stong : ma hā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong : go ro rtsa na la sogs klad sna stong : ba su ta sogs nang rol rnam pa lnga: shing thog me tog 'bras bu rtsi thog dang : zan dang khur ba thugs pa'i bye brag dang : khrag rul nya sha la sogs mthun pa'i rdzas: la du la phug yid 'ong 'bru yi zan: mar thud khrum dang 'o ma zho la sogs: bca' sga g.yer ma go snyod sgo gtsong spod: gzugs sgra dri 678

ro reg bya 'dod yon tshogs: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang ཿོ sman rag gtor ma sbyor sgrol mchod pa rnams: dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sarba pu tsa a:hūm̐: de ltar mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis: dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : sprul pa nyi khri chig stong thugs dam bskang: yang sprul bye ba dung phyur thugs dam bskangs:oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gā na gu ya ram̐ sikhyi rdu dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ pā ju puṣ+pe dhu pe a lo ke ghadhe ṇi wi bya shardo pra tits+tsha āḥ r+ghaṃ: ru pa shari ghadhe ra sa spak+ṣe pra tits+tsha āḥ hūm̐: a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling pañtsa ka ma gu na pra tets+tsha swa hā: ma hā badz+ra pad+ma pho gi ni a ho su kha ho: dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dgra 'dre bhur mi kha dgra jag chom rkun mtshon dug sbyor ngan shom pa dang bran lag snying ring dam tshig ngos lkog ngos shag lkog lab gsang 'khyal shung rkun mna' zan 'gro mgo bud 'jug ngo log rgyab bstan bka' 'das khyim 'gal byed pa'i tshe bla srog dbugs drod mdangs thams cad mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma hā me sa la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā ko ro tsa na la kha hi: ma hā ba su ta la kha hi: ma tram ru tra pra ban tsakra r+ghaṃ phaṭa: a spa ra ṇa phaṭoḥ khyad par gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin dngos po dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab la mgon po tshogs bdag ma ning nag po 'khor dang bcas pa la sngar byas las kyi btang rag phyi byed las kyi zhu skyem da lta las kyi gnyer zas su 'bul bas: de rnams kyi ljags phyag mtshan spu gu'i tshul du gsol bar bsam: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gha na ghu ya ram̐ sidhi r+ghaṃ dza: dri yo ru tra r+ghaṃ bh+yo: mun shi bh+yo: mun nag shi shi bh+yoḥ sa pā ri wa ra bha mid+dha gyi ṇ+ḍa gyi ṇ+ḍa kha kha khā hi khā hi bun dza hoḥ rak+ta ar+ghaṃ pi pa to a ta pra ma sa ma ye swā hāḥ zhes phul bas sku gsung thugs mnyes shing tshim nas bdag gi ci re ba dang ci smon pa dang / ci bcol pa'i las thams cad skad cig gi sgrub par bsam laḥ rdzuḥ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus nas sngon byung ba: che mchog ho ru ka dpal sku gsum rdzogs: srid rtsa bdag 'dzin ru tra sde gsum btul: rtsal chen 'phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: r+ghaṃ/ dur khrod thod 'khar me rlung 'tshub dkyil nas:rnal 'byor dpal mgon khyed kyi cha lugs ni: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: sku gsum ldan phyir spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs: rab 'jigs khro gnyer gsum ldan gtum la rngam:zhal gdangs ljags dril drag po'i rnyen sgra sdeb: rin chen thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan: sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab: phyag g.yas ru mtshon g.yon pas snying zhag bsnams: tsan+dan beng chen rked rtsug lha dmag 'gyed: thod pa skam rlon snying 'phreng sbrul chun spras: dar nag ber gsol gser 679

skas mi lpags bcings: bam chen gdan la zhabs gnyis dor stabs bzhugs: ma hā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ bh+yoḥ las la chas tshe srog bdud cha lugs 'dzin: srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum brang la shar: dmag dpon bzhi 'gyed spyan bzhis lhu tshig brgyan: stag ral gzigs shub btags nas rta nag zhon: bdud mda' dgra snying gzer 'deb gling bzhir rgyugoḥ spyan nas khrag 'dzag me yi kha blang 'bar: kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug lcags par thogs nas su: snang srid pho rgyud thams cad pho nyar 'gyed: ci bcol las rnams skad cig yud la bsgrub: rtag tu grogs mdzad mgon po nag po che: ma bskul bar yang gnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgroloḥ ltag na spyan cig ma tshogs dbang du sdud:gar bskul sa/ ru mi ro rab tu brtsegs: bzlog pas mi bzlog sngags bzlog mkhan gyi bshed: sde brgyad bran khol stag sham mi lpags spras: gtsug lag khang bsrung dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: bstan pa gnyan bsrung bka' yi bya ra ba: dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyuḥ chos sku skye ba med pa kun tu bzang : longs sku dpal chen che mchog he ru ka: sprul sku ma ning gsang ba'i khro bo'i rgyal: lha chen dpal 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmag dpon chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gza' bdud chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skyes bu chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodoḥ las mgon rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: r+ghaṃ/ khyed la mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa ni: dgyes pa'i zhal ston bsgrub pa'i rtags phyung shig: sdang ba'i dgra gsod gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul: bar chad rkyen bzlog bsam sgrub re ba skongs: sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: bsgrub pa'i sde skyong bla ma'i sku tshe bsring : 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: na mo ma hā kā la ram̐ rgyu trīḥ d+dhaḥ zhes kun bzang he ru ka'i thugs kyi rol pa'i mdangs las 'chol pa'i khro rgyal sme brtsegs ma ning nag po 'di nyid ni/ rgyud lung man ngag bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po spyi dang / khyad par o rgyan gu ru'i bka' gsang mtha' dag gi bsrung ma chig su ste/ des na 'di nyid gter ma rigs kun tu mchis kyang / 'di ni/ myang/ rdor gling / pad gling / rad gling / bdud 'dul zhabs kyi gter byon dad/ khyad par gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dang / 'ja' tshon snying po dang / rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje rgyu nag bde gshegs snying po rtsal gyi gter kha nas byung ba ltar sgrub thabs dril bar/ bdag tshe dbang nor bu yi 'ong lags smra rgya mtsho'i dran mchog bla ma'i bsti gnas mdo khams ci rong rol lam drag po e klong du dge byed nag zlar sbyor ba'i yi ge'i rig snga ma rab 'byams pa dang phyi ma ni 'gyur 680

med tshul khrims bsod nams mchog grub zung gi bgyis so/ /bkra shis/༄ga /'phags mchog nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i rgyun khyer gyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ susti/ phyag drug pa'i gtor chog 'phrin las rgyun khyer/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi/ de yang gtor ma nas nag sran phye gru gsum pa sha chang sogs kha zas bzang dgus sbags pa ste/ gnas skabs rnams su ni ci 'byor ba'i rdzas gtsang mar bshams la/bdag nyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho trīḥ mang du brjod pa/ gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma g.yas na dpa' bo dar dang bcas shing / g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa 'khor bka' bstod zhing skyong / pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra ma hā ka la sa pā ri ba ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ k+ṣi/ nye gcig ma hā ka la ar+ghaṃ nas/ shalda'i bar gyi mchod/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus gsal ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ tra bisgrin bi na ya ka r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ i rda ba lin ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣe k+ṣe tra bisdin bi na ya ka trag rag mo ba lin ta me sa rak+ta ru ti ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyi mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ shrī di wi hūṃ phaṭa/ i rda ba lin ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ oṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la bisnan rgyu phaṭa/i rda ྾ oṃ dzi na mi tra pā sha ku ru r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ i rda ྾ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dzā sa ma ya bh+yoḥ du dza hūm̐ paṭa/ i rda ྾ oṃ du yag dza la hā ka la trak+ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ i rda ྾ zhes lha mo dang 'khor bzhi la 'bul/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la sha sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa.a brtsi ma ka lo a yo i rda rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti sto/ sma ra si tād i rda duṣ+ṭan kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gyisna gyisna/ bad+dha brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā na ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ e dam ྾ zhes lan gsum gyi gtso 'khor spyi la 'bul/ slar yang / ar+ghaṃ nas shaja'i bar gyi mchod/ hūṃ/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi na ya ga mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thab can/ /phyag drug sbrul 681

gyi rgyan gyi rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas kyi gri gug bar pa phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍa ma ru ni grag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar sin dhu ra yi thig les byug /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ /khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yi dbu la rgyan/ /shing las byon nas gtor ma lan mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bh+yo/ khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na/ /mtsho che dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar/ /mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /bdud kyi khram shing nad kyi brkyal pa bsnams/ /sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed/ /thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ma cig re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /r+ghaṃ/dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' nyan pa/ /ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /ma rung bdud 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /las byed pho nya bzhi la bdag cag bstod/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang / /me lha srin bu rlung lha 'byung po dang / /steng gi tshangs pa sa yi lha mo ste/ /sprul pa phyogs skyongs bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / /dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /zhes pa'i mthar yig brgya ci rigs pas kha bskang / /khyad par du/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /ces gsol ba mang du btab/ de nas/ badz+ra muḥ gtso bo rang gi snying kha dang 'khor rang bzhin gnas brten la gshegs/ smon lam gdab bkra shis brjod/ de skad spyan ras gzigs nag po/ /phyag drug pa yi 'phrin las kyi/ /rim pa rgyun khyer bkod pa'i mthus/ /'phags mchog nyid 'bras deng thob shog /ces jo nang rje btsun dam pa'i gsung las khyer bder/ dpal tshe dbang nor bus sdeb pa ste/ 'phags mchog nag po chen po'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rgyu gyur cig dge'o/ / 682

rdzo /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rje me 'od kun tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo mañdzu badz+re bh+ya: bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum sgru ba thabs rin chen rdo rje me 'od kun tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje rab tu khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab 'od gsal dri ma yongs spang rdo rje yi/ /'khor bcas bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa kun bcom mi 'gyur bde/ /mchog la 'god mdzad khro rgyal yongs kyi dbang phyug che/ /gshin rje mthar byed 'jam mgon bla mar phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gdul bya'i 'khrul rtog bag chags sbyang slad du / /spros bral ye shes dkyil 'khor lha sku'i 'tshul/ /yongs shar las dang dngos grub tshogs mtha' dag /myur 'grub sngags kyi lam 'di rmad du byung / /tha ma'i dus 'dir lhag par mthu byin nus/ /bla med gshin rje 'jigs mdzad bsgrub gzhung 'di/ /yang yang klags la snying nas dga' ba skyes/ /lam 'dir gegs med skal bzang yongs 'du shog /de yang 'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal 'jigs mdzad chen po lha bcu gsum ma bsgrub par 'dod pas/ dur khrod la sogs par dbugs bral gyi gdan la 'dug ste 'di skad do/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang nyams pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la ྾ dam pa'i chos rnams la ྾ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la ྾ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnams pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyis bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems 683

bskyed bgyi/ /de ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de dag ni mang nyung ji ltar rig par bya zhing / de rjes rdo rje sems pa'i bsgoms bzlas kyi rgyud sbyangs ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ hūṃ las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil mo krung gi bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo rang dang mtshungs pas khyud pa/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can du gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar r+ghaṃ: thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa h+ye no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sidhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shrī yam̐/ ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa badzi bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa a/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas mthar/phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen pos bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchis/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad thol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ de nas skad cig gis rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa'i snying khar pad nyi la hūṃ nag po mchog tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyi/ bla ma mi bskyod pas gtso bo'i dbu rgyan du byas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza: na mo gu ru bh+ya: na mo badz+ra hai ra wa maṇ+ḍa le bh+ya: gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje phyag gis drangs mdzad nas/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra lā su r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra girti trī/ oṃ badz+ra nirti a/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tram̐/oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke trī/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe āḥ zhes phyag dang bcas pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag 684

skyabs mchis/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs rig lnga'i sdom bzung dang / tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par brjod cing sgom: de nyid byang chub kyi sems dang 'brel pa yang bsgom par bshad la bsdu na rigs lnga'i sdom gzung ma byas kyang mchog go/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shurnyo3rgyu: stong pa'i ngang las r+ghaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/byang ljang / lte bar mthing nag la rdu gi mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir rwa gur bla re dang bcas pa/ phyi rol rdo rje'i gtams par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa r+ghaṃ rgyu rgyu phaṭa swā hā: bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du pad zla'i steng du/ sam las kun tu bzang po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin chen rgyan pa/ de zhu ba las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka gyen tu phyog pa/ de'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang /a las zla ba la gnas pa'i r+ghaṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa rgyu gyi mtshan pa/ de las byung ba'i rnam snang dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin phyag rgyas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs shing dar rin po ches brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i zhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rin chen sna lngas las grub pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pha gur ser po dang / dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ steng mda' yab mchod rten gyis rnam pas mdzes pa/ pu shu'i 'khor yug la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan ba dan sgreng ba nang gi lha rnams shar dkar lhor ser nub dmar byang ljang ba/ dbus kyi gru chad kyi 'og bzhi rdo rje bzhi la steng du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa/ nang ka ba brgya dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su mi mgo skam po'i ra ba zlum po sgo gcig pa/ phyi nang gi gzhi thams cad khrag zhag 'khrugs pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi'i mig mang ris su bris pa/ nang re mig dgur gyur pa'i steng phyogs keng rus kyi ka gdung gis phug pa/ g.yang bzhi'i bla bre dang / rgyu blon gyi lda ldi la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gi mtshan pa/ rtsigs pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyis snam bu la mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang / sgo bzhi'i thad ka nas ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta bab rnams rtse mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang /gdugs kyi mtshan pa/ khyams la mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi brgyan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du gtum drag la sogs pa dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung zhing skyi g.ya' ba brgyad kyi bskor ba ste/ de dag du na ga ge sar la sogs pa shing chen po brgyad dang / brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong brgyad dang / gzhan yang zhing skyongs ba brgyad dang / chu dang me dang / klu dang / sprin dang / ri dang / mchod rten rnams 685

kyang brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa/ ma mo dang / srin mo dang / sha za dang / gshin rje dang / ro langs la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing / ha ha'i sgra dang / ku co brag cha dang bcas lhang lhang por 'bod pa/ mdung la bskyon pa dang / shing la dpyangs pa dang / mes tshig pa la sogs ro sna tshogs dang / keng rus dang / ro mgo med gar byed cing / rus pa dang / khrag dang / sha dang / klad pa 'thor ba dang / dum bus khebs pa dang / bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs 'thab pa dang / 'khrugs pa dang /nga ro 'don pa 'byung po rnams kyi spyod pa sna tshogs pas yid bsgyur bar byed pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / sgrub pa po dang sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams dam tshig gis spyod pa dang / 'jigs pa med par thod lnga'i sgra dang bcas gar byed pa dang / sgrub pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dang / mchod rdzas sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi re mig tu/ yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can la mi ro mgo dang rkang lag bral ba/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ re mig brgyad la shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa gnyis/nub tu sgyu ma/ byang bu rkang pa gnyis/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gi phug pa'o/ /de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du pad zla/ lhor pad nyi/ nub tu pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma 'od dang bral ba/ byang du pad+ma la rlung dkyil/ mtshams gzhir pad zla'i gdan/shar gyi lha rnams la/ sgo'i g.yas su gri gug 'phang thung gtun shing / g.yon du chu gri/ ka ṇa ya/lcags kyu/ lho'i lha rnams la/ g.yas su sta re/ mda'/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yon du dbyug pa/ 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ nub kyi lha rnams la/ g.yas su rdo rje/ cang te'u/ phub/ g.yon du gzhu/ dril bu rlung ras/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sdig mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang lpags/ g.yon du tho ba/ mdung / me thab so/shar sgor tho ba/ lho sgor dbyug pa/ nub sgor pad+ma/ byang sgor ral gri rnams nyal thabs su gnas pa bzhi po de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ drwa bzhir ro langs nag po mgo gsum/ lag pa gsum/rkang pa gsum gar byed pa'am/ yang na phyag gnyis pa g.yas thal mo 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar thal mo byed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a las zla ba la dhī: las ral gri dhīs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu gur gum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa ltar dmar ser phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thugs kar ut+pal sngon po kha byes gnas pa'i po ti bsnams pa/zhi zhing sgeg pa rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan cing / mtshan dpe rdzogs pa brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra'i thor btsugs zur phud lnga dang bcas pas mdzes pa/ rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar ā las bdun pa'i bdag po la gnas pa'i r+ghaṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ 686

phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang rigs ma khro bo la sogs pa spyan drangs/ 'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa de thams cad nyi ma la thim pas/ tsha ser 'bar ba dpag tshad bdun du khyab par gyur/ yang de'i 'od kyis ā li kā li dang sngags phreng rnams spyan drangs te bstems pas/ rtsu nag po 'od zer lnga ldan du gyur/ de'i 'od kyi de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i thugs ye shes chen po phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyangs te thim pas/ r+ghaṃ de nyid rdo rje chen po mthing nag rtse dgu pa/twa gdengs pa/ 'od 'bar ba/ lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las de bzhin gshegs la sogs pa dang rdo rje phra mo mtha' yas pa 'phros/ sdang ba dang gdug pa rnams tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ zhing khams dag par byed/ de rnams dang 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa spyan drangs te/ de dag thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mun pa ltar gnag cing ngam za ba/ zhal dgu'i rtsa zhal mthing nag ma te nag po rab tu 'khros pa'i gdong rwa sngo sangs shin tu rno shing rdo rje'i me lce lhab lhab 'bar bas phyogs thams cad gnon pa// rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal gsum sngon po/ dmar po/ ser po ste shin tu mkhros pa/ rwa'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal gsum dkar po/ dud pa/ nag po ste/ mche ba gcigs pa/ rwa gnyis kyis dbus su steng zhal dmar po/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ srin po ltar ches 'jigs shing ha ha dze dze zhes drag tu gzhad pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal gser mdog yid tsam 'khro zhing 'dzum pa/ zur phud lnga ldan byis pa'i rgyan bzang pos spras pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum pa/khro zhal thams cad rdo rje gad mo drag tu rgod cing / hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra gnam du 'bod pa/ dgra bgegs kyi sha dang rkang dang / tshil za ba/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i 'gram nas 'bar ba'i smin ma 'gyogs por bcus shing / dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum gdang mig tu blta zhing bzlog pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ me stag lta bu'i smin rdzi dang / sma ra dang ba spu can/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad sdig mdzub kyis bsdig pa/ mi zad pa'i zhal rnams mche ba/rnon po bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ 'jigs pa chen po dus kyi rlung dang 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i mtshams rngam gyi sgra'i gad rgyangs kyi bdud sde'i snying 'gas pa/ lang tsho la bab pa sku lus che zhing rags pa'i yan lag dang / snying lag sbom thung drag shing 'khrang bag can/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ rab tu rgyas pa'i ling ga gyen du sgreng ba/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pas/ yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyi 'phang mdung / gtun shing / chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig sta re/ mdung ring / mda'/ lcags kyu/ 687

dbyug pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ tho ba/ ral gri/ rnge chung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag ma rnams kyi mgo/ phub rkang pa/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ sgyu ma/ dril bu/ lag pa/ ro ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la gtsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal gyis kha phor bdud rtsis gang ba/ sdig mdzub/ ba dan rtse gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa'i ras rnams 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags rlon khrag 'dzag pa stod g.yog su byas pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ gyad chen po'i stobs kyi srid pa gsum bskyod cing 'dar bar byed pas lhag par brjid pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa'i g.yas brgyad kyi mi/ ma he/ glang / bong ba/ rnga mo/ khyi/ lug wa rnams dang / g.yon brgyad kyis bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ bya rog ne tso/ bong khra bya chen po/ ri skeg gzhad rnams gnon pa de rnams kyi 'og tu/ tshangs pa/dbang po/ khyab 'jug drag po ste bdud bzhi dang / gzhon nu gdong drug la sogs pa rnams kha phub tu bsgyel nas gnan pa/ gcer bu shin tu gtum pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa brgya phyed sgyu rlon la brgyus pa'i do zhal dang / gdug pa'i sbrul nag po mchod phyir thogs dang / rus pa'i brgyan drug dang / khrag dang / zhag dang / thal chen gyis spras pa/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spro ba 'jig dus kyi me ltar du 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten gsum pos blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la r+ghaṃ nag po 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i sku la 'khyud pa'i yum khro mo'i dbang phyug rdo rje ro langs ma gcer bu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ khro sgegs lang tsho la bab zhing / dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi bcom ldan 'das dang mnyam sbyor ba 'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gi mtshan pa dang / yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stongs pa'i ngang las/ ā las pad+ma dmar po ze'u 'bru la ā: sa mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa yig gi bkag pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ srog dag pa'i lam nas yum gyi khar bab pa thig le bcu bdun du gyur/ de rnams lha so so'i sa bon du gyur/dbus su ya las rdo rje g.yas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed nas mi zad pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ 'dir yum ma bskyed kyang chog /bskyed par spro na bcom ldan 'das 688

de'i sogs gong bzhin bya/ shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyi nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ma las rin chen mas mtshan pa la/ phra ma gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang po gnyis gong dang 'dra/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyi rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu me yig las pad+ma me yig gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal phyag dang po gnyis 'dra/ g.yas gnyis kyi pad+ma dang ral gri/ /g.yon gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang nor bu/byang du da yig las ral gri da yi ge mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ phrag dog gshin rje ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyi ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyi rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar lhor dza las 'khor lo dzas mtshan pa las rdo rje tsartsika dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba sogs gti mug gshin rje dang 'dra ba la/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang gis thabs la 'khyud pa/ ces rjod/ lha mo gzhan gsum la'ang phyag dang po gnyis rigs 'dre'o/ /lho nub tu sa las rdo rje pas mtshan pa las/ rdo rje phag mo sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum rtsa zhal gyi steng du phag gdong can/g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma nub byang du do las pad+ma do yig gis mtshan pa las/ rdo dbyangs can ma dmar mo dmar nag sogs 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang 'dra/byang shar du ra tu las ral gri tu yig gis mtshan pa las/ go bo ri ljang khu sogs phra dog gshin rje gshed dang 'dra/ de dag gi phyi ngos shar phyogs su ya las tho ba g.yas mtshan pa las/ tho ba gshin rje gshed nag dkar dmar sogs rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ g.yas gnyis na tho ba rwa nyi shu pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na nor bu dang pad+ma/ lhor tsa las dbyug pa tsa yig gis mtshan pa las/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i/ g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ nub tu ni las pad+ma ni yig gis mtshan pa las/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po sogs 'dod chags gshin rje gshed 'dra/ byang shar du ra las ral gri ra yig gis mtshan pa las/ ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu sogs phrag dog gshin rje gshed 'dra/ lha mo bzhi rnams mchod phyir thog spangs shing bud med kyi mtshan nyid can/ khro bo brgyad se ral kha dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum mche gcigs dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags dang / mgo phreng dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon rkyang gi bzhugs pa/ cha thams cad bcom ldan 'das yab yum dang mtshungs 689

shing / gti mug gshin rje gshed dang lha mo bzhi zla ba'i 'od can/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i 'od can thams cad kyang me spung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir/ ṇa yo ni ra rnams las thod pa khrag gi gang ba bzhi po rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ o trī:snri:wi kri tā na na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtso bo dang bcas pa'i ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir byung / mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang bar byas/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing /khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sbyang / zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo rang nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ bde stong gnyis su med par sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ mkha' nang gi gti mug gshin rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtso bo dang bcas pa'i ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir byung / mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang bar byas/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad cing / khyad par du yang gti mug sbyangs/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phangs la bkod/tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ shar gyi re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ oṃ rat+na sgrika r+ghaṃ phaṭa/phra ma gshin rje gshed ྾ khyad par du nyon mongs pa nga rgyal ser sna ྾ phra ma gshin rje gshed kyis ྾ lho'i re mig tu pad nyi la ྾ oṃ a re lika hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed ྾nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi rnam rtog ྾ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi ྾ nub kyi re mig tu pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma 'od dang bral ba'i gdan la ྾ oṃ pradzñā sgyug hūṃ phaṭa/ phra dog gshin rje gshed ྾ nyon mongs phrag dog gi nyams pa ྾ phra dog gshin rje gshed kyi ྾ byang gi re mig tu pad+ma dang rlung dkyil gyi gdan la/ oṃ mo hā ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje tsim kā ྾ khyad par du sa'i khams sbyang byams pa chen po la bkod/ shar lho'i re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la 'khod ྾ oṃ de ṣar te phroṃ phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje phag mo ྾ chu'i khams ྾ snying rje chen po ྾ lho nub kyi re mig gi pad zla ྾oṃ ra gar te r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje dbyangs can ྾ me'i khams ྾ dga' ba chen po ྾ nub byang gi re mig tu pad zla'i ྾ oṃ badz+ra tā re r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje gau rī/ rlung gi khams ྾ btang snyoms chen po ྾ byang shar gyi re mig tu pad zla'i ྾ oṃ mud ka ra sgrika r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ tho ba gshin rje gshed ྾ phung po'i bdud bcom/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ shar sgor pad nyi'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa dh+rika rgyu phaṭa/ dbyugs pa gshin rje gshed ྾ nyon mongs pa'i bdud ྾brtson 'grus kyi stobs la ྾ lho sgor pad nyi ྾ oṃ pad+ma skṛka rgyu phaṭa/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed ྾'chi bdag gi bdud ྾ dran pa'i stobs ྾ nub sgor pad nyid ྾ oṃ khad ga lhaka rdu phaṭa/ 690

ral gri gshin rje gshed/ lha'i bu'i bdud bcom ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ྾ dkyil 'khor chen po'i byang sgor pad nyi la 'khod par gyur/ oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ lan bzhi/ thod pa bzhi gdan dang bcas pa ྾khyad par yul drug gi dri ma sbyangs/ mngon par shes pa drug la bkod/ lha rnams kyi dra bzhi la/ rdo rje ro lang bzhi'i mdun du pad+ma'i gdan re re la 'khod par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi/ mig tu k+ṣe ṣa las 'khor lo k+ṣe gi mtshan pa la sa ba'i snying po/ gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu rna ba dzi las rdo rje dzi gis mtshan pa las/ phyag na rdo rje steng zhal spangs ba'i rdo rje phag mo lta bu/ snar khams las rin po che khams kyis mtshan pa las nam mkha'i snying po phra ma gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lce la gi las pad+ma gi gis mtshan pa las spyan ras gzigs 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ dpral bar kai las ral gri kai gis mtshan pa las/sgrib pa rnam sel phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lte bar paṃ las rdo rje paṃ gis mtshan pa las/ kun tu bzang po dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug phyag mtshan rdo rje phag mo lta bu'o/ /spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyi mtshan pa las/ sku rdo rje gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ mgrin par aḥlas pad+ma ā: sa mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ thugs kar r+ghaṃ las rdo rje r+ghaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ thugs rdo rje steng zhal spangs pa'i rdo rje/ phag mo lta bu ste skyed mched drug dang rdo rje gsum ste/ lha dgu po rnams kyi thugs kar yang rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'dun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ ṇi we te ā: rdu/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kharga ho/ ya r+ghaṃ las 'od zer phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo'i rgyal po rnams rang rang gi rigs kyi btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa dbang gi don du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shari'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas rnams la rdor 'chang gis/ /dbang bskur bzhin du 'gro ba rnams/ /bsgral phyir yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de bzhin bdag la gnang ba zhu/ /oṃ a snyi ṣiñtsa du me sarba ta thā ga ta/ ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po 'di/ /byin cig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ju/ zhes spyan drangs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/byurtsa ka la sogs pas rdo rje'i glu len/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas yang dag par mchod/ gur gum 691

la sogs pa me tog gi 'char dang / rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra bsgrags de dbang bskur bas/ lha rnams kyi sku lus bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi khyab ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ dbang gi lha rnams spyi bo nas zhugs/ bdag nyid sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byas/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gti mug rdo rje tsiñtsa ka tho ba gshin rje gshed rnams la rnam snang / ser sna rdo rje/ phag mo dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnams la rin 'byung / 'dod chags rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed rnams la snang mtha'/ phrag dog rdo rje go bo rī/ ral gri gshin rje gshed rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ wa ka dang / tsit+ta la yang sbyar/ de rjes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas gnas gsum du gtug la/ hrī: ṣ+ṭi+oḥ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra snye re wa ru pa badzi a r+ghaṃ/ de bzhin du shalda/ ghadhe/ ra sa/ sparnye/ oṃ badz+ra hai ra wa dhad+ma dha tu badz+rī ā: hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā su hūṃ sogs gong bzhin dang / gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol tu gsol/ gnas par mdzod/mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol tu gsol/ /ho chags pa med cing chags pa mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzā badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ r+ghaṃ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun khyod la 'dud/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun dang ni/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /khyab bdag chags pas chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'byung bzhi rnam dag tshad med bzhi/ /phrin las bzhi ldan sku bzhir ldan/ /'gying bag ldan pa lha yi tshogs/ /mnyes mdzad yum bzhi'i sku la 'dud/ /bdud bzhi sgrib pa bzhi sbyongs zhing / /lta ba bzhi las rnam grol ba/ /dgug 'dzin 'ching sdom gzir byed pa/ /sgo skyong bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū ti badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haṃ/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas bde ba bsgom par mos la/ oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra su bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes brjod do nang mchod 'du byas la/ oṃ ā:bisnan ta kri ta r+ghaṃ 692

phaṭa/ zhes pas bsangs su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kai las mi mgo'i snyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/de'i dbus su na las mi'i sha ya yig gi mtshan pa/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha k+ṣes mtshan pa/ lhor sku las khyi'i sha las mtshan pa/ nub tu da las ta'i sha mes mtshan pa/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha das mtshan pa/ dbus kyi steng du shu las byang sems hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor bi las dri chen dzas mtshan pa/ lho nub tu mu las dri chu sas mtshan pa/ nub byang du ma las klad pa ngos mtshan pa/ byang shar du ra las rak+ta rus mtshan pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yob/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge bcu dang bcas pa zhu/ spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du/ chags pa'i lte bar zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/shar tu gti mug gshin rje gshed/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed rnams rang rang gi yab yum dang bcas pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pas yab yum bcu rjes chags kyi me 'od du zhu nas rdzas rnams la thim pas/ kha dog dang dri ro nus pa phun gsum tshogs pa bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā: r+ghaṃ ha ho trī: g.yon pa'i theb srin gyis bdud rtsi blang ste lce thog tu bzhag la 'bru gsum brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā mṛ ta su dan badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas man ngag ltar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ sngags bzlas par bya te/ oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha/ ni rā ma ya/ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ trīḥ sbyi wi kri ta na na hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'khor gyi bzlas pa byed par spro na/ yab yum la/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ta lī ā gats+tsha a gats+tsha r+ghaṃ dza ṭ+wā hā/zhes pa dang / gong du gshad pa'i 'khor gyi byin sngags rnams zla'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de 'od du zhu gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'od du zhu lha rnams la thim/'khor bcu gnyis po dang yum yang rang nyid la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/de yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar r+ghaṃ/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna war badzi/ sna la khams/ lce la gi/ dpral bar kai/ lte bar paṃ rnams kyi rgyas btab par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul 693

bar 'dod na/ lag len ltar gtor ma bshams la/ nang mchod byin rlabs kyis skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdor bsdu na/ mdun du dkyil 'khor gyis 'khor lo skad cig tsam gyi gsal btabs cing gtor ma phul bas chog la/ rgyas pa la spro na/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar me las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du r+ghaṃ las rdo rje rgyu gi mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dus mtha'i sprin dang zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten gsum pos lta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid can gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ mig tu k+ṣi dkar po sa'i snying po/ rna bar dzi sngon po phyag na rdo rje/ sna la khams ser po nam mkha'i snying po/ lce la gi dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyugadapral bar rka ljang khu sgrib pa rnam sel/ lte bar paṃ dkar po kun tu bzang po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po gsung rdo rje/ thugarme kar rtsu sngon po thugs rdo rje rnams su gyur/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer mkha' dbyings thams cad du son pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa ma dza: zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ r+ghaṃ/ de bzhin/ dhu pe a lo ke ghadhe rna wi bya zhes sbyar bas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /khyed kyi dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ud ka a gi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ pu ra sta swā/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bo'am mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad dbang bar byas/ chu'i dngas ma'i spyi bor 'khyil pa las/ mi bskyod pa dang 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi ljags r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ sngags gsum ka'am snying po'i mthar/sarba bisnan sha trun mā rā ya i rda ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyi phul/ oṃ badz+ra la su hūṃ/ sogs kyi mchod/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ zhes pa nas/ dud kha mun chen khyed la 'dud/ /gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /zhes pa'i bar gyi 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ gsum pa phyogs skyongs rnams la 'bul ste/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo la/khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ phyogs skyong thams cad bkug par gyur/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ r+ghaṃ in+d+ra ā di rna sarba duṭaṃ a kar+ṣa ya dza: phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar 694

du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ dbus kyis g.yas su tshangs pa/ g.yon du sa'i lha mo rnams rang gi 'khor gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ /rgyas pa la spros na/ zhal phyag sogs rdzogs par bskyed do/ /slar yangs rang gi snying ga nas khro bo phur bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ in+d+ra a dī na sarba duṭaṃ badz+ra ki la ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ grub pa'i dngul chus bcud kyi rigs pa na/ khams rnams gser du 'gyur ba ji lta bar/ rdo rje phur bu'am reg pa tsam gyis kyang / phyogs skyong 'khor bcas gshin rje bshed du gyur/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ma he'i gdong pa can/gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgrongs ba/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ rang rang gi bzhon pa'i steng du g.yon brkyang ba'i bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣe las rgyas btab par gyur gyi bar gong ltar/ rang gi snyingalhag nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza: zhes pa nas/ chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥ r+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ in+d+ra ya ā+oṃ: ya ma yasbyi: wa ru ṇa ya wi/ ku be ra ya kri/ zhi sha ra ya ta/asna ye a/ ni ri h+ye na/ wa ya we na/ brah+maṇa ye r+ghaṃ/ ba surnya ra ṇa ye phaṭa/ sarba bhu te bh+yo/ ha ha hi hi r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ be+e be+e phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa gang rigs kyi phul la/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pa la sa pā ri wa ra bh+yaḥ zhes sbyar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shaja'i bar gyi mchod/ hrī: sbyi: mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo 'dul dka' 'dul mdzad pa/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di gzhes la/ /sogs 'phrin las bcol/ gtor ma bzhi pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la 'bul te gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /slar yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad dmigs la mchod pa bsdus pa zhig byas la/ bcom ldan dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs rnams dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang / de'i sdong grogs mdzad cing bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang / yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra lha ra wa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra mū:oṃ ka la ru pā sa pā ri wa ra gats+tsha/ sems can thams cad bde gyur gcig /sems can thams cad 695

skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyi grol gyur pa/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyi/ /ma rung pa rnams tshar gcod shog /gzhan yang smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang du brjod/ /de ltar rgyal kun gyi byin rlabs rigs sngags mthu/ /gcig bsdus lha mchog 'jam dpal khros pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'jigs mdzad gang gi bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhal lung rmad du byung / /snying po bsgrub pa bcu gsum lhan thabs dag /phyogs gcig bklags pas grub pa'i cho ga 'di/ /dang po'i las can rnams la ches phan cing / /sgom pa la yang yid bzhin bsam 'phel tshul/ /'di ltar bdag gi 'bad pas bris pa'i dge ba yi/ /'gro kun sngags lam ma zhugs rnam dag dam tshig spyod/ /rim gnyis yon tan myur rdzogs he ru ka'i go 'phang / /nyer bsgrod dam pa sku gnyis rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig /de ltar bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal khros pa rdo rje 'jigs mdzad rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rje me 'od kun tu 'bar ba 'di ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa rwa lo gsum pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sgrub thabs snying po dang lha bcu gsum mar sgrub pa'i cho ga lhan thabs gnyis dkyus gcig tu bsgrigs ste bklags pas 'grub pa 'di ni dang po'i las can rang dang skal ba mnyam pa mang po la phan pa'i slad du drag po zhes lcags sprel gyi lo rdzogs la nye ba mgo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi nub byang klong yul dkar nag gi mtshams sa yi thig le rtag brtan rin chen spungs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'chi med dga' ba'i tshal du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus legs par sbyar ba ste kun tu dge legs rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ bkra shis/ /༄ga /khrus gsol rig stobs nang 'dren khrus bzhugs so/ /de nas sku khrus kyi yo byad khrus sder/ dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i 'bru mar/ sran dkar kyi phye ma'i 'dag chal/ dur ba'i phon po/ sku phyis gos gzungs rnams tshogs par byas nas/ rten dngos me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ khrus kyi snyan gsan 'bul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bdag gi yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o/ /khrus 696

kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ gser gyi sa bzhi 'tsher zhing gsal ba ltar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i dka' ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/ /khrus ces khrus khang bsgyed ma rten dngos bsam/ /me long du shar ba la rung ba'i spir gyi phyun po'i dri bzang snum dang sbyar ba dang / sran dkar 'dag chal byug la dur phon gyi mnye zhing drung la/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldan pa yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyi thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyis/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya ba shwa dha ni swā hā/ de nas las bum thogs la/ lha mo khaṇ+ḍa ro ho mi/ byin brlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus gsol bas/ /sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro ho sarba ta thā ga ta ā bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃ/ zhes bkru zhing rol chen bya/ khrus kyi tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang / khrus tshan re re rdzogs mtshams su rol chen dang sngags tshig gi mtshams su dril bsil bya/ de nas dri bzang gis bsgos pa'i dar ram ras dkar thogs la/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ gtsang ma dri rab gos kyi sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ tram̐ trī ā: ka ya bhi ni sho dha ni ṭ+wā hā+oḥ zhes chu'i rdul phra rab byang tshul kyi sku phyi/ de nas dri snum 'dag chal gong ltar byug zhing / stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldan pa yi/ /sogs khrus bum thogs la/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rjes chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci radod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a gi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye r+ghaṃ/ rol chen/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos྾ oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ trī ā: dri snum 'dag chal phul nas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyongs mdzad cing / /stong pa dri yi legs sgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol zhes phar phyin drug po rjod do/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin ྾ bzod pa'i ྾ brtson 'grus ྾bsam gtan ྾ shes rab ྾ chu bo drug gi khrus byas nas sogs bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs bya/de dag sku la sogs dang / oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ trī ā: zhes pa phar phyin drug la sku phyi gcig bya'o/ /dri snum 'dag chal phul la/ ji ltar bltam pa sogs bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā bhi ṣe ka ta ྾ de dag sku la ྾o hūṃ tram̐ trī ā: dri snum 'dag chal phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de'i sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par gang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ྾ de dag ྾ oṃ hūṃ tram̐ trī ā: dri snum sngar ltar/rgyal ba'i sku la tsha grang mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur gcig /rgyal ba'i gsungs la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can ngag gi sgrib pa ྾ rgyal ba'i gsung la ྾ sems can ngag gi ྾ 697

rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa yi mnga' yang / /sems can yid kyi ྾ rgyal ba'i thugs ྾ sems can yid kyi ྾ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /sems can lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur gcig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya rnyi sho dha ni su hā: de dag sku la ྾oṃ r+ghaṃ tram̐ trī ā: ka ya bhi sho dha ni su hā: de ltar khrus kyi tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang khrus mtshan re rdzogs mtshams su rol chen dang sngags tshig mtshams su dril bsil bya/ de nas bde legs kyi khrus gsol rgyas pa ni dri bzang 'dag chal phul la/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' de/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la ྾ ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad de/ /khyed la ྾ skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yis/ /thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin tu rtag bskyangs te/ /khyed la ྾ gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yis/ /sems can kun gyi bstan gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa de/ /khyed la ྾ gang zhig chos kun mngon sum du/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' yang / /gsum tsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ /khyed la ྾ dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing / /don 'grub tshogs kyang 'grub pa de//khyed la ྾ gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams kun/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la bde legs ྾ byang chub snying por gshegs pas na/ /sa dag rnam drug rab g.yos zhing / /bdud yid mi der gyur pa des/ /khyed la ྾ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung zhing / /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ /khyed la ྾yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la ྾ sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun kyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur gcig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de di ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs gyur/ /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs gyur/ /phyir 'ong rnams kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ /phyir 'ong rnams kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shing / / 698

khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur gcig /ston mchog dam pa lha ma'i mchod 'os pa/ /zhes pas nas/ dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag ྾ de gad thams cad ྾ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /sogs sku phyis kyang 'bul lo/ /de nas gos gzung thogs la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi skyod rdo rje'i ྾ mi phyed dad pas ྾ bdag kyang rdo rje'i ྾ oṃ badz+ra bsta ā r+ghaṃ/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab kra zhing / /gang la reg na ྾ ྾ ྾ a badz+ra wa tra a r+ghaṃ/ zhes 'bul lo/ /bkra shis/ /

gsum dmar zlum gzigs: ral pa dmar nag rgod ma'i ma 'dod brjes: thod skam dbu brgyan rus pa'i snyan chas brgyan: dbu gtsug bya rog mgo bo ral gri mchu: thog gi lce can kang sgras dgra snying 'gems: sku ba gsor byed cing : g.yon gyi bzhi pas bdud kyi khram shing bsnams: lnga pas nyams pa'i tsit+ta dmar po 'dzin: tha gnyis nyi ma zla ba cha la gdab:sku la dug sbrul rigs lngas rab tu brgyan: dar nag 'bar ba'i klong : ra: las srin po rak+ka dz+wa la ni: dmar nag dbu dgu phyag g.yas dbyug tho dang : g.yon na thod khrag mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: mgo 'phreng khrag 'dzag glog zhags stag sham dkrisoḥ mi sdug 'jigs pa'i chas kyi rab brgyan zhing ཿོ chibs su gdug pa ro langs mgo dgu zhon: 'khor du srin po sha zan 'bum gyis skor: g.yon du 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khrug gur dbus: na: las klu mo rdo rje glog 'gyu nag: sbal pa'i dbu dgu rab 'jigs khrag gi mig: phyag g.yas klu shing g.yon na khrag mtsho bsnams: sku smad sbrul mjug dug sbrul mgo dgu chibs: sbrul dang rin chen glog gi 'phreng bas spras: 'khor du klu dang srin mo 'bum gyi bskoroḥ mdun du sprin nag bskal rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: maḥ las gnam sman thog gi bu yug ma: me mdog zhal gcig spyan gsum ral pa brjes: ral bseb zla tshes lte bar rgyab du rin chen brag steng 'og dmar klong : k+ṣa las gza' gdong dmar nag khrag rul mdog: zhal gcig spyan gsum am 701

mthong ཿོ lho nub phyogs nas drang srong gza' mchog che: ma lus 'khor bcas skad cig yud tsam gyis: spyan drangs rang rang dam dbye dbyer med gyur: rgyu rak+ṣa rā hu la sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma yā tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥ dza: ya bh+yo dza: bskal me 'khrug 'dra'i tshang tshing sgra dbyangs 'dir: rab 'jigs rdo rje ur mo'i gad mo sgrogs: mi zad dug rlangs rab tu 'thib pa'i gur: drag po'i tsha snying sna khrag sna bsam mi khyab: drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dgyes bzhes sangs rgyas bstan la 'tshe ba yi: dgra gdon bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: hoḥ drang srong chen po yab yum 'khor bcas la: rmad byung gsang ba'i mchod pa bla med pa: snang stong rdor pad mnyam nyid zung du sbyor: gnyis snang 'khrul rtog shes rab mtshon gyis bsgral: 'khor 'das phyam brdal rang rig nyag pa'i mig gis brgyan: dug mda' ltong dmar sgro lnga gnam lcags mdel: byas 'di rwa la dug sdong khyod la 'bul: dgyes bzhes bdag la gnod byed dgra 'dre byur: mi kha bra mchu ngos shag lkog lab mkhan: kha
