gsum khyab par 'jug: dam nyams rnams la bka' chad phral du 'beb: sgrub mchog dam ldan bu ltar skyong mdzad pa: rdzogs chen bka' yi bstan bsrung mthu bo che: gza' bdud ma ning nag por phyag 'tshal bstod: mchod gtor bzhes la rdzogs chen bstan pa bsrung : sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan ston la dgra bo bsod: ci ltar bcol ba'i 706

'phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: dza: gdug pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ba: rak+ka glog 'phreng klu mo khrag mig ma: 'jigs pa'i chas 'dzin srog gcod las la brtsonoḥ dgra bgegs myur bsgral dam nyams rtsad nas bcad: srin nag yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: dbyings kyi ma mo sman gyi skur bstan nas: dam tshig can skyongs dam nyams dgra bo la: mi bzad thog char dbab nas byang chub bar: sgrol mdzad thogs kyi bdag mo nam mkha'i sman: ma mo chen mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ya: drag shul rmad byung gnod sbyin yongs kyi rje: rgyal ba'i mchod gyur gsang sngags bsrung ma che: gdug pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs rtsad nas bcad: shan pa dmar nag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyu bh+yo: phyi nang gsang ba sprul pa'i gza' chen po: rgyu skar gdong mo dregs pa sde brgyad sogs: snang srid dregs pa gza' yi dmag dpung che: ma lus 'khor dang bcas la bdag gis bstod: sprul pa mi nag sngags nag shan pa dang : lce spyang stag gzig dom dred 'phar spyang sogs: ma nges rdzu 'phrul du ma'i rtsal bsgyur pa: yang 'khor bcas la dam tshig dbang gis bstod: mchod gtor bzhes la 'phrin las thogs med mdzod: de ltar drang srong sgra gcan 'khor bcas la: mchod cing bstod nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni+oḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgyes pa'i zhal ston brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs: mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas: 'dod dgu'i bsam don 'bad med 'grub pa dang : mi mthun nad gdon rkyen ngan bar chad zhi: tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod mnga' thang spel: rigs rgyud chos rgyud nus med dar rgyas shing : lha chen mi chen ma lus dbang du bsdus: dgra bgegs byad ma sgab 'dre byur sri dang : bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa ma lus kun: drag shul stobs kyis ma lus brlag par mdzod: mdor na bdag ni 'di phyi tshe rabs kun: drang srong khyod kyi zhabs brtan bsrung skyob cing : bu ltar skyong nas 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi: 'bad med rab 'grub khyad par rnam dkar las: mi nyams gong 'phel mthun dgu bsgrub pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe bsring ba dang ཿོ dam tshig sel med smin grol gdams ngag rgyas: byang chub chen po myur 'grub 'phrin las mdzod: sarba sirnyi me pra yats+tshan tu swā hā:zhes bskyed cing mchod bstod kyi gzhung bsrang la: gnyis pa bzlas pa bya ba'i rim par: rang nyid me shes ra hu la mdun bskyed ci 'dra ba sku mdog dkar po'i snying pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje/ de yi thugs kar pad 'byung yab yum rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs can: de yi thugs kar ye shes ra hu la phra gsal nyung dkar 'bras bu tsam pa: de yi thugs kar sa bon bcas gsal ba'i mdun du dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku nam mkha'i khams dad+ngha ༵nyam

pa'i thugs ye shes chen po'i klong du drang srong 'jig rten pa gtso 'khor gzhal yas khang bcas gsal ba'i ngang du ma yengs par sngags 'dis 'bod de: rag sha ra hu la: hri shag ru ram̐ tun na gi tsit+ta tram̐ ma ma yo za sgro ha he yo ke she la dza dza: zhes bsnyen pa'i dus su brgya rtsa re dang : sgrub pa'i dus su rtags dang sbyar la bzla ste/ de ni rtsa ba'i 'dzab sngags dang : gtso 'khor bye brag tu bsgrub pa ni:rang mdun gtso 'khor so so yi: thugs kar rang rang sa bon mthar: sngags 'phreng 'khor nas 'od zer gyis: srog snying blang la sems gtad ngang : gtso bo'i srog gi snying po ni: oṃ ke ta ke te swā hā: tri dza wa ri ra hu la dzā: yab srin po'i srog sngags ni: sha ka rak+ṣa ka ra hūṃ: ma srin mo'i srog sngags ni: bh+yo mi li phaṭa: nā ga mi haṃ shaṃ tri dza dza: yum gnam sman gyi srog sngags ni: oṃ a na le sa a dza rgyu: sras mchog gnod sbyin gyi srog sngags ni: e ho me ru tse lhu na hri ti khra bh+yo: zhes bzla zhing : gtso 'khor spyi dril gyi sngags ni: oṃ ā: rgyu badz+ra pā ni ke ta ke ta ra hu la rak+ṣa yak+ṣa nā gi a na le sa a rag mo trag tri: dza: yo ram̐ lo khaṃ kai swā hā: zhes pa gtso 'khor spyi dang bye brag skabs thob ci rigs su bzla zhing : rtag tu dran pa lha yi bskyed rim ma yengs ba gnad do: de ltar bzlas pa'i rtags su+oḥ dngos nyams rmi lam du: thog ser rlung 'tshub drag pos bag dro ba dang :'brug dang sbrul dang : ra rog dang : mi nag sngags nag a tsa ra/ bya nag khyi nagagayag nag lug nag rta nag dang / mon pa pho mo dang / spyang ki dang / 'phar ba dang / gzhan yang 'od dang zer dang sgra dang / thog 'tshag pa/ mig mang ris dang / dud pa dang / 'ja' tshon dang / mi ring nag po sogs byung zhing : mdor na de dag rnams kyang rang la gus par byed pa sogs byung na legs shing / khro 'khrug mi gus pa'i tshul gyis byung na lha yi nga rgyal bsar la bcun no: khyad par du dngos su rgyu dus dang : sngags bzla ba dang / mchod bstod kyi dus su glog 'od 'khyug pa dang / ra gzhob dang / rang gi lus bri be re ba dang / mgo thom pa dang / zil chen po dang / sha 'gul ba dang /'dar ba sogs 'byung ste de dag nye ba'i rtags yin pas gang byung yang 'jigs skrag ya nga khu khrir dang dga' spro snyem pa gang yang mi byed par rang mdangs rgyu 'bras dang rten 'brel rol par shes shing lta ba chos nyid kyi ngang du 'jog pa gnad dam pa'o: mthar drang srong zhal brtan pa'i dus ni nam mkha' sa gzhi thams cad 'ja' 'od du 'khyil ba'i klong du sku mthong bar gsungs so: de ltar bzlas pa'i thun mtshams rnams su yid kyis mchod cing bstod bskul yang bya la: gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni: mdun gyi drang srong chen po 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim gtso bo la thim gtso bo yang rang gi sa bon la thim: rang lus yang 'od du zhu nas snying gi sa bon 708

la thim: snying ga'i sa bon mthar thig ler gyur nas de yang ko mog tu rdo skyur ba ltar mtha' nas yal te: rang sems dang drang srong gza' bdud kyi ngo bo nyid dbyer med ngang du mnyam par bzhag ste:de yang snang srid kyi chos nyid don dam gshis kyi ngo bor yin min spang blang lha 'dre zhes ma grub pa chos sku brjod bral gnas lugs ngo bor thag gcod do+oḥ mdor na rang rig gzo med zang ka ma dri bral rjen pa 'di ni rgyal ba kun gyi thugs te dpal gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'o: de ltar rig pa'i rang mdangs rtogs tshogs 'gag med wal le ba 'di ni drang srong chen po'o: des na drang srong gza' bdud ra hu la nag po zhes pa dang : gza' bdud ma ning nag po zhes: ma rig pa'i gyog po sangs nas ye shes ngo bo nyid du drangs bas na drang srong : chos nyid kyi ngo bo ni gza' gtad dang bral bas na gza': 'khrul snang gi dri ma 'joms par byed pas na bdud: chos dbyings skye ba med pas na rā: longs sku zung du 'jug pas na hu: sprul sku 'gag pa med pas na ma: chos nyid ka dag 'gyur ba med pas na nag: myang 'das grol 'khrul dang bral bas na so: zhes dang / yang gnas lugs kyi ngo bo mtha' dang bral bas na gza': 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang gcod pas na bdud:'khor 'das dang gsal stong yod med sogs gnyis chos mtha' dag gnyis su med pas ma ning :chos kyi sku la sgrib g.yog dang blos byas 'dod pa spros mtshan bral ba zang kha ma yin pas na nag po ste:de ltar drang srong gza' bdud ma ning nag po ni rang gi rig pa gzo med tha mal gyi shes pa hur re ba ngo bo smras bsam brjod bral 'di ka ste gza' ni rang rig 'di las gzhan du ma mchis pas la zla'o: ha ha he ho ho ho hūṃ: e ma ngo mtshar rang gi sems: sems can kun gyi sems dpa' mor: ye sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bo 'byung : thog mtha' dus bzhi kun tu gnas: rang ngo ma shes dri mas sgrib:ngo shes rang rig kun tu bzang : kun bzang g.yo med cho 'phrul las: 'khor ba myang 'das bde sdug sogs: du ma 'phro zhing du mar snang : 'phro la ngo bo brjod dang bral: brjod bral shes pa zang kha ma: blta med blta ba po yang med: sems med sems kyi yul las 'das: rtogs tshogs lha yin ye shes sems: bdag la phan pa du ma ston: rtog tshogs 'dre yin nag po bdudoḥ bdag la gnod pa 'ba' zhig bskyal: lha 'dre ha ha rang rang gi sems: rang sems lha 'dre 'ba' zhig go: lha mchod 'dre brdung ro dor khyod: da ni chos sku'i thang la khrol: mtha' bral yod med gnyid las 'das: phaṭa phaṭa 'ub chub dbyings su bsdus: rang la gad mo rang gi'o: dregs pa rtogs na sku gsum yin: ma rtogs chos sku bdud du 'khrul: byed po rang sems a ha ha: hoḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma thod 'phreng gis: rjes 'jug byar med rdzogs chen gyi: rnal 'byor las kyi rdo rje nga : 709

nga bral kye ma spros dang bral: rang rig gza' rgod chos skur mjal: mjal lo drag po rdo rje glu:phyogs bral khyon yangs nam mkha' yi: rnal 'byor nga yi gad mo'o: skal ldan dag gi mthong na ltos: ma mthong ba yang ngo mtshar che: bde chen mchog gi rtogs pa'o: lha 'dre stong gi dra ba ste:gza' bdud srog gi snying po'o: badz+ra ra hu la a phaṭa: de ltar dpal drang srong nag po bskyed bzlas rdzogs pa'i man ngag khyad par can ghu h+ya: zab rgya: don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa cho 'phrul srog ser mnan bsreg 'phang ba ni gzhan du gsal la:thun mtshams stod kyi bya ba gtor ma bshams zhing spos bsur rol mo bcas te 'di skad do: r+ghaṃ bh+yo:ya dza: phyogs bral chos nyid nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas: ma skyed dpal chen kun bzang che ba'i mchog: 'gag med rang mdangs 'jam dpal rta mchog dpal: thugs kyi ye shes gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: thugs nyid zhi las khro bo'i skur snang nasoḥ gdug pa'i ru tra ma lus bsgral mdzad pa:gza' bdud ma ning nag po'i sku bzhengs shig: bh+yoḥ ya: bskal pa me 'bar khrag mtsho khol ma'i klong : sku gsum rang bzhin e yi gzhal yas nang : 'phrin las bzhi rdzogs 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i lter: lha mchog gshin rje khros pa'i sku bsgyur ba: ki kai drag po me 'bar rog ti che: sgra gcan dug gi sdong po chen po ni: sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i tshul ston pa: chos nyid don la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda': dbu dgu theg dgu'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i brda': zhal dgu skye dgu 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod byed: mche so drug skye shi rtsad nas gzhom: ljang dmar dgu 'dril skye mched dgu la rol: rtsa bdun can gyi chos nyid bden pa gzigs: bco brgyad snyan gyis stong nyid ye shes rtogs: rus pa'i snyan cha dkar po khrol ba ni: gti mug rnam dag me long ye shes brda': ral pa me dpung gyen du spyod pa ni: nyon mongs bag chags dri ma bsregs par byed: thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan pa ni: sku lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brda': dbu gtsug bya rog mgo yi brgyan pa ni: srid pa gsum gyi mel tshe byed pa dang : rdzogs chen a ti'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i brda':bcu gnyis phyag gis rten 'brel bcu gnyis bzlog: yang dag nges pa'i sa la sbyor bar mdzad:phyag g.yas dang po ral gri me 'bar bsoḥ nyon mongs mun pa'i dra ba gcod par byed: g.yon gyi dang po chu srin rgyal mtshan 'phyar: bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam par rgyal ba'i brda': bar pa gnyis kyi rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs: rten 'brel zung 'jug 'gro kun 'dul ba'i brda': g.yas kyi gsum pas dug sbrul 'dzin pa ni+oḥ bstan pa'i dgra bo ma lus phung pa'i brda'oḥ g.yon gyi gsum pas glog zhags bsnams pa ni: dam nyams rnams kyi lnga phung 'ching bar byed: g.yas kyi bzhi pas 710

dgra sta kha che gdengs: dug lnga'i 'khrul 'khor rtsad nas sgyel bar byed: g.yon gyi bzhi pas khram shing bsnam pa ni: bstan la sdang byed khram la 'debs par byed: g.yas kyi lnga pas spu gri 'phyar ba yi: dgra bgegs srog rtsa glo bur gcod par byed: g.yon gyi lnga pas tsit+ta dmar po 'phyar:bdag 'dzin ru tra rtsad nas gcod par byed: tha gnyis nyi zla cha lang gdab pa ni: gnyis 'dzin dgra bo'i tshogs rnams rlag byed cing : bde chen mnyam pa'i don la sbyor ba'i brda': spyan dmar stong gi sku lus brgyan pa ni: sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrung bar byed: sku ni nag po khrag gi ra ri 'charoḥ ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: phyag mgul bdug pa dug gis sbrul gyis brgyan:zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang dgra bo brlag: mi lpags g.yang bzhi'i khrag 'dzag gsol ba ni: nga rgyal tshul gyis nga rgyal dregs gyur gshed: dar nag cod pan rlung gi skyod pa ni: phra dog bdud dpung ma lus 'dul ba'i brda': sma ra smin ma ag tshom me 'bar bas: 'dod chags 'khrug pa'i dgra rnams bsregs par byed: kha nas khrag rgyun nad kyi rlangs pa 'thul: mtshon cha'i char 'bebs mi bzad nga ro sgrogasoḥ sku smad sbrul mjug dud pa'i mdangs ldan 'khyil: lto bar za byed 'jigs pa'i zhal gdang nas: dgra bgegs byad ma ma lus hab hab gsol: gdug pa chu srin mgo dgu la zhon nas: skad cig se gol tog pa'i yud tsam la: srid gsum ma lus lan brgyar nyul bar byed:sku la me rlung du 'tshub thog mer dang : glog 'od dug rlangs khams nag 'ja' ru 'khyil: sprul pa'i bya can mi nag sngags nag dang : a tsar mon pa bdud nag zhag thog 'gyed: gshin rje khram thog 'bum sde las la bkol: snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad yongs kyi bskor: 'gro ba'i tshe dang srog la dbang byed pa'i: rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung ye shes mgon po'i bran: gza' bdud ma ning nag por phyag 'tshal bstodoḥ khyed ni rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa ste: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bsrung ma chen po yin: khyod ni sngags bsrung khros ma'i bka' bstod ste: rdzogs chen yang gsang bka' yi gnyer 'dzin yin: khyod ni rig 'dzin pad+ma thod 'phreng gis: bka' sgos dam la bzhag pa'i dge bsnyen te: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor rnams kyi dgra lha yin: ma g.yel ma lab gza' mchog dam la 'dusoḥ gum gum chum chum tshur byon grogs la byon: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blang ltar:dam rdzas gser skyems dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po myur du ston:bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo glo bur sod: ci bcol 'phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: hūṃ bh+yo: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: yab gcig srin po rak+ka dzā la ni: dmar smug dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa gnyis: rtsa bdun spyan gyi bstan pa'i bya ra mdzadoḥ tshems dkar so 711

drug dgra bo'i sha khrag rol: phyag g.yas thod dbyug dgra bgegs lnga phung bcom: g.yon gyi thod par dam nyams snying khrag rngub: sku stod mi lpags khrag gi rgyun 'dzag gsol: stag lpags sham thab khrag 'dzag mgo 'phreng rgyan: glog gi 'od khyug dmar ser ral pa rjes: chibs su ro lang thal mdog mgo dgu zhon: 'khor du sha za srin po bye bas bskor: dam nyams rnams la bka' chad phral du 'bebs: zhing bcu tshang ba'i srog gi gshed ma ste: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu ldan pa: srin po chen po khyed la bdag gis bstod: dam rdzas dmar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes loḥ sngon tshe shāka thug phyag rdor pad 'byung gi: spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas ji bzhin du: sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po myur du ston: dam nyams mnal zan srog dbugs myur du bsdus:bstan dgra rnams la gri 'thab cho 'phrul gtong : ci bcol 'phrin las thogs med myur 'grub mdzod: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khol ma'i nang shed na: yum gcig klu mo rdo rje glog 'gyu ma: mdog nag dbu dgu sbal mgo khrag gi migoḥ phyag gnyis g.yas pas klu shing klu rnams 'dul: g.yon na khrag mtsho dgra bgegs dmyal thag gcod: sku smad sbrul mjug dug sbrul mgo dgu chibs: dug rlang 'ja' sprin na bun nang du bzhugs: rin chen rgyan dang sbrul rigs lnga yi spras: 'khor du klu dang srin mo 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig can la bu ltar skyong byed cing :dam nyams rnams la bka' chad phral du 'bebasoḥ gsang sngags bka' yi bsrung ma mthu bo che: rdo rje klu mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod: dam rdzas dmar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po myur du ston: dam nyams rnams la mdze nad cho 'phrul btong : ci ltar bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: dgung sngon rlung nag 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus: sprin nag thog ser 'khrugs pa'i klong shed nas: nam mkha'i sman gcig thog gi bu yug ma: 'bar ma mi yi mdog 'dra blta ba yi: mi bzod spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba brtsigs:gcer bu gser g.yu'i phyag zhabs gdu bu 'khrol: sprin dkar stod g.yog chos nyid dri ma bral:dar dkar smad g.yog 'phrin las bzhi mnga' brnyes: ral bseb zla tshes ma rig mun pa bsal:lte bar nyi 'bar 'dod khams dbang du bsdud: phyag g.yas thog 'beb dam nyams thal bar rlog:phyag g.yon ser chen dgra yul 'joms par byed: chibs su g.yu 'brug rlung gshog mgo dgu chibasoḥ ye shes grub kyang las kyi ma mo'i tshul: stong khams khyab rgyu zhing bcu'i skye rgyun gcod:'khor du snang srid sman mo yongs kyi bskoroḥ rdo rje nam mkha'i sman la phyag 'tshal bstod: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blang bzhin: dam rdzas dmar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: sgrub 712

pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po myur du ston: slob bu dam log mna' zan byed pa rnams: stong khams gang du 'dug kyang thog char gyi: ma thogs glo bur nyid du sgrol la shog: ci bcol 'phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: 'od dmar rab tu 'tsher ba'i nang shed noḥ drang srong gza' mchog chen po'i sras gcig po: gnod sbyin mig dmar byi ru lhun po'i mdangs: khrag gi ral bseb dug gi char pa 'beboḥ dgra la oṃ tshigs sma smin me ru 'bar: spyan gsum 'bru tshug khro gnyer rba lab 'khrug: phyag bzhi g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar ba yi: dgra bgegs lus srog tshal pa dum bur btub: g.yon gyi dang po thod pa bsnam nas ni: dam tshig nyams pa'i klad khrag 'thung bar byed: g.yas kyi gnyis pas gri gug gdeng pa ni: dgra bo'i glo snying tshal par 'phen par byed:g.yon gyi gnyis pas mi snying 'dzin pa ni: zhing bcu'i tshe srog rab tu 'phrog par byed: mi lpags mgo 'phreng dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: chibs su zangs kyi khyung dmar mgo dgu zhon: 'khor du gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: sangs rgyas bstan bsrung khyad par pad 'byung gis: brgyud 'dzin bu ltar skyong ba'i drag shul canoḥ mi srun mthu rtsal rmad du cher byung ba: dam nyams mna' zan rnams kyi srog bdud che: gnod sbyin dmar nag khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas dmar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes loḥ sngon tshe zhal bzhes ci bzhin deng 'di ru: sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po myur du ston: gsang sngags bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo dang : mna' zan snying ring ngo log rgyab bstan pa'i: tshe srog lo zlar ma 'gyang myur du chod: ci bcol 'phrin las thogs med myur 'grub mdzod: hūṃ bh+yo: phyogs mtshams khrag mtsho khol ma'i nang shed na: sprul pa sde brgyad dmag dpon king rka brgyad: nad btang ma mo'i ki rka chen po ste: tshes ba'i/'i srod la nub nas shar na rgyu: yam nad 'bebs pa dgra lha'i king kai ste: tshes brgyad drod chen shar lho nub byang rgyu:bal nad 'beb pa gshin rje'i king kai ste+oḥ bcu gcig nam 'bying byed yol byang lhor rgyu: 'dre rgod btang ba srin gyi king rka ste: bco lnga'i nyin phyed lho nub byang shar rgyu: bying nad btang ba smu yi king kai ste+oḥ bco brgyad nam phyed shar nas nub tu rgyu: gzer nad gtang ba btsan gyi king kai ste:nyer gnyis phyed yol nub byang shar lhor rgyu: mdze nad btang ba klu yi king kai ste: nyer lnga'i skya reng lho nas byang du rgyu: lha nad 'bebs pa lha yi king kai ste: nyer dgu'i myur smad byang shar lho nub rgyu:kun kyang sde brgyad dmag dpung 'bum 'bum bskor: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma gser skyems bzhes: sngon tshe khrag 'thung spyan sngar khas blang bzhin: rnal 'byor bdag la sdang byed dgra dang bgegs: dmag jag mtshon dug sbyor ngan 'chang byed dang : ngos shag lkog lam gsang 'chal 713

brun rkun mkhan: snga dgra lag byas phyi dgra yid la sems: da dgra thad du long ba gyur pa rnams:skad cig nyid la ming med rlag par mdzodoḥ dam tshig dus la bab po sa ma yā: hūṃ bh+yo: phyogs bzhi nam mkha'i yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dus bzhi dbang bsgyur rtag pa'i rgyal mo ste:gdong mo chen mo mched de rnam pa bzhi: shar nas stag srin zor ba'i gdong pa can: lho nas shi srin dred kyi gdong pa can: nub nas rkang srin ba lang gdong pa can: byang nas 'brog srin chu srin gdong pa can: kun kyang ral pa gyen rdzes thur du 'phyang : mi sdug srin mo khros pa'i gzugs 'chang ma: lag na mngon spyod mtshon cha ma nges thogs: thog ser glog 'od skyi ser drag po 'bebs: lo ma me tog 'bras bu'i bcud rnams bsdud: dgra bo'i tshe bla srog dbugs longs spyod byed: rnal 'byor bdag gi ci bcol 'phrin las bsgruboḥ slob bu dam log chung ma snying ring dang :bran pho mna' zan dkor jag brung rkun dang : ngos shag lkog lab bsam ngan sbyor rtsub mkhanoḥngos log rgyab bstan phod gtsug do brdo ba'i: tshe srog lo zlar ma 'gyang myur du sgrol: bsad rtags don snying mtshan ma khyer la shog: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā+oḥ r+ghaṃ bh+yo+oḥ gza' bdud ma ning khyod kyi sprul 'khor ni: 'byung lngar dbang bsgyur lha chen gza' rgod brgyad: nyi zla mig dmar lhag pa phur bu dang : pa sangs spen pa du ba mjug ring che: rgyu skar lha mo chen mo nyi shu brgyad:gzhan yang drang srong nag po'i bka' sdod ni: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang bsgyur ba'i: lha srin dregs pa'i sde tshogs bsam mi khyab: shar lho nub byang steng 'og phyogs mtshams du+oḥ khyab par rgyu nas bstan dgra'i srog dbugs bsdud: kun kyang rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung chen po ste: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma gser skyems bzhes: sngon tshe khrag 'thung chen po'i spyan snga ru: khas blang dam bcas ji bzhin ma g.yel bar: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po bsrung ba dang : gsang sngags bstan 'dzin skyes ba'i sku tshe bsring : dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs sgrub pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi ci bcol 'phrin las kun: thogs pa med par myur du 'grub par mdzodoḥ dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: r+ghaṃ bh+yo: drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam dus la babs:bdag gi 'phrin las gnad nas bskul ba'i don: sangs rgyas bstan dang bla ma'i sku yi dgra:bsam ngan sbyor rtsub ngos shag lkog lab mkhan: sku dgra rnam lnga nyams pa bdun gyur dang : bsgral ba'i zhing bcu sgrol ba'i dus la babs: chung ma bran 'khor ngo log snying ring dang : chos kyi khrims gshig dbang chos tshod yod mkhan: rdzun zhus mgo skor tho co dregs spyod byed: kha dkar zhe nag kha nang snying phyir gyu: phyag rdzas phri zhog zur bkol phrog 'jom 'jab: blang rkun mna' zan bka' 714

'gal byed pa dang : khyad par slob bu dam las log pa 'dis: slob dpon thugs dkrug dam tshig khyad du bsad: ngo log rgyab bstan ngon btags sgro bkur 'debs: las rgya g.yel zhing ngan spyod rna 'dren byed: 'di bzhag srid na dus gsum rgyal ba bslu: ngan song kha 'phel gsang sngags che ba bri: bsrung ma rnams kyang nus pa mi nyams sam: bcol ba'i las 'di khyod kyis ma mdzad na: rdo rje 'chang gi bka' chad phog ta re: de bas bcol 'di g.yel med mdzad dus bab: bdag la sdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo la: lo zlar mi 'gyang rtags mtshan mi ston na: tshe zad dus su khyod kyi nus pa ci: do nub nyid du sgrol ba'i dus la bab: rbad kyang mi 'gro bcol kyang mi mdzad na: bdag gi khyod nyid brten pa'i dgos pa ci: glo bur hur thum dgra srog ma bcad noḥ khyod nus stobs kyis bdag la ji ltar phan: des na ma g.yel myur du dam nyams sgrol: snying gshog snying khrag 'thung la srog rtsa gcod: sa steng ma bzhag thal ba rdul du thong : 'ur 'ur cho cho dam nyams dgra la yoḥrgyugs rgyugs breng breng rtags mtshan da lta thong : dgra srog mā ra ya rbad sod thun bh+yo: tsit+ta trig nan ni e hur thums dza: bla mtshong dbugs bsdus drod long srog rtsa btub: tshe btung lus sems phyes zhig myur du bsodoḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā: bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: rak+karwa hu la trī shag ru ram̐ run nā gi tsit+ta dha ram̐ ma ma yo za dha ra ke she la dza dza:rā hu la hri shag ru ram̐ rak+ka ram̐: nag po mgo dgu dgra bo'i srog la thun thun: hri pa sha mi li rak+ka rā hu la bh+yo: zhes thal mo brdab cing gtor ma rgyu phyogs su 'phang bas theb par nges so/ /de ltar drang srong chen po sgrub pa'i zhal gdams gnad rnam pa lnga ste: thog mar phyag rdor dang gza' yi dbang lung tshang bar thob cing rta phyag gi bsnyen pa bye ba re bskyal ste des ni gong non cing bkra shis pa'i gnad do: de nas ma sgrub pa'i gong du dus gnyan brgyad la gtor ma 'bul zhing mchod bstod byas pas snying nye la 'khu log mi 'byung ba'i gnad do: sgrub pa'i dus su tshes gcig la zhugs nas nyer dgur 'bod rbad bsad gsum rdzogs par byas nas gnam stong la mnan bsreg 'phang bas mjug bsdu ste sgrub dus mun mtshams sam mi khyi gang dang gdong mi sprad par ngag bcad la bzlas pas mi zhud mi sdog cing las la myur ba'i gnad do: sgrub pa'i rdzas rten gtor ma gang la yang 'bag btsog mi shor zhing gtsang mar byed pa dang : rdzas rnams la gri sha gri khrag sogs kho dang mi mthun pa'i rdzas rnams spangs ba dang :dam nyams mdze yugs dme mnal gyi kha blang dri mas ma gos par gces shing / kho sgrub pa'i khang par mi gzhan 'dzam pas rtags mtshan bzang po bcas myur du 'grub pa'i gnad do: khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma la dam sel med cing : stong nyid kyi don rtogs sam: gnyen po'i lhar bsnyen sgrub them pa dang :715

chos skyong gtor ma khengs shing sgrub thabs lag len rang blos ma slad par gzhung bzhin nyams su len cing gzhus pa'i phyir brtson na chos skyong gang yang mi 'grub mi srid pa'i gnad do: gzhan yang rang dang dam tshig gcig pa dang bstan par phan pa dang nyes med snyad chung rnams la mi rbad pa dam tshig yin no: shin tu zab pa'i zhal gdams so: ghu sgyu rgya: de ltar drang srong sgra gcan nag po yi: las gzhung stong thun zab mo khyad par can: rab 'jigs bskal me 'khrugs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes: rgyal ba gong ma'i phyag len sgrub gzhung dang : zab gter 'khrul med rnams nas gsungs pa'i don: mthong dang khyad par bdag snying bum pa ru: rgyal ba pad 'byung 'od zer cha shas gcig: shar ba'i mthu las rang sems gdod ma'i gshis: skye 'gag gnas btsan bral las rang byung gdangs: 'char cha 'gag med sor rtogs ye shes rtsal: las byung drang srong sgrub pa'i las rim che: lha dang bla mas snang ba thob pa dang : rten 'brel dus la bab tshe bkod pa ste: mi shes mkhas 'dod rtog ges tsam pa dang : bka' lung dkrugs dang 'dra min bsre slad kyi: gzhan gdams rku ba'i dri mas 'dir ma gos: dge des sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po che: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bshad sgrub ste: nub med dar rgyas 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig: zhes pa 'di nyid ni bdag chung ngu : lo bcu gcig gi dus su rmi lam snang bar gza' brgyad yin zhes lcags sdig 'dra ba brgyad mthong zhing tha ma des bdag la srong snying phul tshul dang / rang lo bco brgyad skabs su dmar nag mig gis gang ba'i gzugs can du rdo rje bsrung ma 'ga' dang lhan du mthong zhing : khyad par rang lo nyer gsum par drang srong mngon sum du snang nas 'phrin las sgrub pa'i zhal bzhes byung zhing :ma 'gyang bar rang la zhe nag pa 'ga' lnga par 'god song bar ya mtshan zhing / de nas rgyun du rang la 'go ba'i ltas 'ga' shar ba dang bcas te/ 'phral du yang don gnyer can gyi bskul ba yang dus la bab par shes shing / bsrung ma yang dgyes pa'i ltas shar ba la rten nas dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes bzlum pa'i bdag nyid te ru ka bde chen gling pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa gsung rab rgya mtsho'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ dus snyigs mar sngags 'chang gi zol 'dzin pa chang dang bud med na chung la longs spyod pa'i sprang rgan tshe dbang nor bu las kyi rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis rang lo nyer lnga lhag pa'i dus su gnas mchog dhe wa ko ṭa'i cha shas brag skad/ kong dza lar shing sbrul hor zla dang por bkod pa ste 'dri la 'dra min bsre bslad bzo bcos rtsi gzhi thu ba sogs byas na drang srong nag pos bka' yi chad pa chod cig: dam ldan rnams kyi ci bsam yid bzhin chos dang mthun pa'i btong grogs mdzod cig:badz+ra sa ma yā rda dza: 'di nyid bka' rab tu gnyan par yod do: sa ma ya: zab rgya: sa ma 716

ya: zab rgyoḥ sarba maṅga lo: shu lha:gag /la dwags rgyal po dang mu we rgyal po gnyis kyi chings 'dum la phebs skor/ /oṃ swāste sidhi rti rā dzo bha waskyo/ mi 'gyur gdod nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /'bri gang las 'das rtag pa g.yung drung che/ /srid zhi phun tshogs dpal kun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal chos sku ngo bo nyid/ /kun gyi rgyud du til la mar bzhin du/ /gnas mdo gser la g.ya' bzhin glo bur gyis/ /sgrib pa gsal byed bden gnyis zung 'jug sku/ /dran mchog bla ma kun tu bzang por 'dud/ /rnam kun mi 'gyur bde ba tshad med pa yi nam mkha'i mthar gtugs sems can sgrol slad du/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas 'gyur yi dam zhi dang khro bo mchog gi sprul sku tshad med thugs rje'i gar/ /de sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang slob gyur rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gang gi thugs dang zhal la legs gnas lung dang rtogs pa dam pa'i chos rin chen sgron me che/ /rin chen mchog gsum rab tu gnyen zhing bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i phyir/ /sa bcu'i mgon po rdo rje chos skyong chen por sprul dang de las gzhan/ /'jig rten las kyi tshul snang phyogs skyong zhing skyong bsrung ma dam tshig can/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'byams klas legs nyes btang 'dzin rig dus kun mkhyen che/ /de ltar gcig dang du ma'i spros bral gocig du ma/ /rang shar dkon mchog rin chen rtsa ba gsum gyi tshogs/ /ma grub bzhin snang sgyu 'dra'i 'gro la dus rtag par/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rtog med rjes chags kyi/ /rgyun chad med mdzad de la bskul brtan mi 'tshal yang / /gnyis 'dzin las nyon sgrib pas bcing rnams snyigs dus kyi/ /mi bzad duḥ khas rab tu mnar la ma bzod pas/ /dpung dang ra mdar sgran gyis dus 'dir dgongs mdzod la/ /skye dgu spyi dang bye brag rgyal ba'i bstan/ /nyer gnas gangs ri'i bskor ba'i yul ljongs 'dir/ /nad zhi mu ge med cing khyad par du/ /mtha' dmag gdug pa'i mtshon skal yongs nyams nas/ /ris med 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal bzang pos/ /bsrung phyir gangs can mgon po'i phrin las su/ /mar yul bdag po'i legs bzlum bdag 'bad 'di/ /ji bzhin dus srid bar du gnas par mdzod/ ces skyabs yul rnams la mchog tu gus pas rang blo ngal gso ba'i slad du gsol 'debs shugs 'byung 'gag pa med pa'i tshigs su bcad pa kha shas shig gi mdun bsus te 'dir brjod par bya ba/ de yang rgyal ba chos kyi sku yi zhing nam mkha'i mtha' thug pa nyid du rgya chad 717

phyogs lhung las 'das pa mi gnas gnas pa chen po'i brdar bzhag pa de las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing rgyan stug po bkod pa ye shes kyi gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma bcom par sla ba/ de las mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i zhing lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i gnas las ma g.yos bzhin du bsgyur ba'i zlos gar 'jig rten gyi khams stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya'i bdag nyid can ston pa sku gsum gyi rgyal ba chos kyi sku chos kyi dbyings gcig tu mnyam bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gcig dang tha dad pa ma yin pa/ sprul pa'i sku gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin ma 'dres so sor snang ba'i bdag nyid can rgyal ba thams cad kyi bkod pa rtag par mnyam pa/ de lta bu las dus 'dir rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rjes bzod pa dang ldan pa mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams lha rnams kyi gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma bcu phrag brgyar byas pa rgyal ba'i dge mtshan gyi spras pa mthong bas bskal pa bzang po zhes gdags pa rnam 'dren mchog gyur stong las bzhi pa khams gsum gyi bla ma/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ srid pa gsum gyi sgron me/ mtshungs pa mi mnga' ba bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i dbang po shākya'i tog shākya don kun grub pa zhes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan rnams las ches rmad du byung ba'i thugs bskyed kyis dzasbu gling gi skye dgu bskal pa rtsod ldan gyi mtha' la mthar thug pa pha la phar mi 'dzin zhing / ma la mar mi 'dzin pa/ bram ze dang dge sbyong la khyad par du mi byed cing / mi dge ba'i las lam bcu yongs su bdo zhing mtshams med pa'i las la zhugs pa'i dus su dga' ldan gyi gnas chos kyi rgyal mtshan mthon po nas skye ba sprul pa'i sku dam pa tog dkar po nyid gzigs pa lngas dzasbu gling du skye ba'i srid pa yongs su bzung ba'i tshul snang bar byas te mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang bla na med pa ste tshul bcu gnyis legs par brtan pa chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bden pa bzhi dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa snying po'i gtam ste/ dang po ni drang ba dang / bar ba ni nges pa'i don rtsa ba nyid dang / phyi ma ni nges don gsal ba legs par rnam par dbye ba bshad sbyar tshul gyi ste gdul bya rnams rang rang dbang skal dang mthun par dkri bar mdzad cing /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rnams ni thun mong gi gnas o rgyan gyi yul dang dpal ldan 'bras spungs sogs su yang snang bar mdzad cing thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje btsun mo'i mkhar rtag tu gnas bzhin par brtan par mdzad pa dang / gdul bya 'ga' zhig la dgongs te theg pa gsar la ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur du lung bstan pa'i tshul yang mdzad nas thun mong gi ngor byang phyogs gyad kyi yul rtswa can du dgung lo brgyad bcu par mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul sprul pa'i sku longs sku bzhi mthun pa'i bkod pas/zhi ba chos kyi skur gshegs pa'i tshul bstan cing gang gi bstan pa rin chen sgron me yun ring du gnas 718

pa'i ched du thun mong gi sde snod rnams 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dang / rgyal tshab 'od srung sogs la gtad cing / theg chen rnams rigs gsum mgon po sogs nye sras rnams dang / rgyal tshab byams pa la nye bar gtad cing smon lam gyi mthu'i bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcu'am bcu gcig tu gnas par byin gyis rlabs shig de yang byang nas byang gi phyogs su 'phel zhing lho phyogs su bstud par gsung ba ltar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs kha bas yongs su brgyan pa'i ri bo'i khrod bho ṭa zhes bod du sgrogs pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bdag gir bzung ba'i yul khams sa yi dkyil 'khor rgya khyon ni mi khyim bye ba'i grangs su nye bas bcing ba'i yul gyi tshad can du mkhas pa'i dbang po kha cig gi bzhed bzhin sngon dus skye bo'i tshogs kyi yongs su khengs zhing 'byor bar nges kyang / deng dus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ rin chen dang mjal ba'i mi lus dam pa rnyed par dka' ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mi khyim gyi grangs ni de ltar smos kyang ci 'tshal te skye bo'i grangs yongs su bsdoms kyang de'i rjes su 'gro ba dka' bar snang la/ gang ltar yul ljongs 'dir 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi chad par byon nas sems can la phan cing bde ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ste/ de yang thog mar yul la dbang ba rgyal po'i tshul gyi 'dul bar dgongs te byang chub sems dpa' khyim na gnas pa'i tshul can chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon yab sras rnams rim par byon zhing de rnams kyi dus su rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams 'gro ba'i yul dus dbang po dang mtshams par slob dpon chen po dang mkhan po chen po sogs 'jig rten mig mkhas pa chen po rnams su snang bar mdzad nas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa dang srol gtod pa dang dar rgyas su spel bar byas shing / de nas yang rim pas da lta la thug gi bar mos pa tha dad kyi ngo bzhin paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dang / rab tu byung ba dang / dge bsnyen gyi tshul bsgrang gi mi chod pa byon te/ dam pa'i chos tshul gyi sgo phar brgya phrag du ma dbye bar mdzad cing / gdul bya rnams kyi 'khor ba'i sgo bcad/thar pa'i lam dbye byang chub kyi 'bras bu'i gsos rmad du byung ba yi/ sgyu 'phrul mdo dang sems klong man ngag gi sde 'dzin pa dang / lam 'bru dang bcas shing / chos drug gi gdams pa rigs gnyis dang /dus 'khor bde dgyes gsang 'dus kyi mtshon sngags bla na med pa'i chos tshul 'byams klas pa dang /gzhan yang gnyug ma'i don zab mo gtso bor ciston pa zhi byed spyod yul phyag chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dbu ma'i lta khrid sogs rnam grangs brjod par bka' ba dang / theg pa chen po lam gyi gzhung shing med du mi rung ba shing rta chen po'i srol bstan pa spyi'i rim pa'am byang chub lam rim du grags pa nyid dang / byang chub blo sbyong gi gdams pa tshogs du ma 'byams klas pa sogs mdor na bslab pa 719

gsum las tshul khrims kyi so thar byang sems rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa gsum gyi rgyun dang shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i man ngag rnam grangs tshad bzung las 'das pa kun kyang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal ba thar pa mchog gi lam du 'jug pa bla na med pa'i go 'phang bsgrod pa/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i shul du snyeg pa de lta bu'i chos tshul mchog tu gyur pa du mas 'dzam gling spyi las khyad par du byas pas gangs ri'i khrod 'di ni yul gyi cha nas dman pa dang nyung ngu nyid du zad kyang / mngon mtho nges legs kyi sgo nas gangs can bho ṭa nyid byang phyogs sham+bha la la lhag par bdo bu'i ngang tshul can ste/da lta 'dzam gling 'di na gdugs kyi tog gam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo bzhin mngon par mdzes shing 'phags pa gyur pa'i yul bod dang bod chen po gnyis su bzhag pa'i bod chen po zhes nyi 'og gi yul mdo khams sgang lnga'am sgang drug tu grags pa dang / bod kyi rgyal khams nyid la gling dgu bcad pa'i dbus 'gyur gyi mtshal tu bzhi dang / stod du rnam par gyes pa'i yul mnga' ri skor gsum ste/ de na skye rgu thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi mchod 'os lag na pad+mo 'dzin pa gang ngur smrig gar gyi sgeg pa nges legs kyi dad dpon chen po mngon mtho gru 'dzin gyi spor seng ge'i khrir 'jig rten mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur bdun pas yul dbus su bstan pa bskyang ba'i lo kan ldan lcags byi nas so gsum 'das shing da lta dpal gdong chu bya ste so bzhi'i steng du sleb pa dang / 'dzam gling phyogs kyi rgyal po chen po rnams las/ ta sig rgyal pos ha ta bāk+ṣaḥ ra 'bod pa shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i bar sa yi dkyil 'khor chen po la dbang mdzad chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs gong ma shub tsi na gyi gdung las gnam skos lhas skyong gi rgyal thabs bskyang nas lo bco brgyad pa/ lho phyogs 'phags pa'i yul rgya bal gyi mtshams sid+dha la nas rgya mtsho chen po'i bar sa yi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la dbang spyod pa nub phyogs ta sig ces dang / da ltar zur chag skad stag gzig zhes brjod pa kla klo'i rgyal po bā k+ṣuḥ dhe bhar+sha'i rigs las bāk+ṣu a ma rā zhes pas ḍi lir srid bskyang nas lo bdun gyi steng du gnas pa/ byang phyogs bsil ljongs dang nye ba'i yul sa ṭha na zhes sngar ḍi li'i 'og tu 'dus kyang da lta rang dbang du shas che ba yul na dir+ṣa nas byung ba'i rigs/ rā dza ma la ra khang gi srid skyong nas lo brgyad song ba'i skabs/ chu klung chen po'i nī la'i ngogs ri bo gangs can chen po'i lho smad kyi char 'dzam gling sum cha'i yul du mngon rlom kyi nga rgyal ldan pa bstan bcos rnams su rukla zhes dang / da lta zur chag gi rum du 'bod pa'i stobs kyi rgyal po ha si rati a wa bha ka ra sirnyi'i rgyud ha si rasbyi a las khrims bskyang ba'i dus ste skar rtsis pa spyi'i rab byung bcu gnyis 'das shing bcu gsum pa shar nas lo lnga song ba/ de'i dus rgya dkar dang rgya nag gi mnga' ris kyis mtshams stod hor 720

dang sog po'i rgyu srang bod yul gyi stod mnga' ri skor gsum gyi sa yi thig le ri yi rgyal po ke ta ra'i nub phyogs klung seng ge kha 'bab du du grags pa nī la'i chu mgo mar yul g.ya' yi skor ba'i ljong gi bdag po rgyal po mang po bskur ba'i rig4dri ma med pa shākya lits+tsha ba'i rgyud bod kyi rje bo lha btsad po mes dbon gyi gdung las skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi sras/ mgon gsum gyi gcen dpal lde rig pa mgon nas mnga' thang lang tsho da lta'i bar du nyams pa med par spyod pa'i rgyun mar yul la dwags rgyal po zhes yun nas yun du dge ba'i dpal dang ldan pa de lta la/ phyi ma'i dus 'dir chu bo si ta'i lho phyogs kyi khyon 'dir rgyal po chen po dang / khams kyi rgyal po dang / rgyal phran dang rgyal rigs kyi tshogs mtha' dag thub bstan lnga brgya'i mtshams dus kyi 'gyur bas gcig la gcig gi rgol zhing mdza' bshes nye du rnams kyang brtse ba chung zhing phan pa'i mtshams sbyor dkon cing gnod pa'i sbyor ba lhur len pa'i skye bo mang ba yi mar yul bdag po khu dbon yang mi mdza' ba'i ngang tshul brtas pas mtha'i dmag dpung chen po drag tu g.yo ba'i rgyu rkyen la zhugs te skye rgu mtha' yas pa la bzod par dka' ba'i duḥ kha ster bar 'chas pa shā5/gangs can mgon po lag na pad+mo sdom brtson rgyalu po'i tshul du sprul gyur gang gi ris su ma chad pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag la byams pa dang brtse ba'i thugs kyi yongs su byas pas 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag du mar yul phan bde'i rtsa lag tu dgongs nas gangs can khrims kyi byed po mdun na 'don chen po rnams brgyud de nyi 'og bod chen gyi phyogs su rang dbang gi chos smra ba'i go sar skyes gyur phyogs med ris med kyi rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa bsten pa bzhi ldan bho ṭa dzo ki ha ri nā tha la rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi byed por mnga' ri stod kasmi ra yi yul mtshams su khyod nyid bgrod par 'os zhes bka' lung phebs par gyur yang / rang nyid spyir nam 'chi cha med kyi blo la lhag tu bsgrang byas yongs su bsod nams tshogs chen gyi las su bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso zhig grub na skam pa tsam las gzhan phyogs bgrod kyi spros pa mang po mi ldan pa dang / stod phyogs su bgrod par ltas kyang cung zad 'tshub cing /lhag tu bdag lta blo gros kyi lang tsho ma brtas pas 'jig rten mthun mjug gi spyod par mi mkhas pa kun gyi mngon par gsal bar gyur ba de bzhin pas rgyal po dregs ldan dag gi legs bzlum rngo thogs par dka' ba yi 'gro bar mi spro tshul gsol yang skye rgu du mar phan bde'i btsas su bka' nan chen pos bcing ba la rten sgo gsum gyi ngal ba mtha' dag khyad du bsod de chu pho sprel gyi lo hor zla bdun par mnga' ri stod sgar thog tu 'byor zhing / la dwags rgyal po dang mul lbe rgyal po gnyis ka waṃ ler 'phral 'byor dgos tshul gyi snga 'gros so so'i phebs bsu der byung ba'i khrod nas brdzangs shing rang nyid zla ba 721

de'i dmar phyogs tshes bcur bod yul rje bo dang la dwags bdag po'i yul mtshams gu ru'i gnas chen bde mchog lha ri dkar po dang / hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes 1la kha sbyor du son/ la dwags nas rgyal sras dang rgyal mo yang waṃ ler rigs khyad kyi phebs grub 'dug cing / mul lbe rgyal po sngar bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa che bar grags gshis phral 'byor yong bar byas kyang zla ba de ka'i tshes 17la mul lbe rgyal po'i bka' blon bstan 'dzin son pa'i rag mar la dwags rgyal po'i pho nya kha che nas yong bar kha che nas dpung che ba gnyis yongs rgyu'i mi dang yi ge lag zin byung gshis/ dogs zin gyi phral yong ma bde bas zla mtshams tsam la yong rtsis yin tshul byung ba de ltar gangs can rje bo gzhung sa mchog tu bar 'ching bgyid par nged dgos tshul gsol ba bzhin kha che'i dpung gi sna 'dren byed pa mi 'os shing / yid kyang 'khrugs pas phan tshun la 'phros kyang gsal bar bgyis par la dwags rgyal blon nas khyod la dwags su yongs ba'i nges pa ma snyed gong du kha cher a khu'i sna tshogs zhus par bsten de dang cha mthun gyi nyer len btang ba las 'dir phebs rgyur thos nas btang ba min tshul sogs dang / mul lbe rgyal po'i blon pos kyang khyod 'dir phebs rgyur thos pa nas rgyal po nas kyang dmag 'khrug gi bsam sbyor bshol ba yin tshul zer bas de la ngos kyi la dwags dang mul lbe rgyal po khu dbon gnyis thad nas kha cher na bab dang wa gir la rgyal po khu dbon sku ngo nang legs spel grub gshis kha che nas dpung dang mi sna su yang yong mi dgos tshul yi ge phral btang dgos tshul smras bzhin la dwags pas ze reg mig ston dang mul lbe nas kyang zer reg de mthun ston rgyur dgos tshul bcas pho nya tshes nyer bdun la brdzangs kyang mul lbe rgyal po rang nas 'di rigs la dwags pa'i rdzun rtsom la gsan pa yin 'dug zhes pho nya zlog 'dug kha che'i dpung 'jug 'di tshab shin tu che gshis de rting yang lan gnyis bskyar nan byas kyang snga phyi gsum ka mal lbe rgyal po rang gi thugs rtog stabs btang bar ma mdzad cing / khong rang nas nged kyi ngag bkod dang mthun pa'i yi ge zhig bskur yod zer 'dra bshus ni ston ma byung / de skabs kha che'i yi ge de phyis kha che'i yig mkhan rnams kyi bod skad du bsgyur tshig 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ltar gyi dmag nyan shin tu che ba yod nges yin 'dug pa de ltar nged nas lhag bsam dag pas la dwags pa'i pho nya brdzang ba lan du mar bzlog par byed pa ni spyir kha ba can dgos la dgas ljongs/ yang dgos mul lbe rang ma rung bar 'gyur ba'i god chags yin 'dug kyang 'di lo dkon mchog gi thugs rjes khyab nas rkyen ma byung ba der gda'/ rgyal po phun sum tshogs rnam rgyal ni rgyu rkyen mang po zhig gi nged la dwags su sleb skabs zur bzhugs mdzad nas zla ba kha shas sang 'dug pa/ de yang legs spel gang skabs bab byung na byed rgyu gang spyir thog mar khu dbon legs spel byed skabs sku ngo tshang ma 'dzom pa kho na legs/ mul lbe rgyal 722

po ma 'byor ba yun ring skabs gsung pa/de yang rgyal po chos la mi mos pa min/ nged la dad pa med pa yang min/ blang dor gyi gnas gtan nas mi shes pa yang min 'dug rung rgya 'dre 'gong po du ru ka'i 'dre gsar byung nag po'i phyogs can mang po mtha' dmag gi sna 'dren sogs rgyal khams du mi ngan pa sna tshogs bskyed par 'dod pas yid bsgyur ba nyid du shes la/ de dang de'i cho 'phrul mngon gyur dang lkog 'gyur ches mang ba snga phyi rim can du byung zhing / de rnams kyi nus pas mi rnams kyang rnam rtog sna tshogs pa'i lab chol sel 'jug phung khrol gyi tshig mang pos dus 'da' ba zhig 'dug kyang / dus 'dir gzhung gi sku rim gong sa'i thugs rje la rten/ 'gor che'i mthar mar yul bdag po yas mas kun waṃ ler lhan cig tu 'joms par gyur pas legs tshogs kyi rgyur gyur/ rang yang mar yul du sleb nas rtsa chu yi snyoms pas gro tshal ba dang /skabs su rtsa dkar dang rlung nad kyi kyang tsher ba sogs lus kyang mi bde zhing / lhag tu rang nyid nam 'chi cha med du nges na bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig bso la ring bas thog mar la dwags phyogs su zla ba gsum las mi sdod pa'i rtsis byas shing / cis kyang 'di lo dgun bal por bgrod ma thub tshe zhang zhung dang mar yul dag gi yul mtha' lho phyogs kyi 'char gdod nas grub pa'i gnas chen rgya bod du grub mtha' 'dzin pa kun la rlung ltar du grags pa yul nyer bzhi las mkha' spyod kyi gnas brgyad kyi ya gyal du gyur pa dang / sgyu 'phrul sras kyi bstan la ston pa gnyis pa lta bu 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs kyi gser gyi ri bor byin gyis rlabs par dgongs pa sa/ṇ+ḍa ri dang / lan tshwa'i 'byung khungs su snang ba mazlo ri sogs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma nges par 'du ba'i gnas chen de rnams su tshogs gtor 'du mchod sogs 'grub na bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag la phan che ba'i ltas nges pa dang / rang gi tshogs gsum 'phel ba yang gzhir bcas kyi sa khad kyang shin tu nye zhing bsgrod 'dod thun mong ma yin pa yod na yang / rgyal po spyir mul lbe nas ma byon zhing / byon nas shel du don gzhan med par zla ba hril po gnyis rang gzhan duḥ kha drag po la 'khod par mdzad pas bdag gi dge legs de rnams bshol ba'i rgyur song / 'on kyang da lta khu dbon bzang spel legs par grub pa'i 'di bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag mang por phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyu rgyal ba dgyes pa'i ched du dmigs nas blo yi ngal ba sangs ba las 'os ci yod/mang yul rgyal la gtam khungs skyel dris par/ mi tshogs nas de lta nges par zer ba las khungs 'di yin ston rgyu med zer/ nges par zer na rtsa ba ston dgos dang / nges med yin tshe nges pa dang mi 'brel zhing / spyir yang rgyal rigs dra ma rnams kyi khyad par gyi yon tan lnga las dpyad bzod du byed pa 723

nyid kyang gtso bo yin na khung dang mi ldan pa'i kha la sla chol gyi rgyug pa rgyal po rang gi mtshan nyid ci ltar 'gyur rgyal po nyid rang dang shes ldan mtha' dag gi gzigs shig /nged lta bu yang las nyon ma spang pas dgra gnyen gyi snang ba dbyings su dag pa ni smos ci 'tshal/ tshul de hrag ba yang yod pas 'khrul zhig dang dngos grub kyi dri tsam yang med mod/ 'on kyang chos ltar bcos pa'i sgrib shing la rten/ dad ldan rang 'dod ched gnyer kyi shes bzhin bslus pa ni byis pa mon shes nas da lta'i bar sngar yang ma byas/ da yang mi byed la/ der yang ma zad skye ba kun tu tshul der ni 'jug par mi 'gyur grangs/ kho bo cag bya bral khos med khyer zhan pa zhig yin yang yul rgya dkar dbus 'gyur gyi cha nas rgya nag grag sgo'i bar rang 'khos kyi chos smra ba po dam pa chos kyi 'phrin las skyong ba zhig yin/ zhes smras par bdag de skabs lha 'dres bslus pa yin 'dug zhes gsung sngags gcig dang phyag rgya gcig la zhe gdeng mdzad phyir zhu thes yang mi 'dug la/gzhan gyi zhu dbang du ma song ba dgos gsung ba ni ngos rang lo bcu drug nas phal gyi ngag rjes su 'brang 'dod ma byung zhing / rgyal bas gsung pa'i blang dor gnas gang thub dang / snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i mthar thug tu skyes pas nyon mongs pa dang / bag med dbang gi ma thub pa yang btang snyoms ma yin par 'gyod bshags ci nus byas/ nyes pa gang yang log lta yi dbang gi byas pa ni ye nas med nges yin/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bkas nger par gnang na srog kyang 'dor nus pa'i zhe gdeng yod la/ yan lag gi bla ma rnams la yang dag snang sbyang zhing bka' stsal 'bad pas sangs rgyas kyi bka' la yid ches pa yi sgo nas sgrub ci nus su byas/ gzhan ni tshe 'di snang gi nye du grwa 'khor sbyin bdag mdza' bshes gus pa byed mkhan rnams la yang 'phral yun bde ba'i bsngo smon nyid las gang zer la nyan pa de sngar yang ye nas ma byed na/ da lam la dwags rgyal po'i gzi brjid mi bzod nas zhus tshad nyan 'gro dgongs pa yin srid kyang mar yul bdag po'i legs spel byed na rang gi ma smad pa'i blo gros steng nas gzu bos dpyad de byed pa las/ sngar rgyal sras sku mched kyi bar du yang gzhan med cing da dung khu dbon legs spel lta bu zhig bgyid par srid na yang la dwags rgyal po'i zhus dbang dang mul lbe rgyal blon te phyogs gnyis ka'i zhus dbang du bdag ga la 'gyur bas tshul de thugs las chung ngur gnang chog sam ṭa zhes rdul byang la bkod/ mul lbe rgyal po sngar 'gor che ba'i bshags sten a ched 'phags yul gyi kar+ṣa pa ṇi'i phung po rnam par spung nas bstan par mdzad pa/rgyal po nas de ltar gsung ba gnong ba'i las gnong bar ngos bzung nas 'gyod bshags byed pa yang mkhas pa dam pa yin mod/ 'on kyang blo 'dus byas yin pas mi rtag rung da lta'i dus skabs 724

'dir gzhan gyi rin thang mchog tu rtsi ba'i dngos po 'di lta'i rigs la bdag rang gi blo la ha cang gi cer cer po mi 'char zhing sngon bsags las 'phro gu ru'i thugs rjes phyogs med yul du lto rgyab phyed tsam gyi dad rdzas rtag par dpyad du yod na lab ching gi zhu rten dang bshags par dmigs pa'i rdzas 'di lta ni se ba gang bdag gir mi bya ste/ der ma zad mar yul ljongs su sleb nas nged lo phyed lhag song yang de ring nged rang dpon slob tshang ma'i 'tsho chas kyang rin bcal te nas nyos pa las la dwags rgyal po yonajisbyar ba cung zad yang ma blang ba kun gyi mthong yul du bab pa 'di yin/ de ltar 'tsho chas tsam yang khyed rgyal po yas mas nas sngar dang da dung yang mi blang na phyogs 'di'i lab ching ched du khab skud tsam yang mi len pa'i zhe dam bcas pa yin pas rgyal po'i mthol bshags ni blang la/ dngos po ni mi 'tshal/ zhes dus snyigs ma der kar zlogamul lbe rgyal blon sogs nas phan tshun shor gleng gyis bzhin ma du 'gro bas rang gzhan sun pa las mi 'dug gshis sku zhabs nas thugs rje gang che dgongs bcad kyi gcod mtshams zhus par ྾gzhi nas sngar phan tshun lab sher cung zad nyan rtsis ma byas na'ang bden tshig brjod long ma byung bar gcod mtshams byas song zhes ma 'ongs klan kā 'byung bar dogs pas de lta nyan pa mi byed dka' med྾de skad la dwags yul skad bye brag pa ni sngar bon gyi ston pa gshen rab gu ger 'khrungs zhing /zhang zhung zhes pa ni mnga' ri skor gsum gyi spyi ming dang / la dwags yul dbus 'gyur gyi ser skya lta bu ni gu ge yin yang / sngon zhang zhung gi skad zhes bod kyi brda las phal cher log pa zhig yod snang yang da lta bod kyi skad dang phal cher gcig par gyur yang / zhang zhung gi skad rnying gnas pa yang mang du snang zhing / la dwags kyi yul mtshams bha ti'i rang skad rnying pa dngos 'bru sha dang bod skad 'dra'o cha lta bur yod dgos kyang da lta ni de las zur chags shing grub mtha'i dbang gi kla klo'i skad rim gyis 'phel yod 'dug pas/྾ ji skad du/ rgyal rigs 'phris kyang thub chod spang / /gzhon nu snyas pa yang mi bya/ /dregs pa can la gnong mi bkur/ /chen po rnams la dha mi 'bebs/ /zhes ltar/྾de skabs kha gcig nas na re/ mul lbe rgyal por rigs sras 'byung na bar smon la de lta byung na smos med dang / de min rgyal sras rgyal mo'i sras dang mul lbe rje'i sras mo zhig yod pa chab gcig bzhag na ji ltar rung zhes bdag la dri bar mdzad pa de la smras pa/ tshul de bdag la dri bar mi 'os shing /lan 'debs kyang mi btub la/ g.yong ni pha yi rigs dgu rgyud/ ma yi rigs gsum rgyud kyi bar gnyen du mi sdeb par phyi nang gi gzhung lung mang por rlung ltar du grags shing / bod yul dbus su pha yi rigs 725

su gyur tshad dang / gtsang pa rnams kyi de yi khar ma yi rigs gsum rgyud kyi bar du 'jems shing / rgya nag tu yang de dang 'dra skad dang / da lta 'phags yul du sangs rgyas kyi grub mtha' dkon yang mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' gar yod du gong du bshad pa de las mi 'da' mod/ 'on kyang bod yul mtha' khob kha cig dang / 'phags yul kla glo'i grub mtha' lhag par dar ba'i gnas su spun dngos ma'i bu dang bu mo khyim thabs su sbrel bar thos te/ de ni byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi gnas shing / mtshon gyi bskal pa dang nye ba cha mthun skabs mi rnams khrel dang ngo tsha bral te/ khyi dang / phag pa/ wa skyes bzhin/ sring mo dang bu mo sogs dang / lhan cig tu 'tshogs shing de nas mtshon gyi bskal pa dngos kyi 'dzam gling gi skye rgu phal cher kha dag par gsungs te/ spyir de lta bu'i dus kyi nyen pa dang / yul khiskyo stes dbang gi de ltar gyur pa la ni/ yul gyi lha rnams grib kyi non cing / bkra mi shis pa'i rgyu ltas ngan tu skye bo mkhas pa rnams kyi brjod par byas na ya rabs drwa ma rnams kyi tshul lugs la ni de mi 'byung mod/ 'on kyang mi ngan ci byed ya cha kha gcig nas yul dbang rje btsan mgu ba'i kha bsag tshul/ de lta shāka rigs yin zhes smreng ba po byung ba ni tshig de rnam par 'khyams pa ste/sngon drang srong ser skya'i gsung ni/ dgos pas dgag pa zil gyi gnon pa rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi spyi nas dbang bskur ba 'os pa'i bu la pha yi bkas gnang ste rgyal srid kyi dbang thang bor nas dka' thub kyi nag du gnas nas rigs mi mnyam pa dang / mnyam yang gzhan gyi bud med la lag pas reg pa tsam yang mi byed pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par mas dben gyi snying mo sten par gsung ba yin gyi/ de ma yin pa gzhan la phyi rol drang srong gi rig byed du kun tu ma bsten pa yin no/ /gal te rigs byed du bstan na yang / sangs rgyas bstan dang mi mthun pa'i tshig ci'i phyir g.yul du shi ba lhar skye ba dang /rgyal rigs kyi ched du mi dge ba'i las lam chen po rung bar bshad pa ni log par blta bas kun tu non pa yin pas de yang spang byar shes pas rtogs pa nyid do/ /drang srong ser skyas skyong ba'i rgyal rigs shākya spun rnams nu bo rgyal srid la dga' ba shi ba'i 'og tu shākyar gyur pa spun che rim nas rgyal srid la bkod kyang pho bo gsum la sras ma byung bar grongs shing / nu bo la sras byung ba'i rgyud shākya chen po'i rigs las bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa byon pa ste/ de yang mas dben sring mo'i bu rgyud las min pa shes dgos so/ /des na tshig 'di dag ni mi rigs pas gzhan la go bar gyis shig ci'i phyir 'di yi skye bo mang po la phan nam/ de las ldog gam/ mngon shes ma thob pas brtag mi nus pa yis so/ /zhes smras pa gong gi smra ba po rnams spyom chung ngu kha rog te sdod do/ /'dir yi ge'i tshegs su che yang skye bo drwa ma rnams kyi tshul 726

spyod la phan phyir nyung ngu'i ngag gis cha tsam bris pa'o/ /྾de ltar legs nyes byed shes snying nas bcol bar bar khrel gzhung ngo tshas dbul ba rnams ni bag yangs spyod pa'i brtsas su che yang khrel ldan 'dzang ba'i tshogs rnams 'ching ba'i zhags par dam pa dang /྾ gang gi bka' drin mi brjed par dran zhes don gyi'am gcam bu yin kyang rung dus der ni dga' tshor tshad med byas song yang / yid la ring du gnas min ni ma shes mod/ ྾spyir kho bo ni bya bral phra mo las kyang / phra mor gyur gshis dngos su phan gnod rngam chen 'grub mkhan ni min mod/ 'on kyang mdo khams nas da lta'i bar gnod pa skyal ba'i yul ni ha cang mi mang ste nyung ngu nyid du zad/ phan gdags ni khos dpag kyi mchog dman du ga la byas kyang de kun dge ba'i las 'bras bslu med nyid las rang gi las kyi rgyu bas drin du sems pa ni shes ldan dam pa re zung tsam ste/ gzhan ni shin tu phra bar zad do/ /྾ dus skabs 'dir yang skye rgu spyi dang bye brag mang po'i bde thabs su dgongs nas/ gangs can mgon po rgyal ba mchog gi bkas mngags bzhin bal yul nas chu sprel sbo zla'i mthar mar yul gyi lam du zhugs/ da lta chu bya snron zla rdzogs su 'cha' ba ste da dung bal yul sleb bar las sngar lo hril po gcig dang phyed nye'i ring sgo gsum gyi ngal ba kun bzod pa gsum gyi go chas dang du blang/ mar yul stod ring lab ching la rten pa'i dar skud gcig gser dngul ke ba gang gur gum 'jag ma gcig gi mtshon ste dngos po'i yo byad phra mo de tsam yang sngar ma blang na rags pa smos ci 'tshal/ da dung yang blang bar mi byed ste/ der yang ma zad rang nyid kyi 'tsho chas kyang zong gi bcal nas la dwags pas nyin rer bud shing khur kha shas kyi mtshan mthe thug tsam las rgyal po yas gsung la yang tshegs su 'gro ba cung zad kyang med pa kun gyi mthong gsal gtan la phab pa 'di yin/྾ ྾ ྾ci phyir gdeng can dbang po che rim bzhin mgo bo yang mang la sdug bsngal yang de nyid thob par gsung ba bzhin/ rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams can re zung ni srid mtha' ma skag gzhan ni ci tsam 'byor bzhin sdug bsngal yang de snyed ldan pa lung rig mthun par ma zad dngos su grub bzhin pa dang / ྾྾ ya rabs dra ma rnams ni khrel yod ngo tsha che zhing bya ba drin du bzo ba'i rang bzhin can yin la don du yang de med thabs med pa ste mngon mtho lha mi'i theg pa la de med na ngan 'gro las mi grol/ nyan rang gi theg par zhi lam gyi bslab pa'i kun spyod la de med thabs med/ theg chen gyi lhag bsam yang khrel ngo tsha byas bzo las skye ste de med na mkha' khyab pa ma yin pas mi phan/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa la yang med thabs med ste drin bzo ma dgos na sangs thams cad las rtsa ba'i bla ma lhag zhes ga la brjod/ des na ya rabs kyi go 'phang la gnas pa rnams ya rabs kyi rnam thar la nges par slob dgos 727

zhes pa'i don yin gyi nged la stod ra btang dgos zhes pa'i tshig la snyegs pa min la/smras pa/ gzhan gyi skyon yon cha shas 'ol phyi nyid/ /thos pa'i mod la ngang tshul phyogs mthong mod/ /'on kyang rtsing nge spang ste zhib dpyad blos/ /gzur gnas drang po nyid kyi thig btab pas/ /skye dgu ris med dga' 'gu bskyed pa 'di/ /skyes mchog mi yi seng ge gangs can mgon/ /gang gi thugs rje 'jug pa kho na las/ /bdag gi bgyi ba cung zad yang ma dmigs/ /zhes so/ /la dwags yul skad zhabs 'thams su grags pa rje bo gcig shos la ma 'gu nas cig shos la mgo btad zhu nas blang ba 'di rigs che phra su la yang nang mi shim pa'i rgyu mthong thos myong grub tu snang bas de rigs sku ngo nang thabs mkhas mthun 'jug gi steng nas blang na ma rtogs/ ma gzos pa'i rang mtshams kyi sku ngo nang phan tshun smos ci tshal yul spyi gang dang mi mthun pa'i mi mgo ltad bzhes na mi mdzes pa'i rgyur 'gro bas gal che thugs su 'jug 'os dang ྾ de ltar da lta'i dus na duḥ kha rū pa ka ra ṇa yi sgo chu bdag gi phyogs nas chu gter gyi dkyil 'khor 'khrug nas lud pa lta bu 'byung bar nye ba nyid mthun pa'i rlung shugs kyis brdas pa ltar dus lo re zhig bar phyir bcil ba yi bsil ljongs kyi ra bar 'khod pa'i skye dgu'i yid kyi ngal bsor gyur/lar rgya'i gnas gal che ba'i rigs rnams sku mched dngos su'am de min pho nya tshad thub yi ge'i lam nas mol chid zhib gros bzang pos blang dor 'jug pa mthun par bya ste 'di ni yul khams mi nyams pa'i rgyu bdun rgyal bas bsngags pa'i nang mtshan gtso che shos zhig yin/ de yang de ltar thugs su bzhag 'os te/ ྾de bzhin gshegs pas ma skye'i dgra yi mdun na 'don bram ze dbyar byed la yul yangs pa can mi nyams pa'i rgyu bdun bka' stsal pa/ ngas spong byed pa la rnam par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu bdun bshad do/ /bdun ni yang dang yang du 'du zhing 'du ba la ring du gnas pa dang / 1 'gro 'dug dang dgos pa dang bya ba mthun par gnas pa dang / 2 smon par bya ba ma yin pa la mi mos smon pa mi 'dor khrims bcas pa bzhin du spyod pa dang / 3 bud med bgrod bya ma yin pa la mi bgrod pa dang / 4 rgan rabs la bkur sti byed cing tshig nyan pa dang / 5 mchod rten la mchod cing sngon gyi mtshan ma mi 'dor ba dang / 6 yul gyi dgra bcom pa rnams la dad pas bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ / 7 spong byed pa rnams de dag gcig dang ldan na yang / ma skyes dgras thub par mi 'gyur na bdun dang ldan na lta ci smos zhes gsungs pa ltar ste/ sngon gyi mtshan ma mi 'dor ba ni zhwa gos rgyan rnams sngar rnying pa la spyod cing gsar 'gro mi byed pa'i don yin la/ deng dus dgra bcom mngon gyur mi rtogs tshe phyogs re ma 728

yin par sangs rgyas pa yi grub mtha' ris med kyi dge slong tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa kun la bsnyen bkur ba ste/ de rnams nges par phyi mthar thug gi bar du 'bad bya'i gtso bo yin zhes 'dir kho bos legs par gdams pa lag na mchog dman kun gyi 'bad pas lhu ru blang bar 'os so 'jig rten na gsal grags ya rabs mchog /khrel yod ngo tsha mtho ris lha mi'i theg /legs par spyod ni nges legs thar pa yang / ring po ma yin myur du 'grub par nges/ /ces pa yang smras so/ de ltar dam du bca' ba tshul ji bzhin dngas du blang ba'i len pa'i dbang por/ 'phags pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ dam pa'i chos/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs mkha' khams phyur phur khengs pa nyid dang / bla med sngags kyi dkon mchog gsum/ dkyil 'khor rigs kyi gtso bo bla ma/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin yi dam/ rang snang yum dang chos kyi gnyer 'dzin mkha' 'gro ste rtsa ba gsum dang / de ltar dkon mchog rtsa gsum gyi rang mdangs sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gnyen par byed cing sems can gyi bde skyid spel bar legs nyes kyi gtong tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang / rdo rje lha mo nag mo'i tshogs ste/de las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer dpal rtsegs rgyal po gang stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir chos kyi sprin gyi dbang phyug chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs snyigs dus chos byed sgrub po rnams la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / rnal 'byor phal gyur rnams kyi bar do'i duḥ kha gsal ba/ dbul 'phong gyur pa rnams la nor gyi dngos grub ster ba ste tshul de gsum la gzhan las rmad du byung ba'i thugs bskyed gsar dam can dpal rdo rje nag po chen po myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa yab yum sras 'khor bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / dpal ho ru kas gdug pa can rnams thabs kyi rang 'dra'i gzugs kyi btul phyir 'jigs byed dregs pa'i cha byad rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa dang / dpal khrag 'thung chen po gangs ri'i bdag po'i gras kyi tshul bzung zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa nye bar bsrung ba thal bas khebs pa'i zhing du thal ba'i dbang por sangs rgyas pa rdo rje nag po legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du srid zhi zab gsal pho mo gnyis chos thams cad gnyis med du ro mnyam zhing dregs pa'i gtso bo lha chen klu bdud/ sgra gcan ste 'chi bdag gsum gyi srog dbyer med du 'dres pas ma ning nag po zhes su mtshan gsol ba gcig gyur rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor 'das dur khrod kun tu spyod pa'i mnga' bdag lha yi lha bdud kyi bdud bgegs kyi bgegs chen po bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bsrung ma rmad du byung ba 'chol pa'i khro rgyal nag po skal ldan nag po smug 'dzin nag po rig 729

pa'i rang mdangs las shar ba'i rang snang gi yab rang snang gi yum dbyer mi phyed la tha dad du grub pa sngags kyi bdag mo rdo rje ral gcig ma dang bcas pa ma ning nag po yab yum sras 'khor bran gyi tshogs dang bcas pa zhing rab 'byams mtshams sbyor gyi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa dang / gzhan yang stag zhon la sogs pa sku'i mgon po'i rigs dang / la la gho ra sogs gsung gi mgon po'i rigs dang /rdo rje gur/ ber nag mi'u thung / lho nub zang gri can sogs thugs kyi mgon po'i rigs dang / seng zhon tshogs bdag ljang sngon sogs yon tan gyi mgon po'i rigs dang / trak+ṣad bdud rgyal thod pa can sogs phrin las kyi mgon po'i rigs dang / de bzhin zhal bzhi pa seng ge nag po zhing skyong chen po kun dga' gzhon nu la sogs pa nye ba'i mgon po dang / nag po chen po de rnams dang mthu dang rdzu 'phrul yon tan mtshungs par spyod pa 'dod khams kyi bdag mo srid pa gsum gyi rgyal mo lha rnams bsrung ba'i rdzong / lha ma yin rnams 'joms pa'i gshed ma 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i sring mo lha dbang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi yid skyes sras mo dbang ldan bdag po'i rigs kyi bu mo rdo rje nag mo chen mo ri khrod dbang phyug ma dud pa ltar sngo zhing sol ba ltar gnag pa de bzhin gshegs pa las kyi rigs dang ldan zhing ma 'ongs pa na dam tshig sgrol mar sangs rgyas pa'i rang rtags lag na ral gri'i mtshon cha 'dzin pa srin kyi rgyal po zil gyi gnon cing / chags ldan dregs pa rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog phyir kha ra la zhon te skad cig gi srid gsum khyab par nyul ba dpal ldan lha mo nag mo nyid dang / deng gnyis su med pa sngags kyi rang gzungs smon lam gyi mthu'i byung ba rdo rje re wa ti nam gru nag mo dre'u la zhon pa dpon g.yog gnyis nges pa'i don du dgra bcom mar gyur kyang gdul bya 'dren pa'i thabs la mkhas pas 'phags pa brgyad dang bcu yi dbang bskur thob par bstan pa rang rang gi yab dang sras dang 'khor dang g.yog bran 'bangs kyi tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams dang / rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa dang sems can las kyi 'jig rten skyong ba chen por grub pa tshangs pa dang / drag po dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang po dang / rtog 'dod dang / skem byed dang / dgra sta can sogs mthu dang ldan pa rgyal ba'i zhal mthong zhing 'jig rten gyi 'phel zad byed pa'i tshul can dang / de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa legs par gtad pa kun rdzob nyan thos kyi theg par chos mig rdul med bsnyes pa'i tshul bzung / bzung zhing theg pa chen por sa brgyad pa dang / yang bcu pa'i byang chub sems par yang gsung zhing nges pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul par yang bstan pa phyogs bzhir bstan pa skyong ba ngal sos po sogs rgyal po chen po bzhi slas kyi btsun mo dang mdza' mo dang / bran mo dang sde chen stobs dang ldan pa sras dang g.yog dang dpung gi tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang / 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig 730

rten la legs nyes chos bzhin du spyod pa'i khrims kyi bdag po chen po dpal chen po bka' sdod mthu chen dregs pa yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dge sdig gi rong 'dzin pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yum tsa guṇ+ḍi dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang tshangs pa lha yi gshin rje gcer bu nag po/ dbang po gshin rje srog bdag dmar po me 'bar gshin rje ma ru tse/ srin po'i gshin rje rā hu la/ klu yi gshin rje nā ga rak+ṣa/ gnod sbyin gyi gshin rje drag po rta sngon/ dbang ldan gyi gshin rje tsu tshun+da ra dang / sa 'og gi gshin rje bye ba gu ring ste srid gsum gshin rje'i tshogs yab yum sras 'khor ma lus lus pa med pa dang /rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung arka dkar la dam bcas pa gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ arka dmar la dam bcas pa'i mgon po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu/ sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad/ phyi'i lha srin sde brgyad/ nang gi lha srin sde brgyad/ gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad/ gab pa'i lha srin sde brgyad/ brtags chags kyi lha srin sde brgyad sogs lha ma srin sde rigs sum brgya drug cu/ kun gyi mthu stobs gcig tu dril ba gling chen bcu drug gtso bo gyad chen dmar po phyag gnyan tshang pa dung gi mche ba can 'khor 'byung po 'gong po rgyal bswen mi srun pa bye ba phrag dung phyur grangs med tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'dzam gling bod kyi gtsug lag khang / g.yu ru khra 'brug ra sa 'phrul snang / gzhan yang dpal gyi bsam yas mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang gi bsrung ma rnams dang / dbus kyi zab phu lung / shar gyi ljon pa lung sogs lung chen lnga/ lung phran brgyad/ dpal gyi tsa ri tra dang stag tshang la sogs pa'i gnas chen bzhi/ gnas phran bcu drug grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi/ gangs ri chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig rdzong bco brgyad/ pad+ma bkod sogs sbas pa'i yul chen/ 'bras ljongs sogs sbas yul 'bring po/ rol pa mkha' 'gro'i gling sogs sbas yul chung ngu ste mdor na sbas pa'i yul ljongs che phra sum bcu rtsa drug rnams kyi bsrung ma dang / bod yul gyi mthu chen dregs pa sde bzhi/ phrang bsrung bzhi/sgo bsrung bzhi/ gtsug lag chos 'khor gyi dkor bdag gtso bo thugs kyi rgyal po sder chen/ gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha/ sku'i rgyal po pu tra/ yon tan gyi rgyal po shing bya can/ phrin las be har me'o che/ btsun mo lnga/ blon po lnga/ rgyal chen lnga/ ru 'dren bzhi sogs mthu ldan dregs pa brjod las 'das pa dang /bod yul rtags chags kyi lha chen/ ti se'i zhing skyong legs grub rdo rje/ rma rgyal spom ra/ rdo rje g.yung drung / gnyan chen thang lha rdo rje 'bar ba/ 'dzam gling skyes gcig rdo rje legs pa sogs dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig gnam mtsho phyug mo/ sha med gangs dkar/ rkong btsun de mo sogs 'dzam gling bstan ma bcu gnyis/ mnga' ris phyogs su mthu stobs nus pa can/ che btsan rol pa skya bdun/ sta sgo gangs btsan/ sku lha ge god/ rong gi sku lha mched gsum sogs pho rgyud rnams dang / tsa muṇa ma sogs ma yam 731

srid pa'i rgyal mo chen mo rnams dang / skyid grong bhodhe ma bdun/ glo bo'i rdo rje legs ldan/ khyung lung bhodhe spyan gcig sogs ma mo bdun/ phug bdag chen mo dgu la sogs pa'i mo rgyud spyi dang / khyad par du mar yul ljongs su dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba'i yul bdag ma chen mo sngon tshe dpal chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i spyan sngar srog gi snying po mdangs gsol du phul nas dam tshig gnyan po blang zhing / bar du jo bo rje dang / lo chen rin chen bzang po'i spyan sngar sems rbeskyed gson gshin chos bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag skyong bar zhal gyi bzhes bzhin phyi ma'i dus 'dir mar yul gyi rgyal blon rnams dge ba'i rtsas su bdag gi bsgrub pa'i grogs mo mdza' bshes ma rdo rje chen mo sde 'khor gsog dang bcas pa rnams dang / de bzhin bdag gi dge ba'i 'phrin las byed pa po mthu chen dregs pa'i tshogs spyi dang bye brag ma lus pa dang / gzhan yang kha che khri brtan gyi yul dang / kha che dza larnya ri'i phug yul ga dha war zhang zhung 'bru sha sogs da lta kla klo rnams kyi brdas nang khom dang chags sor 'bod pa'i yul gyi mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul dregs pa'i mthu dang ldan pa rnams dang / skye bo rnams kyi mna' dang bug gi dbang por gzhan gyi ma bcol kyang las kyi shugs kyi byed pa dkar po spyan gcig sogs srog bdag dgu dang / ser skyong sogs srog bdag stong sde'i tshogs rnams legs bzlum chad don gyi yi ge 'di yi rgyab rdzi gnyer dam du zhu zhing gsol ba yin pas khyed rnams mthu dang stobs dang nus pa rtsal shugs ma chung bar gang zhig ched don 'di la mi gnas pa byed pa po gang yin pa de la bka' yi chad pa drag po phobs shig de yang lha chen po'i mod pa dang / dregs pa drag shul can gyi chad pa dang / rigs sngags grub pa'i rbod gtong rnams kyi nus mthu ni mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa ste/ rnam smin 'jig rten phyi mar dus mi btab/las kyi rnam par smin pa dbang btsan no zhes pa'i snyad mi gdags/ rang bzhin grub pa'i skye 'chir khung mi 'byin pa ste/ des na 'dir yang ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten rang rgyud kyi grub par bsam pa tsam gyi las sgrub par dbang ba sngags kyi dmod pa'i mtshon cha can drag shul nus pa'i stobs dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyi rnal 'byor pa bdag gi 'phrin las su bcol ba'i las ni sems can gyi bde skyid 'phel bar byed pa dang / chos bzhin gyi khrims btsan par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas nub med yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir 'bad pas bsgrub par bgyis pa 'di yi gnyer mdzod la/ legs spel bzang bzlum gyi yi ge 'di yi chad mdo'i don las che phra su'i 'gal ba byas pa yin yang rung / de la bka' yi chad pa drag po lo dang zla ba mi 'gyang bar zhag dang / za ma'i khongs su nges par 'beb pa dang / de yang pa mna' dang chad la mi rtsi ba gang yin pa de yi lus srog phrol cig klad khrag zho ltar dkrug cig snying phyung shig snying khrag dron mo zhal du gsol shig732

srog rtsa chod cig tshe dang bsod nams snubs shig drod dbugs khrol cig mdangs dang klung rta nyams par gyis shig las —kyi rlung dmar drag po la skyon cig /gshin rje'i lcang mkhar nag po'i sgo drung du skyol cig /'chi bdag las cikyi gshin rje'i lto bar brub cig bdun brgyud tshun chad kyi rigs rus sde chen mtha' dag brlagapar gyigashig mnga' thang longs spyod mtha' dag ba mo sad kyi khyer ba bzhin du chom shig gang zhig dkon mchog tshad la bzhag pa'i bro tshal ba bslu bar byas na mchod 'os bslu ba dang dam pa'i chos spong ba nyid yin pas/ de yi rnam par smin pa ni mtshams med lnga las kyang lci ba'i rnam smin can ste des na mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen po mchog gi bskal pa'i bar du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po myong bar gdon mi za bas des na 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka'i khe nyen la legs par bsam nas mna' dpang de la rje blon 'bang bcas sus kyang 'da' bar ma byed ciga'adir bkod pa'i blang dor tshul bzhin bzung bar byed pa su yang rung ste de la dkon mchog rtsa gsum chos skyong dam can ye shes spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi dgyes pa'i spyan ras kyi bu ltar rtag tu btsa' bar mdzad pa dang / mi ma yin mthu ldan dregs pa rnams kyis yang grogs ltar bsrung ba yi/'dir tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang longs spyod snyan pa dang grags pa stobs dang gzi brjid dbang thang dang byug g.yang rigs rgyud dang 'khor g.yog mtha' dag gong du 'phel zhing rab tu rgyas pa dang /mi dang mi ma yin pa kun gyi yid du 'ong ba dang / lha 'dre mi gsum dga' bas 'du zhing 'jigs pa brgyad bcu drug nges par zhi ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing / dus kyi 'chi bar gyur pa na yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzod spu nas byung ba'i 'od zer gyis reg ste 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang bar do'i 'jigs skrag med par skad cig ma der mngon par dga' ba lta bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan bde ba can gyi zhing du me tog pad+ma'i spubs su zhugs te skye ba'i nying mtshams sbyar nas de ma thag me tog pad+ma'i sdong po kha dbye zhing sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong nas gsung gi gnang ba gnod par gyur cig bde ba can du nyin re bzhin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed 'byon pa rnams kyi zhal mjal zhing gdams pa thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan tshad med pa du yang 'od dpag med pa'i smon lam gyi mthu'i yongs su bsgrod de sangs rgyas grangs med pa'i zhal lta zhing dam pa'i chos thos shing / tshogs rnam pa gsum yongs su spel zhing rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo rnams kyi smon lam mchog ci tsam pa de thams cad la spyod pa'i skal ba mchog dang ldan cing mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i ded dpon bla na med pa'i gru thar pa'i bshes gnyen lha dang mi'i ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 733

ring po ma yin par myur ba nyid du 'grub par gyur cigade ltar mar yul ljongs ri yi rgyal po ke ta ra yi bya 'dab nas 'bru sha'i yul la regs kyi bar du skye dgu rnams kyi blang dor gyi gnas legs nyes kyi gtong chos bzhin nyid du 'dzin pa dkon mchog spyi dang mgon po tshogs dang drag shuladregs pa can rnams la yang gsol ba 'debs shing 'phrin las bcol ba de rnams ji bzhin nyid du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang bla med bsngags kyi dkon mchog rtsa gsum gyi bden pa'i mthu byin gyis rlabs pa'i nus pas de kho na nyid du 'grub pa dang /lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa dang / 'byung po tshig gi nus pa thob pa rnams kyi yang 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cing / gzhan yang bdag nyid las kyi bya ba 'dir zhugs te mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pa dang reg pa dang bgrod pa'i bshul lam du srin 'bu phra mo nyams par byas pa yang ste rlung gi rdzi phyogs kyi byab pa'i btang snyoms nyid du gnas pa'i 'gro ba dang bcas shing / de ni zhi ba dang chags pa'i yul du gyur pa dang / de las kyang khro ba dang 'khrug pa'i yul du gyur rnams ste mdor na 'brel gyur gyi 'gro ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad la byang chub sems kyi yongs su bzung zhing dge ba'i tshogs thun mong du bsngos pa nyid dang / khyad par sa yi phyogs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams kyi sems sdang ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / kun tu mi bzad pas dkris te g.yul bshams pa dang / 'gyed pa dang /'thab pa sogs las ldog par byas shing 'gro ba phal mo che byang chub sems kyi sdom pa la yang dag par bkod cing / ci ltar 'os pa'i bslab pa la brgyud pa sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag bdag gi yongs su ma bzung bar gzhan la bsngo ba'i mthu dang nus pa la brten te 'gro ba de kun tshe 'dir rang rang gi legs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal ma lus pa rab tu rgyas nas yongs su spyod pa dang / mi bral ba dang / skye ba phyi ma yang bde ba dang dge ba dang rtag tu 'grogs shing thar pa byang chub mchog gi 'bras bu ring po ma yin pa myur du thob pa'i rgyu ru smon lam gyis rgyas btab pa de kho na nyid du 'grub par gyur cig khyad par du bsil ldan ra ba'i ljongs 'dir rnam 'dren rgyal ba gangs can mgon po sogs skyes bu mchog gyur dam pa rnams sku tshe 'tsho bzhes zhabs pad brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed dgu lhun gyis grub pa dang / rgyal bstan ris su ma chad pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhing de rnams thugs mdza' gshis dam pa chos kyi sgra rgyun mi chad pa dang / mnga' 'bangs kyi skye rgu khol bu dang nyi tshe tsam ma yin par rgyal khams kun nad dang mug mtshon cha'i bskal pa las thar te rdzogs ldan bkang po'i dga' ston la rtag tu spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig de skad rnam par dge ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje sum rtsen bdag po yi/ /gzhan phan bka' lung nor rgyas bsrub thag gi/ /bdag blo dag pa'i gyen phyur yid 'dzin gyi/ / 734

1 legs bsrub rgyal khams lha rdzing mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /tshigs kyi zla ba gzhon nu'i 'di 'char bas/ /phyogs kyi nu mo'i rna ba mdzes ba'i rgyan/ /ut+pal dkar po'i chun por cis mi 'gyur/ / 2 des na legs spel tshig gi 'phreng ba 'di ji bzhin/ /smon cing re b.rakhyas pa'i don kun gyi mtha'i thar 'bri rgud med par yongs 'du shing gi rtsa ba bzhin/ /bskal pa'i bar du nyams med rab tu gnas par shog /3 snyigs dus 'gro ba bsod nams ches cher dman na yang / /rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /mi zad sdug bsngal las rgyun skad cig nyid la bzlog /dge legs phun tshogs dpal gyi dga' ston la spyod shog / 4 khyad par sā la'i ngad mtshungs rdul dkar gyis spras nor 'dzin me long ngos/ /skye dgu dga' bde'i dpal spyod mig yangs 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur brtan ltar gsal/ /de la mi bde ra ri'i gos min dga' bo'i sras mo'i bla gab bzhin/ /'chi med dga' ba'i tshal gnas ji bzhin dga' ba'i dpal gyi yongs 'tsho shog / 5 thog ma med pa'i dus nas rab bsags 'du dge sirnyi su ta ka yi sbyor ba dang / /bdag med 'dus ma byas pa chos dbyings don dam bdag po zab gsal nor bu kaustu bhi/ /gang dag de mthus 'khor ba'i rang bzhin rol ha'i phung po mtha' dag sa le sbram du byas/ /'gro tshogs bde bas 'phong rnams yid mdzod phun tshogs nor bu yongs bkang byed por bdag grub shog / 6 gang zhig bdag sems chags pas bzung ba'i yul/ khyad par mi bzad sdang ba'i yul gyur la/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge bskyed yongs bsngo'i mthu'i/ /bdag dang tshom bu gcig tu byang chub shog / 7 nam mkha'i mthar thug ci tsam sems can kun/ /ma lus bdag gi mdza' bor yongs bzung zhing / /sangs rgyas byang 'phags phrin las ma lus pa'i/ /byed po nyid du bdag nyid yongs grub shog / 8 zhes yul bsil ldan gangs kyi phreng bas skor ba'i stod mnga' ri skor gsum gyi gangs ri'i rgyal po ke ta ra yi nub phyogs bod pa rnams kyi seng ge kha 'bab tu brjod pa 'phags yul klung chen po nī la mi chu mgo ljongs mar yul g.ya 'a yi skor ba zhes kasmi ra yi yul dang nye bar 'brel ba bod kyi la dwags dang / stag gzig gi ka ra ti bod du bsang grags pa/ da lta'i dus su 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i lho yi khyon phyogs gsum rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du dbang bsgyur ba dbang thang dang stobs kyi dpung pas ches cher dregs pa ta sig du ru ka yi rgyal po stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bāk+ṣa yi mnga' 'og tu gnas pa yul la dwags kyi mnga' bdag lha rigs btsad po'i gdung rgyal po khri la bzhugs pa ched/ zur du gyes pa khu bo rgyal po bcas legs spel ji bzhin pa mar yul stod wam le'i dgon dung gyis shing de yi gros zhib mor bgyid 'os kha shas ni rgyal po khu dbon yul ljongs de yi ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag gi 'dod gdung chen po dang mi ma yin mthu stobs nus pa can gyi yang bskul ba yi 735

'gro bar mi spro bzhin mar yul gyi mthil shel gyi pho brang bar du phyin cing / der rgyal po rnams kyi legs spel zhib tshang blon bu dag layang sprod 'jigs gsar dgos/ he na ku'i rgyal po la yang kho rang gi dbang ris bdag thob ges nyi ma'i skabs su 'dzags pa gang yin bcos bsgyur med par mul lbe dang zangs dkar bzhin gtan 'jags kyi brtan rling kha che dang la dwags bar gyi tshong pa'i rgyu 'grul la phan pa la yig zangs kyi byang bu mtha' btsan bcas rnam par dkar ba dge ba'i bgyid pa ci nus rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las su 'bad par byas shing / sa yi phyogs 'di nyid stobs 'byor ci ltar yang rang so rgyal rigs dra ma dang po nyid nas gnas shing / ta sig rgyal pos kyang bur bzung ste rā dza zhes ming gi gsang mthon por sdod pa la rten gangs can dbus 'gyur dbyings nas bsngags pa'i phrin las par gyur kyang phan tshun kun tu 'jam des gzos shing rling bas legs zlum chad po'i yi ge rnams bris rim bzhin so sor zhib tig byas shing mthar thug mdo don mna' rtsigs bskor chu bya snron zla'i tshes nyi shu brgyad la bklags/ de la phan tshun gyi yid mthun par byas nas rgyab yig chu stod zla ba'i tshes gcig la blang nas gnyis la grub par byas/ 'da' med bro bo ba dngos gzhi chu stod zla ba'i tshes drug la dpal gyi gtor ma bsham nag po lcam dral gyi sku brnyan byin ldan yul de yi rten du bzhags pa dag spyan drangs nas bkod/ dgon khag so so rang lugs bsrung ma'i bris sku/ bdag gi yang ci tsam nus pa'i bden stobs brjod nas rtsigs kyi yi ge bsgrags shing / rgyal po blon 'bang dang bcas pa'i tshogs spyi yi spyi bor chos skyong gi sku brnyan dang / dpal gyi gtor ba bkod de gong gsal gyi bro tshig rang rang gi mna' dam legs par blang ba yin la/ des phan tshun thams cad kyang yid ches yid bde'i gnas su 'khod song la/ de yi nyi ma phyi ma tshes bdun ma rgyud rtsis lugs kyi nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor la smon lam tshigs bcad bzang pos mtha' bskang nas rgyud rtsis pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi sngar char rgyal po phan tshun gyi sna chen zhang blon rgan gtso dgon sde'i bla ma las sne bcas tshangs pa'i dbus su legs par bklags te legs spel bya ba rjes gtsang thag chod bkra shis dge ba'i 'khor lo bzang por grub pa de dus ji srid rtag tu gnas par gyur cig rgyal kun thugs kyi go 'gyed dmigs med brtse blo'i sprin spung yongs rgyas shing / /rgyal gyur smon lam bzang 'jug 'gro phan don bsgrub chu khur myu gu'i rgyun/ /rgyal zhing skal ldan bzang po'i 'dun sar phun tshogs dpal snye yongs rgyas byed/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag thar 'bras yongs ster gang gi bka' drin gyi/ /rgyal khams dge legs byed pa'i dpal gyur gang / /rnam par rig pa'i blo gros ma smad pas/ /legs byas 'dzin ma'i 'khyon kun bde ba'i brtsas/ /dam pa gang 'di yun nas yun gnas shog / sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo swā hā/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ / / /736
